Catherine II restored town rights in 1783 and made Fellin the centre of a county, beginning its modest revival as a provincial market town.
zh:
费林即爱沙尼亚语的维尔扬迪，位于萨卡拉高地。北方十字军到来以前，这里是爱沙尼亚萨卡拉地区最重要的要塞。1211年，主教军队、佩剑兄弟会、拉特加人和利夫人联合围城却未能攻克；1223年爱沙尼亚人起义并引入罗斯驻军，骑士团才在当年8月迫使要塞投降。1224年，这里首次出现修建条顿式石堡的记载，后来的修道院城堡规模在利沃尼亚仅次于里加。1283年，现存一份特许状确认其享有汉堡—里加城市法；14世纪，费林加入汉萨同盟，成为里加通往罗斯道路上的小集镇。1444年，这里是利沃尼亚骑士团治下的天主教指挥官驻城，靠转运贸易和城墙外的乡村物产维持。

1481年，伊凡三世的俄军围攻城堡却未能攻破。利沃尼亚战争中，骑士团野战军于1560年8月2日在海尔格迈覆没后，莫斯科军队随后炮轰费林三周；欠饷佣兵放敌军入城，前利沃尼亚团长威廉·菲尔斯滕贝格被俘。1582年，《亚姆—扎波利斯克和约》把这座残破要塞划给波兰—立陶宛。1600年，卡尔公爵的瑞典军队夺取费林；在波兰—瑞典战争中，城池屡次易手，到1611年已成废墟。1624年，古斯塔夫二世把费林及周边土地封给雅各布·德拉加尔迪，其家族在中世纪遗迹旁经营庄园。大北方战争再次摧毁小镇和庄园，此后这里归入俄国统治。叶卡捷琳娜二世1783年恢复城市权，并将费林设为县治，这座地方集镇才开始缓慢复兴。

en:
Riga occupies a sheltered harbour fifteen kilometres up the Daugava, the Western Dvina, where Liv fishermen had long traded along the river road to Polotsk and Smolensk. German merchants set up an outpost in 1158, and in 1201 Bishop Albert of Buxhoeveden, arriving with a fleet of Westphalian crusaders, moved his see there and founded the city. The Order of the Sword Brothers followed in 1202, the cornerstone of the Dom was laid in 1211, and from 1225 the citizens elected their own council. Raised to an archbishopric in 1255 and enrolled in the Hanseatic League in 1282, Riga engrossed the trade of the western Dvina, loading the timber, flax, hemp, wax and furs of the Russian interior onto cogs at its quays while the Order's fortress of Dünamünde guarded the river mouth. In 1444 the walled city was the dominant emporium of the eastern Baltic, ruled by its German merchant council under the prince-archbishop, whose rivalry with the Livonian Order for mastery of Livland was growing ever sharper.

Riga accepted the Reformation in 1522, and two years later iconoclasts put the cathedral's statue of the Virgin on trial as a witch and burned it. With the collapse of the Livonian Order in 1561 the city declared itself a free imperial city, but when no imperial help came it swore homage to Stephen Báthory of Poland by the Treaty of Drohiczyn in 1581. Gustavus Adolphus took Riga in September 1621 during the Polish–Swedish War, and the Truce of Altmark in 1629 confirmed it as Sweden's second-largest city; it withstood a Russian siege in 1656. Charles XII crossed the Düna nearby to victory in 1701, yet plague and a Russian blockade forced the city to capitulate to Sheremetev on 4 July 1710, and the Peace of Nystad in 1721 assigned Riga to Russia, whose Livonian timber trade it went on to dominate.
zh:
里加位于道加瓦河（西德维纳河）上游十五公里处的避风港湾，利沃人早就在此沿通往波洛茨克与斯摩棱斯克的河路贸易。1158年德意志商人设立商站；1201年，主教阿尔布雷希特·冯·布克斯赫夫登率威斯特伐利亚十字军船队抵达，把主教座迁到此处并建城。宝剑骑士团1202年随之成立，1211年主教座堂奠基，1225年起市民可自选市议会。里加1255年升为大主教区，1282年加入汉萨同盟，垄断了西德维纳河的贸易：俄国内地的木材、亚麻、大麻、蜂蜡和毛皮在码头装上柯克商船，河口则由骑士团的迪纳明德要塞把守。1444年，这座城墙环绕的城市是波罗的海东部首屈一指的商埠，由德意志商人议会在采邑大主教治下治理，而大主教与利沃尼亚骑士团争夺利沃尼亚宗主权的较量正愈演愈烈。

1522年里加接受宗教改革，两年后破坏圣像者把主教座堂的圣母雕像当作女巫审判后付之一炬。1561年利沃尼亚骑士团崩溃，城市宣布为帝国自由城市；等不到皇帝的援助，它于1581年依《德罗希琴条约》向波兰国王斯特凡·巴托里宣誓效忠。波瑞战争中，古斯塔夫·阿道夫于1621年9月攻占里加，1629年的《阿尔特马克停战协定》确认瑞典的占有，里加成为瑞典王国第二大城；1656年它又顶住俄军围攻。1701年卡尔十二世在附近强渡德维纳河获胜，但瘟疫加上俄军封锁迫使城市于1710年7月4日向舍列梅捷夫投降，1721年《尼斯塔德和约》将里加划归俄国，此后它主导了利沃尼亚木材的出口贸易。

en:
Goldingen, called Kuldīga in Latvian, commands the ford of the Venta at the Venta Rapid, where the land road from Prussia to the Daugava crosses the river; downstream stood the old Curonian hill-fort. In 1230 the papal envoy Baldwin of Alna received the baptism and submission of the Curonian ruler Lammekin, and in 1242 the Livonian Order's master Dietrich von Grüningen raised the castle of Goldingen, first called Jesusburg, from dolomite quarried in the riverbed. It became the seat of a Komtur whose commandery took in Durbe, Sabile, Skrunda and Aizpute. The church of St Catherine is documented from 1252, the settlement was already called a town in 1263, and in 1355 Master Goswin von Herike granted it a new privilege and a St Catherine coat of arms. It joined the Hanseatic League in 1368 and held a weekly market from 1439. In 1444 Goldingen was the Livonian Order's chief stronghold in western Courland, its river tolls and timber trade watched over by the Komtur and his brethren.

When the Order was dissolved in 1561, its last master, Gotthard Kettler, made Goldingen one of the residences of the new Duchy of Courland, a fief of the Polish Crown. After his death in 1587 the duchy was divided, and in 1596 his younger son Wilhelm made Goldingen the capital of western Courland, fostering metalworking and shipyards until the nobility had him removed in 1616. His son Duke Jacob, born in Goldingen in 1610, brought the duchy to its peak: the yards built a merchant fleet, powder mills and saltpeter works multiplied, and Courlander ships sailed to colonies founded in Gambia in 1651 and soon afterwards on Tobago. Swedish armies overran Courland in 1655, took Goldingen in 1658 and kept the duke captive until the Peace of Oliva in 1660, while the colonies were lost to the Dutch. Charles XII's Swedes occupied the town in 1701 during the Great Northern War, Russian troops entered in 1705, and plague later carried off much of the population. Goldingen never recovered its old trade, though its organ builders flourished for a time; in 1795 the Third Partition of Poland gave Courland to Russia, and the town became a district seat in the Courland Governorate.
zh:
库尔迪加德语名戈尔丁根，地据文塔河文塔急流处的渡口，是普鲁士通往道加瓦河的陆路与文塔河水道的交会点，库尔兰人的古老堡寨就在下游。1230年，教皇使节阿尔纳的鲍德温接受了库尔兰首领拉梅金的受洗与归服；1242年，利沃尼亚骑士团首领迪特里希·冯·格吕宁根用河床采出的白云石建起戈尔丁根堡，最初取名耶稣堡。这里后来成为一名骑士团指挥官的驻地，辖区还包括杜尔贝、萨比莱、斯孔达和艾兹普泰。圣凯瑟琳教堂在1252年已有记载，1263年定居点已被称作城镇，1355年骑士团首领高斯温·冯·黑里克颁赐新的特权和圣凯瑟琳纹章，1368年加入汉萨同盟，1439年起获准每周开市。1444年，戈尔丁根是利沃尼亚骑士团在西库尔兰的首要要塞，河上的税卡和木材贸易都由指挥官和他的修士骑士掌管。

1561年骑士团解散，末代首领戈特哈德·克特勒把戈尔丁根作为新建的库尔兰公国——波兰王位下的封国——的驻跸地之一。他1587年死后诸子瓜分公国，1596年幼子威廉以戈尔丁根为西库尔兰的首府，在这里兴办金属作坊和船厂，直到1616年被贵族逼位。其子雅各布公爵1610年生于戈尔丁根，治内公国臻于鼎盛：船坞造出一支商船队，火药磨坊和硝石作坊纷纷设立，库尔兰船只远航1651年在冈比亚、随后又在多巴哥建立的殖民地。1655年瑞典军队攻入库尔兰，1658年拿下戈尔丁根，将公爵囚禁到1660年《奥利瓦条约》签订，殖民地则落入荷兰人之手。大北方战争中，卡尔十二的瑞典军1701年占领此城，俄军1705年跟进，后来瘟疫又夺走大量人命。戈尔丁根的旧商路再未复兴，只有管风琴造业兴盛一时；1795年第三次瓜分波兰后库尔兰归入俄国，此地成为库尔兰省的一个县治。

en:
Memel guards the narrow passage where the Curonian Lagoon meets the Baltic, beside the mouth of the Neman. In 1252 the Teutonic Order raised Memelburg castle on the site of a Curonian fishing settlement, and the town beneath it received Lübeck city rights. As the Order's northernmost stronghold in Prussia it watched the frontier with Samogitia and Lithuania: Gediminas besieged it in 1323, and Lithuanian armies sacked castle and town in 1360 and again in 1379. The Treaty of Melno in 1422 settled the border for centuries and left Memel to the Order. In 1444, its ramparts rebuilt seven metres high, the town lived by its fortress and by the timber and grain floated down the Neman.

In 1454 King Casimir IV incorporated the region into Poland at the request of the rebellious Prussian Confederation, but the Thirteen Years' War ended in 1466 with Memel restored to the Order as a Polish fief, and the town received Kulm law in 1475. In 1525 Grand Master Albert secularised the Order's state and Memel turned Lutheran, becoming a port of the new Duchy of Prussia, its wheat ships sailing out through the lagoon. Swedish garrisons held it at intervals between 1629 and 1635, and in 1656 Elector Frederick William had to open its harbour to Sweden before the Treaty of Oliva confirmed Hohenzollern sovereignty in 1660. Memel became a Prussian royal town in 1701 and lay under Russian occupation from 1757 to 1762 during the Seven Years' War. Later in the century English merchants built industrial sawmills there, and by 1784 nearly a thousand ships called, half of them British, loading timber for the Royal Navy. In 1807 and 1808, with Berlin in French hands, Frederick William III kept his court at Memel and signed the October Edict abolishing serfdom in Prussia.
zh:
梅梅尔扼守库尔斯潟湖注入波罗的海的狭窄水口，坐落在内曼河畔。1252年，条顿骑士团在库尔西人渔村的原址上筑起梅梅尔堡，堡下的城镇获得吕贝克城市法。作为骑士团在普鲁士最北边的据点，它监视着与萨莫吉希亚和立陶宛接壤的前线：格迪米纳斯1323年曾围攻此城，立陶宛军队又在1360年和1379年两度洗劫城堡与市镇。1422年的《梅尔诺条约》把边界确定下来，此后数百年不变，梅梅尔仍归骑士团。1444年时，城墙已重修到七米高，城镇的生计系于要塞，以及顺内曼河漂下的木材和粮食。

1454年，卡齐米日四世应起兵的普鲁士联盟请求，把这一地区并入波兰王国；十三年战争结束后，1466年的和议将梅梅尔作为波兰封邑归还骑士团，城市又于1475年改授库尔姆法。1525年，大团长阿尔贝特把骑士团国家世俗化，梅梅尔改宗路德宗，成为新立的普鲁士公国的港口，运麦船只从潟湖出海。1629至1635年间，瑞典驻军数度占据该城；1656年，选帝侯弗里德里希·威廉被迫向瑞典开放港口，直到1660年《奥利瓦条约》确认霍亨索伦家族的主权。1701年梅梅尔成为普鲁士王国的城市，七年战争期间于1757至1762年被俄军占领。18世纪后期，英国商人在此建起工业化锯木厂，到1784年有近千艘船进港，其中半数为英国船，装运供皇家海军使用的木材。1807至1808年柏林落入法军之手时，弗里德里希·威廉三世在梅梅尔驻跸，并在此签署了废除普鲁士农奴制的《十月敕令》。

en:
Königsberg began in 1255, when the Teutonic Knights destroyed the Old Prussian stronghold of Twangste at the mouth of the Pregel and raised a castle named in honour of Ottokar II of Bohemia, who had financed the campaign. Three towns grew beneath it: the Old Town, granted Culm rights in 1286, Löbenicht in 1300, and Kneiphof on its river island in 1327, where the brick cathedral was built between 1330 and 1380. Königsberg joined the Hanseatic League in 1340 and became the residence of the Order's marshal and a forward base in its wars with pagan Lithuania, whose thrust at the city was beaten back at Rudau in 1370. Burdened by the Knights' war taxes, the three towns joined the newly founded Prussian Confederation in 1440, so that in 1444 Königsberg was a prosperous, restive Hanseatic port, handling the grain, wax, hemp and timber of the Lithuanian hinterland while drifting toward revolt.

The storm came with the Thirteen Years' War in 1454. In 1457 Grand Master Ludwig von Erlichshausen abandoned Marienburg and made Königsberg the Order's capital, and the Second Peace of Thorn of 1466 left the monastic state a fief of the Polish Crown. In 1525 the last Grand Master, Albert of Brandenburg, secularised his lands as the Duchy of Prussia and made the city Lutheran; in 1544 he founded the Albertina University, whose scholars compiled the Prussian Tables with Königsberg as their prime meridian. After the Treaties of Wehlau and Oliva freed the duchy from Polish suzerainty, Elector Frederick III crowned himself King in Prussia as Frederick I in the castle church on 18 January 1701. Plague carried off roughly a quarter of the inhabitants in 1709–10, and in 1724 the three towns were united into one city; Immanuel Kant was born there that same year. Russian troops occupied Königsberg unopposed from January 1758 until the peace of May 1762. After Jena the court of Frederick William III took refuge in the city, where the Stein reforms were drafted, and the East Prussian Landwehr was raised there following the Convention of Tauroggen in 1812.
zh:
柯尼斯堡始于1255年：条顿骑士团摧毁普雷格尔河口古普鲁士人的特旺斯特据点，建起一座城堡，以出资支持这场征伐的波希米亚国王奥托卡二世命名。城堡脚下先后长出三座城镇：1286年获库尔姆法特权的老城、1300年建镇的勒伯尼希特，以及1327年在河岛上建镇的克奈普霍夫，岛上的砖砌大教堂兴建于1330至1380年间。柯尼斯堡1340年加入汉萨同盟，成为骑士团军务长驻地和对异教立陶宛用兵的前沿基地，1370年立陶宛人直扑该城的进军在鲁道被击退。不堪战争税负担，三座城镇1440年加入新成立的普鲁士邦联，因此1444年的柯尼斯堡是一座繁荣却不安分的汉萨港口，经营立陶宛腹地的谷物、蜂蜡、大麻和木材，正一步步走向反叛。

风暴随1454年的十三年战争而来。1457年大团长路德维希·冯·埃尔利希斯豪森放弃马林堡，以柯尼斯堡为骑士团首都；1466年的第二次托伦和约把这个修道国家降为波兰王冠的封邑。1525年末任大团长、勃兰登堡的阿尔布雷希特将领地世俗化为普鲁士公国，该城改宗路德宗；1544年他创办阿尔贝蒂娜大学，校内学者编订《普鲁士星表》，以柯尼斯堡为本初子午线。《魏劳条约》与《奥利瓦条约》使公国摆脱波兰宗主权后，选帝侯腓特烈三世于1701年1月18日在城堡教堂自冠为「在普鲁士的国王」腓特烈一世。1709至1710年的瘟疫夺走约四分之一居民的性命，1724年三座城镇正式合并为一城，伊曼努尔·康德也在这一年出生于此。七年战争中，俄军于1758年1月兵不血刃占领柯尼斯堡，直到1762年5月和约订立才撤出。耶拿战败后，腓特烈·威廉三世的朝廷避难该城，施泰因改革的方案在此拟成；1812年《陶罗根协定》后，东普鲁士后备军也在这里组建。

en:
Warmia is a country of lakes and forests on the upper Alle, once the land of the Warmian Old Prussians. The Teutonic Order conquered it in the thirteenth century, and the papal legate William of Modena made Warmia one of the four bishoprics of Prussia; its prince-bishop held court at Heilsberg while the cathedral chapter sat at Frauenburg. At Allenstein, where the Alle breaks through the southern lake ridge, the Order began a brick Ordensburg in 1347 and the chapter granted the settlement Kulm law in October 1353. Lithuanian raids troubled the frontier: Polish-Lithuanian armies took Allenstein after Grunwald in 1410 and burned it during the Hunger War of 1414. The town joined the Prussian Confederation in 1440, and in 1444 it was a Catholic market town of the bishopric, well placed on the road linking Warsaw with Königsberg.

In February 1454 Allenstein's burghers handed their castle to the Confederation, bringing Warmia into the Kingdom of Poland, and the Second Peace of Thorn in 1466 ended the Thirteen Years' War by confirming the prince-bishopric within Polish Royal Prussia. A disputed election then caused the low War of the Priests from 1467 to 1479. Nicolaus Copernicus administered the chapter's estates from Allenstein castle between 1516 and 1521, strengthening the walls against the Order; in 1521 a small Teutonic probe against the town was beaten off, after which he resettled the wasted villages with Polish farmers from Mazovia and carried on the observations still marked by his astronomical table in the castle. In 1565 Cardinal Hosius founded the Jesuit Collegium Hosianum at Braunsberg, the foremost school of the Catholic north, and after 1569 the Union of Lublin tied the bishopric more closely to the Polish Crown. Swedish troops sacked Allenstein in 1655 during the Deluge, and the great plague of 1709 to 1712 nearly emptied it. The First Partition of 1772 gave Warmia to Prussia, which secularised the see; its last prince-bishop, Ignacy Krasicki, was a poet of the European Enlightenment. On 3 February 1807 Napoleon fought the battle of Allenstein in its hills and visited the castle to ask after traces of Copernicus.
zh:
瓦尔米亚是维纳河上游一片湖林之地，曾是古普鲁士瓦尔米亚人的家园。13世纪条顿骑士团征服此地，教皇特使摩德纳的威廉把瓦尔米亚划为普鲁士四个主教区之一；亲王主教在海尔斯贝格驻跸，教士团则驻于弗劳恩堡。在维纳河切过南部湖脊的地方，骑士团从1347年起修建砖砌的 Ordensburg 要塞，1353年10月教士团向聚落在该地的市镇颁授库尔姆法，是为阿伦施泰因。立陶宛人的袭扰长期困扰这条边疆：波兰—立陶宛联军1410年在格伦瓦德战役后拿下阿伦施泰因，又在1414年的「饥饿战争」中将它焚毁。1440年该城加入普鲁士联盟；1444年时，它是主教区治下的天主教集镇，正处在华沙通往柯尼斯堡的商路上。

1454年2月，阿伦施泰因市民把城堡交给普鲁士联盟，瓦尔米亚随之并入波兰王国；十三年战争结束时，1466年的第二次《托伦和约》确认这个亲王主教区归属波兰王属普鲁士。此后一场主教选举之争又引发1467至1479年低烈度的「牧师战争」。1516至1521年，哥白尼以教士团产业管理人的身份住在阿伦施泰因城堡，在骑士团来犯时加固城防；1521年，一支骑士团小部队试探攻城被击退。战后他从马佐夫舍招来波兰农户，重建荒弃的村庄，并继续天文观测，城堡里还留有他用过的天文观测桌。1565年，霍久斯枢机在布劳恩斯贝格创办耶稣会的霍久斯学院，成为天主教北方首屈一指的学府；1569年卢布林联合后，主教区与波兰王冠的联系更加紧密。1655年「大洪水」期间，瑞典军队洗劫了阿伦施泰因，1709至1712年的大瘟疫又使城镇几乎人烟断绝。1772年第一次瓜分波兰，瓦尔米亚划归普鲁士，主教区被世俗化；末任亲王主教伊格纳齐·克拉西茨基是欧洲启蒙时代有名的诗人。1807年2月3日，拿破仑在城外丘陵间打响阿伦施泰因之战，并到城堡探访哥白尼的遗迹。

en:
Gdańsk, known across the Hanse as Danzig, arose in the 980s at the mouth of the Vistula, probably founded by order of Mieszko I to link his Piast realm to the Baltic trade routes. The dukes of Pomerelia ruled it until November 1308, when the Teutonic Knights seized the town and put many of its people to the sword; they rebuilt it from the 1320s with settlers from Lübeck, raised a castle in 1340, and made it a Hanseatic port for the grain, timber and wax funnelled down the Vistula. Resentful of the Order's heavy hand, the city joined the newly founded Prussian Confederation on 14 March 1440. So in 1444, when the great wooden harbour crane, the Krantor, was completed on the Motława, Danzig was the Monastic State's richest and most restive city, already preparing to throw off its rule.

In February 1454 the burghers drove out the Knights, and on 6 March they swore homage to Casimir IV of Poland. Danzig's fleet won the battles of Bornholm in 1457 and the Vistula Lagoon in 1463, and the Second Peace of Thorn in 1466 left the city, armed with sweeping privileges, in Royal Prussia under the Polish Crown; the Great Privilege of 1457 freed Vistula traffic through its port. A Lutheran rising that overthrew the town council in 1525 was crushed in April 1526, when Sigismund I entered with 8,000 troops and executed the ringleaders, yet Protestant worship was tolerated from 1557. The first printed outline of Copernicus's heliocentric theory, the Narratio Prima, came from a Danzig press in 1540. By the later sixteenth century Danzig was the largest city on the Baltic, crowned by the Main Town Hall and St Mary's Church, and when it defied Stephen Báthory a six-month siege in 1577 failed to take it; the king confirmed its liberties in December. The Polish fleet defeated the Swedes at Oliwa in 1627, and the Treaty of Oliwa ended the Deluge there in 1660. Plague struck in 1709, Russian armies besieged the city from February to September 1734, and when the First Partition of 1772 left it a blockaded Polish exclave Prussia annexed it in 1793. French and Polish troops captured it in May 1807 and Napoleon made it a Free City, until the long siege of 1813–14 returned Danzig to Prussia.
zh:
格但斯克在汉萨世界通称但泽，兴起于980年代的维斯瓦河入海口，相传奉梅什科一世之命建立，用以把皮雅斯特王朝接入波罗的海商路。波美雷利亚公爵们统治它直到1308年11月，条顿骑士团攻占城镇、大肆屠城；1320年代起骑士团用吕贝克来的移民重建城市，1340年筑起城堡，把它经营成汉萨港口，吞吐沿维斯瓦河而下的谷物、木材和蜂蜡。不堪骑士团的高压，城市于1440年3月14日加入新成立的普鲁士邦联。因此1444年，当莫特瓦瓦河畔巨型木制港口起重机「鹤门」（克兰门）建成时，但泽已是骑士团国家最富庶、也最不安分的城市，正酝酿着挣脱其统治。

1454年2月市民驱逐骑士团，3月6日向波兰国王卡齐米日四世宣誓效忠。但泽舰队1457年在博恩霍尔姆海战、1463年在维斯瓦潟湖海战中接连取胜，1466年第二次托伦和约把这座手握广泛特权的城市划归波兰王冠治下的王家普鲁士，1457年颁下的大特权免除了过境货物的一切盘查。1525年，一场推翻市议会的路德宗起义在1526年4月被镇压——齐格蒙特一世率八千军队入城，处死起事首领——但新教礼拜自1557年起获得宽容。1540年，但泽的印坊印出第一部向世人介绍哥白尼日心说的《初论》。到16世纪后期，但泽已是波罗的海沿岸最大的城市，主城市政厅和圣马利亚教堂俯瞰全城；1577年它抗拒斯特凡·巴托里，历时半年的围攻终不能破城，国王于12月确认其特权。1627年波兰舰队在奥利瓦击败瑞典人，1660年结束「大洪水」战争的《奥利瓦条约》也在此签订。1709年瘟疫袭来，1734年2月至9月俄军围城；1772年第一次瓜分后它沦为遭封锁的波兰飞地，1793年被普鲁士吞并。1807年5月法国与波兰军队攻占该城，拿破仑将其设为自由市，直到1813至1814年的长期围城之后，但泽才重归普鲁士。

en:
Hamburg began as the Hammaburg, a fort Charlemagne ordered in 808 between the Alster and the Elbe against Slavic raiders; in 810 he added a baptismal church, and in 831 Louis the Pious made it a bishopric and soon an archbishopric, whose holder later moved to Bremen. Vikings burned the little town in 845, sailing up the Elbe with 600 ships, yet its position at the shortest crossing between North Sea and Baltic guaranteed its future. In the twelfth century Count Adolf III of Schauenburg founded a trading settlement on the Alster; Frederick Barbarossa's prized charter of 1189 freed its ships of tolls on the Lower Elbe. Hamburg's 1241 pact with Lübeck is remembered as the beginning of the Hanseatic League, and in 1266 its merchants opened a hanse in London. Beer, fish and cloth flowed through its quays. The Black Death of 1350 killed at least three-fifths of the people, yet Hamburg recovered, and in 1410 civic strife ended in the written Rezeß, its first constitution. In 1444 it was a thriving, Catholic Hanseatic port with a self-assured merchant council.

In 1510 Hamburg's status as a free imperial city was at last confirmed beyond dispute. It turned Lutheran in 1529 without bloodshed, took in Reformed refugees from the Netherlands and France, and Sephardic Jews settled there before 1600. The stock exchange opened in 1558, one of Germany's first. During the Thirty Years' War the Dutch engineer Jan van Valckenborgh girdled it with a second ring of bastions and the grid of the New Town; spared by the war, Hamburg overtook its Hanse rivals. The Gänsemarkt opera house of 1678 was Germany's first, and Lessing's National Theatre of 1767 crowned a cultural flowering to match its merchant wealth. After the Empire's end in 1806 Hamburg styled itself the Free and Hanseatic City, but Napoleon annexed it in 1811 as capital of the Elbe's Mouth département; Russians under Bennigsen freed it in 1814, and the Congress of Vienna in 1815 confirmed it as a sovereign member of the German Confederation.
zh:
汉堡的前身是808年查理曼下令在阿尔斯特河与易北河之间修建的哈姆堡，用以抵御斯拉夫人袭扰；810年又建洗礼堂，831年虔诚者路易设为主教区，不久升格为大主教区，后来驻地迁往不来梅。845年，维京人率六百艘船溯易北河而上焚毁小镇，但此地扼守北海与波罗的海之间最便捷的转运通道，注定会再度兴起。12世纪，绍恩堡的阿道夫三世在阿尔斯特河畔辟建商人定居点；1189年腓特烈·巴巴罗萨颁发汉堡人视若建城凭证的特许状，免除本市船只下易北河的通行税。1241年汉堡与吕贝克结盟，被视为汉萨同盟的开端；1266年汉堡商人在伦敦开设商站。啤酒、鱼和布匹在码头吞吐。1350年鼠疫至少夺去五分之三人口，汉堡仍恢复过来；1410年市民冲突以书面妥协《Rezeß》收场，即汉堡的第一部宪法。1444年的汉堡，是一座繁荣的天主教汉萨港口，由自信的商人议会治理。

1510年，汉堡的帝国自由城市地位终于得到毫无争议的确认。1529年未经流血改奉路德宗，接纳来自尼德兰和法国的归正宗难民，1600年前塞法迪犹太人也来定居。1558年汉堡交易所开张，是德意志最早的交易所之一。三十年战争期间，荷兰工程师法尔肯堡为城市加筑第二圈棱堡、按方格路网规划新城；汉堡躲过战火，借此超越汉萨老对手。1678年鹅市场歌剧院是德意志第一座歌剧院，1767年莱辛的民族剧院又为与其财富相称的文化繁荣添冠。1806年帝国解体后，汉堡定名「自由汉萨城市」，1811年被拿破仑并入法国，成为易北河口省省会；1814年本尼格森麾下的俄军解放汉堡，1815年维也纳会议确认它为德意志邦联的主权成员。

en:
Lübeck grew up on an island in the Trave, near the Baltic, on the site of the Slavic settlement of Liubice. In 1143 Count Adolf II of Holstein founded a new town there; after the fire of 1157 Henry the Lion rebuilt it and in 1160 moved the bishopric of Oldenburg to the city. Granted Soest town rights in 1160 and a charter of imperial freedom by Emperor Frederick II in 1226, Lübeck stood where the North Sea and Baltic trades met: Lüneburg salt and cloth went east, while herring, furs and timber came back from the Baltic ports and Novgorod. Its merchant law was taken up by roughly a hundred towns around the sea, and from the first common Hansetag in 1356 the city led the Hanseatic League, reaching the height of its power with the Peace of Stralsund in 1370. In the 1440s, however, its patrician council, the Zirkelgesellschaft, had only recently weathered the guild revolts of 1384 and 1408, and the Queen of the Hanse was ruled as a strict oligarchy beneath the twin towers of St Mary's.

The Reformation reached Lübeck with the first evangelical sermon in 1524, and in 1530–31 the council introduced Johannes Bugenhagen's church order. The burgomaster Jürgen Wullenwever tried to restore Lübeck's Baltic mastery by intervening in the Count's Feud of 1534–36, even melting down church treasure to pay his fleets; driven out in 1535, he was executed in 1537. Dutch skippers were already sailing past the city's staple straight to the eastern Baltic. Lübeck stayed neutral through the Thirty Years' War, and in 1629 Christian IV of Denmark made his peace with the emperor there, yet the last Hansetag assembled in the city in 1669. The Napoleonic wars ended its old independence: after Blücher's defeat at the Battle of Lübeck on 6 November 1806 French troops occupied the city, and from 1811 to 1813 it formed an arrondissement of the French department of Bouches-de-l'Elbe. Freed in December 1813, Lübeck was confirmed as a sovereign free city by the Congress of Vienna in 1815.
zh:
吕贝克坐落于特拉维河临近波罗的海处的河洲上，其地本是斯拉夫人的定居点柳比策。1143年，荷尔斯泰因伯爵阿道夫二世在此建立新城；1157年大火之后，狮子亨利重建城市，并于1160年把奥尔登堡主教区迁到这里。吕贝克1160年获授索斯特城市法，1226年又从皇帝腓特烈二世手中取得帝国自由特许状。它地处北海与波罗的海贸易的交会处：吕讷堡的盐和布匹向东运出，鲱鱼、毛皮和木材则从波罗的海各港和诺夫哥罗德源源而来。吕贝克法被波罗的海沿岸约一百座城镇采用；1356年第一届全汉萨议会在此召开，吕贝克从此统领汉萨同盟，1370年《施特拉尔松德和约》签订时势力达到顶峰。但在1440年代，由显贵圈子社把持的市议会刚熬过1384年和1408年两次行会暴动，这位「汉萨女王」在圣母教堂双塔的俯瞰下，由一个森严的寡头集团统治着。

宗教改革于1524年随第一场新教布道传入吕贝克，1530至1531年，市议会颁行了约翰内斯·布根哈根制定的教会规程。市长于尔根·武伦韦伯试图重振吕贝克在波罗的海的霸权，出兵介入1534至1536年的伯爵战争，甚至熔化教会财宝充作舰队军费；他1535年被逐出城，1537年被处决。此时荷兰商船已经绕过吕贝克的堆栈特权，直航波罗的海东部。三十年战争中吕贝克保持中立，1629年丹麦国王克里斯蒂安四世在此与皇帝缔和，但汉萨同盟的最后一届议会于1669年在吕贝克召开。拿破仑战争终结了它旧日的独立地位：1806年11月6日布吕歇尔在吕贝克战役中战败，法军入城占领；1811至1813年，吕贝克成为法兰西帝国易北河口省的一个专区。城市于1813年12月光复，1815年维也纳会议正式确认其为主权自由城市。

en:
Rostock began as a Slavic landing place on the Warnow, whose name referred to the river spreading into a broad estuary. After Danish forces burned the local prince's stronghold in 1161, German merchants and craftsmen settled the higher west bank, and in 1218 the ruler of Mecklenburg confirmed Lübeck law. The three wards around St Peter's, St Mary's and St James's churches united between 1262 and 1265; the town joined the Hanseatic towns in 1283 and secured its sea road by buying Warnemünde in 1323. Beer, herring, shipbuilding and Baltic traffic made it Mecklenburg's leading port, while the university founded in 1419 gave it a second name. In 1444 Rostock was still a largely self-governing Catholic Hanse city, ruled by its council and only loosely subject to the dukes of Mecklenburg.

After the Domfehde of 1491, the citizenry had to accept ducal authority. In April 1531 the council adopted Joachim Slüter's Lutheran preaching in the four parish churches, and the Reformation widened the duke's role. John Albert I's troops compelled submission in 1565, and the inheritance agreements of 1573 and 1584 ended Rostock's hopes of imperial immediacy. During the Thirty Years' War Wallenstein blockaded Warnemünde and made the town a garrison in 1627; imperial occupation gave way to Swedish domination in 1631. Fire in 1677 destroyed some 700 houses, nearly a third of the city, and its population later fell to about 5,000. In the Great Northern War of 1700–1721 Danish and Swedish armies again preyed on the port, and French rule from 1806 to 1813 stifled shipping under the Continental System before the wars of liberation.
zh:
罗斯托克起于瓦尔诺河畔的斯拉夫渡口，其地名来自河水在宽阔河口分流的形态。1161年丹麦军队焚毁当地王公的堡寨后，德意志商人和工匠在地势较高的西岸定居，1218年梅克伦堡统治者确认其享有《吕贝克法》。圣彼得、圣马利亚和圣雅各三座教堂周围的市区在1262年至1265年间合并；城市于1283年加入汉萨诸城，1323年购得瓦尔明德，确保通往大海的航路。啤酒、鲱鱼、造船和波罗的海贸易使它成为梅克伦堡首要港口，1419年创立的大学又让它成为学术之城。1444年的罗斯托克仍是一座高度自治的天主教汉萨城市，由市议会治理，只在名义上松散臣属于梅克伦堡公爵。

1491年「大教堂纷争」失败后，市民不得不接受公爵权威。1531年4月，市议会接受约阿希姆·施吕特的路德宗宣讲，令四座本堂区教堂遵行新教，宗教改革也扩大了公爵的作用。1565年，约翰·阿尔布雷希特一世的军队迫使城市屈服；1573年和1584年的继承协议终结了罗斯托克谋求帝国直辖地位的希望。三十年战争期间，华伦斯坦于1627年封锁瓦尔明德，把这里变成驻军城市，1631年帝国占领又转为瑞典控制。1677年的大火烧毁约七百栋房屋，接近全城建筑的三分之一，人口后来降至约五千人。1700年至1721年的大北方战争中，丹麦和瑞典军队再度劫掠这座港口；1806年至1813年法国统治期间，大陆封锁令使航运大受打击，直至解放战争到来。

en:
Stralsund began as the Slav fishing settlement of Strale on the Strelasund, the sound separating the island of Rügen from the Pomeranian mainland. Its lands belonged to the Danish-ruled Principality of Rügen when, on 31 October 1234, Prince Wizlaw I granted the town Lübeck law; it is the oldest town in Pomerania. Lübeck burned its young rival in 1249, and the citizens rebuilt behind walls with eleven gates and thirty watchtowers. In 1293 Stralsund joined the Hanseatic League, and in the fourteenth century some 300 ships sailed under its flag, making it the leading Hanse port of the southern Baltic after Lübeck. When the Rügen princely line died out in 1325 the town passed to the dukes of Pomerania-Wolgast while keeping its self-rule, and the Peace of Stralsund of 1370, which ended the Hanseatic war with Denmark, was sealed in its town hall. In 1444 Stralsund was a Catholic Hanse city grown rich on Baltic trade, shipbuilding and herring.

In 1525 most of its citizens turned Protestant, making Stralsund one of the pacemakers of the Reformation in northern Germany. In 1628, during the Thirty Years' War, Albrecht von Wallenstein's imperial army besieged the town after its council rejected the Capitulation of Franzburg; Danish and Swedish relief saved it, though the war cost the region much of its population, and in 1648 Stralsund passed to Swedish Pomerania. Brandenburg took the fortress in 1678 and returned it in 1679. Charles XII of Sweden defended it for a year in 1715 before the Danes, Prussians and Saxons stormed it; in 1720 it reverted to Sweden and became the capital of Swedish Pomerania. French troops occupied Stralsund in 1807, Ferdinand von Schill's freikorps briefly drove them out in 1809, and the Congress of Vienna assigned the city to Prussia in 1815.
zh:
施特拉尔松德起于施特雷拉海峡畔的斯拉夫人渔村施特拉莱，海峡对岸便是吕根岛。其地本属丹麦治下的吕根亲王国，1234年10月31日吕根亲王授予它吕贝克法，它由此成为波美拉尼亚最古老的城市。1249年吕贝克焚毁了这个崛起中的对手，市民随后在城墙内重建城市，城墙开有十一座城门、三十座瞭望塔。1293年施特拉尔松德加入汉萨同盟，14世纪时约有三百艘船只悬挂它的旗帜，成为波罗的海南部仅次于吕贝克的汉萨大港。1325年吕根亲王绝嗣，城市转归波美拉尼亚-沃尔加斯特公爵，同时保有自治；1370年结束汉萨与丹麦战争的《施特拉尔松德和约》就在这里签订。1444年的施特拉尔松德是一座信奉天主教的汉萨城市，靠波罗的海贸易、造船和鲱鱼致富。

1525年，多数市民改宗新教，施特拉尔松德成为北德意志宗教改革的先行者之一。三十年战争中，城市议会拒绝投降后，阿尔布雷希特·冯·华伦斯坦的帝国军队于1628年围城，丹麦和瑞典出兵解围，但战争仍使这一带人口锐减；1648年施特拉尔松德并入瑞典属波美拉尼亚。1678年勃兰登堡攻陷要塞，1679年又归还瑞典。1715年瑞典国王卡尔十二世在此据守一年，城池最终被丹麦、普鲁士和萨克森联军攻破；1720年它依约归还瑞典，并成为瑞典属波美拉尼亚的首府。1807年法军占领施特拉尔松德，1809年费迪南·冯·希尔率领自由军团短暂驱逐法军，1815年维也纳和会把城市划归普鲁士。

en:
Kolberg is a Baltic fishing port at the mouth of the Parsęta, its early stronghold standing a few miles upstream at Budzistowo. A Pomeranian settlement grew there around salt workings, and in 1000 the short-lived Diocese of Kolberg was created during the Congress of Gniezno. In 1255 Duke Wartislaw III chartered a new town on Lübeck law near the river mouth, and this German-founded settlement soon overtook the older Pomeranian stronghold. The bishops of Kamień made Kolberg their residence in 1276 and became imperial princes in 1345; the town joined the Hanseatic League in 1361. By the fifteenth century its ships carried salt, beer, honey, wool and flour to Scotland, Amsterdam and Scandinavia. In 1444 Kolberg was therefore a Catholic bishop's port on the Pomeranian coast, governed by Kamień rather than directly by Wolgast.

The Pomeranian Reformation of 1534 dissolved the bishops' old secular principality, leaving Kolberg a Lutheran port under the Griffin dukes; its population reached about 5,000 in the sixteenth century. Imperial troops held it from 1627 to 1630 during the Thirty Years' War, after which Swedish forces occupied the town. Brandenburg took over in 1653, turned Kolberg into a fortress, and the town declined on the edge of Brandenburg-Prussia. Russian troops captured it in 1761 during the Seven Years' War. Its most famous defence came in 1807, when Major Gneisenau held the fortress against Napoleonic and Polish troops until the Peace of Tilsit made Prussia surrender. With the post-1815 reorganization of Prussian Pomerania, Kolberg remained a heavily garrisoned Baltic coastal town.
zh:
科尔贝格是帕尔森塔河入海口的波罗的海渔港，最早的波美拉尼亚堡寨位于上游数英里外的布齐斯托沃，周边因制盐而兴起。1000年，格涅兹诺会议曾在此设立短暂存在的科尔贝格主教区。1255年，公爵瓦尔齐斯瓦夫三世按吕贝克法在河口附近授予新城市状，这座德意志移民建立的城镇很快取代旧堡寨。1276年，卡缅主教把科尔贝格作为驻地，1345年其世俗领地成为帝国诸侯领地；城市则在1361年加入汉萨同盟。到15世纪，这里的船只把盐、啤酒、蜂蜜、羊毛和面粉运往苏格兰、阿姆斯特丹和斯堪的纳维亚。因此1444年的科尔贝格是波美拉尼亚海岸上的天主教主教港口，由卡缅而非沃尔加斯特直接统治。

1534年波美拉尼亚宗教改革结束了主教旧世俗领地，科尔贝格成为格里芬公爵治下的路德宗港口，16世纪人口约有5000。三十年战争期间，帝国军队1627—1630年占据此城，随后又落入瑞典军队之手。勃兰登堡1653年接管科尔贝格，将其改建成要塞，城市也在勃兰登堡—普鲁士边陲逐渐衰落。七年战争期间，俄军1761年攻占该城。它最著名的防御发生在1807年：格奈森瑙少校坚守要塞，抵抗拿破仑军队和波兰部队，直到《提尔西特和约》迫使普鲁士屈服。1815年普鲁士重组波美拉尼亚后，科尔贝格仍是一座重兵驻守的波罗的海沿岸城镇。

en:
The Neumark was Brandenburg's wooded frontier beyond the Oder, bounded by the Warta and Noteć marshes. Margrave John I founded Landsberg on the Warta in 1257, placing a new crossing above the old Polish stronghold of Santok and drawing long-distance trade away from it. Low German settlers and knightly estates spread through the district, but rule from distant Berlin weakened after the Ascanian line died out. Sigismund pawned the country to the Teutonic Knights in 1402, and it passed fully into their hands in 1429. Their neglect was followed in June 1433 by a Polish-Hussite raid that took Santok and besieged Landsberg. In 1444 the cattle-raising borderland remained a Catholic, Saxon possession of the Teutonic Order.

The Order pledged the Neumark back to Elector Frederick II of Brandenburg in 1454 and sold it outright for 40,000 guilders in 1463. In 1535 John of Küstrin made it the separate margraviate of Brandenburg-Küstrin, introduced the Reformation in 1537, and moved his seat from Soldin to Küstrin in 1548. Swedish and imperial armies plundered the country during the Thirty Years' War, and plague struck in 1626 and 1631. Recovery came after 1648 through trade with Poland, and under Prussian rule from 1701 Huguenot weavers helped establish clothmaking; drainage of the Warta and Noteć marshes after 1770 brought new farmland into the province.
zh:
诺伊马克是勃兰登堡在奥得河以东的林木边疆，南接瓦尔塔河与诺泰奇河沼泽。1257年，藩侯约翰一世在瓦尔塔河畔建立兰茨贝格，在旧波兰要塞桑托克上游设置新的渡口，并把长途贸易引向新城。低地德意志移民和骑士庄园随后遍布这一带，但阿斯坎尼家族绝嗣后，遥远的柏林对这里的控制逐渐衰弱。西吉斯蒙德1402年把诺伊马克抵押给条顿骑士团，1429年全境转入骑士团之手。骑士团治理不善，1433年6月波兰与胡斯派联军又攻占桑托克、围攻兰茨贝格。1444年，这片以畜牧为生的边地仍是条顿骑士团名下的天主教萨克森文化地区。

1454年，骑士团把诺伊马克重新抵押给勃兰登堡选帝侯腓特烈二世，1463年又以四万古尔登金币彻底出售。1535年，约翰·冯·屈斯特林把这里建为独立的勃兰登堡-屈斯特林藩侯国，1537年推行宗教改革，并在1548年把统治中心从索尔丁迁往屈斯特林。三十年战争期间，瑞典和皇帝军队轮番劫掠，1626年和1631年又遭瘟疫打击。1648年后，对波兰贸易带动复苏；1701年起纳入普鲁士治下，胡格诺织工推动了呢绒业，1770年后瓦尔塔河与诺泰奇河沼泽的排水工程又为这片地区增添了耕地。

en:
Berlin and Cölln began as two merchant settlements facing each other across the Spree, on the crossing of the Via Imperii with the road from Bruges to Novgorod. Cölln, on the river island, is first mentioned in 1237 and Alt-Berlin, on the north-eastern bank, in 1244; in 1307 the two towns built a common town hall and ran a shared foreign policy, growing rich on their staple right. They passed with the Mark of Brandenburg from the Ascanians to the Wittelsbachs and Luxembourgs, and in the Landbuch of Charles IV of 1375 Berlin already ranked among the margraviate's most heavily taxed towns. In 1415 King Sigismund enfeoffed Frederick I of Hohenzollern with Brandenburg, and in 1443 Elector Frederick II Irontooth began a stone palace in the twin city on the Spree island. Thus in 1444 Berlin-Cölln, still a self-governing Hanse trading town, watched the Hohenzollern citadel rise that would soon overawe its council.

The burghers' protest against the palace, the Berliner Unwille of 1448, was put down and cost the city its old freedoms; in 1486 Elector John Cicero made the palace the permanent residence of the Brandenburg electors. The Reformation came peacefully in 1539 under Joachim II. The Thirty Years' War wrecked the city, ruining a third of its houses and halving its population, before the Great Elector Frederick William took over in 1640, laid out new suburbs, admitted fifty Jewish families from Austria in 1671 and with the Edict of Potsdam of 1685 summoned the Huguenots: 6,000 French refugees settled in Berlin, a fifth of its people by 1700. Crowned at Königsberg in 1701, the Hohenzollerns made Berlin the capital of the Kingdom of Prussia, and in 1709 Berlin, Cölln and the three new suburbs were merged into one royal residence city. Russian troops briefly held it during the Seven Years' War. Napoleon entered Berlin in 1806, and under the French occupation the Stein city ordinance of 1808 gave Berlin its first elected council and a lord mayor; in 1815 the city passed into the new Prussian Province of Brandenburg.
zh:
柏林与克尔恩本是施普雷河两岸隔河相望的两座商人城镇，正处在帝国大道与布鲁日至诺夫哥罗德商路的交会处。河洲上的克尔恩首见于1237年文献，东北岸的老柏林首见于1244年；1307年两城合建一座市政厅，对外奉行一致政策，凭堆栈权致富。它们随勃兰登堡马克先后归属阿斯坎尼、维特尔斯巴赫与卢森堡家族；在1375年查理四世的《土地簿》中，柏林已是马克境内税负最高的城市之一。1415年，国王西吉斯蒙德把勃兰登堡封给霍亨索伦家族的腓特烈一世；1443年，选帝侯「铁牙」腓特烈二世开始在双城的河洲上修建石造宫殿。于是在1444年，仍是汉萨自治商业城镇的柏林－克尔恩，眼睁睁看着霍亨索伦的宫堡拔地而起——这座宫堡很快就会压过市议会的权威。

市民对建宫的抗议，即1448年的「柏林之怒」，遭到镇压，城市也丧失了旧有自由；1486年，选帝侯约翰·西塞罗把这座宫殿定为勃兰登堡选帝侯的永久驻地。1539年，宗教改革在约阿希姆二世治下和平传入。三十年战争摧毁了这座城市：三分之一的房屋破败，人口减少一半。1640年「大选帝侯」腓特烈·威廉继位后开辟新郊区，1671年收容了五十个来自奥地利的犹太家庭，又于1685年颁布《波茨坦敕令》招募胡格诺派：六千名法国难民定居柏林，到1700年已占全城人口的五分之一。1701年霍亨索伦家族在柯尼斯堡加冕，柏林成为普鲁士王国的首都；1709年，柏林、克尔恩与三座新郊区合并为一座王家驻地城市。七年战争期间俄军曾短暂占领柏林。1806年拿破仑进入柏林；法国占领期间，1808年的《施泰因城市规程》让柏林有了第一个民选市议会和一位市长。1815年，柏林被划入新设的普鲁士勃兰登堡省。

en:
Ruppin is the lakeland around Lake Ruppin, where the Slavic Zamzizi had a stronghold on Poggenwerder before German expansion after the Wendish Crusade of 1147. Around 1214 Gebhard von Arnstein acquired the lordship, and his family became the counts of Lindow-Ruppin, ruling from the castle at Alt Ruppin. Neuruppin, their planned market settlement beside the lake, was first mentioned in 1238 and received Stendal town rights on 9 March 1256; a Dominican monastery followed in 1246. In 1444 the walled town, its Latin school and the surrounding farms and woodlands still belonged to the Lindow-Ruppin lords, under the growing overlordship of Brandenburg.

When Count Wichmann died without heirs in 1524, Elector Joachim I absorbed Ruppin into Brandenburg. The Reformation closed the Dominican house, and Elector Joachim II gave its buildings to the town in 1564. The Thirty Years' War brought repeated quarterings and impoverishment, especially around 1638. Huguenots settled after the Edict of Potsdam in 1685, and in 1688 Neuruppin became one of Brandenburg's earliest garrison towns; Crown Prince Frederick held a regiment there from 1732 to 1740. On 26 August 1787 fire destroyed 401 houses and the principal churches, though no one was killed. Bernhard Matthias Brasch rebuilt the town on a regular neoclassical plan between 1788 and 1803, and the novelist Theodor Fontane was born here in 1819.
zh:
鲁平是鲁平湖一带的湖沼之地。1147年文德十字军后，德意志势力向东扩张，而此前斯拉夫扎姆齐齐人曾在波根韦德岛上设有要塞。约1214年，格布哈德·冯·阿恩施泰因取得这片领地，其家族后来成为林多-鲁平伯爵，以旧鲁平城堡为统治中心。湖畔的新鲁平是他们规划兴建的市场聚落，1238年首见记载，1256年3月9日获得施滕达尔城市法，1246年又建起多明我会修道院。1444年，这座有城墙的城镇、城中的拉丁文学校以及周围的农场林地仍属林多-鲁平家族，同时处在勃兰登堡日益增强的封主权下。

1524年维希曼伯爵无嗣而终，选帝侯约阿希姆一世将鲁平并入勃兰登堡。宗教改革中，多明我会修道院被关闭，选帝侯约阿希姆二世于1564年把修院建筑赠予城镇。三十年战争期间，军队反复驻扎，居民陷入贫困，1638年前后尤其严重。1685年《波茨坦敕令》颁布后，胡格诺教徒来此定居；1688年，新鲁平成为勃兰登堡最早的驻军城镇之一，腓特烈王储在1732年至1740年间于此领有一个团。1787年8月26日的大火烧毁401栋房屋和主要教堂，但没有造成人员死亡。伯恩哈德·马蒂亚斯·布拉施在1788年至1803年间按整齐的新古典主义规划重建城市，作家特奥多尔·冯塔纳于1819年出生在这里。

en:
Magdeburg, first named as Magadoburg in Charlemagne's Capitulary of Diedenhofen in 805, guards a crossing of the Elbe and the old road east into the Slavic lands. Otto I made the town his favoured palace and was buried in its minster in 973, while the archbishopric founded in 968 directed the German mission beyond the Elbe. A charter of 1035 granted trading privileges that grew into Magdeburg law, adopted across Central and Eastern Europe. Fire gutted the city and its Ottonian cathedral in 1207, yet by the later Middle Ages it was one of the largest cities in the Empire, with over 20,000 inhabitants, a Hanseatic member since the late 13th century whose ships traded down the Elbe to Flanders and the North Sea. In 1444, after armed clashes with their archbishop around 1430, its wealthy citizens managed most of their affairs through their own council, though the city remained formally his cathedral seat.

Luther, who had attended school in Magdeburg as a boy in 1497, returned to preach in June 1524, and on 17 July the Reformation was introduced in every city church save the cathedral. The town joined the Schmalkaldic League, defied the Augsburg Interim and withstood a siege by Elector Maurice of Saxony in 1550-1551, its presses making it the publishing citadel of German Protestantism, where the Magdeburg Centuries were compiled. It held out against Wallenstein in 1629, but on 20 May 1631 Tilly's Catholic League army stormed it, and the sack remembered as the 'Magdeburg Wedding' burned the city almost to the ground and left barely 4,000 inhabitants. The mayor Otto von Guericke led the rebuilding and, six years after the peace, demonstrated the vacuum with his famous hemispheres. In 1680, on the administrator's death, the secularised Duchy of Magdeburg passed to Brandenburg, which built it into the strongest fortress of the Prussian kingdom and settled Huguenot refugees there. The fortress opened its gates to the French in 1806, and from 1807 Magdeburg became the seat of the Elbe department in the Kingdom of Westphalia. Restored to Prussia in 1814, it became capital of the Prussian Province of Saxony in 1816.
zh:
马格德堡最早见于805年查理曼的《蒂永维尔敕令》，名作马加多巴堡，扼守易北河渡口和通往东方斯拉夫人土地的古道。奥托一世把这里作为最喜爱的行宫，973年葬在城内的修道院；968年设立的大主教区主导了易北河以东的德意志传教事业。1035年的特许状授予城市贸易特权，由此发展出通行于中东欧的马格德堡法。1207年大火焚毁全城和奥托时代的大教堂，但到中世纪后期，马格德堡已是帝国最大的城市之一，居民超过两万，13世纪末加入汉萨同盟，商船顺易北河远达佛兰德与北海。1444年时，在1430年前后与大主教兵戎相见之后，富庶的市民通过自己的市议会处理大部分事务，尽管城市名义上仍是大主教的座堂城。

路德1497年童年时曾在此求学，1524年6月又回来布道，7月17日，除主教座堂外，马格德堡所有教堂都改奉新教。城市加入施马尔卡尔登同盟，拒绝《奥格斯堡临时敕令》，1550至1551年顶住萨克森选侯莫里茨的围攻而不屈；印刷业使它成为德意志新教的出版堡垒，《马格德堡世纪史》即在此编修。1629年它扛住了华伦斯坦的围攻，但1631年5月20日，蒂利率领的天主教同盟军队破城，史称「马格德堡婚礼」的劫掠把城市几乎夷为平地，幸存者仅约四千人。市长奥托·冯·居里克主持重建，并在战争结束六年后以著名的马格德堡半球实验证明了真空的存在。1680年末代行政官去世，世俗化的马格德堡公国并入勃兰登堡，普鲁士把它建成王国内最坚固的要塞，并在此安置胡格诺难民。1806年要塞向法军开城，1807年起马格德堡成为威斯特伐利亚王国易北省的省会。它1814年归还普鲁士，1816年成为普鲁士萨克森省的首府。

en:
Lüneburg grew around salt. By 956, when Otto I granted the toll of its saltworks to the monastery of St Michael, brine was already being boiled along the Ilmenau, and after Henry the Lion destroyed the rival trading town of Bardowick in 1189 Lüneburg received city rights and took its place. Its salt cured the Baltic and Norwegian herring sold at the Scania market, carried first over the Old Salt Road to Lübeck and, after the Stecknitz Canal opened in 1398, by barge into Lübeck's salt stores; the trade made it one of the wealthiest Hanse towns. From 1235 it belonged to the Welf Duchy of Brunswick-Lüneburg, but in 1371 rebel citizens drove out the princes and razed their castle on the Kalkberg, and the settlement of 1392 left the town almost wholly self-governing, fortified by the staple right granted that same year. In 1444 Lüneburg, Catholic and ruled by its salt-rich patrician families, was in all but name a free Hanse city.

The Prelates' War of 1446–1462, a bitter feud between the town council and the clergymen who co-owned the saltworks, first shook that order. Lüneburg turned Protestant in 1529–1530, when Urbanus Rhegius was called in and drafted its church ordinance, and the mid-sixteenth century was its cultural peak; then the herring vanished from the Scania waters around 1560, the Hansa declined, and the city grew poor. The Thirty Years' War finished the work: Swedish forces spared it from plunder only for a ransom of 34,000 thalers, and imperial armies closed in as the town opened its gates on 3 September 1637 to Duke George of Brunswick-Lüneburg, who made good his sovereignty in 1639, took back the Kalkberg and had the town towers pulled down. Two centuries of near-independence were over. Napoleon annexed Lüneburg in 1810, and in the north German rising of 1813 the citizens drove out the French officials; the skirmish at Lüneburg on 2 April 1813 was among the first fights of the wars of liberation.
zh:
吕讷堡因盐而兴。早在956年奥托一世把盐场税入赐给圣米迦勒修道院之前，伊尔默瑙河畔煮盐的炉灶已经燃起；1189年狮子亨利摧毁了与之争胜的商镇巴尔多维克，吕讷堡获得城市权并取而代之。吕讷堡盐用来腌制在波罗的海和挪威沿海捕获、运到斯科讷市场出售的鲱鱼，食盐先经「老盐路」陆运至吕贝克，1398年施特克尼茨运河开通后改由驳船直抵吕贝克盐仓，这座城市也凭此成为汉萨同盟最富庶的城市之一。1235年起它归属韦尔夫家族的不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公国，但1371年起义市民赶走公爵、拆毁卡尔克山上的城堡，1392年的和议使城市几乎完全自治，同年又获得强制过路商人卸货发卖的堆叠权。1444年的吕讷堡信奉天主教，由靠盐业致富的门阀家族治理，实际上与汉萨的自由城市无异。

1446至1462年的「高级教士之争」是市议会与同样持有盐场股份的教士之间的恶斗，第一次动摇了这一秩序。1529至1530年城市改宗新教，乌尔巴努斯·雷吉乌斯1531年应召前来制定教会规章，16世纪中叶是吕讷堡文化的鼎盛时期；此后约1560年鲱鱼群离开斯科讷近海，汉萨同盟也走向衰落，吕讷堡迅速败落。三十年战争给了它最后一击：瑞典军队以纵兵劫掠相胁，勒索了三万四千古尔登赎金，皇帝军随后又兵临城下，城市终在1637年9月3日向不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵格奥尔格开城；公爵于1639年彻底确立主权，收回卡尔克山并下令拆除城塔，两个世纪的准独立就此终结。1810年拿破仑吞并吕讷堡，1813年北德民变中市民赶走法国官吏，同年4月2日的吕讷堡之战是解放战争最早的战斗之一。

en:
Stade stands on the lower Elbe at the mouth of the Schwinge, the safest natural harbour between Cuxhaven and Harburg and the crossing where the Oxen Road from Jutland met the ferry to Itzehoe. It first appears in records as Stethu in 994, when Vikings plundered the settlement. In 1180 it passed to the Prince-Archbishopric of Bremen, and on 2 May 1209 Emperor Otto IV granted the burghers town privileges, confirmed by the see in 1236. A Hanseatic town from the League's early days, Stade sent representatives to the Hansetage from 1373. In 1444 it was a Catholic merchant and fishing town under the Archbishop of Bremen, its five parishes and old harbour crowded along the Schwinge, although Hamburg was already overtaking it.

Stade went Lutheran in 1522, when the city's first Lutheran sermon was preached. In 1601 the Hanse expelled it for harbouring the English Merchant Adventurers, who moved their staple on to Hamburg in 1611. Tilly took the town for the Catholic League in 1628; the Swedes seized it in February 1645 and kept it at the Peace of Westphalia in 1648, making Stade the seat of government of Bremen-Verden. Fire destroyed two-thirds of the town on 26 May 1659, and it was besieged from April to August 1676 in the Swedish-Brandenburg War. From 1663 a Swedish customs frigate patrolled the Elbe off Brunshausen. Danish bombardment in the Great Northern War ended Swedish rule in 1712, the year plague also struck, and in 1715 Stade passed to Hanover, confirmed by the Treaty of Stockholm in 1719. French troops entered in 1803, and from 1810 to 1813 the town belonged to the French Empire in the department of Bouches-de-l'Elbe before returning to Hanover.
zh:
施塔德位于易北河下游、施温格河入河口，是库克斯港与哈尔堡之间最安全的天然港口，从日德兰半岛南下的牛道在此与通往伊策霍埃的渡船相接。此地最早于994年以Stethu之名见于记载，当时维京人洗劫了这座聚落。1180年起施塔德归属不来梅大主教区，1209年5月2日皇帝奥托四世授予市民城市权，大主教区又于1236年予以确认。施塔德在汉萨同盟早期即已入盟，1373年起向汉萨议会派遣代表。1444年时，它是不来梅大主教治下一座信奉天主教的商贸与渔业城镇，五个堂区与老港沿施温格河排开，只是汉堡已开始后来居上。

1522年施塔德迎来第一次路德宗布道，改宗新教。1601年，汉萨同盟因它接纳英格兰商人冒险家公司的商人而将其除名，这些英国人1611年把商站迁往汉堡。1628年蒂利为天主教同盟夺取此城；瑞典人1645年2月攻占，1648年依《威斯特伐利亚和约》保有其地，并把施塔德设为不来梅-费尔登的行政中心。1659年5月26日大火烧毁全城三分之二，1676年4月至8月它在瑞典-勃兰登堡战争中再遭围攻。1663年起，一艘瑞典关税巡船在布伦斯豪森附近的易北河上常驻巡弋。大北方战争中丹麦人的炮击于1712年终结瑞典统治，同年瘟疫也袭击此城；1715年施塔德转归汉诺威，1719年《斯德哥尔摩条约》予以确认。法军1803年入城，1810年至1813年施塔德作为易北河口省的一部分并入法兰西帝国，此后重归汉诺威。

en:
Oldenburg grew up at a ford of the Hunte, on the trade road running from Bremen and Westphalia toward Frisia. It first appears as Aldenburg in 1108, in connection with Egilmar I, its first count, and in the 12th century the counts built a water castle there to command the crossing and its toll. Count Konrad I gave the settlement Bremen town law in 1345, after which it was fortified with walls, a wide moat and five gates. The counts warred on the pagan Frisians, feuded with Bremen and the bishops of Münster, and repeatedly granted Delmenhorst to younger sons. In 1444 Oldenburg was a small Catholic county town in the shadow of Hanseatic Bremen, ruled by the young Count Christian.

In 1448 that same Christian was elected King of Denmark, then King of Norway in 1450 and of Sweden in 1457, and in 1460 he made Oldenburg over to his brother Gerhard. Count Anton I introduced the Reformation and dissolved the monasteries in the mid-1500s. Under Anton Günther, count from 1603, Oldenburg bred the heavy Oldenburg horses prized as artillery teams; neutrality and gifts bought Tilly off in the Thirty Years War, a Renaissance castle was built from 1607, and an imperial grant of tolls on Weser shipping filled the treasury. Anton Günther died without legitimate heirs in 1667 and the county fell to Denmark, the very year plague broke out; in 1676 a lightning fire destroyed almost the whole town, and the Danes rebuilt it as a fortress. The Christmas Flood of 1717 drowned more than 4,000 people across the county. By the Treaty of Tsarskoye Selo in 1773 Denmark exchanged Oldenburg to the Holstein-Gottorp line, which ruled it as a duchy from 1774 and rebuilt the town in classical style. French annexation joined it to the department of the Bouches-du-Weser from 1811 to 1813, and in 1815 the restored state became a grand duchy.
zh:
奥尔登堡兴起于洪特河上的一处渡口，这里正处在不来梅、威斯特伐利亚通往弗里斯兰的商道上。1108年，此地以Aldenburg之名首次见于记载，与奥尔登堡家族第一位伯爵埃基尔玛一世有关；12世纪时伯爵们在此修建水堡，扼守渡口、征收关税。1345年伯爵康拉德一世授予聚落不来梅城市法，此后城市筑起城墙、宽阔壕沟和五座城门。伯爵们向北攻伐信奉异教的弗里斯兰人，又与不来梅和明斯特主教纷争不断，代尔门霍斯特则多次被分封给家族幼支。1444年时，奥尔登堡是汉萨城市不来梅阴影下一座小小的天主教伯国都城，由年轻的伯爵克里斯蒂安统治。

1448年，这位克里斯蒂安当选丹麦国王，1450年成为挪威国王，1457年又成为瑞典国王；1460年他把奥尔登堡交给弟弟格哈德。16世纪中叶，伯爵安东一世引入宗教改革、解散修道院。1603年即位的安东·君特治下，奥尔登堡培育的重型挽马成为抢手的炮兵用马；三十年战争中，他靠中立和厚礼买通蒂利，使城池免于兵燹；1607年起一座文艺复兴式城堡动工兴建，皇帝授予的威悉河航运关税更让府库充盈。安东·君特1667年无嫡嗣而终，伯国并入丹麦，同年瘟疫便告暴发；1676年一场雷击大火几乎烧毁全城，丹麦人将其重建为要塞。1717年的圣诞洪水在伯国境内溺死四千余人。1773年依《皇村条约》，丹麦将奥尔登堡交换给荷尔斯泰因-戈托普家族，该家族1774年起以公爵身份统治，并按古典主义风格重建城市。法国吞并期间，奥尔登堡于1811年至1813年成为威悉河口省的一部分；1815年，复国的奥尔登堡升格为大公国。

en:
Osnabrück grew up around a crossing of the Hase, where Charlemagne founded a bishopric in 780 during the Saxon wars. The place is first recorded as Osnabrugga in 851, and in 889 King Arnulf granted its market, customs and minting rights. Emperor Frederick Barbarossa confirmed the town's judicial and civic rights in 1171, and in 1236 the counts of Tecklenburg surrendered their lordship to the bishop, creating the prince-bishopric. Old and New Town were united in 1306, and the council charter of 1348 fixed their common constitution. From 1404 every bolt of linen sold in the city had to pass the Legge, which stamped it with the Osnabrück wheel, and this linen was carried as far as London and the Novgorod yard of the Hanse. Osnabrück first sent delegates to a Hansetag in 1412 and became a principal city of the League's Westphalian quarter. In 1444 the see was administered by Heinrich von Moers, bishop of neighbouring Münster.

The first Lutheran services were held in 1543 under the superintendent Hermann Bonnus, yet the city never turned wholly Protestant: after it opened its gates to the Catholic League in 1628, Bishop Franz Wilhelm von Wartenberg expelled the Lutheran preachers, raised the Petersburg citadel to overawe the burghers and opened a Jesuit university in 1632, which closed when Swedish troops took the town in 1633. Witch trials between 1565 and 1639 sent 276 women and two men to the stake, 163 of them during the single mayoralty of Johann Hammacher. From 1643 to 1648 Osnabrück and Münster hosted the Westphalian peace congress, with the Protestant envoys lodged here, and on 25 October 1648 the peace was proclaimed from the steps of the late-Gothic town hall; the bishopric became a bi-confessional state ruled by Catholic and Lutheran bishops in turn. From 1667 Ernst August of Brunswick-Lüneburg, the first Protestant bishop, built the baroque Schloss, where his brother George I of Great Britain died in June 1727. The jurist Justus Möser largely governed the last small bishopric from the 1760s and wrote its constitutional history. Occupied by the French in 1803, Osnabrück passed in turn to Hanover, Prussia, the Kingdom of Westphalia and Napoleonic France, and back to Hanover in 1815; the Waterloo Gate of 1817 honours the townsmen who fought there.
zh:
奥斯纳布吕克兴起于哈瑟河的一处渡口。萨克森战争期间，查理大帝于780年在此设立主教区；851年地名首见记载，作Osnabrugga，889年国王阿努尔夫授予这里市集、关税和铸币特权。1171年，皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨敕许城市法庭权；1236年，特克伦堡伯爵把护区权让予主教，这里由此成为直属帝国的主教诸侯邦。老城与新城1306年合并，1348年的城市约章确立了共同的治理体制。自1404年起，城内交易的每匹亚麻布都须经检验局验讫，盖上奥斯纳布吕克车轮印，这种亚麻布远销伦敦乃至汉萨商人在诺夫哥罗德的商馆。1412年，城市首次派代表出席汉萨议会，成为同盟威斯特伐利亚区的首要城市之一。1444年，主教座由邻邦明斯特的主教海因里希·冯·默尔斯以行政官身份兼领。

1543年，宗教改革家赫尔曼·博努斯在此主持了首次路德宗礼拜，但城市从未彻底改宗：1628年它不战开门迎入天主教同盟军队，主教弗朗茨·威廉·冯·瓦滕贝格驱逐路德宗牧师，修筑彼得斯堡要塞压制市民，并于1632年开办耶稣会大学，次年瑞典军队攻占城市后大学即告关闭。1565年至1639年间的猎巫审判把276名妇女和2名男子送上火刑柱，其中163人死于市长哈马赫尔一任之内（1565—1588年）。1643年至1648年，奥斯纳布吕克与明斯特共同承办威斯特伐利亚和会，新教使节驻节于此；1648年10月25日，和约在晚期哥特式市政厅的台阶上向市民宣告，主教区成为天主教徒与路德宗教徒各奉其教、主教由两派轮流担任的邦国。1667年起，首任新教主教、不伦瑞克-吕讷堡的恩斯特·奥古斯特兴建巴洛克式宫殿，他的兄长、英王乔治一世1727年6月在此病逝。法学家尤斯图斯·默泽尔自1760年代起实际主持末代主教区的政务，并撰有城邦制度史。1803年法军入城后，城市先后归属汉诺威、普鲁士、威斯特伐利亚王国和法兰西第一帝国，1815年重回汉诺威王国；1817年修建的滑铁卢门纪念在彼作战的本市士兵。

en:
Brunswick grew up at a ford of the Oker, the highest point from which the river runs navigable down to the Aller, Weser and the North Sea. Henry the Lion, the Welf duke of Saxony, made it his residence in 1142, built the cathedral of St Blasius and around 1166 set up before Dankwarderode Castle the bronze lion that became the city's emblem. After the Welf lands were partitioned in 1269, Brunswick stayed the chief city of the Wolfenbüttel line of Brunswick-Lüneburg. It joined the Hanseatic League in the mid-13th century, grew rich on cloth, metalware and its strong Mumme beer, and as one of the league's leading towns presided over its Saxon quarter. Burghers and guilds proved stronger than the princes: after repeated civic revolts, the dukes moved their residence to nearby Wolfenbüttel in 1432, so that in 1444 Brunswick was in all but name a self-governing city, with no lord but its own council.

In 1528, while Duke Henry the Younger campaigned in Italy, the council and burghers carried through the Reformation with a church order drafted by Johannes Bugenhagen, and in 1531 the city joined the Schmalkaldic League. Duke Frederick Ulrich besieged it for three months in 1615 in vain, but in 1671 a combined army of the Welf princes stormed Brunswick and ended its independence. Charles I founded the Collegium Carolinum in 1745 and in 1753 moved the ducal residence back to a newly built palace, drawing writers such as Lessing to his court. French troops entered the city in 1806, and after the Peace of Tilsit in 1807 Brunswick became capital of the Oker department in the Kingdom of Westphalia, while the exiled Duke Frederick William raised his volunteer corps, the 'Black Brunswickers', to fight the French. The restored Duchy of Brunswick was confirmed at the Congress of Vienna in 1815.
zh:
不伦瑞克兴起于奥克河畔的渡口，从这里顺流而下，经阿勒尔河和威悉河可通航至北海。1142年，韦尔夫家族的萨克森公爵狮子亨利以此为都城，修建圣布莱修斯大教堂，并在1166年前后于丹克瓦德罗德城堡前立起青铜狮子像，成为城市的标志。1269年韦尔夫领地分裂后，不伦瑞克仍是不伦瑞克-吕讷堡沃尔芬比特尔支系的首要城市。它于13世纪中叶加入汉萨同盟，靠呢绒、金属制品和浓烈的穆姆啤酒致富，并作为同盟首屈一指的城市主持萨克森区块。市民与行会的势力压倒了公爵：在接连不断的市民暴动之后，公爵于1432年把宫廷迁往附近的沃尔芬比特尔，因此1444年的不伦瑞克虽无自由城市之名，却由市议会实际自治。

1528年，趁公爵海因里希二世在意大利征战，市议会和市民按照约翰内斯·布根哈根拟定的教会规章推行宗教改革，1531年城市加入施马尔卡尔登联盟。1615年，公爵弗里德里希·乌尔里希围城三个月无功而返；1671年，韦尔夫诸邦的联军攻陷不伦瑞克，结束了它的独立。卡尔一世1745年创办卡罗林学院，1753年把公爵宫廷迁回新建的宫殿，莱辛等文人因此出入其宫廷。1806年法军入城，1807年《提尔西特和约》之后，不伦瑞克成为威斯特伐利亚王国奥克省的省会，流亡公爵弗里德里希·威廉则组建「黑色不伦瑞克」志愿军对法作战。复辟的不伦瑞克公国在1815年维也纳会议上得到确认。

en:
Anhalt takes its name from Anhalt Castle near Harzgerode. When the Ascanian inheritance was divided in 1212, Henry I received the Anhalt lands and took the title of prince in 1218. His descendants repeatedly partitioned the territory among the lines of Aschersleben, Bernburg, Zerbst and Dessau. Dessau itself was first documented in 1213, having grown at a crossing on the Mulde near its confluence with the Elbe under the protection of Waldeser Castle. In 1444 this Catholic Saxon countryside was a modest world of Ascanian dynastic shares, market roads, wool and river traffic between Magdeburg, Wittenberg and Leipzig.

Dessau became the fixed residence of the Anhalt-Dessau princes in 1470. Catholic princes gathered there in 1526, yet George III introduced the Reformation in 1534; Wolfgang of Anhalt-Köthen, a signatory of the Augsburg Confession in 1530, was placed under the imperial ban after Mühlberg in 1547 and bought his lands back in 1552. Joachim Ernest united all Anhalt in 1570, but the princes divided it again in 1603. The Elbe bridge at Roßlau made the region a battleground in the Thirty Years' War, including the Battle of Dessau Bridge in 1626. Leopold I, the 'Old Dessauer', born in 1676 and later a Prussian field marshal, rebuilt Dessau as a baroque residence. His successor Leopold III made it an Enlightenment centre and created the Dessau-Wörlitz Garden Realm, while in 1807 Anhalt-Dessau and Anhalt-Köthen became duchies in the Confederation of the Rhine.
zh:
安哈尔特得名于哈茨格罗德附近的安哈尔特城堡。1212年阿斯坎尼家族分家时，亨利一世分得安哈尔特诸地，并在1218年取得亲王头衔。他的后裔一再把领地分给阿舍斯莱本、贝恩堡、采尔布斯特和德绍各支。德绍首见于1213年文献，它在穆尔德河靠近易北河汇流处的渡口成长起来，受瓦尔德瑟城堡庇护。1444年时，这片信奉天主教的萨克森乡野只是阿斯坎尼家族各支分领的小天地，依靠市集道路、羊毛和马格德堡、维滕贝格、莱比锡之间的河水往来为生。

1470年，德绍成为安哈尔特-德绍亲王的固定王宫驻地。天主教亲王1526年曾在此集会，格奥尔格三世却在1534年引入宗教改革；安哈尔特-克滕的沃尔夫冈1530年签署《奥格斯堡信条》，1547年米尔贝格战役后遭帝国剥夺令，1552年才购回领地。约阿希姆·恩斯特1570年统一整个安哈尔特，但诸亲王1603年再度分家。三十年战争中，罗斯劳的易北河桥使这里成为军队往来的战场，1626年爆发德绍桥战役。1676年出生、后来成为普鲁士元帅的利奥波德一世绰号「老德绍人」，把德绍改造成巴洛克王宫城市。他的继任者利奥波德三世使这里成为启蒙运动中心，并营建德绍-沃利茨园林王国；1807年，安哈尔特-德绍与安哈尔特-克滕升为公国，加入莱茵邦联。

en:
Wittenberg was a Flemish-founded village on the Elbe, first recorded in 1180, that became the seat of the Ascanian dukes of Saxony in 1260 and received its charter from Duke Albrecht II in 1293. The Golden Bull of 1356 confirmed its lords as prince-electors, making Wittenberg the capital of the Saxon electorate. Market rights followed in 1354 and a ferry ordinance in 1380, and its walls held against the Hussites in 1429. When the Ascanian line died out in 1422 the electoral dignity passed to the House of Wettin, and Wittenberg lost some of its glamour though not its trade. In 1444 Elector Frederick the Gentle confirmed the town's privileges and extended its high jurisdiction, but it remained a quiet Elbe crossing of the Saxon electors, with guilds of cloth-makers and craftsmen busy at the ferry, on the eve of its greatest age.

The Leipzig Partition of 1485 gave Wittenberg to the Ernestine Wettins, and Elector Frederick the Wise, ruling from 1486 on the silver of the Erzgebirge, rebuilt it as his residence: the Elbe bridge went up in 1487–1490 and the Castle Church in 1496–1506, and his university, founded in 1502, drew Martin Luther as professor of theology in 1508 and Philipp Melanchthon in 1518. On 31 October 1517 Luther posted the Ninety-Five Theses on the Castle Church door, and in December 1520 he burned the papal bull Exsurge Domine outside the Elster Gate; from the former Augustinian monastery he translated the Bible, while Lucas Cranach ran his painters' workshop off the market square. In the Schmalkaldic War the defeated John Frederick the Magnanimous surrendered Wittenberg and the electoral dignity to the Albertine line by the Capitulation of 1547. The town weathered the Thirty Years' War, although the Swedes burned its wooden bridge in 1637, and an imperial bombardment on 13 October 1760 destroyed the Schloss and the church, together with the original theses door. Rebuilt in late baroque by 1770, Wittenberg was refortified by Napoleon after 1806, endured a French garrison and a winter siege, and fell to Prussian troops under Tauentzien on the night of 13 January 1814. The Congress of Vienna gave the town to Prussia in 1815, its university was merged into Halle in 1817, and a Luther monument was unveiled on the market square in 1821.
zh:
维滕贝格是佛兰芒移民在易北河畔建立的村落，1180年首见记载，1260年成为阿斯坎尼亚家族萨克森公爵的驻地，1293年公爵阿尔布雷希特二世授予其城市权。1356年的金玺诏书确认其领主为选侯，维滕贝格由此成为萨克森选侯国的都城。1354年它获得市集权，1380年颁行渡口规章，1429年城墙击退了胡斯派军队。1422年阿斯坎尼亚家族绝嗣，选侯之位转入韦廷家族，维滕贝格的光彩略减，商贸却未衰落。1444年，选侯「温和者」腓特烈确认城市特权并扩大其司法权；但在最伟大的时代到来前夜，它仍是萨克森选侯治下一个平静的易北河渡口，织工和各行工匠在渡头忙碌。

1485年的莱比锡分割把维滕贝格分给韦廷家族恩斯特系；1486年起当政的选侯「智者」腓特烈凭厄尔士山脉的银矿收入，把它重建为自己的驻地：易北河桥建于1487—1490年，城堡教堂建于1496—1506年，1502年创办的大学于1508年聘来马丁·路德任神学教授，1518年又迎来菲利普·梅兰希通。1517年10月31日，路德把《九十五条论纲》张贴在城堡教堂的门上；1520年12月，他在埃尔斯特门外焚毁教皇诏书《主啊，起来吧》。他在昔日奥古斯丁修道院的居室里翻译圣经，卢卡斯·克拉纳赫则在市集广场旁经营画室。施马尔卡尔登战争中，战败的「宽宏者」约翰·腓特烈依1547年的维滕贝格投降协定，把城市和选侯资格让予韦廷家族阿尔布雷希特系。三十年战争中城市守住了城池，但瑞典人1637年烧毁了木桥；1760年10月13日，帝国军队的炮轰摧毁了宫殿、教堂连同最初的论纲之门。城市到1770年以晚期巴洛克风格重建。1806年后拿破仑下令将其重新筑为要塞，法军长期驻守；经历冬季围困后，1814年1月13日夜城市被陶恩齐恩率领的普军攻克。1815年维也纳会议把它划归普鲁士，1817年大学并入哈雷大学，1821年市集广场竖起路德纪念碑。

en:
The upper Spree country around Bautzen, or Budyšin in Upper Sorbian, was the land of the Milceni, the West Slavic people whose settlements became part of Sorbian Lusatia. The strongpoint above the river is first recorded in 1002, and the later town grew rich at the Spree crossing of the Via Regia, linking the Rhineland with Silesia. In 1346 Bautzen joined Görlitz, Kamenz, Lauban, Löbau and Zittau in the Lusatian League, the six-city alliance that defended town privileges and bought broad village lands under its councils. The league supported Emperor Sigismund against the Hussites, and Bautzen survived sieges in 1429 and 1431. In 1444 the weakening Bohemian Crown left the Upper Lusatian estates and towns largely to manage their own affairs; Sorbian speech remained strong in the villages, and the country was still Catholic.

In 1469 the estates rejected the Utraquist king George of Poděbrady and accepted Matthias Corvinus of Hungary, whose rule ended with the return to Bohemia in 1490. Lutheran teaching reached Bautzen in the early 1520s, although the collegiate chapter of St Peter kept its Catholic rites. After the Schmalkaldic War, Ferdinand I punished the six towns in 1547 by revoking their privileges and seizing their estates. During the Bohemian revolt the Saxon elector occupied Upper Lusatia in 1619-20, and the Peace of Prague transferred it to Saxony in 1635, a year after an imperial garrison fired the suburbs and a fire killed some 700 Bautzen residents. In 1722 Nikolaus Ludwig von Zinzendorf opened his Upper Lusatian estates to refugees from the Bohemian Brotherhood. Napoleon won his last major victory nearby at the Battle of Bautzen on 20-21 May 1813; two years later the Congress of Vienna divided Upper Lusatia, leaving Bautzen itself in Saxony.
zh:
包岑（上索布语称布迪申）周围的施普雷河上游，曾是米尔恰内人的土地；这支西斯拉夫人的聚落后来成为索布人卢萨蒂亚的一部分。河畔要塞最早见于1002年的记载，城镇则因国王大道在施普雷河上的渡口繁荣，这条道路连接莱茵兰与西里西亚。1346年，包岑与格尔利茨、卡门茨、卢班、勒包和齐陶结成卢萨蒂亚同盟，六城共同维护城市特权，并把大片乡村购入市议会治下。同盟支持西吉斯蒙德皇帝对抗胡斯派，包岑也在1429年和1431年顶住围城。1444年，波希米亚王权衰弱，上卢萨蒂亚等级与六城大体自行处理内部事务；索布语在乡村仍很强势，此地也仍信奉天主教。

1469年，当地等级拒绝承认信奉饼酒同派的波杰布拉德的伊日，转投匈牙利的马加什·科尔温，直到1490年才重归波希米亚。路德宗学说在1520年代初传入包岑，但圣彼得参事会仍保留天主教礼仪。施马尔卡尔登战争后，斐迪南一世在1547年惩处六城，废除特权并没收地产。波希米亚起义期间，萨克森选帝侯于1619年至1620年占领上卢萨蒂亚；1635年《布拉格和约》将其划归萨克西。前一年，帝国守军焚毁城郊，火势蔓延入城，约700名包岑居民死亡。1722年，尼古拉·路德维希·冯·亲岑道夫向逃离波希米亚的弟兄会信徒开放自己在上卢萨蒂亚的领地。1813年5月20日至21日，拿破仑在包岑附近赢得他最后一场重大胜利；两年后，维也纳会议分割上卢萨蒂亚，包岑本城留在萨克森。

en:
Dresden grew up at a ford of the Elbe on the site of a Sorbian village, whose Old Sorbian name Drežďany gave the town its name. The Margrave of Meissen, Dietrich, founded a German trading settlement on the south bank, first recorded as Dresdene on 31 March 1206, and from 1220 a stone bridge joined it to the Sorbian town of Altendresden on the far bank. Its early growth was tied to mining in the nearby Ore Mountains and to river traffic on the Elbe; the Christmas market first attested in 1434, later famous as the Striezelmarkt, drew miners and merchants each winter. In 1423 the Wettin Margrave Frederick the Warlike secured the Saxon electoral dignity for his dynasty, yet in 1444 Dresden remained a modest market town in the Meissen lands, overshadowed by Meissen itself and the electoral country around Wittenberg.

Dresden received staple rights in 1455, and after the Wettin brothers divided their lands at Leipzig in 1485 it became the residence of the Albertine dukes. When Duke Maurice gained the electoral title in 1547 after the Schmalkaldic War, Dresden became the capital of the foremost Protestant state in the Empire; the two settlements on either bank were united in 1549, and Elector August made the Dresden mint the only one in Saxony in 1556. The city was spared plunder during the Thirty Years' War but lost many inhabitants to plague around 1632. Altendresden burned down in 1685 and was rebuilt as the New City, completed in 1732. Under Frederick Augustus I, Elector and from 1697 King of Poland as Augustus II the Strong, the court raised the Zwinger and the Green Vault, while Tschirnhaus and Böttger discovered European hard-paste porcelain in 1708 and the royal factory opened at nearby Meissen in 1710. Prussian troops took Dresden in 1745, when the treaty ending the Second Silesian War was signed here, and bombarded it during a failed siege in 1760. Schiller wrote his Ode to Joy in the city in 1785, and the Pillnitz Declaration against revolutionary France was issued at the elector's palace in 1791. In 1806 Napoleon made Dresden the capital of the Kingdom of Saxony, and on 27 August 1813 he won his last great victory at the Battle of Dresden, before the kingdom joined the German Confederation in 1815.
zh:
德累斯顿兴起于易北河一处渡口，最初是索布人的村落，地名即来自古索布语的「德列日贾内」。迈森藩侯迪特里希在南岸建立德意志人商镇，1206年3月31日的一份文书首次以「德累斯德内」之名记载此地；1220年起，一座石桥把商镇与北岸的索布人城镇旧德累斯顿连为一体。城市的早期发展依托邻近厄尔士山脉的采矿和易北河航运，1434年即见记载、后来闻名的斯特里策尔圣诞集市每年冬天吸引矿工和商人前来。1423年，韦廷家族的迈森藩侯好战者腓特烈为家族取得萨克森选侯头衔，但1444年的德累斯顿仍只是迈森领地上一座普通集镇，声势不及迈森城和维滕贝格一带的选侯直领地。

1455年德累斯顿获得堆货权，贸易为之一振；1485年韦廷兄弟在莱比锡瓜分领地后，这里成为阿尔布雷希特系公爵的驻地。1547年施马尔卡尔登战争后，莫里茨公爵取得选侯头衔，德累斯顿成为帝国境内头号新教国家的首都；1549年两岸两镇正式合并，1556年奥古斯特选侯把德累斯顿造币厂定为萨克森唯一的造币厂。三十年战争中城市未遭劫掠，但1632年前后瘟疫仍夺去许多居民的生命。旧德累斯顿1685年焚毁，之后按新城重建，1732年完工。在选侯腓特烈·奥古斯特一世治下——他自1697年起又以奥古斯特二世（强力王）的身份兼任波兰国王——宫廷建起茨温格宫和绿穹珍宝馆；契恩豪斯与伯特格尔1708年在此破解欧洲硬瓷的秘密，皇家瓷厂1710年在附近的迈森开工。1745年普军占领德累斯顿，结束第二次西里西亚战争的和约也在此签订；1760年普军围城不克，炮轰内城。1785年席勒在此写下《欢乐颂》，1791年针对革命法国的《皮尔尼茨宣言》在选侯的行宫发表。1806年拿破仑立德累斯顿为萨克森王国首都；1813年8月27日，他在德累斯顿战役中赢得在德意志土地上的最后一场大胜，1815年萨克森王国加入德意志邦联。

en:
Leipzig lies where the Via Regia crossed the Via Imperii in the open Leipzig plain. It was first named as urbs Libzi in Bishop Thietmar of Merseburg's chronicle in 1015, and in 1165 Margrave Otto the Rich of Meissen granted it town and market rights; its fair tradition reached back to 1190. The university founded on 2 December 1409 gave the trading town a second life as a seat of learning. Meissen had been absorbed into the Saxon electorate in 1439, so in 1444 Leipzig was a Catholic Saxon market town, its inns and warehouses busy with cloth, wool and fur moving between western and eastern Germany.

Imperial fair status in 1497 and staple rights over a radius of 115 kilometres in 1507 made Leipzig a European market and Germany's chief exchange between east and west. In 1519 Martin Luther, Andreas Karlstadt and Philipp Melanchthon debated Johann Eck in the Pleissenburg, and in 1539 Luther and Justus Jonas firmly introduced the Reformation. The Thirty Years' War struck the city directly: Tilly's imperial army was defeated at Breitenfeld in 1631, Leipzig was besieged five times between 1631 and 1642, and Swedish occupation lasted until 1650, with population falling from 18,000 to 12,000. A six-day newspaper appeared in 1650, an opera house opened on the Brühl in 1693, and J. S. Bach served as Thomaskantor from 1723 until 1750. Prussia occupied Leipzig in 1756-1763, and in 1813 the Battle of Leipzig ended in Napoleon's decisive defeat; the peace settlement left the city in Saxony.
zh:
莱比锡位于开阔的莱比锡平原，是皇帝之路与帝国之路的交会处。1015年，梅泽堡主教蒂特马尔在编年史中首次以urbs Libzi之名记载此地；1165年，迈森藩侯富人奥托授予它城市权和市场权，市集传统则可追溯至1190年。1409年12月2日创立的大学，又让这座商镇成为学术中心。迈森藩侯领在1439年并入萨克森选帝侯国，因此1444年的莱比锡是一座天主教萨克森商镇，客栈和仓廒忙于转运德意志东西部之间的布匹、羊毛和毛皮。

1497年，莱比锡成为帝国市集城市；1507年，它又获得半径115公里内的堆叠权，成为欧洲级市集和德意志东西贸易最重要的交换地。1519年，马丁·路德、安德烈亚斯·卡尔施塔特和菲利普·梅兰希通在普莱森堡与约翰·艾克辩论；1539年，路德和尤斯图斯·约纳斯正式把宗教改革引入城中。三十年战争直接波及这里：1631年，蒂利的帝国军队在布赖滕费尔德战败，莱比锡在1631至1642年间五次被围，1642至1650年又遭瑞典占领，人口从一万八千降至一万二千。1650年，当地出现每周发行六期的报纸；1693年，布吕尔开设歌剧院；约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫则在1723至1750年担任圣托马斯合唱团乐长。七年战争期间，莱比锡在1756至1763年被普鲁士占领。1813年，反法同盟在莱比锡战役中决定性击败拿破仑；战后安排仍把这座城市留在萨克森。

en:
Erfurt grew up at a ford of the Gera where the kings' highway, the Via Regia, met the road from Lübeck to upper Italy. Boniface founded a bishopric here at Erphesfurt in 742, and from the tenth century the town stood under the secular lordship of the Archbishops of Mainz, though it never belonged to the Thuringian principalities around it. A city council from 1217 and a bought territory of nearly a hundred villages made it a regional power, and after 1300 it became the greatest of the German woad markets: the blue dye of the Thuringian woad towns, sold under a fair privilege granted by Emperor Louis IV in 1331, drew merchants along the Via Regia. Its university, chartered in 1379 and opened by the city in 1392, was the third in Germany. In 1444 Erfurt numbered some 20,000 souls, surpassed in Germany only by Cologne, Nuremberg and Magdeburg; allied with Mühlhausen and Nordhausen, it had joined the Hanse in 1430, and workmen were raising a second, higher ring of walls (1432-1446) around a city that governed itself under the distant overlordship of Mainz.

Martin Luther studied at the university from 1501, was ordained in the cathedral in 1507 and lived as an Augustinian friar here until 1511. Erfurt appointed its first Protestant pastor, Georg Petz, in 1521, and the Hammelburg agreement of 1530 made it one of Europe's first officially bi-confessional cities. The later sixteenth century brought decline, and in the Thirty Years' War Swedish garrisons held Erfurt from 1632 to 1635 and again from 1637 to 1650. In 1664 French and imperial execution troops acting for Archbishop Johann Philipp von Schönborn of Mainz stormed the city and ended its self-rule; the great Petersberg citadel, built from 1665 to 1726, kept watch over it thereafter. Erfurt passed to Prussia in 1802, capitulated to the French without a fight on 16 October 1806, and from 1807 formed Napoleon's own Principality of Erfurt, where he met Tsar Alexander I at the Congress of Erfurt in 1808. Besieged after the Battle of Leipzig, the city opened its gates to the allies in January 1814, though the French held the citadels until May. In 1815 the Congress of Vienna restored Erfurt to Prussia as a district capital of the Province of Saxony.
zh:
埃尔福特兴起于格拉河的一处渡口，王家大道「帝王之路」与吕贝克通往上意大利的商路在此交汇。742年，博尼法斯在埃尔普斯富特建立主教区；从10世纪起，城市处在美因茨大主教的世俗宗主权下，却始终不属于周围的图林根诸邦。1217年设立市议会，又买下近百个村庄组成的直辖领地，成为一方强权；1300年前后，它成为德意志最大的菘蓝市场之一——图林根诸染料城出产的蓝色染料，凭皇帝路德维希四世1331年授予的集市特许沿帝王之路行销四方。这里的大学1379年获特许、1392年由城市出资开办，是德意志土地上的第三所大学。1444年的埃尔福特约有两万居民，在德意志仅次於科隆、纽伦堡和马格德堡；它与米尔豪森、诺德豪森结盟，1430年一同加入汉萨同盟，1432至1446年正在修筑第二道更高的城墙，在美因茨的遥远宗主权下自行治理。

马丁·路德1501年起在这所大学求学，1507年在主教座堂晋铎，1505至1511年在城中的奥斯定会修道院当修士。1521年，埃尔福特任命第一位新教牧师格奥尔格·佩茨，改奉新教；1530年的《哈默尔堡协议》又使它成为欧洲最早官方实行两教派并存的城市之一。16世纪后期城市渐趋衰落，三十年战争中瑞典驻军两度占领埃尔福特，分别是1632至1635年和1637至1650年。1664年，受美因茨选侯大主教约翰·菲利普·冯·申博恩调遣的法军和帝国执行军队攻破城市，自治就此终结；1665至1726年建成的彼得斯贝格要塞此后一直监视着全城。1802年埃尔福特划归普鲁士，1806年10月16日不战而降于法国，1807年起成为拿破仑直接领有的埃尔福特侯国，1808年他在此与沙皇亚历山大一世举行埃尔福特会议。莱比锡会战后城市遭到围攻，1814年1月向反法同盟开城，法军则据守要塞至5月；1815年维也纳会议把埃尔福特归还普鲁士，成为萨克森省的一座专区首府。

en:
Landshut was founded in 1204 by Duke Louis I on the Isar beneath Trausnitz Castle. The Wittelsbachs kept a residence there from 1231, and after the Bavarian partition of 1255 it became the capital of Lower Bavaria. The further partition of 1392 created Bavaria-Landshut, the wealthiest of the rival duchies. Duke Henry XVI enlarged his lands in the Straubing inheritance of 1429 and drew revenue from the salt trade of Reichenhall, Kitzbühel, Rattenberg and Kufstein, the 'white gold' that made his court richer than Munich. In 1444 this Catholic Bavarian residence was at the height of its late-medieval power, with St Martin's Church rising above the old town.

Henry absorbed most of Bavaria-Ingolstadt in 1447, and in 1475 his grandson George married Hedwig Jagiellon with the tournaments and banquets of the Landshut Wedding, one of the most splendid festivals of the age. When George died without a male heir on 1 December 1503, his attempt to leave the duchy to Ruprecht of the Palatinate caused the Landshut War of Succession; by 1505 Bavaria-Landshut had been reunited with Bavaria-Munich. Duke Louis X built the Italianate City Residence from 1537 to 1543, the first Renaissance palace north of the Alps. Swedish troops stormed and plundered Landshut on 22 July 1634 and killed the imperial general Johann von Aldringen; plague and famine then took a third of the inhabitants. A Franco-Swedish army under Turenne and Wrangel occupied the town for five months in 1648. The university came from Ingolstadt in 1800, and Napoleon defeated the Austrians there on 21 April 1809.
zh:
兰茨胡特1204年由路易一世公爵在伊萨尔河畔、特劳尼茨城堡下方建立。维特尔斯巴赫家族自1231年起在此居住，1255年巴伐利亚分封后，这里成为下巴伐利亚的都城。1392年再次分封产生巴伐利亚-兰茨胡特，它也是几个相互竞争的公国中最富有的一个。亨利十六世公爵在1429年的施特劳宾继承中扩张领土，并从赖兴哈尔、基茨比厄尔、拉滕贝格和库夫施泰因的食盐贸易中取得收入；这种「白色黄金」让他的宫廷比慕尼黑更加富有。1444年，这座信奉天主教的巴伐利亚都城正处于中世纪晚期权势的顶点，圣马丁教堂高耸在老城之上。

1447年，亨利接管了巴伐利亚-英戈尔施塔特的大部分领地；1475年，他的孙子格奥尔格与雅德维加·雅盖隆卡成婚，庆典中的骑士比武和宴会即著名的兰茨胡特婚礼，是那个时代最奢华的节庆之一。格奥尔格1503年12月1日去世且没有男嗣，他试图让普法尔茨的鲁普雷希特继承公国，引发兰茨胡特继承战争；到1505年，巴伐利亚-兰茨胡特重新并入巴伐利亚-慕尼黑。1537年至1543年，路易十世修建意大利风格的城市宫，这是阿尔卑斯山以北第一座文艺复兴宫殿。1634年7月22日，瑞典军队猛攻并洗劫兰茨胡特，帝国将领约翰·冯·阿尔德林根战死；随后的瘟疫和饥荒又夺走三分之一居民的生命。1648年，蒂雷纳与弗兰格尔率领的法国-瑞典联军占领该城五个月。1800年，大学从英戈尔施塔特迁来；1809年4月21日，拿破仑在此击败奥地利军队。

en:
Munich grew up at the Isar crossing that Henry the Lion, duke of Saxony and Bavaria, captured for the salt route after destroying the bishop of Freising's bridge at Föhring; the Augsburg arbitration of 14 June 1158, recording 'forum apud Munichen', counts as the city's founding. It was walled in 1175, passed to the Wittelsbachs in 1240, and in 1255 became the residence of the dukes of Upper Bavaria. Duke Louis IV, born in Munich, was German king from 1314 and crowned emperor in 1328, and secured for the town its salt staple. A second ring of walls went up in 1429 against the Hussites, and in 1442 Duke Albert III expelled the city's Jews. In 1444 Munich was the Catholic ducal seat of Bavaria-Munich, a salt and market town on the Isar, still smaller than Nuremberg and Augsburg.

The foundation stone of the great Gothic Frauenkirche was laid in 1468. In 1506 Munich became capital of the reunited duchy, and under Dukes William IV and Albert V a stronghold of the Counter-Reformation: Albert built the Antiquarium in the Residenz from 1568 and brought Orlando di Lasso to his chapel, while William V raised the Jesuit Michaelskirche and, in 1589, the Hofbräuhaus. The Catholic League was founded there in 1609. Duke Maximilian I won the electoral dignity, but in 1632 the Swedes of Gustavus Adolphus occupied the city, which saved itself with ransom and hostages; plague then carried off a third of its people. Under Elector Ferdinand Maria the Nymphenburg palace and Theatiner Church rose in Italian baroque. The alliance with France brought Habsburg occupation from 1704, and the peasant rising of 1705 ended in the Sendling Christmas massacre; Austrian troops occupied Munich again in 1742. The Academy of Sciences was founded in 1759, the English Garden laid out in 1789, and the medieval walls dismantled. In 1806 Munich became capital of the Kingdom of Bavaria, and in October 1810 the wedding feast of Crown Prince Ludwig and Therese of Saxe-Hildburghausen on the riverside meadows was the first Oktoberfest.
zh:
慕尼黑兴起于伊萨尔河的渡口：萨克森兼巴伐利亚公爵狮子亨利焚毁弗赖辛主教在弗灵的桥梁，把食盐商路夺到自己手中，并在日后慕尼黑老城一带另建收费桥和集市；1158年6月14日的奥格斯堡仲裁书中出现了「forum apud Munichen」（慕尼黑附近的集市）之名，这一天被当作建城之日。1175年城市筑城获权，1240年归入维特尔斯巴赫家族，1255年成为上巴伐利亚公爵的驻地。出生于此的公爵路德维希四世1314年当选德意志国王、1328年加冕为皇帝，并为城市保住了食盐栈市权。1429年为防胡斯派增筑第二道城墙，1442年阿尔布雷希特三世把城中犹太人驱逐殆尽。1444年的慕尼黑是巴伐利亚-慕尼黑公国信奉天主教的公爵驻地，伊萨尔河上的盐贸集镇，规模仍在纽伦堡和奥格斯堡之下。

1468年，宏伟的哥特式圣母教堂奠基。1506年慕尼黑成为重新统一的巴伐利亚公国都城，在威廉四世和阿尔布雷希特五世治下成为反宗教改革的堡垒：1568年起阿尔布雷希特在王宫修建古物馆，把奥兰多·迪·拉索请到宫廷乐团；威廉五世则为耶稣会修建圣弥额尔教堂，又于1589年兴办宫廷酿酒坊。1609年，天主教同盟在慕尼黑成立。马克西米利安公爵为巴伐利亚赢得选帝侯资格，但1632年古斯塔夫·阿道夫的瑞典军队占领城市，慕尼黑靠缴纳赎金、交出人质才免于被毁，随后瘟疫又夺去三分之一人口。斐迪南·马利亚选帝侯时期，宁芬堡宫和戴蒂尼教堂以意大利巴洛克风格建起。与法国结盟招来1704年起的哈布斯堡占领，1705年的农民起义在森德灵圣诞之夜被血腥镇压；1742年奥地利军队再次入城。1759年科学院成立，1789年英国花园开辟，中世纪城墙随后被拆除。1806年慕尼黑成为巴伐利亚王国首都；1810年10月，王储路德维希与萨克森-希尔德堡豪森的特蕾泽在河畔草甸举行婚礼庆典，这便是第一届十月节。

en:
Bamberg grew up above the Regnitz, near its junction with the Main, around the Babenberch castle first recorded in 902. In 1007 Emperor Henry II made it the seat of a new diocese and built the cathedral where he and his wife Cunigunde lie buried; Bishop Suidger became Pope Clement II in 1046, and his is the only papal tomb north of the Alps. From the mid-thirteenth century its bishops were princes of the Empire, ruling a scattered land of vineyards, forests and castles that stretched north-east to the Franconian Forest. In January 1430 a Hussite army marched on the city: the cathedral chapter fled with its treasure, and Bamberg bought the invaders off with 12,000 gulden without a storm. In 1444 it was thus a small but wealthy Catholic prince-bishopric of the Empire, its walled town living from river trade, the church and Regnitz valley wine.

In 1507 Bishop Georg III Schenk von Limpurg had Johann von Schwarzenberg issue the Bamberg penal code, a landmark code for criminal trials and torture. Lutheran preaching reached the city in the 1520s, and peasant bands attacked the bishop's hilltop stronghold in 1525. In 1552 Margrave Albrecht Alcibiades of Brandenburg-Kulmbach occupied much of the bishopric and installed Protestant clergy, until Jesuits called in in 1610 enforced the Counter-Reformation. Under Prince-Bishop Johann Georg II Fuchs von Dornheim the witch hunts of 1612 to 1631 killed nearly 900 people, among them Mayor Johannes Junius in 1628, in the Drudenhaus prison built the year before. Swedish troops drove the bishop out in 1631, and by the restoration of 1634 the city had lost a fifth of its people; its Gymnasium was raised to a university in 1648. The Schönborn bishops rebuilt Bamberg in Baroque, completing the Neue Residenz in 1703 and the Vierzehnheiligen pilgrimage church. Prussians occupied it three times in the Seven Years' War, and in 1802 Bavarian troops ended the old prince-bishopric.
zh:
班贝格位于雷格尼茨河临近汇入美因河处的丘陵之上，围绕着首见于902年记载的巴本贝格堡发展起来。1007年，皇帝亨利二世在此设立新主教区并修建主教座堂，他与妻子库妮贡德后来都葬在堂中；1046年，主教苏伊德格离开班贝格就任教皇，称克雷芒二世，他的陵墓是阿尔卑斯山以北仅存的教皇墓。从13世纪中叶起，班贝格主教成为帝国诸侯，统治着一片由葡萄园、森林和城堡组成的分散领地，东北一直延伸到法兰克尼亚森林。1430年1月，胡斯军队进逼城下，主教座堂圣职团带着宝藏出逃，班贝格缴纳12000古尔登赎金，城市未被攻破。因此在1444年，这里是一个小而富庶的天主教教会邦国，城墙内的城市靠河运、教会和雷格尼茨河谷的葡萄酒为生。

1507年，主教格奥尔格三世·申克·冯·林普格命约翰·冯·施瓦岑贝格颁布班贝格刑事法院规程，为刑事审判和刑讯定下规矩。1520年代路德宗传入，1525年起义农民攻打主教山上的城堡。1552年，勃兰登堡-库尔姆巴赫藩侯阿尔布雷希特·阿尔齐比亚德斯占领主教区大部，派驻新教牧师，直到1610年召来耶稣会士强力推行反宗教改革。在采邑主教约翰·格奥尔格二世·富克斯·冯·多恩海姆治下，1612至1631年的猎巫狂潮夺去近九百条人命，市长约翰内斯·尤尼乌斯也于1628年在一年前建成的德鲁登狱中遇害。1631年瑞典军队赶走主教，到1634年恢复统治时，城市已损失五分之一人口。1648年，当地文科中学升格为大学。申博恩家族的采邑主教们以巴洛克风格重建班贝格，1703年建成新宫，还主持修建十四圣徒朝圣教堂。七年战争中城市三次被普军占领；1802年，巴伐利亚军队终结了古老的主教采邑。

en:
Nuremberg grew up around an imperial castle on the Pegnitz, first recorded in 1050, at the crossing of the roads between Italy and northern Europe. Frederick II's Great Charter of 1219 gave it town rights and imperial immediacy, and in 1427 the city bought the burgraves' ruined castle and lands, becoming wholly sovereign within its walls. The Golden Bull of 1356 made Nuremberg the customary seat of a newly elected emperor's first diet, and in 1423 King Sigismund entrusted the city with the Imperial regalia. A craftsmen's rising against the patricians failed in 1349, after which the guilds were abolished and the leading families ruled alone. In 1444 Nuremberg was a Catholic imperial city near the height of its wealth, its merchants trading by way of Venice with the Levant, and with Cologne and Prague one of the largest cities in the Empire.

The years from 1470 to 1530 were its golden age. Albrecht Dürer was born there in 1471, Martin Behaim made his globe for the city in 1492, and its printers, locksmiths and metalworkers supplied the whole of Europe; Hans Sachs the Meistersinger embodied its literary life. Nuremberg adopted the Reformation in 1525, and the Religious Peace of Nuremberg between Catholics and Lutherans was concluded there in 1532. In 1552 Margrave Albert Alcibiades attacked it without warning and extorted a harsh peace. In 1632 Gustavus Adolphus made the city his base against Wallenstein, and although it was never stormed, the Thirty Years' War reduced its people by nearly half; the Swedish-led peace banquet of 1649 sealed the implementation of the Peace of Westphalia there. Burdened with debt, Nuremberg sought Prussian protection in vain, and in 1806 the Confederation of the Rhine handed the old imperial city to Bavaria, which took over its public debt of twelve and a half million guilders.
zh:
纽伦堡围绕佩格尼茨河畔的一座皇帝城堡发展起来，1050年首见记载，正处在意大利与北欧道路的交会处。1219年腓特烈二世颁布《大自由诏书》，授予城市建城权和帝国直辖地位；1427年城市买下城堡伯家族被毁的城堡和领地，在城墙之内完全自主。1356年的《金玺诏书》定纽伦堡为新当选皇帝首开帝国议会之地，1423年国王西吉斯蒙德又把帝国珍宝永久托付该城保存。1349年工匠反对城市贵族的起事失败后，行会被解散，名门望族独揽政权。1444年的纽伦堡是一座奉天主教的帝国城市，财富如日中天，商人经威尼斯与黎凡特贸易，与科隆、布拉格并称帝国最大的几座城市。

1470至1530年是纽伦堡的黄金时代：阿尔布雷希特·丢勒1471年出生于此，马丁·贝海姆1492年为城市制作了他的地球仪，印刷匠、锁匠和金银工匠的产品行销全欧，工匠歌手汉斯·萨克斯则代表了城市的文学生活。1525年纽伦堡接受宗教改革，1532年天主教徒与路德宗之间的《纽伦堡宗教和约》在此缔结。1552年，藩侯阿尔布雷希特·阿尔西比亚德斯不宣而战突袭此城，强迫城市接受苛刻的和约。1632年古斯塔夫·阿道夫以纽伦堡为对抗华伦斯坦的基地；城市虽未被攻破，三十年战争却使人口减少近半，1649年瑞典方面主持的和平盛宴在此庆祝《威斯特伐利亚和约》的落实。债台高筑的纽伦堡请求普鲁士保护未果，1806年莱茵邦联把这座老牌帝国城市交给巴伐利亚，由后者接下其1250万古尔登的公共债务。

en:
Memmingen grew up on the Iller, where the salt road from Bohemia, Austria and Munich toward Lindau met routes between northern Germany, Switzerland and Italy. First recorded as Mammingin in 1128, the Welf settlement was raised to a town in 1158 by Duke Welf VI. After the fall of the Hohenstaufen it reverted to the Empire, and in 1286 King Rudolf I made it a Free Imperial City. By 1444 its patrician families had grown rich on overland commerce, and the Catholic Swabian town stood behind walls, gates and churches as a self-governing member of the Holy Roman Empire.

The walls were enlarged for the last time in 1445, and in 1480 Albrecht Kunne opened a printing office that issued about 200 different works before 1520. The Reformation prevailed after the Memmingen Disputation in January 1525, and the Twelve Articles, attributed chiefly to Sebastian Lotzer and Christoph Schappeler, were drafted there in February and March during the Peasants' War; some 25,000 copies soon circulated. Memmingen became a Swedish base after 1632 in the Thirty Years' War, and an imperial army under Adrian von Enkevort besieged its Swedish garrison from September to November 1647. The old Free Imperial City passed to Bavaria in 1802.
zh:
梅明根兴起于伊勒河畔，波希米亚、奥地利和慕尼黑通往林道的盐路，在这里与北德、瑞士和意大利之间的道路交会。此地1128年首见于记载，时称马明金，1158年由韦尔夫公爵韦尔夫六世升格为城镇。霍亨斯陶芬家族绝嗣后，城市收归帝国，1286年国王鲁道夫一世将其确立为帝国自由城市。到1444年，城中的贵族世家已靠长途贸易致富；这座信奉天主教的施瓦本城市凭城墙、城门和教堂拱卫自身，是神圣罗马帝国中自治的一员。

1445年，梅明根最后一次扩建城墙；1480年，阿尔布雷希特·库讷在此开办印刷坊，到1520年前印行了约二百种不同著作。1525年1月梅明根辩论后，宗教改革在这里取得优势，同年2月至3月农民战争期间，主要由塞巴斯蒂安·洛策和克里斯托夫·沙佩勒执笔的《十二条款》在此写成，很快印行约二万五千份。三十年战争中，梅明根1632年后成为瑞典军队的基地；1647年9月至11月，阿德里安·冯·恩克沃特率领的帝国军队围攻瑞典守军。这座古老的帝国自由城市最终于1802年并入巴伐利亚。

en:
Dortmund, first mentioned in 882 as Throtmanni, grew up on the Hellweg, the old east-west road across Westphalia, around a Carolingian royal court; an imperial diet met there in 1016 and Frederick Barbarossa held a court assembly in the town in 1152. After the great fire of 1232 destroyed the town and its archives, Emperor Frederick II renewed its privileges in 1236 and for the first time called Dortmund an imperial city. Its merchants traded as far west as England from their position as chief town of the Rhine-Westphalian and Netherlands quarter of the Hanse, and in 1293 the city was granted a brewing right. In 1339 a consortium of its patricians, led by the Berswordt and Klepping families, even held the English crown in pledge for Edward III's debts. In 1388–89, in the Great Dortmund Feud, the city withstood an eighteen-month siege by the Count of Mark and the Archbishop of Cologne.
