Leeuwarden raised bastions and a moat in 1481-1494. In 1496 Franeker surprised Harlingen, and in 1498 Albert III of Saxony landed there to intervene for the Schieringers; he needed nine weeks to take Leeuwarden under Maximilian I's commission as governor. Saxon rights were sold in 1515 to the future Charles V, but Pier Gerlofs Donia led the peasant and mercenary Black Army of Arum until his death in 1520; Wijerd Jelckama and the last rebels were beheaded at Leeuwarden in 1523, and Charles formed the Lordship of Frisia in 1524. A short-lived bishopric followed in 1559. During the Dutch Revolt most of Friesland entered the Union of Utrecht in 1580, the year Leeuwarden's churches passed to Protestant worship; in 1581 it deposed Philip II. Franeker University opened in 1585, Leeuwarden minted Frisian coin until 1752, and the Frisian Admiralty moved to Harlingen in 1645, while the Peace of Münster confirmed the republic in 1648. The port shipped cattle and dairy produce to Holland and the Baltic while importing timber and grain. The old provincial order ended in 1798 during the French-backed revolutionary reorganization.
zh:
弗里斯兰是须德海与劳沃斯河之间一片由人工丘、排水牧场和瓦登海航道组成的低地。牛群和乳制品维系着市镇贸易，而「弗里斯兰自由」的传统使地方司法掌握在乡区共同体和富裕豪强手中，没有封建领主。吕伐登在中海边的人工丘上兴起；水道淤塞后，奥尔德霍弗、奈耶霍夫和胡克三个聚落在1435年1月21日合并，但其确切获得城市特权的年份已不可考。1234年获特许状的哈灵根则是渔业和航运门户。1444年，这片操弗里斯兰语的天主教土地在法理上没有领主，维特科佩尔与希林格两派却正把私斗升级为筑垒对抗。

1481至1494年，吕伐登修筑棱堡和护城河。1496年，弗拉讷克军队突袭哈灵根；1498年，萨克森的阿尔布雷希特三世在哈灵根登陆，支持希林格派，凭马克西米利安一世的总督委任费时九周攻下吕伐登。萨克森方面在1515年把权利售予后来的查理五世，但皮尔·格尔洛夫斯·多尼亚率领由农民和佣兵组成的阿鲁姆黑军继续作战，直到他1520年去世；副将维耶德·耶尔卡马与最后的叛军于1523年在吕伐登被斩首，查理五世次年设立弗里斯兰领地。1559年，这里又设立了存续不久的主教区。荷兰起义期间，弗里斯兰大部于1580年加入乌得勒支同盟，吕伐登教堂也在同年改归新教礼拜；1581年，弗里斯兰废黜腓力二世。弗拉讷克大学1585年创立，吕伐登造币厂铸造弗里斯兰钱币至1752年，弗里斯兰海军部1645年迁至哈灵根，明斯特和约则在1648年确认共和国地位。哈灵根向荷兰和波罗的海输出牲畜与乳制品，输入木材和谷物。旧省区体制最终在1798年法国支持的革命改组中终结。

en:
Genoa, 'La Superba', climbs from a deep natural harbour on the rocky Ligurian coast. Its sailors made the city in the Crusades, and in the thirteenth century its galleys fought Pisa and Venice for eastern trade: Pisa was broken at Meloria in 1284, while Chioggia ended in defeat in 1381. Genoese colonies ringed the eastern seas — Pera outside Constantinople, Caffa in the Crimea, Chios, alum-rich Phocaea, and Corsica, annexed in 1347. The first doge took office in 1339, but the feuding Adorno and Fregoso clans delivered Genoa to France and the Visconti of Milan. The Bank of Saint George, founded in 1407, ran much of the city's overseas finance. In 1444, under Doge Raffaele Adorno, Genoa was again an independent oligarchic republic, its harbour crowded with Black Sea shipping and its counting houses famed in Europe, yet its politics stayed violent and fragile.

In 1453 the Genoese captain Giovanni Giustiniani died defending Constantinople, where Genoa held the suburb of Pera; Ottoman expansion shut its shipping out of the Black Sea, and Caffa fell in 1475. The doge ceded Genoa to France in 1458; the republic returned in 1461, passed under Sforza rule for long stretches, and from 1499 to 1528 endured almost continuous French occupation, until Spanish troops sacked it on 30 May 1522. In 1528 Admiral Andrea Doria, allied with Emperor Charles V, drove out the French and gave Genoa a new oligarchic constitution of noble alberghi and two-year doges that brought stability. Genoese bankers then entered their golden age: after Philip II's default of 1557 they replaced the Fuggers as financiers of the Habsburg crown, and American silver from Seville paid for Ambrogio Spinola's armies in the Netherlands. Chios fell in 1566, yet Genoese fortunes raised the Strada Nuova's palaces. Plague killed perhaps half the city in 1656-57, and a French fleet bombarded it in 1684. A revolt led by the boy Balilla drove out an Austrian garrison in 1746, and in 1768 the exhausted republic ceded Corsica to France. Napoleon overthrew the oligarchy in June 1797 and set up the Ligurian Republic; the Austrian siege of 1800 starved 30,000 Genoese to death, and in 1805 France annexed the city. After a short-lived restoration in 1814, the Congress of Vienna gave Genoa to the Kingdom of Sardinia.
zh:
热那亚别称「雄城」，沿着利古里亚海岸岩石间的天然深水港铺展开来。它的水手在十字军东征中崛起，13世纪，热那亚舰队与比萨、威尼斯争夺东方贸易：1284年梅洛里亚海战击垮比萨，1379至1381年的基奥贾战争却以热那亚失败告终。尽管如此，热那亚人的殖民地环列东方海域——君士坦丁堡城下的佩拉、克里米亚的卡法、希俄斯岛、产明矾的福西亚，以及1347年正式兼并的科西嘉。1339年共和国设立首任终身总督，但阿多尔诺与弗雷戈索两大家族的仇杀使城市先后落入法兰西和米兰维斯孔蒂家族之手。1407年成立的圣乔治银行打理着城市的大部分海外金融。1444年，在总督拉斐尔·阿多尔诺治下，热那亚再次成为独立的寡头共和国：港内挤满来自黑海的商船，账房闻名全欧，政治却依旧凶险脆弱。

1453年，热那亚将领乔瓦尼·朱斯蒂尼亚尼战死于君士坦丁堡——热那亚人在那里据有郊区佩拉；奥斯曼的扩张把热那亚商船逐出黑海，卡法也于1475年陷落。1458年总督把共和国交给法兰西，1461年复国，此后又长期处在斯福尔扎家族治下，1499至1528年几乎一直被法军占领，1522年5月30日西班牙军队破城大肆劫掠。1528年，海军名将安德烈亚·多里亚与皇帝查理五世结盟，逐出法军，并以贵族宗族集团和两年一任的总督制建立新的寡头宪政，带来稳定。热那亚银行家随之进入黄金时代：1557年西班牙国王腓力二世赖债后，他们取代富格尔家族成为哈布斯堡王室的债主，来自塞维利亚的美洲白银资助了安布罗焦·斯皮诺拉在尼德兰指挥的大军。1566年希俄斯陷落，但热那亚的巨富仍建起新街上的连片宫殿。1656至1657年的瘟疫夺去约半数居民的性命，1684年法国舰队炮轰城市。1746年，少年巴利拉领导的起义赶走奥地利占领军；1768年，精疲力竭的共和国把科西嘉割让给法国。1797年6月，拿破仑推翻旧寡头政权，成立利古里亚共和国；1800年奥地利围城，三万热那亚人饿死，1805年城市被法国直接兼并。1814年共和国短暂复辟，旋即被维也纳会议判给撒丁王国。

en:
Nice was founded around 350 BC by Greeks of Marseille, who named it Nikaia after Nike, goddess of victory, and it grew into one of the busiest ports of the Ligurian coast. In the early Middle Ages it joined the Genoese league, repulsed the Saracens in 729 but was sacked by them in 859 and again in 880, and later warred against Genoa in alliance with Pisa while the counts of Provence reached for the city again and again. On 27 September 1388 the commune ended these disputes by placing itself under Amadeus VII of Savoy, the dedication that created the County of Nice and gave the Alpine counts their window on the Mediterranean. In 1444 Nice was a fortified Savoyard port, its garrisons watching for Barbary corsairs and its merchants handling the coastal trade between Provence and Genoa.

The Italian wars fell heavily on the city. In 1538 Pope Paul III mediated near Nice a ten-year truce between Francis I and Charles V, but in 1543 the Franco-Ottoman fleet of Francis and Barbarossa bombarded the city and forced its surrender: Nice was pillaged and 2,500 of its people were carried off. In 1561 Emmanuel Philibert made Italian the language of its administration; the Duke of Guise failed to seize it in 1600, and from 1626 the opening of the county's ports to all nations brought a commercial boom. French armies under Catinat took Nice in 1691 and besieged it again in 1705, demolishing its citadel and ramparts; the Treaty of Utrecht restored it to Savoy in 1713. In the 1740s French and Spanish armies ravaged its countryside in vain, and in 1775 Victor Amadeus III abolished its last communal liberties. Republican troops entered on 29 September 1792 and France annexed the county the following January; Giuseppe Garibaldi was born here in 1807, and the Treaty of Paris returned Nice to the Kingdom of Sardinia in 1814.
zh:
尼斯约在公元前350年由马赛的希腊人建立，以胜利女神尼刻命名为尼凯亚，后来成长为利古里亚海岸最繁忙的港口之一。中世纪早期它加入热那亚联盟，729年击退撒拉森人，却在859年和880年两度遭其焚掠；此后它与比萨结盟对抗热那亚，普罗旺斯伯爵则一再试图染指这座城市。1388年9月27日，尼斯公社以「献地」归附萨伏依伯爵阿梅迪奥七世，尼斯伯国由此诞生，阿尔卑斯山中的伯爵们也得到了面向地中海的窗口。1444年的尼斯是萨伏依治下的设防港口，守军防备着巴巴里海盗，商人经营着普罗旺斯与热那亚之间的沿海贸易。

意大利战争重重地压在这座城市身上。1538年，教宗保禄三世在尼斯附近为弗朗索瓦一世与查理五世调停，促成十年休战；1543年，法王与巴巴罗萨的法奥联合舰队炮轰尼斯并迫其投降，城市遭到洗劫，2500人被掳走。1561年，埃马努埃莱·菲利贝托下令以意大利语作为行政语言；1600年吉斯公爵夺城的图谋被击退，1626年起伯国各港对所有国家开放，贸易由此繁荣。1691年卡蒂纳率法军攻占尼斯，1705年法军再度围城并拆毁城堡与城墙，1713年乌得勒支和约把它归还萨伏依。1740年代法西军队蹂躏尼斯乡郊徒劳无功，1775年维托里奥·阿梅迪奥三世废除了残存的全部公社自由。1792年9月29日共和派法军入城，次年1月法国正式吞并尼斯伯国；朱塞佩·加里波第1807年出生于此，1814年巴黎和约把尼斯交还撒丁王国。

en:
Turin commands the upper Po valley where the road from Gaul crosses the Western Alps. Hannibal stormed the Taurini's chief town in 218 BC, and under Augustus the castrum of Augusta Taurinorum rose on its rectangular plan. The Arduinici counts and the Frankish kings held it in turn; the marriage of Adelaide of Susa into the House of Savoy opened the way for Savoyard rule, and in 1280 William VII of Montferrat ceded the city to Thomas III of Savoy. A cadet branch kept court at nearby Pinerolo until 1418, when Duke Amadeus VIII reunited Turin to his domains and seated his ducal council there; the university, the Studium, had opened in 1404. In 1444 Turin, a city of Savoyard palaces set among vineyards, was the chief town of Piedmont, though the dukes still kept their capital beyond the Alps at Chambéry.

French armies occupied Turin in 1536, and the Peace of Cateau-Cambrésis returned it to Savoy only in 1559; Emmanuel Philibert, victor of Saint-Quentin, made the city his capital in 1563, enlarged its walls and palaces, and brought the Holy Shroud from Chambéry to the cathedral in 1578. In 1706 a French army besieged Turin for 117 days until Prince Eugene of Savoy broke the siege on 7 September; the sapper Pietro Micca died in its defence, and Victor Amadeus II fulfilled his vow by raising Filippo Juvarra's Basilica of Superga on the hill above. The Treaty of Utrecht made the duke a king, and Turin became the capital of the Kingdom of Sardinia, rebuilt with baroque arcades and regular squares. In 1786 Antonio Benedetto Carpano invented sweet vermouth in a city wineshop, and it became the fashion of the court. French revolutionary troops entered in December 1798 and forced Charles Emmanuel IV to abdicate; Austro-Russian forces recovered the city briefly in 1799, Napoleon visited it after Marengo in 1800, and in 1802 Piedmont was annexed to France with Turin as chief town of the Po department. The House of Savoy returned in 1814.
zh:
都灵扼守波河上游，是高卢翻越西阿尔卑斯山大道的要冲。公元前218年汉尼拔攻破陶里尼人的主城，奥古斯都时代又在棋盘格路网的军寨上建起奥古斯塔-陶里诺鲁姆。此后阿尔杜伊尼奇伯爵与法兰克诸王先后据有此地；苏萨的阿德莱德嫁入萨伏依家族，为萨伏依入主铺路，1280年蒙费拉的古列尔莫七世将城市让给托马索三世·迪·萨伏依。家族一支在附近的皮内罗洛开府，直到1418年阿梅代奥八世把都灵收回直辖、设立公爵会议，而大学早在1404年便已开办。1444年的都灵遍布萨伏依王公的府邸，四周葡萄园环绕，已是皮埃蒙特的首城，只是公爵的都城仍在阿尔卑斯山那一侧的尚贝里。

1536年法军占领都灵，直到1559年卡托-康布雷齐和约才把它归还萨伏依；圣康坦一役的胜利者埃马努埃莱·菲利贝托1563年定都于此，着手扩建城墙与宫殿，并于1578年把圣裹尸布从尚贝里迎入都灵大教堂。1706年法军围城117天，萨伏依的欧根亲王于9月7日破围而进，工兵彼得罗·米卡在守城时殉难；维托里奥·阿梅代奥二世为践誓言，在城郊山丘上建起菲利波·尤瓦拉设计的苏佩尔加圣殿。乌得勒支和约使公爵跻身国王之列，都灵成为撒丁王国首都，城里陆续建起巴洛克式的拱廊与整齐的广场。1786年，安东尼奥·贝内德托·卡尔帕诺在城中酒铺创制甜味味美思，一时风行宫廷。1798年12月法国革命军入城，迫使卡洛·埃马努埃莱四世退位；1799年奥俄联军一度收复都灵，1800年拿破仑在马伦戈战役后亲临此地，1802年皮埃蒙特并入法国，都灵成为波省首府。1814年，萨伏依王朝重返都灵。

en:
Milan, the Roman Mediolanum on the Lombard plain, was destroyed by Frederick I Barbarossa in 1162 and rose again with the Lombard League's victory at Legnano in 1176, becoming one of Europe's richest cities, its wealth built on armour, cloth and the roads crossing the Po plain. The Visconti became its lords and then its dukes: Gian Galeazzo Visconti received the title of duke from King Wenceslaus in 1395, and the marble Duomo had been rising since 1386. His son Filippo Maria, duke from 1412, fought long wars against Venice, and the Peace of Cremona in 1441 gave his daughter Bianca Maria, with Cremona as her dowry, to the condottiero Francesco Sforza. In 1444 the ageing Filippo Maria, without a legitimate son, still ruled from the Castello di Porta Giovia, but the succession of the Visconti state was already in question.

When Filippo Maria died in 1447 the Milanese proclaimed the Ambrosian Republic, but three years of war with Venice drove them to accept Sforza, who entered the city as duke on 25 March 1450. The Peace of Lodi in 1454 opened decades of balance and prosperity: mulberry planting and silk processing spread, the Ospedale Maggiore was founded, and under Ludovico il Moro, Leonardo da Vinci painted The Last Supper at Santa Maria delle Grazie while Bramante worked in the city. The Italian Wars then tore the duchy apart: Louis XII of France took Milan in 1499, the Swiss restored Massimiliano Sforza in 1512, Francis I won it back at Marignano in 1515, and the imperial victory at Pavia in 1525 followed by the death of Francesco II Sforza in 1535 delivered Milan to Charles V and the Spanish Habsburgs. Spanish rule brought stagnation and the great plague of 1629-31, which killed some 60,000 of the city's 130,000 people. The Utrecht-Rastatt settlement of 1713-14 passed Milan to Austria, where enlightened reforms revived its silk industry, and the Teatro alla Scala opened in 1778. Napoleon made Milan capital first of the Cisalpine Republic in 1796 and then of his Kingdom of Italy, where he was crowned with the Iron Crown in 1805, until Austria returned in 1814-15 and the city became part of the Kingdom of Lombardy-Venetia.
zh:
米兰古称梅迪奥拉努姆，雄踞伦巴第平原；1162年被皇帝腓特烈一世（巴巴罗萨）摧毁，又随1176年伦巴第同盟在莱尼亚诺的胜利而复兴，成长为欧洲最富庶的城市之一，靠铠甲、呢绒和波河平原上四通八达的商路致富。维斯孔蒂家族先成为城市领主，再晋封公爵：1395年，吉安·加莱亚佐·维斯孔蒂从文策尔国王手中取得公爵头衔，而大理石建造的米兰大教堂早在1386年就已动工。他的儿子菲利波·马里亚1412年继位，与威尼斯连年交战；1441年的《克雷莫纳和约》把女儿比安卡·马里亚连同嫁妆克雷莫纳城许给雇佣兵首领弗朗切斯科·斯福尔扎。1444年，年迈而无嫡子的菲利波·马里亚仍在焦维亚门城堡主政，但维斯孔蒂国家的继承问题已然浮现。

1447年菲利波·马里亚去世，米兰人宣布成立安布罗焦共和国，但与威尼斯交战三年后，只得迎立斯福尔扎；1450年3月25日，弗朗切斯科以公爵身份入城。1454年的《洛迪和约》开启了数十年的均势与繁荣：桑树种植和丝织业推广开来，马焦雷医院得以创办，在卢多维科·斯福尔扎（「摩尔人」）治下，列奥纳多·达·芬奇在感恩圣母堂画出《最后的晚餐》，伯拉孟特也在城中留下作品。随后的意大利战争把公国撕得粉碎：法兰西国王路易十二1499年夺取米兰，瑞士人1512年扶立马西米利亚诺·斯福尔扎，弗朗索瓦一世1515年在马里尼亚诺取胜后将其夺回；1525年帝国军队在帕维亚大胜，1535年弗朗切斯科二世·斯福尔扎去世，米兰落入查理五世与西班牙哈布斯堡王朝之手。西班牙统治带来停滞，以及1629至1631年的大瘟疫——全城十三万人中约六万丧生。1713至1714年的乌得勒支—拉施塔特和约把米兰转归奥地利，开明改革重振了丝织业，斯卡拉歌剧院于1778年开幕。1796年，拿破仑以米兰为奇萨尔皮尼共和国首都，1805年又在此戴上铁王冠加冕，立其为意大利王国首都；1814至1815年奥地利卷土重来，米兰成为伦巴第-威尼托王国的一部分。

en:
Parma sits on the small Parma stream where the Via Aemilia crosses the western Po plain. The Romans founded a colony here in 183 BC with Mutina, and the medieval town became a Lombard ducal seat, then a bishop-ruled city and a free commune around 1140. Milan took control in 1341; after the Terzi signoria of 1404-1409, Visconti and then Sforza patronage bound Parma's feudal families to Milan. Water meadows north of the city fattened cattle for the hard cheese made in Parma and Reggio monasteries by the 12th-13th centuries, while local pigs supplied salted hams. In 1444 Parma was a Catholic market town under Milanese lordship, its roads and livestock trade tied to the Po and the Via Francigena.

Louis XII's invasion of 1499 pulled Parma into the Italian Wars, and French, papal and Sforza claims repeatedly changed its ruler until the Papal States took the territories south of the Po in 1521. On 17 August 1545 Pope Paul III erected the Duchy of Parma for his son Pier Luigi Farnese; Piacenza was joined to it in 1556. The Farnese made the small capital a court center, building the citadel, the Pilotta complex from 1602 and later the Teatro Farnese, though plague struck in 1630. When the male Farnese line died out in 1731 the duchy passed to Charles of Bourbon, then to Austria in 1735 and back to a Bourbon cadet line under Philip by the 1748 Treaty of Aix-la-Chapelle. French troops arrived in 1796; French sovereignty followed in 1802, and from 1808 Parma was capital of the French Department of the Taro. The duchy was restored after Napoleon's fall and assigned by the 1815 Congress of Vienna to Marie Louise of Austria.
zh:
帕尔马位于波河平原西部，帕尔马小河与艾米利亚大道在此相交。公元前183年，罗马人与穆提那一同在此设立殖民地；中世纪时，这里成为伦巴第人的公爵驻地，后又成为主教伯爵治下的城市，并在1140年前后成为自由公社。米兰于1341年取得帕尔马；1404—1409年泰尔齐家族曾短暂统治，此后维斯孔蒂及斯福尔扎的庇护关系把当地封建家族绑在米兰势力周围。12至13世纪，城北水草丰美的牧场饲养牛群，帕尔马和雷焦的修道院一带发展出硬质奶酪，本地猪群则供应盐腌火腿。1444年，帕尔马是米兰统治下的天主教集镇，名义上仍在神圣罗马帝国范围内，道路和牲畜贸易连接着波河与法兰契杰纳大道。

1499年路易十二入侵，把帕尔马卷入意大利战争，法国、教廷和斯福尔扎的宣称使其反复易主，直到1521年教皇国取得波河以南领地。1545年8月17日，教皇保罗三世为其子皮耶尔·路易吉·法尔内塞设立帕尔马公国，1556年皮亚琴察并入。法尔内塞家族把这座小都城建成宫廷中心，修筑城堡，1602年起兴建皮洛塔宫群，后来又建造法尔内塞剧院；1630年鼠疫曾重创此地。1731年法尔内塞男系断绝，公国传给卡洛斯·德·波旁，1735年转归奥地利，1748年《亚琛和约》又把它交给波旁支系的费利佩。法国军队1796年抵达，1802年主权转入法国，1808年起帕尔马成为法国塔罗省省会。拿破仑失败后公国恢复，1815年维也纳会议将其交给奥地利的玛丽·路易丝。

en:
Modena, the Roman Mutina, lies on the Via Aemilia in the southern plain of the Po. Planted as a Roman colony in 183 BC, it was ruined by floods in the 7th century and rebuilt and fortified by its bishop towards the end of the 9th. Its citizens joined the Lombard League in 1167, and in 1288 feuding among the noble houses led the commune to accept Obizzo II d'Este as its lord; after a short communal revival the Este held the city permanently from 1336. The cathedral, begun in 1099 and consecrated in 1184, rose with its Ghirlandina tower over the market squares, and a university had opened as early as 1175. In 1444 Modena was an imperial fief governed from Ferrara by the Marquis Leonello d'Este, set amid the pastures and cattle herds of the Po plain.

In 1452 Borso d'Este, who had succeeded Leonello, was created Duke of Modena and Reggio by the Emperor Frederick III. The court remained at Ferrara until Pope Clement VIII refused Cesare d'Este the succession there, and in January 1598 the Este capital was moved to Modena. Francesco I began the Ducal Palace in 1632, and Francesco II refounded the university in 1686. In 1700 Duke Rinaldo made Lodovico Muratori his ducal librarian, and the Biblioteca Estense was opened to the public in 1761. French troops entered Modena in 1702 during the War of the Spanish Succession, and imperial forces restored Rinaldo in 1707. In 1746 the indebted Francesco III sold a hundred of the Este gallery's finest paintings to the king of Poland and elector of Saxony, and they were carried off to Dresden. Napoleon's army arrived in 1796, Ercole III fled, and delegates of Modena, Reggio, Bologna and Ferrara met in the city to form the Cispadane Republic, merged into the Cisalpine Republic in 1797. The Congress of Vienna restored the duchy in 1814 under Francesco IV of Austria-Este.
zh:
摩德纳古称穆蒂纳，位于波河南岸平原的艾米利亚大道上。公元前183年罗马在此设立殖民地，7世纪城市毁于洪水，9世纪末由主教重建并修筑城墙。1167年市民加入伦巴第同盟；1288年贵族家族间的争斗使公社接受奥比佐二世·埃斯特为领主，共和短暂恢复后，埃斯特家族自1336年起稳固统治此地。1099年动工、1184年祝圣的主教座堂与吉兰迪纳钟楼耸立在集市广场之上，大学更早在1175年即已创办。1444年的摩德纳是一处帝国采邑，由驻跸费拉拉的侯爵莱昂内洛·埃斯特统辖，四乡是波河平原牧场连绵、牛群成群的农牧之地。

1452年，继莱昂内洛而立的博尔索·埃斯特被皇帝腓特烈三世封为摩德纳与雷焦公爵。宫廷长居费拉拉，直到教皇克雷芒八世不承认切萨雷·埃斯特对费拉拉的继承权，1598年1月埃斯特宫廷把首都迁到摩德纳。弗朗切斯科一世1632年动工兴建公爵宫，弗朗切斯科二世1686年重振大学。1700年，里纳尔多公爵聘卢多维科·穆拉托里为公爵图书馆长，埃斯特图书馆1761年向公众开放。西班牙王位继承战争中，法军1702年开入摩德纳，帝国军队1707年助里纳尔多复位。1746年，债台高筑的弗朗切斯科三世把公爵画廊中百幅名画卖给波兰国王兼萨克森选帝侯，画作从此被运往德累斯顿。1796年拿破仑大军抵达，埃尔科莱三世出逃，摩德纳、雷焦、博洛尼亚和费拉拉的代表在城中集会，成立奇斯帕达纳共和国，1797年并入奇萨尔皮尼共和国。维也纳会议后，公国于1814年复辟，归属奥地利-埃斯特家族的弗朗切斯科四世。

en:
Brescia, the Roman Brixia, lies at the foot of the Alps between lakes Garda and Iseo, on the Mella river. A Lombard ducal seat and then a free commune, it endured a six-month siege by Emperor Henry VII in 1311 and passed in turn under the Scaligeri, the Visconti and Pandolfo Malatesta, who ceded it to Filippo Maria Visconti in 1416. In 1426 the city surrendered to Venice, whose mercenaries under Carmagnola beat the Milanese at Maclodio in 1427; when Piccinino's army invested it in 1438 the Brescians held firm, and the Senate hailed their city as Brixia fidelis, worthy bride of the Lion. In 1444 Brescia was one of the richest cities of the Venetian Terraferma, guarding the roads down from Trent.

From about 1490 its workshops led Italy in making viols and the earliest instruments called violins. During the Italian Wars the city admitted a Venetian garrison and rose against the French, and on 18 February 1512 Gaston de Foix's troops stormed it in a rainstorm and sacked it for five days; thousands died, and Brescia never quite recovered. The French held it until 1520, when it returned to Venice for nearly three centuries. In 1769 lightning fired a powder store in the San Nazaro bastion, and ninety tonnes of gunpowder exploded, killing some 3,000 people and destroying a sixth of the city. Napoleon ended Venetian rule in 1797; an allied army took the fortress in 1799, and in 1815 Brescia passed to Austrian Lombardy–Venetia.
zh:
布雷西亚古称布里克西亚，位于阿尔卑斯山麓、加尔达湖与伊塞奥湖之间，梅拉河穿城而过。它曾是伦巴第人的公爵驻地，后来成为自由公社，1311年顶住皇帝亨利七世长达六个月的围攻，此后先后落入斯卡利杰家族、维斯孔蒂家族和潘多尔福·马拉泰斯塔之手，后者于1416年把它让给菲利波·马里亚·维斯孔蒂。1426年布雷西亚归顺威尼斯，1427年卡尔马尼奥拉率领威尼斯雇佣军在马克洛迪奥击败米兰军队；1438年皮奇尼诺的军队围城，布雷西亚人坚守不降，威尼斯元老院赐城「忠诚的布里克西亚」之名，称它为「雄狮当之无愧的新娘」。1444年的布雷西亚是威尼斯陆上领地最富庶的城市之一，扼守从特伦托南下的道路。

约从1490年起，这里的工匠在维奥尔琴及最早一批小提琴的制作上冠绝意大利。意大利战争期间，布雷西亚引入威尼斯驻军、起兵对抗法国人，1512年2月18日加斯东·德·富瓦的军队冒雨强攻得手，随后五天大肆劫掠，数千人丧命，布雷西亚再未完全恢复。法国占据该城直到1520年，此后它重归威尼斯近三百年。1769年，雷电引爆圣纳扎罗棱堡中的火药库，九十吨火药殉爆，约三千人罹难，六分之一的城区被毁。1797年拿破仑终结威尼斯的统治，1799年反法联军攻陷城塞，1815年布雷西亚并入奥地利治下的伦巴第-威尼托。

en:
Verona guards the Adige where the river breaks out of the Alps into the Lombard plain, a meeting of roads since the Roman colony of 89 BC and home to the great amphitheatre known as the Arena. It was a Lombard and then a Frankish royal seat before becoming a free commune in 1135, first of the Veronese League and then of the Lombard League that checked Frederick Barbarossa. Ezzelino da Romano made himself tyrant in 1226, and after him the della Scala family held the city; under Cangrande I (1308–1329), host and patron of the exiled Dante, Verona ruled from Treviso to Padua and girdled itself with new walls and the brick Castelvecchio. The Scaligeri fell to the Visconti in 1387, and after a brief Carrarese interlude the Veronese opened their gates to Venice on 22 June 1405. Thus in 1444 Verona is the greatest city of the Venetian mainland, governed for the Republic by a podestà, its river trade and grainlands protected by Venetian arms and diplomacy.

When the League of Cambrai crushed Venice at Agnadello in 1509, Verona passed to the Emperor Maximilian, and only the Treaty of Brussels in 1516 restored the city to the Republic. Plague struck in 1630–1631 and carried off some 33,000 people, more than three fifths of the population. Venetian rule lasted until 1797: Napoleon's troops occupied the city, and on Easter Monday the townspeople rose in the Pasque Veronesi and drove the French garrison into its castles, but the revolt was crushed within days and the Venetian Republic itself extinguished; the Treaty of Campo Formio gave Verona to Austria, which took possession in January 1798. The Treaty of Pressburg in 1805 transferred it to Napoleon's Kingdom of Italy, and in 1814 it returned to Austria, whose military engineers rebuilt it as the strongest of the four fortresses of the Quadrilatero guarding Lombardy–Venetia.
zh:
维罗纳据守阿迪杰河冲出阿尔卑斯山、进入伦巴第平原的要口，自公元前89年罗马殖民建城起便是道路交汇之地，宏伟的古罗马竞技场便坐落城中。它先后是伦巴第人和法兰克人的王都，1135年成为自由市镇，先加入维罗纳联盟，后并入伦巴第联盟，共同抵御红胡子腓特烈。1226年埃泽利诺·达·罗马诺建立僭主统治，其后德拉·斯卡拉家族执政；在坎格兰德一世（1308—1329年）治下——他曾收留并庇护流亡的但丁——维罗纳的势力从特雷维索伸展到帕多瓦，新城墙和红砖砌成的老城堡也在此时筑起。1387年斯卡拉家族败于维斯孔蒂家族，卡拉雷西家族又短暂据城，1405年6月22日，维罗纳人开城归附威尼斯。因此在1444年，维罗纳是威尼斯大陆领地中最大的城市，由共和国委派的波德斯塔治理，河上贸易和四郊粮田受威尼斯的武力与外交庇护。

1509年康布雷同盟在阿尼亚代洛击溃威尼斯，维罗纳转归皇帝马克西米利安，直到1516年布鲁塞尔和约才把城市归还共和国。1630至1631年鼠疫袭来，约3.3万人病死，占当时全城人口五分之三以上。威尼斯的统治一直延续到1797年：拿破仑的军队占领城市后，复活节星期一市民发动「维罗纳复活节」起义，把法国守军赶进城堡，但起义数日内即遭镇压，威尼斯共和国本身也随之灭亡；坎波福尔米奥条约将维罗纳划给奥地利，奥军于1798年1月入城。1805年普雷斯堡条约又把它转交拿破仑的意大利王国，1814年复归奥地利，奥军工兵随后把它营建为拱卫伦巴第-威尼托的「四边形」四大要塞中最坚固的一座。

en:
Mantua rises from the marshes of the Mincio, the river that carries the waters of Lake Garda to the Po, ringed by artificial lakes dug in the 12th century for its defence. It was an Etruscan and then a Roman town, and the poet Virgil was born in the nearby countryside in 70 BC. After the age of Countess Matilda of Canossa it was a free commune until the Bonacolsi seized the signoria in 1273; on 16 August 1328 Luigi Gonzaga, backed by the Scaliger of Verona, overthrew the last Bonacolsi and opened nearly four centuries of Gonzaga rule. Gianfrancesco Gonzaga brought the humanist Vittorino da Feltre to run his Casa Giocosa school in 1423, and in 1433 he bought the title of marquis from the Emperor Sigismund for 120,000 florins. He died in 1444, leaving to his son Ludovico III, husband of Barbara of Brandenburg, a small but rich condottiere state whose court already drew scholars and painters.

Pope Pius II held the Council of Mantua here in 1459 to preach a crusade against the Turks, Andrea Mantegna spent decades as court painter, and Isabella d'Este, who married Francesco II in 1490, made her studiolo one of the wonders of Renaissance collecting. Charles V made Federico II the first duke in 1530, and Giulio Romano built the frescoed Palazzo Te for him; Monteverdi's L'Orfeo, one of the earliest operas ever written, was staged at court in 1607. The Gonzaga main line died out in 1627, the War of the Mantuan Succession followed, and in 1630 Imperial troops sacked the city and brought the plague. Imperial troops took possession in 1707 and the transfer was confirmed when the last Gonzaga duke died in 1708, after which Austria rebuilt Mantua as a fortress and academy town, seat of a Royal Academy of Sciences and Arts. Napoleon's army besieged it from June 1796 and forced its surrender in February 1797 after the Battle of Castiglione; the Austrians retook it in 1799, and in 1810 Andreas Hofer, leader of the Tyrolean rising, was shot at the Porta Giulia. Restored to Austria in 1814, Mantua became one of the four fortresses of the Quadrilatero.
zh:
曼图亚崛起于明乔河下游的沼泽之间——这条河把加尔达湖的湖水送入波河，12世纪开挖的人工湖三面环城，充当城防。这里先后是埃特鲁里亚人和罗马人的城镇，公元前70年诗人维吉尔出生在附近乡间。卡诺莎的玛蒂尔达女伯爵时代之后，曼图亚成为自由市镇，1273年博纳科尔西家族夺得领主之位；1328年8月16日，路易吉·贡扎加借维罗纳斯卡利杰家族之力推翻末代博纳科尔西，开启贡扎加家族近四百年的统治。詹弗朗切斯科·贡扎加1423年请来人文主义者维多里诺·达·费尔特雷主持名为「欢乐之家」的学校，1433年又以12万弗罗林金币从皇帝西吉斯蒙德手中购得侯爵头衔。他1444年去世，把一个狭小而富庶的雇佣军国家留给儿子卢多维科三世——新侯爵迎娶了勃兰登堡的芭芭拉，而曼图亚宫廷此时已开始吸引学者与画家。

1459年，教皇庇护二世在此召开曼图亚会议，鼓吹对土耳其人的十字军；安德烈亚·曼特尼亚在此做了数十年宫廷画家；1490年嫁给弗朗切斯科二世的伊莎贝拉·德·埃斯特，把自己的书房经营成文艺复兴收藏的一大奇观。1530年查理五世封费代里科二世为首任公爵，朱利奥·罗马诺为他建起满布壁画的得特宫；1607年，蒙特威尔第的《奥菲欧》在曼图亚宫廷首演，这是最早的歌剧作品之一。1627年贡扎加嫡系绝嗣，随后爆发曼图亚继承战争，1630年帝国军队洗劫城市并带来瘟疫。1707年帝国军队接管曼图亚，末代贡扎加公爵1708年死去，易主就此敲定，奥地利随后把它重建成要塞和学术之城，设立了皇家科学与艺术学院。拿破仑的军队1796年6月围城，卡斯蒂廖内战役之后于1797年2月迫使城市投降；1799年奥地利人一度夺回，1810年，蒂罗尔起义领袖安德烈亚斯·霍费尔在朱利亚门外被枪决。1814年曼图亚复归奥地利，成为「四边形」要塞群的四大堡垒之一。

en:
The Trentino is the valley of the upper Adige, where the Brenner road descends from the Alps into Italy. In 1027 Emperor Conrad II created the Prince-Bishopric of Trent, an ecclesiastical state of the Empire, putting a loyal bishop rather than a restive secular lord in charge of the passage. Around 1200 Bishop Federico Wanga ringed the city with walls, began the cathedral and issued the Alps' first mining statute for the silver dug at Monte Calisio. The counts of Tyrol nevertheless engrossed the bishopric's Vogtei, and after Margaret Maultasch bequeathed Tyrol to the Habsburgs in 1363 Austrian weight grew steadily. The citizens' revolt of 1407 under Rodolfo Belenzani was bloodily crushed, and when Trento rose again in 1435 Austro-Tyrolean troops marched in. In 1444 the small Italian-speaking principality, its wealth in Adige tolls, wine and the silver of Monte Calisio, kept only a wary autonomy within the Habsburg orbit; in June of that year its bishop, the Piast prince Alexander of Masovia, died after nearly twenty years on the see.

In 1487, near Calliano, the small army of the bishopric and Tyrol routed a much larger Venetian force and killed its commander Roberto di Sanseverino, ending Venice's push up the Adige. The reforming cardinal Bernardo Clesio, bishop from 1514, rebuilt Trento as a Renaissance city and kept the friendship of Erasmus; he also helped crush the great peasant rising of 1525-26 under Michael Gaismair. Clesio's new churches and lodgings served the city when the Council of Trent met there in three sessions between 1545 and 1563, defining the Catholic answer to the Reformation. His successor Cristoforo Madruzzo presided over the council's later years, but in 1567 Emperor Ferdinand I occupied Rovereto and annulled the old confederation, which the Imperial Diet only restored in 1578. In November 1796 an Austrian corps defeated the French at Calliano, yet the old bishopric was secularised and merged into Tyrol in 1803; under Napoleon Trento passed to Bavaria in 1805 and to the Kingdom of Italy in 1810, before the Congress of Vienna returned the Trentino to Austria in 1814.
zh:
特伦蒂诺地处阿迪杰河上游谷地，布伦纳大道正是从这里出阿尔卑斯山进入意大利。1027年，皇帝康拉德二世设立特伦托采邑主教区这个帝国教会邦，把山口通道交给一位效忠皇帝的主教，而非桀骜的世俗诸侯。1200年前后，主教费代里科·万加为城市筑起城墙、开工修建大教堂，并为开采蒙特卡利西奥银矿颁布了阿尔卑斯最早的矿业章程。尽管如此，蒂罗尔伯爵仍逐步攫取了主教区的护佑之权；1363年玛格丽特·毛尔塔施把蒂罗尔遗赠给哈布斯堡家族后，奥地利的压力更是日甚一日。1407年市民在罗多尔福·贝伦扎尼率领下起义，旋即遭血腥镇压；1435年特伦托再度起事，奥地利-蒂罗尔军队直接开入境内。1444年，这个讲意大利语的小小教会国靠着阿迪杰河的商税、葡萄酒和蒙特卡利西奥的白银，在哈布斯堡的势力范围内维持着警惕的自治；同年6月，出身皮雅斯特家族的主教马佐夫舍的亚历山大在任近二十年后去世。

1487年，在卡利亚诺附近，主教区与蒂罗尔的联军以少胜多，击溃威尼斯大军，阵斩其统帅罗贝尔托·迪·圣塞韦里诺，终结了威尼斯沿阿迪杰河北上的扩张。锐意革新的枢机主教贝尔纳多·克莱肖自1514年出掌主教区，把特伦托改造成文艺复兴式城市，并与伊拉斯谟交好；1525至1526年，他还参与镇压了米夏埃尔·盖斯迈尔领导的农民大起义。他兴建的新教堂和馆舍后来派上大用场：1545至1563年，特伦托公会议分三个阶段在此召开，为天主教定下回应宗教改革的纲领。继任主教克里斯托福罗·马德鲁佐主持了公会议的后期会议；但1567年皇帝斐迪南一世进占罗韦雷托、废除旧同盟，直到1578年帝国议会才恢复主教的宗主权。1796年11月，奥地利军队在卡利亚诺击败法军，但老主教区仍于1803年被世俗化并并入蒂罗尔；拿破仑时代，特伦托于1805年归巴伐利亚，1810年转入意大利王国，最终在1814年经维也纳会议回归奥地利。

en:
Friuli stretches from the Carnic Alps and the Tagliamento plain to the Adriatic lagoons of Marano and Grado, with Udine at its centre. Roman Aquileia was one of Italy's greatest cities until Attila destroyed it in 452, after which the Lombards made Cividale the seat of their first Italian duchy. In 1077 the emperors granted temporal power to the Patriarch of Aquileia, whose estates developed their own parliament and laws. The patriarch took up residence at Udine in 1222, and Venetian troops conquered the city on 7 June 1420. In 1444 Friuli was Venice's eastern mainland march, ruled through Udine, its old nobility and the surviving Friulian parliament.

Ottoman raiders struck the Venetian borderland in 1477, 1478 and again in 1499, carrying off plunder and captives. In February 1511 factional fighting known as the Crudel Zobia Grassa spread through Udine and Friuli; earthquake, fire and plague followed within months. To secure the frontier after further wars with Austria and the Ottomans, Venice founded the nine-pointed star fortress of Palmanova on 7 October 1593. The old Friulian parliament survived until Venetian rule collapsed in 1797. After a brief Austrian interval, Napoleonic France absorbed Friuli into the Kingdom of Italy in 1805, the year the historic parliament held its last meeting; in 1815 the Congress of Vienna placed the region in Austrian Lombardy-Venetia.
zh:
弗留利北起卡尼克阿尔卑斯山，跨过塔利亚门托河平原，南至马拉诺和格拉多的亚得里亚海潟湖，中心是乌迪内。罗马时代的阿奎莱亚曾是意大利最宏伟的城市之一，452年被阿提拉摧毁；此后伦巴第人以奇维达莱为他们在意大利的首个公国都城。1077年，皇帝把世俗权力授予阿奎莱亚牧首，这片领地逐渐发展出自己的议会和法律。1222年，牧首移驻乌迪内；1420年6月7日，威尼斯军队攻占该城。1444年的弗留利是威尼斯在大陆东部的边疆，由乌迪内、旧贵族和保留下来的弗留利议会共同治理。

1477年、1478年以及1499年，奥斯曼袭掠者多次攻入这片威尼斯边地，劫走财物和人口。1511年2月，被称为「残酷胖星期四」的家族仇杀从乌迪内蔓延到整个弗留利，数月之内又接连发生地震、火灾和瘟疫。在与奥地利和奥斯曼的战争之后，为巩固边境，威尼斯于1593年10月7日建立九角星形要塞帕尔马诺瓦。旧弗留利议会一直延续到1797年威尼斯统治崩溃。经过短暂的奥地利过渡期，拿破仑的法国在1805年把弗留利并入意大利王国，历史悠久的议会也在这一年召开最后一次会议；1815年维也纳会议将这一地区划归奥地利治下的伦巴第-威尼托王国。

en:
Venice rises from the lagoon between the mouths of the Brenta and the Sile, 126 islands raised on alder piles driven into the mud and settled from the 5th century by refugees from the ruined Roman cities of the mainland. Under its elected doges it grew into the greatest of the maritime republics: the Arsenal built galleys like a factory, the gold ducat was the coin of Mediterranean trade, and the Rialto was the market where the spices, silk and grain of the East changed hands for European metals and wool. After the Fourth Crusade of 1204 Venice shared in the sack of Constantinople and carried off the bronze horses set above St Mark's, and in 1291 its glass furnaces were concentrated on Murano, its mirrors and beads a craft guarded like state secrets. By 1444 the Republic had pushed across the mainland to the Adda, holding Verona, Padua, Brescia and Bergamo; Doge Francesco Foscari, elected in 1423, still ruled from the Ducal Palace, and Venice was perhaps the richest city in Christendom.

The fall of Constantinople in 1453 opened a century of Ottoman wars, and Vasco da Gama's voyage of 1497–1499 drew the spice trade around Africa away from the Rialto. Already Europe's printing capital, Venice saw Aldus Manutius issue pocket editions of the Greek and Latin classics from the 1490s. In 1509 the League of Cambrai crushed the Republic at Agnadello, yet Andrea Gritti retook Padua within weeks and diplomacy restored the mainland state. Cyprus, acquired in 1489, fell to the Turks in 1571; the galleys of the Holy League, many of them Venetian, won Lepanto the same year but could not save the island. Plague killed 50,000 people in 1575–1577 and a third of the city's 150,000 in 1630, but the Serenissima defied Rome itself when Paolo Sarpi guided it through the papal interdict of 1606. The Treaty of Passarowitz in 1718 cost it the Morea, and by 1792 its merchant fleet had dwindled to 309 sail. On 12 May 1797 the Great Council bowed to Napoleon and the last doge, Ludovico Manin, ended the thousand-year republic; Campo Formio gave Venice to Austria in 1798, the Treaty of Pressburg assigned it to Napoleon's Kingdom of Italy in 1806, and in 1814 it returned to Austria as part of Lombardy–Venetia.
zh:
威尼斯崛起于布伦塔河与西莱河河口之间的潟湖之上——126座小岛靠打入黏土层的赤杨木桩从沼泽中托起，5世纪以降，大陆罗马诸城沦陷后的难民陆续来此栖身。在选举产生的公爵治下，它发展为最强大的海上共和国：兵工厂像工厂一样成批建造桨帆船，金杜卡特是地中海贸易的硬通货，里亚尔托市场上，东方的香料、丝绸和谷物换走欧洲的金属与呢绒。1204年第四次十字军东征中，威尼斯参与洗劫君士坦丁堡，把铜驷马带回置于圣马可教堂门楣之上；1291年，全城玻璃作坊奉命迁往穆拉诺岛，那里出产的镜子和玻璃珠成为守护最严的工艺秘密。到1444年，共和国的大陆领地已推进到阿达河畔，维罗纳、帕多瓦、布雷西亚和贝加莫尽入版图；1423年当选的公爵弗朗切斯科·福斯卡里仍在公爵宫秉政，威尼斯或许是当时基督教世界最富庶的城市。

1453年君士坦丁堡陷落，开启了长达一个多世纪的奥斯曼战争；1497至1499年瓦斯科·达·伽马的远航使香料贸易绕好望角而行，里亚尔托的命脉随之动摇。此时威尼斯已是欧洲印刷之都，1490年代起，阿尔多·马努齐奥的阿尔多印社把希腊和拉丁典籍装进可系于马鞍的小开本。1509年康布雷同盟在阿尼亚代洛大败共和国，安德烈亚·格里蒂却在数周内收复帕多瓦，外交手腕又让大陆领地失而复得。1489年取得的塞浦路斯1571年沦入土耳其人之手；同年，以威尼斯桨帆船为主力的神圣同盟舰队赢得勒班陀海战，却救不回塞浦路斯。1575至1577年瘟疫夺命5万，1630年又有全城15万人中的三分之一病死；而在保罗·萨尔皮辅佐下，共和国硬顶过了1606年教皇的绝罚禁令。1718年帕萨罗维茨和约使它失去摩里亚，到1792年商船队仅余309艘。1797年5月12日，在拿破仑的兵锋下大议会被迫解散，末代公爵卢多维科·马宁亲手终结了千年共和国；坎波福尔米奥条约1798年把威尼斯交给奥地利，1806年普雷斯堡条约又将它划入拿破仑的意大利王国，1814年它作为伦巴第-威尼托的一部分重归奥地利。

en:
Ferrara stands on a branch of the Po, amid the waterlogged marshes that stretch towards the Adriatic. The Lombards took it in 753 and the Franks soon granted it to the Papacy, but after a century as a free commune it fell to the Este: in 1264 Obizzo II was proclaimed its lifelong lord, and his house ruled until 1598. The moated Este Castle was begun in 1385, the cathedral had been consecrated in 1135, and a university opened in 1391. From January 1438 the city hosted the great council seeking union with the Greek Church, until plague drove it to Florence. In 1444 the young Marquis Leonello d'Este kept one of Italy's most polished courts, schooled by Guarino da Verona, while the Comacchio lagoons yielded salt for the ducal treasury.

Borso d'Este, already Duke of Modena from 1452, was enfeoffed as Duke of Ferrara by Pope Paul II in 1471. Ercole I's expansion of the Comacchio saltworks angered Venice, which declared war in 1482; the Peace of Bagnolo in 1484 kept Ferrara with the Este but cost it Rovigo and the Polesine. In 1492 Ercole commissioned Biagio Rossetti's Erculean Addition, doubling the walled city on a grid of broad streets and palaces. Ariosto and Tasso wrote at the Este court, and Alfonso I, husband of Lucrezia Borgia, cast artillery that routed a papal and Spanish army at Ravenna in 1512. A great earthquake shook the city in 1570, and when Alfonso II died without heirs in 1597 Pope Clement VIII seized the fief; in 1598 the court departed for Modena and Ferrara became a quiet papal frontier town, its Jews confined to a ghetto and a papal citadel raised over demolished quarters. Napoleon's campaign of 1796 swept away papal rule; Ferrara passed through the Cispadane and Cisalpine republics into the Napoleonic Kingdom of Italy, until Austrian troops returned it to the Papal States in 1815.
zh:
费拉拉坐落在波河一条岔流之畔，四野是伸向亚得里亚海的沼泽湿地。753年伦巴第人夺取此城，法兰克人随即将它赠予教皇；经历一个世纪的公社自治后，城市落入埃斯特家族之手：1264年奥比佐二世被拥戴为终身领主，其家族的统治一直延续到1598年。环壕的埃斯特城堡1385年动工，主教座堂1135年祝圣，大学创办于1391年。1438年1月起，谋求与希腊教会合一的大公会议在此召开，直到瘟疫迫其迁往佛罗伦萨。1444年，年轻的侯爵莱昂内洛·埃斯特师从瓜里诺·达·维罗纳，拥有意大利最风雅的宫廷之一，科马基奥潟湖出产的食盐充实着公爵府库。

博尔索·埃斯特1452年已受封摩德纳公爵，1471年又被教皇保罗二世册封为费拉拉公爵。埃尔科莱一世扩建科马基奥盐场，激怒威尼斯，1482年招来战祸；1484年的巴尼奥洛和约虽让费拉拉留在埃斯特家族手中，却迫使它割让罗维戈与波莱西内。1492年，埃尔科莱命比亚焦·罗塞蒂主持「埃尔科莱亚扩建区」，以宽阔街道与宫殿组成的规整格局把城墙内的城区扩大一倍。阿里奥斯托与塔索在埃斯特宫廷写作；阿方索一世是卢克雷齐娅·博尔贾的丈夫，他的铸炮厂造出的火炮1512年在拉文纳击溃教皇与西班牙联军。1570年大地震重创城市；1597年阿方索二世无嗣而终，教皇克雷芒八世收回采地，1598年宫廷迁往摩德纳，费拉拉沦为冷落的教皇边城——犹太人被圈入隔都，拆平的街区上建起教皇要塞。1796年拿破仑的进军结束教皇统治；费拉拉先后隶属奇斯帕达纳与奇萨尔皮尼共和国，并入拿破仑的意大利王国，1815年奥地利军队将它交还教皇国。

en:
Ravenna rose among the lagoons south of the Po delta. Honorius moved the Western Roman court there in 402, and the city remained an imperial, then Ostrogothic and Byzantine capital, endowing it with San Vitale and its other mosaic churches; the Lombard seizure of the Exarchate in 751 opened its long decline, and the sea gradually deserted the silted harbour of Classis. From 1275 the da Polenta family ruled as papal vassals, and Dante, exiled from Florence, died in their city in 1321. In February 1441 the Republic of Venice deposed the last da Polenta lord, Ostasio III, and by the Treaty of Cremona took Ravenna together with the salt pans of Cervia. In 1444 Venetian rectors governed the city, its wealth resting on Cervia salt shipped north to the lagoons.

Venice held Ravenna until the disaster of Agnadello on 14 May 1509, after which the city and Cervia passed to Pope Julius II. On 11 April 1512 the French under Gaston de Foix crushed a Spanish and papal army outside its walls in one of the bloodiest battles of the Italian Wars; the young victor fell in the pursuit, and his troops sacked Ravenna before withdrawing four months later. The Venetians briefly reoccupied the city in 1527–29, and a terrible flood in May 1636 began three centuries of canal-cutting and marsh reclamation around it; in 1697 Pope Innocent XII had Cervia rebuilt beside its pans with great salt silos. French troops under Augereau entered Ravenna on 26 June 1796, and it followed the Cispadane and Cisalpine republics into the Napoleonic Kingdom of Italy. Restored to the Papal States in 1815, it seethed with Carbonari plots, encouraged in those years by the poet Lord Byron, who was then living in the city.
zh:
拉文纳兴起于波河三角洲以南的潟湖之间。402年霍诺留把西罗马宫廷迁至此地，城市先后作为帝国、东哥特与拜占庭的都城，留下圣维塔莱教堂等饰满镶嵌画的建筑；751年伦巴第人攻占总督区后它长期衰落，克拉塞港也因泥沙淤塞渐渐被大海抛弃。1275年起，达·波伦塔家族以教皇封臣身份统治此地，遭佛罗伦萨放逐的但丁1321年在他们的城中去世。1441年2月，威尼斯共和国废黜末代达·波伦塔领主奥斯塔西奥三世，依克雷莫纳条约取得拉文纳和切尔维亚盐场。1444年，城市由威尼斯市政官治理，财富仰仗运往北方潟湖诸城的切尔维亚食盐。

威尼斯统治拉文纳，直到1509年5月14日阿尼亚代洛惨败，此后城市与切尔维亚一同归于教皇尤利乌斯二世。1512年4月11日，加斯东·德·富瓦率法军在城外击溃西班牙与教皇联军，是意大利战争中最惨烈的战役之一；这位年轻的胜利者在追击中阵亡，部下洗劫拉文纳，四个月后才撤离。威尼斯人1527至1529年一度重新占据城市；1636年5月的特大洪水开启了此后三百年绕城开凿运河、排干沼泽的工程；1697年教皇英诺森十二世命切尔维亚在盐场旁重建，修起巨大的储盐仓。1796年6月26日奥热罗率法军入城，拉文纳先后随奇斯帕达纳、奇萨尔皮尼共和国并入拿破仑的意大利王国。1815年它被交还教皇国，城中烧炭党密谋不断，当时正客居于此的诗人拜伦也为他们鼓动声援。

en:
Pisa straddles the Arno a few miles above its mouth. Already an Etruscan and Roman harbour, it became one of the four maritime republics: in the 11th and 12th centuries Pisan merchants and galleys dominated the Tyrrhenian Sea, and treasure taken at Palermo in 1063 paid for the cathedral, with its round baptistery and the bell tower begun in 1173 that took two centuries to finish and grew into the Leaning Tower. Rivalry with Genoa ended at the battle of Meloria on 6 August 1284, which broke Pisan sea power; the Genoese destroyed Porto Pisano in 1290, and from 1323 the Aragonese conquest stripped Pisa of Sardinia. A papal bull of 1343 founded its Studium. Sold to the Visconti in 1399, the city was annexed by Florence in 1406, and in 1409 it hosted the council that sought to end the Great Schism. In 1444 Pisa is a subject city of Florence, its river port silting up while the Florentines develop the little haven of Livorno, bought in 1421.

From 1473 Lorenzo de' Medici revived the university, and the Palazzo della Sapienza was built for it from 1486. As Charles VIII's army entered Italy, the Pisans rose on 9 November 1494 and restored their republic; fifteen years of sieges followed before Florence retook the city in 1509, the war in which Machiavelli tried out his citizen militia. Duke Cosimo I reopened the university in 1543 and founded the Garden of Simples, the first botanical garden attached to a university, and from 1558 Vasari rebuilt the Piazza dei Cavalieri for the Knights of St Stephen; their church holds Turkish banners captured at Lepanto in 1571. Galileo Galilei, born in Pisa in 1564, held the mathematics chair from 1589 and pursued his studies of motion here. Livorno, girdled with the Fortezza Vecchia and laid out from 1577 on Buontalenti's pentagonal plan, was made a free port by Ferdinando I and drew Sephardic Jews and merchants from all nations, becoming one of the busiest harbours in the Mediterranean. Napoleon founded the Scuola Normale here in 1810, and after the Napoleonic years Tuscany returned to its grand duke in 1815.
zh:
比萨位于阿诺河入海口上游不远处，扼河海之要。这里早在伊特鲁里亚和罗马时代就是港口，中世纪成为意大利四大海洋共和国之一：11至12世纪，比萨的商人和舰队称雄第勒尼安海，1063年从巴勒莫获得的财宝资助了大教堂的修建，教堂旁是圆形洗礼堂和1173年动工、历时两个世纪才完工的钟楼——日后闻名的比萨斜塔。与热那亚的争霸在1284年8月6日的梅洛里亚海战中告终，比萨的海上霸权就此断送；1290年热那亚人捣毁波尔托皮萨诺港，1323年起撒丁岛又被阿拉贡夺走。1343年，教皇诏书在此设立大学。1399年比萨被卖给维斯孔蒂家族，1406年被佛罗伦萨吞并，1409年又在此召开试图结束天主教会大分裂的公会议。1444年的比萨是佛罗伦萨治下的臣服之城，河口港口日渐淤塞，佛罗伦萨人转而经营1421年买下的小港里窝那。

1473年起，洛伦佐·德·美第奇重振比萨大学，1486年起又为它兴建智慧宫。1494年查理八世的军队入侵意大利，比萨人于11月9日起义，恢复共和国；历经十五年围攻，佛罗伦萨才在1509年重新夺回城市，马基雅维利正是在这场战争中试练他的公民军。科西莫一世公爵1543年重开大学，设立药草园——世界上第一所附属于大学的植物园；1558年起瓦萨里为圣斯德望骑士团重建骑士广场，骑士团教堂中收藏着1571年勒班陀海战缴获的土耳其军旗。1564年生于比萨的伽利略自1589年起担任数学教席，在此进行运动研究。与此同时，建起旧要塞、1577年由布翁塔伦蒂按五边形理想城规划营建的里窝那被费迪南多一世辟为自由港，吸引塞法迪犹太人和各国商人，成为地中海最繁忙的港口之一。拿破仑1810年在此创办高等师范学校；拿破仑时代结束后，托斯卡纳于1815年归还大公。

en:
Florence lies on the Arno among the hills of Tuscany. A Roman colony of 59 BC, it grew in the high Middle Ages into a wool-manufacturing and banking commune: the gold florin of 1252 became the standard coin of European trade, while the Ordinances of Justice of 1293 lodged power in the greater guilds. The Black Death of 1348 cut the city down by half, and the wool workers' revolt of the Ciompi shook it in 1378. From 1382 the Albizzi led the republic until Cosimo de' Medici, back from exile in 1434, ruled from behind republican forms. Brunelleschi raised the cathedral's great dome between 1420 and 1436, the year Pope Eugene IV consecrated Santa Maria del Fiore, and in 1439 Cosimo hosted the council that briefly united the Greek and Latin churches. In 1444, four years after Anghiari, Florence — some 60,000 people, mistress of Pisa since 1406 — is the wealthiest city in Italy, its banks and looms financing a new art and learning.

Lorenzo the Magnificent, ruler from 1469, made Florence the school of Italy, surviving the Pazzi conspiracy of 1478 in which his brother Giuliano was killed. The Medici were driven out in 1494 as Charles VIII entered Italy; Savonarola was hanged and burned in the Piazza della Signoria on 23 May 1498, and the restored republic set up Michelangelo's David in 1504. Brought back by Spanish arms in 1512 and expelled again in 1527, they returned after the siege of 1529–30; Alessandro became its first duke, and in 1569 Cosimo I was made Grand Duke of Tuscany. The court moved to the Palazzo Pitti, Vasari built the Uffizi from 1560, and Cosimo's Knights of St Stephen fought at Lepanto in 1571. Galileo, who had shown the Medicean stars through his telescope, lived his condemned last years at Arcetri and died there in 1642; in 1657 Medici princes founded the Accademia del Cimento, Europe's first society devoted to experiment. In 1716 Cosimo III delimited the Chianti vineyards in one of Europe's earliest wine laws. The Medici died out in 1737 and Tuscany passed to the dukes of Lorraine, under whom Peter Leopold abolished the death penalty in 1786. From 1801 Florence was the capital of the Kingdom of Etruria, then a French prefecture, until the grand duke returned in 1814.
zh:
佛罗伦萨位于阿诺河畔、托斯卡纳丘陵之间。它本是公元前59年设立的罗马殖民城，中世纪盛期发展为以毛纺和银行业立身的公社：1252年起铸造的金弗罗林成为欧洲贸易的标准货币，1293年的《正义法规》把权力交到大行会手中。1348年的黑死病使人口减半，1378年梳毛工人又发动梳毛工起义。1382年起阿尔比齐家族主导共和国，直到科西莫·德·美第奇1434年放逐归来，靠庇护网络让家族以共和之名行统治之实。布鲁内莱斯基在1420至1436年间建起大教堂的巨型穹顶，教皇尤金四世也在1436年祝圣圣母百花大教堂；1439年，科西莫在此促成了短暂合一东西教会的公会议。1444年，即安吉亚里击败米兰四年之后，这座约有六万人口、自1406年起领有比萨的城市已是意大利最富庶之地，银行和织机滋养着新兴的艺术与学问。

1469年起执政的豪华者洛伦佐把佛罗伦萨办成了意大利的学校，并在1478年的帕齐阴谋中幸存——其弟朱利亚诺在那场刺杀中身亡。1494年查理八世攻入意大利，美第奇家族被逐；萨伏那洛拉1498年5月23日在领主广场被绞死焚尸，恢复的共和国于1504年树立米开朗琪罗的《大卫》。美第奇家族1512年靠西班牙武力回城，1527年再遭驱逐，在1529至1530年的围城后复辟，亚历山德罗成为第一代公爵，1569年科西莫一世受封托斯卡纳大公。宫廷迁入皮蒂宫，瓦萨里从1560年起督建乌菲齐宫，科西莫的圣斯德望骑士团参加了1571年的勒班陀海战。曾用望远镜展示美第奇星的伽利略，被判罪后在阿尔切特里度过晚年，1642年逝于该地；1657年美第奇家族的亲王们创办实验学院，这是欧洲第一个以实验为宗旨的科学社团。1716年，科西莫三世划定基安蒂葡萄酒产区，是欧洲最早的葡萄酒立法之一。1737年美第奇家族绝嗣，托斯卡纳转入洛林公爵之手，彼得罗·莱奥波德治下于1786年废除死刑。1801年起佛罗伦萨成为伊特鲁里亚王国首都，后为法国的行省省会，大公于1814年复位。

en:
Siena rides a ridge in the Tuscan hills, the Etruscan Saina and Roman Saena Iulia. After Countess Matilda's death in 1115 it made itself a free commune, a Ghibelline banking and wool city against Guelph Florence: on 4 September 1260, with King Manfred's cavalry, it crushed the Florentines at Montaperti. Under the Nine from 1287 it raised the Palazzo Pubblico and Torre del Mangia above the Campo, built its striped cathedral and filled its churches with Duccio, Simone Martini and Lorenzetti. Perhaps 50,000 lived here before the Black Death of 1348, which halved the city and stopped the cathedral's enlargement. In 1399 the priors gave its lordship to Gian Galeazzo Visconti of Milan, whose garrison was driven out five years later. Its studium of 1240 and Maremma port of Talamone still gave the republic weight. In 1444 Siena is an independent merchant republic, watchful of Florence, with glass furnaces recorded in the Valdelsa from 1331 and pasture lands running down to the malarial coast.

In 1458 the Sienese humanist Enea Silvio Piccolomini became Pope Pius II, and in 1472 the republic founded the Monte Pio, ancestor of the Monte dei Paschi, backed by the revenues of its Maremma pastures. From 1487 Pandolfo Petrucci, called the Magnifico, gave the city order and prosperity until his death in 1512; his house ruled until 1525. A year later they defeated a papal and Florentine army at Camollia, which drew the attention of Emperor Charles V: a Spanish garrison entered Siena and a citadel was begun in 1548. On 26 July 1552 the citizens rose, demolished the works and called in France. A long imperial and Florentine siege followed; Piero Strozzi's relief army was beaten at Marciano in August 1554, and on 21 April 1555 famine forced surrender. Seven hundred families held out at Montalcino until Cateau-Cambrésis in 1559 delivered Siena to Cosimo I, who rebuilt the citadel as the Fortezza Medicea in 1561–63. At Grosseto the Medici raised the bastioned walls completed in 1593. The Palio, run here since the 13th century, moved round the Campo and took its fixed yearly form in 1656, and the Accademia de' Fisiocritici was founded in 1691. With the rest of Tuscany Siena passed to the dukes of Lorraine in 1737, sharing the grand duchy's fate through the Napoleonic years to the restoration of 1814.
zh:
锡耶纳坐落在托斯卡纳丘陵的一道山梁上，即古伊特鲁里亚人的萨伊纳、罗马人的萨埃纳·尤利亚。1115年玛蒂尔达女伯爵死后，它成为自由公社；作为皇帝派的银行业与毛纺之城，它同教皇派的劲敌佛罗伦萨长期交战：1260年9月4日，在曼弗雷德国王骑兵的助战下，锡耶纳人在蒙塔佩尔蒂重创佛罗伦萨。1287年起的九人政府时期，城市在田野广场上方建起市政宫和曼吉亚塔楼，修起条纹大理石大教堂，教堂里挂满杜乔、西蒙内·马提尼和安布罗焦·洛伦泽蒂的画作。1348年黑死病之前，这里约有五万居民；瘟疫夺去一半人口，大教堂的扩建也中辍。此后疫病与党争不断，执政会议几经更迭，1399年执政官们把城市统治权献给米兰的吉安·加莱亚佐·维斯孔蒂，五年后其驻军被逐。1240年创办的大学和马雷马的塔拉莫内港仍维系着共和国的分量。1444年的锡耶纳是一个独立的商人共和国，对佛罗伦萨戒心十足：瓦尔德尔萨的玻璃窑在1331年已有记载，牧场一直延伸到疫病流行的海岸。

1458年，锡耶纳人文主义者埃内亚·西尔维奥·皮科洛米尼当选教皇庇护二世；1472年，共和国以马雷马牧场的收入为担保创办虔诚山信贷社，即锡耶纳牧山银行的前身。1487年起，人称豪华者的潘多尔福·彼得鲁奇独揽大权，在1512年去世前给城市带来秩序与繁荣，其家族又维持统治到1525年。一年后，锡耶纳人在卡莫利亚击败教皇与佛罗伦萨联军，却引来皇帝查理五世的注意：西班牙驻军进驻城市，1548年又动工修筑要塞。1552年7月26日，市民起义、拆毁工事并向法国求援，换来的是帝国与佛罗伦萨的长期围城。1554年8月皮耶罗·斯特罗齐的援军在马尔恰诺战败，1555年4月21日饥困的城市开城投降；七百户人家退守蒙塔尔奇诺，直到1559年卡托－康布雷齐条约把锡耶纳交给科西莫一世。科西莫于1561至1563年在旧要塞旧址重建美第奇要塞，又在格罗塞托筑起棱堡城墙，1593年完工。自13世纪起在此举办的赛马节转入田野广场绕圈赛跑，1656年形成固定的年度形制；博物学者学院则于1691年创立。1737年，锡耶纳随整个托斯卡纳转入洛林公爵之手，此后与大公国共命运，历经拿破仑时代，至1814年复辟。

en:
Rome, the city of seven hills on the Tiber, had once ruled the Mediterranean as the capital of the Roman Empire; after the Gothic Wars it shrank to a town of perhaps 20,000 people living among its ruins. From 756 the popes governed it as the capital of the Papal States, its lordship contested between the Church, the Roman baronage — Colonnas and Orsinis entrenched in their fortress-towers — and the emperor. The first Jubilee, proclaimed by Boniface VIII in 1300, drew some two million pilgrims, but the papacy's removal to Avignon in 1309 and the long Western Schism left Rome to neglect and faction warfare. The Council of Constance closed the schism in 1418, and Martin V, a Roman Colonna, brought the Curia home. In 1444, under Pope Eugene IV, Rome was still a small city of ruins, vineyards and pilgrims, but after a century of turmoil it was once again the settled seat of the papacy.

Nicholas V, elected in 1447, founded the Vatican Library and set Rome on its course as a capital of humanist learning, rebuilding its walls, churches and streets. Under Julius II and Leo X the high Renaissance came to the city: Bramante planned and began the new St Peter's, Michelangelo painted the Sistine Chapel ceiling and Raphael frescoed the papal apartments, their work financed by bankers such as Agostino Chigi. In 1527 the Landsknechts of Emperor Charles V sacked Rome, ending its golden age, and after the Council of Trent opened in 1545 the city became the headquarters of the Counter-Reformation. Sixtus V drove new streets through the old city and restored its aqueducts between 1585 and 1590, the new St Peter's was consecrated in 1626, and Bernini and Borromini gave baroque Rome its fountains and facades. In 1773 Clement XIV, pressed by the Catholic powers, suppressed the Jesuit order. French troops under Berthier entered Rome in February 1798 and proclaimed a Roman Republic; Pius VI was carried into exile and died in France, and Neapolitan intervention restored papal rule under Pius VII in 1800. French troops returned in 1808 and Rome was absorbed into Napoleon's empire, its treasures looted and the pope held in France until his return in 1814; the Congress of Vienna confirmed the restored Papal States.
zh:
罗马是台伯河畔七丘之上的城市，曾作为罗马帝国之都号令地中海；哥特战争后衰落到只剩约两万居民，在大片废墟间谋生。756年起，教宗以此为教宗国首都，统治权在教会、据塔楼而守的科隆纳与奥尔西尼等罗马贵族、以及皇帝之间反复争夺。博义八世1300年宣布首次禧年，约两百万朝圣者涌来，但1309年教廷迁往阿维尼翁，随后漫长的西方大分裂使罗马陷入荒废与家族仇杀。1418年康斯坦茨公会议结束大分裂，出身科隆纳家族的玛定五世把教廷带回罗马。1444年，在恩仁四世治下，罗马仍是一座废墟、葡萄园与朝圣者并存的小城，但经历百年动荡之后，它重新成为教廷的稳固驻地。

1447年当选的尼各老五世创办梵蒂冈图书馆，重修城墙、教堂与街道，把罗马引上人文主义学术之都的道路。在儒略二世和良十世治下，盛期文艺复兴降临此城：伯拉孟特设计并动工兴建新圣彼得大教堂，米开朗基罗绘制西斯廷教堂天顶画，拉斐尔为教廷套房绘制湿壁画，阿戈斯蒂诺·基吉等银行家为这一切出资。1527年，查理五世的德意志雇佣步兵洗劫罗马，黄金时代戛然而止；1545年特伦托公会议开幕后，罗马成为反宗教改革的大本营。思道五世在1585至1590年间凿穿旧城开辟新路、修复输水道，新圣彼得大教堂于1626年祝圣，贝尔尼尼和波洛米尼则用喷泉与立面塑造了巴洛克的罗马。1773年，克雷芒十四世迫于各天主教强国的压力取缔耶稣会。1798年2月，贝尔蒂埃率法军进入罗马，宣布成立罗马共和国；庇护六世被押往法国并死于流放，1800年经那不勒斯出兵，庇护七世恢复教宗统治。1808年法军再至，罗马被并入拿破仑的帝国，珍藏遭劫掠，教宗本人被拘于法国，直到1814年归来；维也纳会议确认了重建的教宗国。

en:
Ancona was founded around 387 BC by Greek exiles from Syracuse, on a promontory sheltering the finest natural harbour on the Adriatic's western shore. It kept its Greek character as a Roman municipium, and Trajan's harbour works are still crowned by his arch. After Byzantine rule it passed to the Papacy in 774 and gave its name to the March of Ancona. From the 11th century it was a maritime republic, ruled by six Elders, minting its own agontano and usually allied with Ragusa and Constantinople, while Venice grudged it a rival in the Adriatic. An imperial army failed to starve it out in the great siege of 1173, remembered for the widow Stamira's sortie against the siege engines; the Malatesta held the city only from 1348 to 1383. In 1444 the oligarchic city, under papal suzerainty, lived by the Levant trade and had lately produced the navigator-antiquarian Cyriac of Ancona.

Ancona kept its self-government until 19 September 1532, when papal troops issued from the citadel Pope Clement VII had asked to build against a Turkish threat and occupied the city; Antonio da Sangallo the Younger's five-bastioned fortress then commanded town and harbour. A papal safe-conduct at once invited Greek, Turkish, Jewish and Iberian merchants to settle, and Ancona became the busiest port of the Papal States. Under Paul IV twenty-six Portuguese Sephardim who refused baptism were burned here in 1556; after 1569 it was nonetheless one of only three papal cities where Jews might remain. In 1732 Pope Clement XII made it a free port and set Luigi Vanvitelli to rebuild the harbour, with its pentagonal Lazzaretto rising on an artificial island. French troops came in 1797 and set up the Anconine Republic, merged into the Roman Republic in 1798; from 1808 Ancona belonged to Napoleon's Kingdom of Italy, until an Anglo-Austrian siege in 1815 returned it to the Popes.
zh:
安科纳约建于公元前387年，由叙拉古的希腊流亡者建在一处海岬上，环抱亚得里亚海西岸最好的天然良港。这座多里斯人的城市成为罗马自治城后仍保有希腊色彩，图拉真扩建了港口，他的凯旋门就冠立码头。拜占庭统治之后，安科纳于774年并入教宗领地，并把名字留给了安科纳边区（马尔凯一名即由此而来）。11世纪起它成为海上共和国，由六名元老治理，铸造自己的阿贡塔诺银币，通常与拉古萨和君士坦丁堡结盟，威尼斯则始终忌惮这个亚得里亚海上的对手。1173年帝国大军久围不克，寡妇斯塔米拉冲出城防火烧攻城器械的事迹由此传世；马拉泰斯塔家族也只在1348至1383年间占据过此城。1444年的安科纳是一个寡头执政的城市，名义上臣属教宗，靠黎凡特贸易为生，航海家兼古迹学者安科纳的基里亚科正是这里的人物。

安科纳的自治一直维持到1532年9月19日：教宗克雷芒七世借口土耳其人来犯，先获准修建城堡，这天天主教军队从堡中涌出占领全城，小安东尼奥·达·桑加洛设计的五棱要塞从此扼住城市与港口。教廷随即颁发通行证，招徕希腊、土耳其、犹太和伊比利亚商人定居，安科纳成为教宗国最繁忙的港口。1556年，二十六名拒绝改宗的葡萄牙塞法迪犹太人在保禄四世治下被焚身处死；1569年以后，它仍是教宗国内仅有的三个允许犹太人居留的城市之一。1732年，教宗克雷芒十二世将这里辟为自由港，命路易吉·万维泰利改造港口，建在人工岛上的五角形检疫站拉扎雷托是其标志。1797年法军到来，成立安科纳共和国，1798年并入罗马共和国；1808年起安科纳入拿破仑的意大利王国，1815年英奥联军围城，城市又重归教宗。

en:
L'Aquila was a royal foundation of the Hohenstaufen: Frederick II gathered ninety-nine mountain villages into one hill town facing the Papal States, completed under his son Conrad IV in 1254. Manfred destroyed it in 1259, Charles I of Anjou rebuilt it and the walls closed in 1316; each mother-village kept a borough, and the federation became the second city of the Kingdom of Naples. Its wealth came from the saffron of the Aterno valley and transhumant wool flocks moving between the high pastures and the via degli Abruzzi linking Florence and Naples. In 1294 the hermit Pietro da Morrone was crowned Pope Celestine V here and proclaimed the Perdonanza indulgence at Collemaggio. After Braccio da Montone's thirteen-month siege the royal army beat him beneath the walls on 2 June 1424; he died three days later. In 1444, under the newly victorious Alfonso of Aragon, the self-governing city was at its richest when Saint Bernardino of Siena died there on 20 May.

A basilica rose over Saint Bernardino's shrine, receiving his body in 1472 after the earthquake of 26 November 1461. In 1481 Adam of Rottweil, a pupil of Gutenberg, set up one of Italy's earliest printing presses. They flew the French flag for Charles VIII in 1494 and again admitted France in 1527; after the defeat of 1529 the Spanish viceroy Filiberto of Orange sacked the city, annulled its privileges and split off its countryside. It was then forced to raze a whole quarter and pay a hundred thousand ducats a year for the massive Forte Spagnolo, guarding the Naples-Florence wool road. Plague struck in 1656; on 2 February 1703 the Great Earthquake flattened the city and killed over 6,000, and baroque rebuilding took half a century. In 1799 the townsmen rose for King Ferdinand under General Salomone; Napoleonic rule after 1806 abolished feudalism and the old Aragonese sheep-drove privileges, and in 1815 the city returned to the Bourbons.
zh:
拉奎拉是霍亨斯陶芬王朝的王家新建之城：腓特烈二世把九十九个山村合并为一座面向教宗国的山城，1254年由其子康拉德四世建成。1259年曼弗雷迪将它摧毁，安茹的查理一世又予重建，城墙于1316年合龙；每个母村在城中各有一区，这个联盟发展成那不勒斯王国仅次于都城的第二大城。它的财富来自阿泰尔诺河谷的藏红花和转地放牧的羊群——羊群往返于高山牧场与连接佛罗伦萨、那不勒斯的「阿布鲁佐大道」之间，羊毛由此外销。1294年，隐修士莫罗内的彼得在此加冕为教宗雷定五世，并在科莱马焦发布「佩尔多南扎」大赦令。布拉乔·达·蒙托内围城十三个月后，1424年6月2日王家军队在城下将其击败，他伤重三日后死去。1444年，在新胜的阿拉贡的阿方索治下，这座仍享有自治的城市正值富庶顶峰，锡耶纳的圣伯尔纳定于5月20日在此辞世。

圣伯尔纳定圣殿在其墓地上建起，1461年11月26日的大地震撼动重建中的城市，他的遗体于1472年移灵安放。1481年，古腾堡的门徒罗特韦尔的亚当在此设立意大利最早的印刷所之一。1494年拉奎拉人为查理八世竖起法兰西旗帜，1527年又一次开门迎入法军；1529年法国失败后，西班牙总督、奥兰治亲王菲利贝托洗劫城市，废除其古老特权并肢解了它的乡野。全城被迫铲平一整个街区，以每年十万杜卡托的代价修建庞大的西班牙要塞，由它扼守那不勒斯通往佛罗伦萨的羊毛商路。1656年瘟疫袭来；1703年2月2日的大地震将城市夷平，六千余人遇难，巴洛克式的重建持续了半个世纪。1799年，市民在萨洛莫内将军率领下起兵效忠费迪南德国王；1806年起拿破仑政权废除封建制和古老的阿拉贡牧道特权，1815年拉奎拉重归那不勒斯的波旁王室。

en:
Napoli climbs from its bay toward the slopes behind its ancient Greek street plan. Cumaean Greeks founded Parthenope in the late eighth century BC and refounded the settlement as Neapolis in the late sixth century BC; after centuries as a Roman and then Byzantine city, it became the Angevin dynasty's southern capital after 1282. Frederick II had opened his Studio generale there in 1224, and Alfonso V of Aragon seized the kingdom from René of Anjou in 1442. In 1444 Napoli was the capital of an Aragonese-ruled, Neapolitan-speaking Catholic kingdom, a crowded court city and Mediterranean port whose bankers, merchants and royal officials served one of Italy's largest monarchies.

Charles VIII claimed the Angevin inheritance and French troops overran Napoli in February 1495, but Aragonese rule returned within months. After a secret French-Aragonese partition in 1500, Gonzalo Fernández de Córdoba's Spanish army took the city in May 1503 and sealed the conquest at the Garigliano on 29 December. From 1532 Viceroy Pedro de Toledo paved new streets, laid out Via Toledo, rebuilt the Sant'Elmo fortress and centralized justice in Castel Capuano while tightening Spanish control. In July 1647 the fisherman Masaniello led a tax revolt; a short French-backed republic followed until Spanish forces returned in April 1648. Plague in 1656 killed some 200,000 people in the city. Austria replaced the Spanish viceroys in 1707, but Bourbon troops took Napoli in May 1734 and won Bitonto on 25 May, securing a Bourbon kingdom recognized in 1738. The Parthenopaean Republic briefly displaced Ferdinand IV in 1799. Joseph Bonaparte entered in February 1806 and was proclaimed king on 30 March; Joachim Murat succeeded him in 1808 but lost Tolentino in May 1815. Ferdinand returned that June, and in December 1816 Naples and Sicily were united as the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies.
zh:
那波利（今通译那不勒斯）从海湾向背后的坡地展开，老城仍保留希腊城市的街格。公元前8世纪末，库迈的希腊人建立帕耳忒诺珀，公元前6世纪末又将定居地扩建为尼阿波利斯；它在罗马和拜占庭时代始终是重要城市，1282年后成为安茹王朝在南意大利的都城。腓特烈二世1224年在此创办总学馆，1442年阿拉贡的阿方索五世从安茹的勒内手中夺取王国。1444年，那波利是一个由阿拉贡王朝统治、居民说那波利语的天主教王国首都，也是人口稠密的宫廷城市和地中海口岸，银行家、商人与王室官员服务于意大利境内最大的国家之一。

查理八世以安茹继承权为名出兵，法军于1495年2月席卷那波利，但阿拉贡王朝数月后复辟。1500年法国与阿拉贡密约瓜分王国，贡萨洛·费尔南德斯·德·科尔多瓦率领的西班牙军队1503年5月入城，并在12月29日的加里利亚诺战役锁定胜局。1532年起，总督佩德罗·德·托莱多铺设新街、开辟托莱多路、改建圣埃尔莫堡，把司法机构集中到卡普阿诺堡，强化西班牙统治。1647年7月，渔民马萨涅洛领导抗税起义，随后出现法国支持的短命共和国，1648年4月西班牙恢复统治。1656年的鼠疫在城内夺去约20万人的生命。1707年奥地利取代西班牙总督，但波旁军队1734年5月攻占那波利，5月25日在比通托取胜，1738年波旁王国获得承认。1799年，帕尔泰诺佩共和国曾短暂取代费迪南多四世。1806年2月约瑟夫·波拿巴入城，3月30日被宣布为国王；若阿基姆·缪拉1808年继位，1815年5月在托伦蒂诺战败。费迪南多于6月返回，1816年12月那波利与西西里合并为两西西里王国。

en:
Salento forms the heel of the Italian boot, a land of Greek, Byzantine and Norman memories whose eastern and southern coasts face the Adriatic and Ionian sea lanes. Its game capital, Taranto, began as the Spartan colony of Taras and guards the narrow ground between the Mar Grande and the Mar Piccolo. In 1088 the Normans made it the seat of the Principality of Taranto, a fief that came to embrace nearly all of Salento. In 1442 Alfonso V of Aragon conquered the Kingdom of Naples; two years later this Catholic, Neapolitan-speaking coast was a powerful feudal corner of his new monarchy, its ports and castles watching the traffic between Italy and the Balkans.

In 1480 an Ottoman army under Gedik Ahmed Pasha stormed and sacked Otranto, killing hundreds of its inhabitants; neighbouring towns strengthened their walls in response. Venice briefly held parts of Salento during the 1482–1484 war before they returned to Naples. In 1534 Charles V repaired the peninsula's castles, including Lecce, as Turkish raiding continued, while Lecce itself became the great showplace of Salentine Baroque in the following two centuries. The Treaty of Utrecht assigned the region to Austria in 1713, but Spain's victory at Bitonto in 1734 brought Apulia back under a Spanish dynasty. Feudal jurisdiction in the Terra d'Otranto was abolished under the French-backed Kingdom of Naples in 1806.
zh:
萨伦托构成意大利「靴跟」，海岸同时通向亚得里亚海与伊奥尼亚海商路，土地上留着希腊、拜占庭和诺曼人的层积。首府塔兰托最初是斯巴达人建立的殖民城塔拉斯，扼守大海与小海之间的狭窄要地。1088年，诺曼人以它为塔兰托亲王国的首府，这个封国后来几乎囊括整个萨伦托。1442年，阿拉贡的阿方索五世征服那不勒斯王国；两年后，这片信奉天主教、使用那不勒斯语的海岸成为其新王国中强藩林立的一角，港口与城堡监视着意大利和巴尔干之间的往来。

1480年，格迪克·艾哈迈德帕夏率领奥斯曼军队攻陷并洗劫奥特朗托，数百名居民遇害，邻近城镇随即加固城墙。1482年至1484年的战争中，威尼斯曾短暂控制萨伦托部分地区，战后又归还那不勒斯。1534年，面对土耳其袭掠，查理五世修缮包括莱切城堡在内的多处要塞；此后两个世纪里，莱切发展成萨伦托巴洛克艺术最华丽的橱窗。1713年《乌得勒支和约》将此地划归奥地利，但1734年西班牙在比通托战役获胜，普利亚又落入西班牙王朝之手。1806年，法国支持的那不勒斯王国废除奥特朗托地区的封建司法权。

en:
This is the Aspromonte toe of Italy, where Reggio guards the Strait of Messina opposite Sicily. Greek Rhegion became a Byzantine duchy and metropolis; Eastern Roman rule brought mulberry groves and silk working, and after the Norman conquest of 1060 the city passed with southern Italy through the Hohenstaufen, Angevin and Aragonese struggles. Reggio long served as capital of the Calabrian giustizierato, but it backed René of Anjou against Alfonso V. After Alfonso's victory in 1442 its provincial seat was transferred to Catanzaro. In 1444, therefore, Reggio was a newly Aragonese port in the Kingdom of Naples, Catholic in allegiance but still marked by Greek-rite monasteries, its Jewish quarter, fisheries and silk trade.

Ferdinand I restored Reggio's capital status in 1465. Ten years later its Jewish quarter produced the first dated printed edition of a Hebrew text, a Rashi commentary on the Pentateuch. The French wars for Naples reopened the Angevin succession, but from 1504 Reggio and Calabria lived under Spanish viceregal government. Reggio silk was bought by Genoese, Venetian, Spanish, Dutch and English merchants, while the bergamot orange recorded there in the fifteenth century was being intensively cultivated by 1750. War came from the sea: Hayreddin Barbarossa's Ottoman fleet burned Reggio in 1534 and carried off eight hundred people, and Barbary raiders enslaved much of the remaining population in 1558. An earthquake destroyed the medieval port in 1562, and the great earthquake of 1783 devastated southern Calabria. Napoleon's forces took Reggio in 1806 and made it a duchy and military headquarters.
zh:
这个省份位于意大利「靴尖」的阿斯普罗蒙特山区，首府雷焦隔着墨西拿海峡与西西里相望。希腊人的雷吉翁后来成为拜占庭公爵驻地和总主教区；东罗马统治带来桑树种植与丝织业，1060年诺曼人征服后，城市又随南意大利卷入霍亨斯陶芬、安茹与阿拉贡诸王朝的争夺。雷焦长期担任卡拉布里亚司法区首府，却在纷争中支持安茹的勒内、反对阿方索五世。阿方索1442年获胜后，把省级治所迁往卡坦扎罗。因此在1444年，雷焦是那不勒斯王国境内一座刚归入阿拉贡体系的港口，居民尊奉天主教，但希腊礼仪修道院、犹太区、渔业和丝绸贸易仍深深塑造着城市。

1465年，费尔南多一世恢复了雷焦的首府地位。十年后，当地犹太区印出第一部有明确日期的希伯来文印刷品，即拉希的《摩西五经》注释。法国争夺那不勒斯的战争重开安茹继承问题，但从1504年起，雷焦和卡拉布里亚处于西班牙总督政府治下。热那亚、威尼斯、西班牙、荷兰和英格兰商人都购买雷焦丝绸；15世纪已有记载的香柠檬到1750年已在当地成片种植。战争也从海上袭来：1534年，赫伊尔丁·巴巴罗萨的奥斯曼舰队焚毁雷焦并掳走八百人；1558年，柏柏尔海盗又把许多幸存者掳往的黎波里为奴。1562年的地震摧毁了中世纪港口，1783年的大地震则重创南卡拉布里亚。1806年，拿破仑军队攻占雷焦，并将其设为公国和军事司令部。

en:
Messina guards the Sicilian side of the narrow, current-swept strait that carries its name. Greek settlers developed the sickle-shaped harbor of Zancle and renamed it Messana around the early fifth century BC. Arab forces destroyed the city in 843, and Roger I of Hauteville took the site in 1060 during the Norman reconquest. After the Sicilian Vespers it became a second royal capital alongside Palermo under the Aragonese dynasty, its senate, merchants and silk workers enriched by a port linking the Tyrrhenian and Ionian seas, while fishermen had long harpooned swordfish in the strait's strong currents. In 1444 Messina was a Catholic, Sicilian-speaking city of the Crown of Aragon, wealthy and proud enough to rival Palermo.

In 1548 Ignatius of Loyola founded the Jesuit college that became the University of Messina. On 7 October 1571 the Holy League fleet under Don John of Austria sailed from the harbor to defeat the Ottomans at Lepanto. That age of imperial galley wars was also Messina's peak, but rivalry with Palermo and resentment of Spanish rule led the senate to revolt in July 1674. French aid sustained the city until April 1678; after the Peace of Nijmegen Spain recovered Messina, sacked it, abolished its senate, university and ancient privileges, and built the Real Cittadella to overawe the port. Plague returned in 1743. Utrecht assigned Sicily to Savoy in 1713, Austrian rule followed in 1720, and the Bourbons secured the island in 1734-1735. The earthquakes that began on 5 February 1783 shattered much of Messina, leaving only the citadel standing in the ruined city. The Bourbons retained Sicily during the Napoleonic wars and joined it to Naples as the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies in December 1816.
zh:
墨西拿扼守同名海峡的西西里一侧，峡中水流湍急。希腊殖民者经营镰刀形的赞克勒港，并在公元前5世纪初前后将其改称墨萨拿。843年，阿拉伯军队摧毁城市；1060年，欧特维尔的鲁杰罗一世在诺曼收复中夺取此地。西西里晚祷之后，它在阿拉贡王朝治下与巴勒莫并列为王国的第二都城；元老院、商人和丝织工匠依托连接第勒尼安海与伊奥尼亚海的港口致富，渔民则早就在海峡急流中叉捕剑鱼。1444年的墨西拿是阿拉贡联合治下一座天主教、说西西里语的城市，富庶而自负，足以同巴勒莫相争。

1548年，依纳爵·罗耀拉创办的耶稣会学院后来发展为墨西拿大学。1571年10月7日，奥地利的堂胡安率领神圣同盟舰队从此港出发，在勒班陀击败奥斯曼舰队。帝国桨帆战争的年代也是墨西拿的鼎盛期，但它与巴勒莫的竞争以及对西班牙统治的怨恨，促使元老院于1674年7月起义。法国援助使城市坚持到1678年4月；《奈梅亨和约》后西班牙收复墨西拿并洗劫城市，废除元老院、大学和古老特权，又修建雷亚尔城堡压制港口。1743年，鼠疫再度袭来。《乌得勒支和约》1713年将西西里交给萨伏依，1720年转为奥地利统治，1734—1735年波旁家族取得该岛。1783年2月5日开始的地震群摧毁墨西拿大片城区，废墟中只有城堡仍然矗立。波旁王朝在拿破仑战争中守住西西里，并于1816年12月把它与那不勒斯合并为两西西里王国。

en:
Palermo lies on a broad Tyrrhenian gulf, ringed by the fertile plain the Arabs called the Conca d'Oro. Phoenicians founded it as Ziz, and the Greeks named the harbour Panormos. Arab armies took it in 831 and made it Sicily's capital; after a five-month siege the Normans under Robert Guiscard took it in 1072. Roger II was crowned king at Palermo in 1130, and his court at the Palazzo dei Normanni made the city the centre of one of the wealthiest kingdoms in Europe. It was the favourite city of the Hohenstaufen emperor Frederick II, until the Angevin conquest of 1266 drew power toward Naples. In 1282 the Sicilian Vespers, the rising against French rule, began here at the vespers bell, and the crown passed to the kings of Aragon. By 1330 the city held about 51,000 people. In 1444 Palermo belongs to Alfonso V of Aragon, who conquered Naples in 1442 and keeps his court there; a viceroy and the kingdom's parliament still sit at Palermo, whose merchants ship grain, sugar and the wine of the Conca d'Oro.

On Alfonso's death in 1458 Sicily passed to his brother John II of Aragon, and in 1516, with the union of the Spanish crowns, it came to Charles V, opening two centuries of rule by Habsburg viceroys. In 1583 the viceroy Marcantonio Colonna divided the island into 42 comarche, while nobles built palaces on the profits of grain, silk and sugar. Famine and crushing gabelles drove the city to revolt in 1647: in May the miller Nino La Pelosa led the first rising, and in August Giuseppe D'Alesi, elected captain by the people, stormed the royal palace and put the viceroy to flight, until he was betrayed and beheaded on 22 August. The Peace of Utrecht in 1713 gave Sicily to the House of Savoy; Spanish troops reoccupied it in 1718, Austria held it from 1720, and in 1734 Charles of Bourbon conquered the island and was crowned king in Palermo the following year. The court stayed at Naples, and Palermo became a provincial city. Ferdinand of Bourbon took refuge there from the French in 1798 and again from 1806 under British protection; the constitution of 1812 was swept away in 1816 when the Two Sicilies were united with their capital at Naples.
zh:
巴勒莫濒临第勒尼安海的一处宽阔海湾，环抱城郊的是阿拉伯人所称的「金盆」沃土。腓尼基水手最早在此建城，取名齐兹，希腊人把这片良港称为帕诺尔莫斯。831年阿拉伯军队攻占此城，把西西里都城从叙拉古迁来；1072年，罗贝尔·吉斯卡尔与鲁杰罗一世率诺曼人围攻五个月后入城。1130年，鲁杰罗二世在巴勒莫加冕为王，诺曼王宫的宫廷使这座城市成为欧洲最富庶王国之一的中心。这里也是霍亨斯陶芬王朝皇帝腓特烈二世最喜爱的城市，直到1266年安茹王朝征服后，权力重心逐渐移向那不勒斯。1282年，反抗法兰西统治的「西西里晚祷」起义在巴勒莫的晚祷钟声中爆发，西西里王位转入阿拉贡国王之手。到1330年，全城人口约有五万一千。1444年的巴勒莫属于阿拉贡的阿方索五世，他1442年征服那不勒斯后长住彼处，但一位副王和西西里王国议会仍坐镇巴勒莫，商人从这里输出谷物、蔗糖和「金盆」出产的葡萄酒。

1458年阿方索去世，西西里传给他的弟弟胡安二世；1516年随西班牙诸王冠一并归于查理五世，开始了哈布斯堡副王长达两个世纪的统治。1583年，副王马尔坎托尼奥·科隆纳把全岛划为四十二个行政区；巴勒莫贵族则靠谷物、生丝和蔗糖的收益大兴土木，营建宅邸和礼拜堂。1647年，饥荒与沉重的消费税把城市逼上反叛之路：5月，磨坊工尼诺·拉佩洛萨率先举事；8月，被民众推举为统领的朱塞佩·达莱西率军攻破王宫，逼得副王从海上逃走，但他最终遭人出卖，于8月22日被斩首。1713年《乌得勒支和约》把西西里交给萨伏依家族；西班牙军队1718年重新占领，1720年起改归奥地利；1734年波旁家族的查理攻取全岛，次年在巴勒莫加冕为王。然而宫廷始终留在那不勒斯，巴勒莫就此沦为外省城市。1798年和1806年，波旁的费迪南多两度为躲避法军逃到巴勒莫，在英国舰队庇护下维持统治；1812年西西里颁布宪法，但1816年两西西里合并、都城定在那不勒斯，宪法随即被废。

en:
Malta commands the narrow central Mediterranean crossing between Sicily and North Africa. Its old capital Mdina crowns an inland plateau above the approaches to the Grand Harbour. Aghlabid forces took Byzantine Melite in 870, and Roger I of Sicily brought the islands under Norman rule in 1091, after which they followed the Kingdom of Sicily and, from 1282, the Crown of Aragon. A revolt against Count Gonsalvo Monroy later persuaded Alfonso V to bring Malta back under direct crown administration. A Hafsid raid besieged Mdina in 1429 and carried off many islanders. In 1444 the roughly 10,000 Catholic, Maltese-speaking islanders were ruled from Aragon through the Università in Mdina: their harbour was valuable, but their coasts remained exposed to corsairs.

On 23 March 1530 Charles V enfeoffed Malta to the Hospitallers, driven from Rhodes in 1522, for an annual tribute of a falcon. The Order made fortified Birgu, not Mdina, its seat. In 1551 Dragut's Ottomans raided Gozo and carried off most of its people, and from 18 May to 8 September 1565 the Ottomans pressed the Great Siege until a Sicilian relief force decided the fight. The Hospitallers then built Valletta on the Sciberras heights and turned the harbour into one of Christendom's strongest naval bases; their galleys attacked Ottoman shipping while Baroque churches and palaces rose during two prosperous centuries. The 1693 Sicily earthquake damaged Mdina, whose cathedral Lorenzo Gafà rebuilt from 1697 to 1703. Napoleon seized Malta in June 1798, but a Maltese uprising that September opened a two-year blockade with British and Neapolitan support. The French surrendered in 1800, and the Treaty of Paris in 1814 placed Malta under the British Crown.
zh:
马耳他扼守西西里与北非之间的地中海中部航道，旧都姆迪纳高踞内陆台地，俯瞰通往大港的方向。870年，阿格拉布军队攻占拜占庭的梅利特；1091年，西西里的鲁杰罗一世把群岛纳入诺曼统治，此后马耳他随西西里王国沉浮，并于1282年起归属阿拉贡王权。后来岛民反抗贡萨尔沃·蒙罗伊伯爵，阿方索五世随即将马耳他收回王室直接管理。1429年，哈夫斯入侵者围攻姆迪纳并掳走大量岛民。1444年，约一万名信奉天主教、操马耳他语的岛民由阿拉贡通过设在姆迪纳的市镇公会（Università）治理；大港价值重大，海岸却暴露在海盗面前。

1530年3月23日，查理五世把马耳他封给1522年被逐出罗得岛的医院骑士团，年贡为一只猎鹰。骑士团没有入驻姆迪纳，而以防备森严的比尔古为驻地。1551年，德拉古特率领的奥斯曼军队袭击戈佐岛，掳走大部分岛民；1565年5月18日至9月8日，奥斯曼军队发动马耳他大围攻，最终因西西里援军抵达而失败。骑士团随后在希伯拉斯高地修建瓦莱塔，把大港建成基督教世界最强的海军基地之一。此后两个世纪，骑士团桨帆战舰攻击奥斯曼航运，巴洛克教堂和宫殿也随港口繁荣而兴起。1693年西西里大地震损毁姆迪纳，洛伦佐·加法在1697年至1703年重建圣保禄主教座堂。1798年6月拿破仑夺取马耳他，同年9月马耳他人起义，在英国和那不勒斯支持下展开两年封锁。法军1800年投降，1814年《巴黎条约》把马耳他置于英国王权治下。

en:
Sassari grew up a few miles inland from the Roman harbour of Turris Libisonis (Porto Torres), whose people abandoned the coast for the hills during the Saracen raids; the merged villages are first documented in 1131. It became the last capital of the Giudicato of Torres and, after Genoa broke Pisan power at Meloria in 1284, a free city allied to Genoa under statutes of its own issued in 1316. In 1323 its citizens opened their gates to the Infante Alfonso of Aragon, and in 1331 it became a royal city of his new Kingdom of Sardinia. Brancaleone Doria seized it for the Giudicato of Arborea in 1391, and in 1420 William III of Narbona sold the last Arborean rights, Sassari included, to Alfonso V for 100,000 gold florins. In 1444 it is an Aragonese royal city watched over by a Catalan castle, its sea trade hounded by Barbary corsairs.

French troops under Renzo da Ceri sacked Sassari in 1527, and plague thinned the city in 1528 and again in 1652. It recovered in the later Spanish century: in 1562 the Jesuits opened Sardinia's first university and a printing press arrived, feeding the humanist circle of the historian Giovanni Francesco Fara, while the old Aragonese castle housed the Spanish Inquisition. By the Treaty of Utrecht Sardinia passed to Austria in 1713 and to the House of Savoy in 1720. In December 1795 peasants of the Logudoro marched on the city against feudal dues, and the judge Giovanni Maria Angioy arrived with viceregal powers, hailed as a liberator; the rising collapsed in 1796 and Angioy died in exile in Paris in 1808. The House of Savoy weathered the Napoleonic wars from the island, and Sassari entered 1821 as a city of the Kingdom of Sardinia.
zh:
萨萨里兴起于罗马港口图尔里斯利比索尼斯（今波尔图托雷斯）几英里外的内陆——萨拉森海盗袭扰海岸时，港人退入丘陵，与附近村落合并，合并后的聚落首见于1131年的文献。它后来成为托雷斯吉乌帝卡提的末代都城；1284年热那亚在梅洛里亚海战击垮比萨后，它成为与热那亚结盟的自由城邦，1316年颁行自己的法典。1323年，市民向阿拉贡的阿方索王子开城，1331年成为新生的撒丁王国的王属城市。1391年，布兰卡莱奥内·多里亚替阿尔博雷亚吉乌帝卡提攻占此城；1420年，纳博讷的纪尧姆三世把阿尔博雷亚的剩余权利连同萨萨里一起，以十万金弗罗林卖给阿方索五世。1444年的萨萨里是阿拉贡的王属城市，卡塔兰城堡监视着全城，海上贸易则饱受巴巴里海盗侵扰。

1527年，伦佐·达·切里率领的法军洗劫萨萨里；瘟疫又在1528年和1652年两度使人口锐减。西班牙统治后期城市复苏：1562年耶稣会士创办撒丁岛第一所大学，印刷机同年传入，滋养了历史学家乔瓦尼·弗朗切斯科·法拉周围的人文主义圈子，而那座古老的阿拉贡城堡里设的是西班牙宗教裁判所。根据《乌得勒支和约》，撒丁岛1713年归奥地利，1720年转归萨伏依王朝。1795年12月，鲁古多罗的农民为反对封建赋役向萨萨里进发，法官乔瓦尼·马里亚·安焦伊被授予副王权前来，被民众当作解放者欢迎；起事1796年失败，安焦伊流亡法国，1808年死于巴黎。拿破仑战争期间，萨伏依王朝在岛上保住了王国，1821年的萨萨里仍是撒丁王国的城市。

en:
Klagenfurt lies in the Klagenfurt basin, where the Glan carries the waters of the Wörthersee to the Drau, and German and Slovene villagers shared the surrounding countryside. The Spanheim dukes of Carinthia laid out a market here, first recorded as 'in foro Chlagenvurth' in 1192–99, and Duke Bernhard moved the flood-prone settlement to safer ground in 1246; it received its charter in 1252. Carinthia, a duchy since 976, passed to the Habsburgs in 1335 and was ruled together with Styria and Carniola as Inner Austria. In 1444 Klagenfurt was still a modest market town overshadowed by St. Veit, the seat of the duchy's Estates, though the forges of the Görtschitz valley already worked the iron of the Hüttenberg, prized here since the age of Roman Noricum.

Ottoman raiders crossed the Seeberg into the Jaunfeld in 1473 and returned four more times before 1483, while the leagues the peasants formed for their own defence proved no match for them. After a fire destroyed the town in 1514, Emperor Maximilian I gave it to the Carinthian Estates in 1518, and they made it their capital: the Italian architect Domenico dell'Allio laid out the chessboard streets, the Lend canal reached the Wörthersee in 1527, and the Estates' Landhaus and the Trinity Church rose from 1574 and 1581. By then almost all the Estates were Lutheran, but Archduke Ferdinand's Counter-Reformation closed the church in 1600 and gave it to the Jesuits. French troops entered without a fight in 1797 and occupied the town again in 1805 and 1809, when the old walls were blown up and the border with Napoleon's Illyrian Provinces was drawn just to the west.
zh:
克拉根福地处克拉根福盆地，格兰河把沃尔特湖的湖水引入德劳河，周围乡间德意志与斯洛文尼亚农户杂处。克恩滕公爵施潘海姆家族在此设立市集，1192至1199年间的文献首次以「in foro Chlagenvurth」之名记载其地；1246年伯恩哈德公爵把屡遭水患的聚落迁往高处，1252年获得城市特许状。克恩滕自976年起为公爵领地，1335年归于哈布斯堡家族，与施泰尔马克、卡尼奥拉合并，按内奥地利治理。1444年的克拉根福还只是座不起眼的集镇，声势在公爵领地等级会议驻地格兰河畔圣法伊特之下，唯有格尔奇茨河谷的铁匠铺已在冶炼许滕贝格的铁矿——这种铁自罗马诺里克时代起便备受珍视。

1473年，奥斯曼袭扰军越过塞贝格山口攻入尧恩费尔德，到1483年又先后四度来犯，农民自行结社自保却不堪一击。1514年全城毁于大火，皇帝马克西米利安一世遂于1518年把这座城赐予克恩滕等级会议，后者将其建成自己的首府：意大利建筑师多梅尼科·德利·阿利奥规划棋盘式街道，1527年伦德运河连通沃尔特湖，1574年起兴建等级会议大厦，1581年起建造三一教堂。那时等级会议几乎已全体皈依路德宗，费迪南德大公推行反宗教改革，1600年封闭新教教堂并转交耶稣会。1797年法军不战入城，1805年和1809年又两度占领；1809年旧城墙被炸毁，拿破仑伊利里亚行省的边界就划在城市以西不远处。

en:
Krain, called Kranjska in Slovene and Carniola in English, covers the Sava headwaters and the forested limestone country between Carinthia and Istria. Kranj and Kamnik were its early seats, but in 1256 Duke Ulrich III of Carinthia moved his provincial residence to Laibach (Ljubljana), a market town on the road from the Adriatic toward the Danube. The Habsburgs secured Carniola in 1335, and Rudolf IV raised it to a duchy in 1364. In 1444 German-speaking nobles and burghers governed the walled capital while Slovene villagers pastured livestock in its valleys; the Catholic Habsburg land lay within the Holy Roman Empire, close to the Ottoman frontier.

Emperor Frederick III established the Diocese of Laibach in 1461. After the severe earthquake of 1511 the city was rebuilt with Renaissance walls and buildings, only for the great Slovene peasant revolt to break out in Carniola in 1515, when roughly 80,000 villagers demanded their old customs and trade rights before imperial mercenaries crushed the five-month rising. Protestant teaching spread in Laibach after 1529, supporting a secondary school, public library and printing house, but the Protestants were expelled in 1598 and Jesuits led the town's return to Catholicism. French revolutionary troops first occupied Laibach in 1797; from 1809 to 1813 Krain formed part of Napoleon's Illyrian Provinces, whose capital was Laibach, before Austrian rule was restored and confirmed at Vienna in 1815.
zh:
克拉尼在斯洛文尼亚语中称克拉尼斯卡，英文常作卡尼奥拉，地处萨瓦河上游与克恩滕和伊斯特里亚之间森林密布的石灰岩山地。它早期的统治中心在克拉尼和卡姆尼克，1256年，克恩滕公爵乌尔里希三世把行省驻地迁到莱巴赫，即后来的卢布尔雅那；这座商镇位于从亚得里亚海通往多瑙河流域的道路上。哈布斯堡家族1335年取得卡尼奥拉，鲁道夫四世又在1364年将其升为公国。1444年，讲德语的贵族和市民统治着设防的首府，斯洛文尼亚村民则在山谷间放牧牲畜；这片天主教的哈布斯堡领地属于神圣罗马帝国，且邻近奥斯曼边境。

皇帝腓特烈三世1461年设立莱巴赫教区。1511年的强烈地震后，城市以文艺复兴式城墙和建筑重建；1515年，卡尼奥拉又爆发斯洛文尼亚农民大起义，约八万名村民要求恢复旧有惯例和贸易权利，五个月后被帝国雇佣军镇压。1529年后，新教教义在莱巴赫传播，并促成中学、公共图书馆和印刷所设立，但新教徒在1598年被驱逐，耶稣会随后主导城市回归天主教。法国革命军队1797年首次占领莱巴赫；1809年至1813年，克拉尼成为拿破仑治下伊利里亚行省的一部分，莱巴赫为首府，随后奥地利恢复统治，并在1815年的维也纳会议上得到确认。

en:
Istria is the largest peninsula in the Adriatic and takes its name from the Histri, pirate tribes whom Rome needed two campaigns to subdue in 177 BC; at Pola, its chief town, the Romans left one of the best-preserved amphitheatres of the ancient world. Slavic settlers occupied the interior in the seventh century while the coastal towns kept their Romance speech. In the thirteenth century those towns passed one by one to Venice: Parenzo submitted in 1267, Umago in 1269 and Rovigno in 1283, and Pola became part of the Venetian Stato da Mar in 1331, while the castle country around Mitterburg (Pazin) had already fallen to the Habsburgs. In 1444 the Istrian coast was Venetian: its harbours served galleys sailing between Venice and the Levant, and salt from the pans at Pirano, together with the wine and oil of the coastal slopes, filled the holds of Venetian merchants.

The Venetian centuries were unkind to Pola, hit by Genoese and Hungarian attacks and by recurrent malaria and typhus, until it had scarcely 3,000 inhabitants by the mid-eighteenth century. The fall of the Republic in 1797 brought Istria to the Habsburgs under the Treaty of Campo Formio. In 1805 Napoleon attached the peninsula to his Kingdom of Italy, and in 1809 to his Illyrian Provinces, which introduced the Code Napoleon and built roads and schools. Austrian troops reoccupied Istria on 20 September 1813, and after 1815 it was administered within the Habsburg Kingdom of Illyria and later the Austrian Littoral.
zh:
伊斯特里亚是亚得里亚海最大的半岛，得名于当地的希斯特里人；罗马人视其为海盗部族，经两次战役于公元前177年将其征服。半岛首城普拉留存着古代世界保存最完好的竞技场之一。7世纪时斯拉夫人定居内陆，沿海诸城则保留了罗曼语。13世纪，这些城镇相继落入威尼斯之手：波雷奇1267年归附，乌马格1269年、罗维尼1283年先后纳入版图，普拉1331年正式成为威尼斯「海洋之国」的一部分，而内陆以帕津为中心的堡寨地带此前已归属哈布斯堡。1444年的伊斯特里亚海岸是威尼斯的疆土：各港为往返威尼斯与黎凡特的桨帆船提供停靠，皮兰盐田出产的盐连同沿海坡地的葡萄酒和橄榄油，装满了威尼斯商人的船舱。

威尼斯统治的几百年对普拉并不仁慈：热那亚与匈牙利的攻袭、反复流行的疟疾和伤寒，使它到18世纪中叶只剩约三千居民。1797年威尼斯共和国灭亡，伊斯特里亚依《坎波福尔米奥条约》转归哈布斯堡。1805年拿破仑将半岛并入意大利王国，1809年又划入伊利里亚行省，在当地推行《拿破仑法典》，修筑道路、兴办学校。1813年9月20日奥地利军队重新占领伊斯特里亚；1815年以后它并入哈布斯堡的伊利里亚王国，后来改属奥地利滨海区。

en:
Zagreb grew from two hills on the southern slopes of Mount Medvednica above the Sava; the Roman town of Andautonia once stood nearby at Šćitarjevo. In 1094 King Ladislaus of Hungary founded a diocese on the eastern hill, Kaptol, where the cathedral and the canons' quarter took root, while craftsmen and traders settled the neighbouring height of Gradec. Both places were ravaged by the Mongols in 1242, and Béla IV's Golden Bull of that year made Gradec a free royal city with its own walls and courts; the brook between the two towns set the scene for feuds between bishop and burghers that ran for centuries. In 1444 Zagreb belonged to the Croatian-Hungarian crown: its Catholic craftsmen wove the cloth and its merchants ran the markets of Zagorje, while beyond the southern hills the Ottoman advance that had swept the Balkans was drawing near.

As the southern frontier collapsed, Zagreb inherited the kingdom's institutions: the Sabor convened at Gradec, the town is documented as Croatia's capital from 1557, and the ban took up residence there in 1621. The strain of the Turkish wars helped ignite Matija Gubec's peasant rising in Zagorje, which broke out on 28 January 1573 against Baron Ferenc Tahy; on 9 February the baronial army broke Gubec's 10,000 men at Stubičko polje, leaving 3,000 dead, and he was tortured and executed six days later. The Jesuits, who had opened a grammar school in 1607, built the baroque church of Saint Catherine in 1620–32 and later an academy teaching philosophy, theology and law. In 1671 the Zrinski–Frankopan conspiracy ended on the scaffold: Ban Petar Zrinski and Fran Krsto Frankopan were beheaded at Wiener Neustadt on 30 April. Fire and plague scourged the town as cruelly as war, yet in 1776 the royal council moved from Varaždin to Zagreb, confirming it as Croatia's capital.
zh:
萨格勒布发源于梅德韦德尼察山南麓、萨瓦河畔的两座小山；附近的什奇塔尔耶沃曾坐落着罗马城镇安达通尼亚。1094年，匈牙利国王拉斯洛一世在东山卡普托尔设立主教区，大教堂与法政牧师区在此扎根，工匠和商人则聚居于相邻的格拉代茨高地。1242年两地同遭蒙古人蹂躏，同年贝拉四世颁发金玺诏书，把格拉代茨辟为自由王城，许其自筑城墙、自设法庭；两镇之间的小溪见证了主教与市民长达数百年的争斗。1444年的萨格勒布属于克罗地亚—匈牙利共主邦联：天主教市民织布经商，掌控着扎戈列的市集，而在南部群山之外，席卷巴尔干的奥斯曼兵锋正步步逼近。
