In 1444 its stones stood empty above the river while the surrounding steppe belonged to the dissolving Golden Horde; Mishar Tatars and Nogai herders pastured their flocks along the watercourses, and shipping on the Volga paid tribute or ransom to whoever was strong enough to take it. No permanent town yet stood on the bluffs.

The Russian fortress of Saratov was founded on 2 July 1590 by Prince Grigory Zasekin and Fyodor Turov, halfway between Samara and Tsaritsyn, to guard the Volga shipping. It burned in the winter of 1613–14, was rebuilt on the left bank in 1617, and moved to the hills of the right bank in 1674. Stepan Razin gave the town over to three days of plunder in 1670, and Bulavin's rebels besieged it in 1708. Peter I's Tsaritsyn defence line made the right bank safe for settlement, and after a salt office opened in 1747 Saratov grew rich as the transit point for salt from Lake Elton and Volga fish. From 1766 its Chancellery of Guardianship of Foreigners directed the German colonies founded on Catherine II's invitation. Pugachev's army stormed the town on 7 August 1774 and lost it again on 11 August, and in 1780 Catherine made Saratov the seat of a viceroyalty reorganised as the Saratov Governorate in 1796.
zh:
伏尔加河在此处的高岸被鞑靼人称作萨雷套，意为「黄山」；上游不远便是乌韦克——一座金帐汗国城市，1395年毁于帖木儿之手。1444年，故城残石空立河畔，周围草原归于正瓦解的金帐汗国，米萨鞑靼人与诺盖牧人沿水道放牧，伏尔加河上的往来商旅只能向强者纳贡或输赎。此时的河岸高坡上还没有一座常驻城镇。

1590年7月2日，格里戈里·扎谢金公爵与费奥多尔·图罗夫在萨马拉与察里津之间的中点筑起萨拉托夫要塞，以护卫伏尔加航运。城池1613至1614年冬焚毁，1617年在左岸重建，1674年又迁至右岸高地。1670年斯捷潘·拉辛纵兵在城内大掠三日，1708年布拉文起义军围攻该城。彼得一世修筑察里津防线后，右岸才得以安居；1747年盐务署设立，萨拉托夫作为埃尔通湖食盐与伏尔加河鱼货的转运枢纽兴盛起来。1766年起，设于此处的「外籍移民监护公署」统管奉叶卡捷琳娜二世诏书迁来的德意志人殖民地。1774年8月7日普加乔夫的军队攻破城池，8月11日即被米赫尔松所部收复；1780年叶卡捷琳娜二世设立萨拉托夫总督区，1796年改组为萨拉托夫省。

en:
These upper reaches of the Sura and the Moksha are the country of the Moksha Mordvins, whose princes had their capital, Noronshasht, on the ground later called Narovchat. Batu's armies destroyed it in 1237, and the Golden Horde built on the ruins the city of Mukhshi, seat of the Mukhsha ulus. Öz Beg Khan kept court there in 1313–1342, the city struck its own silver and copper coin, and in 1320 the khan formally adopted Islam. It lived through the wars of the beg Tagai, who raided Ryazan in 1365 and was overthrown by Arab-Shah in 1377, before Timur's army sacked it utterly in 1395. By 1444 Mukhshi was a shadow of a city among Mordvin villages, its surviving Tatar and Mordvin lords looking to the khan of Kazan.

The place revived from 1520 as the palisaded Narovchat gorodishche, with a six-towered wooden ostrog in the sixteenth century. After the fall of Kazan in 1552 the country opened to Russian service settlers, and in 1627 Narovchat was named a mustering point for Russian armies. A stronger bulwark rose on the Sura: beyond an earlier stockade, the architect Yuri Kontransky arrived in May 1663 to build the fortress of Penza, its name taken from a Moksha word for the end of a swampy river, garrisoned by Cossacks and linked into the Lomov sentry line. In 1774 Pugachev's rebels were welcomed into Penza, even though a rebel band four thousand strong under Yelistratov was cut to pieces near Narovchat. Penza Viceroyalty was formed in 1780 and Narovchat became one of its uyezd towns, losing that standing in 1798 and regaining it in 1803; Penza's first stone houses went up after 1801, and by 1809 the town counted more than 13,000 inhabitants.
zh:
苏拉河与莫克沙河上游是莫克沙摩尔多瓦人的家园，他们王公的都城诺龙沙什特就在后来称作纳罗夫恰特的地方。1237年拔都的大军将其摧毁，金帐汗国在废墟上建起莫赫什城，作为莫赫什兀鲁思的治所。月即别汗1313至1342年驻跸于此，城中自铸银钱和铜币，1320年汗廷又在此正式皈依伊斯兰教。此后它历经别乞塔盖的战乱——塔盖1365年袭掠梁赞，1377年被阿拉伯沙赫推翻——最终于1395年被帖木儿的大军彻底摧毁。到1444年，莫赫什已是摩尔多瓦村落间一座凋敝的残城，幸存的鞑靼与摩尔多瓦王公唯喀山汗马首是瞻。

1520年起，此地以「纳罗夫恰特城址」之名复苏，16世纪建起一座六塔木栅要塞。1552年喀山陷落后，这片土地向俄国军役移民敞开，1627年纳罗夫恰特被指定为俄军集结地。更坚固的屏障在苏拉河畔立起：早先这里只有木寨，1663年5月建筑师尤里·孔特兰斯基奉命修建奔萨要塞——城名得自莫克沙语，意为「沼泽河的尽头」，由哥萨克驻守，并入洛莫夫警戒防线。1774年普加乔夫的起义军在奔萨受到欢迎，而叶利斯特拉托夫率领的四千余人队伍在纳罗夫恰特附近被击溃。1780年设立奔萨总督区，纳罗夫恰特成为其县城之一，1798年被裁撤编制，1803年重为县城；奔萨最早的石砌房屋出现于1801年之后，到1809年全城已有一万三千余名居民。

en:
The Kama leaves the Ural foothills through the land the Komi-Permyaks called Perem, the 'far land' that gave the Permic peoples their name. Its forests yielded sable and squirrel pelts, for which Novgorod's traders had travelled north since the twelfth century, while the Komi princes of Great Perm held their seat at Cherdyn upriver and salt was boiled at Sol-Kamskaya from 1430. The middle Kama around the Chusovaya mouth was a rougher border country of Komi trappers and Bashkir herdsmen, and in 1444 the new Tatar khanate of Kazan, emerging from the break-up of the Golden Horde, numbered the Kama peoples among its tribute-bearers.

Moscow's armies subdued Cherdyn in 1472, and after Ivan the Terrible stormed Kazan on 2 October 1552, the Udmurt and Bashkir lands submitted without a fight. In 1558 the tsar granted the empty grounds along the Kama and Chusovaya to the Stroganov family; its men built saltworks and the fort of Kargedan, later Oryol-gorodok, in 1564, settled Russian peasants on the clearings, and in 1581 equipped Yermak's Cossacks there for the conquest of Siberia. The village of Yagoshikha is first named in the Stroganovs' census of 1647. In 1720 Peter the Great sent Vasily Tatishchev to organize Ural copper works, and on 4 May 1723 the Yegoshikha smelter was founded by the copper-bearing streams; Georg Wilhelm de Gennin saw it built. Catherine II named the settlement Perm and opened it as a city in 1781, and in 1796 it became the seat of Perm Governorate, the gateway on the Kama route to Siberia.
zh:
卡马河流出乌拉尔西麓时，穿过科米-彼尔姆克人称为「佩列姆」的土地，意为「远方之地」，彼尔姆诸族便由此得名。林中出产紫貂和灰鼠皮，自12世纪起诺夫哥罗德商人便沿河北上收购；科米王公的大彼尔姆国以上游的切尔登为都，1430年起索尔-卡姆斯卡亚已在煮盐。丘索瓦亚河口一带的中卡马地区更为荒莽，是科米猎人和巴什基尔牧人交错的边地。1444年，从金帐汗国分立出来的喀山鞑靼汗国，把卡马河诸族算作自己的纳贡之民。

1472年，莫斯科的军队降服切尔登；1552年10月2日伊凡雷帝攻陷喀山后，乌德穆尔特和巴什基尔之地不战归附。1558年，沙皇把卡马河与丘索瓦亚河沿岸的空旷土地封赐给斯特罗加诺夫家族；家族开设盐场，1564年筑起卡尔格丹堡，后称奥廖尔堡，又在林间空地安置俄罗斯农民，并于1581年在此为叶尔马克的哥萨克装备行装，开启对西伯利亚的征服。亚戈希哈村首见于1647年斯特罗加诺夫家的人口册。1720年，彼得大帝派遣瓦西里·塔季谢夫筹办乌拉尔炼铜厂；1723年5月4日，叶戈希哈炼铜厂在含铜的溪涧旁奠基，由格奥尔格·威廉·德·亨宁主持建成。叶卡捷琳娜二世将其定名彼尔姆，1781年正式设市，1796年成为彼尔姆省省会，是卡马河水路通往西伯利亚的门户。

en:
Nizhny Novgorod, 'Lower Novgorod', commands the confluence of the Oka and the Volga. Grand Prince Yuri II of Vladimir founded it on 4 February 1221 as a fortress on his eastern border against the Mordvins and Volga Bulgars, and for a century and a half it was the easternmost Russian town. The Mongols occupied it after 1238, and in 1350 it became the capital of the Nizhny Novgorod-Suzdal principality under Dmitry Konstantinovich, a rival of Moscow; in 1377 the monk Lavrenty copied the Laurentian Codex of the Primary Chronicle there. Moscow annexed the principality in 1392, and Edigu's Tatars burned the town in 1408. In 1444, under a Muscovite namestnik, its timber kremlin and river wharves made Nizhny Moscow's main forward base in the long contest with the Tatar khanate of Kazan.

The Tver merchant Afanasy Nikitin passed through around 1469 on his voyage to India. The red-brick Kremlin above the two rivers was built in 1508–1515 under the Italian architect Pietro Francesco and was never stormed; it weathered Kazan Tatar sieges in 1521 and 1536. After Kazan fell in 1552 the frontier rolled far to the east. Through the Time of Troubles the city stood by Moscow, and in 1611–1612 the merchant Kuzma Minin and Prince Dmitry Pozharsky raised their national militia beneath its walls and marched on to free Moscow. In the 1600s the Stroganovs made Nizhny their chief trading seat, and the Stroganov school of church architecture and icon painting grew up there; Old Believers fleeing Nikon's reforms settled the Kerzhenets forests, prompting the foundation of the Nizhny Novgorod and Alatyr diocese in 1672. Peter I made the city a governorate seat in 1714, and Catherine II's visit in 1767 led to its rebuilding on a regular street plan. In 1817 the great Makaryev Fair, burned out at its monastery, was moved to Nizhny, drawing merchants from across Europe and Asia and making the city the trading capital of the Russian interior.
zh:
下诺夫哥罗德意为「下游的新城」，扼守奥卡河汇入伏尔加河的河口。1221年2月4日，弗拉基米尔大公尤里·弗谢沃洛多维奇在此筑城，作为抵御莫尔多瓦人与伏尔加保加尔人的东部边防要塞，此后一个半世纪里它都是罗斯最东端的城镇。蒙古人在1238年后占据此地；1350年，它成为德米特里·康斯坦丁诺维奇治下与莫斯科争雄的下诺夫哥罗德—苏兹达尔大公国的都城，1377年修士拉夫连季在此抄成《往年纪事》的拉夫连季抄本。1392年莫斯科兼并该公国，1408年叶基盖伊的鞑靼军队焚毁城市。1444年的下诺夫哥罗德由莫斯科总督管辖，木构克里姆林和河港使它成为莫斯科与喀山鞑靼汗国长期对峙时最主要的前沿据点。

1469年前后，特维尔商人阿法纳西·尼基京在前往印度的途中经过此地。俯瞰两河的红砖克里姆林由意大利建筑师彼得罗·弗朗切斯科主持，建于1508至1515年间，从未被敌人攻陷，曾在1521年和1536年两度顶住喀山鞑靼人的围攻。1552年喀山陷落后，边界远远东移。混乱时期全城始终支持莫斯科；1611至1612年，商人库兹马·米宁和德米特里·波扎尔斯基公在城墙下组织民军，从这里出发解放了莫斯科。17世纪，斯特罗加诺夫家族把这里作为主要的经营据点，斯特罗加诺夫教堂建筑与圣像画派在此兴起；逃避尼康改革的旧礼仪派迁入克尔热涅茨河畔的森林，当局遂于1672年设立下诺夫哥罗德—阿拉特尔教区。1714年彼得一世将其设为省府；1767年叶卡捷琳娜二世到访，不满于城内弯曲的街道，推动了按规整规划进行的改建。1817年，毁于火灾的马卡里耶夫大集市从修道院旁迁至下诺夫哥罗德，欧亚各地商人云集奥卡河口，使这座城市成为俄国内陆的商贸之都。

en:
Vladimir stands on the Klyazma, founded around 1108 by Prince Vladimir Monomakh as a fortified outpost of the Rostov-Suzdal land. In 1157 Andrey Bogolyubsky made it his capital, raised the Golden Gates and the white-stone Dormition Cathedral, and was murdered at his nearby palace of Bogolyubovo in 1175. Under Vsevolod the Big Nest (1176–1212) it was the foremost city of northern Rus, but Batu Khan's Mongols stormed and burned it on 8 February 1238. The metropolitan's see moved from Kiev to Vladimir in 1299 and on to Moscow in 1325, and the wonder-working Vladimir Icon of the Mother of God followed in 1395. The city passed to Moscow by inheritance in 1389, and in 1408 Andrei Rublev and Daniil Chyorny frescoed its cathedral anew. In 1444 Vladimir was a provincial town of Vasily II's Muscovy, yet Moscow's rulers still came to the Dormition Cathedral to be crowned grand princes of Vladimir, and in the royal title the city stood second only to Moscow.

Between 1475 and 1479 Aristotele Fioravanti built the Dormition Cathedral in the Moscow Kremlin on the model of Vladimir's, and coronations then moved to Moscow. A great fire in 1491 brought new fortifications on the earthen ramparts, and in 1565 Ivan the Terrible placed Vladimir in the zemshchina, outside his oprichnina. In the Time of Troubles the town briefly served the second False Dmitry, but in April 1609 its people beat off a six-day siege by Polish-Lithuanian troops, and Lisowski's raiders wasted the countryside in 1615. In 1724 Peter the Great had the relics of Alexander Nevsky carried from the Nativity Abbey to the Alexander Nevsky Lavra in his new capital. From 1719 Vladimir headed a province of Moscow Governorate; Catherine II made it a viceroyalty seat in 1778, rebuilt in stone after the regular plan of 1781, and Paul I reconstituted it as Vladimir Governorate in 1796. The first printing press opened in 1797, beside the Vladimirka road along which convoys of exiles marched to Siberia.
zh:
弗拉基米尔坐落在克利亚济马河畔，约1108年由弗拉基米尔·莫诺马赫所建，最初是罗斯托夫—苏兹达尔地方的设防据点。1157年，安德烈·博戈柳布斯基迁都于此，建起金门和白石砌成的圣母升天大教堂，1175年他在附近的博戈柳博沃行宫遇刺身亡。在弗谢沃洛德「大窝」（1176—1212年在位）治下，弗拉基米尔成为东北罗斯首屈一指的名城，但1238年2月8日被拔都的蒙古大军攻破焚毁。1299年，都主教驻地从基辅迁至弗拉基米尔，1325年又随都主教彼得迁往莫斯科；1395年，灵验的弗拉基米尔圣母圣像也被移往莫斯科。1389年，弗拉基米尔作为世袭领地归入莫斯科公国，1408年安德烈·鲁布廖夫与丹尼尔·乔尔内为圣母升天大教堂重绘壁画。1444年的弗拉基米尔已是瓦西里二世治下的一座普通省城，然而莫斯科的统治者仍要到这座大教堂加冕为弗拉基米尔大公，在君主的头衔中，此城的位次仅次于莫斯科。

1475至1479年，阿里斯托泰莱·菲奥拉万蒂以弗拉基米尔的圣母升天大教堂为蓝本建成莫斯科克里姆林宫的同名大教堂，加冕礼此后改在莫斯科举行。1491年的大火之后，城市沿土垒重修了防御工事；1565年伊凡雷帝推行特辖区制，弗拉基米尔被划在特辖区之外的普通区。大动乱年代，此城一度归附伪德米特里二世，但1609年4月市民击退了波兰—立陶宛军队历时六天的围攻，1615年利索夫斯基的骑兵又蹂躏了四乡。1724年，彼得一世下令将亚历山大·涅夫斯基的遗骨从圣诞修道院迁往新首都的亚历山大·涅夫斯基修道院。1719年起弗拉基米尔成为莫斯科省下辖一个省的治所，1778年叶卡捷琳娜二世将其设为总督区首府，按1781年的正规规划以石材重建，1796年保罗一世又将其改制为弗拉基米尔省。1797年，城里第一家印刷所在「弗拉基米尔卡」路旁开张——一代代流放者正是沿这条路被押往西伯利亚。

en:
Yaroslavl grew on the steep Strelka cape where the Kotorosl joins the Volga. Tradition attributes its founding in the early eleventh century to Yaroslav the Wise during his rule at Rostov, and the Spaso-Preobrazhensky Monastery was already taking shape by the twelfth century. In 1218 the town became the capital of a separate principality under Vsevolod, son of Konstantin of Vladimir. The Mongols sacked it in 1238, and Prince Vsevolod was killed at the Sit River in the same campaign; later Horde raids, fires and plague repeatedly interrupted its growth. Ivan I of Moscow even burned Yaroslavl in 1332 on the khan's orders. In 1444 it was still the seat of its own Rurikid prince, an Orthodox Volga town overshadowed by an expanding Moscow.

In 1463 the last prince of Yaroslavl surrendered the succession to Ivan III, though the annexation was completed in law only in 1471. During the Time of Troubles, Kuzma Minin and Dmitry Pozharsky's Second People's Militia made the city its main camp from April to July 1612, governing the national cause there before marching on Polish-held Moscow. The seventeenth century then brought prosperity as Volga traffic connected Arkhangelsk with Siberia; leather, textiles and silverwork employed hundreds, merchants raised stone churches, and by 1700 the city had about 15,000 people, making it second only to Moscow in the tsardom. A great fire in 1658 destroyed the old Kremlin and confirmed the shift to brick building. In 1750 Fyodor Volkov established the theatre remembered as Russia's first permanent public stage. Catherine II made Yaroslavl a governorate centre in 1777 and approved Ivan Starov's classical city plan in 1778.
zh:
雅罗斯拉夫尔兴起于科托罗斯尔河汇入伏尔加河的陡峭斯特列尔卡角。传统认为，智者雅罗斯拉夫11世纪初统治罗斯托夫时建立此城，到12世纪，主显圣容修道院已在城外成形。1218年，这里成为弗谢沃洛德（弗拉基米尔的康斯坦丁之子）治下独立公国的都城。1238年蒙古人洗劫城市，王公弗谢沃洛德也在同次远征的锡季河之战中阵亡；此后金帐汗国袭掠、火灾和瘟疫一再打断城市发展，1332年莫斯科的伊凡一世还奉汗的命令焚毁雅罗斯拉夫尔。1444年，它仍是留里克王公的都城、一座信奉东正教的伏尔加河城市，只是已处在不断扩张的莫斯科阴影下。

1463年，雅罗斯拉夫尔末代王公把继承权交给伊凡三世，但法律上的兼并到1471年才完成。动荡时期，库兹马·米宁和德米特里·波扎尔斯基的第二人民义军在1612年4月至7月以雅罗斯拉夫尔为主要营地，在此统筹全国事务，随后进军波兰占据的莫斯科。17世纪，伏尔加商路把阿尔汉格尔斯克与西伯利亚连接起来，城市随之繁荣；皮革、纺织和银器作坊雇用工匠数百人，商人捐资修建石砌教堂，到1700年全城约有一万五千人，仅次于莫斯科。1658年的大火摧毁旧克里姆林，也促使城市几乎全面改用砖石。1750年，费奥多尔·沃尔科夫在此建立剧院，后被视为俄罗斯第一个常设公共剧场。叶卡捷琳娜二世1777年将雅罗斯拉夫尔设为省治，1778年批准伊凡·斯塔罗夫设计的古典主义城市规划。

en:
Olonets lies on the Olonka River east of Lake Ladoga, in a land of Karelian river settlements, forests and church pogosts. A note attached to a charter of Prince Svyatoslav Olgovich was once read as an 1137 mention, but Russian scholarship dates the addition later and treats several chronicles of 1228 as the first secure reference. Under the Novgorod Republic the Olonets district belonged to the archbishop rather than to a secular prince. In 1444 it was therefore an Orthodox Karelian back country of Novgorod, linked to Ladoga by river and organized around the Rozhdestvensky pogost; the later fortress town did not yet exist.

The Peace of Stolbovo in 1617 placed the Swedish frontier only about forty kilometres from the pogost. In September 1649 Tsar Alexis ordered a border fortress built at the meeting of the Olonka and Megrega, under Prince Fyodor Volkonsky and clerk Stepan Elagin. Its walls ran for more than 1.5 kilometres with nineteen towers, 1,300 embrasures, thirty-one guns and 824 muskets, while wealthy peasants from the Zaonezhye pogosts were resettled to trade and work iron. By the end of the seventeenth century Olonets had 726 households and merchants sailing as far as Stockholm. In 1702 its foundries were casting cannon for the Great Northern War, and from 1703 the Olonets shipyard on the Svir built Baltic frigates. The frontier role ended after the Treaty of Nystad in 1721; the old fortress burned in 1741 and was not rebuilt. Catherine II made Olonets a provincial center in 1773, but Petrozavodsk overtook it in 1784, and from 1801 it remained a district town.
zh:
奥洛涅茨位于拉多加湖以东的奥洛尼卡河畔，是一片分布着卡累利阿人河畔聚落、森林和教会教区的土地。附在斯维亚托斯拉夫·奥尔戈维奇王公规章后的一条文字曾被视为1137年的记载，但俄文文献考证认为该附笔写成更晚，应以1228年几部编年史中的记载作为可靠首见。诺夫哥罗德共和国时期，奥洛涅茨地区归属诺夫哥罗德大主教，而不是世俗王公。因此在1444年，这里还是诺夫哥罗德治下的东正教卡累利阿边地，经水路连接拉多加湖，以圣诞教区为中心；后来的要塞城镇尚未出现。

1617年《斯托尔博沃和约》后，瑞典边境距奥洛涅茨教区只有约四十公里。1649年9月，沙皇阿列克谢下令在奥洛尼卡河与梅格列加河交汇处修建边境要塞，由费奥多尔·沃尔孔斯基王公和书吏斯捷潘·叶拉金主持。城墙长逾1.5公里，设19座塔楼、1300个射击孔，配有31门火炮和824支火枪；政府又从外奥涅加各教区迁来富农经商和冶铁。到17世纪末，奥洛涅茨已有726户，商人甚至驾小船远航斯德哥尔摩。1702年，当地铁厂已在为大北方战争铸造火炮；1703年起，斯维里河畔的奥洛涅茨造船厂开始建造波罗的海舰队的巡航舰。1721年《尼斯塔德和约》后，边境要塞使命结束；旧要塞于1741年焚毁且未再重建。叶卡捷琳娜二世在1773年将奥洛涅茨设为省级政区中心，但彼得罗扎沃茨克于1784年后来居上，1801年以后这里仅为县治。

en:
Novgorod straddles the Volkhov at the outlet of Lake Ilmen, linking Baltic river routes with the fur forests of the Russian north. Its stone Cathedral of St Sophia was built in 1045–50, and after the townsmen expelled Prince Vsevolod Mstislavich in 1136 the veche, elected posadniks and archbishop shared power with boyar families. Hanseatic merchants maintained the Peterhof kontor, through which sable, ermine, squirrel pelts and beeswax moved to northern Europe; about 200 German merchants lived there in the 1430s. Novgorod began striking its own silver coins in 1420 and issued its law code in 1440. In 1444 it remained a vast, Orthodox merchant republic living on northern furs, but its dependence on southwestern grain and the rise of Moscow were already narrowing its freedom of action.

Moscow's wars ended that independence. Ivan III defeated the Novgorodian militia at Shelon in 1471, and on 15 January 1478 the republic submitted; the veche was abolished, its bell was carried to Moscow and many boyar families were deported. The brick citadel walls were rebuilt in 1484–90, and Ivan closed the Hanseatic kontor in 1494, although trade reopened in 1514. In winter 1569–70 Ivan IV's oprichniki sacked Novgorod for six weeks, torturing and drowning thousands and seizing church and merchant property. The German trading post was restored in 1603, but during the Time of Troubles Jakob de la Gardie's Swedish troops took the city in 1611 and held it until the Treaty of Stolbovo in 1617; recorded households fell from 1,158 in 1607 to 493 in 1617. Novgorod revived late in the century as a craft and church-building center, became an Old Believer stronghold after the schism, and after Saint Petersburg eclipsed the old routes became the seat of Novgorod Governorate in 1727.
zh:
诺夫哥罗德横跨沃尔霍夫河，坐落在伊尔门湖出水口，把波罗的海河水商路与俄罗斯北方的毛皮林地连接起来。石造圣索菲亚大教堂建于1045至1050年；1136年市民驱逐弗谢沃洛德·姆斯季斯拉维奇后，维彻、选举产生的行政长官和大主教与波雅尔家族共同掌权。汉萨商人在此设有彼得霍夫商站，紫貂、白鼬、松鼠皮和蜂蜡经此输往北欧；1430年代约有200名德意志商人住在这里。诺夫哥罗德1420年开始自铸银币，1440年颁布自己的法典。1444年时，它仍是幅员辽阔、依靠北方毛皮兴盛的东正教商业共和国，但对西南方粮食的依赖和莫斯科的崛起，已经使其活动余地日益狭窄。

莫斯科的战争终结了这种独立。伊凡三世1471年在舍隆河击败诺夫哥罗德民军，1478年1月15日共和国臣服；维彻被废除，维彻钟被运往莫斯科，许多波雅尔家族遭流放。1484至1490年，砖砌内城城墙得到重建；伊凡1494年关闭汉萨商站，贸易在1514年重新开放。1569至1570年冬，伊凡四世的特辖军洗劫诺夫哥罗德达六周，数以千计的人遭拷打和溺杀，教会与商人财产被没收。德意志商站1603年恢复，但动乱时代中，雅各布·德·拉加尔迪率领瑞典军队1611年攻占城市，占据到1617年《斯托尔博沃和约》签订；登记户数从1607年的1158户降至1617年的493户。17世纪末，诺夫哥罗德作为手工业和教堂建筑中心有所复苏，教会分裂后成为旧礼仪派据点；圣彼得堡取代旧商路后，它又在1727年成为诺夫哥罗德省省会。

en:
Kholm occupies the high ground above the confluence of the Lovat and Kunya, rivers that carried Novgorodian traffic along the old water road from the Baltic toward the Dnieper. Early Novgorod chronicle notices associated with the settlement call it Klin and date to 1131-1132; by the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries its center had moved to the opposite high bank of the Lovat. In 1444 the country around it belonged to the Novgorod republic and formed part of its Derevskaya pyatina, where boatmen, fishermen, and trappers lived by the river, forest, and marsh.

After Moscow's war with Novgorod, Kholmovsky pogost is documented in 1471, and Moscow made Kholm one of the administrative centers of Derevskaya pyatina. In the 1530s a timber-and-earth fortress was raised on Tatilova Hill; a 1575 survey describes the Spasskaya, Nikolskaya, and Klinskaya sides of the town. During the Livonian War, Stephen Bathory's troops seized Kholm, but the Truce of Yam-Zapolsky returned it to Moscow in 1582. By 1593 it was recorded as a posad under civilian administration, while Polish-Lithuanian attacks continued into the next century. The reform of 3 August 1777 raised the posad into the uyezd town of Kholm in Pskov Viceroyalty, and in 1796 it was placed in Pskov Governorate.
zh:
霍尔姆位于洛瓦季河与库尼亚河汇流处的高地上，两河连接着从波罗的海通向第聂伯河的古老水路，也曾承载诺夫哥罗德人的商旅。与本地有关的早期诺夫哥罗德编年史称这里为克林，记载见于1131—1132年；到14至15世纪，聚落中心已迁到洛瓦季河对岸的高坡。1444年时，这一带属于诺夫哥罗德共和国的杰列夫斯卡亚皮亚季纳，船工、渔夫和猎户依河流、森林与沼泽谋生。

莫斯科与诺夫哥罗德交战后，霍尔姆乡在1471年见于记载，莫斯科当局随后把霍尔姆设为杰列夫斯卡亚皮亚季纳的行政中心之一。1530年代，塔季洛瓦山上建起土木要塞；1575年的调查文书把城镇分为斯帕斯、尼科利斯克和克林三侧。利沃尼亚战争期间，斯特凡·巴托里的军队攻占霍尔姆，但1582年的亚姆—扎波利斯克停战协定又将它交还莫斯科。到1593年，文书已把它作为由文官管理的城镇聚落，波兰和立陶宛的袭击仍延续到下一世纪。1777年8月3日的行政改革把这座聚落升格为普斯科夫总督区的县治霍尔姆，1796年它划入普斯科夫省。

en:
Beloozero, the town on Lake Beloye, grew in the country of the Veps, whom the chronicles called the Ves. Archaeology places a fortified trading town on the Sheksna in the mid-tenth century, its customs posts checking beaver, marten, squirrel and otter furs moving between the Volga route and the northern rivers. From 1238 it was the seat of the small Beloozero principality. Plague nearly emptied it in 1352, and the settlement was refounded on its present lakeside site in 1363–1364. Russian sources consider that Moscow probably acquired the town in 1328, through Ivan Kalita's Tatar grants; in 1444 it was an Orthodox lake port and middleman in north-south commerce, though fur supplies were already giving way to arable farming.

In 1539 Beloozero received a criminal-justice charter allowing local gentry and townsmen to administer criminal justice. As northern trade shifted toward Arkhangelsk by way of the Sukhona and Northern Dvina, the older lake route lost business. On 10 July 1612 Lisowczycy raiders took the town without a fight and looted it; its earthen rampart and wooden walls could no longer meet artillery. Peter the Great included Beloozero in Ingermanland Governorate in 1708, and in 1727 it became the seat of Belozersk Province in Novgorod Governorate. The reform of 1777 renamed the town Belozersk, and in 1796 it became the centre of Belozersky Uyezd in Novgorod Governorate. The Mariinsk water system, opened in 1810, restored some of its traffic by linking the Volga basin with the Baltic.
zh:
别洛奥泽罗（后改名别洛焦尔斯克）坐落在白湖畔，兴起于编年史所称「维西人」的维普斯人之地。考古显示，10世纪中叶舍克斯纳河畔已有一座设防商城，海关检查经伏尔加商路与北方河流转运的河狸、貂、松鼠和水獭毛皮。1238年起，这里成为小邦别洛奥泽罗公国的中心。1352年瘟疫几乎使全城死绝，1363—1364年城镇在今白湖岸边重建。俄文资料认为，莫斯科可能在1328年凭伊凡·卡利塔从金帐汗国获得的封赐取得此地；1444年，它是一座东正教湖港和南北贸易中介，不过毛皮资源渐少，周边经济已更多转向农耕。

1539年，别洛奥泽罗获得地方治安特许状，可由本地贵族和市民审理刑案。随着北方贸易改经苏霍纳河与北德维纳河通向阿尔汉格尔斯克，旧湖路日渐萧条。1612年7月10日，利索夫奇基轻骑兵不血刃占领并洗劫城镇，土垒和木墙已抵挡不了火炮。1708年，彼得大帝将别洛奥泽罗划入英格曼兰省；1727年，它成为诺夫哥罗德省别洛焦尔斯克州的中心。1777年行政改革中，城市改名别洛焦尔斯克，1796年成为诺夫哥罗德省别洛焦尔斯克县治。1810年马里因斯克水系通航，把伏尔加河流域与波罗的海连接起来，也为这座老城挽回了部分运输生意。

en: Soroka was a small White Sea landing at the mouth of the Vyg River on Onega Bay, first mentioned in 1419. In 1429 the monks who became the founders of Solovetsky Monastery sailed from this shore to the Solovetsky Islands, where their community took shape in 1436. In 1444 the Orthodox fishermen and trappers of Soroka belonged to Novgorod, whose northern lands supplied furs, fish and salt. When Ivan III ended the republic in 1478, Soroka passed with the White Sea coast to Moscow. In 1551 Ivan IV made Sorotskaya an estate of Solovetsky Monastery, tying the village's fishing and trapping to one of the greatest landowners of the north.
zh: 索罗卡是维格河注入奥涅加湾处的小白海渡口，最早见于1419年记载。1429年，后来开创索洛韦茨基修道院的修士从这片海岸渡海前往索洛韦茨基群岛，修道团体于1436年在岛上成形。1444年时，索罗卡的东正教渔民和捕兽人属于诺夫哥罗德，这片北方土地输出毛皮、鱼和盐。1478年伊凡三世灭亡诺夫哥罗德共和国，索罗卡随白海海岸并入莫斯科。1551年，伊凡雷帝将索罗茨卡亚赐给索洛韦茨基修道院为领地，使该村的渔猎产业归入北方最大的世俗与教会领主之一。

en:
Vologda stands on the river of the same name, where the Volga and Northern Dvina systems meet at a short portage. Tradition dates its foundation to 1147, when the monk Gerasimus founded a Trinity monastery by the water, though the first firm record is a treaty of 1264 listing it among Novgorod's outlying lands. Its waterways drew Tver and Moscow as well as Novgorod: Tver sacked it in 1273, and in 1371 the monk Dmitry Prilutsky founded the Spaso-Prilutsky Monastery under Dmitry Donskoy's patronage, a Muscovite bridgehead in the northern trade. Vasily I of Moscow took the town by force in 1397, and it later weathered several Novgorod attacks. In 1444 Vologda was a wholly wooden Muscovite frontier town, busy with the furs carried between Moscow, Novgorod and the White Sea.

In September 1446 Dmitry Shemyaka granted Vologda to Vasily II, who was released at the Kirillo-Belozersky Monastery in 1447 from his oath never to seek Moscow and returned to the civil war; Shemyaka besieged the town in vain in 1450. From 1462 it was the appanage of Andrey Menshoy and reverted to Ivan III in 1481. After Richard Chancellor reached the White Sea in 1553, English merchants opened a trading post in 1555, and Vologda became Russia's chief northern mart. In 1565 Ivan the Terrible made it the planned capital of his oprichnina: on 28 April 1566 he himself founded the new Nason-gorod fortress, and the St Sophia Cathedral, copied from the Kremlin's Dormition Cathedral, rose in 1568–70 but was consecrated only in 1587, after the Tsar dropped the project in 1571. In the Troubles the town rose against False Dmitry II in November 1608 and armed the northern militias, yet after sending its men to Minin and Pozharsky it was sacked on 22 September 1612 by a Lithuanian raiding band. Vologda recovered as a trading city and received Peter the Great on his journeys to Arkhangelsk, but the Baltic rerouting of foreign trade, its inclusion in Archangelgorod Governorate in 1708 and Peter's 1722 curbs on Arkhangelsk commerce left it a quiet provincial town. Catherine II made it a viceroyalty seat in 1780, rebuilt on the regular plan of 1781, and Paul I constituted it Vologda Governorate in 1796.
zh:
沃洛格达位于同名河畔，伏尔加河与北德维纳河两大水系在此只隔一道短短的旱路连水。相传1147年修士格拉西姆在河边建起圣三一修道院，城市由此发源，但首次可靠记载是1264年的一份条约，它被列为诺夫哥罗德的边远领地。此地的水路既属诺夫哥罗德，也引来特维尔和莫斯科：1273年特维尔军队洗劫了它，1371年，修士德米特里·普里卢茨基在德米特里·顿斯科伊的庇护下创办斯帕索-普里卢茨基修道院，成为莫斯科打入北方贸易的桥头堡。1397年，莫斯科的瓦西里一世以武力夺取此城，此后它又数次顶住诺夫哥罗德的进攻。1444年的沃洛格达是一座全木结构的莫斯科边塞城镇，往来于莫斯科、诺夫哥罗德与白海之间的毛皮生意令它市面繁忙。

1446年9月，德米特里·舍米亚卡把沃洛格达封给瓦西里二世；1447年，瓦西里在基里洛-别洛泽尔斯基修道院被解除不再争夺莫斯科的誓言，重开战事，1450年舍米亚卡围攻此城不克。1462年起它成为「小安德烈」的封邑，1481年因无嗣而封邑收回，重归伊凡三世。1553年理查德·钱塞勒抵达白海后，英国商人于1555年在此开设商站，沃洛格达遂成为俄国北方首屈一指的贸易中转站。1565年，伊凡雷帝打算把它建成特辖区的都城：1566年4月28日他亲临奠基，筑起新城「纳索城」要塞；1568至1570年，仿照克里姆林宫圣母升天大教堂的圣索菲亚大教堂落成，却要到1587年才祝圣——沙皇已在1571年放弃了这项营建。大动乱期间，市民于1608年11月起兵反抗伪德米特里二世，并为北方民军提供军械；但在把壮丁派往米宁和波扎尔斯基的队伍之后，1612年9月22日，一支立陶宛匪帮攻陷并焚毁了几乎不设防的城市。沃洛格达后来凭贸易复苏，彼得一世前往阿尔汉格尔斯克途中多次驻跸于此，但外贸改走波罗的海、1708年被划入阿尔汉格尔斯克省，再加上1722年彼得限制阿尔汉格尔斯克贸易，使它沦为僻静的省城。1780年叶卡捷琳娜二世将其设为总督区首府，按1781年的正规规划重建，1796年保罗一世正式设立沃洛格达省。

en:
Finnmark is Norway's Arctic edge, where Sámi hunters and reindeer people met Norwegian fishing settlements on the outer fjords. The crown's claim rested on Vardøhus, raised on Vardøya by 1307 and accompanied by a church at Vardø. Rivalry with Novgorod over taxes from the Sámi ended with the Treaty of Novgorod in 1326, while dried cod drew Norwegian fishing villages along the coast. In 1444, Vardø was a remote Catholic garrison and trading haven under the Norwegian crown, its wealth fish rather than grain.

Vardøhus became the seat of its own fief in 1576, and Christian IV sailed there with eight ships in 1599 to assert the northern frontier. Religious fear then struck the town: in the seventeenth century 91 people were executed for witchcraft in Finnmark, many at Vardøhus. The present star-shaped fortress was built in 1734-1737 against the Russian border. Bergen merchants held the Finnmark monopoly until it was abolished in 1787, and two years later Vardø received town rights. Its quays prospered in the Pomor trade, exchanging fish for grain and timber from Arkhangelsk.
zh:
芬马克位于挪威的北极边陲，萨米猎人与牧鹿人在此活动，挪威渔民则在外峡湾建立渔村。挪威王权的依托是瓦尔德岛上至迟1307年已经建成的瓦尔德胡斯要塞，瓦尔德教堂也在此时设立。挪威与诺夫哥罗德围绕向萨米人征税的争夺，在1326年《诺夫哥罗德条约》后告一段落；与此同时，干鳕鱼贸易吸引挪威人沿海岸建立定居点。1444年的瓦尔德是挪威王冠治下遥远的天主教驻军地和贸易港，这里的财富来自鱼类，而不是谷物。

1576年，瓦尔德胡斯成为独立封邑的治所。1599年，克里斯蒂安四世率八艘船航抵此地，宣示北方边疆。宗教恐惧随后笼罩城镇：17世纪的芬马克有91人因巫术被处死，其中许多人丧命于瓦尔德胡斯。现存的星形要塞建于1734年至1737年，用于防卫俄罗斯边界。卑尔根商人对芬马克的垄断一直持续到1787年才被废除；两年后，瓦尔德获得城市地位。这里的码头因波莫尔贸易而兴盛，用鱼类换取来自阿尔汉格尔斯克的谷物和木材。

en:
Kocaeli is the peninsula and coast around the Gulf of Izmit, where the roads from Anatolia converge on the Bosphorus. Its capital, ancient Nicomedia, was refounded by King Nicomedes I in 264 BC and became Diocletian's eastern capital in AD 286, for a while the fourth city of the Roman world; after Constantinople became capital in 330 it lived in its shadow. The Ottomans entered under Orhan: the warrior Akça Koca, who gave the region its name, overran the southern shore of the gulf in 1327, and when famine weakened the defence Nicomedia itself fell in 1337 and became the sanjak of Kocaeli, whose first governor was Orhan's son Süleyman Paşa. During the Interregnum after Timur's victory of 1402 the town was briefly handed back to the Byzantines, but Mehmed I recovered it by 1413 and rebuilt it. In 1444 Izmit was a quiet Ottoman grain port and market on the sea road to Constantinople, with a shipyard on its shore.

On 14 September 1509 the great earthquake that shook Constantinople struck Izmit too, wrecking the sea walls, five mosques and three hundred houses, the Süleyman Paşa Medresesi among them. Plague arrived from the capital in 1592 and kept the bazaars shut for six months, and in the bitter winter of 1621 the head of the gulf froze. Under Murad IV the rebel Gürcü Abdünnebi marched through Kocaeli against Istanbul before his rising collapsed and he was killed in 1659; Abaza Hasan Ağa's revolt of 1651 left the district plundered. Damat Ibrahim Pasha restored the town during the Tulip Period of Ahmed III, but the earthquakes that began on 22 May 1766 and lasted two months largely destroyed Izmit and put its shipyard out of action. The town slowly recovered and remained a modest port feeding the capital grain and timber.
zh:
科贾埃利是环绕伊兹密特湾的半岛与滨海地带，安纳托利亚通往博斯普鲁斯的道路在此汇聚。首府伊兹密特古称尼科米底亚，公元前264年由尼科美德一世重建，286年成为戴克里先的东都，一度位列罗马世界第四大城；330年君士坦丁堡定都后便屈居其侧。奥斯曼人在奥尔汗时代进入此地：为这一地区留下名字的战将阿克恰·科贾1327年席卷海湾南岸，1337年城中又逢饥荒，尼科米底亚终被攻取，成为科贾埃利桑贾克，奥尔汗之子苏莱曼帕夏为首任总督。1402年帖木儿安卡拉获胜后的大空位期里，城市一度交还拜占庭，穆罕默德一世1413年将其收回并着手重建。1444年的伊兹密特是一座平静的奥斯曼谷物港与商埠，扼守通往君士坦丁堡的海路，岸边设有船厂。

1509年9月14日，震动君士坦丁堡的大地震同样袭击伊兹密特，海墙、五座清真寺和三百栋房屋被毁，苏莱曼帕夏经学院也未能幸免。1592年瘟疫自都城传入，市集关闭半年；1621年严冬，海湾尽头竟然封冻。穆拉德四世时期，叛乱的格鲁吉亚人阿卜敦内比取道科贾埃利进军伊斯坦布尔，最终兵败，于1659年被杀；1651年阿巴扎·哈桑阿加之乱又使这一带遭到劫掠。艾哈迈德三世的郁金香时代，达马特·易卜拉欣帕夏主持修复了城市，但1766年5月22日起持续两个月的地震群将伊兹密特再度大部摧毁，船厂也无法使用。此后城市慢慢恢复，继续充当为都城供应谷物与木材的朴素港口。

en:
Bursa, the Byzantine Prusa beneath Mount Olympus (Uludağ), was a fortified thermal town and a silk-weaving centre from the sixth century. The Ottomans blockaded it from 1317 and Orhan Gazi's men entered on 6 April 1326; in 1335 it became the Ottoman capital. Orhan founded the first imperial mosque complex and the first official Ottoman mint, and the sultans were still laid to rest here after the court moved to Edirne in the 1360s. Bayezid I built his Yıldırım mosque between 1390 and 1395 and the Great Mosque from 1396 to 1400. After Ankara, Timur's grandson Muhammad Sultan sacked and burned the city in 1402, but Mehmed I reunited the empire and raised the tile-clad Green Mosque, finished in 1420, with the Green Tomb following in 1421; Murad II's Muradiye complex came next. In 1444 Bursa was the Ottomans' richest Anatolian city, crowded with hans and bazaars, its looms fed by Iranian raw silk and the Çekirge springs already drawing bathers.

The conquest of Constantinople ended its administrative role, yet silk carried it to new prosperity: the 1487 registers list 174 quarters and 6,457 taxpaying heads, and Sephardic Jews expelled from Spain in 1492 joined the old Romaniote community. Bayezid II ordered the Koza Han, the cocoon caravanserai, begun in March 1490 and opened on 29 September 1491; the Medici of Florence kept an agent in its galleries in the early 1500s. Raw silk arrived from Iran and sometimes from Ming China, and through the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries Bursa looms supplied the palace with kaftans, cushions and embroidery, while the Yeni Kaplıca thermal bath went up under Süleyman. The Koza Han was repaired in 1630, 1671 and 1784, and its silk auctions continued into the nineteenth century.
zh:
布尔萨即拜占庭的普鲁萨，坐落于今乌鲁达山（古名奥林匹斯山）麓，6世纪起就是有驻军的温泉城和丝织业中心。奥斯曼人1317年起围城，奥尔汗加齐的部下于1326年4月6日破城，1335年这里成为奥斯曼首都。奥尔汗修建了最早的皇家清真寺建筑群和第一座官方铸币厂；14世纪60年代宫廷迁往埃迪尔内之后，历代苏丹仍葬于此城。巴耶济德一世1390至1395年建起耶尔德勒姆清真寺，1396至1400年又建成大清真寺。安卡拉战役之后，帖木儿之孙穆罕默德·苏丹于1402年纵兵焚掠布尔萨；穆罕默德一世重新统一帝国，修建了满贴彩釉瓷砖的绿色清真寺（1420年完工），绿色陵墓1421年落成，穆拉德二世的穆拉迪耶建筑群随后建起。1444年的布尔萨是奥斯曼在安纳托利亚最富庶的城市，客店与市集林立，织机靠伊朗生丝供料，切基尔盖的温泉也已吸引浴客。

君士坦丁堡被征服后，它失去了行政中心的地位，但丝绸贸易把它推向新的繁荣：1487年的册籍载有174个街区、6457名纳税男丁；1492年被逐出西班牙的塞法迪犹太人来到这里，加入古老的罗曼尼奥犹太人社群。巴耶济德二世下令修建蚕茧客店科扎罕，1490年3月动工、1491年9月29日开业，16世纪初佛罗伦萨美第奇家族的代理商就在其廊下设有办事处。生丝自伊朗、间或自明代中国运来，整个16、17世纪，布尔萨织机为宫廷供应长袍、靠垫和绣品；苏莱曼时期又建起耶尼卡普勒贾温泉浴场。科扎罕先后在1630、1671和1784年重修，丝绸拍卖一直延续到19世纪。

en:
Smyrna, the future İzmir, lies at the head of a deep gulf on the Aegean coast, beneath Mount Pagos and its citadel, the Kadifekale. In the 14th century the Aydınid Turks made the upper castle a base for naval raids under Umur Bey, while a crusader league took the harbour castle in 1344; for sixty years Christian knights held the waterfront and Turks the heights. Bayezid I brought the upper city under the Ottomans in 1390, but after his defeat at Ankara Timur's army stormed Smyrna in December 1402, razed the Knights' castle and massacred much of the population. Mehmed I recovered the town in 1415, and Murad II made it firmly Ottoman in 1424, when he overcame the last Aydınid, Cüneyd Bey. In 1444 Smyrna was a modest market town and kaza centre under the sanjak of Aydın, its Aegean cotton, fruit and cordage shipped from a half-silted harbour.

A Venetian fleet raided the town in 1475, and after 1492 Sephardic Jews expelled from Spain added their crafts and trade. Around 1573 İzmir became the seat of the new Sığla sanjak, and its rise began as Aegean cotton drew French, English, Dutch and Venetian merchants to the gulf. The capitulations of 1620 opened the port to privileged foreign houses; the French consulate moved from Chios in 1619 and the English followed in 1621, each with its own quay. Caravans from inner Anatolia, and Iranian silk rerouted through Erzurum and Tokat, made it the busiest of the Levant ports, and it provisioned the fleet during the long Cretan war of 1648–1669. Plague in 1676, the great earthquake of 1688 and a fire in 1743 failed to check it: by 1700 perhaps 90,000 people lived there, Turks alongside Greeks, Armenians, Jews and Franks. In 1770 the Ottoman fleet was burned at nearby Çeşme, and in 1797 a janissary riot sacked the Frankish quarter.
zh:
士麦那，即今伊兹密尔，位于爱琴海一处深水海湾的湾顶、帕戈斯山（卡迪费卡莱城堡所在）下。14世纪时，艾登奥卢突厥人以上城堡为海上袭掠的据点，乌穆尔贝伊即以此起家；1344年十字军联盟夺取海港城堡，此后六十年间基督徒骑士守着港区、突厥人占着山冈。巴耶济德一世于1390年将上城堡纳入奥斯曼版图，但安卡拉战役之后，帖木儿的军队于1402年12月攻陷士麦那，夷平骑士团城堡并屠戮大量居民。穆罕默德一世1415年收复此城，穆拉德二世1424年讨平最后的艾登奥卢王公居内伊德贝伊，城池才彻底归入奥斯曼。1444年的士麦那只是艾登桑贾克治下一座普通集镇和卡扎（县）治所，爱琴海的棉花、果品和船具从日渐淤塞的港口运出。

1475年威尼斯舰队袭掠此城；1492年后，被逐出西班牙的塞法迪犹太人带来手艺和贸易。约1573年，伊兹密尔成为新设的瑟拉桑贾克的驻地，随后凭借爱琴海棉花吸引法、英、荷、威尼斯商人云集海湾。1620年的通商特惠特权将港口向外国商馆开放，法国领事馆1619年、英国领事馆1621年先后从希俄斯迁来，各据一处码头。安纳托利亚内陆的商队和改经埃尔祖鲁姆、托卡特运出的伊朗丝绸以此为终点，使它成为黎凡特最繁忙的港口；1648至1669年的克里特战争期间，这里又是舰队的补给港。1676年的瘟疫、1688年的大地震和1743年的大火都没能阻挡它的扩张，到1700年居民已有约九万人，突厥人与希腊人、亚美尼亚人、犹太人和法兰克人杂处。1770年奥斯曼舰队在附近的切什梅被焚毁，1797年耶尼切里哗变又劫掠了法兰克人街区。

en:
The mountains and three peninsulas of ancient Caria became the land of the Menteşe Turks in 1284, when Menteşe Bey took Muğla. Ruling from Milas, the beylik was the first sea power among the Anatolian principalities: its captains, called the Sea Turks, raided as far as Rhodes under Mesut Bey in 1300, while the port of Mağrı, later Fethiye, shipped grain, horses and alum to Venetian Crete. Orhan Bey drew tribute from Negroponte after 1332. Weakened by the earthquake of 1389, the dynasty submitted to Bayezid I in 1391, was restored by Timur in 1402 under İlyas Bey, and was fully incorporated into the Ottoman realm under Murad II in 1425. The Ottomans moved the seat of the new sanjak from Milas inland to Muğla, yet at Bodrum the Knights Hospitaller still held the Castle of St Peter, raised after 1402 with stone quarried from the ruins of the Mausoleum of Halicarnassus. In 1444 Menteşe was thus an Ottoman shipbuilding coast with a Christian fortress at its Aegean gateway.

When Mehmed II besieged Constantinople in 1453, Menteşe shipyards and seamen supplied roughly two in five vessels of the assault fleet. The Hospitaller enclave outlasted the Byzantine capital by nearly seventy years: only after Süleyman I conquered Rhodes in 1522 did the knights surrender Bodrum and withdraw to Malta, and the sultan's own Rhodes fleet marshalled in these gulfs. The sanjak of Menteşe then passed the following centuries as a quiet timber- and ship-building province; when Evliya Çelebi visited in the seventeenth century he found Muğla a small, inward-looking mountain town, while the forested shore still launched vessels for the Ottoman navy.
zh:
这里是古卡里亚的山地与三道半岛，1284年门泰谢贝伊夺取穆拉后，成为门泰谢土耳其人的家园。侯国以米拉斯为都，是安纳托利亚诸侯国中第一个海上强权：它的船长被称为「海上土耳其人」，梅苏德贝伊时曾于1300年袭扰远至罗得岛，马厄勒（后称费特希耶）港则向威尼斯治下的克里特岛输出粮食、马匹和明矾，奥尔汗贝伊更在1332年后向内格罗蓬特征收贡赋。1389年的大地震使侯国元气大伤，王朝于1391年臣服巴耶济德一世，1402年经帖木儿之手恢复伊利雅斯贝伊的君位，最终于1425年穆拉德二世在位时被彻底并入奥斯曼。奥斯曼人把新桑贾克的治所从米拉斯迁往内陆的穆拉，但在博德鲁姆，医院骑士团仍占着圣彼得城堡——它是1402年后拆取哈利卡纳苏斯摩索拉斯陵墓的石料建成的。1444年的门泰谢，是奥斯曼的造船海岸，爱琴海的门户上却还嵌着一座基督徒要塞。

1453年穆罕默德二世围攻君士坦丁堡时，参战舰队里约五分之二的船只由门泰谢的船厂和水手提供。骑士团的飞地比拜占庭都城多撑了近七十年：直到1522年苏莱曼一世攻克罗得岛，骑士们才交出博德鲁姆，撤往马耳他；而苏丹远征罗德岛的舰队，正是在这一带海湾集结。此后门泰谢桑贾克作为出产木材和船只的安静行省度过几个世纪；17世纪爱维亚·瑟勒布游历时，见到的穆拉是一座封闭内向的山城，林木繁茂的海岸则仍在为奥斯曼海军下水新船。

en:
Rhodes, largest of the Dodecanese, lies a few miles off the Anatolian shore, its city commanding one of the finest harbours in the eastern Mediterranean. After centuries of Byzantine rule the island was taken in 1306–1309 by the Knights Hospitaller, who sailed from Cyprus in company with the Genoese corsair Vignolo Vignoli and made Rhodes the seat of their Order. They rebuilt the city as a fortified convent, with the Palace of the Grand Master, the auberges of the Order's Tongues and new walls devised by Italian engineers against gunpowder, while the Greek islanders kept their Orthodox faith outside the Latin ruling caste. In 1444 a Mamluk fleet from Egypt landed on 10 August and stormed the western walls and the Mandraki harbour, only to re-embark on 18 September; weeks later, as our era opens, Grand Master Jean de Lastic still held the strongest fortress in the Aegean.

The end came in two Ottoman sieges. In 1480 an army of some 70,000 sent by Mehmed II failed to break the defenses, Grand Master Pierre d'Aubusson fighting in the thick of the breach. In 1522 Suleiman the Magnificent came in person with some 400 ships and 100,000 men; after six months Grand Master Philippe Villiers de L'Isle-Adam surrendered, and on 1 January 1523 the surviving knights sailed away followed by 3,000 to 4,000 Rhodians, beginning the exile that led them by way of Sicily to Malta. The church of St John was turned into a mosque, the Sultan founded medreses and an imaret, and the Greeks were removed outside the walls into the marásia suburbs, entering the town by day to work in its markets and shipyards. Rhodes became the seat of an Ottoman sanjak, and so it remained when the Greek revolt broke out in 1821.
zh:
罗得岛是多德卡尼斯群岛中最大的岛屿，距安纳托利亚海岸仅数海里，罗得城前的良港是东地中海最好的港口之一。拜占庭统治数百年后，医院骑士团于1306—1309年夺取该岛：他们与热那亚海盗维尼奥洛·维尼奥利合作，从塞浦路斯出征，把罗得城建成修会总部——大教长宫、各语区会馆，以及意大利工程师按火炮攻防设计的新城墙；希腊岛民仍信奉东正教，处在拉丁统治阶层之外。1444年，埃及的马穆鲁克舰队于8月10日登陆，猛攻西墙和曼德拉基港，却在9月18日登船撤走；几周之后开局之时，大教长让·德·拉斯蒂克仍据有爱琴海上最坚固的要塞。

结局由两次奥斯曼围攻决定。1480年，穆罕默德二世派出约七万大军仍未能破城，大教长皮埃尔·德·奥比松在突破口的激战中亲自抵抗。1522年，苏莱曼大帝亲率约四百艘战船、十万大军前来；围攻六个月后，大教长菲利普·维利耶·德·利勒—亚当投降。1523年1月1日，幸存的骑士登船离去，随行的还有三四千罗得岛人，取道西西里，最终落脚马耳他。圣约翰教堂被改为清真寺，苏丹设立了经学院和施粥所；希腊人被迁出城墙，住进名为马拉西亚的城外郊区，白天才能入城在市集和船坞做工。罗得岛成为奥斯曼一个桑贾克的治所，1821年希腊独立战争爆发时仍在苏丹手中。

en:
Nicosia stands in the middle of the Mesaoria plain between the island's two mountain ranges, and has been the island's capital since Byzantine times, chosen around 965 against sea raiders. Under the French Lusignan kings from 1192 it was the seat of a Latin court, where kings were crowned in the Gothic cathedral of Saint Sophia and the island grew rich on trade and on the Crusader-era sweet wine of the commandery villages. Genoese fleets sacked the city in 1373–74, and in 1426 a Mamluk army captured King Janus at Khirokitia on 7 July, sacked Nicosia and made the kingdom tributary to Cairo. In 1444 John II still reigns in the old royal palace, Catholic Frankish nobles ruling over Orthodox Greek peasants, its wine and the plain's produce leaving the ports.

John died in 1458, and after a quarrel between his daughter Charlotte and his illegitimate son James, James, once Archbishop of Nicosia, took the crown with Mamluk help in 1460 and reigned as James II. He married the Venetian Caterina Cornaro but died on 10 July 1473; their infant son James III died in 1474, and Caterina ruled until Venice forced her abdication on 26 February 1489. The Republic gave Nicosia star-shaped bastioned walls in 1567, but an Ottoman army under Lala Mustafa and Piali Pasha stormed the city on 9 September 1570 after a forty-day siege; some 20,000 died, and Saint Sophia became the great mosque. Cyprus became an Ottoman eyalet, then in 1670 a sanjak of the Kapudan Pasha; a two-year agha revolt under Boyacıoğlu Mehmed followed in the 1680s, and tax rioters killed the governor Çil Osman in 1764. As the Orthodox archbishop and the dragoman gathered power, news of the Greek rising of 1821 brought terror: on 9 July the governor Küçük Mehmed had Archbishop Kyprianos hanged before the old palace and put 470 notables to death.
zh:
尼科西亚位于塞浦路斯两条山脉之间的梅萨奥里亚平原中央，自约965年拜占庭为避海盗而选定它起，就是岛上的首府。1192年起法兰西吕西尼昂王朝以此为拉丁宫廷所在：国王在哥特式的圣索菲亚大教堂加冕，全岛凭贸易和骑士管区村庄出产的甜酒致富，酒名便得自十字军时代。1373至1374年热那亚舰队洗劫城市，1426年马穆鲁克军队又在7月7日的希罗基蒂亚战役中生擒国王雅努斯、劫掠尼科西亚，王国从此沦为向开罗纳贡的藩属。1444年，约翰二世仍在旧王宫中临朝，奉天主教的法兰克贵族统治着信东正教的希腊农民，骑士管区的甜酒和平原的物产从岛上各港口运出。

约翰1458年去世，其女夏洛特与私生子詹姆斯争位；曾被立为尼科西亚大主教的詹姆斯借马穆鲁克之兵于1460年夺得王冠，是为詹姆斯二世。他娶威尼斯女子卡特琳娜·科纳罗为妻，1473年7月10日死去，幼子詹姆斯三世1474年夭亡，科纳罗以女王身份统治到1489年2月26日被迫让位给威尼斯。共和国着手加固全岛，1567年为尼科西亚建起星形棱堡城墙；1570年，拉拉·穆斯塔法与皮亚利帕夏率奥斯曼军围城四十日，9月9日破城，约两万人死亡，圣索菲亚大教堂被改作主清真寺。塞浦路斯初为奥斯曼行省，1670年降为卡普丹帕夏辖下的桑贾克。17世纪80年代，博亚哲奥卢·穆罕默德率领地方豪强起兵作乱两年；1764年抗税民众又杀死总督奇勒·奥斯曼。随着东正教大主教和译员权势日重，1821年希腊起义的消息给尼科西亚带来恐怖：7月9日，总督库丘克·穆罕默德下令把大主教基普里亚诺斯绞死在旧王宫前，并处死了470名显贵。

en:
Kütahya, the Cotyaeum of Roman and Byzantine Phrygia, stands on the Porsuk River beneath its citadel. It became the capital of the Germiyanid beylik. In 1381 Süleyman Bey married his daughter Devletşah Hatun to the Ottoman prince Bayezid and transferred Kütahya with neighboring lands as her dowry. Timur restored Yakub II after the Battle of Ankara in 1402, Karaman briefly seized the city in 1411, and the last Germiyanid lands passed to Murad II in 1428. In 1444 Kütahya was a newly integrated Ottoman Turkish and Sunni town, its markets and early tile workshops lying on the roads between Bursa, Ankara and the Aegean lowlands.

After İshak Pasha took up residence in 1451, Kütahya became the seat of the Anatolia beylerbeyilik, later overseeing a province organized into fourteen sancaks. The Şahkulu rising, sympathetic to Shah Ismail, reached the area under Bayezid II and was suppressed in 1511. During the Celali disorders, Deli Hasan besieged Vizier Hafız Ahmed Pasha in Kütahya Castle for three days in August 1601 before heavy snow forced him to raise the siege, though his men plundered the houses outside the walls. In 1657 the townspeople killed about three hundred soldiers of Governor Can Mirza Pasha after he joined Abaza Hasan Pasha's revolt, and then held out against his siege. Through these troubled decades Kütahya's tile and ceramic workshops remained its distinctive industry, supplying mosques, churches and Ottoman official buildings.
zh:
屈塔希亚在罗马和拜占庭时代是弗里吉亚的科泰乌姆，城凭山冈上的堡垒而立，波尔苏克河从旁流过。它后来成为格尔米扬贝伊国的都城。1381年，苏莱曼贝伊把女儿德夫莱特沙哈·哈敦嫁给奥斯曼王子巴耶济德，并将屈塔希亚及周边土地作为嫁妆交出。1402年安卡拉战役后，帖木儿恢复了亚库布二世的领地；1411年卡拉曼曾短暂夺城，到1428年，格尔米扬最后的领土归入穆拉德二世。1444年时，屈塔希亚是一座刚纳入奥斯曼的土耳其人、逊尼派城镇，市集和早期瓷砖作坊位于通往布尔萨、安卡拉与爱琴海低地的道路上。

1451年伊沙克帕夏驻节于此，屈塔希亚成为安纳托利亚贝伊莱尔贝伊利克的驻地，后来管辖下分十四个桑贾克的省份。巴耶济德二世时期，支持沙阿·伊斯玛仪的沙赫库鲁起事波及此地，于1511年被镇压。杰拉里动乱期间，德利·哈桑在1601年8月把维齐尔哈菲兹·艾哈迈德帕夏围困在屈塔希亚城堡中三日，终因大雪撤围，但其部下洗劫了城外房屋。1657年，总督詹·米尔扎帕夏投奔阿巴扎·哈桑帕夏叛乱后，市民杀死他约三百名士兵，并坚守城池抵御其围攻。在这些动荡年代里，瓷砖与陶器作坊始终是屈塔希亚最有特色的产业，为清真寺、教堂和奥斯曼官方建筑供应制品。

en:
Konya, ancient Iconium, lies on the Lycaonian plain at the south-western edge of the central Anatolian plateau. The Seljuk Turks took it in 1084, and after the loss of Nicaea in 1097 it became the capital of their Sultanate of Rum. Under Ala al-Din Kayqubad I (1220–1237), walls ringed a city of 45,000 to 50,000 with seven Friday mosques, the greatest in Anatolia. Jalal al-Din Rumi, the Mevlana of the Turks, fled from Balkh before the Mongols and settled here young; after his death on 17 December 1273 the Green Tomb rose over his grave, nucleus of the Mevlevi order of whirling dervishes. When Seljuk power dissolved it passed from the Eshrefids to the Karamanids in 1322, becoming their capital and changing hands between the two dynasties sixteen times. In 1444 it was held by Ibrahim II, who had raided Karahisar and Bolvadin while Murad II fought the Varna crusade and been forced to terms that August.

Ibrahim II died in 1464; his sons Pir Ahmed and Ishak split the beylik, until Pir Ahmed, with Ottoman backing, defeated Ishak's Aq Qoyunlu allies in 1465. In April 1468 the Ottoman army stormed Gevele and took Konya; Mehmed II made his son Prince Mustafa, a grandson of Ibrahim II, governor. Pir Ahmed held out in the Taurus until a campaign in 1474 took Nigde, Develi and the Icel coast; Bayezid II annexed the last of the beylik in 1487. As capital of the Karaman province it was ruled by imperial princes: Mustafa, then Cem, who disputed the succession in 1481 and fled to Rhodes in 1482, and later the future Selim II. A Karamanid cavalrymen's rising in a pretender's name in 1500–1501 was put down; the Mevlevi lodge remained under sultans' patronage, and textiles and mining throve in the provincial capital.
zh:
科尼亚在希腊罗马时代称以哥念，位于安纳托利亚高原西南缘的吕考尼亚大平原上。1084年塞尔柱突厥人攻占该城，1097年尼西亚失守后，这里成为鲁姆苏丹国的都城。阿拉丁·凯库巴德一世在位时（1220—1237年）绕城筑起坚墙，全城有居民四万五千至五万、七座聚礼清真寺，是安纳托利亚最大的城市。哲拉鲁丁·鲁米（突厥人称梅夫拉纳）幼时随家人为躲避蒙古人从巴尔赫西迁，少年时定居于此；1273年12月17日他在科尼亚去世，后人在其墓上建起绿顶陵墓，旋转托钵僧的梅夫拉维教团围绕陵墓发展起来。塞尔柱政权瓦解后，科尼亚先属埃什雷夫侯国，1322年并入卡拉曼侯国并成为其统治中心，此后在卡拉曼人与奥斯曼人之间十六度易手。1444年时统治这里的是卡拉曼君主易卜拉欣二世：他乘穆拉德二世出征瓦尔纳十字军之机攻掠卡拉希萨尔和博尔瓦丁，穆拉德二世回师后，他被迫于同年8月求和。

1464年易卜拉欣二世去世，其子皮尔·艾哈迈德与伊沙克瓜分侯国，皮尔·艾哈迈德倚仗穆罕默德二世，于1465年击败引来白羊王朝援军的伊沙克。1468年4月，奥斯曼军队攻破盖韦莱要塞、拿下科尼亚，穆罕默德二世任命自己的儿子、易卜拉欣二世的外孙穆斯塔法皇子为总督。皮尔·艾哈迈德退守托罗斯山区，1474年奥斯曼大军又平定尼代、德韦利和伊切尔沿海；1487年巴耶济德二世最终吞并侯国，科尼亚成为新设立的卡拉曼省省会，此后由皇子坐镇，先后有穆斯塔法与杰姆：杰姆在1481年穆罕默德二世死后争夺皇位，兵败后于1482年逃往罗得岛；后来的塞利姆二世也曾在此任职。1500至1501年，旧卡拉曼骑兵拥立一名宗室起事，旋即被镇压。历代苏丹厚待梅夫拉维道堂，科尼亚的纺织和采矿业也随这座省会持续繁荣。

en:
Karaman stands on a high plain north of the Taurus Mountains, about a hundred kilometres south of Konya. The Greeks knew the town as Laranda, and in the mid-thirteenth century the Turkmen chief Karaman Bey made it his seat and renamed it after himself; from 1275 it was the capital of the Karamanid dynasty. It is a town of Sufi memory: Baha al-Din Walad, Rumi's father, settled here with his family in 1222, Rumi married Gevher Hatun in Larende, and his mother, who died in 1224, lies in the Aktekke Mosque, the 'Mother of Mevlana', which Alaeddin Ali Bey rebuilt in 1370. The folk poet Yunus Emre spent his last years in the town and is buried beside the Yunus Emre Mosque. In 1444 Karaman was the chief seat of the Karamanid ruler Ibrahim II, who had just raided Ottoman lands during the Varna crusade and been forced to terms by Murad II that August, and whose imaret and medrese, built in 1432, stood in the town.

Mehmed II's army ended Karamanid rule when it overran the country in 1468, and in 1483 the capital of the new Ottoman province was moved to Konya, leaving Karaman a walled castle town beneath its old dynasty's mosques and medreses; the Dikbasan mosque was added in 1493. The old country rose once more in 1500, when Karamanid cavalrymen angered by cuts to their fief revenues proclaimed a prince of the fallen house, until the revolt was crushed. When Evliya Celebi visited in the seventeenth century he found the castle maintained, bazaars busy with 470 shops along the main street, and Yunus Emre's tomb still drawing pilgrims.
zh:
卡拉曼位于托罗斯山脉以北的高原上，南距科尼亚约一百公里。希腊人称此城为拉兰达，13世纪中叶，土库曼首领卡拉曼贝伊以此为据点，并以自己的名字为其改名；自1275年起，这里成为卡拉曼王朝的都城。这座城市也留有深厚的苏菲印记：鲁米之父巴哈丁·瓦拉德1222年携家眷定居于此，鲁米在此娶盖芙赫尔哈屯为妻；他的母亲1224年去世，葬在阿克泰克清真寺——阿拉丁·阿里贝伊1370年将其重建，寺名意为「梅夫拉纳之母」。民间诗人尤努斯·埃姆雷晚年寓居此城，死后葬在尤努斯·埃姆雷清真寺旁。1444年，卡拉曼是卡拉曼君主易卜拉欣二世的主要驻地：他刚在瓦尔纳十字军期间攻掠奥斯曼领土，于同年8月被迫接受穆拉德二世的条件；他1432年修建的济贫院和经学院仍立于城中。

1468年，穆罕默德二世的大军攻灭卡拉曼政权，1483年新设省份的省会迁往科尼亚，卡拉曼遂成为一座有城墙的城堡城镇，旧王朝留下的清真寺和经学院环绕四周；1493年城中又添建迪克巴尚清真寺。1500年，旧卡拉曼骑兵因封地收入被削减而起事，拥立亡国宗室，旋即被镇压。17世纪埃夫利亚·切莱比到访时，城堡仍在使用，集市熙攘，大街上有四百七十家店铺，尤努斯·埃姆雷的墓前依然朝圣者不绝。

en:
Kastamonu sits in the wooded Paphlagonian highlands south of the Black Sea, on a tributary valley of the Gökırmak. After the Seljuk advance the citadel town passed to Turkmen lords; Süleyman, son of Candar, took it in 1309 and made the castle the seat of his beylik. Copper and iron mined around Küre were traded through Sinop to Genoese and Venetian merchants, while baths, caravanserais, mosques and madrasas grew up in the town. After decades of Ottoman pressure, İsfendiyar Bey retained Kastamonu in 1423 as a tributary ruler. In 1444 the young İsmail Bey held the town, while his brother Kızıl Ahmed had challenged the succession and taken refuge with the Ottomans.

In 1461 Mehmed II brought Paphlagonia under direct Ottoman rule during his Trebizond campaign, occupying Kastamonu on his return. Küre's copper had already been used for Ottoman cannon production, and the Candar arsenal at Sinop strengthened the Ottoman navy after annexation. Kızıl Ahmed, briefly favored by Mehmed, was removed from the region and later served elsewhere. Kastamonu long formed part of the Bolu sanjak, and in the reign of Suleiman I it became the seat of an eyalet. The Sufi teacher Şaban-ı Veli, who died in 1569, made the town a noted place of Sunni piety, and his tomb remained one of its principal shrines.
zh:
卡斯塔莫努坐落在黑海以南林木茂密的帕夫拉戈尼亚山地，城址位于格克河一条支流旁的谷地。塞尔柱人扩张后，这座城堡城镇转入土库曼王公之手；詹达尔之子苏莱曼于1309年夺取该城，把城堡作为贝伊国的统治中心。库雷一带开采的铜铁经锡诺普卖给热那亚和威尼斯商人，城中也陆续建起浴场、商队旅馆、清真寺和伊斯兰学校。历经数十年奥斯曼压力，伊斯凡迪亚尔贝伊在1423年以称臣纳贡为条件保住卡斯塔莫努。1444年，年轻的伊斯玛仪贝伊统治此地，他的兄弟克孜勒·艾哈迈德争位失败，已投奔奥斯曼人。

1461年，穆罕默德二世在远征特拉布宗期间将帕夫拉戈尼亚纳入奥斯曼直接统治，并在回师时占领卡斯塔莫努。库雷的铜矿此前已为奥斯曼火炮生产提供原料，詹达尔人在锡诺普的船坞并入帝国后也增强了奥斯曼海军。克孜勒·艾哈迈德虽一度受穆罕默德青睐，很快被调离此地，后来在帝国别处任职。卡斯塔莫努长期隶属博卢桑贾克，苏莱曼一世在位时成为艾亚莱特的治所。神秘派学者沙班·韦利于1569年去世，使这座城镇成为逊尼派著名的虔修之地，他的陵寝也一直是城中主要圣迹之一。

en:
Ankara occupies a rocky ridge above the Ankara River, at the crossing of the great north-south and east-west roads of inner Anatolia. It was Ancyra, stronghold of the Galatian Tectosages and capital of Roman Galatia, and after the Seljuk conquest it grew wealthy on caravan traffic; the craftsmen's brotherhood of the Ahiler governed the town as a free city until it accepted Ottoman suzerainty in 1304, and Murad I made it fully Ottoman. From 1393 it was the seat of the governor-general of Ottoman Anatolia. On 28 July 1402 Timur crushed Bayezid I on the plain outside the walls and led the sultan away captive, leaving Ankara wrecked, and Murad II had it rebuilt. In 1444 the town was still recovering, its citadel quarter graced by the shrine of the Sufi master Hacı Bayram Veli, who had died there in 1430.

Ankara's wealth in the Ottoman centuries was its cloth, woven from the silky fleece of the long-haired Angora goats herded across the surrounding steppe and sold to Europe as mohair. English merchants of the Levant Company kept a factory in the town from 1639 until 1768, buying fleece and cloth in the hans below the citadel. The 1400s left the Hacı Bayram mosque and tomb beside the ruined Roman Temple of Augustus, the Karacabey mosque and the Kurşunlu Han caravanserai, and the 1500s the Cenabi Ahmet Pasha mosque. By the later eighteenth century the caravan traffic had ebbed, and Ankara lived on as a quiet provincial cloth and market town beneath its old walls.
zh:
安卡拉踞于安卡拉河畔的岩石高地上，正当安纳托利亚内陆南北与东西大道的交汇之处。古城安基拉曾是加拉太人特克托萨格部的据点、罗马加拉太行省的首府；塞尔柱人征服后，它凭商队贸易致富，由工匠行会组织阿希兄弟会作为自由城市治理，1304年接受奥斯曼宗主权，穆拉德一世时正式并入奥斯曼版图，1393年起成为奥斯曼安纳托利亚总督的驻地。1402年7月28日，帖木儿在城外平原击垮巴耶济德一世，将苏丹本人俘走，城市遭到重创，穆拉德二世时期才得以修复。1444年的安卡拉仍在恢复之中，城堡区内，1430年在此去世的苏菲大师哈吉·拜拉姆·韦利的圣祠已经开始吸引信众。

奥斯曼时代，安卡拉的财富来自用安哥拉山羊丝般长羊毛织成的布匹；羊群放牧在周围草原，羊毛以马海毛之名销往欧洲。英国黎凡特公司自1639年起在城内设有商馆，在城堡下的客栈收购羊毛和布匹，直到1768年撤出。15世纪，城里陆续建起毗邻罗马奥古斯都神庙遗址的哈吉·拜拉姆清真寺与圣墓、卡拉卡贝伊清真寺和库尔顺卢商队旅馆；16世纪又添了杰纳比·艾哈迈德帕夏清真寺。到18世纪后期，商队贸易衰落，安卡拉成为旧城墙下安静的行省织布与集贸小城。

en:
Adana lies on the Seyhan River in the fertile Çukurova, the Cilician plain beneath the Taurus passes. After the Mamluks overran Armenian Cilicia in 1359 they entrusted the plain to Ramazan Bey's Yüreğir Türkmens, settled southeast of the city with Cairo's leave in 1352, and the Ramadanid emirs made Adana their seat, holding it as a frontier buffer between the Mamluk sultanate and the rising Ottomans. Ahmet Bey took Tarsus in 1415 and married a daughter to Sultan Faraj in Cairo, but his son İbrahim lost out in Mamluk politics and was executed there on 15 December 1427, after which the emirate lost much of its weight. In 1444 Eylük Bey held Adana, a Sunni Türkmen prince of a de facto independent buffer state ringed by Mamluk garrisons at Tarsus, Ayas and Sis, his wealth the harvest of the great plain.

Halil Bey's long rule from 1485 drew the beylik toward the Ottomans, and when his successor Mahmut was deposed by Cairo he fled to Selim I in 1514, fought at Marj Dabiq in 1516 and was killed at Ridaniye in 1517, by which time the Çukurova had passed under Ottoman rule. The Ramadanids kept Adana as a hereditary family governorate: Piri Mehmet Paşa built the bazaar bath in 1529 and completed his father's Great Mosque in 1541. This last politically surviving of the Anatolian beyliks ended in 1608, when Pir Mansur Bey stepped aside and Adana became an ordinary sanjak of the Aleppo eyalet. As such it was touched by the great Celali rising of the Aleppo governor Abaza Hasan Pasha in 1658, whose assassination in Aleppo on 16 February 1659 closed the long era of Anatolian rebellions. Through the eighteenth century the town remained a provincial market of the plain.
zh:
阿达纳位于塞伊汉河畔、托罗斯山口下肥沃的丘库罗瓦（奇里乞亚平原）上。1359年马穆鲁克攻占亚美尼亚人的奇里乞亚后，把平原交给拉马赞贝伊率领的于雷吉尔土库曼人——他们1352年已经开罗方面许可在城东南定居，拉马赞家族随后以阿达纳为都城，充当马穆鲁克苏丹国与崛起中的奥斯曼之间的边疆缓冲。艾哈迈德贝伊1415年夺取塔尔苏斯，还在1410年把女儿嫁给苏丹法赖吉；但他的儿子易卜拉欣在马穆鲁克的政争中失败，被押到开罗，于1427年12月15日处死，侯国从此大为衰落。1444年，埃伊吕克贝伊据有阿达纳，作为事实独立的缓冲国的逊尼派土库曼王公，塔尔苏斯、阿亚斯和西斯都驻有马穆鲁克守军，他的财富来自大平原上的收成。

哈利勒贝伊自1485年起的长期统治把侯国引向奥斯曼一边；其继任者马哈茂德被开罗废黜后，于1514年投奔塞利姆一世，1516年参加迈尔季·达比克战役，1517年在里达尼耶战役中阵亡，丘库罗瓦至此全部归入奥斯曼。拉马赞家族仍以世袭方式保有阿达纳的治理权：皮里·穆罕默德帕夏1529年建成市集浴场，1541年又完成其父始建的大清真寺。作为安纳托利亚最后一个保有政治地位的侯国，它于1608年终结——皮尔·曼苏尔贝伊主动退位，阿达纳成为阿勒颇行省属下的普通桑贾克。1658年，它又被阿勒颇总督阿巴扎·哈桑帕夏的杰拉勒大叛乱波及，此人1659年2月16日在阿勒颇遇刺，绵延多年的安纳托利亚叛乱时代随之结束。整个18世纪，阿达纳始终是平原上一座地方性的集镇。

en:
Sinop occupies a fortified headland on the safest natural harbour of the Black Sea's southern shore, the old Greek colony of Sinope in Paphlagonia and birthplace of Diogenes. It fell to the Seljuk sultan Izz al-Din Kaykawus on 3 October 1214, whose men seized the local governor out hunting, and the cathedral became the Alaeddin mosque. After the Mongol withdrawal it was the maritime seat of the Candar, or İsfendiyar, Turks; Ibn Battuta, who stayed some forty days in the 1330s, called it a superb city that joined strong walls to beauty, and its shipyard gave the beylik its name at sea. In 1444 İsmail Bey, who had succeeded in 1443, held Sinop and Kastamonu as an independent Sunni prince, the castle guarding the sea road to the Crimea and the dockyards turning out Black Sea shipping.

Mehmed II took it without a storm: marching east against Trebizond in late June 1461, he reached Sinop with İsmail's disaffected brother Kızıl Ahmed at his side, and the bey surrendered the fortress without a fight and went into exile at Philippopolis in Thrace, while Ahmed governed for the Ottomans until 1464. The Candar yard passed into Ottoman service and was enlarged, its shipwrights building war galleys for the Black Sea fleet. The port did not always sleep safely: in 1614 Don Cossacks in light boats swept down on it, looting and burning much of the town to the shock of Ottoman observers. Thereafter Sinop settled into life as a fortified provincial harbour, administered from the Canik liva at Samsun, its quays still shipping timber and stores through the eighteenth-century wars with Russia.
zh:
锡诺普据有黑海南岸最安全的天然良港旁的设防海岬，古时是帕夫拉戈尼亚的希腊殖民城邦锡诺普，也是第欧根尼的故乡。1214年10月3日，鲁姆苏丹伊兹丁·凯考斯的部下趁当地总督出猎将其擒获，城池有条件投降，大教堂随即被改作阿拉丁清真寺。蒙古势力退去后，它成为詹达尔（一称伊斯凡迪亚尔）突厥人濒临大海的据点；伊本·白图泰在14世纪30年代曾在此停留约四十天，称这座城池兼具坚固的工事与美观，当地船厂更让这个侯国闻名海上。1444年，1443年继位的伊斯梅尔贝伊以独立的逊尼派突厥王公身份据有锡诺普和卡斯塔莫努，城堡扼守通往克里米亚的海路，船坞中建造着黑海船只。

穆罕默德二世没有强攻：1461年6月下旬，他东征特拉比松途中抵达锡诺普，身边带着与伊斯梅尔反目的弟弟克孜勒·艾哈迈德，贝伊不战交出城堡，本人被流放色雷斯的菲利普波利斯，艾哈迈德则代奥斯曼人统治至1464年。詹达尔船厂被奥斯曼接收并扩建，船匠为苏丹的黑海舰队建造战舰。港口并非高枕无忧：1614年，乘轻便船只南下的顿河哥萨克人大举袭入，洗劫并焚毁大半个城区，令奥斯曼上下震惊。此后锡诺普归于平静，成为一座设防的地方港口，归驻于萨姆松的贾尼克辖区管辖，在18世纪对俄战争期间，码头依旧外运木材和船具。

en:
Sivas, the Byzantine Sebasteia, lies in a high broad valley of the Kızılırmak, where caravan roads from the Black Sea coast turned toward Syria and Iran. The Danishmend Turks held it after Manzikert until the Seljuk sultan Kılıç Arslan II incorporated the city in 1174. Under the Rum Seljuks and Ilkhanids, trade paid for a citadel and several stone madrasas. Eretna and Kadı Burhaneddin ruled it in turn before the townsmen submitted to Bayezid I in 1398. Timur's army sacked Sivas and broke its walls in the summer of 1400. Ottoman control was restored by 1408, and in 1444 the city was a guarded market and staging place in the province of Rum, although the governor's seat was then at Tokat.

In 1526 Sivas replaced Amasya as the seat of the Rum governors. The Celali uprisings that began in the late sixteenth century shook this part of Anatolia, as Turkmen bands, dispossessed sipahis and unpaid musketeers rose against Ottoman tax and military demands, and the city's older monuments suffered in the disorders. When Evliya Çelebi visited in 1649, he described 44 quarters and 4,600 houses within the walls, with another 1,460 households in the Inner Citadel and Pasha Castle. Imperial authority was reasserted under the Köprülü viziers, and in 1813 the Sivas governorship was again entrusted to a vizier; plague struck the city only a year later.
zh:
锡瓦斯古称塞巴斯蒂亚，坐落在克孜勒河上游的宽阔高谷中，黑海沿岸通往叙利亚和伊朗的商路在此交会。曼齐刻尔特战役后，达尼什曼德突厥人长期占据此城，罗姆塞尔柱苏丹基利杰·阿尔斯兰二世于1174年将其并入版图。在罗姆塞尔柱和伊儿汗国治下，商路贸易为这里带来城堡和多座石建伊斯兰学校。此后埃雷特纳与卡迪·布尔汉丁相继统治，1398年市民向巴耶济德一世投降。1400年夏，帖木儿军队洗劫锡瓦斯并拆毁城墙。到1408年，奥斯曼已恢复对此地的控制；1444年的锡瓦斯是鲁姆行省中设有防卫的商队城镇和驻兵要地，不过行省长官当时驻在托卡特。

1526年，锡瓦斯取代阿马西亚，成为鲁姆行省长官驻地。16世纪末开始的杰拉里叛乱震动安纳托利亚这一带，土库曼武装、失去封地的西帕希和欠饷火枪手反抗奥斯曼的赋税与兵役，城中的古老建筑也在动乱中受损。1649年埃夫利亚·切莱比途经此地，记载城墙内有44个街区、4600户，连同内堡和帕夏堡中的住户共约6060户。柯普吕律家族任大维齐尔期间，中央权威重新稳固；1813年，锡瓦斯长官再次由维齐尔出任，仅一年后城中又遭遇瘟疫。

en:
Trebizond is a Black Sea port on the rocky Pontic coast, founded by Greek settlers from Miletus in 756 BC. In 1204 Alexios Komnenos, a grandson of Emperor Andronikos I, used Georgian help to seize the city and founded the Empire of Trebizond, the longest-lived of the Byzantine successor states. Its wealth came less from its narrow coastal strip than from the caravans passing between Persia and the Black Sea: the Genoese bought the sea-fort of Leonkastron west of the harbour in 1306, and the Venetians settled beside them, forming a European quarter. In 1444 John IV Komnenos still ruled an Orthodox, Greek-speaking city, its dynasty linked by marriage to the Ak Koyunlu and Kara Koyunlu Turkmen; an Ottoman seaborne attack under Murad II had been driven off by heavy surf two years before.

After Constantinople fell the Ottomans closed in: in 1456 the governor of Amasya raided the hinterland and imposed a tribute, and in summer 1461 Mehmed II seized Sinope, neutralised Uzun Hasan by a swift march inland, and placed Trebizond under siege. The city surrendered on 15 August 1461, ending the last Byzantine state; the ex-emperor David and his sons were executed in Constantinople in November 1463. The conqueror settled Turkish families in the region, yet the 1523 tax registers still counted 1,473 taxable men, about 85 per cent of them Christian. Prince Selim, the future Selim I, governed the sanjak under his father Bayezid II, and his son Süleyman was born here in 1494. In 1598 Trebizond became the seat of its own eyalet; its quays remained a focus of the Persian and Caucasian caravan trade, and the province sent troops to the sultans' wars through the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries.
zh:
特拉比松（今特拉布宗）是本都岩石海岸上的黑海良港，公元前756年由来自米利都的希腊殖民者建立。1204年，安德洛尼卡一世皇帝之孙阿莱克修斯·科穆宁借格鲁吉亚之力夺取此城，建立特拉比松帝国，是拜占庭诸继承国中国祚最长的一个。它的富庶与其说来自那条狭窄的沿海地带，不如说来自波斯与黑海之间往来的商队：热那亚人1306年买下港西的莱昂卡斯特隆海防堡垒，威尼斯人随后在其旁定居，形成一片欧洲人街区。1444年，约翰四世·科穆宁仍统治着这座说希腊语的东正教城市，王室与阿克科雍鲁、卡拉科雍鲁土库曼首领联姻；两年前穆拉德二世发动的一次海上进攻刚被巨浪击退。

君士坦丁堡陷落后，奥斯曼人步步紧逼：1456年阿马西亚总督劫掠腹地并强索贡赋，1461年夏穆罕默德二世先取锡诺普，又以一次迅速的内陆进军稳住乌尊·哈桑，随即兵临特拉比松。城池坚守一个月后于1461年8月15日投降，最后一个拜占庭政权就此终结；被废的皇帝大卫和诸子于1463年11月在君士坦丁堡被处死。征服者向此地迁入突厥民户，但1523年的税册仍登记有1473名纳税男丁，其中约85%是基督徒。皇子塞利姆——后来的塞利姆一世——在其父巴耶济德二世朝出任本城桑贾克贝伊，他的儿子苏莱曼1494年生于此城。1598年，特拉比松成为新设行省的省会，码头依旧是波斯和高加索商队汇聚之地，该省也在16、17世纪不断为苏丹的战争提供兵员。

en:
Set on a plateau 1,900 metres above the sea, Erzurum was known to the Armenians as Karin. The Romans fortified it as Theodosiopolis, their chief stronghold on the Armenian frontier. After Manzikert in 1071 the Saltukid Turkmen made it the seat of their beylik until the Seljuk sultan of Rum took it in 1202; the twin-minaret Çifte Minareli Medrese, the largest Seljuk madrasa in Anatolia, was founded there in the following decades by Hüdavent Hatun, daughter of Sultan Alaeddin Keykubad. Mongols under Bayju Noyan sacked the city in 1242, and it afterwards passed through the Ilkhanate, Timur's armies and the Black Sheep Turkmen. In 1444 the Black Sheep ruler Jahan Shah held its citadel, hard pressed by his White Sheep rivals, while Armenian merchants and herdsmen lived from the Trabzon–Tabriz caravan road that crossed the plateau.

In 1467 the White Sheep sultan Uzun Hasan surprised Jahan Shah and killed him, and Erzurum became a White Sheep city; the law code he granted there, the 'Law of Hasan Padishah', remained in force for some years after the Ottoman conquest. The Safavid shah Ismail I took the city in 1502, imposed Shiism and drove many Sunni families into exile, leaving it half deserted. Selim I camped close by after Chaldiran in 1514, but the Ottomans firmly annexed Erzurum only under Suleiman I, who rebuilt and repeopled it as their forward base for the Iranian wars, lodging there in September 1534 and again in 1554. It became the seat of the eyalet of Erzurum. In 1622 the governor Abaza Mehmed Pasha rose to avenge the murdered Osman II, slaughtered the janissaries of the garrison and held the citadel until he surrendered and was pardoned in 1628. Murad IV visited it in July 1635 during his Yerevan campaign. Nader Shah's Iranians took Erzurum in 1733, and the city returned to the sultan after Nader's death in 1747.
zh:
埃尔祖鲁姆坐落在海拔近两千米的高原上，亚美尼亚人旧称卡林。罗马人将其加固为狄奥多西波利斯，作为亚美尼亚边防的首要要塞。1071年曼齐刻尔特战役后，萨尔图克突厥蛮以此为贝伊国中心，直到1202年被罗姆苏丹国吞并；数十年后，阿拉丁·凯库巴德苏丹之女胡达万特·哈通在此修建了双宣礼塔经学院，即安纳托利亚规模最大的塞尔柱经学院。1242年，拜住那颜率领的蒙古军洗劫全城，此后城市先后历经伊儿汗国、帖木儿大军和黑羊突厥蛮。1444年，黑羊君主贾汉·沙据守城堡，白羊突厥蛮正自西方紧逼；亚美尼亚商人和牧民则靠着穿越高原、连接特拉布宗与大不里士的商路为生。

1467年，白羊苏丹乌尊哈桑发动突袭，击杀贾汉·沙，埃尔祖鲁姆转入白羊之手；他在此颁行的《哈桑帕迪沙法典》在奥斯曼征服后仍沿用了一段时间。萨法维王朝的伊斯玛仪一世1502年攻占此城，强迫居民改宗什叶派，大批逊尼派家庭流亡，城市几近荒废。1514年查尔迪兰战役后，塞利姆一世曾在城旁扎营，但城市迟至苏莱曼一世时才被奥斯曼稳固吞并：他重建城池、招民实边，把埃尔祖鲁姆经营成对伊朗战争的前进基地，并于1534年9月和1554年两度驻留。此后这里成为埃尔祖鲁姆行省的首府。1622年，总督阿巴扎·穆罕默德帕夏以为遇害的奥斯曼二世复仇为名起兵，屠戮驻军新军，据守城堡，至1628年投降获赦。1635年7月，穆拉德四世在埃里温战役途中到此停留。1733年纳迪尔沙的伊朗军队攻占埃尔祖鲁姆，1747年纳迪尔沙死后城市复归奥斯曼。

en:
Marash, the Arabs' Mar'ash and Byzantine Germanikeia, guards the roads from the Anatolian plateau toward Cilicia and Syria, its castle rising over the plain at the foot of Mount Ahır. Once the seat of the Neo-Hittite kings of Gurgum and later a frontier fortress of the caliphate, it became an Armenian city in the eleventh century, hosted the host of the First Crusade on its march to Antioch, and was thrown down by a great earthquake in 1114 that killed some 40,000 people before passing through Danishmend, Seljuk and Mamluk hands. From 1337 it was one of the principal cities of the Dulkadir Turcomans, vassals of Cairo. In 1444 Süleyman Bey ruled the buffer principality from Elbistan, and Marash lived from its bazaars and the wool of the Turcoman herds pastured between the mountains.

Süleyman married his daughters to both his mighty neighbours: one to the Mamluk sultan Jaqmaq, another, Sittişah, to the young Mehmed II. Marriage ties could not save the emirate: after a generation of border wars, on 12 June 1515 Selim I and his grand vizier Hadım Sinan Pasha overthrew the aged Ala al-Dawla at the Battle of Turnadağ, and Marash became an Ottoman sanjak, in time the seat of the governors of the Dulkadir, or Marash, eyalet. Before the end the old bey had given the town its Great Mosque in 1496, beside the Stone Medrese and the covered bazaar. The tax register of 1525-1526 counted some 7,500 inhabitants, all Muslim, and for the rest of the period the town beneath its citadel lived on its bazaars and the wool of the Turcoman tribes around it.
zh:
马拉什，阿拉伯人称马拉什、拜占庭人称盖尔马尼基亚，扼守安纳托利亚高原通往奇里乞亚与叙利亚的大道，城堡矗立在阿赫尔山下的平原高地上。这里曾是新赫梯古尔古姆王国的都城，后来成为哈里发的边塞重镇；11世纪成为一座亚美尼亚人的城市，曾招待开赴安条克的第一次十字军大军，1114年又遭大地震重创、约四万人罹难，此后先后经过达尼什曼德、塞尔柱和马穆鲁克之手。从1337年起，它成为向开罗称臣的杜勒卡迪尔土库曼人最重要的城市之一。1444年，苏莱曼贝伊在埃尔比斯坦统治着这个缓冲侯国，马拉什的生计来自城内的市集，以及山间游牧的土库曼畜群出产的羊毛。

苏莱曼把女儿们分别嫁给两边的强邻：一个嫁给马穆鲁克苏丹贾克马克，另一个锡蒂沙赫嫁给年轻的穆罕默德二世。联姻终究救不了侯国：经过一代人的边境战争，1515年6月12日，塞利姆一世与大维齐尔哈德姆·锡南帕夏在图尔纳达格战役击灭年迈的阿拉丁·道莱，马拉什成为奥斯曼的桑贾克，日后成为杜勒卡迪尔（亦称马拉什）埃亚莱特的总督驻地。亡国之前，老贝伊还在1496年为城市留下了大清真寺，与石造经学院和有顶市集相邻。1525—1526年的税册上，全城约有七千五百名居民，全部是穆斯林；在本时期余下的岁月里，这座城堡下的城市依靠市集和周围土库曼部落的羊毛贸易为生。

en:
Mallorca is the largest of the Balearic Islands, with Palma sheltered on its great south-western bay. Muslim rule from 902 made Medina Mayurqa a Mediterranean market and expanded irrigated farming across the island. James I of Aragon landed at Santa Ponça in September 1229 and entered Palma on 31 December, then proclaimed the Kingdom of Mallorca in 1230. After decades of separate rule, Peter IV incorporated the island into the Crown of Aragon in 1343. In 1444 it was a Catalan Catholic kingdom with its own jurats and Grand Council, where Palma's merchants faced a restive countryside known as the Part Forana.

Rural and urban craftsmen rose in the Revolta Forana of 1450-53 against citizen knights and merchants. In 1464 a company of merchants and landowners united farms to plant sugar cane and build a sugar mill, but the experiment could not compete with Atlantic plantations. A new artisans' revolt, the Germania, broke out at Palma in February 1521 after craftsmen were imprisoned and lasted until royal victory in 1523; its leaders were executed. Ottoman corsairs under Sinan Reis sacked Santanyí on 3 October 1531 and carried off 52 people, prompting new walls. During the War of the Spanish Succession an Anglo-Dutch fleet brought the island to the Austrian cause on 27 September 1706; Bourbon forces did not take Palma until 2 July 1715, and the Nueva Planta decree of 28 November abolished Mallorca's own institutions.
zh:
马略卡是巴利阿里群岛中最大的岛屿，帕尔马坐落在西南方优良海湾内。902年开始的穆斯林统治把麦地那·马尤尔卡建成地中海市场，并在岛上推广灌溉农业。1229年9月，阿拉贡国王海梅一世在圣庞萨登陆，12月31日进入帕尔马，随后于1230年建立马略卡王国。经过数十年分立统治，佩德罗四世在1343年将该岛并入阿拉贡联合王国。1444年的马略卡是一个操加泰罗尼亚语的天主教王国，拥有自己的市政陪审官和大议会；帕尔马商人掌控港口，称为「郊外」的乡村则暗流涌动。

1450至1453年，乡下手工业者和城市工匠发动「郊外起事」，反抗城中的骑士与商人。1464年，一个由商人和地主组成的公司合并农庄种植甘蔗、修建糖坊，但这场试验竞争不过大西洋种植园。1521年2月，多名工匠被捕后，帕尔马爆发新的工匠起事「兄弟会」，战争持续到1523年王师获胜，首领被处死。1531年10月3日，锡南·雷斯率领奥斯曼海盗洗劫桑塔尼，掳走52人，促使当地修筑新城墙。西班牙王位继承战争中，英荷舰队在1706年9月27日使马略卡转向奥地利阵营；波旁军队直到1715年7月2日才占领帕尔马，11月28日的《新基本法令》废除了马略卡的自有制度。

en:
Tangier commands the southern shore of the Strait of Gibraltar. Once the Phoenician and Roman port of Tingis, it was taken by Muslim forces between 707 and 711 and became a forward base from which Tariq ibn Ziyad crossed to Iberia. Almoravid, Almohad and Marinid rulers prized its harbour; Ibn Battuta was born there in 1304, and by the late fourteenth century ships from Tangier and Salé were raiding traffic in the strait and the North Atlantic, while the port also received Muslim families fleeing al-Andalus. After Ceuta fell to Portugal in 1415 Tangier became a frontier fortress. A Portuguese army under Henry, Duke of Viseu, besieged it for about a month but was defeated on 19 October 1437. In 1444 Tangier therefore remained a Moroccan garrison and market on the strait, facing Christian Ceuta and living from shipping, corsair prizes and the comings and goings of volunteers for al-Andalus.

The Portuguese entered Tangier unopposed on 28 August 1471 after the fall of Asilah, converted its chief mosque into a cathedral and built European houses and religious houses; Wattasid assaults in 1508, 1511 and 1515 all failed. The town passed to Spain with the Portuguese crown in 1580, and in 1661 it was given to England's Charles II as part of Catherine of Braganza's dowry. English troops arrived in January 1662, strengthened the walls and began an expensive harbour mole. On 4 May 1664 fighters under Khadir Ghaïlan killed the Earl of Teviot and about 470 of the garrison. Colonial costs and continuing Moroccan pressure led Parliament to abandon it in 1680; the English demolished the town and port before Moroccan forces entered on 7 February 1684. Alawi governors repopulated Tangier from the surrounding countryside, and Moulay Ismail and later Sidi Muhammad rebuilt its walls, mosques and markets. Spain attacked the city in 1790, but in 1821 Tangier was again a Moroccan royal gateway between the two seas.
zh:
丹吉尔扼守直布罗陀海峡南岸。它曾是腓尼基和罗马港口廷吉斯，707年至711年间被穆斯林军队攻取，随后成为塔里克·伊本·齐亚德渡海进入伊比利亚的前沿基地。穆拉比特、穆瓦希德和马林王朝都重视这座港口；伊本·白图泰1304年出生于此。到14世纪末，丹吉尔与塞拉的船只已在海峡和北大西洋袭扰航运，港口也接待从安达卢斯逃来的穆斯林家庭。1415年休达落入葡萄牙之手后，丹吉尔成为前线要塞。维塞乌公爵恩里克王子率领的葡萄牙军队围城约一个月，却在1437年10月19日战败。因此1444年的丹吉尔仍是摩洛哥在海峡边的驻军城镇与市场，与基督教休达对峙，靠航运、海盗战利品以及前往安达卢斯的志愿人员往来维持其重要性。

1471年8月28日，葡萄牙人趁艾西拉陷落之机兵不血刃进入丹吉尔，把主清真寺改为大教堂，并修建欧式住宅和修道院；瓦塔斯王朝在1508年、1511年和1515年的反攻都未能夺回。1580年，丹吉尔随葡萄牙王位转入西班牙之手。1661年，它又作为布拉干萨的凯瑟琳嫁妆的一部分交给英格兰国王查理二世。英军1662年1月抵达，加固城墙并开始修建耗资巨大的港口防波堤。1664年5月4日，哈迪尔·盖兰麾下的武装人员杀死提维奥特伯爵和约470名守军。殖民开支与摩洛哥人的持续压力，使英国议会在1680年决定放弃；1684年2月7日摩洛哥军队入城前，英军拆毁了城镇和港口设施。阿拉维王朝的地方长官从周围乡村移民充实丹吉尔，穆莱·伊斯梅尔和后来的西迪·穆罕默德又重建城墙、清真寺和市场。1790年西班牙曾进攻该城，但到1821年，丹吉尔重新成为摩洛哥扼守两海之间的皇家门户。

en:
Melilla faces the Mediterranean on the coast of the Rif, where Phoenician seafarers founded the trading post of Rusadir. Muslim dynasties from the Umayyads to the Marinids held the town, but in the 15th century it withered like the other Mediterranean ports of the Kingdom of Fez, eclipsed by Atlantic trade; fought over again and again by Fez and Tlemcen, it was left largely abandoned. In 1444 its ruins belonged in name to the Marinid sultan in Fez, while Berber fishermen and herders still worked the cape.

On 17 September 1497 a fleet sent by the Duke of Medina Sidonia and led by Pedro de Estopiñán occupied the empty town almost without bloodshed, with the backing of Ferdinand and Isabella. Melilla was run jointly by the duke's house and the Crown of Castile until 1556, when the Crown took over the garrison and the fortress of Melilla la Vieja became a royal presidio. Sultan Ismail ibn Sharif's troops seized the outer forts in the 1680s but could not break the citadel in the sieges of the 1690s. In December 1774 Sultan Mohammed III returned with a large army and Algerian mercenaries; the Irish-born governor Juan Sherlocke held out until a relief fleet raised the siege in March 1775, and the Treaty of Aranjuez in 1780 confirmed Spanish rule.
zh:
梅利利亚位于里夫山区北临地中海的海岸，腓尼基航海者曾在此建立贸易站鲁萨迪尔。从倭马亚王朝到马林王朝，历代穆斯林政权都曾据有此城，但15世纪时它和非斯王国的其他地中海港口一样衰败，被大西洋贸易甩在身后；非斯与特莱姆森反复争夺，城池大半废弃。1444年，这片废墟名义上臣属于非斯的马林苏丹，海角一带仍有柏柏尔渔民和牧民谋生。

1497年9月17日，梅迪纳-西多尼亚公爵派出、佩德罗·德·埃斯托皮尼扬率领的舰队，在费尔南多与伊莎贝拉支持下几乎兵不血刃占领空城。梅利利亚起初由公爵家族与卡斯蒂利亚王室共管，1556年王室接管驻军，旧梅利利亚要塞成为王家驻防地。穆莱·伊斯梅尔苏丹的军队在1680年代夺占外围堡垒，却在1690年代的连番围城中无法攻破城寨。1774年12月，穆罕默德三世率大军偕阿尔及利亚雇佣兵再度来攻，爱尔兰裔总督胡安·舍洛克坚守至1775年3月援军解围，1780年的《阿兰胡埃斯条约》确认了西班牙的统治。

en:
Tlemcen lies on a high, well-watered plateau of the central Maghreb, where the road from Morocco to Ifriqiya crosses the caravan track running from Oran to Sijilmasa and the lands beyond the Sahara. It grew from the Roman town of Pomaria and the twin settlements of Agadir and Tagrart, the latter founded in 1081–82 by the Almoravid Yusuf ibn Tashfin. After 1236 Yaghmurasen ibn Zyan merged the two into one city, named Tlemcen, 'the two springs' in Berber, and made it the capital of his Zayyanid kingdom. Gold from south of the Sahara passed through its funduk to Genoese merchants, the Tashfiniya madrasa founded by Abu Tashfin I (r. 1318–37) was famed across the Maghreb, and the historian Ibn Khaldun served as vizir to Sultan Abu Hammu Musa II. Marinid armies sacked and occupied the city more than once, above all during the great siege of 1299–1307 and in 1337, and after 1423 the Zayyanids became clients of the Hafsids of Tunis. In 1444 Abu al-Abbas Ahmad I (r. 1430–61) held the Mechouar citadel as a Hafsid vassal, ruling a city still rich from cloth, leather and the southern caravans.

Late in the century Aragon pulled the strings at court while the sultan's authority scarcely reached beyond the walls, and after the fall of Granada in 1492 thousands of Jewish and Muslim refugees from Spain swelled the city. Spain took Mers-el-Kebir in 1505 and Oran in 1509; in 1518 the corsair Aruj Barbarossa, called in against a Spanish-allied sultan, was trapped and killed at Tlemcen, and a Spanish army captured the city in 1543 and set a client king on its throne. In 1555 the Ottomans of Algiers made themselves its masters, and the last Zayyanid sultan fled to Oran, where he was baptised as Carlos. Under the regency Tlemcen ceased to be a capital, for the western beylik was governed from Mazuna, Mascara and finally Oran, though more than five hundred looms long kept its cloth trade alive. It recovered effective autonomy with the rest of the regency in 1671, the Spanish abandoned Oran in 1792, and by the early nineteenth century the once great city numbered barely ten thousand people.
zh:
特莱姆森坐落在马格里布中部水源丰足的高原上，摩洛哥通往伊夫里奇亚的大路，在此与从奥兰经锡吉勒马萨通往撒哈拉以远的商道交会。此地源于罗马城镇波马里亚，以及阿加迪尔、塔格拉尔特两座姊妹聚落——后者由穆拉比特首领优素福·本·塔什芬建于1081至1082年。1236年后，亚格穆拉辛·本·扎扬将两镇合并为一城，按柏柏尔语取名特莱姆森，意为「双泉」，并定为扎扬王朝的国都。撒哈拉以南的黄金经城中的商栈流入热那亚商人之手；阿布·塔什芬一世（1318至1337年在位）兴建的塔什菲尼亚经学院闻名马格里布；史学家伊本·赫勒敦也曾在素丹阿布·哈穆·穆萨二世朝中担任维齐尔。马林王朝的军队不止一次洗劫、占领这座城市，尤以1299至1307年的长期围攻和1337年之役为甚；1423年以后的乱局中，扎扬王朝沦为突尼斯哈夫斯王朝的附庸。1444年，阿布·阿拔斯·艾哈迈德一世（1430至1461年在位）以哈夫斯附庸的身份坐镇迈舒瓦尔堡，治下城市仍靠布料、皮革和南方商队富庶一方。

15世纪后期，阿拉贡在幕后操纵宫廷，素丹威权几乎不出城墙；1492年格拉纳达陷落后，数千名犹太和穆斯林难民从西班牙涌入，城市人口大增。西班牙1505年夺取米尔斯凯比尔、1509年夺取奥兰；1518年，应反对亲西素丹之请而来的海盗阿鲁杰·巴巴罗萨在特莱姆森被围杀，1543年西班牙军队又攻陷该城，扶立附庸国王。1555年，阿尔及尔的奥斯曼人成为这里的主人，末代扎扬素丹逃奔奥兰，在那里受洗改名卡洛斯。奥斯曼摄政时期，特莱姆森不再是都城——西部贝伊辖区先后以马祖纳、穆阿斯凯尔和奥兰为首府，但城中五百余台织机长期维系着布料生意。1671年，它随整个摄政国摆脱阿尔及尔的实际控制，1792年西班牙人撤出奥兰；到19世纪初，这座昔日重镇的居民已只剩万把人。

en:
Oran, Wahrani in Arabic, curves around a bay beneath the Murdjajo hills, with Mers El Kébir guarding the better roadstead to its west. Founded in 902 by Andalusi settlers, it prospered under the Almohads, when Caliph Abd al-Mu'min built thirty vessels to link the port with Andalusia. Under the Zayyanids of Tlemcen it became one of the chief maritime outlets of the central Maghreb and a regular point of exchange with Spain. In 1444, therefore, Oran was the principal northwestern port of a Muslim inland kingdom, its warehouses and waterfront tied to the caravan city of Tlemcen rather than to Algiers.

Cardinal Cisneros's Castilians conquered Oran in 1509 after securing Mers El Kébir and ringed it with walls and a kasbah. A major Ottoman assault from Algiers failed in 1563, and Moulay Ismail of Morocco was repulsed before the walls in 1707. During the War of the Spanish Succession, however, Mustafa Bouchelaghem, bey of Mascara, took the city in 1708. A Spanish army recovered it in 1732. The great earthquake of October 1790 killed more than 3,000 people and shattered the defenses, allowing Mohammed el-Kebir to begin the siege that ended with the Spanish evacuation in 1792. Oran then became the seat of the western beylik of Algiers, where the Pasha Mosque was raised in the late 1790s.
zh:
奥兰（阿拉伯语称瓦赫兰）环抱穆尔贾杰山下的海湾，西侧有条件更好的锚地凯比尔港拱卫。902年，安达卢西亚移民建立此城；穆瓦希德王朝时期港口走向繁荣，哈里发阿卜杜勒·慕敏曾建造三十艘船，把它与安达卢西亚连接起来。在特莱姆森的扎扬王朝治下，奥兰成为马格里布中部最重要的出海口之一，也是与西班牙经常往来的交易地点。因此在1444年，奥兰是这个穆斯林内陆王国西北方的首要港口，仓库和码头同特莱姆森这座商队城相连，关系远比对阿尔及尔密切。

1509年，西斯内罗斯枢机的卡斯蒂利亚军队在先取得凯比尔港后征服奥兰，在城周修筑城墙和卡斯巴。1563年，阿尔及尔发动的一次大规模奥斯曼攻势被击退；摩洛哥的穆莱·伊斯梅尔也于1707年在城下受挫。但在西班牙王位继承战争期间，穆阿斯凯尔贝伊穆斯塔法·布歇拉格姆于1708年攻占奥兰。1732年，西班牙军队又夺回此城。1790年10月的大地震造成三千多人丧生并摧毁防御工事，穆罕默德·凯比尔随即展开围攻，最终迫使西班牙人在1792年撤离。奥兰此后成为阿尔及尔西部贝伊辖区的治所，帕夏清真寺也在18世纪90年代末建起。

en:
Mitidja is a fertile coastal plain behind the Bay of Algiers, about 100 kilometres long and five to twenty kilometres wide. Its grain fields and gardens long served as the breadbasket of Al-Djazair, the white port rebuilt on the older harbour of Icosium by Buluggin ibn Ziri and named for the islets guarding its roadstead. In the thirteenth century the coast passed to the Zayyanid sultans of Tlemcen, yet the town and plain kept a large measure of self-rule under local amirs rooted in Mitidja. In 1444 Al-Djazair was still a modest harbour rather than a great capital, valued for the grain shipped from its hinterland and its place on the sea lane between the Maghreb and Iberia.

Spanish troops fortified the offshore Peñón in 1510. Six years later the local amir Salim al-Thumi called on the corsair brothers Oruç Reis and Hayreddin Barbarossa; Oruç seized Al-Djazair, and after his death near Tlemcen Hayreddin lost the city in 1524 before recovering it in 1529 and placing the new regency under Ottoman sovereignty. Charles V's expedition of October 1541 was scattered by storms and its army of some 30,000 men was defeated outside the walls. Al-Djazair then became one of the principal Barbary corsair ports, living from prizes, ransomed captives, and Mitidja grain; Miguel de Cervantes was held there from 1575 to 1580. The citadel above the city was begun in 1556, and by the eighteenth century the local deys ruled almost independently of Istanbul. In 1821 their regency remained a formidable, though increasingly challenged, Barbary power.
zh:
米提贾是阿尔及尔湾后方的肥沃沿海平原，长约100公里，宽5至20公里。这里的麦田和园圃长期供养着白色港口阿尔及尔；该城由布卢金·伊本·齐里在古港伊科西乌姆旧址上重建，因扼守锚地的近海小岛得名。13世纪，这片海岸归入特莱姆森的扎扬王朝苏丹治下，但城市与平原仍由扎根米提贾的本地埃米尔保持相当自治。1444年的阿尔及尔还不是大国都城，只是一座中等港口，其价值来自腹地输出的谷物，以及它在马格里布与伊比利亚之间航路上的位置。

1510年，西班牙军队在近海的佩尼翁岛修筑要塞。六年后，本地埃米尔萨利姆·图米向海盗兄弟奥鲁奇·雷斯与海雷丁·巴巴罗萨求援；奥鲁奇夺取阿尔及尔，他在特莱姆森附近死后，海雷丁于1524年失去该城，又在1529年收复，并把新生的摄政领地置于奥斯曼宗主权下。1541年10月，查理五世的远征军遭风暴打散，约三万人的军队在城外战败。阿尔及尔随后成为巴巴里海岸最重要的海盗港之一，靠战利品、俘虏赎金和米提贾谷物维持；米格尔·德·塞万提斯就在1575年至1580年被囚于此。俯瞰城市的城堡始建于1556年，到18世纪，本地德伊已几乎不受伊斯坦布尔节制。1821年，这个摄政领地仍是强大的巴巴里势力，只是面临越来越强的欧洲压力。

en:
Béjaïa, the ancient Saldae, lies on its gulf beneath the Djurdjura mountains, homeland of the Kabyle Berbers. In 1067 the Hammadid emir al-Nasir moved his capital down from the Qal'a of the Banu Hammad to this fishing harbour, which became one of the richest ports of the western Mediterranean. Pisan, Genoese and Catalan merchants shipped its beeswax, from which the French word bougie derives, as well as hides, alum and iron, together with wool and cotton brought overland from Biskra and M'sila; Fibonacci learned Arabic numerals here as a boy. After the Almohads the city passed to the Hafsids, and for most of the fifteenth century a younger Hafsid line ruled it as an all-but-independent 'kingdom of Bougie', still receiving Andalusian refugees from the Reconquista. In 1444 it is the chief city of the Kabyle coast, ruled in the name of Tunis, its commerce already slipping as the Portuguese ocean routes draw trade away.

In 1510 Pedro Navarro stormed Béjaïa for Spain, expelling Sultan Abd al-Aziz; his brother Abu Bakr, who proclaimed himself sultan at Constantine, failed to retake it in 1512, and the corsair Aruj Barbarossa lost an arm in the siege. In the mountains behind the coast, Ahmed ou el-Qadi built the Kabyle kingdom of Koukou, which defeated Khayr ad-Din Barbarossa at the Issers and held Algiers itself from 1520 to 1527, while the rival Aït Abbas princes held their Kalaa. In 1555 the beylerbey Salah Raïs, with Koukou's warriors, finally retook the city, and Béjaïa became a port of the Regency of Algiers within the Beylik of Constantine, kept alive chiefly by its arsenal and the timber and wax of its hinterland; an English fleet bombarded it in 1671 to put a stop to corsair raids. The Turks never subdued the Kabyle mountains: Koukou declined early in the seventeenth century, but the Aït Abbas remained masters of their Kalaa.
zh:
