The Timurid Abu Sa'id Mirza killed Sultan Muhammad and annexed the country, and in 1504 its usurper Amir Khusrau submitted to Babur, who sent his kinsman Khan Mirza to govern it in 1506. Khan Mirza's son Mirza Sulaiman held Badakhshan for decades: he surrendered to Prince Kamran in 1541 and was restored by Humayun in 1545, invaded Balkh in 1560 where his son Ibrahim fell, and intervened repeatedly in the Kabul wars of Mirza Hakim. In 1575 his grandson Shahrukh drove him out, and in 1584 Abdullah Khan II of Bukhara overran the country; Shahrukh fled to the Mughal Empire and Sulaiman ended at Akbar's court, where he died at Lahore in 1589. Shah Jahan conquered Badakhshan in 1641 and made it an imperial province, only to lose it in 1647, and after a rising in 1657 the local Yarid mirs ruled again from the Kokcha. Durrani troops first reached the country in 1753, and in 1768 Shah Wali Khan stormed Fayzabad and put Sultan Shah to death, annexing Badakhshan to Ahmad Shah Durrani's empire.
zh:
巴达赫尚是兴都库什山与阿姆河上游之间的高地，群山锁闭，只有河谷中才有农田和村落。此地自古以宝石闻名：科克恰河谷萨尔桑的青金石矿，曾是古代世界唯一的深蓝宝石产地；红色的尖晶石被称作「巴拉斯红宝石」，而「巴拉斯」一名正来自这片土地的古称。省治蒙詹就坐落在产宝石的群山中，1270年代马可·波罗翻山而过，在游记里记下了这里的红宝石矿。1444年，这里仍由本地的米尔王朝统治，末代国王苏丹穆罕默德自称亚历山大大帝的后裔；山地王国只对帖木儿朝廷承担松散的臣属关系，1420年苏丹还曾遣使向明朝朝贡。

帖木儿王公阿布·赛义德杀死苏丹穆罕默德，将巴达赫尚并入帖木儿版图；1504年篡位者埃米尔·胡斯劳向巴布尔投降，1506年巴布尔派宗亲汗·米尔扎出镇此地。汗·米尔扎之子米尔扎·苏莱曼长久统治巴达赫尚：1541年他被迫向卡姆兰·米尔扎投降，1545年由胡马雍释放复位；1560年出征巴尔赫，儿子易卜拉欣战死；他还数度进兵喀布尔，介入米尔扎·穆罕默德·哈基姆的纷争。1575年，孙子沙哈鲁将他逐走；1584年布哈拉的阿卜杜拉汗二世攻占全境，沙哈鲁逃入莫卧儿帝国，苏莱曼投奔阿克巴并受封军职，1589年死于拉合尔。1641年沙贾汗征服此地，设为帝国行省，1647年即告失守；1657年当地起兵，雅尔家族的米尔们在科克恰河畔重建政权。杜兰尼军队1753年首次压境，1768年沙·瓦利汗攻陷费扎巴德，处死苏丹沙，巴达赫尚并入艾哈迈德沙·杜兰尼的帝国。

en:
Qarshi occupies the fertile Qashqadaryo oasis south of Samarkand, on the eleven-day caravan road from Bukhara to Balkh. The older city was known as Nakhshab and Nasaf. In the 1320s Kebek Khan of the Chagatai khanate built a residence near the old settlement, and the name Qarshi came into use; Timur added a moated fortified palace there in 1364. Wheat, cotton and silk sustained the oasis. In 1444 its Sunni, Turkic-speaking townspeople lived under Timurid rule in Transoxiana, while Ulugh Beg governed from Samarkand.

Muhammad Shaybani drove the Timurids from Samarkand in 1500 and took Bukhara in 1501, bringing Qarshi under the Shaybanid Khanate of Bukhara. The town expanded in the 16th century: the Kok Gumbaz mosque and old bath date from that period, and a bridge over the Qashqadaryo was built in 1583. The Sharafboy madrasa followed in the early 18th century. Nader Shah conquered Bukhara in 1740, and after Shah Murad founded the Manghit emirate in 1785 Qarshi served as a seat of the Bukharan crown prince, protected by double walls with ten caravanserais and four madrasas.
zh:
卡尔希位于撒马尔罕以南肥沃的卡什卡达里亚绿洲，坐落在布哈拉通往巴里黑、全程约十一天的商路上。旧城先后称那黑沙不和纳萨夫。1320年代，察合台汗国的怯别汗在旧聚落附近营建宫室，卡尔希之名开始使用；1364年，帖木儿又在这里修建了带壕沟的坚固宫殿。绿洲以小麦、棉花和丝绸为生。1444年，城中说突厥语的逊尼派居民处在帖木儿系政权统治下的河中地区，兀鲁伯则在撒马尔罕主持政务。

1500年，穆罕默德·昔班尼把帖木儿后裔逐出撒马尔罕，1501年又攻取布哈拉，卡尔希随之归入布哈拉汗国的昔班尼王朝。城市在16世纪发展起来，科克贡巴兹清真寺和古浴场都建于这一时期，卡什卡达里亚河上的古桥则于1583年建成。18世纪初，沙拉夫波伊经学院落成。1740年纳迪尔沙征服布哈拉；1785年沙赫·穆拉德建立曼吉特王朝后，卡尔希成为布哈拉王储的驻所之一，城有双重墙垣，城内设有十座商队旅馆和四所经学院。

en:
Samarkand lies in the oasis of the Zeravshan, the old Sogdian city of Marakanda on the Silk Road between China and Persia. Genghis Khan's armies stormed it in 1220, but it rose to its greatest fortune under Timur, who made it his capital in 1370 and settled it with craftsmen brought from Damascus, Delhi and Aleppo. He raised the Bibi-Khanym Friday Mosque between 1399 and 1404 and was buried in the Gur-i Amir. His grandson Ulugh Beg, governor from 1409, built the madrasa on the Registan in 1417–1420 and an observatory in 1428, where al-Kashi, Qadi Zada al-Rumi and Ali Qushji mapped 1,018 stars; in 1444, the year of the book's opening, Ulugh Beg completed his new astronomical tables, the Zij-i Sultani. The city was then at the height of the Timurid Renaissance, a Persian-speaking Sunni realm of tilework, gardens and libraries under an astronomer-king.

Shah Rukh died in 1447 and Ulugh Beg himself was murdered in 1449, after which the Timurid princes tore the empire apart. Babur of Fergana took Samarkand in 1497 and again in 1511, but could not hold it; in 1501 Muhammad Shaybani's Uzbeks made themselves masters of the city and had their khan crowned there. In 1533 Ubaydullah Khan moved the capital to Bukhara, yet the khans of Bukhara were still enthroned at Samarkand's Kuksarai palace on Timur's old stone throne. Under the Janids the governor Yalangtush Bahadur raised the Sherdar and Tilya-Kari madrasas between 1612 and 1656, completing the three-sided Registan. The eighteenth century was cruel: after Kazakh raids, famine and plague the city stood nearly deserted by 1735, and Nader Shah's troops sacked it in 1740, carrying off Timur's jade gravestone before returning it. The Manghit emir Muhammad Rahim began to resettle Samarkand in 1756, and in 1821 it lived on, diminished but still crowned with its madrasas, as a city of the Bukharan emirs.
zh:
撒马尔罕位于泽拉夫尚河畔的绿洲，是丝绸之路上连通中国与波斯的粟特古城马拉坎达。1220年成吉思汗的军队攻破此城，但它的极盛在帖木儿时代：帖木儿1370年定都于此，把从大马士革、德里和阿勒颇掳来的工匠安置在城里，1399至1404年建起比比哈奴大清真寺，身后葬入古尔-埃米尔陵。其孙兀鲁伯1409年起出镇撒马尔罕，1417至1420年在雷吉斯坦修建经学院，1428年又建成天文台，卡西、卡迪扎达·鲁米和阿里·库什奇在此测定了1018颗恒星的位置；就在本剧本开局的1444年，兀鲁伯完成了他的新历数书《新古拉干历数书》。此时的撒马尔罕正处帖木儿文艺复兴的巅峰，是一座瓷砖、园林与图书馆辉映的逊尼派波斯语城市，统治者本人便是天文学家。

1447年沙哈鲁去世，兀鲁伯本人也于1449年遇弑，帖木儿诸王随即把帝国撕扯得四分五裂。费尔干纳的巴布尔1497年、1511年两度攻占撒马尔罕，都未能守住；1501年穆罕默德·昔班尼的乌兹别克人成为城市之主，并在此为汗加冕。1533年乌拜杜拉汗迁都布哈拉，但历代布哈拉汗仍在撒马尔罕的库克萨莱宫、对着帖木儿留下的石座登基。札尼王朝时期，城主雅兰图什·巴哈杜尔于1612至1656年建起希尔·多尔和季里·牙·卡尔里两座经学院，使雷吉斯坦成为今日的模样。18世纪对它极为残酷：哈萨克袭掠、饥荒与瘟疫之后，到1735年全城几乎空无一人；1740年纳迪尔沙的军队洗劫此城，把帖木儿的玉碑掠走后又送还。曼吉特埃米尔穆罕默德·拉希姆1756年着手重新安置居民；1821年的撒马尔罕已风光不再，却仍戴着经学院的冠冕，作为布哈拉埃米尔治下的城市延续着。

en:
Kyzylkum means Red Sand in Turkic: a sandy and stony desert of roughly 300,000 square kilometres between the Amu Darya and Syr Darya, bounded to the north-west by the Aral Sea. Its wells and seasonal pastures linked Khwarezm with the Syr Darya towns of Syghnaq and Sozak and with the oases of Transoxiana, while camel, horse and sheep herds supplied the caravan trade. In 1444 the desert marches belonged to Abu'l-Khayr's Uzbek confederation, which had raided into Timurid Transoxiana in 1430-46 and was pressing on the Syr Darya cities.

Kerei and Janibek broke from Abu'l-Khayr and founded the Kazakh Khanate in 1465, drawing many Uzbek tribes after the confederation collapsed. Qasim Khan, ruler from 1511, captured the Nogai capital Saray-Juk in 1520 and extended Kazakh authority to the Syr Darya pastures bordering the desert. After Tauke Khan's death in 1715 or 1718 the Kazakh juzes split, and in spring 1723 the Dzungars overwhelmed the southern steppe; fleeing clans crossed the Syr Darya, and some disappeared into the Kyzylkum and Karakum sands. The Junior Juz sought Russian protection in 1731, and during the rest of the eighteenth century Russian forts and tribute agreements closed around the northern approaches, though desert clans kept much of their seasonal movement.
zh:
克孜勒库姆在突厥语中意为红沙，是阿姆河与锡尔河之间、咸海东南方的沙质与石质荒漠，面积约30万平方公里。水井和季节性牧场把花剌子模、锡尔河畔的瑟格纳克和苏扎克，以及河中各绿洲连接起来，驼、马和羊群则为商队贸易提供牲畜。1444年，这片沙漠边缘属于阿布海尔汗的乌兹别克联盟；该联盟1430—1446年已攻入帖木儿帝国治下的河中，并向锡尔河诸城施压。

克烈与贾尼别克脱离阿布海尔，于1465年建立哈萨克汗国；联盟瓦解后，许多乌兹别克部落加入他们。哈斯木1511年称汗，1520年攻占诺盖都城萨赖奇克，把哈萨克势力扩展到毗邻沙漠的锡尔河牧场。头克汗1715或1718年去世后，哈萨克三玉兹分裂；1723年春，准噶尔大军突袭南部草原，逃亡的部族渡过锡尔河，其中一些人散入克孜勒库姆和卡拉库姆沙漠。小玉兹1731年向俄国寻求保护，此后到18世纪末，俄国防线和贡赋约定逐渐围向北方通道，但沙漠中的部族仍保留了大部分季节性迁牧生活。

en:
Yasi, the future Turkestan, grew up beside the Syr Darya on the caravan road between Khwarezm and Transoxiana; the older settlement of Shavgar in its vicinity is already named in tenth-century sources. In the twelfth century it was the home of Khoja Ahmad Yasawi, the Turkic Sufi poet, who died there in 1166, and his tomb made the town, called Hazrat-i Turkistan by pilgrims, one of the holy cities of the steppe. After defeating Tokhtamysh in 1395 Timur ordered a grand mausoleum and khanaqah over the grave, work began in 1397, but construction stopped with his death in 1405 and the entrance portal was left unfinished. In 1444 Yasi was a shrine town on the Timurid frontier, living by pilgrimage and caravan traffic, while Abu'l-Khayr's Uzbek confederation gathered strength on the steppe and in 1446 seized the Syr Darya towns of Sighnaq and Sozak.

The new name Turkestan is first recorded in the mid-sixteenth century, when the town passed under the Kazakh khans; under Haqnazar and his successors it became their chief seat on the Syr Darya, served by a copper and silver mint. Tauekel Khan wrested the river towns from Bukhara before 1598, and Esim Khan, ruling from 1598 to 1628, held them against Tashkent and the Oirats; the Yasawi mausoleum became the khans' residence and burial place, gathering lesser tombs such as that of the Timurid princess Rabiya Sultan Begim. Bukhara's Abdullah Khan II paid for the long-ruined portal of Timur's mausoleum to be completed. Tauke Khan, who died about 1715, ruled and judged from Turkestan in the khanate's last strong decades. In spring 1723 the Dzungar invasion remembered as the Great Disaster overran the Syr Darya oases and stormed the Kazakh capital, and a fresh Dzungar army swept the region in 1739-1741. The city then changed hands among Kazakh sultans and the rulers of Tashkent and Bukhara, until Alim Khan of Kokand took it with the Tashkent lands in 1809; lost to Bukhara, it was reconquered by Umar Khan in 1815, who prayed at Yasawi's tomb and had himself proclaimed amir al-muslimin there. By 1821 the Syr Darya towns were firmly held by Kokand governors.
zh:
亚西，即后来的突厥斯坦，位于锡尔河畔、连接花剌子模与河中的商道上；附近更古老的定居点沙夫加尔在10世纪的文献中已有记载。12世纪时，这里是突厥语苏菲派诗人霍贾·艾哈迈德·亚萨维居住并于1166年安葬之地，他的陵墓使这座被朝圣者称作「哈兹拉特-突厥斯坦」的城镇成为草原上的伊斯兰圣城之一。1395年帖木儿战胜脱脱迷失后，下令在墓上修建宏大的陵寝和道堂，1397年动工，但1405年他去世后工程中辍，正门始终没有建成。1444年，亚西是帖木儿王朝边境上一座靠朝觐和商队贸易为生的圣城，城外草原上阿布海尔的乌兹别克联盟正日益强大，并于1446年攻取了瑟格纳克、苏扎克等锡尔河诸城。

「突厥斯坦」这一新名最早见于16世纪中叶，当时城镇转入哈萨克汗之手；在哈克纳扎尔及其后继者治下，它成为哈萨克汗国在锡尔河上的首要驻地，设有铜银铸币作坊。塔乌凯勒汗1598年以前从布哈拉手中夺得沿河诸城，1598—1628年在位的叶斯穆汗又顶住塔什干和卫拉特的压力将其守住；亚萨维陵成为汗王的驻地和安葬之所，周围还聚有帖木儿公主拉比娅·苏丹·别姬姆等人的小陵。布哈拉的阿卜杜拉汗二世出资完成了帖木儿陵墓荒废已久的正门。1715年前后去世的头克汗，曾在汗国最后强盛的数十年里以突厥斯坦为统治和断案之所。1723年春，被称为「大灾难」的准噶尔入侵席卷锡尔河诸绿洲并攻破这座哈萨克都城，1739—1741年又有一支准噶尔大军横扫此地。此后城市在哈萨克苏丹与塔什干、布哈拉的统治者之间几度易手，直到1809年浩罕的阿里姆汗在吞并塔什干政权时将其攻占；城市一度落入布哈拉之手，1815年由乌马尔汗夺回，他亲往亚萨维陵祭拜，并在那里受封为「信士之长」。1821年时，锡尔河诸城已稳固处于浩罕长官的治下。

en:
Tashkent occupies the Chirchik oasis south of the Syr Darya, where the older Silk Road centre of Chach once linked Sogdian market towns with the Turkic steppe. The Mongols destroyed it in 1219, but Timur restored the strategic city and marched from it against Tokhtamysh in 1391. By 1444 it was a walled Sunni town in Ulugh Beg's Timurid realm, governed from Samarkand and valued for its citadel, caravan traffic and scholars. The Naqshbandi leader Ubaydallah Khoja Ahrar had returned to the Tashkent region around 1431 and taught there before moving to Samarkand.

The city changed masters as Timurid power fractured: Yunus Khan seized it in 1485, and the Shaybanids took it in the early sixteenth century. Suyunchkhoja Khan ruled Tashkent from 1513 to 1525, gathering poets and scholars at his court, while later Shaybanid governors struck coin there and built the Kukeldash Madrasa by 1569. Around the close of the century the Kazakh khans secured the city, although Bukharan forces contested it and Imam Quli Khan's troops took it in 1612. Dzungar raids began in 1691 and the great invasion of 1723 opened decades of tribute and changing overlords. In 1784 Yunus Khoja united the city's four warring quarters into an independent Tashkent state, trading across the steppe with 60,000 to 80,000 people behind nearly nineteen kilometres of earthen walls. Kokand subdued it in 1807–1808, and by 1820 travellers found about 100,000 inhabitants, ten madrasas and busy textile workshops.
zh:
塔什干位于锡尔河以南的奇尔奇克绿洲，前身是丝绸之路上的赭时，连接粟特城镇与突厥草原。蒙古人在1219年摧毁此城，帖木儿恢复了这座战略要地，并于1391年从这里出兵讨伐脱脱迷失。1444年时，它是兀鲁伯治下帖木儿帝国的一座逊尼派城墙城镇，政令出自撒马尔罕，以城堡、商队贸易和学者闻名。纳格什班迪教团领袖乌拜杜拉·和卓·阿赫拉尔约在1431年回到塔什干地区讲学，1451年才迁往撒马尔罕。

帖木儿政权分裂后，塔什干几度易主：羽奴思汗1485年夺取此城，昔班尼王朝则在16世纪初将其纳入版图。苏云奇·和卓汗1513年至1525年统治塔什干，在宫廷招聚诗人与学者；后来的昔班尼长官在此铸币，并在1569年前建成库克尔达什经学院。16世纪末，哈萨克汗取得城市，但布哈拉仍不断争夺，伊玛目·库里汗的军队1612年一度攻占塔什干。准噶尔人1691年开始来袭，1723年的大举入侵开启了数十年称贡与宗主更替的局面。1784年，尤努斯·和卓结束城内四区的长期混战，建立独立的塔什干政权；城周长近十九公里的土墙之内有六万至八万居民，商队贸易远达草原。浩罕在1807—1808年降服塔什干，到1820年，旅人见到的已是约十万居民、十座经学院和繁忙纺织作坊的大城。

en:
Kokand lies at the southwestern edge of the Ferghana Valley, where the caravan roads from Tashkent and Khujand meet the irrigated plain. Arab geographers of the tenth century knew a town here called Khavakand, a Silk Road station between Persia and China, but the Mongols sacked it in the thirteenth century, and it long remained a modest market overshadowed by older Ferghana cities such as Akhsikath and Andijan. In 1444 the district belonged to the Timurid realm ruled from Samarkand, its orchards, irrigated fields and iron workings serving the valley's caravan trade.

After Muhammad Shaybani's Uzbek conquest early in the sixteenth century, Ferghana passed to the Shaybanid khans of Bukhara and their Janid successors, whose grip loosened in the early eighteenth century. In 1709 Shahrukh Biy of the Uzbek Ming tribe founded an independent principality; his son Abd al-Karim Biy built the Kokand fortress and made it his capital in 1740, survived a Dzungar invasion in 1742, and repelled a siege of the town in 1745. Irdana Biy later opened relations with the Qianlong emperor once Qing power reached Altishahr, and under Narbuta Biy (1770–1799) the valley was largely united. Alim Khan dredged the Yangi Ariq canal, struck silver coin and took Khujand and Tashkent, until his brother Umar had him killed in 1811; under Umar the khanate's arms reached the Kazakh steppe while Kokand's merchants grew rich on the trade with Qing Xinjiang.
zh:
浩罕位于费尔干纳盆地西南缘，从塔什干和苦盏进入灌溉平原的商路在此汇合。10世纪的阿拉伯地理学家已记载此地有一座名叫哈瓦干德的城镇，是波斯与中国之间丝绸之路上的驿站；13世纪蒙古人将其劫掠一空，此后很久它都只是个普通集镇，声势在阿赫西肯特、安集延等费尔干纳古城之下。1444年，这片地方属于以撒马尔罕为中心的帖木儿帝国，果园、灌溉田和铁作坊供应着盆地里的商队贸易。

16世纪初穆罕默德·昔班尼率乌兹别克人征服河中后，费尔干纳归布哈拉的昔班尼汗及其后的札尼王朝统治，到18世纪初汗廷的控制逐渐松弛。1709年，乌兹别克明格部首领沙鲁克·比自立建国；其子阿卜杜勒·卡里姆·比1740年修筑浩罕城堡、定为国都，1742年顶住准噶尔的大举入侵，1745年又击退对浩罕的围攻。清朝势力进入天山南路后，伊尔达那·比（清廷称额尔德尼）与乾隆皇帝建立了联系；到纳尔布塔·比在位时（1770—1799年），费尔干纳大体归于一统。爱里木汗疏浚扬吉阿雷克渠、铸造银币，攻占苦盏和塔什干，1811年被其弟奥马尔所杀；奥马尔在位时浩罕兵锋远及哈萨克草原，浩罕商人则靠着对清朝新疆的贸易富足起来。

en:
Taraz, the medieval Talas, grew on the Talas River where the road from Transoxiana crossed into the Ili country. It was a Sogdian trading town first recorded under the name Talas in 568, and already famous when Tang and Abbasid armies clashed nearby in 751. Under the Karakhanids of the tenth to twelfth centuries it was a wealthy Muslim city of paved streets, terracotta water-pipes and the domed mausolea of Karakhan and Aisha-Bibi. The Mongols sacked it in 1220 and renamed it Yangi, 'the New'; Chagatayid coins were struck there until 1334, and a road-book of 1345 still lists it on the route to Almalyk. In 1444 Taraz was a much-shrunken caravan settlement amid its old ruins, notionally ruled from Moghulistan.

In the 1460s the Moghul khan Esen Buqa had granted the Chu and Talas valleys to the sultans Kerei and Janybek, who proclaimed the Kazakh Khanate there around 1465; Taraz became one of its towns, and a chronicle notes Kazakh tribes living there from 1513. In 1723 the Dzungars overran the Talas valley in the calamity the Kazakhs call the Great Disaster, and the town lay in ruins until 1727; Dzungar garrisons held it almost to 1756. After the Qing destroyed the Dzungar state in 1755–57, the Qianlong Emperor in 1766 allowed Kazakh clans to resettle the empty valley. Early in the nineteenth century Qipchaq soldiers of the Khanate of Kokand raised on the ancient ruins a fortress called Namangan-i Kochek, and a new town grew up around it, drawing caravans between Tashkent, the steppe and the Talas-Alatau passes.
zh:
怛罗斯（中世纪称塔拉斯）位于塔拉斯河畔，是河中通往伊犁流域的商路要冲。这座粟特商镇在568年即以塔拉斯之名见于记载，751年唐朝与阿拔斯王朝的军队在城附近交锋时，它已颇具声名。10至12世纪喀喇汗国治下，怛罗斯是富庶的伊斯兰城市，街道铺砌，地下铺有陶制水管，喀喇汗与艾莎-比比的穹顶陵墓也建于此时。1220年蒙古人攻陷该城，改名扬吉，意为「新」；察合台汗国在此铸币一直到1334年，1345年的行旅指南仍把它列在前往阿力麻里的道上。1444年的怛罗斯是旧城废墟间一个大大萎缩的商队聚落，名义上由东察合台统治。

15世纪60年代，东察合台汗也先不花将楚河与塔拉斯河谷赐给克烈与贾尼别克两位苏丹，二人于1465年前后在此建立哈萨克汗国，怛罗斯成为汗国最早的城镇之一，1513年的史料已记载有哈萨克部落居住于此。1723年，准噶尔人在哈萨克人称为「大灾难」的浩劫中席卷塔拉斯河谷，城镇被毁，直到1727年仍是一片废墟，准噶尔的驻军更一直占据到1756年前后。清朝于1755至1757年攻灭准噶尔之后，乾隆帝在1766年准许哈萨克部落重返空旷的河谷定居。19世纪初，浩罕汗国的钦察士兵在古城废墟上筑起一座名为「小纳曼干」的堡垒，一座新镇在堡旁兴起，吸引往来于塔什干、草原与塔拉斯-阿拉套山口之间的商队。

en:
Uzgen stands where the road from the Ferghana basin climbs toward Kashgar, and Chinese annals knew a settlement here in the second century BC. From the later eleventh to the thirteenth century it was the Karakhanid governor's seat in Ferghana and struck its own coin; a 44-metre minaret was raised in the early twelfth century and Karakhanid princes were buried in the mausolea beside it. The city never regained its former size after the Mongol years, and by 1444 it was a quiet market town in Timurid Ferghana, overshadowed by Andijan, while Kyrgyz herders grazed the high pastures above it.

When the Uzbek leader Muhammad Shaybani overran the Timurid lands, he defeated the young Babur, who had ruled Ferghana from Andijan; by 1504 Babur had abandoned the valley and taken Kabul, and Uzgen passed to the Shaybanids with the rest of Ferghana, and later to the khans of Bukhara. In 1709 Shahrukh-biy, chief of the Uzbek Ming tribe, broke from a weakening Bukhara and founded the principality that grew into the Khanate of Kokand, and his son Abdurahim-biy added Andijan and Khujand to it. Dzungar armies swept through the valley in 1745–1747, taking Osh, Andijan and Margilan and besieging Kokand; Kyrgyz sources record that Uzgen itself passed under Kokand's rule only in the early nineteenth century.
zh:
乌兹根地处费尔干纳盆地通往喀什噶尔的山道要冲，中国史籍在公元前2世纪已记载此地有城。11世纪下半叶到13世纪，它是喀喇汗王朝费尔干纳省的治所，曾自铸钱币；12世纪初建起44米高的宣礼塔，旁边的王陵安葬着喀喇汗王朝的王族。蒙古时代以后，城势再未恢复旧观，到1444年已是帖木儿王朝治下费尔干纳一座冷清的商镇，声望远在安集延之下，吉尔吉斯牧人则在城上方的高山牧场放牧。

乌兹别克首领穆罕默德·昔班尼席卷帖木儿故土时，曾以安集延为治所统治费尔干纳的年轻巴布尔为其所败；到1504年巴布尔放弃谷地、南下夺取喀布尔，乌兹根随整个费尔干纳归入昔班尼王朝，后来又受治于布哈拉的汗。1709年，乌兹别克明格部首领沙鲁克·比摆脱衰微的布哈拉建立政权，即后来的浩罕汗国，其子阿卜杜拉欣·比又为汗国攻取安集延与苦盏。1745至1747年，准噶尔军队横扫谷地，连克奥什、安集延、马尔吉兰并围攻浩罕；据吉尔吉斯方面的史料，乌兹根本城直到19世纪初才归入浩罕统治。

en:
Beneath the snowy wall of the Trans-Ili Alatau, the Almaty region was crossed by the Silk Road branch linking Taraz with Almalyk and China. Saka kings were buried in the great kurgans along the Almatinka, and Wusun herders tilled its alluvial fans; between the eighth and tenth centuries a town called Almatau stood there, its name preserved on silver dirhams of the thirteenth century. The Mongols took Zhetysu early in the thirteenth century, and in 1390 Timur's army marched through on its way from Tashkent to Issyk-Kul and the Ili. Timurid wars drove the caravan roads south into the Tarim basin, and the towns shrank to villages. In 1444 the Almaty country belonged to Moghulistan, its pastures held by Turkic and Mongol clans for whom Islam was still little more than a ruler's creed.

By the early sixteenth century the Senior Juz of the Kazakhs pastured here. The Dzungar onslaught of 1723 emptied the valleys in the Great Disaster, but in the spring of 1730 Kazakh forces under Abulkhair defeated a Dzungar army in the Anyrakai hills, seventy kilometres north-west of Almaty. Qing armies destroyed the Dzungar state in 1755–57, and Kazakh clans returned to the Zailiysky pastures as nominal tributaries of the Qing. Through the later eighteenth century the region remained a grazing country on the marches of the Khanate of Kokand, with no town yet standing where Almaty would one day rise.
zh:
外伊犁阿拉套的雪峰之下，阿拉木图地区横亘着连接怛罗斯、阿力麻里与中国的丝绸之路支线。萨卡人的王陵沿阿拉木丁卡河而建，乌孙牧人在冲积扇上耕作；8至10世纪，一座名为阿尔马图的城镇兴起于此，13世纪的银迪尔汗上铸有它的名字。13世纪初蒙古人征服七河，1390年帖木儿的军队自塔什干经开往伊塞克湖与伊犁，途经此地。帖木儿系的战祸迫使商路南迁塔里木盆地，城镇纷纷萎缩为村庄。1444年的阿拉木图属东察合台，草场上的突厥、蒙古诸部对伊斯兰教仍不过是对统治者信仰的名义遵从。

到16世纪初，哈萨克大玉兹已在此游牧。1723年准噶尔人的进攻在「大灾难」中空了诸谷，但1730年春，阿布勒海尔率领的哈萨克军队在阿拉木图西北七十公里的安拉凯山区击败一支准噶尔大军。1755至1757年清军攻灭准噶尔，哈萨克部落作为清朝名义上的藩属返回外伊犁牧场。整个18世纪后期，这里仍是浩罕汗国边缘的游牧之地，日后阿拉木图兴起之处还没有一座城镇。

en:
Odishi, later called Samegrelo or Mingrelia, is the Black Sea coastal plain between the Tskhenistsqali and Enguri rivers, homeland of the Mingrelians and the domain of the Dadiani. The family had held it as eristavi, or duke, since the high Middle Ages. In 1444 Liparit I Dadiani, ruling since 1414, governed from Zugdidi over vineyards and Black Sea traffic while the unified Kingdom of Georgia crumbled around him.

In 1463 Liparit joined Bagrat of Imereti at the battle of Chikhori; after the victory Bagrat was crowned at Kutaisi and made the Dadiani princes of Mingrelia, a title that became hereditary and fully independent under Levan I in 1557. The Ottomans seized the northern port of Tskhumi in 1578, and by about 1615 Mingrelia paid them tribute as Abkhazia broke away to the north. Levan II Dadiani (1611-1657) raided his neighbours for slaves and ransom; in 1646 the scribe Mamuka Tavakalashvili copied the epic 'The Knight in the Panther's Skin' at his Zugdidi court. Jean Chardin, visiting late in the seventeenth century, found the land emptied by the sale of Christian captives to Istanbul. After Levan's death the courtier Katsia Chikovani seized power, and his son ruled as Giorgi IV Dadiani; in 1702 Imeretian and Mingrelian forces halted the Abkhazians at the Enguri, which became the border. In 1802 Grigol Dadiani submitted to the Russian tsar, and in 1804 Mingrelia became an autonomous Russian protectorate; when he died later that year his widow Nino, a daughter of George XII, was regent for their son Levan until 1811.
zh:
奥迪希（后称萨梅格雷洛，俄罗斯文献作明格列利亚）是茨赫尼斯茨卡利河与因古里河之间的黑海沿岸平原，明格列尔人世居之地，达迪亚尼家族的领地。该家族自中世纪盛期起便以埃里斯塔维（公爵）身份领有此地。1444年，自1414年起在位的利帕里特一世·达迪亚尼坐镇祖格迪迪，治下有葡萄园和黑海商路之利，而统一的格鲁吉亚王国正在他身边瓦解。

1463年，利帕里特在奇霍里战役中加入伊梅列季王公巴格拉特一方；获胜后巴格拉特在库塔伊西加冕，封达迪亚尼为明格列利亚王公，1557年列万一世时这一头衔成为世袭，公国也完全独立。1578年，奥斯曼攻占北方港口茨胡米；到1615年前后，明格列利亚被迫向奥斯曼纳贡，北面的阿布哈兹也脱离而去。列万二世·达迪亚尼（1611—1657年在位）以劫掠邻邦、掳人勒赎闻名；1646年，书吏马穆卡·塔瓦卡拉什维利在他的祖格迪迪宫廷抄录了史诗《虎皮武士》。法国旅行家让·夏尔丹17世纪后期到访时，见到的是基督徒被卖往伊斯坦布尔、乡野为之一空的景象。列万二世死后，廷臣卡齐亚·奇科瓦尼夺权，其子改称格奥尔基四世·达迪亚尼统治；1702年，伊梅列季与明格列利亚联军在因古里河挡住阿布哈兹人，此河此后成为边界。1802年格里戈尔·达迪亚尼向俄罗斯沙皇称臣，1804年明格列利亚成为俄罗斯治下的自治藩属；他同年去世，王后妮诺（格鲁吉亚国王格奥尔基十二世之女）为幼子列万摄政，直到1811年。

en:
The wooded foothills between the Kuban River and the main Caucasus range, watered by the Belaya and Laba, form the western heartland of the Adyghe — the Circassians, whom earlier writers called Zikhi or Kassogs. Christianity reached them from Byzantium in the time of Justinian, and the Orthodox see of Zichia long answered to Constantinople. The Mongols raided from the 1220s onwards, and in 1395 Timur's armies wasted the land 'from Azov to the Elbrus', forcing the tribes back behind the Kuban. Early in the fifteenth century Prince Inal united the feuding clans, ruled from Shanjir near Taman, planted his kinsmen in the Kabarda country around 1434, and in 1438 drove the Tatar bands beyond the Kuban. In 1444 Inal still rules a free Circassia as its grand prince: Orthodox Adyghe clans graze cattle and horses on the foothill pastures and trade them through the Genoese factories at Matrega and Kopa, while each prince, the pshi, remains master of his own valley.

After Inal's death in 1458 his lands were divided among his sons, and Circassia broke into the tribal principalities of later centuries — Temirgoy, Besleney, Zhaney and the rest; the Bolotokov princes of Temirgoy held the lower Belaya, and the Genoese traveller Giorgio Interiano described these clans at the end of the century. The Ottoman capture of Caffa in 1475 ended the Genoese trade and placed the coast under the sultan and the Crimean khan, whose raids and slave-tribute shadowed the valleys for three hundred years. Adyghe embassies reached Moscow in 1552, 1555 and 1557 to ask Ivan the Terrible for protection, and in 1556 the western tribes stormed the Crimean-Ottoman forts at Temryuk and Taman. The alliance faded after the Crimean revival of the 1570s, and during the seventeenth century Sunni Islam, often blended with older custom, slowly displaced Orthodoxy. In 1770 the free Abzakh farmers of the mountains killed or expelled their princes and took to ruling through village assemblies; the Natukhaj followed in 1791 and the Shapsug in 1803. Russia annexed the Crimea in 1783 and built its forts along the Kuban, and with the opening of the Caucasian War in 1817 the fighting reached these foothills.
zh:
库班河与高加索主脉之间林木茂密的山麓，由别拉亚河与拉巴河浇灌，是阿迪格人——即切尔克斯人，古籍中的济赫人、卡索格人——西部的腹心。基督教在查士丁尼时代从拜占庭传入，隶属君士坦丁堡牧首的东正教济希亚教区延续很久。蒙古人自1220年代起不断入侵，1395年帖木儿的军队「从亚速夫一直劫掠到厄尔布鲁士」，把各部逼退到库班河以南。15世纪初，王公伊纳尔统一了互相仇杀的氏族，以塔曼附近的尚吉尔为都，约1434年把亲族安置到东方的卡巴尔达地方，1438年又把鞑靼部落逐过库班河。1444年的伊纳尔仍以大公之主治着一个自由的切尔克西亚：信奉东正教的阿迪格氏族在山麓牧场牧养牛马，经马特列加、科帕的热那亚商站外销，而每个王公（пщы）仍是自己山谷的主人。

伊纳尔1458年死后土地分给诸子，切尔克西亚分裂为后世的部落公国——捷米尔戈耶夫、巴斯列涅耶夫、扎涅耶夫等；博洛托科夫家族的捷米尔戈耶夫王公领有别拉亚河下游，热那亚旅行家乔治·因特里亚诺在该世纪末记下了这些氏族的风俗。1475年奥斯曼攻占卡法，热那亚贸易终结，海岸落入苏丹与克里木汗之手，此后三百年间，入寇和奴隶贡赋一直笼罩着各山谷。阿迪格使团于1552、1555、1557年三赴莫斯科，请求伊凡雷帝庇护；1556年西部各部又攻陷克里木—奥斯曼在捷姆留克和塔曼的据点。1570年代克里木重新得势后联盟瓦解，17世纪里，常与旧俗混杂的逊尼派伊斯兰教逐渐取代东正教。1770年，山中自由的阿布扎赫农夫杀死或驱逐王公，改由村社会议议事，纳图哈伊人1791年、沙普苏格人1803年相继效法。俄国1783年吞并克里木，沿库班河修筑要塞；1817年高加索战争爆发，战火烧到了这片山麓。

en:
Hajji Tarkhan, the forerunner of Astrakhan, stood on the right bank of the Volga in the upper delta, twelve kilometres above the modern city. Under the Golden Horde it grew into one of the great marts of the steppe: caravans from Sarai carried eastern silk and spices through it to Tana on the Sea of Azov, where Venetian and Genoese ships waited, while fish, salt and slaves moved the other way. Ibn Battuta wintered there with Khan Özbeg in 1333, and Timur sacked and burned the city in 1395. In 1444 Hajji Tarkhan belonged to the Great Horde, a Sunni Muslim Tatar trading town still bearing the marks of that destruction.

In 1459 Mahmud, son of the Horde's ruler Küchük Muhammad, made the city the capital of the breakaway Astrakhan Khanate. Afanasy Nikitin passed through around 1469, and in 1476 the Venetian envoy Contarini found a poor place of mud-brick houses behind a low stone wall. Crimean khans seized it briefly in 1523 and 1549. Ivan the Terrible's troops took the city in 1554 and again in 1556, when the khanate was abolished and the largest slave market on the Volga broken up. In 1558 the town was moved twelve kilometres downstream to its present site and a wooden kremlin was raised there, replaced in 1582 by stone walls with eight towers. An Ottoman-Tatar army failed to take it in 1569. Stenka Razin's rebels held Astrakhan in 1670–71, and streltsy and townspeople rose again in 1705–06; in 1717 Peter the Great made the city the seat of a governorate, Russia's gateway to the Caspian and the East.
zh:
阿斯特拉罕的前身哈吉塔尔汉位于伏尔加河三角洲上游的右岸，在今城以北十二公里。金帐汗国时期，它发展成草原上最大的商埠之一：来自萨莱的商队把东方的丝绸和香料经此运往亚速海畔的塔纳，由等候在那里的威尼斯和热那亚商船转销欧洲，鱼、盐和奴隶则反向流通。1333年，伊本·白图泰随月即别汗在此过冬；1395年帖木儿攻陷并焚毁了这座城市。1444年的哈吉塔尔汉属大帐汗国，是一座逊尼派鞑靼人的商镇，兵燹的痕迹仍未消退。

1459年，大帐统治者库楚克·马哈麻之子马哈茂德与兄弟阿黑麻争权失败，退据哈吉塔尔汉，以此为都建立独立的阿斯特拉罕汗国。阿法纳西·尼基特约在1469年路过此地；1476年威尼斯使节孔塔里尼见到的，只是一道矮石墙围着的土坯屋，一派萧条。克里米亚可汗的军队曾在1523年和1549年两度短暂占城。伊凡雷帝的军队1554年首次攻下该城，1556年再度占领，汗国灭亡，伏尔加河上最大的奴隶市场被取缔。1558年城市南迁十二公里到今址，先建起木构克里姆林，1582年又换成带八座塔楼的石墙。1569年奥斯曼与鞑靼联军攻城不克。1670至1671年，斯捷潘·拉辛的起义军据守此地；1705至1706年，射击军和市民再次起事。1717年彼得大帝设立阿斯特拉罕省，这里成为俄罗斯通向里海与东方的门户。

en:
The lower Yaik, renamed the Ural in 1775, crosses the flat Caspian steppe to its delta, through country dotted with self-sown salt lakes, of which Inder is the largest. Fifty kilometres above the delta stood Saraychik, raised on a winter camp where the road from Tana to Khwarazm crossed the river by a bridge of boats. It became one of the greater cities of the Golden Horde and struck its own coin, until Timur's army sacked it in 1395. Rebuilt in 1430–1440, in 1444 it was the seat of the Manghit yurt: the heirs of Edigu, founder of the Nogai confederation, ruled the Sunni Manghit clans pasturing between the Yaik and the Volga, and caravans again watered at Saraychik.

From the 1490s, under Musa, son of Vakkas, Saraychik was the capital and the only true city of the Nogai Horde, where furs, livestock and salt mostly changed hands by barter. Around 1520 the Kazakhs of Qasim Khan overran the lands east of the Yaik and held the city, and in 1577 Haqnazar Khan seized it again. After Muscovy annexed Astrakhan in 1556 the bey Ismail accepted Ivan the Terrible's suzerainty, and in 1557 a dissident branch broke away to the Kuban to form the Lesser Nogai Horde. In 1580 free Cossack atamans, Nechai and Bogdan Barbosha, stormed and burned Saraychik, and its surviving people fled to Khiva. In 1628–1634 the Kalmyks under Kho-Urluk overwhelmed the Great Nogai Horde, and the Nogais abandoned the Yaik for the right bank of the Volga. In 1640 Russian settlers built a small ostrog beside the ruins.
zh:
亚伊克河（1775年改名乌拉尔河）下游穿过平坦的里海草原注入三角洲，沿岸多自沉积盐湖，以因杰尔湖最大。三角洲上游约50公里处矗立着萨莱楚克城，它建于一处蒙古时代的冬季营地，塔纳通往花剌子模的商道在此以舟桥渡河。萨莱楚克是金帐汗国最大的城市之一，自铸钱币，1395年被帖木儿的军队攻陷。1430至1440年间城市重建，1444年时是曼吉特帐的驻地：诺盖联盟的缔造者也迪古的后裔，统治着在亚伊克河与伏尔加河之间游牧的逊尼派曼吉特各部，商队又开始在萨莱楚克歇脚补水。

1490年代瓦卡斯之子穆萨在位时，萨莱楚克成为诺盖汗国的都城，也是汗国唯一真正的城市，毛皮、牲畜和盐在市面上多以物易物。1520年前后，哈斯木汗率哈萨克人攻占亚伊克河以东并占据此城，1577年哈克纳扎尔汗再次夺城。1556年莫斯科吞并阿斯特拉罕后，诺盖别克伊斯梅尔向伊凡雷帝称臣，1557年一支异见部落西走库班，另立小诺盖帐。1580年，不受莫斯科管束的哥萨克首领涅恰伊和波格丹·巴尔博沙攻破并焚毁萨莱楚克，幸存居民逃往希瓦。1628至1634年，霍·乌尔留克率领卡尔梅克人击灭大诺盖帐，诺盖人放弃亚伊克河，退往伏尔加河右岸。1640年，俄罗斯移民在废墟旁建起一座小城堡。

en:
Sarai, the seat of the khans of the Golden Horde, rose on the lower Volga among the channels of the Akhtuba. Batu founded the city in the early 1250s, and William of Rubruck found a new town on the Itil in 1254; under Öz Beg and Jani Beg it became one of the greatest cities of the steppe, the hinge of the road from the Crimea to China. Florentine merchant handbooks list its exports: raw silk, furs, sturgeon and caviar, hides and Turkic slaves. Ibn Battuta admired its broad streets and crowded bazaars, where Mongols, Kipchaks, Circassians, Russians and foreign merchants each had their own quarter. Timur's army destroyed the newer of the two Sarai cities in 1395. In 1444 the surviving Sarai, much diminished, was still the capital of the Great Horde of Küchük Muhammad, its bazaars drawing the last caravan trade of the steppe.

Afanasy Nikitin passed through around 1469, and Vyatka river raiders sacked Sarai in 1471. In 1502 the Crimean khan Mengli I Giray, allied with Ivan III, burned the city and overthrew the Great Horde, claiming the Golden Horde's inheritance for Crimea. Sarai was never rebuilt, and its ruins stood in pastures where Nogai herds grazed. After Russia took Kazan and Astrakhan in 1552–56, the lower Volga opened to Muscovite shipping, and the empty steppe twice rose in revolt: Stenka Razin's Cossacks swept this river in 1670, and Yemelyan Pugachev's host crossed it in 1774, before the tsar's rule closed over the old khans' land.
zh:
萨莱是金帐汗国诸汗的王庭，兴起于伏尔加河下游阿赫图巴河的河汊之间。1250年代初拔都建城，1254年鲁不鲁乞见到它时，还是伊蒂尔河畔的一座新城；到月即别和札尼别时代，它已成为草原上最宏大的城市之一，扼守克里米亚通往中国的商路。佛罗伦萨商人的行商手册列有此地的出口货：生丝、毛皮、鲟鱼肉、鱼子酱、皮革和突厥奴隶。伊本·白图泰赞叹这里街道宽阔、市集熙攘，蒙古人、钦察人、切尔克斯人、罗斯人和外来商贾各居一区。1395年帖木儿的军队摧毁了两座萨莱中较新的新萨莱。1444年，元气大伤的萨莱仍是库楚克·马哈麻治下大帐汗国的都城，巴扎里做着草原上最后的商队生意。

阿法纳西·尼基特约在1469年途经此地，1471年维亚特卡的河上武装又攻破并洗劫了萨莱。1502年，与伊凡三世结盟的克里米亚可汗明里一世·格莱焚毁城市、攻灭大帐，宣称克里米亚继承金帐汗国的正统。萨莱再未重建，遗址留在诺盖人放牧的草野之间。俄罗斯于1552至1556年攻灭喀山和阿斯特拉罕后，伏尔加河下游向莫斯科的航运敞开，空旷的草原两度成为叛军的天下：1670年斯捷潘·拉辛的哥萨克席卷这条大河，1774年叶梅利扬·普加乔夫的部众又穿过这里，旧汗的土地最终彻底归于沙皇治下。

en:
This is the forest-steppe country between the upper Khopyor and its tributary the Vorona, where oak groves break up the open grassland. In 1444 it was the north-western fringe of the Great Horde, summer pasture for Tatar herds and a corridor for Crimean and Nogai raiding parties riding north towards Ryazan; only scattered Mishar and Mordvin fishing and beekeeping camps broke the emptiness. As Muscovy pushed its fortified lines south, the forts of Voronezh and Tambov rose nearby in the late sixteenth and early seventeenth centuries, while the empty woods and waters here were simply leased out as hunting and fishing grounds.

During the preparations for Peter I's Azov campaigns, timber from the great Tellerman oak forest was felled here and built into barges for the Azov fleet, and in 1698 the Pavlovsk fortress was raised on the Vorona for protection against Crimean, Azov and Nogai raids. A church of Saints Boris and Gleb went up in 1704, and the stronghold took its present name, Borisoglebsk. Townsmen joined Bulavin's Cossack rebellion in 1708 and held the town briefly before the tsar's troops retook it; the last Kalmyk and Tatar raid reached the walls in 1713. With the frontier moving farther south, Borisoglebsk became a grain market, shipping sixty to ninety barges a year of rye, flour, oats and timber down the Khopyor and Don to Azov and the Black Sea, and in 1779 it was made an uyezd town of Tambov Governorate.
zh:
这片地方位于霍皮奥尔河上游与其支流沃罗纳河之间，属森林草原地带，开阔草场上点缀着成片橡林。1444年这里是大帐汗国的西北边缘，是鞑靼牧群的夏季牧场，也是克里米亚和诺盖劫掠队伍北上奔袭梁赞的通道；空旷的原野上只有米萨尔鞑靼人和莫尔多瓦人零星的渔猎营地。随着莫斯科公国把设防边墙向南推进，16世纪末至17世纪初，附近先后建起沃罗涅日和坦波夫要塞，而此地空旷的林地水面只被出租作渔猎场。

彼得一世筹备亚速远征时，在泰列尔曼大橡林伐木、建造亚速舰队所需的驳船；1698年，为防备克里米亚、亚速和诺盖人入寇，沃罗纳河畔建起巴甫洛夫斯克要塞。1704年，圣鲍里斯与格列布教堂落成，要塞由此得今名鲍里索格列布斯克。1708年，市民响应孔德拉季·布拉文的哥萨克起义，一度占据城镇，旋即被沙皇军队夺回；1713年，卡尔梅克与鞑靼人的最后一次入寇兵临城下。随着边界继续南移，鲍里索格列布斯克变成粮食集散地，每年有六十至九十条满载黑麦、面粉、燕麦和木材的驳船顺霍皮奥尔河、顿河驶往亚速和黑海；1779年，它成为坦波夫省的县城。

en:
Manych is named after the saline Manych river, whose shallow lakes and marshes run through the Kuma-Manych Depression between the Don, the lower Volga and the North Caucasus. In 1444 these pastures belonged to the Great Horde, the surviving core of the Golden Horde ruled from Sarai. Astrakhani Tatar and Nogai herders moved sheep, cattle and horses between the Manych grasslands and the Volga crossings, while trade moved downriver toward the great market at Hajji-Tarkhan. The black earth bluff later called Chyorny Yar commanded one stretch of that Volga road, but no Russian fort yet stood there.

In 1459 Mahmud, son of Küchük Muhammad, formed the Astrakhan polity around Hajji-Tarkhan; it became fully independent only after the Crimeans destroyed the Great Horde in 1502. Nogai riders controlled much of the western steppe and crossed the Volga to attack Astrakhan in 1521. Moscow installed Dervish Ali as khan in 1554, but on 2 June 1556 a small Cossack vanguard found Hajji-Tarkhan abandoned and Russian troops ended the khanate. The Volga fort of Mikhailov Novgorod was founded on the black bluff in 1627 and moved to higher ground in 1634 as Chyorny Yar, called Yankala or 'new town' by neighbouring Nogais. Kalmyk defeats of the Great Nogai Horde in the 1630s pushed surviving Nogai groups westward toward the right bank. During Stenka Razin's revolt the fort fell to the rebels in 1670-1671, and Astrakhan rebels seized it again in 1705. In 1785 Chyorny Yar became an uyezd town of Astrakhan Governorate.
zh:
马内奇得名于咸水的马内奇河；浅湖与沼泽沿库马—马内奇洼地延伸，介于顿河、伏尔加河下游和北高加索之间。1444年时，这片牧场属于大帐，即金帐汗国残存的核心，政厅设在萨莱。阿斯特拉罕鞑靼人与诺盖牧人赶着羊、牛和马，在马内奇草原与伏尔加河渡口之间转场，商货则顺伏尔加河运往哈吉—塔尔汗的大市场。后来称为乔尔内亚尔的黑土崖俯瞰着这段伏尔加商路，但当时那里还没有俄罗斯要塞。

1459年，小穆罕默德之子马哈茂德以哈吉—塔尔汗为中心形成阿斯特拉罕政权；直到1502年克里米亚人摧毁大帐后，它才完全独立。诺盖骑兵控制着西部草原的大片土地，并在1521年渡过伏尔加河进攻阿斯特拉罕。1554年，莫斯科把德尔维什·阿里扶上汗位；但1556年6月2日，一小支哥萨克前锋抵达时哈吉—塔尔汗已遭放弃，俄军随即灭亡汗国。1627年，俄罗斯人在黑土崖上修建米哈伊洛夫新城要塞，1634年迁至更高处，称乔尔内亚尔；邻近的诺盖人把它叫作扬卡拉，意为「新城」。1630年代，卡尔梅克人重创大诺盖帐，迫使残存的诺盖部众西迁至伏尔加河右岸。斯坚卡·拉辛起义期间，要塞在1670—1671年被起义军占领，1705年又被阿斯特拉罕起义者夺取。1785年，乔尔内亚尔成为阿斯特拉罕省的县城。

en:
The Ryn sands fill the watershed between the lower Volga and the lower Yaik, a belt of dunes and salt-marsh in the Caspian lowland where shallow rivers vanish among reed-grown lakes. In 1444 this was the southern pasture of the Nogai Horde, the confederation led by the Manghit beys that had emerged from the breakup of the Golden Horde. Herds wintered in the sheltered hollows, while the sturgeon-rich waters of the lower Volga and Yaik, bordering these pastures, supplied the nomads with fish.

In the early sixteenth century the Kazakh khans drove the Nogais westward, and in 1580 free Cossack bands from the Volga burned the Horde's town of Saray-Jük on the lower Yaik. The decisive blow fell in 1628–1630, when the Torghut Oirats under Kho-Urluk crossed from beyond the Yaik and overran the whole Volga–Yaik steppe; the Nogai uluses scattered towards the Kuban, and the Ryn became Kalmyk grazing ground. After the great Torgut exodus of 1771 the sands were left nearly empty. During Pugachev's revolt of 1773–1774 Kazakh bands rode with the rebels across these pastures. In 1801 the emperor Paul allowed Bukey, a sultan of the Junior Jüz, to bring five thousand tents, more than 22,000 people, across the Yaik into the vacant steppe, where they formed the Bukey, or Inner, Horde.
zh:
雷恩沙漠横亘在伏尔加河下游与亚伊克河下游的分水岭上，是里海低地上一片沙丘与盐沼交错的地带，水浅的河流消失在芦苇丛生的湖泊之间。1444年，这里是诺盖汗国南部的牧场——这个以曼格特部首领为首的联盟，从金帐汗国的瓦解中兴起。牧群在避风的洼地过冬，牧地边缘伏尔加河、亚伊克河下游多鲟鱼的水面，则为游牧人提供渔获。

16世纪初，哈萨克诸汗把诺盖人向西驱赶；1580年，来自伏尔加河的自由哥萨克武装焚毁了汗国在亚伊克河下游的城镇萨莱楚克。决定性的打击发生在1628—1630年：和鄂尔勒克率领的土尔扈特卫拉特人越过亚伊克河，席卷伏尔加河与亚伊克河之间的整片草原，诺盖各部纷纷西逃库班河一带，雷恩沙地成了卡尔梅克人的牧场。1771年土尔扈特人大举东归后，这里几乎空无一人。1773—1774年普加乔夫起义期间，哈萨克人的队伍随起义军驰骋过这片牧场。1801年，沙皇保罗准许小玉兹苏丹布克依率五千帐、两万两千余人渡过亚伊克河，进入空旷的草原，建立布克依斡耳朵，又称内帐。

en:
The Bayuly country is the open grazing plain east of the middle Yaik, stretching towards the Irgiz and the arid steppe beyond. It holds no cities: herds of horses, sheep and cattle move between summer pasture up the rivers and winter camps in the warmer south, following a chain of wells. In 1444 these were the western pastures of the Nogai Horde, where Sunni Manghit clans grazed their livestock and caravans travelling from Saraychik to the Syr Darya passed along the desert wells.

As the Nogai Horde crumbled before Kazakhs and Kalmyks, the Alshyn, the greatest of the Kazakh tribes, entered the plain, and the twelve rods of the Bayuly, with the Adai, Berish and Zhappas among them, became one of its two great divisions within the Little Jüz. In 1731 the Bayuly followed Abulkhair Khan in swearing allegiance to Russia. In 1774 their riders under Syrym Datuly fought beside Pugachev's Cossacks, and from 1783 Syrym led the Little Horde's rising against Khan Nuraly and the Russian ban on moving to the right bank of the Yaik; Nuraly was driven out in 1786 and Syrym fled to Khiva in 1797. In 1801 Bukey, a son of Nuraly, led five thousand families across the Yaik into the empty Volga steppe and founded the Inner Horde.
zh:
巴伊乌勒之地是亚伊克河中游以东的开阔牧场，一直延伸到伊尔吉兹河和更干燥的草原。这里没有城市：马群、羊群和牛群沿着一连串水井，往返于河流上游的夏牧场与温暖南方的冬营地之间。1444年时，这里是诺盖汗国的西部牧场，逊尼派曼吉特各部在此放牧，从萨莱楚克前往锡尔河的商队也循着沙漠水井穿过此地。

诺盖汗国在哈萨克人和卡尔梅克人夹击下崩溃后，哈萨克最大部落阿尔申进入这片平原；巴伊乌勒十二部——阿代、别里什、扎帕斯等——成为小玉兹阿尔申部落的两大分支之一。1731年，巴伊乌勒各部随阿布勒海尔汗向俄罗斯宣誓效忠。1774年，瑟雷姆·达托夫率领他们的骑兵与普加乔夫的哥萨克并肩作战；1783年起，瑟雷姆又领导小玉兹起义，反抗努拉里汗以及沙俄禁止牧民迁往亚伊克河右岸的禁令，努拉里1786年被逐，瑟雷姆1797年败走希瓦。1801年，努拉里之子布克依率五千户越过亚伊克河，进入空无人烟的伏尔加草原，建立布克依斡耳朵（内帐）。

en:
The Alimuly country lies farther south and drier: the stony Mugodzhar hills rise from the steppe between the Yaik and the Irgiz, and the pastures run on to the north-eastern shore of the Aral Sea and the edge of the Ustyurt. Wells and caravan tracks linked Saraychik this way with Khiva. In 1444 this was the south-eastern grazing ground of the Nogai Horde, where Sunni Manghit herders moved between the Mugodzhar springs and the reedy Aral littoral.

After the Nogai collapse the six rods of the Alimuly, 'the six fathers', with Shekty and Tortkara among them, became the southern wing of the Alshyn tribe in the Kazakh Little Jüz, the Shekty pasturing especially in the north-eastern Aral lands. The seventeenth century brought Kalmyk raids from the west and Dzungar pressure from the east, and the great Dzungar invasion of the 1720s drove the Alimuly clans behind Abulkhair Khan, whose own following lay among their six rods and whose Kazakhs defeated the Dzungars at Anrakai in 1729. After Abulkhair took the Russian oath in 1731 the clans found themselves under a tsar-backed khan, and when Baraq Sultan killed him in 1748 the Shekty refused his son Nuraly, proclaimed Batyr their khan and split the Little Jüz in two.
zh:
艾力木乌勒之地更靠南、也更干旱：多石的穆戈贾雷山隆起在亚伊克河与伊尔吉兹河之间的草原上，牧场一直延伸到咸海东北岸和乌斯秋尔特高原边缘，水井和商道由此把萨莱楚克与希瓦连接起来。1444年时，这里是诺盖汗国的东南牧场，逊尼派曼吉特牧人在穆戈贾雷山的泉水与芦苇丛生的咸海岸之间往返游牧。

诺盖崩溃后，艾力木乌勒六部——意为「六祖」，包括谢克特、托尔特卡拉等——成为哈萨克小玉兹阿尔申部落的南翼，谢克特人尤其在咸海东北一带游牧。17世纪里，西有卡尔梅克人袭扰，东有准噶尔人进逼；1720年代准噶尔大举入侵，艾力木乌勒各部投奔阿布勒海尔汗，他的本部就在这六族之中，其哈萨克联军于1729年在安拉凯大败准噶尔人。阿布勒海尔1731年向俄罗斯宣誓后，各部头上有了沙皇支持的汗；1748年巴拉克苏丹将他杀害，谢克特人拒认其子努拉里，另立巴蒂尔为汗，小玉兹一分为二。

en:
The Zhetyru steppe is the northern edge of the nomad world, where the dry plain climbs into the wooded foothills of the southern Urals along the upper Yaik and the headwaters of the Tobol; birch and pine cover the ridges while herds pasture on the black-earth below. In 1444 this was the north-eastern march of the Nogai Horde, with Sunni Manghit clans camping along the forest edge and Bashkir herders in the nearby mountains. Its later lords were the seven old Desht-i-Kipchak clans, Tabyn and Tama among them, whom Tauke Khan united into a single body, the Zhetyru or 'seven rods', in the late seventeenth century and attached to the Kazakh Little Jüz.

Dzungar raids in the 1720s pushed the seven rods into Abulkhair Khan's alliance and the Russian oath of 1731. The tsar's frontier then moved onto their pastures: the Orenburg expedition built Orsk at the mouth of the Or in 1735, and in 1736 the Chelyaba fortress rose on the Miass on the site of a Bashkir village, forming the northern anchor of a chain of forts that reached its goal at Orenburg on the Yaik in 1743. The Bashkir rising of 1735–1740 was fought in these same hills, and afterwards the Zhetyru rods pastured under the eyes of the Orenburg Cossack line, trading their livestock at its frontier fairs.
zh:
杰特鲁草原是游牧世界的北缘：干旱平原沿亚伊克河上游和托博尔河源头抬升为林木覆盖的南乌拉尔山麓，山岗上遍布桦树和松树，山下的黑土地带可供牧放。1444年时，这里是诺盖汗国的东北边地，逊尼派曼吉特各部在林缘扎营，附近山里就是巴什基尔牧人。后来据有此地的是七个钦察草原老氏族——塔本、塔马等——17世纪末经头克汗合并为一个整体，称杰特鲁，意为「七部」，并入哈萨克小玉兹。

1720年代准噶尔东侵，七部加入阿布勒海尔汗的联盟，并随他于1731年向俄罗斯宣誓。沙皇的边防随即推进到他们的牧场：奥伦堡考察队1735年在奥尔河口建起奥尔斯克要塞，1736年又在米阿斯河畔一处巴什基尔村落的旧址上建起车里雅巴要塞，作为堡垒链的北端；堡垒链1743年以亚伊克河畔的奥伦堡为终点告成。1735至1740年的巴什基尔人起义就在这片山地中进行，此后杰特鲁七部便在奥伦堡哥萨克防线的监视下游牧，在边境集市上交易牲畜。

en:
Samara lies where the Samara River joins the Volga, at the great loop called the Samara Bend. The Arab envoy Ahmad ibn Fadlan noted the river as the Samur in 921, on his journey to the Volga Bulgars, and a Volga port of Samara already appears on Italian maps of the fourteenth century. Under the Golden Horde the bend was a notorious pirates' nest: lookouts marked passing boats and freebooters sallied out from the peninsula. In 1444 the left bank was the steppe frontier of the new Khanate of Kazan, pasture for Nogai herders, with no permanent Russian town yet standing.

After the fall of Kazan in 1552 Moscow moved to secure the waterway from Kazan to Astrakhan, and in 1586, by decree of Tsar Fyodor, voevoda Prince Grigory Zasekin built the Samara fortress at the river mouth between May and August. A customs house followed in 1600, and the town became a meeting point of Russian merchants and envoys with the East. Stepan Razin's rebels seized it in 1670, and in 1773 Samara became the first town to go over to Yemelyan Pugachev. In the 1740s it housed the Orenburg expedition run at one time by Vasily Tatishchev, under which Orenburg and Stavropol on the Volga were founded, and in 1780 Catherine II made it an uyezd town of Simbirsk Governorate.
zh:
萨马拉位于萨马拉河注入伏尔加河处，扼守萨马拉河湾。阿拉伯使者艾哈迈德·伊本·法德兰921年出使伏尔加保加利亚途中，将这条河记为「萨穆尔」；14世纪的意大利地图上已标出伏尔加河畔的萨马拉港。金帐汗国时期，河湾一带是有名的盗巢：望手发现过往船只，匪徒便从半岛出击。1444年，伏尔加左岸是新兴喀山汗国的草原边地，诺盖牧人在此放牧，俄国人的常驻城镇尚未出现。

1552年喀山陷落后，莫斯科着手保障喀山至阿斯特拉罕的水路。1586年奉费奥多尔沙皇诏令，督军格里戈里·扎谢金公爵于5月至8月间在河口筑起萨马拉城堡。1600年这里设立海关，城镇逐渐成为俄国商人、使者与东方往来的枢纽。1670年斯捷潘·拉辛的起义军攻占萨马拉；1773年，萨马拉成为第一座倒向叶梅利扬·普加乔夫的城市。1740年代，瓦西里·塔季谢夫曾主管的奥伦堡考察团驻节于此，奥伦堡与伏尔加河畔的斯塔夫罗波尔都在这一时期建立；1780年叶卡捷琳娜二世推行县制改革，萨马拉成为辛比尔斯克省的县城。

en:
The Yaik is the long river that runs from the southern Urals to the Caspian. In 1444 its middle course was Nogai country: the Horde's herds moved along its banks, and the river was already prized for its runs of sturgeon. There was no Russian settlement and no town of any size, only the camps of nomad fishermen; the Horde's city of Saray-Jük lay far downstream, nearer the sea.

Fugitive Volga Cossacks led by the ataman Bogdan Barbosha built their first stronghold on the river in 1584. After the Nogais destroyed it in 1613, the Yaik Cossacks refounded the settlement fifty kilometres downstream, on the peninsula between the Yaik and the Chagan, and 1613 became the accepted founding date of Yaitsk. Under Tsar Michael they received a charter granting them the whole river from its source to its mouth. The fisheries, sturgeon and caviar made their wealth; in 1717 fifteen hundred Yaik Cossacks perished in Bekovich-Cherkassky's disastrous expedition against Khiva. Quarrels over fishing rights and lost self-government produced a rising in 1772, when the Cossacks cut down General von Traubenberg, and the repression that followed drove them into the arms of Yemelyan Pugachev. On 17 September 1773 Pugachev raised his standard at the Budarinsky outpost near Yaitsk and proclaimed himself Tsar Peter III. The insurgents took the town and besieged the fortified cathedral of the Archangel Michael, where a loyal garrison held out until relieved in mid-April 1774. In January 1775 Catherine II renamed the river the Ural, the host the Ural Cossacks and Yaitsk the town of Uralsk.
zh:
亚伊克河是一条发源于南乌拉尔山、注入里海的长河。1444年，其中游还是诺盖人的土地：汗国的牧群沿两岸游动，河中鲟鱼回游，早已为人看重。这里没有俄罗斯人的定居点，也没有像样的城镇，只有游牧渔民的营地；汗国的城市萨莱楚克远在靠近河口的下游。

1584年，在首领波格丹·巴尔博沙率领下，出逃的伏尔加河哥萨克在河畔建起第一座堡寨。1613年诺盖人将其摧毁，亚伊克哥萨克遂在下游五十公里处、亚伊克河与恰甘河环抱的半岛上重建城镇，1613年由此被定为亚伊茨克的建城年份。米哈伊尔沙皇在位时，他们获颁诏书，领有整条亚伊克河，自源头直到河口。渔场、鲟鱼和鱼子酱是他们财富所系；1717年，一千五百名亚伊克哥萨克在别科维奇-切尔卡斯基远征希瓦的惨败中丧生。围绕渔业权益和自治丧失的争端引发了1772年的暴动，哥萨克杀死了冯·特劳本贝格将军，随之而来的镇压把他们推向叶梅利扬·普加乔夫一边。1773年9月17日，普加乔夫在亚伊茨克附近的布达林斯基哨所举旗，自称沙皇彼得三世。起义军占据城镇，围攻以天使长米哈伊尔大教堂为核心的堡垒，忠于政府的守军一直坚守到1774年4月中旬解围。1775年1月，叶卡捷琳娜二世将亚伊克河改名乌拉尔河，亚伊克哥萨克军改称乌拉尔哥萨克军，亚伊茨克改名乌拉尔斯克。

en:
The middle Belaya (Aghidhel) is the old heart of Bashkiria, where Bashkir tribes grazed cattle and horses between forest and steppe. Arab geographers knew the country as Bashgird, and the Pizzigano map of 1367 and the Catalan Atlas of 1375 mark a town called Pashkerti on the Belaya, which later writers identified with the site of Ufa; in the sixteenth century the place was Imen-kala, the oak-built seat of the Nogai governors. With the breakup of the Golden Horde the western Bashkir tribes passed to the Kazan khanate, and in 1444 they were Hanafi Sunni herdsmen, subject to Kazan and exposed to Nogai raids.

After Kazan fell to Ivan the Terrible in October 1552, Bashkir tribal embassies treated with the tsar's governors in 1554–1557 and received charters confirming their ancestral lands. In 1574 the voevoda Mikhail Nagoy built the Ufa fortress on the old settlement's hill, and it was granted town status in 1586. In 1635 its garrison beat off a raid by the Siberian tsarevich Ablai and his Kalmyks and took him prisoner. The great Bashkir rising of 1735–1740, provoked by the Orenburg chain of forts, swept the country round the town, and in the winter of 1773–1774 Ufa withstood siege and assault by Pugachev's rebels while Bashkir horsemen swelled their ranks. Ufa became the seat of a viceroyalty in December 1781, and on 4 December 1789 the Orenburg Mohammedan Spiritual Assembly opened there, directing Muslim affairs across the Russian east; in 1798 the Bashkirs were organised into an irregular host.
zh:
别拉亚河（巴什基尔语称阿吉代尔）中游是巴什基尔地方的古老心脏，巴什基尔诸部在森林与草原之间放牧牛马。阿拉伯地理学家称这片国度为巴什吉尔德；1367年的皮齐加诺地图与1375年的加泰罗尼亚地图集都在别拉亚河畔标出名为帕什凯尔季的城，后世学者将其位置比定为乌法；16世纪时这里是诺盖比伊的橡木驻地伊缅卡拉。金帐汗国解体后，巴什基尔西部诸部归喀山汗国管辖。1444年时，这里的居民是奉哈乃斐教法的逊尼派游牧人，臣属于喀山，又不时遭到诺盖骑兵的袭掠。

1552年10月喀山被伊凡雷帝攻灭，巴什基尔各部的使团在1554—1557年与沙皇的总督谈判，领到确认其祖传土地的特许状。1574年，督军米哈伊尔·纳戈伊在旧城山丘上筑起乌法要塞，1586年获准设城；1635年，守军击退西伯利亚王公阿布莱联合卡尔梅克人的来犯，并将阿布莱俘获。1735—1740年，修建奥伦堡要塞链激起巴什基尔大起义，战火席卷乌法四乡；1773—1774年冬，普加乔夫的义军围攻并强攻乌法不克，而大批巴什基尔骑兵投效其麾下。1781年12月乌法成为乌法总督区的驻地，1789年12月4日，奥伦堡穆罕默德宗教会议在此开幕，统管俄国东部穆斯林的教务；1798年，沙皇政府将巴什基尔人组编为非正规军。

en:
Kypshak is the central Kazakh steppe of the Kipchak tribe, a country of dispersed wells and seasonal pastures later counted among the six tribes of the Middle Jüz. After the eastern Golden Horde broke apart, Abu'l-Khayr Khan united the Shibanid clans of Dasht-i Qipchaq and took the khan's title in 1429. In 1431–1432 he captured the nomadic headquarters called Orda-Bazar and struck coin there; unlike a walled town, it was a moving court and market. In 1444, two years before Abu'l-Khayr took Sighnaq, Sozak and other Syr Darya towns in 1446, Orda-Bazar served as the centre of his Uzbek ulus. Kipchak, Kerey, Naiman and related tribes pastured horses and sheep under his uneasy lordship.

The discontented Chinggisid sultans Kerei and Janibek withdrew toward Moghulistan, and Kazakh tradition dates their khanate to 1465. When Abu'l-Khayr died in 1468, they returned to central Kazakhstan and drew much of the steppe after them; under Burunduk from 1480 and Qasim Khan from 1511 to 1521, the Kazakh confederation became the dominant power of the eastern steppe. Dzungar armies shattered the Kazakh lands in the spring of 1723, driving Middle Jüz refugees toward Samarkand and Khujand, although Kazakh forces recovered with victories in 1728 and 1730. The Middle Jüz accepted nominal Russian suzerainty soon after 1731, while Ablai Khan, ruling from 1771 to 1781, rebuilt its power during Dzungaria's collapse. By 1821, after Vali Khan's death in 1817, the old Kipchak pastures lay under the shadow of Russian forts and frontier officials.
zh:
钦察是哈萨克中部草原上钦察部落的牧地，水井分散、牧场随季节转换，后来属于中玉兹六大部落之一。金帐汗国东翼瓦解后，阿布勒海尔汗统一了钦察草原上的昔班尼诸部，于1429年称汗。1431—1432年，他夺取名为奥尔达-巴扎尔的游牧王庭并在那里铸币；它不是城墙环绕的城镇，而是移动的汗廷与市集。1444年，即阿布勒海尔1446年攻取昔格纳黑、苏扎克等锡尔河城市的两年前，奥尔达-巴扎尔是他的乌兹别克兀鲁思中心。钦察、克列、乃蛮等相关部落在其并不稳固的统治下放牧马匹和羊群。

不满其统治的成吉思汗系苏丹克列和贾尼别克迁往蒙兀儿斯坦，哈萨克传统把他们建国定在1465年。阿布勒海尔1468年死后，他们返回哈萨克中部，草原诸部大量归附；自1480年在位的布伦杜克，以及1511—1521年在位的卡西姆，使哈萨克联盟成为东部草原的强权。1723年春，准噶尔军队重创哈萨克诸地，中玉兹难民被迫涌向撒马尔罕和苦盏，哈萨克人又在1728年和1730年取胜，逐渐恢复声势。中玉兹在1731年后不久接受俄国名义上的宗主权，1771—1781年在位的阿布赉汗则趁准噶尔崩溃重建权势。到1821年，随着瓦里汗1817年去世，旧的钦察牧场已处在俄国要塞和边疆官员的阴影之下。

en:
The Nadym pastures occupy the arid middle reaches of the Sarysu, between the oasis towns of the Talas valley and the low ridges of the Sary-Arka. Wells are few and often brackish, and to the south the grass runs out into the hunger-steppe of Betpak-Dala. In 1444 the Kipchak clans camping here belonged to the Uzbek ulus of Abu'l-Khayr Khan, whose capital then still stood at Tura in western Siberia; their horses and wool went by caravan tracks to the markets of Sighnaq on the Syr Darya.

In 1457 Oirats under Uz-Temur-tayishi routed Abu'l-Khayr near Sighnaq, and when he died in 1468 the ulus fell apart; Kerei and Janibek, who had broken away a few years earlier, led the Kazakh clans into mastery of the steppe. The Dzungars overran these pastures in 1723, opening the 'Years of the Great Disaster', when the auls abandoned their winter camps and stock and fled to the Syr Darya. The united militia answered with victories at Bulanty in 1726 and near Lake Balkhash in 1729. The rulers of the Middle Jüz accepted Russian suzerainty in 1740, and Abylai Khan, elected khan of the three jüzes at Turkestan in 1771, held the confederation together until his death in 1781.
zh:
纳德姆的牧地位于萨雷苏河中游的干旱草原，北接萨雷阿尔卡丘陵，南邻塔拉斯河谷的绿洲城镇。这里水井稀少且多含苦咸水，草原向南渐渐没入别特帕克-达拉「饥饿草原」。1444年，在此游牧的钦察诸部属于阿布勒海尔汗的乌兹别克兀鲁思，汗廷当时还设在西西伯利亚的图拉城，马匹和羊毛沿商道运往锡尔河畔昔格纳克的市集。

1457年，乌兹帖木儿太师率领的卫拉特人在昔格纳克附近大败阿布勒海尔；1468年他去世后兀鲁思瓦解，数年前出走的克烈与贾尼别克率领哈萨克诸部成为草原的主人。1723年准噶尔人席卷这片牧场，史称「大灾难年代」，诸部抛下冬营地和牲畜逃往锡尔河。联军1726年在布兰泰、1729年在巴尔喀什湖附近先后取胜。1740年中玉兹诸汗接受俄国宗主权；1771年阿布莱在突厥斯坦被三玉兹推举为汗，将联盟维系到1781年去世。

en:
The Argyn are the most numerous tribe of the Kazakh Middle Jüz, roaming the steppe from the Turgai plateau in the west to the Chingiz mountains on the edge of the Altai, and down to the north-western shore of Lake Balkhash. Their genealogies trace them to Karakhodzha, an emir of the Golden Horde in the fourteenth century, and they are split into two great branches, Meiram and Momyn, with the battle cry 'Akzhol'. In 1444 the Argyn clans pastured the dry grasslands of the central Sary-Arka as part of the Uzbek ulus of Abu'l-Khayr Khan.

After Abu'l-Khayr's death in 1468 the Argyns joined the sultans Kerei and Janibek and grew into the foremost tribe of the Middle Jüz. Their judges sat in the khan's council: under Tauke Khan the Argyn biy Kazybek, born in 1667, helped compile the Zhety Zhargy, the steppe's code of customary law. In the Dzungar war the young sultan Abylai rose to lead the large Atygai clan, was taken prisoner in the invasion of 1741 and held at Galdan Tseren's headquarters until his release in 1743. The Middle Jüz had accepted Russian suzerainty in 1740. Kazybek biy died in 1763, and Abylai, elected khan of all three jüzes at Turkestan in 1771, died in 1781.
zh:
阿尔浑是哈萨克中玉兹人数最多的部落，游牧地域西起图尔盖高原，东到阿尔泰麓的成吉思山脉，南抵巴尔喀什湖西北岸，包括帕夫洛达尔、阿克莫拉、卡拉干达一带。其谱系把始祖追溯到14世纪金帐汗国的埃米尔卡拉霍加，下分梅拉姆、莫温两大支系，部族战呼为「阿克卓勒」。1444年，阿尔浑诸部在阿布勒海尔汗的乌兹别克兀鲁思中游牧于萨雷阿尔卡中部的干草原。

阿布勒海尔1468年去世后，阿尔浑人归附克烈与贾尼别克的哈萨克，后来成长为中玉兹最大的部落。阿尔浑的比位列汗廷：1667年出生的哈孜别克比在头克汗时期参与编纂了草原习惯法典《七项法典》。准噶尔战争中，年轻的苏丹阿布莱成为大阿提盖部的首领，在1741年的入侵中被俘，囚禁在噶尔丹策零的营地，1743年才获释。中玉兹已于1740年接受俄国宗主权；哈孜别克比1763年去世，阿布莱则于1771年在突厥斯坦被三玉兹推举为汗，1781年去世。

en:
Kerey takes its name from a small, closed salt lake in the basin of Lake Tengiz, and a river of the same name drains the surrounding dry pasture. Those seasonal camps were used by Kerei clans, later counted among the six tribes of the Middle Jüz; their older memories reached toward the Altai, but by the fifteenth century their fortunes belonged to the eastern Dasht-i Qipchaq. In 1444 the pastures owed allegiance to Abu'l-Khayr, the Shibanid khan of the Uzbek nomads, while the people grazing them were Kazakh-speaking Sunni Muslims.

In the late 1450s the sultans Kerei and Janibek led the break from Abu'l-Khayr. His campaign against the seceding nomads ended with his death in 1468, allowing a Kazakh khanate to take root across the steppe. The Kerei remained part of the Middle Jüz as Dzungar power rose to the east. Dzungar armies struck the Middle Jüz in the war of 1739-1741 and compelled its sultans to send hostages, while the Middle Jüz khan accepted Russian subjecthood in 1740. Ablai Khan later restored much of Kazakh bargaining power, but after his death in 1781 the northern pastures lay increasingly exposed to the Russian frontier.
zh:
凯里得名于田吉兹湖流域一座没有出流的小咸水湖，同名河流贯穿周围的干草原。湖畔与河畔的季节性营地属于克烈部，克烈后来被算作中玉兹六大部落之一；其更早的记忆指向阿尔泰山方向，但到15世纪，他们的命运已属于东钦察草原。1444年，这片牧场臣属于统率乌兹别克游牧人的昔班尼系汗王阿布勒海尔，在此放牧的人则是说哈萨克语的逊尼派穆斯林。

15世纪50年代末，克列汗与贾尼别克苏丹率众脱离阿布勒海尔。阿布勒海尔1468年在征讨这些分离游牧人的途中死去，哈萨克汗国得以在草原上站稳。克烈部仍属中玉兹，准噶尔势力则在东方兴起。1739—1741年，准噶尔军队攻入中玉兹，迫使诸苏丹送交人质，中玉兹汗也于1740年接受俄国臣属。阿布赉汗后来恢复了哈萨克人的许多周旋空间，但1781年他去世后，这片北部牧场越来越直接地暴露在俄国边防线之前。

en:
Kulunda lies south of the Baraba steppe, between the Ob and Irtysh, where grassland, bitter lakes and salt lakes reach toward the Altai foothills. Turkic-speaking Teleuts, who called themselves Telenget, pastured sheep, horses and cattle through this country and the upper Ob; after the Mongol conquest their clans moved within the orbit of the Oirat khans. In 1444 there was no town or fixed frontier here, only camps and winter quarters owing service and tribute to Oirat power. Hunting, livestock and the salt of the inland lakes gave the land its value.

Russian records first mention the Teleuts in 1598 and more reliably in 1601; official documents later call the pastures the Teleut land. In 1609 Prince Abak allied himself with the Russian realm and joined its campaigns in 1611 and 1615, but the buffer country was soon caught between Muscovy and the Dzungar Khanate. Prince Koka swore to the Dzungars in 1645 and to the tsar in 1658, then renewed war the next year. Russian forces drove him from the Meret camp across the Ob in 1661, and in 1663 the Dzungar ruler Sengge subdued the ulus. In 1703 more than 20,000 Telengets were removed toward the Altai and the Ili, after which Dzungar exactions grew heavier; by 1717 the Teleut princes had become Dzungar officials rather than independent rulers.
zh:
库伦达位于巴拉巴草原以南，展布在鄂毕河与额尔齐斯河之间，草地、苦湖和盐湖一直延伸到阿尔泰山麓。操突厥语的捷列乌特人自称捷连格特，在这一带和上鄂毕地区放养羊、马和牛；蒙古征服之后，各部落在瓦剌汗廷的势力范围内辗转。1444年，这里没有城镇或固定边墙，只有向瓦剌服役纳贡的营地和冬牧场。狩猎、牲畜和内流湖泊出产的盐，构成了这片土地的价值。

俄国文献在1598年首次提到捷列乌特人，1601年已有较可靠记载，官方文书后来把这片牧地称为捷列乌特之地。1609年，阿巴克王公与俄罗斯国结盟，并在1611年和1615年随军出征；但这个缓冲地区很快被莫斯科与准噶尔汗国夹击。科卡王公1645年向准噶尔宣誓，1658年又向沙皇宣誓，次年便重启战端。1661年，俄军把他从梅列特营地逐过鄂毕河；1663年，准噶尔首领僧格征服这个兀鲁思。1703年，两万多名捷连格特人被迁往阿尔泰和伊犁一带，此后准噶尔的征发不断加重；到1717年，捷列乌特王公已成为准噶尔官吏，不再是独立统治者。

en:
Bermuda is a remote North Atlantic archipelago of cedar-covered islands and encircling coral reefs, far beyond the nearest American coast. Seabirds and turtles nested on its shores, but storm-wracked approaches and hidden reefs made the waters dangerous to shipping. No Indigenous people lived there when Europeans first reached the islands. In November 1444, Bermuda was therefore uninhabited, unknown to European pilots and absent from their Atlantic charts.

Early in the sixteenth century the Spanish captain Juan de Bermúdez sighted the islands that took his name; by 1511 they appeared in print and on Spanish charts, although Spain and Portugal used them only for water and fresh meat. On 3 August 1609 the Virginia Company ship Sea Venture, driven off course by a hurricane while bound for Jamestown, was deliberately run onto the reefs; her company survived, built the Deliverance and Patience, and their report opened the way for the Plough to found St George's in 1612. The Somers Isles Company took over in 1615, the assembly met from 1620, and the first enslaved people, one Black and one Native American brought from the West Indies, arrived in 1616. After the company's charter was revoked in 1684, Bermuda turned from weak tobacco crops to shipbuilding, whaling, salt and privateering. During the American Revolutionary War islanders shipped gunpowder to the rebels in 1775, and from 1811 the Royal Naval Dockyard on Ireland Island made Bermuda a base for Atlantic operations, including the War of 1812.
zh:
百慕大是北大西洋深处的遥远群岛，岛上有刺柏林，海岸有海鸟和海龟栖息，外围则被珊瑚暗礁环绕。这里远离美洲大陆，风暴和险滩让船只难以靠近；欧洲人最初抵达时，岛上并无原住民。1444年11月的百慕大因此仍是一片无人居住的岛群，欧洲领航员还不知道它的位置，海图上也没有它的踪影。

16世纪初，西班牙船长胡安·百慕大望见这片后来以其姓氏命名的群岛；到1511年，百慕大已见诸文献和西班牙海图，但西班牙、葡萄牙都只把这里当作补给淡水和鲜肉的停泊地。1609年8月3日，驶往詹姆斯敦的弗吉尼亚公司船只「海洋冒险号」在飓风中偏离航线，为避免沉没而主动冲上暗礁。船员和乘客全部生还，随后造出「拯救号」和「忍耐号」；他们的记述促成1612年「犁号」运来移民，建立圣乔治镇。萨默斯岛公司1615年接管殖民地，议会自1620年召开，1616年则有两名奴隶自西印度群岛运来，一人为黑人，一人为美洲原住民。公司特许状1684年被撤销后，百慕大放弃收成不佳的烟草，转向造船、捕鲸、盐业和私掠巡航。美国独立战争期间，岛民在1775年向革命者偷运火药；1811年起，爱尔兰岛上的皇家海军造船厂使百慕大成为大西洋作战基地，1812年战争中的行动也由此发起。

en:
The Bahamas are a long chain of low islands and cays on the Great Bahama Bank, north of Cuba and Hispaniola. The Lucayans, who called themselves Lukku-Cairi, or people of the islands, were related to the Taíno and had crossed from Cuba or Hispaniola in dugout canoes centuries earlier, spreading through the nineteen largest islands. In 1444 they lived in small chiefdoms, fished the grass flats and reefs, gathered queen conch and sea turtles, tended cassava and other crops, wove cotton, and traded pottery and stone tools across the shallow bank. On the eve of European contact their population has been estimated at about 30,000; no European settlement yet guarded the harbour that would become Nassau.

On 12 October 1492 Columbus landed at Guanahani, which he named San Salvador, and met the Lucayans. Vespucci carried 232 islanders away as slaves in 1500, and after a royal order of 1509 Spanish raiders took Lucayans to Hispaniola and Cubagua as labourers and pearl divers; by 1520 a search found only eleven islanders in the Bahamas, leaving the cays deserted for roughly 130 years. In 1648 William Sayle's Eleutheran Adventurers came from Bermuda and made the first permanent English settlement on Eleuthera. Charles Town was founded on New Providence in 1670, burned by Spanish raiders in 1684, and rebuilt under Nicholas Trott in 1695 as Nassau, honouring William III of Orange-Nassau. The port later became a pirate republic, but Woodes Rogers arrived as royal governor in 1718, pardoning pirates who submitted and hanging those who did not; he also held the town against a Spanish attack in 1720. An assembly followed in 1729. Americans briefly took Nassau in 1776, Spain captured it in 1782, and British rule returned in 1783, bringing Loyalist planters, cotton estates, and enslaved African majorities. Britain ended the slave trade in 1807, and by 1818 Africans brought into the Bahamas on foreign ships could obtain manumission.
zh:
巴哈马是大巴哈马浅滩上一长串低矮岛屿和珊瑚礁，位于古巴与伊斯帕尼奥拉以北。卢卡扬人自称Lukku-Cairi，意为「岛屿之人」，与泰诺人有亲缘关系；他们在几个世纪前乘独木舟从古巴或伊斯帕尼奥拉渡来，逐渐扩散到十九个最大的岛屿。1444年，他们以小型酋邦为社会组织，在海草浅滩和礁岩间捕鱼，采集女王凤凰螺和海龟，种植木薯等作物，纺织棉花，并在浅水浅滩之间贸易陶器和石器。欧洲人到来前夕，他们的人口估计约有30000人；那时还没有欧洲人据点守卫后来成为拿骚的港湾。

1492年10月12日，哥伦布在瓜纳哈尼登陆，将其命名为圣萨尔瓦多，并第一次见到卢卡扬人。1500年，韦斯普奇带走232名岛民为奴；1509年西班牙王室下令输入劳力后，掠奴者把卢卡扬人带往伊斯帕尼奥拉和库瓦瓜，充当劳工和采珠人。到1520年，一场搜索在整个巴哈马只找到11名岛民，此后群岛荒芜了约130年。1648年，威廉·塞尔率领的埃留特拉冒险者从百慕大前来，在埃留特拉建立第一个永久性英格兰定居点。查尔斯顿1670年建于新普罗维登斯，1684年被西班牙袭掠者焚毁，1695年由尼古拉斯·特罗特重建并改名拿骚，以奥兰治-拿骚家族的威廉三世命名。这里后来成为海盗共和国，但伍兹·罗杰斯1718年以皇家总督身份抵达，归顺者赦、抗拒者绞，恢复了秩序，并在1720年守住城镇、击退西班牙进攻。1729年，殖民地设立议会。美国军队1776年短暂攻占拿骚，西班牙1782年夺取该城，1783年英国恢复统治，随后到来的效忠派种植园主建立棉花庄园，也使被奴役的非洲人成为人口主体。英国1807年废止奴隶贸易，到1818年，乘外国船只抵达巴哈马的非洲人已可获得解放。

en:
The Turks Islands are the small, arid south-eastern edge of the Lucayan Archipelago: Grand Turk, called Abawana by its Lucayan people, Salt Cay, and their surrounding keys. Arawakan-speaking islanders from Hispaniola began settling the southern islands after about 500, and a Classic Taíno settlement wave from Hispaniola renewed the southern cays around 1200, partly to use natural salt pans. In 1444 villages on Grand Turk and nearby Caicos fished the banks, gathered conch, tended gardens, made pottery, and moved goods by dugout canoe. The shallow salinas were already the land's most distinctive resource.

The first documented European sighting was Juan Ponce de León's in 1512; a possible Columbus landfall in 1492 remains unproven. Spanish slave raiding and disease emptied the islands by about 1513. Bermudians began seasonal salt raking in the 1660s: Balfour Town on Salt Cay is dated to 1673, and Cockburn Town, the first permanent settlement, was founded on Grand Turk in 1681. Spanish forces seized Grand Turk in 1710 before Bermudan privateers reclaimed it. France pressed a claim in 1753, and on 21 January 1754 crews from HMS Jamaica and HMS Shoreham cut down French crosses and royal arms on Grand Key, Salt Key, and Seal Key. Year-round salt working expanded in the 1750s, Britain asserted ownership in 1764, and Grand Turk became the seat of government in 1766. French troops took the island in February 1783, and Horatio Nelson's counterattack in HMS Albemarle failed on 9 March, but the Treaty of Paris restored the islands to Britain later that year. Loyalists then brought more than 1,000 enslaved Africans and tried cotton and sisal; by 1820 most planters had left, leaving sea salt as the decisive trade.
zh:
特克斯群岛是卢卡亚群岛东南缘的干旱小岛群，包括卢卡扬人称作Abawana的大特克、盐岛和周围礁屿。约500年以后，来自伊斯帕尼奥拉、操阿拉瓦克语的岛民开始在南部岛屿定居；约1200年，又有一批古典泰诺人从伊斯帕尼奥拉前来重新经营南部礁屿，部分原因是利用天然盐池。1444年，大特克和邻近凯科斯岛上的村庄在浅滩捕鱼、采集凤凰螺、经营园圃、制作陶器，并用独木舟转运货物。浅浅的盐田已是这片土地最具特色的资源。

首次有文献记载的欧洲望见是1512年胡安·庞塞·德莱昂的航行；1492年哥伦布曾登陆此地的说法仍未证实。到约1513年，西班牙掠奴和疫病已使群岛人口绝迹。1660年代，百慕大人开始季节性前来刮盐：盐岛上的鲍尔弗镇可追溯至1673年，大特克的科伯恩城则于1681年建立，是第一个永久定居点。1710年西班牙军队夺取大特克，随后百慕大私掠者又将其收复。法国1753年提出主权主张，1754年1月21日，英国军舰「牙买加」号和「肖勒姆」号的船员拆除了法军在大礁、盐礁和海豹礁竖立的十字架与王徽。1750年代，全年制盐业扩大，英国1764年宣布主权，大特克1766年成为政府驻地。1783年2月法军攻占大特克，霍雷肖·纳尔逊乘「阿尔伯马尔」号在3月9日反攻失败，但同年《巴黎条约》将群岛归还英国。此后效忠派带来1000多名被奴役非洲人，试种棉花和剑麻；到1820年大多数种植园主已经离开，海盐仍是决定群岛生计的贸易。

en:
The finest harbor on Cuba's north coast opens on the island's northwest shore, a sheltered bay of narrow entrance and deep anchorages. In 1444 the land around it belonged to the Taíno chief Habaguanex; his people planted conucos of cassava and maize, fished the bay, and paddled the coast in dugout canoes. No European had yet entered the careening anchorage later called Puerto de Carenas, and the whole of Cuba remained in indigenous hands.

Sebastián de Ocampo, circumnavigating Cuba in 1508, was the first Spaniard to careen his ships in the bay. Diego Velázquez had San Cristóbal de la Habana founded in 1514 on the swampy south coast, but in 1519 the town was moved to the harbor it has kept ever since. In 1555 the French corsair Jacques de Sores sacked and burned it; the crown answered with the Castillo de la Real Fuerza, and in 1561 made Havana the rendezvous of the treasure fleets sailing for Seville. The governor moved his seat from Santiago, El Morro and La Punta guarded the mouth of the bay, and in 1592 Philip II granted the town the title of city, 'Key to the New World and Rampart of the West Indies'. A yellow fever epidemic brought from Cartagena in 1649 killed a third of its people; the city walls went up between 1674 and 1740; the university opened in 1728; and by 1740 Havana had the only dry dock in the New World. With more than 70,000 inhabitants it ranked third among the cities of the Americas when, on 13 August 1762, British troops entered after a two-month siege in which El Morro fell. Havana was returned to Spain under the Treaty of Paris in 1763 at the price of Florida, and the Spanish then raised the vast Fortress of San Carlos de la Cabaña above the bay. Columbus's remains were brought from Santo Domingo in 1796, and by 1821 Havana presided over a slave-grown sugar boom that made Cuba Spain's richest colony.
zh:
古巴北岸最好的港湾开在岛屿西北岸，入口狭窄、锚地幽深。1444年，港湾四周是泰诺酋长阿瓦瓜内克斯的领地；部民在木薯和玉米的田园里耕作，在湾中捕鱼，划着独木舟往来沿岸。还没有欧洲人驶入这个后来被称作卡雷纳斯港的倾船修泊之所，整个古巴仍在原住民手中。

塞瓦斯蒂安·奥坎波1508年环航古巴，最先在湾中倾修船底。迭戈·贝拉斯克斯1514年在泥泞的南海岸建起圣克里斯托瓦尔·德拉阿瓦纳，城镇却在1519年迁到这座港湾，此后再未移动。1555年，法兰西海盗雅克·德·索雷斯攻陷并焚毁城镇；西班牙王室随即修建皇家力量城堡，又在1561年把哈瓦那定为驶往塞维利亚的珍宝船队集结地。都督把驻地从圣地亚哥迁来，莫罗城堡与蓬塔城堡扼守海口，1592年腓力二世授予城镇城市头衔，号称「新世界的钥匙、西印度的壁垒」。1649年，一场来自卡塔赫纳的黄热病夺去三分之一居民的性命；城墙于1674至1740年间筑成，大学1728年开办，到1740年哈瓦那已拥有新大陆唯一的干船坞。城中居民超过七万、位居美洲城市第三时，英军在两个多月的围城中攻陷莫罗城堡，于1762年8月13日入城。根据1763年的《巴黎条约》，西班牙以佛罗里达换回哈瓦那，随后在湾畔筑起宏大的圣卡洛斯·德拉卡瓦尼亚要塞。1796年，哥伦布的遗骨从圣多明各迁葬到此；到1821年，哈瓦那统领着由奴隶劳动支撑的蔗糖繁荣，古巴也由此成为西班牙最富庶的殖民地。

en:
Morón lies on the marshy north coast of central Cuba, behind a chain of offshore cays and reefs cut through by mangrove channels. In 1444 Taíno communities fished those channels and tended conucos along the shore; the low, wet savanna stretching inland was only thinly peopled.

Spaniards first sailed these waters with Sebastián de Ocampo's voyage around Cuba in 1508, and after the conquest the country became cattle land. On 24 May 1543 the cabildo of Sancti Spíritus granted the hato of Morón, a stock ranch on the Río del Roble, to Luis de Almeida; its first settlers were creoles from Sancti Spíritus together with Andalusian and Canary Island sailors, and floods later moved the hamlet to higher ground. For two centuries Morón stayed a remote ranching town on a smuggler's coast, supplying passing ships with hides and dried meat while its cays sheltered pirates. The Andalusian proverb about the rooster of Morón, 'without feathers and still crowing', was already current in Cuba by 1763, though it originally belonged to Morón de la Frontera in Spain. Sugar was ground on a few small trapiches, but in 1821 Morón remained a quiet cattle town at the end of a mule track.
zh:
莫龙位于古巴中部多沼泽的北海岸，外海是一串礁岛和珊瑚礁，近岸遍布红树林水道。1444年，泰诺人的村落在此捕鱼、耕作岸边田园，向内陆延伸的低洼湿草原上人烟稀少。

1508年塞瓦斯蒂安·奥坎波环航古巴，最先驶过这片海域；征服完成后，此地成了牧牛之乡。1543年5月24日，圣斯皮里图斯市政会把罗布莱河畔的养牛庄园「莫龙牧场」授予路易斯·德·阿尔梅达；最早的居民是来自圣斯皮里图斯的土生白人和安达卢西亚、加那利水手，后来村落又因河水泛滥迁到地势较高处。两个世纪里，莫龙始终是走私者海岸边一座偏远的牧牛小镇，用皮革和肉干接济过往船只，近海礁岛则为海盗提供藏身之处。安达卢西亚谚语「像莫龙的公鸡，掉光了毛还在打鸣」至迟在1763年已在古巴流传，尽管它说的原本是西班牙的莫龙-德拉弗龙特拉。当地只有少数小糖坊榨糖，到1821年，莫龙仍是骡道尽头一座安静的牧牛小镇。

en:
Guantánamo occupies a fertile valley in southeastern Cuba, watered by the Bano, Jaibo and Guaso rivers as they run toward a broad bay on the island's southern coast. Taíno farmers and potters lived in the valley before European contact, while fishermen used the harbor they called Guantánamo, 'land between the rivers'. In 1444 the region was still a network of Taíno villages, manioc fields and coastal canoe landings, untouched by the Spanish conquest that would soon transform Cuba.

Christopher Columbus reached the bay in 1494 and named it Puerto Grande, where his men found Taíno fishermen preparing a feast for their chief. After the Spanish conquest reached eastern Cuba, the Taíno chief Guamá began a long revolt in 1522, using surprise raids and quick retreats in the mountains until he was killed in his sleep on 6 June 1533. The harbor remained strategically valuable: in 1741 Edward Vernon entered it with eight warships and 4,000 soldiers during the War of Jenkins' Ear, but local guerrilla fighters checked his march toward Santiago and forced him to withdraw. Santa Catalina de Guantánamo was formally founded in the valley in 1796; sugar mills and coffee farms then spread along the three rivers.
zh:
关塔那摩位于古巴东部肥沃的河谷，巴诺河、海博河和瓜索河流经此地，注入岛屿南岸一处宽阔海湾。欧洲人到来之前，泰诺农民和制陶者居住在河谷中，渔民则使用他们称为关塔那摩的港湾；这个地名在泰诺语中意为「河流之间的土地」。1444年，这里仍是泰诺村落、木薯田和沿岸独木舟停泊点组成的世界，尚未被不久后改变古巴的西班牙征服波及。

1494年，哥伦布抵达这个海湾并命名为大港，他的部下遇到正在为首领准备宴会的泰诺渔民。西班牙征服扩展到古巴东部后，泰诺首领瓜马于1522年发动长期反抗，在山区以突袭和快速撤退周旋，直至1533年6月6日在睡梦中被杀。这个港湾始终具有战略价值：1741年詹金斯耳朵战争期间，爱德华·弗农率八艘战舰和四千名士兵进入海湾，但当地游击武装阻截了他向圣地亚哥的进军，迫使其撤退。1796年，圣卡塔利娜·德·关塔那摩在河谷中正式建立，糖厂和咖啡种植园随后沿三条河发展起来。

en:
Jamaica is the third-largest island of the Greater Antilles, a rugged land of forested mountains, rivers and south-coast harbours. The Taíno called it Xaymaca, the land of wood and water. By the fifteenth century they lived from farming and fishing in villages governed by caciques, with their densest settlement along the southern plain; their population on the island may once have reached about 60,000. In 1444 the island belonged entirely to that Taíno world, still beyond the routes of Spanish caravels.

Christopher Columbus landed in 1494 and claimed Jamaica for Spain, and in 1503 he was stranded there for a year. Juan de Esquivel founded Sevilla in 1509, but the unhealthy settlement was abandoned around 1524 and Spanish Town became the island's chief town around 1534. Disease and enslavement shattered Taíno society, while African slaves were brought in to replace it; runaways joined surviving Taíno in the mountains as Maroons. An English force under William Penn and Robert Venables seized the island in May 1655, defeated Spanish counterattacks in 1657 and 1658, and gained formal recognition in the 1670 Treaty of Madrid. Port Royal became a buccaneering base associated with Henry Morgan until an earthquake destroyed much of it in 1692, after which Kingston rose. Sugar plantations made enslaved Africans a majority by the early 1670s, and in the eighteenth century sugar, coffee, cotton and indigo drove a brutal economy. The First Maroon War ended with treaties in 1739 and 1740; Tacky's Revolt shook the plantations in 1760; the Second Maroon War followed in 1795 and 1796. Britain abolished the slave trade in 1807, while slavery itself still shaped Jamaica in 1821.
zh:
牙买加是大安的列斯群岛第三大岛，岛上多林木茂密的山地与河流，南部分布着港口和平原。泰诺人称此地为「Xaymaca」，意为水和树木之地。到15世纪，他们以农耕和渔猎为生，聚居于酋长管辖的村落中，南部平原人口最为稠密；岛上人口一度可能约有六万。1444年的牙买加完全属于泰诺人的世界，西班牙卡拉维尔帆船尚未来到这里的航路。

哥伦布1494年登陆并宣布牙买加归属西班牙，1503年又曾在此困居一年。胡安·德·埃斯基维尔1509年建立塞维利亚，但这块不宜健康的殖民地约1524年被放弃，西班牙城约1534年成为岛上首要城镇。疾病和奴役摧毁了泰诺社会，非洲奴隶被运来补充劳力；逃亡者与幸存的泰诺人进入山区结合成马龙人。1655年5月，威廉·宾和罗伯特·维纳布尔斯率领英军夺取岛屿，并在1657年、1658年击退西班牙反攻；1670年的《马德里条约》正式确认英国占有。罗亚尔港成为海盗基地，亨利·摩根便由此成名，直到1692年地震摧毁港城大部，京斯敦随后兴起。17世纪70年代初，甘蔗种植园已使非洲黑奴成为岛上人口主体；18世纪，蔗糖、咖啡、棉花和靛蓝支撑起残酷的种植园经济。第一次马龙战争以1739年和1740年的条约告终，塔基起义1760年震动各种植园，第二次马龙战争则发生于1795年至1796年。英国1807年废除奴隶贸易，但到1821年，奴隶制本身仍支配着牙买加。

en:
The low coast around the Bay of Les Cayes, sheltered by offshore cays and Île-à-Vache, was Zui, Taíno country on the southern side of Hispaniola's Tiburon Peninsula. Villages fished the Caribbean, cultivated cassava, and traded along the shore; inland rose the mountains later called the Massif de la Hotte. In 1444 local caciques still governed the district before any European settlement. Spanish accounts later described Zui and neighboring Yáquimo as the two parts from which Jaragua, largest of the island's five chiefdoms, had been formed.

In 1503, during Nicolás de Ovando's governorship, Spanish colonists established Salvatierra de la Zabana on the bay, but the settlement was abandoned in 1540. A French town was laid out in 1726 by M. de la Lance and became Aux Cayes, a southern port of Saint-Domingue shipping sugar and coffee. Hurricanes destroyed it in 1781 and 1788. The Haitian rising of 1791 spread to the southern plantations, and in July 1793 the white inhabitants of Les Cayes were killed amid the civil war. André Rigaud and Toussaint Louverture contested the south in 1800, and after independence the town served as seat of the Conseil du Sud, which broke with Alexandre Pétion in 1810 and 1811. In December 1815 Simón Bolívar landed there; Pétion supplied his expedition after Bolívar promised to abolish slavery in the lands he liberated.
zh:
莱凯湾一带的低地海岸受近海沙洲和瓦什岛屏护，是伊斯帕尼奥拉岛蒂伯朗半岛南侧的泰诺人之地祖伊。村落居民在加勒比海捕鱼、种植木薯，并沿海岸交换物产；内陆矗立着后来称为拉霍特山的山地。1444年，地方酋长仍统治着这片地区，欧洲人尚未在此定居。后来的西班牙记载把祖伊和相邻的亚基莫称为哈拉瓜的两个组成部分，而哈拉瓜是岛上五大酋长国中疆域最大的一个。

1503年，在尼古拉斯·德·奥万多总督任内，西班牙殖民者在湾畔建立萨尔瓦铁拉·德拉萨瓦纳，但该据点于1540年废弃。1726年，德·拉朗斯按规划建立法国城镇，即后来的莱凯，使这里成为法属圣多明各南部输出蔗糖和咖啡的港口。1781年和1788年，飓风两度摧毁城镇。1791年海地起义蔓延到南部种植园，1793年7月，莱凯的白人居民在内战中被杀。1800年，安德烈·里戈与杜桑·卢维杜尔争夺南方；海地独立后，莱凯成为南方委员会所在地，该委员会于1810年至1811年与亚历山大·佩蒂翁政府决裂。1815年12月，西蒙·玻利瓦尔抵达这里；在他承诺于解放的土地上废除奴隶制后，佩蒂翁为其远征提供物资。

en:
Tortuga is a long, mountainous island in the Windward Passage off Marien, north-western Hispaniola. Its iron-bound northern shore gives way to the sheltered southern roadstead later called Cayona. In 1444 the island lay within the Taíno maritime world of the neighbouring mainland, and no European power yet occupied it or used the Columbus name that later made its anchorage famous.

Columbus sighted Tortuga in December 1492 and named it for its turtle-like outline. French and English settlers from Saint Kitts arrived in 1625, but Spanish forces under Fadrique de Toledo drove them out in 1629. Settlers returned around 1630, and in 1640 the French officer Le Vasseur seized the island after another Spanish occupation and built Fort de Rocher above Cayona; by 1641 the buccaneers called themselves the Brethren of the Coast. Spanish troops retook the island in 1654 and lost it to French and English adventurers in 1655. In June 1665 Bertrand d'Ogeron became French governor, bringing settlers and tobacco planting under the French West India Company; Tortuga was the first base of French Saint-Domingue until administration moved to Port-de-Paix in 1676. Spain recognized French possession at Ryswick in 1697. During the Haitian Revolution General Charles Leclerc died on Tortuga on 2 November 1802, and French forces abandoned the island in April 1803.
zh:
托尔图加（中文常译托尔蒂岛）是向风海峡中的狭长多山岛屿，位于伊斯帕尼奥拉岛西北的马里安外海。岛的北岸崖壁陡峻，南岸则有后来称为卡约纳的避风锚地。1444年，该岛属于邻近大陆的泰诺人海世界，尚无欧洲势力占据，也还没有哥伦布将赋予它的名字。

1492年12月，哥伦布望见托尔图加，因岛的轮廓像海龟而以此命名。1625年，来自圣基茨的法国和英国移民抵达，但法德里克·德·托莱多率领的西班牙军队在1629年将他们驱逐。移民约在1630年返回；1640年，法国军官勒瓦瑟尔在西班牙又一次占领后夺取该岛，并在卡约纳上方修筑罗谢堡。到1641年，岛上的布坎尼尔海盗已自称海岸兄弟会。西班牙军队1654年攻占托尔图加，又在1655年被法国和英国冒险者夺回。1665年6月，贝特朗·多热龙出任法国总督，在法国西印度公司体制下招徕移民、种植烟草；在殖民行政中心于1676年迁往和平港之前，托尔图加是法属圣多明各最早的据点。1697年，《里斯维克条约》确认法国占有该岛。海地革命期间，夏尔·勒克莱尔将军于1802年11月2日在托尔图加去世，法军则在1803年4月弃守该岛。

en:
The southern coast of Hispaniola, from the Nizao and Ocoa lowlands toward the bay later called Barahona, was Taíno country in 1444. The Baní plain was a nitainato, a district governed by a local noble, attached to the chiefdom of Maguana, while the southwest around Barahona belonged to Jaragua, largest of the island's five chiefdoms. Taíno villages farmed the river valleys and fished the Caribbean under their caciques, untouched as yet by European ships.

Followers of Christopher Columbus reached the coast in the 1490s, and Spaniards named Francisco, Gabriel, Luis and Juan de Barahona gave the southwestern bay its name. In July 1503 Governor Nicolás de Ovando broke Jaragua's power, killing Anacaona and the chiefdom's nobles during a staged celebration. Sugar mills soon appeared along the rivers, including an important one founded on the Ocoa by Alonso de Suazo, judge of the Audiencia of Santo Domingo. Canary Islander families settled the Baní plain from 1680 to 1684, and Baní was formally founded on 3 March 1764, when its residents bought the Cerro Gordo site for 370 pesos fuertes. In 1802 Toussaint Louverture's administration began developing the Barahona valley as a military post of Azua; Jean-Jacques Dessalines burned Baní in 1805, and the rebuilt town received its first council in 1810.
zh:
1444年，伊斯帕尼奥拉岛南部从尼萨奥、奥科阿低地到后来称巴拉奥纳的海湾，都是泰诺人的土地。巴尼平原是附属于马瓜纳酋长领地的尼塔伊纳托，即由地方贵族治理的辖区；更西南的巴拉奥纳一带则属于岛上五大酋长领地中最大的哈拉瓜。泰诺人的村落耕种河谷、在加勒比海捕鱼，由各村首领管辖，此时还没有欧洲船只到来。

1490年代，克里斯托弗·哥伦布的追随者来到这片海岸，弗朗西斯科、加夫列尔、路易斯和胡安·德·巴拉奥纳等西班牙人使西南这座海湾得名。1503年7月，圣多明各总督尼古拉斯·德·奥万多在一场安排好的庆典中摧毁哈拉瓜的统治层，阿纳卡奥娜与诸首领遇害。糖坊很快沿河出现，圣多明各检审庭法官阿隆索·德·苏亚索便在奥科阿河畔建有一座重要糖坊。1680年至1684年，加那利群岛移民家庭定居巴尼平原；1764年3月3日，居民以370枚银比索买下塞罗戈多址，巴尼正式建镇。1802年，杜桑·卢维杜尔政权开始开发巴拉奥纳河谷，将其设为阿苏阿下属的军事据点。让-雅克·德萨林1805年焚毁巴尼，重建后的城镇在1810年设立首个市政会。

en:
Aruba and Curaçao are dry, reef-bound islands off the Paraguaná Peninsula of Venezuela, where cactus scrub, gullies and sheltered bays mark a southern Caribbean very different from the wetter islands to the north. Caquetío farmers and fishers had reached them from the mainland before 1000, and in 1444 their villages formed the western edge of an Arawakan world joined by canoes. They traded salt, canoes, tobacco and beads with the Venezuelan coast and grazed no European cattle on the thin pasture.

A Spanish expedition under Alonso de Ojeda reached the area in 1499. Between 1513 and 1515 Diego Salazar deported roughly 2,000 Caquetío from the ABC islands to Hispaniola, and after formal Spanish settlement of Curaçao in 1527 the islands were treated chiefly as cattle ranches. The Dutch West India Company captured Curaçao in 1634 and occupied Aruba in 1636, turning Willemstad's Schottegat inlet into a harbour for shipping, salt and privateering. From 1662 Curaçao became a major mart of the Atlantic slave trade, and in 1674 it was made a free port; Sephardic merchants helped make Willemstad one of the Caribbean's leading commercial towns. A French fleet sent against the island wrecked on reefs off Las Aves in 1678. In 1795 Tula Rigaud led a slave rising of as many as 4,000 people in north-western Curaçao. British forces held the islands for intervals during the French Revolutionary and Napoleonic Wars, and Dutch rule was restored by 1816.
zh:
阿鲁巴和库拉索是委内瑞拉巴拉瓜纳半岛外海的干旱岛屿，周围多暗礁，陆上有仙人掌灌丛和冲沟，避风海湾则面向南美海岸。这里的风貌与北方湿润的加勒比岛屿截然不同。卡克蒂奥农民和渔民在1000年以前已从大陆来到岛上；1444年，他们的村落构成阿拉瓦克世界的西缘，独木舟把各岛与大陆连在一起。岛民同委内瑞拉海岸交易盐、独木舟、烟草和珠饰，当时薄瘦的牧场上还没有欧洲人带来的牛群。

1499年，阿隆索·德·奥赫达率领的西班牙探险队到达这一带。1513年至1515年间，迭戈·萨拉萨尔把ABC群岛约二千名卡克蒂奥人强行迁往伊斯帕尼奥拉；1527年西班牙正式殖民库拉索后，这些岛屿主要被当作牧场。荷兰西印度公司1634年夺取库拉索，1636年占领阿鲁巴，并把威廉斯塔德的斯霍特加特湾经营成航运、盐业和私掠活动的港口。1662年起，库拉索成为大西洋奴隶贸易的重要集散地，1674年又成为自由港，塞法迪犹太商人助力威廉斯塔德崛起为加勒比主要商镇之一。1678年，一支奉命来攻的法国舰队在拉斯阿韦斯群岛外海触礁覆没。1795年，图拉·里戈在库拉索西北部领导多达四千人参加的奴隶起义。法国革命战争和拿破仑战争期间，英军曾阶段性占领这些岛屿，到1816年荷兰统治已完全恢复。

en:
Borikén was the Taíno name for the easternmost and smallest of the Greater Antilles, a mountainous island set between the Atlantic and the Caribbean and ringed by smaller cays. Its people lived in yucayeques, or villages, under caciques, farming their plots, fishing and making canoes and pottery; the best land lay along coastal plains and river valleys. In November 1444 there were no Spanish towns, missions or forts on the island. Borikén remained a Taíno world, its chiefdoms linked by language and exchange but still untouched by the caravels that were beginning to reshape the Atlantic.

Columbus reached it on 19 November 1493 and named it San Juan Bautista. Juan Ponce de León founded Caparra in 1508; the settlement moved to the sheltered bay that became Ciudad de Puerto Rico in 1521, and in time island and city exchanged the names Puerto Rico and San Juan. Gold washing and encomiendas brought war: after Agüeybaná II's coalition killed Cristóbal de Sotomayor, Ponce de León defeated the first Taíno rising in 1511, Caparra was burned in 1513, and fugitive fighting continued into the 1520s. The Crown allowed African slave imports from 1517; the first major slave revolt came in 1527, and survivors fled to the mountains alongside remaining Taíno. After gold gave out around 1570, tobacco, cotton, cacao and ginger sustained the island while El Morro guarded the fleet route. Its gunners repelled Francis Drake in 1595; the Earl of Cumberland held San Juan briefly in 1598 but withdrew through disease.
