Balduino Enrico's Dutch force sacked and burned the city in 1625, yet never took El Morro. Ralph Abercromby's siege also failed in 1797. Sugar expanded soon afterward, and the 1815 Royal Decree of Graces offered land to Catholic immigrants as Spain tried to hold one of its last American strongholds.
zh:
博里肯是泰诺人对大安的列斯群岛最东端、也是四大岛中最小一岛的称呼。岛屿多山，夹在大西洋与加勒比海之间，周围散布着小礁；岛民住在称为「尤卡耶克」的村落中，由酋长统辖，耕种土地、捕鱼，也制造独木舟和陶器，最好的农田分布在沿海平原和河谷。1444年11月，岛上还没有西班牙人的城镇、传教站或要塞。博里肯仍是泰诺人的世界，各酋长领地以语言和交换相互联系，而此时改变大西洋的卡拉维尔帆船尚未到来。

1493年11月19日，哥伦布抵达这里，将其命名为圣胡安包蒂斯塔。胡安·庞塞·德·莱昂1508年建立卡帕拉；殖民地后来迁到避风港湾，1521年正式建立波多黎各城，日久之后，岛名与城名互换，岛屿称波多黎各，城市称圣胡安。淘金和监护征赋引发战争：阿圭巴纳二世联合各酋长杀死克里斯托瓦尔·德·索托马约尔后，庞塞·德·莱昂在1511年击退第一次大起义；1513年卡帕拉被焚毁，逃亡者的战斗延续到16世纪20年代。西班牙王室1517年起允许输入非洲奴隶，1527年爆发第一次大规模奴隶起义，幸存者与残留泰诺人一同退入山区。到1570年前后金矿枯竭，烟草、棉花、可可和生姜成为岛上重要物产，埃尔莫罗堡则扼守西班牙舰队航路。1595年，要塞炮火击退弗朗西斯·德雷克；1598年坎伯兰伯爵一度占领圣胡安，却因疾病撤军。1625年，巴尔多伊诺·恩里科率领荷兰军队洗劫并焚毁城市，却始终未能攻下埃尔莫罗堡。1797年，拉尔夫·阿伯克龙比的围城同样失败。此后蔗糖业扩张，1815年的《皇家恩典法令》向天主教移民授予土地，西班牙试图以此保住它在美洲最后的据点之一。

en:
St. Thomas is a hilly island in the Virgin group, with one of the finest natural harbours in the Lesser Antilles. The Ciboney reached it around 1500 BC, and Arawak-speaking villagers followed; Carib groups had also settled in the Virgin Islands by the fifteenth century. In 1444 Taino families farmed and fished along its bays, their thatched settlements untouched by Europeans, who did not yet know the island existed.

Columbus sighted St. Thomas in 1493 on his second voyage, but Spain never settled it. The Dutch West India Company opened a post in 1657, the Danes raised their flag and claimed the island in 1666, and a permanent colony came ashore on 25 May 1672. The first slave ships arrived the next year, and sugar plantations spread inland. In 1685 the Danish company leased trading rights to a Brandenburg company, while governors such as the Esmit brothers dealt openly with the buccaneers who used the harbour. The port town was renamed Charlotte Amalie in 1691 in honour of Christian V's queen, and its free harbour drew ships of every flag. Moravian missionaries came to live among the enslaved in 1732. The British seized the island in 1801 and returned it under the Peace of Amiens, then occupied it again from 1807 to 1815.
zh:
圣托马斯是维尔京群岛中一座多山的岛屿，拥有小安的列斯群岛最好的天然良港之一。约公元前1500年，西沃内人首先在此定居，讲阿拉瓦克语的村民随后迁入，到15世纪加勒比人的袭掠者也在群岛间往来。1444年时，泰诺人在各海湾边农耕渔猎，茅草村落散布全岛，欧洲人尚不知这座岛屿的存在。

1493年，哥伦布在第二次航行中望见圣托马斯，但西班牙始终没有殖民。荷兰西印度公司1657年在此设立商站，丹麦人1666年升旗宣称主权，1672年5月25日正式建立永久殖民地，第一批贩奴船次年即抵达，甘蔗种植园随之向岛内扩展。1685年，丹麦公司把岛上贸易权租给勃兰登堡公司；埃斯米特兄弟等几任总督则公开与盘踞港口的海盗做生意。港口城镇1691年以克里斯蒂安五世王后之名改称夏洛特阿马利亚，港口辟为自由港后各国商船云集。1732年，摩拉维亚弟兄会的传教士来到奴隶中间生活传教。英军1801年攻占该岛，依《亚眠和约》归还，1807年再度占领，直到1815年才交还丹麦。

en:
St. Kitts, called Liamuiga, 'the fertile isle', by its people, is a volcanic island in the northern Leewards, its centre crowned by the forested cone of Mount Liamuiga. Archaic fishers gave way to Arawak-speaking villagers, and around 1300 the Kalinago, a Carib people, seized the island and pushed the older inhabitants north. In 1444 Kalinago farmers lived along the shore, untroubled by any European power.

Columbus reached St. Kitts in 1493 and claimed it for Spain, but English settlers established the first colony in 1623, with the French following in 1625. Forewarned of a Kalinago ambush, the two nations fell on the islanders first and then partitioned the land, the English holding the centre and the French the two ends, where they laid out Basseterre. A Spanish expedition expelled both peoples in 1629, though the English returned after peace in 1630. Tobacco gave way to sugar in 1640, and the cane brought the mass importation of enslaved Africans. The island changed hands repeatedly in the wars that followed: French guns on Brimstone Hill helped take Fort Charles in 1689 and English forces retook it the next year, and in 1782 de Grasse and Bouillé forced the great hilltop fortress, the 'Gibraltar of the Caribbean', to surrender. The Treaty of Paris returned St. Kitts to Britain in 1783, and a French naval attack on the rebuilt works failed in 1806.
zh:
圣基茨是背风群岛北部的一座火山岛，岛民曾称之为「利亚穆伊加」，意为「肥沃之岛」，岛中央矗立着林木覆盖的火山峰利亚穆伊加山。远古渔猎民族之后，讲阿拉瓦克语的村民在此定居；约1300年，加勒比族的卡利纳戈人攻占该岛，把早先的居民逐向北方。1444年时，卡利纳戈农人沿海岸而居，尚无任何欧洲势力涉足。

1493年哥伦布抵达圣基茨，以西班牙之名宣布占有，但英格兰移民1623年率先建立殖民地，法国人1625年接踵而至。两国移民预先得知卡利纳戈人设伏的消息，先下手袭击岛民，随即瓜分岛屿：英格兰人占据中部，法国人据有两端，并在南端修建巴斯特尔。1629年一支西班牙远征军把两国人都赶走，1630年议和后英格兰人重返该岛。1640年烟草改种甘蔗，随之而来的是大规模贩运非洲奴隶。此后的战争中圣基茨屡次易手：法军1689年在硫磺山上架炮助攻，拿下查尔斯堡，英军次年即夺回；1782年，德格拉斯与布耶迫使山上号称「加勒比直布罗陀」的巨型要塞投降。1783年《巴黎条约》将圣基茨归还英国，1806年法国海军进攻重建后的要塞仍告失败。

en:
Antigua is a Leeward island whose south-eastern coast shelters the deep anchorage of English Harbour. Its indigenous name Waladli meant roughly 'our own'. The Guanahatabey were its first known inhabitants, and Arawak farmers later grew cassava, cotton and the dark Antiguan pineapple. Most Arawak communities left around 1100 as Carib canoe parties pressed north from Venezuela. In 1444 Carib parties used its beaches and cays, and no European had yet landed there.

Columbus sighted Antigua on his second voyage in 1493 and named it Santa María de la Antigua, after the old Virgin's chapel in Seville Cathedral, but the Spanish never stayed. English colonists left St. Kitts to settle the island in 1632. Around 1674 Christopher Codrington settled Betty's Hope and brought Barbadian sugar methods; sugar then drove out tobacco, and by the mid-1770s the island held about 37,500 enslaved Africans. In 1736 Prince Klaas, called Court by his enslavers, was crowned 'King of the Coromantees' outside St. John's and planned to destroy the planters' government and found an African kingdom. After an enslaved informer revealed the plot, Klaas and four accomplices were broken on the wheel, six others were hanged or starved, and fifty-eight more were burned. A naval dockyard was begun at English Harbour in 1725, where Captain Horatio Nelson enforced the Navigation Acts from 1784 to 1787, to the fury of Antigua's merchants.
zh:
安提瓜是背风群岛中的一座岛屿，东南海岸有英吉利港这处深水锚地。其原住民名称「瓦拉德利」大意是「我们自己的」。已知最早的居民是瓜纳哈塔贝人，后来阿拉瓦克农夫在此种植木薯、棉花和安提瓜黑菠萝。约1100年，随着加勒比独木船队从委内瑞拉向北进逼，大多数阿拉瓦克社群离去。1444年时，加勒比队伍利用岛上的海滩和礁屿，欧洲人尚未在此登陆。

1493年哥伦布第二次航行时望见安提瓜，依塞维利亚大教堂中的古老圣母礼拜堂将其命名为圣玛利亚·拉安提瓜，但西班牙人从未在此长住。1632年，一批英格兰移民离开圣基茨，到安提瓜定居。约1674年，克里斯托弗·科德林顿在「贝蒂的希望」种植园定居，并带来巴巴多斯的制糖技术；甘蔗随后取代烟草，到1770年代中期，岛上约有三万七千五百名非洲奴隶。1736年，被奴隶主称作考特的克拉斯亲王在圣约翰郊外加冕为「科罗曼特人之王」，计划摧毁种植园主政权并建立非洲人王国。由于一名奴隶告密，密谋败露，克拉斯与四名同谋被处轮刑，另有六人被绞死或饿死、五十八人被烧死。英吉利港的海军船坞1725年动工；1784至1787年，霍雷肖·纳尔逊舰长在此执行《航海条例》，令安提瓜商人极为不满。

en:
Guadeloupe is really two islands divided by the narrow channel of the Rivière Salée: mountainous Basse-Terre in the west and the flatter Grande-Terre in the east, with Marie-Galante and the Saintes nearby. Arawak farmers were the first identifiable inhabitants, before Kalinago groups displaced them and called Basse-Terre Karukera, 'the island of beautiful waters'. In 1444 Kalinago villages held the coasts and anchorages, and no European power had yet forced a settlement there.

Columbus landed on 4 November 1493 and named the islands Santa María de Guadalupe after the Extremaduran shrine, but Spanish attempts at settlement broke against Kalinago resistance. In 1635 the Compagnie des Îles de l'Amérique occupied Guadeloupe under Charles Liénard de L'Olive and Jean du Plessis d'Ossonville. Charles Houël made Basse-Terre a fortified trading post in 1650, the year the first enslaved Africans arrived, and an open slave revolt broke out in 1656. The crown annexed the island in 1674, and the Code Noir of 1685 regimented a booming sugar economy later joined by coffee and cocoa. The British held Guadeloupe from 1759 to 1763, and France surrendered Canada in the peace settlement to win the sugar island back. The British seized Guadeloupe again in April 1794, but Victor Hugues arrived with republican troops, drove them out by June and proclaimed abolition on 7 June 1794. In 1802 General Richepanse's expedition arrived to restore slavery, and on 28 May Louis Delgrès and his last followers blew up their powder stores at Matouba rather than surrender; slavery was formally reimposed on 14 May 1803. The British conquered the island in 1810, ceded it nominally to Sweden in 1813 without the Swedes ever taking possession, and returned it to France in 1814.
zh:
瓜德罗普实为被狭窄的萨莱水道隔开的两座岛屿：西面多山的巴斯特尔岛与东面低平的格朗德特尔岛，附近还有玛丽加朗特岛和桑特群岛。最早可辨识的居民是阿拉瓦克农夫，后来卡利纳戈人将他们逐走，并把巴斯特尔岛称作卡鲁克拉，意为「碧水之岛」。1444年时，沿海和锚地仍掌握在卡利纳戈村落手中，尚无欧洲势力能在此建立定居点。

1493年11月4日哥伦布登陆，以埃斯特雷马杜拉的瓜达卢佩圣母圣地将其命名为圣玛利亚·德瓜达卢佩，但西班牙人的定居尝试都在卡利纳戈人的抵抗下失败。1635年，美洲群岛公司在夏尔·利埃纳尔·德·洛利夫和让·迪普莱西·多松维尔率领下占领瓜德罗普。夏尔·乌埃尔1650年把巴斯特尔建成设防商站，第一批非洲奴隶也在同年抵达，1656年即爆发公开的奴隶起义。1674年法兰西王室把该岛并入王领，1685年的《黑人法典》将繁荣的蔗糖经济纳入规制，后来咖啡和可可也加入其列。英军1759年攻占瓜德罗普并占据到1763年，法国在和议中割舍加拿大以换回这座糖岛。1794年4月英军再度夺岛，维克托·于格率共和军抵达，在6月将其逐出，并于1794年6月7日宣布废除奴隶制。1802年里什庞斯将军率远征军前来恢复奴隶制；5月28日，路易·德尔格雷斯与最后的随从在马图巴引爆火药库，宁死不降。1803年5月14日，奴隶制被正式恢复。英军1810年再占全岛，1813年名义上将其割让给瑞典，瑞典人却始终没有接收，瓜德罗普1814年归还法国。

en:
Dominica is a steep, rainforested volcanic island between Guadeloupe and Martinique, called Wai'tu kubuli, 'tall is her body', by its people. Arawakan villagers had settled there from the fifth century, but by the fourteenth century Kalinago canoe-warriors, moving up the Lesser Antilles from the South American coast, had made the island their own. In 1444 it was a land of Carib villages, garden plots and fast rivers, its forested ridges never yet seen by a European.

Columbus sighted the island on Sunday 3 November 1493, during his second voyage, and named it Dominica, but Spanish expeditions through the 1500s broke against Carib resistance. In 1660 France and England declared Dominica and St Vincent neutral Carib ground; French woodcutters from Martinique and Guadeloupe nonetheless moved in from 1690, and in 1727 the first French commander made Dominique a colony of coffee quarters worked by enslaved Africans. Andrew Rollo's British expedition took it in 1761, and the Treaty of Paris ceded it to Britain two years later. A French fleet recaptured it with the colonists' help in 1778; Rodney's victory off the Saintes on 12 April 1782 and the peace of 1783 gave it back. French attacks of 1795 and 1805 failed, although on 22 February 1805 the invaders burned much of Roseau, by then the island's capital.
zh:
多米尼克是瓜德罗普与马提尼克之间一座山势陡峭、雨林密布的火山岛，岛上居民称之为瓦伊图库布利，意为「她身躯高大」。阿拉瓦克人自5世纪起在此定居，但到14世纪，从南美海岸沿小安的列斯群岛逐岛北上的卡利纳戈独木舟战士已成为岛屿的主人。1444年时，这里仍是一片由加勒比村落、园圃和湍急河流组成的土地，林木覆盖的山岭还从未有欧洲人见过。

1493年11月3日星期日，哥伦布第二次远航时望见该岛，为之取名多米尼克，意为「星期日」，但整个16世纪西班牙人的多次远征都在加勒比人的抵抗下失败。1660年，法国与英国约定把多米尼克和圣文森特留作加勒比人的中立之地；然而来自马提尼克和瓜德罗普的法国伐木者自1690年起陆续迁入，1727年首任法国长官把多米尼克正式变为殖民地，全岛划分为若干区，靠被贩卖来的西非黑奴在咖啡种植园劳作。1761年安德鲁·罗洛率英国远征军攻占该岛，两年后《巴黎条约》将其割让给英国。1778年法国舰队在当地居民协助下夺回岛屿；1782年4月12日罗德尼在桑特群岛附近取胜，1783年的和约又把它归还英国。法国1795年和1805年的两次进攻均告失败，但1805年2月22日入侵者焚毁了当时已是岛府的罗索的大半城区。

en:
Martinique is a rugged island between Dominica and St Lucia, dominated by the volcano of Mount Pelée; the Kalinago knew it as Madinina. Arawak farmers from the Orinoco had lived there from the first century, and Carib groups from the Venezuelan coast reached it around the seventh. In 1444 Kalinago clans held its valleys and coasts; Spain, judging the Lesser Antilles too small and their people too dangerous, had made no move against them.

Columbus only anchored there on 15 June 1502, during his fourth voyage, and Spain left the island alone. On 15 September 1635 Pierre Belain d'Esnambuc landed at Saint-Pierre with about 150 settlers from St Kitts and claimed Martinique for Louis XIII's Company of the American Islands. Sugar spread from the 1640s; the Kalinago rising of 1658 was crushed and the survivors expelled to Dominica and St Vincent, and after 1674, when Louis XIV took the island into direct royal rule, enslaved Africans made up most of its people. A British army took Fort-Royal on 12 February 1762, only to hand the island back at the peace of 1763. In 1794, as the Revolution reached the Caribbean, planters who feared the abolition of slavery called the British in; after a siege they took Saint-Pierre and stayed until the Treaty of Amiens returned Martinique to France in 1802. General Beckwith's 12,000 men conquered it again in February 1809, and the Treaty of Paris of 30 May 1814 gave it back once more, with slavery restored.
zh:
马提尼克是多米尼克与圣卢西亚之间一座地势崎岖的岛屿，佩莱火山雄峙其间，卡利纳戈人称之为马迪尼纳。来自奥里诺科流域的阿拉瓦克农人自1世纪起在此生活，来自委内瑞拉海岸的加勒比人约在7世纪抵达。1444年时，岛上的谷地与海岸都掌握在卡利纳戈各氏族手中；西班牙认为小安的列斯群岛太小、岛民又太强悍，尚未向这里伸手。

哥伦布迟至1502年6月15日第四次远航时才在此停泊，西班牙对该岛始终没有兴趣。1635年9月15日，皮埃尔·贝兰·德南比克率约150名来自圣基茨的殖民者在圣皮埃尔登陆，以路易十三的美洲群岛公司名义宣布占领马提尼克。甘蔗种植园自1640年代兴起；1658年卡利纳戈人起义被镇压，幸存者或遭驱逐，或逃往多米尼克和圣文森特。1674年路易十四把该岛收归国王直接统治，此后被贩运而来的非洲黑奴很快占了岛上人口的大多数。1762年2月12日英军攻陷法兰西堡，却在次年议和时把岛屿归还法国。1794年革命波及加勒比，唯恐奴隶制被废除的种植园主把英军请进岛来；英军经围城战拿下圣皮埃尔，一直占领到1802年《亚眠条约》把马提尼克归还法国。1809年2月贝克威思将军率一万二千人大举征服该岛，1814年5月30日的《巴黎条约》又把它还给法国，奴隶制也随之恢复。

en:
Saint Lucia is a volcanic island south of Martinique, with an open Atlantic shore and a sheltered western roadstead; the Kalinago who mastered it around 800 called it Hewanorra. Arawak farmers from the South American coast had first settled the island in the third or fourth century. In 1444 it held only Carib villages and gardens, and no European had yet set foot on it.

An English ship blown off course landed 67 colonists in 1605, but Carib attacks left only 19 to flee five weeks later, and another attempt in 1638 was destroyed. The first lasting French settlement came from Martinique in 1651 under the sieur de Rousselan, and a Franco-Carib treaty followed in 1660; English claimants under Philip Warner were gone by the Treaty of Breda in 1667, and from 1674 Saint Lucia was a French crown colony attached to Martinique. Britain and France then exchanged it so often that it was called the Helen of the West: Rodney and Monckton took it in 1762, France got it back in 1763 and laid out sugar plantations from 1765, and the British held it from 1778 to 1783. The Revolutionary Wars brought three more changes, as Jervis's fleet took it in April 1794, Victor Hugues recaptured it in June 1795 and a British expedition retook it in 1796, when Castries was burned. The Treaty of Amiens restored it to France in 1802, the British seized it again in 1803, and the Treaty of Paris of 1814 left Saint Lucia in British hands for good.
zh:
圣卢西亚是马提尼克以南的一座火山岛，东岸直面大西洋，西岸有一处隐蔽的锚地；约在800年成为岛上主人的卡利纳戈人把这里称作埃瓦诺拉。最早在3、4世纪来此定居的是来自南美海岸的阿拉瓦克农人。1444年时，岛上还只有加勒比人的村落和园圃，欧洲人从未踏足。

1605年，一艘偏离航线的英国船送来67名殖民者，但加勒比人的进攻使他们五周后只剩19人仓皇逃离，1638年的又一次尝试也被摧毁。1651年，鲁瑟朗骑士率人从马提尼克前来，建立第一个持久的法国定居点，1660年法国与加勒比人缔约；菲利普·沃纳代表英国夺岛，可到1667年《布雷达条约》签订时英国人已撤离，1674年起圣卢西亚成为附属于马提尼克的法国王室殖民地。此后英法反复易手之频繁，使它得到「西方的海伦」之称：罗德尼与蒙克顿1762年攻占该岛，法国1763年将其收回，自1765年起开辟大片甘蔗种植园，英国又在1778年至1783年间占领。革命战争期间再经三易其主：杰维斯的舰队1794年4月占岛，维克多·于格1795年6月夺回，1796年英国远征军重新攻占，卡斯特里在战火中被焚。1802年《亚眠条约》把它归还法国，1803年英国再度夺取，1814年的《巴黎条约》最终把圣卢西亚永久留给了英国。

en:
Saint Vincent is a mountainous volcanic island between St Lucia and the Grenadines, crowned by La Soufrière; its Kalinago people called it Hairun. Arawak farmers had settled there around the third century, and Carib groups had made the island their own by the fourteenth. Its rugged windward coast made it a stronghold: in 1444 it was one of the most independent Carib islands of the Lesser Antilles, and it would later shelter both native refugees and escaped Africans, who together became the Garifuna, or Black Caribs.

Columbus is thought to have sighted it on 22 January 1498, the feast of St Vincent, but Spain never settled. In 1660 France and England declared the island neutral Carib ground; French planters from Martinique nonetheless established themselves at Barrouallie around 1700, and from 1719 sugar, coffee and indigo plantations spread on enslaved African labour while runaways merged with the Caribs to form the Garifuna. General Monckton's British force took the island in 1762 and the Treaty of Paris confirmed it a year later, when Fort Charlotte was begun. The Garifuna fought the First Carib War of 1769–1773; the French retook the island in 1779 but handed it back in 1783. Led by Joseph Chatoyer and backed by Victor Hugues from Martinique, they rose again in 1795, and after their defeat in 1797 Ralph Abercromby deported nearly 5,000 Garifuna to Roatán and the Bay Islands. When La Soufrière erupted in 1812, the colony was firmly in British hands.
zh:
圣文森特是圣卢西亚与格林纳丁斯群岛之间一座多山的火山岛，苏弗里耶尔火山耸立其间，岛上的卡利纳戈人称之为海伦。阿拉瓦克农人约在3世纪来此定居，到14世纪加勒比人已成为岛屿的主人。陡峭的向风海岸使这里易守难攻：1444年时，它是小安的列斯群岛中最独立的加勒比人岛屿之一，日后还会收留土著难民和逃亡黑奴，两者融合形成加里富纳人，即黑加勒比人。

一般认为哥伦布在1498年1月22日圣文生瞻礼日望见该岛，为之取名圣文森特，但西班牙人从未在此殖民。1660年法国与英国宣布该岛为加勒比人的中立之地；然而来自马提尼克的法国种植园主约在1700年在巴鲁阿利落脚，自1719年起靠非洲黑奴劳力开辟甘蔗、咖啡和靛蓝种植园，逃亡奴隶则与加勒比人融合为加里富纳人。1762年蒙克顿将军率英军攻占该岛，次年《巴黎条约》予以确认，夏洛特堡也在同年动工。加里富纳人在1769—1773年进行了第一次加勒比战争；法国1779年夺回该岛，1783年又把它交出。1795年，加里富纳人在约瑟夫·查托耶率领下、得到马提尼克的维克多·于格支持再度起义，1797年被拉尔夫·阿伯克龙比击败，近五千人被放逐到罗阿坦和海湾群岛。1812年苏弗里耶尔火山喷发时，这座殖民地已牢牢掌握在英国手中。

en:
Barbados is a low, flat coral island far out in the Atlantic, east of the Windward chain, called Ichirouganaim by its Arawak villagers. Arawak farmers from the South American mainland had settled there from around 800, and a new wave arrived in the thirteenth century; Carib canoe parties came and went, though they left no permanent villages. In 1444 small Amerindian communities farmed and fished along its wind-swept coasts, unaware that Spanish slave raids within two generations would strip the island and leave it almost uninhabited.

The Portuguese navigator Pedro a Campos named the island Os Barbados in 1536, but Portugal never settled it, leaving only wild boar for passing ships to hunt. An English ship under John Powell claimed it on 14 May 1625, and on 17 February 1627 eighty settlers founded Jamestown, later Holetown; the island's House of Assembly first met in 1639. Sugar arrived from Dutch Brazil in the 1640s and the island was remade: by 1680 some 46,000 enslaved Africans outnumbered 20,000 whites, and the Barbados Slave Code became a model for other colonies. After Charles I was executed the island declared for the Stuarts, surrendering to Sir George Ayscue only with the Treaty of Oistins in January 1652. Alone among the major Caribbean islands it was never taken by a foreign fleet, though the hurricane of October 1780 killed more than 4,000 people. When Parliament ended the slave trade in 1807, Bussa led some 20,000 enslaved men and women from seventy plantations in the rising of 14 April 1816; it was crushed within days, leaving about 120 rebels dead in the fighting and 144 more executed after trial.
zh:
巴巴多斯是远悬大西洋、位于向风群岛以东的一座低平珊瑚岛，岛上的阿拉瓦克居民称之为伊奇鲁加奈姆。来自南美大陆的阿拉瓦克农人约在800年已在此定居，13世纪又有新的一批人到来；加勒比人的独木舟队往来于此，却没有留下永久村落。1444年时，一个个美洲原住民小社群在多风的海岸耕作捕鱼，尚不知不出两代人之后，西班牙奴隶贩子的袭击就会把岛屿劫掠一空，使它几乎荒无人烟。

1536年，葡萄牙航海家佩德罗·阿·坎波斯把该岛命名为「巴尔巴多斯」，意为「长胡子的人」，但葡萄牙从未在此定居，只留下野猪供过往船只猎取。1625年5月14日，约翰·鲍威尔的英国船宣布占岛；1627年2月17日，八十名殖民者建立詹姆斯敦，即今霍尔敦；岛上的议会首次召开于1639年。1640年代，甘蔗随荷属巴西的技术与资金传入，全岛为之一变：到1680年，约四万六千名非洲黑奴在人数上已超过两万名白人，《巴巴多斯奴隶法典》也成为其他殖民地效仿的样板。查理一世被处死后，巴巴多斯宣布效忠斯图亚特王朝，直到1652年1月乔治·艾斯丘爵士兵临、《奥伊斯廷斯条约》签订才投降。在加勒比各主要岛屿中，它是唯一从未被外国舰队攻占的一个，但1780年10月的飓风夺去了四千多人的生命。英国议会1807年废除奴隶贸易后，布萨于1816年4月14日率领约七十座种植园的两万名黑奴起义；起义数日内即被镇压，约120人战死，另有144人经审判被处决。

en:
Trinidad is a broad continental island only 11 kilometres off the Venezuelan coast, set between the Gulf of Paria and the Atlantic approaches to the Orinoco. In 1444 its people included Arawakan-speaking Nepoya and Shebaya and Cariban-speaking Yao, whose canoes and trails linked the island to mainland villages and the Lesser Antilles. Its Arawakan name, Iëre, is commonly translated as the Land of the Hummingbird; no European fleet had yet entered the Dragon's Mouths or claimed its anchorages.

Christopher Columbus sighted Trinidad on 31 July 1498 and renamed it La Isla de la Trinidad. Antonio de Sedeño campaigned there in the 1530s, and in 1592 Antonio de Berrío founded San José de Oruña, the island's first permanent Spanish town and capital. Walter Raleigh arrived on 22 March 1595, captured Berrío, used Trinidad as a base for his Orinoco expedition in search of El Dorado, and sacked San José. Catalan Capuchins began missions in 1687; abuses at San Fernando de los Arenales led to the Arena revolt of 1 December 1699, in which Amerindians killed the missionaries and Governor José de León y Echales before the rising was bloodily suppressed. The 1783 Cedula of Population then opened land grants to loyal Catholic settlers, especially French planters from the eastern Caribbean, and the colony held 18,627 people by 1797. That February an 18-ship British fleet under Ralph Abercromby invaded, and Governor José María Chacón surrendered; British possession was confirmed by the 1802 Treaty of Amiens.
zh:
特立尼达是一座宽阔的大陆岛，距委内瑞拉海岸仅11公里，位于帕里亚湾与通往奥里诺科河的大西洋水道之间。1444年，岛上居民包括讲阿拉瓦克语的内波亚人、谢巴亚人，以及讲加勒比语的姚人；他们的独木舟和陆路把岛屿同大陆村落及小安的列斯群岛连接起来。岛的阿拉瓦克语名称耶雷通常译为「蜂鸟之地」，此时还没有欧洲舰队进入龙口海峡或占据这里的锚地。

1498年7月31日，克里斯托弗·哥伦布望见特立尼达，并将其改名为「特立尼达岛」。1530年代，安东尼奥·德·塞德尼奥在此作战；1592年，安东尼奥·德·贝里奥建立圣何塞·德·奥鲁尼亚，这是岛上第一座永久西班牙城镇和首府。1595年3月22日，沃尔特·雷利抵达，俘获贝里奥，并以特立尼达为基地前往奥里诺科河寻找黄金国，随后洗劫圣何塞。1687年，加泰罗尼亚嘉布遣会开始建立传教站；阿雷纳莱斯的圣费尔南多传教站的压榨引发1699年12月1日的阿里纳起义，印第安人杀死传教士和总督何塞·德·莱昂-埃查莱斯，起事随后遭到血腥镇压。1783年的《人口敕令》向效忠西班牙王室的天主教定居者授予土地，尤其吸引东加勒比的法裔种植园主，到1797年殖民地已有18627人。同年2月，拉尔夫·阿伯克龙比率领18艘英国战舰入侵，总督何塞·马里亚·查孔投降；英国的占有在1802年《亚眠条约》中得到确认。

en:
Kutch lies between the Gulf of Kutch and the Great and Little Rann, where seasonal lagoons dry into white salt flats. The Jadeja Rajputs, a Samma lineage that had moved east from Sindh, became the dominant ruling family of the peninsula and took their Jadeja name by the thirteenth century. After Raydhan Ratto's death in 1215 his lands were split among kinsmen holding Lakhiarviro, Kanthkot, Gajod and Bara. In 1444 the senior Lakhiarviro branch still kept its seat near Nakhatrana, but Kutch was a patchwork of related Hindu chiefdoms, its herds, coastal villages and salt pans exposed to pressure from Sindh and the Gujarat Sultanate.

Mahmud Begada of Gujarat routed a Kutchi army in 1472. A deeper succession feud followed Jam Rawal's murder of Jam Hamirji in 1537; Hamirji's son Khengarji I received Morbi and troops from the Gujarat court, and in 1548 expelled Jam Rawal, united Kutch, made Bhuj his capital and founded Mandvi. Kutch acknowledged Mughal overlordship after defeats in 1590 and 1591, though its rao kept several thousand cavalry and paid little tribute. Under Lakhpatji in the mid-eighteenth century Mandvi's shipping and coastal trade flourished and Kutch struck its silver kori. Invasions from Sindh in 1763 and 1765 cost border lands, while British and Baroda forces occupied Anjar and Tuna in 1815. In 1819 Kutch accepted East India Company suzerainty, and an earthquake struck the same year.
zh:
卡奇位于卡奇湾与大、小卡奇盐沼之间，季节性潟湖退水后露出白色盐滩。13世纪时，由信德东迁的萨姆马拉杰普特家族成为半岛上的统治势力，改称贾德贾。1215年赖丹·拉托死后，土地分给亲族，分别以拉基阿尔维罗、坎特科特、加佐德和巴拉为据点。1444年，拉基阿尔维罗的长支仍以纳卡赫特拉纳附近为驻地，但卡奇由数个彼此有亲缘关系的印度教首领分治，牧场、沿海村落和盐场同时承受信德与古吉拉特苏丹国的压力。

1472年，古吉拉特的马哈茂德·贝加达击败卡奇军队。1537年，贾姆·拉瓦尔谋杀贾姆·哈米尔吉，继承纷争加深；哈米尔吉之子肯加吉一世在古吉拉特宫廷得到莫尔维封地和军队，1548年驱逐贾姆·拉瓦尔，统一卡奇，定都普杰，并建立曼德维港。1590年和1591年连遭败绩后，卡奇承认莫卧儿宗主权，但拉奥仍保有数千骑兵，贡赋也很轻。18世纪中期拉克帕特吉在位时，曼德维的航运与沿海贸易兴盛，卡奇开始铸造银科里。1763年和1765年信德军队两度入侵，使边地失守；1815年英国与巴罗达联军占领安贾尔和图纳，1819年卡奇接受东印度公司宗主权，同年又遭遇大地震。

en:
Thatta stands in the Indus Delta, where shifting channels carried Sindhi grain, cloth and coastal trade toward the Arabian Sea. Samma chiefs overthrew Sumra power and broke from Delhi in 1351, making the town, also called Samanagar, their capital; on the nearby Makli ridge their governors and saints began the great funerary city. In 1444, after Jam Sikandar's death, Jam Raidhan was raised to the throne at Thatta. A Muslim jam ruling lower Sindh, he depended on delta tribes, river traffic and the fertile lands around the capital.

Raidhan ruled until 1453. Jam Nizamuddin II's long reign from 1461 to 1508 was remembered as the Samma golden age, and in 1495 he ordered the building of a new Thatta. Shah Beg Arghun's invasion ended Samma rule in 1523. In 1555 Isa Khan Tarkhan called in Portuguese troops carried by twenty-eight ships; when their pay was refused, the soldiers sacked the town. Akbar's forces annexed Sindh in 1592. English merchants opened a factory in 1635, a storm devastated the city in 1637, and the tile-covered Shah Jahan Mosque was begun in 1647 and finished in 1659. A Dutch factory followed in 1652, and visitors in that decade counted about 2,000 looms. Late-seventeenth-century siltation shifted the Indus and ended Thatta's seaport. The Kalhoras took the city in 1736, Nadir Shah received Sindh in 1739, and the lower Sindh capital moved to Hyderabad in 1789; by the early nineteenth century Thatta held perhaps 20,000 people.
zh:
特达位于印度河三角洲，纵横的河汊曾把信德的谷物、布匹和沿海贸易送往阿拉伯海。1351年，萨姆马首领推翻苏姆拉人的势力并脱离德里，以又称萨马纳加尔的特达为都；附近的马克利山脊上，后来的长官和圣徒逐渐建起宏大的墓葬之城。1444年贾姆·西坎达尔去世后，贾姆·拉伊丹在特达被拥立为贾姆。这位穆斯林君主统治下信德，权力依托三角洲部落、河运和都城周围的良田。

拉伊丹统治到1453年。贾姆·尼扎姆丁二世1461至1508年的长期治世后来被视为萨姆马王朝的黄金时代，1495年他又下令营建新的特达城。沙赫·贝格·阿尔洪的入侵最终在1523年结束萨姆马统治。1555年，伊萨汗·塔尔汗召来由二十八艘船载来的葡萄牙军队；因酬劳遭拒，这些军队洗劫了城市。阿克巴的军队1592年吞并信德。英国商人1635年在此开设商馆，1637年风暴重创意城，铺饰琉璃砖的沙贾汗清真寺1647年动工、1659年完工。荷兰商馆随后于1652年设立，十年间的来访者记载城中约有两千台织机。十七世纪末印度河淤积改道，特达失去海港功能。卡尔霍拉王朝1736年取得此城，1739年纳迪尔沙获得信德，1789年下信德都城迁往海得拉巴；到十九世纪初，特达人口约只剩二万。

en:
Sehwan stands on the west bank of the Indus below the Lakki Hills, the ancient Sivistan or Sindomana, its old mound remembered as Kafir Qila. Muhammad bin Qasim took it in 711 and Mahmud of Ghazni in 1026, after which it passed under the Soomras and then the Sammas. The wandering saint Lal Shahbaz Qalandar settled here and died in the thirteenth century, and Firuz Shah Tughlaq had his tomb raised in 1356, making Sehwan one of the great Sufi shrines of Sindh. In 1444 the town answers to the Samma Jam at Thatta, a Muslim garrison on the Indus caravan road, its trade moving up and down the river.

In 1542 Humayun, driven out by Sher Shah Suri, failed to take Sehwan and moved on through Umarkot, where his son Akbar was born. Akbar's own armies under the Khan-i-Khanan entered Sindh in 1591, and with Jani Beg Tarkhan's submission in 1593 the town became a Mughal sarkar; the shrine was greatly enlarged in 1639. Around 1701 the Kalhoras were made subahdars of upper Sindh and Sehwan under Mughal suzerainty and ruled from Khudabad; mid-century brought Durrani overlordship, and in 1783 the Talpur Mirs overthrew them at the Battle of Halani.
zh:
塞赫万位于勒基山下的印度河西岸，古称锡维斯坦或辛多马纳，城外的古丘留有卡菲尔堡之名。穆罕默德·伊本·卡西姆711年攻取此城，马哈茂德·伽色尼又在1026年拿下它，此后它先后归入苏姆拉王朝与萨姆马王朝治下。游方圣人拉尔·沙赫巴兹·卡兰达尔13世纪在此定居并终老，菲鲁兹沙·图格鲁克1356年为他修建陵墓，塞赫万由此成为信德最重要的苏非圣地之一。1444年，这座城镇听命于坐镇特达的萨姆马贾姆，是印度河商路上的一处穆斯林驻军要地，贸易沿河上下往来。

1542年，被舍尔沙逐出印度的胡马雍围攻塞赫万不克，继续前往乌默科特，他的儿子阿克巴便出生在那里。阿克巴自己的军队1591年在汗坎南率领下攻入信德，1593年贾尼·贝克·塔尔汗归降，塞赫万成为莫卧儿的一个萨尔卡尔；圣祠于1639年大规模扩建。1701年前后，卡尔霍拉家族受莫卧儿册封出任北信德与塞赫万的苏巴达尔，以库达巴德为都进行统治；18世纪中叶杜兰尼王朝成为宗主，1783年塔尔普尔的米尔们在哈拉尼战役中将其推翻。

en:
Multan stands on the old bank of the Chenab in the hot southern Punjab plain, one of the oldest cities in India and for centuries its gateway to the west. Arab armies took it in 712, and under the Arab emirs its Sun temple drew pilgrims and taxes while caravans from Khorasan assembled at its gates; Mahmud of Ghazni stormed it in 1006, and after the Ghaznavids it passed to the Delhi sultans, whose frontier province it became. Its shrines of Bahauddin Zakariya and Shah Rukn-e-Alam made it the City of Saints. Timur's invasion of 1398 broke Delhi's hold, and in 1438 the townsmen chose Shaikh Yousaf Qureshi, a descendant of Bahauddin Zakariya, as their ruler. In 1444 this mild scholar still governs an independent Multan, whose merchants already keep a caravanserai at Baku on the Caspian, while the Langah clans of the surrounding country hold the real power of the sword.

In 1445 Rai Sahra Langah seized the city in a night attack and founded the Langah sultanate; under his grandson Husayn, who reigned from 1469 to 1498, Multan prospered, repelled the armies of Delhi and settled Baloch tribesmen in the Derajat in exchange for military service. Shah Husayn Arghun of Sindh took the city after a long siege in 1527, and Sher Shah Suri seized it in 1541, linking it to the Grand Trunk Road. Akbar's forces retook Multan in 1557 and in 1580 made it one of the twelve original Mughal subahs; the two centuries that followed were its Dar al-Aman, the abode of peace, when its cotton cloth, coinage and glazed tiles were known across the empire and Multani traders bought land in Bukhara. The city walls went up in 1627 under Murad Baksh, and Aurangzeb governed the province from 1648 to 1652. Nader Shah overran the region in 1739, Ahmad Shah Durrani took the city in 1752, and Maratha and Afghan armies tussled over it until the Sikhs of Ranjit Singh breached the fort with the Zamzama cannon in 1818, killing Nawab Muzaffar Khan and seven of his sons.
zh:
木尔坦坐落在奇纳布河旧日的河岸上，地处南旁遮普的炎热平原，是印度最古老的城市之一，数百年来一直是印度面向西方的门户。712年阿拉伯军队攻占此城；在阿拉伯埃米尔治下，城中的太阳神庙既吸引香客也带来巨额税入，呼罗珊的商队在城门前汇聚。1006年伽色尼的马哈茂德破城，此后木尔坦经伽色尼王朝转入德里苏丹之手，成为其边疆省份。巴哈乌丁·扎卡里亚与沙阿·鲁克尼·阿拉姆的圣陵使它得到圣徒之城的名号。1398年帖木儿入侵瓦解了德里的控制，1438年市民推举巴哈乌丁·扎卡里亚的后裔谢赫·优素福·库雷希为统治者。1444年，这位性情温和的学者仍统治着独立的木尔坦，其商人远在里海之滨的巴库设有商队客栈，而四乡的朗加部族才是真正握有刀剑的力量。

1445年，拉伊·萨赫拉·朗加夜袭夺取城市，建立朗加苏丹国；其孙侯赛因1469至1498年在位期间，木尔坦商贸繁荣，击退德里的军队，还引俾路支部落迁居德拉加特，以兵役换取土地。1527年，信德的沙阿·侯赛因·阿尔浑久攻克城；1541年舍尔沙·苏尔占领木尔坦，把它接入大干道体系。1557年阿克巴的军队收复木尔坦，1580年将其列为最初十二个苏巴之一；此后两百年是它的达尔阿曼时代，即安宁之邦，棉布、铸币与琉璃砖闻名于整个帝国，木尔坦商人甚至在布哈拉置产。1627年穆拉德·巴赫什下令修筑城墙，1648至1652年奥朗则布曾任该省总督。1739年纳迪尔沙阿横扫此地，1752年艾哈迈德沙阿·杜兰尼攻占此城，此后马拉塔与阿富汗反复拉锯；1818年兰季特·辛格的锡克军用扎姆扎马巨炮轰开堡垒，纳瓦布·穆扎法尔汗与七个儿子战死，木尔坦并入锡克帝国。

en:
Lahore lies on the Ravi at the gate between the Kabul highlands and the plains of Hindustan. It is first named in the Hudud al-'Alam of 982, became the eastern capital of the Ghaznavids after the conquests of Mahmud of Ghazni, and was for a time the first capital of the sultans of Delhi. Mongol raids wrecked it again and again, and when Timur entered in 1398 he did not even bother to sack it. Under the failing Sayyid dynasty the Khokhar chief Jasrat besieged the city in 1431–32, and in 1441 the court handed Lahore to Bahlul Lodi, the Afghan lord of Sirhind, to defend it. In 1444, therefore, Lahore is a battered frontier town, famed for its Persian-writing poets and its saints' shrines, held by the ambitious Bahlul in the name of a moribund Delhi.

Bahlul seized Delhi itself in 1451 and founded the Lodi dynasty. Later his governor Daulat Khan Lodi, once the employer of Guru Nanak, called in Babur, whose armies took Lahore in 1525 on the road to Panipat. Sher Shah Suri held the city from 1540 until Humayun returned in 1555, and under the Great Mughals Lahore entered its greatest age. Akbar rebuilt the citadel and the walls and from 1584 kept his court here for fourteen years, making Lahore a capital and the Akbari Mandi the granary of the Punjab. Here, in 1606, Jahangir put the Sikh Guru Arjan to death after the revolt of Prince Khusrau; Shah Jahan, born in Lahore in 1592, gave it the Naulakha pavilion and the Shalimar Gardens of 1641, while Wazir Khan raised his tile-clad mosque. Aurangzeb added the Badshahi Mosque in 1673 and the Alamgiri Gate of the fort. After Nader Shah's passage in 1739 the city was fought over by Mughals, Ahmad Shah Durrani and the Sikhs: the Bhangi Misl entered it in 1767, three Sikh chiefs divided it among themselves in 1780, and in July 1799 Ranjit Singh made Lahore the capital of a rising Sikh kingdom.
zh:
拉合尔位于拉维河畔，扼守喀布尔高原通往印度斯坦平原的门户。982年的《世界境域志》首次提到此城；伽色尼的马哈茂德征服后，它成为伽色尼王朝的东都，还一度是德里诸苏丹最早的都城。蒙古人的屡次侵袭将城市摧毁，1398年帖木儿入城时甚至不屑于劫掠。赛义德王朝衰微之际，霍卡尔人首领贾斯拉特于1431至1432年围城，朝廷遂在1441年把拉合尔交给西尔欣德的阿富汗领主巴赫鲁尔·洛迪防守。因此，1444年的拉合尔是一座饱经兵燹的边镇，以波斯语诗人和圣徒陵寝闻名，由野心勃勃的巴赫鲁尔替气数将尽的德里镇守。

巴赫鲁尔1451年夺取德里，建立洛迪王朝。后来的总督道拉特·汗·洛迪曾是古鲁·那纳克的雇主，他引巴布尔入援，巴布尔的军队1525年在通往帕尼帕特的路上攻占拉合尔。1540年起舍尔沙据有此城，1555年胡马雍卷土重来，拉合尔在莫卧儿盛世迎来最辉煌的年代。阿克巴重修城塞与城墙，1584年起在此驻跸十四年，拉合尔成为帝国都城，阿克巴里曼迪市集则是旁遮普的粮仓。1606年，贾汉吉尔在皇子胡斯劳之乱后处死锡克教第五代祖师阿尔琼；1592年生于此城的沙贾汗为它留下瑙拉克哈亭和1641年的沙利马尔花园，瓦齐尔·汗则建起琉璃砖镶嵌的清真寺。奥朗则布1673年增建巴德夏希清真寺，又为城堡修造阿拉姆吉尔门。1739年纳迪尔沙过境之后，莫卧儿、艾哈迈德·沙·杜兰尼和锡克人反复争夺此城：邦吉米斯尔1767年入城，1780年三名锡克首领将城市瓜分，1799年7月兰季特·辛格把拉合尔定为新兴锡克王国的都城。

en:
The Vale of Kashmir lies in a high basin between the Pir Panjal Range and the Great Himalayas, watered by the Jhelum and by Dal Lake at Srinagar, the valley's capital since Pravarasena founded the city in the sixth century. Hindu and Buddhist kingdoms made it a centre of learning, their deeds recorded in the Rajatarangini chronicles. In 1339 Shah Mir founded the Muslim sultanate, and under Sultan Sikandar (1389–1413) the disciples of Mir Sayyid Ali Hamadani carried Islam through the valley. In 1444 the throne belongs to Zain-ul-Abidin, the Bud Shah, who won it in 1420 with Khokhar help: he has recalled exiled Pandits, abolished the jizya, and brought Persian and Central Asian craftsmen to weave shawls and carpets and to make paper and books, while his Zaina Kadal bridge and the Mar canal bind old Srinagar together.

Zain-ul-Abidin died in 1470, and his later successors were weaker. In 1540 the Chagatai general Mirza Haidar Dughlat, Babur's cousin, conquered the valley and ruled it until his death in 1551. The Shia Chaks, highlanders whose forebears had come from Gilgit, seized Srinagar in 1561 under Ghazi Shah; the last Chak sultan, Yakub Shah, submitted to Akbar in 1589, three years after Mughal armies entered Kashmir. The emperors made the valley their summer retreat: Jahangir laid out the Shalimar Bagh beside Dal Lake in 1619, and Asif Khan built the terraced Nishat Bagh in 1633. Afghan Durrani armies took Srinagar in 1752, opening nearly seventy years of harsh Afghan governorship. In the summer of 1819 Ranjit Singh's Sikhs defeated the Afghans near Shopian and occupied the valley; by 1821 Kashmir was a Sikh province, its shawls already famed across India.
zh:
克什米尔谷地是皮尔潘贾尔岭与大喜马拉雅山之间的高山盆地，杰赫勒姆河穿流而过，达尔湖畔的斯利那加自6世纪婆罗伐罗犀那建城以来便是谷地的首府。印度教与佛教诸王朝曾使这里成为学术之地，历代王统载于《王河》。1339年沙阿·米尔建立穆斯林苏丹国，锡坎达尔苏丹（1389—1413年在位）时期，米尔·赛义德·阿里·哈马丹尼的门徒将伊斯兰教传遍谷地。1444年在位的是扎因·乌尔·阿比丁，臣民称他「大德王」。他1420年借霍哈尔人之助夺得王位，召回流亡的潘迪特，废除人丁税，又从波斯和中亚请来工匠织造披肩与地毯、造纸与装订书籍；他修造的扎伊纳卡达尔桥和马尔运河把斯利那加旧城连成一片。

扎因·乌尔·阿比丁于1470年去世，后来的苏丹日渐孱弱。1540年，察合台系将领、巴布尔的表亲米尔扎·海达尔·杜格拉特征服谷地，统治到1551年身亡。源出吉尔吉特山地的什叶派查克家族1561年在加齐·沙率领下入主斯利那加；末代苏丹雅各布·沙于1589年向阿克巴投降，此时距莫卧儿军队开入克什米尔已三年。莫卧儿皇帝把谷地当作避暑胜地：贾汉吉尔1619年在达尔湖畔辟建夏利玛尔花园，阿萨夫汗1633年建成台地式的尼沙特花园。1752年阿富汗杜兰尼军队攻占斯利那加，开始了近七十年严酷的阿富汗统治。1819年夏，兰季特·辛格的锡克军队在绍皮安附近击败阿富汗人并占领谷地；到1821年，克什米尔已是锡克人的一个行省，所产披肩已闻名全印度。

en:
Kangra is the foremost of the Punjab Hills states, ruled from time out of mind by the Katoch Rajputs. Its citadel, Kot Kangra or Nagarkot, rises on a rock between the Manjhi and Banganga rivers beneath the Dhauladhar peaks, and its temples were famed for heaped treasure; Mahmud of Ghazni sacked the place in 1009. The Tughluq sultans of Delhi stormed the fort more than once in the fourteenth century yet could never hold the surrounding hills, and in 1428 the Punjabi chieftain Jasrat fought the Delhi general Sikandar Tohfa beneath its walls before falling back. In 1444 the Katoch raja still reigned unbowed from his rock, the oldest and largest lordship between the Ravi and the Sutlej.

Raja Dharam Chand did homage to Akbar in 1556, but the fort itself defied the Mughals until November 1620, when Prince Khurram, campaigning for his father Jahangir, starved the garrison into surrender after a fourteen-month siege; a mosque was raised within the walls and the Katoch rajas became Mughal vassals. In the 1780s Sansar Chand recovered his ancestors' stronghold and built a short-lived mastery over Chamba, Mandi and the neighbouring hill rajas. The Gurkhas of Nepal poured into the valley in 1806 and pressed the fort for three years, until Sansar Chand called in Ranjit Singh; the Sikhs drove the Gurkhas back across the Sutlej in 1809 and kept the fortress, leaving the raja his lands as a fief of Lahore.
zh:
冈格拉是旁遮普山区首屈一指的山邦，自古由拉杰普特人的卡托奇王朝统治。它的要塞科特·冈格拉（又名纳加尔科特）雄踞曼吉河与班甘加河之间的岩丘，背倚道拉达尔雪峰，堡中神庙以聚敛的财宝闻名，1009年曾遭伽色尼的马哈茂德洗劫。14世纪，德里的图格鲁克苏丹不止一次攻下城堡，却始终守不住周围的山地；1428年，旁遮普首领贾斯拉特在堡下同德里将领西坎德尔·托赫法激战，最终退兵。1444年，卡托奇拉杰仍据这座岩堡自立，是拉维河与萨特莱杰河之间最古老、也最大的山邦。

1556年，拉杰达拉姆·昌德向阿克巴称臣，但城堡本身仍拒不从命，直到1620年11月，皇子胡拉姆奉其父贾汉吉尔之命出征，在长达十四个月的围困后以饥饿迫降守军，莫卧儿才终于拿下冈格拉，并在堡内修建清真寺，卡托奇拉杰从此沦为莫卧儿封臣。1780年代，桑萨尔·昌德收复祖先的要塞，一度降服昌巴、曼迪等邻近山邦，建立起短暂的霸权。1806年，尼泊尔的廓尔喀军涌入河谷，围攻堡垒三年之久，桑萨尔·昌德只得向兰吉特·辛格求援；锡克军1809年把廓尔喀人逐回萨特莱杰河对岸，顺势占据堡垒，只留给拉杰一片向拉合尔称臣的封地。

en:
Sirhind commands the high road between Delhi and Lahore, the gateway from the Punjab into the Ganges plain. The astronomer Varahamihira knew the region as Satudar Desh, and in the seventh century the Chinese pilgrim Xuanzang found it the chief town of the Shatadru district, named after the Sutlej. Its later name was read as Sar-i Hind, 'the frontier of Hind'. Under Prithviraj Chauhan it was a Rajput military outpost, and the Khokhar chief Jasrat besieged it in vain in 1421. By 1444 it had become the stronghold of the Afghan chief Bahlul Khan Lodi, who held Lahore and Dipalpur and overawed the feeble Sayyid court at Delhi.

In 1451 Bahlul marched from Sirhind to Delhi and founded the Lodi dynasty, and the town remained the key fortress guarding the road from the capital to the Punjab. After the Lodi defeat at Panipat in 1526 it passed to Babur, and in June 1555 Humayun broke Sikandar Shah Suri at the battle of Sirhind on his way to recover Delhi. Under Mughal peace it became the administrative seat of the eastern Punjab: Akbar founded the Aam Khas Bagh highway-inn, rebuilt by Shah Jahan, and the city was said to hold 360 mosques, gardens, tombs, caravanserais and wells. The Naqshbandi scholar Sheikh Ahmad Sirhindi, who died here in 1624, lies buried in the Rauza Sharif. The faujdar Wazir Khan put the two young sons of Guru Gobind Singh to death in 1705, and on 12 May 1710 Banda Singh Bahadur's Khalsa slew him at Chappar Chiri and sacked the city. In 1763 the Sikh army defeated its Afghan governor Zain Khan and plundered Sirhind again; the town never recovered, and gurdwaras rose over the ruins.
zh:
西尔欣德扼守德里至拉合尔的官道，是旁遮普进入恒河平原的门户。天文学家伐罗诃密希罗称这一带为「萨杜尔国」；7世纪时中国求法僧玄奘到此，记它为娑多德罗（以苏特莱杰河得名）地区的首邑。其名称后被解作「萨里—欣德」，意为「印度的边疆」。普利色毗罗阇·兆汉时代，这里是拉杰普特人的军镇，1421年科卡尔人首领贾斯拉特围攻此城不克。到1444年，西尔欣德已成为阿富汗首领巴鲁勒·汗·洛迪的大本营，他据有拉合尔与迪帕尔普尔，实力凌驾于德里孱弱的赛义德朝廷之上。

1451年，巴鲁勒从西尔欣德进军德里，建立洛迪王朝，此城仍是拱卫都城通往旁遮普大道的首要要塞。1526年洛迪王朝败于帕尼帕特，西尔欣德并入巴布尔的版图；1555年6月，胡马雍在西尔欣德之战击败锡坎达尔·沙·苏利，随后收复德里。莫卧儿治下的太平岁月里，这里成为东旁遮普的行政中心：阿克巴始建名为「公私园」的官道驿馆，后由沙贾汉重建；据说全盛时城中有三百六十处清真寺、园林、陵墓、商队客栈与水井。纳合什班底教团学者谢赫·艾哈迈德·西尔欣迪1624年卒于此，安葬在「圣陵」。城守瓦齐尔汗于1705年处死古鲁·戈宾德·辛格的两个幼子；1710年5月12日，班达·辛格·巴哈杜尔的卡尔萨军队在恰帕尔奇里阵斩瓦齐尔汗，随即洗劫全城。1763年，锡克军队击败阿富汗总督扎因汗，再掠西尔欣德，城市从此一蹶不振，废墟之上建起一座座谒师所。

en:
Garhwal, the 'land of forts', is a tangle of ridges and valleys around the sources of the Ganges, once parcelled among fifty-two petty hill chieftains, each holding his own garh. Tradition brings the first Panwar prince, Kanak Pal, out of Malwa in 823 to wed the heiress of Chandpur Garhi, and his descendants slowly made themselves lords of the fifty-two forts; Ajay Pal united them into a single kingdom in 1358 and fixed his seat at Devalgarh. In 1444 a Hindu raja of the Panwar line still reigned there over Pahari herdsmen and terraced fields, screened from the plains by the forested Siwalik hills.

Balbhadra Shah, ruling from 1575, was the first raja to take the title Shah, and in 1623 Mahipat Shah moved the court downstream to Srinagar. When his widow Karnavati ruled for their young son, she cut to pieces a Mughal army under Najabat Khan in 1640, earning the name Nakti Rani, the Noseless Queen. Fateh Shah fought Guru Gobind Singh at Bhangani in 1688 and gave shelter to Ram Rai, the estranged son of Guru Har Rai, whose camp in the Dun valley grew into the town of Dehradun. Rohilla troops under Najib-ud-daula seized Dehradun in 1757 and were driven out in 1770. The Gurkhas of Nepal struck in 1803 and slew Raja Pradyumna Shah in January 1804, holding Garhwal for twelve harsh years. Their defeat in the war of 1814-15 and the Treaty of Sugauli split the country: the British kept the eastern half with Srinagar, while Sudarshan Shah received the western half in 1815 as the new princely state of Tehri Garhwal.
zh:
加瓦尔意为「堡垒之地」，是恒河源头一带山岭与谷地交错的山区，从前分属五十二座山寨（加尔）的小首领。相传帕瓦尔家族的第一位王公卡纳克·帕尔823年从马尔瓦前来，娶了昌德普尔加尔希首领的独女，他的后人逐个降服五十二寨；阿贾伊·帕尔终于在1358年将众寨合并为一个王国，定都代瓦尔加尔。1444年，帕瓦尔家族的印度教拉杰仍在此统治着帕哈里牧民与梯田村落，林木密布的西瓦利克山把这片山地与平原隔开。

1575年继位的巴尔巴德拉·沙阿是第一个采用「沙阿」称号的拉杰，1623年马希帕特·沙阿把王庭沿河谷迁到斯利那加。他死后，遗孀卡尔纳瓦蒂代幼子听政，1640年击溃纳贾巴特汗率领的莫卧儿军队，得了「割鼻王后」的绰号。法塔赫·沙阿1688年在邦加尼与古鲁·戈宾德·辛格交战，又收容了与教团失和的古鲁·哈尔·拉伊之子拉姆·拉伊，后者在栋河谷地的营地后来发展成德拉敦城。1757年，纳吉卜·乌德·道拉率罗希拉军队攻占德拉敦，1770年被逐走。1803年尼泊尔的廓尔喀军攻入，1804年1月杀死拉杰普拉迪尤姆纳·沙阿，统治加瓦尔十二年，政令严酷。1814至1815年的战争与《苏高利条约》把这个国家一分为二：东半部分连同斯利那加归英国，西半部分则在1815年封给苏达尔尚·沙阿，成为新的特里加瓦尔土邦。

en:
Jangladesh, the 'rough and dry country' also called Janglu, is the arid belt of northern Rajasthan covering the modern Bikaner, Churu, Ganganagar and Hanumangarh tracts. It was long a land of Jat clans governed by their own headmen; its north and west were held by Bhati Rajputs, Muslim Bhattis and Johiyas pastured around Bhatner, and in earlier centuries it had been the Chahamana heartland of Sapadalaksha. Pugal, its chief fort, was seized in 1414 by the Bhati chieftain Rao Kelana, who raided as far as Bhatinda and Abohar and defeated the Baloch beyond Dera Ghazi Khan. In 1444 his line still held Pugal as a small desert chiefdom set amid the Jat villages, drawing what wealth it could from flocks, wells and passing caravans.

In the last quarter of the century Rao Bika, a fifth son of Rao Jodha of Marwar, left his father's court with the blessing of Karni Mata and a coalition of Rathores, Charans and Godara Jats, and made himself master of Jangladesh. Rao Shekha of Pugal gave him his daughter Rang Kanwar in marriage; Bika built his first fort in 1478 and founded the city of Bikaner in 1488, the Jat headmen accepted his suzerainty, and the country took his name. The oasis town throve on the caravan route between Central Asia and the Gujarat coast. Under Rai Singh, who accepted Mughal vassalage in 1571 and rose to high command under Akbar and Jahangir, Bikaner raised the Junagarh fort. The eighteenth century brought grinding wars with Jodhpur, until Maharaja Surat Singh accepted British protection in 1818.
zh:
禅伽罗意为「干旱粗粝之地」，又称姜加尔卢，是拉贾斯坦北部的干旱地带，大体相当于今比卡内尔、久鲁、根加纳格尔和哈努曼格尔一带。这里长期是贾特各部的土地，由本族头人按自身习俗治理；北部和西部为巴蒂拉杰普特人所据，珀特纳周边住着穆斯林巴蒂人和乔希亚人，更早时这里还曾是乔汉王朝的萨帕达拉卡沙故地。1414年，巴蒂首领拉奥·凯拉纳夺取境内要堡普格尔，兵锋远及珀丁达和阿博哈尔，又远征德拉加齐汗击败俾路支人。1444年，他的后人仍以普格尔为据点，在贾特村落之间维持着这个沙漠小邦，靠畜群、水井和过往商队为生。

15世纪后期，马尔沃尔的拉奥·乔达第五子拉奥·比卡带着圣徒卡尔尼·玛塔的祝福，联合拉索尔人、查兰人和戈达拉贾特人离开焦特布尔，逐步征服禅伽罗。普格尔的拉奥·谢卡将女儿朗格·坎瓦尔嫁与他为妻；比卡1478年筑起第一座堡垒，1488年兴建比卡内尔城，贾特诸部首领相继臣服，整片土地也以他的名字改称比卡内尔。这座绿洲城镇扼守中亚通往古吉拉特海岸的商路，随商队贸易而兴盛。1571年，拉伊·辛格臣服莫卧儿，在阿克巴与贾汉吉尔朝中官至高级将领，朱纳加尔堡即建于其治内。18世纪，比卡内尔与焦特布尔长期攻战、国势凋敝，1818年摩诃罗阇苏拉特·辛格接受英国保护。

en:
In the heart of the Thar, Jaisalmer was founded in 1156, when Rawal Jaisal of the Bhati Rajputs abandoned the exposed old capital at Lodhruva and raised a yellow-sandstone fort on Trikuta Hill. The 'Golden Fort', girdled by 99 bastions, looked onto the caravan routes linking Sindh, Multan and Gujarat with northern India, and Jain merchants raised a cluster of ornate temples within its walls between the twelfth and fifteenth centuries. Alauddin Khalji's long siege ended in 1294 with the rite of jauhar, the Bhati women perishing on the pyre and 3,800 riders charging out to die under Mularaja; in Firoz Shah Tughluq's reign a second siege ended in another jauhar. Surviving Bhatis retook the deserted fort, and in 1444 Rawal Bersi Singh ruled a small desert kingdom of herdsmen, camels, wool and caravan tolls.

In Rawal Lunakaran's time the Afghan chief Amir Ali smuggled armed men into the fort in palanquins, and in the rout that followed the Rawal slew his own womenfolk for want of time to build a pyre, the tragedy remembered as the 'half jauhar'; in 1541 Lunakaran fought Humayun when he attacked the fort on his march to Ajmer. In 1570 Rawal Harraj submitted to Akbar and gave him his daughter Nathi Bai, and a later Jaisalmer princess became Jahangir's queen Malika Jahan. The Bhatis served the Mughal throne with military contingents for nearly two centuries while keeping their own line of rulers, and the city grew rich on the carrying trade. In 1762 Maharawal Mulraj shook off the collapsing empire, and the carved sandstone havelis of his merchants spread below the fort. Mulraj signed a subsidiary alliance with the East India Company on 12 December 1818 and died in 1820, leaving the throne to his grandson Gaj Singh.
zh:
斋沙默尔地处塔尔沙漠腹地。1156年，巴蒂族拉杰普特王公拉瓦尔·贾萨尔放弃易受袭扰的旧都罗德鲁瓦，在特里库塔山上用黄色砂岩筑起城堡。这座九十九座棱堡环绕的「金色城堡」俯瞰着连接信德、木尔坦、古吉拉特与北印度的商路；12至15世纪，耆那商人在堡内建起一组华美的神庙。阿拉丁·卡尔吉长期围城，战事于1294年以「乔哈尔」告终——巴蒂妇女投火自焚，三千八百名战士在穆拉杰率领下开城赴死；菲鲁兹沙·图格鲁克在位时，第二次围城又以一场乔哈尔收场。幸存的巴蒂人后来收回空城。1444年，拉瓦尔·贝尔西·辛格统治着这个靠牧人、骆驼、羊毛和商队税为生的沙漠小邦。

拉瓦尔·卢纳卡兰在位时，阿富汗首领阿米尔·阿里把武士藏进花轿混入堡中，败局将定之际，卢纳卡兰来不及垒起火葬堆，亲手杀死自家女眷，史称「半次乔哈尔」；1541年，胡马雍进军阿杰梅尔途中攻堡，卢纳卡兰又据堡与之交战。1570年，拉瓦尔·哈拉杰臣服阿克巴，将女儿纳蒂·拜嫁给他，后来的一位斋沙默尔公主则成为贾汉吉尔的王后玛莉卡·贾汉。此后近两百年，巴蒂人派兵为莫卧儿朝廷效力，城仍由本族王公治理，并因转运贸易富足。1762年，摩诃拉瓦尔·穆尔杰吉趁莫卧儿衰乱摆脱控制，商人们雕饰的砂岩宅邸也在堡下铺展开来。1818年12月12日，穆尔杰吉与东印度公司签订附属同盟条约，1820年去世，王位传给孙子加吉·辛格。

en:
Marwar, the 'land of death and thirst', is the Thar country west of the Aravallis, and its old heart was Mandore, seat of the Pratihara kings from the sixth century. The Rathores, driven west after Kannauj fell to the Delhi sultans, won Mandore when Rao Chunda married a Pratihara princess and received its fort as dowry. His son Rao Ranmal became regent of neighbouring Mewar, but in 1438 Rana Kumbha had him murdered at Chittor, seized Mandore and overran Marwar; Rao Jodha fled with only seven companions. In 1444 the dispossessed Rathore prince lived as an exile in the desert while Kumbha's Mewar held Mandore and its cotton lands.

Jodha surprised and retook Mandore in 1453, when Kumbha was hard pressed by the sultans of Malwa and Gujarat, and on 12 May 1459 he founded Jodhpur on a rocky ridge south of the old town, raising Mehrangarh above the Delhi–Gujarat road with its trade in opium, silk, copper and sandalwood. Rao Maldeo (1532–1562) made Marwar feared across Hindustan and fought Sher Shah Suri to a bloody stand at Sammel in 1544. Akbar's armies entered in 1561; after Rao Chandrasen's death in 1581 Marwar passed under direct Mughal rule until its administration was handed to Udai Singh in 1583. When Jaswant Singh died at his Jamrud post, Aurangzeb's troops sacked Jodhpur in 1679, whereupon Durgadas Rathore waged a thirty years' guerrilla war on behalf of the posthumous Ajit Singh, recapturing Jodhpur after Aurangzeb's death in 1707. Maratha interference followed; the Scindia general Jai Appa was killed besieging Nagaur in 1755, and in January 1818 Jodhpur accepted a British subsidiary alliance.
zh:
马尔瓦尔意为「死亡与干渴之地」，是阿拉瓦利山脉以西的塔尔地带，其古老的心脏是曼多尔——6世纪起波罗提诃罗诸王的都城。拉索尔人在卡瑙季被德里苏丹攻灭后向西迁徙，拉奥·春达娶了波罗提诃罗公主，以嫁妆取得曼多尔堡。其子拉奥·兰马尔又成为邻邦梅瓦尔的摄政，却于1438年被拉那·贡波杀死在奇托尔，曼多尔被占，马尔瓦尔尽入梅瓦尔之手；拉奥·乔达出逃时身边仅剩七骑。1444年，这位失国的拉索尔王子流落沙漠，贡波的梅瓦尔占据着曼多尔和它的棉花之乡。

1453年，贡波同时被马尔瓦与古吉拉特的苏丹牵制，乔达突袭收复曼多尔；1459年5月12日，他在旧城南面的石脊上建立焦特布尔，在德里—古吉拉特商路之上筑起梅兰加尔堡，鸦片、丝绸、铜和檀香木的贸易使城市富足。拉奥·马尔德奥1532年继位后让马尔瓦尔威震印度斯坦，1544年在萨姆梅尔与舍尔沙·苏利血战相持。阿克巴的军队1561年入境；拉奥·昌德拉森1581年去世后，马尔瓦尔被莫卧儿直接统治，直到1583年才交还给乌代·辛格。贾斯万特·辛格在贾姆鲁德任上去世后，奥朗则布的军队于1679年洗劫焦特布尔；杜尔加达斯·拉索尔为遗腹子阿吉特·辛格打了三十年游击战，1707年奥朗则布一死便收复焦特布尔。此后马拉塔势力介入，信迪亚的将领贾伊·阿帕1755年围攻纳高尔时被杀；1818年1月，焦特布尔接受英国的附属同盟。

en:
Girnar is a great isolated hill rising above the southern flats of Saurashtra, its summit reached by a long stone stairway that pilgrims have climbed for more than a thousand years. Jains hold it the place where their twenty-second tirthankara Neminatha attained liberation, and the temples ranged on a shelf of the mountain, led by the Neminatha shrine and the Vastupala–Tejapala temples consecrated in 1230, drew merchant pilgrims from across Gujarat. At the hill's foot stands the Uparkot, the ancient fort of Junagadh and seat of the Chudasama raos, Rajput lords who had ruled the land of Sorath for centuries and owed little more than nominal allegiance to the sultan in Ahmedabad. In 1444 the mountain, the fort and the rock bearing Ashoka's edicts were still in Hindu hands.

Sultan Mahmud Begada, resolved to subdue the strongest principality in Kathiawar, campaigned from 1467 and forced the hill-fort to surrender in 1472; the last rao, Mandalika III, accepted Islam, and Junagadh was renamed Mustafabad. Later Tatar Khan Ghori and his son Amin Khan ruled Sorath almost independently as the Gujarat Sultanate collapsed, until Akbar's generals stormed Junagadh in 1591–92. Mughal faujdars then garrisoned the Uparkot, and Sardar Khan laid out the Sardar Baug palace in 1681. In 1730 Sher Khan Babi broke away as Maratha armies raided into the peninsula, founding the nawabi state of Junagadh, which accepted British protection in 1807. Pilgrims kept climbing the mountain all the while, and a new shrine of Rishabhanatha was consecrated there in 1792.
zh:
吉纳尔是索拉什特拉南部平野上拔地而起的一座孤山，朝圣者沿漫长石阶攀登千余年，只为抵达山顶。耆那教徒相信第二十二代祖师内米纳特在此解脱；山腰台地上的寺庙群以内米纳特主寺和1230年开光的瓦斯图帕拉—特贾帕拉双寺为首，吸引全古吉拉特的商人香客。山脚的乌帕尔科特堡即朱纳格特旧城所在，是丘达萨马罗阇的驻地。这一拉杰普特王族统治索拉特约数百年，对艾哈迈达巴德的苏丹只在名义上称臣。1444年，吉纳尔山、古堡和刻有阿育王敕令的巨石仍在印度教徒手中。

古吉拉特苏丹马哈茂德·贝加达决意征服卡提阿瓦最强的诸侯，自1467年连年出兵，1472年迫使山寨投降；末代罗阇曼达利卡三世改宗伊斯兰教，朱纳格特改名穆斯塔法巴德。此后塔塔尔汗·古里与儿子阿明汗趁古吉拉特苏丹国崩溃而割据索拉什特拉，直到1591至1592年阿克巴的将领攻陷朱纳格特。莫卧儿的法乌吉达尔此后镇守乌帕尔科特，萨达尔汗1681年修建了萨达尔巴格宫。1730年，谢尔汗·巴比趁马拉塔军队攻入半岛自立，建立朱纳格特纳瓦卜政权，并于1807年接受英国保护。其间香客仍不断登山布施，1792年山上还有一座新的黎舍婆那特祠庙开光。

en:
Baroda, or Vadodara in Gujarati, stands on the Vishwamitri River, in the plain between the Mahi and the Narmada. Its older neighbour Akota, ancient Ankottaka, was a trading town and a centre of Jainism whose buried bronzes span five centuries; by the 1100s Baroda itself was a city of the Chaulukya kingdom, where Jain scholars copied manuscripts and merchants endowed shrines. Under the Delhi sultans the Afghan 'nobles of the hundred' made it the heart of a great Gujarat revolt in 1344, until Muhammad bin Tughluq crushed them near Bharuch the following year. When the Gujarat Sultanate was founded, Firuz Khan held Baroda and from it challenged his nephew Ahmad Shah I for the throne in 1411, then stood down without a battle. In 1444 the town was ruled from Ahmadabad by the Gujarat sultans, its Jain and Hindu merchants trading as far as Patan and the port of Khambhat.

In 1451 the troops of Mahmud Khalji of Malwa sacked the town, and under Sultan Mahmud Begada it was refounded as a new city named Daulatabad beside the old one. Akbar's conquest of Gujarat in 1573 brought Mughal rule, and Baroda was granted to the noble Aurang Khan. As Mughal power weakened, Koli raiders plundered it for two days in 1705 and Maratha armies swept into Gujarat; in 1721 the Maratha general Pilaji Gaekwad founded his dynasty's state, and as the Marathas overran the region Baroda became the Gaekwad capital. The Second Anglo-Maratha War of 1803-1805 ended with the Gaekwads acknowledging British suzerainty while keeping their court in the city.
zh:
巴罗达（今瓦多达拉）地处维什瓦米特里河畔、默希河与讷尔默达河之间的平原。它旁边的阿科塔古称安科塔卡，早先是商镇和耆那教中心，出土的耆那教铜像前后延续五个世纪；到12世纪，巴罗达本身已是乔鲁基亚（索兰基）王国的城市，耆那教学者在此抄写典籍，商人捐资修建神殿。德里苏丹时期，号称「百户贵族」的阿富汗埃米尔1344年以这里为中心发动遍及古吉拉特的大叛乱，次年被穆罕默德·伊本·图格鲁克在布罗奇附近镇压。古吉拉特苏丹国建立之初，菲鲁兹汗据有巴罗达，1411年据此向侄子艾哈迈德沙阿一世争位，最终未战而罢兵。1444年，这座城镇受艾哈迈达巴德的古吉拉特苏丹统治，耆那教与印度教商人的商路远及帕坦和港口坎贝。

1451年，马尔瓦苏丹马哈茂德·卡尔吉的军队洗劫了巴罗达；后来在马哈茂德·贝加达苏丹治下，城市在旧城旁被重建，命名为道拉塔巴德。1573年阿克巴征服古吉拉特，巴罗达进入莫卧儿统治时期，被封给贵族奥朗汗。随着莫卧儿势力衰落，科利人1705年入城劫掠两日，马拉塔军队也席卷古吉拉特；1721年，马拉塔将领皮拉吉·盖克瓦德建立盖克瓦德政权，随着马拉塔人席卷这一地区，巴罗达成了盖克瓦德王朝的都城。1803至1805年的第二次英国—马拉塔战争后，盖克瓦德家族承认英国宗主权，仍在巴罗达保有宫廷。

en:
Surat lies on the Tapti near the Arabian Sea, with Rander beside it on the same river. Arab merchants from Kufa settled Rander in 1225 and built a wealthy maritime town trading with Mecca, Malacca, Bengal, Pegu and Sumatra in spices, silks, musk and porcelain. Firuz Shah Tughlaq built a fort at Surat in 1373, though the settlement was still not large, and after 1407 it passed to the independent Gujarat sultans. In 1444, therefore, Surat was a fortified Gujarat river port overshadowed by rich Rander, whose Arab-Navayat merchants and large ships dominated the Tapti mouth.

The Portuguese burned Surat in 1512 and 1530 and sacked Rander around 1530, after which much of the river trade shifted to Surat. Malik Gopi laid out the new town and built Gopi Talav in 1516, and the name Surat was in use by 1520. Akbar conquered the port in 1573, and under Mughal rule it became the empire's busiest haven for Hajj shipping, textiles, shipbuilding and commerce with the Red Sea and Persian Gulf. The English East India Company opened its first Indian factory here in 1612. Shivaji sacked the wealthy city from 5 to 13 January 1664 and raided it again in October 1670. Marathas controlled much of the district by about 1725; the English seized Surat castle in 1759 and took over the city's administration in 1800.
zh:
苏拉特位于达布蒂河靠近阿拉伯海的一侧，兰德尔就坐落在同一条河畔。1225年，来自库法的阿拉伯商人定居兰德尔，把它建成富庶的海港城镇，用香料、丝绸、麝香和瓷器同麦加、马六甲、孟加拉、勃固和苏门答腊贸易。菲鲁兹沙·图格鲁克1373年在苏拉特修筑堡垒，但当时聚落规模仍不大；1407年以后，这里归属独立的古吉拉特苏丹国。因此1444年的苏拉特只是古吉拉特治下一座设防河港，真正光芒四射的是富庶的兰德尔，阿拉伯-纳瓦亚特商人和他们的大船掌控着达布蒂河口。

葡萄牙人1512年和1530年两度焚毁苏拉特，又在1530年前后洗劫兰德尔，此后大量河海贸易转向苏拉特。马利克·戈皮营建新城，1516年修建戈皮湖，到1520年，苏拉特之名已经通用。阿克巴1573年征服此港，在莫卧儿治下，它成为帝国最繁忙的港口，承载朝觐麦加的航船、纺织、造船以及通往红海和波斯湾的贸易。1612年，英国东印度公司在此设立其在印度的第一座商馆。希瓦吉于1664年1月5日至13日洗劫这座富庶城市，又在1670年10月再次来袭。到1725年前后，苏拉特地区大半已受马拉塔人控制；英国人1759年夺取苏拉特城堡，并于1800年接管城市行政。

en:
Chittor (commonly rendered Chittorgarh in Chinese) is the great hill fort of Mewar, rising above the Berach valley on a long rocky plateau. Alauddin Khalji of Delhi captured it in 1303 after a long siege, but Hammir Singh of the Sisodia clan restored Rajput rule and made it the heart of Mewar. Rana Kumbha, who came to the throne in 1433, fought the sultans of Malwa and Gujarat and built the kingdom into a major Rajput power; between 1440 and 1448 he raised the Vijaya Stambha to honour his victory over Mahmud Khalji at Sarangpur. In 1444 the tower was still taking shape above a fortress capital at the height of its power.

Mewar's fortunes rose again under Rana Sanga until his defeat by Babur at Khanwa in 1527. Bahadur Shah of Gujarat then besieged Chittor in 1533-1535; his guns breached the walls on 8 March 1535, Rani Karnavati and the fort's women performed jauhar, and the Sisodias recovered the stronghold soon after the Gujarati army withdrew. Udai Singh II founded a safer capital at Udaipur in 1559. Akbar's siege of 1567-1568 ended when the defender Jaimal was shot on 22 February 1568 and the fort fell the next morning. Under the 1615 treaty between Amar Singh I and Jahangir, Chittor returned to Mewar but was neither to be repaired nor re-fortified. Aurangzeb ordered the destruction of 63 temples there in 1680, and in 1818 Mewar became a British princely state.
zh:
吉多尔（中文常译吉多尔格尔）是梅瓦尔的巨型山堡，雄踞在贝拉奇河谷上方的绵长岩台上。德里苏丹阿拉丁·卡尔吉曾于1303年久攻后夺取它，但西索迪亚家族的哈米尔·辛格恢复拉杰普特统治，把这里变成梅瓦尔的心脏。1433年继位的拉纳·昆巴连年对抗马尔瓦与古吉拉特苏丹，使梅瓦尔成为拉杰普特强权；1440年至1448年间，他为纪念萨朗普尔战胜马哈茂德·卡尔吉而修建胜利塔。1444年，这座塔仍在这座正值鼎盛的要塞都城上方逐渐成形。

拉纳·桑加曾让梅瓦尔再度强盛，却在1527年的坎瓦战役中败于巴布尔。古吉拉特的巴哈杜尔沙阿随后于1533年至1535年围攻吉多尔；1535年3月8日，炮火突破城墙，拉妮·卡尔纳瓦蒂与堡中妇女行乔哈尔，古吉拉特军队撤离后，西索迪亚人很快收复要塞。乌代·辛格二世于1559年在更安全的乌代布尔建立新都。阿克巴1567年至1568年围城，守将杰马尔于1568年2月22日中枪阵亡，堡垒次日清晨陷落。根据1615年阿马尔·辛格一世与贾汉吉尔的条约，吉多尔归还梅瓦尔，但不得修复或重新设防。1680年，奥朗则布下令摧毁当地63座神庙；1818年，梅瓦尔成为英国治下的土邦。

en:
Dhundhar, the historic Jaipur region east of the Aravallis, was the core land of the Kachwaha Rajputs. In the eleventh century Dulha Rai established his power at Dausa and Khoh, and his successor Kakil took the Meena settlement of Amer; the rocky town became the dynasty's principal stronghold. Udaikaran strengthened Kachwaha hold after ascending in 1367. In 1444 Amer still ruled a small Hindu Rajput kingdom in the hills above the later Jaipur plain, a modest court overshadowed by stronger neighbours such as Mewar.

In the fifteenth century Rana Kumbha of Mewar defeated Raja Chandrasen and extracted tribute from Dhundhar. Prithviraj Singh joined Rana Sanga's Rajput confederacy against Babur and fought at Khanwa in 1527, the year of his death after the allied defeat. Amber's fortunes changed under Bharmal: his 1562 marriage alliance with Akbar brought the Kachwahas into Mughal service, and Bhagwant Das and Man Singh I rose to be leading imperial commanders; Man Singh built much of the present Amber Fort. As Mughal power weakened, Sawai Jai Singh II reasserted the kingdom's independence in 1708 and founded the planned walled city of Jaipur on 18 November 1727, moving his court south from crowded Amer and patronising astronomy and architecture. In 1818 Jaipur entered a subsidiary alliance with the English East India Company.
zh:
敦达尔是日后斋浦尔一带的历史地区，位于阿拉瓦利山脉以东，也是卡奇瓦哈拉杰普特人的核心领地。11世纪时，杜尔哈·拉伊在道萨和科赫建立势力，他的继任者卡基勒夺取了米纳人聚居的安贝尔；这座山城随后成为王朝的主要要塞。乌代卡兰于1367年继位后巩固了卡奇瓦哈人的统治。1444年的安贝尔仍是一个印度教拉杰普特小王国，雄踞后来斋浦尔平原以北的山地，宫廷规模不大，并处在梅瓦尔等强邻的阴影下。

15世纪，梅瓦尔的拉纳·昆巴击败拉奥·昌德拉森，迫使敦达尔纳贡。普里特维·辛格后来加入拉纳·桑加领导的拉杰普特联盟，在1527年的坎瓦战役中迎战巴布尔；联盟战败，他也在同年去世。安贝尔的命运在巴尔马尔时期改变：他在1562年与阿克巴联姻，卡奇瓦哈王公由此进入莫卧儿体系，巴格万特·达斯和曼·辛格一世都成为重要统帅，现存安贝尔堡的主要宫殿也多由曼·辛格修建。莫卧儿势力衰落后，萨瓦伊·贾伊·辛格二世在1708年重新确立独立，又于1727年11月18日建立规划严整、城墙环绕的斋浦尔，把宫廷从拥挤的安贝尔南迁，并赞助天文与建筑。1818年，斋浦尔与不列颠东印度公司结成辅助联盟。

en:
Mewat is the broken Aravalli country south of Delhi, a land of rocky ridges and fortified valleys peopled by the Meos and ruled from the hill fort of Alwar. Its Khanzada lords began as Hindu Jadaun Rajputs: Bahadur Nahar, born Sonpar Pal, accepted Islam under Firuz Shah Tughlaq in 1355 and founded the hereditary line of the Wali-e-Mewat. His grandsons held off the Sayyid sultans—Feroz Khan defended Kotla for a year against Khizr Khan in 1420, and Jalal Khan repulsed Mubarak Shah from the Tijara hills in 1427, ruling as a sovereign thereafter. In 1444, under Ahmad Khan, who had succeeded his father the previous year, Mewat was an independent Muslim Rajput kingdom astride the roads running south from Delhi.

The Khanzadas fell with the coming of the Mughals. Hasan Khan Mewati, who had taken the Alwar fort from the Nikumbh Rajputs in 1492, fought for Ibrahim Lodi at Panipat in 1526 and at Khanwa in March 1527 joined Rana Sanga against Babur, taking command of the army after the Rana was wounded and dying in the battle; Babur then annexed Mewat. Hemu, born at Machari in the Alwar hills, seized Delhi on 7 October 1556 and took the title Vikramaditya, only to fall at the second battle of Panipat a month later. Under Akbar the country became the four sarkars of Alwar, Tijara, Sahar and Rewari, growing indigo, sugarcane and cotton for Agra and Delhi and trading in salt and iron. Aurangzeb sent Jai Singh I to crush the rebel Khanzada of Tijara; after the emperor's death the south passed to the Jat rajas of Bharatpur while Marathas overran the north. In 1775 Pratap Singh Naruka made the captured Alwar fort the seat of a new Rajput state, and in 1803 his successor Bakhtawar Singh became the first ruler in Rajputana to sign a treaty with the East India Company.
zh:
梅瓦特是德里以南一片阿拉瓦利丘陵纵横、谷中筑堡的地方，居民以梅奥人为主，统治中心在山上的阿尔瓦尔堡。这里的汗扎达统治者本是印度教贾东族拉杰普特：巴哈杜尔·纳哈尔原名松帕尔·帕尔，1355年在菲鲁兹沙·图格鲁克治下改宗伊斯兰教，开创了世袭的「梅瓦特瓦利」（梅瓦特之主）一系。他的子孙顶住了德里赛义德王朝的攻势——1420年菲罗兹汗据守科特拉堡一年，逼退希兹尔汗；1427年贾拉尔汗在蒂贾拉山中再次击退穆巴拉克沙，此后即以独立君主自居。1444年，前一年继位的艾哈迈德汗在位，梅瓦特是扼守德里南路的一个穆斯林拉杰普特小国。

汗扎达的统治终结于莫卧儿人之手。哈桑汗·梅瓦蒂1492年从尼康布拉杰普特手中夺取阿尔瓦尔堡，1526年在帕尼帕特为易卜拉欣·洛迪作战，1527年3月又随拉纳·桑伽在坎瓦对抗巴布尔，桑伽中箭后他代掌军队，最终战死，梅瓦特随后被巴布尔吞并。出生在阿尔瓦尔山区马查里村的赫姆于1556年10月7日攻占德里，取号维克拉马蒂亚，一个月后即战死于第二次帕尼帕特战役。阿克巴时期，此地划为阿尔瓦尔、蒂贾拉、萨哈尔、雷瓦里四个萨尔卡尔，种植靛蓝、甘蔗和棉花供应阿格拉与德里，并以盐铁贸易闻名。奥朗则布派贾伊·辛格一世镇压了蒂贾拉反叛的汗扎达；他死后南部落入婆罗多布尔的贾特首领之手，北部则被马拉塔人占领。1775年，普拉塔普·辛格·纳鲁卡以夺取的阿尔瓦尔堡为都建立新的拉杰普特邦；1803年，其继任者巴克塔瓦尔·辛格成为第一个与东印度公司签约的拉杰普塔纳君主。

en:
Rajkot stands on the Aji river in the heart of Kathiawar, grazing country where the Kathi clans pastured their herds and Rajput landholders held scattered walled villages. The district was known by its older seat of Sardhar, and in 1444 its headmen answered loosely to the strongest lord of the peninsula, the Chudasama rao of Junagadh, while officers of the sultan in Ahmedabad were never far away. No town yet bore the name Rajkot, 'the king's fort'.

The town was founded in 1620 by Thakur Vibhoji Ajoji Jadeja, grandson of Jam Sataji of Nawanagar, who held the pargana of Sardhar under a sanad of the emperor Jahangir. His Jadeja line mostly kept its independence, though a Mughal subedar once occupied the place, and built Rajkot into a compact state of the Halar country. In 1808 the settlement negotiated by Colonel Alexander Walker with the Kathiawar chiefs made Rajkot tributary to the Gaekwad of Baroda, and in 1820 the British leased ground beside the town for a cantonment, their first permanent footing in the peninsula.
zh:
拉杰果德地处卡提阿瓦半岛中部的阿吉河畔，这一带是卡提诸部放牧的草场，拉杰普特地主据守着零星的围壁村庄。地区旧称取自更古老的治所萨尔达尔，1444年时，各首领只松散地听命于半岛上最强的领主——朱纳格特的丘达萨马罗阇，艾哈迈达巴德苏丹派来的官吏也从不遥远。当时还没有一座叫拉杰果德（意为「王城」）的城镇。

1620年，塔库尔·维博吉·阿乔吉·贾德贾建城，他是纳瓦纳加尔的贾姆·萨塔吉之孙，凭皇帝贾汉吉尔颁赐的敕书领有萨尔达尔帕尔格纳。其贾德贾家族大体保持独立，仅一度被莫卧儿苏贝达尔的军队占领，日后把拉杰果德经营成哈拉尔地区一个小而完整的政权。1808年，经亚历山大·沃克上校与卡提阿瓦诸首领议定的协定，拉杰果德开始向巴罗达的盖克瓦德纳贡；1820年英国人又在城边租地修建军营，这是他们在半岛上的第一个永久立足点。

en:
Delhi stands on the Yamuna on the natural road between the Punjab and the Ganges valley, and a chain of cities has risen there in turn. The Tomara Rajputs built the Lal Kot in 1052, which the Chauhans took and renamed Qila Rai Pithora. After Muhammad of Ghor defeated Prithviraj Chauhan at Tarain in 1192, his general Qutb-ud-din Aibak made Delhi the seat of the Delhi Sultanate and began the Qutb Minar, finished under Iltutmish. Khaljis, Tughluqs and later sultans raised new capitals beside the old — Siri, Tughlaqabad, Jahanpanah, Firozabad — until Timur sacked the city in 1398. By 1444 the Sayyid sultans ruled little beyond Delhi and its immediate countryside, overshadowed by the Afghan lords of the Punjab.

Bahlul Lodi, long the master of the Punjab, took Delhi in 1451 and founded the Lodi dynasty, which ended at Panipat in 1526 when Babur entered the city. Humayun began the citadel of Din Panah by the Purana Qila before Sher Shah Suri drove him out in 1540, and Sher Shah's son Salim Shah built the island-fort of Salimgarh in 1546. Humayun returned in 1555, and in 1556 the Sur general Hemu seized Delhi and had himself crowned, only to fall at the second battle of Panipat the same year. The court long preferred Agra, until Shah Jahan laid out the seventh city, Shahjahanabad, from 1639; the Red Fort, its riverside palace, was completed in 1648, and the walled city remained the Mughal capital for the rest of the dynasty.

After Aurangzeb died in 1707 the empire unravelled fast. In 1737 Baji Rao's Marathas sacked Delhi, and in 1739 Nader Shah of Persia crushed Muhammad Shah at Karnal and carried off the Peacock Throne and the Koh-i-Noor, leaving the capital prostrate. Ahmad Shah Durrani's Afghans sacked it again in 1757 and raided it after Panipat in 1761; in 1765 the Jats of Bharatpur even seized the Red Fort. In 1771 Mahadji Shinde's Marathas brought the exiled Shah Alam II back to the throne, and after the Rohilla chief Ghulam Kadir blinded the emperor and wrecked the city in 1788, Maratha arms restored order. The East India Company defeated Daulat Rao Sindhia at the battle of Delhi in 1803, and by 1821 the Mughal emperor still dwelt in the Red Fort as a Company pensioner.
zh:
德里坐落于亚穆纳河畔，扼守旁遮普通往恒河平原的天然大道，历代城池在此相继而建。1052年，托马拉拉杰普特人筑起拉尔科特堡，后被兆汉人夺取，改名拉伊·皮多拉堡。1192年穆罕默德·古尔在塔兰战役击败普利色毗罗阇·兆汉后，其部将库特卜—丁·艾伯克以德里为都建立德里苏丹国，并动工修建库特卜尖塔，后由伊尔杜特米什完工。卡尔吉、图格鲁克及以后的苏丹们在旧城旁另筑新都——锡里、图格鲁克巴德、贾汉帕纳、菲罗扎巴德——直到1398年帖木儿攻陷并洗劫此城。到1444年，赛义德王朝的苏丹所辖已不出德里城及其近郊，威势反在旁遮普的阿富汗贵族之下。

久为旁遮普之主的巴鲁勒·洛迪于1451年入主德里，建立洛迪王朝；1526年帕尼帕特一战后巴布尔进入此城，王朝告终。胡马雍在古堡旁开建「迪恩帕纳」堡垒，1540年即被舍尔沙·苏利逐出；1546年，舍尔沙之子萨利姆沙在亚穆纳河心岛上修筑萨利姆加尔堡。胡马雍1555年还都，1556年苏利朝名将黑穆一度进占德里、加冕称王，同年便在第二次帕尼帕特战役中败亡。此后朝廷久居阿格拉，直到1639年沙贾汉动工兴建第七座都城沙贾贾纳巴德；临河的红堡于1648年落成，这座城墙环绕的城市此后一直是莫卧儿帝国的首都。

1707年奥朗则布死后，帝国迅速瓦解。1737年，巴吉·拉奥率领的马拉塔人洗劫德里；1739年，波斯的纳迪尔沙在格尔纳尔击溃穆罕默德沙，掠走孔雀宝座与光之山钻石，京城自此一蹶不振。1757年艾哈迈德沙·杜兰尼的阿富汗军队再度洗城，1761年帕尼帕特之战后又来劫掠；1765年，婆罗多布尔的贾特人甚至一度攻占红堡。1771年，玛哈吉·辛迪亚的马拉塔人护送流亡皇帝沙·阿拉姆二世复位；1788年罗希拉首领古拉姆·卡迪尔弄瞎皇帝、蹂躏京城，又是马拉塔军队出兵定乱。1803年，东印度公司在德里之战击败道拉特·拉奥·辛迪亚；到1821年，莫卧儿皇帝仍居红堡，却已是领受公司供养的傀儡。

en:
Lucknow stands on the Gomti in the heart of Awadh, the fertile plain later called the granary of India. In older times the country was part of Kosala, and from 1394 it belonged to the Sharqi sultans of Jaunpur, who broke from Delhi as the Tughluq empire fell apart. Under Ibrahim Shah Sharqi, who reigned from 1402 to 1440, Jaunpur was the great Muslim kingdom of the upper Ganges, filling its capital with mosques and colleges while Lucknow remained a provincial town of Avadhi-speaking Hindus governed from afar. In 1444 Ibrahim's son Mahmud Shah Sharqi sat on the throne, and Lucknow's turn as a seat of power still lay more than three centuries away.

In 1452 Mahmud Shah besieged Delhi and was beaten off by Bahlul Lodi, whose dynasty swallowed the Sharqi kingdom in the wars of 1478 to 1486; after Panipat in 1526 Lucknow passed with the rest of Awadh to the Mughals, interrupted only by the Sur interregnum before Humayun returned in 1555. Under Jahangir an estate here was granted to the favoured Sheikh Abdul Rahim, who built Machchi Bhawan, the seat from which his heirs long ran the district. In 1722 Saadat Khan Burhan-ul-Mulk was made governor of Awadh and set up his court at nearby Faizabad; his successor Shuja-ud-Daula was crushed alongside Mir Qasim at Buxar in 1764, after which a British resident arrived in 1773 and the Awadh mint was moved to Lucknow in 1776. The city's fortune came in 1775, when the fourth nawab Asaf-ud-Daula moved his capital from Faizabad and set about building: the great Bara Imambara was raised between 1780 and 1784 to give work through a decade of famine, and the Rumi Darwaza gate with it. Lucknow became the glittering centre of Shia court culture, Urdu poetry and the mixed Hindu-Muslim Ganga-Jamuni way of life. After Wazir Ali was deposed in 1798 Saadat Ali Khan ruled as a puppet, ceded half of Awadh to the East India Company in 1801 and disbanded his army, and in 1819 Ghazi-ud-Din Haidar at last dropped the Mughal emperor's name and struck coins in his own.
zh:
勒克瑙坐落于戈默蒂河畔，地处阿瓦德腹地，这片肥沃平原后来被称为印度的粮仓。上古时这里属拘萨罗之地，1394年起归入章普尔的沙尔基苏丹国——图格鲁克王朝瓦解时，沙尔基家族脱离德里自立。在1402至1440年在位的易卜拉欣沙·沙尔基治下，章普尔是恒河上游最强大的伊斯兰王国，都城内清真寺与经学院林立，而勒克瑙只是一座由远方治理、居民多说阿瓦德语的印度教城镇。1444年在位的是易卜拉欣之子马哈茂德沙·沙尔基，勒克瑙还要等三百多年才迎来自己的权力时代。

1452年，马哈茂德沙围攻德里，被巴赫鲁尔·洛迪击退；1478至1486年的战争中，洛迪王朝吞并了沙尔基王国。1526年帕尼帕特战役后，勒克瑙随阿瓦德并入莫卧儿帝国，其间只有苏尔王朝的短暂插曲，直至1555年胡马雍卷土重来。贾汉吉尔时期，宠臣谢赫·阿卜杜勒·拉希姆获封此地的庄园，建起马奇巴万宫，他的后代长期以此为据点治理这一地区。1722年，萨阿达特汗·布尔汉·穆勒克被任命为阿瓦德总督，在附近的法扎巴德开府；其后继者舒贾·乌德·道拉因与米尔·卡西姆联手，1764年在布克萨尔惨败，英国驻扎官随后于1773年进驻，阿瓦德造币厂也于1776年迁往勒克瑙。城市的转机在1775年到来：第四代纳瓦卜阿萨夫·乌德·道拉把都城从法扎巴德迁来，随即大兴土木——1780至1784年，为在连年饥荒中以工代赈，宏伟的巴拉伊玛目巴拉拔地而起，鲁米门也同期建成。勒克瑙由此成为北印最耀眼的城市，是什叶派宫廷文化、乌尔都语诗歌以及印度教徒与穆斯林交融的「甘加—贾穆尼」风尚之都。1798年瓦齐尔·阿里被废后，萨阿达特·阿里汗形同傀儡，1801年把半个阿瓦德割让给东印度公司并解散军队；1819年，加齐·乌德·丁·海达尔终于去掉钱币上莫卧儿皇帝的名字，以自己的名义铸币。

en:
The Central Doab is the broad, fertile middle reach of the Ganges–Yamuna wedge, whose oldest city is Mathura on the Yamuna. Mathura was already ancient when it ruled the Surasena kingdom: at the fork of the northern road to Malwa and the western ports, it was a great Buddhist and Jain city and the reputed birthplace of Krishna, one of the seven holy cities of the Hindus. Mahmud of Ghazni sacked it in 1018 and carried off its golden idols; the temples were rebuilt, only to be harried again under later sultans. By the fifteenth century the country had become a march disputed between Delhi and the Sharqi rulers of Jaunpur, whose armies campaigned along the Yamuna. Thus in 1444 Mathura is a pilgrim city governed by Muslim officers, its festivals drawing crowds from all over Hindustan, while downstream Agra is still little more than a village.

Sikandar Lodi broke the Sharqi grip on the Doab, razed Mathura's shrines and in 1504–05 rebuilt Agra and moved his court there; Ibrahim Lodi ruled from it until Panipat in 1526, when Humayun occupied the town for Babur. After the Sur interlude Akbar refounded Agra on the right bank in 1558, raised its great red-sandstone fort between 1565 and 1573, and from 1571 built his new capital of Fatehpur Sikri nearby, only to abandon it within fifteen years. In 1585 Ralph Fitch judged the city larger than London. At Mathura the Bundela raja Bir Singh Deo raised a lavish new Keshavadeva temple, but in January 1670 Aurangzeb demolished it, built a mosque on its plinth and renamed the town Islamabad; the Jat leader Gokula, whose 1669 rising had convulsed the district, was put to death in Agra. Shah Jahan, builder of the Taj Mahal (1632–53) and the rebel Prince Khurram of 1622, was deposed after Samugarh and spent his last years captive in Agra Fort, dying there in 1666.

With the empire crumbling, the Jat raja Suraj Mal besieged and took Agra in June 1761 and stripped the silver doors of the Taj. The Mughals recovered the city in 1774, lost it to the Marathas in 1785, and Lord Lake seized it for the British in 1803.
zh:
中河间地是恒河与亚穆纳河之间楔形沃土的中段，雅木纳河畔的马图拉是这里最古老的城市。马图拉在统辖苏拉塞纳王国时便已十分古老：北方大道在此分岔，一路通往马尔瓦，一路通往西海岸诸港，它既是伟大的佛教与耆那教城市，又相传是黑天的诞生地，位列印度教七大圣城之一。1018年，伽色尼的马哈茂德攻破并洗劫此城，掠走金像；神庙后来得以重建，在后世苏丹治下又屡遭破坏。15世纪时，这一带成为德里与章普尔沙尔基王朝反复争夺的边地，沙尔基军队曾沿亚穆纳河征战。因此，1444年的马图拉是一座由穆斯林官吏管辖的朝圣之城，节庆吸引着印度斯坦各地的香客，而下游的阿格拉还几乎只是一座村庄。

洛迪王朝的西坎达尔打破沙尔基人对河间地的控制，捣毁马图拉的神庙，又于1504至1505年重建阿格拉并迁都于此；伊卜拉欣·洛迪以此为都，直到1526年帕尼帕特之战后，胡马雍替巴布尔占领该城。经过苏尔王朝的插曲，阿克巴1558年在亚穆纳河右岸重建阿格拉，1565至1573年筑起宏伟的红砂岩城堡，并从1571年起在附近营建新都法塔赫布尔西格里，不到十五年便将其废弃。这座城市跻身当时世界最宏大的都会之列，1585年英国旅人拉尔夫·菲奇断定它比伦敦还要大。在马图拉，本德拉王公维尔·辛格·迪奥建起华丽的新凯沙瓦提婆神庙；1670年1月，奥朗则布将其拆毁，在神庙台基上修建清真寺，又把城市改名为伊斯兰堡。1669年底，以戈库拉为首的贾特人起义震动全区，戈库拉最终在阿格拉被处死。沙贾汗1632至1653年为亡妻修建泰姬陵，他身为库拉姆王子时曾于1622年在这一带举兵反叛，1658年其部在萨穆加尔战败后，他被奥朗则布废黜，囚禁于阿格拉堡，1666年死在那里。

帝国土崩之际，贾特王公苏拉杰·马尔于1761年6月攻陷阿格拉，熔走泰姬陵的银门。莫卧儿1774年收复此城，1785年又落入马拉塔人之手；1803年，莱克勋爵率英军夺取阿格拉，这座旧帝都归入东印度公司治下。

en:
Gird is the plain around the rock of Gwalior, called Gopachal in older inscriptions, where a single sandstone bluff carries one of the strongest forts of Hindustan. Iltutmish of Delhi took the fort in 1232, and in the 1390s the Tomar Rajput Virasimha made himself its master amid the collapse of Tughlaq authority. Under the Tomaras Gwalior entered its golden age. In 1444 Dungar Singh (r. c.1425–1459) rules an independent kingdom from the clifftop; Jain merchants and monks are carving the colossal Gopachal images, work that ran from 1440 to 1473, and the court is famed for its dhrupad singers, an island of Rajput power between Delhi, Jaunpur and Malwa.

Man Singh Tomar (1486–1516) built the Man Mandir and Gujari Mahal palaces and bought off Bahlul Lodi with 800,000 tankas; Sikandar Lodi ravaged the countryside in 1505–1506 but never took the fort. After Man Singh's death his son Vikramaditya surrendered it to Ibrahim Lodi in 1518 and fell fighting for him at Panipat in 1526. The fort passed to Babur, was lost to Sher Shah in 1542 and used as a base by Hemu, and in 1558 Akbar's armies retook it after a long siege. Under the Mughals it served as a state prison, where Murad Bakhsh and Sulaiman Shikoh were executed, and the Sikh Guru Hargobind was confined under Jahangir. The last Tomar raja, Ram Shah, fell at Haldighati in 1576 with three of his sons; the singer Tansen, born at Behat nearby, joined Akbar's court in 1562 and was buried at Gwalior. In 1740 Bhim Singh Rana of Gohad seized the fort; the Scindias took it in 1755–1756, lost it to Captain Popham's night escalade on 3 August 1780, and recovered it in 1784. Daulat Rao Scindia afterwards laid out Lashkar below the hill as the capital of his state.
zh:
吉尔德是瓜廖尔巨岩周围的平原，古碑铭中称戈帕查尔；平原上一整块砂岩台地拔地而起，顶上是印度斯坦最坚固的堡垒之一。德里苏丹伊勒杜迷失1232年攻占此堡，14世纪90年代，拉杰普特托马尔家族的维拉辛哈趁图格鲁克王朝权威崩溃之际成为堡主，瓜廖尔由此进入黄金时代。1444年，东加尔·辛格（约1425–1459年在位）在崖顶统治着一个独立王国；耆那教商人和僧人正在崖壁上开凿戈帕查尔巨型造像（工程从1440年持续到1473年），宫廷又以德鲁帕德声乐闻名，是德里、江布尔与摩腊婆之间的拉杰普特强权。

曼·辛格·托马尔（1486–1516年在位）修建了曼曼迪尔宫和古杰里宫，并以八十万坦卡钱币向巴鲁尔·洛迪纳贡买和；西坎达尔·洛迪1505至1506年纵兵蹂躏四乡，却始终未能破堡。曼·辛格死后，其子维克拉马蒂亚于1518年把堡垒交给易卜拉欣·洛迪，1526年又在帕尼帕特为其战死。堡垒随后归入巴布尔，1542年落入舍尔沙之手，又被黑姆充作据点；1558年，阿克巴的大军在长期围攻后将其收复。莫卧儿时期，这里成为关押要犯的国家监狱，穆拉德·巴赫什和苏莱曼·舒科在此被处死，锡克古鲁哈尔戈宾德也曾被贾汉吉尔囚禁于此。末代托马尔王公拉姆·沙阿1576年带着三个儿子战死于哈尔迪加蒂；生于附近贝哈特的歌唱家坦森1562年进入阿克巴宫廷，身后归葬瓜廖尔。1740年，戈赫德的比姆·辛格·拉纳夺取此堡；辛迪亚家族1755至1756年占领该堡，1780年8月3日波帕姆上尉乘夜攀墙将其攻克，1784年辛迪亚又将堡垒收回。道拉特·拉奥·辛迪亚后来在崖下营建拉尔什卡尔，作为本邦都城。

en:
Mandu, also called Mandavgad, is a fortress town on a Vindhya ridge, with the Malwa plateau to its north and the Narmada valley below its southern cliffs. The Paramaras used its walls before Delhi's armies broke the stronghold in the thirteenth century. After Timur's invasion weakened Delhi, Dilawar Khan made Malwa independent, and his son Hoshang Shah moved the capital from Dhar to Mandu, renaming it Shadiabad. By 1444 Mahmud Khalji ruled from this fortified capital, whose gates, mosques and palaces were becoming the architectural centre of the Malwa Sultanate.

Ghiyas-ud-din succeeded Mahmud in 1469 and built the ship-shaped Jahaz Mahal between the royal tanks. In 1531 Bahadur Shah of Gujarat captured Mandu, ending the Khalji line's rule. Humayun briefly held the fortress in the mid-1530s, but after years of disputed successions power passed to Baz Bahadur, whose court was remembered for music and his love for Rani Roopmati. A Mughal army under Adham Khan and Pir Muhammad Khan defeated him at Sarangpur on 29 March 1561; Roopmati poisoned herself as Mandu fell, and Baz Bahadur briefly returned before Akbar's forces conquered Malwa in 1562. Mandu remained an important Mughal fortress until the Marathas under Baji Rao I took it in 1732; the Pawar rulers then moved their seat back to Dhar.
zh:
曼杜又称曼达瓦加德，是温迪亚山脉山脊上的要塞城，北望摩腊婆高原，南俯讷尔默达河谷。帕拉马拉王朝曾凭借这里的城墙据守，13世纪德里军队攻破要塞。帖木儿入侵削弱德里后，迪拉瓦尔汗使摩腊婆独立，其子胡尚格沙把都城从达尔迁至曼杜，改名沙迪阿巴德。1444年，马哈茂德·卡尔吉正以这座设防都城统治全国，城门、清真寺和宫殿也使曼杜成为摩腊婆苏丹国的建筑中心。

吉亚斯丁于1469年继马哈茂德即位，在两座御池之间建造了船形的贾哈兹宫。1531年，古吉拉特的巴哈杜尔沙攻占曼杜，终结卡尔吉世系的统治。胡马雍在16世纪30年代中期短暂据有这座要塞，随后继承纷争延续多年，权力最终落入巴兹·巴哈杜尔手中；他的宫廷以音乐以及他与拉妮·鲁普马蒂的爱情闻名。1561年3月29日，阿扎姆汗和皮尔·穆罕默德汗率领的莫卧儿军队在萨兰布尔击败巴兹·巴哈杜尔，曼杜陷落时鲁普马蒂服毒自尽。巴兹·巴哈杜尔曾短暂复位，但阿克巴的军队于1562年征服摩腊婆。曼杜仍是重要的莫卧儿要塞，直到巴吉拉奥一世麾下的马拉塔人在1732年将其夺取；此后帕瓦尔统治者把治所迁回达尔。

en:
Burhanpur (the Chinese Wikipedia renders the name as Buerhanbuer) sits on the north bank of the Tapti, with Asirgarh Fort commanding the Satpura pass above it, the route later called the key to the Deccan. Malik Nasir Khan of the Faruqi dynasty made the settlement his capital in 1388 and named it after the Sufi Burhan-ud-Din. Miran Mubarak Khan I had succeeded in 1441, so in 1444 Burhanpur was the young capital of the independent Faruqi sultans of Khandesh, guarded by Asirgarh and already placed on the trade roads between Hindustan, Malwa and the Deccan.

Miran Adil Khan II, ruling from 1457 to 1501, built the citadel and palaces and turned Burhanpur into a major centre for trade and textiles. Akbar's army occupied the city in 1599, and after Asirgarh fell on 17 January 1601 the last Faruqi ruler Bahadur Shah submitted; Burhanpur became capital of the Mughal subah of Khandesh. Abdul Rahim Khan-i-Khanan supplied it with new waterworks and gardens, and in 1609 Prince Parviz made the city his Deccan headquarters. Shah Jahan later enlarged the Shahi Qila, while cotton, indigo and cloth brought the region its greatest prosperity. Maratha raiders reached its outskirts in 1670, Peshwa forces took Khandesh in 1760, and the city passed to the British in 1818; Asirgarh itself held out until 9 April 1819.
zh:
布尔汉普尔（中文维基常译「布尔汉布尔」）位于塔普蒂河北岸，阿西尔加尔堡扼守着城北萨特普拉山脉的山口，这条通往德干的道路后来被称为「德干之钥」。法鲁奇王朝的马利克·纳西尔·汗在1388年把此地立为都城，并以苏菲圣徒布尔汉丁的名字命名。米兰·穆巴拉克·汗一世于1441年继位，因此1444年的布尔汉普尔已是独立的坎德什法鲁奇苏丹国都城，外有阿西尔加尔堡屏障，也正处在印度斯坦、马尔瓦与德干之间的商路上。

1457年至1501年在位的米兰·阿迪勒·汗二世修建城堡和宫殿，使布尔汉普尔成为重要的贸易与纺织中心。阿克巴的军队在1599年占领城市，阿西尔加尔堡于1601年1月17日陷落后，末代法鲁奇君主巴哈杜尔沙阿投降，布尔汉普尔成为莫卧儿坎德什行省的首府。阿卜杜勒·拉希姆·汗伊汗南为城市修建新的供水设施和园林，1609年王子帕尔维兹又把这里作为自己经略德干的总部。沙贾汉后来扩建皇家城堡，棉花、靛蓝和布匹贸易则让这一地区达到极盛。马拉塔骑兵1670年已袭掠近郊，佩什瓦军队于1760年取得坎德什，城市在1818年转入英国之手，阿西尔加尔堡则坚守到1819年4月9日。

en:
Hadoti is the south-eastern corner of Rajasthan, the land of the Hada Chauhans: a rolling tract between the Aravalli hills and the Malwa plateau, cut by the Chambal River. The Hadas, a branch of the Chauhan clan, took Bundi from the Meena and Bhil clans in 1241 under Rao Deva and seized Kota in 1264, giving the country its older name of Haravati. The walled town of Kota grew on the Chambal in the following century. In 1444 the Hada raos rule their cotton-growing lands from the hill fort of Bundi, holding them as vassals of the Sisodias of Mewar, squarely on the road between Mewar and Mandu.

The long Malwa–Mewar wars were fought across these marches, from the Battle of the Banas in 1446 to the siege in which Mahmud Khalji took Mandalgarh in 1456–1457, and around 1468–1473 the great fort of Ranthambore passed into Hada keeping. Bahadur Shah of Gujarat held it briefly from 1532 to 1535, and Rao Surjan Singh's surrender of it to Akbar in 1568 brought the Hadas into Mughal service. In 1631 the Emperor Shah Jahan divided the Hada kingdom, granting Kota to Rao Madho Singh, the second son of Ratan Singh of Bundi; Kota soon outgrew its parent state. Southern weavers settled at Kaithoon wove the light, checkered Kota doria cloth, the Kota school of miniature painting flourished at court, and Maharao Bhim Singh held a mansab of five thousand under Bahadur Shah I. From 1771 Zalim Singh, regent for a minor ruler, built up Kota's revenue and irrigation on the Chambal's water, and in 1817 he placed the state under British protection.
zh:
哈多蒂在拉贾斯坦东南角，是哈达·乔汉人的土地——阿拉瓦利山岭与摩腊婆高原之间一片起伏之地，被昌巴尔河横切而过。哈达人是乔汉人的一支，1241年在拉奥·德瓦率领下从米纳和比尔诸部手中夺取本迪，1264年又夺得科塔，这一带由此得名哈拉瓦蒂。此后一个世纪，筑有城墙的科塔城在昌巴尔河畔发展起来。1444年，哈达诸拉奥以本迪山寨为治所，统治这片盛产棉花的土地；他们是梅瓦尔西索迪亚王公的藩属，封地正卡在梅瓦尔与曼杜之间的通路上。

摩腊婆与梅瓦尔的长期战争反复在这片边境地带进行，从1446年的巴纳斯河之战，到1456至1457年马哈茂德·卡尔吉围攻夺取曼达尔加尔；约1468至1473年，重镇伦滕波尔堡也转入哈达人之手。1532至1535年，古吉拉特的巴哈杜尔·沙一度占据该堡，1568年拉奥·苏尔詹·辛格把它交给阿克巴，哈达人自此进入莫卧儿效力。1631年，皇帝沙贾汗拆分哈达国家，把科塔封给本迪的拉坦·辛格次子拉奥·马多·辛格，科塔后来居上，很快超过母邦。来自南方的织工在凯通落户，织出轻薄带方格的科塔多里亚布；细密画的科塔画派在宫廷兴盛，马哈拉奥·比姆·辛格在巴哈杜尔·沙一世治下领有五千曼萨卜。1771年起，扎利姆·辛格以幼主摄政的身份，依托昌巴尔河水整顿田赋、兴修水利，并于1817年使科塔接受英国保护。

en:
Thana, the old harbour of Shristhanaka, lies at the north-eastern end of Salsette Island, the centre of a chain of North Konkan ports that also included Mahim, Bombay and Bassein. The Shilaharas ruled this coast from about 800 to 1265, and an inscription of 1094 already called their town a harbour active in import and export. After Yadava rule and lords tied to the Delhi Sultanate, the coast passed to the Muzaffarid sultans of Gujarat. In 1444 their Gujarat kingdom controlled a Marathi-speaking Hindu shore of fishermen, farmers and cotton fields, whose salt, timber, rice and cloth moved through the creeks of Thana and Bassein.

Portuguese raiders burned Bassein in 1530 and 1531, and in 1533 their fleet swept the coast from Bandora through Thana to Surat. By the treaty signed on 23 December 1534, Sultan Bahadur Shah ceded Bassein, Bombay and the adjoining waters and territories to Portugal; Bassein became the capital of the Portuguese northern province, with Garcia de Sá its first captain in 1536. The seven Bombay islets passed to England in 1661 as part of Catherine of Braganza's dowry, were leased to the East India Company in 1668, and in 1687 replaced Surat as the Company's main western seat. Thana itself was fought over by Mughals, Marathas and Portuguese; Shivaji took it from the Mughals in 1675, Portuguese work on a new fort began in 1734, and Maratha forces under Chimaji Appa took Thana and Salsette in 1737 before Bassein Fort fell on 16 May 1739. Company troops occupied Salsette and Thana Fort in 1774, and the Treaty of Salbai in 1782 left the older Konkan harbours in British hands while Bombay became the region's dominant port.
zh:
塔那古称什里斯塔纳卡，位于萨尔塞特岛东北端，是北康肯一连串港口的中心，南侧有马希姆与孟买，北侧有巴塞因。希拉哈拉王朝约在800年至1265年间统治这段海岸；1094年的铭文已把这里称作从事进出口贸易的港口。经过雅达瓦王朝和与德里苏丹国关联的地方首领之后，海岸转入古吉拉特穆扎法尔王朝苏丹之手。1444年，这里是古吉拉特治下说马拉地语的印度教滨海之地，渔民、农户和棉田分布在港湾之间，盐、木材、稻米与布匹经由塔那和巴塞因的水道外运。

葡萄牙袭掠军1530年和1531年两度焚毁巴塞因，1533年舰队又从班多拉沿塔那、巴塞因一路扫荡到苏拉特。1534年12月23日，巴哈杜尔沙阿签订条约，把巴塞因、孟买及邻近土地和水域割让给葡萄牙；巴塞因成为葡萄牙北方领地的首府，加西亚·德·萨于1536年出任首任长官。孟买七岛1661年作为布拉干萨的凯瑟琳嫁妆的一部分转归英国，1668年租给东印度公司，1687年又取代苏拉特成为公司在印度西海岸的主要驻地。塔那本身则在莫卧儿、马拉塔与葡萄牙之间反复易手：希瓦吉1675年从莫卧儿手中夺取此地，葡萄牙人1734年开始修建新堡垒，奇马吉·阿帕率领马拉塔军1737年攻占塔那和萨尔塞特，巴塞因堡垒随后于1739年5月16日陷落。东印度公司军队1774年占领萨尔塞特和塔那堡，1782年的《萨尔拜条约》确认这些康肯旧港归英国控制，孟买则逐渐成为这一地区最主要的港口。

en:
Dabhol stands where the Vashishti River meets the Arabian Sea, the finest anchorage of the South Konkan coast. Arab and Persian traders had settled among its Marathi-speaking fishermen and farmers by the tenth century, and the port's mosques and merchant elders managed much of its own affairs. Ships from the Red Sea, the Persian Gulf and even Ethiopia called here, landing horses from Arabia and Khorasan for the Deccan armies and loading spices and textiles. In the Bahmani period the town was called Mustafabad, the handiest seaport for the court at Bidar.
