In 1444 its wharves were run by wealthy Muslim merchants while its hinterland remained Hindu and Marathi, pressed upon from both the Bahmani sultanate and Vijayanagara.

In 1453 Mahmud Gawan, later the great vizier of the Bahmani kingdom, first landed at Dabhol to sell horses to the court, and around 1469 the Russian traveller Afanasy Nikitin found a large town with a spacious harbour. As the foremost Muslim port between Chaul and Goa it drew Portuguese wrath: on 29 December 1508 the viceroy Francisco de Almeida's fleet bombarded, sacked and burned Dabul, as the Portuguese called it, slaughtering its people before sailing on to Diu. Further assaults followed, the last recorded in 1571 against its governor Khwaja Ali Shirazi. After the Bahmani collapse Dabhol passed to Bijapur, while its commerce slipped south to the rising port of Rajapur. Shivaji conquered it about 1660 and added it to his Maratha kingdom, and his son Sambhaji later granted the town and its revenues to his courtier Khando Ballal Chitnis.
zh:
达布尔位于瓦希什蒂河注入阿拉伯海之处，是南康坎海岸最优良的锚地。早在10世纪，阿拉伯和波斯商人便已定居于此，与讲马拉地语的渔民、农户杂处，港内的清真寺和商人长老在很大程度上自理港务。从红海、波斯湾乃至埃塞俄比亚驶来的船只在此靠岸，卸下阿拉伯和呼罗珊的战马供德干诸邦军队采购，再装上香料和布匹。巴赫马尼时期此城称穆斯塔法巴德，是进出比达尔宫廷最便捷的海港。1444年时，码头由富有的穆斯林商人经营，内陆乡邻仍是信奉印度教的马拉地人，巴赫马尼苏丹国与毗奢耶那伽罗都从南北两面向它施压。

1453年，日后成为巴赫马尼名相的马哈茂德·加万首次在达布尔上岸，向苏丹宫廷兜售战马；约1469年俄罗斯旅行家阿法纳西·尼基京抵达时，见到的是一座大城和宽阔的港湾。作为焦尔与果阿之间首屈一指的穆斯林商港，它被葡萄牙人称作达布尔，也因此招来兵祸：1508年12月29日，印度总督弗朗西斯科·德·阿尔梅达的舰队炮轰、洗劫并焚毁全城，大肆屠戮后才驶往第乌。此后葡萄牙人又多次来犯，史籍记载的最后一次在1571年，当时的守将是赫瓦贾·阿里·设拉子。巴赫马尼王国解体后达布尔归属比贾布尔，贸易却逐渐南移到新兴的拉贾布尔。约1660年希瓦吉攻取此城，纳入他新建的马拉塔王国；其子桑巴吉后来把达布尔连同赋税赐给近臣坎多·巴拉尔·奇特尼斯。

en:
North Kanara is the narrow strip where the forested Western Ghats fall straight to the Arabian Sea, a coast of river mouths and roadsteads — Bhatkal, Honnavar, the creeks by the Kali river. Arab traders, the Nawayath, settled its ports from early times, and Ibn Battuta, landing at Honnavar about 1342, found a Muslim chief and a busy pepper trade there. Jain and Hindu chiefs of the Ghats, among them the lords of Haduvalli, ruled the hinterland, and with the break-up of Hoysala power the coast passed to Vijayanagara. In 1444 it was a valued edge of the empire: cardamom and the pepper of the rainy Ghat forests went out through Bhatkal, while Arab horses for the imperial cavalry came in over the same quays.

In 1479 imperial troops sacked Bhatkal and Honnavar, accusing their merchants of trafficking with the Bahmani sultans, but the coast stayed with Vijayanagara's heirs. Portuguese fleets burned a fort at the Kali river mouth in 1510 and sacked Bhatkal itself in 1542, yet trade bent rather than broke: from 1552 the Jain queen Chennabhairadevi of Gerusoppa, whom the Portuguese called the Queen of Pepper, ruled the ports and fought their fleets to a standstill in the wars of 1559 and 1570. When the Keladi nayakas inherited the coast, Shivappa Nayaka drove the Portuguese from Honnavar in 1653, not long after English traders had opened a factory up the Kali at Kadwad in 1638. Keladi fell to Hyder Ali of Mysore in 1763, and after Tipu Sultan's defeat the ports of Bhatkal and Honnavar passed to the British with the rest of the coast in 1799.
zh:
北卡纳达是西高止山密林直插阿拉伯海之间的一条狭长海岸，河口与锚地星罗棋布——巴特卡尔、霍纳瓦尔，还有卡利河畔的港湾。阿拉伯裔的纳瓦亚特商人很早就定居各港；伊本·白图泰约1342年在霍纳瓦尔登岸时，见到一位穆斯林酋长和繁忙的胡椒贸易。内陆则由西高止山的耆那教与印度教首领统治，哈杜瓦利的领主便是其中之一；随着曷萨拉政权瓦解，海岸归入毗奢耶那伽罗。1444年，这里是帝国珍视的海疆：湿润山林出产的胡椒和豆蔻从巴特卡尔出海，帝国骑兵所需的阿拉伯马也在同一批码头登岸。

1479年，帝国军队以商人私通巴赫曼尼苏丹为由，洗劫巴特卡尔与霍纳瓦尔，但海岸仍留在毗奢耶那伽罗后继者手中。1510年葡萄牙舰队焚毁卡利河口的一处要塞，1542年又劫掠巴特卡尔本城，贸易却只是受挫、并未断绝：1552年起，盖鲁索帕的耆那教女王琴娜巴伊拉黛薇统治诸港——葡萄牙人称她「胡椒女王」，她在1559年和1570年的战事中力抗葡萄牙舰队，使其无法得逞。凯拉迪纳亚克王朝继承海岸后，希瓦帕·纳亚克1653年把葡萄牙人逐出霍纳瓦尔；此前不久，英国商人已于1638年在卡利河上游的卡德瓦德开设商馆。1763年凯拉迪被迈索尔的海德尔·阿里攻灭，1799年蒂普苏丹战败，巴特卡尔、霍纳瓦尔连同整条海岸一并割让给英国。

en:
Raichur commands the fertile tongue of land between the Krishna and Tungabhadra rivers known as the Raichur Doab. A fort inscription dates its stronghold to 1294, when the Kakatiyas of Warangal guarded the river crossings. After the fall of Warangal the doab became a frontier between the Bahmani sultans and Vijayanagara; the Bahmanis secured Raichur in 1363. In 1444 it was a Bahmani fortress town in a Kannada-speaking, Hindu countryside, its tanks and trade exposed to the long rivalry with the emperors south of the Tungabhadra.

When the Bahmani kingdom broke up, Raichur passed to the Adil Shahi sultans of Bijapur in 1489. Krishnadevaraya of Vijayanagara marched against the fortress and in 1520 defeated Bijapur at the Battle of Raichur, throwing the sultanate back across the Krishna. The victory lasted less than half a century: after the allied Deccan sultans crushed Vijayanagara at Talikota in 1565, Bijapur recovered the doab. Aurangzeb's Mughal army took it in 1686, and from 1724 Raichur passed under the Nizam of Hyderabad, whose governors held the district through the rest of the period.
zh:
赖丘尔（中文维基译赖久尔）扼守克里希纳河与栋格珀德拉河之间肥沃的赖丘尔河间地。要塞铭文把城堡的历史追溯到1294年，当时瓦朗加尔的卡卡提雅王朝以此控制渡河要冲。瓦朗加尔陷落后，河间地成为巴赫曼尼苏丹国与毗奢耶那伽罗帝国的边境，巴赫曼尼王朝于1363年取得赖丘尔。1444年，这里是巴赫曼尼的要塞城镇，周围是说卡纳达语的印度教乡野，水塘和商路都处在与栋格珀德拉河以南帝国长期对抗的前沿。

巴赫曼尼王国分裂后，赖丘尔于1489年转归比贾布尔的阿迪勒·沙希苏丹。毗奢耶那伽罗皇帝克里希纳德瓦拉亚率军北上围攻要塞，1520年在赖丘尔战役击败比贾布尔，把苏丹军队逐回克里希纳河以北。这场胜利维持不到半个世纪：1565年德干诸苏丹联盟在塔利科塔摧毁毗奢耶那伽罗后，比贾布尔重新取得河间地。1686年，奥朗则布的莫卧儿军队攻占此地；1724年起，赖丘尔转归海得拉巴的尼扎姆，其派任的长官在此后的年代继续管辖这片地区。

en:
The Mysore country is a rolling upland south of the Kaveri, where the Chamundi Hills look down on the small fort-town of Mysore. Around 1399 the chief Yaduraya founded the Wadiyar line there, taking the title wodeyar, 'lord'; in 1444 his successors still ruled a small chiefdom of villages as feudatories of the Vijayanagara emperors. South-east of Mysore, at Ummattur near Yelandur, another line of palaigars held a fortified town already old in Jain times, with a thirteenth-century basadi and garuda pillars before its Ranganatha temple.

Between 1512 and 1514 Krishnadevaraya's armies crushed the rebel palaigar of Ummattur. Chamaraja Wodeyar III built the fort of Mysore in 1524, and after the Vijayanagara collapse at Talikota in 1565 the Wadiyars withheld tribute and made themselves independent. In 1610 Raja Wodeyar I took Srirangapatna from the emperor's governor and moved his court to the island. Chikka Devaraja (1672–1704) added Bangalore and Salem to the kingdom. In 1761 the general Hyder Ali seized power and planted mulberry for silk; with his son Tipu Sultan he fought four wars against the British. Tipu died defending Srirangapatna in 1799, the boy Krishnaraja Wodeyar III was restored, and the capital returned to Mysore.
zh:
迈索尔地方是高韦里河以南一片起伏的高原，查蒙迪山俯瞰着迈索尔这座小堡城。约1399年，首领亚杜拉亚在此开创瓦迪亚家族，取号「瓦迪亚」，意为领主。1444年，其后人仍作为毗奢耶那伽罗皇帝的藩臣，统治着由若干村落组成的小酋邦。迈索尔东南、耶兰杜尔附近的乌马图尔，是另一家帕莱加尔世代驻守的堡城，早在耆那教兴盛的年代便已存在，当地有13世纪的天衣派寺院，朗加纳塔神庙前立着古老的嘉鲁达石柱。

1512至1514年间，克里希纳德瓦拉亚的大军讨平了乌马图尔帕莱加尔的叛乱。1524年，查马拉贾·瓦迪亚三世修筑迈索尔堡；1565年毗奢耶那伽罗在塔利科塔之战崩溃后，瓦迪亚家族停止纳贡，逐步独立。1610年，拉贾·瓦迪亚一世从帝国总督手中夺取塞林伽巴丹，将宫廷移往河洲。奇卡·德瓦拉贾在位期间（1672—1704年），王国兼并班加罗尔和塞勒姆等地。1761年，将领海德尔·阿里夺得大权，在当地种桑养蚕；他与儿子蒂普苏丹同英国打了四仗。1799年蒂普在塞林伽巴丹战死，幼王克里希纳拉贾三世复位，都城迁回迈索尔。

en:
Calicut, called the City of Spices, lies on the Malabar coast of Kerala. The town took shape in the 13th century, when the Eradi lords of inland Nediyiruppu, after forty-eight years of war with the Porlathiri chiefs of Polanad, seized this shore and moved their seat to the new port; their ruler took the title Samoothiri, which Europeans rendered as Zamorin. He made Calicut a free harbour, and pepper and ginger drew Arab, Persian and Chinese merchants to its wharves. Muslim Mappila merchants came to dominate the port's sea-borne commerce, and the cotton cloth they shipped gave European languages the word calico. Ibn Battuta came six times between 1342 and 1347 and found merchants from all the world; Zheng He's Ming treasure fleets returned on every voyage, and Chinese sources place the admiral's death here on his last voyage in 1433. In 1444 the Zamorin was the foremost power of the Malabar coast, his suzerainty acknowledged by every chief north of Cochin, and Abdur Razzak, envoy of Shah Rukh, praised the safe anchorage and the riches piled along the bazaars.

Vasco da Gama landed at Kappad, a short way up the coast, on 20 May 1498, opening the sea road from Europe to India. The Zamorin's fleets, led by the Kunjali Marakkar admirals, fought the Portuguese for the rest of the century: their first sea fight came off Cannanore in January 1502, and the destruction of the Mamluk, Gujarati and Calicut fleet at Diu in 1509 handed Lisbon the spice trade. A Portuguese fort built in 1511 was lost by 1525, and in 1571 the Zamorin stormed the Portuguese fort at nearby Chaliyam. In 1604 he signed the Dutch East India Company's first treaty with an Indian ruler, and with Dutch help the Portuguese were driven from their Malabar strongholds in 1663. The English, first arriving with William Keeling in 1615, and the French in 1698, opened factories of their own. Defeat by Travancore at Purakkad in 1755 began the decline, and in 1766 Hyder Ali of Mysore sacked Calicut, the reigning Zamorin dying by his own hand in his palace. Under the peace of 1792 the British took Malabar and made the town capital of their Malabar District.
zh:
卡利卡特又称「香料之城」，位于喀拉拉的马拉巴尔海岸。城市成形于13世纪：内陆内迪伊鲁普的埃拉迪领主与波拉纳德的波尔拉蒂里酋长交战四十八年，最终夺得这段海岸，把治所迁到新建的港口；其首领采用「萨穆特里」称号，欧洲人转写作「扎莫林」。他把卡利卡特辟为自由港，任何需要补给和交易的船只皆可入港，胡椒、生姜把阿拉伯、波斯和中国商人引到码头，穆斯林马皮拉商人逐渐掌握了港口的海运，从这里输出的棉布让欧洲语言有了calico（印花布）一词。伊本·白图泰在1342至1347年间六次到此，见各国商人云集；郑和的宝船每次下西洋都到访古里，中文史料载郑和1433年最后一次下西洋时卒于此地。1444年，扎莫林已是马拉巴尔海岸的头号强权，科钦以北的酋长无不承认其宗主权；沙哈鲁的使者阿卜杜勒·拉扎克也盛赞港内锚地安全、市集珍宝堆积。

1498年5月20日，瓦斯科·达·伽马在城北不远的卡帕德登陆，打通了欧洲到印度的航路。此后一个世纪，扎莫林的舰队在昆贾利·马拉卡尔等海军统帅指挥下持续抗击葡萄牙人：1502年1月，双方在坎纳诺尔外海首次交战；1509年第乌海战中，马穆鲁克、古吉拉特与卡利卡特的联合舰队覆灭，香料贸易就此落入里斯本之手。葡萄牙人1511年在卡利卡特筑起堡垒，1525年前即告失守，1571年扎莫林又攻破附近查利亚姆的葡军要塞。1604年，他与荷兰东印度公司签约，这是该公司与印度统治者订立的第一个条约；1663年借助荷兰人之力，葡萄牙人被逐出马拉巴尔各据点。英国人1615年已随威廉·基林首次到此，法国也在1698年开设商馆。1755年在普拉卡德败于特拉凡哥尔，港口由此转衰；1766年迈索尔的海德尔·阿里洗劫卡利卡特，在位的扎莫林在宫中自尽。1792年议和后，英国人取得马拉巴尔，并将此城设为马拉巴尔县的首府。

en:
Kochi occupies a sheltered chain of lagoons and islands on the Malabar Coast. The Periyar flood of 1341 opened its harbour as the older spice roadstead at Muziris declined, and the Perumpadappu rulers moved their seat to the rising port. Arab, Chinese, Jewish, Syrian Christian and Malayali merchants dealt in pepper and other spices, while Chinese fishing nets became a familiar sight along the waterfront. In 1444 the Hindu raja of Cochin ruled a Malayalam-speaking trading state, but the expanding Zamorins of Calicut had stripped it of vassals and pressed hard upon its northern approaches.

On 24 December 1500 Raja Unni Goda Varma welcomed Pedro Álvares Cabral and made Cochin Portugal's first ally on this coast. The Portuguese built Fort Emmanuel in 1503, and its guns helped Cochin survive the Calicut siege of 1504. Vasco da Gama was buried in the town in 1524 before his remains were returned to Portugal, and Francis Xavier opened a Latin mission there in 1530. A Dutch fleet took Fort Cochin in 1663, beginning more than a century of alliance with the Dutch East India Company. Mysorean invasions after 1766 forced Cochin to pay tribute, and British power replaced the Dutch during the 1790s; the Anglo-Dutch Treaty of 1814 placed Fort Kochi under British rule while the Cochin raja retained his inland state.
zh:
科钦位于马拉巴尔海岸一片受潟湖与岛屿掩护的水域。1341年培里亚尔河洪水冲出新港，古老的香料穆济里斯港随之衰落，佩鲁姆巴达普统治者把都城迁到这座兴起的港口。阿拉伯、中国、犹太、叙利亚基督教和马拉雅拉姆商人在此交易胡椒等香料，中式吊网也成为水边常见的景象。1444年，科钦的印度教罗阇统治着这个说马拉雅拉姆语的贸易小国，但扩张中的卡利卡特扎莫林已夺去其属国，并从北方步步紧逼。

1500年12月24日，罗阇乌尼·戈达·瓦尔马迎接佩德罗·阿尔瓦雷斯·卡布拉尔，使科钦成为葡萄牙在这片海岸的第一个盟友。葡萄牙人1503年修建伊曼纽尔堡，城上炮火帮助科钦挺过1504年卡利卡特的围攻。瓦斯科·达·伽马1524年安葬于此，遗骨后来才运回葡萄牙；方济各·沙勿略1530年在此开辟拉丁礼仪传教区。1663年，荷兰舰队攻占科钦堡，开启科钦与荷兰东印度公司一个多世纪的同盟。1766年后的迈索尔入侵迫使科钦纳贡，1790年代英国势力取代荷兰；1814年《英荷条约》把科钦堡划归英国统治，科钦罗阇则保留其内陆土邦。

en:
Madurai stands on the banks of the Vaigai, in the heart of the Tamil country. For nearly two thousand years it was the seat of the Pandyas, patrons of the third Tamil Sangam, and the Meenakshi Temple drew pilgrims and merchants from across southern India. The Cholas held the city through much of the 9th to 13th centuries, until a revived Pandya line made it their capital again. Early in the 14th century armies of the Delhi Sultanate sacked it, and the governors they left behind broke away as the Sultans of Madurai, until the Vijayanagara prince Kumara Kampana overthrew their kingdom in 1378 and restored the temple. In 1444 Madurai is a southern governorship of Vijayanagara, a Tamil Hindu temple city living by weaving and the coastal trade.

In 1529 the emperor appointed Viswanatha Nayak governor of Madurai, and his line turned the office into the hereditary Nayak dynasty, ruling through the palaiyakkarar military chieftains and rebuilding the shrines the sultans had wrecked. Tirumala Nayak (r. 1623–1659) brought the court back to Madurai in 1635, raised the great Thirumalai Nayakkar Palace, ceased sending tribute to Vijayanagara and set the sultans of Golconda and Bijapur against the dying empire. From 1689 to 1704 the regent Rani Mangammal kept the peace, built roads and rest houses for pilgrims, and paid tribute to the Mughal armies besieging Gingee. After a bitter succession dispute the Arcot general Chanda Sahib made himself master of the kingdom, ending Nayak rule in 1736; the widowed queen Meenakshi died in captivity three years later. Madurai changed hands repeatedly during the Carnatic Wars, until the English East India Company annexed it to the Madras Presidency in 1801.
zh:
马杜赖坐落于泰米尔之地腹地的韦加伊河畔。近两千年间，这里是潘地亚王朝的都城，王室曾赞助第三届泰米尔桑伽姆，城中的米纳克希神庙吸引着南印度各地的香客与商人。9至13世纪的大部分时间里城市在朱罗王朝治下，其后复兴的潘地亚再次定都于此。14世纪初，德里苏丹国的军队洗劫了城市，留守的将领割据自立，建立马杜赖苏丹国；1378年，毗奢耶那伽罗王子库马拉·坎帕纳攻灭苏丹国，修复神庙。1444年的马杜赖是毗奢耶那伽罗南部的一处总督辖地，一座以纺织和沿海贸易为生的泰米尔印度教圣城。

1529年，皇帝任命维斯瓦纳特·纳亚克为马杜赖总督，他的后人将这一职位变成世袭的纳亚克王朝，通过受封的帕莱亚卡拉尔军事首领治理地方，并重修被苏丹军破坏的神殿。蒂鲁马拉·纳亚克（1623—1659年在位）1635年把宫廷迁回马杜赖，兴建宏伟的蒂鲁马拉·纳亚克宫，停止向毗奢耶那伽罗纳贡，并借戈尔孔达与比贾布尔苏丹国之力对抗走向末路的帝国。1689至1704年摄政的芒格玛尔女王维持境内安定，修筑道路和香客旅舍，并向围攻金吉的莫卧儿大军纳贡。此后继承之争激化，阿尔科特将领昌达·萨希卜趁机控制全国，于1736年终结纳亚克统治；守寡的米纳克希女王三年后死于囚禁之中。卡纳提克战争期间马杜赖几度易手，1801年被英国东印度公司并入马德拉斯管区。

en:
Venad stretched between the Western Ghats and the Arabian Sea, with its rulers seated at the old spice port of Quilon on Ashtamudi Lake. Arab, Persian, Chinese and Malayali merchants had long met there, and the Kollam roadstead was especially known for pepper. The principality emerged after the decline of the Chera kings, bowed at times to Pandya power, and Ravi Varma Kulasekhara carried its arms into the Tamil country around 1312-1316. In 1426 the Vijayanagara emperor Deva Raya II received tribute from the ruler of Kollam. In 1444, therefore, Venad was a Hindu, Malayalam-speaking coastal kingdom whose wealth came from Indian Ocean trade while its rulers balanced stronger empires beyond the Ghats.

Portuguese traders settled at Tangasseri in the early sixteenth century and built St Thomas Fort in 1517; in 1578 a Tamil Christian book, Thambiran Vanakkam, was printed at Quilon, the first book published in an Indian language. The Dutch East India Company took the town in 1661. The English East India Company opened a factory at Vizhinjam in 1664 and built Anjengo Fort in 1695, and resentment at the new English connection helped spark the Attingal attack of 1721. Marthanda Varma, ruling from 1729 to 1758, broke the power of the regional nobles and reshaped Venad into Travancore. British forces took Quilon in 1795, and in 1809 they defeated Velu Thampi Dalawa's rising at the Battle of Quilon.
zh:
韦纳德位于西高止山脉与阿拉伯海之间，统治者驻在阿什塔穆迪湖畔的古老香料港奎隆。阿拉伯、波斯、中国和马拉雅拉姆商人久已在此相会，奎隆锚地尤以胡椒闻名。这个王公邦在哲罗诸王衰落之后兴起，曾一度臣服潘地亚势力；拉维·瓦尔马·库拉谢卡拉约在1312年至1316年间率军攻入泰米尔地区。1426年，毗奢耶那伽罗皇帝德瓦·拉亚二世接受奎隆统治者纳贡。因此到1444年，韦纳德是一个印度教的马拉雅拉姆语海岸王国，财富来自印度洋贸易，统治者又必须周旋于西高止山以东的强国之间。

16世纪初，葡萄牙商人在坦加塞里定居，并于1517年修建圣多马堡；1578年，泰米尔语基督教著作《坦比兰·瓦纳卡姆》在奎隆印成，是第一本在印度以印度语言出版的书。1661年，荷兰东印度公司夺取此城。英国东印度公司1664年在维津詹姆设立商馆，1695年修建安金戈堡；对英国新关系的不满促成1721年的阿廷加尔袭击。1729年至1758年在位的玛尔坦达·瓦尔马打击地方贵族权力，把韦纳德改造为特拉凡哥尔。英军1795年占领奎隆，1809年又在奎隆战役击败韦卢·坦皮·达拉瓦的起事。

en:
Kongu is the upland country of western Tamilakam, where the Kaveri, Amaravati and Noyyal descend from the Ghats toward the Carnatic plain. Its chief town, Karur, was the ancient Karuvur, a Chera seat and market on the road from the Malabar port of Muziris through the Palghat Gap to Arikamedu. Cholas, Pandyas and Western Gangas disputed the region before Vijayanagara armies established their rule in the fifteenth century. In 1444 Kongu was a Tamil Hindu border country under Vijayanagara, held for its river crossings and the traffic between the two coasts.

As Vijayanagara's imperial authority weakened after 1646, Kongu passed into the orbit of the Madurai Nayaks and their palaiyam commanders, whose forts secured the roads and river crossings. In the eighteenth century the wars of Mysore carried that kingdom's frontier into the region, and Karur changed hands repeatedly. British forces took the town for the third time in 1790, used its fort as a garrison until 1801, and after Tipu Sultan's defeat attached the district to the Madras Presidency in 1799.
zh:
贡古是泰米尔故地西部的山乡，高韦里河、阿默拉沃蒂河和诺伊尔河从西高止山流向卡纳蒂克平原。首府卡鲁尔古称卡鲁武尔，曾是哲罗人的要地和市场，位于从马拉巴尔港口穆济里斯穿过帕尔加特山口通往阿里卡梅杜的商路上。朱罗、潘地亚和西恒伽王朝曾反复争夺此地，15世纪毗奢耶那伽罗军队确立统治。1444年的贡古是毗奢耶那伽罗治下的泰米尔印度教边地，价值在于各处渡口和连接两海岸的往来贸易。

1646年后毗奢耶那伽罗皇权衰弱，贡古转入马杜赖纳亚克及其帕莱亚姆将领的势力范围，他们修筑堡垒控制道路与渡口。18世纪，迈索尔的历次战争把王国边界推进到这一地区，卡鲁尔也多次易手。英军于1790年第三次攻占该城，并将堡垒用作驻军据点至1801年；提普苏丹战败后，该地区于1799年并入马德拉斯管辖区。

en:
Tondainadu is the northernmost plain of the Tamil country, a land of weaving villages and palm-fringed backwaters whose seaward gate is Pulicat, on the long sandspit dividing the Pulicat lagoon from the Bay of Bengal. Pallavas and Cholas ruled it in turn, and after the Pandya collapse the Madurai Sultans passed through before Vijayanagara's generals secured the region in the 1360s. In 1444 it is a prosperous Tamil province of Deva Raya II's empire, its cotton looms feeding the coastal trade, while the ambitious Gajapati kingdom of Odisha presses against the northern marches.

The storm broke under the weak Mallikarjuna Raya: Kapilendra Deva's Gajapatis poured south and took Udayagiri and Chandragiri in 1463, until Saluva Narasimha won the country back before seizing the Vijayanagara throne himself in 1485. In 1502 the Portuguese opened a trading post at Pulicat with imperial leave, and in 1609 the Dutch drove them out; Fort Geldria, the Dutch East India Company's first fort in India, rose in 1613. From 1616 to 1690 Pulicat was the capital of Dutch Coromandel, shipping cloth from more than a thousand looms and minting copper coins for the eastern trade. After the fall of Vijayanagara in 1646 the coast passed to Golconda and then to the Nawabs of Arcot. Famine scourged Pulicat in 1746, and the Carnatic Wars ended nearby with Coote's defeat of Lally at Wandiwash in 1760. British troops occupied the town in 1795 and blew up Fort Geldria in 1804.
zh:
通代纳杜（Tondaimandalam）是泰米尔之地最北端的平原，遍布织村与椰林环绕的潟湖，它面向大海的门户是布利格德（泰米尔语称帕扎韦尔卡杜），坐落在把布利格德潟湖与孟加拉湾隔开的长沙洲上。帕拉瓦王朝与朱罗王朝先后统治此地，潘地亚衰落后马杜赖苏丹国曾一度控制，14世纪60年代毗奢耶那伽罗的将领平定了这一地区。1444年，这里是德瓦·拉亚二世帝国治下富庶的泰米尔省份，棉织机供应着沿海贸易，而奥里萨雄心勃勃的加贾帕提王国正压迫着北方边境。

风暴在懦弱的马利卡朱纳·拉亚在位时到来：卡皮伦德拉·提婆的加贾帕提大军南下，1463年攻取乌德耶吉里和昌德拉吉里，最终萨卢瓦·纳拉辛哈收复故土，并于1485年登上毗奢耶那伽罗皇位。1502年，葡萄牙人经皇帝许可在布利格德设立商馆，1609年荷兰人将其逐出；荷兰东印度公司在印度的第一座堡垒海尔德兰堡于1613年落成。1616至1690年，布利格德是荷属科罗曼德的首府，外销上千架织机织出的布匹，并铸造铜币供应东方贸易。1646年毗奢耶那伽罗崩溃后，海岸先归戈尔孔达，后属阿尔科特的纳瓦布们。1746年饥荒重创布利格德，卡纳提克战争也在附近落幕——1760年库特在万迪瓦什击败拉利。1795年英军占领此城，1804年炸毁海尔德兰堡。

en:
Cuddalore is a Tamil roadstead on the Coromandel coast, where the Ponnaiyar and Kedilam rivers reach the sea through a maze of backwaters; a few miles up the coast lies Pondicherry. Roman merchants knew an emporium here as Poduke, and at Arikamedu their beads and wine jars have been dug up. Pallavas, Cholas and Pandyas held it before Vijayanagara, whose vassals, the Nayaks of Gingee, governed this coast by the 15th century. In 1444 it is a quiet line of fishing and weaving villages inside Deva Raya II's empire, its cloth already moving downriver to the harbour.

In 1608 Krishnappa Nayak of Gingee let the Dutch build at Devanampatnam, but Portuguese intrigue forced them to abandon the works. Bijapur's armies took Gingee in 1649, and Shivaji's Marathas seized it in 1677; in 1690 Rajaram, then besieged in Gingee by the Mughals, sold the coastal fort to the English, who named it Fort St David after the patron saint of Wales. Sixteen years earlier, in 1674, François Martin had founded French Pondicherry just up the shore, losing it to the Dutch in 1693 and winning it back in 1699. The rival settlements became the cockpit of the Carnatic Wars: Dupleix failed before Fort St David in 1747, Lally stormed it in 1758, and Eyre Coote retook it in 1760 after Wandiwash; Pondicherry fell on 16 January 1761 and was restored in 1763. A French garrison backed by Haidar Ali withstood the siege of 1783, and in 1785 Cuddalore passed finally to the British; Pondicherry was taken again in 1793 and returned to France in 1814.
zh:
古达罗尔（泰米尔语称库达卢鲁）是科罗曼德海岸上的泰米尔锚地，蓬奈亚尔河与凯迪拉姆河穿过纵横的潟湖在此入海；沿海岸北上不远便是本地治里。罗马商人早就知道此地有个叫波杜凯的商站，阿里卡梅杜还出土过他们的珠子和酒罐。帕拉瓦、朱罗、潘地亚先后据有此地，其后并入毗奢耶那伽罗，到15世纪时这片海岸由帝国的封臣金吉纳亚克治理。1444年，这里是德瓦·拉亚二世帝国境内一串宁静的渔村与织村，布匹已顺着水路运往港口。

1608年，金吉的克里什纳帕·纳亚克准许荷兰人在德瓦南帕特纳姆筑堡，却因葡萄牙人作梗而半途停工。比贾布尔的军队1649年攻下金吉，1677年希瓦吉的马拉塔人又取而得之；1690年，被莫卧儿大军困在金吉的拉贾拉姆把海边堡垒卖给英国人，后者以威尔士主保圣人之名称之为圣大卫堡。早在十六年前的1674年，弗朗索瓦·马丹已在北边不远建起法属本地治里，1693年被荷兰人夺走，1699年又收复。这两处对峙的商站此后成了卡纳提克战争的焦点：1747年杜布雷攻圣大卫堡不克，1758年拉利将其攻陷，1760年艾尔·库特在万迪瓦什大捷后将其收复；本地治里于1761年1月16日陷落，1763年归还法国。海德尔·阿里支持的法国守军顶住了1783年的围攻，1785年古达罗尔最终归英；本地治里则在1793年再被英军占领，1814年还给法国。

en:
Vijayanagara, the City of Victory, rose on the Tungabhadra around the ancient Shaiva pilgrimage ground of Hampi, whose Virupaksha temple had drawn worshippers for centuries. In 1336 the brothers Harihara I and Bukka, commanders of fallen Kampili, founded their capital there, by tradition under the sage Vidyaranya of Sringeri, and made it the bulwark against the Bahmani sultans. Under their Sangama line the city spread ring upon ring of walls and tanks along the granite gorge, and Niccolò de' Conti, visiting about 1420, reckoned its circuit at sixty miles. In 1444 Deva Raya II sat on the throne, the ablest of the Sangamas; his arms had reached Ceylon and made the kings of Pegu and Tenasserim tributaries, yet war with the Bahmanis had reopened in 1443 amid revolt at home, and the Persian envoy Abdur Razzak, sent by Shah Rukh, wrote of seven layers of fortification and bazaars crowded with merchants from every sea.

Deva Raya II died in 1446, and weak successors let it shrink until the general Saluva Narasimha took the crown in 1485; a coup in 1503 set up the Tuluva line. Under Krishna Deva Raya (1509–1529) Vijayanagara became perhaps the second city on earth after Beijing, with half a million people. He crushed Ismail Adil Shah of Bijapur at Raichur in 1520, raised the Vitthala and Krishna temples with pillared halls and towering gopurams, dammed streams to feed the city's tanks, and composed the Telugu poem Amuktamalyada. Domingo Paes, who came with the Goa traders in 1520, called it as large as Rome and the best-provided of cities. After his death coups and regents left real power with Rama Raya, whose meddling drew the Deccan sultanates together. At Talikota in January 1565 their cannon and two turncoat captains undid the Hindu host, and Rama Raya was beheaded on the field; the allies sacked and burned the capital for six months. The court fled to Penukonda, the Aravidu line died out by 1646, and two years after the fall the Italian Federici found only tigers in the empty houses. The ruins lay deserted until Colonel Colin Mackenzie's surveys brought them to light in the early 19th century.
zh:
毗奢耶那伽罗意为「胜利之城」，崛起于栋格珀德拉河畔、古老的湿婆朝圣地亨比——这里的维鲁帕克沙神庙已吸引信众数百年。1336年，亡国的坎皮利王国将领诃里诃罗一世与布卡兄弟在此奠都，相传得力于斯林格里圣人维迪亚兰雅的指点，并以此作为抵御北方巴赫曼尼苏丹国的屏障。在其桑伽马王朝治下，城市沿花岗岩峡谷层层展开城墙与蓄水池；约1420年到访的意大利人尼科洛·达·康提估算城周达六十英里。1444年在位的是桑伽马王朝最能干的德瓦·拉亚二世：他的兵锋远达锡兰，勃固与丹那沙林之王都向他称臣，但1443年与巴赫曼尼的战事因国内叛乱而重开，沙哈鲁派来的波斯使者阿卜杜勒·拉扎克看到的，是七层城墙环护、市集中各国商人摩肩接踵的都城。

1446年德瓦·拉亚二世去世，后继者孱弱，疆土日蹙，直到将领萨卢瓦·纳拉辛哈于1485年夺取王位；1503年又一次政变拥立图卢瓦王朝。在1509至1529年在位的克里希纳·德瓦·拉亚治下，毗奢耶那伽罗或许是仅次于北京的世界第二大城，人口约五十万：1520年他在赖丘尔击溃比贾布尔的伊斯梅尔·阿迪勒·沙阿，建起维塔拉神庙与克里希纳神庙的列柱大殿和高耸门楼，筑坝引水充盈城中蓄水池，还写下泰卢固语长诗《阿姆克塔马利亚达》。1520年随果阿商人到此的多明戈·派士称它与罗马等大，是世界上供给最充裕的城市。他死后政变频仍，大权落入拉马·拉亚之手，他对德干战事的插手促使苏丹们联起手来。1565年1月的塔里科塔之战，苏丹的火炮与两名倒戈将领击溃印度教大军，拉马·拉亚阵前被斩；联军进逼都城，焚掠达六个月之久。朝廷先逃奔佩努孔达，阿拉维杜王朝也在1646年前走向消亡；城破两年后，意大利人费代里奇发现空屋中只有老虎出没。直到19世纪初，麦肯齐上校的测绘才让峡谷中的废墟重见天日。

en:
Golconda stands on a granite rise west of Hyderabad, its Telugu name Golla Konda, the shepherd's hill, from the tale of a cowherd who unearthed a sacred idol there in 1143. The Kakatiya rajas of Warangal turned the shrine into a mud fort, and Ganapati Deva, who reigned from 1199 to 1262, placed a stone post on the hilltop to guard his western marches. Ulugh Khan took it with Warangal for the Tughluqs in 1323, and although the rebel chief Kapaya Nayaka recovered it in 1343, he ceded it to the Bahmani sultan Mohammed Shah in 1363. Under the Bahmanis the fort grew into the seat of the governor of Telangana, one of the four great provinces of the sultanate, and in 1444 its garrison watched over the eastern Telugu lands for the sultan.

In 1496 the Bahmani sultan made Sultan Quli, a Turkoman officer from Hamadan, governor of Telangana; he rebuilt the old earthworks as Muhammadnagar and in 1518, as the Bahmani kingdom fell apart, made himself the first Qutb Shahi sultan. Over three reigns and sixty-two years the mud fort became a granite citadel with walls five kilometres about, cladding the whole hill, while the Kollur diamond workings on the Krishna made Golconda the diamond market of the world: the great Golconda stones, traditionally including the Koh-i-Noor, were graded and sold under its vaults, and the city's name became a byword for treasure. Quli was murdered by his son Jamsheed in 1543; Jamsheed's death in 1550 opened a civil war that ended when the exile Ibrahim Quli was brought back to the throne, and in 1591 Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah laid out a new city at Hyderabad below the hill, with the Charminar at its heart. Shah Jahan forced Qutb Shahi vassalage on Golconda in 1636, and in 1687 Aurangzeb took the fort only after an eight-month siege, by bribery and treachery; the last sultan Abul Hasan spent the rest of his life captive at Daulatabad. Golconda became the chief stronghold of the Mughal Deccan, and in 1724 the viceroy Asaf Jah made himself the first Nizam of an independent Hyderabad; through 1821 the old citadel still guarded the Nizam's treasury.
zh:
戈尔孔达坐落在海得拉巴以西的花岗岩山冈上，泰卢固语名作戈拉孔达，意为「牧人山」——相传1143年一个牧童在山上掘出神像，因而得名。瓦朗加尔的卡卡提亚诸王把圣地修成土堡，1199至1262年在位的加纳帕蒂·提婆又在山顶设置石寨，守卫西部边疆。1323年，乌鲁格汗攻陷瓦朗加尔，土堡也归图格鲁克王朝；叛酋卡帕亚·纳亚卡1343年收复旧堡，却于1363年依约把它交给巴赫曼尼苏丹穆罕默德沙。在巴赫曼尼治下，此堡升为特伦甘纳总督的驻节地，是苏丹国四大行省之一；1444年，堡内驻军为苏丹镇抚东方的泰卢固之地。

1496年，巴赫曼尼苏丹任命来自哈马丹的土库曼将领苏丹·库利为特伦甘纳总督；他把旧土工重筑为「穆罕默德纳加尔」，1518年趁巴赫曼尼瓦解自立，成为库特布沙希王朝初代苏丹。历经三代、六十二年，土堡变成周长约五公里的花岗岩坚城，墙垣包住整座山；克里希纳河畔的科卢尔矿场更使戈尔孔达成为世界钻石贸易中心，戈尔孔达名钻（传统上包括「光明之山」）在此分级发售，城名也成了宝藏的代名词。1543年，库利被儿子贾姆希德所弑；贾姆希德1550年病死后爆发内战，流亡的易卜拉欣·库利被迎回复位；1591年，穆罕默德·库利·库特布沙在山下营建新都海得拉巴，查尔米纳尔门居于城心。1636年，沙贾汗迫使戈尔孔达称臣；1687年，奥朗则布围城八个月，终靠贿赂与内奸破城，末代苏丹阿布勒·哈桑被囚于道拉塔巴德了此余生。戈尔孔达成为莫卧儿德干的首要要塞；1724年，德干总督阿萨夫·贾自立为海得拉巴第一代尼扎姆，直到1821年，这座古堡仍为尼扎姆镇守府库。

en:
Velanadu is the fertile Telugu plain between the Krishna and Penna rivers; its seaward gate was Masulipatnam, the old Bandar at the Krishna mouth. Greek and Roman traders knew the anchorage as Maisolos or Masalia, and its muslins already travelled with Indian Ocean shipping. After the Kakatiya collapse, the Kondavidu Reddys made the hill fort west of the plain their capital, patronized Telugu poets and held the Krishna delta against rival Deccan powers. In 1444 Velanadu was therefore a Hindu Telugu country of rice villages, weavers and boatyards, while Kapilendra Deva's Gajapati Empire was pressing south toward its frontier.

The Kondavidu Reddy kingdom ended in 1448 and Velanadu passed under Gajapati rule; Bahmani forces invaded the Circars in 1471, and Krishnadevaraya of Vijayanagara took Kondavidu in 1516. Qutb Shahi armies conquered Guntur and Masulipatnam in 1541, completing their hold on the Northern Circars by 1571. Under Golconda, Bandar became the kingdom's chief sea port, shipping Godavari textiles, Kalamkari cloth and Krishna-valley diamonds; the English opened a factory in 1611 and the French in 1669. Aurangzeb's conquest of Golconda in 1687 drew the port into the Mughal Deccan. In the 1750s the French held the Northern Circars until Francis Forde besieged Masulipatnam from 6 March to 7 April 1759. The British kept the port, and the Nizam acknowledged their title to the Circars in the 1768 Treaty of Masulipatnam, with Guntur reserved until 1788.
zh:
贝拉纳杜是克里希纳河与彭纳河之间肥沃的泰卢固平原，通往大海的门户是克里希纳河口的默吉利伯德讷姆，波斯语称「班达尔」，意为港口。古希腊和罗马商人称这处锚地为迈索洛斯或马萨利亚，这里的平纹细布早已随印度洋商船外销。卡卡蒂亚王朝崩溃后，孔达维杜雷迪王朝以平原以西的山城为都，庇护泰卢固诗人，控制克里希纳三角洲与德干诸强抗衡。1444年的贝拉纳杜因此是印度教泰卢固人的土地，散布着稻米村、织户和船场；卡皮伦德拉·德瓦的加贾帕蒂帝国正向南扩张，边境已近在眼前。

孔达维杜雷迪王国于1448年终结，贝拉纳杜转入加贾帕蒂治下；1471年巴赫曼尼军队入侵西尔卡尔，1516年毗奢耶那伽罗的克里希纳德瓦拉亚攻占孔达维杜。1541年，库特布沙希军队征服贡土尔和默吉利伯德讷姆，到1571年完成对北西尔卡尔的控制。在戈尔康达治下，班达尔成为王国首要海港，输出戈达瓦里纺织品、卡拉姆卡里印花布和克里希纳河谷钻石；英国于1611年开设商馆，法国则于1669年设厂。1687年奥朗则布征服戈尔康达，港口并入莫卧儿德干。1750年代，法国人据有北西尔卡尔，直到弗朗西斯·福德在1759年3月6日至4月7日围攻默吉利伯德讷姆。英国人保留该港，尼扎姆又在1768年《默吉利伯德讷姆条约》中承认英国对西尔卡尔的权利，只有贡土尔保留至1788年。

en:
The valley of the Sina river, where Ahmadnagar now stands, was in 1444 the north-western march of the Bahmani sultanate, governed from Bidar and garrisoned around older settlements such as Bhingar and the great fortress of Daulatabad. The villages of the Desh were worked by Marathi-speaking Hindu peasants, their revenues passing through Deccani and Habshi officers of the Bahmani court. Half a century later the son of one such officer, governor of Junnar, would raise his capital on the battlefield of Bhingar.

Malik Ahmad, the Bahmani governor of Junnar, defeated the armies sent against him and declared independence on 28 May 1490, founding the Nizam Shahi dynasty. In 1494 he laid out a walled city on the Sina by the old site of Bhingar, naming it Ahmadnagar after himself, and in 1499 secured Daulatabad. His son Burhan, enthroned at the age of seven in 1510, later adopted Shi'a Islam. At Talikota in 1565 Sultan Hussain Nizam Shah led the confederacy of Deccan sultans that broke Vijayanagara and himself beheaded Rama Raya. Murtaza Nizam Shah annexed Berar in 1574 and repelled an invasion by Akbar in 1586. When the Mughals returned, Chand Bibi held the fort through the siege of 1595, but after she was killed in 1600 the city was stormed. Malik Ambar carried on the Nizam Shahi cause from his new city of Khadki until his death in 1626, and in 1636 Shah Jahan's son Aurangzeb annexed what remained. Aurangzeb himself died at Ahmadnagar in 1707 after twenty-six years campaigned in the Deccan. The town passed to the Maratha Peshwa in 1759 and to Daulat Rao Sindhia in 1795; a British force took it in 1803 and, after its return to the Marathas, the Treaty of Poona ceded it to the East India Company in 1817.
zh:
1444年，后来建起艾哈迈德讷格尔的锡纳河谷还是巴赫曼尼苏丹国的西北边疆，政令出自比达尔，兵马屯驻在宾加尔等旧聚落和道拉塔巴德要塞周围。德什地区的村庄由讲马拉地语的印度教农民耕种，赋税经巴赫曼尼朝中德干派与哈比舍人将领上缴。近半个世纪后，一位这样的将领之子——朱尼尔总督——将在宾加尔的战场上建起自己的都城。

朱尼尔的巴赫曼尼总督马利克·艾哈迈德接连击败前来征讨的大军，于1490年5月28日宣布独立，建立尼扎姆·沙希王朝。1494年，他在锡纳河畔的宾加尔旧址营建带城墙的新城，以自己的名字命名为艾哈迈德讷格尔，又于1499年取得道拉塔巴德。其子布尔汗1510年七岁继位，后来改宗什叶派伊斯兰教。1565年塔利科塔一役，侯赛因·尼扎姆沙统率德干诸苏丹联军击灭毗奢耶那伽罗，并亲手斩下拉马·拉亚。穆尔塔扎·尼扎姆沙1574年兼并贝拉尔，1586年击退阿克巴的入侵。莫卧儿大军再至时，昌德·比比据守要塞熬过1595年的围攻，但她1600年被杀后城池终被攻陷。马利克·安巴尔在新建的赫德基城继续扶立尼扎姆·沙希幼主，直至1626年去世；1636年，沙贾汗之子奥朗则布吞并残余疆土。奥朗则布本人在德干征战二十六年后，于1707年死在艾哈迈德讷格尔。此后城市于1759年转入马拉地佩什瓦之手，1795年归道拉特·拉奥·辛迪亚；1803年英军一度攻陷，归还马拉地人后，终依1817年《浦那条约》割让给东印度公司。

en:
Daulatabad, the 'city of fortune', crowns a sheer rock hill in the Marathwada uplands, where the caravan roads from Gujarat and northern India turn south into the Deccan. It began as Devagiri, the stronghold of the Yadava kings, who fortified the hill about 1187; Alauddin Khalji's armies raided it in 1296 and annexed it in 1308. Muhammad bin Tughluq renamed it Daulatabad and in 1327 dragged the population of Delhi south to make it his capital, only to abandon the experiment in 1334. It then passed to the Bahmani sultans, and in 1444 it was one of the great forts of their kingdom, a provincial command above Marathi-speaking farmland; the tower called Chand Minar would be raised there in 1445 to mark Ala-ud-din Ahmad Shah's victory over Vijayanagara.

In 1490 Malik Ahmad, the Bahmani governor of Junnar, broke away to found the Nizam Shahi sultanate of Ahmadnagar, and his men secured Daulatabad itself in 1499, after which it served the new dynasty as a second capital. When Akbar's armies broke into the Deccan and took Ahmadnagar city in 1600, the Habshi general Malik Ambar carried on the Nizam Shahi cause from a new capital he founded at Khadki nearby in 1610, wearing the Mughals down until his death in 1626. Imperial troops stormed Daulatabad hill in 1633 and annexed the sultanate in 1636, and in 1653 Prince Aurangzeb, viceroy of the Deccan, renamed Khadki as Aurangabad; from 1681 it housed his camp and court through the long wars against the Marathas. In 1724 the Mughal viceroy Asaf Jah made the city the first capital of the Hyderabad state he founded, and in 1760 Maratha forces stormed the old Yadava fort.
zh:
道拉塔巴德意为「幸运之城」，雄踞马拉特瓦达高地上一座陡峭的岩山，自古是古吉拉特与北印度商路折入德干南部的要冲。其前身为亚达瓦王朝的都城德瓦吉里，约1187年亚达瓦人开始在山上筑垒；1296年阿拉乌德丁·卡尔吉率军劫掠此地，1308年将其吞并。穆罕默德·本·图格鲁克将它改名道拉塔巴德，1327年强令德里居民南迁、定都于此，这场迁都试验却在1334年草草收场。此后它归入巴赫曼尼苏丹国；1444年时，它是苏丹国最重要的堡垒之一，作为行省重镇俯瞰着马拉塔人耕作的原野，1445年城中还将建起纪念阿拉乌德丁·艾哈迈德沙战胜毗奢耶那伽罗的月塔。

1490年，朱纳尔的巴赫曼尼总督马利克·艾哈迈德自立，开创艾哈迈德讷格尔的尼扎姆沙王朝，其部众1499年攻克道拉塔巴德，此后这里成为新王朝的第二都城。阿克巴的军队1600年攻入德干、拿下艾哈迈德讷格尔城后，阿比西尼亚裔将领马利克·安巴尔继续扛起尼扎姆沙的旗号，1610年在附近新建都城哈德基，以游击消耗战与莫卧儿周旋，直到1626年去世。1633年帝国军队攻克道拉塔巴德岩山，1636年正式吞并苏丹国；1653年，时任德干总督的奥朗则布将哈德基改名奥兰加巴德，1681年起更在此设营驻跸，支撑对马拉塔人的长期战争。1724年，莫卧儿德干总督阿萨夫·贾以该城为他所建海得拉巴国的最初都城；1760年，马拉塔军队攻克了这座亚达瓦古寨。

en:
East Berar is the open black-soil plain of the upper Wainganga and Kanhan rivers, the future Nagpur country, planted with cotton and girdled to the east by dense teak forests. Its forest forts, or garh, belonged to Gond rajas; Wairagarh had first been fortified centuries before by the Mana dynasty, whose line the Gonds overthrew. Since 1347 the sultans of the Bahmani line had administered Berar as a province from Gawilgarh and Ellichpur, but their officers seldom pressed far beyond the plain, and in 1444 the villages of the east paid tribute as much to the Gond strongholds in the hills as to the governor at Ellichpur.

The break-up of the Bahmani kingdom brought Fathullah Imad-ul-Mulk's Berar sultanate in 1490, and its absorption by Ahmadnagar in 1574; Chand Bibi ceded the country to Akbar's Mughals in 1596. The true lords of the eastern forest remained the Gond house of Deogarh, tributary to Delhi: in January 1637 its raja Kok Shah submitted to the Mughal general Khan-i-Dauran at the siege of Nagpur, and after a spell of direct rule Bakht Buland Shah restored Gond power and founded the city of Nagpur in 1702. His dynasty ended in 1743, when Raghoji I Bhonsle reduced the Gond raja to a pensioner and made Nagpur a Maratha capital.
zh:
东贝拉尔是韦恩根加河与卡南河上游开阔的黑土平原，即后来的那格浦尔一带，遍植棉花，东面环绕着茂密的柚木林。林中的堡寨（garh）归贡德酋长所有：瓦伊拉加尔最早是数百年前马纳王朝修筑的要塞，后来马纳王统被贡德人推翻。1347年起，巴赫曼尼王朝以加维尔加尔和埃利奇布尔为中心把贝拉尔作为一行省治理，但官吏很少深入平原之外，到1444年，东部村庄向山中贡德堡寨缴纳的贡赋不亚于交给埃利奇布尔省督的部分。

巴赫曼尼王国瓦解后，法图拉·伊马德-穆勒克于1490年建立贝拉尔苏丹国，1574年被艾哈迈德讷格尔吞并；1596年昌德·比比把这片土地割给阿克巴的莫卧儿。东部森林真正的主人仍是向德里称臣的代奥格尔贡德家族：1637年1月，其王科克·沙阿在那格浦尔围城战中向莫卧儿将领汗伊道兰投降；经过一段直接统治后，巴赫特·布兰德·沙阿恢复了贡德人的势力，于1702年建那格浦尔城。1743年，拉古吉·邦斯勒一世把贡德王降为领取年金者，以那格浦尔为马拉塔都城，这个王朝告终。

en:
Bastar lies in the forests of Dandakaranya, where the Indravati winds through sal woods and clearings farmed by Gondi and Halba communities. Its dynasty traditionally traced its origin to Annamadeva, a Kakatiya prince from Warangal who is said to have founded the kingdom about 1324 under the protection of the goddess Danteshwari. In 1444 Bhaitai Deva ruled from the old Bastar centre over a land rich in timber, lac, wax and honey, but isolated from the plains by hills, rivers and monsoon forest.

Later in the fifteenth century the Bastar realm split, with Kanker becoming a separate kingdom to the north. Purushottama Deva succeeded Bhaitai Deva in 1468 and ruled into the following century, while the forest roads preserved Bastar's autonomy from the Deccani sultanates. A succession crisis followed Rajapala Deva's death in 1721: Dalapati Deva fled to Jeypore and regained the throne only in 1731, after which Jagdalpur became the enduring seat of the court. Maratha power was then reshaping central India, but Bastar's rajas kept their dynasty and Danteshwari cult in the wooded country around the new capital.
zh:
巴斯塔尔位于丹达卡兰亚的丛林之中，因德拉瓦蒂河穿过萨尔树林，贡德人与哈尔巴人在林间隙地上耕作。当地王朝传统上把始祖追溯到阿南马提婆，据说他是来自瓦朗加尔的卡卡提耶王子，约1324年在丹特什瓦里女神的护佑下建立王国。1444年，巴伊塔伊·提婆以旧巴斯塔尔为中心统治此地；这里出产木材、紫胶、蜂蜡和蜂蜜，却也因山岭、河流和季风雨林而与平原世界相隔。

15世纪后期，巴斯塔尔疆域分裂，北部的坎凯尔成为独立王国。普鲁肖塔马·提婆1468年继位，统治延续至下一世纪；林间道路使巴斯塔尔没有落入德干诸苏丹国之手。1721年罗阇波罗·提婆去世后爆发继承危机，达拉帕蒂·提婆逃到杰伊布尔，直到1731年才夺回王位，此后贾格达尔普尔成为王朝长期驻地。此时马拉塔势力正在重塑中印度，但巴斯塔尔诸王仍在新都周围的林地中保有王朝和丹特什瓦里信仰。

en:
Ellichpur, as the old city of Achalpur was called under Muslim rule, was the chief city of Berar, set beneath the Satpura passes whose keys were the hill forts of Gawilgarh and Narnala. Named among the famous cities of the Deccan in the thirteenth century, it passed under Delhi's sultans after 1294 and to the Bahmanis in 1347; in 1425 Ahmad Shah Wali rebuilt Gawilgarh while encamped here. In 1444 Ellichpur was the seat of the Bahmani governor of Berar, a Muslim garrison town ringed by the cotton fields and villages of Maratha-speaking Hindu landholders.

In 1490 the governor Fathullah Imad-ul-Mulk, once a Kanarese Hindu boy carried off in war, made himself the first Imad Shah and kept Ellichpur as his capital, fortifying Gawilgarh and Narnala and annexing Mahur. His successors leaned on Gujarat and Bijapur against a hungry Ahmadnagar, but in 1574 Murtaza Nizam Shah I overran Berar, put the usurping minister Tufail Khan and the captive sultan Burhan Imad Shah to death, and annexed it. Chand Bibi surrendered Berar to Akbar in 1596, and from 1636 Ellichpur became the capital of the Mughal subah of Berar, with Gawilgarh as its citadel; the emperor Aurangzeb twice served there as viceroy of the Deccan. Maratha inroads opened the way to the Nizam, who took the province in 1724.
zh:
埃利奇布尔是贝拉尔的首城，即古城阿恰尔普尔在穆斯林统治时期的称呼，坐落在萨特普拉山脉诸隘口之下，扼守山口的是加维尔加尔和纳尔纳拉两座山堡。它在13世纪就被列为德干名城，1294年后臣服德里苏丹，1347年归入巴赫曼尼；1425年艾哈迈德·沙阿·瓦利在此驻营时重修了加维尔加尔堡。1444年的埃利奇布尔是巴赫曼尼贝拉尔省督的驻地、一座穆斯林驻军城镇，四周是说马拉地语的印度教地主的棉田和村庄。

1490年，省督法图拉·伊马德-穆勒克——他幼年本是卡纳拉印度教徒，在战争中被掳——自立为第一代伊马德·沙阿，仍以埃利奇布尔为都，加固加维尔加尔与纳尔纳拉，并吞并马胡尔。其后诸王借古吉拉特和比贾普尔之力抵挡虎视眈眈的艾哈迈德讷格尔，但1574年穆尔塔扎·尼扎姆·沙阿一世攻陷贝拉尔，处死擅权的大臣图费勒汗和被囚禁的苏丹布尔汉·伊马德·沙阿，将其吞并。1596年昌德·比比把贝拉尔献给阿克巴；1636年起埃利奇布尔成为莫卧儿贝拉尔苏巴的首府，加维尔加尔为其主堡，奥朗则布曾两度在此出任德干总督。马拉塔人的入侵为尼扎姆打开道路，后者于1724年取有此地。

en:
Kalingandhra is the Telugu-speaking southern end of Kalinga, the coastal corridor between the Eastern Ghats and the Bay of Bengal as it runs from Odisha toward the Godavari. The Eastern Ganga kings ruled the region until Kapilendra Deva displaced the last Ganga ruler in 1435 and founded the Gajapati Empire. In 1444 the future Vizianagaram country lay on that empire's southern march: Telugu cultivators and weavers occupied the coastal plain and river valleys, while hill chiefs and fortress lords answered to Gajapati governors and the Jagannath-centred court at Cuttack. It was a frontier held through forts rather than a single capital town.

Gajapati power weakened in wars with Vijayanagara, whose Krishnadevaraya subjugated Odisha in 1514, and Golconda's suzerainty reached the Northern Circars by 1571. After Aurangzeb annexed Golconda in 1687, Asaf Jah made the Deccan viceroyalty hereditary under the Nizam title in 1724. In 1711 Pusapati Vijayaram Raju broke from Jeypore, and Vizianagaram itself was founded in 1713, with its fort rising in those years. French influence grew under Bussy: the estate allied with France in 1754, and on 24 January 1757 a French and Vizianagaram army stormed Bobbili. Francis Forde's 1759 campaign took the Northern Circars from the French, and the Nizam acknowledged British title in 1768. When Vizianagaram resisted the new order, Company troops killed Vijayaram Raju II and broke its army at Padmanabham on 10 July 1794, reducing the rajas to tributary zamindars.
zh:
羯陵伽案达罗是羯陵伽的泰卢固语南缘，即东高止山脉与孟加拉湾之间、从奥里萨向戈达瓦里延伸的沿海走廊。东恒伽诸王曾统治此地；1435年，卡皮伦德拉·德瓦取代末代恒伽君主，建立加贾帕蒂帝国。1444年，未来的维济亚讷格勒姆一带正位于帝国南境：泰卢固农耕者和织户住在沿海平原与河谷，山地首领和堡主则听命于加贾帕蒂长官，以及以札格纳特崇拜为中心、驻在克塔克的朝廷。这里是依靠要塞维系的边疆，而不是由单一首府统辖的地区。

加贾帕蒂在与毗奢耶那伽罗的战争中衰落，克里希纳德瓦拉亚于1514年征服奥里萨；到1571年，戈尔康达的宗主权已延伸到北西尔卡尔。1687年奥朗则布吞并戈尔康达，1724年阿萨夫·贾使德干总督职位在尼扎姆名号下世袭。1711年，普萨帕蒂·维贾亚拉姆·拉朱脱离杰伊布尔；维济亚讷格勒姆本城则建于1713年，城堡也在这几年修筑。比西麾下的法国势力随之增长，1754年该土邦与法国结盟，1757年1月24日，法国与维济亚讷格勒姆联军猛攻博比利。1759年，弗朗西斯·福德的战役从法国手中夺取北西尔卡尔，尼扎姆于1768年承认英国的权利。维济亚讷格勒姆反抗新秩序时，公司军队于1794年7月10日在帕德马纳巴姆击毙维贾亚拉姆·拉朱二世并击溃其军，罗阇家族被降为纳贡的柴明达尔。

en:
Mahakoshal is the upper valley of the Narmada, a grain country of alluvial plains broken by sandstone hills, whose chief place was the old fort-town of Garha that gave the Garha kingdom its name. After the Kalachuri power of Tripuri declined, the Gond captain Jadurai, risen from service at the royal court, made himself master of Garha, and his descendants held the hill fort of Madan Mahal above the town. In 1444 the raja Kharji was enlarging his army, and Hindu, Gondi-speaking Garha was a growing power on the forested eastern flank of the Muslim sultanate of Malwa.

Garha's great age came with Sangram Shah, who from about 1480 carried its arms through the Narmada valley and over the Satpura hills, taking fifty-two forts and keeping a court that patronised Sanskrit letters; the Akbarnama reckoned his kingdom at 70,000 villages. His son's widow, the Chandela princess Durgavati, ruled as regent from 1550, digging tanks around Garha and routing an invasion by Baz Bahadur of Malwa. In 1564 Akbar sent Asaf Khan against her: outnumbered and outgunned, she stabbed herself after the battle of Narrai on 24 June. A tributary Gond line survived under Chandra Shah, but the realm shrank piece by piece until the Marathas made it tributary in 1742 and annexed it in 1781; the upper Narmada passed to the British East India Company in 1818.
zh:
马哈高沙尔即讷尔默达河上游河谷，是一片冲积平原与砂岩丘陵交错的谷物之乡，首邑便是为加哈王国得名的古城加哈。特里普里的卡拉楚里势力衰微之后，出身宫廷、渐掌大权的贡德酋长贾杜拉伊取而代之，成为加哈之主，他的后人世代镇守城后山上的马丹玛哈尔堡。1444年，国王卡尔吉正在扩充军备；此时的加哈信奉印度教、通行贡德语，是穆斯林摩腊婆苏丹国东侧山林里一个正在崛起的政权。

加哈的鼎盛之世随桑格拉姆沙阿而来：1480年前后，他兵锋遍及讷尔默达河谷与萨特普拉群山，连克五十二座堡垒，宫廷崇奉梵文学术，《阿克巴本纪》称其国有七万个村庄。他的儿媳、昌德拉王族出身的杜尔加瓦蒂自1550年起以太后摄政，在加哈一带广修池塘湖沼，并击退了摩腊婆巴兹·巴哈杜尔的入侵。1564年，阿克巴遣阿萨夫汗来攻；在寡不敌众、火器悬殊的纳尔赖之战中，王后于6月24日负伤后自刎殉国。此后贡德王统在旃陀罗沙阿治下以藩属身份延续，国土却日渐割裂，1742年沦为马拉塔人的纳贡之国，1781年被吞并，讷尔默达河上游最终于1818年归入英国东印度公司治下。

en:
Mandla lies in a great loop of the Narmada, which surrounds the town on three sides, in the forested hill country east of Garha. It belonged to the Gond rulers of Garha from the kingdom's earliest days: tradition preserved in an inscription at Ramnagar traced the dynasty to the adventurer Jadho Rai, and Ramnagar a short way down the river served with Mandla and Garha as one of the seats of the line. In 1444 it was still a forest chiefship on the eastern edge of the Garha realm, its hills yielding timber and its river ghats drawing pilgrims, for the Narmada is worshipped here as a holy river.

Sangram Shah's expansion after 1480 drew this country into the heart of his kingdom, and it became the dynasty's last refuge. When Asaf Khan invaded in 1564, Rani Durgavati made her stand in a narrow defile on the retreat towards Mandla and died there on 24 June; the Mughals carried off more than a thousand elephants, and Garha never recovered its strength. Hriday Shah, ruling as a Mughal tributary, moved his court from Chauragarh to Ramnagar, and in 1670 Mandla itself became the capital of the shrunken kingdom. The Maratha Peshwa invaded in 1742 and imposed tribute; the last Gond raja was deposed in 1781, Mandla passed to the Bhonsles of Nagpur in 1799, and in 1818 a British force under General Marshall stormed the riverside fort after its Maratha garrison refused to surrender.
zh:
曼德拉地处讷尔默达河的一个大河湾中，三面环水，位于加哈以东的山林地带。自有加哈王国起，这里便属于贡德诸王：拉姆纳加尔一处碑文所传的世系把王族始祖溯至冒险者贾杜·拉伊，而下游不远的拉姆纳加尔与曼德拉、加哈同为王朝的几处治所。1444年，这里仍是加哈东境的林间封地，山丘出产木材，河畔的渡口石阶吸引着朝圣者——讷尔默达河在此被奉为圣河。

1480年后桑格拉姆沙阿的扩张把这片土地纳入王国腹心，而它最终又成了王朝最后的避难所。1564年阿萨夫汗入侵，杜尔加瓦蒂在退往曼德拉途中的峡谷隘口力战，于6月24日殉难；莫卧儿人仅战象便掳走千余头，加哈从此一蹶不振。以藩臣身份事奉莫卧儿的赫里代沙阿把王廷从乔拉加尔迁往拉姆纳加尔，1670年，曼德拉本城成为这个已被削弱的王国的都城。1742年马拉塔佩什瓦来犯并强征贡赋，1781年末代贡德王被废，曼德拉于1799年转归那格浦尔的邦斯勒家族；1818年，马歇尔将军所部英军在马拉塔守军拒降之后，强攻拿下了这座河湾城堡。

en:
Cuttack grew as Kataka, the fort settlement at the head of the Mahanadi delta, with its old quarter pressed between the Mahanadi and Kathajodi rivers. The tenth-century Barabati Fort gave the town its name, and Anangabhima Deva III of the Eastern Ganga dynasty made the site his capital in 1211. In 1444 Kapilendra Deva's Suryavamsi Gajapati dynasty had ruled from Barabati for ten years, and Cuttack was the Hindu, Odia-speaking centre of a still powerful coastal kingdom. River craft linked the fort with Puri and the inland markets, while weavers sold cotton and silk cloth and craftsmen worked gold, silver and ivory filigree.

The independent Gajapati order ended in 1568, when Kalapahad, general of Sultan Sulaiman Khan Karrani of Bengal, defeated Mukunda Dev and occupied Cuttack. Afghan chiefs kept hold of the region after the Mughal victory at Rajmahal in 1576, but Raja Man Singh's campaign of 1590-1593 forced the evacuation of Cuttack in 1592 and brought Odisha into the Bengal Subah by 1593. Under Shah Jahan the city became the seat of a separate Orissa Subah. The Nagpur Bhonsles obtained Odisha in 1751, after which Cuttack served as their commercial link with Bengal. British forces took the city in 1803 during the Second Anglo-Maratha War, and in 1816 it became the capital of the British Orissa division.
zh:
克塔克古称卡塔卡，意为要塞，是在默哈讷迪河三角洲顶端发展起来的堡城，旧城夹在默哈讷迪河与卡塔焦迪河之间。10世纪的巴拉巴蒂堡赋予城市名字，东恒伽王朝的阿南加比马·德瓦三世又于1211年在此定都。1444年，卡皮伦德拉·德瓦创立的苏里耶瓦姆希·伽贾帕蒂王朝已在巴拉巴蒂统治十年，克塔克仍是一个强盛沿海王国的印度教、奥里亚语中心。河船把城堡与普里及内陆市集相连，织工出售棉布和丝绸，工匠则制作金、银与象牙累丝工艺品。

1568年，孟加拉苏丹苏莱曼·汗·卡拉尼的将领卡拉帕哈德击败穆昆达·德瓦并占领克塔克，独立的伽贾帕蒂秩序至此终结。1576年莫卧儿赢得拉杰马哈尔战役后，阿富汗首领仍控制这一地区；1590年至1593年，罗阇曼·辛格远征，1592年迫使守军撤出克塔克，到1593年奥里萨被并入孟加拉苏巴。沙贾汗时期，这座城市成为单独的奥里萨苏巴治所。1751年，那格浦尔的邦斯莱家族取得奥里萨，克塔克随之成为他们与孟加拉贸易往来的商业枢纽。1803年第二次英马拉塔战争期间，英军夺取该城；1816年，克塔克成为英属奥里萨专区的首府。

en:
Sambalpur lies on the Mahanadi where the forests of western Odisha open into the upper river valley, a country long called Hirakhand for its diamonds. Sabara and other forest peoples, Garjat strongholds and river traders met there. Ramai Deva overthrew the weakening Eastern Ganga administrator and founded Chauhan rule in the Patna kingdom in 1360. In 1444 Bhojaraj Deva ruled from Patna, and Sambalpur was not yet a separate state; its river crossing and Samalei shrine anchored a Garjat market for cloth and forest produce in a land later famed for diamond mines.

In 1540 the Patna kingdom was divided along the Ang River: Narasingh Deva kept Patna, while his brother Balarama Deva took the northern Huma tract, established forts at Nuagarh and Bargarh, and then made Sambalpur his capital. His Chauhan successors built Hirakhand into a regional power with Garjat chieftains as vassals, and local weavers developed the cloth later known as Sambalpuri. In the seventeenth century Jean-Baptiste Tavernier reported 8,000 people working the dry-season diamond mines around Sumelpur. The Nagpur Bhonsles imposed their rule in 1800 and occupied Sambalpur between 1808 and 1817. After the Third Anglo-Maratha War, the British restored Jayant Singh in 1817 but detached the Garjat vassal states; British administration lasted from 1818 to 1820, when the Chauhan raja returned under protection.
zh:
萨姆巴尔普尔（今通译森伯尔布尔）位于默哈讷迪河畔，西奥迪沙的森林在此展开为上游河谷；这一地区古称希拉坎德，因钻石得名。萨巴拉等森林族群、迦贾德堡寨和河上商人在此往来。1360年，拉迈·德瓦推翻日渐衰弱的东恒伽王朝地方长官，在巴特那建立乔汉家族统治。1444年，波杰拉杰·德瓦以巴特那为治所，萨姆巴尔普尔尚未成为独立邦国；但凭借渡口和萨玛莱女神祠，这里已是上默哈讷迪一处交易布匹与山林物产的迦贾德市镇，周围土地后来更以钻石矿闻名。

1540年，巴特那王国沿昂河分裂：纳拉辛哈·德瓦保留巴特那，其弟巴拉罗摩·德瓦取得北方的胡马地区，先在努阿加尔和巴尔加尔设立堡寨，随后定都萨姆巴尔普尔。他的乔汉后裔把希拉坎德建成区域性强国，迦贾德诸首领成为附庸，本地织工也发展出后来所称的萨姆巴尔普里织物。17世纪，让-巴蒂斯特·塔韦尼耶记载，苏梅尔普尔周边旱季有八千人开采钻石。1800年，那格浦尔的邦斯莱家族确立统治，并在1808年至1817年间实际占领萨姆巴尔普尔。第三次英马拉塔战争后，英国于1817年恢复贾扬特·辛格的王位，却剥离了迦贾德附庸诸邦；1818年至1820年由英国直接管理，1820年乔汉王公在英国保护下复位。

en:
Jumla lies high in the Karnali basin, whose Sinja valley was the heart of the old Khasa kingdom of the 11th to 13th centuries; the Khas speech of Sinja is the parent tongue of Nepali. When the Khasa realm broke apart, its lands split into the Baisi Rajya, the 'twenty-two kingdoms' of the Karnali and Bheri hills, and Jumla grew into the strongest of them. Around 1404 Baliraja of the Kalyal line married the daughter and heiress of the last Malla raja of the Yatse kingdom and succeeded to his lands. In 1444 the aged Baliraja still ruled from Jumla, first among the fractious twenty-two.

His successors waged hill war for three centuries, and under Bhanashahi, who reigned from about 1529, Jumla was the dominant power of western Nepal. In 1760 its forces crossed the high passes and seized the trans-Himalayan kingdom of Mustang. Jumla beat off the first Gorkha attack, and legend says Prithvi Narayan Shah himself was wounded in the fighting; but in 1789 the regent Bahadur Shah sent Kaji Shiva Narayan Khatri at the head of the combined hill-state levies and annexed the kingdom. In Jumla's great days its sway had run from Mustang to the Kumaon border, and in 1816 the lands west of the Mahakali were lost to the East India Company.
zh:
久姆拉雄踞格尔纳利盆地高处，境内的辛贾河谷是11至13世纪古老卡萨王国的心脏；辛贾的卡萨语正是尼泊尔语的母语。卡萨王国瓦解后，故土分裂为格尔纳利河与贝里河山区的「二十二王国」，即拜西拉贾，久姆拉逐渐成为其中最强的一个。约1404年，迦利耶尔世系的巴利拉贾娶了雅特瑟（末罗）王国末代罗阇的女儿兼继承人，接管了其国土。1444年，年迈的巴利拉贾仍在久姆拉执政，是纷争不断的二十二邦之长。

此后三个世纪里，后继诸王征战于群山之间；约1529年即位的巴那沙希治下，久姆拉成为尼泊尔西部的霸主。1760年，其军队翻越高山口，夺取了喜马拉雅山以北的穆斯塘王国。久姆拉击退了廓尔喀人的第一次进攻，传说普里特维·纳拉扬·沙阿本人都在战斗中负伤；但1789年，摄政巴哈杜尔·沙阿遣卡吉·湿婆·纳拉扬·卡特里率各山邦联军攻来，吞并了这个王国。久姆拉强盛时势力东起穆斯塘、西抵库毛恩边界，1816年，马哈卡利河以西的土地被东印度公司攫取。

en:
Jaunpur stands on a bend of the Gomti, the city Firuz Shah Tughlaq founded and named for his cousin Jauna Khan, better known as Muhammad bin Tughluq. In 1394 its governor Malik Sarwar took the title Malik us-Sharq and, as the Delhi Sultanate crumbled after Timur's invasion, made himself independent, founding the Sharqi dynasty. Under Ibrahim Shah (1402–1440) the sultanate stretched from Kanauj to Bihar, and Jaunpur, endowed with colleges and with mosques in a distinctive Hindu-Muslim style, was called the Shiraz of the East. In 1444 the throne belongs to Mahmud Shah Sharqi, and the sultanate is one of the great Muslim powers of the Ganges plain, facing a revived Delhi under the Afghan Lodis.

In 1452 Mahmud Shah marched on Delhi and was routed by Bahlul Lodi. His brother Husain Shah, ruling from 1458, three times set out to take Delhi, and three times Bahlul broke his armies; in 1486 the Lodis set Bahlul's son Barbak Shah on Jaunpur's throne, and Husain ended his days in exile in Bihar in 1505. The Atala, Jama and Lal Darwaza mosques survived the dynasty's fall. The poet Malik Muhammad Jaisi made his home in the town and there wrote his Hindi romance Padmavat. After the Mughal conquest the great stone bridge over the Gomti, built by order of Akbar, was completed in 1564 and has carried the town's traffic ever since.
zh:
章普尔坐落在戈马蒂河的一处河湾，菲鲁兹沙·图格鲁克建城时，以其表兄焦纳汗——即后来的穆罕默德·本·图格鲁克——的名字命名。1394年，总督马利克·萨尔瓦尔受封「马利克·乌什·沙尔格」之号，趁帖木儿入侵后德里苏丹国瓦解之机自立，开创沙尔吉王朝。易卜拉欣沙在位时（1402—1440年），苏丹国疆域西起卡瑙季、东抵比哈尔；章普尔广建经学院和清真寺，融印度教与伊斯兰教风格于一体，被誉为「东方的设拉子」。1444年在位的是马哈茂德沙·沙尔吉，章普尔苏丹国仍是恒河平原上的穆斯林强国之一，与阿富汗洛迪人复兴的德里东西对峙。

1452年，马哈茂德沙进军德里，被巴赫卢勒·洛迪击溃。其弟胡赛因沙1458年即位后三度攻打德里，三次都败在巴赫卢勒手下；1486年，洛迪人把巴赫卢勒之子巴尔巴克沙扶上章普尔王位，胡赛因最终流亡比哈尔，1505年死于当地。阿塔拉清真寺、聚礼清真寺和拉尔门清真寺都在亡国后留存下来。诗人马利克·穆罕默德·贾伊西曾在城中居住，并在此写成印地语叙事长诗《莲花公主传》。莫卧儿征服后，奉阿克巴之命修建的戈马蒂河大石桥于1564年落成，此后一直承担着城里的交通。

en:
The Lower Doab is the bottom of the wedge between the Ganges and the Yamuna, where the two rivers meet at Prayag, the Triveni Sangam — the foremost of Hindu confluence pilgrimages, where the Ganges is joined by the Yamuna and, by tradition, the unseen Sarasvati. A great city stood here in the seventh century, when Xuanzang watched pilgrims bathe at the meeting of the waters and kings give away their wealth at the alms-ground; later the river shifted, the city sank into its sands, and the tract was governed from the river-fortresses of Kara and Manikpur above the confluence. The Sharqi sultans of Jaunpur held Kara and the Lower Doab among their dominions. Thus in 1444 Prayag is above all a pilgrimage ground, its Magh fairs drawing hosts of bathers to the sangam under the eyes of the sultan's officers, while the river quays are busy with grain and cloth moving between Bengal, Delhi and the Deccan.

In 1558–59 Akbar's commanders subdued the last Afghan chiefs of Jaunpur, and on 13 November 1583 Akbar himself came to the confluence, laid out the city of Ilahabas, soon called Allahabad, and built the great fort that commands the meeting of the rivers; the new town became the seat of a Mughal subah. Here, in May 1602, the rebel Prince Salim had the khutba read in his own name and struck coin as an independent ruler. In 1624 his son Prince Khurram, then in revolt against Jahangir, besieged the fort in vain, and in January 1659 its commandant surrendered it to Aurangzeb's officers during the war against Shah Shuja. After Buxar the Treaty of Allahabad was concluded within the fort in 1765, when Clive, Shuja-ud-Daulah and the emperor Shah Alam II settled the revenues of Bengal, Bihar and Orissa on the East India Company; Shah Alam himself dwelt in the fort under British guard until 1771. Restored to the Nawabs of Awadh, the fort was handed to the Company in 1798 and the Lower Doab was formally ceded in 1801, making Allahabad the British stronghold of the middle Ganges.
zh:
下河间地是恒河与亚穆纳河之间楔形地带的下段，两河在普拉亚格交汇，是为特里韦尼桑加姆——印度教最负盛名的河口圣地：恒河与亚穆纳河在此相汇，传说还有肉眼不可见的萨拉斯瓦蒂河同流。7世纪时这里曾矗立着一座大城，玄奘目睹香客在河口沐浴、国王在布施场倾财施舍；后来河道改徙，城池没入流沙，这一带遂由汇流口上游的卡拉与曼尼克布尔两座临河要塞管辖。章普尔的沙尔基苏丹将卡拉和下河间地纳入版图。因此，1444年的普拉亚格首先是一处朝圣之地，摩伽庙会把成群的沐浴者吸引到河口，一切都在苏丹官吏的注视之下；河边码头上谷物与布匹往来繁忙，连通着孟加拉、德里与德干。

1558至1559年，阿克巴的将领攻灭章普尔残余的阿富汗势力；1583年11月13日，阿克巴亲临汇流口，规划伊拉哈巴斯城（不久改称安拉阿巴德），并修筑扼守两河交汇处的宏大城堡，新城成为一个莫卧儿苏巴的治所。1602年5月，反叛的萨利姆王子正是在此以自己的名义诵读呼图白、铸造钱币，形同独立君主。1624年，其子库拉姆王子起兵反对贾汉吉尔，围攻此堡却徒劳无功；1659年1月，在与沙舒贾的王位战争中，城堡守将向奥朗则布的将领献城。布克萨尔战役后，克莱武、舒贾—乌德—道拉与皇帝沙阿拉姆二世于1765年在堡内签订《安拉阿巴德条约》，把孟加拉、比哈尔和奥里萨的税收权授予东印度公司，沙阿拉姆本人也在英军看守下住在堡中，直到1771年离开。安拉阿巴德重归阿瓦德纳瓦卜后，城堡于1798年交给公司，下河间地则在1801年正式割让，安拉阿巴德由此成为英国在恒河中游的要塞。

en:
The Kathmandu valley is a high green bowl between the Himalaya and the middle hills, its three walled Newar towns — Kathmandu, Patan and Bhaktapur — strung along an old trade road. Licchavi kings ruled it from the fourth century, when it was already the halfway mart between the plains and Tibet: Newar caravans carried cloth and metalware north and brought back musk, herbs and incense, and Nepali coinage became the currency of trans-Himalayan trade. An earthquake in 1255 killed perhaps a third of the population, and a raid by Shamsuddin Ilyas Shah of Bengal in 1345 and 1346 sacked the shrines, but Jayasthiti Malla, reigning from 1382 to 1395, reunited the valley and codified its laws. In 1444 his grandson Yaksha Malla rules a still-united Nepal Mandala, a Hindu king over Buddhist and Hindu Newars, while Pashupatinath and Swayambhunath draw pilgrims and the merchants of Kantipur grow rich on the Tibet road.

When Yaksha Malla died in 1482 his sons split the valley between Kantipur, Patan and Bhaktapur, and the three courts spent three centuries outbuilding one another in pagodas, ponds and durbar squares. Pratap Malla of Kantipur, who reigned from 1641 to 1674, monopolised the Tibet trade, wrote Newar poetry and gave Kathmandu's Durbar Square most of its monuments; he welcomed Jesuit priests in 1670, and a Capuchin mission followed in 1715. The rivalry undid the Mallas: Prithvi Narayan Shah of Gorkha took Kirtipur in 1767 and, on the night of the Indra Jatra festival in September 1768, entered Kathmandu almost unopposed; Bhaktapur fell the next year, and the Gorkha kings made the city the capital of their newly unified hill realm of Nepal. Its armies fought the Qing in Tibet in 1788 to 1792 and the East India Company in 1814 to 1816, the latter war ending in the Treaty of Sugauli, which fixed the Himalayan frontier.
zh:
加德满都谷地是喜马拉雅山脉与中部丘陵之间一只苍翠的高谷盆，加德满都、帕坦、巴克塔普尔三座有城墙的尼瓦尔城镇沿着一条古道展开。4世纪起李查维王朝统治此地，那时它已是印度平原与西藏之间的中途商埠：尼瓦尔商队北运布匹与金属器皿，带回麝香、药材和熏香，尼泊尔铸币成为跨喜马拉雅贸易的通货。1255年的大地震夺走约三分之一人口，1345至1346年孟加拉的沙姆苏丁·伊利亚斯·沙阿入寇、劫掠神庙；1382至1395年在位的贾亚斯提·马拉重新统一谷地并编订法典。1444年，其孙亚克沙·马拉仍统治着统一的尼泊尔曼陀罗，作为印度教君王君临兼奉佛教与印度教的尼瓦尔人；帕苏帕提那特与斯瓦扬布纳特吸引着香客，坎蒂普尔的商人靠西藏商路致富。

1482年亚克沙·马拉去世，诸子将谷地分为坎蒂普尔、帕坦、巴克塔普尔三国，此后三个世纪，三家宫廷竞相修筑塔式神庙、水池与王宫广场。坎蒂普尔的普拉塔普·马拉1641至1674年在位，垄断对藏贸易，以尼瓦尔语作诗，加德满都王宫广场的大部分建筑都建于他的时代；他还在1670年接纳耶稣会士，1715年嘉布遣会传教站随之设立。列国相争终结了马拉王朝：廓尔喀的普里特维·纳拉扬·沙阿1767年攻下基尔蒂普尔，1768年9月因陀罗节之夜几乎兵不血刃进入加德满都，次年巴克塔普尔陷落；廓尔喀诸王以此城为新统一的山地王国尼泊尔的首都。此后其军队1788至1792年在西藏与清朝交战，1814至1816年又与东印度公司开战，后者以《苏高利条约》划定了喜马拉雅山麓的边界。

en:
On a broad reach of the Ganges, where the Son and Gandak come in, Patna occupies the site of Pataliputra, founded around 490 BCE as a Magadhan fortress. As the capital of the Mauryas and Guptas it was one of the greatest cities of the early world: Megasthenes described its long timber walls, and Aryabhata worked here. After the Gupta collapse the city faded, and the raids of Bakhtiyar Khalji around 1200 overthrew the Buddhist monasteries of Bihar. The country passed to the sultans of Delhi and then, in the fifteenth century, to the Sharqi rulers of Jaunpur, who held Bihar as their eastern province. In 1444 Mahmud Shah Sharqi reigned in Jaunpur, while Patna itself, already known for its river-borne paper and rice, was only a dim successor to Pataliputra.

The Sharqis fell to Bahlul Lodi in 1494, and Lodi governors parcelled Bihar into Afghan jagirs, including Sasaram, seat of the Sur family. Sher Shah made himself master of Bihar by 1530, routed Humayun at Chausa on the Ganges in June 1539, and after taking Delhi rebuilt the ancient site as Patna, with a fort and a congregational mosque. Akbar marched here in person in 1574 to break Daud Khan Karrani, the last Afghan chief of Bihar, and Abul Fazl found a flourishing centre of paper, glass and the long-grained Patna rice shipped to Europe. The English opened a factory in 1620, and Patna grew richest of all on saltpetre; in 1632 Peter Mundy called it the greatest mart of the eastern regions. The tenth Sikh Guru, Gobind Singh, was born here in 1666, and in 1704 Aurangzeb allowed his grandson to rename the town Azimabad. Nawab Mir Qasim had his English prisoners killed here in 1763, but defeat at Buxar in 1764 transferred Bihar's revenues to the East India Company, which took direct charge in 1793.
zh:
巴特那地处恒河的宽阔河段，宋河与甘达克河在此汇入，其地古称巴连弗邑，约公元前490年由摩揭陀国王阿阇世筑为要塞。孔雀、笈多两朝均以此为都，曾是古代世界最宏大的城市之一：麦加斯梯尼记述过它绵长的木栅城墙，阿耶波多也曾在此治学。笈多衰落后城市凋敝，1200年前后巴赫蒂亚尔·卡尔吉的入侵摧毁了比哈尔的佛教寺院群。这一带先归德里苏丹，15世纪时转入章普尔沙尔基王朝之手，比哈尔是其东部行省。1444年，马哈茂德·沙·沙尔基在章普尔在位，而此时的巴特那虽已凭河运纸张和稻米闻名，却只是巴连弗邑昔日荣光的黯淡余响。

沙尔基王朝于1494年被巴赫鲁尔·洛迪攻灭，洛迪任命的总督把比哈尔分封给阿富汗封建主，舍尔沙出身的苏尔家族得到了萨萨拉姆。舍尔沙到1530年已成为比哈尔的实际主宰，1539年6月在恒河畔的恰乌萨击溃胡马雍，夺取德里后在古城旧址上重建巴特那，筑起城堡和聚礼清真寺。1574年，阿克巴亲征至此，攻灭比哈尔最后一位阿富汗首领达乌德·汗·卡拉尼；阿布勒·法兹勒见到的巴特那以造纸、玻璃和远销欧洲的长粒巴特那米著称。英国人1620年在此设立商馆，巴特那尤其靠硝石贸易致富，1632年彼得·蒙迪称它为东方最繁盛的商埠。锡克教第十代祖师戈宾德·辛格1666年生于此城；1704年，奥朗则布应皇孙阿齐姆之请，把城市改名为阿济姆阿巴德。1763年，纳瓦卜米尔·卡西姆在此处死被囚的英国人，但1764年布克萨尔战败后，比哈尔的税收权转入东印度公司之手，公司又于1793年直接接管此地。

en:
Jhansi stands between the rivers Pahuj and Betwa at the southern edge of the Gangetic plain, the gateway into the hilly Bundela country. Rajput Khangars had earlier ruled these parts from Garh Kundar, until Bundela clans overshadowed them in the fourteenth century. By the fifteenth century the tract around the forested Bangra hill belonged to the Muslim kingdom of Kalpi, down on the Yamuna; when Mahmud Shah of Jaunpur invaded in 1443, Mahmud Khalji of Malwa marched to Kalpi's defence, and the peace of 1444 left this border country under Malwa's sway. There was as yet no town of Jhansi, only jungle and grazing grounds.

The Kalpi kingdom's lands were absorbed by Bahlul Lodi of Delhi in 1484, and in the next century the Bundela chief Rudra Pratap Singh founded Orchha, down the Betwa, in 1531. The Orchha raja Bir Singh Deo built Jhansi Fort on Bangra hill in 1613, and a town called Balwantnagar grew beneath it; after the ruin of his son Jhujhar Singh it passed to the Mughals. Chhatrasal of Bundelkhand seized it in 1722, lost it to Muhammad Khan Bangash in 1728 and won it back with Maratha help, bequeathing Jhansi to the Peshwa Baji Rao in 1731. From 1742 the Maratha governor Naru Shankar enlarged the fort and settled the town, many of the newcomers coming from declining Orchha. Shuja-ud-Daula of Awadh took it after a siege on 1 February 1762, but Malhar Rao Holkar restored Maratha rule four years later. Under Raghunath Rao Newalkar a Mughal army was beaten outside Jhansi in 1773, and the Newalkars made the town their capital; his brother Sheo Rao raised the city walls between 1796 and 1814, signed a treaty with the British in 1804, and in 1817 Jhansi passed under British paramountcy.
zh:
占西地处帕胡杰河与贝德瓦河之间、恒河平原南缘，是进入本德拉丘陵地带的门户。拉杰普特人的坎加尔族早先以加尔昆达尔堡为据点统治这一带，14世纪以后被本德拉诸部压倒。到15世纪，林木覆盖的班格拉山周围这片土地属于亚穆纳河下游的穆斯林政权迦尔毗王国；1443年江布尔的马哈茂德沙阿入侵时，马尔瓦的马哈茂德·哈尔吉出兵相救，1444年的和议使这片边地转入马尔瓦势力之下。此时还没有占西城，此地只有丛林和牧场。

迦尔毗王国的土地于1484年被德里的巴赫卢勒·洛迪兼并。进入下一个世纪，本德拉首领鲁德拉·普拉塔普·辛格于1531年在贝德瓦河下游建立奥尔查；奥尔查罗阇比尔·辛格·德奥1613年在班格拉山上修筑占西堡，山下兴起名为巴尔万特纳格尔的城镇，他的儿子朱杰哈尔·辛格败亡后，城镇归于莫卧儿。本德尔肯德的查特拉萨尔1722年夺取此地，1728年败于穆罕默德·汗·班加什，又借马拉塔之力收复，1731年临终时将占西赠予佩什瓦巴吉·拉奥。1742年起，马拉塔总督纳鲁·尚卡尔扩建堡垒、招徕居民，许多新来者出自正趋衰落的奥尔查。阿瓦德纳瓦布舒贾-乌德-道拉围城后于1762年2月1日攻占占西，但四年后马尔哈尔·拉奥·霍尔卡便恢复了马拉塔的统治。拉古纳特·拉奥·纽瓦尔卡任内，一支莫卧儿军队于1773年在占西城外被击败，纽瓦尔卡家族随后以这座城镇为都；其弟谢奥·拉奥在1796至1814年间修筑城墙，1804年与英国人缔约，1817年占西转归英国最高统治之下。

en:
The Koel and the Son water the forested hills of Palamu, the north-western edge of the Jharkhand plateau. In the twelfth century the Khayaravala dynasty ruled its Japila tract, and after the Pala empire fell, Chero chieftains spread over southern Bihar until the Ujjainiya Rajputs drove them back into these woods. In the 1400s the land belonged to the Raksel Rajputs, who had reached it by way of Rohtasgarh and held the old fort on the Koel; walled in by sal jungle, Palamu paid tribute to no sultan of Jaunpur or Bengal. Its forests yielded elephants, timber and iron, and the plains to the north offered easy plunder.

In the 1530s Sher Shah Suri sent Khawas Khan against the Chero raider Maharata Chero, but the Battle of Chausa cut the campaign short. Around the turn of the seventeenth century Bhagwant Rai, a Chero who had taken service with the Raksel raja Man Singh, overthrew his masters and founded Chero rule in Palamu. Akbar's commander Man Singh invaded in the 1590s and carried off fifty-four elephants, yet the Cheros drove out the Mughal garrison when Akbar died. Medini Ray, the strongest of the line, rebuilt the two forts of Palamu and led his armies south to sack the Nagvanshi capital at Navratangarh. Tribute wars followed: the expeditions of 1641–1643 under Shaista Khan made the Cheros pay, and in 1660 Daud Khan forced his way through the jungle and stormed Palamu fort; from 1666 the country was administered through the Mughal subedar of Bihar. Mughal armies returned in 1720 and 1740, the Marathas of Raghoji Bhonsle crossed it on their way to raid Midnapore, and in 1800 British troops crushed the Chero insurrection and ended the dynasty's power.
zh:
科埃尔河与松河浇灌着帕拉毛的丛林丘陵，这里是贾坎德高原的西北缘。12世纪时，喀亚拉瓦拉王朝统治过当地的贾皮拉地区；波罗帝国崩溃后，切罗酋长们在南比哈尔广建小邦，最终被乌贾因尼亚拉杰普特人逐回这片山林。15世纪时，帕拉毛属于经罗赫塔斯加尔迁来的拉克塞尔拉杰普特人，他们据有科埃尔河畔的旧堡；娑罗双林如高墙环绕，江布尔和孟加拉的苏丹都未能迫使其纳贡。林中出产大象、木材和铁矿，北面的平原则是现成的劫掠之地。

1530年代，舍尔沙·苏利派部将哈瓦斯汗征讨四处劫掠的切罗首领默赫尔达·切罗，却因乔恩萨之战半途而废。17世纪初前后，曾效力于拉克塞尔首领曼·辛格的切罗人巴格万特·拉伊弑主夺权，开创了帕拉毛的切罗政权。阿克巴的大将曼·辛格1590年代入侵，掳走五十四头大象，但阿克巴一死，切罗人便赶走了莫卧儿驻军。王朝最强者梅迪尼·拉伊重修帕拉毛的两座堡垒，并挥师南下洗劫那格万什人的都城纳夫拉坦加尔。此后是连绵的贡赋之战：1641至1643年沙伊斯塔汗的远征迫使切罗人纳贡，1660年达乌德汗穿林而入攻克帕拉毛堡，1666年起该地由莫卧儿的比哈尔总督统辖。莫卧儿军队1720年和1740年两度再来，拉戈吉·邦斯勒的马拉塔人也曾过境前往米德纳布尔劫掠；1800年，英军镇压切罗起义，终结了这个王朝的统治。

en:
The Bhagirathi takes the name Hooghly as it turns south through the Ganges delta. On the west bank, Bator stood by Shibpur in Howrah as a market and anchorage below Satgaon; across the water lay the villages of Kalikata, Sutanuti and Gobindapur, with Salkia beside Bator. The Howrah and Hooghly countryside belonged to the medieval Hindu realm of Bhurshut. In 1444 these river marts were part of the Bengal Sultanate ruled by Nasiruddin Mahmud Shah of the restored Ilyas Shahi line, their Bengali Hindu traders and landholders living under a Muslim court that drew wealth from the delta's textiles, rice and shipping.

Bipradas Pipilai, writing in 1495, described Bator as a provisioning stop for travellers; in the 1570s Cesare Federici noted large ships anchoring there because the river grew shallow upstream. After Akbar's armies defeated Daud Khan Karrani in 1576, Bhurshut entered the Mughal revenue system as a wealthy pargana while local Hindu rajas kept much of their power. The English East India Company established its factory at Kalikata, Sutanuti and Gobindapur in 1690 and raised the first Fort William from 1696. Siraj-ud-Daulah captured the settlement on 20 June 1756 and renamed it Alinagar, but Robert Clive and Charles Watson retook it on 2 January 1757; victory at Plassey that June cleared the way for Company rule. In 1760 Mir Qasim ceded control of Howrah, and Calcutta became capital of the Company's Indian territories in 1772.
zh:
帕吉勒提河南流进入恒河三角洲后称胡格利河。西岸的贝托尔位于豪拉的希布布尔一带，是萨特冈下游的市场与锚地；对岸散布着卡利卡塔、苏塔努蒂和戈宾德普尔等村，萨尔基亚则在贝托尔一侧。豪拉与胡格利一带原属中世纪印度教政权布尔舒特。1444年，这些河口市集归复辟的伊利亚斯·沙希王朝苏丹纳西尔丁·马哈茂德沙赫统治，孟加拉印度教商人和土地所有者生活在穆斯林朝廷治下，三角洲的布匹、稻米与航运为其带来财富。

1495年，诗人比普拉萨德·皮皮莱已把贝托尔记作旅人补给的市场；1570年代，切萨雷·费代里西记述大船在此停泊，因为再往上游河道变浅。1576年阿克巴的军队击败达乌德汗·卡拉尼后，布尔舒特被纳入莫卧儿税收体系，成为富庶的帕尔加纳，而本地印度教罗阇仍保有很大权力。1690年，英国东印度公司在卡利卡塔、苏塔努蒂和戈宾德普尔设立商馆，并于1696年开始修建第一座威廉堡。西拉杰·乌德·达乌拉于1756年6月20日攻占此地，改名阿里讷格尔，罗伯特·克莱夫与查尔斯·沃森却在1757年1月2日将其收复；同年6月普拉西获胜后，公司统治孟加拉的道路被打开。1760年，米尔·卡西姆交出豪拉控制权，1772年加尔各答成为东印度公司印度领地的首府。

en:
Koch is the monsoon-watered North Bengal plain of western Kamata, with Kamatapur, later called Gosanimari, as its capital. A Kamata kingdom had taken shape when rulers from Kamarupa moved west in the thirteenth century. In 1440 Niladhwaj founded the Khen dynasty, and in 1444 he ruled from Kamatapur over Koch communities in the country between the Karatoya and the Torsa. Its kings honoured the goddess Kamateshwari, and their realm lay between Gaur to the south, the Bhuyan chiefs to the east and the Himalayan passes used by Bhutanese traders and raiders.

In 1498 Alauddin Husain Shah of Gaur destroyed Kamatapur; Nilambar died in the same year, bringing Khen rule to an end. The Bengal governor Danyal was soon overthrown by the Baro-Bhuyan confederacy. In 1515 the Koch leader Biswa Singha defeated the Bhuyans and was crowned as a Hindu king, restoring Kamata's power from the old capital. Under Nara Narayan the kingdom reached its height, and the teacher Sankardev spread his Ekasarana faith with royal support. After Nara Narayan's death in 1586 the country split into Koch Bihar and Koch Hajo. The western court accepted Mughal suzerainty in 1609, although Pran Narayan used the Mughal succession war of 1657 to invade Bengal before making peace with Shaista Khan in 1664. Bhutan backed rival claimants after 1680, Mughal forces seized Boda, Patgram and other estates in 1711, and Rup Narayan moved the court to Guriahati on the Torsa. In 1772 a Bhutanese garrison tried to rule directly, but a Koch-British force recovered the capital; the peace of 1774 left Koch Bihar as a tributary state, where Harendra Narayan reigned from 1783.
zh:
科奇是北孟加拉的季风雨平原，位于卡马塔旧地西部，都城在卡马塔布尔，后来又称戈萨尼马里。13世纪迦摩缕波的统治者西迁后，卡马塔王国在此成形。1440年，尼拉德瓦杰建立肯王朝；1444年，他以卡马塔布尔为都，统治加拉托亚河与托尔萨河之间的科奇人聚落。王国诸王供奉迦摩特什瓦里女神，南接高尔，东邻各路布安酋长，北方则对着不丹商队和袭掠者出入的喜马拉雅山口。

1498年，高尔的阿拉丁·侯赛因·沙阿摧毁卡马塔布尔，尼兰巴尔也在同年死去，肯王朝告终；孟加拉派来的统治者达尼亚尔不久也被巴罗-布安联盟推翻。1515年，科奇首领比什瓦·辛哈击败布安人，以印度教国王身份加冕，在旧都重振卡马塔王权。那拉纳拉扬在位时王国达到鼎盛，导师巽格尔代沃也在王室支持下传播一神虔信教义。1586年那拉纳拉扬去世后，王国分裂为库奇比哈尔和科奇哈乔两支。西支朝廷于1609年接受莫卧儿宗主权；普拉纳拉扬曾趁1657年莫卧儿继承战争入侵孟加拉，最终在1664年与沙伊斯塔汗议和。1680年后，不丹屡屡支持王位争夺者；1711年莫卧儿军队夺取博达、帕特格拉姆等封地，鲁普纳拉扬遂把朝廷迁到托尔萨河畔的古里亚哈蒂。1772年，不丹驻军试图直接统治，但科奇与英国联军夺回都城；1774年和约使库奇比哈尔成为纳贡土邦，哈伦德拉纳拉扬自1783年起在此统治。

en:
The province of Gauda takes its name from the old Ganges city of Gaur, also called Lakhnauti, but in 1444 the Bengal Sultanate's court lay nearby at Pandua. Since Shamsuddin Ilyas Shah united Bengal in 1352, that walled capital had drawn soldiers, Sufis, Persian-speaking officials and travelling merchants. Sikandar Shah's Adina Mosque was the greatest in the subcontinent, and Jalaluddin Muhammad Shah was buried under the terracotta Eklakhi Mausoleum. Its ordered bazaars sold fine muslin and silk, and mulberry bark supplied local paper. Under the restored sultan Nasiruddin Mahmud Shah, Pandua remained a prosperous Muslim royal centre set in a largely Bengali Hindu countryside, while older Gaur waited beside the shifting Ganges.

Mahmud Shah ordered the court south to Gaur in 1450, and the transfer was complete by 1453. The sultans built a citadel, palace, mosques, canals and bridges there, decorating chambers with glazed tiles and filling the bazaars with goods that drew Middle Eastern, Central Asian and European merchants. A Portuguese visitor in 1521 watched Sultan Nusrat Shah at polo beneath the citadel. Humayun occupied Gaur in 1538 and renamed it Jannatabad, but Sher Shah Suri's Afghans took control in 1539 and sacked the city. Sultan Sulaiman Karrani moved the capital to Tanda in 1565; Mughal troops under Munim Khan captured Gaur in 1575, and the Battle of Rajmahal ended the independent sultanate in 1576. Plague and the Ganges changing course emptied the site, though Shah Shuja's governors later built the cool Tahakhana complex amid its declining ruins.
zh:
高达因恒河河畔古城高尔得名，高尔又称拉赫纳乌蒂；但1444年时，孟加拉苏丹国的王庭设在不远的潘杜亚。自沙姆苏丁·伊利亚斯·沙阿1352年统一孟加拉以来，这座有城墙的都城聚集了士兵、苏菲行者、说波斯语的官员和往来商人。西坎达尔·沙阿所建的阿迪纳清真寺曾是次大陆最大的清真寺，贾拉鲁丁·穆罕默德·沙阿则安葬在陶土饰面的埃克拉希陵墓。整齐的市集出售精细平纹细布和丝绸，桑树皮还供给本地造纸。在复辟的苏丹纳西鲁丁·马哈茂德·沙阿治下，潘杜亚仍是繁荣的穆斯林王都，周围乡野则以孟加拉印度教徒为主，而古老的高尔就在改道频繁的恒河旁。

1450年，马哈茂德沙下令把王庭南迁至高尔，迁移至1453年完成。苏丹们在此修建城堡、宫殿、清真寺、运河和桥梁，以琉璃砖装饰宫室，市集货物也吸引了中东、中亚和欧洲商人。1521年，一名葡萄牙访客曾看到苏丹努斯拉特·沙阿在城堡下观看马球。1538年，胡马雍占领高尔并将其改名为詹纳塔巴德，但舍尔沙·苏尔的阿富汗军队次年夺取并洗劫了此城。1565年，苏丹苏莱曼·卡拉尼把都城迁往坦达；1575年穆尼姆汗率莫卧儿军队攻占高尔，1576年拉杰马哈尔战役终结了独立苏丹国。瘟疫和恒河改道使这座城市荒废，尽管沙舒贾手下的总督后来在日渐衰落的废墟间修建了清凉的塔哈卡纳建筑群。

en:
Dhaka lies in the river-webbed Ganges Delta, its old quarters pressed against the Buriganga. Weavers and shell-cutters had bazaars there before the town passed under Turkic and Afghan governors, and by 1444 it was part of the Bengal Sultanate's eastern Sonargaon lands. Under Sultan Nasiruddin Mahmud Shah, Dhaka remained smaller than the royal capital at Gaur and the neighbouring administrative centre of Sonargaon, but its river landings, Bengali craftsmen and cotton cloth gave it more than local importance.

The brick Binat Bibi Mosque was built at Narinda in 1454, and an Afghan fort later guarded the town before Mughal armies broke the last sultanate forces in 1576. Eastern chiefs led by Isa Khan and Musa Khan still held out until Islam Khan Chishti subdued the country in 1608 and moved Bengal's capital from Rajmahal to Dhaka in 1610, renaming it Jahangirnagar. The Hussaini Dalan was built in 1642 and the Bara Katra caravanserai in 1644-1646, but Shah Shuja returned the court to Rajmahal. Mir Jumla restored Dhaka as capital in 1660. Under Shaista Khan, governor from 1664 to 1688, the city expanded, ships loaded fine cotton and silk, and Lalbagh Fort was begun in 1678. After Murshid Quli Khan moved the government to Murshidabad in 1717, a Naib Nazim ruled eastern Bengal from Dhaka. The East India Company took the revenues in 1765 and full control in 1793; by the early nineteenth century the old Mughal city was poorer and dotted with ruins.
zh:
达卡位于河网密布的恒河三角洲，旧城紧贴布里甘加河。早在突厥和阿富汗统治者到来之前，织工与贝壳匠已在这里形成市集；到1444年，此地已是孟加拉苏丹国东部索纳尔冈辖地的一部分。在苏丹纳西鲁丁·马哈茂德沙治下，达卡仍不及王都高尔和邻近的行政中心索纳尔冈，但河港、孟加拉工匠和棉布使它的重要性不限于一隅。

1454年，纳林达建成砖砌的比纳特·比比清真寺；莫卧儿军队1576年击灭苏丹国残余势力前，一座阿富汗要塞已在此镇守。伊萨·汗、穆萨·汗等东部首领仍继续抵抗，直到伊斯兰·汗·奇什提1608年平定地方，并于1610年把孟加拉首府从拉杰马哈尔迁至达卡，改名贾汉吉尔纳加尔。1642年侯赛尼·达兰建成，1644年至1646年巴拉卡特拉商队驿馆落成，但沙舒贾后来又把宫廷迁回拉杰马哈尔。1660年，米尔·朱姆拉恢复达卡的首府地位。1664年至1688年沙伊斯塔汗任总督期间，城市扩展，船只满载细棉布和丝绸，拉尔巴格堡也于1678年动工。1717年穆尔希德·库利汗把政府迁往穆尔希达巴德后，由一名副总督在达卡统辖东孟加拉。东印度公司1765年取得税收权，1793年接管全面行政；到19世纪初，这座莫卧儿旧城已经衰落，城中处处可见废墟。

en:
Paro is a high valley in western Bhutan, opening toward Tibet through a pass that carried both caravans and invading columns. Kyichu Lhakhang, traditionally founded in the seventh century by the Tibetan king Songtsen Gampo, was already an old Buddhist sanctuary when Drukpa Kagyu teaching spread through the valley after the missions of Phajo Drugom Zhigpo. By 1444 no single ruler governed all Bhutan; Paro's villages, pastures and monastic estates were held by local lords whose closest ties ran north to Tibet rather than to the eastern valleys.

In the fifteenth century Lama Drung Drung Gyal, a descendant of Phajo, built a temple and then the five-storey Hungrel Dzong above the river. His descendants surrendered the fortress to Ngawang Namgyal, the Zhabdrung, who unified Bhutan's valleys from 1616. In 1644 the old stronghold was dismantled and work began on Rinpung Dzong; it was consecrated in 1646 as the monastic and administrative centre of western Bhutan. After the Zhabdrung's death in 1651, central authority weakened and the Penlop of Paro became one of Bhutan's two great provincial governors, controlling lucrative western trade routes. Bhutanese pressure south through the Duars led to the seizure of Cooch Behar in 1772–73, war with the East India Company, and a treaty in 1774.
zh:
帕罗是不丹西部的高山河谷，谷中通往西藏的山口既迎送商队，也放过入犯的军队。祈楚拉康传统上被认为建于7世纪，由吐蕃赞普松赞干布下诏兴建；帕卓·德鲁格姆·希波传入竹巴噶举派后，这里早已是古老的佛教圣地。1444年时不丹尚未统一，帕罗的村庄、牧场和寺院庄园分属地方豪族，他们与北方西藏的联系比同东部诸谷更密切。

十五世纪，帕卓的后裔喇嘛敦敦杰在河畔岩山上先建寺院，后筑起五层的洪格尔宗。他的后裔后来把宗堡献给自1616年起统一不丹诸谷的夏仲·阿旺南杰。1644年旧堡被拆除，仁朋宗动工，并于1646年开光，成为不丹西部的宗教与行政中心。1651年夏仲去世后中央权威衰落，帕罗佩罗成为不丹两大地方长官之一，掌控利润丰厚的西部商路。不丹势力经杜阿尔斯南下，1772—1773年夺取库奇比哈尔，随后同东印度公司交战，并于1774年缔约。

en:
Charaideo, the 'shining city of the hills' in the old Tai tongue, was founded in 1253 by Sukaphaa, the Tai prince who had crossed the Patkai from Mong Mao in 1228 with some 9,000 followers and turned the marshy upper Brahmaputra valley into embanked rice country. His Ahom kingdom rested on the paik labour service and two great councillor houses, the Burhagohain and the Borgohain, and its kings were buried in the maidam mounds that still crown the town's hills. Sudangphaa defeated a Mong Kwang invasion in 1401, after which the realm took the name Assam. In 1444, in the long reign of Susenphaa (1439–1488), the chronicles record fat harvests and a peace broken only by Tangsu Naga raids; Brahmin advisers already stood beside the king, but the court still honoured the old Tai gods.

Under Suhungmung (1497–1539) the militia was remade, the Hinduised Chutia kingdom was annexed in 1524 and a Bengal army under Turbak was destroyed in 1532 and pursued as far as the Karatoya river; Suklenmung laid out the walled capital of Garhgaon in 1540. Sutamla Jayadhwaj Singha became the first king formally initiated into Hinduism in 1648. Mir Jumla's Mughals sacked Garhgaon in 1662, but Lachit Borphukan broke the Mughal fleet on the Brahmaputra at Saraighat in 1671, and Gadadhar Singha's victory at Itakhuli in 1682 fixed the western border at the Manas. Pramatta Singha raised the brick Rang Ghar pavilion at Rangpur in 1744–1751. In November 1769 the Moamoria rising seized the capital and carried off the king, and the long rebellion cost the valley about half its people; Burmese armies entering from 1817 left the old kaghazi raj, the 'kingdom of records', a Burmese-occupied land by 1821.
zh:
查莱碉（Charaideo）在古傣语中意为「山上的光辉之城」。1228年，傣族王子苏卡法从勐卯翻越帕特凯山，率约九千人进入布拉马普特拉河上游，1253年定都于此，把沼泽林地开成堤坝环绕的灌溉稻田。他建立的阿洪姆王国以帕克（paik）劳役和布尔哈戈海因、博尔戈海因两大辅政家族为支柱，历代国王葬在城外山丘上的麦道（maidam）坟冢中。1401年苏当发击退孟拱（诺拉）的来犯，此后政权以「阿萨姆」为名。1444年正值苏森发（1439—1488年在位）的漫长治世，史籍称岁丰民安，只有唐苏那加人的袭扰为患；婆罗门顾问已立于王侧，宫廷却仍敬奉傣族旧神。

苏混发（1497—1539年在位）改组民兵，1524年吞并印度教化的楚蒂亚王国，1532年歼灭图尔巴克率领的孟加拉军队并追击至卡拉托亚河；1540年苏肯法营建了城墙环绕的新都加尔加翁。1648年，苏坦拉（贾亚德瓦吉·辛格哈）成为首位正式皈依印度教的国王。1662年米尔·久姆拉率莫卧儿军队洗劫加尔加翁，但1671年拉吉特·博尔普坎在萨拉伊加特大破莫卧儿水师，1682年加达达尔·辛格哈赢得伊塔库里之战，把西界定在马纳斯河。1744至1751年，苏嫩发在朗布尔砖砌了让加尔竞技场。1769年11月，摩亚马里亚起义攻陷都城、劫持国王，长年战乱使河谷损失了约一半人口；1817年起缅甸军队数度入侵，到1821年，这个素有「文书之国」之称的旧王国已成缅甸人驻军之地。

en:
Sylhet, the ancient Srihatta, is the lowland of the Surma River ringed by the Khasia and Tripura hills. Its Hindu rajas, last among them Gour Govinda of the Gour kingdom, held the country until 1303, when the army of Shamsuddin Firoz Shah of Lakhnauti, led by his nephew Sikandar Khan Ghazi and accompanied by the saint Shah Jalal, overthrew him after a quarrel over the killing of a cow; Govinda fled and the town was renamed Jalalabad. Shah Jalal's disciples spread through the valley, and the Moroccan traveller Ibn Battuta visited the ageing saint here. With Shamsuddin Ilyas Shah's unification of Bengal, Sylhet became the northeastern march of the Bengal Sultanate, governed by a wazir; one Muqabil Khan is recorded in that office in 1440. In 1444 it was a largely Hindu cotton-growing country under a Muslim court, its mosques and dargahs rising beside old Hindu estates, and a restless frontier exposed to Tripura and the hill tribes.

In 1472 the governor Majlis Alam built a replica of the Adina Mosque in the Dargah quarter. Around the turn of the 16th century Sultan Bazid of Pratapgarh seized Sylhet town until Alauddin Husain Shah's minister Sarwar Khan defeated him, and later in the century Tripuri raiders briefly overran the country. After the Karrani dynasty fell in 1576, Sylhet broke into Afghan-held chiefdoms, the last and strongest led by Khwaja Usman. On 12 March 1612 he was mortally wounded by musket fire at the Battle of Daulambapur, after which Sylhet became a Mughal sarkar of the Bengal Subah, Dhaka's principal outpost in the east. The East India Company took over with the Diwani of 1765, and in December 1782 the Muharram Rebellion against Company exactions was crushed at the old Shahi Eidgah.
zh:
锡尔赫特古称斯里赫塔，是苏尔马河流域的低地，四周为卡西丘陵与特里普拉丘陵环抱。这里的印度教罗阇世代割据，最后一位是古尔王国的古尔·戈文达。1303年，因穆斯林居民宰牛引发冲突，拉克瑙蒂苏丹沙姆苏丁·菲罗兹沙派侄子西坎达尔·汗·加齐率军来攻，圣徒沙阿·贾拉勒随军同行，戈文达兵败出逃，城市改名贾拉拉巴德。沙阿·贾拉勒的弟子散居谷地各处，摩洛哥旅行家伊本·白图泰也曾在此拜访这位年迈的圣徒。沙姆苏丁·伊利亚斯沙统一孟加拉后，锡尔赫特成为孟加拉苏丹国的东北边地，由瓦齐尔管辖，1440年在任的瓦齐尔是穆卡比尔汗。1444年的锡尔赫特以印度教棉农为主体，由穆斯林宫廷统治，清真寺和圣徒陵园在旧日印度教庄园旁建起，东面则是正对特里普拉和山中部落的动荡边地。

1472年，长官马吉利斯·阿拉姆在圣陵区仿建了一座阿迪纳清真寺。16世纪前后，普拉塔普加尔的苏丹巴济德一度占据锡尔赫特城，被阿拉乌丁·胡赛因沙的大臣萨瓦尔汗击败；该世纪后期特里普拉军队还曾短暂占领此地。1576年卡拉尼王朝灭亡后，锡尔赫特分裂为阿富汗酋长的领地，其中最强者是赫瓦贾·乌斯曼。1612年3月12日，他在道兰巴布尔之战中中枪伤重而死，锡尔赫特随后成为孟加拉苏巴的一个萨尔卡尔，是达卡以东最重要的莫卧儿据点。1765年东印度公司凭迪万特权接管此地，1782年12月反对公司盘剥的穆哈兰姆起义在旧王室会礼场被镇压。

en:
Chittagong commands a deep natural harbour on the Karnaphuli River, where it meets the Bay of Bengal. Arab merchants kept a trading post there in the ninth century, and in 1340 Sultan Fakhruddin Mubarak Shah of Sonargaon brought the port into the Bengal Sultanate; Ibn Battuta visited five years later. By 1444 it was the sultanate's chief maritime gateway, a royal mint and shipbuilding centre where muslin, rice, pearls, horses and gunpowder moved between Bengal, China, Sumatra, Sri Lanka and the Middle East.

The Tripura king Dhanya Manikya seized Chittagong in 1513, but a Bengal army under Prince Nasrat retook it in 1516 and named it Fatehabad. Portuguese ships arrived the next year, and the port became their wealthy trading centre of Porto Grande. From about 1580 Chittagong was held almost without interruption by the Arakanese kingdom of Mrauk U, whose fleets joined Portuguese mercenaries in trade and slave raiding. On 27 January 1666 Buzurg Umed Khan, son of the Mughal governor Shaista Khan, captured it for Aurangzeb; the Mughals called the town Islamabad and curbed the sea raids. It passed to the East India Company in 1793.
zh:
吉大港扼守戈尔诺普利河注入孟加拉湾处的天然深水港。9世纪时，阿拉伯商人已在此设立商站；1340年，索纳冈的苏丹法赫尔丁·穆巴拉克沙将港口并入孟加拉苏丹国，伊本·白图泰五年后到访。到1444年，这里已是苏丹国首要的海上门户、王家铸币地和造船中心，细棉布、稻米、珍珠、马匹与火药在孟加拉、中国、苏门答腊、斯里兰卡和中东之间流转。

1513年，特里普拉国王达尼亚·马尼基亚攻占吉大港，但纳斯拉特王子率领的孟加拉军队在1516年收复此地，改名法塔哈巴德。葡萄牙船只次年抵达，港口随后成为他们富庶的商站「大港」。约1580年起，吉大港几乎不间断地处于若开妙乌王国治下，其舰队与葡萄牙雇佣兵既经营贸易，也从事奴隶劫掠。1666年1月27日，莫卧儿总督沙伊斯塔汗之子布祖尔格·乌米德汗为奥朗则布夺取此城；莫卧儿人称该城为伊斯拉姆巴德，并压制了海上袭掠。1793年，吉大港转入东印度公司之手。

en:
Bijapur, originally Vijayapura, the 'city of victory', arose in the tenth or eleventh century under the Kalyani Chalukyas and later passed to the Yadavas of Devagiri.
