The Bahmanis conquered it in 1347 and made the town the seat of a large province, its governors reaching west toward the Konkan ports. In 1444 it was a Bahmani provincial capital on the cotton-growing Maidan: Kannada-speaking towns and villages supplied the markets while Muslim governors and garrisons represented the sultanate of Gulbarga and Bidar.

Yusuf Adil Shah became governor in 1481 and, as Bahmani power dissolved, established the Adil Shahi Sultanate of Bijapur by 1490. He built the citadel and the Farrokh Mahal; Ali Adil Shah I later strengthened the walls and raised the great Jami Masjid. Under Ibrahim Adil Shah II, who reigned from 1580 to 1627, the capital became a court of music, poetry and religious toleration, with contemporary estimates placing its population between half a million and a million. Mohammed Adil Shah's Gol Gumbaz was begun after 1627 and left unfinished at his death in 1656, its huge dome and whispering gallery surviving as the monument of Bijapur's imperial confidence. Shivaji's defeat of Afzal Khan and repeated Maratha raids weakened the kingdom, and in 1686 Aurangzeb's army took Bijapur after a long siege, ending Adil Shahi rule. The Mughals held it until the Nizam of Hyderabad took the city in 1724; the Marathas gained it in 1760, and Company forces occupied it during the Third Anglo-Maratha War in 1818.
zh:
比贾布尔原名维贾亚普拉，意为「胜利之城」，10或11世纪在卡利亚尼遮娄其王朝治下兴起，后来转归德瓦吉里的雅达瓦王朝。巴赫曼尼苏丹国1347年征服此地，把城镇设为一个大省的治所，其长官势力向西延伸到康肯诸港。1444年，这里是巴赫曼尼在产棉马坦高原上的省区都会：说卡纳达语的城镇和村落供应市场，穆斯林长官与驻军则代表从古尔伯加、比达尔发号施令的苏丹国。

优素福·阿迪尔沙1481年出任此地长官，随着巴赫曼尼权力瓦解，他在1490年前建立阿迪尔沙希王朝的比贾布尔苏丹国，并修建内堡和法鲁赫宫；阿里·阿迪尔沙阿一世后来加固城墙，兴建宏伟的贾马清真寺。易卜拉欣·阿迪尔沙阿二世1580年至1627年在位期间，这座都城成为音乐、诗歌与宗教宽容的宫廷，当时估计人口有五十万至一百万。穆罕默德·阿迪尔沙阿的果尔·古姆巴斯在1627年后开工，1656年他去世时仍未完全竣工，巨穹和回音廊成为比贾布尔帝国气象的遗存。希瓦吉击败阿夫扎尔汗，马拉塔军又连年袭扰，使苏丹国日益衰弱；1686年，奥朗则布的军队经长期围攻攻占比贾布尔，阿迪尔沙希王朝告终。莫卧儿统治持续到1724年海得拉巴尼扎姆取城，马拉塔人1760年获得此地，东印度公司军队则在1818年第三次英国—马拉塔战争期间占领它。

en:
The Naga Hills rise above the Dhansiri valley, where Naga villages from many distinct Tibeto-Burman tribes held the forest ridges above the plains. On the river below stood Dimapur, the brick-walled capital of the Dimasa Kachari kingdom. The Dimasa had controlled the Dhansiri valley and northern Cachar hills since at least the late thirteenth century; the city kept a brick wall nearly two miles long and two great tanks. In 1406 the Ming established a Dimasa pacification office under Lawangpa. In 1444 this was still Kachari country ruled from Dimapur, while Naga headmen managed their own villages in the timbered highlands.

War with the expanding Ahom kingdom reached the valley in 1526. Forces of King Suhungmung defeated the Kachari army, took the Nenguriya fort, pursued Kachari King Khunkhara to Dimapur and occupied the brick city; Khunkhara fled with his son. The Dimasa court withdrew south to Maibang, its capital from the sixteenth to the eighteenth centuries, where later rulers adopted Hinduism. A marriage alliance in 1745 merged the Dimasa line with the Koch rulers of Khaspur and drew the lowland court southward, while the Naga villages beyond the old Dhansiri road remained under local headmen. The Moamoria rebellion of 1769–1805 weakened the neighboring Ahom kingdom and left the hill frontier largely outside lowland administration.
zh:
那加丘陵耸峙在丹西里河谷上方，分属许多不同藏缅语部落的那加村落据守着平原上方的森林山脊；河谷中的迪马普尔则是底马撒卡恰里王国的砖城。底马撒人至少从13世纪后期起控制丹西里河谷和北卡恰尔丘陵，迪马普尔留有近两英里长的砖墙和两座大池。1406年，明朝设立底马撒宣慰司，以腊罔帕为宣慰使。1444年，这里仍是由迪马普尔统治的卡恰尔人土地，盛产木材的高地上，那加村落则由各自头人管理。

1526年，扩张中的阿洪王国把战争带到这条河谷。阿洪国王苏洪蒙的军队击败卡恰里军，攻破边境堡寨，把卡恰里国王一直追至迪马普尔并占领砖城，国王携子出逃。底马撒王廷随后南撤到迈邦格，这里在16至18世纪作为都城，后来的统治者也在此接受印度教。1745年，底马撒王室通过联姻与卡斯普尔的科奇统治者合并，低地宫廷随之南移，而丹西里旧路深处的那加村落仍由本地头人掌控。1769—1805年的摩亚马里亚叛乱削弱了邻近的阿洪王国，使这条山地边地大体留在低地行政体系之外。

en:
The Darrang country is the north-bank plain of the Brahmaputra between the Bhareli and Barnadi rivers, a belt of duar passes opening into the Bhutan hills; its name comes from an Assamese word for a doorway. Chutia kings planted thousands of Chutia families on the land, and in 1444 it was a patchwork of Chutia lords, Bodo villages and Baro-Bhuyan chiefs. Opposite on the south bank stood Koliabar, the river gateway to upper Assam; its flats were the rice bowl of the valley, and in Ahom times the Borphukan, the viceroy of the west, kept his headquarters there.

Mid-sixteenth-century wars brought Darrang under the Koch king Nara Narayan, and the Koch partition of 1581 assigned it to the eastern kingdom of Koch Hajo. Its raja Bali Narayan called in the Ahoms against the Mughals and fell fighting in 1637, when Ahom garrisons took over the district. Mir Jumla's invasion rolled through it on the way to Garhgaon in 1662, and after Itakhuli in 1682 it remained permanently Ahom. From the early seventeenth century Bhutanese ponlops held the hill duars above the Gohain Kamal Ali road. When the Moamoria wars shattered Ahom power the Darrang rajas reasserted independence about 1785, only to be crushed by Captain Welsh's Company sepoys in 1792.
zh:
达让地处布拉马普特拉河北岸、巴雷利河与巴尔纳迪河之间，分布着一排通向不丹山区的杜阿尔山口，地名即来自阿萨姆语的「门」。楚蒂亚国王曾把数千户楚蒂亚人家迁置于此，1444年的达让是楚蒂亚豪酋、博多村落与巴罗—布扬首领交错分治之地。南岸对岸的科利亚巴尔（Koliabar）扼守通往阿萨姆上游的河口，其平野号称河谷的米仓，阿洪姆时代西疆副王博尔普坎曾在此驻节。

16世纪中叶的战争使达让归入科奇国王纳拉纳拉扬，1581年科奇王国分裂，它被分给东支科奇哈乔。当地拉贾巴利纳拉扬招来阿洪姆援兵抵御莫卧儿，1637年兵败身死，阿洪姆驻军就此接管此地。1662年米尔·久姆拉的入侵大军穿过达让直扑加尔加翁，1682年伊塔库里之战后，这里永久归入阿洪姆版图。17世纪初起，不丹的蓬洛普总督控制了戈哈因·卡马尔大道上方的山地山口。摩亚马里亚战乱瓦解阿洪姆统治后，达让诸拉贾约在1785年重新自立，旋于1792年被韦尔什上尉率领的东印度公司土兵击溃。

en:
Kotte rose on a swamp-girt ridge beside the Kelani river, a day's journey inland from the anchorage at Colombo. The fortress was first raised in the 1370s by Alakesvara, chief minister of the Gampola kingdom, to guard the western coast against raids from South India. In 1415 Parakramabahu VI made it his capital, rebuilding the citadel and the royal palace and raising a shrine for the Tooth Relic. His long reign was a golden age of Sinhalese letters, graced by monk-poets such as Sri Rahula, and by 1444 Kotte was the paramount power on the island, its merchants shipping the cinnamon of the western lowlands to Arab and Tamil traders calling at Colombo.

In 1450 the Kotte army under Prince Sapumal took Jaffna, and for the first time in generations the whole island obeyed one king. That unity did not outlast Parakramabahu VI, who died in 1467; the hill country rebelled in 1469 and became the kingdom of Kandy. The first Portuguese, led by Lourenço de Almeida, reached Colombo in 1505 and secured the cinnamon trade, turning their factory there into a fort from 1517. After the Vijayaba Kollaya of 1521 the kingdom was torn into Kotte, Sitawaka and Raigama, and beleaguered Kotte leant increasingly on Portuguese arms. In 1565 Dharmapala abandoned the swamp capital for Colombo under Sitawaka's attacks, and in 1597, baptised Dom João and without an heir, he willed his realm to the king of Portugal. A Dutch army took Colombo in 1656 after a siege that left only ninety-three Portuguese alive, and held the cinnamon coast until the British seized it in 1796.
zh:
科特坐落在克拉尼河畔一片沼泽环绕的高地上，距科伦坡锚地只有一日路程。14世纪70年代，甘波罗王国的重臣阿罗吉湿婆罗为防备南印度来犯，首先在此修筑要塞。1415年，波罗迦罗摩巴忽六世定都于此，扩建城寨与王宫，并为佛牙舍利修建寺院。他在位长久，是僧伽罗文学的黄金时代，室利·罗睺罗等高僧诗僧辈出；到1444年，科特已是全岛首屈一指的强权，商人把西部低地出产的肉桂运到科伦坡，与阿拉伯和泰米尔商人交易。

1450年，沙布摩尔王子率科特军队攻取贾夫纳，全岛数十年来第一次奉一位国王为共主。但这份统一未能维持到波罗迦罗摩巴忽六世1467年去世之后：中部山区1469年反叛，发展为康提王国。1505年，洛伦索·德·阿尔梅达率领的首批葡萄牙人抵达科伦坡，取得肉桂贸易之利，并从1517年起把商馆加固为要塞。1521年「维阇耶巴忽之变」后，王国分裂为科特、悉多伐伽和罗依伽摩三部，困守的科特日益倚仗葡萄牙武力。1565年，达摩波罗在悉多伐伽的攻势下放弃沼泽中的都城，退往科伦坡；他受洗取名堂·若昂，身后无嗣，1597年按遗嘱把王国献给葡萄牙国王。1656年，荷兰军队经长期围攻拿下科伦坡，城破时幸存的葡萄牙人仅九十三名；荷兰人统治肉桂海岸，直到1796年被英国人夺取。

en:
Maibang, whose Dimasa name means a place rich in rice, lies on the Mahur River in the Dima Hasao, the Dimasa Hills. These forested ridges formed the southwestern highlands of the Dimasa Kachari kingdom; Ahom chronicles traced its lands from the Kopili River to the Dhansiri, including North Cachar. In 1444 the dynasty's principal capital was Dimapur, north of these hills, while Maibang held the southern tracks toward the Barak valley, Sylhet and Manipur. Dimasa chiefs still followed their own rites, and Brahmanical Hindu titles came only after the court moved deeper into the hills.

Ahom expansion altered the district in 1526, when Suhungmung's forces took Dimapur and drove the Dimasa court south; Maibang served as its capital from the sixteenth through the eighteenth centuries, and its rulers adopted Hinduism there. In 1562 Koch King Chilarai conquered the Barak valley from Twipra, and his brother Kamal Narayan's descendants built the Koch kingdom of Khaspur. That state joined Maibang in 1745, when Kanchani, daughter of its last king Bhima Singha, married Dimasa prince Laxmichandra; the united court moved to Khaspur and Brahmins invested its Dimasa aristocracy as Barman Kshatriyas. In 1802 the Manipuri court allied with King Krishnachandra and married Princess Induprabha to him, soon drawing Cachar into the Burmese wars pressing in from Manipur.
zh:
迈邦格在底马撒语中意为稻米丰饶之地，坐落在底马哈撒，即底马撒人丘陵的马胡尔河畔。这些森林山脊构成底马撒卡恰尔王国的西南高地；阿洪编年史称其疆域从科皮利河延伸到丹西里河，北卡恰尔也在其中。1444年，王朝的主要都城在丘陵以北的迪马普尔，迈邦格则扼守通往巴拉克河谷、锡尔赫特和曼尼坡的南部山路。当时底马撒首领仍保留本族仪轨，婆罗门式的印度教名号要等到王廷深入丘陵后才出现。

1526年，阿洪扩张改变了此地：苏洪蒙的军队攻占迪马普尔，迫使底马撒王廷南移；16至18世纪，迈邦格成为都城，统治者也在这里接受印度教。1562年，科奇国王奇拉莱从特里普拉手中夺取巴拉克河谷，其弟卡马尔·纳拉扬的后裔后来建立卡斯普尔的科奇王国。1745年，末代国王比姆·辛哈之女坎查尼嫁给底马撒王子拉克什米·钱德拉，迈邦格与卡斯普尔合并；统一后的王廷迁往卡斯普尔，婆罗门又将底马撒贵族册封为巴尔曼刹帝利。1802年，曼尼坡王室与国王克里希纳钱德拉结盟，将公主因杜普拉巴嫁给他；不久，来自曼尼坡方向的缅甸战事也把卡恰尔卷入其中。

en:
The Andaman and Nicobar Islands form two chains between the Bay of Bengal and the Andaman Sea, separated by the Ten Degree Channel. In the northern islands, Andamanese communities lived by hunting, fishing and gathering and had little sustained contact with passing ships. The Nicobarese farther south spoke Austroasiatic languages and took part in the sea route linking India with Southeast Asia; vessels called for coconuts, and the early fifteenth-century Mao Kun chart marked Great Nicobar as Cuilan. In 1444 no mainland kingdom garrisoned the islands, and political life remained in the hands of their own village societies.

European powers later tried to turn these anchorages into permanent posts. A Danish East India Company expedition sailed from Tranquebar in 1755, founded New Denmark on Great Nicobar in 1756 and established New Zealand on Nancowry in 1757. Malaria and local resistance forced out the survivors by April 1759. Moravian missionaries and soldiers returned to Nancowry in 1768 and planted coffee and cotton, while an Austrian expedition occupied Kamorta in 1778. Neither outpost endured. In 1789 Archibald Blair opened a British naval base and penal settlement on Chatham Island; it moved to Port Cornwallis two years later and was abandoned in May 1796 because of disease. Danish troops left Nancowry in 1809, so by 1821 no European garrison remained on either island chain.
zh:
安达曼群岛和尼科巴群岛是孟加拉湾与安达曼海之间的两串岛链，由十度海峡隔开。北部群岛上的安达曼人以狩猎、捕鱼和采集为生，很少与过往船只持续往来。更南面的尼科巴人使用南亚语系语言，参与连接印度与东南亚的海上航路；商船会停泊换取椰子，15世纪初的《郑和航海图》还把大尼科巴岛标作翠兰屿。1444年，没有大陆王国在这些岛上驻军，岛上事务仍由本地村社自行掌握。

欧洲列强后来试图把这些停泊地变成永久据点。丹麦东印度公司的远征队1755年从特兰奎巴出发，1756年在大尼科巴岛建立新丹麦，1757年又在楠考里岛建立新西兰。疟疾和本地人反抗迫使幸存者在1759年4月前撤离。1768年，摩拉维亚传教士和士兵回到楠考里岛，种植咖啡和棉花；1778年，一支奥地利远征队又占据格莫尔达岛。两处据点都没有维持多久。1789年，阿奇博尔德·布莱尔在查塔姆岛开设英国海军基地和流放地，两年后迁往康沃利斯港，却因疾病流行而在1796年5月废弃。丹麦军队也于1809年撤出楠考里岛；到1821年，两组群岛上都已没有欧洲驻军。

en:
Gwadar, whose name means 'gate of the winds' in Balochi, sits on a hammerhead peninsula enclosing a deep anchorage on the Makran coast. Nearchus, the admiral of Alexander, sailed past it in 325 BC and found fishermen and the people the Greeks called the Ichthyophagoi; later Arab and Persian geographers knew the headland, and the Ming chart compiled from Zheng He's voyages marks it as Kewata'er. For two centuries before 1444 it had been left to local Baloch chiefs of the Buledai house, who combined fishing, pastoralism and the coastal carrying trade. In 1444 Gwadar was a small Sunni fishing town under a Baloch malik, its harbour known to every dhow sailor between Sindh and Oman.

The Ottoman admiral Seydi Ali Reis called here in the 1550s and recorded in his Mirror of Countries of 1557 a Baloch town whose chief was Malik Jalal al-Din, son of Malik Dinar. In 1581 Portuguese raiders burned Gwadar and nearby Pasni, though they never held the coast. The Buledais ruled until 1740, when the Gichkis displaced them, and Nasir Khan I of Kalat then wrung from the Gichkis a share of the revenues. In 1783 Nasir Khan granted Gwadar to the exiled Muscat prince Sultan bin Ahmad, who made himself Sultan of Oman in 1797 but kept the port; an Omani wali built the fort and ran a busy trade in ivory, spices, woollens and slaves. The Buledais briefly retook the town after the sultan's death in 1804, but Omani troops soon restored it, and Gwadar entered the nineteenth century a Muscati possession.
zh:
瓜达尔在俾路支语中意为「风之门」，坐落在莫克兰海岸一个环抱深水锚地的锤形半岛上。公元前325年，亚历山大的海军将领涅阿尔霍斯航经此地，见到的是渔民和被希腊人称为「食鱼者」的居民；后来的阿拉伯、波斯地理学者都知道这个海角，据郑和远航绘成的明代航海图也把它标作「克瓦塔儿」。1444年之前的两百年间，这里由布莱迪家族的俾路支地方首领自治，营生兼及捕鱼、畜牧和沿海航运。1444年的瓜达尔是一座逊尼派俾路支人的小渔港，受马利克统辖，它的港湾为信德到阿曼之间的每一艘独桅帆船所熟知。

奥斯曼海军将领赛义迪·阿里·赖斯在1550年代到访，在1557年成书的《列国镜》中记下这座俾路支城镇，其首领是马利克·迪纳尔之子马利克·贾拉勒丁。1581年，葡萄牙袭掠者焚毁了瓜达尔和附近的帕斯尼，但始终未能占据这段海岸。布莱迪家族统治到1740年，被吉奇基家族取代，卡拉特汗纳西尔汗一世随后迫使吉奇基人分出一部分岁入。1783年，纳西尔汗把瓜达尔封给流亡的马斯喀特王公苏丹·本·艾哈迈德；后者1797年登上阿曼苏丹之位，却留下港口不还。阿曼派来的瓦利修建了城堡，经营象牙、香料、毛织物和奴隶的繁忙贸易。1804年苏丹去世后布莱迪人一度收复此城，但阿曼军队很快将其夺回——进入19世纪时，瓜达尔已是马斯喀特的海外领地。

en:
Kalat is a fortified plateau town above the Bolan Pass, where the caravan road from Kandahar drops toward Sindh and the Indus plains; its older names Kalat-i-Sewa and Kalat-i-Nichari remember an ancient Sewa dynasty and the indigenous Brahui tribes of the highlands. Arab columns raiding into Qiqan met the Jats here in the seventh century, and through the later Middle Ages the hill-fort passed among local chiefs, owing allegiance as suited them to Kandahar or Delhi. In the fifteenth century the Brahuis of the Mirwari clan took Kalat from its Sewa rulers and built a highland kingdom around it, so that by 1444 the fortress was already the seat of the Brahui confederacy, whose grazing lands ran from Quetta toward the edge of the Kacchi.

In 1666 Mir Ahmad Khan I led the confederacy out of Mughal Kandahar into independence, taking Quetta, Mastung and Pishin and campaigning as an ally of Aurangzeb. His successor Mir Samandar Khan (r. 1697–1714) defeated a Safavid invasion and received Karachi from the Mughals, while Mir Abdullah Khan (r. 1716–1731) carried Kalat's arms through Sindh and Makran to Bandar Abbas, before falling in 1734 to an alliance of Hussain Hotak and the Kalhoras; Nader Shah granted Kacchi to his heir as blood-price. Nasir Khan I (r. 1749–1794) made Kalat great: a Durrani vassal since 1748, he revolted in 1758, routed Shah Wali Khan's army and withstood Ahmad Shah's forty-day siege until a treaty left the khanate tribute-free. He set up a standing army, a vizierate and his own coinage, exchanged embassies with the Ottomans, Iran and Oman, and in 1784 gave Gwadar to Oman's fugitive sultan. At his death in 1794 Kalat was the strongest power between Kandahar and the Arabian Sea.
zh:
喀拉特是波伦山口上方的高原军镇，脚下的商路从坎大哈下行，通向信德与印度河平原；它的旧称「塞瓦之堡」和「尼查里之堡」，分别记着古老的塞瓦王朝和世居高地的布拉灰部落。7世纪时，攻入基坎的阿拉伯军队曾在此与贾特人交战；进入中世纪以后，这座山寨在地方酋长之间转手，视形势向坎大哈或德里称臣。15世纪，布拉灰人的米尔瓦里氏族从塞瓦王朝手中夺取喀拉特，以此为中心建立高地王国；1444年的喀拉特已是布拉灰部落联盟的首邑，周围的牧场从奎达一直延伸到卡奇平原边缘。

1666年，米尔·艾哈迈德汗一世率领部落联盟脱离莫卧儿治下的坎大哈独立，连克奎达、马斯通和皮欣，并作为奥朗则布的盟友出征。继任的米尔·萨曼达尔汗（1697—1714年在位）击退萨法维军队的入侵，被莫卧儿人赐以卡拉奇港；米尔·阿卜杜拉汗（1716—1731年在位）把喀拉特的兵锋带到信德、莫克兰直至阿巴斯港，1734年在与侯赛因·霍塔基和卡尔霍拉联军的作战中阵亡，纳迪尔沙随后把卡奇封给他的继承人作为血偿。纳西尔汗一世（1749—1794年在位）成就了喀拉特的全盛：自1748年起为杜兰尼藩属的他于1758年起兵，击溃沙·瓦利汗的军队，并顶住艾哈迈德沙四十天的围攻，最终以条约换得免纳贡赋的地位。他设立常备军、维齐尔官署并自铸钱币，与奥斯曼、伊朗和阿曼互通使节，1784年还把瓜达尔赠予流亡的阿曼苏丹。到1794年他去世时，喀拉特已是坎大哈与阿拉伯海之间最强的政权。

en:
The high valley of Quetta, known of old as Shal or Shalkot, lies ringed by mountains above the Bolan Pass, where the road from Kandahar descends into the Baloch country. Its name comes from the Pashto kwatta, a fort, and the mud-walled citadel of Miri dominated the early settlement. Ghaznavid, Ghurid and Mongol rulers mastered the valley in turn; Mahmud of Ghazni captured it in the eleventh century. The land itself belonged to the Kasi Pashtuns, whose chiefs, the arbabs, apportioned the fields, grazing grounds and karez watercourses, while apples, grapes and grain did well in the upland orchards. In 1444 Shal was a tribal march on the Baloch frontier: Kasi headmen held the valley, the Timurid governors of Kandahar claimed its allegiance, and Baloch confederacies pressed up from the hot plains below the pass.

Towards the end of the fifteenth century the Timurid ruler of Herat conferred Shal on Shah Beg Arghun, whose family governed Kandahar before conquering Sindh. In 1543 the fugitive Mughal emperor Humayun passed through the valley on his way to exile at the Safavid court. The Ain-i-Akbari later counted Shal and neighbouring Pishin among the lands furnishing Akbar with troops and revenue, and thereafter they followed the fortunes of Kandahar, passing more than once between Mughals and Safavids during the seventeenth century. In 1709 the Hotak Afghans of Kandahar swept the region into their revolt, and in 1747 Ahmad Shah Durrani incorporated it into his new Afghan empire. He soon granted Quetta's revenue and administration to Nasir Khan I of Kalat in reward for Baloch arms, the sanad also confirming the Kasi in their ancestral lands. Caravans kept threading the Bolan, carrying the valley's fruit, grain and wool between India, Kandahar and Persia.
zh:
奎达所在的高山谷地旧称沙尔（一作沙尔科特），群山环抱，俯视博兰山口——从坎大哈而来的道路经此下行进入俾路之地。其名来自普什图语「kwatta」，意为堡垒，早年聚落之上矗立着米尔堡的夯土城墙。加兹尼王朝、古尔王朝和蒙古人先后做过谷地的主人，11世纪马哈茂德·加兹纳维在东征中将其攻取。土地本身归普什图卡西部所有，各部酋长（阿尔巴布）分掌农田、牧场和坎儿井水道，高地果园里葡萄、苹果和谷物长势兴旺。1444年的沙尔是俾路支边陲的部族边地：卡西头人据有谷地，坎大哈的帖木儿总督遥领其忠，俾路支诸部则从山口以南的炎热平原步步逼近。

15世纪末，赫拉特的帖木儿君主把沙尔封给阿尔洪家族的沙赫·贝格；该家族本据坎大哈，后来又南下征服信德。1543年，败逃的莫卧儿皇帝胡马雍途经谷地，前往萨法维宫廷流亡。后来成书的《阿克巴则例》把沙尔和邻近的皮辛列为向阿克巴提供兵役与贡赋之地，此后两地便随坎大哈浮沉，17世纪间在莫卧儿与萨法维之间不止一次易手。1709年，坎大哈的霍塔克普什图人起兵，把这一带卷入其版图；1747年，艾哈迈德·沙·杜兰尼将它纳入新建的阿富汗帝国，不久又以俾路支出兵相助之功，把奎达的赋税和行政授予卡拉特汗纳西尔汗一世，所降特许状同时确认了卡西部对祖传土地的权利。商队依旧穿行博兰山口，把谷地出产的水果、谷物和羊毛贩运于印度、坎大哈与波斯之间。

en:
Roh is the name the chroniclers of India gave to the rugged Pashtun country running from the Kabul River to the hills above the Indus, and its gateway town is Peshawar, set at the mouth of the Khyber Pass. Ancient Purushapura was a capital of the Kushans and later a city of the Kabul Shahis until Mahmud of Ghazni won the Battle of Peshawar on 28 November 1001; it passed to the Ghurids and was wrecked by the Mongols in the early 1200s. By the fifteenth century the valley belonged to the Dilazak and other Pashtun tribes, whose flocks and horses were sold down the road into India while caravans between Kabul and Lahore passed through the ruined town. In 1444 Peshawar was little more than a caravan staging post in tribal hands, its bazaars kept busy by the Khyber traffic.

Babur's men took Peshawar, then called Begram, in July 1526 and rebuilt its citadel, and under the Mughals the town became the chief frontier market on Sher Shah Suri's Grand Trunk Road. Akbar restored the name Peshawar, but the hill clans never accepted the empire: the Roshani followers of Pir Roshan besieged it in 1586-87, Yusufzai tribes rose in 1667, and in 1672 the Afridis cut to pieces a Mughal battalion in the Khyber and shut the pass until Aurangzeb marched through in 1674. Governors of Kabul wintered here, the Mohabbat Khan Mosque went up in 1630, and a fire in the citadel in 1586 consumed over a thousand camel-loads of merchandise. Nader Shah seized Peshawar on 18 November 1738, and from 1747 the Durranis used it as their winter capital; Marathas and Sikhs briefly held the city in 1758 before Ahmad Shah returned the next year. In 1809 a British mission under Elphinstone met Shah Shuja there, the first such embassy. Ranjit Singh's Sikhs overran the valley in 1818 and left the Barakzai sardar Yar Mohammad Khan to rule as their tributary, the position in 1821.
zh:
罗兴伽（Roh）是印度史籍对喀布尔河到印度河上游山地之间这片普什图人土地的称呼，它的门户是镇守开伯尔山口的白沙瓦。古城布路沙布逻曾是贵霜帝国的都城，后来归属喀布尔沙希王朝；1001年11月28日，加兹尼的马哈茂德赢得白沙瓦之战，此地转入伽色尼王朝之手，继而落入古尔王朝，13世纪初又毁于蒙古人。到15世纪，谷地已归迪拉扎克等普什图部族所有，他们的羊群和马匹沿商道贩往印度，喀布尔与拉合尔之间的商队则穿过残城南来北往。1444年的白沙瓦只是部族掌握中的一座商队驿站，集市却因开伯尔山口的往来依旧喧闹。

1526年7月，巴布尔的军队攻取当时称贝格拉姆的白沙瓦并重建城堡；莫卧儿时代，这座城镇成为舍尔沙所修大干道上的首要边镇。阿克巴恢复了白沙瓦之名，但山地部族从不接受帝国统治：皮尔·罗尚的罗沙尼派信徒1586至1587年围攻此城，优素福扎伊人1667年举事，1672年阿夫里迪人在开伯尔山口歼灭一支莫卧儿军队并封锁山口，直到奥朗则布1674年亲自率军打通。喀布尔总督们在此过冬，莫哈巴特汗清真寺1630年落成，1586年城堡的一场大火烧掉了上千驮货物。纳迪尔沙1738年11月18日夺取白沙瓦，1747年起杜兰尼王朝把它作为冬都；1758年马拉塔人与锡克人一度占领此城，次年艾哈迈德沙便卷土重来。1809年，埃尔芬斯通率领的英国使团在城中觐见沙阿·舒贾，这是英国与阿富汗的首次正式接触。兰季特·辛格的锡克军队1818年席卷谷地，留下巴拉克扎伊酋长亚尔·穆罕默德汗作为附庸统治，1821年时局势便是如此。

en:
Mrauk U stands on the Arakan coastal plain, ringed by streams, hill ranges and the tidal creeks that fed its moats and canals. Min Saw Mon founded the city in 1430 after returning from long exile in Bengal with Bengali military help, and made it the capital of a renewed Arakanese kingdom. His brother Min Khayi took Sandoway in 1437, extending the dynasty southward. In 1444 the young Theravada court at Mrauk U kept close Bengali ties, visible in Islamic-style royal titles and coinage, while Arab and Indian ships already called along the coast.

Min Bin, who took the throne in 1531, strengthened the city's walls and built the fortress-like Shitthaung temple; by 1542 his governors held Chittagong. Mrauk U drove off Toungoo invasions in 1546–1547 and 1580–1581, and at its height around 1599–1603 its fleets dominated the coast from the Sundarbans to the Gulf of Martaban. By the early seventeenth century the capital had perhaps 160,000 people, thirty kilometres of fortifications, Portuguese and Dutch traders, and a profitable traffic in slaves and plunder. The Mughals took Chittagong in 1666, weakening the kingdom, and Burmese armies of the Konbaung dynasty ended Mrauk U's independence in 1785.
zh:
妙乌位于阿拉干沿海平原，河汊、潮汐水道与周围山陵共同构成其壕沟和运河体系。明苏蒙在孟加拉流亡多年后，借孟加拉军队于1430年建立此城，并把它作为复兴的阿拉干王国都城。其弟阿里钦（明克意）1437年攻取丹兑，把王朝势力推向南方。1444年，妙乌年轻的上座部佛教朝廷仍与孟加拉保持密切联系，伊斯兰式王号和货币即是明证，阿拉伯与印度商船也已往来于附近海岸。

1531年即位的明彬加固城防，修建形如要塞的八万佛寺（瑞特杭寺）；到1542年，他任命的官员已控制吉大港。妙乌先后在1546—1547年和1580—1581年击退东吁入侵，并在1599—1603年前后达到鼎盛，舰队控制着从孙德尔本斯到马达班湾的海岸。17世纪初，都城约有十六万人，环城工事长达三十公里，葡萄牙和荷兰商人云集，奴隶与劫掠贸易也带来巨额财富。1666年莫卧儿夺取吉大港，王国由此转弱；1785年，缅甸贡榜王朝的军队终结了妙乌的独立。

en:
Kale, in the valley of the Myittha River where the Chin Hills fall away to the Chindwin, was the chief town of the Kale-Kabaw country; local tradition dates its founding to 966. After the fall of Pagan the valley became a small Shan principality, which Ava brought under its control in 1406, when King Minkhaung sent his son Prince Min Nyo to govern it. In 1444 the frontier town was held for King Narapati by a Shan saopha who was the king's son-in-law; Shan lowlanders, Chin hill villagers and dealers in ivory and hill produce made it a quiet market on the road towards Manipur.

From the 1470s the rising saopha of Mohnyin raided Kale and the Kabaw Valley, and by the 1520s Kale had been drawn into the Mohnyin fold; its men marched with the Shan confederation that took Ava in 1527 and again defended it until the Toungoo drove the confederation up the Chindwin in 1555 and Bayinnaung secured the northern Shan states in 1557. Manipuri raiders later made the valley their road into Upper Burma between 1724 and 1741. Alaungpaya returned the blow in November 1758, marching this way to invade Manipur, stationing garrisons at Tamu and Thaungdut and bringing back horsemen who became his Cassay Horse. In 1813 Bodawpaya pushed forward bases into the Kabaw Valley to place his own candidate on the Manipuri throne.
zh:
格礼（今吉灵庙）坐落在钦敦江一条支流的河谷里、钦山丘陵倾入平原的地方，是格礼—格包一带的首镇，当地传说把建城之年追溯到966年。蒲甘王朝崩溃后，这里成为一个小小的掸邦；1406年，阿瓦王明康把王子明纽（即后来的格礼杰当纽）派来镇守，格礼并入阿瓦的势力范围。1444年，为阿瓦王那腊勃底镇守这边镇的是他的女婿、一位掸族诏法；河谷的掸人、西山里的钦人以及象牙和山货贩子，使这里成为通往曼尼普尔路上一处安静的市集。

1470年代起，日益强盛的孟养诏法连年袭掠格礼和格包河谷，到1520年代格礼已被孟养收入囊中。1527年，格礼兵随掸邦联军攻陷阿瓦；1555年，东吁大军又把联军沿钦敦江逐走，莽应龙（勃印曩）在1557年平定北方诸掸邦，格礼重归伊洛瓦底江政权管辖。1724至1741年间，曼尼普尔袭掠者把这条河谷当作深入上缅甸的通道。1758年11月，雍笈牙沿此道亲征曼尼普尔，在德穆和当都屯驻守军，带回的骑手后来编为他的「卡赛骑兵」。1813年，波道帕耶把前进基地推进格包河谷，将自己的代理人扶上曼尼普尔王位。

en:
Sagaing lies on the Irrawaddy opposite Ava, its ridge crowded with pagodas and forest monasteries. After the fall of Pagan, Prince Saw Yun made the town his seat in 1315 and replaced its timber walls with brick in 1316, ruling an independent kingdom until Maw Shan raiders sacked it in 1364. His grandson Thado Minbya seized the ruined city and nearby Pinya, and in 1365 founded Ava across the river. Under the Ava kings Sagaing became the customary fief of the crown prince. In 1444 it is a prosperous river town beside the granaries of the Mu valley and a retreat for monks, looking straight across at the royal capital.

In 1636 King Thalun dedicated the great egg-shaped Kaunghmudaw Pagoda, modeled on the Ruwanwelisaya of Sri Lanka. When the Mon armies of Pegu took Ava in 1752, Sagaing fell with it, but Alaungpaya of the new Konbaung dynasty soon won the river back; his son Naungdawgyi kept his court at Sagaing from 1760 to 1763 before the capital returned to Ava. Through the long wars with Siam and Qing China, kings and nobles went on endowing its hillside monasteries, and Sagaing remained the great monastic refuge of Upper Burma.
zh:
实皆位于伊洛瓦底江畔，与阿瓦（因瓦）隔河相望，江岸丘陵上佛塔与林间寺院密布。蒲甘王朝衰落后，王子苏云于1315年在此割据，1316年把木栅城墙改成砖墙，建立独立的实皆王国，直至1364年孟养掸军攻破城池。他的孙子他拖弥婆耶占据已成废墟的实皆与邻近的彬牙，于1365年在对岸另建阿瓦城。阿瓦时期，实皆按惯例封给王储。1444年的实皆是毗邻穆河谷粮仓的富庶江城，也是僧侣修行的去处，与对岸王都遥遥相对。

1636年，他隆王仿斯里兰卡的鲁万韦利萨雅塔，建成蛋形的贡慕陶大佛塔。1752年勃固孟族军队攻陷阿瓦，实皆一同陷落，但新兴贡榜王朝的雍笈牙很快收复沿江诸城；其子瑙道吉于1760至1763年以实皆为王廷，之后朝廷才迁回阿瓦。在与暹罗和清朝连年交战的岁月里，历代国王与贵族仍不断布施营建山坡上的寺院，实皆始终是上缅甸最大的僧侣庇护之地。

en:
Möng Yang, called Mohnyin in Burmese — the name means 'land of the snipe' in Shan — was the northernmost of the Shan states looking down on the Kingdom of Ava. The Yuan opened a tribal command there in 1295; after throwing off Mong Mao in 1399 it was recognised as a Ming pacification commission in 1404, and from 1406 Ava posted the prince later known as Mohnyin Thado to hold it, though its obedience seldom ran far. When the Ming crushed Mong Mao in the Luchuan wars, Si Renfa fled to Möng Yang in 1441, and Chinese and Burmese envoys haggled over his kin for the rest of the decade. In 1444 the sawbwa at Mohnyin held a war-pressed plain, sending tribute wherever he had to.

From the 1470s Möng Yang became Ava's nemesis. Its sawbwa Sawlon overran the kingdom from 1524 and in 1526 sacked its capital and set his son Thohanbwa on the throne; on his way back from attacking Prome he was murdered by his own ministers in 1533. Bayinnaung received Möng Yang's submission in 1557, but it rose with Mogaung in 1571, and after the long northern war the chief Si Ge, betrayed by his followers, was put to death and the land annexed in 1579; the Ming generals Liu Ting and Deng Zilong briefly won it back in 1583 and 1584. In 1769 Fu Heng's Qing army marched through, storming four stockades and posting a garrison, until the Kaungton peace returned the country to Burma. Under the Konbaung kings the Shan sawbwas gave way to Burmese governors, and Mohnyin became a royal myo.
zh:
孟养，缅语称莫宁（Mohnyin），掸语意为「鹬鸟之地」，是俯瞰阿瓦王国的诸掸邦中位置最北的一个。1295年元朝在此设雲遠路，1399年它脱离麓川，1404年被明朝册封为宣慰使司；1406年起阿瓦又派后来称孟养德多的王子镇守，但它对阿瓦的顺从向来有限。麓川之役中，思任法1441年战败逃奔孟养，此后十年间，明朝与阿瓦的使节一直为他的家族反复交涉。1444年，坐镇莫宁的诏法据着这片兵连祸结的平原，只得四面进贡、左右周旋。

1470年代起，孟养反过来成了阿瓦的克星。诏法色隆法1524年起兵攻入阿瓦，1526年攻陷其都，立儿子多汉发为王；1533年他在出征卑谬的回师途中被部下刺杀。1557年，孟养向莽应龙臣服，1571年又与孟拱联手反叛；长年北征之后，首领思个被部下出卖，1579年遇害，其地遭吞并，1583至1584年刘綎、邓子龙反攻时一度将其收复。1769年，傅恒率领的清军取道孟养，连破四寨并设台站驻军，直到老官屯议和才把这片地方交还缅甸。贡榜王朝时期，掸族诏法由中央任命的缅甸官员取代，莫宁成为王国治下的一个谬。

en:
Hsenwi, called Theinni by the Burmese and Mubang in Chinese records, lies in the valley of the Nam Tu (the Myitnge). Shan chronicles hail it as the seat of ancient Kawsampi, the kingdom where the first Shan princes came down from heaven. It rose after the Mongols overran Dali and Pagan, and around 1400, as Möng Mao broke up, the Ming court enrolled its ruler as the Mubang pacification commissioner and called Hsenwi troops into the campaigns that shattered Möng Mao in 1438–1444. In 1444 it was the greatest of the Shan states west of the Salween, its Theravada Buddhist saopha ruling dozens of vassal towns from a large walled capital.

In 1557 Bayinnaung's Toungoo armies subdued Hsenwi with the rest of the Shan states and confirmed its saopha as a Burmese vassal. After Bayinnaung's empire collapsed, Nyaungyan Min and his heir Anaukpetlun retook the town in October 1605, the two armies marching from Momeik and Hsipaw and routing the Hsenwi forces twice; the ailing Nyaungyan died on the road home south of Hsipaw. Around 1738 the Burmese court at Ava destroyed the old Kawsampi polity and parcelled its lands among chiefs of its own choosing. Hsenwi's last appearance on the wider stage came in 1767, when the Chinese general Ming Rui made the town his supply base on the march to Ava and Maha Thiha Thura was repulsed before its walls, though Ming Rui's army was destroyed at Maymyo three months later and the Qing invasion collapsed.
zh:
兴威，缅语称登尼，中国史籍称木邦，坐落于南杜河（米界河）谷地。掸族编年史把它奉为古国侨赏弥的王都，传说最早的掸族王子自天而降便在此地。蒙古攻灭大理与蒲甘之后木邦乘机崛起，1400年前后麓川瓦解，明朝封其统治者为木邦宣慰使，并征调木邦兵马参加1438至1444年击垮麓川的战役。1444年时，它是萨尔温江以西最强大的掸邦，信奉上座部佛教的诏法在坚固的都城里统治着数十个属邦。

1557年，勃印曩的东吁军队在平定诸掸邦时征服兴威，兴威诏法被确认为缅甸藩属。勃印曩帝国崩溃后，1605年10月，良渊王与王储阿那毕隆自莫梅、昔卜两路进军，两度击溃兴威军队，收复其地；染病的良渊王在班师途中死于昔卜以南。1738年前后，阿瓦的缅人朝廷攻灭古老的侨赏弥政权，把其土地分封给听命于阿瓦的头人。兴威最后一次登上大舞台是1767年：清将明瑞以此城为进军阿瓦的补给基地，玛哈·希哈修亚攻城受挫；但三个月后明瑞大军在眉苗被歼，第三次清缅战争以溃败告终。

en:
Ava, or Inwa, was built from 26 February 1365 on an artificial island at the meeting of the Irrawaddy and Myitnge rivers, where canals joined the surrounding swamps into a walled royal city. Thado Minbya founded it after uniting Sagaing and Pinya, and its command over the Kyaukse rice lands made it the chief Burmese power of Upper Burma. In 1444 Narapati I, king for two years, ruled from Ava after the long Forty Years' War had exhausted the kingdom; Mogaung raids and Ming campaigns on the Yunnan frontier were already testing his northern vassals.

A new golden palace was raised in 1511 under King Shwenankyawshin, but Ava's independence did not long outlast it. On 25 March 1527 the Mohnyin-led Shan confederation and Prome sacked the city, and on 22 January 1555 Bayinnaung of Toungoo captured it. After Toungoo power collapsed in 1599, Kings Nyaungyan and Anaukpetlun used Ava as the base for their restoration, and Thalun moved the royal court back from Pegu in January 1635. Restored Hanthawaddy forces sacked and burned Ava in 1752–53. Hsinbyushin rebuilt the city and returned the court there in July 1765, but Bodawpaya moved the capital to Amarapura in May 1783.
zh:
阿瓦，又译因瓦，1365年2月26日建于伊洛瓦底江与密埃河交汇处的人工岛上；运河连通周围沼泽，围成一座有城墙的王都。他拖弥婆耶统一实皆和彬牙后建立此城，阿瓦凭仗周边叫栖稻作区，成为上缅甸最主要的缅人政权。1444年，即位两年的那腊勃底在阿瓦临朝，此时漫长的四十年战争已经耗尽国力，孟拱的袭扰和明朝在云南边境的军事行动正考验着北方藩属。

1511年，瑞南觉欣王在城中建起新的金宫，但阿瓦的独立并未维持太久。1527年3月25日，以孟养为首的掸族联盟会同卑谬洗劫此城；1555年1月22日，东吁的勃印曩攻占阿瓦。1599年东吁政权崩溃后，良渊王和阿那毕隆以阿瓦为基地复兴王国，他隆王又于1635年1月把朝廷从勃固迁回。1752—1753年，复兴的汉达瓦底军队洗劫并焚毁阿瓦。辛标信重建城市，于1765年7月还都；1783年5月，波道帕耶又把首都迁往阿马拉布拉。

en:
Taungoo was founded in 1279 as the Pagan kingdom pushed settlers into the Sittaung valley. After Pagan collapsed in 1287, the town passed through the rulers of Myinsaing and Pinya, then broke away in 1358 and kept its independence until 1367. Its governors afterwards acknowledged Ava only nominally, preserving their freedom by balancing Ava against the Mon kingdom of Hanthawaddy. In 1444 Taungoo was therefore a Theravada Burmese frontier principality rather than a securely held province: a walled town between the hills, valuable as a southern approach to the Irrawaddy basin and as a refuge from the wars of Upper Burma.

Ava crushed another Taungoo revolt in 1470 and gave the governorship to its general Sithu Kyawhtin. His grandson Mingyi Nyo took office in 1485, built up the little state, and formally renounced Ava's overlordship in October 1510. Under Tabinshwehti and Bayinnaung the dynasty created a vast Burmese empire, but Tabinshwehti moved the capital from Taungoo to Pegu in 1539, leaving the old town as a viceregal seat. In 1599 Viceroy Minye Thihathu II joined Arakanese forces and Portuguese mercenaries in the sack of Pegu and declared himself king. Natshinnaung succeeded in 1609, yet the independence of Taungoo lasted only until 1610, when King Anaukpetlun captured the city and ended its separate ruling line.
zh:
东吁建于1279年，最初是蒲甘王国向锡当河谷拓展时形成的前沿据点。1287年蒲甘崩溃后，这座城镇先后受制于敏象和宾亚，1358年起兵自立，维持独立至1367年。此后的统治者只在名义上臣服阿瓦，借阿瓦与孟人的罕礁越利王国相互制衡来保有自治。1444年的东吁因此更像一个上座部佛教的缅人边境侯国，而非被牢固控制的行省：它是群山间的筑城之地，既扼守伊洛瓦底江流域的南方通道，也成为逃避上缅甸战祸者的避难所。

1470年，阿瓦镇压东吁再次爆发的叛乱，把此地封给平叛将领西都觉廷。其孙明吉瑜1485年就任总督，逐步壮大这个小国，并于1510年10月正式摆脱阿瓦宗主权，建立东吁王国。在德彬瑞蒂和勃印曩治下，东吁王朝建立起幅员辽阔的缅甸帝国，但德彬瑞蒂1539年把都城从东吁迁往勃固，旧城仅保留为副王驻地。1599年，副王明耶底哈都二世联合若开军队与葡萄牙雇佣军洗劫勃固，并自立为王。那信南1609年继位，东吁的独立却只维持到1610年；阿那毕隆攻占该城，终结了当地独立的统治世系。

en:
Pegu began as a small Mon town on the tidal plains of Lower Burma and became the capital of Hanthawaddy in 1369, when King Binnya U moved his court there. Under Razadarit, the kingdom withstood Ava in the long Forty Years' War. In 1444 Binnya Ran I was in the twentieth year of his reign; after decades of peace with the north, his Mon kingdom drew merchants across the Indian Ocean, and its Buddhist court ruled over one of the wealthiest ports in the region.

Queen Shin Sawbu and King Dhammazedi, who reigned from 1472 to 1492, strengthened Pegu's Buddhist institutions and foreign commerce. António Correia landed there in 1519, opening direct Portuguese trade, but Tabinshwehti of Toungoo captured the city in 1538–39. Bayinnaung made Pegu his capital in 1553–54 and opened the rebuilt Kanbawzathadi Palace in 1568. Toungoo and Arakanese armies sacked it in 1599, and the court withdrew to Ava in 1634. A Mon rising restored Hanthawaddy in 1740, until Alaungpaya took Pegu in May 1757. Bodawpaya later rebuilt the town, but the shifting river had cut it off from the sea.
zh:
勃固起初是下缅甸潮汐平原上的一座孟人小镇，1369年彬尼亚乌王建都于此，成为汉达瓦底的都城。罗娑陀利在位时，王国在漫长的四十年战争中抵挡住北方阿瓦。1444年正值彬尼亚仰一世统治后期；与北方维持了数十年和平后，他的孟人王国吸引着跨越印度洋的商人，佛教王室掌握着这一带最富庶的港口之一。

信修浮女王和1472年至1492年在位的达摩悉提王强化了勃固的佛教制度与海外贸易。1519年，安东尼奥·科雷亚登陆勃固，打开了葡萄牙人的直接贸易；但东吁的德彬瑞蒂在1538—1539年攻占此城。勃印曩在1553—1554年定都勃固，并于1568年启用重建的甘菩遮塔迪宫。1599年，东吁与若开军队洗劫城市，朝廷随后在1634年迁往阿瓦。1740年孟人起义，恢复汉达瓦底，最终雍笈牙于1757年5月攻占勃固。波道帕耶后来重建此城，但河道改道已使它不再临海。

en:
Kengtung occupies a broad valley in the eastern Shan hills, on the old routes linking Sipsongpanna with Lanna. The town was the seat of a Tai Khün saopha, whose dynasty traced its origins to the thirteenth-century expansion of King Mangrai; Tai Khün, Tai Lü and Tai Yai farmed the valley floor, while Akha, Lahu and Wa communities lived in the surrounding mountains. Ming China recognized the principality as a tusi in 1405, calling it Menggen. In 1444 its ruler stood between China, Lanna and the Burmese kingdoms, usually sending the ritual gold-flower tribute westward while keeping the government of his own hills.

In 1558, after Bayinnaung's conquest of Lanna, Kengtung submitted to the Toungoo rulers, and the Burmese court confirmed its local Mangrai-line prince as saopha. The hills again became a frontier in 1802, when Chiang Mai forces under Thammalangka, brother of Kawila, captured Kengtung and deported thousands of Tai Khün to repopulate Chiang Mai. Sao Kawng Tai submitted in 1804, while his brother Maha Hkanan maintained resistance from Mong Yawng. In 1813 Maha Hkanan accepted Burmese suzerainty, restoring Kengtung as a Konbaung-protected Shan principality.
zh:
景栋占据掸邦东部山岭中的一片宽谷，地处十二版纳与兰纳之间的旧商路上。城镇是傣坤诏法的驻地，其王朝可追溯到13世纪孟莱王扩张时期；傣坤、傣仂和傣亚在谷底耕作，阿卡、拉祜和佤族群落住在周围山地。1405年，明朝承认这个土邦为土司，称孟艮。1444年，统治者夹在中国、兰纳与缅甸诸王国之间，通常把仪式性的金花送往西方，同时仍由自己掌管山地政务。

1558年勃印曩征服兰纳后，景栋归顺东吁王朝，缅甸宫廷确认孟莱血统的本地统治者继续担任诏法。1802年，山地再度成为前线：清迈王卡维拉之弟探玛兰伽率军攻占景栋，把数千名傣坤人迁往清迈补充人口。在位诏法于1804年臣服，其弟玛哈卡南则以孟永为据点坚持抵抗。1813年，玛哈卡南接受缅甸宗主权，景栋作为受贡榜王朝保护的掸邦土邦恢复。

en:
Mong Nai, the Burmese Mone, sits in a broad rice- and cotton-growing valley of the southern Shan hills. Shan and Northern Thai chronicles disagree over its beginnings: one tradition has it conquered by Sam Long Hpa of the northern Shan empire in 1223, while another makes it a foundation of Khun Khüa, a son of King Mangrai of Lan Na, in 1318. What is not in doubt is the bond with Chiang Mai, for the rulers of Mone were kin to Lan Na's Mengrai dynasty. In 1444 it was one of the strongest of the southern Shan states, its saopha holding court in the timber palace (haw) at Mong Nai town while smaller hill mong paid him allegiance.

Mone sent tribute to Bayinnaung in 1556 and so escaped the first Toungoo sweep of the Shan country, but in 1557 it rose with Lan Na's backing, seized Hsipaw and put Bayinnaung's newly appointed saopha to death. In November 1557 five Toungoo armies, 33,000 strong and led by the king in person, retook Hsipaw and Mone without a hard fight. When the Toungoo empire dissolved, Mone broke free until Nyaungyan Min captured it in 1603; Naresuan of Siam marched to avenge this in 1605 but died on the border, and in 1614 Anaukpetlun's northern army jumped off from Mone for the reconquest of Lan Na. Burmese kings afterwards kept Mone as their principal garrison and administrative seat in the southern Shan states, and by the early nineteenth century its ruler governed with the Burmese title of myoza.
zh:
孟乃，缅语称莫内（Mone），坐落于掸邦高原南部一处盛产稻米与棉花的宽谷。掸族与泰北的编年史对其起源说法不一：一说它在1223年被北部掸人帝国的三隆法征服，另一说称其为兰纳国王芒莱之子坤夸1318年所建。可以确定的是它与清迈的渊源——孟乃的统治者与兰纳的孟莱王族同出一支。1444年时，孟乃是南部诸掸邦中最强者之一，诏法在孟乃城的木宫（haw）中听政，周围更小的山区勐都向他称臣。

1556年孟乃向勃印曩进贡，因而躲过东吁军对掸地的第一次扫荡；但1557年它在兰纳支持下起兵，夺取昔卜，处死勃印曩新任命的诏法。1557年11月，勃印曩亲率五支大军、三万三千人反攻，昔卜与孟乃未经苦战便告易手。东吁帝国崩溃后孟乃重新自立，直至1603年被良渊王攻占；暹罗国王纳黎萱1605年出兵为其复仇，却病死在边境；1614年阿那毕隆的北路军即以孟乃为出发基地，重新征服兰纳。此后历代缅王以孟乃为南掸诸邦的主要驻军与行政中心，到19世纪初，其统治者以缅人封号「谬沙」（myoza）治邦。

en:
Chiang Mai, the 'new city', was founded on the Ping River in 1296 by King Mangrai, who had united his Tai chiefdoms with the old Mon kingdom of Hariphunchai and abandoned flood-prone Wiang Kum Kam; he laid out its brick walls and moat with his allies Ngam Mueang of Phayao and Ram Khamhaeng of Sukhothai. Wat Chiang Man was the first temple within the walls, and later kings built Wat Phra Singh and raised the great brick Chedi Luang, while a relic stupa went up on Doi Suthep in 1386. Theravada learning and the caravan trade in ivory, teak and lac made Lan Na rich. In 1441 Tilokkarat seized the throne from his father, and in 1442 he routed an Ayutthayan army sent to back his brother’s revolt. In 1444, at the opening of his long reign, Chiang Mai stood at the height of its power, the crossroads where Yunnanese and Shan caravans met the trade of the Siamese plains.

Tilokkarat fought Ayutthaya for the old Sukhothai lands, annexed Phayao in 1456 and held Chaliang for twelve years before making peace in 1475; in 1477 he held a Buddhist council to recompile the Tripitaka at the Wat Chet Yot he had built. The next century was a long decline: King Ket was assassinated in 1545, his widow Chiraprapha bought off an Ayutthayan invasion, and in 1547 the Shan chief Mekuti took the throne. On 2 April 1558 Mekuti surrendered Chiang Mai to Bayinnaung, opening two centuries of Burmese rule, interrupted only when Nawrahta Minsaw submitted to Naresuan in 1602 and in the years after Naresuan's death, before the Burmese returned in 1614. The English merchant Ralph Fitch, passing through in 1586, found Yunnanese caravans trading gold, silver and civet in the occupied city. Heavy taxation provoked a great revolt in 1727; the townspeople threw the Burmese back twice, and the Ping valley ruled itself until the Konbaung dynasty retook it in 1757. With Siamese help Kawila of Lampang captured the city on 15 January 1775, but a Burmese counterstroke in 1776 left Chiang Mai abandoned and overgrown; Kawila re-entered and rebuilt it in the 1790s as a vassal of Bangkok, and his conquest of Chiang Saen helped fill the old city with people again.
zh:
清迈意为「新城」，1296年由孟莱王建于宾河畔：他先兼并了孟人古国哈里奔猜（南奔），又因魏功甘（Wiang Kum Kam）屡遭水患而弃用，便与盟邦帕夭王恩孟、素可泰王兰甘亨共同选定城址，筑起砖城与护城河。清曼寺是城内第一座寺院，后来的国王又兴建帕辛寺、大修斋里銮大佛塔；1386年，素贴山顶的舍利塔动工。上座部佛学与象牙、柚木、紫胶的商队贸易使兰纳富足。1441年，蒂洛卡拉逼父夺位，1442年击溃一支前来支援其兄叛乱的阿瑜陀耶军队。1444年，他的漫长统治才刚开始，清迈正处在国力鼎盛之时，是云南、掸邦商队与暹罗平原贸易相会的十字路口。

蒂洛卡拉与阿瑜陀耶争夺旧素可泰之地，1456年吞并帕尧，占据查良十二年，至1475年议和；1477年，他在自己所建的七塔寺（Wat Chet Yot）召集佛教结集，重新校订三藏。此后百年国势日衰：国王盖（Ket）1545年被弑，王后吉拉帕芭以财帛退去阿瑜陀耶之师，1547年掸邦土司美古提（Mekuti）继位。1558年4月2日，美古提向勃印曩投降，清迈自此进入两百年缅统时期，其间只有1602年诺拉塔敏昭一度臣服纳黎萱、以及纳黎萱死后的短暂独立，1614年缅甸再度入主。英国商人拉尔夫·菲奇1586年路过此城，见到云南商队在缅军占领下的清迈买卖黄金、白银与灵猫香。1727年，重税激起大规模民变，城中军民两度击退缅军，宾河谷地自立，直到1757年被贡榜王朝重新征服。1775年1月15日，南邦的卡维拉（Kawila）在暹罗支援下攻克清迈；但1776年缅军反攻后，清迈城荒草丛生、无人居住，卡维拉在1790年代才重返重建，以曼谷藩臣的身份统治，他攻占清盛，也使这座古城重新有了人烟。

en:
Martaban, called Mottama in Burmese, lies on the west bank of the Salween estuary, opposite Moulmein on the Gulf of Martaban. The Mon knew the old city as Sampanago, and an inscription set up in 1176 by Sithu II of Pagan already records it as a trading port. When Pagan collapsed in 1287 the Mon merchant-chief Wareru seized the town and made it the capital of the Mon kingdom, and it kept that rank until the court moved to Pegu in the 1360s. Long afterwards Martaban remained one of the busiest harbours east of India: junks cleared its quays for Siam, Java and Sumatra, and the great glazed storage jars it shipped were known across the Indian Ocean as martabans. The Chinese traveller Wang Dayuan found a crowded market town dealing in ivory, silk and metals. In 1444 it was the chief port of the Mon kings of Hanthawaddy Pegu, a Theravada Buddhist land grown rich on the Bay of Bengal trade.

Early in the sixteenth century the viceroy Saw Binnya ruled Martaban like a sovereign, hiring Portuguese mercenaries and gunners and refusing to aid Pegu against Toungoo. When Tabinshwehti took Pegu in 1538–1539 the port stood alone, and in 1541, after a long siege, Toungoo troops stormed and sacked it and put Saw Binnya to death. Martaban never recovered its old wealth, becoming a frontier stronghold in the wars between Burma and Siam. In 1740 the Mon of Pegu rebelled and restored the kingdom of Hanthawaddy, but Alaungpaya of the new Konbaung dynasty crushed the restoration and took Pegu in May 1757. Martaban returned to Burmese rule, and thousands of Mon fled east into Siam.
zh:
马达班，缅语称莫塔马，地处萨尔温江口西岸，临马达班湾，与毛淡棉隔河相望。孟人古称此城为三巴纳哥，蒲甘国王悉都二世1176年所立的碑铭，已把它记作贸易港口。1287年蒲甘崩溃后，孟人商人首领瓦里鲁夺取此城，立为孟人王国的都城，直到14世纪60年代朝廷才迁往勃固。迁都之后很久，马达班仍是印度以东最繁忙的港口之一：帆船从这里启航前往暹罗、爪哇和苏门答腊，当地外运的大型釉陶瓮在整个印度洋被称为「马达班」。中国航海家汪大渊见到的，是一座买卖象牙、丝绸和金属的繁华商镇。1444年，它是孟人勃固王国的首要港口，这是一个靠孟加拉湾贸易致富的上座部佛教国家。

16世纪初，总督苏毕尼亚（Saw Binnya）在马达班形同割据，雇用葡萄牙雇佣兵和炮手，又不肯发兵救援正与东吁交战的勃固。1538至1539年德彬瑞梯攻占勃固后，马达班便孤立无援；1541年，东吁军经长期围城猛攻而下，洗劫全城，处死苏毕尼亚。马达班再未恢复昔日的富庶，沦为缅甸与暹罗历次战争中的边地要塞。1740年，勃固的孟人起兵复兴勃固王国，但新建贡榜王朝的雍笈牙镇压了这次复兴，于1757年5月攻占勃固。马达班重归缅甸统治，数以千计的孟人向东逃入暹罗。

en:
Tavoy lies thirty kilometres up the Dawei River estuary from the Andaman Sea, its low streets flooded at every monsoon. At Sagara, six miles north of the present city, archaeologists have found Pyu burial urns, beads and coins, and from the eleventh to the thirteenth century the coast belonged to the Pagan Empire. After Pagan fell in 1287 the estuary passed to Sukhothai and then to Ayutthaya. In 1444 Tavoy was a Mon-speaking, Theravada Buddhist port on Siam's remote western shore, shared by Dawei, Mon, Karen and Thai mariners.

Bayinnaung of Toungoo took Tavoy with the rest of Siam in 1564, and though Siamese arms recovered the city in 1594, King Anaukpetlun retook the northern coast as far as Tavoy in 1614, stationing a Burmese garrison in his southernmost possession. During the Burmese civil wars Siam seized the city in the late 1740s, but Alaungpaya, founder of the Konbaung dynasty, recovered it in 1760, and his son Hsinbyushin had made the whole Tenasserim coast Burmese by 1765. Tavoy served as a forward base for the Burmese invasions of Siam of 1775–1776, 1785–1786 and 1809–1812, while Siamese attempts to regain the coast in 1787 and 1792 both failed.
zh:
土瓦位于土瓦河河口，距安达曼海约三十公里，地势低洼，每逢雨季常有水患。现城以北约六英里的萨加拉古城出土过骠人的骨灰瓮、串珠和钱币，11至13世纪间，这一带海岸属于蒲甘王国。1287年蒲甘崩溃后，河口先归入素可泰，后转属阿瑜陀耶。1444年的土瓦是暹罗偏远西岸一座讲孟语、信奉上座部佛教的港口，土瓦人、孟人、克伦人和泰人的水手在此往来。

1564年，东吁的勃印曩在征服全暹罗时一并拿下土瓦；暹罗虽于1594年收复此城，阿拿毕隆1614年又攻占北部海岸直至土瓦，并在这座最南端的领地屯驻缅军。18世纪40年代末的缅甸内战中，暹罗趁乱夺取土瓦，但贡榜王朝开国之主雍笈牙于1760年将其收复，其子辛标信更在1765年控制整条丹那沙林海岸。此后土瓦成为缅甸进军暹罗的前进基地，1775—1776年、1785—1786年和1809—1812年的几次入侵皆由此发动；暹罗1787年和1792年反攻海岸，也都告失败。

en:
Ratchaburi sits on the west bank of the Mae Klong River, where the road from Ayutthaya enters the Tenasserim hills and the passes toward Burma. Archaeologists have found Dvaravati settlements here more than two thousand years old, founded inland at the edges of marshes rather than on the ancient shoreline, and the old town was long a meeting point for merchants between the Chao Phraya plain and the western frontier. In the thirteenth century Ram Khamhaeng brought Ratchaburi into Sukhothai, and under Ayutthaya it served both as a trading town and as a fortress guarding the western approaches. In 1444 it was a Siamese, Theravada Buddhist town whose river boats carried the rice of the Mae Klong plain downstream.

When Burmese armies overran and destroyed Ayutthaya in 1767, Ratchaburi too fell under a Burmese garrison. In 1768 King Taksin, campaigning out of his new base to the east, drove the Burmese from the town, restoring the western approaches to the Siam he was reunifying.
zh:
叻武里位于夜功河西岸，从阿瑜陀耶西去丹那沙林山区、通往缅甸各山口的道路在此入山。当地发现了两千多年前的堕罗钵底文化聚落，它们当初建在沼泽边缘的内陆，而非古海湾岸边；这座古城很早便是湄南河平原与西部边陲之间商人往来的交汇之地。13世纪兰甘亨将叻武里并入素可泰，到阿瑜陀耶时代，它既是商镇，也是扼守西部门户的要塞。1444年，这里是一座暹罗人的上座部佛教城镇，河船把夜功平原的米粮运往下游。

1767年缅军攻陷并毁灭阿瑜陀耶时，叻武里也落入缅军戍守。1768年，郑信王从东部新根据地出师，将缅军逐出该城，把西部门户重新纳入他正在统一的暹罗。

en:
Nakhon Si Thammarat lies on the east coast of the Malay Peninsula and ranks among the oldest cities in Siam. An inscription records the king of Srivijaya establishing himself at Ligor, as foreigners called the place, as early as 775, and under the name Tambralinga it sent tribute to Song China. In 1231 King Sri Thammasok raised Wat Phra Mahathat, the great relic-stupa, and brought in Sinhalese Theravada Buddhism; the Ramkhamhaeng stele of 1292 lists the city as the southernmost tributary of Sukhothai. After a fourteenth-century decline it was refounded by a prince of Phetchaburi and drawn into Ayutthaya's orbit. In 1444 its own dynasty still ruled, the Phra Mahathat drew pilgrims from across the region, and traders plying the Gulf of Siam knew the port as Ligor.

King Trailok's palatine law of 1468 numbered Ligor among Ayutthaya's eight great cities, though its governorship still passed from father to son within the old dynasty. When the city rose against King Prasat Thong in 1629, he sent the Japanese adventurer Yamada Nagamasa to crush the revolt and briefly made him its lord. Under King Narai the French architect de Lamare rebuilt the walls in the 1680s, and after the Siamese revolution of 1688 another rising was put down in 1692. The fall of Ayutthaya in 1767 left Ligor independent under its vice-governor Nu until Taksin subdued it in 1769. Rama I reduced its ruler to an appointed governor in 1784, and two years later Burmese armies sacked the city. From 1811 the governor Nakhon Noi, whom the British called the Raja of Ligor, presided over a largely autonomous southern trading centre.
zh:
那空是贪玛叻（西方称洛坤，Ligor）位于马来半岛东岸，是暹罗最古老的城市之一。有铭文记载，三佛齐国王早在775年已在洛坤立足；这里古称单马令（Tambralinga），曾向中国宋朝朝贡。1231年，室利昙摩索王建起供奉佛舍利的玛哈泰寺，传入锡兰系上座部佛教；1292年的兰甘亨碑铭把此城列为素可泰最南端的属邦。14世纪该城一度衰落后，由碧武里的一位王子重建，转入阿瑜陀耶的势力范围。1444年，这里仍由本地王朝统治，玛哈泰寺的大佛塔吸引着各地香客，往来暹罗湾的商船都知道这座港口叫洛坤。

戴莱洛迦纳王1468年的宫廷法把洛坤列为阿瑜陀耶的八大都城之一，但总督之位仍在旧王朝内父子相传。1629年该城起兵反对巴萨通王，国王派日本佣兵头领山田长政将其镇压，并一度封他为洛坤之主。那莱王时代，法国建筑师拉马尔（de Lamare）在1680年代重修城墙；1688年暹罗革命后，当地再起的叛乱于1692年被讨平。1767年阿瑜陀耶陷落，洛坤副都督努自立于南部，直到1769年被郑信征服。拉玛一世1784年把洛坤之主降为任命的总督，两年后缅军洗劫了这座城市。1811年起出任总督的那空·诺依被英国人称为「洛坤罗阇」，在他治下，这座南方商埠享有很大的自治权。

en:
Patani lies on the north-eastern coast of the Malay peninsula, where its river mouth gave anchorage to ships crossing the Gulf of Siam and the South China Sea. It grew as the successor of older Malay maritime realms such as Langkasuka, and in the 15th century its raja accepted Islam and took the title of sultan. Muslim merchants from Pasai and Chinese junks already kept warehouses along the river, while rice lands and the forested hinterland supplied pepper, timber, ivory and hides. In 1444 Patani was an independent Malay Muslim sultanate on the edge of Ayutthaya's orbit, balancing Siamese power against the demands of the foreign merchants who made its harbour one of the busiest on the peninsula's eastern shore.

The fall of Malacca to the Portuguese in 1511 turned Patani into the chief refuge of traders fleeing Portuguese rule: Portuguese factors arrived in 1516, a Portuguese fleet raided the port in 1524, and the Japanese, Dutch and English followed in 1592, 1602 and 1612. Sultan Mudhaffar Shah marched on Ayutthaya in 1563 while Bayinnaung's Burmese armies pressed Siam, but died on campaign the next year. Murders over the succession then cleared the royal line of men, and from 1584 four queens ruled in turn, the Green, Blue, Purple and Yellow Rajas; under them Patani entered its golden age, its market crowded with Chinese, Javanese, Indian and European shipping. The Purple Queen threw off Siamese overlordship and repulsed a Siamese invasion in 1633–1634. After Ayutthaya crushed Patani's rebellion of 1688 with 50,000 men, the merchants drifted away. Patani broke free again when Ayutthaya fell in 1767, but in 1786 a Siamese army under Prince Surasi stormed and destroyed the town and deported much of its people, reducing the old sultanate to seven small principalities under Bangkok.
zh:
北大年位于马来半岛东北岸，河口为往来暹罗湾与南海的船只提供了停泊之所。它是狼牙修等古代马来海洋政权的后继者，15世纪时，当地统治者皈依伊斯兰教，改称苏丹。巴赛的穆斯林商人与中国商船早年来此沿河开设货栈，稻田和丛林腹地则出产胡椒、木材、象牙和皮革。1444年的北大年是一个独立的马来人穆斯林苏丹国，处在阿瑜陀耶势力范围的边缘，在暹罗强邻与各国商人之间周旋，港口已是半岛东岸最繁忙的港湾之一。

1511年马六甲落入葡萄牙人之手，逃避葡萄牙统治的商人纷纷转投北大年：葡萄牙商行1516年到此，一支葡萄牙舰队又在1524年袭掠港口，日本、荷兰、英国商人也分别于1592年、1602年和1612年接踵而至。苏丹穆扎法尔·沙趁勃印曩的缅甸大军压境，于1563年进军阿瑜陀耶，却在次年班师途中病死。此后继位之争让王族男丁凋零，1584年起绿女王、蓝女王、紫女王、黄女王四位女王相继执政，北大年进入黄金时代，码头上挤满中国、爪哇、印度和欧洲的商船。紫女王拒向暹罗称臣纳贡，并在1633至1634年击退暹军入侵。1688年阿瑜陀耶出动五万大军镇压北大年反叛，商人随之纷纷离去。1767年阿瑜陀耶城破，北大年再举独立之旗，但1786年素拉西亲王率暹军攻陷并摧毁城市，大量居民被迁徙，古老的苏丹国被拆成七个听命于曼谷的小邦。

en:
The Perak River winds out of the tin-bearing highlands to a mangrove coast on the Strait of Malacca. Earlier Hindu-Buddhist chiefdoms had grown rich on the river's trade, and by the 15th century the kingdom of Beruas held its lower valley; Muslim graves around the river ports show merchants from Malacca and Sumatra settling there. The country had no sultan of its own, and its river chiefs answered to Malacca. In 1444 Perak tin and forest produce were already moving south through Malacca's market, carried by Malaccan and Sumatran traders.

After the Portuguese took Malacca in 1511, the last Malaccan sultan's son Muzaffar Shah was invited upriver by the trader-chief Tun Saban and installed in 1528 as Perak's first sultan. Tin soon drew predators: an Acehnese army overran the country in 1573 and carried the royal family off to Sumatra, and in 1620 Aceh struck again and captured the reigning sultan. Dutch pressure then replaced Acehnese overlordship, and in the 1650s treaties granted the VOC a monopoly over Perak's tin; from 1670 the company kept a fort on Pangkor Island, repeatedly sacked and rebuilt. Forty years of civil war over tin revenues drew in Bugis war fleets, and in 1747 the hard-pressed sultan leased the monopoly afresh to the Dutch, who moved their factory to the Perak estuary. In 1776 the sultan brought Chinese miners in from Dutch Malacca to work the tin fields, but the Anglo-Dutch war of 1780 ruined the trade and many of them left, leaving a poorer, feud-torn Perak to the new century.
zh:
霹雳河从产锡的高地蜿蜒西行，经红树林海岸注入马六甲海峡。伊斯兰教传入之前，印度教与佛教小邦已凭河上贸易兴盛；到15世纪，下游有木威王国，河口港口一带的穆斯林墓葬表明，马六甲和苏门答腊商人已在此落户。这片土地没有自己的苏丹，沿河酋长都听命于马六甲。1444年时，霹雳的锡和林产品已由马六甲和苏门答腊商人贩运南下，进入马六甲的市场。

1511年葡萄牙攻占马六甲后，马六甲末代苏丹之子目扎法沙应商人首领敦沙班之请溯河而上，于1528年受立为霹雳第一任苏丹。锡矿很快引来觊觎：1573年亚齐军队攻破霹雳，将王室掳往苏门答腊；1620年亚齐再度来犯，俘走在位苏丹。此后荷兰人的压力取代了亚齐的宗主权，1650年代的几项条约把霹雳锡矿的收购权授予荷兰东印度公司；1670年起公司在邦咯岛修筑要塞，又屡毁屡修。为争夺锡矿收入，霹雳陷入四十年内战，武吉斯战船卷入其中；1747年苏丹被迫与荷兰重订商约，荷兰人把商站迁到霹雳河口。1776年，苏丹从荷属马六甲引入华工开采锡砂，1780年英荷战争使锡矿贸易萧条，许多华工离去，霹雳也在贫困与纷争中进入新的世纪。

en:
Malacca began as a fishing village at the mouth of the Malacca River, where Parameswara founded a new port around 1400 after the fall of Singapura. Orang Laut patrols guided shipping through the nearby strait and checked piracy, while the sheltered roadstead drew Chinese, Arab, Indian and Persian merchants. A Ming embassy in 1405 and Zheng He's later calls gave the port diplomatic backing against Siamese pressure. Sultan Muhammad Shah, who reigned from 1424 to 1444, adopted Islam and regulated commerce through the Maritime Laws of Malacca, with four shahbandars serving the port's foreign trading communities. In 1444, as his reign closed, Malacca was a Sunni Malay emporium dealing in spices, tin, Indian cloth, Chinese porcelain and silk.

Under Muzaffar Shah, Mansur Shah and the bendahara Tun Perak, Malaccan power spread over much of the Malay Peninsula and into Riau and Sumatra; by around 1500 the city was the archipelago's leading Muslim market and a centre of Islamic learning. Diogo Lopes de Sequeira arrived on 1 August 1509, but fled when a court faction tried to seize his ships and left several men captive. Afonso de Albuquerque returned in April 1511 and took the city in August, after which the Portuguese built A Famosa. Sultan Mahmud Shah withdrew south, and his heirs established the dynasties of Johor and Perak. Francis Xavier preached in Malacca in 1545, 1546 and 1549, while warfare with Aceh and Johor and the rise of rival ports dispersed its trade. A Dutch East India Company force, aided by Johor, captured the city on 14 January 1641. Batavia remained the Dutch centre of power; Perak tin brought Malacca some profit for a time, but by 1700 the old emporium had faded. The British occupied it from 1795 during the European wars and began dismantling the fortress in 1807, leaving only the Porta de Santiago; Dutch administration returned in 1818.
zh:
马六甲原是马六甲河口的渔村，约1400年，拜里米苏拉在新加坡拉陷落后到此开辟新港。罗越人在近海巡逻，引导商船通过附近海峡并压制海盗；这个避风锚地随之吸引中国、阿拉伯、印度和波斯商人。1405年明朝使节来航，郑和船队此后多次停泊，为马六甲牵制暹罗压力提供了外交支撑。1424至1444年在位的穆罕默德沙苏丹改宗伊斯兰教，以《马六甲海商法》规范贸易，并设置四名沙班达管理外来商团。1444年其统治结束时，马六甲已是逊尼派马来人的商贸都会，经营香料、锡、印度布匹、中国瓷器和丝绸。

在穆扎法尔沙、曼苏尔沙和盘陀诃罗敦·霹雳治下，马六甲势力扩及马来半岛大部以及廖内、苏门答腊；到1500年前后，该城已是马来群岛首屈一指的穆斯林市场和伊斯兰学术中心。1509年8月1日，迪奥戈·洛佩斯·德·塞凯拉抵达，但马六甲宫廷一派企图夺取其船，他只得逃走，部众多人被俘。1511年4月，阿方索·德·阿尔布克尔克率军再来，8月攻占城市，葡萄牙人随后修建法摩沙堡。马哈茂德沙苏丹南撤，其后人建立柔佛和霹雳王朝。方济各·沙勿略曾于1545、1546和1549年在马六甲传教；与亚齐、柔佛的战争以及其他港口兴起，使贸易逐渐分散。1641年1月14日，荷兰东印度公司军队在柔佛协助下攻占该城。巴达维亚始终是荷兰人的权力中心，霹雳的锡虽一度给马六甲带来利润，但到1700年，这座旧商埠已经衰落。1795年欧洲战争期间，英国占领马六甲，1807年开始拆除要塞，只留下圣地亚哥城门；1818年，马六甲恢复荷兰统治。

en:
Johor fills the southern tip of the Malay Peninsula, a land of mangrove-fringed river mouths looking across the strait to the Riau Islands. The Johor River opens a route deep inland, and the Muar to its west joins the Penarikan, the short portage by which traders dragged their boats across to the Pahang River and the South China Sea. These straits were home to the Orang Laut, sea people whose patrols and loyalty helped Malacca's founders build their sultanate around 1400. Johor became that sultanate's southern hinterland, sending jungle and sea produce up the strait and taking in Chinese porcelain. In 1444 it is a quiet Sunni Malay dependency of the great port to its north, governed by Malacca's chiefs and with no court of its own.

Malacca fell to the Portuguese in 1511; after they destroyed Sultan Mahmud Shah's exile court on Bintan in 1526, his son Alauddin Riayat Shah II returned to the Johor River and founded the Johor Sultanate in 1528, making Kota Batu, later Johor Lama, his capital from 1536. The new port drew Muslim merchants who shunned Portuguese Malacca. Aceh sacked Kota Batu in 1564 and carried Alauddin to his death, and after Sultan Ali Jalla rebuilt it and attacked Malacca, the Portuguese stormed the town in 1587. Aceh invaded again in 1613 and 1615, until a Portuguese-Johor fleet destroyed its armada before Malacca in 1629. Johor then joined the Dutch, and on 14 January 1641 their combined armies under Bendahara Skudai took Malacca. Batu Sawar fell to Jambi in 1673, in a thirteen-year war won only with Bugis aid in 1679; Riau meanwhile became one of the archipelago's richest marts, trading pepper, tin and spices. In 1699 the murder of Sultan Mahmud II ended the old Malacca royal line, and the Bendahara took the throne. Bugis warriors drove out the pretender Raja Kecil in 1722 and dominated the state as Yam Tuan Muda until the Dutch expelled them from Riau in 1784. When Mahmud Shah III died in 1812 his sons disputed the succession: the Dutch backed Abdul Rahman, while in 1819 Stamford Raffles recognised the elder Hussein and obtained Singapore from the Temenggong. In 1821 the Johor mainland stood under the Temenggong's house, the islands within the Dutch orbit.
zh:
柔佛位于马来半岛最南端，红树林夹岸的河口隔着海峡与廖内群岛相望。柔佛河可上溯内陆深处，西边的麻河上游衔接「佩纳里坎」短途拖船陆运，商旅把小船拖过地峡，即可进入彭亨河，驶往南海。这片海峡本是海人（Orang Laut）的家园，凭借这支海上族群的巡弋与效忠，马六甲的开国者才在1400年前后建起苏丹国。柔佛成为该苏丹国的南方腹地，丛林与海产沿海峡北运，中国瓷器由此流入。1444年的柔佛是北方大港马六甲治下安静的逊尼派马来人属地，由马六甲的酋长治理，尚无自己的宫廷。

1511年马六甲落入葡萄牙人之手；1526年葡萄牙人摧毁苏丹马末沙在民丹的流亡朝廷后，其子阿拉乌丁·里阿亚特沙二世回到柔佛河，于1528年建立柔佛苏丹国，1536年起以哥打峇株（即后来的旧柔佛）为都。新港吸引了回避葡属马六甲的穆斯林商人。1564年亚齐洗劫哥打峇株，阿拉乌丁被掳往亚齐遇害；阿里·贾拉苏丹重建旧柔佛并进攻马六甲之后，葡萄牙舰队于1587年攻陷该城。1613、1615年亚齐两度入侵，1629年葡萄牙与柔佛联军在马六甲外海摧毁亚齐的庞大舰队。柔佛随后与荷兰结盟，1641年1月14日，两军在班达哈拉·斯库代率领下攻占马六甲。河畔都城巴都沙哇于1673年被占碑攻陷，这场十三年战争到1679年靠武吉斯人的援助才告结束；与此同时，廖内崛起为群岛最富庶的商埠之一，经营胡椒、锡与香料。1699年马哈茂德二世遇刺，马六甲一系绝嗣，班达哈拉继位。武吉斯武士1722年逐走僭位者拉惹·克奇尔，以「杨端·慕达」之名掌权，直至1784年被荷兰人逐出廖内。1812年马哈茂德沙三世去世，诸子争位：荷兰支持阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼，莱佛士则在1819年承认长兄侯赛因，从天猛公处取得新加坡；到1821年，柔佛本土处在天猛公家族治下，群岛则落入荷兰势力范围。

en:
Pahang fills the wide basin of the river that shares its name, opening on the South China Sea at the estuary town of Pekan, the old Inderapura. Chinese annals called it Pohuang and record its embassies to the Liu Song court in 449 and 456; in later centuries it was a dependency of Langkasuka, Srivijaya and the Ligor kingdom, one of Ligor's twelve vassal cities. Gold washings along its rivers dated from the early centuries of the Common Era, and in the fourteenth century its maharaja was overlord of the southern peninsula as far as Temasek. In 1444 the last native ruler, Maharaja Dewa Sura, still reigned at Pekan as a reluctant tributary of Siam, while Malacca was rising on the opposite coast.

In 1454 a two-hundred-ship Malaccan fleet under the bendahara Tun Perak conquered Pahang and carried Dewa Sura captive to Malacca. Around 1470 the exiled Malaccan prince Raja Muhammad was installed at Tanjung Langgar in Pekan as Sultan Muhammad Shah, and Pahang grew into a rival of Malacca before its fall to the Portuguese in 1511. Pahang joined Johor's siege of Portuguese Malacca in 1551, and under Sultan Abdul Kadir its gold was sold in quantity in the city's market. In 1607 Admiral Matelief de Jonge anchored at Kuala Pahang to negotiate an alliance against Portugal. Acehnese armies under Sultan Iskandar Muda overran the country in 1615 and again in 1617, and in 1623 Sultan Abdul Jalil Shah inherited Johor, joining the two crowns. Ruled thereafter by Johor's bendaharas, Pahang became an autonomous kingdom under Tun Abdul Majid in 1770.
zh:
彭亨地处同名大河的广阔流域，在河口要埠北根（古称因陀罗补罗）注入南海。中国史书称其为婆皇，记载它曾于449年和456年遣使刘宋；此后数百年里，它先后臣属狼牙脩、室利佛逝和洛坤王国，是洛坤十二属邦之一。彭亨河川的淘金活动可追溯到公元初，14世纪时其摩诃罗阇还领有半岛南端直至淡马锡的土地。1444年，末代本土君主摩诃罗阇·提婆素罗仍在北根称尊，勉强向暹罗称臣，而马六甲正在半岛另一海岸崛起。

1454年，马六甲宰相敦霹雳率两百艘战船征服彭亨，提婆素罗被掳往马六甲。约1470年，被放逐的马六甲王子拉惹·穆罕默德在北根的丹绒朗加即位，称苏丹穆罕默德沙；彭亨日渐强盛，到1511年马六甲落入葡萄牙之手时已是旧主的劲敌。1551年彭亨出兵参加柔佛围攻葡属马六甲之役，阿卜杜勒·卡迪尔苏丹在位时，彭亨黄金在马六甲市集大量售卖。1607年，荷兰海军上将马特列夫停泊瓜拉彭亨，缔结盟约共图葡萄牙。亚齐苏丹伊斯坎达尔·穆达的大军于1615年和1617年两度攻陷彭亨，1623年苏丹阿卜杜勒·贾利勒沙继承柔佛王位，两王冠合一。此后彭亨由柔佛宰相世代治理，1770年敦阿都·马吉德将其建为自治王国。

en:
Kelantan lies on the fertile delta of the Kelantan River, on the South China Sea coast. Chinese records knew a kingdom here as early as 607, when Chih Tu sent word to the Sui court; later it was claimed in turn by Srivijaya and, in the Nagarakretagama of 1365, by Majapahit. By the early fifteenth century the river mouth was a trading port where Chinese junks called, and around 1411 its Muslim ruler, Raja Kumar, asserted independence from Siam and sent an embassy to the Ming court. The Malay Annals remember Kelantan at this time as a kingdom strong enough to rival Patani. In 1444 it was still ruled by its own rajas from the river estuary, a Muslim state on the edge of the Siamese world.

Malacca conquered Kelantan in the reign of Sultan Mansur Shah, and from 1499 it was a Malaccan vassal. After Malacca fell to the Portuguese in 1511 the country broke into chiefdoms, most of them paying tribute to Patani. In 1619 Kelantan allied with the queens of Patani, and in 1651 its ruler Raja Sakti I deposed Patani's last queen and set his own son over her kingdom. Tradition makes the warrior queen Cik Siti Wan Kembang rule here in the seventeenth century; on her abdication the throne passed to her adopted daughter, heiress of the small kingdom of Jembal, and the two realms were united. Around 1760 Long Yunus, backed by Terengganu, reunified Kelantan. A Terengganu attempt to install his son-in-law in 1795 brought war, and in 1800 Long Muhammad triumphed and ruled as Sultan Muhammad I. By 1812 he had shaken off Terengganu, and Kelantan entered the 1820s as a separate tributary of Siam.
zh:
吉兰丹位于吉兰丹河的肥沃三角洲，面朝南海。中国史籍早在607年就提到这里的赤土国遣使隋朝；此后它先后被室利佛逝称藩，1365年的《爪哇史颂》又把它列入满者伯夷的属国。15世纪初，吉兰丹河口已是中国帆船停泊的贸易港，约1411年穆斯林君主拉惹·库马尔摆脱暹罗独立，并遣使明朝。《马来纪年》称这一时期的吉兰丹国力足以与北大年匹敌。1444年，它仍由本地罗阇在河口统治，是暹罗世界边缘的一个穆斯林小国。

满速沙苏丹在位时，吉兰丹被马六甲征服，1499年起成为马六甲属邦。1511年马六甲亡于葡萄牙后，吉兰丹分裂为众多酋长领地，大多向北大年纳贡。1619年吉兰丹与北大年的女王们结盟，1651年其君罗阇·萨克蒂一世废黜北大年末代女王，立自己的儿子统治其国。相传巾帼君主西蒂旺肯邦于17世纪统治吉兰丹，她退位时把王位传给养女——小国珍巴君主的继承人，两国由此合并。约1760年，得到丁加奴（今登嘉楼）支持的隆·尤努斯重新统一吉兰丹。1795年丁加奴试图改立他的女婿，引发战争，1800年隆·莫哈末获胜，即位为苏丹莫哈末一世。到1812年他已摆脱丁加奴，吉兰丹作为暹罗单独册封的藩属进入19世纪20年代。

en:
Ayutthaya rose on an island girdled by the Chao Phraya, Lopburi and Pa Sak rivers in the lower Chao Phraya plain. On 4 March 1351 King Ramathibodi I, Uthong, founded his capital on the older port of Ayodhya, uniting the lower-basin polities of Lavo and Suphannaphum and naming the city for Ayodhya of the Ramayana. Its kings worked the Ming tribute trade harder than any court, sending sixty missions between 1369 and 1429, while Ryukyu junks and Persian merchants, who called it Shahr-i Naw, the New City, crowded its moorings. In the 1430s Ayutthayan armies attacked Angkor, and Khmer power faded from the Chao Phraya basin. In 1444, under Borommarachathirat II, the walled city was one of the great emporia of Southeast Asia, its riverfront crowded with Chinese, Malay and Indian shipping.

King Borommatrailokkanat, who took the throne in 1448, gave the kingdom its Palatine Law and turned the old royal palace into the Wat Phra Si Sanphet, later crowned by three chedis of royal ashes; under his son Ramathibodi II a sixteen-metre gilded bronze Buddha was raised in its chapel. The Portuguese arrived in 1511, the first Europeans, and concluded a trade treaty five years on. In 1569 the Burmese of Bayinnaung stormed the city and held it until Naresuan declared independence in 1584 and killed the Burmese crown prince Mingyi Swa in the elephant battle of 1593. Peace made Ayutthaya a world mart: the Japanese quarter led by the samurai Yamada Nagamasa stood beside Dutch and Chinese factories, and sixty-one markets traded inside the walls. Under Narai (1656–1688) the Greek adventurer Phaulkon directed foreign affairs, French troops garrisoned Bangkok and embassies went to Louis XIV, until Phetracha's coup of 1688 killed Phaulkon and expelled the French. Chinese merchants then dominated a final century of trade. Konbaung Burmese armies failed to take the city in 1760 but returned in 1766; after a fourteen-month siege the walls were mined and Ayutthaya fell on 7 April 1767. Palaces and temples were burned and the gold of the great Buddha melted down. Taksin retook the ruins the same year but built his capital downstream at Thonburi, leaving Ayutthaya a provincial town among its own foundations.
zh:
阿瑜陀耶兴起于昭披耶河下游平原上一座由昭披耶河、华富里河与巴萨克河环绕的江心岛。1351年3月4日，乌通王拉玛铁菩提一世在旧港阿约陀雅建都，合并罗涡与素攀那蓬两大城邦，并以《罗摩衍那》中的圣城阿约陀雅为新都命名。历代国王最善于经营对明朝贡，1369至1429年间入明使团多达六十次；琉球的戎克船和把这里称作「新城」（Shahr-i Naw）的波斯商人云集码头。1430年代，阿瑜陀耶军队进攻吴哥，高棉在昭披耶河流域的势力就此消退。1444年波隆摩罗阇二世在位时，这座水城已是东南亚首屈一指的商埠，河畔挤满华人、马来人和印度人的商船。

1448年继位的波隆摩戴莱洛迦纳颁行《宫廷法》，并把旧王宫改为帕喜善佩寺，后来寺上又建起三座安放王室骨灰的佛塔；其子拉玛铁菩提二世时，寺中铸成一尊高十六米的鎏金铜佛。1511年，葡萄牙人作为首批欧洲人到来，五年后签订通商条约。1569年，勃印曩的缅军攻陷此城，直到纳黎萱1584年宣布独立，并在1593年的象战中斩杀缅甸王储敏基苏瓦。承平之时，阿瑜陀耶成为世界性商埠：由武士山田长政统领的日本人町与荷兰、华人商馆比邻，城内共有六十一处市集。那莱王（1656—1688年在位）时，希腊冒险家华尔康主持外交，法军进驻曼谷，暹罗数度遣使觐见路易十四；1688年帕碧罗阇发动政变，诛杀华尔康、驱逐法人。此后一个世纪由华商主导贸易。贡榜王朝的缅军1760年攻城不克，1766年再度来犯：围城十四个月后，城墙被地道炸塌，阿瑜陀耶于1767年4月7日陷落，宫殿寺院尽焚，大佛像上的黄金被熔取。郑信同年收复残城，但定都下游的吞武里，阿瑜陀耶从此成为废墟之间的一座省城。

en:
Sukhothai, the 'dawn of happiness', rises on the Yom river in the north-central plain. In 1238 local Tai chiefs threw off Khmer rule and made it the first Thai royal capital, seat of the Phra Ruang dynasty. Under Ram Khamhaeng the Great (1279–98) Theravada Buddhism and the Thai script, dated to 1283, took root here, and embassies to Yuan China brought home the techniques of glazed stoneware; upriver at Si Satchanalai the kilns of Chaliang grew until more than a hundred fired at once, their sangkhalok celadon shipped across the Southeast Asian seas. Power faded after Ram Khamhaeng, and Sukhothai slipped under Ayutthayan overlordship; when its last king, Borommapan, died in 1438, the old kingdom was fully joined to Ayutthaya. In 1444 the royal city is a northern march of Borommarachathirat II, its temples crowded with Buddha images and the Yom still busy with pottery boats.

Sukhothai rose against Ayutthaya in 1462, and to hold the northern frontier King Borommatrailokkanat moved his whole court to Phitsanulok in 1463, directing from there the long wars with Tilokkarat of Lan Na for Chaliang and the upper Yom. Under later Ayutthaya, Sawankhalok ranked among the kingdom's six second-class provinces, and its kilns kept exporting sangkhalok ware until 1584, when Naresuan, clearing the north ahead of a Burmese invasion, carried off the towns' populations; the old cities were left half-deserted and the ceramic industry died, reviving only partly after an officer was posted to hold Sawankhalok in 1592. In 1765 the Burmese northern army under Nemyo Thihapate swept through the northern towns on its march to Ayutthaya, which fell in April 1767; Taksin's forces retook the region in the years after he restored Siamese power, and by 1821 the old royal capital survived only as ruins beside the Yom, while its province answered to Bangkok.
zh:
素可泰意为「幸福的曙光」，坐落在中北部平原的永河之滨。1238年，本地泰人首领摆脱高棉统治，在此建立泰国人第一个王朝的都城，即帕銮王朝。兰甘亨大帝（1279—1298年在位）时，上座部佛教与1283年创制的泰文在此扎根，出使元朝的使团又带回了施釉瓷器的工艺；上游西萨查那莱的查良窑场规模日盛，多时上百座窑同时生火，宋加洛青瓷远销东南亚海域。兰甘亨之后国势转衰，素可泰沦为阿瑜陀耶的属国；1438年末代国王波罗蒙潘去世，古国被完全并入阿瑜陀耶。1444年的素可泰是波隆摩罗阇二世治下的北方边镇，佛寺中佛像林立，永河上运瓷的船只往来不绝。

1462年素可泰起兵反抗阿瑜陀耶；为镇守北疆，波隆摩·戴莱洛迦纳1463年把整个朝廷迁到彭世洛，在那里指挥与兰纳国王蒂洛卡拉争夺查良和永河上游的长期战争。在后来的阿瑜陀耶，宋加洛位列全国六个二等府之一，窑场继续外销宋加洛器，直到1584年——纳黎萱为在缅甸入侵前清空北境，迁走诸城人口，旧城大半荒废，瓷业就此断绝，直到1592年朝廷派兵驻守宋加洛才略有恢复。1765年，内苗·西哈波底率领的缅甸北路大军横扫北方诸城，长驱直入阿瑜陀耶，该城于1767年4月陷落；郑信复国后，其军队在随后几年收复这一地区。到1821年，旧都只剩永河畔的残垣，而这片土地作为一个府听命于曼谷。

en:
Chiang Rai guards the rice-growing Kok River basin in upper Lan Na, where routes from Chiang Mai meet the older northern country around Chiang Saen and Kengtung. Mangrai founded the city in 1262 after uniting the mueangs of Ngoenyang, and it served as his first capital before he moved south and founded Chiang Mai in 1296. It remained a city of the Mangrai dynasty, enriched by Theravada monasteries and the trade of the northern valleys. In 1432 an earthquake split the chedi at Wat Phra Kaeo and revealed the jade image later known as the Emerald Buddha. In 1444, three years into Tilokaraj's reign, Chiang Rai was part of a still-powerful Lan Na.

Tilokaraj ruled until 1487, repelling an Ayutthayan army in 1442 and annexing Phayao in 1456, but later succession quarrels weakened the northern kingdom. Bayinnaung's Toungoo forces made Lan Na a Burmese vassal in 1558. Local kings kept considerable autonomy until the empire weakened; Nawrahta Minsaw declared independence in 1596 and acknowledged Siam in 1602, yet Burmese rulers returned after 1614. Heavy Toungoo taxation helped provoke the Chiang Mai revolts of 1727–1728 and 1731–1732, which freed the Ping valley for a generation. In January 1775 Kawila of Lampang and Siamese troops took Chiang Mai, and the Burmese withdrawal after the war of 1775–1776 carried Chiang Rai into Siam's northern tributary order.
zh:
清莱扼守兰纳北部的廓克河流域稻米盆地，清迈北上的道路在此通往清盛、景栋一带更古老的勐地。孟莱1262年统一恩央诸城后建立清莱，并以此为最初都城；后来他向南扩张，于1296年创建清迈。清莱仍是孟莱王朝的重要王城，上座部寺院兴盛，也受益于北部河谷贸易。1432年，一场地震震裂玉佛寺的佛塔，后来被称为玉佛的碧玉佛像因此现身。1444年，即滴洛拉阇即位第三年，清莱仍属于国力强盛的兰纳。

滴洛拉阇统治至1487年，1442年击退阿瑜陀耶军队，1456年吞并帕尧，但此后的继承纷争削弱了这个北方王国。1558年，勃印曩的东吁军队使兰纳成为缅甸属邦。当地国王保留了相当大的自主权，直到帝国转弱；诺拉塔明绍1596年宣布独立，1602年向暹罗称臣，但1614年后缅甸统治者再度归来。东吁王朝的重税促成1727—1728年和1731—1732年的清迈起义，宾河流域由此获得一代人的自主。1775年1月，南邦的咖威拉联合暹罗军队攻占清迈；1775—1776年战争后缅军撤退，清莱也被纳入暹罗北方藩属秩序。

en:
At the easternmost corner of the Gulf of Siam the Cardamom Mountains run down to the sea, forested ridges giving way to fishing harbours and a scatter of islands, the largest of them Ko Chang. The Ayutthaya court knew this remote eastern seaboard as Mueang Thung Yai, 'the great field town', the old name of Trat; its gem-bearing hills were already famous when the Chinese voyager Ma Huan noted the rubies and sapphires of the Chanthaburi–Trat country in 1408. In 1444 it was a lightly held fringe of Ayutthaya's eastern maritime provinces, a string of small ports floating forest goods down to the capital.

Trat grew into a customs seaport in the reign of King Prasat Thong (1629–1656), when it was placed under the Phra Khlang, the treasury department; hides and deer antlers, aromatic woods and spices were brought down the Khao Saming River from the eastern hills to Chinese junks waiting at the river mouth. In mid-1767, after breaking out of the Burmese siege of Ayutthaya and storming Chanthaburi, Taksin sailed to Trat. The town submitted without a fight, but the Chinese junks at anchor opened fire, and his war-boats took half a day to capture them all; their cargoes armed and paid the army with which he reconquered Siam.
zh:
那空童艾（即泰文史籍里的童艾城，今桐艾，又译达叻）在暹罗湾最东端：豆蔻山余脉直逼海岸，林莽覆盖的丘陵尽头是渔村港湾与一连串岛屿，最大的是象岛。阿瑜陀耶朝廷称这片偏远的东部滨海之地为童艾城，即后来的桐艾；内地丘陵出产宝石，中国航海家马欢1408年就记下了尖竹汶—桐艾一带的红蓝宝石。1444年，这里是阿瑜陀耶东部沿海诸府控制较松的边缘，一串小港把山货运往京城。

桐艾成为正式税港是在巴沙通王（1629—1656年在位）时期，归财政衙门（Phra Khlang）管辖：东部山区的兽皮、鹿角、香木和香料沿考萨明河而下，在河口换上等候的中国帆船。1767年年中，郑信从缅甸军围困中的阿瑜陀耶突围、袭取尖竹汶之后挥师桐艾，城中不战而降，可停泊在河口的中国帆船开炮抗拒，他的战船打了半天才将其全数缴获；船上财货成了他复国军队的军饷与军械。

en:
Oudong takes its name from Phnom Oudong, a sandstone ridge rising from the alluvial plain northwest of Chaktomuk, where the Mekong meets the Tonlé Sap. It was old royal land of the Khmer, and it shared the kingdom's fate after Ayutthayan troops sacked Angkor in 1431: King Ponhea Yat abandoned Yasodharapura and carried his court south, first to Basan and then to Chaktomuk, the future Phnom Penh. In 1444 the ridge was still open country of monasteries and rice fields, belonging to a Theravada Buddhist kingdom whose rulers now held river crossings rather than temple cities and kept a wary eye on Siam.

Under Ang Chan I the court moved in 1529 to the fortified city of Lovek just north of the ridge, a trading town known to Portuguese and Spanish visitors simply as 'Cambodia', until King Naresuan of Siam stormed it in 1593. King Srei Soryapor founded a new royal town on the slopes of Phnom Oudong in 1601, and from 1618 Oudong Meanchey served as the capital; over the following centuries its crest filled with the burial stupas of Khmer kings. In 1771, after sacking the port of Hà Tiên, King Taksin of Siam marched on Oudong against Outey II, and the Siamese-backed prince Ang Non seized the throne himself in 1775. In 1811 Ang Snguon, brother of King Ang Chan II, rebelled with Siamese support and Ang Chan fled to Saigon; a Vietnamese army under Lê Văn Duyệt retook Oudong in 1813, restored him, and left garrisons behind. In 1821 Oudong remained the royal capital, but its king ruled under Vietnamese protection.
zh:
乌栋得名于乌栋山，这座砂岩低岭矗立在四臂湾西北的冲积平原上，四臂湾正是湄公河与洞里萨河交汇之处。这里本是高棉人的王畿旧地，也随王国一同经历了1431年的转折：阿瑜陀耶军队攻陷吴哥后，国王奔哈·亚放弃耶输陀罗拔罗，带着宫廷南迁，先至巴萨，最终落脚四臂湾，也就是后来的金边。1444年的乌栋山一带还是寺院与稻田相间的乡野，属于一个上座部佛教王国；君主们凭河津要冲而非石庙王城维系统治，对西邻暹罗满怀戒心。

安赞一世时，宫廷于1529年迁至乌栋山北设防坚固的洛韦。这座商城在葡萄牙和西班牙访客口中就是「柬埔寨」的代称，直到1593年被暹罗国王纳黎萱攻破。1601年，国王斯雷·索里约波在乌栋山南麓营建新的王城，1618年起乌栋梦谢成为都城，此后几个世纪里，山脊上布满历代高棉国王的陵塔。1771年，暹罗国王达信洗劫港口河仙后进兵乌栋，矛头指向乌迭二世；受暹罗支持的王子安农于1775年夺位。1811年，安赞二世之弟安斯农在暹罗支持下起兵，安赞逃往西贡；1813年黎文悦率越军收复乌栋、扶安赞复位，并留下驻军。1821年的乌栋仍是王都，但在位的国王已处于越南的保护之下。

en:
Prey Nokor, 'the kingdom in the forest' in Khmer, was a fishing village and timbered country on the lower Saigon River, the thinly settled eastern fringe of the Cambodian delta. Khmer fishermen worked its creeks and its woods supplied timber and forest goods, their hamlets interspersed with Cham, Châu Ro and S'Tiêng settlements. Chinese and Vietnamese traders already used the river road from the coast to the Mekong, and Zhou Daguan's embassy of the 1290s listed a riverside district called Trĩ Côn, often taken as the earliest trace of the name Sài Gòn. In 1444 the land still belonged to the Cambodian king at Phnom Penh, though his hold on these distant woodlands was loose.

In 1620 the Vietnamese princess Nguyễn Phúc Ngọc Vạn married King Chey Chettha II, and three years later the Nguyễn lords of Huế won leave to post tax stations at Prey Nokor. Vietnamese settlers drifted in through the long Trịnh–Nguyễn wars, and in 1679 the Nguyễn lord planted fleets of Ming refugees fleeing the Qing along these waterways; Cù Lao Phố became one of the lower Mekong's greatest markets. In 1698 the general Nguyễn Hữu Cảnh came to organise the frontier, founding Gia Định prefecture with the counties of Tân Bình and Phước Long, and the new administration counted some ten thousand households, perhaps 200,000 settlers; a Cambodian attempt to stop him was defeated in 1700. During the Tây Sơn wars Nguyễn Ánh retook Saigon in 1788 and made it his seat, and in 1790 his French engineers Théodore Lebrun and Victor Olivier de Puymanel raised the eight-trigram Bát Quái citadel. Crowned the emperor Gia Long in 1802, he made Gia Định the stronghold of Vietnam's five southern provinces, while the Chinese market town of Chợ Lớn grew up beside it as delta rice sailed down the Saigon River to sea.
zh:
波雷诺哥在高棉语中意为「林中之都」，本是西贡河下游的渔村林地，地处柬埔寨（高棉）三角洲东部人烟稀疏的边缘。高棉人在河汊捕鱼，从林地采伐木材和山货，村寨之间还杂居着占婆移民与遮罗、斯丁等山地部族。华人和越南商人早已取道这条河往来海岸与湄公河；1290年代出使吴哥的周达观在《真腊风土记》中记有一个河滨属郡「雉棍」，学者多认为这是「柴棍」一名最早的痕迹。1444年，这片土地仍在金边的柬埔寨国王治下，只是王室对这片偏远林地的控制十分松散。

1620年，越南公主阮氏玉万嫁给柬埔寨国王吉·哲塔二世；三年后，顺化的阮主获准在波雷诺哥设立税关。郑阮长期纷争，越南流民不断南下，1679年，阮主又把逃避清朝的明朝遗民船队安置在这一带水道；他们开辟的浦岛（Cù Lao Phố）商港成为下湄公河两大商埠之一。1698年，阮主遣大将阮有镜经略边地，置嘉定府，设新平、福隆两县，新编户籍约一万户、二十万口；柬埔寨出兵驱逐，于1700年被他击败。西山起义在1770至1780年代席卷南方，阮福映1788年夺回柴棍，建为复兴基地，1790年由法国工程师西奥多·勒布朗（Théodore Lebrun）和奥利维耶·德·皮曼纽尔（Victor Olivier de Puymanel）主持，修筑八卦形制的嘉定城（八卦城）。1802年阮福映称帝、建元嘉隆，嘉定成为越南南方五镇的重镇，城旁兴起的堤岸华人市镇，把三角洲的稻米经西贡河源源运出海去。

en:
Panduranga was the southernmost and most autonomous of the principalities of Champa, its centre at Pan Rang on the dry coast south of the Central Highlands. A southern dynasty seated at Virapura near Ninh Phước united all Champa in 757, and in 787 Javanese raiders burned its Shiva temple. Ruled by its own kings from the 13th century with loose obedience to Vijaya, it was restored under King Po Kathit in 1430, when a northern and a southern Champa stood side by side. In 1444, while King Maha Vijaya's war with Đại Việt raged around Hóa Châu far to the north, Panduranga kept its own court at Biuh Bal Batsinâng, its people living by fish, salt and the southern sea roads.

After Vijaya fell to Lê Thánh Tông in March 1471, the Cham general Bố Trì Trì fled to Pan Rang and submitted; the emperor enfeoffed him over a Champa reduced to Panduranga, Kauthara and the highland vassals. Trade revived in the 16th century: Cham ships sailed to Siam, Malacca, Johor, Patani, Makassar and Macao, and in 1594 a fleet went to help Johor fight the Portuguese at Malacca. King Po Rome (r. 1627–1651), who had studied in Kelantan, drew court and people to Islam, reconciled the Muslim Bani with the Hindu Balamon, reformed the sakawi calendar and granted the Dutch free trade. The Nguyễn lords pressed south regardless: Phú Yên was lost in 1611, and in 1692 King Po Saut attacked the prefecture of Diên Ninh. Nguyễn Hữu Cảnh captured him in March 1693 and renamed the kingdom Trấn Thuận Thành; a Cham rising under A Ban that winter retook Phan Rang and Phan Rí, so the Nguyễn restored the Cham monarchy as a vassal princedom, confirming its rights in the five-article treaty of 1712. The Tây Sơn wars then made it a battlefield: the rebels enthroned Po Tisuntiraidapuran in 1780, Nguyễn Ánh took Pan Rang in 1790 and had him executed in 1793, and the revolts of Po Chongchan and Tuan Phaow were crushed in 1796. Under the Nguyễn dynasty of 1802 Thuận Thành kept its autonomy, ranked with Laos and Cambodia as the last self-ruling Cham land.
zh:
宾童龙在中国史籍中作宾童龙、奔陀浪，是占婆诸邦中地处最南、自治最深的一个，中心在今宁顺省干旱海滨的潘郎。757年，定都毗罗补罗（今宁福一带）的南方王朝一度一统占婆；787年，爪哇海寇焚毁了这里的湿婆庙。13世纪起，宾童龙由本地王世袭统治，只对阇盘的众王之王保持松散臣属；占人编年史记载，波卡提王于1430年复国，形成南北两占城并立的局面。1444年，摩诃贲该王与大越在北方遥远的化州鏖战时，宾童龙仍在Biuh Bal Batsinâng自有朝廷，百姓以渔盐和南海商路为生。

1471年3月阇盘陷落后，占将逋持持南奔潘郎称臣，黎圣宗封他为占王，占婆余土缩为宾童龙、古笪罗和西原诸藩。16世纪海运复兴，占船往来暹罗、马六甲、柔佛、北大年、望加锡和澳门，1594年宾童龙还派出舰队助柔佛攻打据守马六甲的葡萄牙人。波·罗姆王（1627—1651年在位）曾游学吉兰丹，他引导宫廷与民众改宗伊斯兰教，又调和穆斯林巴尼派与印度教巴蒙派，修订阴阳合历的萨卡维历，并准许荷兰人自由贸易。阮主的南进并未止步：富安于1611年失守；1692年，婆争王北上攻打延庆府，阮有镜于1693年3月将他俘获，改其国为顺城镇。当年年底阿班领导的占人起义一度收复潘郎、潘里，阮主只得恢复占人王统、列为藩封，并在1712年以五条之约确认其权利。西山起兵后，顺城沦为战场：西山军1780年扶立阮文佐为顺城王，阮福映1790年攻取潘郎、1793年将他处死，1796年又先后镇压了波钟占和端扶之叛。1802年阮朝建立，顺城仍保自治，与哀牢、高蛮同列藩封，是占人最后的自治之地。

en:
Vijaya, called Đồ Bàn by the Vietnamese, was the brick-walled Cham capital on a tributary of the Côn River, a short march from its seaport of Thị Nại on the bay of Quy Nhơn. It had served as the seat of Champa's kings since 938: Mongol troops under Sogetu sacked it in 1283, and in 1377 a royal Vietnamese army broke against its walls and the Trần king himself was killed. By the fifteenth century the kings of Vijaya ruled the coast between the Hải Vân Pass and the Kauthara hills, shipping highland forest produce out of Thị Nại. In 1444 King Maha Vijaya was raiding the Vietnamese border province of Hóa Châu; two years later the army of the child emperor Lê Nhân Tông stormed Vijaya and carried the king north.

Restored as a Vietnamese vassal, Champa lasted only a generation: in 1471 King Trà Toàn's raid on Hóa Châu gave Lê Thánh Tông his pretext. A great armada carrying 100,000 men sailed in November 1470; Thị Nại fell on 18 March 1471, and Vijaya, battered by cannon, fell on 22 March after a four-day siege. Vietnamese accounts number the Cham dead at 60,000 and the deported at 30,000, Trà Toàn among them, and the old capital was demolished. That July the victors raised phủ Hoài Nhơn on its lands, three counties settled by soldier-farmers, and the border moved to the Cù Mông Pass. In 1570 Nguyễn Hoàng added the district to his southern governorship, and in 1602 his administration renamed it Quy Nhơn. The old Cham land rose again in the eighteenth century: in 1771 the three Tây Sơn brothers rebelled at their home hamlet in the western hills, and in 1773 Nguyễn Nhạc had himself carried into the citadel in a feigned prisoner's cage and seized it at midnight; the city became his seat and he took the imperial title Thái Đức in 1778. It fell to Nguyễn Ánh in 1799 and was renamed Bình Định; when the Tây Sơn retook it in 1801, the Nguyễn general Võ Tánh blew himself up in its eight-cornered tower rather than surrender; with the Nguyễn victory of 1802 the land entered the new empire at peace.
zh:
毗阇耶，越南语称阇槃（Đồ Bàn），是占婆砖砌的王都，坐落于棍河支流畔，距归仁湾上的外港尸耐（Thị Nại）只有一日路程。自938年起它就是占婆国王的都城：1283年元将唆都的军队曾洗劫此城，1377年陈朝大军又在其城下溃败，陈睿宗亲战死阵。到15世纪，毗阇耶诸王据有海云关以南到古笪罗丘陵之间的海岸，经尸耐港输出高地的山林物产。1444年，占王摩诃贲该（Maha Vijaya）正连年入寇越南边地化州；两年后，黎仁宗朝廷的大军攻破毗阇耶，把国王俘虏北去。

复国为藩的占婆只维持了一代人：1471年，占王槃罗茶全（Trà Toàn）再犯化州，给了黎圣宗出兵的口实。1470年11月，十万大军乘巨舰南下；1471年3月18日尸耐陷落，毗阇耶在火炮围攻下坚守四天，3月22日城破。越方记载占人死者六万、被掳北迁者三万，槃罗茶全也在其中，旧都就此夷平。同年七月，胜者在其地置怀仁府，领蓬山、符离、绥远三县，由军户屯垦，国界南移至库蒙山口（Cù Mông）。1570年阮潢兼领顺化、广南，把这片土地纳入他的南方辖区，1602年改称归仁府。18世纪，古占婆之地再起风云：1771年，阮氏三兄弟在西山邑举兵；1773年阮岳让人把自己装成囚犯抬入城中，夜半开笼发难，外应齐发，一举夺城，以此为根本，1778年称帝建元泰德。1799年阮福映攻下此城，改名平定；1801年西山军反攻围城，守将武性拒不投降，在城中八角楼堆薪燃药自尽，城池再陷；1802年阮福映大获全胜，这片土地终于在新王朝治下安定下来。
