Yangzhou guards the junction of the Yangtze and the Grand Canal, where the ancient Han Canal first joined the river in 486 BC. Under the Tang it was the richest emporium in China, crowded with Arab, Persian and Korean merchants, and under the Song it briefly served the refugee court as a capital. Yuan-era Yangzhou still harboured foreign travellers, and the Vilioni tomb of 1342 attests to an Italian trading community. Under the Ming the city became the great exchange for Huai salt, rice and silk, and the court rebuilt it behind nine kilometres of walls raised partly against the wokou raiders. In 1444, with the capital at Beijing and southern tribute grain moving up the canal, Yangzhou sat at the busiest crossing of trade routes in the empire.

When the Ming fell, the Southern Ming grand secretary Shi Kefa held Yangzhou for the dynasty, but the Qing army of Prince Dodo stormed it on 20 May 1645 after a short siege, and the ten-day massacre that followed emptied the city. It rose again on salt: Huai salt was distributed here to Anhui, Jiangxi, Hubei and Hunan, and the Lianghuai salt duty long supplied some two-fifths of the empire's revenue, as Anhui merchant houses built gardens held to be the finest in China. The Dutch envoy Johan Nieuhof in 1655 already found the city rebuilt in its old splendour; the Kangxi and Qianlong emperors toured the gardens on their southern journeys, the Eight Eccentrics made Yangzhou a centre of painting, and lacquer, jade and block-printing workshops lined the canal.
zh:
扬州扼长江与大运河的交汇处，公元前486年吴王夫差所开的邗沟便在此入江。唐代的扬州是天下最富庶的商埠，阿拉伯、波斯和新罗商人云集，宋室南渡时又一度作为行都。元代的扬州仍多外来商旅，1342年维利奥尼家族的墓碑说明城中已有意大利商人聚落。入明以后，扬州成为淮盐与稻米、丝绸的大集散地，朝廷重筑府城，环城九公里的城墙也为抵御倭寇而设。1444年的扬州，正值迁都北京之后、江南漕粮沿运河北上的要冲，是全国最繁忙的水陆商路交会之处。

明亡之后，南明大学士史可法据守扬州，1645年5月20日多铎的清军短暂围城后破城，随后的「扬州十日」屠城使这座都会几乎为之一空。但扬州凭盐业迅速复苏：淮盐在此集散，运往安徽、江西、湖北、湖南，两淮盐税长期占全国税收的四成以上，徽商家族修筑的园林被时人推为天下之冠。1655年荷兰使臣尼霍夫已见城市恢复旧观；康熙、乾隆南巡屡次临幸这里的园林，康乾之际的「扬州八怪」使扬州成为画坛中心，运河畔漆器、玉器与雕版印刷作坊林立。

en:
Anqing guards the north bank of the lower Yangtze at the foot of the Dabie range, at the river defile later called the throat of the long Yangtze and the first frontier between Wu and Chu. Under the Song it was Shuzhou, named the Anqing army in 1147 and raised to a prefecture in 1195, with its seat upriver at Qianshan. In April 1217, after the Jurchen Jin seized Guangzhou, the prefect Huang Gan petitioned to build a new walled city at the Yicheng ferry, the present site. Work stopped and started, the seat fled before the Mongols in 1236, and in March 1260 Ma Guangzu rebuilt the city and brought Huaining county inside its walls. Zhu Yuanzhang renamed it Ningjiang in 1361 and restored the name Anqing a year later. In 1444 it was a six-county prefecture of Nanzhili, a fortified river garrison through which all Yangtze traffic between Nanjing and Huguang had to pass.

In 1568 work began on the Zhenfeng Pagoda in Yingjiang Monastery, its name promising to rouse the wind of letters, and it remained a landmark for every passing junk. As rebel armies pressed the late Ming, the court in 1637 set up a special governor at Anqing over four prefectures straddling Nanzhili, Huguang and Jiangxi. The Qing kept the post; in 1667 the western half of Jiangnan became the province of Anhui, and its government finally moved to Anqing from Jiangning in 1760. More quietly, Tongcheng county conquered the Qing republic of letters. Fang Bao (1668–1749) founded a school of prose that prized moral principle, textual evidence and style together; Liu Dakui (1698–1779) carried it forward, and Yao Nai (1732–1815) brought it to completion, so that Tongcheng letters set the standard of the age. In the Kangxi reign the grand secretary Zhang Ying of Tongcheng answered a family lawsuit over a wall with a poem urging the gift of three feet; both sides yielded, leaving the famous Six-Foot Alley.
zh:
安庆踞大别山余脉、长江下游北岸，江面收束如扼咽喉，后人称之「万里长江此封喉，吴楚分疆第一州」。宋代为舒州，1147年改名安庆军，「安庆」得名始此，1195年升为安庆府，府治尚在上游的潜山。1217年四月，金军攻破光州，安庆知府黄干奏请在盛唐湾宜城渡畔另筑新城备战，是为安庆建城之始；工程时辍时续，1236年蒙古军南下，府治弃城转移，直到1260年三月，沿江制置使马光祖重筑府城，怀宁县迁入附郭，城址才固定下来。1361年朱元璋改安庆路为宁江府，次年复名安庆。1444年的安庆领六县、直隶南直隶，是南京与湖广之间长江舟船必经的江防重镇。

1568年，迎江寺内始建振风塔，取「以振文风」之意，成为往来舟船眼中的江上地标。明末起义军逼近，1637年朝廷从应天十府中划出安庆、庐州、池州、太平四府，专设巡抚驻节安庆。清朝因袭其制，1667年江南左布政使司改名安徽布政使司，寄治江宁，1760年布政使司正式移驻安庆，安庆从此成为安徽省会。桐城一县则在文坛称雄：方苞（1668—1749）创立桐城派，主张义理、考据、辞章并重，刘大櫆（1698—1779）承先启后，姚鼐（1732—1815）集其大成，桐城古文遂为一代文章准绳。康熙年间，桐城籍大学士张英的家人与邻争墙，张英以诗作答，劝家人让地三尺，邻人见状也退三尺，「六尺巷」由此传名。

en:
Nanyang lies in the broad basin between the Funiu Mountains and the Han River, and its chief city, Wan, was already the seat of Nanyang Commandery under the Qin. In Han times it was one of the empire's great ironworking cities and the 'southern capital' that raised Liu Xiu, founder of the Eastern Han; Zhuge Liang farmed at its Wolong Ridge. The early Ming made it the seat of Nanyang Prefecture and enfeoffed Zhu Jing, twenty-third son of the Hongwu Emperor, as Prince of Tang, building a great palace for him in the city. In 1444, with the Tang prince in residence and the green jade of Dushan Hill still leaving its workshops, Nanyang was the political and market centre of south-western Henan, guarding the roads from the Central Plains into Hubei and Shaanxi.

The late Ming rebellions reached the basin in 1633, when Zhang Xianzhong's army was repulsed under the walls by Zuo Liangyu; he tried again in 1638 and was beaten once more. In November 1641 Li Zicheng stormed Nanyang and killed the reigning Prince of Tang on Qilin Ridge west of the city, and the region stayed in rebel hands until Qing troops pacified it in 1645. Under the Qing the great post road from Beijing to Hunan, Guizhou and Yunnan passed through the Wancheng station outside the east gate, where northern pack trains met river boats; Shanxi and Shaanxi merchants built their guild hall there in the Kangxi years. On the eastern lowlands Zhoujiakou, a river harbour founded in early Ming times at the meeting of the Jialu and Shaying rivers, had grown by the late eighteenth century into a town of tens of thousands, sending grain and goods north to the Yellow River and south to the Yangtze.
zh:
南阳位于伏牛山与汉水之间的盆地，首府宛城自秦代便是南阳郡治所。汉代这里是全国首屈一指的冶铁都会，东汉开国皇帝刘秀由此起兵，南阳号称「南都」；诸葛亮也曾在城西卧龙岗躬耕。明初于此设南阳府，明太祖第二十三子朱桱受封唐王，就藩前朝廷在城中大兴土木，建起规模宏大的唐王府。1444年的南阳，唐王府坐镇于此，城外独山的玉料仍源源不断送入作坊，是豫西南的政治与商业中心，扼守从中原进入湖北、陕西的通道。

明末战乱在1633年波及盆地，张献忠攻城，被左良玉击退；1638年义军再袭南阳，仍败于左良玉军。1641年11月李自成攻破南阳，在城西麒麟岗杀唐王朱聿鏼，此后这一带一直为起义军所据，直至1645年清军平定河南。清代北京通往湖广、云贵的驿道干线经过城东的宛城驿站，北马南船在此相接，康熙年间山陕商人建起富丽的山陕会馆。东部低地上的周家口是明初兴起的河港，地处贾鲁河与沙颍河交汇处，到18世纪末两岸集镇连成一片，常住居民达数万人，货物北走黄河、南达长江。

en:
Kaifeng lies on the south bank of the Yellow River. King Hui of Wei moved his capital here in 364 BC as Daliang, and the Sui Grand Canal, whose Bian River section joined the Yellow River to the Huai, made Bianzhou a great entrepôt. Four of the Five Dynasties ruled from the city, and as Dongjing, the Northern Song capital, it became the richest city in China, its night markets, theatres and riverside crowds painted in Zhang Zeduan's 'Along the River During the Qingming Festival'. The Jurchen took it in 1127 and the Mongols in 1233. In 1381 Zhu Yuanzhang installed his fifth son Zhu Su here as Prince of Zhou. In 1444 Kaifeng was the provincial seat of Henan, flooded by the river five times since 1375, and home to a small Jewish community whose synagogue dated from 1163.

A stele of 1489 lists fourteen Jewish clans, and in 1605 the community introduced itself to the Jesuits as 'Yicileye', Israel; by the late Ming it numbered some 4,000. Li Zicheng besieged Kaifeng three times in 1641 and 1642. In the first assault the Prince of Zhou, Zhu Gongxiao, paid the defenders from his palace treasury, and Li was wounded in the left eye by an arrow. The third siege, from April 1642, starved much of the city, and the relief army was routed at Zhuxian to the southwest. In October the rain-swollen Yellow River, which both sides had tried to turn on the other, burst its dikes and buried Kaifeng: of some 370,000 people about 30,000 survived, and the synagogue lost most of its scrolls. The Qing rebuilt the walls in 1662 and kept the city as the seat of Henan, but its trade and crafts never regained their Ming level.
zh:
开封地处黄河南岸。前364年，魏惠王把都城迁到这里，名为大梁；隋代开凿大运河，其中段汴河连通黄河与淮河，汴州由此成为水运要冲。五代之中有四朝定都于此，北宋称之为东京，是当时中国最繁华的城市，夜市、瓦肆和汴河两岸的人流都画进了张择端的《清明上河图》。1127年金军攻陷东京，1233年城又被蒙古军攻破。1381年，朱元璋封第五子朱橚为周王，就藩开封。1444年的开封是河南省会，自1375年以来已五次遭黄河水淹；城里住着一支犹太人社群，他们的会堂始建于1163年。

1489年所立的弘治碑记下了十四个犹太姓氏，1605年这里的犹太人向耶稣会士自称「一赐乐业」，即以色列；到明末，社群约有四千人。1641年至1642年，李自成三次围攻开封。第一次攻城时，周王朱恭枵拿出王府存银犒赏守军，李自成被箭射伤左眼。1642年4月起的第三次围城使城中大半人饿死，援军在城西南的朱仙镇被击溃。到了10月，双方都曾想借黄河淹对方，被秋雨涨满的河水冲决堤防，开封全城被淹，三十七万人仅存三万，犹太会堂的经卷也大多被毁。清朝于1662年重修开封城，仍以此为河南省治，但城中的商业和手工业再也没有恢复到明代的水平。

en:
Locked between the Qinling range and the Daba Mountains, the Han River basin is the gate between the Guanzhong plain and Sichuan, reached over plank roads cut into the cliff faces of the gorges. After the fall of Qin, Liu Bang held it as King of Han with his seat at Nanzheng, and the Han dynasty later took its name from the country. Under the Northern Song its commercial tax revenue was surpassed only by those of Kaifeng and Chengdu. The Yuan called it Xingyuan Route, and in 1370 the Ming made it Hanzhong Prefecture, governing two departments and fourteen counties from Lüeyang to Ziyang; the prefect Fei Zhen rebuilt the walls, and a guard was stationed to watch the road into Sichuan. In 1444 it is a quiet garrison prefecture of Shaanxi, its market towns living on basin rice and the tea, timber and mountain goods carried over the plank roads.

In 1627 Zhu Changhao, fifth son of the Wanli Emperor and Prince of Rui, took up residence in a palace more than twenty years in the building, its precincts covering about a third of the walled city; he added salt levies and other taxes that weighed heavily on the people. A peasant rising broke out in Hanzhong in 1637, and through the 1640s the armies of Li Zicheng and Zhang Xianzhong moved back and forth along the old Sichuan road. The prince fled to Chongqing, where Zhang put him to death in 1644, and the palace he left behind was dismantled and looted by the townspeople. The great White Lotus rising of 1796–1804 swept the mountain borders of Sichuan, Hubei and Shaanxi, drawing imperial armies into the Qinling valleys and draining the treasury for nine years.
zh:
汉中盆地夹在秦岭与大巴山之间，是关中通往四川的门户，往来要走在峡谷崖壁上凿出的栈道。秦亡之后，刘邦受封汉王，以南郑为都，后来的汉朝便得名于此。北宋时这里商税之丰仅次于开封、成都，居全国前列。元代称兴元路，1370年明朝改设汉中府，领金、宁羌二州及从略阳到紫阳的十四县；知府费震重修府城，又设汉中卫把守入川大道。1444年的汉中是陕西一处安静的卫所要地，市镇靠着盆地米粮与栈道运来的茶叶、木材和秦巴山货度日。

1627年，明神宗第五子、瑞王朱常浩就藩汉中；瑞王府修了二十多年，院落相连，约占府城三分之一，他还在正税之外加派盐税等名目，百姓负担沉重。1637年汉中府爆发农民起事，整个1640年代李自成、张献忠的军队沿入川古道往来不断。瑞王逃往重庆，1644年被张献忠处死，留在汉中的王府也被当地人拆毁抢空。1796—1804年的川楚白莲教大起义席卷川、鄂、陕交界的山地，清军被拖进秦岭峡谷作战，九年战事耗尽了国库的存银。

en:
Qingzhou takes its name from the Yu Gong: 'between the sea and Mount Dai lies Qingzhou', one of the Nine Provinces of antiquity. A county seat named Guang was founded here in 204 BC, and in 399 Murong De made the fortress of Guanggu the capital of his Southern Yan, the only dynastic capital on Shandong soil; Liu Yu's Jin army stormed and razed it in 410. Under the Song it was the seat of the Jingdong Eastern Circuit, and under the Jin and Yuan the city of Yidu remained eastern Shandong's administrative centre. The Ming made it Qingzhou Prefecture and briefly the capital of Shandong, until the provincial seat moved to Jinan in 1376. Zhu Fu, seventh son of the Hongwu Emperor, held his fief here as Prince of Qi from 1382 until he was deposed for good in 1406, his palace left empty. In 1444 Qingzhou remained one of Shandong's foremost prefectural towns, on the road from Jinan to the Jiaodong peninsula, though it no longer housed a princely court.

In 1499 Zhu Youhui, seventh son of the Chenghua Emperor, took up residence as Prince of Heng, his line holding the fief until the Ming fell. In 1644 Zhao Yingyuan, one of Li Zicheng's officers, seized Yidu and had Wang Aoyong, the Qing commissioner sent to pacify Shandong, put to death by dismemberment, in the Qingzhou Incident; Qing troops retook the city within months. The last Prince of Heng, Zhu Youzou, had surrendered and was taken to Beijing and executed in 1646 with eleven other Ming princes, including the Hongguang Emperor. In 1729 the Yongzheng Emperor posted a banner garrison general at Qingzhou with 2,000 cavalry and 400 infantry; when the walled Manchu city was completed in 1732, the general Emida led the first bannermen down from Beijing. In 1761 the general's post was reduced to a vice-commander, who also oversaw the banner garrison at Dezhou.
zh:
青州之名见于《尚书·禹贡》：「海岱惟青州」，为古九州之一。西汉高祖三年（前204年）在此建广县，399年慕容德以广固为都建立南燕——这是山东唯一做过王朝都城的地方，410年刘裕北伐灭南燕，夷平广固。宋代青州为京东东路路治，金元两代以益都为山东东部的统治中心。明初置青州府，并曾为山东省治，至洪武九年（1376年）省治迁往济南。明太祖第七子朱榑于1382年就藩为齐王，1406年被永乐帝再次废为庶人，齐王府从此空悬。1444年的青州仍是山东数一数二的府城，扼守济南通往胶东半岛的官道，却已没有藩王宫廷。

1499年，明宪宗第七子朱祐楎就藩青州，是为衡王，其子孙在此传国直至明亡。1644年，李自成部将赵应元趁乱占据益都，将清廷派往山东招抚的侍郎王鳌永肢解杀害，史称青州之变，清军数月后夺回城池。末代衡王朱由棷此前已降，被执送北京，1646年与弘光帝等十一名明朝藩王同时遇害，衡王府遭抄没。1729年，雍正帝在青州设驻防将军，下辖马甲两千、步甲四百；1732年满城竣工，将军鄂弥达率八旗兵自北京进驻。1761年朝廷裁撤青州将军，改设专城副都统，并兼辖德州驻防。

en:
Jinan, the 'City of Springs' around Daming Lake and its seventy-two named springs, became a superior prefecture under the Song in 1116; the poets Li Qingzhao and Xin Qiji were born here before the Jurchen conquest drove them south. Ming armies took the city in 1368, and in 1376 the Shandong provincial government was moved here from Qingzhou, making Jinan the provincial capital. In 1400, during the Jingnan campaign, the rebel Prince of Yan Zhu Di was checked beneath its walls: after his victory at the Baigou River his men breached a dike to flood Jinan, but the assistant administration commissioner Tie Xuan and the general Sheng Yong held out for three months, first feigning surrender and dropping an iron portcullis at the prince, then hanging tablets bearing his father's posthumous title along the ramparts so he dared not open a cannonade. Zhu Di raised the siege, yet after taking the throne in 1402 he had Tie Xuan executed. In 1444 Jinan, where the provincial government and Jinan Prefecture sat together, was a flourishing capital on the post road from Beijing to the south.

Long peace made Jinan one of the richest cities of northern China in the Jiajing and Wanli reigns; Li Panlong, born at Licheng in 1514, led the 'Later Seven Masters' of letters. War returned with the dynasty's end: in the fourth Manchu inroad of 1638-39, Dorgon's raiders swept through Shandong and sacked Jinan in 1639. The left administration commissioner Zhang Bingwen, the investigating censor Song Xuezhu and the prefect Gou Haoshan died defending it, the Prince of De Zhu Youshu was carried off captive, and his palace burned. In 1644 Jinan passed first to Li Zicheng's Shun regime and then to the Qing; in 1666 the ruined De palace was rebuilt on a smaller scale as the yamen of the Shandong governor. Under the Kangxi Emperor its trade slowly recovered, and Jinan remained Shandong's capital thereafter.
zh:
济南北临大河、南靠泰山，因大明湖与七十二名泉而别称泉城。1116年北宋升齐州为济南府，词人李清照、辛弃疾都出生于此，女真南下后相继南渡。1368年明军攻克济南，1376年山东布政使司自青州移治历城，济南从此成为山东省会。靖难之役中，燕王朱棣1400年白沟河大捷后进围济南，山东布政使司参政铁铉与大将盛庸死守：燕军掘开河堤放水灌城，铁铉先遣千人诈降、暗放铁板伏击朱棣，又在城头高悬书有「高皇帝神牌」的木牌，使燕军不敢开炮。围城三个月不下，朱棣解围北撤，盛庸乘胜收复德州；1402年朱棣登基后，铁铉被执，不屈而受磔刑。1444年的济南是布政使司与济南府同治的省会，北京通往江南官道上的繁华都会。

承平日久，嘉靖、万历年间济南跻身北方最繁华的都会之列；1514年生于历城的李攀龙后来主盟文坛，为「后七子」之首。明末战祸再起：1638年至1639年清军第四次入塞，奉命大将军多尔衮所部横扫山东，1639年初济南城破，山东左布政使张秉文、巡按御史宋学朱、知府苟好善等死之，德王朱由枢被掳北去，德王府毁于大火。1644年济南先归李自成的大顺，随即入清；1666年朝廷在德王府旧址缩建山东巡抚都察院署。康熙年间济南商贸缓慢复苏，终清之世稳居山东省会。

en:
The country at the foot of the Taihang range, where the Qin River leaves Shanxi for the Yellow River plain, was called Yewang in Qin times and Henei from the Sui, and a Huaizhou garrison sat here from the fifth century. In December 1126 the Jin general Wanyan Zonghan stormed Huaizhou after the Song garrison fought to the end. Under the Mongols it became Huaiqing Route, and in 1368 the new Ming dynasty set Huaiqing Prefecture over six counties, with its seat at Henei on the lower Qin. Its well-watered fields made it grain country, and in 1443 the court moved the Prince of Zheng, Zhu Zhanjun, to Huaiqing from Fengxiang; the prince entered his new fief in 1444, so the region opens the period with a Ming princely court newly settled beneath the Taihang.

The Zheng fief's most famous scholar was Zhu Zaiyu (1536–1611), heir of its prince, who in 1584 worked out the mathematics of twelve-tone equal temperament. Huaiqing was also known for its four medicines, rehmannia, Chinese yam, achyranthes and chrysanthemum, whose dealers, the Huai merchants, built guild halls in the great drug markets of the north. In the late 1630s the rebellions reached Henan, and Li Zicheng's army destroyed the Ming forces in the province before his Shun dynasty briefly held it in 1644; Qing armies then took Huaiqing, kept the prefecture, and later added Yuanwu and Yangwu to its six counties.
zh:
太行山南麓、沁河出山西入黄河平原之处，秦代称野王，隋代起改名河内县，五世纪以来便是怀州治所。1126年12月，金将完颜宗翰攻克怀州，宋朝守军力战而亡。元代称怀庆路，1368年明朝改置怀庆府，府治设在沁河下游的河内县，领六县，沁河灌溉的良田以产粮著称。1443年，朝廷将郑王朱瞻埈从陕西凤翔改封怀庆，郑王于1444年就藩，开局时一座明代王府刚在太行山下落成。

郑藩最出名的人物是朱载堉（1536—1611），郑恭王嫡子，他在1584年以精密的数学计算首创十二平均律。怀庆的另一张名帖是四大怀药——怀地黄、怀山药、怀牛膝、怀菊花，经营怀药的怀商结成怀邦，在北方各大药都会馆林立。1630年代末民变波及河南，李自成军歼灭了省内的明军主力，1644年其大顺朝一度据有此地，随后清军攻取怀庆，沿袭府治，后来又把原武、阳武二县划入，共领八县。

en:
Taiyuan lies in the central Shanxi basin where the Fen River breaks out of the hills into open plain. Its first walled city, Jinyang, was founded in 497 BC and served as a northern capital under the Tang; when the Song overthrew the Northern Han there in 979 the emperor Taizong had the old city burned and flooded, and in 982 a new town was laid out at Tangming on the Fen, the core of modern Taiyuan. Ming forces under Xu Da took it from the Yuan in 1368. The Hongwu Emperor enfeoffed his third son Zhu Gang as Prince of Jin, whose palace was the grandest of the Ming princely courts, and the general Xie Cheng enlarged the city with walls fourteen kilometres around; the prince also built the vast Chongshan Temple in memory of his mother Empress Ma. Rated one of the nine border commands, Taiyuan in 1444 forged weapons and produced iron for the northern garrisons while Shanxi merchants grew rich provisioning them.

The late Ming rebellions reached the city with the dynasty's collapse: in the first months of 1644 Li Zicheng's Dashun army stormed Taiyuan and the Shanxi governor Cai Maode hanged himself as it fell, opening the road through the northern passes toward Beijing. In the fighting that soon brought the Qing, the Jin palace and Chongshan Temple both burned. Earlier, between 1597 and 1612, the two brick pagodas of Yongzuo Temple had been raised south-east of the walls, the second of them built from 1608 under the Wutai monk Fudeng at the invitation of a Prince of Jin. Under Qing peace the basin throve on iron, sulphur and coal, and Taiyuan Prefecture anchored the merchant empire of the Shanxi firms: its counties of Pingyao, Taigu and Qi became the bankers of the empire, their draft banks financing tea caravans to Mongolia and Russia, while Taiyuan itself grew into a northern centre of trade and handicrafts.
zh:
太原地处山西盆地中部、汾河出山入原之处。最早的城邑是公元前497年建在汾西的晋阳城，唐代以此为北都、龙兴之地；979年宋太宗攻灭北汉，火烧晋阳城又引汾水、晋水灌城，982年潘美在汾河畔的唐明镇另建新城，即今太原城的前身。1368年徐达从元朝手中夺取太原。明太祖封第三子朱棡为晋王，晋王府是明代各王府中规模最大的一座，谢成又将城池向东、南、北三面扩展，筑起周长十四公里的城墙；晋王还为生母马皇后修建了规模宏大的崇善寺。太原被列为九边重镇之一，1444年时，这里为北方各卫所打造兵器、出产铁货，山西商人也靠供给边军起家。

晚明民变在王朝末年波及太原：1644年初李自成大顺军攻破城池，山西巡抚蔡懋德自缢殉国，太原一失，李自成北取宁武、大同，直逼北京。随后清军入晋的战火中，晋王府与崇善寺都毁于大火。此前的1597年至1612年，城东南先后建起永祚寺双塔：文峰塔于1599年建成，宣文塔则由晋王朱敏淳请来五台山妙峰禅师（福登）主持，1612年完工。入清承平之后，盆地的炼铁、硫磺和煤炭日益兴旺，太原府更支撑着晋商的商业网络：所辖平遥、太谷、祁县成为全国金融中心，票号为前往蒙古和俄罗斯的茶叶商队融资，太原本身也成为北方商业与手工业重镇。

en:
Pingyang occupies the Fen River basin of southwestern Shanxi, a fertile corridor between the Luliang and Taiyue mountains. It was the ancient Pingyang of Jin; in 583 the Sui created Linfen Commandery and renamed Pinghe County Linfen, the Song raised Jinzhou to Pingyang Prefecture in 1116, and the Ming restored that name in 1368, governing six subprefectures and twenty-eight counties. Shielded by mountain barriers, southwestern Shanxi escaped the worst of the late Yuan wars and became unusually populous. From 1373 to 1417, eighteen official migrations were assembled at Hongtong's Great Pagoda Tree before being sent to the war-scarred North China Plain and other regions. In 1444 Pingyang was therefore a densely settled Ming prefecture sustained by the cultivated Fen valley.

The Qing at first preserved Pingyang's large Ming jurisdiction, with the Taiyuan regional military commander stationed there. On 18 May 1695 a great earthquake struck Linfen, reaching the eleventh degree on the Chinese seismic intensity scale, affecting more than 120 counties in eight provinces and killing an estimated 52,600 people. After reconstruction, the prefecture was gradually reduced: in 1724 Pu, Jie, Jiang, Ji and Xi subprefectures became directly administered subprefectures, and during the Qianlong reign Huozhou followed, leaving Pingyang with one subprefecture and ten counties. Through those changes Linfen remained the prefectural seat on the Fen.
zh:
平阳位于山西西南部的汾河谷地，是吕梁山与太岳山之间的肥沃通道。此地古称平阳，曾属晋国；583年隋代设临汾郡，改平河县为临汾县，1116年北宋升晋州为平阳府，明代又在1368年恢复平阳府，下辖六州二十八县。晋西南有山河屏障，未像中原那样深遭元末战祸，人口较为稠密。1373年至1417年，官方先后十八次在洪洞大槐树集结山西移民，再迁往华北平原等遭兵火破坏的地区。因此1444年的平阳是明朝治下人烟稠密、靠汾河河谷农耕支撑的一府。

清初沿袭明制，平阳府最初仍领六州二十八县，太原镇总兵也驻在这里。1695年5月18日，临汾发生大地震，最高烈度达十一度，波及八省一百二十余州县，约五万二千六百人遇难。重建之后，府域逐渐缩小：1724年蒲州、解州、绛州、吉州、隰州升为直隶州，乾隆年间霍州也升为直隶州，平阳府最后只领一州十县。历次调整中，临汾始终是汾河畔的府治。

en:
Hejian lies in the flat, river-cut country of the North China Plain, its name originally describing the land between rivers. Under the Sui, Wuyuan County was renamed Hejian; in 1108 the Song raised Yingzhou to Hejian Prefecture, and the Yuan made it Hejian Route. The Ming converted the route into a prefecture in 1368 and assigned it to the Northern Metropolitan Region in 1369. By 1444, Hejian's walled seat was the first prefectural city on the road south from Beijing, while its subordinate Cangzhou reached toward the Bohai Gulf. Those coastal flats belonged to the Changlu salt country, where salt boilers produced sea salt and tied the plain to Ming revenues and north-south commerce.

The prefecture's registered population was 378,658 people in 42,548 households in 1491, and had reached 419,152 people in 45,024 households by 1578. Under the Ming, a salt administration at Changlu town supervised twenty-four saltworks along the Bohai shore. Hejian County remained the prefectural seat after the Qing conquest of 1644, but in 1731 Cangzhou was transferred to Tianjin Prefecture, separating the coastal salt district from the administrative center at Hejian.
zh:
河间地处华北平原河流纵横的平野之间，名称本指诸河之间的土地。隋代武垣县改名河间县，1108年宋朝升瀛州为河间府，元代又改为河间路。1368年明朝改路为府，1369年划归北直隶。到1444年，河间府城是北京南下官道上的第一座府城，所辖沧州则伸向渤海湾。滨海滩涂属于长芦盐区，灶户煮海为盐，使这片平原与明朝财赋和南北商路联系在一起。

1491年，河间府登记有42548户、378658人；到1578年，增至45024户、419152人。明代，长芦镇设有统辖海盐产销的转运使，管辖渤海沿岸的24处盐场。1644年明清易代后，河间县仍为府治；1731年沧州改属天津府，滨海盐区遂与河间这个行政中心分离。

en:
Baoding lies below the eastern escarpment of the Taihang Mountains, where rivers run east toward Baiyang Lake and the plain opens toward Beijing. Mongol troops sacked Baozhou in 1213, and the surrendered Jin general Zhang Rou rebuilt the city in 1227; in 1275 Shuntian Route was renamed Baoding, meaning the defence of the capital. The Ming made it Baoding Prefecture in 1368 and moved the Daning military commission there in 1403. In 1444 the seat at Qingyuan County was therefore both a prefectural city and a military strongpoint on Beijing's southern flank, with Zijing Pass in the hills to the northwest ranking among the Three Inner Passes. The Quyang kilns to the west had produced the celebrated white Ding porcelain of Northern Song times, though production had ended under the Yuan.

In 1449, after the Tumu disaster, Esen's Oirats forced Zijing Pass and advanced on Beijing, exposing how closely Baoding's defences guarded the capital. The Ming established a Baoding grand coordinator in 1515, founded the Ercheng Academy in 1531 and later renamed it Jintai, opened the Shanggu Academy in 1606, and built a mosque at the city's southeastern corner in 1616. In 1638 the Baoding governor-general was separated from the Jiliao command and given oversight of Baoding, Shandong, Tianjin and Deng-Lai. Under the Qing, the Zhili governor moved from Zhending to Baoding in 1669, and the office became the Viceroyalty of Zhili in 1724. The Lotus Pond Academy followed in 1733. Work on the Western Qing tombs began in 1729 at Yongning Mountain in Yi Prefecture, where the Tailing, the Yongzheng Emperor's mausoleum, was completed in 1737.
zh:
保定位于太行山东麓，拒马河、唐河等河东流入白洋淀，平原由此通向北京。1213年蒙古军攻陷保州并屠城，降蒙金将张柔于1227年主持重建；1275年顺天路改称保定路，取护卫京师、安定天下之意。1368年明朝改设保定府，1403年又将大宁都司移驻于此。因此到1444年，清苑县治既是府城，也是北京南侧的军政重镇，西北山中的紫荆关与居庸关、倒马关并称内三关。西部曲阳定窑曾烧造北宋极负盛名的白瓷，但入元后已经停烧。

1449年土木之变后，也先率领的瓦剌军攻破紫荆关进逼北京，保定关隘拱卫京师的地位更加凸显。1515年明廷设保定巡抚，1531年建二程书院，后改称金台书院；1606年上谷书院落成，1616年城东南又建清真寺。1638年，保定总督从蓟辽总督任内析出，统辖保定、山东、天津、登莱四巡抚之地。入清后，直隶巡抚于1669年由真定移驻保定，使这里成为直隶省会；1724年改设直隶总督，1733年莲池书院建立。1729年，清廷在易州永宁山动工经营清西陵，雍正帝的泰陵于1737年完工，西北部山岭由此成为清代皇家陵寝重地。

en:
Datong lies in the northern Shanxi basin where the Sanggan and Yu rivers drain toward the Mongolian Plateau, where Chinese garrison lands met steppe pastures. Pingcheng was capital of the Northern Wei from 398 to 494, and the nearby Yungang Grottoes were carved between 460 and 494; in 1044 the Liao raised Yunzhou to Datong Prefecture and made it their Western Capital. After 1368 the Ming turned the Yuan Datong Route into a prefecture of four subprefectures and seven counties, but the city's character was above all military. In 1372 Xu Da rebuilt the old town as a brick fortress. By 1444 Datong was one of the Nine Border Garrisons, held a Ming princely fief and guarded the passes toward Mongolia; its largest Ming garrison was put at 136,000 soldiers and more than 50,000 horses.

In 1449 Oirat raids through Datong and Xuanfu drew the Zhengtong Emperor's army into the Tumu campaign, which ended with his capture and turned Ming frontier policy sharply defensive. War with the Mongols alternated with border trade until 1570, when the Xuan-Da commander Wang Chonggu and Datong grand coordinator Fang Fengshi used a family quarrel that brought Altan Khan's grandson to the Ming border to negotiate tribute and frontier markets, easing nearly two centuries of raiding. In 1645 Jiang Xiang killed the local rebel officer Zhang Tianlin and surrendered Datong to the Qing. When the city rose against Qing rule, Dorgon's army took it and carried out a massacre in 1649. Datong was rebuilt in 1652; its Drum Tower and Nine-Dragon Wall remained monuments of the Ming garrison age.
zh:
大同地处山西北部的大同盆地，桑干河横贯市境，御河流经城侧，向北连通蒙古高原，自古是农耕防线与草原牧场相接之处。平城在398年至494年为北魏都城，460年至494年又在附近开凿云冈石窟；1044年辽朝升云州为大同府，建为西京。1368年后，明代改大同路为府，领四州七县，但这里更是军镇。1372年，徐达在辽金元旧城基础上督建砖城。到1444年，大同已是九边重镇之一，设有藩王封地，扼守通往蒙古高原的关隘；其明代驻军最多时达13.6万人、战马5万多匹。

1449年，瓦剌经大同、宣府一路进犯，明英宗亲征，最终在土木堡被俘，明朝对北方的战略由此转入守势。此后蒙古诸部与明朝时战时市。1570年，宣大总督王崇古和大同巡抚方逢时借俺答汗之孙投明的家事争端，促成封贡与互市，结束了近二百年的敌对状态，边境马匹贸易也随之缓和。1645年，姜瓖杀死驻大同的农民军将领张天琳，降清；1649年大同反清，城破后清军奉多尔衮命令屠城。1652年大同重建，鼓楼与九龙壁则是明代军镇时代留下的标志。

en:
Ningxia joins two landscapes: the Yellow River plain in the north, under the Helan Mountains and facing the Ordos, and the Liupan hill country of old Yuanzhou in the south. Han canals beginning with the Hanyan watered the northern plain into the 'Jiangnan beyond the passes'; southern pastures raised horses for Western Han stud farms, and salt came from the Huamachi lakes on the Ordos edge. In 1038 Li Yuanhao founded the Western Xia at Xingqing; two centuries later the Mongols overthrew it and named the land Ningxia, 'the pacified Xia'. Under the Ming, five guards held the plain and Ningxia was one of the Nine Border Garrisons. Zhu Zhan, sixteenth son of the Hongwu Emperor, first commanded the frontier from Weizhou and took residence at Ningxia in 1397; he compiled the first Ningxia gazetteer and died in 1438. In 1444 his son Zhu Zhikui holds the prince's court amid military farms and salt-certificate markets, watching the Mongols beyond the wall while old Yuanzhou guards the road into Shaanxi.

Yuanzhou was renamed Guyuan in 1445 and given a guard in 1469. In 1468 Man Si, chief of the Mongol 'local Tartar' clans below the Liupan, seized the cliff fortress of Shicheng with 20,000 followers; Xiang Zhong and Ma Wensheng starved it through the winter, razed it, and sent Man Si to Beijing for execution. In 1497 Wang Yue took the new post of supreme commander over the three border garrisons of Ningxia, Yansui and Gansu, headquartered at Guyuan; made permanent in 1525, the command kept autumn watch at the Huamachi lakes against Ordos raiders. In 1592 the retired Mongol-born general Bobei mutinied in Ningxia town, killed the grand coordinator and overran forty-seven forts. Li Rusong and Ma Gui ringed the walls, flooded the city with Yellow River water, and in the ninth month Bobei killed himself — the first of the Wanli reign's Three Great Campaigns. Qing forces arrived in 1645. In 1697 the Kangxi Emperor made Ningxia the base of his last Galdan campaign: two columns under Fiyanggu and Maska marched out in February and followed in April. Ningxia and Ningshuo counties were set up in the garrison city in 1724, and on 3 January 1739 a magnitude-eight earthquake wrecked the Yinchuan plain and killed 50,000 people.
zh:
宁夏由两片土地组成：北为贺兰山与长城环抱、面向鄂尔多斯的宁夏平原，南为六盘山下旧原州一带的黄土丘陵。自汉代起便引黄河水开渠，最早的汉延渠把北部平原溉成「塞上江南」；南部草场自西汉起即为官营养马之地，东缘花马池一带的盐湖出产池盐。1038年，李元昊以兴庆府为都建立西夏，这个党项人王国延续近两个世纪，终为蒙古所灭，其地得名宁夏，取「平定西夏」之意。入明以后，平原上设宁夏五卫，宁夏列为九边重镇之一。明太祖第十六子庆靖王朱㮵先驻韦州，1397年正式就藩宁夏，修成宁夏第一部方志《宁夏志》，1438年去世。1444年，其子朱秩煃在此嗣爵，境内遍布军屯和凭盐引交易的市集，长城之外便是蒙古部落；南面的原州则扼守着进入陕西的要道。

1445年原州改名固原，取「讳故改固」之意，1469年设固原卫。1468年，落籍六盘山北麓的蒙古「土鞑」首领满四起事，聚众两万据守石城；项忠、马文升督军围困一冬，断水焚草，最终攻克并捣毁石城，满四被押送北京处死。1497年，王越首任总制宁夏、延绥、甘肃三镇军务，开府固原；该职1525年定为常设，每年秋后移驻花马池，防秋备边。1592年，已致仕的蒙古裔副总兵哱拜在宁夏镇起兵，杀巡抚党馨，连陷河西四十七堡；李如松、麻贵围城数月，决黄河水灌城，九月城破，哱拜自尽，是为万历三大征之首的宁夏之役。1645年清军入据宁夏。1697年，康熙帝以宁夏为最后一次亲征噶尔丹的基地，二月费扬古、马斯喀率两路出师，四月御驾抵宁。1724年，于镇城内分设宁夏县、宁朔县；1739年1月3日，一场约八级的大地震摧毁银川平原，压死五万余人。

en:
Lanzhou lies in a narrow basin where the Yellow River turns east through the mountains, the chief crossing on the old Northern Silk Road before it enters the Hexi Corridor. The Han founded Jincheng, the 'Golden City', here in 86 BC, and five years later made it seat of Jincheng commandery. In 583 the Sui renamed it Lanzhou after Mount Gaolan south of the city. The Tibetan Empire seized it in 762 and held it until Zhang Yichao recovered the Longyou lands for the Tang in 848; Western Xia, Jin and Mongol rule followed in turn. Early Ming reduced Lanzhou to a county under Lintao prefecture, yet it remained a garrison town and the seat of the Princes of Su: Zhu Ying, fourteenth son of the Hongwu Emperor, was the first of the line, which kept its court here into the seventeenth century. From 1385 chained boats formed the Zhenyuan pontoon bridge below White Pagoda Mountain, the only bridge on the upper Yellow River, described as commanding the road to the Western Regions. In 1444 Lanzhou was a fortified frontier town of Ming Shaanxi, its garrison farming and storing grain to supply the posts farther west.

In 1477 Lan-xian was raised back to the subprefecture of Lanzhou. In 1643 Zhang Xianzhong's rebel army stormed the city, the last Prince of Su, Zhu Shihong, was killed, and the princedom was extinguished. Under the new Qing dynasty, Gansu was made a province separate from Shaanxi in 1666 with its capital at Lanzhou. In 1738 the seat of Lintao prefecture was moved into the city, which became Lanzhou prefecture, and in 1764 the governor-general of Shaan-Gan transferred his yamen from Xi'an, making Lanzhou the military and administrative headquarters of the entire north-west.
zh:
兰州地处黄河河谷盆地，是北方丝绸之路进入河西走廊前最重要的渡口。西汉昭帝始元元年（前86年）在此置金城县，取「金城汤池」之意，五年后又设金城郡，以金城县为郡治。隋开皇三年（583年），因城南的皋兰山改金城郡为兰州，兰州之名由此始。762年吐蕃攻陷兰州，直到848年张议潮收复陇右十一州；此后兰州又先后归属于西夏、金朝和蒙古。明初降兰州为兰县，隶属临洮府，但城中仍设兰州卫，并是肃王的封国：明太祖第十四子朱楧为第一代肃王，肃藩世代在此开府，直至明末。自1385年起，白塔山下以舟船连锁架成镇远浮桥，时称「控扼冲要，道通西域」，是黄河上游唯一的桥梁。1444年的兰州是明朝陕西边防的军事重镇，屯田积谷，卫护着通往西域的补给线。

1477年，明廷升兰县为兰州，恢复旧名。1643年张献忠军攻陷兰州，末代肃王朱识鋐被杀，肃藩国除。入清以后，1666年陕甘分治，设甘肃行省，定省会于兰州；1738年临洮府治移至兰州，改称兰州府；1764年陕甘总督衙门又自西安迁来，兰州自此成为统辖整个西北的军政中心。

en:
Xi'an, the ancient Chang'an, lies in the Wei valley where the Silk Road entered China and the Zhou royal capital Hao once stood. In 202 BC the Han founder Liu Bang established his capital at Chang'an, and the Weiyang Palace that followed was the largest palace complex the world had seen. The Sui rebuilt the city as Daxing and the Tang renamed it Chang'an, making it the largest city on earth: Xuanzang directed his translation board here, the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda was begun in 652 to house his Indian sutras, and monks, Sogdian merchants and envoys of the Church of the East crowded the wards, while the Nestorian stele of 781 recorded that community in Chinese and Syriac. With the fall of Tang the city was devastated and its people forcibly moved to Luoyang. Ming armies took it in 1369 and renamed it Xi'an, 'Western Peace', and from 1370 a great new wall and moat girdled the much smaller city. In 1444 Xi'an was the chief city of Shaanxi, a fortified north-western bastion guarding the road to the Hexi Corridor and the caravan trade with the western regions.

On 23 January 1556 the great Huaxian earthquake struck Shaanxi; at Xi'an the Small Wild Goose Pagoda was cracked and reduced from fifteen storeys to thirteen, and famine and ruin across the province pushed the death toll as high as 830,000. In 1625 workmen unearthed the long-buried Nestorian stele, whose account of the Tang Church of the East soon drew Jesuit scholars to the city. In November 1643 Li Zicheng's rebel army broke through Tongguan and occupied Xi'an, and at the new year he proclaimed himself emperor of the Great Shun with the reign title Yongchang, restoring the old name Chang'an. Driven back by the Qing after the fall of Beijing, he abandoned the city in 1645 and was killed in the Hubei hills that summer. Xi'an remained the seat of the Shaanxi provincial government, though in 1764 the Qing moved the governor-general's yamen for the north-west on to Lanzhou.
zh:
西安古称长安，地处渭河谷地，是丝绸之路进入中原的门户，西周宗周镐京即在附近。公元前202年，汉高祖刘邦定都长安，随后营建的未央宫是当时世界上规模最大的宫殿建筑群。隋代改建大兴城，唐代复名长安，成为当时世界上最大的城市：玄奘在此主持译经，652年起营建大雁塔以存放他从印度取回的经卷，城里僧侣、粟特商人和景教使者往来不绝，781年所立的《大秦景教流行中国碑》还用汉文和叙利亚文记下了景教信众的情况。唐末长安城遭残破，居民被强行迁往洛阳。1369年明军攻取奉元路，改名西安，取「西方安定」之意，1370年起在小得多的城址外筑起高大的新城墙与护城河。1444年的西安是陕西首邑、西北军事重镇，扼守通往河西走廊的大道和与西域之间的商队贸易。

1556年1月23日，华县大地震震撼陕西，西安的小雁塔被震裂，塔身由十五层减为十三层；全省因饥荒和流离死亡的人数可能多达八十三万。1625年，埋没已久的《大秦景教流行中国碑》出土，所载唐代景教史事很快吸引耶稣会士前来考察。1643年十一月，李自成军攻破潼关、占领西安，次年正月他在西安称帝，国号大顺，改元永昌，并恢复长安旧名。北京兵败之后，他被清军追击，1645年弃城南逃，同年夏死于湖北九宫山。西安此后仍是陕西省的治所，不过1764年清廷已把统辖西北的陕甘总督衙门迁往兰州。

en:
Ordos is the dry plateau enclosed on three sides by the great northern bend of the Yellow River, where the Kubuqi and Mu Us deserts meet riverine grasslands and the loess hills watched by Ming frontier lines. After the Yuan court withdrew north in 1368, Mongol camps used the loop as pasture and a raiding corridor. In 1444 there was no fixed provincial capital here: herders moved horses, sheep, cattle and camels between desert and river grass, while Ming garrisons guarded the walled southern approaches. The Eight White Yurts of Genghis Khan had not yet settled in the plateau, and the palace-tent guardians who would be called the Ordos were only about to make it their home.

The name Ordos appears in the late fifteenth century, from the Mongol word for palace tents. After the non-Chinggisid lords Iburai and Mandulai controlled the shrine and the herds, Dayan Khan subdued the Ordos in 1510 and made it one of the three right-wing tumens, placing Bars Bolud over them as jinong. His descendants ruled the camps through the next century. Mongol pressure on the Ming frontier helped reopen border trade after the 1571 accord, when Ordos horses and livestock again reached Chinese markets. In 1578 Altan Khan met the Third Dalai Lama at Yanghua Monastery in Kokonor, with the Ordos prince Khutughtai Sechen Khongtaiji among those promoting the Gelug order; lamas, monasteries and Buddhist law then reshaped a society that had largely kept shamanic rites. Ligdan Khan's westward campaign scattered the Ordos in 1628, and after his death they submitted to Hong Taiji in 1635. The Qing organized them into six jasagh banners in 1649 and added a seventh in 1736; the banners assembled at Ikh Juu, while the Eight White Yurts found their lasting home at Ejin Khoro under the care of the jinong.
zh:
鄂尔多斯是黄河大河弯三面环绕的干旱高原，库布其、毛乌素两片沙地与河畔草原相接，南方黄土丘陵则有明朝边墙守望。1368年元廷北撤后，蒙古营地把河套当作牧场和南下袭掠的通道。1444年，这里还没有固定的省治；牧民赶着马、羊、牛和骆驼在沙地与河滨草场之间迁徙，明朝守军则守卫南侧边墙。成吉思汗的八白室尚未迁入高原，那些后来被称为鄂尔多斯的宫帐守护者，也正要把这里变成自己的家园。

鄂尔多斯之名在15世纪末出现，源自蒙古语中众多宫帐之意。异姓领主亦卜剌、满都赉一度控制祭祀宫帐和牧地后，达延汗于1510年收服鄂尔多斯，将其列为右翼三万户之一，并以巴尔斯博罗特为济农统辖，其子孙此后统治诸营。蒙古对明朝边境的压力促成1571年封贡和互市，鄂尔多斯的马匹、牲畜重新进入中原市场。1578年，俺答汗在青海仰华寺会见三世达赖喇嘛索南嘉措，鄂尔多斯贵族切尽黄台吉也在推动格鲁派传播的行列中；喇嘛、寺院和佛教戒律由此改变了这个仍大量保留萨满仪式的社会。1628年林丹汗西征，鄂尔多斯部溃散；林丹汗死后，他们于1635年归附皇太极。清朝在1649年将鄂尔多斯编为六个扎萨克旗，1736年增设一旗；七旗在伊克昭会盟，八白室也在济农主持下移奉伊金霍洛。

en:
The Hohhot plain lies between the Daqing Mountains and the great bend of the Yellow River, north of the Ming frontier at Datong. King Wuling of Zhao founded Yunzhong here, the Han used it as a base against the Xiongnu, and under the Liao, Jin and Yuan the plain was governed from the market town of Fengzhou. The Ming attached the area to the Dongsheng garrison, but Mongols who had withdrawn beyond the Wall kept grazing here, and in 1444 the plain was Mongol pasture on the edge of Ming China.

In 1572 Altan Khan settled his Tümed here and built Kökeqota, the Blue City, which the Ming, having made him Prince Shunyi, renamed Guihua. After meeting the Third Dalai Lama in 1578, he began the Da Zhao temple in 1579 and had a silver Buddha cast for it, which Sonam Gyatso consecrated in 1586. Ligdan Khan of the Chahar took Guihua in 1627, and in 1632 Hong Taiji, pursuing him, burned the town but spared its temples. Hui merchants built a mosque here in 1693, and in 1735–1739 the Qing raised the garrison city of Suiyuan just to the northeast.
zh:
呼和浩特所在的土默特川夹在大青山和黄河大弯之间，南面是明朝的大同边塞。赵武灵王在这里设云中城，汉代以云中为出击匈奴的基地，辽、金、元三朝则以商业繁荣的丰州治理这片平原。明朝把这一带划归东胜卫，但退回塞外的蒙古人仍在这里放牧，1444年的土默特川是明朝边外的蒙古牧场。

1572年，阿勒坦汗率土默特部来此定居，筑起库库和屯城，意为「青城」；他受明朝封为顺义王，明廷给这座城赐名归化。1578年阿勒坦汗会见三世达赖索南嘉措，次年动工兴建大召，并用纯银铸造释迦牟尼像，1586年索南嘉措亲临大召为银佛开光。1627年察哈尔部林丹汗攻取归化城，1632年皇太极追击林丹汗至此，纵火焚城，只留下寺庙。1693年回族商人在这里建起清真寺，1735年至1739年清朝又在城东北筑起驻防的绥远城。

en:
Chengde lies in the ridges where the Yan Mountains meet the Bashang steppe, with the Wulie River running through it to the Luan. Its hot springs gave the place its Mongol name Halun Gol, rendered in Chinese as Rehe. For centuries it was pasture rather than farmland, ranged in turn by the Xiongnu, Xianbei, Khitan and Jurchen; the Xi herded there under the Liao, and after the Yuan fell it became the horse country of the Mongol tribes beyond the wall, among them the Uriankhai whom the Ming called the Three Guards. No walled town stood there in 1444, only felt camps and herds moving between mountain and plain, a few days' ride past Gubeikou and the passes guarding Beijing.

For more than two centuries it stayed Mongol grazing land, belonging early in the Qing to the Kharchin and Ongniud. The Kangxi Emperor made it a second seat of empire: from 1683 his northern tours took shape as the century-long Mulan autumn hunts, and in 1703 he began the Rehe Traveling Palace, the Mountain Resort, around which the Outer Temples rose; the work ran for eighty-nine years and was finished only in 1792. Rehe Subprefecture was created in 1723, and in 1733 the Yongzheng Emperor renamed the place Chengde, 'inheriting the ancestors' virtue'. Qianlong used it as his stage for Inner Asia: he received the three Dorbod princes in 1754, greeted Ubashi Khan after the Torghut migration of 1771—the year the Potala-like Putuo Zongcheng Temple was completed—and raised the town to Chengde Prefecture in 1778, famed as the 'capital beyond the wall'. In 1793 he received the Macartney embassy in the Garden of Ten Thousand Trees and refused all its requests. A Jehol commandant was appointed in 1810, and at the resort, in 1820, the Jiaqing Emperor died.
zh:
承德坐落在燕山山脉与坝上草原相接的群山之间，武烈河穿城而过，汇入斜贯全境的滦河。当地温泉在蒙古语中称「哈伦郭勒」，汉译便是热河。千百年间，这里以牧场而非田园闻名，匈奴、鲜卑、契丹、女真先后在此游牧，辽代是奚人的居地；元亡之后，更成为塞外蒙古各部的牧马之乡，其中就有明朝称作兀良哈三卫的朵颜诸部。1444年，这里还没有城垣，只有移动的毡帐和往返于山地与草原之间的畜群，出古北口、越过拱卫北京的关隘再走数日便到。

此后两个多世纪，这里仍是蒙古牧场，清初分属喀喇沁、翁牛特两部。康熙帝把它变成了帝国的第二重心：1683年起，他的出塞北巡逐渐定型为延续百年的木兰秋狝；1703年又在热河上营动工兴建热河行宫，即避暑山庄，山庄周围陆续建起外八庙，工程历时89年，到1792年才基本完工。1723年设热河厅，1733年雍正帝取「承受先祖德泽」之意改设承德州，「承德」之名由此而来。乾隆帝把这里当作经营内亚的舞台：1754年在万树园接见杜尔伯特部三策凌，1771年接见自伏尔加河流域东归的土尔扈特首领渥巴锡，仿拉萨布达拉宫而建的普陀宗乘之庙也在这一年建成；1778年升为承德府，号称「塞外京都」。1793年，他在万树园接见英国马戛尔尼使团，对其各项要求一概拒绝。1810年设置热河都统，1820年，嘉庆帝在避暑山庄病逝。

en:
Ningyuan guards the middle of the Liaoxi Corridor, the narrow coastal strip between the Rehe hills and the Bohai Sea that carries the only road from Shanhai Pass into Liaodong. The Liao dynasty knew the place as Xingcheng, but the present walled town was founded in 1428, when the Ming set up the Ningyuan Guard under the Liaodong Regional Military Commission. Its square ramparts carried gate towers and barbicans on all four sides, with a drum tower over the cross streets, making it the chief strongpoint of the western corridor. In 1444 it was a garrison town of soldier-farmers on a still-quiet stretch of the Mongol and Jurchen frontier.

In 1564 the walls were rebuilt by the military intendant Chen Jiang. The quiet ended with the rise of the Later Jin: in the first month of 1626 Nurhaci threw his whole army at Ningyuan, and Yuan Chonghuan answered from the ramparts with newly cast European-style 'red barbarian' cannon. The assault failed, the first Ming victory over the Jin in a city siege, and Nurhaci died at Shengjing eight months later. His men instead crossed the frozen sea to Juehua Island, annihilating its garrison and destroying the Liaodong army's island granary. In 1627 Hong Taiji was repulsed again before Ningyuan and Jinzhou. In 1644 Wu Sangui led the garrison through Shanhai Pass and the city passed to the Qing, who later replaced the guard with Ningyuan Subprefecture under the Shengjiang garrison general.
zh:
宁远扼守辽西走廊中段——热河丘陵与渤海之间的狭长滨海地带，是从山海关进入辽东的唯一大路。辽代曾在此设兴城县，现存城垣则始于明代：宣德三年（1428年）置宁远卫，隶辽东都指挥使司，方城四门各筑箭楼瓮城，十字街心架起鼓楼，是辽西走廊上的首要军镇。1444年，这里是蒙古、女真边陲上一处以军户屯田为生的卫城，边境尚算平静。

嘉靖四十三年（1564年），兵备副使陈绛重修城垣。明末后金兴起，平静终结：天启六年（1626年）正月，努尔哈赤倾全军来攻，督师袁崇焕凭城以新铸的红夷大炮还击，后金攻城不克，这是明军第一次在守城战中击败后金，努尔哈赤退回盛京，八个月后病死。后金军转踏海冰进攻觉华岛，全歼岛上守军，摧毁了辽东可储粮八万余石的海岛粮仓。1627年，皇太极再攻宁远、锦州，又被击退。1644年，吴三桂率宁远守军入关勤王，清军随即占领宁远；清代裁卫建州，设宁远州，隶属盛京将军。

en:
Yushu is the high country of southern Qinghai, where the Tanggula range marks the southern skyline and the headwaters of the Yangtze and the Mekong gather among the pastures. Its people are Khampa Tibetans, herding sheep and yaks over grasslands whose southern valleys, around Nangchen, hold brine springs that have yielded salt for a thousand years. At a fork of valleys on the old Xining–Lhasa road stands Jyekundo—Gyêgu, the “market at the valley mouth”, where tea carried up from the east was traded for the wool, salt and livestock of the plateau. Since the twelfth century the land has belonged to the kings of Nangchen: in 1175 their founder Zhewa Alu submitted to the Southern Song and had his domain recognised, and in 1239 the house submitted to the Mongols of Godan Khan. Sakyapa and Kagyupa monasteries, Gyêgu's Döndrub Ling among them, grew wealthy on the caravans. In 1444 the Nangchen king still ruled his tribes beneath the Tanggula, vassal of no distant court but tied to Lhasa by trade and faith.

In the 1630s the Bön lord of Beri overran Nangchen, until Güshi Khan's Khoshut Mongols broke his power in 1639 and restored the royal house, which thereafter paid tribute to the Fifth Dalai Lama's government. After Qing armies crushed the Khoshut rising of Lobzang Danjin in 1723–1724, the eighteenth king of Nangchen was confirmed in 1725 as thousand-household chief over the Yushu tribes under the amban at Xining, and the caravans of Jyekundo continued to pass as before.
zh:
玉树是青海南部的高原之地，唐古拉山横亘南境，长江与澜沧江的上游在群牧之间汇聚。居民是康巴藏族，在草原上放牧绵羊和牦牛；南部囊谦一带有盐泉二十九处，出盐已近千年。旧西宁至拉萨的商道上，扎曲与巴塘河交汇的谷口立着结古多——结古，藏语意为「货物集散地」，东方驮来的茶叶在此与高原的羊毛、食盐和牲畜交易。12世纪以来这片土地属囊谦王：1175年，始祖者哇阿路归附南宋，受册承认其领地；1239年囊谦又归附阔端麾下的蒙古。萨迦派与噶举派的寺院——结古顿珠林（结古寺）即在其中——靠往来商队致富。1444年，囊谦王仍在唐古拉山下统领诸部，不向远方的朝廷称臣，只以商路和信仰与拉萨相连。

17世纪30年代，信奉苯教的白利土司攻占囊谦，1639年固始汗率领和硕特蒙古击灭白利，恢复囊谦王的领地，囊谦自此向五世达赖喇嘛的政府朝贡。1723至1724年清军平定和硕特罗卜藏丹津之乱后，1725年第十八世囊谦王多杰才旺被清朝册封为千户，统辖玉树诸部，归西宁办事大臣管辖；结古的商队仍照旧往来。

en:
The Qaidam is a high, rain-starved basin locked between the Altyn Tagh, the Qilian range and the Kunlun, its Tibetan and Mongol names both meaning 'salt marsh'. A quarter of it is covered by saline lakes and playas, the Qarhan and Dabusun among them, whose salt crusts nomads scraped up for their flocks and for trade, while rivers running off the Kunlun watered strips of pasture and oasis. The herdsmen were the Sarïgh Yogïr, the 'Yellow Uyghurs', Vajrayana Buddhist descendants of the old Ganzhou Uyghurs who had pastured beyond the Jiayu Pass since the Tangut age. The early Ming enrolled their chiefs in loose tributary guards: the Quxian guard, restored in 1406 on the oases below the Kunlun between the Utumehren and the Taijinar lakes, and the Adong guard, whose chief led his people back to the pastures near Mangya in 1431. In 1444 their camps still moved between the salt lakes, owing the Ming little but tribute horses.

The guards' days were numbered. In 1512 the Mongol lord Iburai, defeated by Dayan Khan, flooded into Qinghai with his Yongshiyebu, scattered the Sarïgh Yogïr tribes and put an end to the Quxian guard; he was himself crushed by the brothers Gün Bilig and Altan Khan in 1533. Mongol lords then held the basin's pastures, and after Altan Khan met the Third Dalai Lama in 1578 the Gelug order spread among the herdsmen. In 1637 the Khoshut Güshi Khan defeated Choghtu Khong Tayiji by Qinghai Lake and made the Qaidam the grazing ground of his Khoshuts. When Lobzang Danjin rose against the Qing in 1723 and was broken the next year, the court in 1725 registered the Qinghai Mongols in twenty-nine banners, nine of them in the Qaidam, under the amban resident at Xining.
zh:
柴达木是被阿尔金山、祁连山与昆仑山围锁的高寒干旱盆地，藏语和蒙古语的名字都是「盐泽」之意。盆地约四分之一是咸水湖与干盐滩，察尔汗、达布逊等盐湖即在其中，牧人刮取盐壳自用并贸易；昆仑山流下的河水则滋养出一条条牧场和绿洲。牧民是撒里畏兀儿，即「黄头回鹘」，甘州回鹘的后裔，西夏时代以来就在嘉峪关外游牧，仍信奉金刚乘佛教。明初把他们的首领编为松散的朝贡羁縻卫：曲先卫1406年复置于昆仑山北麓乌图美仁河与台吉乃尔湖之间的绿洲，阿端卫首领1431年率部回到茫崖一带的牧场。1444年，他们的帐幕仍往来于盐湖之间，对明朝只须贡马，别无负担。

诸卫的日子已屈指可数。1512年，被达延汗击败的蒙古永谢布领主亦不剌率部涌入青海，击散撒里畏兀儿诸部，曲先卫就此灭亡；1533年他又被吉囊、俺答兄弟击溃。盆地牧场此后归蒙古领主，1578年俺答汗会见三世达赖喇嘛后，格鲁派在牧民中传播开来。1637年，和硕特固始汗在青海湖边击败绰克图台吉，柴达木成为和硕特人的牧场。1723年罗卜藏丹津反清、次年败亡后，清朝于1725年将青海蒙古编为二十九旗，其中九旗游牧于柴达木，归西宁办事大臣管辖。

en:
West of Jiayuguan the Silk Road leaves the Gansu corridor for the desert road to Hami, and Yumen, watered by the Shule River, was its first pasturage. It takes its name from the Jade Gate, the Han frontier pass farther west near Dunhuang; under the Tang its county seat stood at Chijinzhen, after which Tibetan and Tangut rule left the oasis largely to herdsmen. In 1404 Tani, son of a former Yuan chancellor, led his Mongol followers into Ming allegiance, and the court planted their camp at Chijin, north-west of modern Yumen, raising it to the Chijin Mongol Guard in 1410. In 1444 its horsemen, Ming-titled pastoralists of the western guards, bred horses and escorted the Hami caravans and embassies through to the pass, while the Oirats gathered strength on the steppe.

In the Zhengde reign of 1506-1521 the armies of Mansur of Turpan overran Hami and broke the Chijin guard, whose people were resettled inside Suzhou; in 1539 the Ming closed the frontier with flanking walls and beacon towers at Jiayuguan, leaving Yumen beyond the pale. For nearly two centuries the oasis was pasture disputed between Mongol and oasis powers, until the Qing wars against the Dzungars brought the soldiers back. A Chijin garrison was restored in 1718 and made a military colony under the Yongzheng Emperor, and in 1759, after the conquest of Xinjiang, it was merged into the newly founded county of Yumen.
zh:
玉门在嘉峪关外，疏勒河滋养着这片绿洲，是丝绸之路走出河西走廊、踏上去哈密的戈壁路前的第一段牧场。其名得自更西边、敦煌附近的汉代玉门关；唐代玉门县治在赤斤镇，此后历经吐蕃、西夏统治，绿洲上的居民渐渐以牧人为多。永乐二年（1404年），元朝故丞相苦术之子塔力尼率部归明，明朝在今玉门市西北的赤斤站设赤斤蒙古千户所，永乐八年（1410年）升为赤斤卫。1444年时，赤斤骑兵作为关西羁縻卫所的牧人受明朝封号，牧养马匹，护送哈密方向的商队和贡使出入嘉峪关，而瓦剌正在草原西边崛起。

正德年间（1506—1521年），吐鲁番满速儿的军队攻灭哈密、击破赤斤卫，部众内迁肃州南山；嘉靖十八年（1539年）明朝在关城关南、关北修筑两翼长城和烽火台，将关门紧锁，玉门遂弃于边外。此后近两百年，绿洲成为蒙古诸部与绿洲势力往还争夺的牧场。直到清朝与准噶尔的战争把军队带回这里：康熙五十七年（1718年）复设赤金卫，雍正年间改为赤金所，乾隆二十四年（1759年）平定新疆后并入新设的玉门县。

en:
Zhangye is the midpoint oasis of the Hexi Corridor, watered by the Hei River beneath the Qilian snows. The Han opened Zhangye Commandery here in 111 BC, 'to extend the empire's arm into the Western Regions', and caravans made it a Silk Road hub; the Western Xia built the Dafo Temple in 1098, its hall housing a colossal reclining Buddha, and Marco Polo claimed to have spent a year in the city. In 1411 the Yongle Emperor conferred on the temple the name Baojue Temple. Under the Ming, Ganzhou became the seat of the Shaanxi Regional Military Commission and of the Gansu Garrison, westernmost of the nine border commands. In 1444 it was above all a fortress city: military colonists farmed the oasis, while its markets saw horses and livestock from the Qilian pastures and Hami exchanged for Chinese tea and cloth.

In the winter of 1643 the rebel general He Jin, campaigning for Li Zicheng, overran Lanzhou and the Hexi cities, and at Ganzhou the defending governor Lin Rirui was killed. Qing rule was barely established when, in 1648, the Muslim officers Milayin and Ding Guodong, men of the former Ming garrison, rose at Ganzhou and swept the corridor until imperial troops broke them, Milayin falling in 1648 and Ding in 1649. The Kangxi Emperor renamed the great temple Hongren Temple in 1678. In 1724 the Yongzheng government turned the old military guards into Ganzhou Prefecture, with the new Zhangye County as its seat; in this civil form the city passed the rest of the era as a grain and posting centre on the road to the far west.
zh:
张掖古称甘州，是河西走廊中段、祁连雪山下黑河滋养的绿洲。公元前111年西汉在此置张掖郡，取「张国臂掖，以通西域」之意，商队使它成为丝路重镇；西夏1098年建起大佛寺，殿中安放着巨大的卧佛，马可·波罗也曾自称在甘州住了一年。1411年明成祖赐寺名「宝觉寺」。明代甘州是陕西行都司和甘肃镇的治所，而甘肃镇是九边最西的一镇。1444年的甘州首先是一座军城：卫所军户在绿洲上屯田，市上则以中原的茶叶、布匹交换来自祁连山牧场和哈密的马匹牲畜。

1643年冬，李自成麾下将领贺锦连克兰州与河西诸城，固守甘州的甘肃巡抚林日瑞被杀。清朝统治方定，1648年原明军降清的回族军官米喇印、丁国栋在甘州起兵反清，一度席卷河西；清军随即反攻，米喇印1648年败死，丁国栋于1649年被杀。1678年康熙帝赐改大佛寺为宏仁寺。1724年雍正朝将旧日军卫改为甘州府，并置张掖县为府治；改为民政建制后的张掖在此后年代里，一直是通往西域大道上的粮仓与驿传中心。

en:
The Alxa plateau fills the arid country west of the Yellow River's great northern bend, the Helan Mountains rising along its eastern edge and the Tengger desert spreading across its centre. Han settlers opened military farms here after 102 BC, and Western Xia garrisons guarded the Helan passes, but the soil answered better to flocks than to the plough, and for most centuries the plateau belonged to nomads; its only real town was the Tangut black city of Khara-Khoto, far out on the Ejin river. Ming columns swept through the marches in 1372 and then fell back behind the Great Wall, leaving the wells and pastures to the Mongols. In 1444 Alxa is Oirat country, grazing land of the confederation the taishi Esen is drawing together beyond the Ming frontier.

Esen's wars reached their height in 1449, when his horsemen captured the Ming emperor in person, and afterwards the Oirats drifted west, leaving Alxa a thinly peopled borderland between the wall and the road to Hami. New masters came in the 1670s, when the Khoshut prince Khoroli, hard pressed by Galdan's Dzungars, led his people in from the west and submitted to the Qing. In 1697 the Kangxi emperor enrolled his followers as the Alxa Banner, granting them pastures west of the Yellow River beyond Ningxia, and under the Yongzheng emperor a walled garrison town was laid out at Dingyuanying, later the seat of the Alxa princes. Together with the Torghut banner on the Ejin river to the west, it formed the 'two banners west of the river'.
zh:
阿拉善高原占据黄河北套以西的干旱之地，东缘耸立着贺兰山，腹地铺展着腾格里沙漠。公元前102年后，汉朝屯田卒在此开垦，西夏也曾在贺兰山诸口戍兵，但这里的土地更宜牧群而非犁锄，多数世纪里高原属于游牧人，唯一像样的城镇是远在额济纳河畔的党项黑水城。1372年明军出塞横扫边外，随后退回长城之内，把水井和草场留给蒙古人。1444年的阿拉善是瓦剌牧地，属于太师也先在明朝边外聚拢的部落联盟。

也先的战乱在1449年达到顶点，瓦剌骑兵一度俘虏明英宗本人；此后瓦剌西迁，阿拉善仍是长城与哈密道之间人烟稀少的边地。1670年代，和硕特台吉和啰理为躲避噶尔丹的准噶尔兵锋，率部自西来投清朝。1697年，康熙帝将其部众编为阿拉善旗，赐牧黄河以西、宁夏边外；雍正年间又在定远营筑起驻军城，后来成为阿拉善扎萨克王公的府城。它与西边额济纳河畔的土尔扈特旗合称「套西二旗」。

en:
Hotan is the great oasis on the southern rim of the Taklamakan, watered by the Karakash and the Yurungkash, the Black Jade and White Jade rivers, as they leave the Kunlun Mountains. On the oldest branch of the Silk Road, its caravans carried Chinese silk westward and the river jade that gave the streams their names eastward into China; its carpets and atlas silk were prized across Central Asia. It was once the fervently Buddhist kingdom of Khotan, whose Saka-speaking rulers hosted some four hundred monasteries, until the Kara-Khanid Turks under Yusuf Qadir Khan stormed the city around 1006 and made it Muslim. Marco Polo, visiting under Mongol rule, found a peaceful people living by cotton, orchards and trade. In 1444 the oasis was held by the Dughlat emirs, Mongol nobles long settled in the Tarim cities, under the loose overlordship of Moghulistan.

In 1514 Sultan Said Khan drove out the Dughlat ruler Mirza Abu Bakr and made Hotan one of the chief cities of the new Yarkand Khanate, which held the Tarim Basin for nearly two centuries under its Chinggisid khans and the rival White Mountain and Black Mountain khojas. In 1680 the Dzungars of Galdan conquered the khanate and ruled the oasis through puppet khans and the Sufi orders. Qing armies broke the Dzungar empire in 1755, and in 1759, after crushing the revolt of the Khoja brothers, they stationed an imperial resident at Hotan under Yarkand; the white jade of its riverbeds then travelled as tribute to Beijing.
zh:
和阗是塔克拉玛干沙漠南缘的大绿洲，喀拉喀什河与玉龙喀什河——即墨玉河与白玉河——出昆仑山北麓流贯此地。它在丝绸之路最古老的南道上：西去的商队运着中国丝绸，东行的货物则是两条河得名的和田玉，和阗地毯与艾德莱斯绸也风行整个中亚。这里曾是虔信佛教的于阗王国，说塞语的国王供养着约四百座寺院，直到1006年前后喀喇汗突厥的优素福·卡迪尔汗攻陷此城，将其伊斯兰化。蒙古统治时期马可·波罗路过，看到居民以棉花、果园和贸易为生，并不好战。1444年的和阗由早已定居塔里木诸城的蒙古朵豁剌惕异密统治，名义上臣属于蒙兀儿斯坦。

1514年，苏丹萨亦德汗赶走朵豁剌惕统治者米儿咱·阿巴·癿乞儿，和阗成为新生的叶尔羌汗国的主要城市之一。此后近两百年间，塔里木盆地处在成吉思汗后裔的汗与白山派、黑山派和卓的明争暗斗之下。1680年，噶尔丹的准噶尔人攻灭叶尔羌汗国，先后以傀儡汗和苏菲教团统辖这片绿洲。1755年清军击溃准噶尔汗国，1759年平定大小和卓之乱后，在和阗设置办事大臣，受叶尔羌办事大臣节制，河中的白玉从此作为贡玉源源送往北京。

en:
Qarqan, the ancient Qiemo, is an oasis on the southern rim of the Taklamakan, where the Cherchen River carries Kunlun meltwater into the desert. The Han knew a small kingdom here of 230 households, 1,610 people and 320 bearing arms, on the Jade Road that carried Khotan jade towards Dunhuang. Around 399 the pilgrim Faxian found more than 4,000 Buddhist monks in the country, all of the Hinayana school. In 442 King Bilong of Shanshan fled here with half his people before the army of Juqu Anzhou, and in 609 the Sui made the town a commandery after defeating the Tuyuhun. Xuanzang passed in 644 and saw only an empty fortress; Marco Polo in the 1270s found Muslim villagers. In 1444 the oasis lay within the domains of the Moghul khan, a quiet stage on the southern caravan route.

In 1514 Sultan Said Khan made the southern oases part of his new Yarkand Khanate, and Qarqan shared the fortunes of Kashgaria, where the Black Mountain and White Mountain factions of the khojas feuded through the seventeenth century. In 1680 the Dzungar khan Galdan took Yarkand and reduced the khanate to a client state; direct Dzungar rule followed around 1700. Qing armies campaigning against the Khoja brothers reached Yarkand and Hotan in 1758 and 1759, and Qarqan passed with the rest of the southern route into the Qing Empire, a remote pastoral oasis at the edge of the new dominion.
zh:
且末（维吾尔语称恰尔羌）是塔克拉玛干沙漠南缘的绿洲，车尔臣河引昆仑山雪水在沙漠边缘滋养出田畴。《汉书》记此为且末国，有二百三十户、一千六百一十口、胜兵三百二十人，坐落在把和阗美玉输往敦煌的玉石之路上。399年前后，西行求法的法显到此，见国中有僧四千余人，俱奉小乘。442年，沮渠安周来攻，鄯善王比龙带着半数国人投奔且末；609年隋朝击破吐谷浑，于此设置且末郡。644年玄奘路过时只剩一座空城，有城垣而无人烟；13世纪70年代马可·波罗经过，居民已是穆斯林。1444年，这片绿洲在蒙兀儿汗的疆域之内，是丝路南道上安静的一站。

1514年，萨亦德汗建立叶尔羌汗国，且末随南路诸绿洲归入汗国，此后和卓黑山派与白山派的争斗贯穿了整个17世纪。1680年，准噶尔汗噶尔丹攻占叶尔羌，汗国沦为附庸，约1700年策妄阿拉布坦时期准噶尔直接统治天山南路。1758至1759年，清军征讨大小和卓，兵抵叶尔羌、和阗，且末随天山南路并入清朝版图，成为新帝国边缘一处偏远的畜牧绿洲。

en:
Aksu is the oasis watered by the Aksu River on the northern edge of the Tarim Basin, where the northern Silk Road met the dangerous Muzart route across the Tian Shan to the Ili valley. Earlier known as Gumo or Baluka, it was already trading fine cotton and hemp cloth to neighbouring oases when Xuanzang passed through in 629. After the Chagatai realms split, it became a Muslim Moghul territory. In 1444 the Sunni Turki cultivators and merchants of this cotton oasis lived under Esen Buqa II, who had made Aksu his base while restoring the loyalty of his amirs after years of aristocratic disorder.

In 1514 Sultan Said Khan overthrew Dughlat rule in the western Tarim and founded the Yarkand Khanate, with Aksu among its chief cities. As khanal authority weakened after the late sixteenth century, Aksu became a centre of a regional subkhanate while the Naqshbandi khojas overshadowed the Chagatayid princes. Their White Mountain and Black Mountain factions fought from Kashgar and Yarkand, drawing in Kyrgyz tribes and the Dzungars. Galdan's Dzungar army invaded in 1680 and set up puppet khans; around 1700 Tsewang Rabtan ended the old Chagatayid line and brought Aksu firmly under Dzungar overlordship. Qing armies defeated the Dzungars in 1757 and posted an imperial agent at Aksu in 1758, beginning the oasis's integration into the Qing frontier administration before 1821.
zh:
阿克苏是塔里木盆地北缘、阿克苏河滋养的绿洲；塔里木盆地北侧的丝绸之路，与经天山木扎尔特险路通往伊犁河谷的道路在此相接。此地古称姑墨、跋禄迦，629年玄奘经过时，已向邻近绿洲贩运精细的棉布和麻布。察合台诸汗国分裂后，阿克苏成为穆斯林蒙兀儿人的领地。1444年，这片逊尼派棉花绿洲上的突厥语农耕者与商人臣属也先不花二世；他在贵族长期纷争后移驻阿克苏，并以此为基地重新争取诸异密的忠诚。

1514年，萨亦德汗推翻杜格拉特部在塔里木盆地西部的统治，建立叶尔羌汗国，阿克苏是其主要城市之一。16世纪末以后汗权衰落，阿克苏成为地方小汗廷的中心之一，纳格什班迪派和卓的权势则逐渐压过察合台王公。白山派与黑山派分别以喀什噶尔和叶尔羌为据点长期争斗，又把吉尔吉斯诸部和准噶尔人卷入其中。1680年噶尔丹的准噶尔军队入侵，扶立傀儡汗；约1700年，策妄阿拉布坦终结旧察合台汗统，阿克苏也牢固置于准噶尔宗主权下。1757年清军击败准噶尔，1758年向阿克苏派驻办事大臣，这片绿洲由此在1821年前逐步纳入清朝边疆行政体系。

en:
Beshbalik, the 'five cities' of Old Turkic and the Beiting of Chinese records, stood on an oasis below the eastern Tianshan, its ruins now near Jimsar. It was the seat of the Tang protectorate at Beiting and later a capital of the Uyghur Kingdom of Qocho. Mongol rulers kept administrative offices and military colonies there, but wars between the Yuan and Chagatai princes broke its caravan prosperity in the late thirteenth century, and renewed fighting in the early fifteenth century left the walls derelict. In 1444 the old site lay within the Muslim Moghul realm of Esen Buqa, who had ruled since 1428; Ming records still used Beshbalik as the name of the Chagatayid polity, though no great city anchored the tract.

Esen Buqa used the northern Tianshan pastures as a base for raids on the Timurids, and after his death in 1462 Moghul allegiance divided between the courts of Turfan and Yarkand. In 1570 Yarkand captured the Turfan khan and brought the old Beshbalik-Turfan line under its rule. Galdan's Dzungars conquered the Moghul oases in 1678 and held the region until Qing armies took Dzungaria in 1755–1758. The Qing posted an inspector at Jimsar in 1759, settled 775 Green Standard soldiers on military farms there in 1767, and built Kai'an Cheng in 1772 after finding the Beiting ruins beyond repair; a county assistant was added in 1776.
zh:
别失八里在古突厥语中意为「五城」，汉籍称北庭，故城在如今天山以东的吉木萨尔绿洲。唐代在此设北庭都护府，后来它又成为高昌回鹘的都城之一。蒙古统治者曾在这里设治、屯田，但13世纪后期元朝与察合台宗王长期交战，商路繁荣遭到破坏；15世纪初战火再起，城垣最终荒废。1444年，故城处在自1428年在位的歪思之孙也先不花所领的伊斯兰化蒙兀儿势力范围内；明代史籍仍以别失八里称呼这支察合台政权，但这片地方已没有大城作为中枢。

也先不花以天山北麓牧场为基地袭扰帖木儿王朝，1462年他死后，蒙兀儿诸部逐渐分属吐鲁番和叶尔羌两庭。1570年，叶尔羌汗国俘获吐鲁番汗，别失八里—吐鲁番一系的汗统并入叶尔羌。1678年，噶尔丹的准噶尔军征服蒙兀儿绿洲，控制此地，直到1755—1758年清军攻取准噶尔。1759年，清朝在济木萨设巡检；1767年派绿营兵七百七十五人在此屯田；1772年，因北庭故城毁坏难修，清军另筑恺安城；1776年又裁巡检、设县丞管理民政。

en:
Hoboksar's grazing grounds stretch between the Hobok River and the long ridge of the Saur Mountains. Earlier Turkic and Mongol powers had used the same grasslands, and by the fifteenth century they were herd land of the Oirats. In 1444, after Toghon's death in 1438, his son Esen Taishi directed the Oirat confederation as its real master; Hoboksar supplied livestock and seasonal camps rather than a fixed trading town.

As Oirat power re-formed in northern Xinjiang, Erdeni Batur unified the tribes in 1636 and made Hoboksar his base. Between 1639 and 1643 he built a castle five kilometres southeast of Hoboksar, one of the fixed centres around which the Dzungar state grew. Dzungar rule ended in the Qing wars of 1755-1758, and in 1758 the pastures were placed under the Tarbagatai military administration. In 1771 Old Torghut Mongols returning from the Volga were settled here under their own banners, giving Hoboksar the Mongol pastoral character it retained through the later imperial period.
zh:
和布克赛尔的牧场展开在和布克河与绵长的赛尔山之间。更早的突厥、蒙古势力都曾利用这片草地，到15世纪这里已成为瓦剌人的游牧地。1444年，脱欢已于1438年去世，其子也先太师以实际宗主的身份统领瓦剌联盟；和布克赛尔此时提供的是牲畜和随季节迁徙的营地，而不是一座固定商镇。

卫拉特势力在新疆北部重新整合时，巴图尔珲台吉于1636年统一各部，以霍博克赛里为大本营。1639年至1643年，他在和布克赛尔东南五公里处修建城堡，使这里成为准噶尔政权兴起时的固定中心之一。1755年至1758年的清准战争结束了准噶尔统治，1758年这片牧场被划归塔尔巴哈台参赞大臣管辖。1771年，从伏尔加河流域东归的旧土尔扈特部被安置于此，编入自己的盟旗，也使和布克赛尔在帝国后期保持了蒙古牧地的面貌。

en:
Urumqi occupies a well-watered gap at the northern foot of the Tianshan, where tracks cross from the Dzungarian Basin toward the Turpan Depression. The Tang established Luntai there in 648, garrisoned the route and taxed caravans on the northern Silk Road. After the Tang withdrawal the country passed to the Uyghurs of Qocho, but the old settlement never recovered; between Tang and Qing times there is little evidence of a permanent city on the site. Under Mongol rule the surrounding land was counted as part of Beshbalik and used chiefly as pasture. In 1444 it lay on the eastern edge of Esen Buqa's Moghulistan, a caravan crossing and grazing ground rather than a walled oasis capital.

During the 1620s and 1630s Khoshut Mongols grazing around Urumqi moved toward Qinghai and Tibet amid the wars that made the Dzungars masters of Dzungaria. Qing forces took the area in 1755 and built the first earthen fort in 1758. State farms, banner garrisons and Chinese and Hui settlers followed after 1759, turning the watered grassland into grain country and a market. In 1763 the enlarged fort was named Dihua by the Qianlong Emperor, and in 1772 Gongning Cheng was built beside it for the Manchu garrison. The adjoining towns formed a paired settlement: Gongning Cheng held the administration while Dihua became the commercial town, securing Urumqi's place on the Qing frontier.
zh:
乌鲁木齐位于天山北麓水草交汇处，控扼准噶尔盆地通往吐鲁番洼地的山口。648年，唐朝在此设轮台城，驻军守护天山北麓的丝绸之路，并向商队征税。唐朝势力退出西域后，这一带归入高昌回鹘，旧城却未能恢复；唐代至清代之间，今乌鲁木齐一带长期没有固定大城。蒙古统治时期，周围土地被视作别失八里的一部分，主要用作牧场。1444年，它位于也先不花的蒙兀儿势力东缘，是商队通道和游牧地，而不是一座有城墙的绿洲都城。

1620至1630年代，在准噶尔部争夺准噶尔盆地的战争中，游牧于乌鲁木齐周围的和硕特蒙古人陆续迁往青海和西藏。1755年清军攻取此地，1758年筑起第一座土城。1759年后，旗营、屯田以及汉民和回族移民相继到来，水草牧场逐渐变成产粮地和市集。1763年，扩展后的城池被乾隆帝命名为迪化；1772年，城旁又建巩宁城驻扎满营。两城相邻，巩宁城掌军政，迪化兴商业，奠定了乌鲁木齐在清朝西北边疆的地位。

en:
Tannu Uriankhai occupies the forested basin between the Sayan Mountains and the Tannu-Ola, around the headwaters of the Yenisei. The Mongol name Uriankhai meant the 'people living in the woods,' and its Tuvan camps combined fur hunting, fishing and pastoralism with reindeer. After the Yuan withdrawal from Mongolia, the Oirats, the western Mongols, drew the basin into their confederation. In 1444 it therefore formed a cold, fur-bearing frontier of Oirat power, where local headmen answered to Mongol lords through tribute and service.

For the next two centuries the country was pulled between Oirats, eastern Mongols and the Khotogoit Altan khans, and later came under Dzungar rule. Many Tuvans joined Amursana's anti-Qing rising in 1755 and the Khotogoit prince Chingünjav's revolt of 1756 to 1757. After the Dzungar collapse in 1758, Qing authorities placed the land under the Uliastai military governor and organized its people into five banners and subordinate sumu companies, taking furs and livestock through local Tuvan and Mongol nobles. That banner order still defined Tannu Uriankhai in 1821.
zh:
唐努乌梁海位于萨彦岭与唐努乌拉山之间的森林盆地，叶尼塞河上游诸水在此汇合。蒙古语称这里的图瓦语居民为乌梁海，意为「林中百姓」；各部以猎取毛皮、捕鱼和放牧为生，也使用驯鹿。元朝势力退出蒙古后，瓦剌（西蒙古）把这一盆地纳入自己的联盟。1444年，它因此是瓦剌势力北缘寒冷而盛产毛皮的边地，各部首领以贡赋和差役听命于蒙古领主。

此后两个世纪，瓦剌、东蒙古与和托辉特阿拉坦汗诸势力反复争夺此地，它后来又归入准噶尔统治。1755年，许多图瓦人支持阿睦尔撒纳反清；1756年至1757年，他们又参加和托辉特王公青衮杂卜起义。1758年准噶尔败亡后，清廷将该地划归乌里雅苏台定边左副将军管辖，编为五旗及若干佐领，通过当地图瓦与蒙古贵族征收毛皮和牲畜。到1821年，这套旗佐秩序仍是唐努乌梁海的基本格局。

en:
The Kherlen rises in the Khentii mountains and winds 1,254 kilometres east across the steppe to Hulun Lake. At its confluence with the Tsenker stood Avarga, the first camp-capital of the Mongol empire: Temüjin seized it from the Jurkin clan, kept his ordus and stores there, and under Kublai it became a shrine to Genghis Khan. On 23 September 1409 a Ming army under Qiu Fu, drawn north of the river by a feigned retreat, was destroyed west of the Onon, and the Yongle Emperor led his own army across these pastures in 1410. In 1444 the Kherlen grasslands were held by the eastern Mongols of the Great Khan Toghtoa Bukha, while real power lay with his Oirat taishi Esen.

After Esen's death in 1455 the Mongols fell back into factional strife until Batumöngke, enthroned as Dayan Khan in 1480, reunited the tribes and gave the Khalkha tümen to his son Gersenji, whose descendants ruled these valleys as the Tüsheet and Setsen khans. In 1688 Galdan's Dzungars overran Khalkha, and after his check at Ulan Butung the khan camped on the upper Kherlen for six years. On 7 June 1696 the Kangxi Emperor reached the river to find Galdan already fled; five days later the Dzungar army was destroyed at Jao Modo, and the Kherlen pastures passed under the Qing banner system.
zh:
克鲁伦河发源于肯特山，向东蜿蜒1254公里，横贯草原注入呼伦湖。克鲁伦河与僧库尔河汇流处的曲雕阿兰，是蒙古帝国最初的游牧都城，即成吉思汗的大斡耳朵：铁木真从主儿乞部手中夺得此地，在此囤积物资，忽必烈时又成为祭祀成吉思汗的祠庙。1409年9月23日，丘福率领的明军在河畔被佯败之计引向北岸，最终在鄂嫩河以西全军覆没；1410年明成祖亲率大军穿过这片草原北征。1444年，克鲁伦草原属于大汗脱脱不花治下的东蒙古，真正掌权的却是他的瓦剌太师也先。

1455年也先死后，蒙古再度陷入纷争，直到1480年巴图蒙克即达延汗位，重新统一诸部，把喀尔喀万户封给儿子格哷森札，其后人以土谢图汗、车臣汗之名游牧于这些河谷。1688年，噶尔丹率准噶尔军攻入喀尔喀，在乌兰布通受挫后，他在克鲁伦河上游驻扎了六年。1696年6月7日，康熙帝进抵河畔，噶尔丹已先行西逃；五天后准噶尔军在昭莫多被歼，克鲁伦草原就此归入清朝的盟旗体制。

en:
Kobdo is the high country between the Govi-Altai ranges and the basin of the Khovd River, whose snowmelt waters run from Tavan Bogd toward Khar-Us Nuur. Its valleys and semi-desert pastures were Oirat country, where horses, sheep and camels moved between seasonal grazing grounds and the western Mongols followed the Tengri cult. In 1444 the Oirat confederation was led by Esen Taishi, who had united the Mongol tribes under a puppet Chinggisid khan, making these pastures part of a powerful western Mongol polity rather than a quiet borderland.

Esen's power did not long survive his capture of the Zhengtong Emperor at Tumu in 1449; after he claimed the khan's title he was killed in 1455, and the Oirats gradually lost ground to the Khalkha. The Choros restored western Mongol power in the seventeenth century, and Galdan became Boshogtu Khan in 1678 at the head of the Dzungar Khanate. The long Dzungar-Qing struggle then settled Kobdo's fate. Qing forces built a fortified town on the Khovd River in 1730, and after the Dzungar collapse of 1755-1758 a Kobdo councilor took up his post in 1761. Flooding ended the old riverside settlement, and a new walled town on the Buyant River was built in 1767, anchoring Qing garrisons, tribal banners and caravan trade beneath the Altai.
zh:
科布多是戈壁阿尔泰山与科布多河流域之间的高地，科布多河汇集塔万博格多的雪水，流向哈尔乌苏湖。河谷和半荒漠草原是瓦剌人的牧场，马、羊、骆驼随季节转场，西蒙古人在此信奉腾格里。1444年，瓦剌联盟由也先太师统领，他以成吉思汗后裔为傀儡汗，统一蒙古诸部，使这些牧场成为强大西蒙古政权的一部分，而不是偏僻边地。

也先的权势未能持久：1449年他在土木之变中俘虏明英宗，随后自称汗号，1455年被杀，瓦剌此后在喀尔喀进逼下逐渐失势。17世纪，绰罗斯部重建西蒙古势力，1678年噶尔丹成为准噶尔汗国的博硕克图汗。准噶尔与清朝的长期战争随后决定了科布多的命运。清军1730年在科布多河畔筑城；1755—1758年准噶尔败亡后，清朝1761年设置科布多参赞大臣。旧城后因洪水废弃，1767年在布彦特河畔另建新城，驻扎军队、统辖盟旗，并维系阿尔泰山下的商队贸易。

en:
The Chigestai and Bogdiin rivers meet in a mountain-girt valley west of the Khangai, high grazing country whose Mongol name Uliastai means a place with poplars. There was no permanent garrison town here in 1444; the Zavkhan basin was Oirat pastureland, its sheep, horses and camel trains controlled by the confederation built by Toghon and held in practice by his son Esen. Khalkha herders lived under that western Mongol power, and the wool and livestock of the high valleys moved with seasonal camps rather than through a fixed city.

After Esen's fall Oirat power fragmented, and during the sixteenth century Khalkha lords displaced it from much of the Khangai. The Sain Noyon line grew from Tümengken, a patron of the Gelug school, but its decisive organization came through the Qing. Galdan's invasion of 1688 drove the Khalkha into Qing allegiance; the Sain Noyon banners returned to their pastures after the Dzungar defeat of 1696. In 1725 the Qing detached Khalkha banners to form Sain Noyon aimag, and in 1733 they built the Uliastai garrison for Tsereng's campaigns. In 1755 an army sent from here joined the final Qing advance against the Dzungars. The post then became the seat of the Uliastai General, overseeing Sain Noyon and Zasagt affairs while camel caravans linked the fortress to Urga, Khovd and Xinjiang.
zh:
奇盖斯泰河与博格丁河在杭爱山西侧群山环抱的河谷相会，这里是高寒牧场；蒙古语地名乌里雅苏台意为「有杨树的地方」。1444年时尚无清代军城，扎布汗河流域是瓦剌牧地。脱懽整合的卫拉特联盟已由其子也先实际掌握，马群、羊群和骆驼队随季节营地迁徙，喀尔喀牧民则在这一西蒙古势力之下生活。

也先败亡后，瓦剌势力分裂，16世纪间喀尔喀贵族逐渐接管杭爱山一带的大片牧场。赛音诺颜一支出自护持格鲁派的图蒙肯，但其制度化主要在清朝完成。1688年噶尔丹入侵，喀尔喀投附清朝；1696年准噶尔战败后，赛音诺颜各旗于次年返回旧牧地。1725年，清朝析置喀尔喀旗分，设立赛音诺颜部；1733年又在乌里雅苏台筑军城，作为策棱对准噶尔作战的驻地。1755年，一支清军由此出发，参加对准噶尔汗国的最后进军。此后这里成为乌里雅苏台将军驻地，统辖赛音诺颜部、札萨克图汗部等军政事务，驼商道路也把军城与库伦、科布多和新疆连接起来。

en:
The eastern Gobi is a waste of gravel plains and dry watercourses without a river, where herders live on wells and groundwater through sandstorms and winter blizzards. These pastures were the southern flank of the Eastern Mongols: families moved camp with sheep, horses and Bactrian camels, and the Borjigin taijis of the nascent Khalkha grazed the desert edge. In 1444 the herders still worshipped Tengri, and the walled towns and garrisons of the Ming lay far beyond the sands to the south.

Dayan Khan made the Khalkha one of the three left-wing tümen, and his son Gersenje held the seven northern otogs; his descendants ruled as the Tüsheet, Zasagt and Setsen khans. From the later sixteenth century, as Altan Khan of the Tümed championed the Gelug order, Tibetan Buddhism spread among the Khalkha. In 1688 Galdan's Dzungars overran the country and the khans fled south across the desert, and at Duolun in 1691 they declared allegiance to the Kangxi Emperor, whose armies destroyed Galdan at Jao Modo in 1696. Under Qing banner rule the wells of Dzamiin Üüde, the 'road's gate', served the caravan crossing south, and in 1820 the poet-monk Danzanravjaa founded the Red Hat Khamar Monastery near Sainshand, a Gobi centre of learning with its own theatre.
zh:
东戈壁是一片布满砾石滩和干涸河道的荒漠，全境没有河流，牧人靠井水和地下水熬过沙暴与冬雪。这里的牧场是东蒙古人的南翼：牧民赶着羊、马和双峰驼逐井而居，初兴的喀尔喀部孛儿只斤台吉们在沙漠边缘游牧。1444年时，这里的牧人仍信奉腾格里，南方沙海之外很远才是明朝筑城驻军的边镇。

达延汗将喀尔喀编为左翼三个万户之一，其子格哷森札领有北部七鄂托克，后裔分衍出土谢图汗、札萨克图汗和车臣汗三汗。16世纪后期，土默特的俺答汗护持格鲁派，藏传佛教随之传入喀尔喀。1688年噶尔丹的准噶尔军攻陷喀尔喀，三汗越过戈壁南逃，1691年在多伦向康熙帝称臣；康熙的大军穿漠北上，1696年在昭莫多歼灭噶尔丹主力。清朝旗制之下，意为「道路之门」的扎门乌德诸井成为南行商队穿漠的门户；1820年，诗僧丹津拉布贾在赛音山达附近创建红教哈玛尔寺，成为戈壁上的学术与戏剧中心。

en:
The Setsen lands are the grasslands of the lower Kherlen, at the far eastern end of the Khalkha steppe: broad pastures watered by the Kherlen and its tributaries, where herdsmen grazed horses, cattle and sheep. The Onon–Kherlen country had been the Mongols' homeland since the age of Genghis Khan, whose first camp at Avarga stood on this river. In 1444 the clans here pastured their stock under the Chinggisid khan Taisun, while real power among the eastern Mongols rested with his Oirat taishi Esen, and the old unity of the steppe was already slipping.

In the sixteenth century the northern Khalkha spread into these pastures, and early in the next century Sholoi, a descendant of Dayan Khan's son Gersenji, took the title Gegeen Setsen Khan, after which the country was called the Setsen Khan's aimag. Sholoi sent tribute to Hong Taiji in 1635, and from 1638 his house rendered the annual 'nine whites' – eight white horses and one white camel – to the Manchu court. When Galdan's Dzungars overran the Khalkha lands in 1688 the young Setsen Khan Ömkhei led more than a hundred thousand households south across the Gobi and submitted to the Kangxi Emperor. At the Dolonnur assembly of 1691 the Khalkha entered the Qing order, and the Setsen pastures were organised as the Khalkha Left Route, twelve banners at first and twenty-three by 1755. The triennial assembly of the khanate's lords gathered at Kherlen Bars on the Kherlen, and after Galdan's fall the herdsmen returned to their river in 1697.
zh:
车臣汗的牧地在克鲁伦河下游，地处喀尔喀草原最东端：克鲁伦河及其支流滋养着辽阔的牧场，牧民在此放牧马、牛、羊。鄂嫩河与克鲁伦河流域自成吉思汗时代起便是蒙古人的故土，他早年的大营就设在这条河畔。1444年，此地的部众在成吉思汗后裔岱总汗治下游牧，而东蒙古的实权掌握在卫拉特太师也先手中，草原旧日的统一已然松动。

16世纪，外喀尔喀诸部进入这片牧场；17世纪初，达延汗之子格哷森札的后裔硕垒称格根车臣汗，这片土地遂称车臣汗部。1635年硕垒遣使向皇太极朝贡，1638年起其家族每年向清廷进献「九白」——八匹白马加一匹白驼。1688年噶尔丹的准噶尔军攻入喀尔喀，年幼的车臣汗乌默客率十万余户南下越过戈壁，归附康熙皇帝。1691年多伦诺尔会盟后，喀尔喀纳入清朝秩序，车臣汗部编为喀尔喀东路，初设十二旗，到1755年已增至二十三旗。诸汗三年一次的会盟在克鲁伦河畔的巴尔斯城举行；噶尔丹败亡后，牧民于1697年重返克鲁伦河牧场。

en:
The Jirem steppe runs from the Nen and Tao'er rivers south toward the Western Liao, a web of streams fattening the herds of the Nen Khorchin, who count themselves descendants of Genghis Khan's brother Khasar. The Ming enrolled their forebears as the Fuyu Guard, one of the Three Uriankhai Guards set up in 1389. After their khan Adai was killed by the Oirats in 1438 the tribe fled southward, and in 1444 it grazed along the Nen and Onon without a strong lord, its horse-trade ties to the Ming its surest anchor.

The Khorchin rode with Dayan Khan when the Uriankhai were broken at the battle of Dalan Terqin in 1510. Early in the Jiajing reign their chief Kuimuk Tasikhar led the left wing from the Onon and Argun to the Nen, absorbing the Jalaid, Dorbod and Gorlos and forging the Nen Khorchin. In 1624 Oba submitted to Nurhaci, the first Mongol chief to join the Later Jin, and Khorchin brides became the mothers of Qing emperors: Bumbutai (1613–1688), daughter of a Khorchin beile, married Hong Taiji and as Empress Dowager Xiaozhuang guided the Shunzhi and Kangxi courts. From 1636 the Qing divided the four tribes into ten banners, and in the Kangxi reign their chiefs assembled at Jirem Mountain in the Khorchin Right Wing Middle Banner, which gave the league its name.
zh:
哲里木草原北起嫩江、洮儿河，南抵西辽河，河网纵横，水草丰美，是嫩科尔沁人的牧场。他们自认是成吉思汗之弟拙赤合撒儿的后裔，明初被编为1389年设立的兀良哈三卫之一的福余卫。1438年，其可汗阿台被瓦剌所杀，部众被迫南逃；1444年前后，他们游牧于嫩江与鄂嫩河之间，没有强主，与明朝的马匹互市是最稳的依靠。

1510年，科尔沁随达延汗在达兰特哩衮之战中击破兀良哈。明嘉靖初年，首领奎蒙克塔斯哈喇率左翼从鄂嫩河、额尔古纳河一带迁至嫩江流域，收服扎赉特、杜尔伯特、郭尔罗斯等部，形成嫩科尔沁。1624年，奥巴归附努尔哈赤，是最早投向后金的蒙古部落；科尔沁女子也成为清朝皇帝的母族：贝勒寨桑之女布木布泰（1613—1688年）嫁与皇太极，即孝庄文皇后，先后辅佐顺治、康熙两朝。崇德元年（1636年）起，清廷将四部编为十旗；康熙年间，各旗会盟于科尔沁右翼中旗境内的哲里木山，盟以山得名。

en:
Xilin Gol is the grassland basin of the Xilin River and other seasonal streams on the Mongolian Plateau. Kublai Khan built Shangdu, his summer capital, in what is now Plain Blue Banner, and the Yuan kept pastures and horse herds around it. After the Yuan collapse, the Ming turned Shangdu into the Kaiping garrison and then withdrew behind the Great Wall during the Yongle reign. Oirat Mongols subsequently occupied the pastures, so in 1444 this was open nomadic country on the road between the northern steppe and the Ming frontier, valued for horses, sheep and cattle rather than walled towns.

In the late fifteenth and early sixteenth centuries, Dayan Khan's reorganization placed these grazing lands among the left-wing Mongol tümen, and they later formed part of the Chakhar tribes. As the Qing brought Inner Mongolia under their rule, ten banners of the Ujumchin, Khaughit, Abaga, Abganar and Sonid were established between 1641 and 1667. The ten banners held a joint assembly at Khurkhaya in 1702; when the Qing restored such assemblies in 1728, they met on the northern bank of the Xilin River and the gathering became known as the Xilin Gol league. The five tribes and ten banners kept this order through the remaining eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries.
zh:
锡林郭勒是蒙古高原上锡林河等季节性河流滋养的草原盆地。忽必烈曾在今正蓝旗一带建立夏都上都，元朝在周边保有牧场和马群。元朝灭亡后，明朝将上都改为开平卫，永乐年间又撤入长城以内。这片草原随后一度为瓦剌所据，因此1444年时，这里是北方游牧势力与明朝边墙之间的开阔牧场，没有显赫城邑，价值在于马匹、牛羊和连通南北的牧道。

15世纪末至16世纪初，达延汗重整蒙古各部，这片牧地被纳入左翼三万户，后来归属察哈尔八部。清朝收服漠南蒙古后，在1641年至1667年间陆续设置乌珠穆沁、浩齐特、阿巴噶、阿巴哈纳尔和苏尼特五部十旗。1702年，十旗曾在呼尔哈哈雅会盟；1728年清廷恢复会盟，会址设在锡林河北岸，会盟遂得名锡林郭勒。五部十旗的格局一直延续到1821年以前。

en:
Hulunbuir takes its name from the two great lakes of its steppe, Hulun and Buir, where the Greater Khingan forests meet the grasslands in the far northeast of Inner Mongolia. It has long been Mongol pasture. In 1388 a Ming army ran the Northern Yuan court to earth at Buir Lake and destroyed it there, after which the steppe tribes fell back on their old feuds. In 1444 the camps of Mongol herdsmen moved with the seasons between the lakes and the Argun River, owning no master but their own chiefs.

In the early seventeenth century the rising Later Jin conquered the Hulunbuir tribes and enrolled them in the Eight Banners, and under the Kangxi emperor the country was placed under the new Heilongjiang military government. To hold the long Argun frontier, the Qing in 1734 raised a walled city on the left bank of the Yimin River, naming it Hulunbuir after the two lakes. A vice commander-in-chief governed the Solon and New Barga mounted banners and the Oolot garrison from its walls, and for the rest of the dynasty the grassland kept its cavalry in readiness for the Qing while its herds moved as they always had.
zh:
呼伦贝尔得名于草原上的两大湖泊呼伦湖与贝尔湖，地处内蒙古最东北，大兴安岭林海与草原相接于此，自古是蒙古人的牧场。1388年，明军在贝尔湖一带的捕鱼儿海击溃北元朝廷，元朝皇室彻底败亡，草原诸部重新陷入纷争。1444年，蒙古牧人的营地随季节在两湖与额尔古纳河之间迁徙，放牧畜群，只听命于各自的首领。

17世纪初，兴起的后金征服呼伦贝尔各部，将部众编入八旗；康熙年间设黑龙江将军，这一带归其管辖。为镇守额尔古纳河边防，1734年（雍正十二年），清廷在伊敏河左岸筑城，因地处呼伦、贝尔两湖之间而名呼伦贝尔城。呼伦贝尔副都统在此统辖索伦八旗、新巴尔虎八旗和厄鲁特旗，终清一代，草原骑兵随时听调出征，牧群则依旧沿着古老的路线转场。

en:
The middle Nen runs through flat, well-watered steppe, pasture that the Korchin Mongols shared with Daur herdsmen and Solon hunters moving between the forests of the Greater Khingan and the river meadows. The name Qiqihar is Daur for a borderland or natural pasture. Through most of the fifteenth century there was no town here, only seasonal camps at the place later called Bukui, where Mongols, Tungus and Jurchen bartered horses, cattle and sable. In 1444 the country belonged to the Korchin, eastern Mongols pasturing west of the Sungari, and no walled city yet stood on the Nen.

Qiqihar was built as a garrison of the Qing frontier. A post station was opened at Bukui in 1665, and in 1674, with Cossacks thrusting down the Amur, the court moved the Jilin river fleet here, stacking timber, barracks and arsenals along the Nen as a base for the Amur front. A water-borne brigade was established in 1683 and a firearms camp added the next year, when the Bukui Mosque was founded for the garrison's Muslims, seven years before the city itself. In 1691, during the wars against Galdan, a walled city was raised, and in 1699 the Heilongjiang General moved his yamen from Mergen, making Qiqihar the seat of the northernmost military government of the empire, and around 1700 a mart of the Russo-Chinese fur trade and a place of exile.
zh:
嫩江中游流经平坦湿润的草原，科尔沁蒙古人在此游牧，达斡尔牧人和索伦猎手则在大兴安岭林地与江畔草甸之间往来。齐齐哈尔是达斡尔语，意为边地或天然牧场。整个15世纪这里没有城郭，只有后来称作卜奎之处的季节性营地，蒙古人、通古斯人和女真人在此以马匹、牲畜和紫貂相交易。1444年，这片土地属于游牧在松花江以西的东蒙古科尔沁部，嫩江上还没有一座城墙环绕的城镇。

齐齐哈尔是作为清朝的边塞军镇建起来的。1665年卜奎驿站设立；1674年面对哥萨克沿黑龙江深入，清廷把吉林水师移驻于此，嫩江畔木材堆积、营垒林立，成为黑龙江前线的后援基地。1683年定制设水师营，次年增设火器营，卜奎清真寺也在这年为营中的穆斯林建起，比齐齐哈尔建城还早七年。1691年，正当与噶尔丹交战之际，齐齐哈尔城版筑而起；1699年黑龙江将军衙门从墨尔根城迁来，齐齐哈尔从此成为大清最北军府的治所，并在1700年前后成为中俄毛皮贸易的商埠和发遣流人之地。

en:
Shenyang sits on the north bank of the Hun River, the Shen Shui that gave the city its name, where the Liaodong hills meet the Liao plain. The Liao and Jin kept a garrison city here as Shen Prefecture, and under the Yuan it became the Shenyang Circuit, the first use of the name Shenyang. In 1386 the Ming replaced the circuit with the Shenyang Central Guard, under the Liaodong Regional Military Commission; when Min Zhong took command in 1388 he had the old Yuan earthen ramparts faced with brick and stone, four gates set over the cross streets and twin moats drawn from the Hun.
