1454年普鲁士联盟举事：卡齐米日四世于3月6日颁诏将海乌姆诺地并入波兰王国，托伦市民则把骑士团城堡拆得几近一砖不剩。十三年战争以1466年10月19日在此签订的《第二次托伦和约》告终，此地成为波兰王治下的皇家普鲁士。托伦跻身波兰立陶宛联邦四大城市之列，1528年起设有皇家造币厂，1473年2月19日，尼古拉·哥白尼出生于此。城市1557年改宗新教，耶稣会士1595年来此推动反宗教改革；1645年，瓦迪斯瓦夫四世在此召开「爱心座谈会」，让天主教徒、路德宗与加尔文宗共聚一堂谋求和解。大洪水时代，瑞典军队于1655年底攻占托伦，据守至1658年7月至12月的围城战之后才撤离，扬二世·卡齐米日随即入城。大北方战争期间，卡尔十二世于1703年炮轰城市，1708年瘟疫又使人口锐减；1709年，彼得大帝与奥古斯特二世在此缔结《托伦条约》。1724年7月16日的「托伦骚乱」以新教市长约翰·戈特弗里德·勒斯纳被斩首收场。1772年第一次瓜分时，海乌姆诺及乡村地区并入普鲁士，唯独托伦仍留在波兰，孤城困守、百业凋敝，直至1793年1月24日普军入城。1807年《提尔西特条约》把它划入华沙公国，1809年还一度充任公国的临时首都；拿破仑失败后，1815年维也纳会议将其交还普鲁士，1817年起又修筑了宏大的托伦要塞。

en:
Norwich stands on the Wensum in the heart of the Norfolk wool country, a market town since the tenth century with a mint of its own under King Æthelstan; the Danes burned it in 1004, and after the Conquest the Normans cleared ninety-eight houses for the castle while Bishop Herbert de Losinga began the cathedral in 1096. Its walls went up between 1280 and 1340, enclosing more ground than the City of London itself. Wool from the county's sheep-walks made its fortune: worsted took its name from the Norfolk village of Worstead, its cloth went out through Great Yarmouth, made a staple port in 1353, and a Hanseatic warehouse stood in the city; in 1274 a feud between townsmen and monks even brought excommunication on the city. In 1444 it was among England's largest and richest cities, thick with churches and friaries, the capital of the East Anglian cloth trade.

The cloth city's peace broke in 1549, when Robert Kett's rebels against enclosure camped on Mousehold Heath, occupied Norwich on 29 July and were cut to pieces at Dussindale on 27 August; Kett was hanged in chains from the castle walls. From 1567 waves of Flemish and Walloon Protestant weavers, the 'Strangers', settled there, at times a third of the population, bringing new draperies, the city's first press and the name of Strangers' Hall. Norwich stood for Parliament in the Civil War, though a Royalist riot in 1648 ended in the 'Great Blow', when the Committee House powder magazine exploded in one of the largest blasts of the century. After the Restoration its worsted stuffs entered a golden age, and early Georgian Norwich held some 30,000 people and a name as the wealthiest town in England, its Jacobite toasts dying only after Culloden. Norwich shawls became the fashion from the 1780s, and in the 1790s its radical Dissenters so angered Pitt that he called it 'the Jacobin city'.
zh:
诺里奇坐落在诺福克羊毛产区腹地的温瑟姆河畔，10世纪时已是集市城镇，在埃塞尔斯坦国王治下设有自己的铸币厂；丹麦人1004年焚毁此城，诺曼征服后，诺曼人为修建城堡拆除了九十八所房屋，赫伯特·德·洛辛加主教则于1096年动工兴建大教堂。城墙在1280至1340年间修筑，圈起的面积比伦敦城还要大。诺福克牧场上的羊毛成就了这座城市：精纺毛料得名于郡内的沃斯特德村，布匹经1353年被定为大宗货物港的大雅茅斯出海，城里还设有汉萨商人的仓库；1274年市民与修士械斗，诺里奇甚至被教皇处以绝罚。1444年的诺里奇是英格兰最大、最富庶的城市之一，教堂与修道院鳞次栉比，是东盎格利亚布匹贸易的都会。

1549年，这座布业之城的平静被打破：罗伯特·凯特领导的反圈地起义者在茅斯霍尔德荒野扎营，7月29日占领诺里奇，8月27日在达辛代尔被击溃，凯特被铁链吊死在诺里奇城堡的城墙上。1567年起，一波又一波佛兰德和瓦隆新教织工——人称「异乡人」——定居于此，一度占全城人口的三分之一，带来了新式毛织技术、城里第一台印刷机，也留下了「异乡人会馆」之名。内战中诺里奇支持议会，但1648年一场王党骚乱酿成「大爆炸」，委员会大厦的火药库被引爆，是那个世纪最大的爆炸之一。王政复辟后，诺里奇的精纺呢绒进入黄金时代；乔治朝初年的诺里奇约有三万人口，号称英格兰最富庶的城镇，城里为詹姆斯党祝酒的风气直到卡洛登战役之后才消散。1780年代起，诺里奇披肩成为时尚；1790年代，城里激进的不从国教者令皮特大为光火，称之为「雅各宾之城」。

en:
Derby stands on the Derwent, where the Roman fort and vicus of Derventio supplied the Peak District lead workings, made pottery and worked iron. The Vikings later made Djúra-bý one of the Five Boroughs of the Danelaw. In July 917 Æthelflæd, Lady of the Mercians, stormed the burh and brought its district back under English Mercia. After the Norman Conquest much of Derbyshire was governed through great honours and forest jurisdictions, passing in time to the Duchy of Lancaster. Augustinian canons settled at Darley Abbey around 1160, while Derby itself served the markets and river crossings below the Pennine foothills. In 1444 it was a small Catholic English borough and county town, drawing trade from the shire's iron, lead and wool rather than from a great court or cathedral.

The Wars of the Roses touched Darley when James Tuchet, Baron Audley, was buried at the abbey after his death at Blore Heath in 1459; the monastery was surrendered to the Dissolution in 1538. During the First English Civil War Sir John Gell became Parliament's governor of Derby in 1643 and used its garrison across the Midlands. In 1692 George Sorocold built waterworks that raised Derwent water through wooden pipes, and in 1717 John Lombe's water-powered silk mill became the first in Britain. Bonnie Prince Charlie's Jacobite army entered Derby on 4 December 1745, but its council of war ordered retreat the next day and the invasion turned back at Swarkestone Bridge. In 1771 Richard Arkwright, Samuel Need and Jedediah Strutt opened their successful water-powered cotton mill at Cromford; Strutt's Belper and Milford mills followed, making the Derwent valley one of the earliest landscapes of mechanized textile production.
zh:
德比位于德文特河畔，罗马时代的德尔文提奥要塞和村镇曾为峰区的铅矿供应物资，同时制作陶器、冶炼铁器。维京人后来把Djura-bý建成丹麦区五城之一。917年7月，麦西亚女领主埃塞尔弗莱德攻破这座堡镇，使周边地区重归英格兰人的麦西亚。诺曼征服后，德比郡大部分土地通过大贵族领地和森林法辖区治理，后来归入兰开斯特公国。约1160年，奥斯定会修士在达利修道院定居，德比则把持着奔宁山麓的市场与渡河通道。1444年，这里是一座信奉天主教的英格兰小自治镇和郡治，贸易依靠郡内的铁、铅和羊毛，而不是王宫或大教堂。

玫瑰战争也波及达利：1459年，奥德利男爵詹姆斯·图谢在布洛希思之役阵亡后葬于达利修道院；这座修道院则在1538年被解散。第一次英国内战期间，约翰·盖尔爵士于1643年成为议会派的德比总督，以当地驻军转战米德兰兹。1692年，乔治·索罗科尔德修建供水工程，用水车把德文特河的水送入木制管道；1717年，约翰·洛姆的水力丝厂成为英国第一座同类工厂。1745年12月4日，小王位觊觎者查理的詹姆斯党军队进入德比，但次日军事会议便决定撤退，南侵在斯沃克斯通桥掉头。1771年，理查·阿克莱特、塞缪尔·尼德和杰德戴亚·斯特鲁特在克罗姆福德开办成功的水力棉纺厂，斯特鲁特随后又在贝柏和米尔福德设厂，使德文特河谷成为最早的机械化纺织工业区之一。

en:
Cremona sits on the left bank of the Po amid the richest grain country in Lombardy. It was a Ghibelline commune of the Lombard plain, its Torrazzo bell tower rising beside the cathedral, and its merchants were organised in the fustian-makers' university established in 1411. From 1322 the Visconti made themselves its lords, and in 1420 Filippo Maria made the signoria hereditary, binding Cremona to the Duchy of Milan; in June 1431 the Visconti fleet defeated a Venetian attack on the river below the city. In 1441 Cremona was granted to the condottiero Francesco Sforza as the dowry of Bianca Maria Visconti, who married him there at San Sigismondo on 25 October. Thus in 1444 Cremona, rich on Po valley grain and canal water, was held by Sforza himself — the soldier the ageing duke in Milan could neither pay nor defy.

The city withstood another siege in 1446, and after Sforza seized the duchy in 1450 it became a favoured Sforza town, with Ludovico il Moro funding work on its cathedral and baptistery. The Italian Wars swept back and forth over it: Venice held Cremona from 1499 to 1509, when Agnadello returned it to French-ruled Milan, and Spanish troops took it in 1524 after the castle of Santa Croce surrendered. Famine in 1628 and plague in 1630 marked the long Spanish peace, and the city passed to Austria in 1707. Far from politics, Cremona became the workshop of the world's finest string instruments: Andrea Amati, who died in 1577, founded the violin-makers' school, Claudio Monteverdi was born here in 1567, and Antonio Stradivari made his instruments here from c.1644 until his death in 1737. With the rest of Lombardy the city passed through the Napoleonic Kingdom of Italy and returned to Austria in 1815 as part of Lombardy-Venetia.
zh:
克雷莫纳位于波河左岸，处在伦巴第最富庶的产粮区中央。它曾是波河平原上的吉伯林派公社，托拉佐钟楼高耸于大教堂旁，商人则组织在1411年成立的粗棉布商行会中。1322年起维斯孔蒂家族成为城市领主，1420年菲利波·马里亚将领主权改为世袭，克雷莫纳就此并入米兰公国；1431年6月，维斯孔蒂舰队在城旁的河面上击溃了来犯的威尼斯舰队。1441年，克雷莫纳作为比安卡·马里亚·维斯孔蒂的嫁妆被交给雇佣兵首领弗朗切斯科·斯福尔扎，两人于10月25日在城中的圣西吉斯蒙多教堂成婚。因此，1444年的克雷莫纳靠波河平原的粮食和渠水富足一方，握有此城的正是斯福尔扎本人——米兰那位年迈公爵既付不起军饷、也惹不起的大将。

1446年，城市又顶住了一次围攻；1450年斯福尔扎夺取公国后，克雷莫纳成为受斯福尔扎家族厚爱的城市，卢多维科·摩尔人出资修建大教堂和洗礼堂。意大利战争的大军在城前来回拉锯：威尼斯在1499至1509年间占据克雷莫纳，阿尼亚代洛一战后它被还给法国治下的米兰；1524年圣十字城堡投降，西班牙军队入城。漫长的西班牙岁月里，1628年饥荒、1630年瘟疫相继袭来，城市于1707年转归奥地利。远离政治漩涡的克雷莫纳成了世上最精良弦乐器的作坊：1577年去世的安德烈亚·阿马蒂开创了小提琴制作流派，克劳迪奥·蒙特威尔第1567年出生于此，安东尼奥·斯特拉迪瓦里约在1644年至1737年间在此制琴。与伦巴第其余地区一样，克雷莫纳经历了拿破仑的意大利王国，1815年又随伦巴第-威尼托王国重归奥地利。

en:
Graz guards a crossing of the Mur where the river leaves the Alps for the broad, grain-rich Graz plain. Its Slavic name means the little fort above the ford; Bavarian settlers laid out a market below the Schlossberg, first documented in 1128 and securely attested from 1140. The Otakars made it chief town of Styria, the Georgenberg treaty of 1186 carried the duchy to the Babenbergs, and King Rudolf I granted the town its privileges in 1281. From 1379 Graz was the residence of the Inner Austrian Habsburgs over their Alpine lands, and Frederick III, who kept court here longer than anywhere, built the Burg from 1438 with its Gothic cathedral. In 1444, then, Graz was the true capital of Inner Austria, a Catholic German market town living on the harvests of the Graz Feld, its Schlossberg fortress watching the roads to the south.

Ottoman raiders reached the Mur in 1480, and the cathedral's Landplagenbild of 1485 depicts locusts, plague and Turks together; Maximilian I added the famous double-spiral staircase to the Burg and in 1496 expelled Styria's Jews. Most burghers were Lutheran by mid-century, but Archduke Karl II founded the Jesuit university in 1585 and raised the Renaissance Landhaus of Domenico dell'Allio. Ferdinand II drove out the Protestant preachers in 1598 and closed their schools in 1599, sending Johannes Kepler, who taught here from 1594, to Prague; in 1619 the whole court moved to Vienna. French troops first entered Graz in April 1797, Napoleon lodging in the Herrengasse, and returned in 1805. In 1809 the Schlossberg fortress, rebuilt against the Turks and held by Major Hackher with 800 men, defied the French guns until the peace of Schönbrunn doomed it; the townspeople bought its clock tower from the demolition.
zh:
格拉茨扼守穆尔河上的渡口，河水在此流出阿尔卑斯山，进入盛产谷物的格拉茨平原。城名来自斯拉夫语，意为渡口上方的小堡；巴伐利亚移民在城堡山下开设市集，1128年首见记载，1140年已有确切凭证。奥塔卡尔家族把它经营成施泰尔马克的首邑，1186年的《格奥尔根贝格条约》把公爵领地传给巴本贝格家族，1281年国王鲁道夫一世赐予城市特权。1379年起格拉茨成为哈布斯堡内奥地利支系统治各阿尔卑斯领地的驻地；在此居留最久的腓特烈三世1438年起兴建城堡，旁边又建起哥特式主教座堂。因此在1444年，格拉茨已是内奥地利真正的都城：一座讲德语的天主教商业城市，靠格拉茨原野的收成供养，城堡山要塞扼守着南通的大路。

1480年奥斯曼袭扰军进抵穆尔河，主教座堂里1485年的《天灾图》把蝗灾、瘟疫和土耳其人画在一起；马克西米利安一世在城堡中增修著名的双螺旋楼梯，又于1496年把犹太人逐出施泰尔马克。到16世纪中叶，市民多数已皈依路德宗，卡尔二世大公却于1585年创办耶稣会大学，并建起多梅尼科·德利·阿利奥设计的文艺复兴式州议会大厦。费迪南德二世1598年驱逐新教牧师，1599年封闭新教学校，自1594年在此任教的约翰内斯·开普勒被逐往布拉格；1619年整个宫廷迁往维也纳。1797年4月法军首次入城，拿破仑下榻黑伦街，1805年法军再度占领。1809年，为抵御土耳其人而改建的城堡山要塞由哈克尔少校率八百人坚守，顶住法军炮火，直到《申布伦条约》判了它死刑；市民出资从拆毁令中赎下山中的时钟塔。

en:
Somogy is the rolling livestock country south of Lake Balaton; with Tolna and Baranya, the province also reaches east toward the Mecsek hills and Pécs. After the Hungarian conquest, Somogyvár was the seat of Koppány, who rose against King Stephen I and was defeated around 997; the crown then granted the county to Pannonhalma Abbey. Kapos, the future Kaposvár, appears in the foundation charter of the Diocese of Pécs in 1009, received a Benedictine monastery in 1061, and gained its first castle under Béla IV after the Mongol invasion. Pécs itself became a bishopric in 1009 and, through the university founded by Louis I in 1367, was the chief scholarly centre of this southern countryside. In 1444 Catholic Hungarian nobles and church estates fattened cattle on the Somogy pastures and used Kapos Castle on the road toward Slavonia, while Ottoman conquests in the Balkans drew the frontier nearer.

In 1526 Mohács opened the Ottoman wars, and Suleiman's army sacked Pécs. Rival kings Ferdinand and John Zápolya divided local loyalties; an Ottoman army occupied Pécs during the 1529 advance on Vienna, and the city opened its gates in June 1543. It became a sanjak centre, its churches remade as mosques around baths and a bazaar. Kaposvár fell in September 1555 after a five-day siege, and the wars of 1552–1601 so depopulated Somogy that its county administration ceased and its lands were split among the Kanizsa, Szigetvár, Koppány and Simontornya sanjaks. In 1664 Nicholas Zrínyi burned Pécs and raided Babócsa and Berzence, but the Peace of Vasvár left southern Transdanubia under Ottoman rule. Louis of Baden recovered Kaposvár and Pécs in 1686; Szigetvár fell in 1689 and Kanizsa in 1690. The Habsburgs razed Kapos Castle in 1702, yet the Esterházy family revived the town, obtaining market rights in 1703; after damage in Rákóczi's War, a church followed in 1748 and Kaposvár became county seat in 1749. Pécs received free royal city status in 1780 as settlers and herds returned.
zh:
绍莫吉是巴拉顿湖南岸起伏的畜牧之乡；按游戏省份范围，它还与托尔瑙、巴兰尼亚相连，向东抵达迈切克丘陵和佩奇。匈牙利人征服后，绍莫吉堡是起兵对抗伊什特万一世的科帕尼的据点，科帕尼约在997年战败，王室随后把这片县地赐给潘农哈尔马修道院。考波什堡的前身考波什在1009年佩奇教区创立诏书中出现，1061年建起本笃会修道院，蒙古入侵后又在贝拉四世治下有了第一座城堡。佩奇也于1009年成为主教驻地，拉约什一世1367年在此创办大学，使它成为南部乡野最重要的学术中心。1444年，信奉天主教的匈牙利贵族和教会领地在绍莫吉牧场上养肥牛群，并以通往斯拉沃尼亚道路上的考波什城堡控扼交通；此时奥斯曼在巴尔干的征服已把边界越推越近。

1526年莫哈奇战役开启了奥斯曼战争，苏莱曼的军队洗劫佩奇。斐迪南与亚诺什·绍波尧伊两王并立，使当地效忠对象分裂；奥斯曼军队1529年进军维也纳途中占领佩奇，该城又于1543年6月开城。它成为桑贾克中心，教堂被改成清真寺，周围建起浴室和巴扎。1555年9月，考波什堡在五日围攻后陷落；1552—1601年的连绵战争使绍莫吉人口锐减，县政停摆，土地被划入考尼饶、锡盖特堡、科帕尼和希蒙托尔尼奥等桑贾克。1664年，兹里尼·米克洛什焚毁佩奇，袭击包博乔和拜尔任采，但沃什瓦尔和约仍把外多瑙南部留在奥斯曼统治下。巴登的路德维希1686年收复考波什堡和佩奇，锡盖特堡、考尼饶又先后于1689年、1690年易手。1702年，哈布斯堡拆毁考波什城堡；埃斯特哈齐家族随后复兴城镇，1703年取得市集权。拉科齐战争的破坏之后，新教堂于1748年建成，考波什堡则在1749年成为县治。1780年，佩奇获得自由王家城市地位，移民和畜群也陆续回到这一地区。

en:
Ghent grew up at the confluence of the Leie and Scheldt, where wet meadows supplied wool for its looms. Saint Amand founded St Peter's and St Bavo's abbeys in the seventh century, and by the thirteenth century the cloth guilds had made Ghent one of the richest cities north of the Alps, its belfry and cloth hall facing the merchants' quays. English and Scottish wool kept thousands of weavers and fullers at work until war disrupted the trade. In 1444 the city was part of the Burgundian Netherlands of Philip the Good: Flemish-speaking, Catholic, prosperous from cloth, and jealous of its urban privileges.

Tax disputes soon brought that autonomy under attack. In 1453 Philip's army defeated Ghent at Gavere, ending a revolt and hastening the shift of commerce toward Antwerp and Brussels. Charles V was born here on 24 February 1500, yet after the Ghent Revolt of 1539 he stripped the city of its privileges, made its leading citizens parade with nooses, and demolished St Bavo's Abbey for a Spanish fortress. In the town hall on 8 November 1576 the provinces concluded the Pacification of Ghent against Spanish rule; the city then led the Calvinist Republic of Ghent from 1577 until Alexander Farnese forced its surrender in 1584. French armies held Ghent in 1745–1748, and after 1794 it belonged to revolutionary and Napoleonic France. Lieven Bauwens brought a Mule Jenny and British machine plans to the city in 1800, launching its cotton industry. The Treaty of Ghent was signed here in December 1814, and after the Napoleonic Wars the university was founded in 1816 under the United Kingdom of the Netherlands.
zh:
根特兴起于利斯河与斯海尔德河交汇处，河畔湿润草地出产的羊毛曾供养城中织机。7世纪，圣阿曼杜斯建立圣伯多禄和圣巴夫两座修道院；到13世纪，织工行会已使根特成为阿尔卑斯山以北最富庶的城市之一，钟楼与织物厅面向商人码头矗立。英格兰和苏格兰羊毛维持着数千名织工与缩绒工的生计，直到战争打断贸易。1444年，根特属于好人菲利普统治下的勃艮第尼德兰：居民操弗拉芒语、信奉天主教，靠布匹贸易致富，并对城市特权极为在意。

赋税争端很快侵蚀这种自治。1453年，菲利普的军队在哈弗勒击败根特，镇压起义，也促使商业重心转向安特卫普和布鲁塞尔。1500年2月24日，查理五世出生于此；但1539年根特起义后，他剥夺城市特权，命名流颈套绳索游街，并拆毁圣巴夫修道院改建西班牙要塞。1576年11月8日，尼德兰诸省在市政厅缔结《根特协定》，共同反对西班牙统治；根特随后在1577年成为加尔文派共和国的中心，直至1584年亚历山大·法尔内塞迫使其投降。1745年至1748年，法军一度占领根特；1794年后，城市归属革命法国和拿破仑帝国。1800年，利芬·鲍文斯把骡机和英国机器图纸带到根特，开启棉纺织业。1814年12月，《根特条约》在此签署；拿破仑战争结束后，根特大学于1816年在尼德兰联合王国治下创立。

en:
Namur guards the confluence of the Sambre and Meuse, where a rocky spur above the river crossing carried the counts' castle. A county had taken shape there by the tenth century, and the town expanded on the Meuse's north bank while the bishops of Liège held Jambes across the water. In 1421 John III, the last local count, sold the county to Philip the Good of Burgundy. In 1444 the Walloon-speaking Catholic district therefore belonged to the Burgundian Netherlands, its tolls, bridge and fortress commanding traffic between Flanders, Hainaut and the Rhineland.

After Charles the Bold's death in 1477, Namur passed with the Burgundian inheritance to the Habsburgs and, later, to Spain. A new diocese was established there in 1559, during the church reorganization of the Netherlands. Its citadel was heavily strengthened in the 1640s, but Louis XIV's armies took it in 1692 and Vauban rebuilt the forts; William III recovered Namur for the anti-French coalition in 1695. The 1713 Treaty of Utrecht placed the Southern Netherlands under Austrian rule, although Dutch garrison rights remained part of the barrier system. French revolutionary forces besieged the city from 19 November to 1 December 1792 and captured its 3,000-man garrison; France annexed the region in 1794.
zh:
那慕尔扼守桑布尔河与默兹河汇流处，伯爵城堡矗立在渡口上方的岩岬。10世纪时，这里已形成伯国；城镇主要在默兹河北岸扩展，对岸的让布则属列日主教。1421年，末代本地伯爵约翰三世把伯国卖给勃艮第公爵好人菲利普。1444年，这片讲瓦隆语的天主教土地因此属于勃艮第尼德兰，关税、桥梁和要塞控制着佛兰德、埃诺与莱茵兰之间的往来。

1477年大胆查理死后，那慕尔随勃艮第遗产转入哈布斯堡家族手中，后来又归西班牙统治。1559年尼德兰教区改组，那慕尔设立新教区。1640年代，城堡大幅加固；路易十四的军队仍在1692年攻下此地，沃邦随后重建堡垒，威廉三世则在1695年代表反法同盟收复那慕尔。1713年《乌得勒支和约》把南尼德兰划归奥地利统治，但屏障条约体系仍保留荷兰的驻军权。1792年11月19日至12月1日，法国革命军围城，俘获三千名守军；1794年法国兼并这一地区。

en:
The Vaud is the broad country between the Jura and Lake Geneva, a land of pastures and lake-shore vineyards with the episcopal city of Lausanne at its heart. Rome planted Aventicum, the capital of Roman Helvetia, above its lakes, and Burgundians and Franks followed. The house of Savoy entered the region in the thirteenth century: Peter of Savoy built up its lordships from 1234, the Barony of Vaud was formally recognised in 1286, and in 1359 Count Amadeus VI bought it back for 160,000 florins and united it to his state. Lausanne, Morges, Vevey, Nyon and Yverdon lived from the lake traffic, while herdsmen drove cattle across the Jura passes. In 1444 the French-speaking Vaud belonged to Duke Louis of Savoy, who ruled it from Chambéry and drew it into his dynasty's Italian ambitions.

The Vaud became a battlefield in the Burgundian Wars: Swiss confederates destroyed Charles the Bold's army at Grandson on 2 March 1476 and defeated him again near Murten on 22 June. Most of the country returned to Savoy, but Bern kept Aigle and shared Grandson, Orbe and Echallens with Fribourg. In 1536 Hans Franz Nageli led a Bernese army to the relief of Geneva and went on to occupy the whole Vaud; statutes of 13 May divided it into twelve bailiwicks. At the Lausanne Disputation of 1 to 8 October 1536, held in the cathedral, Pierre Viret, Farel and Calvin overcame the Catholic clergy, and the Bernese imposed the Reformation, founding the Schola Lausannensis in 1537. By the Treaty of Lausanne of 30 October 1564 Duke Emmanuel Philibert renounced the Vaud outright. Rule from German-speaking Bern fed Vaudois resentment: Major Abraham Davel rose in 1723 and was beheaded at Vidy on 24 April. In January 1798 the Vaudois proclaimed their independence as the Lemanic Republic and French troops moved in; under the Helvetic Republic the country became the canton of Leman. The Bourla-Papey rising of 1802 burned the feudal records, and the Act of Mediation in 1803 made Vaud a sovereign canton, its independence confirmed at Vienna in 1815 despite Bern's attempts to reclaim it.
zh:
沃州是汝拉山与莱芒湖之间的广阔乡野，牧场沿坡铺开，湖畔葡萄园连片，中心是主教驻节的洛桑。罗马人曾在湖滨设立阿旺蒂库姆，即罗马海尔维第的首府，此后勃艮第人、法兰克人相继入主。13世纪起萨伏依家族进入此地：萨伏依的彼得自1234年起兼并各处领地，1286年沃州男爵的封授正式确立，1359年阿梅迪奥六世伯爵以十六万弗罗林将其购回，并入自己的国家。洛桑、莫尔日、沃韦、尼翁、伊韦尔东等城镇依湖为生，牧民则赶着牛群翻越汝拉山口。1444年，讲法语的沃州属于从尚贝里发号施令的萨伏依公爵路易，被这个家族的联姻与意大利野心牵动。

勃艮第战争中，沃州沦为战场：1476年3月2日，瑞士邦联军在格朗松歼灭大胆查理的军队，6月22日又在穆尔滕附近再胜。战后沃州大部归还萨伏依，但伯尔尼保住了埃格勒，并与弗里堡共管格朗松、奥尔布与埃沙朗。1536年，汉斯·弗朗茨·内格利率伯尔尼军驰援日内瓦，顺势占领整个沃州；5月13日的法令将其划为十二个管辖区。同年10月1日至8日，洛桑大教堂举行辩论，皮埃尔·维雷、法雷尔和加尔文驳倒天主教士，伯尔尼当局随即强制推行宗教改革，并于1537年创办洛桑学院。1564年10月30日的《洛桑条约》中，公爵埃马纽埃尔·菲利贝尔正式放弃沃州，主权归于伯尔尼。来自德语区伯尔尼的远统治积怨日深：1723年达维尔少校举事，4月24日在维迪被斩首。1798年1月，沃州人宣布成立莱芒共和国，法军随即入境；海尔维第共和国时期，此地成为莱芒州。1802年的「烧纸者」起义焚毁封建契约，1803年的《调停法案》使沃州成为主权州，1815年维也纳和会确认其地位，伯尔尼索地未果。

en:
Augsburg stands where the Alpine rivers Lech and Wertach meet, on the site of the Roman colony of Augusta Vindelicorum, founded in 15 BC and by the second century the capital of the province of Raetia. The tomb of Saint Afra kept the Christian town alive after the Romans withdrew. In 955 Otto I defeated the Hungarians on the Lechfeld just to the south, and in 1156 Frederick Barbarossa granted its city rights; on 9 March 1276 Rudolf of Habsburg made Augsburg a Free Imperial City, and after the craftsmen's rising of 1368 the guilds shared power with the patriciate. The town lay where the north-south roads crossed the routes over the Alps into Italy, and grew wealthy above all on weaving. In 1444 Augsburg was a self-governing Swabian city of cloth merchants and weavers, still Catholic, whose bishop had withdrawn his residence to Dillingen.

In 1468 Gunther Zainer set up the first of the presses that made Augsburg one of Europe's leading book cities, and in the next century the Fugger and Welser houses, grown rich on cloth, metals and imperial loans, made it the banking centre of the Empire; the Fuggerei, Jakob Fugger's walled settlement for poor citizens, dates from these years. Luther was questioned by Cardinal Cajetan in the Fugger houses in 1518, the Augsburg Confession was presented at the Diet of 1530, and the Religious Peace of Augsburg in 1555 settled the faiths of the Empire. Gustavus Adolphus entered the city in 1632, and the imperial-Bavarian siege of 1634-1635 carried off two thirds of its people by hunger and disease. The recovered city remained famed for its goldsmiths, scientific instruments and the rococo 'Augsburg taste'. Bavarian troops occupied it in December 1805, and with the dissolution of the Empire in 1806 the Free Imperial City passed to the Kingdom of Bavaria.
zh:
奥格斯堡位于阿尔卑斯山流出的莱希河与韦尔塔赫河交汇处，罗马殖民城奥古斯塔-温德利科鲁姆的故址上；该城建于公元前15年，2世纪时已是雷蒂安行省的省会。罗马势力撤退后，圣阿弗拉墓维系着这座基督教城镇的香火。955年，奥托一世在城南的莱希菲尔德击败匈牙利人；1156年腓特烈一世（红胡子）颁赐城市权，1276年3月9日哈布斯堡的鲁道夫将奥格斯堡立为帝国自由城市，1368年手工业者起义后，行会与城市贵族共同执政。这里地处南北大道与翻越阿尔卑斯山通往意大利的商路交会处，尤其靠织造业致富。1444年的奥格斯堡是一座自治的施瓦本城市，居民是布商和织工，仍奉天主教，而主教早已把驻地迁往迪林根。

1468年，金特·蔡纳尔在此开办第一家印刷所，奥格斯堡后来成为欧洲首屈一指的印书之城；进入16世纪，靠布料、金属和帝国贷款致富的富格尔、韦尔瑟两大家族让这里成为帝国的银行业中心，雅各布·富格尔为贫民修建的围合社区福格社区也建于这些年。1518年，路德在富格尔宫接受卡耶坦枢机的质询；1530年帝国议会上宣读了《奥格斯堡信纲》，1555年的奥格斯堡和约确立了帝国境内的信仰格局。古斯塔夫二世1632年入城，1634至1635年皇帝与巴伐利亚联军围城，三分之二市民死于饥饿和疫病。复苏后的奥格斯堡仍以金匠、科学仪器和洛可可的「奥格斯堡趣味」闻名。1805年12月巴伐利亚军队占领城市，1806年神圣罗马帝国解体，帝国自由城市并入巴伐利亚王国。

en:
Zürich commands the place where the Limmat leaves Lake Zürich. The Roman customs post of Turicum stood on the Lindenhof, and in 853 Louis the German founded Fraumünster Abbey; in 1045 Henry III granted its abbess rights over markets, tolls and the mint. After the Zähringer line died out in 1218 the city became an imperial free city, and Rudolf Brun's guild revolution of 1336 brought the craft guilds into government. On 1 May 1351 Zürich joined Lucerne, Schwyz, Uri and Unterwalden as the fifth member of the Swiss confederates. The Toggenburg inheritance dispute then split the alliance: Zürich was expelled in 1440, allied with Frederick III of Habsburg in 1442, and on 23 July 1443 was defeated at St. Jakob an der Sihl, where Burgomaster Rudolf Stüssi died defending the bridge. The walls held, but in November 1444 the Catholic trading city remained at odds with the other confederates.

The quarrel ended formally in 1450, when Zürich renounced its Habsburg alliance and renewed its confederate oaths. From 1519 Huldrych Zwingli's preaching at the Grossmünster made the city a centre of the Reformation; the Anabaptist Felix Manz was drowned in the Limmat in January 1527, and Zürich's defeat at Kappel on 11 October 1531 cost Zwingli his life. Heinrich Bullinger then consolidated the new church and received Protestant refugees from Italy, France and England, whose weaving and commerce strengthened the city's textile economy. A second ring of fortifications rose in 1624 during the Thirty Years' War, and in 1648 Zürich proclaimed itself a republic. The old oligarchy fell with the French invasion of 1798. On 25–26 September 1799 André Masséna defeated Alexander Rimsky-Korsakov's Russians along the Limmat and within the city gates. Under the Act of Mediation in 1803, Zürich became capital of the reconstituted canton.
zh:
苏黎世扼守利马特河从苏黎世湖流出的位置。罗马人的税站图里库姆设在林登霍夫山上；853年，德意志人路易建立圣母修道院，1045年亨利三世又把市场、关税和铸币权授予女修道院院长。1218年策林根家族绝嗣后，苏黎世成为帝国自由城市；1336年鲁道夫·布伦发动行会革命，使手工业行会进入政权。1351年5月1日，苏黎世与卢塞恩、施维茨、乌里和翁特瓦尔登结盟，成为瑞士同盟的第五个成员。托根堡继承权争端随后撕裂同盟：苏黎世1440年被开除出邦联，1442年与哈布斯堡的腓特烈三世结盟，1443年7月23日又在锡尔河畔的圣雅各布战败，市长鲁道夫·施图西防守桥梁时战死。城池守住了，但1444年11月，这座信奉天主教的商业城市仍与其他同盟城邦处于对立之中。

冲突到1450年才正式结束，苏黎世放弃哈布斯堡盟约，重新宣誓加入邦联。1519年起，慈运理在苏黎世大教堂的讲道使这里成为宗教改革中心；1527年1月，重洗派信徒费利克斯·曼茨被溺死在利马特河中，1531年10月11日苏黎世在卡佩尔战败，慈运理也命丧沙场。海因里希·布林格随后巩固新教会，并接纳来自意大利、法国和英格兰的新教难民，他们的织造技术和商业活动增强了城市的纺织业经济。三十年战争期间，苏黎世在1624年筑起第二圈城墙，1648年宣布成立共和国。1798年法军入侵，旧寡头政权倒台。1799年9月25日至26日，安德烈·马塞纳在利马特河沿线和城门内击败亚历山大·里姆斯基-科尔萨科夫的俄军。1803年《调解法令》颁布后，苏黎世成为重建的苏黎世州首府。

en:
St. Gallen grew up beside the Benedictine abbey founded around 719 on the hermitage of the Irish monk Gallus. Its scriptorium and library made the monastery one of the chief centres of learning north of the Alps, and in 1207 Abbot Ulrich von Sax became an imperial prince. The burghers gradually carved out a separate town: Abbot Wilhelm von Montfort confirmed their privileges in 1291, and by about 1353 the cloth-weavers' guild led the civic government. In 1415 the town bought its liberties from King Sigismund, and after the Appenzell rising against the abbot it became an ally of the Swiss confederates in 1411. In 1444 the province was therefore a divided country: a wealthy guild town looked toward Switzerland, while the Catholic prince-abbot still ruled the monastery and the surrounding pasturelands.

On 23 June 1454 the burghers swore an Everlasting Alliance with the confederates, and in 1457 they paid the abbot for their final release. Conflict soon returned: in 1489 Mayor Ulrich Varnbüler backed the destruction of the new monastery being built at Rorschach, and in 1490 four protecting cantons invaded, fined the town and forced Varnbüler into exile. In the 1520s Joachim von Watt, known as Vadian, carried the Reformation through the city, while the abbey remained Catholic and was restored after the Catholic victory of 1531. Swiss troops plundered its books during the Toggenburg War of 1712, though Peter Thumb's late-baroque rebuilding began in 1755. The abbot's secular state collapsed in 1798, when his subjects founded the Republic of the Old Landscape and the French merged the region into the canton of Säntis. The canton of St. Gallen was created in 1803, and the monastery was dissolved in 1805; one of Switzerland's early mechanical spinning mills was then rising in the textile town.
zh:
圣加仑是在本笃会修道院旁发展起来的；这座修道院约于719年建在爱尔兰修士加卢斯的隐修所旧址上。修道院的抄写室和藏书室使其成为阿尔卑斯山以北最重要的学术中心之一，1207年院长乌尔里希·冯·萨克斯受封帝国亲王。市民则逐渐经营出一座独立城市：1291年院长威廉·冯·蒙福特确认市民特权，到1353年前后，织布工行会已主导市政。1415年，城市从西吉斯蒙德国王手中购得自治权；阿彭策尔反抗修道院后，圣加仑也在1411年成为瑞士邦联的盟友。因此1444年的这片地区实际上分成两重世界：富庶的行会城市朝向瑞士，而天主教修道院长仍统治着修道院和周围牧场。

1454年6月23日，圣加仑市民与瑞士邦联宣誓缔结永久同盟，1457年又向院长支付赎金，最终解除其对城市的控制。冲突很快再起：1489年，市长乌尔里希·瓦恩比勒支持摧毁正在罗尔沙赫修建的新修道院；1490年，四个保护州出兵入侵，城市被处以罚金，瓦恩比勒被迫流亡。1520年代，学者约阿希姆·冯·瓦特（瓦迪安）在城市推动宗教改革，修道院仍奉天主教，并在1531年天主教一方获胜后恢复。1712年托根堡战争期间，瑞士军队掠走大量藏书；1755年起，彼得·图姆主持的晚期巴洛克式重建工程开工。1798年，修道院臣民建立旧地共和国，修道院长的世俗国家崩溃，法国又把这里并入森蒂斯州。1803年，圣加仑州成立，1805年修道院被解散；此时这座纺织城市中也建起了瑞士最早的机械纺纱厂之一。

en:
The Valais is the long trench of the upper Rhone, walled in by the Bernese and Pennine Alps on the road from Lake Geneva to the Great St Bernard pass. Rome knew it as Vallis Poenina and traded through Octodurus, while the abbey of Saint-Maurice guarded its western gate. In 999 King Rudolph III of Burgundy made the bishop of Sion count of the Valais. The dukes of Savoy nevertheless made themselves masters of the French-speaking lower valley, while German settlers from Hasli pushed up the Rhone, and from 1384 the Morge stream below Sion marked the border. Up-valley the seven German-speaking tithings had their liberties confirmed by the emperor in 1354, routed the bishop's and Savoy's men at Visp in 1388, and drove out the lords of Raron in 1414-1420. In 1444 the Valais was thus a divided, Catholic land, Savoyard below Sion and self-governing above it, and the witch trials begun in 1428, among the first in Europe, still dragged on with hundreds sent to the stake.

In 1475 the tithings allied with Bern and, on 13 November, routed a Savoyard army at the Planta by Sion, overrunning the Lower Valais as far as Saint-Maurice; the conquered districts became subject lands. On 12 March 1529 the Valais became an associate member of the Swiss Confederation, and while the Reformation swept the neighboring Vaud it kept the Catholic faith. In 1536 its troops overran the Chablais; the Treaty of Thonon of 4 March 1569 returned Evian and Thonon to Savoy but left Monthey to the Valais. In 1634 the tithings stripped the bishop of his secular power and proclaimed the federal Republic of the Seven Tithings under a Landeshauptmann. In 1798 the subject Lower Valais rose and won equality, and the Valais became a canton of the Helvetic Republic. Napoleon made it the separate Rhodanic Republic on 5 September 1802, to keep the Alpine crossing in hand, then annexed it on 13 December 1810 as the French department of the Simplon. Austrian troops arrived late in 1813, and on 4 August 1815 the Valais entered the Swiss Confederation as its twentieth canton.
zh:
瓦莱是罗讷河上游的一道深长河谷，夹在伯尔尼山与彭尼山之间，扼守从莱芒湖通往大圣伯纳德山口的道路。罗马人称此地为波宁河谷，取道奥克托杜鲁姆通商，谷口则有圣莫里斯修道院据守。999年，勃艮第国王鲁道夫三世把瓦莱的世俗君权封给锡永主教。尽管如此，萨伏依公爵还是成了讲法语的下瓦莱的主人，来自哈斯利的德意志移民则沿罗讷河上溯；1384年起，锡永下方的莫尔日河成为双方分界。上游的七个德语「十庄」1354年获皇帝确认自由，1388年在菲斯普击溃主教与萨伏依的联军，又于1414至1420年赶走拉龙家族。1444年的瓦莱因此是一片分裂的天主教土地：锡永以下属萨伏依，上游高度自治；始于1428年的猎巫是欧洲最早的一批，此时仍在延续，已有数百人被送上火刑柱。

1475年，十庄与伯尔尼结盟，11月13日在锡永旁的普朗塔击败萨伏依军队，顺势征服下瓦莱直至圣莫里斯，被征服的地区此后作为属地受其统治。1529年3月12日，瓦莱成为瑞士邦联的联系成员；宗教改革席卷邻邦沃州时，瓦莱仍奉旧教。1536年，瓦莱军队攻占沙布莱；1569年3月4日的《托农条约》把埃维昂和托农归还萨伏依，蒙泰则留在瓦莱手中。1634年，十庄褫夺主教的世俗权力，成立由最高执政管辖的联邦式七十庄共和国。1798年，沦为属地的下瓦莱起义争得平等地位，瓦莱作为州加入海尔维第共和国。拿破仑于1802年9月5日将其分出，成立罗达尼亚（瓦莱）共和国以控制阿尔卑斯通道，又于1810年12月13日将其吞并，划为法国的辛普朗省。1813年底奥军进入瓦莱，1815年8月4日，瓦莱作为第二十个州加入瑞士邦联。

en:
Ulm lies on the upper Danube below the Swabian Jura, where the little river Blau joins it. It is first mentioned in 854, when Louis the German signed a charter at the royal estate of Hulma, and in 1181 Frederick Barbarossa made it an Imperial City. In 1376 Ulm led the founding of the Swabian League of Cities and was styled the 'head and ornament of Swabia'; on 30 June 1377 its citizens began the vast minster at their own expense, and the Great Schwörbrief of 1397 gave the guilds thirty council seats to the patricians' ten. Its wealth came from Barchent, a cotton-and-linen fustian stamped with the Ulm seal as a guarantee accepted across Europe, and Ulmer merchants kept houses in Venice, Vienna, Antwerp and Constantinople. In 1444 this self-governing, Catholic Swabian city, its sculptors and winged-altarpiece makers already famous, stood near the height of its medieval power.

Around 1500 Ulm held the second-largest territory of any imperial city after Nuremberg, with three towns and fifty-five villages, and served as meeting place of the Swabian League founded in 1488 and then of the Swabian Circle. The citizens voted in the Reformation in 1531, and an iconoclastic storm wrecked the city's school of altarpiece sculptors; in the Schmalkaldic War it surrendered to Charles V, who annulled the 1397 constitution. The Thirty Years' War and later occupations, plagues and indemnities wore the city down, and by 1770 it was bankrupt. Bavaria annexed Ulm in 1802, and in October 1805 Napoleon trapped General Mack's Austrian army before its walls in the Battle of Ulm and forced its surrender. In 1810 the city passed to the Kingdom of Wurttemberg, losing the right bank of the Danube, which became Neu-Ulm.
zh:
乌尔姆位于施瓦本山麓的多瑙河上游，布劳河在此汇入干流。它最早见于854年的记载，日耳曼人路易在王家领地Hulma签署文书；1181年腓特烈一世（红胡子）将其立为帝国自由城市。1376年，乌尔姆牵头组建施瓦本城市同盟，被誉为「施瓦本的首府与荣耀」；1377年6月30日，市民自筹资金动工修建宏伟的大教堂，1397年的《大誓书》（Großer Schwörbrief）又规定行会占三十个市参事席位、城市贵族仅占十席。乌尔姆的财富来自一种棉麻混纺的粗绒布（Barchent），盖有乌尔姆印鉴的布匹品质通行全欧，乌尔姆商人在威尼斯、维也纳、安特卫普和君士坦丁堡都设有商馆。1444年的乌尔姆是一座自治的天主教施瓦本城市，本地雕塑家和翼式祭坛制作师已声名远播，正接近中世纪权势的顶峰。

1500年前后，乌尔姆拥有仅次于纽伦堡的帝国城市领地，下辖三座城镇、五十五个村庄，并是1488年成立的施瓦本同盟以及后来施瓦本帝国行政圈的集会之地。1531年市民投票改宗新教，随后的毁像风暴终结了城中祭坛雕刻流派；施马尔卡尔登战争中乌尔姆向查理五世投降，1397年宪法被废止。三十年战争及此后的占领、瘟疫和赔款耗尽了城市，到1770年乌尔姆已告破产。1802年巴伐利亚吞并乌尔姆；1805年10月，拿破仑在城下的乌尔姆战役困住马克将军的奥地利大军，迫其投降。1810年乌尔姆转属符腾堡王国，多瑙河右岸之地被划出，后来发展为新乌尔姆。

en:
Chur lies where the Alpine Rhine turns north and the roads over the Julier, Septimer, Splügen and San Bernardino passes meet. The Roman Curia Raetorum became capital of Raetia prima and, in the fourth century, seat of the first bishopric north of the Alps. Emperor Otto I strengthened the see with toll and mint rights, and in 1170 the bishop became a prince-bishop controlling the road toward Chiavenna. In 1367 the bishop's subjects formed the League of God's House at Chur to resist both him and the Habsburgs; a burgomaster is recorded from 1413, and attacks on the episcopal residence in 1418 and 1422 wrung concessions from the prelate. In 1444 the Catholic town was still the bishop's seat, but it was also the chief place of the God's House League, linked with the Grey League and League of the Ten Jurisdictions while the full Three Leagues were still taking shape.

Fire destroyed most of Chur on 27 April 1464, and German-speaking craftsmen who rebuilt it strengthened the guilds; a constitution of 17 January 1465 transferred civic power from the bishop to five guilds. The leagues drew together in 1471, allied with the Swiss confederates in 1497–98 and fought Austria in the Swabian War of 1499. Johannes Comander began preaching the Reformation at St. Martin's in 1523, the league constitution followed on 23 September 1524, and the Ilanz Articles allowed local religious choice; Catholic mass ended in the town's churches in 1527, though the bishop's estates remained. During the Thirty Years' War the Austrians captured Chur on 22 November 1621, before a French and Swiss force retook it on 27 October 1624. The Three Leagues gained formal independence in 1648, became the Helvetic canton of Raetia during the wars of 1799, and entered Switzerland as the canton of Graubünden in 1803.
zh:
库尔位于阿尔卑斯莱茵河折向北流之处，也是尤利尔、塞普蒂梅、斯普吕根和圣贝纳迪诺诸山口道路的交汇地。罗马人的库尔西亚·雷托鲁姆后来成为第一雷蒂亚行省首府，并在4世纪成为阿尔卑斯山以北第一个主教区驻地。奥托一世授予主教关税和铸币权，1170年库尔主教成为采邑主教，控制通往基亚文纳的道路。1367年，主教的属民在库尔组成神所同盟，以抵制主教和哈布斯堡；1413年已有市长的记载，1418年和1422年市民两度攻击主教府邸，迫使这位教俗领主让步。1444年，这座天主教城市仍是主教驻地，但也是神所同盟的首要城市，与灰色同盟和十辖区同盟保持联合；完整的三同盟体制此时仍在形成之中。

1464年4月27日，大火摧毁库尔大部分城区，参与重建的德意志语工匠增强了行会力量；1465年1月17日的宪法把市政权力从主教手中交给五个行会。三个同盟在1471年进一步结合，1497—1498年与瑞士邦联结盟，并在1499年士瓦本战争中对奥地利作战。1523年，约翰内斯·科曼德在圣马丁教堂开始宣讲宗教改革；1524年9月23日三同盟宪法订立，伊兰茨条款又允许各地方自行选择信仰。1527年，城市教堂停止天主教弥撒，但主教直辖领地仍保留旧教。三十年战争期间，奥地利于1621年11月22日占领库尔，法国和瑞士联军又在1624年10月27日夺回该城。三同盟1648年取得正式独立，在1799年战火中成为海尔维第共和国的雷蒂亚州，1803年作为格劳宾登州加入瑞士。

en:
Bremen grew up on a dune bank of the Weser, at the head of the tides where seagoing ships could still unload. Charlemagne made it a bishop's seat in 787, and the see of Hamburg-Bremen long directed the missions of the northern seas. In 1186 the Gelnhausen Privilege of Frederick Barbarossa granted the town city rights under imperial justice, and in 1260 Bremen joined the Hanseatic League, growing rich as beer, grain, cloth and herring passed its Schlachte quay. As the merchants shook off the archbishops' rule, they raised the stone Roland on the market square in 1404 and built their town hall beside it. In 1444 Bremen was a largely self-governing Catholic merchant city of the Empire, ruled by a council of guild-masters and busy buying rights and estates along the lower Weser.

The Reformation was introduced in 1522, after the first Protestant sermon was preached at St Ansgarii on 9 November. As the Weser silted up, Dutch engineers built Germany's first artificial harbour downstream at Vegesack in 1619-23. The Linz Diploma of Emperor Ferdinand III in 1646 recognised Bremen's imperial freedom, and after the surrounding prince-archbishopric became Swedish Bremen-Verden in 1648 the city held out against Swedish claims; Hanover, which acquired the duchy in 1715, recognised the free city in 1720. In 1783 Bremen merchants opened a direct transatlantic trade with the United States. French troops occupied the city in 1806, and in 1811 Napoleon made it capital of the Bouches-du-Weser department. The French withdrew in 1814, the restored free city joined the German Confederation, and in 1817 a Bremen wharf launched the first German-built steamship, the paddle-wheeler Weser.
zh:
不来梅兴起于威悉河的一处沙丘河岸，地处潮汐河段顶端，海船尚可在此卸货。787年查理大帝在此设立主教区，汉堡-不来梅大主教区曾长期主持北方海域的传教事务。1186年，皇帝腓特烈一世授予城市特许状，把不来梅置于帝国直辖司法之下；1260年不来梅加入汉萨同盟，啤酒、谷物、呢绒和鲱鱼经施拉赫特码头转运，城市由此致富。为摆脱大主教的世俗统治，商人于1404年在集市广场竖立象征自由的罗兰骑士雕像，又在旁边建起市政厅。1444年的不来梅是帝国境内一座高度自治的天主教商人城市，由行会长老组成的市政议会主政，并不断在威悉河下游购置地权与庄园。

1522年宗教改革传入不来梅，当年11月9日有人在圣安斯加里教堂首次宣讲新教。威悉河泥沙淤积日重，1619至1623年荷兰工匠在下游的维格萨克建成德国第一座人工港。1646年，皇帝斐迪南三世颁发《林茨证明》，承认不来梅的帝国直辖地位；1648年周边的大主教区被世俗化为瑞典治下的不来梅-费尔登公国，瑞典一再施压，城市仍保住了自由，1715年取得公国的汉诺威于1720年承认其自由城市地位。1783年，不来梅商人开通了与美利坚合众国的直接跨大西洋贸易。1806年法军占领城市，1811年拿破仑将它并入法国，设为威悉河口省的省会；1814年法军撤离，恢复自由的不来梅加入德意志邦联。1817年，不来梅的船坞下水了德国人自建的第一艘蒸汽船——明轮汽船「威悉号」。

en:
Cuneo stands on a wedge-shaped plateau (its name means 'wedge') at the confluence of the Stura and Gesso, commanding the roads up to the Maddalena and Tenda passes. It was founded in 1198, when villagers fleeing the lords of Montferrat and Saluzzo declared a free commune; the marquises occupied it in 1210, but Emperor Frederick II recognised its liberty in 1238. In 1259 the Cuneesi put themselves under Charles I of Anjou, count of Provence, and with Alba the town became the chief Angevin foothold in Piedmont, even minting its own coin. It passed to the Duchy of Savoy in 1382, and the dukes shaped it into a fortress pointed at France. In 1444 Cuneo was a garrison town guarding Savoy's Alpine frontier, its grid of streets running down from the citadel.

French and allied armies besieged it in 1515, 1542, 1557, 1639, 1641 and 1691, and each time the walls held. After the defence of 1557 Emmanuel Philibert named Cuneo a city, 'most faithful and unconquered'. In 1744 a Franco-Spanish army invested it for a month and fought the Piedmontese in a battle outside the walls, yet again withdrew. Napoleon's troops entered unopposed in April 1796, and Cuneo became capital of the French Stura department; an Austro-Russian army retook it in 1799, but Marengo returned it to France the following year, and in 1815 the town reverted to the House of Savoy.
zh:
库内奥位于斯图拉河与杰索河交汇处一块楔形高地上，城名即「楔子」之意，扼守通往马达莱纳山口与滕达山口的道路。1198年，不堪蒙费拉托与萨卢佐封建主压迫的村民宣布建立自由公社；侯爵们于1210年占领该城，但皇帝腓特烈二世在1238年承认其自由。1259年，库内奥人投附普罗旺斯伯爵安茹的查理，与阿尔巴一同成为安茹家族在皮埃蒙特的主要据点，甚至自铸钱币。1382年它并入萨伏依公国，公爵们把它营建为一座指向法国的要塞。1444年的库内奥是守卫萨伏依阿尔卑斯边境的驻军城镇，棋盘式街道从城塞向下铺开。

法国及其盟军先后于1515、1542、1557、1639、1641和1691年围城，城墙每次都守住了。1557年防御战之后，埃马努埃莱·菲利贝托封库内奥为城市，赐号「至忠无敌」。1744年，法西联军围城一月，并在城外与皮埃蒙特军队会战，最终仍告撤退。1796年4月拿破仑的军队兵不血刃入城，库内奥成为法国斯图拉省的省会；1799年奥俄联军一度夺回，但次年马伦戈战役后复归法国，1815年交还萨伏依王室。

en:
Frankfurt grew up at the Franks' ford across the Main, first named in a charter of Charlemagne in 794, when a church synod met at his palace. Louis the German made it one of his chief seats and founded the church that became St Bartholomew's Cathedral, whose spire Madern Gerthener raised in 1415. Royal elections had been held here since 1147, and the Golden Bull of 1356 made Frankfurt the fixed election city; in 1372 it bought out the imperial bailiff to become a free imperial city under patrician and guild rule. Its fortune rested on trade: the fair was recorded in 1150, Frederick II gave it imperial protection in 1240, and a spring fair followed in 1330, drawing merchants as the Provençal fairs declined. In 1444 Frankfurt was a self-governing Catholic imperial city at the height of its fair wealth, with a Jewish community going back to 1150; eighteen years later the Jews were shut into the ghetto lane by the river.

From 1478 it also hosted a book fair, the clearing house of the German printing trade, and in 1585 merchants fixed common exchange rates for the many currencies, the seed of its stock exchange. Pogroms had struck the Jews in 1241 and 1349, and the Judengasse ghetto confined them from 1462 to 1796. The city introduced the Reformation in 1533, but after the Augsburg Interim of 1548 returned its collegiate churches to Catholic rites to safeguard fairs and elections; Huguenot refugees arrived in 1554. From 1562 the emperors were crowned here, from Maximilian II to Francis II in 1792, who set the day on 14 July. Neutral through the Thirty Years' War, it nonetheless took in plague refugees, and in 1742–1744 Emperor Charles VII, barred from occupied Bavaria, kept court here; Goethe was born in the city. French troops occupied Frankfurt in 1792 and shelled it later; in 1806 it passed to the prince-primate Dalberg, who became Grand Duke of Frankfurt in 1810. The allies ended that grand duchy in 1813, and the Congress of Vienna in 1815 restored the free city as seat of the German Confederation's Bundestag.
zh:
法兰克福起于美因河畔一处「法兰克人的渡口」，794年查理曼的一份文书首次提到它，当年还有一次教会会议在他的行宫召开。日耳曼人路易以此为主要行宫之一，创办的修院教堂后来成为圣巴多罗买大教堂，1415年马德恩·格特亨纳为它建起高耸的尖塔。自1147年起国王选举多在此举行，1356年金玺诏书确定法兰克福为固定选王之城；1372年城市买下皇帝的地方长官职位，成为贵族与行会共治的帝国自由城市。它的繁荣根基在商业：市集1150年已有记载，1240年腓特烈二世给予帝国保护，1330年又添春市；普罗旺斯旧市集衰落后，商人纷纷转来此地。1444年的法兰克福是自治的天主教帝国城市，正值市集财富的巅峰，犹太社区可追溯到1150年；十八年后，犹太人就被赶进河畔的隔都小巷。

1478年起又开办书市，成为德意志印刷业的集散地；1585年商人共同为各色货币定出统一兑换比价，这便是证券交易所的源头。1241年和1349年都发生过屠犹暴行，1462至1796年犹太人被禁足于犹太巷。1533年城市引入宗教改革，但1548年《奥格斯堡临时敕令》后，为保住市集和选王特权，又把修院教堂交还天主教礼仪；1554年胡格诺难民来此。1562年起皇帝加冕礼改在法兰克福，自马克西米利安二世至1792年的弗朗茨二世，后者特意把日子定在7月14日。三十年战争中保持中立，却仍染上随难民而来的鼠疫；1742至1744年，无法返回被占巴伐利亚的皇帝查理七世在此驻跸，歌德也出生于此城。1792年法军占领法兰克福，其后又予炮击；1806年城市落入首席侯爵达尔贝格之手，他1810年成为法兰克福大公。1813年反法联军终结这个短暂的大公国，1815年维也纳会议恢复其自由城市地位，德意志邦联议会设在此处。

en:
Charolais is the rolling southern Burgundian country around Charolles, a town on the Arconce and Semence rivers. A castle lordship passed to Duke Hugh IV of Burgundy in 1237, and Charolles became the capital of the new county in 1277. After the Armagnac marriage of 1327, Bernard VII sold the county to Duke Philip the Bold of Burgundy by a contract of 11 May 1390 for 60,000 gold francs; a three-year redemption lapsed and Charolais was definitively attached to the duchy in 1393. The title Count of Charolais was then given to the Burgundian heir. In 1444 that heir was the young Charles, later called the Bold, ruling under his father Philip the Good.

When Charles fell at Nancy in 1477, Louis XI seized Charolais and installed a royal bailli at Charolles, but the county rose for Mary of Burgundy. The Treaty of Arras in 1482 made it part of Margaret of Austria's dowry; after the French marriage plan collapsed, the Treaty of Senlis returned it to Philip the Fair in 1493. It passed to Charles V and the Spanish Habsburgs as a fief within the kingdom of France, a status confirmed by the Peace of Cateau-Cambrésis in 1559. When the Spanish crown could not pay the million francs promised to the Great Condé in 1659, the Parlement of Paris adjudged Charolais to him on 28 March 1684. Louis XV finally united the county to the French Crown in 1761.
zh:
沙罗勒是以沙罗勒镇为中心、位于勃艮第南部的起伏乡野，镇城坐落在阿尔孔斯河与瑟芒斯河畔。1237年，这片城堡领主权转到勃艮第公爵于格四世手中；1277年，沙罗勒成为新伯国的首府。1327年经婚姻转入阿马尼亚克家族后，贝尔纳七世又在1390年5月11日以6万金法郎的契约把伯国卖给勃艮第公爵勇敢的腓力；三年赎回期过后，沙罗勒于1393年确定并入勃艮第公国。此后，沙罗勒伯爵头衔封给勃艮第继承人。1444年，这位继承人就是少年查理，即后来的大胆查理，当时仍在父亲好人腓力之下。

1477年查理战死于南锡后，路易十一夺取沙罗勒，在沙罗勒设置王室司法官，但当地起兵支持勃艮第的玛丽。1482年的《阿拉斯条约》把它列为奥地利的玛格丽特嫁妆的一部分；联姻计划破裂后，1493年的《桑利斯条约》又将它归还美男子腓力。伯国后来传给查理五世和西班牙哈布斯堡家族，却仍是法兰西王国境内的封邑，这一地位在1559年的《卡托—康布雷西和约》中得到确认。1659年西班牙王室未能偿付许诺给大孔代的100万法郎后，巴黎高等法院于1684年3月28日将沙罗勒判给他。1761年，路易十五最终把伯国并入法兰西王室领地。

en:
Aachen grew around hot springs west of the Rhine, the Roman Aquae Granni. Charlemagne made the place his favoured northern residence, raising a palace and the Palatine Chapel where he was buried in 814. After Otto I was crowned there in 936, the chapel became the traditional church for German royal coronations. Emperor Frederick Barbarossa granted Aachen market and minting rights and made it an imperial city in 1166. Woollen cloth, river traffic and pilgrims drawn by its relics and springs sustained the medieval town. In 1444, Aachen was a Catholic free imperial city close to Flanders, proud of its Carolingian legacy but too weak to overawe Jülich, Liège or its other Rhenish neighbours.

Thirty German kings had been crowned in Aachen when Ferdinand I became the last in 1531. The Reformation then split the city, and in 1598 Spanish troops from the Netherlands backed the removal and expulsion of Protestant office-holders; many Protestant coppersmiths had already left for Stolberg and Vaals, weakening a brass industry fed by local zinc and copper ores. Aachen saw little fighting in the Thirty Years' War, but on 2 May 1656 a bakery fire destroyed 4,664 houses. Rebuilt as a spa, it hosted the treaties of Aix-la-Chapelle in 1668 and 1748. French forces occupied the city in 1794 and swept away its imperial constitution; the Peace of Lunéville in 1801 confirmed French rule on the left bank of the Rhine. After Napoleon's defeat, Aachen passed to Prussia in 1815 and hosted the European congress of 1818.
zh:
亚琛兴于莱茵河以西的温泉，罗马时代称阿奎斯·格拉尼。查理大帝把这里作为晚年偏爱的北方行在，兴建行宫和行宫礼拜堂，并于814年葬于其中。936年奥托一世在此加冕后，这座礼拜堂成为德意志国王传统的加冕教堂。1166年，皇帝腓特烈一世（红胡子巴巴罗萨）授予亚琛市场权与铸币权，并将其确立为帝国自由城市。中世纪的亚琛靠毛纺织业、河道商运，以及被圣物和温泉吸引的朝圣者维持繁荣。1444年，亚琛是邻近佛兰德的天主教帝国自由城市，拥有加洛林王朝的显赫记忆，却没有足够力量压服于利希、列日等莱茵邻国。

到1531年斐迪南一世成为最后一位在此加冕的国王时，先后已有三十位德意志国王在亚琛加冕。宗教改革随后撕裂城市，1598年，来自尼德兰的西班牙军队支持罢免并驱逐新教官员；许多新教铜匠此前已迁往施托尔贝格和法尔斯，削弱了依托当地锌、铜矿发展的黄铜业。三十年战争期间亚琛几乎没有战事，但1656年5月2日，一场从面包房燃起的大火摧毁4664栋房屋。城市重建后发展为温泉胜地，并在1668年和1748年两度成为《亚琛和约》的缔约地。法国军队1794年占领亚琛，废除其帝国城市宪制；1801年《吕内维尔和约》确认法国对莱茵河左岸的统治。拿破仑失败后，亚琛于1815年并入普鲁士，并在1818年承办欧洲列强会议。

en:
Alençon stands on the Sarthe at the southern march of Normandy, where the medieval town grew up around a castle first raised by the lords of Bellême. William of Normandy had to besiege it in 1051, when the garrison taunted him by waving animal hides in memory of his tanner grandfather. From the thirteenth century the county was an apanage for sons of the kings of France: Peter, son of Louis IX, received it in 1268, and a duke Peter's great keep still stands. Raised to a duchy and peerage in 1414, Alençon lost its duke Jean at Agincourt the following year and opened its gates to Henry V's army in October 1417. Young Jean II was captured at Verneuil in 1424 and freed only after three years for a heavy ransom, after which he fought beside Joan of Arc. In 1444, the twenty-seventh year of English occupation, the drapers' town on the Sarthe was still held for the English king while its dispossessed duke waited on Charles VII.

In 1449 Jean II recovered his city through the complicity of four burghers, who were ennobled for it; he later joined the revolt of the dauphin, was tried in 1458 and again in 1472, and ended by surrendering the duchy to his son René. René's duchess, Marguerite of Lorraine, completed the churches of Notre-Dame and Saint-Léonard and founded the convent of the Poor Clares in 1497. The duchy escheated to the crown in 1524 on the death of the childless Charles IV, passed in jointure to Catherine de' Medici in 1559, and in 1566 became the appanage of her youngest son Francis. Colbert set up a royal lace workshop at Alençon in 1665, and Marthe La Perrière so altered the Venetian needle technique that around 1675 the town gave its name to a lace of its own, the point d'Alençon. The Revolution disturbed the town little, though captured Vendéens were shot there after the fighting at Le Mans in 1793 and the chouans long haunted the countryside; Napoleon's patronage, and the orders for his marriage to Marie-Louise in 1810, revived the failing lace trade.
zh:
阿朗松地处萨尔特河畔、诺曼底的南部边隘，中世纪城镇围绕贝莱姆领主最早修建的城堡发展起来。1051年，诺曼底公爵威廉曾围城攻打，守军还在城头挥舞兽皮，嘲笑他的鞣皮匠祖父出身。13世纪起，阿朗松伯国成为法国诸王子的封地：路易九世之子皮埃尔1268年受封，皮埃尔公爵所建的大塔楼依然矗立。1414年伯国升为公爵兼贵族院领地，次年公爵让一世便殁于阿金库尔战役，1417年10月城市向亨利五世的军队开城。年轻的让二世1424年在韦尔讷伊被俘，关押三年后才以重金赎出，此后随圣女贞德作战。1444年是英格兰占领的第二十七个年头，这座萨尔特河畔的呢绒之城仍为英王据有，被夺封地的公爵则在查理七世的宫廷中等待时机。

1449年，让二世靠四名市民做内应光复城市，四人后来都被封为贵族；他后来参与王太子的叛乱，1458年和1472年两度受审，最终把公国交给儿子勒内。勒内的公爵夫人玛格丽特·德·洛林主持完成了圣母院和圣莱奥纳尔教堂，并于1497年创建贫穷修女会修道院。1524年，绝嗣的查理四世去世，公国收归王室，1559年成为卡特琳·德·美第奇的寡妇封邑，1566年又封给她的幼子弗朗索瓦。1665年，科尔贝在阿朗松设立皇家花边作坊，玛尔特·拉佩里耶尔改进威尼斯针绣技法，约1675年形成独有的「阿朗松花边」。大革命对这座小城冲击不大，不过1793年勒芒之战后，大批被俘的旺代军被押到此处枪决，舒昂党人也长期在乡间活动；拿破仑的眷顾，包括1810年他与玛丽—路易丝成婚时的大批花边订单，让衰落的花边业重获生机。

en:
The Sundgau, the Alemannic 'south shire', is the rolling country of southern Alsace between the Vosges, the Jura and the bend of the Rhine. Its capital Altkirch, first recorded in 1102, was a town of the counts of Ferrette; when the line failed in 1324, Joanna of Ferrette married Duke Albert II of Austria and brought the land to the Habsburgs. Ruled from Ensisheim as part of Further Austria through four bailiwicks, the Sundgau all but surrounded the imperial city of Mulhouse. Plague in 1349, the Basel earthquake of 1356 and the Armagnac mercenary raids of 1439 and 1444 emptied many villages. In 1444 it was a Catholic, German-speaking Habsburg district of the Empire, thinly peopled after years of marching armies.

In 1469 Duke Sigismund mortgaged Upper Alsace to Charles the Bold of Burgundy, and the land was only redeemed in 1474; Swiss columns marched through to relieve Mulhouse in 1466 and ravaged the country again in the Swabian War of 1499. Peasants rose in 1524, but after their defeat at Illzach the Sundgau remained firmly Catholic under Austrian rule. The Thirty Years' War reached it in 1632: Swedish, imperial and French troops passed in turn, the peasant rising of 1633 ended at Blotzheim, and by 1648 some districts had lost up to four fifths of their people. The Peace of Westphalia gave the Sundgau to France, and Louis XIV granted the county of Ferrette to Cardinal Mazarin in 1659. Turenne drove out imperial forces in the 1670s and Vauban built Huningue fortress on the Rhine from 1680; Swiss settlers recolonised the empty villages, and the 18th century brought iron-working and cloth mills spreading from Mulhouse.
zh:
松德高（Sundgau，阿勒曼尼语意为「南方郡」）是阿尔萨斯南部、夹在孚日山脉、汝拉山脉与莱茵河河曲之间的起伏乡野。首府阿尔特基什最早见于1102年的记载，本是费雷特伯爵的城市；1324年伯爵男嗣断绝，女继承人费雷特的约翰娜嫁给奥地利公爵阿尔布雷希特二世，土地并入哈布斯堡家族。它作为前奥地利的一部分由恩西赛姆统辖，分设四个裁判区，几乎将帝国自由城市米卢斯团团围住。1349年的瘟疫、1356年的巴塞尔地震和1439、1444年阿马尼亚克雇佣兵的劫掠，使许多村庄沦为废墟。1444年的松德高是神圣罗马帝国境内讲德语、信奉天主教的哈布斯堡辖区，久经兵燹，人烟稀少。

1466年瑞士军队为救援米卢斯深入此地劫掠，1469年奥地利公爵西吉斯蒙德把上阿尔萨斯抵押给勃艮第的大胆查理，直到1474年才赎回，1499年士瓦本战争中瑞士兵锋再度波及。1524年农民起事，但在伊尔扎克败降，此后松德高在奥地利统治下始终坚持天主教。三十年战争于1632年蔓延到此，瑞典、帝国和法国军队轮番过境，1633年的农民起事被镇压于布洛蔡姆；到1648年，部分地区损失了多达五分之四的人口。《威斯特伐利亚和约》将松德高划归法国，1659年路易十四把费雷特伯国封给马萨林枢机。1670年代蒂雷纳在此驱逐帝国军队，1680年起沃邦在莱茵河畔修建于南格要塞；来自瑞士的移民重新填实荒废的村庄，18世纪里，冶铁和呢绒织造从米卢斯一带传播开来。

en:
St. Martin is a small island in the northern Leewards, ringed by beaches and salt ponds. The Kalinago knew it as Soualiga, 'the island of salt', and the Arawaks before them as Oualichi, 'the island of women'; Arawak villagers settled it first, and Kalinago groups displaced them around 1300–1400. In 1444 its people fished, farmed and scraped salt from the pans, untouched by Europe.

Columbus's fleet passed on 11 November 1493, the feast of St Martin of Tours, and the saint's name drifted onto this island through confused charts. The Dutch settled first: their West India Company built Fort Amsterdam in 1631 and began working the salt pans, but Spain, still at war with the Republic, seized the island in 1633 and held it for fifteen years; Peter Stuyvesant's attempt to retake it in 1644 was repulsed. The Spanish withdrew in 1648, and French settlers from St. Kitts and Dutch settlers from St. Eustatius divided the island on 23 March 1648 by the Treaty of Concordia. The border shifted sixteen times in the wars that followed, and French rule covered the whole island from 1795 to 1815, after which the old partition returned. Cotton, tobacco and sugar plantations meanwhile drew in enslaved Africans, who soon outnumbered the Europeans.
zh:
圣马丁是背风群岛北部一座小岛，海滩环绕，遍布盐池。卡利纳戈人称之为苏阿利加，意为「盐之岛」，更早的阿拉瓦克人则称其为瓦利奇，意为「女子之岛」；阿拉瓦克村民最先在此定居，约1300至1400年间被卡利纳戈人取代。1444年时，岛民捕鱼、务农、从盐池中刮取海盐，欧洲人尚未涉足。

1493年11月11日（图尔的圣马丁瞻礼日），哥伦布的船队经过此地，这位圣徒的名字后来因海图混淆落到了这座岛上。荷兰人最先定居：荷兰西印度公司1631年修建阿姆斯特丹堡并开始外运海盐；正与荷兰共和国交战的西班牙1633年夺取该岛，据守十五年，彼得·斯泰弗森特1644年试图反攻未果。西班牙人1648年撤离后，来自圣基茨的法国移民与来自圣尤斯特歇斯的荷兰移民于1648年3月23日签订《协和条约》，瓜分全岛。此后的战争中边界先后十六次变动，1795至1815年全岛处于法国统治之下，之后又恢复旧日分治。棉花、烟草和甘蔗种植园在此期间引入大批非洲奴隶，奴隶人数很快超过欧洲人。

en:
Annaba, the later Bône, began as Hippo Regius, the seaport of Numidia beside the Seybouse river beneath the wooded Edough massif. Augustine was its bishop from 396 and died there in 430 while the Vandals besieged the city. The low-lying ancient site was abandoned in the eleventh century for a defensible height nearby, where the Sanhaja Berbers walled a new town called Bouna. It was raided by a Pisan fleet in 1034, taken by the Normans of Sicily in 1153 and by the Almohads in 1160, and passed to the Hafsids in 1250; a Castilian occupation in 1360 was only an interlude. In 1444 Bona is a fortified port answering to Tunis, shipping the timber of the Edough and the grain of the Seybouse plain to Italy and receiving Andalusian refugees from Granada.

Ottoman corsairs made themselves masters of the town in 1533. In 1535 a Spanish squadron sent by Charles V seized its citadel, but the Turkish blockade and a hostile countryside wore the garrison down until Charles ordered it evacuated in 1540. The Turks then rebuilt the walls, added Fort Cigogne and attached Bona to the Regency of Algiers and its Beylik of Constantine. For two and a half centuries its roadstead served the corsairs, whose galleys were built from Edough timber, while merchants loaded grain, wool and hides. In the eighteenth century the town shared the beylik's prosperity: the Sidi Brahim mosque was founded in 1768, and Salah Bey of Constantine built his two-minaret mosque in 1791, its halls serving both the Maliki and Hanafi rites.
zh:
安纳巴后来欧洲人称之为博讷，最初是塞布斯河畔、林木葱郁的埃杜格山下的努米底亚海港希波勒吉乌斯。奥古斯丁396年起在此任主教，430年汪达尔人围城时死于城中。11世纪，低平的古城被放弃，人们在附近一处易守难攻的高地上筑起新城布纳，由桑哈贾柏柏尔人筑墙据守。1034年比萨舰队劫掠此城，1153年西西里诺曼人将它攻占，1160年落入阿尔摩哈德王朝之手，1250年转归哈夫斯王朝；1360年卡斯蒂利亚曾短暂占据。1444年的布纳是听命于突尼斯的设防港口，把埃杜格山的木材和塞布斯平原的谷物运往意大利，并接纳来自格拉纳达的安达卢西亚难民。

1533年，奥斯曼海盗成为此城之主。1535年，查理五世派出的西班牙舰队夺取了城堡，但土耳其人的海上封锁和充满敌意的内陆使守军日益难支，查理终于1540年下令撤离。土耳其人随后重修城墙、增建锡戈涅堡，把布纳纳入阿尔及尔摄政国及其君士坦丁贝伊领。此后两个半世纪里，这里的锚地为海盗所用，他们的桨帆船用埃杜格山的木材建造，商人则在此装运谷物、羊毛和皮革。18世纪，该城分享了贝伊领的繁荣：西迪·易卜拉欣清真寺建于1768年，君士坦丁的萨拉赫贝伊1791年又建起双宣礼塔清真寺，殿内同时为马立克和哈乃斐两个教法学派服务。

en:
Mpangu and its chief town Sundi lay in the Inkisi River valley, in the broken country between the manikongo's Mbanza Kongo and the Malebo Pool. Mpangu had once been a kingdom of Kongo dia Nlaza, the old Seven Kingdoms of the middle Congo, until Kongo's conquests up the Inkisi in the fifteenth century made it a royal province, whose governor the mwene Mpangu ranked among the crown's highest officers. Its people farmed the valley sides, worked copper and wove the raffia cloth that served as currency all down the river. In 1444 that cloth trade and the road to the Pool made Mpangu a wealthy northern march looking onto the lands of the Tio.

The future Afonso I ruled at Sundi before he took the throne, and in 1521 Henrique, the Kongo-born bishop, came home to govern Mpangu. Under Álvaro II, Sundi was restyled a duchy on the European pattern, and its duke Manuel Jordão made and unmade kings until Ambrósio I broke him in 1628. Early in that century the lands of the old Seven Kingdoms wove as much as 100,000 metres of raffia cloth a year for the Luanda market alone. Catastrophe came at Mbwila in 1665, where António I fell to the Portuguese: Kongo split into warring houses, and Sundi's dukes of the Kimpanzu line ruled the Inkisi valley as all but independent lords until royal authority began to reknit in the early eighteenth century.
zh:
姆潘古及其重镇松迪（史称恩松迪）地处因基西河谷，是夹在马尼刚果的姆班扎刚果与马莱博湖之间的丘陵地带。姆潘古本是刚果河中游古国「刚果·迪亚·恩拉扎」七王国之一，15世纪刚果沿因基西河扩张，将它并为王室行省，其长官姆韦内·姆潘古位列王廷最高级的总督之一。当地人耕作坡地、炼铜，并编织沿河全境当作货币使用的拉菲草布。1444年，凭借布匹贸易和通往马莱博湖的大道，姆潘古成为富庶的北疆，与特约人的土地相望。

后来的阿方索一世在登基前曾镇守松迪；1521年，刚果出生的主教恩里克归国，出任姆潘古总督。阿尔瓦罗二世时代，松迪按欧洲建制改称公国，公爵曼努埃尔·若尔当一度能废立国王，直至1628年被安布罗西奥一世铲除。17世纪初，旧七王国故地仅销往罗安达的拉菲草布每年就多达十万米。1665年大难临头：安东尼奥一世殒命姆布维拉战场，刚果裂为诸家混战，金潘祖一系的松迪公爵作为近乎独立的诸侯统治因基西河谷，直到18世纪初王权才重新收拢。

en:
The Tana is the longest river in Kenya. It rises in the cold highlands of Mount Kenya and the Aberdares, swings far north through the dry Nyika plains, then turns east through a wide delta to enter the Indian Ocean at Ungwana Bay by Kipini. By 1444 its lower banks were held by the Pokomo, Bantu farmers and fishermen who planted the riverine flats after the two yearly floods and were split into upper-river and delta clans; their tongue, descended from old Kingozi, lies close to Swahili. Their kinsmen had traded and intermarried with the Arabs of Lamu as early as the twelfth and thirteenth centuries, and Pokomo teachers sat in the mosques of Pate. Near the river mouth stood the Swahili stone town of Ungwana, whose Friday mosque, first built in the fourteenth century, was rebuilt around 1400 to 1450 with rows of columns and a seven-step coral minbar. Beyond that narrow green belt of riverine forest stretched dry plains roamed by herdsmen and hunters.

The Portuguese reached this coast in 1506, when the fleet of Tristão da Cunha forced Lamu to pay tribute, and in the 1580s the archipelago towns rose against them with Turkish prompting; an Omani fleet came to Lamu's aid in 1652. Ungwana was in time abandoned to the bush, but the Pokomo stayed in their river villages along the whole lower Tana. Oromo-speaking Warra Daya herdsmen, first named in a fifteenth-century Arabic source, moved into the Juba lands in the sixteenth century, and their pressure crept closer in the centuries that followed, although they did not cross the Tana in force until after 1821. Under the loose Omani protectorate of the late seventeenth and eighteenth centuries Lamu knew its golden age, until in 1812 a Pate-Mazrui army was cut down on the beach at Shela and Lamu called in an Omani garrison.
zh:
塔纳河是肯尼亚最长的河流，发源于肯尼亚山与阿伯德尔山脉的寒冷高地，先向北远远穿过干旱的恩伊卡平原，再折而向东，经宽阔的三角洲从基皮尼附近的翁瓜纳湾注入印度洋。到1444年，下游两岸的主人是波科莫人：这些班图农民和渔人趁一年两度的汛期在河畔平地耕作，分作上游与三角洲两支氏族；他们的语言由古老的金戈齐语演变而来，与斯瓦希里语相近。早在12至13世纪，波科莫人的先民便与拉穆的阿拉伯人通商联姻，波科莫出身的经师还曾在帕泰的清真寺讲学。河口附近立着斯瓦希里石城翁瓜纳，城中的聚礼清真寺初建于14世纪，1400至1450年间又以成排石柱和七级珊瑚石敏拜尔重建。河林这条狭窄绿带之外，是牧人和猎手出没的干旱平原。

1506年葡萄牙人来到这片海岸，特里斯唐·达·库尼亚的舰队迫使拉穆纳贡；1580年代，群岛诸城在土耳其人鼓动下起而反叛，1652年阿曼舰队前来援助拉穆。翁瓜纳后来被弃于荒野，波科莫人却始终守着塔纳河下游一长串河畔村落。讲奥罗莫语的瓦拉达亚牧人最早见于15世纪的阿拉伯文献，16世纪迁入朱巴河地区，此后几个世纪里他们的压力步步逼近，但在1821年以前尚未大举渡过塔纳河。在17世纪末至18世纪松散的阿曼保护下，拉穆步入黄金时代；1812年，帕泰—马兹鲁伊联军在谢拉海滩被歼，拉穆随后请来阿曼驻军。

en:
Åland is the Swedish-speaking archipelago between Roslagen and Finland Proper, its main island surrounded by fishing grounds, seal waters and hundreds of skerries. Western contacts strengthened in the early Middle Ages; the islands were Christianised in the 1000s, their first stone churches rose in the 1200s, and the sea lane from Roslagen through Åland to Finland carried traders and royal messengers. Kastelholm Castle was begun in the 1380s and first documented in 1388, combining a fortress with an administrative fief; it was besieged in 1433 during the Engelbrekt rebellion. In 1444 Åland was therefore a Catholic Swedish fishing and seafaring land, guarded by Kastelholm and bound economically to the Baltic passage between Stockholm and Åbo.

In 1485 the crown ordered Kastelholm repaired and strengthened. Danish troops burned the castle in 1507 and held Åland from 1510 until Gustav Vasa recovered it in 1521. Gustav used its forests as a royal hunting estate, a shipyard employing about fifty shipwrights developed there, and in 1571 Eric XIV was briefly imprisoned in the castle. It was damaged in the 1599 war against Sigismund and repaired by 1631; the Kastelholm witch trials followed in 1665 and 1668. Russian forces occupied Åland from 1714 to 1721 during the Great Wrath, which ended only with the Peace of Nystad. The islands were again caught in the Russian occupation of 1742–1743, settled by the Peace of Åbo on 7 August 1743. Fire gutted the decaying castle in 1745, and when Russian armies conquered Finland in 1808–1809, the Treaty of Fredrikshamn transferred Åland from Sweden to the Russian Empire.
zh:
奥兰是罗斯拉根与芬兰本部之间讲瑞典语的群岛，主岛周围遍布渔场、海豹出没的水域和数以百计的岩礁。中世纪早期，西方影响增强，群岛在11世纪基督教化，13世纪建起最早的石砌教堂；从罗斯拉根经奥兰通往芬兰的海路运送商人，也传递王室命令。卡斯特霍尔姆城堡兴建于1380年代，1388年首次见于文献，兼具要塞和行政封地功能，并在1433年恩厄尔布雷克特起义期间遭到围攻。因此1444年的奥兰是瑞典天主教渔民与海民之地，由卡斯特霍尔姆守卫，经济系于斯德哥尔摩与奥布之间的波罗的海通道。

1485年，王室下令修缮并加固卡斯特霍尔姆。丹麦军队1507年焚毁城堡，又在1510年至1521年间控制奥兰，最后由古斯塔夫·瓦萨收复。古斯塔夫把周围森林划为王室猎苑，当地发展出雇有约五十名船匠的船厂；1571年，埃里克十四世曾被短暂囚禁在城堡中。城堡在1599年对齐格蒙特的战争中受损，1631年完成修复，1665年和1668年又在此审判卡斯特霍尔姆猎巫案。大动乱期间，俄罗斯军队在1714年至1721年占领奥兰，占领直到《尼斯塔德和约》才结束。1742年至1743年俄罗斯占领芬兰时，群岛再度卷入战祸，战争于1743年8月7日以《奥布和约》收场。1745年，日渐荒废的城堡遭大火焚毁；1808年至1809年俄罗斯军队征服芬兰后，《弗雷德里克港和约》把奥兰从瑞典割让给俄罗斯帝国。

en:
East Frisia lies on the Ems estuary and the North Sea, a coast of terps, marshes, moors and islands. Its medieval communities elected judges and claimed Frisian freedom, but plague, floods and clan wars let chieftain families control the seaports and Ems approaches. Focko Ukena overthrew the tom Brok after Detern, and in 1433 the Cirksenas of Greetsiel helped expel him. When Ulrich Cirksena became family head in 1441, marriage, inheritance claims and a Hamburg commission made him the strongest northern chieftain, though Hamburg held southern posts. Emden, then an old Frisian trading place at the Dollart, had not yet received imperial town privileges. In 1444 the Catholic, Frisian-speaking land lived by dike farming, fishing, salt-marsh pasture and Ems shipping, still a network of chiefdoms rather than a county.

In 1464 Frederick III enfeoffed Ulrich as imperial count. Maximilian I granted Emden its privileges in 1495. Edzard I's wars over Groningen brought the Saxon Feud of 1514-1517, but he survived the imperial ban and invasion. Protestant teaching spread after about 1520; under Countess Anna von Oldenburg, Johannes a Lasco preached in Emden from 1542 until imperial pressure forced him out in 1549, and Menno Simons also found shelter. During the Dutch Revolt, Flemish and Brabantine refugees and the Spanish blockade made Emden a Calvinist North Sea hub; the Emden Synod met in 1571. The city revolted against Count Edzard II on 18 March 1595, and the Treaty of Delfzijl opened its quasi-independent course. The 1611 Accord of Osterhusen subordinated the Cirksenas to the estates, while Dutch influence and garrisons grew. After Carl Edzard died heirless on 25 May 1744, Prussia occupied the county under the Emden Convention. Frederick the Great chartered the Canton-trading Emden Company in 1752; French forces took the port in 1757 and Anglo-German troops recovered it in 1758. East Frisia passed to the Kingdom of Holland in 1806, later to Napoleonic France, and in 1815 to Hanover.
zh:
东弗里斯兰位于埃姆斯河口与北海之滨，是一片人工丘、围堤沼泽、荒原和海岛交错的海岸。中世纪共同体自选法官，奉行「弗里斯兰自由」；瘟疫、洪灾和宗族战争之后，首领家族控制了海港与埃姆斯河通道。福科·乌克纳在德特恩战役后推翻汤姆·布罗克家族，1433年格雷茨尔的西克瑟纳家族又协助驱逐乌克纳。乌尔里希·西克瑟纳1441年成为家族首领，凭婚姻、继承权和汉堡委任成为北方最强首领，但汉堡仍保有南方据点。埃姆登已是多拉德湾畔古老的弗里斯兰商埠，却尚未取得帝国城市特权。1444年，这片操弗里斯兰语的天主教土地以围堤农业、渔业、盐沼牧场和埃姆斯河航运为生，仍只是首领网络而非统一伯国。

1464年，腓特烈三世将乌尔里希封为帝国伯爵。1495年，马克西米利安一世授予埃姆登城市特权。埃查德一世争夺格罗宁根，引发1514至1517年的萨克森纷争，但他熬过帝国放逐令和入侵。约1520年起，新教教义在此传播；奥尔登堡的安娜伯爵夫人治下，约翰内斯·阿·拉斯科自1542年在埃姆登传道，至1549年因帝国压力被迫离开，门诺·西蒙斯也曾在此避难。荷兰起义期间，佛兰德和布拉班特难民及西班牙封锁使埃姆登成为加尔文派北海枢纽；埃姆登宗教会议1571年召开。1595年3月18日，市民起兵反抗埃查德二世，《代尔夫宰尔条约》开启了城市近乎自治的局面。1611年《奥斯特胡森协定》使西克瑟纳家族在立法、税收和司法上受制于等级会议，荷兰的影响与驻军也随之增强。卡尔·埃查德1744年5月25日无嗣而终后，普鲁士依《埃姆登协定》占领伯国。腓特烈大帝1752年特许成立通往广州贸易的埃姆登公司；法军1757年夺取港口，英德联军1758年将其收复。东弗里斯兰1806年并入荷兰王国，后又归入拿破仑法国，1815年转属汉诺威。

en:
Bari is Apulia's principal Adriatic port, occupying a low peninsula where the Peucetian harbour of Barium once met the Via Traiana. It served as the centre of an Arab emirate from 847 to 871, then passed back through Byzantine and Norman hands; the Normans took it in 1071 after a long siege. In 1087 relics of Saint Nicholas were brought from Myra to the new basilica, adding pilgrimage to a port already used by crusaders. William I destroyed the city in 1156, and Frederick II later rebuilt its castle. During the Angevin–Aragonese wars Giacomo Caldora held Bari for the Angevins while Giovanni Antonio Orsini del Balzo, Prince of Taranto, supported Aragon. When Alfonso V secured Naples in 1442, Bari became a Catholic, Neapolitan royal port only recently pacified.

Giovanni Antonio died without an heir in 1463, and his Apulian fiefs reverted to the Neapolitan crown. In 1464 Ferdinand I granted the Duchy of Bari to Sforza Maria Sforza, beginning the Sforza period that enlarged the port and drew trade from the olive groves, vineyards and towns of the hinterland. Charles VIII's French army occupied Bari during the 1494–1495 invasion of Naples, but Sforza rule was restored. Isabella of Aragon reached the city in 1501, modernised the Norman-Swabian castle for artillery, and brought Lombard merchants and officials in her train. Her daughter Bona Sforza, widow of Sigismund I of Poland, returned in 1556, strengthened the castle and founded churches and cisterns before her death in 1557, after which Naples ruled Bari directly. In 1813 Joachim Murat laid out the grid-plan Borgo Nuovo beyond the old walls.
zh:
巴里是普利亚在亚得里亚海上的首要港口，坐落在一处低矮半岛上；古代普切蒂人的港口巴吕姆便在这里与图拉真大道相接。847年至871年，它是一个阿拉伯埃米尔国的中心，随后又经历拜占庭与诺曼统治；诺曼人经长期围攻，于1071年夺取此城。1087年，圣尼古拉的遗骨从米拉被迎入新建的宗座圣殿，使这座已是十字军起航港的城市又成为朝圣之地。威廉一世于1156年摧毁巴里，腓特烈二世后来重建其城堡。安茹与阿拉贡交战期间，贾科莫·卡尔多拉代表安茹派占据巴里，塔兰托亲王焦万尼·安东尼奥·奥尔西尼·德尔·巴尔佐则支持阿拉贡。1442年阿方索五世控制那不勒斯后，巴里成为刚平息战乱的天主教那不勒斯王家港口。

1463年，焦万尼·安东尼奥无嗣而终，他在普利亚的封地收归那不勒斯王室。1464年，费迪南一世把巴里公国封给斯福尔扎·玛丽亚·斯福尔扎，开启斯福尔扎时期；港口得到扩建，内地橄榄园、葡萄园和城镇的贸易也被吸引而来。1494年至1495年查理八世入侵那不勒斯时，法军曾占领巴里，但斯福尔扎家族的统治随后恢复。1501年，阿拉贡的伊莎贝拉抵达巴里，将诺曼-施瓦本城堡改造为可承受火炮的要塞，并随她带来伦巴第商人和官员。她的女儿、波兰国王齐格蒙特一世的遗孀博娜·斯福尔扎于1556年回到巴里，加固城堡、修建教堂与蓄水池，1557年去世后巴里由那不勒斯直接统治。1813年，若阿尚·缪拉在旧城外规划了棋盘式的新堡区。

en:
Lucania is the old name of the mountain country now called Basilicata, with Potenza perched on a ridge above the Basento. Frederick II organized it as the justiciarate of Basilicata and promulgated the Constitutions of Melfi there in 1231, but Angevin rule left much of the interior in the hands of feudal barons. As Alfonso V of Aragon conquered Naples, Innico de Guevara was named count of Potenza in 1435; the town and its lands were not fully secured from the Angevins until the Guevara government effectively began in 1444. In that year Potenza was a Catholic Neapolitan county in the Lucanian Apennines, whose pastures, livestock and mule routes mattered more than its small urban centre.

The later fifteenth century brought Greek and Albanian refugees to the Vulture district and Matera after the Ottoman advance, while the baronial conspiracy against Ferdinand I gathered at Miglionico in 1485. On 1 April 1502 Louis d'Armagnac and Gonzalo Fernández de Córdoba met at Rionero in a failed attempt to partition the Kingdom of Naples, and Spanish rule soon followed. Matera rose against the tax-farmer Giovan Carlo Tramontano and killed him on Christmas night 1514; imperial landsknechts devastated Melfi at the 'Bloody Easter' of 1528. Masaniello's revolt reached Basilicata in 1647, forcing the Prince of Celano out of Potenza, and a royal audience was established at Matera in 1663. The Parthenopean rising of 1799 cost the reforming bishop Giovanni Andrea Serrao his life in Potenza. In 1806 the French made Potenza capital of the new province of Basilicata and abolished feudal jurisdiction, though royalist brigand resistance persisted in the mountains.
zh:
卢卡尼亚是这片山地的古称，也就是后来的巴西利卡塔，首府波坦察高踞巴森托河上方的山脊。腓特烈二世把这里设为巴西利卡塔司法区，并于1231年在此颁布《梅尔菲宪法》；但安茹王朝统治期间，内陆大部分土地落入封建男爵之手。阿拉贡国王阿方索五世征服那不勒斯时，伊尼科·德·格瓦拉于1435年被任命为波坦察伯爵；由于城镇和领地尚未完全从安茹势力手中夺取，格瓦拉家族的实际统治到1444年才开始。因此开局时，波坦察是卢卡尼亚亚平宁山区中的一个天主教那不勒斯伯国，山地牧场、牲畜和骡道比狭小的城区更有分量。

15世纪后期，奥斯曼扩张迫使希腊和阿尔巴尼亚难民迁入武尔图雷一带和马泰拉；1485年，反对费尔南多一世的男爵密谋集团又在米廖尼科集会。1502年4月1日，路易·德·阿马尼亚克与贡萨洛·费尔南德斯·德·科尔多瓦在廖内罗会谈，试图瓜分那不勒斯王国却未成功，随后西班牙统治确立。1514年圣诞夜，马特拉居民起兵反抗包税人乔万·卡洛·特拉蒙塔诺并将其杀死；1528年，帝国雇佣军又在「血腥复活节」中蹂躏梅尔菲。1647年，马萨涅洛起义蔓延到巴西利卡塔，切拉诺亲王被迫逃出波坦察；1663年，王室在马泰拉设立审政院。1799年的帕尔瑟诺佩起事失败后，主张改革的主教乔万尼·安德烈亚·塞劳在波坦察被杀。1806年，法国人把波坦察定为新设立的巴西利卡塔省首府，废除封建司法权，但保王派盗匪式的抵抗仍在山区延续。

en:
Mitau, called Jelgava in Latvian, lies on the flat, fertile Semigallian plain where the Driksa joins the Lielupe, the waterway that carried the region's grain and timber down to the sea. Liv fishermen had settled the river island by the tenth century, and in 1265–66 the Livonian Order's master Konrad von Mandern raised Mitau castle on the island fort of Pilssala as the Order's southern bulwark; the surrounding Semigallians were subdued by 1290. Lithuanian raiders stormed and plundered it in 1345. In 1444, under the Catholic Livonian Order, Mitau was the chief fortress of Semigallia, guarding the road from Riga into Lithuania while rafts and river barges gathered tolls below its walls.

When the Order collapsed in 1561, Gotthard Kettler made the castle the seat of his new Duchy of Courland; Mitau received town rights in 1573, became capital of the united duchy in 1578, and became its capital again when the Kettler brothers' partition ended in 1617. Gustavus Adolphus's Swedes took the town in 1621, Krzysztof Radziwiłł won it back for Poland-Lithuania in 1622, and the Swedes returned in 1625; in the 1650s it fell to De la Gardie in 1655 and to Robert Douglas in 1658 before Polish troops reclaimed it in 1659. Charles XII occupied it in 1701, and although Lewenhaupt defeated the Russians at Gemauerthof nearby in July 1705, they took Mitau that August, and plague followed the armies. From 1711 the widowed duchess Anna, niece of Peter the Great, held court here before ruling Russia as empress. Her favourite, Ernst Johann von Biron, was elected duke in 1737 and had Bartolomeo Rastrelli build the great Baroque palace, begun in 1738 and completed in 1772; Biron opened the town's first public library and Peter von Biron founded the Academia Petrina in 1775. Russia annexed Courland in 1795 and made Mitau capital of the Courland Governorate. The exiled Louis XVIII kept a shadow court in the palace, where the French princess Marie-Thérèse married the duc d'Angoulême in 1799, and he returned for a second stay in 1804–07; in 1812 a French-sponsored ducal government briefly sat there.
zh:
米陶今称叶尔加瓦，位于瑟米加利亚平坦肥沃的平原上，德里克萨河在此汇入利耶卢佩河，这条水路把当地的谷物和木材运往大海。利夫渔民早在10世纪已在河洲上定居。1265—1266年，利沃尼亚骑士团首领康拉德·冯·曼德恩在皮尔斯萨拉河洲旧堡上修筑米陶堡，作为骑士团的南方屏障，到1290年周围的瑟米加利亚人尽被征服；1345年立陶宛突袭者攻破并洗劫了这里。1444年，在信奉天主教的利沃尼亚骑士团治下，米陶是瑟米加利亚的首要要塞，扼守从里加通往立陶宛的大路，城墙下的木排与河船还为它带来税入。

1561年骑士团崩溃，戈特哈德·克特勒把这座城堡定为新建库尔兰公国的驻地。米陶1573年获得城市权，1578年成为统一公国的首都，克特勒兄弟分治于1617年结束后，它再度成为都城。古斯塔夫·阿道夫的瑞典军1621年攻下此城，克日什托夫·拉齐维乌1622年为波兰-立陶宛夺回，1625年瑞典人卷土重来；1650年代，它先于1655年落入德拉加迪之手，1658年又被罗伯特·道格拉斯攻占，1659年才由波兰军队收复。1701年卡尔十二占领米陶，尽管莱文豪普特1705年7月在附近的格毛埃特霍夫击败俄军，俄国人仍在当年8月拿下此城，瘟疫也随大军而至。1711年起，守寡的公爵夫人安娜——彼得大帝的侄女——在此设府，后来成为俄国女皇。她的宠臣恩斯特·约翰·冯·比隆1737年被选为公爵，延请巴尔托洛梅奥·拉斯特雷利兴建宏大的巴洛克宫殿，工程1738年动工、1772年落成；比隆开设了城里第一座公共图书馆，彼得·冯·比隆则于1775年创办彼得学院。1795年俄国吞并库尔兰，将米陶定为库尔兰省省会。流亡的路易十八在宫中维持着一个影子朝廷，法国公主玛丽-泰蕾兹1799年在此与昂古莱姆公爵成婚，他本人又于1804至1807年再度寄居；1812年，一个法国扶植的公国政府还曾短暂在此开会。

en:
Kaunas commands the confluence of the Neman and the Neris, where river traffic from the Lithuanian interior met the road to Prussia. A brick castle rose there in the mid-fourteenth century to bar the Teutonic Order from the upper river, and the town first appears in the Order's chronicles as Kawen in 1361. The next year the Knights took and destroyed it after a weeks-long siege: some 400 defenders fell and the commander Vaidotas was captured; Kęstutis and Algirdas arrived too late. River fighting lasted until Lithuania secured Kaunas in 1404. Rebuilt under Vytautas, who had completed the Church of the Assumption there in 1400 after the Vorskla disaster, the town received Magdeburg rights in 1408, with privileges over the public scales and the wax and wool trades, and in 1413 became the seat of Kaunas Powiat in Trakai Voivodeship. In 1441 a Hanseatic kontor opened there, the only one in the Grand Duchy. Thus in 1444 Kaunas was a busy river port of German merchants, timber wharves and customs dues, its castle the Kaunas elder's residence.

By the sixteenth century it had a public school and hospital; Bona Sforza made the eldership a royal domain and launched the Volok Reform there in 1533. A brick town grew and a wall was begun, but the mid-century wars left it unfinished. Plague struck in 1657 and Russian armies stormed the town in 1665. The Swedes occupied it in 1701 until the Altranstädt settlement of 1706; plague returned in 1708 and fires in 1731 and 1732, while the old castle crumbled into the river and became a jail. In autumn 1794 the rebel Samogitian Division of the Kościuszko Uprising withdrew through the county, and the Third Partition of 1795 gave Kaunas to Russia. In June 1812 Napoleon crossed the Neman above the town; the Grande Armée passed through twice that year and left Kaunas devastated.
zh:
科夫诺（考纳斯）扼守涅曼河与内里斯河的汇流处，是立陶宛内地河运与通往普鲁士的大道交会之所。14世纪中叶，这里建起砖石城堡，阻挡条顿骑士团溯河深入，城镇也于1361年首次以Kawen之名出现在骑士团编年史中。次年，骑士团围攻数周后攻陷并拆毁城堡：约四百名守军战死，守将瓦伊多达斯被俘，科斯图提斯和阿尔吉尔达斯驰援不及。围绕河心岛的争夺一直持续，直到1404年立陶宛才稳固据有科夫诺。城堡在维陶塔斯治下重建，他为还1399年沃尔斯克拉河之战脱险之愿而建的圣母升天教堂已于1400年落成；1408年城镇获颁马格德堡法，取得公用秤和蜡、毛贸易的特权，1413年成为特拉凯省科夫诺县的治所。1441年，汉萨同盟在此开设商站，这是立陶宛大公国境内唯一的汉萨商站。因此1444年的科夫诺是一座繁忙河港：德意志商人云集，木材码头与关税收入丰厚，城堡则是科夫诺长老的居所。

到16世纪，城里已有公立学校和医院；博娜·斯福尔扎把科夫诺长老区变为王室领地，并于1533年在此推行沃洛克土地改革。商人的砖房纷纷建起，城墙也动工修筑，却因17世纪中叶的战乱半途而废。1657年瘟疫来袭，1665年俄军几度攻城。1701年瑞典人占领科夫诺并驻扎军队，1706年的《阿尔特兰施泰特条约》结束了这条战线；1708年瘟疫再至，1731和1732年又连遭大火，旧城堡崩塌入河，后来被改成监狱。1794年秋，柯斯丘什科起义中的萨莫吉希亚师在撤退途中经过本县；1795年第三次瓜分后，科夫诺并入俄国。1812年6月，拿破仑在城上游渡过涅曼河，大军当年两度经过科夫诺，使城市遭到毁灭性破坏。

en:
Grodno guards a Neman crossing in Black Ruthenia. First mentioned in 1128 as Goroden, a fortified trading post facing the Yotvingian lands, it entered the Grand Duchy of Lithuania in the thirteenth century and endured repeated Teutonic raids after 1283. Vytautas made it one of his chief seats; after the Knights burned it in 1393, he ordered a brick Gothic castle in 1398, and partial Magdeburg rights followed in 1400. In 1413 Grodno became a county seat in Trakai Voivodeship. In 1444 Casimir IV extended its town rights, granted the stag of Saint Hubert as its coat of arms and confirmed three annual fairs; the council was led in turn by an Orthodox and a Catholic burgomaster. Grodno was therefore a mixed Ruthenian market town and river stronghold on the roads toward Masovia.

Casimir IV died at Grodno Castle in 1492. The Union of Lublin placed Grodno in the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth in 1569, and Stephen Báthory made the castle his residence and headquarters during the Livonian War of 1577–1582; he died there on 12 December 1586. Russian troops under Ivan Khovansky sacked the town in 1655, and it was retaken in 1659. From 1678 every third ordinary Commonwealth Sejm was to meet at Grodno, and Krzysztof Pac rebuilt the castle for parliament and senate, giving the town the informal standing of a third capital. Charles XII's Swedes devastated Grodno in 1708. Between 1765 and 1780 Antoni Tyzenhauz opened eighteen workshops and factories, followed by a royal medical school and botanical garden in 1775 and Gazeta Grodzieńska in 1776. The Grodno Sejm accepted the Second Partition under Russian cannon in 1793, and the town briefly became capital of Grodno Voivodeship. Kościuszko reached it on 30 September 1794; after the rising collapsed, Stanisław August abdicated at the castle on 25 November 1795. Grodno became a Russian governorate seat in 1801 and was briefly occupied by Jérôme Bonaparte's Franco-Polish forces in June–December 1812.
zh:
格罗德诺扼守黑罗斯境内的涅曼河渡口。1128年，它以「戈罗坚」之名首次见于记载，是面向约特温人土地的设防贸易据点。13世纪，格罗德诺并入立陶宛大公国，1283年后屡次遭到条顿骑士团袭击。维陶塔斯把这里作为自己的主要驻地之一；1393年骑士团焚毁城镇后，他于1398年下令修建砖砌哥特式城堡，1400年格罗德诺获得不完整的马格德堡权利。1413年，格罗德诺成为特拉凯省的县城。1444年，卡齐米日四世扩展城市权利，授予圣胡伯特牡鹿城徽，并确认每年举行三次集市；市议会由东正教市长和天主教市长轮流主持。因此，开局时的格罗德诺是一座鲁塞尼亚多元市场城镇和河上要塞，坐落在通往马佐夫舍的道路上。

1492年，卡齐米日四世在格罗德诺城堡去世。1569年，卢布林联合使格罗德诺加入波兰—立陶宛联邦。斯特凡·巴托里在1577—1582年利沃尼亚战争期间把城堡作为驻地和司令部，并于1586年12月12日在此去世。1655年，伊万·霍万斯基率领俄军洗劫城市，1659年格罗德诺被收复。根据1673年议会决定，自1678年起联邦每三次通常议会中就有一次在格罗德诺召开；克日什托夫·帕茨把城堡重建为议会和元老院驻地，使这座城市获得「第三首都」的非正式地位。1708年卡尔十二世的瑞典军队重创格罗德诺。1765—1780年间，安东尼·蒂森豪斯开办十八家工场和工厂；1775年又设立王家医学院和皇家植物园，1776年开始发行《格罗德诺报》。1793年，格罗德诺议会在俄军炮口下接受第二次瓜分，城市短暂成为格罗德诺省省会。1794年9月30日，柯斯丘什科抵达这里；起义失败后，斯坦尼斯瓦夫·奥古斯特于1795年11月25日在城堡退位。1801年，格罗德诺成为俄国格罗德诺省省会；1812年6月至12月，热罗姆·波拿巴的法波联军曾短暂占领此地。

en:
Wizna guards a crossing of the Narew on the old eastern edge of Mazovia. A gord stood here from the eleventh century, watching the river road towards Grodno against Yotvingian and Prussian raiders; a customs chamber is recorded from the mid-eleventh century and a castellany from 1170. The Teutonic Order stormed and burned the gord in 1294, and Duke Bolesław II rebuilt it two years later. In 1382 Siemowit IV pawned Wizna to the Knights for 7,000 florins; it was redeemed only in 1401, and in 1435 it passed to Władysław I of Płock, when the new town received Chełmno rights. In 1444 Wizna was a frontier castle of the Masovian Piasts on the Lithuania–Kraków road, with timber and forest goods floated down the Narew.

In 1495 the town and the Wizna Land were incorporated into the Polish Crown, and from the sixteenth century Wizna hosted the land diets of its county. The late-Gothic church of St John, founded by Duchess Anna of Mazovia, was finished in 1525, and the cortège carrying Sigismund Augustus from Knyszyn to Kraków rested his coffin there. The castle burned in 1603, and Wizna was slowly overshadowed by nearby Łomża, though Augustus the Strong granted it additional fairs in 1710. It passed to Prussia in the Third Partition of 1795, to the Duchy of Warsaw in 1807 and to Russia in 1815.
zh:
维兹纳扼守纳雷夫河的一处渡口，位于马佐夫舍昔日的东部边陲。11世纪起这里就有堡垒，监视着通往格罗德诺的河道，抵御约特文吉人和普鲁士人的袭扰；11世纪中叶已有海关的记载，1170年起设有城主辖区。1294年条顿骑士团攻陷并焚毁堡垒，波列斯瓦夫二世公爵两年后将其重建。1382年，谢莫维特四世以7000弗罗林把维兹纳典当给骑士团，直到1401年才赎回；1435年它转入普沃茨克公爵瓦迪斯瓦夫一世之手，新建的城镇获得海乌姆诺法。1444年的维兹纳是马佐夫舍皮雅斯特王公的边塞城堡，地处立陶宛通往克拉科夫的大道，木材和林产沿纳雷夫河顺流而下。

1495年，城镇连同维兹纳地区并入波兰王国，16世纪起这里是该地区地方议会的召开地。由马佐夫舍的安娜公爵夫人捐资修建的晚期哥特式圣约翰教堂于1525年完工；齐格蒙特·奥古斯特的灵柩从克内申运往克拉科夫途中，曾停放在这座教堂。城堡1603年毁于火灾，维兹纳也逐渐被附近的沃姆扎盖过，不过1710年强者奥古斯特仍赐予它额外的集市权。1795年第三次瓜分后它归属普鲁士，1807年并入华沙公国，1815年转归俄国。

en:
Łęczyca lies on the Bzura in central Poland, the historic capital of the Łęczyca Land. Its gord at nearby Tum was already the chief stronghold of a provincial ruler in the eleventh century, and an assembly held there in 1180 was the first recorded meeting of the Polish sejm. It became the capital of a duchy during the feudal fragmentation and received Magdeburg rights before 1267. In 1331 the Teutonic Knights sacked the town, after which Casimir the Great ringed it with walls and built a brick royal castle; in 1352 the duchy was incorporated into the Crown as the Łęczyca Voivodeship. The Knights burned the castle in 1406, but it was rebuilt in time for Jagiełło's war council of July 1409, and after Grunwald high-ranking Teutonic captives were held there for ransom; in 1420 a Bohemian delegation came here to offer Jagiełło the Czech crown. In 1444 Łęczyca was a royal town and voivodeship capital, freshly granted the staple right that forced passing merchants to sell their wares in its market.

Sejms met at the castle in 1448, 1454 and 1462, and Casimir IV made Łęczyca his headquarters during the Thirteen Years' War of 1454–66 against the Order. Crafts and trade kept the town prosperous until the Swedish Deluge, when the castle was overrun and most of Łęczyca was destroyed; it never fully recovered under the later Commonwealth, though the Warsaw–Dresden road brought kings Augustus II and Augustus III through its gates. Prussia annexed it in 1793 and threw up bastion fortifications around the town. On 16 November 1806 General Dąbrowski's troops entered unopposed, and Łęczyca passed to the Duchy of Warsaw; Austrian troops briefly occupied it in May 1809. From 1815 it belonged to Congress Poland under Russian rule.
zh:
文奇察位于波兰中部的布祖拉河畔，是历史上文奇察地区的首府。附近图姆的设防据点早在11世纪便是一方王公的首要城堡；1180年在此召开的集会，是波兰议会有记载的首次会议。分裂割据时期，它成为文奇察公国的都城，并在1267年前获得马格德堡城市权。1331年条顿骑士团洗劫了这座城市，卡齐米日大王随后为它环城筑墙、建起砖砌的王家城堡；1352年末代文奇察公爵去世，公国并入王国，成为文奇察省。1406年骑士团烧毁城堡，但重建迅速，1409年7月雅盖沃已在此召开作战会议；格伦瓦德战役后，被俘的条顿高级贵族也被关押在此勒索赎金；1420年波希米亚使团还曾到此，提议把捷克王冠献给雅盖沃。1444年的文奇察是王家城市和一省首府，这一年刚取得仓储特权，强制过往商人在本地市集售货。

1448、1454和1462年，王国议会又在城堡召开；1454至1466年的十三年战争期间，卡齐米日四世更把文奇察当作对骑士团作战的大本营。手工业和贸易支撑城市繁荣到17世纪中叶，直到瑞典「大洪水」期间城堡失守、全城大半被毁，此后在共和国晚期再未恢复元气，只有华沙—德累斯顿大道常送奥古斯特二世与奥古斯特三世路过。1793年它被普鲁士吞并，普军还绕城修筑棱堡工事。1806年11月16日，东布罗夫斯基将军的部队兵不血刃入城，文奇察并入华沙公国；1809年5月奥地利军队曾短暂占领。1815年起，它归属俄国治下的波兰会议王国。

en:
Belz occupies a fertile stretch of the Roztocze between the Solokiya and the Richytsia, streams that drain toward the Bug. It was one of the Cherven Cities and entered Kievan Rus in 981, then became the seat of its own duchy in 1170.
