Daniel of Galicia brought it into Halych-Volhynia in 1234, and the Mongols burned the town and castle in 1240. After the Lithuanian and Hungarian contests over Red Ruthenia, Louis of Hungary's governor Wladyslaw of Opole granted Belz Magdeburg rights in 1377. Queen Jadwiga took the town for Poland in 1387, and in 1388 Jogaila granted the duchy to Siemowit IV of Masovia as dowry for his marriage to Jogaila's sister Alexandra. In 1444 the Ruthenian town was held by the Masovian Piasts, its castle guarding the roads toward Lublin and Lwow, with a Jewish community already established in the 1300s.

When Wladyslaw II of Plock, the last Masovian duke of Belz, died in 1462, Casimir IV incorporated the fief and made the town capital of the Belz Voivodeship. Tatar raids devastated it in 1499 and 1502, and by 1620 Belz was protected by three lines of ramparts and four town gates. In 1665 its Jewish community received equal municipal rights and duties. During the First Partition of Poland in 1772 the town passed to the Habsburg monarchy. In 1817 Shalom Rokeach became the first Belzer Rebbe and founded the Belz Hasidic dynasty, making the small Galician town a noted Jewish religious centre.
zh:
贝尔兹位于罗兹托切的肥沃地带，坐落在索洛基亚河与里奇齐亚溪之间，两条水道都流向布格河。它本是切尔文诸城之一，981年并入基辅罗斯，1170年成为一个独立公国的都城。1234年，加利奇的丹尼尔将其并入哈利奇—沃里尼亚；1240年，蒙古人焚毁城镇和城堡。红鲁塞尼亚历经立陶宛与匈牙利争夺后，匈牙利国王路易的总督奥波莱的瓦迪斯瓦夫于1377年授予贝尔兹马格德堡法。1387年，雅德维加为波兰夺取此城；1388年，雅盖沃把公国封给马佐夫舍的谢莫维特四世，作为他与雅盖沃之妹亚历山德拉联姻的嫁妆。因此到1444年，这座鲁塞尼亚城镇由马佐夫舍皮亚斯特家族统治，城堡扼守通往卢布林和利沃夫的道路，犹太社区则在14世纪已经形成。

1462年，末代马佐夫舍系贝尔兹公爵普沃茨克的瓦迪斯瓦夫二世去世，卡齐米日四世收回封邑，设立贝尔兹省并以贝尔兹为首府。1499年和1502年，鞑靼袭掠两度重创城镇；到1620年，贝尔兹已建有三道土墙和四座城门。1665年，当地犹太社区获得与市民同等的权利和义务。1772年第一次瓜分波兰时，贝尔兹转归哈布斯堡君主国。1817年，沙洛姆·罗克阿赫成为首任贝尔兹雷贝，创立贝尔兹哈西德王朝，使这座加利西亚小镇成为知名的犹太宗教中心。

en:
Turov stands on the low meadows where the Yazda and Strumen join the Pripyat, among the Polesian marshes. It was the stronghold of the Dregovichi, one of the chief East Slavic tribes, and the Primary Chronicle names it in 980; a branch of the Baltic-to-Byzantium river road passed its landing stages. One of the earliest Latin-rite churches in the Rus lands was founded there in 1005, and in the 12th century the theologian Cyril of Turov wrote and taught in the town. Mongol raiders struck in 1246, and Turov shrank into an ordinary market town whose bishopric was removed to Pinsk. It passed to the Grand Duchy of Lithuania in the 1320s and in 1430 became the private town of Grand Duke Švitrigaila. In 1444 it was a small Orthodox settlement, shipping wool and timber down the Pripyat in the shadow of Pinsk.

In the late 1400s Turov belonged to the courtier Michael Glinski. Tatars burned it in 1502, and after Glinski fled to Moscow in 1508 it was granted to Hetman Konstanty Ostrogski, who rebuilt it, only for the Tatars to destroy it again in 1521. The Ostrogskis held it for a century, after which it passed with a dowry through the Sapieha family to the Potockis. Cossacks seized the town in 1648, and in 1649 Janusz Radziwiłł's Lithuanians stormed it and put most of the inhabitants to the sword; of the 401 households counted in 1648, only 111 remained by 1667. Turov never recovered its old standing. With the Second Partition of 1793 it went to the Russian Empire as a backwater of Minsk Governorate, and in 1810 a wooden Church of All Saints was raised there.
zh:
图罗夫坐落在亚兹达河与斯特鲁缅河汇入普里皮亚季河的低地草甸，四周是波列西耶沼泽。它是东斯拉夫主要部落之一德列戈维奇人的据点，《往年纪事》在980年已提到它，从波罗的海通往拜占庭的水路有一支经过这里的码头。1005年，罗斯最早的拉丁礼教堂之一在此建立；12世纪，神学家基里尔·图罗夫斯基在城中著书讲学。1246年蒙古来袭，图罗夫衰落成普通集镇，主教区也迁往平斯克。它于1320年代并入立陶宛大公国，1430年成为大公斯维特里盖拉的私领。1444年时，这里是一座东正教小镇，在平斯克的身影下沿普里皮亚季河贩运羊毛和木材。

15世纪末，图罗夫归权臣米哈伊尔·格林斯基所有。1502年鞑靼人焚毁此城，1508年格林斯基逃亡莫斯科后，城市被封给统帅康斯坦丁·奥斯特罗日斯基；他着手重建，但1521年再遭鞑靼人摧毁。奥斯特罗日斯基家族统治一个多世纪后，图罗夫作为嫁妆经萨皮耶哈家族转入波托茨基家族之手。1648年哥萨克占领该城，1649年亚努什·拉齐维乌率立陶宛军队破城，屠戮大部分居民；1648年在册的401户到1667年只剩111户。图罗夫再未恢复旧日地位。1793年第二次瓜分后，它并入俄国，沦为明斯克省的偏僻小镇，1810年一座木制的诸圣教堂在城中建起。

en:
Zhytomyr stands on the Teteriv where the road west from Kyiv turns toward Brest. It was one of the older towns of Kievan Rus, first named in the chronicles in 1240, when Batu Khan's Mongols sacked it after the fall of Kyiv. In the early fourteenth century it passed to the Grand Duchy of Lithuania, whose governors held a wooden castle on the rock above the Kamianka stream. In 1444 Grand Duke Casimir Jagiellon granted the town Magdeburg law. In that year Zhytomyr was a small Orthodox, Ruthenian-speaking borough of the grand duchy, living in the shadow of Crimean Tatar raids.

Tatars burned the town in 1469 and 1481, but during Mengli Giray's great raid of 1482 its castle was one of only four strongholds along the Dnieper that held out. The castle was rebuilt and strengthened after 1540 under Szymon Babiński, and a survey of 1572 counted 142 households. With the Union of Lublin in 1569 Zhytomyr passed to the Kingdom of Poland; as a royal town it housed the starosta and the sejmiks of Kyiv Voivodeship, and in 1596 Sigismund III granted it two annual fairs. Cossacks and Tatars stormed the castle during the Khmelnytsky rising of 1648 and burned the town. The Truce of Andrusovo in 1667 left Kyiv to Muscovy, so the voivodeship courts moved to Zhytomyr, which became the working seat of Kyiv Voivodeship. Jesuits opened a school in 1724, and by 1765 the town had five churches and 285 houses. Annexed to Russia in 1795 after the Third Partition of Poland, Zhytomyr was made capital of the Volhynian Governorate in 1804.
zh:
日托米尔位于捷捷列夫河畔，是基辅西去布列斯特道路的要冲。它本是基辅罗斯最古老的城镇之一，史籍首见于1240年——拔都的蒙古军攻陷基辅后将其洗劫一空。14世纪初，这里并入立陶宛大公国，大公的长官在卡姆扬卡溪畔的高岩上据守一座木堡。1444年，立陶宛大公卡齐米日·雅盖隆颁给此地马格德堡法。这一年的日托米尔是大公国一座说鲁塞尼亚语的东正教小城，常年处在克里米亚鞑靼人袭掠的阴影之下。

1469年和1481年，鞑靼人两度焚毁此城；但1482年明格里·格莱大举入寇时，日托米尔城堡是第聂伯河沿线仅有的四座未陷落的要塞之一。1540年后，城堡在希蒙·巴宾斯基主持下重修加固，1572年的清查计有142户。1569年卢布林联合后，日托米尔随立陶宛南部土地划归波兰王国；作为王室城市，它是城防长官驻地和基辅省地方议会的召开地，1596年齐格蒙特三世又赐其每年开办两次集市。1648年赫梅利尼茨基起义中，哥萨克与鞑靼人攻陷城堡，焚毁全城。1667年安德鲁索沃停战协定把基辅划给莫斯科，省法庭遂迁至日托米尔，这里成为基辅省实际的治所。1724年耶稣会在此开办学校，到1765年全城有五座教堂、285栋房屋。1795年第三次瓜分波兰后，日托米尔并入俄罗斯，1804年成为沃伦省省会。

en:
Bratslav guards the upper Southern Boh in eastern Podolia. The Lithuanian princes Koriatovychi built its first fortress in the early 1360s, after their uncle Algirdas broke Tatar power at the Blue Waters. Vytautas took the castle in 1395 and enfeoffed it to Dmytro Korybut together with Vinnytsia; after passing briefly to Poland in the 1430s it returned to Lithuania, and in 1442 Prince Fedor Ostrozky seized it from Švitrigaila. In 1444 Bratslav is a Lithuanian frontier castle on the Black Tatar Trail, held by an Orthodox Ruthenian garrison under a royal starosta; the salt road from the Black Sea coast to Lutsk runs beneath its walls.

Crimean raids burned the town in 1497 and again, under Devlet Giray, in 1551. Its courts and sejmiks were moved to Vinnytsia in 1554. Bratslav received Magdeburg rights in 1564, and after the Union of Lublin in 1569 it became a royal city and capital of the Bracław Voivodeship, taking its coat of arms in 1589. Nalyvaiko's Cossacks attacked the nobility assembled below the castle in 1594. In 1648 it became a regimental town of the Khmelnytsky Hetmanate, and in 1654 the Cossacks blew the castle up and burned the town. Restored to Poland by the Andrusovo truce of 1667, it was under Ottoman rule from 1672 to 1699 and passed to Russia at the Second Partition in 1793. From 1802 to 1810 Rabbi Nachman taught here, founding the Breslov Hasidic movement.
zh:
布拉茨拉夫扼守东波多里亚的南布格河上游。立陶宛王公科里亚特维奇家族在其叔阿尔吉尔达斯击破鞑靼势力之后，于1360年代初建起最初的要塞。维陶塔斯1395年夺取该堡，把它连同温尼察封给德米特罗·科里布特；1430年代一度归波兰，后又归还立陶宛，1442年费多尔·奥斯特罗兹基王公从斯维特里盖拉手中夺得此地。1444年的布拉茨拉夫是「鞑靼黑路」上的立陶宛边境城堡，由信奉东正教的鲁塞尼亚守军在王室长官统率下戍守；从黑海沿岸通往卢茨克的盐路就从城下经过。

克里米亚鞑靼人1497年焚毁此城，1551年又在杰夫列特·格莱率领下再度焚城。1554年，地方法庭和地方议会迁往温尼察。1564年布拉茨拉夫获马格德堡法，1569年卢布林联合后成为波兰王室城市和布拉茨瓦夫省首府，1589年获颁城徽。1594年，纳雷瓦伊科率领的哥萨克在城堡下袭击集结的贵族。1648年它成为赫梅利尼茨基盖特曼政权的团区城市，1654年哥萨克炸毁城堡、焚毁城区。1667年《安德鲁索沃停战协定》使其复归波兰，1672至1699年受奥斯曼统治，1793年第二次瓜分波兰时归入俄国。1802至1810年，拉比纳赫曼在此讲学，创立了布拉茨拉夫哈西德派。

en:
Cherkasy lies on the right bank of the Dnieper, south of Kyiv, and is documented from the late fourteenth century. In the 1360s it passed to the Grand Duchy of Lithuania, and by 1384 it was a fortified town in the southern defense line that ran through Kaniv, Bratslav and Vinnytsia against the Crimean Tatars, governed by a starosta from its riverside castle. In 1444 Cherkasy was an Orthodox Ruthenian frontier borough of the grand duchy, a mustering place for patrols and for the frontiersmen who were coming to be called Cossacks.

From before 1515 the starosta Ostafiy Dashkevych ruled Cherkasy and Kaniv and led the Dnieper border guard on campaigns against Tatars and Ottomans. In 1532 Khan Saadet Giray besieged the castle with 8,500 Tatars and 1,500 Janissaries; after weeks of assaults and bombardment Dashkevych held out until a Lithuanian relief force came down the Dnieper from Kyiv. His plan for a permanent stronghold beyond the rapids was realised two decades later by another Cherkasy starosta, Dmytro Vyshnevetsky, who built the first Zaporozhian Sich on Mala Khortytsia. A new castle rose on the old site in 1549-1552. After the Union of Lublin in 1569 Cherkasy passed to the Kingdom of Poland, and in 1625 it became the seat of the registered Cossacks' Cherkasy Regiment, which fought through the Khmelnytsky rising of 1648. The Truce of Andrusovo in 1667 left the town to Poland. It was sacked during the Koliyivshchyna revolt of 1768, gained Magdeburg rights in 1791, and after the Second Partition of 1793 was annexed by Russia.
zh:
切尔卡瑟位于第聂伯河右岸、基辅以南，14世纪末始见文献记载。1360年代它并入立陶宛大公国，到1384年已成为南部防线上的设防城镇——这条防线经卡尼夫、布拉茨拉夫、文尼察一线抵御克里米亚鞑靼人，长官由河畔城堡发号施令。1444年的切尔卡瑟是大公国一座信奉东正教的鲁塞尼亚边城，是巡逻队和那些开始被称作哥萨克的边民的集结地。

1515年以前，奥斯塔菲·达什凯维奇出任切尔卡瑟兼卡尼夫长官，率领第聂伯边防军多次出击鞑靼人和奥斯曼人。1532年，萨阿代特·格莱汗以8500名鞑靼人和1500名耶尼切里围攻城堡；强攻炮击持续数周，达什凯维奇坚守不退，直到一支立陶宛援军从基辅顺第聂伯河来援。他提出的在险滩以远常设要塞的设想，二十年后由另一位切尔卡瑟长官德米特罗·维什涅韦茨基实现——后者在小霍尔季察岛建起最早的扎波罗热塞契。1549至1552年，旧堡原址上建起新城堡。1569年卢布林联合后，切尔卡瑟划归波兰王国；1625年这里成为注册哥萨克切尔卡瑟团的驻地，该团参加了1648年开始的赫梅利尼茨基起义。1667年安德鲁索沃停战协定把此城留在波兰一方。1768年科利伊夫希纳起义中城市遭洗劫，1791年获得马格德堡法，1793年第二次瓜分波兰后被俄罗斯吞并。

en:
Severia is the Siverian land along the middle Desna and the Seym, whose capital Novyi Horod, 'the New Town', first appears in Vladimir Monomakh's testament for the winter of 1078-79. After the Council of Liubech in 1097 it became the seat of an appanage principality under the Olhovychi dynasty, guarding Kyiv from the steppe; its smiths smelted the local bog iron and worked it into arms and tools, and in 1185 Prince Igor Sviatoslavich rode from here against the Cumans, the raid remembered in the Tale of Igor's Campaign. Batu's horde obliterated the town in 1239. In 1355 Grand Duke Algirdas took the country from the Golden Horde and enfeoffed it to his son Korybut-Dmytro, and it afterwards passed between several Lithuanian princely houses. In 1444 Severia was a marcher appanage of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania, its ironworks and river roads exposed to both the steppe and Moscow.

In the 1450s Casimir IV granted the town for his keep to the exiled Moscow prince Ivan Shemyachich; his son Vasily defected to Ivan III in 1500, Moscow's troops occupied the town that April, and the truce of 1503 confirmed the land to Muscovy. On 31 December 1604 the 15,000-strong Polish-Cossack host of False Dmitry I routed a much larger Moscow army beneath its walls. Deulino returned Severia to the Commonwealth in 1618, the town received Magdeburg rights in 1620, the first in the Chernihiv country, and in 1635 it became a county seat of Chernihiv Voivodeship. It joined the Khmelnytsky rising, serving the Nizhyn and then the Starodub Cossack regiments, and the 1667 Andrusovo truce assigned it to Russia; in the 1670s Archbishop Lazar Baranovych ran the Left Bank's first printing house and a Slavonic-Latin school at its monastery. From 1781 to 1796 the town was the capital of its own viceroyalty, embracing even Baturyn and Hlukhiv.
zh:
西维利亚是谢韦里安人在杰斯纳河中游和谢伊姆河流域的土地，首府诺夫霍罗德意即「新城」，最早见于弗拉基米尔·莫诺马赫写于1078至1079年冬天的《家训》。1097年柳别奇会议后，这里成为奥利戈维奇王朝封邑公国的都城，为基辅把守草原方向；当地工匠冶炼沼铁，打制兵器和农具。1185年，王公伊戈尔·斯维亚托斯拉维奇从此出兵征讨波洛伏齐人，这次远征后来被写进《伊戈尔远征记》。1239年拔都的大军将该城夷为平地。1355年，立陶宛大公阿尔吉尔达斯从金帐汗国手中夺取此地，封给儿子科里布特-德米特罗，此后它又在立陶宛的几支王公家族间转手。1444年的西维利亚是立陶宛大公国的一个边疆封邑，冶铁作坊和河道商路同时暴露在草原和莫斯科两个方向面前。

1450年代，卡西米尔四世把这座城作为食邑封给流亡来此的莫斯科王公伊万·舍米亚奇奇；他的儿子瓦西里1500年叛投伊凡三世，莫斯科军队当年4月占领该城，1503年的停战又确认了这一归属。1604年12月31日，伪德米特里一世那支一万五千人的波兰-哥萨克联军在城下击溃了人数远多的莫斯科军队。1618年杰乌利诺停战把西维利亚归还联邦，1620年该城获颁马格德堡法，是切尔尼戈夫地区第一个获此权利的城市，1635年成为切尔尼戈夫省的一个县治。它投身赫梅利尼茨基起义，先后隶属尼任团和1663年起的斯塔罗杜布哥萨克团，1667年安德鲁索沃停战将其划归俄国；1670年代，大主教拉扎尔·巴拉诺维奇在当地修道院办起第聂伯河左岸第一家印刷所和一所斯拉夫语-拉丁语学校。1781至1796年，这座城市还曾是单独的总督区驻地，辖地连巴图林和格卢霍夫两座旧都也包括在内。

en:
Satara lies in the southern Desh, where the Venna river joins the Krishna beneath the seven fortified hills that give the place its name. Between 1178 and 1193 the Shilahara raja Bhoja II built on one of them the stronghold later called Ajinkyatara; in 1212 his dynasty fell to the Yadavas of Devagiri, who left the Hemadpanti Yavateshwar temple. After the Khalji conquest of the Deccan in 1296 the country passed to the Bahmani sultans. In 1444 it is a Marathi-speaking Hindu land of millet fields and pasture under Bahmani governors, while the wet forests of its western hills yield timber.

As Bahmani power crumbled, Satara passed to the Adil Shahis of Bijapur, and a town took shape below the fort in the sixteenth century; in 1580 the dowager Chand Bibi was briefly confined there. Shivaji took Parali in May 1673 and the Satara fort that September, wresting it from Bijapur. Rajaram, returning from Jinji in the south, declared Satara his capital in 1698. Aurangzeb besieged the fort from December 1699 and starved it into surrender in April 1700, but the Marathas retook it in 1706. Shahu, released after Aurangzeb's death, was crowned chhatrapati at Satara in 1708 and made the town his capital, laying out thirteen market wards and Shahunagar below the fort; in his forty-two-year reign it was the seat of an empire reaching to the Punjab. In 1750 the dowager Tarabai's quarrel with Rajaram II let the Peshwa Balaji Bajirao dictate the treaty of Sangola, and the Maratha administration moved to Pune, leaving the chhatrapatis as figureheads at Satara. The British took the fort in 1818 during the Third Anglo-Maratha War and installed Pratap Singh as raja of a reduced Satara.
zh:
萨塔拉位于德什南部，地处韦纳河汇入克里希纳河之处，城名来自环绕它的七座堡垒山丘。1178年至1193年间，什拉哈拉（Shilahara）王朝的罗阇波阇二世在其中一座山顶修筑了后来称阿金基亚塔拉的堡垒；1212年该王朝被德瓦吉里的亚达瓦人所灭，亚达瓦时代留下了黑马达潘蒂风格的亚瓦特什瓦尔神庙。1296年卡尔吉人征服德干后，这片土地归入巴赫曼尼苏丹国。1444年的萨塔拉是巴赫曼尼总督治下一片说马拉地语的印度教乡土，遍布小米田和牧场，西山的湿润森林还出产木材。

巴赫曼尼王朝瓦解后，萨塔拉转入比贾布尔的阿迪勒·沙阿王朝，16世纪时堡垒脚下形成城镇，1580年摄政太后昌德·比比曾被短暂囚禁于此。1673年5月希瓦吉夺取帕拉利（今萨姜加德），同年9月又从比贾布尔手中攻下萨塔拉堡。拉贾拉姆从南方的金吉返回后，于1698年宣布以萨塔拉为都。奥朗则布自1699年12月围攻堡垒，守军苦撑半年后于1700年4月出降，1706年马拉塔人又将其夺回。夏胡在奥朗则布死后获释，1708年在萨塔拉堡加冕为贾特拉帕蒂并定都于此，在堡下开辟十三个市集街区和沙胡讷格尔；他在位四十二年，萨塔拉作为帝国之都势力远达旁遮普。1750年，王太后塔拉拜与拉贾拉姆二世的内争让佩什瓦巴拉吉·巴吉拉奥得以强加《桑戈拉条约》，马拉塔朝廷随之迁往浦那，贾特拉帕蒂只在萨塔拉保留虚名。1818年第三次英国—马拉塔战争中英军攻下堡垒，立普拉塔普·辛格为缩小后的萨塔拉土邦的罗阇。

en:
Gingee is a cluster of three steep hillocks on the Tamil plain west of Pondicherry, each crowned by its own citadel and linked by walls across the valley. The Cholas first fortified the hills in the ninth century, the Kadava chiefs held them in the twelfth, and the emperors of Vijayanagara rebuilt them in the fourteenth as a strongpoint on the roads from the Coromandel coast into the Tamil interior. In 1444 a Vijayanagara garrison watched over the surrounding weaving country, whose plain-cotton goods went out through the nearby ports.

In 1509 Krishnadevaraya put the district under Tubaki Krishnappa Nayak, founder of the Nayaks of Gingee, who laid out the fortress as it stands, with its seven-storeyed Kalyana Mahal, granaries and hilltop temples; after Talikota in 1565 his successors ruled as kings. Bijapur and Golconda overran them in 1649, and in July 1677 Shivaji took the fort in his southern conquest, had its mud walls rebuilt in granite and called it the most impregnable fortress in India. The Mughals needed a seven-year siege to take it in 1698. Aurangzeb granted it to the Bundela Rajput Swarup Singh in 1700, and in 1714 his son Tej Singh died in battle against Saadatullah Khan of Arcot, a defeat still remembered in Tamil ballad. The French under Bussy seized Gingee in 1750 and held it until the British took it in 1761; Hyder Ali briefly captured it before it returned to the East India Company.
zh:
京吉是本地治里以西泰米尔平原上三座陡峭山丘的总称，每座山顶各有一座卫城，城墙沿谷地相连。朱罗人9世纪首建山寨，12世纪卡达瓦酋长据守于此，14世纪毗奢耶那伽罗皇帝加以重建，作为扼守科罗曼德海岸通往泰米尔内陆道路的要塞。1444年，毗奢耶那伽罗的驻军镇守着这片以织布为生的乡野，当地出产的棉布经附近港口外销。

1509年，克里希纳·德瓦·拉亚把这一地区封给图巴基·克里希纳帕·纳亚克——京吉纳亚克王朝的开创者；他奠定了后世所见要塞的格局，七层的卡里亚纳宫、粮仓和山顶神庙都建于此时。1565年塔利科塔之战后，其子孙称王建政。1649年，比贾布尔与高康达联手攻灭纳亚克王朝；1677年7月，希瓦吉南征时夺取此堡，下令把土墙改成花岗岩，并称它是印度最难攻克的要塞。莫卧儿人围城七年，才在1698年将其攻陷。1700年奥朗则布把京吉封给本德拉拉杰普特人斯瓦鲁普·辛格；1714年，其子特杰·辛格在与阿尔果德纳瓦布萨阿达图拉汗的交战中兵败身死，这段故事一直传唱于泰米尔民谣。1750年，比西率法军夺取京吉，直到1761年才为英国所占；海德尔·阿里曾一度攻占，要塞最终复归东印度公司。

en:
Bidar commands a rocky height on the Maidan. Ulugh Khan, the future Muhammad bin Tughluq, took its old fort from the Kakatiyas in 1321-22, and the Bahmanis held the place after founding their sultanate in 1347. Ahmad Shah I moved the Bahmani capital from Gulbarga to Bidar in 1427, and reconstruction of the fort ran from 1429 to 1432, with Persian and Turkish architects raising stone walls, palaces, mosques, madrasas and gardens above the Deccan roads. In 1444, therefore, Bidar was the new royal capital: Kannada-speaking villagers and townspeople lived around a Persianate Muslim court whose factions and caravan wealth already linked the Maidan with Goa, Gujarat and the Persian Gulf.

Mahmud Gawan, a Persian trader from Gilan, came to Bidar in 1453 and became the sultanate's chief minister; his residential madrasa, completed in 1471-72, became the scholarly landmark of the capital. After Bahmani power collapsed, Qasim Barid took control of state affairs in 1492, Amir Barid was practically independent after the last Bahmani sultan fled in 1527, and Ali Barid Shah first assumed royal title in 1542 before joining the Deccan coalition against Vijayanagara at Talikota in 1565. The last Barid Shahi ruler, Amir Barid III, was defeated and Bidar was annexed by Ibrahim Adil Shah II of Bijapur in 1619. In March 1657 the Mughal prince Aurangzeb besieged Bidar Fort for twenty-seven days; the governor Siddi Marjan surrendered and died of his wounds, and the city passed to the Mughals. With the foundation of the Asaf Jahi state in 1724, Bidar entered the Nizam of Hyderabad's dominions, and Salabat Jang ruled from its fort between 1751 and 1762. By 1821 it remained a fortress of the Hyderabad Deccan rather than a Maratha or British possession.
zh:
比德尔雄踞在马坦高原的岩石高地上。未来的穆罕默德·本·图格鲁克，当时的兀鲁黑汗，于1321年至1322年从卡卡蒂亚王朝手中夺取旧堡；巴赫曼尼苏丹国1347年建立后，比德尔归入其统治。艾哈迈德沙阿一世1427年把巴赫曼尼都城从古尔伯加迁到比德尔，堡垒重建工程从1429年持续到1432年，波斯和突厥建筑师在德干大道旁筑起石墙、宫殿、清真寺、学院和园林。因此在1444年，比德尔已是崭新的王都：说卡纳达语的乡民与城镇居民生活在波斯化的穆斯林宫廷周围，朝内派系和商队财富把这片马坦高原同果阿、古吉拉特和波斯湾联系起来。

来自吉兰的波斯商人马哈茂德·加万1453年来到比德尔，后来成为苏丹国首席大臣；他创办的住宿式学院1471年至1472年完工，成为这座都城的学术标志。巴赫曼尼权力瓦解后，卡西姆·巴里德1492年掌控国政，末代巴赫曼尼苏丹1527年出逃后，阿米尔·巴里德已实际独立；阿里·巴里德沙阿1542年率先称沙阿，并在1565年参加德干联军，于塔利哥达对抗毗奢耶那伽罗。末代巴里德沙希君主阿米尔·巴里德三世最终战败，比德尔于1619年被比贾布尔的易卜拉欣·阿迪尔沙阿二世吞并。1657年3月，莫卧儿皇子奥朗则布围攻比德尔堡二十七天，守将西迪·马尔詹投降后伤重而死，城市转入莫卧儿之手。1724年阿萨夫·贾希国家建立后，比德尔成为海得拉巴尼扎姆领地的一部分，萨拉巴特·章还曾在1751年至1762年间以这座堡垒执政。到1821年，它仍是海得拉巴德干的要塞，而不属于马拉塔或英国。

en:
Penukonda crowns a steep, boulder-strewn hill in the dry western Rayalaseema uplands, where the roads from the Tungabhadra frontier run south towards Bangalore and the Tamil country. Hoysala kings first fortified the height, and the early rulers of Vijayanagara rebuilt it into one of the empire's western strongholds; a Jain image of Parshvanatha was consecrated in the town in 1359. In 1444, under Deva Raya II, a Telugu governor held the fort for Vijayanagara, and the black-cotton plains below grew the cloth that fed the empire's inland trade.

After the catastrophe of Talikota in 1565, Tirumala Deva Raya carried the imperial court and treasures up to Penukonda, which served as the empire's capital until 1592 and weathered Bijapuri sieges in 1567-68 and 1576, and a Qutb Shahi one in 1590. Venkatapati Deva Raya then moved the court to Chandragiri, but Penukonda remained a great governorship: its dalavayi Koneti Nayudu beat off a Bijapuri army under Mustafa Khan in 1645, only for Khan Muhammad to take the fort for Bijapur in 1653. With the fall of Bijapur to Aurangzeb in 1686 the district passed to the Mughals and then to the Nizam of Hyderabad, who in 1743 granted Penukonda to the Maratha captain Murari Rao of Gooty. After Hyder Ali of Mysore took Murari Rao's forts with the fall of Gooty in 1775, they returned to the Nizam under the Treaty of Seringapatam in 1792 and were ceded to the East India Company in 1800 as part of the Ceded Districts.
zh:
贝努贡达坐落在拉雅拉西玛西部干旱高原一座巨石嶙峋的陡峭山巅，扼守着从栋格珀德拉边境通往班加罗尔和泰米尔地区的道路。曷萨拉国王最早在此筑垒，毗奢耶那伽罗早期君主把它扩建成帝国西线重镇之一；1359年，城中供奉了一尊耆那教的巴湿伐那陀像。1444年，在德瓦拉亚二世治下，一名泰卢固总督替毗奢耶那伽罗镇守此堡，山下黑棉土平原出产的布匹供应着帝国的内陆贸易。

1565年塔利科塔惨败之后，蒂鲁马拉·德瓦·拉亚把朝廷和帝国财库迁到贝努贡达。此地作为帝国都城直至1592年，先后顶住了1567—1568年、1576年比贾布尔的围攻和1590年高康达的围攻。文卡塔帕蒂·德瓦·拉亚后来把朝廷迁往钱德拉吉里，但贝努贡达仍是一大方镇：1645年守将科内蒂·奈杜击退了穆斯塔法汗率领的比贾布尔大军，然而1653年汗·穆罕默德终为比贾布尔夺取此堡。1686年比贾布尔被奥朗则布攻灭，这一地区随之归入莫卧儿，后来转属海得拉巴尼扎姆；1743年，尼扎姆把贝努贡达封给以古提为据点的马拉塔将领穆拉里·拉奥。1775年古提陷落后，迈索尔的海德尔·阿里顺势取得穆拉里·拉奥的各处山堡；1792年《塞林伽巴丹条约》后这些堡垒归还尼扎姆，1800年作为「割让诸县」的一部分移交东印度公司。

en:
Hunyad is the iron-bearing country of southern Transylvania, stretching from the mines above Hunedoara toward the Mureș at Alba Iulia. The settlement was first recorded as Hungnod in 1265; German merchants called the later market Eisenmarkt, and Dacian and Roman furnaces showed how old the local ironworking was. In 1409 Sigismund of Luxembourg granted the Hunedoara domain to Voicu, whose son John Hunyadi turned the old fortress into the great Gothic castle of his family. Alba Iulia, seat of the Transylvanian bishopric on the Mureș, was John's base while he prepared his 1442 Ottoman campaign. In 1444 the county was therefore a Hungarian frontier lordship: its forges supplied weapons, its Vlach highlanders pastured flocks, and Catholic Hungarians and Saxons lived among an Orthodox Romanian population.

John Hunyadi died in 1456 after the relief of Belgrade; his son Matthias Corvinus enlarged the castle and confirmed the iron town's privileges. During György Dózsa's peasant revolt of 1514, rebels from the Hunedoara domain were imprisoned there. After Mohács in 1526, Transylvania became an Ottoman-tributary principality, and in 1542 Alba Iulia became its capital. John II Sigismund rebuilt the princely palace, later enlarged by Stephen Báthory and Gabriel Bethlen. On 1 November 1599 Michael the Brave entered Alba Iulia and for a brief time united Transylvania with Wallachia and Moldavia. A blast furnace was operating by 1603, and a steel mill stood on the Cerna by 1667. The Habsburgs took the city in 1690 and ended princely rule in 1711; the star-shaped Alba Carolina fortress was built from 1716 to 1735. The treasury took the iron works in hand in 1743, and during the peasant rising of 1784 county peasants besieged Deva before Horea, Cloșca and Crișan were executed in Alba Iulia in January 1785.
zh:
胡尼奥德是南特兰西瓦尼亚的铁乡，从胡内多阿拉山间矿区延伸到穆列什河畔的阿尔巴尤利亚。1265年，此地以Hungnod之名首见记载；德意志商人后来把这个铁市称作Eisenmarkt，达契亚和罗马时期留下的熔炉也说明当地冶铁由来已久。1409年，卢森堡的西吉斯蒙德将胡内多阿拉领地封给沃伊库，其子匈雅提·亚诺什把旧堡垒扩建成家族的哥特式大城堡。穆列什河畔的阿尔巴尤利亚是特兰西瓦尼亚主教驻地，1442年匈雅提曾在此筹备对奥斯曼作战。1444年，这里是匈牙利边防贵族领地：铁匠炉打造兵器，弗拉赫山民放牧牛羊，天主教匈牙利人、萨克森人与东正教罗马尼亚人杂居。

1456年贝尔格莱德解围后，匈雅提·亚诺什去世；其子马加什·科尔温扩建城堡，也确认这座铁城的商业特权。1514年哲尔吉·多饶农民起义期间，胡内多阿拉领地上的起事者被关入城堡。1526年莫哈赤战役后，特兰西瓦尼亚成为向奥斯曼纳贡的公国，阿尔巴尤利亚于1542年成为都城。约翰二世·西吉斯蒙德重建亲王府，后来斯特凡·巴托里和拜特伦·加博尔又加以扩建。1599年11月1日，勇敢者米哈伊进入阿尔巴尤利亚，短暂将特兰西瓦尼亚、瓦拉几亚和摩尔多瓦联合在自己治下。到1603年，当地已有高炉运转；1667年，切尔纳河畔建起钢厂。哈布斯堡于1690年占领该城，1711年结束公国统治；星形的阿尔巴卡罗莱纳要塞建于1716—1735年。1743年，官府直接接管铁厂。1784年农民起义时，本县农民围攻德瓦，霍雷亚、克洛什卡和克里尚最终于1785年1月在阿尔巴尤利亚被处死。

en:
Máramaros fills the forested north-eastern corner of the Hungarian kingdom, where the Tisza gathers its first waters under the Carpathian passes. The mountains yielded timber, pitch and potash, and the royal salt mines at Aknaszlatina fed the salt road guarded by Huszt, the county castle; the terra Huzth is first recorded in 1324 and the town was granted privileges in 1329. The fortress, said to have been raised by St Ladislaus I against the Cumans and ruined by the Mongols, is documented from 1353. Below its walls lived Orthodox Ruthenian and Romanian highlanders, herdsmen and loggers, under a Catholic Hungarian ispán. In 1444 the mountain county was a quiet but wealthy edge of the realm, living on salt and masts.

In 1458 King Matthias had his rebellious uncle Mihály Szilágyi imprisoned in the castle, and in 1514 Dózsa's peasants actually seized it. After Mohács Máramaros passed to Transylvania, though Ferdinand I's troops took Huszt in 1546. A Crimean Tatar host poured through the Torun pass in 1594 and wasted the county without taking the fortress; it endured sieges by György Rákóczi I in 1644, by the Poles in 1657 and by Ottoman and Tatar hordes in 1661–62, and the former prince Ferenc Rhédey died within its walls in 1667. On the night of 17 August 1703 the German garrison murdered its captain and went over to the kurucs, from whom the independence of Transylvania was proclaimed; on 12 May 1711 Colonel Acton retook it, the last fortress of Rákóczi's rising. Three lightning strikes burned it on 3 July 1766, and the last tower fell in 1798.
zh:
马拉马勒什位于匈牙利王国森林密布的东北角，蒂萨河在喀尔巴阡诸山口下汇出最初的水流。群山出产木材、松脂和草木灰，王室的阿克瑙斯拉蒂瑙盐矿则走出一条受胡斯特城堡护卫的盐路；胡斯特之地1324年首见记载，1329年获颁市镇特权。城堡据传为圣拉斯洛一世防御库曼人所建、后毁于蒙古人之手，1353年才有确证。城堡之下住着信奉东正教的鲁塞尼亚与罗马尼亚山民，他们放牧、伐木，受天主教的匈牙利州长管辖。1444年时，这个山地州是王国安静却富庶的边陲，靠食盐和船桅为生。

1458年，国王马加什把谋反的舅父西拉吉·米哈伊囚禁在这座城堡；1514年，多饶的农民军更是一度将它攻占。莫哈奇战役后，马拉马勒什随特兰西瓦尼亚而去，但1546年斐迪南一世的军队拿下了胡斯特。1594年，一支克里米亚鞑靼大军经托罗尼亚山口涌入，蹂躏全州却未能攻下要塞；此后它又接连承受1644年拉科齐·哲尔吉一世、1657年波兰人、1661—1662年奥斯曼与鞑靼人的围攻，前特兰西瓦尼亚大公赖代伊·费伦茨于1667年逝于堡中。1703年8月17日夜，德意志守军杀死长官、投往库鲁茨一方，特兰西瓦尼亚的独立也由此宣告；1711年5月12日，阿克顿上校夺回城堡——这是拉科齐起事最后陷落的要塞。1766年7月3日，三道雷火击中城堡将其烧毁，最后一座塔楼也于1798年倾塌。

en:
Szabolcs was one of the oldest counties of the Kingdom of Hungary, on the left bank of the Tisza, named after its first seat. Its greatest town, Debrecen, first recorded as Debrezun in 1235, grew out of three villages after the Mongol invasion, and in 1361 Louis the Great gave it market-town rights with a freely elected judge and council. Fairs and the cattle trade made it rich. Sigismund handed it in 1411 to the Serbian ruler Stefan Lazarević, and in 1444 it belonged to his successor Đurađ Branković.

The Hunyadi family held Debrecen from 1450 to 1507. Its protector Bálint Török brought in the Reformation in 1536, the Reformed College opened in 1538, and by 1552 no Catholic congregation remained in the 'Calvinist Rome'. Having no walls, the town survived between Ottomans, Habsburgs and Transylvania by diplomacy, driving its cattle to German markets. In 1605 Stephen Bocskai ennobled 9,254 hajdú soldiers and settled them at Kálló, Nánás, Dorog, Hadház and Vámospércs; by 1609 seven hajdú towns stood in Szabolcs, later forming their own Hajdú District. Leopold I made Debrecen a free royal town in 1693, and by the 18th century it was the largest town in Hungary.
zh:
索博尔奇是匈牙利王国最古老的州之一，位于蒂萨河左岸，得名于最初的州治。境内最大的城镇德布勒森1235年首见于文献，写作「Debrezun」，由三个村庄在蒙古入侵后合并而成；1361年拉约什一世授予它集镇特许状，市民可以自选法官和议会。集市和牲口买卖让这里富了起来。1411年西吉斯蒙德把德布勒森交给塞尔维亚君主斯特凡·拉扎雷维奇，1444年它属于其继承人久拉德·布兰科维奇。

1450年至1507年，德布勒森归匈雅提家族所有。庇护此城的特勒克·巴林特于1536年引入宗教改革，1538年创办归正会学院，到1552年这座「加尔文派的罗马」已没有天主教会众。城无城墙，只能在奥斯曼、哈布斯堡和特兰西瓦尼亚之间靠外交周旋求存，把牛群赶往德意志的市场。1605年，博奇考伊·伊什特万册封9254名海杜克士兵为贵族，把他们安置在卡洛、纳纳什、多罗格、哈德哈兹和瓦莫什佩尔奇；到1609年，索博尔奇境内已有七座海杜克城镇，后来组成独立的海杜克区。1693年利奥波德一世把德布勒森升为王室自由市，到18世纪它已是匈牙利最大的城市。

en:
Torontál, the western Banat, is a flat, watery land between the Tisza and the Béga, whose marshes and pastures raised the cattle driven west to the markets of Germany. Its chief town, Bečkerek on the Béga, appears in the papal tithe lists of 1326–32 and had become a market town by 1422. After the Ottoman conquest of the Serb lands, refugees settled here, and in 1403 King Sigismund granted the town to the Serbian despot Stefan Lazarević, who held it as a Hungarian vassal and great head of Torontál county. In 1444 the plain was thus a march where Hungarian lords and Orthodox Serb herdsmen lived under the crown of Hungary.

In 1514 the peasant bands of György Dózsa foraged across the Banat. In September 1551 the army of Sokollu Mehmed Pasha took Bečej, and Bečkerek surrendered on 25 September; after Timișoara fell in 1552 it became the Sanjak of Beçkerek in the new Temeşvar eyalet. Early in the Long Turkish War, in 1594, Bishop Teodor of Vršac led some 5,000 local Serbs in revolt and seized several towns before the rising was drowned in blood, for which Sinan Pasha burned the relics of Saint Sava at Belgrade. Bečkerek stayed Ottoman until August 1716, when the Habsburg reconquest made it part of the crown land of Temeswar Banat. German colonists arrived from 1718, a short-lived Catalan 'New Barcelona' rose near the town in 1735–38, and Maria Theresa granted market-town rights in 1769.
zh:
多伦塔尔是巴纳特的西部，地处蒂萨河与贝加河之间，地势平坦、水网密布，沼泽牧场上养大的牛群被向西赶往德意志的市集。其首镇、贝加河畔的贝什凯雷克（Nagybecskerek，今塞尔维亚兹雷尼亚宁）在1326—1332年的教廷什一税册中已有记载，1422年已成为集镇。奥斯曼征服塞尔维亚故地后，难民纷纷来此定居；1403年，国王西吉斯蒙德把此镇封给塞尔维亚专制公斯特凡·拉扎列维奇，后者以匈牙利封臣、多伦塔尔州最高长官的身份统治此地。因此1444年时，这片平原是匈牙利王冠治下匈牙利领主与东正教塞尔维亚牧人共处的边地。

1514年，多饶·捷尔吉的农民队伍在巴纳特辗转就食。1551年9月，索库鲁·穆罕默德帕夏的大军攻克贝切伊，贝什凯雷克于9月25日投降；1552年蒂米什瓦拉陷落后，它成为新设泰梅什瓦尔行省的贝奇凯雷克桑贾克。长土耳其战争初期的1594年，弗尔沙茨主教泰奥多尔率领约五千名当地塞尔维亚人起事，连下数镇后被血腥镇压；作为报复，锡南帕夏在贝尔格莱德焚烧了圣萨瓦的遗骨。贝什凯雷克的奥斯曼统治一直延续到1716年8月，哈布斯堡的反攻把它并入王室领地泰梅什瓦尔巴纳特。1718年起德意志垦户陆续迁入，1735—1738年又有人在镇旁建起加泰罗尼亚人的「新巴塞罗那」，但终归失败；1769年，玛丽亚·特蕾西亚授予其集镇特权。

en:
Kholmogory grew from villages beside a channel of the Northern Dvina, in the fur-bearing Dvina Land that Novgorod knew as Zavolochye. A charter names Kolmogory between 1328 and 1340, and Novgorod raised its first wooden fort there at the end of the fourteenth or beginning of the fifteenth century. Boats carried furs, fish and salt along the Dvina between the White Sea hinterland and Novgorod, while Moscow's rivals burned the place in 1417 and Norwegians raided the river mouth in 1419. In 1444 it was a small Orthodox Novgorodian frontier market, exposed to northern raiders and Muscovite expansion, whose wealth came chiefly from furs.

After Ivan III absorbed Novgorod, Kholmogory passed to Moscow with the rest of Dvina Land in 1478. In 1553 Richard Chancellor was received there after reaching the White Sea and was sent on to Moscow; English merchants then used the town for their Russian fur and hemp trade, opening ropeworks in the 1560s. Ivan IV founded downstream New Kholmogory, later Arkhangelsk, in 1584, yet Kholmogory remained the seat of the Dvina voivode from 1587. A five-towered wooden kremlin, raised in autumn 1613, withstood a Polish-Lithuanian siege on 8 December; an eleven-towered fort replaced it in 1621. The new diocese of 1682 brought stone cathedral building, icon painting and carved-bone work. Administration moved to Arkhangelsk in 1702 and the bishop's see followed in 1762. From 1744 the deposed Brunswick family was confined in the town; Anton Ulrich died there in 1774 and the survivors left in 1780.
zh:
霍尔莫戈雷由北德维纳河一条支汊旁的几座村落发展而成，地处诺夫哥罗德所称扎沃洛切的毛皮产地德维纳之地。1328至1340年间的一份文书首次以科尔莫戈雷之名提到这里，14世纪末至15世纪初，诺夫哥罗德人在此建起第一座木堡。船只沿德维纳河往来，把白海腹地的毛皮、鱼和盐运往诺夫哥罗德；1417年莫斯科一方的军队焚毁此地，1419年挪威人又袭掠河口。1444年时，这里是一座规模不大的东正教诺夫哥罗德边疆市场，受北方袭掠者和莫斯科扩张的双重威胁，财富主要来自毛皮。

伊凡三世吞并诺夫哥罗德后，霍尔莫戈雷于1478年随德维纳之地并入莫斯科。1553年，理查德·钱塞勒抵达白海后在此受到接待，再被送往莫斯科；英国商人随后通过此城经营对俄毛皮和大麻贸易，并在1560年代开设缆索作坊。伊凡四世1584年在下游建立新霍尔莫戈雷，即后来的阿尔汉格尔斯克，但霍尔莫戈雷仍自1587年起成为德维纳督军驻地。1613年秋，五塔木构克里姆林建成，并在12月8日顶住波兰-立陶宛军队围攻；1621年，一座十一塔新堡取而代之。1682年设立教区后，石造大堂、圣像画和骨雕在此发展。行政中心1702年迁往阿尔汉格尔斯克，主教座堂也于1762年迁走。1744年起，被废黜的不伦瑞克家族被幽禁于此；安东·乌尔里希1774年死在当地，幸存者1780年离开。

en:
Suzdal grew on a bend of the Kamenka, on the site of a Meryan settlement, and the chronicles first name it in 1024. By 1096 it was fortified, and under Vladimir Monomakh and his son Yury Dolgorukiy it became the capital of the Rostov-Suzdal land, the nucleus from which Vladimir-Suzdal and then Muscovy grew; the seat moved to Vladimir in 1157. Sacked like its neighbours in the Mongol invasion of 1238, it remained the centre of a smaller Suzdal principality, which in 1341 joined with Nizhny Novgorod, only for its prince to remove his court there in 1350. Vasily I of Moscow annexed the principality in 1392, so that in 1444 Suzdal was an ancient cathedral town of Muscovy, ringed by monasteries though long past its political prime.

Its hour of disaster came on 7 July 1445, when beneath the walls of the St Euthymius Monastery the Kazan Tatars routed the army of Vasily II and carried the grand prince off captive; Suzdal was plundered and burned, and the vaults of the Nativity Cathedral collapsed, to be rebuilt only in 1530 under Vasily III. The town became one of Muscovy's great monastic centres, with the St Euthymius and Intercession houses among the largest in the land, and in 1565 Ivan the Terrible numbered Suzdal among his oprichnina towns. During the Time of Troubles it went over to the Tushino camp and Lisowski's raiders, and by 1610 only 78 households survived in the posad; the Poles besieged it for six months in 1611 in vain, Crimean Tatars raided in 1634, and the plague of 1654–1655 carried off almost half its 2,467 people. Recovery followed, and by 1681 Suzdal counted 515 households and became the recruiting ground of the wandering peddlers known as ofeni. In 1708 it headed Suzdal Province within Moscow Governorate, and from 1778 it was an uyezd town of Vladimir Viceroyalty, its merchants crowning the town in the eighteenth century with some thirty new churches under the regular plan of 1788.
zh:
苏兹达尔坐落在卡缅卡河的一道河弯上，前身是梅里亚人的定居点，编年史首次提到它是在1024年。1096年时它已有设防，在弗拉基米尔·莫诺马赫及其子尤里·多尔戈鲁基治下成为罗斯托夫-苏兹达尔领地的都城——日后的弗拉基米尔-苏兹达尔乃至莫斯科公国皆由此发端；1157年都城迁往弗拉基米尔。1238年蒙古入侵时它与邻城一同遭劫，此后仍是较小的苏兹达尔公国的中心，该公国1341年与下诺夫哥罗德合并，而公爵1350年干脆把宫廷迁去了那里。1392年莫斯科大公瓦西里一世吞并公国，到1444年，苏兹达尔已是莫斯科公国一座古老的主教座堂城镇，修道院环布，但政治上的鼎盛岁月早已逝去。

灾难在1445年7月7日降临：在救世主圣叶夫菲米修道院墙下，喀山鞑靼人击溃瓦西里二世的军队并俘虏了大公本人，苏兹达尔遭洗劫焚毁，圣母圣诞大教堂的穹顶坍塌，直到1530年才在瓦西里三世治下修复。此后苏兹达尔成为俄罗斯最大的修道中心之一，圣叶夫菲米修道院和圣母帡幪修道院都属全国最富有的修院之列；1565年伊凡雷帝将苏兹达尔列入特辖区城市。动乱时期它倒向图希诺营和利索夫斯基的队伍，到1610年城郊工商区只剩78户；1611年波兰人围城六个月而不克，1634年克里米亚鞑靼人又来劫掠，1654至1655年的瘟疫夺去全城近一半人口，当时居民仅有2467人。随后经济复苏，1681年苏兹达尔有515户人家，并成为走南闯北的行脚商贩「奥费尼亚」的故乡。1708年它成为莫斯科省苏兹达尔区的首城，1778年起为弗拉基米尔总督区的县城；18世纪里，本地商人按1788年的正规规划建起约三十座新教堂，装点了这座小城。

en:
Galich Mersky arose around 1159 on the southern shore of Lake Galichskoye, an outpost of the Rostov-Suzdal princes in Merya country; the chronicles first name it in 1237, when the Tatar raids reached 'Galich Mersky' on the Volga. In 1246 it became the seat of its own princes, a line sprung from a younger brother of Alexander Nevsky, until Dmitry Donskoy drove them out in 1362. The town then passed to his son Yury of Galich, whose claim to the grand princely throne opened the long Muscovite civil war. Sacked by the Kazan khan Ulugh Muhammad in 1439, in 1444 Galich was the stronghold of Yury's son Dmitry Shemyaka, then mustering his revolt against Vasily II, while its markets handled the salt boiled at Sol Galitskaya and the furs coming out of the north-east.

Vasily II's men took Galich and ended the principality in 1450; Shemyaka died poisoned in Novgorod three years later. A new fortress made the town Moscow's forward base against Kazan, and Tatar and Cheremis raiders still swept the district in 1522, until the fall of Kazan in 1552 pushed the frontier east. In the Time of Troubles Lisowski's Poles burned Galich on 3 January 1609 and it was harried again in 1619, leaving barely a sixth of its former people. It recovered on trade, sending salt, lake fish and Siberian furs to Arkhangelsk and Moscow; then Peter I had its wooden kremlin demolished, and the shift of Russia's foreign trade from Arkhangelsk to his new capital drew the caravans away. In 1778 Catherine II confirmed Galich as an uyezd town, and its old earthen ramparts were known thereafter as the Shemyaka Hills.
zh:
加利奇（又称梅尔斯基的加利奇）约在1159年兴于加利奇湖南岸，是罗斯托夫-苏兹达尔王公向梅里亚人地区推进的前沿据点；编年史首次提到它是在1237年，当时鞑靼人的兵锋沿伏尔加河「直至加利奇·梅尔斯基」。1246年它成为一支独立王公的驻地，王统一支出自亚历山大·涅夫斯基之弟，1362年被德米特里·顿斯科伊逐走。城池随后传给顿斯科伊之子加利奇的尤里，他对大公之位的要求引爆了漫长的莫斯科内战。1439年，喀山汗兀鲁·穆罕默德的军队洗劫加利奇；1444年，这里是尤里之子德米特里·舍米亚卡的据点，他正整军反叛瓦西里二世，而城中市场已经在经营索利加利奇熬煮的食盐和从东北方运来的毛皮。

1450年，瓦西里二世的军队攻占加利奇，公国终结；三年后舍米亚卡在诺夫哥罗德被毒杀。新修的城堡把这里变成莫斯科对抗喀山的前进基地，1522年鞑靼与切列米斯骑兵仍突入县境劫掠，直到1552年喀山陷落，边防才向东推移。混乱时代中，利索夫斯基麾下的波兰人于1609年1月3日焚毁加利奇，1619年城池再遭兵燹，居民只剩战前的六分之一。它靠贸易复苏，把食盐、湖鱼和西伯利亚毛皮销往阿尔汉格尔斯克与莫斯科；后来彼得一世下令拆除木构克里姆林宫，俄国对外贸易又从阿尔汉格尔斯克转向他的新都城，商队于是改道。1778年，叶卡捷琳娜二世核准加利奇为县城，城外古老的土筑壁垒此后被称作「舍米亚卡岗」。

en:
Kargopol lies on both sides of the Onega River just north of Lake Lacha, on a route from the Russian interior to the White Sea. Finno-Ugric peoples held the country before Novgorodian colonists occupied the Onega banks in the twelfth century, and monasteries appeared by the mid-fourteenth. A later monastic manuscript gave 1146 as a traditional founding date, but the first reliable chronicle mention comes in 1378; in 1380 Prince Gleb of Kargopol led his retinue to the Battle of Kulikovo. In 1444 the Orthodox town was within Novgorod's northern sphere, already placed to handle fish, salt and furs on the Pomor trade route.

In 1447 Dmitry Shemyaka took refuge in Kargopol while fleeing Vasily II. After Novgorod submitted to Moscow in 1478, the Onega lands down to the White Sea were organized as Kargopol district under a Muscovite governor. A new fort and posad were built in the sixteenth century, and in 1539 the town received a charter of local self-government; its merchants held privileges in the Pomor salt and fish trade, rafted timber, bought furs and supplied iron. In 1588 the English ambassador Giles Fletcher listed Kargopol among Russia's notable towns. During the Time of Troubles its rectangular fortress was built after the sack of Vologda; Ivan Bolotnikov was blinded and drowned there in 1607, and the town withstood a long Cossack siege in 1614. A tax revolt broke out in the spring of 1648. Kargopol was assigned to the Olonets shipyard in 1703 and to Ingermanland Governorate in 1708. A fire in 1765 destroyed nine churches and much of the town, after which it was rebuilt on a regular plan; the rise of St Petersburg and the Baltic trade gradually drained away its old commerce.
zh:
卡尔戈波尔位于奥涅加河两岸、拉恰湖北不远处，扼守俄罗斯内陆通往白海的道路。乌戈尔-芬兰语族群曾居住此地，12世纪诺夫哥罗德移民占据奥涅加河两岸，14世纪中期已有修道院。后世修道院手稿把1146年作为传统建城年份，但可靠编年史最早在1378年提到这里；1380年，卡尔戈波尔王公格列布率卫队参加库里科沃之战。1444年时，这座东正教城镇处在诺夫哥罗德的北方势力范围内，已因波莫尔商路上的鱼、盐和毛皮贸易而占有一席之地。

1447年，德米特里·舍米亚卡为躲避瓦西里二世逃入卡尔戈波尔。1478年诺夫哥罗德臣服莫斯科后，奥涅加河直至白海的土地被划为卡尔戈波尔县，由莫斯科派出的长官治理。16世纪，当地修建新堡和工商区，1539年又获得地方自治特许；商人享有波莫尔盐鱼贸易特权，同时筏运木材、收购毛皮并供应铁。1588年，英格兰使节吉尔斯·弗莱彻把卡尔戈波尔列为俄罗斯的重要城镇之一。动乱时期，沃洛格达遭劫后，这里修建起矩形要塞；1607年，伊凡·博洛特尼科夫被押到此处刺瞎并溺死，城镇又在1614年顶住哥萨克的长期围攻。1648年春，卡尔戈波尔爆发抗税起义。1703年，它被划入奥洛涅茨造船厂体系，1708年并入英格曼兰省。1765年的大火焚毁九座教堂和大片城区，此后城市按规整计划重建；随着圣彼得堡和波罗的海商路兴起，旧有北方贸易逐渐衰落。

en:
Torzhok, long also called Novy Torg, grew on the Tvertsa at the crossing of river and land routes between Novgorod and the southern Russian principalities. Its first reliable chronicle mention dates to 1139, when Yuri Dolgoruky of Suzdal seized the town. Grain for Novgorod moved through this frontier market, and in the early thirteenth century some 2,000 Novgorodians are said to have traded there regularly. In 1238 Torzhok withstood a Mongol siege from 21 February to 5 March before it was sacked. By 1444 it was Novgorod's southeastern stronghold, protected by wooden walls, stone towers, a rampart, and a ditch; local silver coins were struck there, and gold-thread embroidery had become its distinctive craft.

Ivan III annexed Torzhok with Novgorod in 1478, and it became the chief town of the Novotorzhsky district. In 1609, during the Time of Troubles, the Russo-Swedish army of Mikhail Skopin-Shuisky and Jacob De la Gardie defeated Polish-Lithuanian forces supporting False Dmitry II near the town, though Torzhok itself was sacked and its monasteries plundered. A cadastral book compiled in 1625 records seventeen church-named districts on the two banks. After St Petersburg was founded in 1703, the old grain road became a busy highway between the two capitals. The last wooden fortifications burned in 1742 and the rampart was leveled. In 1775 Torzhok became an uyezd town of Tver Viceroyalty, which became Tver Governorate in 1796; Catherine II approved its six-dove coat of arms in 1780.
zh:
托尔若克旧称新市场，位于特维尔察河畔，扼守诺夫哥罗德与南方罗斯诸公国之间水路和陆路的交会处。它最早的可靠编年史记载见于1139年，当时苏兹达尔王公尤里·多尔戈鲁基攻占了这座城镇。输往诺夫哥罗德的粮食要经过这个边境市场，13世纪初据说常有约两千名诺夫哥罗德人来此交易。1238年，托尔若克从2月21日坚守到3月5日，最终仍在蒙古围攻下陷落并遭洗劫。到1444年，它已是诺夫哥罗德东南方向的要塞，有木墙、石塔、土墙和壕沟环绕，当地铸造银币，金线刺绣也成为特色手艺。

1478年，伊凡三世随诺夫哥罗德一并吞并托尔若克，这里成为新托尔若克地区的首镇。1609年动乱时期，米哈伊尔·斯科平-舒伊斯基与雅各布·德拉加尔迪率领的俄瑞联军在城附近击败支持伪德米特里二世的波兰立陶宛军队，但托尔若克本身仍遭劫掠，修道院也被抢夺。1625年编成的地籍文书记载，河两岸共有十七个以教堂命名的城区。1703年圣彼得堡建立后，旧日粮道变成两座都城之间繁忙的大路。1742年，最后的木制防御工事焚毁，土墙也被平毁。1775年，托尔若克成为特维尔总督区的县治，总督区于1796年改为特维尔省；叶卡捷琳娜二世在1780年批准了六鸽纹章。

en:
Ostrov, whose name means 'island', began as a Pskovian fortress on an island in the Velikaya River, joined to the bank by the Slobozhikha channel. It probably already existed in the thirteenth century, and its first chronicle mention comes in 1341, when Ostrov men led by their posadnik Vasily Onisimovich marched to help Pskov against the Livonians. By the middle of the fourteenth century Pskov had built a powerful stone fortress there with five towers and a narrow fortified approach. Its garrison beat off Livonian attacks in 1348 and 1406 and won another major defence in 1426. In 1444, therefore, Ostrov was the chief southern stronghold of the Orthodox Pskov Republic, guarding the Velikaya road through forest and bog toward Polotsk and Lithuania.

On 7 September 1501, during the Muscovite-Lithuanian war, Walter von Plettenberg's Livonian army took the fortress by storm with fire arrows and artillery, although the occupiers were soon driven out. When Vasily III abolished Pskov's autonomy in 1510, removing the veche bell to Moscow on 13 January, Ostrov passed with the rest of the republic under direct Muscovite rule. A stone church of St Nicholas was built inside the fortress in 1542. In August 1581 Stephen Báthory's army stormed Ostrov for three days on its march against Pskov; the king joined the assault in person, the town and fortress were left in ruins, and they were returned under the Yam-Zapolsky peace of 1582. Ostrov never recovered its old importance. It became an uyezd town in 1719, was placed in Pskov Governorate in 1777, received a regular town plan from Catherine II in 1778 and a coat of arms in 1781. Its later merchants dealt chiefly in flax, bristle and leather.
zh:
奥斯特罗夫意为「岛」，最初是韦利卡亚河一座岛上的普斯科夫要塞，岛岸由斯洛博日哈河汊相连。据推测它在13世纪已经存在，首次编年史记载见于1341年：岛民在地方长官瓦西里·奥尼西莫维奇率领下驰援正与利沃尼亚人作战的普斯科夫。到14世纪中叶，普斯科夫已在此建成坚固的石造要塞，设五座塔楼和狭窄的设防通道。守军先后在1348年和1406年击退利沃尼亚进攻，并在1426年取得又一次重要防御胜利。因此在1444年，奥斯特罗夫是信奉东正教的普斯科夫共和国南方主要要塞，守卫着穿过森林沼泽、通往波洛茨克和立陶宛方向的韦利卡亚河路。

1501年9月7日莫斯科—立陶宛战争期间，瓦尔特·冯·普莱滕贝格率利沃尼亚军队以火箭和火炮强攻夺取要塞，但占领者很快被逐出。1510年瓦西里三世废除普斯科夫自治，1月13日把市民会议钟运往莫斯科，奥斯特罗夫也随共和国全境转入莫斯科直接统治。1542年，要塞内建成石造圣尼古拉教堂。1581年8月，斯特凡·巴托里的军队在进军普斯科夫途中强攻奥斯特罗夫三日，国王亲自加入战斗，城镇与要塞化为废墟；1582年，《亚姆—扎波利斯克和约》将其归还。奥斯特罗夫再未恢复旧日重要性。它在1719年成为县城，1777年划入普斯科夫省，1778年获叶卡捷琳娜二世批准的规则城市规划，1781年获得城徽。后来当地商人主要经营亚麻、猪鬃和皮革。

en:
Ladoga stands where the Volkhov flows out of Lake Ladoga, the first sheltered haven on the route up from the Baltic. A Norse and Slavic trading town from the mid-8th century, it handled the furs and Islamic silver moving between Scandinavia, Novgorod and Constantinople, and the chronicle names it as Rurik's first seat in 862. In 1136 it passed with Novgorod into the republic, and its stone fortress and the churches of St George and the Dormition, both already standing in the 12th century, guarded the northern water road to the city; Swedish fleets sacked it in 1142 and burned it in 1313, but the walls held in 1338. In 1444 Ladoga was a small Orthodox trading and garrison town of Novgorod, living by the fur fleets that came down from the north.

With Novgorod it fell to Ivan III in 1478, and in the 1580s the fortress was rebuilt with walls seven metres thick and five towers. In the Time of Troubles French mercenaries in Swedish pay seized Ladoga in 1610, and Muscovite voivodes retook it in February 1611; the Russo-Swedish talks that led to the Peace of Stolbovo in 1617 were prepared there, and by that peace Sweden gave up its claims. In 1704 Peter the Great founded New Ladoga at the mouth of the Volkhov, moved the townspeople and offices there, demoted the old town to a suburb and renamed it Staraya Ladoga, Old Ladoga; in 1764 it became a village.
zh:
拉多加位于沃尔霍夫河从拉多加湖流出之处，是波罗的海航路北上后第一个避风良港。自8世纪中叶起，这里就是诺斯人与斯拉夫人的商埠，斯堪的纳维亚、诺夫哥罗德与君士坦丁堡之间往来的毛皮和伊斯兰银币在此中转，编年史还称862年留里克最初的驻地就在拉多加。1136年它随诺夫哥罗德归入共和国，石砌要塞与12世纪已经矗立的圣乔治教堂、圣母安息教堂共同拱卫通往诺夫哥罗德的北方水道；瑞典舰队1142年洗劫此城，1313年又将其焚毁，1338年则未能破城。1444年的拉多加是诺夫哥罗德一座东正教的小商贸驻军城镇，靠北方南下的毛皮船队为生。

1478年它随诺夫哥罗德并入伊凡三世的国家，1580年代要塞重建，墙厚达七米，设五座塔楼。混乱时期，为瑞典效力的法国雇佣兵1610年夺取拉多加，莫斯科督军于1611年2月将其收复；导致1617年《斯托尔博沃和约》的俄瑞谈判曾在此筹备，瑞典最终放弃对拉多加的要求。1704年彼得大帝在沃尔霍夫河口兴建新拉多加，把居民和官署迁往新城，将旧城降为附郭并改名旧拉多加，1764年旧城又被降为村庄。

en:
The forest basins of the Inva and its streams were the southern country of the Komi-Permyaks, hunters and hoe-farmers whose tongue gave the wider Perm lands their name. Their hilltop strongholds guarded the river fords, the Kudymkar settlement above the Inva among them, occupied since the seventh century; Arab merchants knew the Kama country as Visu and traded silver for its furs, hoards of Persian and Arab coin still being unearthed along the banks. The Permyaks were ruled by their own princes and sent pelts as tribute to Novgorod. In 1444 the old republic still claimed their dues, while Moscow's power had only begun to reach up the river valleys.

In 1451 Vasily II of Moscow installed Mikhail Yermolayevich as the vassal prince of Great Perm at Cherdyn. Pitirim, the first Orthodox bishop sent to the Permyaks, was killed by Mansi raiders in 1455; Prince Mikhail accepted baptism in 1470, yet in 1472 Ivan III's voivode Fyodor Paletsky marched in all the same, built the fort of Pokcha and bound the principality to Moscow. Mikhail died in a Mansi raid in 1481, and in 1505 a Russian governor replaced his son, the last Komi prince being taken to Moscow. In 1581 a host raised by the Pelym prince Kikhek — Mansi, Tatars, Udmurts and Bashkirs — scourged the upper Kama once again. Kudymkar itself is first named in the records in 1579, and by the following century it was the market centre of the Inva country, its furs and timber floated down the Kama as Russian settlers filled the forest clearings.
zh:
因瓦河及其支流的林野盆地，是科米-彼尔姆克人的南疆。他们以狩猎和锄耕为生，彼尔姆这片大地的名字便得自他们的语言。河畔山岗上的据点扼守浅滩，因瓦河上的库德姆卡尔古城址自7世纪便有人居住。阿拉伯商人把卡马之地称作「维苏」，以银器换购毛皮，波斯与阿拉伯银币沿商路流入，在卡马河沿岸留下大量窖藏。彼尔姆克人由本族王公统治，以毛皮向诺夫哥罗德纳贡。1444年，这个老共和国仍在索取贡赋，而莫斯科的势力才刚刚沿河谷渗入。

1451年，莫斯科大公瓦西里二世把米哈伊尔·叶尔莫拉耶维奇立为大彼尔姆的附庸王公，驻于切尔登。1455年，派往彼尔姆克人那里的首任东正主教皮季里姆在曼西人袭掠中被杀；米哈伊尔王公1470年接受洗礼，但1472年伊凡三世的将领费奥多尔·帕列茨基仍率军入境，在波克恰筑起要塞，把公国束缚在莫斯科之下。米哈伊尔在1481年曼西人的一次入侵中身亡，1505年一名俄罗斯总督取代了他的儿子，末代科米王公被带往莫斯科。1581年，佩雷姆王公基赫克纠合曼西人、鞑靼人、乌德穆尔特人和巴什基尔人入寇，再一次蹂躏上卡马地区。库德姆卡尔之名首见于1579年的文献，到下一世纪已成为因瓦河流域的集镇；随着俄罗斯移民占满林间隙地，这里的毛皮和木材顺卡马河源源运出。

en:
Cherdyn crowns a high bank of the Kolva River, where the forests of the western Urals drop toward the Kama. The Komi-Permyak homeland of Great Perm, its towns of Iskor, Pokcha and Cherdyn strung along the Kolva, stood at a crossroads of water-and-portage roads: furs came from the Pechora and Yugra, Persian silver and Volga Bulgar goods moved up the Kama, and convoys could pass east into Siberia. Novgorod had collected the 'Trans-Kama silver' tribute here since the twelfth century, though the land kept its own princes and its gods at the Iskor sanctuary; Stephen of Perm had only recently brought Christianity to the neighbouring Vychegda country. In 1444 Cherdyn was the seat of a Christian Komi-Permyak princely dynasty whose people still largely kept the old forest rites, and the fur fleets made it the richest mart of the northern Urals.

In 1451 Vasily II of Moscow named Mikhail Yermolayev his vassal prince of Great Perm. Bishop Pitirim was killed by Mansi raiders while trying to baptise Cherdyn in 1455, and only in 1462 did Bishop Jonah 'baptise the rest' of the land and found the Monastery of St John the Theologian, the first Christian church in the western Urals. The Muscovite voivode Fyodor Pyostry marched in in 1472 and destroyed the Iskor sanctuary, building a fort at nearby Pokcha; Prince Mikhail submitted, and when the Pelym Mansi under Asyka besieged Cherdyn in 1481 they failed to take it, though the prince was slain. Moscow abolished the principality in 1505 and sent its own governors, and in 1535 the dyak Semyon Kurchov raised the first Kremlin in the Urals at Cherdyn, a fortress that lived through eleven sieges; Nogai raiders in 1547 and the Pelym host of Kihek in 1581 ravaged the countryside without taking the citadel. By 1579 it counted 290 households and 67 shops, most of its people living by trade; the river road through Cherdyn carried Moscow's conquest into Siberia. The Babinov Road of 1597 bypassed it, the voivode moved to salt-booming Solikamsk in 1636, and Cherdyn settled into the quieter traffic of grain, furs, Pechora grindstones and river salt, becoming in 1708 a town of the new Siberian Governorate and in 1781 the seat of its own uyezd.
zh:
切尔登雄踞科尔瓦河高岸，地处西乌拉尔森林向卡马河倾斜的地带。这里是科米-彼尔姆克人的故土大彼尔姆，伊斯科尔、波克恰、切尔登诸城沿科尔瓦河排开，正处在水陆联运道的十字路口：毛皮来自伯朝拉和尤格拉，波斯银器与伏尔加保加尔货物溯卡马河而上，船队还能东越乌拉尔进入西伯利亚。诺夫哥罗德自12世纪起就在此征收「外卡马银」贡赋，但当地仍由本邦王公治理，人们到伊斯科尔的神庙祭拜，彼尔姆的斯蒂芬也是不久前才把基督教传到邻近的维切格达河流域。1444年的切尔登是一个已基督教化的科米-彼尔姆克王朝的驻地，而治下民众大多仍守森林旧俗；毛皮船队使它成为北乌拉尔最富庶的商埠。

1451年，莫斯科大公瓦西里二世任命米哈伊尔·叶尔莫拉耶维奇为臣属于莫斯科的大彼尔姆王公。1455年，彼尔姆主教皮季里姆试图为切尔登人施洗时被曼西人袭杀；直到1462年，主教约拿才为当地「补行洗礼」，并创办神学家圣约翰修道院——西乌拉尔的第一座基督教堂。1472年，莫斯科督军费奥多尔·佩斯特雷率军入境，捣毁伊斯科尔的神庙，在附近的波克恰筑起要塞；王公米哈伊尔臣服，1481年佩雷姆的曼西人在首领阿瑟卡率领下围攻切尔登不克，米哈伊尔却在此役中被杀。1505年莫斯科废除公国，改派总督；1535年书吏谢苗·库尔乔夫在切尔登筑起乌拉尔第一座克里姆林，此后历经十一次围攻始终未陷。1547年诺盖鞑靼人的袭击和1581年佩雷姆首领基赫克大军的蹂躏都只殃及乡野，未能攻破要塞。1579年全城已有290户人家、67间店铺，居民多以贸易和服役为生；经此出发的水路曾把莫斯科的征服带入西伯利亚。1597年巴宾诺夫旱路修通后商队改道，1636年督衙迁往因盐业兴盛的索利卡姆斯克，切尔登转而经营粮食、毛皮、伯朝拉磨刀石和河运食盐的平静生意，1708年划入新设的西伯利亚省，1781年成为切尔登县治。

en:
The Sysola enters the Vychegda in the Sysola country of the Komi-Zyryans, where riverside hamlets lived by hunting, fishing and fur. Stephen of Perm, born at Ustyug around 1340, created the Old Permic script, built a church at Ust-Vym in 1380 and became the first bishop of Perm in 1383. His mission drew the Vychegda Komi into Orthodox Christianity without immediately erasing older rites. In 1444 no charter yet named Ust-Sysola, but the river mouth was a useful station for fur traffic through the Perm lands, where Muscovite influence and the new bishopric were increasingly strong.

Komi families moving down from the upper Sysola formed the settlement of Sysolskoye, called Sektyvdin in their language. The Yarensk survey of 1586 first records Ust-Sysola as a parish at the river mouth, with a wooden church of St George, nine households and 48 inhabitants; from 1608 it was known as the Ust-Sysolsk pogost. Its two navigable rivers connected the Komi country by portages with the Kama and Siberian routes. On 25 January 1780 Catherine II transformed the village into the uyezd town of Ust-Sysolsk in Vologda Viceroyalty; the town was ceremonially opened on 10 September, its bear arms were approved on 2 October, and neighbouring villages were attached to it in 1784. By 1795 it had 1,753 registered merchants and townsmen.
zh:
瑟索拉河在科米-济良人的瑟索拉地方注入维切格达河，河畔村落以狩猎、捕鱼和毛皮为生。约1340年生于乌斯秋格的彼尔姆的斯特凡创造古彼尔姆文字，1380年在乌斯季-维姆建起教堂，1383年成为第一任彼尔姆主教。他的传教使维切格达河流域的科米人接受东正教，但旧有仪俗并未立刻消失。1444年时，文书中还没有乌斯季-瑟索拉这个城镇名称，可这座河口已是彼尔姆土地上毛皮往来的便利站点，莫斯科的影响和新生教区的力量都在增强。

后来，科米人从瑟索拉河上游迁来，形成瑟索利斯科耶村落，科米语称谢克特夫丁。1586年的亚连斯克税册首次记载河口处的乌斯季-瑟索拉教区：那里有一座木制圣乔治教堂、9户人家和48名居民；1608年起，这里称乌斯季-瑟索利斯克教区。两条可通航河流经连水陆路，把科米土地与卡马河及西伯利亚道路连接起来。1780年1月25日，叶卡捷琳娜二世下诏把这座村庄改建为沃洛格达总督区的乌斯季-瑟索利斯克县城；新城于9月10日举行开城仪式，10月2日批准熊纹城徽，1784年又并入附近村落。到1795年，城里登记有1753名商人和市民。

en:
The Buzuluk country lies along the lower Samara and its Buzuluk and Domashka tributaries, open steppe between the Bashkir woodlands and the Yaik. In 1444 it was summer pasture of the Nogai Horde, whose camps moved with their herds between the Volga and the Yaik. As Nogai power collapsed and Kalmyks migrated west to the Volga in the seventeenth century, the grasslands became a thinly held no-man's-land beyond the Russian forts along the Samara.

In the spring and summer of 1736 Ivan Kirillov's Orenburg expedition laid the Buzulukskaya fortress on the Samara by the Buzuluk mouth, choosing the ruins of an old Bashkir fortified place; spring floods cut the site off, so the works were moved to higher ground on the Domashka. Its first settlers were 478 Yaik Cossacks, with nineteen Nogais, twelve Kalmyks and a band of exiles. Pugachev's rebellion swept along the Samara line in 1773–1774 and the fighting reached Buzulukskaya. In 1781 the fortress became the district town of Buzuluk in the new Ufa viceroyalty, and in 1811 it counted about a thousand inhabitants.
zh:
布祖卢克地方在萨马拉河下游及布祖卢克河、多马什卡河一带，是巴什基尔林地与亚伊克河之间的开阔草原。1444年时，这里是诺盖汗国的夏牧场，营帐随畜群往来于伏尔加河与亚伊克河之间。17世纪诺盖势衰、卡尔梅克人西迁伏尔加河后，这片草原成了萨马拉沿线俄军要塞之外人烟稀少的两不管边地。

1736年春夏，伊万·基里洛夫的奥伦堡考察团在萨马拉河畔、布祖卢克河口动工修筑布祖卢茨卡亚要塞，选址于一处古老巴什基尔堡寨的废墟；因春汛常将旧地淹没，要塞后迁至多马什卡河畔的高处。首批居民是478名亚伊克哥萨克，另有19名诺盖人、12名卡尔梅克人及一批流放者。1773—1774年普加乔夫起义沿萨马拉要塞线蔓延，战火烧到布祖卢茨卡亚。1781年要塞改设县城，得名布祖卢克，隶属新设的乌法总督区；1811年全城居民约一千人。

en:
The Chelyaba country lies beyond the southern Urals on the Miass, a tributary of the Tobol, where wooded hills open into the trans-Ural steppe. In 1444 its auls belonged to trans-Ural Bashkirs, herding cattle and trapping fur under the loose supremacy of the Nogai Horde, their camps reaching from the Iset lakes towards the upper Uy.

On 13 September 1736, during the Bashkir war, the Russians founded the Chelyaba fortress on the Miass at a Bashkir camping ground called Chelyabi, one of the posts securing the Orenburg line, and from 1743 it served as the seat of the new Iset province. In Pugachev's revolt the whole province rose: the ataman Ivan Gryaznov's first storm was beaten back in January 1774, but after a month's siege the garrison and officials abandoned the fortress on 19 February. It was recovered that spring by General Ivan Decolong's Siberian corps, which advanced after relieving the Dalmatov monastery on 2 March. In 1781 Chelyaba became the district town of Chelyabinsk.
zh:
切利亚巴地方在南乌拉尔山外、托博尔河支流米阿斯河畔，林山在此铺展为外乌拉尔草原。1444年时，这里的村落属于外乌拉尔巴什基尔人，在诺盖汗国松散的宗主权下放牧牲畜、猎取毛皮，营地从伊谢季湖群一直延伸到乌伊河上游。

1736年9月13日巴什基尔战争期间，俄国人在米阿斯河畔一处名叫切利亚比的巴什基尔牧地建起切利亚巴要塞，作为拱卫奥伦堡要塞线的据点之一，1743年起成为新设伊塞特省的省会。普加乔夫起义时全省响应：首领伊万·格里亚兹诺夫1774年1月初强攻不克，围城月余后，守军与官吏于2月19日弃城。同年春，伊万·德科隆将军的西伯利亚军团在3月2日为达尔马托沃修道院解围后反攻，收复切利亚巴。1781年，切利亚巴改设县城，定名车里雅宾斯克。

en:
Khujand commands the western gate of the Ferghana Valley, straddling the Syr Darya where the road from Samarkand enters the plain. Its origins reach back to Cyrus's Cyropolis, and after taking it in 329 BC Alexander the Great rebuilt it as Alexandria Eschate, his furthest Greek foundation. Qutayba ibn Muslim's Arabs conquered it in the eighth century; Genghis Khan's army had to storm the city in 1220 and left it in ruins, but it rose again as one of the richest markets on the northern Silk Road, and in the fourteenth century it gave the Persian-speaking world the ghazal poet Kamal Khujandi, its 'nightingale'. Under the later Timurids the town and its silk bazaars flourished anew, and in 1444 Khujand belonged to the Timurid realm ruled from Samarkand.

Early in the sixteenth century Muhammad Shaybani's Uzbeks incorporated Khujand into the Bukhara khanate, and the sixteenth-century domed mausoleum of Sheikh Muslihiddin and the congregational mosque beside it date to this era. As Bukhara weakened in the eighteenth century, the city became the first prize in its long contest with Kokand: Abd al-Rahim Biy seized it for the new khanate in the 1720s and was murdered there in 1734, and after decades of changing hands Alim Khan of Kokand finally secured Khujand in 1802. Its merchants then shared in Kokand's caravan boom, carrying valley silk west to Samarkand and east into Qing Xinjiang.
zh:
苦盏雄踞费尔干纳盆地的西口，锡尔河穿城而过，从撒马尔罕东来的道路由此进入平原。相传居鲁士大帝在此筑居鲁士城，公元前329年亚历山大攻取后将其改建为「绝域亚历山大里亚」，这是他建得最远的希腊式城市。8世纪初，屈底波·本·穆斯林率阿拉伯军征服此地；1220年成吉思汗的大军强攻得手，将城市夷为废墟，但它不久便复兴，成为北方丝绸之路上最富庶的商埠之一，14世纪还养育了被誉为苦盏「夜莺」的波斯语加泽尔诗大师卡莫尔·胡詹迪。帖木儿朝后期，城市和它的丝绸巴扎再度繁荣，1444年的苦盏属于以撒马尔罕为中心的帖木儿帝国。

16世纪初，昔班尼率领的乌兹别克人把苦盏并入布哈拉汗国，城里谢赫·穆斯利希丁的穹顶陵墓和旁边的聚礼清真寺都建于这一时期。18世纪布哈拉衰落，苦盏成为它与浩罕长期争夺的第一件战利品：阿卜杜勒·拉希姆·比在1720年代替新兴的浩罕夺取此城，1734年他在这里遇刺；此后归属反复易手，直到1802年浩罕的爱里木汗才最终拿下苦盏。当地商人随后也搭上浩罕商队的兴盛，把盆地出产的丝绸向西运到撒马尔罕，向东运入清朝治下的新疆。

en:
Kulob lies in the Yakhsu valley, in the old land of Khuttalan between the Vakhsh and Panj rivers. Muslim geographers knew the district as Khatlon, and its towns and pastures passed from the Mongols and Chagatai princes into Timur's empire. The Sufi teacher Mir Sayyid Ali Hamadani died here in 1384, and his tomb became a focus of pilgrimage and learning. In 1444 the valleys were held by the Timurids, Sunni merchants and shepherds moving wool, hides and livestock along the roads linking Balkh, Badakhshan and the Oxus crossings.

The walled town that became Kulob emerged in the sixteenth century as the new stronghold of Khuttalan, protected on the east by the Hazratishoh range and entered through three gates. Muhammad Shaybani's Uzbeks took it in 1504-05, but after his death in 1510 Timurid princes of Sultan Vays Mirza's line recovered power; Shahrukh Mirza held the town until 1584, when Abdullah Khan II of Bukhara conquered it and brought it under direct Bukharan rule. From 1642 Nadir Muhammad Khan attached Kulob to the Balkh appanage, where his sons governed in turn, and under Ubaydullah Khan II the Katagan chief Buri-biy served as governor. During the following centuries its caravanserais, Quranic schools, weaving shops and poets kept the old Khuttalan trade route alive within the Bukharan khanate.
zh:
库洛布位于亚赫苏河谷，地处瓦赫什河与喷赤河之间的古卡塔兰。穆斯林地理学者称这一地区为哈特隆，当地城镇和牧场先后经历蒙古人与察合台宗王统治，随后并入帖木儿的帝国。苏菲导师赛义德·阿里·哈马丹尼1384年在此去世，他的陵墓成为朝觐和学术中心。1444年，这些山谷处在帖木儿帝国治下；逊尼派商人和牧人沿着连接巴尔赫、巴达赫尚与阿姆河渡口的道路，交易羊毛、皮革和牲畜。

后来成为库洛布的城寨在16世纪兴起，是卡塔兰的新据点，东有哈兹拉提绍山脉屏障，三面设城门。穆罕默德·昔班尼率领的乌兹别克人在1504—1505年夺取此地，但他1510年死后，帖木儿宗王苏丹·维斯·米尔扎一系恢复统治；沙哈鲁·米尔扎据守到1584年，布哈拉的阿卜杜拉汗二世再度攻占，将其置于布哈拉直接管辖。1642年起，纳迪尔·穆罕默德汗把库洛布划归巴尔赫封地，由他的儿子们相继治理；奥贝杜拉汗二世在位时，卡塔甘部首领布里·比伊出任长官。此后数百年间，商队驿站、经文学校、织坊和诗人维持着古卡塔兰商路的活力，这里也始终是布哈拉汗国内的要地。

en:
Sozaq, called Khuzak in thirteenth-century sources, was a walled caravan town at the northern foot of the Karatau ridge, where the road from the Syr Darya oases crossed the dry steppe toward the Kipchak pastures; excavations trace the mound, about nineteen hectares across, from the early Middle Ages to the eighteenth century. In 1444 it stood in the path of Abu'l-Khayr Khan's expanding Uzbek confederation, and in 1446 the town, together with Sighnaq and Akkurgan, submitted to him without a fight, giving his ulus a firm foothold on the Syr Darya line.

After Abu'l-Khayr died in 1468 the Chinggisid sultans Kerei and Janibek made the Syr Darya towns the cradle of the Kazakh Khanate, and Kazakh tradition counts Sozaq as its first capital in 1465-1469. During the long war with the Shaybanids Mahmud, Janibek's eldest son, took the town for the Kazakhs, and under Qasim Khan it again served as the khan's seat in 1511-1521. Through the rest of the sixteenth century Sozaq appears among the Syr Darya cities disputed by the Kazakh khans, the Bukharan Shaybanids and the Timurid rulers to the south. Its history ended with the Dzungars: in 1723-1727 their armies sacked the river towns, and Sozaq was destroyed and never rebuilt. By 1821 its overgrown ruins lay in the pastures of Kazakh clans, while Kokand rule had closed over the Syr Darya cities to its south.
zh:
所扎克在13世纪的文献中称作胡扎克，是卡拉套山北麓一座有城墙的商队城镇，锡尔河绿洲通往钦察草原的道路在此穿过干旱草原；考古发掘表明，这片约19公顷的城址从早期中世纪一直沿用到18世纪。1444年，它正处在阿布海尔汗日益扩张的乌兹别克联盟兵锋之前；1446年，该城与瑟格纳克、阿库尔干一起不战归附，使阿布海尔的兀鲁思在锡尔河防线上站稳脚跟。

阿布海尔1468年死后，成吉思汗系苏丹克烈与贾尼别克以锡尔河诸城为根基建立哈萨克汗国，哈萨克传统把所扎克列为1465—1469年的第一个都城。在与昔班尼王朝的长期战争中，贾尼别克的长子马赫穆德为哈萨克人夺取此城；1511—1521年哈斯木汗在位时，它再次成为汗廷驻地。16世纪余下的时间里，所扎克作为锡尔河诸城之一，屡见于哈萨克汗、布哈拉昔班尼汗与南方帖木儿统治者的争夺。它的历史终结于准噶尔人之手：1723—1727年，准噶尔军队洗劫沿河诸城，所扎克被毁后再未复兴。到1821年，杂草丛生的城址已立在哈萨克部族的牧场之中，而南面的锡尔河诸城已落入浩罕统治。

en:
Sighnaq, the ruins now known as Sunakata, stood about twenty kilometres north of the Syr Darya on the caravan road below the Karatau range. Its workshops exported bows, and canals from the river watered fields around a town that Muslim writers called the land harbour of the Kipchak steppe. From the mid-fourteenth century it was a capital of the Blue Horde, with a mint, mosques and madrasas under Urus Khan, before the campaigns of Tokhtamysh and Timur drew it into war between the Golden Horde and the Timurids. In 1444 the border city still lay in the Timurid orbit, but Abu'l-Khayr's Uzbek confederation was massing beyond the frontier and would take Sighnaq in 1446.

The battle of Kuk Kashanah was fought seven kilometres to the south in 1457, when Oirat Kalmyk forces defeated Abu'l-Khayr and dictated terms. After his state collapsed, the Kazakhs held Sighnaq as one of their capitals from 1469 to 1511, lost it to Muhammad Shaybani's campaigns in the 1490s, and recovered the city around 1520; from 1521 to 1620 it again served the Kazakh khanate. War with Bukhara followed in the 1570s: Baba Sultan and then Abdullah Khan II seized the town, and in 1598 Abdullah issued a grant to the mausoleum of Ziya al-Din while Karakalpak groups were already settling nearby. By the later seventeenth century the caravan road had shifted and Dzungar and Uzbek raids had emptied the old town, whose central ruins became a graveyard before it survived as a name on Remezov's 1698 map of Siberia.
zh:
斯格纳克（又译昔格纳克）遗址今称苏纳卡塔，位于锡尔河以北约20公里、喀拉塔乌山南麓的商路上。当地作坊出口弓箭，引自锡尔河的水渠灌溉城周农田，穆斯林作者称这座城为钦察草原的陆地港口。14世纪中叶起，它成为蓝帐汗国都城，在兀鲁思汗治下设有铸币厂、清真寺和经学院；后来脱脱迷失与帖木儿的战争又把它卷入金帐汗国和帖木儿势力的争夺。1444年，这座边城建制仍在帖木儿势力范围之内，但阿布海尔的乌兹别克联盟已在边墙外集结，并将于1446年夺取斯格纳克。

1457年，库卡沙纳之战在城南7公里爆发，卫拉特卡尔梅克军队击败阿布海尔并迫使他接受议和。阿布海尔汗国崩溃后，哈萨克人在1469—1511年以斯格纳克为都城之一；1490年代，穆罕默德·昔班尼的军队多次攻占此城，哈萨克人约在1520年将其收复，1521—1620年它再次作为哈萨克汗国都城。1570年代，哈萨克与布哈拉为此交战，巴巴苏丹和阿卜杜拉汗二世先后夺城；1598年，阿卜杜拉还向齐亚丁圣陵颁发敕令，当时附近已有卡拉卡尔帕克人居住。到17世纪后期，商路转移，加上准噶尔和乌兹别克诸邦不断袭扰，旧城逐渐空废，中心遗址变成墓地；1698年列梅佐夫的西伯利亚地图上，只留下了斯格纳克这个名字。

en:
Here, at the great bend of the Don, the Volga and the Don run within seventy versts of each other, and the narrow portage between them has carried traffic between the Caspian and the Black Sea since ancient times. In the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries the Golden Horde city of Beldzhamen, perhaps the Bezdezh of Russian chronicles, stood on the Volga bank at the site where Dubovka would later rise, a rich market on the caravan route; Timur's armies sacked it at the end of the fourteenth century, and it never recovered. In 1444 its ruins lay in the pastures of the Great Horde, where Tatar herds grazed and boats were still hauled across the portage.

After Muscovy took Kazan in 1552 and Astrakhan in 1556 the Volga trade revived: a seasonal streltsy guard stood here from 1579, and in July 1589 voivode Grigory Zasekin built the fortress of Tsaritsyn at the mouth of the Tsaritsa, commanding the portage. In 1607 the garrison backed the rebel False Peter and was stormed by Shuisky's troops. Stepan Razin dragged his boats across to the Volga here in 1667 and took Tsaritsyn in April 1670 when the fortress musketeers opened the gates, only for the town to be abandoned after his defeat. Bulavin's Cossacks held it in 1708, and in August 1717 the Crimean serasker Bakhti Gerai, in the great Kuban raid, blockaded Tsaritsyn and swept fifteen to thirty thousand people off to slavery along the Penza-Saratov-Tsaritsyn arc. The Tsaritsyn watch line was begun in 1718, and in 1734 the Volga Cossack Host was settled at Dubovka. Yemelyan Pugachev's assault on the fortress was beaten off in August 1774; from 1780 Tsaritsyn was an uyezd town, growing as a grain and salt port on the lower Volga.
zh:
顿河在此拐出大河曲，伏尔加河与顿河相距不过七十俄里，两河之间狭窄的连水陆路自古便是里海与黑海之间的通道。13至14世纪，金帐汗国的城市别尔贾门（或即罗斯编年史中的别兹杰日）就坐落在今杜博夫卡附近的伏尔加河畔，是商路上富庶的市场；14世纪末，帖木儿的军队洗劫了这座城市，它再未恢复。1444年，故城的废墟躺在大帐汗国的牧场上，鞑靼牧群在四周吃草，船只仍经这条连水陆路拖运。

1552年和1556年莫斯科先后征服喀山与阿斯特拉罕后，伏尔加商路重新繁荣：1579年起这里设有季节性的射击兵哨所，1589年7月，督军格里戈里·扎谢金在察里察河口筑起察里津要塞，扼守连水陆路。1607年，守军支持伪彼得叛乱，被舒伊斯基的军队攻破。1667年，斯捷潘·拉辛在此把船拖过陆路进入伏尔加河，1670年4月借城内射击兵哗变开门拿下察里津，败亡后该城才被放弃。1708年，布拉文的哥萨克一度占据察里津；1717年8月，克里米亚塞拉斯克巴赫季·格莱发动库班大掠，封锁察里津，在奔萨—萨拉托夫—察里津一线掳走一万五千至三万人为奴。1718年，俄国开筑察里津警戒防线；1734年，伏尔加哥萨克军被安置到杜博夫卡。1774年8月，叶梅利扬·普加乔夫强攻察里津被击退；1780年起察里津成为县城，作为下伏尔加的粮食与食盐港口逐渐兴旺。

en:
The southern Udmurts — the 'meadow people', whom the Russians called votyaki — were the native farmers of the forest-steppe between the Vyatka and the Kama, living on rye, cattle and forest honey since the age of the Ananyino burial grounds. Their southern clans, the ary, had paid tribute to Volga Bulgaria and kept princes who served first the Bulgar and then the Tatar governors; their country was called the Arsk land. At the Kama crossing rose Alabuga, a Bulgar border stronghold founded around the end of the tenth century under Emir Ibrahim, with a white-stone fortress-mosque raised in the twelfth to guard the caravan road up to the Visu fur country. In 1444 the Arsk land belonged to the new khanate of Kazan, and Udmurt villages rendered grain, honey and pelts to the khan, while their northern kinsmen lived around the Vyatka trading republic of Khlynov.

After Moscow annexed Vyatka in 1489 the northern Udmurts came under the grand prince. When Kazan fell in October 1552 the tsar's regiments harried the whole Arsk side for ten days, and the Udmurts became yasak peasants, paying tribute in pelts and honey. Russian settlers moved onto the Kama clearings: Sarapul appears in the 1579 census as a refuge of peasants fleeing the Perm country, and Yelabuga, rising beside the old Bulgar ruins, became a palace village with a Trinity monastery built in 1614–1616; both throve on grain and fish carried down the Kama. In 1773 Pugachev's rebels sacked Sarapul, and in 1774–1775 the peoples of the southern Kama country flocked to his rising. Catherine II's reform of 1780 made Yelabuga and Sarapul district towns of the new Vyatka viceroyalty, the market towns through which Udmurt grain went out to Russia.
zh:
南部的乌德穆尔特人——意为「草地之人」，俄罗斯人称之为沃季亚克人——是维亚特卡河与卡马河之间林地里的土著农人，早在安纳尼诺墓群的时代便以黑麦、牲畜和林间蜂蜜为生。他们的南部氏族「阿尔人」向伏尔加保加利亚纳贡，本族王公先后充任保加尔和鞑靼总督的支柱，这片土地因此被称为阿尔斯克之地。卡马河渡口上矗立着阿拉布加——10世纪末前后在埃米尔易卜拉欣治下建立的保加尔边境要塞，12世纪又筑起白石清真寺堡垒，扼守通往「维苏」毛皮之乡的商道。1444年，阿尔斯克之地归于新兴的喀山汗国，乌德穆尔特村庄向汗缴纳谷物、蜂蜜和毛皮，而北方的同族则生活在维亚特卡商贸共和国赫雷诺夫周围。

1489年莫斯科吞并维亚特卡，北乌德穆尔特人归入大公治下。1552年10月喀山城破，沙皇的军队把整个阿尔斯克之地征讨了十天，乌德穆尔特人沦为交毛皮、蜂蜜的雅萨克农户。俄罗斯移民进入卡马河畔的开垦地：1579年的册籍中已记有萨拉普尔，是逃荒出彼尔姆之地的农民的落脚处；叶拉布加在保加尔古城址旁兴起，成为宫廷村落，1614至1616年建起圣三一修道院；两地都靠沿卡马河贩运谷物和鱼产繁荣。1773年，普加乔夫的起义者洗劫了萨拉普尔；1774至1775年，南卡马地区的各族民众群起投奔他的队伍。叶卡捷琳娜二世1780年改制，叶拉布加和萨拉普尔成为新设维亚特卡总督辖区的县城，乌德穆尔特的谷物便经这些集镇输往俄罗斯内地。

en:
Urgench is the grain country of southern Khwarazm, where canals led from the lower Amu Darya, later including the Shavat channel, across flat fields. In 1444 the walled town that now bears this name had not yet been founded; the older Gurganj still lay farther into the delta. Abu'l-Khayr's Uzbeks had occupied Urgench in 1430 or 1431, placing these canal villages and granaries on the Uzbek edge of Timurid Khwarazm. Its Sunni farmers sowed wheat, rice and millet beside the waterways, while merchants still looked northward to the old delta cities.

Timurid rule returned after Abu'l-Khayr's death about 1468, but Muhammad Shaybani conquered Khwarazm in 1505. When he fell at Merv in 1510, a Safavid garrison took over, only for the Sunni nobility to invite Ilbars and expel the Qizilbash in 1511. The khans of the new Arabshahid line ruled from Vazir and then Gurganj, until Bukhara overran the country in 1593 and Haji Muhammad fled to Persia; he returned after Abdullah Khan's death in 1598. During the seventeenth century the Daryaliq channels failed and old Gurganch and Vazir declined. Abu al-Ghazi, reigning from 1643 to 1663, settled their surviving people in southern Khwarazm and founded Yangi Urgench, the new Urgench. Nader Shah occupied Khiva from 1740 to 1746, and Qongirat rule after 1763 brought new irrigation and firmer government; in 1811 Muhammad Rahim Khan completed the subjection of the lower delta.
zh:
乌尔根奇是花剌子模南部的谷物之地，阿姆河下游引出的灌渠（后来包括沙瓦特渠）穿过平坦农田。1444年时，这座后来称作乌尔根奇的城墙城镇尚未建立，更古老的玉龙杰赤仍位于三角洲更深处。阿布海尔率领的乌兹别克人已在1430年或1431年攻占乌尔根奇，使这些渠边村落和粮仓处在帖木儿王朝花剌子模的乌兹别克边境。当地逊尼派农民沿水道种植小麦、稻米和粟，商人仍把目光投向北方旧三角洲诸城。

阿布海尔约于1468年去世后，帖木儿王朝恢复统治，但穆罕默德·昔班尼在1505年征服花剌子模。1510年他在梅尔夫战败身亡后，萨法维驻军接管此地；当地逊尼派贵族随后迎立伊尔巴斯，于1511年逐走克孜勒巴什。新的阿拉伯沙希王朝诸汗先以瓦济尔、后以玉龙杰赤为统治中心。1593年布哈拉攻占花剌子模，哈吉·穆罕默德逃往波斯，直到1598年阿卜杜拉汗死后才返回。17世纪，达里亚雷克各渠水量衰退，古玉龙杰赤和瓦济尔相继衰落。1643年至1663年在位的阿布·哈齐把幸存居民安置到南花剌子模，并建立杨吉·乌尔根奇，即新乌尔根奇。纳迪尔沙在1740年至1746年占领希瓦，1763年后的昆格拉特统治带来新的灌溉工程和更强的政府；1811年，穆罕默德·拉希姆汗完成了对下游三角洲的征服。

en:
Yedishkul is the open steppe of the lower Dnieper below the rapids, looking south to the Perekop isthmus and the Crimea. In 1444, three years after Hacı I Giray founded the Giray khanate, these pastures belonged to the Crimean khan. Tatar herders moved between the Volga grasslands and the peninsula along tracks that ran to Perekop, while Dnieper landings served the ferries; no stone town yet stood in the land.

From 1478 the Crimean khanate was an Ottoman vassal. In the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries Zaporozhian Cossacks pushed down the river with winter camps and palanka districts, and the settlement of Bilchowisce appears on Beauplan's map of 1648. In 1728 the Yedishkul Nogai horde, driven west by the Kalmyks from the Emba by way of the Volga and the Kuban, entered the steppe under Crimean protection and gave the region its name. Münnich's Russians built the Alexander redoubt here in 1737, only to give it back at the Peace of Niš in 1739. Russian troops returned in 1771, and the Treaty of Küçük Kaynarca in 1774 detached the steppe from the khanate; the Nogais were deported to the Kuban and the North Caucasus, their last rising crushed in 1783. On 18 June 1778 Catherine II founded Kherson on the high Dnieper bank, its shipyard laid the first hulls of the Black Sea Fleet from 1783, Potemkin was buried in its St Catherine's Cathedral in 1791, and in 1803 the town became the seat of the Kherson governorate.
zh:
叶迪什库勒是第聂伯险滩以南、第聂伯河下游的开阔草原，南望彼列科普地峡与克里米亚。1444年，即哈吉一世·格来建立格来王朝三年后，这片牧场归克里米亚汗所有。鞑靼牧人沿着通往彼列科普的牧道往返于伏尔加草原与克里米亚半岛之间，第聂伯河上只有若干渡口，全境尚无一座城池。

1478年起，克里米亚汗国成为奥斯曼帝国的附庸。16至17世纪，扎波罗热哥萨克沿河而下，设立冬营和「帕兰卡」营区，名为比利霍维奇（Bilchowisce）的居点出现在1648年的博普兰地图上。1728年，叶迪什库勒诺盖斡耳朵受卡尔梅克人逼迫，从恩巴河经伏尔加河、库班西迁，进入克里米亚汗庇护下的这片草原，地区由此得名。1737年，米尼希率领的俄军在此修筑亚历山大堡垒，1739年依尼什和约归还。1771年俄军再度占领，1774年库楚克开纳吉和约把这片草原从汗国手中夺走；诺盖人被迁往库班和北高加索，他们最后的反抗于1783年被镇压。1778年6月18日，叶卡捷琳娜二世下令在第聂伯河高岸上建赫尔松；1783年起当地船坞为黑海舰队铺设首批舰体，1791年波将金葬于新建的圣叶卡捷琳娜大教堂，1803年赫尔松成为赫尔松省的省治。

en:
Shetland is a rugged archipelago where the Atlantic meets the North Sea. Norse settlers occupied the islands from the late eighth and ninth centuries, Harald Fairhair brought the Northern Isles under the Norwegian Crown in 875, and after 1195 Shetland was ruled directly as a Norwegian lordship. In 1444 its Catholic, Norse-speaking families lived by fishing and small farms around sheltered sounds such as Bressay Sound. The future capital Lerwick did not yet exist; Scalloway was the older centre, and the islands remained a remote Norwegian possession within the Kalmar Union.

On 28 May 1469 Christian I of Denmark-Norway pledged Shetland to James III of Scotland for 8,000 Rhenish guilders as security for the dowry of his daughter Margaret. The pledge was never redeemed, and Scotland annexed the islands in 1472. A sheriff of Orkney and Shetland was appointed in 1541, and Scots law generally superseded local law in 1612. During the seventeenth century Dutch herring and white-fish fleets encouraged a settlement at Lerwick, protected from the 1650s by the fort later called Fort Charlotte; Scalloway men burned the fishermen's huts, and the French fleet burned Lerwick in 1702. Lerwick replaced Scalloway as capital in 1708. After the 1707 Union, salt duties weakened the old North German fish trade, while merchant-lairds fitted out their own vessels. During the Napoleonic Wars of 1800-1815 roughly 3,000 Shetlanders served in the Royal Navy and press gangs were rife; on Fetlar only twenty of 120 pressed men returned.
zh:
设得兰群岛是大西洋与北海交汇处的崎岖群岛。8世纪末至9世纪，诺斯移民占据诸岛；875年，金发哈拉尔将北方群岛纳入挪威王权，1195年以后设得兰成为由挪威直接统治的领地。1444年，群岛上说诺斯语的天主教家庭在布雷塞湾等避风海湾周边以捕鱼和小规模农耕为生。未来首府勒威克尚未出现，旧中心在斯卡洛韦，设得兰仍是卡尔马联盟中一处偏远的挪威属地。

1469年5月28日，丹麦-挪威国王克里斯蒂安一世把设得兰抵押给苏格兰国王詹姆斯三世，作为女儿玛格丽特嫁妆中8000莱茵古尔登的担保。这笔抵押始终未被赎回，群岛于1472年并入苏格兰。1541年，苏格兰设立奥克尼与设得兰治安官；1612年，苏格兰一般法律取代当地旧法。17世纪，荷兰鲱鱼和白鱼船队促成勒威克居民点形成，1650年代起又有后来称为夏洛特堡的要塞护卫；斯卡洛韦居民曾烧毁渔民棚屋，法国舰队也在1702年焚毁勒威克。1708年，勒威克取代斯卡洛韦成为首府。1707年联合之后，盐税削弱了旧有的北德鱼类贸易，本地商人地主开始自行装备船只出口鱼货。1800年至1815年拿破仑战争期间，约有3000名设得兰人在皇家海军服役，强征水兵十分猖獗；费特勒岛被带走的120人中只有20人生还。

en:
The Faroes are a steep, treeless island group between Norway, Shetland and Iceland. Norse settlers arrived early in the ninth century, and after the adoption of Christianity the islands came under the Norwegian Crown. Their assembly met on the Tinganes peninsula, where the harbour of Tórshavn developed from an annual thing and market. During the twelfth century Norwegian trade was centred on Bergen, and a royal licence of 1271 provided regular sailings carrying salt, timber and grain. In 1444 Catholic West Norse islanders belonged to the Norwegian realm within the Kalmar Union, living from sheep, fishing and sea birds while exchanging wool and fish at the sheltered harbour.

Lutheran reform reached the islands in the later 1530s, and only then did sources begin to mention a built settlement at Tórshavn. Around 1580 Magnus Heinason built the small Skansin fort to guard the anchorage; in 1584 the little capital had 101 inhabitants. Kristoffer Gabel received the Faroes from Frederick III in 1655, and from 1662 his family controlled the trading monopoly until a Tinganes gunpowder fire destroyed records and houses in 1673. The Crown took over in 1709, the same year smallpox killed about 250 of Tórshavn's roughly 300 people. From 1768 Niels Ryberg used the monopoly warehouses for entrepôt trade and experiments with salted cod and herring. Tórshavn Cathedral was built in 1788, and after the Treaty of Kiel left the Faroes under Denmark in 1814, the Løgting was suspended in 1816.
zh:
法罗群岛是挪威、设得兰与冰岛之间一组陡峭少树的岛屿。诺斯移民在9世纪初抵达，群岛接受基督教后归入挪威王权。岛民的议会在廷加内斯半岛集会，托尔斯港便由一年一度的庭会和市集发展而来。12世纪时，对挪贸易集中于卑尔根；1271年的王室特许状规定船只定期运来盐、木材和谷物。1444年，信奉天主教、使用西诺斯语的岛民属于卡尔马联盟中的挪威王国，以牧羊、捕鱼和捕海鸟为生，并在这座避风港口交换羊毛与鱼货。

1530年代末，路德宗改革传到群岛，文献此后才开始提到托尔斯港出现成片建筑。约1580年，马格努斯·海纳松修建小要塞斯坎辛，守卫锚地；1584年，这座小首府有101名居民。1655年，克里斯托弗·加贝尔从弗雷德里克三世手中受封法罗群岛，1662年起其家族控制贸易垄断，直到1673年廷加内斯火药爆炸烧毁房屋和大量档案。1709年，王室接管垄断贸易；同年天花流行，托尔斯港约300名居民中有约250人病死。1768年起，尼尔斯·吕贝尔利用垄断仓库经营转口贸易，并尝试腌制鳕鱼和鲱鱼。托尔斯港主教座堂建于1788年；1814年《基尔条约》确认法罗留在丹麦王权治下，Løgting议会又于1816年被中止。

en:
Bornholm is a rocky island far out in the Baltic, east of the Danish mainland, where fishermen had settled by Viking times and whose four round churches were raised in the 12th century. In the 13th century the archbishops of Lund built Hammershus on the northern cliffs, the largest medieval fortress in Scandinavia; crown and crozier long contested it and royal troops took it in 1259, 1265, 1319 and 1325, yet it remained the see's stronghold into the 1500s. Rønne, on a natural harbour with a St Nicholas church from the late 13th century, became the island's chief market town in 1327, and around 1400 merchants of Greifswald kept a trading post there. In 1444 Bornholm was a Catholic Danish fief held by the Archbishop of Lund, living by herring and the Baltic carrying trade.

In 1525 Frederick I pawned the island to Lübeck for fifty years, and its governors taxed it from Hammershus; the Danish crown redeemed Bornholm only in 1576. Swedish troops under Wrangel stormed the fortress in the Torstenson War of 1645, and the Peace of Roskilde in 1658 ceded the island to Sweden, but on 8 December 1658 the islanders shot the Swedish commandant Printzensköld in the streets of Rønne and gave the island back to their king, a return confirmed by the Treaty of Copenhagen in 1660. Hammershus afterwards served as a state prison, holding Corfitz Ulfeldt and Leonora Christina in 1660 and 1661, and it was abandoned in 1743; Rønne then became the island's military and administrative centre.
zh:
博恩霍尔姆是远悬波罗的海的一座岩石岛，孤悬在丹麦本土以东；维京时代已有渔民在此定居，岛上的四座圆形教堂建于12世纪。13世纪，隆德大主教在北岸悬崖上修建了哈默斯胡斯——斯堪的纳维亚最大的中世纪要塞；国王与教会长期争夺此堡，王军虽于1259、1265、1319和1325年几度攻占，它仍是大主教的堡垒，直到16世纪初。伦讷依托天然良港，13世纪末建起圣尼古拉教堂，1327年成为全岛首镇，1400年前后格赖夫斯瓦尔德的商人在此设有商站。1444年，博恩霍尔姆是隆德大主教掌管的丹麦封邑，居民信奉天主教，靠鲱鱼和波罗的海航运为生。

1525年，腓特烈一世把岛屿典押给吕贝克，期限五十年，其总督在哈默斯胡斯征税；丹麦王室迟至1576年才赎回博恩霍尔姆。1645年托尔斯滕森战争中，弗兰格尔麾下的瑞典军队攻破要塞；1658年《罗斯基勒条约》把全岛割让给瑞典，但1658年12月8日，岛民在伦讷街头击毙瑞典长官普林岑舍尔德，把岛屿交回自己的国王，1660年《哥本哈根条约》确认了这次回归。哈默斯胡斯此后改为国家监狱，1660年至1661年关押过科尔菲茨·乌尔费尔特和莱奥诺拉·克里斯蒂娜，1743年遭废弃，伦讷自此成为全岛的军事与行政中心。

en:
Blekinge is the small forested coastland where Sweden's granite frontier meets the Baltic, a country of oak woods and skerries. Danish since the 13th century and ruled under Scanian Law from the castles of Sölvesborg and Lyckeby, it was the easternmost march of the Danish realm, its landsting meeting at Hjortsberga. Ronneby, with its 12th-century Holy Cross church, held town privileges from 1387 and was the province's busiest shipping town, though Swedish raiders came with every Nordic war. In 1444 Blekinge remained Danish, a much-harried border land whose timber and tall oaks supplied the shipyards.

On 4 September 1564 Erik XIV's Swedes stormed Ronneby and burned it in the notorious Ronneby Bloodbath, and in 1611 the young Gustav Adolf surprised and fired Kristianopel. Roskilde ceded Blekinge to Sweden on 28 February 1658, and the Crown remade the coast: Karlshamn was chartered in 1664 and Karlskrona founded on the island of Trossö in 1680 as Sweden's chief naval base, fed by the provincial oak forests, while Ronneby lost its privileges and was emptied into the new towns. The pro-Danish snapphane rising of 1676 began in easternmost Blekinge; plague thinned the people in 1710–1711, yet by the 18th century the fleet had made this Sweden's most urbanised province.
zh:
布莱金厄是瑞典花岗岩边境与波罗的海相接处的小小森林海岸，遍布橡树林与岩岛。这里自13世纪起属丹麦，行斯科讷法，由瑟尔沃斯堡和吕克比两座城堡统辖，是丹麦王国最东边的边陲，地区庭在约茨贝加召开。龙讷比的圣十字教堂始建于12世纪，城镇1387年获特许状，是省内最繁忙的航运城镇，而每一场北欧战争都有瑞典军来袭。1444年，布莱金厄仍属丹麦，是屡遭兵燹的边地，出产的木材和高大橡木供应各船厂。

1564年9月4日，埃里克十四世麾下的瑞典军猛攻龙讷比并纵火焚城，史称「龙讷比血案」；1611年，年轻的古斯塔夫·阿道夫突袭克里斯蒂安诺佩尔并纵火焚城。1658年2月28日，罗斯基勒和约将布莱金厄割让瑞典，新主随即着手改造海岸：卡尔斯港1664年获特许，1680年在特罗瑟岛上建立卡尔斯克鲁纳作为瑞典首要海军基地，本省橡树林供养着船坞；龙讷比被褫夺城市权，居民被迁往新城。1676年亲丹麦的自由射手（snapphane）起义始于布莱金厄最东端，1710—1711年瘟疫又使人口锐减；到18世纪，拜舰队所赐，布莱金厄成了瑞典城市化程度最高的省份。

en:
Lolland and Falster, joined by the narrow Guldborgsund, are flat, fertile islands between Langeland and Zealand, their soil the richest in Denmark and almost all of it in the hands of great manors. Wendish pirates raided these coasts, and in the late 12th century a castle was raised at Nykøbing to guard the sound; Lübeck stormed it and burned the town in 1253, and the Hanseatic cities besieged it again during the Dano-Hanseatic War of 1368 to 1370. Nakskov grew from an 1100s fishing village into the islands' leading market town, its oldest surviving privileges dating to 1266 and its merchants trading with the North German cities. In 1416 a Bridgettine abbey was founded at Maribo, and in 1419 Eric of Pomerania established a Franciscan friary at Nykøbing. In 1444 Lolland and Falster were Catholic crown lands of Denmark, their wealth in grain, cattle and fisheries, and their peasantry already bore the heaviest manorial yoke in the kingdom.

In 1446 the Lolland landsting enacted the Lollands Vilkår, strengthening the nobles' rights and, first anywhere in Denmark, tying tenant farmers to the estates. Lübeckers burned Nakskov in 1510; in the Count's Feud of 1534 Nykøbing and Maribo stood by Christian II, and the Reformation swept the monasteries away in the 1530s. Queen Sophie of Mecklenburg, widow of Frederick II, ruled all Lolland-Falster from the new Renaissance castle at Nykøbing from 1588 until her death in 1631. In 1658 Charles X Gustav's army crossed the ice from Langeland, and in 1659 the Swedes took Nakskov after a long siege, leaving the town ruined and its population halved. After the wars Nakskov became one of the first towns in Denmark where Jewish settlers were permitted, and from the 1780s the local magnate C. D. F. Reventlow led the crown's agrarian reforms, which ended adscription and set tenant farmers on the path to owning their land.
zh:
