In 1444 this is Vijayanagara territory, governed from Yelahanka by hereditary nadaprabhus, its pastures and tanks lying beside the road between the imperial city and the Tamil lowlands.

In 1537 the Yelahanka chief Kempe Gowda I built a mud fort at Bengaluru and laid out the intersecting market streets, or petes, of the new town; after the disaster at Talikota in 1565 his successors ruled it on their own account. In 1638 an Adil Shahi army under Ranadulla Khan and Shahaji Bhonsle defeated Kempe Gowda III, and the town became Shahaji's jagir. In 1687 the Mughal general Kasim Khan, acting for Aurangzeb, drove out the Bhonsles and leased the district to Chikka Devaraja Wodeyar of Mysore. Hyder Ali, who seized power in 1759, made Bengaluru a military centre and laid out the Lal Bagh; Lord Cornwallis stormed the fort on 21 March 1791 in the Third Anglo-Mysore War. Restored to the Wadiyars in 1799, the town received a British cantonment at Ulsoor in 1809.
zh:
米罗桑达即旧籍中的莫拉萨纳德，是迈索尔以东的高原台地，莫拉萨沃卡利加农耕武士的家乡，阿尔卡瓦蒂河流贯其间。贝古尔出土的英雄石在890年的铭文中已经提到本加卢鲁这个村名，毗奢耶那伽罗的宫廷文献则把同一处地方称作德瓦拉亚纳加拉。1444年，此地属毗奢耶那伽罗，由耶拉汉卡的世袭纳德帕布（地方长官）治理，牧场和水塘之间的大道连接帝都与泰米尔平原。

1537年，耶拉汉卡长官肯佩·高达一世在本加卢鲁修筑土堡，规划十字相交的市场街区（佩泰），奠定新城的雏形；1565年塔利科塔之战惨败后，他的后继者自立为主。1638年，拉纳杜拉汗与沙吉·邦斯勒率领的比贾布尔军队击败肯佩·高达三世，本加卢鲁成为沙吉的封地。1687年，莫卧儿将领卡西姆汗奉奥朗则布之命逐走邦斯勒家族，把这片地方租给迈索尔的奇卡·德瓦拉贾·瓦迪亚。海德尔·阿里1759年掌权后，将本加卢鲁营建为军事重镇，辟建拉尔巴格园林；1791年3月21日第三次英迈战争中，康沃利斯率军攻破城堡。1799年地方复归瓦迪亚家族，1809年英军在乌尔苏尔设立兵营。

en:
Malenadu is the rainy spine of the Western Ghats between the Kanara coast and the Deccan, a country of steep forested ridges and scattered villages with some of the heaviest rainfall in India; above the headwaters of the Tungabhadra its woods yield pepper, cardamom, areca and teak. At its western edge lies Ikkeri, whose name means 'two streets' in Kannada, a small town beneath the Sahyadris. In 1444 the hill-chiefs of Malenadu hold their forests as vassals of Vijayanagara, sending ghat pepper and timber down to the ports of Kanara; the Keladi line that will make Ikkeri a capital has yet to rise.

From 1499 the Nayakas of Keladi ruled these hills, first as Vijayanagara's feudatories and, after the empire's overthrow at Talikota in 1565, as an independent power reaching from the Tungabhadra to the sea, and the Aghoreshvara temple rose at Ikkeri, their first capital. Shivappa Nayaka, reigning from 1645 to 1660, governed from the new fortress-town of Bidanur and reformed the land tax, and in 1653 his general Timmanna Nayaka took Mangalore, Barkur, Basrur and Honnavar from the Portuguese. In 1670 the Sufi Baba Budan planted seven coffee beans smuggled from Mocha on the Chandradrona hills, giving India its first coffee gardens. Queen Chennamma, reigning from 1672, sheltered the fugitive Maratha king Rajaram and checked Aurangzeb's armies until a treaty of 1690 left Keladi autonomous; the Mughals never held these forests. In 1763 Hyder Ali of Mysore stormed Bidanur and renamed it Hydernagar, and a British detachment that seized it in 1783 was destroyed by Tipu Sultan, who kept the Malnad until his fall in 1799.
zh:
马伦达是西高止山多雨的山脊，夹在卡纳达海岸与德干高原之间，山岭陡峭、森林密布、村落分散，降雨量为印度之最；栋格珀德拉河源流穿行其间，山中出产胡椒、豆蔻、槟榔和柚木。山脊西缘坐落着伊凯里，卡纳达语意为「两条街」，是萨希亚德里山下的一座小镇。1444年，马伦达的山地酋长作为毗奢耶那伽罗的藩属据守山林，把高止山的胡椒和木材运下卡纳达各港；后来把伊凯里变成王都的凯拉迪家族此时尚未兴起。

1499年起，凯拉迪纳亚卡家族统治这片山地，起初是毗奢耶那伽罗的藩臣，1565年帝国在塔利戈塔败亡后成为独立政权，疆域从栋格珀德拉一直伸展到海边，阿戈雷什瓦尔神庙在他们的第一个都城伊凯里落成。希瓦帕·纳亚卡1645年至1660年在位，以新建的堡垒城镇比达努尔为都整顿地税，1653年他的大将蒂曼纳·纳亚卡从葡萄牙人手中夺取门格洛尔、巴尔库尔、巴斯鲁尔和洪纳瓦尔。1670年，苏菲行者巴巴·布登把从穆哈偷带出的七粒咖啡豆种在钱德拉德罗纳山坡，印度第一批咖啡园由此出现。琴纳玛女王1672年即位后收容逃亡的马拉塔国王拉贾拉姆，抵挡住奥朗则布的大军，1690年签订的条约承认凯拉迪自治，莫卧儿人始终没能占有这片森林。1763年迈索尔的海德尔·阿里攻陷比达努尔，改名海德尔讷格尔；1783年一支英军夺城后被提普苏丹歼灭，马伦达此后一直留在他手中，直到1799年他败亡。

en:
The Dharwad country forms the gateway between the Malenadu forests and the open Deccan: Dharwad fortress watched the hill roads, while old Hubli served the cotton trade. A 1117 inscription records the place under the Chalukyas, and Bahmani armies entered it in the fourteenth century; local tradition attributes the Dharwad fort to the Vijayanagara officer Dharav in 1403. In 1444 it was a fortified Bahmani-Vijayanagara frontier, with Kannada Hindu cultivators and traders around Hubli and Muslim garrisons in the stronger forts.

After Talikota in 1565, Dharwad's Hindu governor ruled briefly on his own, but the Adil Shah of Bijapur stormed the fort in 1573. Hubli grew under Bijapur as a market for cotton, saltpetre and iron and received a British factory, which Shivaji looted in 1673. Aurangzeb took Dharwad in 1685, and Hubli passed to the Afghan Nawabs of Savanur, risen in Mughal service; Basappa Shettar built New Hubli and its fort in 1727. South of the province, the Keladi Nayakas remained independent after Talikota until Hyder Ali annexed them. Marathas seized Hubli in 1755–56, Hyder Ali overran Dharwad in 1764 and took its fort in 1778, Marathas recovered it in 1791, and the East India Company took Old Hubli in 1817 and Dharwad in 1818.
zh:
达尔瓦德一带是马来纳德森林与德干平原之间的门户：达尔瓦德堡监视山路，老胡布利则服务于棉花贸易。1117年的铭文已记载这里受遮娄其王朝统治，14世纪巴赫曼尼军队进入此地；当地传统称毗奢耶那伽罗官员达拉夫在1403年修筑达尔瓦德堡。1444年，这里是巴赫曼尼与毗奢耶那伽罗之间设防的边境，胡布利周围住着说卡纳达语的印度教农民和商人，坚固城堡中则驻有穆斯林守军。

1565年塔利科塔战役后，达尔瓦德的印度教长官曾短暂割据，但比贾布尔的阿迪勒沙在1573年攻占城堡。比贾布尔治下，胡布利发展为棉花、硝石和铁的市场，并设有英国商馆，商馆于1673年遭希瓦吉劫掠。1685年奥朗则布攻取达尔瓦德，胡布利随后转归在莫卧儿军中崛起的阿富汗裔萨瓦努尔纳瓦布；1727年，巴萨帕·谢塔尔修筑新胡布利城和堡垒。省区南部的凯拉迪纳亚卡首领自塔利科塔后保持独立，直到海德尔·阿里将其吞并。1755至1756年马拉塔人夺取胡布利，海德尔·阿里1764年席卷达尔瓦德、1778年攻下城堡，马拉塔人1791年又将其收复；老胡布利和达尔瓦德分别于1817年、1818年落入东印度公司之手。

en:
Pune lies in the northern Desh on the Mutha river, whose black-soil basin has long been a granary of the western Deccan. Copper plates of 858 and 868 record an agricultural settlement called Punnaka under the Rashtrakutas, who also cut the Pataleshwar cave temple into its rock. From the ninth century to 1327 it belonged to the Yadavas of Devagiri, and thereafter to the Muslim sultans of the Deccan. In 1444 Pune is a small Marathi-speaking kasbah of farmers and traders under Bahmani governors, its grain feeding the forts and camps of the northern Deccan.

In 1599 the Nizam Shahis of Ahmadnagar enfeoffed Pune to Maloji Bhosle, grandfather of Shivaji, and it passed to his son Shahaji. In 1636 the Adil Shahi general Murar Jagdeo destroyed the town, but Shahaji, then serving Bijapur, recovered it and settled his wife Jijabai and the young Shivaji there, their Lal Mahal palace completed in 1640; Jijabai's Kasba Ganapati became the city's patron shrine. Pune changed hands repeatedly thereafter and returned to the Marathas in June 1670; Aurangzeb held it from 1703 to 1705 and renamed it Muhiyabad. In 1728 the Peshwa Baji Rao I moved his court from Saswad to Pune and raised the Shaniwar Wada on the Mutha, completed in 1732, the seat of Maratha government for ninety years. Under his son Balaji Bajirao the city spread with new market wards, the Parvati Hill temples, the Katraj lake with its aqueduct and some two hundred and fifty temples and bridges. In October 1802 Yashwantrao Holkar routed the Peshwa at the Battle of Poona and seized the city, drawing the British into the next Maratha war; on 5 November 1817 the Peshwa's army broke at Khadki, and the British occupied Pune in 1818, ending Peshwa rule.
zh:
浦那位于德什北部的穆塔河畔，这里的黑土盆地自古是西德干的粮仓。858年和868年的铜牌记载，罗湿陀罗拘陀（Rashtrakuta）王朝治下已有一个叫普纳卡的农业聚落，帕塔莱什瓦尔石窟神庙也是这一时期凿岩而建。9世纪到1327年，此地归德瓦吉里的亚达瓦人，之后落入德干诸穆斯林苏丹国之手。1444年的浦那是巴赫曼尼总督治下一座说马拉地语的小集镇，农夫与商人聚居，出产的谷物供应北德干的堡垒和兵营。

1599年，艾哈迈德讷格尔的尼扎姆·沙阿王朝把浦那封给希瓦吉的祖父马洛基·邦斯莱，后又传给他的儿子沙吉。1636年阿迪勒·沙阿一方的将领穆拉尔·贾格德奥摧毁了城镇，但转投比贾布尔的沙吉很快收复封地，把妻子吉贾拜和年幼的希瓦吉安置于此，母子居住的拉尔玛哈尔宫于1640年落成，吉贾拜供奉的卡斯巴·甘尼许后来成为全城的保护神庙。此后浦那几经易手，1670年6月重回马拉塔之手；1703年至1705年奥朗则布占据此地，一度改名穆希阿巴德。1728年，佩什瓦巴吉·拉奥一世把朝廷从萨斯瓦德迁到浦那，在穆塔河畔修建沙尼瓦尔瓦达堡，1732年完工，此后九十年间一直是马拉塔政权的中枢。其子巴拉吉·巴吉拉奥在位时，城市不断扩展，新辟众多市集街区，建起帕尔瓦蒂山神庙群、卡特拉吉湖及引水渠，以及约两百五十座神庙和桥梁。1802年10月，雅什万特·拉奥·霍尔卡尔在浦那战役中击溃佩什瓦、占领城市，把英国人卷入下一场马拉塔战争；1817年11月5日佩什瓦的军队在卡德基溃败，1818年英军占领浦那，佩什瓦统治告终。

en:
Gulbarga—Kalburgi, the 'rocky land' of old Kannada inscriptions—commands a grain-growing plain in the northern Deccan. Chalukyas, Rashtrakutas and Kakatiyas held it before the armies of Delhi took the district in the early fourteenth century, and in 1347 Ala-ud-Din Bahman Shah made the town, renamed Hasanabad, the first capital of his independent Bahmani sultanate. Muhammad Shah I raised its Friday mosque within the fort in 1367, and the Persian master-builder Rafi roofed the whole courtyard with domes after the manner of the great mosque of Córdoba, making it one of the earliest such buildings in South India. The Chishti saint Gisu Daraz, invited south by Firuz Shah, died here in 1422, and his tomb shrine became one of the Deccan's great pilgrim places; east of the town stand the Haft Gumbaz, the domed tombs of the early sultans. Ahmad Shah I moved the court to Bidar in the 1420s, so in 1444 Gulbarga was a dethroned but proud fortress city, its Kannada-speaking Hindu countryside ruled by a Muslim elite.

The former capital kept being fought over. In 1512 Krishnadevaraya of Vijayanagara stormed Gulbarga and drove out the Bahmani minister Barid-i-Mamalik, then restored the puppet sultan to his throne as a client. When the Bahmani kingdom was formally dissolved in 1527 the district passed to the Barid Shahi sultans of Bidar, and it followed Bidar in 1619 when Ibrahim Adil Shah II annexed that sultanate to Bijapur. Aurangzeb's conquest of the Deccan brought Gulbarga into the Mughal Empire after the fall of Bijapur in 1686, and in the 1710s the Deccan viceroy Nizam-ul-Mulk, soon to style himself Asaf Jah I, folded the district into his all-but-independent realm of Hyderabad.
zh:
古尔伯加在古卡纳达碑铭中称卡尔布尔吉，意为「石地」，雄踞德干北部一片产粮平原之上。遮娄其人、罗湿陀罗拘陀人和卡卡提耶人先后保有此地，14世纪初德里苏丹国的军队将其攻取。1347年，阿拉—乌德—丁·巴曼沙在此定都，改城名为哈萨纳巴德，这里成为独立的巴赫曼尼苏丹国的第一座都城。穆罕默德沙一世于1367年在堡内建起聚礼清真寺，波斯匠师拉菲仿照科尔多瓦大清真寺，以层层穹顶覆盖整座庭院，是南印度最早的此类建筑之一。契斯提教团圣徒吉苏·达拉兹应菲鲁兹沙之邀南来，1422年在此去世，其陵庙后来成为德干最重要的朝圣圣地之一；城东还矗立着安葬早期苏丹的「七穹顶」陵墓群。艾哈迈德沙一世在1420年代将宫廷迁往比达尔，因此1444年的古尔伯加是一座逊位却仍自傲的堡垒之城：乡间是讲卡纳达语、信奉印度教的农户，统治他们的却是穆斯林精英。

这座故都此后仍一再易手。1512年，毗奢耶那伽罗的克里希纳德瓦拉亚攻陷古尔伯加，赶走巴赫马尼权臣巴里德—伊·马马利克，随后又把傀儡苏丹扶回王位，作为自己的附庸。1527年巴赫曼尼王国正式解体，这一地区归入比达尔的巴里德沙王朝；1619年易卜拉欣·阿迪尔沙二世吞并比达尔苏丹国，古尔伯加随之并入比贾布尔。1686年比贾布尔陷落后，奥朗则布征服德干，古尔伯加并入莫卧儿帝国；1710年代，德干总督尼扎姆—穆勒克——他不久便自称阿萨夫·贾赫一世——把这片地区纳入自己实际独立的海得拉巴国。

en:
Baglana is the hill country north of Nasik, where the forts of Salher and Mayuragiri, later better known as Mulher, overlook the trade road from Surat toward Daulatabad, Golkonda and Burhanpur. Its Rashtraudha chiefs bore the title baharji, claimed Rathore descent and ruled from ridges above grain-growing valleys. They had once coined their own money, but by the late fourteenth century the little Hindu kingdom paid tribute to Gujarat. In 1429 Ahmad Shah Bahmani ravaged the country yet failed to take its chief fort. In 1444 a Maratha-speaking raja still held the passes, supplying grain and guarding the merchants who crossed between Gujarat and the northern Deccan.

When Mubarak of Khandesh attacked Rai Manu in 1453 and 1454, Mahmud Khalji of Malwa intervened to protect his tributary. Ahmad Nizam Shah of Ahmadnagar forced Baglana to pay tribute in 1499. Its raja submitted to Akbar after Surat fell in 1573, and Pratap Shah later kept his forts by promising the Mughals free passage, gifts and a son as hostage. Malik Ambar's Deccani army overran the territory in 1609. In 1637 Shah Jahan placed Aurangzeb over the campaign, and Mulher surrendered in 1638; Baglana was attached to Mughal Khandesh. Shivaji took Salher in 1670 and relieved it from a Mughal siege in 1672, though the Mughals recovered the forts in 1684. The Nizam ruled after 1723, ceded Baglana to the Peshwa in 1795, and Mulher finally surrendered to the British on 3 July 1818.
zh:
巴格拉纳是纳西克以北的山地，萨莱尔堡和后来更广为人知的穆勒赫尔堡（旧称马尤拉吉里）俯瞰着从苏拉特通往道拉塔巴德、戈尔孔达和布尔汉布尔的商路。这里的拉什特劳陀首领号称巴哈尔吉，自称出自拉托尔家族，依靠山谷上的堡寨统治盛产谷物的谷地。他们过去曾自铸钱币，但到十四世纪末，这个印度教小邦已向古吉拉特称臣纳贡。1429年，艾哈迈德沙·巴赫曼尼纵兵蹂躏此地，却未能攻下主要堡垒。1444年，一位说马拉地语的拉杰仍控制山口，向来往于古吉拉特与北德干之间的商人供应谷物并提供护卫。

1453和1454年，坎德什的穆巴拉克进攻拉伊·马努，马尔瓦的马哈茂德·哈尔吉出兵保护这个藩属。1499年，艾哈迈德纳格尔的艾哈迈德·尼扎姆沙迫使巴格拉纳纳贡。1573年苏拉特陷落后，当地拉杰向阿克巴臣服；普拉塔普沙阿后来以保障商路通行、进献礼物并送一子为质，才保住自己的堡寨。1609年，马利克·安巴尔的德干军队攻占此地。1637年，沙贾汗命奥朗则布统军征讨，穆勒赫尔于1638年投降，巴格拉纳被并入莫卧儿的坎德什省。希瓦吉1670年夺取萨莱尔，并在1672年击退围城的莫卧儿军队，但诸堡又于1684年被莫卧儿收复。1723年后尼扎姆统治这里，1795年将巴格拉纳割给佩什瓦；穆勒赫尔最终于1818年7月3日向英军投降。

en:
Warangal, also called Orugallu, was the fortified capital raised by the Kakatiyas on the Telugu Deccan. Ganapatideva rebuilt its earthen fortress in stone in the thirteenth century, and Rudrama Devi and Prataparudra II strengthened its walls and gateways. Malik Kafur besieged it in 1309–10, and Ulugh Khan's campaign of 1323 ended Kakatiya rule and renamed the city Sultanpur. The Musunuri Nayakas recovered it in 1336, but the Recherla Nayakas displaced them in 1368. After the Recherlas turned to Vijayanagara, Bahmani armies captured Warangal and Rachakonda by 1435. In 1444 the old Telugu Hindu capital was a Bahmani-held fortress whose great stone gates stood amid ruined temples and tanks.

The Recherla chiefs returned with an Orissan army under Hamviradeva, recovered the forts by 1461, and ruled Orugallu as tributaries of the Gajapatis until Bahmani forces annexed the kingdom in 1475. When the Bahmani sultanate broke apart, Warangal passed to the Qutb Shahi sultans of Golconda, whose dynasty was established in 1518; barbicans were added to the fort gates between the fifteenth and seventeenth centuries. Aurangzeb conquered Golconda in 1687 and brought Warangal into the Mughal empire. In 1724 it passed with the southern Deccan to the Nizam of Hyderabad, under whom Warangal became a provincial district early in the nineteenth century.
zh:
瓦朗加尔又称奥鲁加卢，是卡卡提雅王朝在泰卢固德干建起的设防都城。13世纪，加纳帕蒂提婆把旧土堡改建成石堡，鲁德拉玛·德维与普拉塔普鲁陀罗二世又加固城墙和城门。1309至1310年，马利克·卡富尔围城；1323年，乌卢格汗的远征终结卡卡提雅统治，并把城市改名为苏丹布尔。穆苏努里·纳亚卡首领1336年收复瓦朗加尔，却在1368年被雷切尔拉·纳亚卡取代。雷切尔拉人转而投靠毗奢耶那伽罗后，巴赫曼尼军队发动进攻，到1435年攻下瓦朗加尔和拉查孔达。1444年，这座泰卢固印度教旧都已是巴赫曼尼掌握的要塞，巨大石门矗立在寺庙残迹与水塘之间。

雷切尔拉首领随后借助哈姆维拉提婆率领的奥里萨军队反攻，到1461年前收复诸堡，以加贾帕蒂王朝藩属的身份统治奥鲁加卢，直到1475年巴赫曼尼军队吞并其国。巴赫曼尼苏丹国瓦解后，瓦朗加尔归属于1518年建立的戈尔孔达库特卜·沙希王朝，城堡城门也在15至17世纪间加筑瓮城。1687年，奥朗则布征服戈尔孔达，把瓦朗加尔纳入莫卧儿帝国。1724年，它随德干南部转归海得拉巴尼扎姆，并在19世纪初成为其下属行政区。

en:
Midnapore stands on the Kangsabati River, at the northern edge of the Orissan coast. Its shoreline was the country behind Tamralipta, the ancient port near Tamluk whose spice trade was noted by Faxian and Xuanzang, while local chiefs of the Hijli creek country held the mouths of the rivers. By the fifteenth century the land formed the Jaleswar march of the Gajapati kings at Cuttack. In 1444 it belonged to Kapilendra Deva, founder of the Suryavamsa dynasty, a Hindu, Bengali-speaking borderland from which the Gajapati armies campaigned north into Bengal.

Around 1510 the bhakti saint Chaitanya passed this way from Puri to Varanasi. In 1568 the Afghan sultan Sulaiman Khan Karrani and his general Kalapahad overran Orissa, and after the Mughal conquest of the 1590s Midnapore became the Jaleswar sarkar of the Orissa subah; under Shah Jahan its chief Bahadur Khan of Hijli was defeated by the prince Shah Shuja. From 1742 Maratha raiders, the Bargis, swept through every year: Mir Jafar fought Mir Habib's men near the town before Alivardi Khan retook Midnapore in 1749, and the peace of 1751 left the border open to their raids. In 1760 Mir Qasim ceded the district with Burdwan and Chittagong to the East India Company. After the Khurda rising, the last Gajapati Mukunda Deva II and his minister Jayi Rajaguru were imprisoned in Midnapore in 1806, and Rajaguru was put to death there.
zh:
米德纳布尔坐落在甘萨巴蒂河畔，地处奥里萨沿海的北缘。其海岸一带的后方就是古港耽摩栗底，毗邻塔姆卢克，法显、玄奘都记载过这里的香料贸易；希吉利水网地带的地方首领则据守着各条河口。到15世纪，这片土地是克塔克伽贾帕蒂诸王的贾莱什沃尔边区。1444年时它属于苏利耶王朝的建立者卡皮伦德拉·德瓦，是一片印度教的孟加拉语边地，伽贾帕蒂的军队正是从这里北征孟加拉。

1510年前后，巴克提圣者柴坦尼亚从普里前往瓦拉纳西，途中经过此地。1568年，阿富汗苏丹苏莱曼·汗·卡拉尼派大将卡拉帕哈德席卷奥里萨；1590年代莫卧儿征服后，米德纳布尔成为奥里萨苏巴下辖的贾莱什沃尔专区，沙贾汗年间希吉利首领巴哈杜尔汗败于王子沙·舒贾。1742年起，被称为「巴吉」的马拉塔骑兵每年来掠，米尔·贾法尔曾在城边与米尔·哈比卜交手，阿里瓦迪汗1749年收复米德纳布尔，1751年的和约仍使边地频遭其袭。1760年，米尔·卡西姆把这一地区连同布尔德万和吉大港割让给东印度公司。库尔达起义后，末代伽贾帕蒂穆昆达·德瓦二世与大臣贾伊·拉杰古鲁1806年被囚于米德纳布尔，拉杰古鲁在此遇害。

en:
The Sunderbans form the tide-washed southern fringe of the Ganges Delta, where mangrove islands, salt creeks and raised rice fields meet the Bay of Bengal. Bagerhat, on the Bhairab River, lay on the settled edge of that wilderness. In 1444 it belonged to the Bengal Sultanate of Mahmud Shah, and Bengali fishermen and cultivators lived beside Muslim governors, Sufis and settlers moving south. Mahmud Shah's Turkic officer Khan Jahan Ali governed the Sundarbans frontier and was laying out roads, bridges, water tanks and brick mosques around the place soon known as the mint town of Khalifatabad.

Inscriptions dated between 1450 and 1459 place Khalifatabad's great building phase in Mahmud Shah's reign. Its most ambitious monument was the Sixty Dome Mosque, with sixty pillars and seventy-seven domes, while more than fifty sultanate-period buildings gave the district its distinctive Khan Jahan style. After Bengal came under Mughal rule, forest tracts were leased for clearance and new settlements. The East India Company obtained rights over the Sundarbans in 1757 and completed its mapping of the area in 1764, drawing the tidal forests, fishing grounds and rice lands into a colonial revenue frontier.
zh:
桑德班斯是恒河三角洲受潮汐冲刷的南缘，红树林岛屿、咸水溪汊与垫高的稻田在此通向孟加拉湾。巴盖尔哈德位于拜拉布河畔，处在这片莽林可定居的边缘。1444年，这里属于马哈茂德沙阿的孟加拉苏丹国；孟加拉渔民和耕作者与向南推进的穆斯林总督、苏非行者和移民毗邻而居。马哈茂德沙阿任命的突厥将领汗·贾汉·阿里管辖桑德班斯边疆，正在一带修筑道路、桥梁、贮水池和砖造清真寺，不久后这里便以铸币镇哈利法塔巴德闻名。

1450年至1459年的铭文表明，哈利法塔巴德的大规模建设正值马哈茂德沙阿在位时期。最宏伟的建筑是六十圆顶清真寺，它有六十根柱子和七十七个穹顶；苏丹国时代留下的五十多处建筑，使这一地区形成独特的汗·贾汉风格。孟加拉归入莫卧儿统治后，林地被租给人们清理和开辟新聚落。1757年，东印度公司取得桑德班斯的权利，并于1764年完成该地区测绘，将潮汐林、渔场和稻田纳入殖民税收边疆。

en:
Sadiya stands on the grassy right bank of the Lohit river where the Himalayan foothills close in, the easternmost town of the Assam valley. It was the capital of the Hinduised Chutia kingdom, Sadhyapuri in the kings' copper-plates, ringed with forts and brick ruins; its rulers grew powerful controlling the eastern trade, for three routes ran from here into Tibet, up the Dihang, the Dibang and the Lohit towards Zayul, and another led through the Shan state of Mongkawng to Yunnan. The Chutia kings also patronised the fierce goddess Kechai-khati, served by her own Deori priesthood. In 1444 the Chutia raja still ruled this frontier from Sadiya.

In 1524 a Mongkawng army under Phukloimung attacked from the direction of Myitkyina and was beaten back, but in the same year Suhungmung's Ahoms annexed the kingdom and appointed Prasengmung Borgohain the first Sadiya Khowa Gohain, who managed relations with the Mishmi, Adi and Miri hill tribes. Ahom expeditions chastised unruly Miri villages in 1665 and 1683, and a great earthquake shattered the hills around Sadiya in 1697. The Moamoria rising of 1769 began among the Morans of this eastern tract, and its chiefs later built the tributary Matak state at nearby Bengmara. The Khamti rising of 1799 was dispersed, but in 1810–1811 Khamtis with Singpho allies expelled the last Sadiya Khowa Gohain, and after 1817 their chiefs aided the Burmese conquest of the valley.
zh:
萨地亚坐落在洛希特河右岸的草原上，四周群山环抱，是阿萨姆河谷最东端的城镇。这里是印度教化的楚蒂亚王国的都城，铜版铭文中称作萨达亚普拉，城周堡寨与砖石遗迹林立；楚蒂亚统治者因控制东方商路而强盛——从萨地亚入藏有三条路，分别溯迪杭河、迪邦河与洛希特河而上，后者通往察隅，另有商道经掸邦孟拱抵达云南。楚蒂亚诸王还供奉凶猛的凯猜卡蒂女神（又称塔姆雷斯瓦里），由世代承袭的德奥里祭司主持。1444年，楚蒂亚罗贾仍以此城统辖这片边地。

1524年，孟拱的普克洛伊蒙从密支那方向来攻，被击退；但同年苏洪蒙的阿洪姆大军吞并了楚蒂亚王国，任命普拉森蒙·博尔戈海因为首任萨地亚科瓦·戈海因（萨地亚总督），负责与僜人、阿迪人和米里人等山地部落周旋。1665年和1683年，阿洪姆两度出兵征讨不服管束的米里村落；1697年一场大地震摧毁萨地亚，多处山体崩塌。1769年的摩亚马里亚起义在这片东方摩朗人的土地上爆发，起义首领后来在附近的本格马拉建立纳贡称臣的莫塔克政权。1799年坎底人的骚乱被驱散，但1810至1811年坎底人联合景颇人（辛颇人）驱逐了末任萨地亚科瓦·戈海因，1817年以后其首领又协助缅甸征服整个河谷。

en:
Manipur is the small rice plain of the Imphal valley, ringed by Naga and Kuki-Chin hills. Meitei farmers and weavers held the valley while related Tibeto-Burman clans occupied the ridges around it. The Ningthouja rulers had made Kangla, on the Imphal River, their fortified seat and absorbed neighboring clan lands, and a written constitution was recorded in the early twelfth century. A Pagan inscription of 1442 numbered Kasan among the principalities claimed by the Mong Mao ruler Thonganbwa, but in 1444 the Meitei court of Kangleipak still ruled from Kangla, followed its old ancestral rites, and Imphal weaving was already known along the hill tracks toward Cachar, Tripura and the Shan country.

In 1559 Bayinnaung of Toungoo ordered an invasion; Binnya Dala led three Shan-dominated armies and the Manipuri king surrendered without a fight, making the valley a Toungoo vassal. Khagemba's reign from 1597 brought rebuilding after northern border wars: captured Chinese artisans built bridges, walls and the Kangla gate, while coins, markets including Ema market, and Muslim migrants became part of Imphal life. In 1717 Pamheiba, also called Gharib Niwaz, made Hinduism the state religion, and in 1724 he renamed Kangleipak as Manipur; his long wars against Burma and Tripura included the capture of Sagaing in 1738. A Burmese invasion in 1819 opened the Seven Years Devastation, sending many Meitei refugees to Cachar, Tripura and Sylhet, and in 1821 Kangla remained under Burmese occupation.
zh:
曼尼坡是以因帕尔河谷为中心的小片稻米平原，四周环抱着那加与库基-钦丘陵。梅泰农民和织工居于谷底，与他们有亲缘关系的藏缅语部族则分布在周围山脊。宁托贾君主以因帕尔河畔的康拉堡为设防王庭，逐步兼并邻近氏族之地，并在12世纪初形成成文政制。1442年蒲甘的一方铭文把卡桑列入蒙毛统治者思昂法名义下的诸邦，但1444年，坎格莱帕克的梅泰王庭仍在康拉自治，奉行旧有的祖先仪轨；因帕尔织物也已沿通往卡恰尔、特里普拉和掸地的山路闻名。

1559年，东吁国王勃印曩下令入侵，彬尼亚·达拉率领三支以掸邦兵为主的军队前来，曼尼坡国王不战而降，河谷成为东吁属邦。1597年开始的卡格姆巴统治带来边境战争后的重建：被俘的中国工匠修筑桥梁、城墙和康拉门，铸币、包括埃马市集在内的市场以及穆斯林移民也进入因帕尔生活。1717年，又称噶尔布·尼瓦兹的旁赫巴立印度教为国教，1724年将国名改为曼尼坡；他长期同缅甸和特里普拉作战，并在1738年攻占实皆。1819年缅甸入侵，开启「七年浩劫」，许多梅泰难民逃往卡恰尔、特里普拉和锡尔赫特；到1821年，康拉仍处于缅甸占领之下。

en:
Gauhati lies where the Brahmaputra narrows below the Nilachal hills, on the site of Pragjyotishpura, a capital of ancient Kamarupa. Above the town on Nilachal stood Kamakhya, the great shrine of the goddess worshipped as a natural stone without image, patronised down the centuries by Kamarupa's kings. By 1444 Kamarupa had long been gone: Baro-Bhuyan chiefs held its ferries and hill-forts, the Kamata kingdom ruled the lowlands to the west, and the town's own name spoke of its long rows of areca-nut stalls.

In 1498 Alauddin Husain Shah of Gaur overran Kamata and wrecked Kamakhya, but his son and governor Danyal was soon captured and killed by the Bhuyans under Harup Narayan, and the land reverted to confederate chiefs. Bisu, who took the Hindu name Biswa Singha, subdued the Bhuyans from about 1509 and had himself crowned king of Kamata in 1515; under his son Nara Narayan and the general Chilarai the Koch power reached its height, and Kamakhya rose again in 1565. The kingdom was divided in 1581, its eastern half becoming Koch Hajo, which fell to the Mughals in 1613–1614. Guwahati then changed hands with every war: the Ahoms held it from 1658, lost it to Mir Jumla in 1662, retook it in 1667, lost the field of Alaboi in 1669, and destroyed Raja Ram Singh's fleet at Saraighat in 1671; after one last Mughal interlude the Ahoms retook it for good at Itakhuli in 1682 and made the town the Borphukan's seat. Captain Welsh reoccupied it for the Ahom king in 1792, and by 1821 Burmese garrisons held the river gate.
zh:
高哈蒂（Gauhati，古瓦哈蒂）位于布拉马普特拉河在尼拉查尔丘陵下收窄之处，其地即迦摩缕波旧都波罗吉奥提什普尔。尼拉查尔山上的卡摩加耶庙奉祀不以神像现身的女神，历代迦摩缕波国王皆为檀越。1444年时迦摩缕波早已不存：巴罗—布扬豪酋据守渡口与山堡，西方低地归迦摩塔王国统属，而城名本身就来自成行成市的槟榔摊。

1498年，高尔的阿拉乌丁·侯赛因·沙阿攻灭迦摩塔、捣毁卡摩加耶庙，但他派驻当地的儿子达尼亚尔不久便被赫鲁普·纳拉扬率领的布扬人擒杀，土地重回诸豪酋之手。出身科奇部落的比苏（改宗印度教后名比斯瓦·辛哈）约自1509年起逐一征服布扬首领，1515年加冕为迦摩塔国王；其子纳拉纳拉扬与名将奇拉莱把科奇王国推向鼎盛，卡摩加耶庙也于1565年重建。1581年王国分裂，东半称科奇哈乔，1613至1614年被莫卧儿攻灭。此后古瓦哈蒂随战局数易其手：阿洪姆1658年据有，1662年陷于米尔·久姆拉，1667年收复，1669年在阿拉博伊战败，1671年于萨拉伊加特歼灭拉贾·拉姆·辛格的水师；莫卧儿最后一次短暂占领后，阿洪姆于1682年伊塔库里之战永久收回此城，并以之为博尔普坎的驻地。1792年韦尔什上尉为阿洪姆国王兵不血刃重占此地，到1821年，这座河上门户已由缅甸军队驻守。

en:
Balasore, or Baleshwar, takes its name from the old Baneshwar Shiva temple in Puruna Baleswar and lies on the Burhabalanga River where it meets the Bay of Bengal, the northernmost coastal tract of Orissa. Just to its north, near the mouth of the Subarnarekha, stood Pipili, a port already busy with Portuguese shipping. The country had belonged to Kalinga and Utkal and then to the Gajapati rajas; in 1444 it was part of the empire of Kapilendra Deva at Cuttack, an Oriya Hindu land whose rice and fine cotton cloth drew merchants to its roadsteads.

In 1568 the Afghan armies of Sulaiman Khan Karrani, led by Kalapahad, ended Gajapati rule. At Tukaroi, in this district, Munim Khan defeated Daud Khan Karrani in 1575, and the Treaty of Katak left him only Orissa; Daud died at Rajmahal in 1576. Under Mughal rule Balasore became the busiest port of the Orissa coast: the English East India Company opened a factory there in 1633, and a fine cotton muslin came to be named after the town. In 1686 Company ships bombarded the port during the Anglo-Mughal War and were driven off by Mughal troops. From 1751 the Bhonsle rajas of Nagpur held the district until the Maratha defeat of 1803, when it passed to the Company under the Treaty of Deogaon and was attached to the Bengal Presidency.
zh:
巴拉索尔又译巴莱什瓦尔，得名于旧巴拉索尔的巴内什瓦尔湿婆神庙，城在布拉巴朗加河注入孟加拉湾处，是奥里萨最北的沿海地带。城北不远、苏巴尔纳雷卡河口附近，就是当时已挤满葡萄牙商船的皮皮利港。这一带先后属于羯陵伽、乌特加尔和伽贾帕蒂诸王；1444年时它是克塔卡卡皮伦德拉·德瓦帝国的一部分，是一片奥里萨人的印度教土地，出产的稻米和细棉布把商人吸引到它的外港锚地。

1568年，苏莱曼·汗·卡拉尼麾下、由卡拉帕哈德率领的阿富汗大军终结了伽贾帕蒂的统治。1575年，穆尼姆汗在本县境内的图卡罗伊击败达乌德·汗·卡拉尼，克塔克条约只给他留下奥里萨；达乌德于1576年在拉杰马哈尔败死。莫卧儿治下，巴拉索尔成为奥里萨沿海最繁忙的港口：英国东印度公司1633年在此开设商馆，一种精细棉布也以这座城市命名。1686年英莫战争中，公司舰队炮轰港口，被莫卧儿军队击退。1751年起，那格浦尔的邦斯勒王公统治此地，直到1803年马拉塔战败，依德奥冈条约割让给东印度公司，并入孟加拉管区。

en:
Bhagalpur, remembered as Champa Nagari, lies on the southern bank of the Ganges in the old country of Anga. Local weavers made tussar silk a staple of river trade, and upstream near Kahalgaon stood the ruins of Vikramashila, a Pala Buddhist mahavihara founded around 800 and destroyed with other monasteries by Muhammad bin Bakhtiyar Khalji's forces about 1193. In 1444 the town was a western march of the Bengal Sultanate, ruled from Gaur by Nasiruddin Mahmud Shah of the restored Ilyas Shahi dynasty; its largely Hindu population lived on a frontier held together by the Ganges road.

Early in the sixteenth century Kahalgaon sheltered Husain Shah Sharqi after Lodi power drove the last Jaunpur sultan from his capital. The same river road later carried Sher Shah Suri against Bengal. On 6 April 1538 he defeated Ghiyasuddin Mahmud Shah, last sultan of the Husain Shahi line, and sacked Gaur; the wounded sultan died soon afterward in the Kahalgaon area. After the Suri collapse in 1556 and Akbar's conquest of Bengal in 1576, Bhagalpur became part of Mughal Bihar, its tolls and silk traffic tied to the Ganges route.
zh:
帕戈尔布尔古称占巴纳格里，位于古老安伽地区的恒河南岸。当地织工生产的柞蚕丝是恒河贸易的重要商品；上游乔尔贡格附近留有超戒寺遗址，这座波罗王朝的佛教大寺约建于800年，1193年前后与其他寺院一同被穆罕默德·本·巴赫蒂亚尔·哈尔吉的军队摧毁。1444年，帕戈尔布尔是孟加拉苏丹国的西部边地，由复辟的伊利亚斯·沙希王朝苏丹纳赛尔丁·马哈茂德·沙阿在高尔统治；当地以印度教徒为主，依靠恒河道路维系着这片边疆。

16世纪初，末代江布尔苏丹侯赛因·沙阿·沙尔基被洛迪势力逐出都城后，曾在乔尔贡格避难。后来，舍尔沙·苏利也沿这条恒河道路进兵孟加拉。1538年4月6日，他击败侯赛因·沙希王朝末代苏丹吉亚斯丁·马哈茂德·沙阿并洗劫高尔；受伤的苏丹不久死于乔尔贡格一带。1556年苏尔王朝崩溃、1576年阿克巴征服孟加拉后，帕戈尔布尔成为莫卧儿比哈尔的一部分，关税和丝绸贸易继续依附恒河水道。

en:
Rangpur stands on the Ghaghat River near the Teesta, on the northern edge of the old Barind or Varendra country, whose red laterite fields stretched between the Karatoya and the plains of Gaur. The sultans of Bengal had kept Ghoraghat as a northern military post since the early thirteenth century, watching the Koch, Bhuyan and Kamata marches. In 1444 Mahmud Shah ruled from Gaur at the head of the restored Ilyas Shahi dynasty, while Rangpur itself was still a network of markets and villages rather than the district seat it later became. Its weavers made satranji, the patterned rugs and floor coverings that wealthy households of North Bengal displayed as marks of status.

In 1498 Alauddin Husain Shah's army passed this way against Kamata, overthrowing the Khen kings and briefly holding the country as far as Hajo. Humayun's campaign of 1538 carried Mughal arms into Gaur, but Sher Shah Suri's victory gave Bengal to the Sur government in 1539. Akbar's commander Raja Man Singh took Rangpur in 1575, and in Todar Mal's revenue settlement Ghoraghat became a great sarkar covering southern Rangpur and neighbouring tracts, with eighty-four mahals and raw silk among its assessed products. Local chiefs kept much of their autonomy, and the area was fully integrated into the Mughal Empire only in 1686. In 1661 a Koch raid on Ghoraghat brought an imperial counter-invasion that stormed Koch Bihar and named it Alamgirnagar. After the Company received Bengal's diwani in 1765, Rangpur District was organised and the town was confirmed as its seat on 16 December 1769; in the following decades Fakir and Sannyasi bands, including followers of Majnu Shah, fought its tax collectors in the northern jungles.
zh:
朗布尔位于加加特河畔、邻近提斯塔河，地处古巴林德（又称瓦伦德拉）地区北缘；红色黏土地带从加拉托亚河一直铺向高尔平原。早在13世纪初，孟加拉苏丹便把戈尔加特作为北方军站，监视科奇人、布安酋长和卡马塔边地。1444年，马茂德沙阿在高尔统治，是为恢复后的伊利亚斯·沙希王朝；此时的朗布尔还是市集与村落网络，尚未成为后来的县治。当地织工生产萨特兰吉织毯，这种有图案的铺地织物是北孟加拉富户展示身份的物件。

1498年，阿拉丁·侯赛因·沙阿的军队经此地进攻卡马塔，推翻肯王朝，一度把势力推进到哈乔。1538年胡马雍的征战把莫卧儿军队带到高尔，但舍尔沙·苏利获胜后，孟加拉在1539年转入苏尔政权治下。1575年，阿克巴的将领曼·辛格攻占朗布尔；在托达尔·马尔的税收整理中，戈尔加特成为下辖朗布尔南部及邻近地区的大萨尔卡尔，领有84个马哈尔，生丝也是其计税物产之一。地方酋长仍保有很大自治权，整个地区直到1686年才完全并入莫卧儿帝国。1661年，科奇军队袭击戈尔加特，引来帝国军队反攻，攻破库奇比哈尔并将其命名为阿拉姆吉尔讷格尔。1765年东印度公司取得孟加拉迪万尼权后，朗布尔县得以组建，城镇在1769年12月16日被确认为县治；此后数十年间，法基尔和桑尼亚西武装——包括马杰努·沙阿的追随者——在北方丛林中抗击其税吏。

en:
Nasirabad is the later sultanate name for the Old Brahmaputra country that became Mymensingh. The tract had once belonged to Kamarupa, and after Kamarupa's breakup it passed into the loose orbit of the Bengal sultans. In 1444 Mahmud Shah's government at Gaur claimed the march between populous Bengal and the Garo Hills and granted forested or riverine estates to incoming landlords, but marshes, shifting rivers and jungle gave Delhi-style officials little purchase. Bengali Hindu villagers cultivated the broader lowlands, while Garo, Hajong and Koch communities kept the country below the hills. The name Nasirabad itself still lay in the future, associated with Nasiruddin Nasrat Shah of the early sixteenth century.

In the late fifteenth and early sixteenth centuries, Bengal's sultans settled more zamindar families in the district, which later entered the records as Tappe Hazradi within the sarkar of Bazuha. After the Karrani dynasty fell in 1576, Isa Khan united the Baro-Bhuyan landholders of Bhati and held this Brahmaputra frontier against Mughal armies until his death in 1599. His son Musa Khan remained the chief of the confederacy until his death in 1623, yet imperial authority in Mymensingh stayed weak, while the rajas of Susang ruled the northern pargana beneath the Garo Hills. The East India Company acquired revenue rights with the diwani of 1765; after the 1770 famine, Fakir and Sannyasi bands fought landlords and Company forces through 1772–1790. Mymensingh District was constituted on 1 May 1787, with its headquarters moved from flooded Begunbari to the Mymensingh site. In the northern estates Karam Shah's syncretic Pagal Panthi following grew among Garo, Hajong and Rajbanshi peasants, passing to his son Tipu Shah when Karam Shah died in 1813.
zh:
纳西拉巴德是后来苏丹朝给予旧布拉马普特拉河一带的名称，这片地区即日后的迈门辛。它原属迦摩缕波，迦摩缕波瓦解后才进入孟加拉苏丹国松散的势力范围。1444年，高尔的马茂德沙阿朝廷声称统治这片介于孟加拉人口腹地与加罗丘陵之间的边地，把林地里和河畔的封地授予迁入的地主；但沼泽、改道的河流与丛林使中央官僚难以深入。孟加拉印度教徒耕种开阔低地，加罗人、哈宗人和科奇人则据有丘陵脚下的地带。纳西拉巴德这个名字当时尚未出现，要到16世纪初纳西尔丁·努斯拉特沙阿时才见于后来的记忆。

15世纪末至16世纪初，孟加拉苏丹把更多柴明达尔家族安置到这里，该地区后来在莫卧儿册籍中属巴祖哈萨尔卡尔下的塔佩·哈兹拉迪。1576年卡拉尼王朝灭亡后，伊萨汗联合巴蒂地区的巴罗-布安地主，在这条布拉马普特拉边线上抵御莫卧儿军队，直至1599年去世。其子穆萨汗继续担任联盟首领，直到1623年死去，但迈门辛的帝国威权始终薄弱，北方加罗丘陵脚下的苏桑帕尔格纳德仍由当地罗阇统治。东印度公司在1765年取得迪万尼税收权；1770年大饥荒后，法基尔和桑尼亚西武装在1772—1790年间持续攻击地主与公司军队。迈门辛县于1787年5月1日设立，县治因贝贡巴里遭洪水破坏而迁到迈门辛。北方封地中，卡拉姆沙阿融合诸教的帕加尔潘提团体在加罗人、哈宗人和拉杰班希农民中壮大，并在1813年卡拉姆沙阿死后传给他的儿子蒂普沙阿。

en:
Tirhut, called Mithila or Tirabhukti in older records, is the plain between the Gandaki and Mahananda rivers, where the Himalayan foothills fall to the Ganges. Its people speak Maithili, and its Brahmins have long set the region's standing in sacred law and letters. The Karnat kings ruled from Simraungadh until the Tughluq invasion of 1324 drove the last of them into Nepal; the Delhi sultan then placed a Maithil Brahmin scholar on the throne, and the Oiniwar dynasty that followed made first Oini and then Sugauna its capital. King Sivasimha struck gold coins and claimed sovereignty, and after he was lost in the wars of the early fifteenth century his queen Lakhimadevi, his brother Padmasimha and Padmasimha's queen Vishwasa Devi held the throne in turn. In 1444 the Brahmin rajas of Sugauna still rule a Hindu Mithila beyond the reach of Delhi, and the aged poet Vidyapati, who served seven of their kings and two queens and made Maithili a literary tongue, is spending his last years at their court.

The Oiniwar line ended with Laxminath Singh Deva, whose bid for independence cost him his life at the hands of Sultan Nusrat Shah of Bengal, who reigned from 1519 to 1533; there followed some thirty years in which rival Rajput clans warred across the country. Order returned with the Mughals, who named the Maithil Brahmin scholar Mahesh Thakur caretaker of Tirhut on the festival of Rama Navami in 1557, and by 1574 the Rajput rajas had submitted. Tirhut became the largest sarkar of the Bihar subah, with more than a hundred mahals assessed from Darbhanga. A firman of Aurangzeb in 1684 turned the Darbhanga family's lands into hereditary property free of tribute to the nawabs of Bengal, and a force Alivardi Khan sent against Narendra Singh in 1750 was defeated. The diwani of Bihar passed to the East India Company in 1765, and by the early nineteenth century Tirhut had become indigo country, its blue dye shipped from Ganges factories to Europe.
zh:
蒂鲁德旧称弥萨罗、提拉布格蒂，是甘达基河与默哈嫩达河之间的平原，北倚喜马拉雅山麓，南抵恒河。当地操迈蒂利语，迈蒂利婆罗门长期以经学与文章维系此地的声望。卡尔纳特王朝曾以锡姆劳恩加尔为都，1324年图格卢克军队入侵，末王逃往尼泊尔；德里苏丹改立一位迈蒂利婆罗门学者为王，其后的奥伊尼瓦尔王朝先后定都奥伊尼与苏高纳。国王湿婆辛哈铸造金币、宣示独立，他在15世纪初的战乱中失踪后，王后拉希玛德维、其弟帕德马辛哈、帕德马辛哈的王后毗湿瓦萨德维相继当政。1444年，苏高纳的婆罗门罗阇仍统治着不受德里管辖的印度教弥萨罗；侍奉过七位国王、两位王后并使迈蒂利语成为文学语言的老诗人维迪亚帕提，正在他们的宫廷中度过晚年。

奥伊尼瓦尔王朝亡于拉克希米纳特·辛格·德瓦：他谋求独立，被1519至1533年在位的孟加拉苏丹努斯拉特沙阿所杀，此后约三十年间拉杰普特诸族混战不休。秩序随莫卧儿人恢复：1557年罗摩诞辰节，朝廷任命迈蒂利婆罗门学者马赫什·塔库尔代管蒂鲁德，到1574年各地拉杰普特罗阇均已臣服。蒂鲁德成为比哈尔苏巴最大的萨尔卡尔，下辖百余默哈尔，治所设在达尔班加。1684年奥朗则布下诏，将达尔班加家族的领地定为世袭私产，免向孟加拉纳瓦布纳贡；1750年阿里瓦尔迪汗出兵征讨纳伦德拉·辛格，也被击退。1765年比哈尔的迪万财税权移交东印度公司；到19世纪初，蒂鲁德已是靛蓝之乡，蓝色染料经恒河各商埠运往欧洲。

en:
Jeypore's province is a forested Eastern Ghats plateau watered by the Machkund, long separated from the coastal plains by ridges, monsoon forest and the forts of Garjat chiefs. Its older political centre was Nandapur, seat of the Silavamsa kings. Pratap Ganga Raja granted lands around Bobbili in 1427 and led a raid to the Bay of Bengal about 1434, where a Srikurmam inscription says he washed his sword in the sea. He died in 1443, and Vinayak Dev of Gudari, husband of his daughter Lilavati, carried the kingdom into a new dynasty later called Suryavansh. In 1444 Nandapur thus stood at the edge of Kapilendra Deva's rising Gajapati power, drawing wealth from hill clearings, jungle timber and the trade roads between Raipur and Visakhapatnam.

Bhairava Dev defended Kondapalli for the Gajapatis against Krishnadevaraya in 1516. Vishwanath Dev Gajapati, ruling from 1527 to 1571, moved his capital to Rayagada, built a mud fort and patronized temples along the Nagavali. After the Gajapati collapse of 1540 the highland kingdom briefly widened its freedom, but in 1571 it became tributary to the Qutb Shahis of Golconda. In the mid-seventeenth century Veer Vikram Dev founded Jeypore and moved the court away from Nandapur, placing the dynasty deeper in the hills. Vishwambhara Dev II ruled from Narayanapatna between 1713 and 1752, when Chaitanya's Vaishnavism helped bind the court to its Khond subjects. After Vikram Dev I joined regional resistance, a British expedition destroyed the Jeypore fort in 1775. His son Rama Chandra Dev II, ruling from 1781, chose cooperation; the 1803 permanent settlement assessed the estate at 16,000 rupees, after which he built a new capital and palace at Jeypore.
zh:
杰伊布尔一省位于东高止山的森林高原，马奇昆德河流经此地，山岭、季风雨林和迦贾德首领们的寨堡长期把它与海岸平原隔开。当地更早的政治中心是南都普尔，尸罗王朝诸王以此为都。波罗多波·恒伽罗阇1427年把博比利一带的土地封给将领，约1434年又远征至孟加拉湾；室利俱卢摩的一篇铭文称他曾在海中洗剑。他于1443年去世，女婿、古达里统治者毗那夜迦·提婆继承南都普尔，开启后来称作日族的新王朝。因此在1444年，南都普尔正处在卡皮伦德拉·提婆崛起的伽贾帕蒂势力边缘，靠山坡耕地、丛林木材以及连接赖布尔与维沙卡帕特南的商路积聚财富。

1516年，拜罗婆·提婆作为伽贾帕蒂的藩属，在孔达帕利抵御克里希纳德瓦拉亚的进攻。毗湿瓦纳特·提婆·伽贾帕蒂于1527年至1571年间在位，把首都迁到拉亚加达，修筑土堡并赞助讷加瓦利河沿岸的神庙。1540年伽贾帕蒂帝国崩溃后，这个高地王国一度获得更大自主，却在1571年向高康达的库特卜沙希王朝纳贡。17世纪中叶，维拉·毗羯罗摩·提婆创建杰伊布尔，把宫廷从南都普尔迁往高原更深处。毗湿瓦姆巴拉·提婆二世1713年至1752年以纳拉亚纳帕特纳为都，遮伊坦耶的毗湿奴信仰成为王室与孔德族臣民之间的重要纽带。毗羯罗摩·提婆一世参加地方抵抗后，英国远征军于1775年摧毁杰伊布尔寨堡。他的儿子罗摩·旃陀罗·提婆二世1781年继位后转而采取合作策略；1803年的永久清丈规定该领地缴纳16000卢比贡赋，此后他在杰伊布尔修建新的都城和王宫。

en:
Khurda is the laterite upland immediately south of Cuttack, between the Mahanadi and the hills of the Garhjat country, where Savara villagers and the fort-holders of the interior raised grain on the forest margins. In 1444 the land lay within the Gajapati empire of Kapilendra Deva, its local rajas holding their hill forts as feudatories of Cuttack, and the great temple of Jagannath at nearby Puri drew pilgrims through its markets.

After the Afghan conquest of 1568 the Bhoi prince Ramachandra Deva I made Khurda the seat of a reduced Gajapati realm that stretched from the Mahanadi to Khimidi, and his fortress became known as the last independent fort of Orissa. He resumed the patronage of Jagannath at Puri and built the Sakshigopal temple, while his successors ruled as tributaries of the Mughals until Divyasingha Deva defeated the governor of Bengal in 1707 and the kingdom stood free from 1717. Maratha armies made it their tributary in 1741, confirmed in 1751. The East India Company took Orissa in 1803 under the Treaty of Deogaon, and when Mukunda Deva II rose against them his minister Jayi Rajaguru was executed in 1806 and the raja deposed, then pensioned at Puri in 1809. In 1817 the Paika militia rose again under Bakshi Jagabandhu, mustering under the banner of Jagannath before Company troops put the rising down.
zh:
库尔达（今译科尔达）是克塔克以南紧邻的红土高地，处在默哈讷迪河与迦贾德山区之间，萨瓦拉村民和内陆的堡寨首领在林缘地带种植谷物。1444年时，这片土地属于卡皮伦德拉·德瓦的伽贾帕蒂帝国，地方罗阇以克塔克封臣的身份据守山寨；附近普里的贾格纳特大庙香客云集，也带动了这里的市集。

1568年阿富汗人征服后，博伊王族的罗摩昌德拉·德瓦一世把库尔达立为这个缩水版伽贾帕蒂王国的都城，其疆域北起默哈讷迪河、南抵基米迪，他的堡垒后来被称为奥里萨最后的独立要塞。他恢复了对普里贾格纳特神庙的供养，又修建了萨克希戈帕尔神庙；后继诸王作为莫卧儿的附庸统治，直到迪维辛哈·德瓦1707年击败孟加拉总督，王国1717年起自立。1741年马拉塔大军使其称臣，1751年再经条约确认。1803年，东印度公司依德奥冈条约取得奥里萨；穆昆达·德瓦二世起而反抗失败，大臣贾伊·拉杰古鲁1806年被处死，罗阇被废，1809年以年金身份安置在普里。1817年，派喀民兵在巴克希·贾加班杜率领下再度举事，以贾格纳特为号召集结，最终被公司军队镇压。

en:
Chanda is the thickly forested Wardha valley, where teak and bamboo grew along the rivers and the Gond rajas kept their forts apart from the Muslim sultanates of the northern plain. An earlier Mana line had ruled the country from Wairagarh until the Gond chief Kol Bhil overthrew it; Bhim Ballal Singh of the Atram clan then founded the Gond house of Chanda by about 1320, with his capital at Sirpur on the Wardha and his stronghold at Manikgarh. In 1444 the Ballal Singh kings still reigned at Sirpur, sending timber and forest produce out along the Wardha and owning no suzerain.

Late in the fifteenth century Khandkya Ballal Shah built the riverside fort of Ballarpur – the Ballarsah of later maps – and founded a walled new capital at Chandrapur, where nine generations of his line held court. Babji Ballal Shah was fully independent when the Ain-i-Akbari was compiled, though he soon paid tribute after the Mughals formed the Berar subah; Krishna Shah joined Khan-i-Dauran's campaign against Deogarh in 1637. The Chanda rajas were famed for irrigation tanks and the first settled revenue system among the Gond kingdoms, but the last of them, Nilkanth Shah, was defeated by Raghoji I Bhonsle of Nagpur in 1749 and shut up in Ballarpur fort; the Marathas annexed Chanda in 1751.
zh:
昌达是森林茂密的瓦尔达河谷，沿河盛产柚木和竹子，贡德诸王的堡寨与北方平原上的穆斯林苏丹国保持着距离。更早的马纳王朝曾以瓦伊拉加尔为都统治此地，后被贡德首领科尔·比尔推翻；阿特拉姆氏族的比姆·巴拉尔·辛格约在1320年建立昌达贡德王统，定都瓦尔达河畔的西尔布尔，以马尼加尔为要塞。1444年，巴拉尔·辛格诸王仍在西尔布尔在位，木材与山货顺瓦尔达河外运，不向任何政权称臣。

15世纪后期，汉德基亚·巴拉尔·沙阿在河畔修筑巴拉尔布尔堡——即后世地图上的巴拉尔沙——并在昌德拉布尔建起有城墙的新都，其后九代王都在此临朝。《阿克巴则例》成书时，巴布吉·巴拉尔·沙阿尚完全独立；莫卧儿设立贝拉尔苏巴后，他开始向德里纳贡。1637年，克里希纳·沙阿随汗伊道兰出征代奥格尔。昌达诸王以灌溉水塘和贡德诸王国中第一套完备的赋税制度闻名，但末代王尼尔坎特·沙阿于1749年被那格浦尔的拉古吉·邦斯勒一世击败，囚禁于巴拉尔布尔堡；1751年马拉塔人吞并昌达。

en:
Gohilvad is the south-eastern coast of the Saurashtra peninsula along the Gulf of Khambhat, and takes its name from the Gohil Rajputs who settled the country around 1260 and held it from Sejakpur, Umrala and Sihor. At Palitana the Shatrunjaya hill carries more than nine hundred marble temples, the holiest pilgrimage of the Svetambara Jains, whose merchants were the chief traders of these harbours. In 1444 the land was divided among small Gohil chieftaincies, Sihor and Palitana among them, Hindu Rajput lords living in the shadow of the Gujarat Sultanate, while coastal craft sailed between these creeks and the markets of Khambhat and Diu.

After the Mughal conquest of Gujarat, imperial authority reached the Kathiawar chiefs as well: in 1656 Prince Murad Bakhsh, Shah Jahan's son governing Gujarat, granted the village of Palitana to the great Jain merchant-banker Shantidas Jhaveri, and in 1730 the hill temples were placed under the Anandji Kalyanji trust. When Maratha raiders threatened Sihor, Bhavsinhji Gohil repelled Khanthaji Kadani and Pilaji Gaekwad in 1722-1723 and in 1723 founded a new harbour seat, named Bhavnagar after himself, whose ships traded to the Persian Gulf, Mozambique and Zanzibar. His grandson Vakhatsinhji took Talaja and Chital in 1793 and added the ports of Ghogha and Mahuva, and in 1807 Bhavnagar accepted British protection.
zh:
格锡瓦德是索拉什特拉半岛东南、坎贝湾西岸的沿海之地，名称来自戈希尔拉杰普特人；他们约在1260年迁居此地，先后以塞贾克布尔、乌姆拉拉和锡霍尔为据点。在巴利塔纳，沙特伦贾亚山上建有九百余座大理石神殿，是白衣派耆那教徒最神圣的朝圣地，耆那教商人也是这些港湾最主要的贸易者。1444年，这片土地由戈希尔人的小酋邦分据，锡霍尔与巴利塔纳即在其中；这些印度教拉杰普特王公处在古吉拉特苏丹国的势力阴影下，近海小船往来于各处河湾与坎贝、第乌的市场之间。

莫卧儿征服古吉拉特后，帝国权威也及于卡提阿瓦的首领：1656年，沙贾汗之子、出镇古吉拉特的穆拉德·巴克什把巴利塔纳村封给耆那教大商人兼银行家尚蒂达斯·扎韦里；1730年，山上神殿交由阿南德吉·卡尔扬吉信托会管理。马拉塔人来犯时，巴夫辛格吉·戈希尔于1722至1723年击退坎塔吉·卡达尼与皮拉吉·盖克瓦德，又于1723年营建新的港口都城，以自己的名字命名为包纳加尔，商船远航波斯湾、莫桑比克和桑给巴尔。其孙瓦卡辛格吉1793年攻取塔拉贾与奇塔尔，又并入戈加、马胡瓦等港口；1807年，包纳加尔接受英国保护。

en:
Halar is the coastal plain fronting the Gulf of Kutch in north-western Saurashtra, where a string of small ports lived by the gulf's pearl banks. In 1444 the country was divided among Hindu Rajput clans: the Jethwas held the little port of Nagnath, the Chavdas held Dhrol, the Vadhels Khambhalia and the Dedas the Jodiya lands, while Kathi herdsmen grazed the inland pastures. The name Halar belonged to the future; it would be coined for the kingdom of the Jadeja chief Jam Rawal.

Driven out of Kutch by Khengarji, Jam Rawal crossed the Rann with his clan, broke the Jethwa, Chavda and Vadhel houses, and in August 1540 laid out his capital of Nawanagar, the 'new town', on the banks of the Rangmati and Nagmati beside the old port. The Jams warred with their neighbours and the Mughals for generations. In 1591 Jam Sataji's army was cut to pieces at Bhuchar Mori while shielding the fugitive sultan Muzaffar Shah III, and his successors paid tribute and obedience to Shah Jahan. About 1664 the imperial faujdar Kutb ud din Kheshgi conquered and annexed Nawanagar; the next century brought Maratha raids and Gaekwad tribute claims, until the Walker treaty of 1807 settled them and Nawanagar accepted British protection in 1812. The pearls of the gulf remained the foundation of its wealth.
zh:
哈拉尔是索拉什特拉西北、濒临卡奇湾的沿海平原，沿岸一串小港靠海湾里的珠蚌采捞为生。1444年，这片土地分属几个印度教拉杰普特部族：杰特瓦人据有纳格纳特小港，查夫达人据有特罗尔，瓦代尔人据有坎巴利亚，杰迪亚一带归代达人，内陆草场上则放牧着卡提人的畜群。哈拉尔之名当时还不存在，要等到贾德贾首领贾姆·拉瓦尔建国后才取作地名。

贾姆·拉瓦尔被肯加尔吉逐出卡奇后，率族人越过卡奇盐沼，击破杰特瓦、查夫达和瓦代尔诸家，于1540年8月在旧港旁的朗格马蒂河与纳格马蒂河畔建起新都纳瓦纳加尔，意为「新城」。此后历代贾姆与邻邦和莫卧儿交战不止：1591年，贾姆·萨塔吉因庇护逃亡的苏丹穆扎法尔·沙阿三世，在布恰尔莫里一役被击溃，其后人转而向沙贾汗纳贡称臣。1664年前后，莫卧儿法乌吉达尔库特卜丁·凯什吉攻占并吞并了纳瓦纳加尔；下个世纪这里又屡遭马拉塔袭掠、承担盖克瓦德的贡赋，直到1807年的沃克条约将其了结，纳瓦纳加尔于1812年接受英国保护。海湾的珍珠始终是此地财富的根基。

en:
Patan, long called Anahilapataka or Anhilwad Patan, was founded on the Saraswati by the Chavda ruler Vanaraja in 746 and became the capital of the Chavda, Chaulukya and Vaghela rulers of Gujarat. Its Jain temples, monasteries, market and Sahasralinga Tank marked the wealthy northern Gujarati capital; Salvi weavers settled there under Chaulukya patronage and wove double-ikat silk patola. Alauddin Khalji's conquest ended Hindu royal rule, and after Ahmad Shah I moved his court to Ahmedabad in 1411, Patan entered 1444 as a former capital within the Gujarat Sultanate, still rich from cloth and overland trade.

During Akbar's conquest the town became a military focus: rebel Mirzas and Sher Khan Fuladi besieged Patan, but Khan A'zam relieved it on 22 January 1573 and routed the besiegers. Under the Gujarat Subah, Patan became one of nine directly taxed sarkars, while its Salvi families kept producing patola whose double-ikat patterns reached Southeast Asian elites and were later carried by European traders. Maratha raids and tribute demands spread through north Gujarat in the 1720s, and the long struggle among Mughal governors, Gaekwads and the Peshwa broke up the old Mughal administration. Through those wars Patan retained its old market and weaving quarter.
zh:
帕坦旧称阿纳希拉帕塔卡或阿尼希瓦德帕坦，746年由查夫达君主瓦纳拉杰在萨拉斯瓦蒂河畔建立，后成为查夫达、索兰基和瓦盖拉三代古吉拉特统治者的都城。耆那教寺院、僧院、市场与萨哈斯特拉灵加池见证了这座北古吉拉特都城的富庶；萨尔维织工在索兰基王朝庇护下定居于此，织造双伊卡扎染丝绸帕托拉。阿拉丁·卡尔吉的征服结束了印度教王统，艾哈迈德沙一世1411年把宫廷迁往艾哈迈达巴德；到1444年，帕坦已是古吉拉特苏丹国境内的旧都，仍靠布匹和陆上贸易保持富足。

阿克巴征服古吉拉特时，帕坦成为军事焦点：米尔扎叛军与谢尔汗·富拉迪围攻该城，汗·阿扎姆于1573年1月22日解围并重创围城军。莫卧儿设立古吉拉特苏巴后，帕坦成为九个直接征税的萨尔卡尔行政区之一；萨尔维家族继续织造帕托拉，双伊卡特纹样远销东南亚上层社会，后来也由欧洲商人贩运。1720年代，马拉塔人的袭掠和索贡蔓延到北古吉拉特，莫卧儿总督、盖克瓦德与佩什瓦的长期争夺瓦解了旧有行政体制。在战乱中，帕坦仍保留着古老市场和织坊街区。

en:
The Sabarmati bank held the older trading settlement of Ashaval, where the Chaulukya king Karna had founded Karnavati, later a town of the Delhi sultans. In 1411 Ahmad Shah I, founder of the Gujarat Sultanate, laid the first bastion of a new walled capital there: the Bhadra Fort was finished in 1413, the great Friday Mosque in 1423, and Ahmadabad, named for its founder, grew ringed by merchants' suburbs called puras. In 1444 it was the young, prosperous capital of the Gujarat sultans, arms dealers and luxury craftsmen crowding the street between fort and mosque, Jain merchants leading the mahajan guilds that ordered its trade.

Mahmud Begada girdled it in 1487 with an outer wall of twelve gates and 189 bastions, and although he moved his court to Champaner in 1484, Ahmadabad remained the greater and richer city. Its fortunes turned with the Portuguese: after Humayun briefly seized it in 1535 and Bahadur Shah of Gujarat died at Diu in 1537, Portuguese sea power impoverished its merchants. In 1571 its workshops were still famed for silk, gold and silver thread and lac. Two years later Akbar conquered Gujarat and Ahmadabad became the chief city of a Mughal province, its textiles shipped as far as Europe; Shah Jahan, once its governor, built the Moti Shahi Mahal at Shahibaug.

Famines in 1630-1632, 1650 and 1686 thinned the city, and as Mughal power crumbled Maratha armies stormed it in 1753; after years of disputed possession it surrendered to them in 1758, its revenues divided between the Peshwa and the Gaekwad. In 1779, during the First Anglo-Maratha War, a British army breached the Bhadra and took the city, but the 1783 Treaty of Salbai restored it. More famines followed in 1790 and 1812, and by 1817 only about 80,000 people remained; under the Treaty of Poona the city passed to the East India Company, which took charge in 1818 and repaired the walls.
zh:
萨巴尔马蒂河畔早先的聚落是商镇阿沙瓦尔，乔鲁基亚国王卡尔纳曾在此修建卡尔纳瓦蒂城，后来这里成为德里苏丹治下的城镇。1411年，古吉拉特苏丹国开创者艾哈迈德沙阿一世在此为一座新的环城都城奠基：巴德拉堡1413年完工，大清真寺1423年落成，这座以开国君主命名的艾哈迈达巴德四周，是一片片称为「普拉」的商人郊区。1444年，它是古吉拉特苏丹年轻而繁荣的都城，堡垒与清真寺之间的大街挤满兵器商和奢侈品匠人，耆那教商人则主持着规范城市贸易的摩诃詹行会。

马哈茂德·贝加达1487年为城市筑起外墙，设十二座城门、一百八十九座棱堡；虽然他1484年已把宫廷迁往尚庞内尔，艾哈迈达巴德仍是更大、更富庶的城市。它的命运随葡萄牙人逆转：1535年胡马雍一度占据此城，古吉拉特的巴哈杜尔沙阿1537年死于第乌之后，葡萄牙人把持海上贸易，城里商人日益贫困。1571年，这里的作坊仍以丝绸、金银线和虫漆闻名。两年后阿克巴征服古吉拉特，艾哈迈达巴德成为莫卧儿行省的首城，纺织品远销欧洲；曾以皇子身份出镇古吉拉特的沙贾汗后来在沙希巴格修建了珍珠宫。

1630至1632年、1650年和1686年的饥荒使城市人口锐减。莫卧儿势力瓦解之际，马拉塔军队1753年攻破城池；经过数年争夺，城市于1758年投降，赋税由佩什瓦与盖克瓦德瓜分。第一次英国—马拉塔战争期间，英军1779年2月攻破巴德拉堡、占领艾哈迈达巴德，但1783年的《萨尔拜条约》又将其归还。1790年和1812年饥荒相继，到1817年城中只剩约八万人；根据《浦那条约》，城市移交东印度公司，公司于1818年接管行政并修缮城墙。

en:
Gorakhpur lies in the Rapti plain of Purvanchal, guarded on the south and west by the Rapti and Rohin rivers and once backed by dense forest to the north. The town grew up around the shrine of the ascetic Gorakhnath, whose Nath yogis made it a place of pilgrimage; a fort stood at Domingarh where the two rivers meet, and around 1400 the local Rajput rajas moved their seat close to the shrine. By the fifteenth century the country was the north-eastern march of the Sharqi sultans of Jaunpur, whose realm reached to the Nepal hills, and in 1444 it is held for Mahmud Shah Sharqi as a wooded frontier above the Ghaghra.

Under Akbar, Gorakhpur became the chief Muslim garrison north of the Ghaghra: a Mughal commander is recorded there in 1572, and the Ain-i-Akbari lists it as the seat of a sarkar of twenty-four mahals in the subah of Awadh, with a brick fort on the Rapti and a copper mint that also struck silver under Aurangzeb. Tavernier knew it as a market for the trade of the northern mountains. In the late 1600s it was renamed Mu'azzamabad in honour of Prince Mu'azzam, the future Bahadur Shah I. It passed to the Nawabs of Awadh in 1722 and was ceded to the East India Company in 1801; during the Anglo-Nepalese War of 1814–1816 a British column marched from the town against Butwal.
zh:
戈勒克布尔位于普拉地区的拉布蒂河平原，南、西两面有拉布蒂河与罗欣河为屏，北面古时密林环绕。城镇围绕苦行者戈勒克纳特的神祠发展起来，其纳特派瑜伽士使这里成为朝圣之地；两河交汇处的多明加尔建有堡垒，约1400年前后，当地拉杰普特王公把治所迁到神祠附近。到15世纪，这一带是章普尔沙尔吉苏丹们的东北边疆，其势力直抵尼泊尔山麓；1444年，这里作为加格拉河以北林木茂密的边地，为马哈茂德沙·沙尔吉所有。

阿克巴时期，戈勒克布尔成为加格拉河以北最重要的穆斯林驻军地：1572年已有莫卧儿将领在此驻守的记载，《阿克巴政典》将其列为阿瓦德苏巴下辖、领有二十四乡的萨尔卡尔治所，拉布蒂河畔有砖堡，还设有铜币铸币厂，到奥朗则布时也铸银币。塔韦尼耶曾记载，这里是与北方山区贸易的市集。17世纪末，城市为纪念穆阿扎姆王子（即后来的巴哈杜尔沙一世）改名穆阿扎姆阿巴德。1722年它归入阿瓦德纳瓦布版图，1801年被割让给东印度公司；1814—1816年英尼战争期间，一支英军从该城出发，进攻布特瓦尔。

en:
Rewa Kantha means the bank of the Rewa, another name for the Narmada. It is a broken corridor of hills, forests and river valleys stretching from the Tapti toward the Mahi, where the Gujarat plain meets the approaches to Malwa. At Champaner, the Khichi Chauhan Rajputs held the crags of Pavagadh below a Hindu and Jain pilgrimage crown, using the hill to guard roads and river crossings. In 1444 the chiefs of this Gujarati-speaking Hindu frontier stood between the Gujarat and Malwa sultanates, strong in hill forts but weak in open-country power.

War began after Mahmud Begada's captain Malik Sida was killed while raiding near Champaner in 1482. A Gujarat army invested Pavagadh for about twenty months and forced the hill fort in 1484; Raval Jaisingh was wounded, spared for six months, then executed for refusing Islam, while his son converted and entered the Gujarat nobility. Mahmud Begada spent twenty-three years walling and adorning Champaner, moved his capital there from Ahmedabad and built its great Jami Masjid. The town prospered on mangoes, sandalwood and coloured silks until Humayun's men scaled a remote cliff and sacked it in 1535. After Bahadur Shah died in 1536, the court returned to Ahmedabad and Champaner dwindled into ruin; when the British reached it in 1803, only about five hundred people remained. Silk preparation briefly revived, but cholera had reduced the town to four hundred families by 1812, and the surrounding Rewa Kantha states passed under British subsidiary alliances after the Third Anglo-Maratha War.
zh:
雷瓦坎塔意为雷瓦河岸，雷瓦是讷尔默达河的别称。这里是丘陵、森林与河谷交错的走廊，从塔普蒂河延伸至默希河，连接古吉拉特平原与通往摩腊婆的山道。尚帕内尔的基奇·乔汉拉杰普特人据守帕瓦加德山岩，山顶是印度教与耆那教巡礼地，山堡则控制道路和渡口。1444年，这片说古吉拉特语的印度教边境上，诸首领夹在古吉拉特和摩腊婆两个苏丹国之间；他们擅长守山堡，却缺少平原争雄的实力。

1482年，马哈茂德·贝加达的将领马利克·西达在尚帕内尔附近抄掠时被杀，战争由此爆发。古吉拉特军队围攻帕瓦加德约二十个月，于1484年攻破山堡。拉瓦尔·贾伊辛赫受伤后先被赦免六个月，最终因拒绝改宗伊斯兰教被处死，他的儿子则改宗并成为古吉拉特贵族。马哈茂德·贝加达用二十三年时间修筑、装饰尚帕内尔，把都城从艾哈迈达巴德迁来，并兴建宏大的聚礼清真寺。此地的芒果、檀香木和彩色丝绸曾带来繁荣，直到1535年胡马雍的军队攀上偏僻崖壁、洗劫城池。1536年巴哈杜尔沙死后，宫廷迁回艾哈迈达巴德，尚帕内尔逐渐沦为废墟。1803年英国人抵达时，城中只剩约五百人。生丝整理业曾短暂复兴，但到1812年霍乱已使人口减至四百户；第三次英国—马拉塔战争后，周围的雷瓦坎塔诸土邦接受英国的附属同盟。

en:
Bhilsa, also called Bhelsa, lay on the fertile north-eastern edge of Malwa between the Betwa and Bes rivers, close to older Besnagar and the Buddhist monuments of Sanchi. Its Sun temple of Bhillasvamin drew pilgrims and wealth, which also attracted Delhi's armies: Iltutmish destroyed the temple in 1233-34, and Alauddin Khalji sacked the town while still a prince in 1293. In 1444 Bhilsa was a Malvi-speaking town and district of the Malwa Sultanate, guarding the routes from Mandu and Ujjain toward Chanderi and the Betwa crossings. The unfinished Bijamandal temple platform, later carrying a small mosque, showed the Hindu and Islamic layers of its rule.

Bahadur Shah of Gujarat sacked Bhilsa in 1532 during his conquest of Malwa. After Mandu changed hands several times, Mughal armies defeated Baz Bahadur at Sarangpur in 1561 and swept through the region; he returned during their retreat, but Akbar's forces annexed Malwa in 1562 and made it a Mughal subah seated at Ujjain. In 1583 a Persian inscription was placed at the Lohangi Pir shrine, evidence of continuing Sufi life in the town. During the eighteenth-century Maratha conquest of Malwa, Bhilsa passed to the Scindias of Gwalior, who held the district into the early nineteenth century.
zh:
比尔沙又称贝尔沙，位于摩腊婆东北缘的肥沃地带，地处贝德瓦河与贝斯河之间，邻近更古老的贝斯纳加尔和桑奇佛教遗址。当地的比勒斯瓦明日神庙曾吸引巡礼者与财富，也因此引来德里军队：伊勒图特米什在1233—1234年摧毁神庙，阿拉丁·卡尔吉尚为王子时又于1293年洗劫此城。1444年，比尔沙是摩腊婆苏丹国境内说摩腊婆语的城镇与辖区，扼守从曼杜、乌贾因通往坚代里和贝德瓦河渡口的道路。未完工的比贾曼达尔神庙台基后来建有一座小清真寺，正显示出印度教与伊斯兰统治层叠的痕迹。

1532年，古吉拉特的巴哈杜尔沙征服摩腊婆期间洗劫比尔沙。曼杜数度易手后，莫卧儿军队于1561年在萨兰布尔击败巴兹·巴哈杜尔并席卷这一地区；巴兹·巴哈杜尔曾趁其撤退时返回，但阿克巴的军队在1562年兼并摩腊婆，将其设为以乌贾因为治所的莫卧儿苏巴。1583年，洛汉吉·皮尔圣陵添立波斯语铭文，说明城中仍有持续的苏非活动。18世纪马拉塔征服摩腊婆期间，比尔沙转入瓜廖尔的辛迪亚家族手中，并由其统辖至19世纪初。

en:
The wooded Aravalli country west of Chittor is Mewar's fastness and the cradle of the Sisodia Rajputs. Through its valleys winds the upper Banas, past Kotharia, Nagda and the old trading town of Ayad, which served as the Guhila capital before Chittor. After Alauddin Khalji stormed Chittor in 1303, the Sisodias rebuilt their power from these hills: Hammir Singh retook the fort in 1326 and defeated Delhi at Singoli, and his successors pushed back to Ajmer. In 1444 Maharana Kumbha, on the throne since 1433, holds his court among these forts while his armies meet the sultans of Malwa and Gujarat, and Bhil bowmen share the forests with the Rajput estates.

Work on Kumbhalgarh, Kumbha's great hill fort above the western passes, began in 1448 under the architect Mandan; its walls ran 36 kilometres and threw back attacks from Gujarat in 1457 and from Malwa in 1458–59 and 1467. Kumbha himself was murdered in the fort by his son in 1468. Under Rana Sanga, Mewar overawed northern India until Babur's guns shattered the Rajput host at Khanwa on 17 March 1527. When Bahadur Shah of Gujarat sacked Chittor in 1535, the young heir Udai Singh II took shelter in these hills, and in 1559 he founded a new capital, Udaipur, beside Lake Pichola. Akbar took Chittor in 1568, and on 18 June 1576 Maharana Pratap met the Mughals in the Haldighati pass near Gogunda; defeated but never captured, he retook Kumbhalgarh in 1583. His son Amar Singh made peace with Prince Khurram at Gogunda in 1615. In 1672 Rana Raj Singh gave refuge to the Shrinathji image, brought from Mathura to Nathdwara; Aurangzeb's army sacked Udaipur in January 1680. Maratha tribute from the 1730s drained the kingdom, and on 13 January 1818 Bhim Singh accepted British protection.
zh:
奇托尔以西林木茂密的阿拉瓦利山地是梅瓦尔的天险，也是西索迪亚拉杰普特人的起家之地。贝纳斯河上游蜿蜒穿行于山谷之间，流经科塔里亚、纳格达和古镇阿亚德——阿亚德在奇托尔之前曾是古希罗王朝的都城。1303年阿拉乌丁·卡尔吉攻陷奇托尔后，西索迪亚人正是从这片山地卷土重来：哈米尔·辛格1326年收复堡垒，又在辛戈利击败德里的军队，他的后继者更把势力重新推回到阿杰梅尔。1444年，自1433年在位的马哈拉那·昆巴在群山要塞之间理政，他的军队同时与马尔瓦和古吉拉特的苏丹们作战，丛林之中，比尔弓箭手与拉杰普特贵族的领地比邻而居。

1448年，昆巴在西山隘口之上动工兴建昆巴加尔堡，由建筑师曼丹主持；城墙绵延36公里，先后击退1457年古吉拉特以及1458至1459年、1467年马尔瓦的进攻，昆巴本人却于1468年在堡中被儿子所杀。拉那·桑伽在位时梅瓦尔威震北印度，直到1527年3月17日巴布尔的火炮在汗瓦击溃拉杰普特大军。1535年古吉拉特的巴哈杜尔沙洗劫奇托尔，幼主乌代·辛格二世避入这片山地，1559年在皮丘拉湖畔建起新都乌代布尔。阿克巴1568年夺取奇托尔；1576年6月18日，马哈拉那·普拉塔普在戈贡达附近的哈尔迪加蒂山口迎战莫卧儿大军——他虽战败却未被擒获，并于1583年收复昆巴加尔堡。其子阿马尔·辛格1615年在戈贡达与胡拉姆王子议和。1672年，拉那·拉杰·辛格收留了从马图拉迁至纳特德瓦拉的什里纳特吉神像；1680年1月奥朗则布的军队洗劫乌代布尔。1730年代起向马拉塔人纳贡耗尽了国力，1818年1月13日比姆·辛格接受英国保护。

en:
Kalpi crowns a bluff on the right bank of the Yamuna, the crossing between the Doab and Bundelkhand. As Kalapriya it had been a Hindu pilgrimage town with a great temple of Surya, until Qutb-ud-din Aibak took it for the Ghurids in 1196. In 1390 the Tughluq governor Mahmud Khan laid out the city of Muhammadabad on the site, and after Timur's sack of Delhi he made it the capital of an independent kingdom, as Nasiruddin Mahmud Shah; scholars and refugees fleeing Delhi made Kalpi a seat of learning. His son Qadir Shah weathered Sharqi invasions from Jaunpur in 1413, 1414 and 1427, and in 1443 another Jaunpur attack on Qadir Shah's son Nasir Khan was met by Mahmud Khalji of Malwa. The peace of 1444 saved the dynasty but left Kalpi a client of Malwa.

Bahlul Lodi of Delhi absorbed Kalpi in 1484. Early in the next century Rana Sanga of Mewar twice defeated Ibrahim Lodi and held the city, only to die, poisoned, at Kalpi in January 1528; it then passed to Babur's Mughals. Under Akbar it was a governor's seat with a royal mint for copper coinage. Around the middle of the eighteenth century it fell to the Marathas, for Chhatrasal of Bundelkhand had bequeathed it together with Jhansi and Sagar to the Peshwa Baji Rao in 1731. The British captured Kalpi in 1803 and, from 1806, kept possession of the city.
zh:
迦尔毗雄踞亚穆纳河右岸的高崖，是河间地与本德尔肯德之间的渡口。此地古称卡拉普里亚，曾是建有大型太阳神庙的印度教朝圣城镇，1196年被库特卜-乌德-丁·艾伯克替古尔人攻取。1390年，图格鲁克王朝总督马哈茂德汗在旧址营建穆罕默达巴德城，帖木儿洗劫德里之后，他以纳西尔丁·马哈茂德沙阿之名在此定都建国；逃离德里的学者和难民使迦尔毗成为学术之都。其子卡迪尔沙阿先后顶住了江布尔沙尔基王朝1413年、1414年和1427年的入侵，1443年江布尔转攻卡迪尔沙阿之子纳西尔汗，马尔瓦的马哈茂德·哈尔吉出兵迎战。1444年的和议保全了王朝，却使迦尔毗沦为马尔瓦的附庸。

1484年，德里的巴赫卢勒·洛迪兼并迦尔毗。下一个世纪初，梅瓦尔的拉纳·桑伽两度击败易卜拉欣·洛迪并占据该城，最终却于1528年1月在迦尔毗中毒身亡，城市随后落入巴布尔的莫卧儿之手。阿克巴时期，这里是总督驻地，设有铸造铜币的皇家造币厂。18世纪中叶前后，迦尔毗转入马拉塔人之手——本德尔肯德的查特拉萨尔早在1731年便将它与占西、萨格尔一并赠予佩什瓦巴吉·拉奥。英国人于1803年攻占迦尔毗，并自1806年起一直占有这座城市。

en:
The Upper Doab is the fertile wedge of country between the upper Ganges and the Yamuna, watered by both rivers and crossed by the old road out of Delhi toward the northern hills. Its chief town, Meerut, was a Buddhist centre in Ashoka's day; one of the emperor's pillars stood here until Feroz Shah Tughluq carried it off to his new capital at Delhi. The Dor Rajputs kept a strong fort nearby when Mahmud of Ghazni arrived in 1018 and received the raja's surrender, and Qutb-ud-din Aibak took Meerut in 1193. Timur stormed and sacked the place in 1399, putting its Afghan garrison and townspeople to the sword. In 1444 the Upper Doab lay within the shrunken hinterland of the Sayyid court at Delhi, grain country disputed between the Afghan lords of the Punjab and the Ganges valley.

Under the Mughals the Doab knew peace and profit: Akbar kept a copper mint at Meerut, and the Ain-i-Akbari lists the town as a pargana of the Delhi sarkar, assessed at 4,391,996 dams. From the Barha country in its northern reaches came the Sayyid brothers, Abdullah Khan and Husain Ali Khan, the kingmakers who made and unmade emperors after 1707; they had Farrukhsiyar deposed and killed in 1719 before Muhammad Shah and the Nizam broke them in 1720–22. Rohilla Afghans, Sikh raiders and Maratha armies swept the district through the rest of the century, while the European soldier of fortune Walter Reinhardt and his heir Begam Samru ruled the little state of Sardhana. With the fall of Delhi in 1803 Daulat Rao Sindhia ceded the Doab to the East India Company; a cantonment was laid out at Meerut in 1806 and the district was constituted in 1818.
zh:
上河间地是恒河上游与亚穆纳河之间的富庶楔形地带，两河灌溉，德里通往北方山地的古道穿行其间。其首邑密拉特在阿育王时代是佛教中心；当地曾立有一根阿育王石柱，后来被菲罗兹沙·图格鲁克运去他在德里的新都。1018年加兹尼的马哈茂德兵临此地，附近据堡而守的多尔族拉杰普特首领献城归降；1193年库特卜—丁·艾伯克攻占密拉特。1399年帖木儿攻破并洗劫此城，阿富汗守军与居民尽遭屠戮。1444年的上河间地，是德里赛义德朝廷残存腹地的一部分，这片粮米之乡正被旁遮普与恒河河谷的阿富汗豪强反复争夺。

莫卧儿治下，河间地迎来太平与富庶：阿克巴在密拉特设有铜币铸坊，《阿克巴则例》将此城列为德里萨尔卡尔下辖的帕尔加纳，核定岁入四百三十九万一千九百九十六达姆。其北部的巴拉地区出了赛义德兄弟——阿卜杜拉汗与侯赛因·阿里汗，这两位「造王者」在1707年后废立皇帝，1719年废黜并杀害法鲁赫西亚尔，最终于1720至1722年被穆罕默德沙与尼扎姆铲除。此后罗希拉阿富汗人、锡克游骑与马拉塔军队在整个世纪里轮番席卷此地；欧洲雇佣军人沃尔特·莱因哈特及其继承者萨姆鲁夫人则割据着小小的萨尔达纳土邦。1803年德里陷落后，道拉特·拉奥·辛迪亚将河间地割让给东印度公司；公司1806年在密拉特设立军营，1818年正式置县。

en:
Katehar, the country later called Rohilkhand, is the plain between the upper Ganges, Awadh and the Kumaon foothills. Its chief town, Budaun, was a Rathore seat called Vodamayuta until Qutb-ud-din Aibak captured it in 1196. It then became a key northern frontier post of the Delhi sultans; Iltutmish ruled from there before taking the throne, and Budaun served as a Delhi capital from 1210 to 1214. By 1444, under Mahmud Shah Sharqi, Jaunpur's arms reached from Etawah toward Bengal and from the Vindhyas toward Nepal, making Budaun a fortress on the Sharqi frontier facing Delhi.

Bahlul Lodi broke Sharqi power in 1479, and after Ibrahim Lodi fell to Babur at Panipat in 1526 the district entered the Mughal world; Budaun itself was burned in 1571. Under Aurangzeb, Daud Khan brought Pashtun soldiers and their families into Katehar to overawe the Katheria Rajputs, and their settlements gave the region its newer name, Rohilkhand. Rohilla power coalesced under Ali Muhammad Khan from 1719, with Bareilly as its capital. In 1773 Maratha armies crossed the Ganges at Ramghat near Budaun; the dispute over Awadh's promised subsidy brought the First Rohilla War, in which Hafiz Rahmat Khan was killed at Miranpur Katra in 1774. Awadh then occupied Rohilkhand, leaving Rampur as a protected Rohilla state, until Saadat Ali Khan ceded the country to the East India Company in 1801.
zh:
卡特哈尔是上恒河平原、阿瓦德与库毛恩山麓之间的地区，后来又称罗希尔坎德。首府布道恩旧称沃达马尤塔，曾是拉托尔人的据点，1196年被库特布丁·艾伊拜克攻占。此后它成为德里苏丹国北方边境的重镇；伊勒图特米什登上帝位前曾在此主政，布道恩也在1210年至1214年间作为德里都城。到1444年马哈茂德·沙·沙尔基在位时，章普尔的兵锋西起埃塔瓦、东抵孟加拉，南起温迪亚山脉、北近尼泊尔，布道恩因此成为沙尔基王朝面向德里的边塞堡垒。

1479年，巴赫鲁尔·洛迪摧毁沙尔基政权；1526年易卜拉欣·洛迪在帕尼帕特败于巴布尔后，这一地区进入莫卧儿势力范围，布道恩本城则于1571年遭焚毁。奥朗则布时期，达乌德汗把普什图士兵及其家眷迁入卡特哈尔，以压制卡特里亚拉杰普特人；这些阿富汗定居者使地区得到了罗希尔坎德这个新名字。1719年起，罗希拉势力在阿里·穆罕默德汗周围集结，以巴雷利为都。1773年，马拉塔军队在布道恩附近的拉姆加特渡过恒河；围绕阿瓦德许诺补助金的争端引发第一次罗希拉战争，哈菲兹·拉赫马特汗于1774年在米兰布尔·卡特拉战死。阿瓦德随即占领罗希尔坎德，仅留下兰普尔作为受保护的罗希拉邦；1801年，萨达特·阿里汗把这片土地割让给东印度公司。

en:
Panipat is a town and level campaigning plain about 95 kilometres north of Delhi, set squarely on the historic road toward Lahore and the Punjab. Under the Delhi sultans its fort and markets watched the capital's northern approach. In 1444 the town belonged to the declining Sayyid court at Delhi, while Bahlul Lodi, the Afghan governor of Sirhind, had already tested its defenses in an unsuccessful march on Delhi in 1443. The open ground beyond the houses gave an army coming from the northwest room to deploy, which would make the name Panipat synonymous with battles for the fate of Delhi.

On 21 April 1526 Babur used field artillery and matchlock fire from a wagon line to destroy Ibrahim Lodi's army; Ibrahim and some 20,000 of his men fell, ending Lodi rule, and Babur laid out the Kabuli Bagh garden and mosque to mark the victory. On 5 November 1556 the armies of the young Akbar met Hemu, who had seized Agra and Delhi and been crowned on 7 October. An arrow struck Hemu in the eye, his army broke, and Bairam Khan had him beheaded. The Ain-i-Akbari later lists Panipat as a Delhi sarkar pargana with a brick fort, 1,000 infantry and 100 cavalry. On 14 January 1761 Ahmad Shah Durrani's Afghan coalition crushed Sadashivrao Bhau's Maratha army there, breaking Maratha domination of the Delhi region. The East India Company took Panipat in 1803, and in the 1819 reorganisation Panipat, Karnal and Sonipat formed the Panipat district within Delhi territory.
zh:
伯尼巴德（通行译名帕尼帕特）是德里以北约95公里的城镇，也是一片平坦的会战平原，正坐落在通往拉合尔和旁遮普的旧道上。德里诸苏丹统治时期，这里的堡垒和市场监视着都城北门。1444年，城镇属于日渐衰弱的德里赛义德王朝；西尔欣德的阿富汗总督巴赫鲁尔·洛迪已在1443年进兵德里，试探过这条通道的防务，只是未能成功。城外开阔地足以让来自西北的大军展开，这使帕尼帕特日后成为争夺德里命运的会战代名词。

1526年4月21日，巴布尔以车阵掩护野战炮和火绳枪火力，击溃易卜拉欣·洛迪的军队；易卜拉欣与约两万名士兵战死，洛迪王朝告终，巴布尔随后开辟喀布尔花园并修建清真寺，纪念这场胜利。1556年10月7日，接连夺取阿格拉和德里的黑穆加冕称王；11月5日，年幼的阿克巴麾下军队在帕尼帕特迎战，黑穆眼部中箭，军队溃散，拜拉姆汗随即将其斩首。后来的《阿克巴政典》把伯尼巴德列为德里专区的帕尔加纳，记有砖堡、1000名步兵和100名骑兵。1761年1月14日，艾哈迈德沙·杜兰尼的阿富汗联军在此击溃萨达希夫拉奥·巴乌率领的马拉塔军队，打破马拉塔人对德里地区的支配。1803年，伯尼巴德被东印度公司接管；1819年行政改组时，帕尼帕特、卡尔纳尔和索尼伯德一带组成德里辖区下的帕尼帕特县。

en:
Etawah lies where the Chambal joins the Yamuna, in the Lower Ganges Doab, a country of Rajput-held villages between the spheres of Delhi and Jaunpur. Muslim rule ran thin here in the thirteenth century, and local Rais long kept the field. In 1392 the zamindars Nar Singh and Sumer Shah rose against Sultan Nasir-ud-din Muhammad, and the eunuch Malik Sarwar, sent to crush them, won the country from Kannauj to Bihar and made himself the first Sharqi sultan of Jaunpur. In 1400-01 Rai Sumar of Etawah fought Mallu Iqbal Khan on the Kali Nadi near Patiali and was chased back to his forts. The doab stayed a march between Delhi and Jaunpur for another lifetime. In 1444 Etawah looks to the Sharqi court, its Rajput landholders answering to whichever army could cross the rivers.

After Panipat the local chief Qutub Khan held out until Mughal troops entered the doab after Khanwa in 1527; the Surs ruled from 1540 to 1556, and the second battle of Panipat returned the country to the Mughals. Akbar divided it among the mahals of the Agra sarkar, and in Prince Salim's revolt against his father the rebel reached Etawah with 30,000 horse and foot before turning back. After Aurangzeb the land passed among Rohillas, the Nawabs of Awadh and raiding Maratha horse, until Nawab Saadat Ali Khan ceded the Lower Doab to the East India Company in 1801. In 1821 Etawah is the seat of a British district.
zh:
埃塔瓦（中文维基作埃达沃）位于昌巴尔河汇入亚穆纳河之处，地处恒河下河间地，是德里与章普尔两大势力之间一片拉杰普特村堡林立的乡野。13世纪时穆斯林的统治在此还很薄弱，本地的拉伊们长期割据称雄。1392年，柴明达尔纳尔·辛格与苏梅尔沙起兵反抗纳赛尔丁·穆罕默德苏丹，奉命平叛的宦官马利克·萨尔瓦尔借此取得从卡瑙杰到比哈尔的大片土地，后来自立为章普尔沙尔基王朝的开国之君。1400至1401年，埃塔瓦的拉伊·苏梅尔在帕蒂亚利附近的卡利河畔迎战马卢·伊克巴尔汗，兵败后被逐回自己的堡寨。此后数十年，河间地始终是德里与章普尔之间的边境战场。1444年的埃塔瓦名义上依附章普尔的沙尔基朝廷，本地拉杰普特地主听命于谁，全看哪支军队能渡过这几条河。

帕尼帕特之战后，地方首领库特布汗据守不降，直到1527年坎瓦之战后莫卧儿军队开入河间地才告归附；1540至1556年这里改属苏尔王朝，第二次帕尼帕特之战后又重回莫卧儿之手。阿克巴将这一地区分属阿格拉萨卡尔下辖的若干马哈尔；皇子萨利姆起兵反抗父亲时，曾率三万骑步兵进抵埃塔瓦，随后退兵。奥朗则布之后，此地在罗希拉人、阿瓦德纳瓦布和袭扰的马拉塔骑兵之间几经易手，最终纳瓦布·萨达特·阿里汗于1801年把下河间地割让给东印度公司。1821年时，埃塔瓦是英属的一座县城。

en:
Shekhawati is the semi-arid plain between the Aravalli ridges and the Bikaner desert, a country of wells and stepwells rather than rivers. Jhunjhunu, Fatehpur and Narhar belonged to the Kaimkhanis, Muslim Chauhan Rajputs converted at the court of Firuz Shah Tughluq, while the rest of the land was held by the Kachwaha Rajputs of Dhundhar, whose raja at Amber was overlord in 1444. Among his kinsmen at Amarsar a boy born in 1433, Rao Shekha, was growing up; the land would later bear his name.

Around the middle of the century Rao Shekha made himself an independent chieftain at Amarsar, and when he died in 1488 his sons, later called the Shekhawats, ruled a country named the garden of Shekha. Over the next century they swallowed the Kaimkhani estates. The greatest of the line, Raja Raisal, took Khandela in 1584 and rose at Akbar's court to a mansab of 3,000 horse, dying on campaign in the Deccan about 1614; his kin became Jaipur's premier hereditary nobles. Their power peaked under Shardul Singh of Jhunjhunu (1681–1742), whose five surviving sons divided his lands into the Panchpana estates and raised the frescoed chhatri at Parasrampura. From the seventeenth to the early nineteenth century Marwari bankers grown rich on the caravan trade between Delhi and the western ports lined their home towns—Nawalgarh, Mandawa, Fatehpur and Sikar—with painted havelis and stepwells, earning Shekhawati the name of an open-air picture gallery. The Shekhawat estates remained tributary to Jaipur and passed under British protection with the treaty of 1818.
zh:
沙卡瓦蒂是阿拉瓦利岭与比卡内尔沙漠之间一片半干旱平原，没有大河，靠水井和阶梯井取水。琼丘农、法塔赫布尔、纳尔哈尔一带旧为凯姆卡尼人所有，他们是在菲鲁兹沙·图格鲁克朝中改宗伊斯兰教的乔罕拉杰普特支系；其余土地则归敦达尔的卡奇瓦哈拉杰普特，1444年时安贝尔的罗阇是这里的宗主。也就在这一时期，1433年出生的家族子弟拉奥·谢卡在阿马尔萨尔长大，这片土地后来将以他为名。

15世纪中叶前后，拉奥·谢卡在阿马尔萨尔自立为独立首领，1488年去世后，他的子孙称谢卡瓦特人，所据之地被叫做「谢卡之园」。此后一个世纪里，他们逐步吞并了凯姆卡尼人的领地。族人中最显赫的拉贾·拉伊萨尔1584年据有坎德拉，在阿克巴朝中官至统率三千骑兵的曼萨卜，约1614年战死于德干，他的同族后来成为斋浦尔最显贵的世袭贵族。谢卡瓦特的权势在琼丘农的沙尔杜尔·辛格（1681—1742）时达到顶峰，他死后五个儿子平分领地，形成「潘奇帕纳」（五份封地），并在伯勒斯伦布尔修建了绘满壁画的恰特里亭。17世纪到19世纪初，靠德里与西海岸之间商队贸易致富的马尔瓦里商人在纳瓦尔加尔、曼达瓦、法塔赫布尔和锡格尔等家乡城镇广建彩绘哈维利宅邸与阶梯井，使沙卡瓦蒂得到「拉贾斯坦露天画廊」之称。谢卡瓦特的各个封地一直向斋浦尔称臣，1818年随斋浦尔与东印度公司签约，归入英国保护。

en:
Bhattiana is the dry Ghaggar tract named after the Bhatti Rajputs, stretching from Hisar toward Bhatner and the old roads into Rajasthan. In 1354 Firuz Shah Tughlaq of Delhi founded Hisar-e-Firoza and built a walled fort containing the Firoz Shah Palace; the works were completed in 1356. Its strongpoints watched the routes from Lahore and Multan toward Delhi. Timur's army passed through Bhatner and Sirsa in 1398, leaving the country wasted before it marched on the capital. In 1444 the Bhatti villages and pastures around Hisar were held under the Sayyid sultans of Delhi, exposed to the rival powers of the Punjab.

In 1526 Humayun took Hisar during Babur's Panipat campaign, and Babur gave him the city as a reward. Sher Shah Suri seized it after Humayun's defeat in 1540; Humayun returned in 1555 and placed it under Akbar. Mughal government lasted at Hisar until 1760. As imperial power loosened after Nadir Shah's withdrawal in 1747, the Bhatti chief Muhammad Hasan Khan seized Rania, Fatehabad and Sirsa and fought the Sikh states of Patiala and Jind. The Irish adventurer George Thomas held Hisar from 1798 until a Sikh, Maratha and French coalition drove him out in 1801. The East India Company took the tract in 1803, but Bhatti leaders Zabita Khan and Khan Bahadur Khan kept up resistance; Company forces took Fatehabad, Sirsa and Rania in 1810 and broke Zabita Khan's last stronghold in 1818.
zh:
巴蒂纳是克格尔河一带的干旱地带，因巴蒂拉杰普特人而得名，范围从希萨尔延伸向巴特奈尔和通往拉贾斯坦的旧道。1354年，德里苏丹菲罗兹沙·图格鲁克建立希萨尔—菲罗扎，修筑带城墙的堡垒，堡内有菲罗兹沙宫；工程于1356年完工。这里的要塞监视着从拉合尔和木尔坦通向德里的道路。1398年，帖木儿的军队经巴特奈尔和锡尔萨西进，在进军德里前蹂躏了这一带。1444年，希萨尔周围的巴蒂村落与牧场仍受德里的赛义德王朝苏丹统辖，同时面对着旁遮普诸势力的压力。

1526年，胡马雍在巴布尔的帕尼帕特战役期间攻取希萨尔，巴布尔随即将这座城市赐给他。1540年，舍尔沙·苏利趁胡马雍战败夺取此地；胡马雍1555年返回印度后，将其交给阿克巴管辖。希萨尔的莫卧儿统治一直延续到1760年。纳迪尔沙1747年撤离后，帝国控制松弛，巴蒂首领穆罕默德·哈桑汗夺取拉尼亚、法塔哈巴德和锡尔萨，同帕特亚拉与金德两个锡克国家长期争战。爱尔兰冒险家乔治·托马斯1798年占据希萨尔，直到1801年被锡克、马拉塔与法国联军逐出。东印度公司1803年取得这一地区，但扎比塔汗和汗·巴哈杜尔汗率领巴蒂人继续抵抗；公司军队1810年攻占法塔哈巴德、锡尔萨和拉尼亚，1818年又攻破扎比塔汗最后的据点。

en:
Nagaur stands on a dead-flat desert plain midway between Ajmer and the Jodhpur-Bikaner road, where caravan routes coming north from Gujarat and Sindh met those crossing from Multan. Anciently Ahichhatrapur, it was a Chauhan stronghold before the Muslim conquests and the site of one of the region's earliest Sufi lodges, that of Hamiduddin, a disciple of Moinuddin Chishti of Ajmer, who kept a cow and taught vegetarian piety. In 1391 the Tughluq court posted Jalal Khan Khokhar to govern the town, and in 1405-07 Shams Khan, brother of Muzaffar Shah I of Gujarat, made Nagaur the seat of his own principality. In 1444 Shams Khan's khanate, with its great desert fort, was an island of Muslim rule ringed by Hindu chiefs, grown rich on tolls from the caravans.

A feud between Shams Khan and his brother Mujahid Khan brought the Mewar host down on Nagaur: Shams called in Rana Kumbha and then refused to raze his battlements as promised, so in 1455 Kumbha routed him and a Gujarat army, sacked the town and carried the fort gates to Kumbhalgarh, where they became the Hanuman Pol. Nagaur changed masters more than once before passing to the Mughals, under whom Amar Singh Rathore served as its governor until his death in 1644. It was later granted to Bakht Singh of Marwar, who built most of the palaces inside the fort and in 1741 led the Rathor horse to victory over Jaipur and a Mughal army at Gangwana. In 1755 the Maratha Jayappa Scindia blockaded the fort; two Rathor volunteers, Gaji Khan Khokhar and Kan Singh, entered his camp disguised as merchants and stabbed him to death on 25 July, after which the Marathas withdrew. Nagaur remained a Marwar possession thereafter.
zh:
纳高尔坐落在一马平川的沙漠平原上，恰在阿杰梅尔与焦特布尔—比卡内尔大道之间，自古吉拉特、信德北上的商路与自木尔坦西行的商路在此交会。古城阿希恰特拉普尔在穆斯林征服之前便是乔汉人的要塞，这里还有本地最早的苏菲道堂之一：阿杰梅尔的穆因丁·奇什蒂的弟子哈米杜丁在此修行，他严守素食、在圣所养牛，信众绵延不绝。1391年，图格鲁克朝廷派贾拉尔汗·霍哈尔出镇长；1405至1407年间，古吉拉特的穆扎法尔沙阿一世之弟沙姆斯汗割据自立，以纳高尔为都城。1444年，沙姆斯汗的汗国凭恃这座大漠雄堡，如孤岛般立于众多印度教首领之间，靠商队捐税丰足一时。

沙姆斯汗与兄弟穆贾希德汗相争，引来梅瓦尔大军：他先向拉纳·昆巴求援，事后却不肯践约拆毁城垣。1455年，昆巴在纳高尔击溃沙姆斯汗与古吉拉特的联军，洗劫城池，把堡门和哈努曼像运到昆巴加尔，命名为哈努曼门。此后纳高尔几经易主，终入莫卧儿版图，阿马尔·辛格·拉索尔莫卧儿时期曾任此地总督，直至1644年去世。城镇后来封给马尔沃尔的巴赫特·辛格，堡内宫殿多由他所建；1741年，他率拉索尔骑兵在冈格瓦纳击败斋浦尔与莫卧儿联军。1755年，马拉塔首领贾亚帕·辛迪亚围城断粮，两名拉索尔死士加吉汗·霍哈尔与坎辛格扮作商人混入营地，于7月25日将其刺死，马拉塔军队随后撤走，纳高尔此后一直为马尔沃尔所有。

en:
The Godwar is the south-western march of Marwar, watered by the Sukri and Jawai where the desert runs up against Gujarat. Its stronghold, Jalore—ancient Jabalipura—crowns the golden rock of Swarnagiri, a fort raised by the Paramaras between the eighth and tenth centuries. In 1181 Kirtipala, youngest son of the Chauhan lord of Nadol, took it and founded the Songara line; under Udayasimha the kingdom withstood Iltutmish's siege of 1228 and won back Nadol and Mandore. Its last Songara king, Kanhadadeva, and his son Viramadeva died defending the rock against Alauddin Khalji's general Malik Kamaluddin in 1311, a siege sung by the bard Padmanabha in the Kanhadade Prabandha of 1455. In 1444 the Godwar, cradle of the Marwari horse, was the embattled western march of Rana Kumbha's Mewar, disputed with the sultans of Nagaur and Gujarat.

After Rao Ranmal's fall the Delhi sultans seized Jalore, but Rao Jodha later conquered the Godwar from Delhi and Mewar. It was won back for Mewar by the 'flying prince' Prithviraj during the reign of his father Rana Raimal (1473–1509). In the sixteenth century the Pathan chiefs of Palanpur in Gujarat briefly held the fort, after which Jalore passed under Mughal administration; it was restored to Marwar in 1704 and remained a Jodhpur possession thereafter.
zh:
戈德瓦尔是马尔瓦尔的西南边陲，苏克里河与贾瓦伊河流经此地，沙漠直抵古吉拉特边界。其要塞贾洛尔古称贾巴利普拉，雄踞「金山」斯瓦尔纳吉里，城堡为8至10世纪的波罗马拉人所建。1181年，纳多尔乔汉王公的幼子基尔蒂帕拉夺城自立，开创松加拉支系；乌达亚辛哈在位时，王国顶住了伊勒杜迷失1228年的围攻，还收复了纳多尔与曼多尔。末代松加拉王坎哈戴维达与儿子维拉马德瓦于1311年抵抗阿拉丁·卡尔吉的将领马利克·卡马鲁丁，战死岩上；行吟诗人帕德马纳布在1455年的《坎哈黛传》中传唱了这场围城。1444年，作为马尔瓦里马产地的戈德瓦尔是拉那·贡波的梅瓦尔西陲战患频仍的边地，与纳高尔和古吉拉特的苏丹反复争夺。

拉奥·兰马尔死后，德里苏丹一度夺取贾洛尔，拉奥·乔达后来从德里与梅瓦尔手中征服戈德瓦尔。「飞行王子」普里特维拉杰又在其父拉那·拉伊马尔1473至1509年在位时替梅瓦尔把它夺回。16世纪，古吉拉特帕兰普尔的阿富汗首领曾短暂据有此堡，其后贾洛尔归入莫卧儿管辖；1704年它被还给马尔瓦尔，此后一直是焦特布尔的领地。

en:
Siwi—later Sibi, with the country around it called Siwistan—lies on the Nari River, where the Bolan road leaves the mountains for the furnace of the Kachhi plains. Sheep swarmed over its rangelands, and wool, horses and the tolls of caravans plying between Kandahar and Sindh were the settlement's living; an old mud fort kept watch over its wells. For centuries a dependency of Multan, the plains had by the fifteenth century drifted into the orbit of the Samma sultans of Thatta. In 1444 Siwi was a poor Baloch march: Rind tribesmen held its pastures, a Samma governor's name meant little so far from the Indus, and Baloch and Brahui clans grazed the plains to the south.

In the later fifteenth century Mir Chakar Rind made Siwi his seat for some thirty years, and under him it became the centre of Rind Baloch power; the old fort was later ascribed to him. About 1500 Shah Beg Arghun took Siwi from the Sammas for Kandahar, but his remaining garrisons were driven out by the Panni Afghans, who became masters of the Sibi and Dhadar plains. Panni chiefs twice routed Mughal forces before yielding the fort at the third assault. Under Aurangzeb their head Junaid Khan Barozai was confirmed over Siwi and Kachhi with the title Bakhtiar Khan, while his son Mirza Khan was named nawab and charged also with Shikarpur. The Panni nawabs fought long wars against the Khans of Kalat; a Kalat raid in 1695 was ended by a marriage alliance, which opened the Kachhi grazing to Brahui flocks. In January 1702 Nawab Bakhtiar Khan II fell at the battle of Uch against the Multan army of Prince Muiz-ud-din, and the Mughals made Sibi and Dhadar over to the Kalhoras of Sindh, who took full possession under Yar Muhammad Khan in 1714. In 1730 Nur Muhammad Kalhoro slew the Khan of Kalat at the battle of Kachhi; after Nader Shah's invasion the country was partitioned, and Ahmad Shah Durrani entrusted Siwi to the Panni nawab Ismail Khan Barozai. Under the Durranis the caravan trade between Sindh, Siwi, Quetta, Kandahar and Central Asia flourished, until disorders in southern Afghanistan under Timur Shah (1772–1793) emptied the roads.
zh:
锡维（后世改称锡比，周围一带领地称锡维斯坦）坐落在纳里河畔，博兰山道在这里出山，通往酷热的卡奇平原。牧场上羊群遍布，羊毛、马匹和往返坎大哈与信德之间商队的税课是此地的生计，一座古老的夯土堡垒守着水源。这里有好几个世纪臣属木尔坦，到15世纪已落入塔塔的萨马王朝苏丹势力范围。1444年的锡维是贫穷的俾路支边地：林德部据有其草场，萨马总督的号令远在印度河之外无足轻重，俾路支与布拉灰诸部则在南方平原游牧。

15世纪后期，米尔·查卡尔·林德以锡维为驻地约三十年，在他治下这里成为林德俾路支势力的中心，古堡相传为他所建。约1500年，阿尔洪家族的沙赫·贝格从萨马王朝手中夺取锡维，并入坎大哈，但残余守军不久即被帕尼普什图人逐出，帕尼部就此据有锡比与达达尔平原。帕尼酋长曾两度击溃莫卧儿军队，第三次围攻才交出堡垒。奥朗则布在位时，其首领朱奈德汗·巴罗扎伊以「巴赫蒂亚尔汗」之号受命统辖锡维和卡奇，其子米尔扎汗受封纳瓦布，兼管希卡布尔。帕尼诸纳瓦布与卡拉特汗长期交战；1695年卡拉特的一次奔袭最终以联姻议和，布拉灰人的羊群获准进入卡奇牧场。1702年1月，巴赫蒂亚尔汗二世在乌杰之战中迎击穆仪兹丁亲王的木尔坦大军，兵败身亡，莫卧儿朝廷随即将锡比与达达尔交给信德的卡尔霍拉家族，后者于1714年在亚尔·穆罕默德汗治下正式接管。1730年，努尔·穆罕默德·卡尔霍罗在卡奇之战中击杀卡拉特汗；纳迪尔沙入侵后这一带被分割，艾哈迈德·沙·杜兰尼把锡维托付给帕尼纳瓦布伊斯梅尔汗·巴罗扎伊。杜兰尼王朝治下，信德—锡维—奎达—坎大哈—中亚一线的商队贸易一度兴盛，直到帖木儿沙在位年间（1772—1793）阿富汗南部秩序崩坏，商路才重新冷清。

en:
Kumaon, the old Kurmanchal, is the hill country between the snowy Himalayan crest and the malarial Tarai belt, bordered by Garhwal to the west and the Kali river to the east. From the seventh century the Katyuri rajas ruled it from Kartikeyapura, the later Baijnath, and raised the stone temples of Jageshwar and Katarmal, until their realm broke into a patchwork of hill forts. In the eighth century Som Chand founded a new line, the Chands, at Champawat, but for centuries his successors held little beyond the Kali Kumaon tract while rival rajas kept the rest. In 1444 the Chand raja still sat at Champawat, drawing wealth from the Bhotia caravans that crossed the high passes into Tibet and the pilgrim road to Kailash and Manasarovar.

After 1450 Ratna Chand and his successors swallowed the neighbouring chiefdoms one by one. In 1563 Balo Kalyan Chand moved the capital from Champawat to a new town, Alamnagar, renamed Almora, and under his son Rudra Chand the kingdom reached its height and began sending tribute to the Mughal emperors in Delhi. In 1670 Baz Bahadur Chand led an army over the Johar pass and took the Tibetan fort of Taklakot, a feat no earlier Indian ruler was recorded to have achieved; early in the next century Kumaoni troops raided Garhwal and sacked its capital Srinagar in 1715. Ali Muhammad Khan's Rohillas overran the southern lowlands in 1744, and as the kingdom crumbled the Gurkhas of Nepal took Almora in 1790 after a skirmish at Hwalbagh, opening twenty-four years of harsh occupation. The Treaty of Sugauli in 1816 handed Kumaon to the East India Company, which joined it to eastern Garhwal as the Kumaon province.
zh:
库马翁古称库尔马恰尔，是夹在北部喜马拉雅雪岭与南部瘴疠流行的特莱湿地之间的山地，西邻加瓦尔，东以卡利河为界。7世纪起，卡图里王朝从卡尔蒂凯亚普拉（即今拜杰纳特）统治此地，留下杰格什沃尔和卡塔尔马尔的石庙，后来王国崩解，碎成一串各自据寨的小邦。8世纪时，索姆·昌德在金巴沃德建立昌德家族的新邦，但其后几百年只领有卡里库马翁一带，其余山地仍在诸小拉杰手中。1444年，昌德拉杰仍住在金巴沃德，翻越高山口往来西藏的菩提亚商队，以及前往冈仁波齐和玛旁雍错的朝圣者，是这片山岭最大的财源。

1450年之后，拉特纳·昌德及其后继者逐个吞并邻近小邦。1563年，巴洛·卡尔扬·昌德把首府从金巴沃德迁到新建的阿拉姆讷格尔，改名阿尔莫拉；其子鲁德拉·昌德在位时国势达到鼎盛，并开始向德里的莫卧儿皇帝进贡。1670年，巴兹·巴哈杜尔·昌德率军越过焦哈尔山口，攻取西藏要塞塔克拉科特，史载此前没有印度君王做到过。进入18世纪，库马翁军队连年西攻加瓦尔，1715年洗劫其都城斯利那加。1744年，阿里·穆罕默德汗的罗希拉人攻占南部低地；国势土崩瓦解之际，尼泊尔的廓尔喀军1790年在赫瓦尔巴格附近一场遭遇战后夺取阿尔莫拉，开始了二十四年的严酷统治。1816年的《苏高利条约》把库马翁割给东印度公司，英人将其与加瓦尔东部合并，置为库马翁省。

en:
The steep ridges between the Marshyangdi and the Trishuli were the heart of the Chaubisi Rajya, the twenty-four hill kingdoms that took shape after the old Khasa kingdom fragmented. Their rajas, Khas, Thakuri and Magar, ruled from hilltop forts, or kot, above terraced rice and millet land. At Ligligkot a yearly footrace up from Chepeghat gave its winner the kingship for a year, while nearby Gorkhakot was held by the Magar raja Mansingh Khadka; this was the western march of Magarat, the loose confederation of Magar principalities. In 1444 the country was a patchwork of rival fort-states, bound as much by caste and kinship as by war, and subject to no ruler in the Kathmandu valley.

In 1559 Dravya Shah, youngest son of the raja of Lamjung, is said to have won the Ligligkot race with Magar backing and then taken Gorkhakot, founding the Gorkha kingdom on the ridge crowned by the Gorakhnath shrine and Gorkha Durbar. His descendant Ram Shah, who reigned from about 1606 to 1636, fixed weights, measures and rates of interest and won a name for justice across the hills. The tenth king, Prithvi Narayan Shah, opened his unification wars with the capture of Nuwakot in 1744; his general Kalu Pande fell before Kirtipur in 1757, and a British relief expedition under Kinloch broke down in the malarial plains in 1767.
