Kathmandu, Lalitpur and Bhaktapur fell between 1768 and 1769, the court moved from the Gorkha ridge to Kathmandu, and the kingdom took the name of Nepal. By the Treaty of Sugauli in 1816 the last of the Chaubisi holdouts had long been absorbed.
zh:
马相迪河与特里苏利河之间的陡峭山地，是乔比西拉贾，即二十四山邦的核心。古卡瑟王国瓦解后，这一带形成二十余个小国，卡斯族、塔库里族和马嘉尔族的拉杰们据守山顶的「科特」堡寨，统辖着层层梯田。在利格利果德，每年有人从切沛噶特赛跑上山，夺魁者便可为王一年；附近的廓尔喀果德则由马嘉尔首领曼辛格·卡德卡占据，这里是马嘉尔松散邦联「马格拉特」的西陲。1444年时，此地仍是彼此联姻又征战不休的堡寨小邦拼合之地，不受加德满都谷地任何君主统属。

1559年，拉姆忠国君的幼子德拉维亚·沙阿据说在马嘉尔人支持下赢下利格利果德的赛跑，继而夺取廓尔喀果德，在山脊上建立廓尔喀王国，山顶的戈拉克纳特神庙与廓尔喀王宫后来成为其象征。他的后裔拉姆·沙阿约在1606至1636年间在位，统一度量衡、定下利率，以公正闻名于诸山。第十代国王普里特维·纳拉扬·沙阿1744年攻占努瓦科特，开启统一战争；1757年，大将卡卢·潘德战死在基尔蒂普尔城下，1767年东印度公司金洛克驰援谷地的远征军在疟疾流行的平原上溃败。1768至1769年，加德满都、勒利德布尔和巴克塔普尔先后陷落，朝廷从廓尔喀山迁往加德满都，王国改称尼泊尔；到1816年《苏高利条约》签订时，硕果仅存的乔比西邦国也早已被逐一吞并。

en:
The misty eastern hills between the Arun River and the Kangchenjunga massif were Limbuwan, 'Yakthung Laaje', the land of the Yakthung, whom outsiders called the Limbu. They lived in ten autonomous kingdoms whose rulers bore the title Hang, each holding a hilltop yiok fort and the kipat lands worked by the clan. Phedap, with its hill fort of Poklabung, was one of the ten; early in the fifteenth century the brothers Sidi Ing and Sangla Ing came out of the east to found its line and that of the lowland Morang. In 1444 Phedap and its fellow rajas still ruled themselves, answering to no power in Kathmandu or Sikkim.

For three more centuries the Hang of Phedap kept their hills while kingdoms rose and fell in the plains below. The Gorkha unification reached the Arun under Prithvi Narayan Shah, and in the Limbuwan-Gorkha war of 1771 to 1774 the rajas were pressed on two fronts. In 1774 Aata Hang Raya, twenty-first in Phedap's line, and the other nine kings signed a collective treaty with Gorkha: Limbuwan entered the kingdom of Nepal, while the Limbu kept their customary kipat lands, language and rites. Sikkim continued to raid across the Mechi in the years that followed, and during the Anglo-Nepalese war of 1814 to 1816 the campaigning passed through the southern lowlands, until the Treaty of Sugauli fixed Limbuwan's forests and ridges within Nepal.
zh:
阿润河与干城章嘉雪山之间雾色深处的东山，是林布，即林布旺，林布语称「亚克通·拉杰」，意为亚克通人的土地，外族则称他们为林布人。这里分为十个自治小国，君主号「杭」，各自据守山顶的「伊奥克」堡寨与氏族共有的「基帕特」土地。佩达普是十国之一，拥有波克拉邦山寨；15世纪初，西迪·英与桑格拉·英兄弟从东方迁来，分别开创了佩达普与低地莫朗的王统。1444年时，佩达普与其余诸邦仍各自为政，不臣服于加德满都或锡金的任何强权。

此后三个世纪，佩达普的历代「杭」据守山乡，低地的王国几经兴亡。普里特维·纳拉扬·沙阿的统一战争推进到阿润河，1771至1774年的林布旺—廓尔喀战争中，诸邦两线受敌。1774年，佩达普王统第二十一代君主阿塔杭·拉亚与其余九王一同同廓尔喀会盟立约：林布旺并入尼泊尔王国，林布人的基帕特公有地、语言与习俗得到保留。此后锡金仍数次越过梅吉河来犯；1814至1816年英尼战争期间，战事在南部低地展开，最终《苏高利条约》将林布旺的森林与山岭确定在尼泊尔版图之内。

en:
Bhakkar guards a stretch of the Indus where the floodplain narrows against the Thal desert, on the river's left bank among date groves and well-watered fields. Local tradition makes the town a late-fifteenth-century plantation of colonists from Dera Ismail Khan, led by one Bakhar Khan who gave it his name. In 1444 it is already the rough northern march of Sindh under the Samma Jam at Thatta, where boatmen and cotton growers rub shoulders with Baloch and Jat raiders; Jam Nizamuddin II would march here with a large force soon after his accession and spend a year scouring the country of freebooters.

In 1541 the fugitive Humayun demanded the fort and, refused by its Arghun governor, sat down to besiege it while his brother Hindal moved against Sehwan, but he soon broke off and crossed the desert. After Humayun's restoration in 1555 Bhakkar passed to the Mughals, governed together with Multan, and in 1641 the Portuguese traveller Sebastian Manrique called it the capital of a kingdom of Bhakkar. In 1787 the ousted Kalhora prince Abdul Nabi seized Layyah and Bhakkar from the Jaskani tribe and held them until 1790.
zh:
珀格尔（Bhakkar）扼守印度河的一段河道：河左岸的冲积平原在这里被塔尔沙漠挤窄，椰枣林与井水灌溉的田畴交错。当地传说称，这座城镇是15世纪末由一个叫贝卡尔汗的人率领德拉伊斯梅尔汗的移民开辟的，城名也由他而来。1444年时，它已是特达萨姆马贾姆治下信德粗粝的北疆——船夫、棉农与俾路支、贾特劫掠者杂处；贾姆·尼扎姆丁二世上位不久便率大军到此，花了一年时间肃清四方盗匪。

1541年，流亡中的胡马雍要求守军交出堡垒，被阿尔浑总督拒绝后就地围攻，同时派兄弟欣达尔进攻塞赫万，但他很快撤围穿过沙漠离去。1555年胡马雍复国后，珀格尔并入莫卧儿版图，与木尔坦一并管辖；1641年，葡萄牙旅行家塞巴斯蒂安·曼里克称它为「珀格尔王国」的都城。1787年，被逐的卡尔霍拉王公阿卜杜勒·纳比从贾斯卡尼部落手中夺取莱亚和珀格尔，一直据守到1790年。

en:
Gilgit lies in a broad valley where the Gilgit River meets the Hunza, close to the junction of the Karakoram, Hindu Kush and Himalaya. Shina-speaking Dards farmed its alluvial fans, while Burusho herdsmen held Hunza and Nagar in the mountains above. A stage on the Silk Road between the Tarim oases and the Indus gorges, it was a stronghold of Vajrayana Buddhism: the Patola Shahis, the Little Bolü of the Chinese records, ruled from here, Faxian and Xuanzang passed through, and the Gilgit manuscripts preserve its scriptures. Tibetan rule lasted into the late ninth century, and by the fourteenth century the local rajas, remembered as the Trakhan dynasty, had embraced Islam with the rest of the hill country. In 1444 Raja Torra Khan (r. 1421–1475) holds Gilgit, his kin ruling tributary valleys from Yasin to Punial, and caravans still cross the passes with wool and salt.

The line of Shah Rais Khan, who fled to Badakhshan and wrested Chitral with its help, disputed the Trakhan succession as the Ra'issiya dynasty, and Chitral more than once reached into Yasin and the western valleys. The Trakhans nevertheless held Gilgit for centuries. Their best-remembered ruler was the seventeenth-century queen Dadi Jawari, who had canals dug to water the town and its fields. About 1810 the old dynasty ended with the death of Raja Abbas, its last raja, and in the years to 1821 the valley was fought over by the chiefs of Yasin, Hunza and Nagar.
zh:
吉尔吉特位于吉尔吉特河与罕萨河交汇处的宽阔河谷，紧邻喀喇昆仑、兴都库什与喜马拉雅三大山脉的相接之地。说希纳语的达尔德人在冲积扇上耕作，布鲁沙绍人的牧人则据有上方山地的罕萨与讷格尔。作为塔里木绿洲与印度河峡谷之间丝绸之路上的大站，这里曾是金刚乘佛教的重镇：汉文记载中的小勃律，即帕托拉·沙希王朝，由此发号施令，法显和玄奘先后取道于此，吉尔吉特写卷保存了当时的经文。吐蕃的统治延续到9世纪末；到14世纪，后世所称的特拉罕王朝拉杰们已随这片山地各部一同皈依伊斯兰教。1444年在位的是托拉汗（1421—1475年），同族首领统治着从亚辛到普尼亚尔的各条纳贡河谷，商队依旧驮着羊毛与盐翻过山口。

沙阿·拉伊斯汗一系与特拉罕家族争位，他逃到巴达赫尚借兵夺得奇特拉尔，后裔称拉伊西亚王朝，奇特拉尔势力也一再伸入亚辛等西部河谷。尽管如此，特拉罕家族仍统治吉尔吉特数百年，其中最受怀念的是17世纪的女王达迪·贾瓦里，她主持开凿水渠，灌溉城镇与农田。约1810年末代拉杰阿巴斯去世，古老王朝告终；此后到1821年，亚辛、罕萨和讷格尔的首领为争夺谷地征战不已。

en:
Ladakh is a high, cold kingdom strung along the upper Indus between the Great Himalayas and the Karakoram, crossed by the trade road linking Kashmir with the Yarkand oasis. Tibetan in speech and Buddhist in faith since the faith's second diffusion into Tibet, it was the kingdom of Maryul from the tenth century, with its seat at Shey above the river while Leh grew into its caravan market, where Changthang herders sold the fine pashm wool of the high plains. In 1444 the old Maryul dynasty still rules under King Lodrö Chokden, but its valleys lie open to Muslim raiders from Kashmir and Baltistan and the royal line is weakening.

In 1460 Bhagan, lord of Basgo, rose with the men of Leh, dethroned the Maryul king and took the name Namgyal, 'victorious'. Tashi Namgyal (r. 1555–1575) beat off Central Asian raiders and fortified the Namgyal peak, and Tsewang Namgyal pushed the frontier towards Nepal. The 'Lion King' Sengge Namgyal (r. 1616–1642) raised the royal palace at Leh and patronised the Hemis and Hanle monasteries, extending his rule over Zanskar and Spiti before the Mughals checked him; his son Deldan Namgyal built a mosque in Leh to satisfy Aurangzeb. When Ladakh backed Bhutan in its quarrel with the Fifth Dalai Lama, Tibetan and Mongol troops crossed the passes in 1679; Mughal aid from Kashmir saved Leh, and the Treaty of Tingmosgang in 1684 made Ladakh a tribute-bearing neighbour of Lhasa while securing its trade in Tibetan pashm wool. The settlement brought more than a century of quiet, and in 1821 the small, remote kingdom, its bazaars busy with caravans, is still ruled by the Namgyal kings.
zh:
拉达克是沿印度河上游展开的高寒王国，夹在大喜马拉雅山与喀喇昆仑山之间，连通克什米尔与叶尔羌绿洲的商道横穿其境。居民操藏语、信佛教；自佛教上路弘传以来，这里在10世纪成为玛域王国，王庭设在印度河畔的谢斯，列城则成长为商队集市，羌塘牧人把高原的细软羊绒（帕什姆）贩运到此。1444年，玛域旧王朝仍在洛追却丹王治下，但各河谷时常暴露在克什米尔和巴尔蒂斯坦穆斯林军队的抄掠之下，王统也在衰微。

1460年，巴斯哥首领巴干联合列城人起兵，废黜玛域国王，取姓南嘉，意为「胜利者」，建立南嘉王朝。扎西南嘉（1555—1575年在位）击退中亚袭掠者，在南嘉峰上修筑堡垒；泽旺南嘉把疆界推向尼泊尔方向。「狮子王」僧格南嘉（1616—1642年在位）在列城兴建王宫，护持黑密斯、汉列等寺，吞并赞斯卡尔和斯皮提，但被已占据克什米尔和巴尔蒂斯坦的莫卧儿人挫败；其子德丹南嘉为安抚奥朗则布，在列城修建清真寺。1679年，拉达克在五世达赖喇嘛与不丹的争端中支持不丹，藏军与蒙古兵遂越过山口，幸而克什米尔的莫卧儿援军保住列城；1684年的《丁莫岗条约》使拉达克成为向拉萨纳贡朝使的邻邦，同时保住了它转运西藏羊绒的贸易之利。此后一个多世纪边事平静，到1821年，这个国小民稀、远在群山之外的王国仍由南嘉王室统治，集市上商旅往来不断。

en:
Doaba, the 'land of two rivers', is the fertile wedge of the Punjab between the Beas and the Sutlej, crossed by the high road from Delhi to Lahore. The Ghaznavids overran it around 1070, and it later formed part of the Lahore province of the Delhi sultans. Jasrat Khokhar seized Jalandhar in 1431, but the country soon passed to Bahlul Lodi, the Afghan lord of Sirhind, who in 1443 refounded its chief market as Sultanpur Lodhi, the midway stage on the road between Delhi and Lahore. In 1444 the Doaba is therefore a rich, densely peopled farming and trading country of Punjabi Hindus, governed by Bahlul's officers, its marts busy with cloth and the produce of the well-watered fields.

Bahlul made himself sultan in 1451, and the Doaba stayed Lodi crown land. At Sultanpur, Guru Nanak kept the governor's grain store and married in 1488; his disappearance in the Kali Bein rivulet and return with a new teaching at the end of the century was the beginning of Sikhism. Babur marched this road through the Doaba on his way to Panipat in 1526, and under the Mughals Jalandhar became a sarkar of the Lahore subah, while Rahon, with its old brick fort, grew rich as a mart on the caravan route towards Tibet and Central Asia. In 1710 the Sikhs of Banda Singh Bahadur stormed and held Rahon before the Mughals retook the town. Ahmad Shah Durrani's raids then swept repeatedly through the Doaba, and after his withdrawal the Sikh misls divided the country among themselves; the Faizullahpuria Misl took Jalandhar in 1766. Ranjit Singh brought the whole Doaba into his Lahore kingdom in 1811, leaving the Ahluwalia chiefs of Kapurthala as its foremost native lords.
zh:
多亚巴意为「两河之地」，是旁遮普比亚斯河与萨特莱杰河之间的肥沃楔形地带，德里至拉合尔的大道横贯东西。伽色尼人约1070年征服这里，此后它成为德里苏丹拉合尔行省的一部分。1431年贾斯拉特·霍卡尔夺取贾朗达尔，但这片土地不久落入西尔欣德的阿富汗领主巴赫鲁尔·洛迪之手；1443年，他把此地的首要商镇重建为苏尔坦普尔洛迪，作为德里与拉合尔之间的中途驿站。因此，1444年的多亚巴是一片富庶、人烟稠密的农桑商贾之地，居民多为旁遮普印度教徒，由巴赫鲁尔任命的官吏治理，市集上布匹与灌溉良田的出产交易繁忙。

巴赫鲁尔1451年自立为苏丹，多亚巴仍是洛迪王朝的直属领地。古鲁·那纳克曾在苏尔坦普尔掌管总督的粮库，1488年在此成婚；他在卡利本溪中失踪后带着新的教义归来，时在15、16世纪之交，锡克教由此发端。1526年，巴布尔在前往帕尼帕特的路上沿这条大道穿过多亚巴；莫卧儿时期，贾朗达尔成为拉合尔苏巴的一个萨尔卡尔，拉洪则凭借古老砖堡和通往西藏、中亚的商队贸易而繁盛。1710年，班达·辛格·巴哈杜尔麾下的锡克人攻克拉洪并据守，后被莫卧儿夺回。此后艾哈迈德·沙·杜兰尼的多次入侵反复席卷多亚巴；他退兵后，锡克诸米斯尔瓜分此地，法伊祖拉普里亚马斯尔于1766年夺取贾朗达尔。1811年，兰季特·辛格把整个多亚巴并入他的拉合尔王国，只留下卡普尔塔拉的阿卢瓦利亚家族作为当地最显赫的首领。

en:
Sialkot lies in the Rechna Doab, the Punjab plain between the Chenab and Ravi, hard by the Jammu hills. It is the old Sagala, rebuilt as the capital of the Indo-Greek king Menander in the 2nd century BCE, but its later fame came with Islam: Muhammad of Ghor took it in 1185 and repaired its fort for the Delhi sultans, and the warrior-saint Imam Ali-ul-Haq later drew much of the town to the faith. Its golden age came under Jasrat Khokhar, who made Sialkot his capital and mastered most of Punjab between 1421 and 1442, taking Jammu in 1423. After Jasrat's death Bahlul Khan Lodi, lord of Sirhind, seized the city and entrusted it to Raja Biram Dev of Jammu, whereupon a Kashmiri force under Malik Tazi Bhat sacked it. In 1444 Sialkot is a garrison town living in the shadow of its recent past as a Punjabi capital.

Babur's commander captured Sialkot in 1520, and under the Mughals it entered the subah of Lahore. Sikh tradition places Guru Nanak's visit and his meeting with the Sufi Hamza Ghaus in these years. Akbar gave the district to Raja Man Singh, who restored the fort; the exiled king of Kashmir, Yousuf Shah Chak, sheltered here in 1580, and Kashmiri papermakers then settled in the town, producing the prized white Hariri paper for the Mughal court while its smiths supplied imperial arms. The scholar Abdul Hakim Sialkoti taught in the imperial madrassa until his death in 1656, and under Aurangzeb plentiful paper made the town a centre of Islamic learning. Nader Shah's Persians sacked it in 1739, and in 1748 it passed to Ahmad Shah Durrani. Bhangi Sikh chieftains had divided the town into four quarters by 1786, and Ranjit Singh took Sialkot in 1808; in 1821 it remains a fortified city of his Sikh Empire.
zh:
锡亚尔科特位于奇纳布河与拉维河之间的雷奇纳河间地，紧邻查谟丘陵。这里是古城奢羯罗，公元前2世纪由印度—希腊国王米南德重建为都，但它后世的声名与伊斯兰相连：1185年古尔的穆罕默德夺取此城、为德里苏丹重修堡垒，战圣伊玛目·阿里·哈克后来在此传教，使城中多数人归信。它的黄金时代在贾斯拉特·霍哈尔治下：他以锡亚尔科特为都，于1421至1442年间据有旁遮普大部，1423年征服查谟。贾斯拉特死后，西尔欣德的领主巴赫鲁尔汗·洛迪夺取此城，交给查谟的罗阇·比拉姆·德夫代管，随后马利克·塔齐·巴特率领的克什米尔军队又将城池洗劫。1444年的锡亚尔科特是一座驻军城镇，刚从旁遮普都城的旧梦中跌落。

1520年巴布尔的将领攻占锡亚尔科特，莫卧儿时期它划入拉合尔省。按锡克传统，古鲁·那纳克曾在此拜访苏菲圣者哈姆扎·高斯。阿克巴把此地封给罗阇·曼·辛格，由他重修堡垒；1580年，被逐出克什米尔的国王优素福·沙·查克到此避难，克什米尔造纸工匠随后迁入，莫卧儿宫廷珍视的洁白「哈里里纸」即出于此，城中铁匠也为帝国供应兵器。学者阿卜杜勒·哈基姆·锡亚尔科蒂在帝国经学院执教，直至1656年去世；奥朗则布时代，充足的纸张使此城成为伊斯兰学术中心。1739年纳迪尔沙的波斯军洗劫此城，1748年它转入艾哈迈德沙·杜兰尼之手。到1786年，班吉米斯尔的锡克首领已把全城划为四区，兰吉特·辛格于1808年夺取锡亚尔科特，1821年时它仍是锡克帝国的设防边城。

en:
The Margalla Hills mark the Himalayan edge of the Pothohar Plateau, where tracks from the Soan valley climb toward Kashmir. Pharwala above the Soan was the fortified center of the local chieftaincy, while Rawat began as a roadside caravanserai. The Khokhar chief Jasrat held these marches after Timur's invasion of 1398, helped Zayn al-Abidin win the Kashmir throne, and dominated much of upper Punjab until his death in 1442. In 1444 his confederation had only just dissolved, leaving the Margalla passes to a rivalry between Khokhar and Gakhar clans; Rawalpindi itself remained a ruined settlement.

A Gakhar chief restored the town as Rawal in 1493. Under the Mughals the Gakhars held Pharwala as marcher lords, but Sarang Khan refused Sher Shah Suri, whose forces attacked the fort in 1540 and built Rohtas to overawe the plateau; Sarang was executed and buried at Rawat. Humayun's returning army expelled the Suri garrisons in February 1555, restoring Sarang's brother Adam Khan. After Akbar's fort at Attock was built in 1581, the emperor reached Rawalpindi in December 1585 during his northwestern campaigns. Nader Shah's army crossed the region in 1738-1739, after which Muqarrab Khan Gakhar ruled Pothohar and captured Gujrat in 1741. Sikh power reached Rawalpindi in 1765, and Ranjit Singh seized Pharwala in 1818.
zh:
马尔加拉山是波托哈尔高原通向喜马拉雅山区的边缘，索安河谷的道路由此翻越山地，前往克什米尔。索安河畔的帕尔瓦拉堡是地方酋长势力的要塞中心，拉瓦特最初则是路旁商队驿站。霍哈尔首领贾斯拉特在1398年帖木儿入侵后控制这些边地，又帮助扎因·阿比丁取得克什米尔王位，并在1442年去世前长期支配上旁遮普大部。1444年，他的联盟刚刚瓦解，马尔加拉各山口成为霍哈尔人与加哈尔人争夺的边疆；拉瓦尔品第当时还是一处荒废聚落。

1493年，一名加哈尔首领重建城镇，取名拉瓦尔。莫卧儿时期，加哈尔人作为边地领主据守帕尔瓦拉，但萨朗汗拒绝臣服舍尔沙·苏利；苏利军队1540年进攻堡垒，并修建罗赫塔斯堡以压制高原，萨朗最终被处死，葬在拉瓦特。1555年2月，胡马雍反攻的军队驱逐苏利驻军，恢复了萨朗之弟阿当汗的地位。1581年阿克巴修建阿塔克堡后，皇帝本人于1585年12月在西北战役期间抵达拉瓦尔品第。1738-1739年，纳迪尔沙的军队穿过这一地区，穆卡拉卜汗·加哈尔随后统治波托哈尔，并于1741年夺取古杰拉特。锡克势力1765年进入拉瓦尔品第，兰季德·辛格则在1818年攻占帕尔瓦拉。

en:
Bannu is the irrigated basin enclosed between the Kurram and Tochi rivers, a short but difficult corridor from the Afghan hills toward the Indus and Punjab. Mahmud of Ghazni had used the route on his raids into India, and in the late fourteenth century the Shitak Pashtuns later called Banuchis were pushed from Shawal into this valley. They defeated or expelled the Mangal and Honai, pressed the Khattaks northward, and divided the irrigated land among their clans. In 1444 the Banuchis therefore held their fields and pastures themselves, their Sunnism and Pashtun tribal order mattering far more day to day than the distant claims of Multan.

Babur invaded the valley in 1505 and massacred the Kevis who resisted him, but the Mughals never reduced Bannu to a quiet revenue district. A detachment of Nader Shah's army entered the Banuchi lands in 1738 and carried off substantial tribute rather than occupying the basin. After Ahmad Shah Durrani founded the Afghan kingdom, Kabul maintained only an uncertain hold and collected little revenue. From 1802 to 1808 Bannu was leased to the Sikhs; Sikh columns later returned every few years to demand taxes, repeatedly facing the Banuchi leader Ghazi Dilasa Khan before the valley entered the colonial era still governed through its fortified clan villages.
zh:
本努是库拉姆河与托奇河之间的灌溉盆地，也是从阿富汗山地通往印度河与旁遮普的一条短而艰险的走廊。马哈茂德·伽色尼曾由此进军印度；14世纪末，后来被称为巴努奇人的希塔克普什图人被从沙瓦尔山地逐入此谷。他们击败或驱走曼加尔人与霍奈人，把哈塔克人向北压迫，再将灌溉土地分给各氏族。1444年，巴努奇人已自行掌握农田和牧场；对日常生活而言，逊尼派信仰和普什图部族秩序远比木尔坦的遥远宗主权重要。

1505年，巴布尔攻入河谷，屠杀了抵抗他的基维部人，但莫卧儿始终未能把本努变成安定税区。1738年，纳迪尔沙军队的一支部队进入巴努奇土地，索取大量贡赋后离开，并未长期占领盆地。艾哈迈德·沙阿·杜兰尼建立阿富汗王国后，喀布尔对这里的控制时断时续，税收也很少。1802年至1808年，本努被租给锡克人；此后锡克军队每隔几年便回来索税，却一再遭遇巴努奇首领加齐·迪拉萨汗的抵抗，直到殖民时代开始前，河谷仍由设防的氏族村落治理。

en:
The Derajat is the dry strip of plain between the Sulaiman Mountains and the west bank of the Indus, its name—from dera, 'camp'—recalling the pastoral Baloch who grazed their flocks along the foothills. Routes through the mountain passes met the river crossings on the way to Multan, and the country was known for wool and livestock rather than towns. In 1444 it was a loosely governed trans-Indus march of the Multan sultanate, which had lately broken away from Delhi; Saraiki-speaking cultivators held the riverine strips while Baloch clans drifted in from the west.

In 1469 or 1471 Sultan Husayn Langah, unable to control the tract, granted it as a jagir to the Baloch chief Malik Sohrab Dodai, whose followers then garrisoned it for Multan. Before the end of the century Mir Haji Khan Mirani had founded the settlement named after his son Ghazi Khan, whose domed tomb was raised about 1495; Dera Ismail Khan and Dera Fateh Khan took shape in the same fashion. The chiefs submitted to Babur in 1526 and afterwards to his son Kamran, ruler of Kabul, and the Mirani nawabs kept their seat at Dera Ghazi Khan for fifteen generations. Early in the eighteenth century the Kalhoras of Sind overran them, and after Nadir Shah's invasion of 1739 Mahmud Khan Gujar governed the town, founding Mahmud Kot and opening canals. Durrani governors sent from Kabul followed, until in 1819 Khushal Singh's army took Dera Ghazi Khan for Ranjit Singh.
zh:
德拉杰德是苏莱曼山脉与印度河西岸之间的干旱平原地带，其名源自「德拉」（dera，营地），让人想起沿山麓放牧的俾路支牧民。山口商路在此接上通往木尔坦的渡口，这片地方以羊毛和牲畜而非城镇闻名。1444年时，它是新近脱离德里的木尔坦苏丹国在印度河以西的一块松散边地，河滨地带有讲萨拉基语的农人耕作，俾路支部落则从西边不断迁入。

1469或1471年，无力控制此地的侯赛因·朗伽苏丹把它封给俾路支首领马利克·苏赫拉布·多多伊作军功采邑，其部众从此为木尔坦戍守这一带。世纪末之前，米尔·哈吉·汗·米拉尼以其子加齐·汗之名建立定居点，加齐·汗的穹顶陵墓约建于1495年；德拉伊斯梅尔汗和德拉法塔赫汗也以同样方式形成。1526年诸酋向巴布尔投降，后又臣服于巴布尔之子、喀布尔统治者卡姆兰，米拉尼系纳瓦卜在德拉加齐汗传了十五代。18世纪初，信德的卡尔霍拉人席卷此地；1739年纳迪尔沙入侵后，马哈茂德·汗·古杰尔主政该城，兴建马哈茂德科特并开挖水渠。此后由喀布尔派来的杜兰尼总督治理，1819年胡沙尔·辛格的军队为兰吉特·辛格夺取了德拉加齐汗。

en:
Srikakulam, long called Chicacole, is the northernmost stretch of the Andhra coast, where the Nagavali River crosses the old country of Kalinga to reach the Bay of Bengal. Its Buddhist stupas at Salihundam mark its place on the ancient sea lane from the deltas to Bengal, and in later centuries it formed the southern march of the Eastern Ganga kings of Orissa. When that line ended the coast passed to the Gajapatis, and in 1444 it belonged to Kapilendra Deva's newly built empire: an Oriya-speaking land of sugar fields and fishing harbours, with Telugu hill chiefs holding the jungles behind it.

As Gajapati power ebbed, the Qutb Shahis of Golconda overran the coast and completed the conquest by 1571. Chicacole became the seat of a faujdar, later styling himself Nawab, who governed the entire North Andhra march. In 1673 Viswambhar Dev I of Jeypore defeated that Nawab and set up a semi-independent rule over the Circars. Aurangzeb's conquest of Golconda in 1687 made the coast Mughal; after 1724 it followed the Nizam, until the French under Bussy took charge of the Northern Circars as his patrons. Colonel Forde defeated the French at Condore on 9 December 1758 and stormed Masulipatnam on 25 January 1759, and although the country was left for a time to the Nizam, Clive obtained the Mughal grant of the Circars in 1765 and the Treaty of Masulipatnam in 1768 made them Company territory.
zh:
斯里卡库拉姆旧称奇卡科莱，是安得拉海岸最北端的一段，纳加瓦利河穿过古羯陵伽之地注入孟加拉湾。萨利洪达姆的佛塔表明，这里自古处在河口水系通往孟加拉的海路上；中古后期，它是奥里萨东恒伽王国的南边地。东恒伽王朝终结后，海岸转归加贾帕蒂王朝。1444年，这片海岸属于卡皮伦德拉·德瓦新建的帝国：居民操奥里雅语，甘蔗田与渔港相连，后方山林则由泰卢固酋长盘踞。

加贾帕蒂衰落后，戈尔孔达的库特卜沙希王朝席卷海岸，于1571年完成征服，奇卡科莱成为一名法乌吉达尔的驻地，此人后来自称纳瓦布，统辖整个北安得拉边地。1673年，杰伊布尔的毗湿瓦姆巴尔·德夫一世击败这名纳瓦布，在北塞尔卡尔建立半独立统治。1687年奥朗则布攻灭戈尔孔达，海岸并入莫卧儿；1724年后转归海得拉巴尼扎姆，其后又由比西率领的法国人受尼扎姆之托控制北塞尔卡尔。1758年12月9日，福德上校在孔多尔击败法军，1759年1月25日攻克默苏利珀德姆；地区虽一度留归尼扎姆管理，克莱夫1765年取得莫卧儿皇帝颁赐北塞尔卡尔的诏谕，1768年的默苏利珀德姆条约最终将其划入公司领地。

en:
Lakhnor lies in the red-soil uplands of Rarh in western Bengal, where forest runs from the Ajay river up to the Rajmahal hills. After the Sena kings of the twelfth century, Khalji raiders broke in early in the thirteenth: the chronicler Minhaj-i-Siraj calls Lakhnur a thana, the frontier headquarters of Muslim rule in Rarh, and Rajnagar, founded by the Hindu raja Bir Singh, fell to Muhammad Shiran Khalji and Ali Mardan. The sultans at Gaur never mastered this hinterland, and in 1444 its jungle forts and villages were held, in all but name, by the Hindu Bir Rajas of the Bagdi Malla line from their seats at Hetampur, Birsinghpur and Rajnagar. Cotton and silk weavers worked the villages, and the forests yielded timber and lac.

Under Mughal rule the Pathan zamindar Jonad Khan founded his Nagar Raj at Rajnagar in 1600, feudatory to the Mughals. Badi-uz-zaman Khan, raja from 1718 under a patent of Murshid Quli Khan, failed to throw off Murshidabad; in the Maratha invasions of 1742–1751 Birbhum was ravaged and Rajnagar overrun. His son Asad-uz-zaman Khan (r. 1752–1777) stood by the nawab; after Plassey the Company defeated him with Mir Qasim in 1761 and routed him at Hetampur in 1765, restoring him shorn of his autonomy. The great Bengal famine of 1770 wiped out whole villages, and more than three-quarters of households perished even in the towns. The Company took direct charge in 1786 and formed the district of Beerbhoom in 1787, with its headquarters at Suri. At Ilambazar, a river mart ringed by weaving villages, the English kept a factory and the French bid for silk in the 1780s; it was sacked in a peasant rising in June 1789, though it later recovered. By the early nineteenth century Rajnagar lay deserted, the forest closing over its ruined palaces.
zh:
拉克纳位于孟加拉西部拉德（Rarh）的红壤高地，灌木与丛林从阿杰伊河畔一直延到拉杰默哈尔丘陵边缘。12世纪时这里在塞纳王朝治下，13世纪初卡尔吉骑兵攻入：史家明哈杰·西拉季把拉克纳（古籍记作Lakhnur）称为穆斯林政权在拉德的「塔纳」，即边防据点；印度教罗阇比尔·辛格所建的拉杰讷格尔也被穆罕默德·希兰·卡尔吉和阿里·马尔丹攻取。以高尔为都的孟加拉苏丹始终未能真正控制这片腹地，到1444年，林地间的寨堡和村庄实际由巴格迪·马拉世系的印度教「比尔罗阇」们号令，赫坦布尔、比尔辛格布尔和拉杰讷格尔都是他们的居城。村里的织工织造棉布与丝绸，山林则出产木材和紫胶。

莫卧儿统治下，普什图裔柴明达尔乔纳德汗于1600年在拉杰讷格尔建立「讷格尔罗阇」政权，作为臣属莫卧儿的穆斯林封邑。1718年称罗阇的巴迪·乌兹·扎曼汗曾受穆尔希德·库利汗册封，他试图摆脱穆尔希达巴德却告失败；1742至1751年马拉塔人连年入侵，比尔布姆遭洗劫，拉杰讷格尔也被攻陷。其子阿萨德·乌兹·扎曼汗（1752年至1777年在位）效忠纳瓦卜，普拉西战役后公司于1761年联合米尔·卡西姆将他击败，1765年又在赫坦布尔之战中将其击溃，他虽得复位，自治权却被削夺殆尽。1770年孟加拉大饥荒中整村人口灭绝，即便是大城镇也有超过四分之三的住户死绝。公司于1786年直接接管，1787年设立比尔布姆县，治所置于苏里。伊拉姆巴扎尔是织村环绕的河埠商镇，公司在此设有商馆，1780年代法国人也来争购丝绸；1789年6月农民起事，城镇遭到洗劫，事后才逐渐复苏。到19世纪初，拉杰讷格尔已是空城，丛林正渐渐吞没倾颓的宫室。

en:
The Raipur plain is the heart of Dakshina Kosala, the open rice country of the upper Mahanadi. Sirpur and Arang, near the modern town, were early seats of kings: a Gupta inscription of the sixth century survives at Arang, and the Sharabhpuriya and Panduvamshi dynasties ruled from Sirpur. Around 1000 Kalingaraja, a Kalachuri prince of the Tripuri dynasty on the upper Narmada, conquered the plain, and his descendants ruled it as the Haihaiyavanshi kings. In 1407 their kingdom was divided between a senior line at Ratanpur and a junior branch seated at Raipur, the two together holding the thirty-six forts (chhattisgarh) of local tradition. Ringed by hills and far from the great invasion routes, the plain escaped the Muslim conquests of northern India. In 1444 Raipur was a quiet Hindu temple town and the capital of a rice-exporting kingdom.

Raipur's Haihaya kings acknowledged Mughal suzerainty only at the end of the sixteenth century. Their long peace ended with the Maratha expansion: in the winter of 1740 Bhaskar Pant, dewan of Raghoji I Bhonsle of Nagpur, overran the thirty-six forts, and the Raipur line came to an end by 1753. When Mohan Singh, the last Haihaya ruler, died in 1758, Bimbaji Bhonsle took direct charge of Chhattisgarh and installed his own district governor at Raipur while Ratanpur kept the older title of capital. The town remained a Bhonsle administrative seat for the rest of the Maratha era, collecting the rice tribute of the southern plain and trading down the Mahanadi toward the Odisha country.
zh:
赖布尔平原是南憍萨罗的腹地，即默哈讷迪河上游开阔的稻米之乡。城址附近的锡尔布尔和阿朗曾是古代王都：阿朗留有6世纪的笈多铭文，沙罗跋补罗与般杜万什两个王朝曾在锡尔布尔建都。约1000年，纳马达河上游特里普里王朝的迦罗朱利王公卡林加拉贾征服这片平原，其后裔作为海哈亚万希诸王统治此地。1407年，王国一分为二，长支驻拉坦布尔，幼支驻赖布尔，两支合治传说中的三十六堡，「恰蒂斯加尔」一名便由此而来。平原群山环抱，远离主要入侵通道，躲过了北印度的穆斯林征服。1444年的赖布尔是一座宁静的印度教神庙城镇，也是一个稻米输出王国的都城。

赖布尔的海哈亚诸王直到16世纪末才承认莫卧儿的宗主权。长久的和平终结于马拉塔的扩张：1740年冬，那格浦尔拉戈吉一世·朋斯勒的重臣巴斯卡尔·潘特征服三十六堡，赖布尔支系于1753年告终。1758年末代海哈亚王莫汉·辛格死去，宾巴吉·朋斯勒直接接管恰蒂斯加尔，在赖布尔派驻自己的县令，拉坦布尔则保留古都的名分。此后赖布尔一直是朋斯勒王朝的行政治所，征收南部平原的稻米贡赋，货物沿默哈讷迪河运往奥里萨。

en:
Udayagiri stands northwest of Nellore, at the foot of a steep hill about 1,000 feet high. By the 14th century a walled town and fortress guarded the site; later defenses climbed the hill and included temples, gardens, tanks and thirteen strongholds, eight above the town and five below. It lay on the contested edge between the Telugu-speaking Vijayanagara Empire and the Gajapati kingdom of Odisha. In 1444 the fortress was held for Vijayanagara, while Gajapati power to the north made it a sensitive frontier post.

In 1489 Saluva Narasimha Deva Raya fought the Gajapati monarch over Udayagiri, was taken prisoner, and surrendered the fort and surrounding country before his release. By 1491 the stronghold was in Gajapati hands. In 1512 Krishnadevaraya opened a siege of the hill fortress, which held out for eighteen months before returning to Vijayanagara. After Vijayanagara's power collapsed, a hilltop mosque with two Persian inscriptions was built above the town. In 1682 Abdullah Arafath became the local ruler, and his descendants still controlled Udayagiri through the 18th century.
zh:
优陀耶耆厘（Udayagiri）位于内洛尔西北，坐落在一座高约1000英尺的陡峭山麓。14世纪时，这里已有城墙环绕的城镇和要塞；后来的防线沿山而上，包括神庙、园林、水池，以及十三处堡垒，其中八处在山上、五处在山下。它处在泰卢固人的毗奢耶那伽罗帝国与奥里萨加贾帕蒂王国争夺的边缘。1444年，这座要塞由毗奢耶那伽罗驻守，而北方加贾帕蒂势力正盛，使它成为敏感的边防据点。

1489年，毗奢耶那伽罗统治者萨卢瓦·纳拉辛哈·德瓦·拉亚为优陀耶耆厘与加贾帕蒂君主交战，兵败被俘，交出要塞和周边地区后才获释；到1491年，这座堡垒已落入加贾帕蒂手中。1512年，克里希那德瓦拉亚开始围攻这座山城，守军坚守十八个月后，优陀耶耆厘才重归毗奢耶那伽罗。毗奢耶那伽罗势力瓦解后，山顶建起一座清真寺，留存两道波斯语铭文。1682年，阿卜杜拉·阿拉法特成为当地统治者，他的后裔在整个18世纪仍控制着优陀耶耆厘。

en:
Konaseema is the green maze of islands the Godavari threads on its last miles to the sea, and above the delta stands Rajahmundry, founded in 919 and made a capital by the Eastern Chalukya king Rajaraja Narendra around 1022. At his court Nannayya, the first Telugu poet, began the Telugu Mahabharata, and the town has ever since been called the cultural capital of Andhra. After the Eastern Chalukyas and the Kakatiyas of Warangal it passed to the Reddy kings, who held the delta from Rajahmundry as one of the last Hindu realms of coastal Andhra. In 1444 the Reddy raja still ruled here, his weavers shipping the calico of the Godavari through the river ports, while Kapilendra Deva's Gajapati armies from Orissa were already pressing his northern frontier.

The Reddy kingdom fell to the Gajapatis by 1448, and the delta was disputed between Odisha, the Bahmanis and Vijayanagara until Krishnadevaraya's campaigns of 1514–1516 carried the whole eastern coast into his empire. In 1572 Ibrahim Quli Qutb Shah of Golconda completed the Muslim conquest, and in 1602 the Dutch built a fortified factory at Rajahmundry to buy its cloth. The Mughals took the town with Golconda in 1687, and in 1758 Forde's victory at Condore and his storm of Masulipatnam moved the coast from French to British keeping; the Company's title to the Circars was sealed by the Mughal grant of 1765 and the Treaty of Masulipatnam in 1768.
zh:
坎纳斯马是戈达瓦里河入海前河道分汊、沙洲棋布的绿色水乡；三角洲上游的高地上矗立着拉贾蒙德里，该城建于919年，约1022年由东遮娄其王罗阇罗阇·纳伦德拉定为都城。被誉为泰卢固第一位诗人的纳纳亚在他的宫廷中开始撰写泰卢固文《摩诃婆罗多》，拉贾蒙德里因此被称作安得拉的文化之都。历经东遮娄其与瓦朗加尔卡卡提亚王朝后，此地归雷迪诸王统治，他们以拉贾蒙德里为据点据有三角洲，是安得拉海岸仅存的印度教政权之一。1444年雷迪罗阇仍在此主政，织工出产的棉布经河港远销外地，而卡皮伦德拉·德瓦的加贾帕蒂大军已从奥里萨压向他的北境。

雷迪王国于1448年为加贾帕蒂所灭，三角洲随后在奥里萨、巴赫马尼与维查耶纳伽尔之间几经易手，直到克里希纳德瓦拉亚1514至1516年的东征把整个东海岸并入帝国版图。1572年，戈尔孔达的伊卜拉欣·库特卜沙完成穆斯林的征服；1602年荷兰人在拉贾蒙德里设立筑防商馆，收购当地棉布。1687年，莫卧儿随戈尔孔达一同取得此城；1758年福德在孔多尔获胜并袭取默苏利珀德姆，海岸由法国转入英国之手。1765年莫卧儿颁赐诏谕，1768年默苏利珀德姆条约签订，公司对北塞尔卡尔的权利就此确立。

en:
Tiruchirappalli commands the head of the Kaveri delta, where the river divides around Srirangam beneath the granite Rockfort. Nearby Uraiyur had been the Early Chola capital, and Pallava cave temples, Chola monuments and the Ranganatha temple made the place both a Hindu sanctuary and a river fortress. Delhi and Madurai sultans held it in the fourteenth century until the Vijayanagara prince Kumara Kampana took it in 1371; the Madurai Sultanate had ceased to exist by 1378. In 1444, restored temples and the rock citadel marked Tiruchirappalli as a Vijayanagara stronghold guarding the road from Kongu into the cotton-growing delta.

Vijayanagara rule gave way to the Madurai Nayaks in the 1530s. Vishwanatha Nayak protected Srirangam with walls and developed the Teppakulam tank, and Tiruchirappalli served as the Nayak capital from 1616 to 1634 and from 1665 to 1736. Chanda Sahib seized it after Queen Meenakshi's end in 1736, but Raghuji Bhonsle's Marathas captured him in the 1741 siege and Murari Rao held the city until the Nizam recovered it in 1743. In 1751-52 Chanda Sahib and the French besieged Muhammad Ali Khan Wallajah here during the Second Carnatic War. Attacks by Hyder Ali in 1780 and Tipu Sultan in 1793 were beaten off, and after the Carnatic annexation of 1801 the city became the headquarters of a Madras Presidency district.
zh:
蒂鲁吉拉帕利控扼高韦里河三角洲的起点，河水在花岗岩岩堡下方分流，绕出斯利兰甘岛。邻近的乌拉尤尔曾是早期朱罗都城，帕拉瓦石窟、朱罗遗迹和兰加纳塔神庙使这里既是印度教圣地，也是河防要塞。14世纪时，德里苏丹国和马杜赖苏丹国先后统治此地，1371年毗奢耶那伽罗王子库马拉·坎帕纳将其攻占；到1378年马杜赖苏丹国已经覆灭。1444年，历经修复的神庙和岩上城堡表明，蒂鲁吉拉帕利是毗奢耶那伽罗的要冲，守卫着从贡古通往产棉三角洲的道路。

1530年代，毗奢耶那伽罗的统治让位于马杜赖纳亚克。维什瓦纳塔·纳亚克为斯利兰甘修筑城墙，并营建特帕库拉姆水池；蒂鲁吉拉帕利于1616年至1634年、1665年至1736年两度成为纳亚克都城。1736年末代女王米纳克希败亡后，昌达·萨希卜夺取此城，但拉古吉·邦斯莱率领马拉塔人在1741年围城中俘获了他，穆拉里·拉奥据城至1743年尼扎姆收复。1751年至1752年第二次卡纳蒂克战争期间，昌达·萨希卜与法军在此围攻穆罕默德·阿里·汗·瓦拉哈。海德尔·阿里1780年和提普苏丹1793年的进攻均被击退；1801年卡纳蒂克被兼并后，该城成为马德拉斯管辖区一个县的治所。

en:
Cholistan, called Rohi in Punjabi, is the western tongue of the Thar Desert, where pastoral tribes grazed camels and cattle among the dunes. The dry bed of the Hakra, the river that once watered the country, served as a caravan highway between Multan and the east, and a chain of Rajput forts—above all Derawar, raised by the Bhati rulers in the ninth century—guarded its wells and pilgrim routes. At the desert's edge stood Uch, the 'Noble Uch' on the old bank of the Indus, one of the great Muslim cities of the Punjab and a refuge of scholars and Sufis since the days of the saint Jalaluddin Bukhari. In 1444 it was held by the Langah sultans of Multan and assigned as a jagir to a Samma prince.

About 1494 the tile-faced shrine of Bibi Jawindi, great-granddaughter of the saint Jahaniyan Jahangasht, was raised at Uch, the finest of the city's surviving tombs. The Arghuns of Sindh invaded in 1525, and the city passed to Sher Shah Suri in 1540; Humayun, driven before Sher Shah's armies, entered Uch later that year only to be repulsed. Under Akbar it became a pargana of Multan province, and the Sufi poet Bulleh Shah was born there in 1680. In the desert Nawab Sadeq Muhammad Khan I took Derawar in 1733, lost it to Jaisalmer in 1747, and his successor Mubarak Khan retook the fort in 1804; meanwhile Ahmad Shah Durrani's general Jahan Khan had attacked Uch in 1751. The country then formed the western lands of the Abbasi state of Bahawalpur.
zh:
焦利斯坦在旁遮普语中称罗希，是塔尔沙漠向西伸出的一角，游牧部落在沙丘间放牧骆驼和牛群。曾经润泽此地的哈克拉河干涸后，河床成了木尔坦与东方之间的商队大道；一系列拉杰普特要塞守卫着沿途的水井与朝觐路线，其中最著名的是巴蒂统治者在9世纪修建的德拉沃尔堡。沙漠边缘的印度河故道旁矗立着乌奇，即「尊贵的乌奇」，自圣人贾拉尔丁·布哈里的时代起便是旁遮普的伊斯兰名城，也是学者和苏菲修士的避难所。1444年时，它由木尔坦的朗伽苏丹统治，作为采邑封给一位萨马王公。

约1494年，比比·贾温迪的瓷砖陵墓在乌奇建成——她是圣人贾哈尼扬·贾汉加什特的曾孙女，这座陵墓也是乌奇现存陵墓中最精美的一座。1525年信德的阿尔浑人入侵，1540年乌奇落入舍尔沙·苏利之手；同年晚些时候，被舍尔沙军队追击的胡马雍进入乌奇，却遭到击退。阿克巴时代它成为木尔坦省的一个帕尔加纳，苏菲诗人布莱·沙阿于1680年出生于此。沙漠中，纳瓦卜萨迪克·穆罕默德汗一世于1733年夺取德拉沃尔堡，1747年该堡落入杰伊瑟尔梅尔之手，继任者穆巴拉克汗于1804年将其收复；其间艾哈迈德沙·杜兰尼的将领贾汉汗于1751年进攻乌奇。这片土地此后成为阿巴西家族巴哈瓦尔布尔邦国的西部疆土。

en:
Ajmer, originally Ajayameru, lies in an Aravalli valley beneath the steep fortress later called Taragarh. The Chahamana king Ajayadeva established it before 1113 and made the rocky town a Chauhan capital, but the Ghurids annexed it in 1193. After Mu'in al-Din Chishti died there in March 1236, his dargah became one of the most venerated Sufi shrines in India. In 1444, during Rana Kumbha's wars with Malwa and Gujarat, Ajmer was a Mewar frontier town on a strategic road through the Aravallis, its fort guarding both pilgrimage routes and the approaches to Chittor.

Late in the fifteenth century Prithviraj Sisodia defeated the governor Mallu Khan at Taragarh and renamed the fortress for his wife Tarabai; Ajja Jhala was appointed governor in 1506. Akbar conquered Ajmer in 1556 and made it capital of the Ajmer subah, using the town as a base for Rajput campaigns while visiting Chishti's shrine fourteen times and rebuilding its sanctum in 1579. Jahanara Begum was born here in 1614 and Dara Shikoh in 1615. Mughal patronage faded during the eighteenth century, the Scindias took Ajmer in 1752, and on 25 June 1818 Daulat Rao Scindia ceded Ajmer-Merwara to the English East India Company.
zh:
阿杰梅尔古称阿阇耶梅鲁，坐落在阿拉瓦利山脉的一道山谷中，城下是后来被称为塔拉尔加尔的险峻要塞。乔汉王阿阇耶提婆在1113年前建城，并把这座岩城建为乔汉人的都城；1193年，古尔王朝吞并此地。穆因丁·奇什提1236年3月在此去世后，他的圣墓成为印度最受尊崇的苏菲圣所之一。1444年，正值拉纳·昆巴与马尔瓦、古吉拉特征战之时，阿杰梅尔是梅瓦尔位于阿拉瓦利通道上的前沿城镇，要塞既护卫朝圣路线，也扼守通往吉多尔的道路。

15世纪末，普里特维拉杰·西索迪亚在塔拉尔加尔击败长官马卢·汗，并以妻子塔拉巴伊的名字为要塞命名；1506年，阿贾·贾拉被任命为阿杰梅尔长官。阿克巴于1556年征服阿杰梅尔，将其设为阿杰梅尔行省首府，把这里作为征讨拉杰普特的基地；他本人十四次拜谒奇什提圣墓，并于1579年重建圣所内殿。贾哈娜拉·贝古姆1614年、达拉·舒科1615年先后出生于此。18世纪莫卧儿的庇护逐渐衰退，辛迪亚家族于1752年夺取阿杰梅尔；1818年6月25日，道拉特·拉奥·辛迪亚依约把阿杰梅尔-梅尔瓦割让给不列颠东印度公司。

en:
Umarkot, formerly called Amarkot, is a desert stronghold where the Thar sands meet southeastern Sindh. A branch of the Soomras founded the early settlement, but the Sodha Rajputs took it in 1226, were expelled in 1330, and regained power in 1439. In 1444 a Sodha rana therefore held the fort, wells and grazing lands around Amarkot. Dhatki-speaking pastoralists moved sheep, camels and wool across the tracks linking lower Sindh with Rajasthan, while Hindu Rajput lords guarded this flank of the Muslim-ruled Indus lowlands.

The desert rana entered Mughal history when Rana Parshad Singh Sodha gave refuge to Humayun, fleeing Sher Shah Suri. On 15 October 1542 Hamida Banu Begum gave birth there to the future emperor Akbar. Umarkot was incorporated into the Mughal Empire in 1590, though an Arghun prince, Abu'l-Qasim Sultan, drove out its Mughal commander in 1599. Nur Muhammad Kalhoro expelled the last Sodha chief in 1736 and built a new fort on the site in 1746. The Rathors of Jodhpur annexed Amarkot from Sindh in 1779 and still held it in the opening years of the nineteenth century.
zh:
欧迈尔果德旧称阿马尔科特，是塔尔沙漠与信德东南缘相接处的沙漠要塞。苏姆拉人的一支最早建立定居点，索达·拉杰普特人1226年夺取此地，1330年被逐，又在1439年重新掌权。因此1444年时，一位索达拉纳据守阿马尔科特的堡垒、水井和牧场。说达特基语的牧人赶着羊和骆驼，沿连接下信德与拉贾斯坦的沙路贩运羊毛；在穆斯林势力统治印度河低地的边缘，这座要塞由印度教拉杰普特首领守护。

拉纳·普拉萨德·辛格·索达曾收留被舍尔沙·苏利击败的胡马雍，欧迈尔果德由此进入莫卧儿历史。1542年10月15日，哈米达·巴努·贝古姆在此生下后来的阿克巴大帝。1590年，欧迈尔果德被并入莫卧儿帝国，但阿尔洪王公阿布·卡西姆·苏丹1599年驱逐了当地的莫卧儿长官。努尔·穆罕默德·卡尔霍罗1736年赶走末代索达首领，又于1746年在旧址修建新城堡。1779年，焦特布尔的拉托尔人从信德手中吞并阿马尔科特，到十九世纪初仍控制此地。

en:
Chaul, whose medieval harbour survives beside Revdanda on the Kundalika, was the principal mart in a coast of island forts reaching south to Janjira and Kolaba. Harihara II of Vijayanagara took Chaul, Dabhol and Goa in 1380. Bahmani armies marched into the Konkan in 1429 and made the Rayagad chief tributary in 1436, but their rule never reached every creek and hill pass. Thus in 1444 the Marathi-speaking shore remained a frontier between Vijayanagara claims, Bahmani governors and local Koli and Maratha chiefs; Chaul's cotton stuffs had already made the harbour worth the contest.

In 1469 Mahmud Gawan gathered troops at Chaul for Bahmani campaigns against Vishalgad, Sangameshwar and Goa. The area passed to the Ahmadnagar Sultanate in 1490. Portuguese forces opened the coast in 1505, but a Mamluk-Gujarat fleet defeated them in Chaul roads in 1508, Portugal's first naval defeat in the Indian Ocean. Burhan Nizam Shah allowed a Portuguese fort at Revdanda in 1521; it was completed in 1524 and rebuilt as the stone Santa Maria fortress in October 1531. A Deccan league failed to take Chaul in 1570, and Portugal secured the neighbouring Korlai fort in 1594. South along the coast, the Kolis' wooden stronghold at Janjira was replaced by Malik Ambar's sea fort in 1567; the Siddis became autonomous in 1621 and repulsed Shivaji in 1676 and Sambhaji in 1682. Kolaba Fort, begun in 1680 and completed in 1681, became Kanhoji Angre's naval base from 1713 and resisted an Anglo-Portuguese attack in 1721. Under the settlement of October 1740, Portugal gave up Chaul to the Marathas, who held the coast until the British conquest of 1818.
zh:
焦尔的中世纪港湾保留在昆达利卡河畔的勒夫丹达旁，是这一带海岛堡垒海岸的主要商港，南面一直连到詹吉拉和科拉巴。毗奢耶那伽罗的哈里哈拉二世1380年夺取焦尔、达博尔和果阿。巴曼尼军队1429年开进康肯，1436年迫使赖加尔首领纳贡，但他们的统治始终未能深入每一处河口与山道。因此到1444年，这段说马拉地语的海岸仍是毗奢耶那伽罗势力、巴曼尼长官与本地科利人、马拉塔首领之间的前沿地带；焦尔出产的棉织物也使这座港湾值得各方争夺。

1469年，马哈茂德·加万在焦尔集结军队，为巴曼尼出征维沙尔加德、桑格梅什沃尔和果阿。1490年，这一地区转入艾哈迈德讷格尔苏丹国。葡萄牙军队1505年打开这段海岸，但1508年马穆鲁克与古吉拉特联合舰队在焦尔外海击败他们，这是葡萄牙人在印度洋的首次海战失败。布尔汗·尼扎姆沙阿1521年允许葡萄牙人在勒夫丹达筑垒，堡垒1524年完工，1531年10月又改建为石砌的圣玛丽亚堡。1570年，德干诸邦联军围攻焦尔未能得手；葡萄牙人又在1594年控制邻近的科尔莱堡。沿海向南，科利人在詹吉拉的木寨1567年被马利克·安巴尔修建的海岛石堡取代；西迪人1621年成为自治势力，并先后在1676年和1682年击退希瓦吉与桑巴吉。科拉巴堡1680年动工、1681年完工，1713年起成为坎霍吉·安格雷的海军基地，1721年还击退了英国与葡萄牙的联合进攻。根据1740年10月达成的协议，葡萄牙把焦尔交给马拉塔人；这片海岸随后由马拉塔人控制，直到1818年被英国征服。

en:
This land lies where the Tungabhadra breaks out of the Deccan towards the eastern plains, its town of Kandanavolu — later Kurnool — a bullock-caravan ford on the great road from the Deccan to the Tamil country. Deeper in the Nallamala forests, at Srisailam above the Krishna, stands the Mallikarjuna temple, counted both among the twelve jyotirlingas of Shiva and among the goddess's Shakta pithas; the Tamil Nayanar saints sang its praises, Reddi chiefs built its mandapas and the long flight of ghat steps down to the river, and the first kings of Vijayanagara enlarged its gopurams. In 1444 it was a Telugu heartland of Deva Raya II's empire: pilgrims climbed to Srisailam, caravans halted at the Kurnool ford, and the hills yielded iron.

Achyuta Deva Raya, who reigned from 1529, built the strong fort at Kurnool, whose surviving tower is called Konda Reddy Buruju. The disaster of Talikota in 1565 opened the region to the Deccan sultans, and in the seventeenth century the Abyssinian general Abdul Wahab Khan, in Bijapur's service, overthrew its Vijayanagara governor Gopal Raja and ruled Kurnool for sixteen years. In 1687 the country passed to Aurangzeb's Mughals and then to the Nizam of Hyderabad, under whose loose overlordship Kurnool was governed by its own nawabs; Srisailam kept its fame as a pilgrimage, and Maratha tradition remembers Shivaji as a devotee who shielded the shrine in the Deccan wars. In 1800 the Nizam ceded the surrounding country to the East India Company, leaving the nawab's little state ringed about by British territory.
zh:
这片地区地处栋格珀德拉河出德干高原、奔向东岸平原的要冲，其城镇坎达纳沃卢（后称卡努尔）是牛车商队的渡口，坐落在从德干通往泰米尔南方的大道上。在更深处的纳拉马莱森林中，克里希纳河畔的斯里赛拉姆山上矗立着摩利迦周那神庙——它既是湿婆十二林伽圣地之一，也是供奉女神的性力派圣地；泰米尔的那延纳尔圣徒曾为它唱颂，雷迪诸酋长修建了庙中的柱殿和直通河畔的漫长石阶，毗奢耶那伽罗开国诸君又扩建了各座瞿布罗门塔。1444年，这里是德瓦拉亚二世帝国的泰卢固腹地：香客攀登斯里赛拉姆山，商队在卡努尔渡口歇脚，山间出产铁矿。

1529年即位的阿周多·德瓦·拉亚在卡努尔修筑了坚固的要塞，城中残存的城楼被称作孔达·雷迪碉楼。1565年塔利科塔之败使这一地区向德干诸苏丹敞开；17世纪，效力于比贾布尔的阿比西尼亚将领阿卜杜勒·瓦哈卜汗推翻毗奢耶那伽罗守将戈帕尔·拉贾，统治卡努尔十六年。1687年，此地并入奥朗则布的莫卧儿帝国，后来转归海得拉巴尼扎姆；在其松散的宗主权下，卡努尔由本地纳瓦布世代统治，斯里赛拉姆则香火不绝——马拉塔传统中，希瓦吉正是在德干战乱中庇护过这座圣庙的虔诚信徒。1800年，尼扎姆把周围地区割让给东印度公司，纳瓦布的小邦就此被英国领土团团围住。

en:
Tripura is the hill country east of the Bengal delta, where the Gomti River comes down from the forested ranges to the plains. Its people are the Tripuri, who honour the Chaturdasa Devata, the Fourteen Gods, alongside the Hindu pantheon; their royal chronicle, the Rajmala, was set down in Bengali verse in the 15th century. Coin evidence places the founding of Manikya power in the early 1400s, when Maha Manikya took the royal title after a victory over Bengal, with the capital fixed at Rangamati on the Gomti. In 1444 Dharma Manikya I, reigning from 1431, ruled a kingdom whose war elephants and timber drew tribute from the surrounding hill chiefs and whose frontier then ran far out into the Bengal plains toward Chittagong and Comilla.

Dhanya Manikya (1490–1515) carried Tripura's arms deep into eastern Bengal and in 1501 raised the Tripura Sundari temple at Udaipur, one of the great Shakti pithas, while Rangamati itself was renamed Udaipur under Udai Manikya (1567–1572). In 1618 the Bengal subahdar Ibrahim Khan Fath-i-Jang sent a fleet of 300 war-boats up the Gomti, sacked Udaipur and carried off Raja Yashodhar Manikya with his elephants. The dynasty was later restored, but as Mughal tributaries, and the fertile western plains slipped away to become the Mughal-held Chakla Roshnabad. In the mid-18th century Shamsher Gazi, the Tiger of Bhati, made himself master of Roshnabad and overran Tripura, falling against the British in 1757. The Manikyas then turned to Calcutta, and in 1809 Tripura became a British protectorate, its rajas still ruling the hills from Udaipur and later Agartala.
zh:
特里普拉是孟加拉三角洲以东的丘陵之国，戈默蒂河从林海覆盖的山地奔流而下，进入平原。居民为特里普里人，既敬奉印度教众神，也祭拜本族的「十四天神」；王室编年史《拉杰马拉》于15世纪以孟加拉韵文写定。据钱币史料，马尼基亚王朝在15世纪初奠定基业：摩诃·马尼基亚战胜孟加拉后采用「马尼基亚」王号，定都戈默蒂河畔的朗加马蒂。1444年在位的是1431年即位的达尔马·马尼基亚一世，他的王国以战象和木材令周边山林酋长称臣纳贡，疆界向西远远伸入孟加拉平原，直抵吉大港和库米拉一带。

达尼亚·马尼基亚（1490—1515年在位）挥师深入东孟加拉，1501年在乌代布尔修建特里普拉孙达里神庙，它是性力派最重要的圣地之一；朗加马蒂也在乌代·马尼基亚在位时（1567—1572）改名乌代布尔。1618年，孟加拉苏巴达尔伊卜拉欣·汗·法特赫-江率三百艘战船溯戈默蒂河而上，攻陷乌代布尔，俘走罗阇亚肖达尔·马尼基亚及其战象。王朝后来复辟，却沦为莫卧儿附庸，富庶的西部平原脱离王国，成为莫卧儿治下的罗什纳巴德恰克拉。18世纪中叶，号称「巴蒂之虎」的沙姆谢尔·加齐自立为罗什纳巴德之主、席卷特里普拉，1757年在抗击英国人的战事中败死。马尼基亚王室随后向加尔各答求助，1809年特里普拉成为英国保护地，罗阇们仍在乌代布尔、后来在阿加尔塔拉统治这片山地。

en:
The Mahadeo hills are the forested spine of the Satpura range south of the Narmada, and their strong place was Kherla, seat of the oldest of the Gond kingdoms. A Rajput raja, Jaitpal, is credited with its first fortress, and in the fourteenth century the Gond raja Narsingh Rai made Kherla a power reaching west to Gawilghur, caught between the Muslim kingdoms to his north and south. In 1398, encouraged by the sultans of Malwa and Khandesh, he raided Bahmani territory as far as Mahur, was defeated, and became a Bahmani vassal. Hoshang Shah of Malwa campaigned against Kherla for years, and in 1433 he slew Narsingh Rai and annexed the country, so that in 1444 these woods – Gondi-speaking and Hindu – answered to Mandu.

Kherla remained the prize in the long Malwa–Bahmani wars. A Bahmani army took the fort in 1467, but two Rajput warriors slew the governor of Berar at his own victory, and diplomacy handed Kherla back to Malwa. Mughal armies assailed Khedla fort repeatedly through the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries, and the country became the Kherla sarkar of the Ellichpur subah, though its forested north was never firmly held. With Mughal power waning, Bakht Buland Shah of Deogarh seized the district, and in the eighteenth century it passed to the Bhonsles of Nagpur. In 1818, after the battle of Sitabuldi, Kherla and the Mahadeo hills came under British rule.
zh:
马哈德奥丘陵是讷尔默达河以南萨特普拉山脉的林莽脊梁，此地的重镇是凯尔拉——贡德诸王国中最古老者的王庭。相传拉杰普特王公贾特帕尔修建了最早的凯尔拉堡；14世纪，贡德拉贾纳尔辛·拉伊使凯尔拉崛起，疆土向西直抵加维尔加尔，却始终夹在南北两强的穆斯林王国之间。1398年，他受摩腊婆与坎德什两位苏丹怂恿，攻入巴赫曼尼境内、远达马胡尔，兵败后沦为巴赫曼尼藩属。摩腊婆的胡尚沙阿连年征讨，终于1433年攻杀纳尔辛·拉伊、吞并其地；1444年，这片通行贡德语、信奉印度教的山林向曼杜称臣。

凯尔拉此后仍是摩腊婆与巴赫曼尼长期战争争夺的焦点。1467年巴赫曼尼军队攻下城堡，两名拉杰普特武士却在贝拉尔总督庆功之际将他刺死，随后的外交谈判又把凯尔拉交还摩腊婆。整个16至17世纪，莫卧儿军队屡次进攻凯德拉堡，这一地区后来成为埃利奇布尔苏巴的凯尔拉萨尔卡尔，只是林木密布的北部始终未被牢固控制。莫卧儿势力衰微之际，德奥加尔的巴克特·布兰德沙阿夺取此地，18世纪它转入那格浦尔邦斯勒家族之手。1818年西塔布尔迪之战后，凯尔拉与马哈德奥丘陵归入英国统治。

en:
Mandsaur, the ancient Dashapura, stands on the frontier where the Malwa plateau meets the hills of Mewar, commanding the road from Ujjain toward Chittor. Its Pashupatinath temple made the town a Hindu holy place, while its fields and crossings gave it value for the armies of western India. In 1444 it was a north-western fortress of Mahmud Khalji's Malwa Sultanate, ruled from the Muslim court at Mandu but looking across a border repeatedly challenged by the Rajputs of Mewar.

In 1521 Malik Ayaz of Gujarat, reinforced by Mahmud Khalji II of Malwa, besieged Mandsaur against Rana Sanga's garrison. Rana Sanga gathered Medini Rai, Silhadi and other Rajput chiefs; mines and covered ways were pushed forward, but Gujarati rivalries and supply troubles forced Malik Ayaz to withdraw without taking the fort. Bahadur Shah's conquest of Malwa reached the border in 1531, Humayun campaigned there in 1535, and after Baz Bahadur's defeat at Sarangpur in 1561 Akbar annexed Malwa in 1562 and made the region part of the Ujjain-based Mughal subah. In February 1732 the Marathas surrounded Jai Singh II of Amber near Mandsaur, forced him to pay six lakh rupees and granted Holkar the collection of chauth from twenty-eight Malwa parganas. On 6 January 1818, after the Holkars' defeat at Mahidpur, the Treaty of Mandsaur accepted British terms and reduced Indore to a princely state.
zh:
曼得萨尔古称达沙普拉，位于摩腊婆高原与梅瓦尔丘陵交界的边境，控制从乌贾因通往奇托尔的道路。帕苏帕提那神庙使这里成为印度教圣城，郊野田土与渡口又令它受到西印度各路军队重视。1444年，它是马哈茂德·卡尔吉的摩腊婆苏丹国西北要塞，政权出自曼杜的穆斯林宫廷，城外面向的却是梅瓦拉拉杰普特人不断争夺的边界。

1521年，古吉拉特的马利克·阿亚兹得到摩腊婆的马哈茂德·卡尔吉二世增援，在此围攻拉那·桑伽驻守的曼得萨尔。拉那·桑伽集结梅迪尼·拉伊、西尔哈迪等拉杰普特首领；攻城方挖掘地道、推进遮蔽甬道，却因古吉拉特将领内讧和补给困难而撤兵，未能夺下要塞。1531年巴哈杜尔沙征服摩腊婆，兵锋抵达这一边境；1535年胡马雍又在此用兵。巴兹·巴哈杜尔1561年在萨兰布尔战败后，阿克巴于1562年兼并摩腊婆，将此地并入以乌贾因为治所的莫卧儿苏巴。1732年2月，马拉塔人在曼得萨尔附近包围安贝尔的杰伊·辛格二世，迫使他缴纳六十万卢比，并允许霍尔卡尔在摩腊婆的二十八个帕尔格纳征收四一税。1818年1月6日，霍尔卡尔政权在马赫德布尔战败后于曼得萨尔签订条约，接受英国条件，印多尔沦为土邦。

en:
Bahraich lies on the Saryu beyond the Ghaghra, where the Awadh plain runs into the wet forests of the Tarai below the Himalayan foothills. In older times it was part of Kosala, the country of Shravasti, and home to the Bhar people. It owes its place in memory to a battle of 1034: by the account of the later Persian hagiography Mirat-i-Masudi, the young Ghaznavid warrior Salar Masud Ghazi was defeated and killed beside Chittora lake by a confederation of rajas led by the Bhar king Suhaldev, and buried at Bahraich. His grave grew into a dargah built up by Firoz Shah Tughlaq, to which Hindus and Muslims came alike to pray. From 1394 the district passed to the Sharqi sultans of Jaunpur, and in 1444 the Avadhi-speaking peasants of this forested march obeyed Mahmud Shah Sharqi.

With the rest of the Sharqi kingdom Bahraich fell to the Lodi Afghans in the wars after 1478. The rigorously orthodox Sultan Sikandar Lodi, who also barred women from saints' tombs, banned the shrine's annual procession of Masud's spear. Mughal rule followed, and in 1571 Akbar made a grant of land to the shrine; the grant was renewed in 1765 by Shuja-ud-Daula, the Nawab of Awadh, whose successor Asaf-ud-Daula came here on pilgrimage several times. By then Bahraich was a northern district of the nawabi, administered from Faizabad and Lucknow, its woods a hunting ground for the court and a refuge hard by the Nepal hills. In 1801 Saadat Ali Khan ceded it to the East India Company together with half of Awadh.
zh:
巴赫赖奇位于加格拉河以北的萨拉尤河畔，阿瓦德平原在这里没入喜马拉雅山麓潮湿的特莱森林。上古时这里属拘萨罗，即舍卫城所在之地，居民中有巴尔人。它被人记住，是因为1034年的一场大战：据后世波斯语圣徒传《马苏德之鉴》记载，年轻的加兹尼武士赛义德·萨拉尔·马苏德·加齐在奇特罗拉湖畔被巴尔王苏赫尔提婆率领的诸王联军击败斩杀，葬于巴赫赖奇。他的墓后来发展为圣祠，菲鲁兹沙·图格鲁克曾加以营建，印度教徒和穆斯林都前来朝拜。1394年起，这一地区归入章普尔的沙尔基苏丹国；1444年，这片森林边地上说阿瓦德语的农夫臣属于马哈茂德沙·沙尔基。

1478年以后的战争中，巴赫赖奇随沙尔基王国落入洛迪阿富汗人之手。恪守正统的苏丹西坎达尔·洛迪还禁止妇女拜谒圣墓，同时取缔了圣祠每年一度的马苏多长矛游行。莫卧儿人继之而来，1571年阿克巴向圣祠颁赐地产；1765年，阿瓦德纳瓦卜舒贾·乌德·道拉延续了这一颁赐，其继任者阿萨夫·乌德·道拉还数次前来朝圣。此时的巴赫赖奇是纳瓦卜国家北部的一个县，受治法扎巴德和勒克瑙，林间是王室游猎之地，也是紧邻尼泊尔山地的一处避难边地。1801年，萨阿达特·阿里汗把它随半个阿瓦德一起割让给东印度公司。

en:
Varanasi, the ancient Kashi, sits on the north bank of the Ganges between the Varuna and Assi streams, its stepped ghats crowded with pilgrims and the cremation fires of Manikarnika burning without end. One of the seven holy cities of Hinduism, it was already the capital of the kingdom of Kashi in the Buddha's age, and the Buddha gave his first sermon just upstream at Sarnath. The Gahadavala rajas made it their second capital in 1090, until Muhammad of Ghor defeated Jayachandra in 1194 and sacked the city. In 1444 it belongs to the Sharqi sultans of Jaunpur, the greatest Hindu city of their dominions: silk and brocade weaving enriches its lanes, and this is the Varanasi of the weaver-saint Kabir and of Ravidas.

As Sharqi power collapsed, Sikandar Lodi had the Vishwanath temple demolished in 1490, and Babur's victory at Panipat in 1526 brought Benares within the Mughal empire. Raja Man Singh rebuilt the temple under Akbar and Todar Mal carried the work forward in 1585, while Tulsidas, living by the river, composed the Ramcharitmanas. Aurangzeb ordered the temple destroyed in 1669 and the Gyanvapi Mosque raised on its plinth in 1678. As Mughal power ebbed, the Bhumihar zamindar Mansa Ram founded the Kashi kingdom in 1725; his son Balwant Singh, who ruled until 1770, built the sandstone fort at Ramnagar. The Nawab of Awadh ceded the city to the East India Company in 1775, and when Chait Singh rose against Warren Hastings in August 1781 he was beaten and driven into exile, dying at Gwalior in 1810. The present Vishwanath temple, beside the mosque, was built in 1780 by Ahilyabai Holkar of Indore.
zh:
瓦拉纳西古称迦尸，位于恒河北岸、瓦鲁纳河与阿西河之间，沿河的石阶码头香客云集，马尼卡尼卡河坛的火葬之火终年不熄。作为印度教七大圣城之一，早在佛陀时代它已是迦尸国的都城，佛陀的首次说法就在上游不远的鹿野苑。1090年，伽哈德瓦拉王朝的王公在此设为第二都城；1194年，古尔的穆罕默德击败阇耶旃陀罗并洗劫城市。1444年，它归属章普尔的沙尔吉苏丹，是其治下最大的印度教城市：街巷因丝织和织锦而富庶，织匠圣者迦比尔与罗维达斯，正是这一时代瓦拉纳西的人物。

沙尔吉势力崩溃之际，西坎达尔·洛迪于1490年拆毁毗湿瓦纳特神庙；1526年巴布尔在帕尼帕特获胜，贝拿勒斯并入莫卧儿帝国。阿克巴时期，拉杰·曼·辛格重建神庙，托达尔·马尔于1585年续成工程；隐居河畔的杜尔西达斯则在此写成《罗摩功行录》。1669年，奥朗则布下令毁庙，1678年在庙基上建起吉扬瓦皮清真寺。莫卧儿势力衰落后，布米哈尔族地主曼萨·拉姆于1725年建立迦尸王国；其子巴尔万特·辛格统治至1770年，在拉姆纳格尔修建了砂岩要塞。1775年，阿瓦德纳瓦布将城市割让给东印度公司；1781年8月查特·辛格起兵反抗沃伦·黑斯廷斯，兵败流亡，1810年死于瓜廖尔。现存的毗湿瓦纳特神庙是1780年由印多尔的阿希莉娅芭伊·霍尔卡在清真寺旁建成的。

en:
The Rajmahal Hills rise from the flat Bengal plain like a wall of sal forest, a stretch the Persians called Damin-i-koh, the skirts of the hills. For centuries their valleys held little more than the occasional village of the Paharia clans—Sauria, Mal and Kumarbhag—who lived beyond the reach of the rajas on the Ganges. At the southern end of the tract stands Deoghar, home of Baidyanath, one of Shiva's twelve jyotirlingas, where pilgrims carried Ganges water more than a hundred kilometres from Sultanganj to offer at the shrine. In 1444 the restored Ilyas Shahi sultans ruled the river plains and their traders bought ivory and elephants from the woods, but no army of Bengal had ever entered the hills, and the Paharias answered to no master.

The lowlands south of the hills passed in 1503 to a new Rajput house, when Dandu Rai founded the Kharagpur Raj and overthrew the fifty-two Khetauri chiefs of the country; his grandson Sangram Singh served Akbar but rebelled in 1601 and fell in battle, after which his son converted to Islam and held the estate as Roz Afzun. The Mughals garrisoned the plains yet never subdued the Paharias, whose raids spread as imperial rule collapsed in the early 1700s. After the Company took the diwani of Bengal in 1765, Captains Brooke and Browne and then Augustus Cleveland, collector of Bhagalpur, won over the hill chiefs with land grants and a corps of Hill Rangers; Cleveland died in 1784, but the Damin stayed quiet through the wars that followed. In those same years Santal axemen began to clear farms in the southern forests, the first comers of a migration that would fill the tract.
zh:
拉杰马哈尔丘陵如一道娑罗双林筑成的高墙耸立于孟加拉平原之上，波斯人称这片地方为达明-伊库赫，意为山峦之裙。几个世纪里，谷间只有帕哈里亚诸族——索里亚、马尔和库马尔巴格——散落的村落，恒河畔的历代罗阇都管不到他们。这片地方的南端是德奥加尔，湿婆十二林伽之一拜迪亚纳特便在此处，香客从苏丹甘吉取来恒河水，跋涉百余公里到庙中供奉。1444年，复辟的伊利亚斯·沙希王朝统治着河畔平原，商人从山林购得象牙和大象，但孟加拉的军队从未踏进丘陵，帕哈里亚人不臣服于任何人。

丘陵以南的低地于1503年易主：丹杜·拉伊建立卡拉格普尔罗阇国，攻灭当地五十二名克陶里首领；其孙桑格拉姆·辛格曾效力阿克巴，1601年起兵反叛，战败身亡，其子改宗伊斯兰教，以罗兹·阿夫祖恩之名保有封地。莫卧儿人在平原屯兵，却始终未能征服帕哈里亚人；18世纪初帝国统治瓦解，帕哈里亚人的劫掠随之蔓延。东印度公司1765年取得孟加拉的迪万尼之后，布鲁克上尉、布朗上尉，以及巴加尔布尔税务官奥古斯塔斯·克利夫兰先后以封赐土地和组建山地突击队的方式争取山地首领；克利夫兰1784年去世，但在此后的战乱中达明一直保持平静。也就在这些年里，桑塔尔人的伐木工开始在南部林间开垦农地，成为日后充盈这片山林的移民潮的第一批来人。

en:
Baghelkhand is the hilly country east of the Vindhyas, crossed by the upper Son and dense sal forest, known in older records as Dahala. The Baghel Rajputs, a branch of the Solanki house that ruled Gujarat, entered it in the 13th century: Vyaghra Dev made himself master of Marpha fort beyond Kalinjar, and his son Karan Dev married a Kalachuri princess of Mandla, receiving Bandhavgarh as her dowry. When Ulugh Khan overthrew the last Vaghela raja of Gujarat in 1298, more of the clan withdrew to these hills, and the fortress of Bandhavgarh became the seat of their growing kingdom. In 1444 the Baghel raja still reigned from that rock, keeping his independence between the Sharqi sultans of Jaunpur and the Lodis of Delhi, while Bagheli-speaking peasants worked the valley lands below.

Sikandar Lodi marched on Bandhavgarh in 1498, but after a year's campaigning his army withdrew without taking the fort. In the 1550s Raja Ramchandra Singh kept a court famed for music, where the singer Tansen served before Akbar summoned him to Delhi. Mughal pressure mounted until 1597, when Akbar's captain Patr Das forced the hill fortress to surrender after an eight-month siege and had it dismantled. In 1618 Maharaja Vikramaditya abandoned the ruined citadel and founded Rewa on the plain, and the Baghel rulers kept their state there through the Mughal and Maratha wars. In 1812 Maharaja Jai Singh accepted British protection.
zh:
巴克尔根德是温迪亚山脉以东的丘陵之地，松河上游穿境而过，娑罗双林密布，古籍中称作达哈拉。巴格尔人是统治古吉拉特的索兰基王族的一支拉杰普特，13世纪进入此地：维亚格拉·德夫夺取了卡林贾尔东北的马尔法堡，其子卡兰·德夫娶曼德拉的迦罗珠利公主，以嫁妆得到班达迦堡。1298年乌卢格汗推翻古吉拉特末代瓦盖拉罗阇后，更多族人退入这片山林，班达迦要塞随之成为这个兴起中王国的统治中心。1444年，巴格尔罗阇仍在那座绝壁之巅治国，在江布尔的沙尔吉苏丹与德里的洛迪王朝之间维持自立，说巴格尔语的农民在山下谷地耕作。

1498年，西坎达尔·洛迪进军班达迦，围攻一年仍未能破城，只得退兵。1550年代，罗阇拉姆金德尔·辛格的宫廷以乐舞闻名，歌唱家坦森曾在此效力，后来被阿克巴召往德里。莫卧儿的压力日增，1597年，阿克巴的将领帕塔尔·达斯经八个月围城迫使这座山顶堡垒投降，随后将其拆毁。1618年，摩诃罗阇维克拉马迪亚弃守残破的山城，在平原上兴建雷瓦为新都，巴格尔诸王在莫卧儿与马拉塔的战乱中保有国家。1812年，摩诃罗阇贾伊·辛格接受英国保护。

en:
Surguja is a broken plateau of forested ridges east of Baghelkhand, between the Son and the upper Mahanadi, with the high grassy tableland of Mainpat standing above its woods. Gond, Korwa, Oraon and other clans cleared its valleys, and the Ramgarh hills hold the rock-cut Sitabenga and Jogimara caves, with Brahmi inscriptions of the 3rd to 1st centuries BC, perhaps a rest-house on an old forest trade route. After the passing of the Mauryans the country broke into tiny chiefdoms, and so it remained: in 1444 Surguja was a patchwork of Gond and other tribal rajas, who bowed to stronger neighbours in war and went their own way in peace.

In 1613 a Rajput raja of the Raksel clan marched in from Palamu with his followers and made himself lord of Surguja, founding the line that ruled from Ambikapur and came to be acknowledged as overlord of the fringe states of Udaipur, Jashpur, Koriya and Changbhakar. In 1753 Maratha armies invaded the hills and reduced the raja to tributary status. British forces arrived after the Third Anglo-Maratha War, and Surguja became a protectorate in 1818; in 1820 its chief was confirmed in the hereditary title of Maharaja.
zh:
苏古贾是巴克尔根德以东的破碎高原，林岭纵横，地处松河与默哈讷迪河上游之间，迈恩帕特的高耸草甸俯瞰着脚下林海。贡德、科尔瓦、奥朗等部族在此开垦谷地，拉姆加尔山中还保存着凿岩而成的悉多邦加洞与焦吉马拉洞，洞内有公元前3世纪至前1世纪的婆罗米文铭文，可能是古代森林商路上的一处驿舍。孔雀王朝的势力退去后，此地碎成众多小首领领地，并一直延续下来：1444年的苏古贾是贡德等部族罗阇拼合的世界，战时向强邻低头，平时各行其是。

1613年，一位拉克塞尔族的拉杰普特罗阇带着部众从巴拉穆攻入，自立为苏古贾之主，开创了以安比卡普尔为都的世系，乌代布尔、杰斯布尔、科里亚、昌格巴卡尔等边缘小邦后来都承认其宗主权。1753年，马拉塔军队攻入山区，迫使罗阇纳贡称臣。第三次英国—马拉塔战争后，英军进入此地，苏古贾于1818年成为保护国；1820年，其首领获得世袭的摩诃罗阇称号。

en:
The wet highland valleys around Gampola and Senkadagalapura, the future Kandy, were Sinhalese Buddhist country above the coastal plain. Gampola became the island's capital after Buwanekabahu IV moved the court from Kurunegala in the mid-fourteenth century; its rice lands and the pilgrim road toward Sri Pada gave the hills a settled life even after the royal centre passed to Kotte. In 1444 the supremacy of Kotte still reached into these mountains, but local lords kept their monasteries, forest routes and much of their own authority.

Senasammata Vikramabahu, regarded as the founder of Kandy, ruled from Senkadagalapura in 1469-1511 as a semi-independent king under Kotte. Wimaladharmasuriya I brought the Buddha's tooth relic to Kandy in 1595, making the city the royal and religious centre of the last Sinhalese kingdom. Kandyan troops defeated a Portuguese army at Gannoruwa on 28 March 1638 and allied with the Dutch to expel Portugal from the coast, yet after Colombo fell in 1656 the Dutch kept the ports and trade. A Dutch invasion briefly occupied the abandoned hill capital in 1765 before peace was made in 1766. The British seized the Dutch coastal lands in 1796, were repulsed in 1803, entered Kandy on 10 February 1815, and secured the Kandyan Convention the following month.
zh:
甘波勒与后来康提所在地森卡达加拉普拉周围湿润的高山谷地，是沿海平原上方的僧伽罗佛教地区。14世纪中期，布伐奈迦巴忽四世把王廷从库鲁内格勒迁到甘波勒，这里一度成为全岛都城；即使王都后来转往科特，山间稻田和通往圣足山的朝山路仍维持着聚落与寺院生活。1444年，科特的宗主权仍延伸到这片山地，但地方首领保留着寺院、林间道路和相当大的自主权。

被视为康提开创者的塞纳萨马塔·维克拉马巴胡于1469—1511年以森卡达加拉普拉为中心，在科特之下作为半独立国王进行统治。维马拉达尔马苏里亚一世1595年将佛牙舍利迎至康提，使这里成为最后一个僧伽罗王国的王权与宗教中心。1638年3月28日，康提军队在加诺鲁瓦击败葡军，随后联合荷兰人把葡萄牙势力逐出沿海；但1656年科伦坡陷落后，荷兰人占据港口并控制贸易。1765年，一支荷兰远征军曾短暂占领已被撤离的山城，双方于1766年议和。英国1796年夺取荷兰人控制的沿海地区，1803年的进攻被击退，1815年2月10日进入康提，并在次月促成《康提协定》。

en:
The Vanni is the forested mainland behind the Jaffna peninsula, a stretch of dry jungle, scrub and lagoons where Tamil chiefs called Vanniars held a string of small chieftaincies, the Vannimai. They had grown up after the fall of Polonnaruwa in the thirteenth century, and the northern confederacy among them paid tribute to the kings of Jaffna, forming a buffer between the Tamil north and the Sinhalese kingdoms of the south. In 1444 their forest forts acknowledged the Aryacakravarti court at Jaffna, itself recently drawn under the overlordship of Vijayanagara, and the Vanni jungles supplied the elephants on which the court's export trade rested.

When Parakramabahu VI of Kotte moved against Jaffna around 1450, his adopted son Prince Sapumal first subdued the Vanniar chiefs before taking the peninsula. The Jaffna kings returned from exile in Madurai in 1467 and the Vanni with them. Portuguese troops conquered Jaffna in 1621, and the chieftaincies passed first to Portuguese and then to Dutch, and later British, suzerainty, though the deep forest kept the Vanniars largely autonomous. The last of them, Pandara Vanniyan, who ruled from 1785, made common cause with the kings of Kandy against the Europeans until a Dutch-born officer in British service broke his rising in 1803, after which the Vanni was ruled directly from Colombo.
zh:
万尼是贾夫纳半岛身后的林地块，旱生丛林、灌木与潟湖交错，一批称万尼亚尔的泰米尔酋长在这里各据一方，称为万尼迈。这些小酋长领是13世纪波隆纳鲁沃王国崩溃后形成的，北部的酋长联盟向贾夫纳国王纳贡，构成泰米尔人北方与僧伽罗人南方诸国之间的缓冲。1444年，林中各要塞听命于贾夫纳的阿利耶·查克拉瓦尔蒂王朝，而贾夫纳此时也刚沦为毗奢耶那伽罗的附庸；万尼丛林中出产的大象，正是贾夫纳宫廷出口贸易的支柱之一。

1450年前后，科特国王波罗迦罗摩巴忽六世进攻贾夫纳，其养子萨普马尔王子先行压服万尼诸酋长，随后才攻占半岛。1467年，贾夫纳国王带着从马杜赖雇来的佣兵复国，万尼也重归其治下。1621年葡萄牙军队攻灭贾夫纳，各酋长领随之先后处于葡萄牙、荷兰以及后来英国的宗主权之下，但密林使万尼亚尔人长期保持着相当的自治。末代酋长潘达拉·万尼扬1785年继位，与康提国王联手抵抗欧洲人，1803年被一名为英国效力的荷兰裔军官击败，起事瓦解，万尼此后改由科伦坡直接管辖。

en:
Tirunelveli stands on the west bank of the Thamirabarani, the river whose channels watered the southern Pandya rice country. In the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries it was the secondary capital of Pandimandalam, and the Nellaiappar temple served as a royal Shaiva shrine. As sultanate invasions and Vijayanagara power loosened Pandya rule around Madurai, a surviving line withdrew to Tenkasi and Tirunelveli; English records date that kingdom's rule over the far south from 1422 to 1499. In 1444 the city was therefore still a Tamil Hindu Pandya centre of the Madurai country, sustained by irrigated fields and the roads toward the southern coast.

In the sixteenth century the Madurai Nayaks made Tirunelveli their subsidiary capital, and Vishwanatha Nayak rebuilt the town and its temples between 1529 and 1564. Power soon rested with fortified palaiyakkarar chiefs, whose rivalries survived the Nawab of Arcot's brief overlordship after 1743 and the first Company intervention in 1755. The East India Company formed Tinnevelly district on 1 September 1790. Veerapandiya Kattabomman of Panchalankurichi then led the polygar rising until he was hanged at Kayathar on 16 October 1799; with the wars ending in 1801, Palayamkottai became the garrison centre of the new Company district.
zh:
蒂鲁内尔维利位于塔米拉巴拉尼河西岸，这条河的渠水滋养着潘地亚南部的稻米之乡。13至14世纪，这里是潘迪曼达拉姆的副都，内莱亚帕尔神庙是王室湿婆神庙。随着苏丹国入侵和毗奢耶那伽罗势力削弱潘地亚在马杜赖周围的统治，一支残余王室退往滕卡西和蒂鲁内尔维利；英文资料记载该政权在1422年至1499年间统治极南之地。因此1444年时，此城仍是马杜赖地方的泰米尔印度教潘地亚中心，靠灌溉农田和通往南部海岸的道路维系。

16世纪，马杜赖纳亚克将蒂鲁内尔维利作为副都，维什瓦纳塔·纳亚克在1529年至1564年间大规模重建城市和神庙。权力很快落入筑堡自守的帕莱亚卡尔首领手中；1743年后阿尔果德纳瓦布短暂称霸，1755年东印度公司首次介入，但这些首领的争斗仍未停止。东印度公司于1790年9月1日设立蒂内维利县。潘恰兰库里奇的维拉潘迪亚·卡塔博曼随后领导波利加尔起事，最终于1799年10月16日在卡亚塔尔被绞死；战争于1801年结束后，帕拉扬科泰成为这个公司治下新县的驻军中心。

en:
Albazin denotes the cold upper Amur country running from the neighborhood of the Shilka-Argun confluence east toward the Urkan tributaries of the Zeya. In 1444 no Russian or Qing garrison governed it. Evenki clans hunted elk and reindeer and trapped sable through the larch taiga, while Daur and Solon villages held the Amur bank with wooden strongholds and fields. Sable furs linked the hunters to wider continental trade, but power remained with the local clans.

In 1639 Hong Taiji's forces campaigned against the Solon leader Bombogor and destroyed the Daur strongholds of Yaksa and Wukur. In 1651 Yerofey Khabarov's Cossacks seized the fortified village of Daur prince Albaza, wintered there, and burned it when they moved on. Fugitive Cossacks and settlers under Nikifor Chernigovsky rebuilt an ostrog on the ruins in 1665 and forwarded fur tribute to Siberian posts; Russia created the Albazin military district in 1682 under Aleksey Tolbuzin. Qing armies took the fort in 1685 and returned to besiege the rebuilt works in 1686, when Tolbuzin was killed by cannon fire. The 1689 Treaty of Nerchinsk required the Russians to withdraw and destroy Albazin. In 1821 only forest, hunting trails and the old fort site remained on this stretch of the Amur.
zh:
阿勒巴钦指黑龙江上游寒地，范围从石勒喀河与额尔古纳河汇合处附近，向东延伸到结雅河支流乌尔坎河的泰加林。1444年，这里没有俄国或清朝驻军管辖。鄂温克氏族在落叶松林中猎捕驼鹿和驯鹿、猎取紫貂，达斡尔与索伦村落则在黑龙江边以木城和田地立足。紫貂皮把猎人与更广的大陆贸易连接起来，但权力仍掌握在当地氏族手中。

1639年，皇太极的军队征讨索伦首领博穆博果尔，摧毁雅克萨、兀库尔等达斡尔木城。1651年，叶罗费·哈巴罗夫的哥萨克占领达斡尔王公阿尔巴西的堡寨，在此越冬后撤离时将其焚毁。1665年，尼基弗尔·切尔尼戈夫斯基率领逃亡的哥萨克和移民在废墟重建堡寨，并向西伯利亚各要塞输送毛皮贡赋；俄国1682年设立阿尔巴津督军区，以阿列克谢·托尔布津为长官。1685年清军攻克该堡，1686年又长期围困重修的工事，托尔布津中炮身亡。1689年《尼布楚条约》规定俄人撤离并拆毁阿尔巴津。到1821年，黑龙江这一段只剩森林、猎路和旧堡遗址。

en:
The Udi is the cold river corridor running from the Dzhagdy Mountains to Ud Bay on the Sea of Okhotsk. In 1444 Solon Evenki hunters used its upper forests and passes, while Lamut, or Even, families on the lower river and coast lived from fishing and sea mammals. Sable furs moved by forest track, river portage and coastal boat rather than through towns; winter camps were more permanent than any fixed settlement, and no fortress guarded the estuary.

After Ivan Moskvitin's expedition reached the Sea of Okhotsk in 1638, Russian scouts explored the shore between the Tauy and the Udi, and local Lamuts told them of the Zeya and Amur. In 1681 Cossacks built a winter hut on the river, the beginning of Udsk. At Nerchinsk in 1689, Qing and Russian envoys left the lands between the Khingan Mountains and the Udi without a settled boundary. The post held only about thirty people in 1690 and roughly two hundred in 1800, its grain carried at great expense along the Yakutsk track; the Udi remained a remote fur-trade outpost.
zh:
乌第河从贾格德山脉流向鄂霍次克海乌第湾，是一条寒冷的森林通道。1444年，索伦鄂温克猎人在上游林地和山口间游猎，河口与海岸的拉穆特人（埃文人）以捕鱼和海兽为生。紫貂毛皮经林间小路、河流转运和沿海船只外运，而不是通过城镇；过冬营地比固定聚落更持久，河口也没有要塞戍守。

1638年伊万·莫斯科维京的探险队到达鄂霍次克海后，俄国斥候探查了陶伊河与乌第河之间的海岸，并从拉穆特人那里听说了结雅河与黑龙江。1681年，哥萨克在河畔搭建过冬小屋，后来发展为乌德斯科耶。1689年《尼布楚条约》没有划定外兴安岭与乌第河之间土地的归属，将其留作待议地区。1690年这个据点只有约三十人，1800年约有二百人，粮食仍须沿雅库茨克商路高价运来，乌第河始终是偏远的毛皮贸易哨所。

en:
Birija is the Evenki name of the long south-flowing river also recorded in Manchu as Niuman and later called the Bureya. In 1444, after Ming power had withdrawn from the Amur, its forests and fishing camps lay within the Tungusic frontier of Jurchen, Evenki and Ducher bands. Sable from the hills and fish from the river moved through tribute and barter networks. There was no walled town on the bank; the Evenki name itself meant the Great River.

Russian Cossacks entered the Amur in 1643-1644, and Yerofey Khabarov's expedition explored the middle river and its tributaries in 1649-1651. Seventeenth-century Russian accounts called the Niuman the Fast River. For forty years Cossack raiders and tribute collectors challenged the Qing hold on the sable country, until the campaigns against Albazin and the Treaty of Nerchinsk in 1689 placed the Amur valley under Qing rule. The Bureya received no fortress; through the eighteenth century its camps and fishing stations remained a quiet hunting dependency behind the garrison at Aigun.
zh:
布列亚是埃文基语Birija的音译，这条南流长河在满语中称牛满江。1444年，明朝势力已从黑龙江后撤，河谷中的林地和渔场处在女真、鄂温克、杜切尔等通古斯语族群的边疆世界。山中的紫貂和河里的鱼通过朝贡与物物交换向外流通，河畔没有城墙城镇；埃文基河名的意思就是「大河」。

俄国哥萨克在1643年至1644年进入黑龙江，叶罗费·哈巴罗夫又于1649年至1651年探查黑龙江中游及其支流。17世纪的俄国记载把牛满江称为「快河」。此后四十年间，哥萨克劫掠者和贡赋征集者不断争夺这片紫貂之地，直到清军进攻阿尔巴津，1689年《尼布楚条约》确认黑龙江流域归清朝统辖。布列亚河畔没有修建要塞；整个18世纪，这里的营地和渔场仍是瑷珲驻军背后安静的渔猎属地。

en: Kuru, the Manchu Kuru Bira, flows for 434 kilometres through a 13,700-square-kilometre basin before joining the Urmi to form the Tunguska, a left-bank tributary of the Amur. In 1444 its banks belonged to Nanai-speaking, or Hezhen, fishing and hunting bands; the Kur-Urmi dialect of Nanai took its name from these rivers. Summer floods spread across the channels, where taimen, lenok and grayling lived and chum salmon came to spawn. Qing geographical accounts preserved the Manchu name and treated the Kuru itself as the main stream entering the Amur, and the valley remained scattered fishing and hunting country through 1821.
zh: 库噜，满语称库噜必拉，全长434公里，流域面积13,700平方公里，与乌尔米河汇合后形成黑龙江左支流通古斯卡河。1444年时，河畔居住着说那乃语（赫哲语）库噜—乌尔米方言的渔猎人群。夏季洪水常漫过河道，水中有哲罗鲑、细鳞鲑和茴鱼，大马哈鱼也会洄游到此产卵。清代地理记载保留了满语河名，并把库噜河视作直接注入黑龙江的正流；直到1821年，这片河谷仍是村落稀疏的渔猎之地。

en:
Furdan is the lower Suifen River country, where the river breaks through the coastal ranges on its way to the Sea of Japan. Its fertile lowland held the twin walled towns of Balhae and the Jin: Shuaibin, headquarters of the Jin Supin circuit, bred horses for the empire, and the eastern town was called Furdan in Manchu. The Mongols sacked the towns in 1233, together with the Eastern Xia ruler Puxian Wannu's mountain capital of Kaiyuan close by, and in 1246 carried off the remaining people to the Liao River valley. The Ming set up the Shuangcheng Guard over the district, and by 1444 Warka Jurchen of the Eastern Sea clans hunted, fished and dug ginseng among the old earthworks, their chiefs holding Ming patents and trading with the Jianzhou and Korea.

The long rivalry between Nurhaci's Jianzhou and the Ula for the Eastern Sea clans was decided at the battle of Wujieyan in 1607, after which the Suifen clans submitted and entered the Manchu realm. Under the Qing, Furdan was a remote corner of the Ningguta banner garrison, established in 1652 and later raised to a military governorship and then a deputy command, and the land stayed a sealed frontier closed to civilian settlers. The old towns were already ruins when the French Jesuits Régis, Jartoux and Fridelli surveyed them in 1709 for the Kangxi Atlas, and d'Anville's map of China in 1734 carried the name Furdan into the atlases of Europe.
zh:
富尔丹即绥芬河下游之地，绥芬河在此穿过沿海群山注入日本海。这片肥沃低地上有两座古城故址：渤海率宾府以产马闻名，金朝恤品路的治所也设在这里；双城并立，清代称东城为「傅尔丹」、西城为「朱尔根」，合称双城子。1233年蒙古军攻占此地，连同附近东夏蒲鲜万奴的上都开元一并摧毁，1246年又把残余人口迁往辽河流域。明代在此设双城卫；到1444年，东海女真瓦尔喀诸部在旧城址周围渔猎采参，酋长持有明朝的卫所敕书，与建州女真和朝鲜往来贸易。

努尔哈赤的建州与布占泰的乌拉长期争夺东海女真，1607年乌碣岩之战后，绥芬一带的部族归附建州，进入日后的满洲版图。清代，傅尔丹归宁古塔驻防管辖——该驻防设于1652年，后改宁古塔将军、宁古塔副都统——这片土地长期封禁，不许民人开垦定居。法国耶稣会士雷孝思、杜德美、费隐1709年为测绘《皇舆全览图》到此，所见率宾故地只剩废墟；1734年当维尔绘制的中国地图把「傅尔丹」一名带进了欧洲的地图集。

en:
Ningguta lies in the forested valley of the Hurka, now the Mudan River, which winds north through the Changbai foothills to join the Sungari. Its name means 'six' in Manchu, for the place was guarded by six grandsons of the Jianzhou chief Möngke Temür, and along with Sanxing it was remembered as one of the two oldest seats of the Manchus-to-be. Upstream at Dongjingcheng stood the ruins of Shangjing Longquanfu, capital of Balhae until the Khitan extinguished that kingdom in 926. In 1444 the valley was Jianzhou Jurchen country, where clans lived by hunting sable, fishing the river and raising millet, and bartered pelts for grain, iron and cloth at the Ming border markets.

As Nurhaci unified the Jurchens at the turn of the seventeenth century, the Hurka tribes along the river came under his banners, and after the Qing entered China the court still regarded Ningguta as ancestral ground. In 1652 Sarhuda arrived with 2,000 horsemen to raise the first Qing garrison beyond the Willow Palisade, and in 1658 he led a fleet of several dozen boats, with Korean musketeers under Shin Ryu, down the Hurka and Sungari to destroy Onufriy Stepanov's Cossack flotilla near the Sungari's mouth. His son Bahai became the first Ningguta military governor in 1662, and four years later the seat moved from the old stockade on the Hailang River to a new walled city on the Hurka. From the 1650s Ningguta was the Qing empire's most feared place of exile: the sea lord Zheng Zhilong was sent there and, by one account, put to death, while the scholar Wu Zhaoqian, condemned in the Jiangnan examination case of 1657, was ransomed home only in 1681. The governor moved to Jilin in 1676, leaving a deputy lieutenant-general, but Ningguta remained the eastern garrison town and mart for ginseng and sable where the Jesuits of the 1709 imperial ginseng expedition found Han merchants and banished farmers crowding its streets.
zh:
宁古塔地处虎尔哈河（今牡丹江）林木幽深的河谷，河水北折，穿过长白山余脉汇入松花江。其名在满语中意为「六个」，因建州酋长猛哥帖木儿的六个孙子分守其地而得名；与三姓一样，它被视作后来满族最古老的发祥重地之一。上游今东京城一带留有渤海国上京龙泉府遗址，926年契丹灭渤海之前，这里长期是渤海王都。1444年的虎尔哈河谷是建州女真的土地，各部以猎貂、捕鱼、种黍为生，到明朝边市上以皮张换取粮食、铁器和布帛。

努尔哈赤统一女真之际，沿河而居的虎尔哈各部相继归入八旗；入关之后，清廷仍把宁古塔视为龙兴故地。1652年，沙尔虎达率两千骑兵进驻，建立柳条边外第一处清军驻防；1658年，他率领数十艘战船，会同申浏所部朝鲜鸟枪手顺虎尔哈河、松花江而下，在松花江汇入黑龙江处歼灭了奥努夫里·斯捷潘诺夫的哥萨克船队。1662年，其子巴海出任首任宁古塔将军；四年后，治所从海浪河畔的旧城迁往虎尔哈河畔的新城，即今宁安。自1650年代起，宁古塔是清朝最令人胆寒的流放地：海商郑芝龙被遣戍至此，一说即遇害于此；文人吴兆骞因1657年丁酉科场案流放，直到1681年才由友人纳资赎还。1676年将军移治吉林乌拉，宁古塔改驻副都统，但仍是东边的驻防重镇与人参、貂皮贸易之地——1709年随皇家采参队到访的耶稣会士看到，汉商与流放垦荒的农户挤满了这里的街巷。

en:
Huncun lies in the lower Tumen River country, where China, Korea and the Siberian seaboard meet a short way inland from the Sea of Japan. Balhae built its Eastern Capital, Longyuan Fu, at Baliancheng on this plain, and Fangchuan at the river mouth served the Tang-era 'Japan Road', sailing trade goods across to the home islands. Later dynasties kept the district as a border stronghold, and under the Ming the Nurgan command posted the Huncun, Mila, Urhunshan and Tongkuanshan guards among the Warka Jurchen clans, whom Korea called its 'subordinate barbarians'. In 1444 the clans lived along the Huncun River, their chiefs holding Ming patents, paying sable and ginseng tribute and bartering across the Tumen with Korea's six northern garrisons.

In the first month of 1607 the Warka lord of Feiyou, the old walled town west of Huncun, offered his people to Nurhaci to escape Bujantai's Ula. Jianzhou troops moved out the whole population and burned the town, then in early February routed ten thousand Ula pursuers at Wujieyan on the Tumen near Jongseong, killing their commander Bokeduo; Ula power never returned to the river basin, and the remaining Eastern Sea clans submitted soon after, bringing Huncun into the Manchu realm. From 1653 the district belonged to the Ningguta military government and was closed as an imperial reserve, its ginseng hills and pearl rivers barred to settlers. In 1714 the Qing created the Huncun commandant, the first official use of the name; his yamen was raised on the north bank of the Huncun River in 1715, when the walled town was founded, and from 1729 the post answered to the Ningguta deputy commander.
zh:
珲春地处图们江下游，中、朝、俄三方交界，东南距日本海仅一步之遥。渤海国在这片平原上建有东京龙原府八连城，江口的防川是唐代通往日本的「日本道」海上航路，商货由此渡海东行。历代都视此地为边寨要地，明朝奴儿干都司在珲春一带设有珲春卫、密拉卫、乌尔珲山卫、童宽山卫等卫所，统辖江外的东海女真瓦尔喀诸部，朝鲜则称之为「藩胡」。1444年，瓦尔喀人沿珲春河而居，酋长持有明朝敕书，以紫貂、人参等物入贡，并渡江与朝鲜六镇贸易往来。

1607年正月，珲春以西古城斐优城的瓦尔喀城主策穆特黑不堪乌拉布占泰压迫，举部投奔努尔哈赤。建州兵迁出城中全部人口后焚城而返，二月初在图们江畔朝鲜钟城附近的乌碣岩迎击一万乌拉追兵，大获全胜，阵斩其主将博克多，乌拉势力从此退出图们江流域，其余东海女真各部相继归服，珲春并入满洲版图。1653年起，此地归宁古塔昂邦章京统辖，划为封禁区，参山珠河不许民人染指。1714年，清朝设珲春协领，这是珲春之名首次见于官方文书；次年在珲春河北岸修建协领衙门、始筑城池，1729年起改隶宁古塔副都统。

en:
Boduna stands where the Nen River joins the Sungari, amid the marshes of the Songnen plain. The Boduo Mohe lived here in early medieval times; under the Jin it was part of Zhaozhou, and the early Ming posted the Sanchahe Guard here before the country became the fishing and grazing ground of the Sibe, vassals of the eastern Mongol clans. Its name is Mongolian for 'quail'. In 1444 there was still no walled town, only riverside camps and herds, while the Qasarid Khorchin pastured beyond the Nen.

In the mid-16th century the southward-moving Khorchin subdued the Sibe, and in 1593 Sibe riders fought in the nine-tribe army that Nurhaci broke at Gule Mountain. With the Qing arming against Russia on the Amur, a relay station was opened at Boduna in 1682 on the post road from Jilin to Qiqihar. In 1692 the throne redeemed the Sibe, Gualca and Daur subjects of the Khorchin princes and enrolled the Sibe in the upper three banners; a vice commander was stationed at Boduna, and a brick New City rose beside the post in 1693, one of the seven garrison towns beyond the willow palisade, feeding the Heilongjiang garrisons and watching the Mongol frontier. Changning County was added in the Yongzheng reign, and Boduna became a subprefecture in 1811.
zh:
伯都讷地处嫩江汇入松花江处，松嫩平原的泡沼之间。隋唐时伯咄靺鞨在此渔牧，金属肇州地，明初曾设三岔河卫，此后成为锡伯人的渔猎游牧之地，受东部蒙古诸部役属；「伯都讷」为蒙古语，意为鹌鹑。1444年的伯都讷还没有城池，只有沿河的营地和畜群，嫩江对岸是合撒儿后裔科尔沁部的牧场。

16世纪中叶，南下的科尔沁收服锡伯；1593年，锡伯骑兵作为九部之一，在古勒山被努尔哈赤击败。清朝为经营黑龙江对俄防务，于1682年在吉林至齐齐哈尔的驿道上设伯都讷站。1692年，朝廷向科尔沁王公赎买锡伯、卦尔察、达斡尔人丁，锡伯被编入上三旗；伯都讷移驻副都统，1693年在驿站南侧建起砖城新城，为柳条边外七大驻防重镇之一，既供给黑龙江八旗粮饷，又扼守通往蒙古的驿路。雍正年间就新城置长宁县，1811年设伯都讷厅。

en:
The Yehe River winds through the wooded hills of southern Jilin, north-east of the Ming frontier town of Kaiyuan. In 1444 its valleys were hunting grounds of the Haixi Jurchens, one of the three great Jurchen divisions recorded by the Ming; the tribe called Yehe did not yet exist. Its rulers came from outside: a Mongol of the Tümed, Singgen Darhan, seized the town of Zhang held by the Nara clan in the Hulun country, adopted the name Nara, and led his followers to the Yehe River in the mid-Ming decades, naming them after the river. His descendants, the beile Cinggiyanu and Yangginu, united the local bands and each built a walled town on its banks. By the late 1500s Yehe overawed the other three Haixi nations and stood as the chief rival of Nurhaci's Jianzhou.

Marriage briefly bound the rivals, when Yangginu's daughter was wed to Nurhaci and bore him Hong Taiji, the future khan. Yehe then led a nine-tribe coalition against him and was crushed at the battle of Mount Gule, a blow from which the Haixi never recovered. In 1619 Nurhaci, by then khan of the Later Jin, stormed the two Yehe towns; the last beile, Gintaisi and Buyanggu, died in the fall of their cities, and their people were enrolled in the Eight Banners. The Yehe valley then passed into the new Manchu order.
zh:
叶赫河蜿蜒于吉林南部的丘陵林地之间，地处明朝边镇开原的东北方向。1444年，这一带是海西女真的围场——明代女真分建州、海西、野人三大部，叶赫河两岸的营地属于海西，以狩猎为生，叶赫部此时尚未成形。它后来的统治者来自外部：蒙古土默特部的星根达尔汉攻取扈伦国那拉氏所居的张城，改姓那拉，明代中叶率部众迁居叶赫河畔，遂以河为号。其后代清佳砮、杨吉砮兄弟统一诸部，各在河上筑城称贝勒。到16世纪后期，叶赫称雄海西四部，成为建州努尔哈赤最强劲的对手。

两部曾以联姻相结，杨吉砮之女嫁给努尔哈赤，生下后来的清太宗皇太极。此后叶赫纠合九部联军来攻，在古勒山一战中惨败，海西诸部从此一蹶不振。1619年，已是后金国汗的努尔哈赤攻破叶赫东西两城，末代贝勒金台石、布扬古皆城破身死，部众被编入八旗，叶赫河谷就此归入满洲人的新秩序。

en:
The Suzi River flows west out of the Changbai foothills to join the Hun, and on its banks in the hill country east of the Ming frontier town of Fushun stands Hetu Ala, 'the Horizontal Ridge' in Manchu. In 1444 these valleys were the newly won homeland of the Jianzhou Jurchens, who had migrated south from the confluence of the Mudan and Sungari rivers. The Ming set up the Jianzhou Guard there in 1438, divided off the Left Guard in 1440 and the Right Guard in 1442, leaving each chief to rule his people by their old customs. Hetu Ala would later become the seat of the chieftain Giocangga, grandfather of Nurhaci.

In 1603 Nurhaci, by then master of all the Jianzhou, walled Hetu Ala as his seat. There, in the Octagonal Hall in 1616, he proclaimed himself khan and founded the Later Jin, the state that became the Qing. In 1621 he built the Eastern Capital beside Liaoyang and moved his court there the following year, after which Hetu Ala was known simply as the Old City; in 1634 Hong Taiji renamed it Xingjing. The family tombs were moved to the Eastern Capital in 1624, but the remains of Giocangga and of Nurhaci's father Taksi were brought back to Hetu Ala in 1658, and the old town lived on as a place of Qing ancestral memory.
zh:
苏子河自长白山余脉西流汇入浑河，河畔山林在明朝边镇抚顺以东，满语意为「横岗」的赫图阿拉就高踞在这片河谷之上。1444年，这里是建州女真新近落脚的家园：他们从牡丹江与松花江汇流处一路南迁，明朝于1438年设建州卫，1440年分置建州左卫，1442年再置建州右卫，合称建州三卫，以各部首领统领旧俗。赫图阿拉后来成为酋长觉昌安的居地，他正是努尔哈赤的祖父。

1603年，已统一建州诸部的努尔哈赤在赫图阿拉筑城，作为根本之地。1616年，他在城中的八角殿称汗，建立后金，即清朝的前身。1621年他在辽阳旁营建东京城，次年迁都，赫图阿拉从此被称作老城，1634年皇太极下令改称兴京。家族陵寝1624年随迁东京，而觉昌安与努尔哈赤之父塔克世的遗骨又在1658年归葬赫图阿拉，这座老城此后便作为清代的祖居之地安静留存。

en:
Andong is the land at the mouth of the Yalu, where the river dividing Liaodong from Korea runs between wooded hills into the Yellow Sea. After the Tang conquered Goguryeo in 668 the new Andong Protectorate gave this frontier its name, and the Liao built Laiyuan Fort at Jiuliancheng, where the river ferry met the road to Liaoyang. Under the Ming the country belonged to the Liaodong Regional Military Commission, watched over by scattered stockades rather than walled cities. In 1444 it was the quiet eastern edge of the Ming world, with the loyal tributary kingdom of Joseon across the water.

Late in the fifteenth century the Ming pushed the eastern arm of their frontier wall down to the Yalu at Hushan and planted posts along the bank, Tangzhan among them in 1480. The country fell under Later Jin sway after Sarhu in 1619, but in 1621 the Ming guerrilla Mao Wenlong led 197 raiders deep behind Jin lines and stormed the riverside Zhenjiang Fort, carrying off its garrison commander in the first Ming victory of the war, celebrated as the Zhenjiang Triumph. Driven back in his turn, he held Pi Island as his Dongjiang naval base and harried the Jin flank until Yuan Chonghuan had him executed in 1629. In 1627 Amin crossed the Yalu with 30,000 men to subdue Joseon, and the peace opened a border market at Chunggang on the river; Hong Taiji crossed again in 1636, and King Injo submitted at Samjeondo in 1637. Under the Qing the Yalu remained a guarded yet trading border, the country administered by the Shengjing garrison general.
zh:
安东在鸭绿江入海口一带——这条分隔辽东与朝鲜的大江在群山间注入黄海。668年唐灭高句丽，置安东都护府，这片边地由此得名；辽代在今丹东市郊的九连城设来远城，临江渡口正接通往辽阳的大路。明代此地属辽东都指挥使司，没有大城，只有分散的堡寨烽燧。1444年，这里是大明世界最安静的东缘，江对岸是恭顺的藩属朝鲜国。

15世纪后期，明廷把边墙东段一直修到鸭绿江畔的虎山，沿江广设堡寨，汤站堡即建于1480年。1619年萨尔浒之战后，这片土地归入后金势力范围；但1621年，明游击毛文龙率一百九十七名勇士深入敌后，奇袭今丹东地方的镇江堡，擒获守将，是为明对后金的首胜「镇江大捷」。他随后退据皮岛设东江镇，以水师牵制后金侧翼，直到1629年被袁崇焕诛杀。1627年，阿敏率军三万跨过鸭绿江征讨朝鲜，战后盟约规定双方在鸭绿江边的中江开市；1636年皇太极再次渡江征朝，朝鲜仁祖于次年在三田渡投降，朝鲜转为清朝藩属。清代的鸭绿江是设防而通商的边界，这片土地由盛京将军管辖。

en:
Gaizhou lies on the northwest shore of the Liaodong Peninsula, where the coastal hills begin to drop into the Bohai Sea. The Han made it Pingguo County in 195 BC; under Goguryeo it was Gaimou, the root of its later name, and after Tang armies took its Jian'an fortress in 645 the Bohai state called the place Gaizhou. The Liao renamed it Chen Prefecture and the Jin restored the name Gaizhou in 1195. In 1371 the Ming turned the prefecture into the Gaizhou Guard and walled a new city the following year; with Jinzhou, Fuzhou and Haizhou it formed the 'four southern guards', whose affairs were administered across the water through Shandong. In 1444 it was a walled garrison and fishing port on the Bohai, its supply boats plying south to the Shandong coast.

With the fall of Shenyang and Liaoyang in 1621 the guard passed to the Later Jin. In 1664 the Qing folded the old names into Gaiping County under Fengtian Prefecture, while nearby Xiongyue became one of the nine Eight Banners garrisons set up beyond Shanhai Pass in 1644.
