1605年，耶稣会旅行家鄂本笃随喀什噶尔商队前往吐鲁番和明朝边境时，在通常被比定为焉耆或库尔勒的「Cialis」商队城停留了三个月。17世纪后期察合台宗主权崩溃，1680年准噶尔的军事行动把这条道路纳入卫拉特势力范围。18世纪50年代，清军击破准噶尔；1758年局势平定后，清朝在焉耆一带派驻军队并移民屯垦。1771年，从伏尔加河流域东归的土尔扈特蒙古人被安置在巴音郭楞，使佛教蒙古营地与穆斯林绿洲城镇并存。直到1821年，铁门关商道始终是清朝边疆管辖下的谷物与牲畜通道。

en:
South of the Khangai foothills the steppe thins into the Black Gobi, a riverless expanse of gravel and salt marsh where the Oirats grazed horses, sheep and Bactrian camels. In 1444 the Four Oirats were at the height of their power under Esen taishi, who ruled the Mongols in the name of Taisun Khan; his riders already held Hami, overawed the Mongol princes of Gansu, and drove the tribute horse trade with the Ming along the desert tracks to the south. The herders of these camps still worshipped Tengri, and the Ming court's curtailment of tribute gifts was pushing the two powers toward war.

In July 1449 Esen invaded China, destroyed the Ming army at Tumu and captured the Zhengtong Emperor, who was freed when peace was made in 1450. Esen proclaimed himself khan in 1453 but was killed in a vassal's rebellion within two years, and Oirat power drifted west with his fall. The pastures then passed to the westernmost of the Khalkha: after Gersenji's death in 1549 his eldest son Ashikhai founded the ruling line, and in 1596 Subadai took the title Zasagt Khan. In 1687 the Tüsheet Khan Chakhundorj killed the Zasagt Khan Shar, and Galdan's Dzungars overran the country the next year; Shar's brother Tsevenjav submitted to the Kangxi Emperor, and at the Dolonnur assembly of 1691 the Khalkha entered the Qing empire. Banner rule followed, and by the Qianlong reign the nineteen banners of the Zasagt league gathered triennially at Biduriyaa Nuur, by the source of the Zag River.
zh:
杭爱山麓以南，草原渐渐化为黑戈壁——一片没有河流的砾石滩与盐沼，瓦剌人在这里牧放马、羊和双峰驼。1444年，四卫拉特在太师也先治下正值鼎盛，也先奉岱总汗之名号令蒙古；他的骑兵已拿下哈密、慑服甘肃的蒙古诸王公，并沿南方的沙漠古道维持着对明朝的贡马贸易。营地里的牧人仍信奉腾格里，而明朝削减贡使赏赐，正把双方推向战争。

1449年7月，也先大举入边，在土木堡歼灭明军、俘获明英宗，1450年议和后才将英宗放回。1453年也先自立为汗，不出两年即在部属叛乱中被杀，瓦剌霸业随之西退。这片牧场后来归入喀尔喀最西的一支：1549年格哷森札死后，长子阿什海一脉在此称长，1596年素巴第称札萨克图汗。1687年，土谢图汗察珵多尔济攻杀札萨克图汗沙喇；次年，曾在西藏出家为僧的噶尔丹率准噶尔大军席卷喀尔喀，沙喇之弟策旺扎布南奔投清，1691年在多伦诺尔会盟上随喀尔喀诸部臣服康熙。清朝随后编设旗分，至乾隆年间札萨克图汗部十九旗每三年会盟于札克河源的毕都尔诺尔湖畔。

en:
The Black Sea coast between Taman and Abkhazia is a narrow shelf of beaches and oak forests pressed beneath the Caucasus, home to the coastal Adyghe clans — the Natukhaj in the north, the Shapsug along the central shore and the Ubykh around the mouth of the Sochi river. Greek ships once traded at Sinda and Gorgippia here, and the north wall of an eleventh-century Byzantine basilica still stands at Loo. Between the thirteenth and fifteenth centuries Genoa held the Black Sea monopoly, keeping the fortified factory of Mapa on the site of Anapa and, further south, the posts of Layso and Costa near modern Sochi, where silk and salt were exchanged for timber, wax, horses and captives. Timur's columns swept down to the shore in 1395, yet no invader cared to hold the forested ravines behind it. In 1444 Genoese vessels still ride at anchor in these roadsteads, while the Orthodox coastal clans answer only loosely to the grand prince of Circassia and live by fishing, herding and the trade passing through their inlets.

In 1475 a fleet of Mehmed II under Gedik Ahmed Pasha, sailing against Caffa, seized Mapa as well, and by 1481 an Ottoman fort guarded the roadstead, administered through the Kafa sanjak. The shore clans kept their arms and much of their old faith: when Evliya Celebi visited in 1641 the castle had no regular garrison, the Shapsug and the shegaki around it paid tithe only under compulsion, and Don Cossacks had sacked it more than once. After Russia annexed the Crimea, the Ottomans rebuilt and enlarged Anapa in 1781-1784 under Ferah Ali Pasha, turning it into the great slave mart of the Circassian coast, where Caucasian captives were shipped to imperial harems and galleys. General Gudovich stormed and demolished the fortress on 22 June 1791, but the peace of Jassy handed it back that December. A Russian squadron took it again in April 1807, a landing party retook it in June 1809, and a Russian garrison held it until the Treaty of Bucharest restored it to the sultan in May 1812. In 1821 Anapa is once more an Ottoman stronghold, while the Ubykh and Shapsug clans behind it remain unconquered.
zh:
从塔曼到阿布哈兹之间的黑海海岸，是一条被高加索群山压在海边的狭窄地带，遍布沙滩与橡林，住着阿迪格人的沿海氏族——北方的纳图哈伊人、中部海岸的沙普苏格人、索契河口一带的乌比赫人。希腊商船古时来此的辛达与戈尔吉皮亚贸易，洛奥的林谷中残存着11世纪拜占庭巴西利卡的墙垣。13至15世纪，热那亚垄断黑海贸易，在安纳帕故址设有设防商站马帕，又在南方今索契附近设有莱索、科斯塔等商站，以丝绸、食盐交换木材、蜂蜡、马匹和俘虏。1395年帖木儿的大军曾席卷至海岸，但没有征服者愿意深入背后林木丛生的峡谷。1444年，热那亚船只仍在这些锚地停泊，沿岸信奉东正教的氏族只在名义上服从切尔克西亚大公，靠渔猎、畜牧和经由各小港湾转口的贸易为生。

1475年，穆罕默德二世的舰队在格迪克·艾哈迈德帕夏率领下进攻卡法，途中将马帕一并夺取；到1481年，一座奥斯曼要塞已守在锚地旁，归卡法桑贾克管辖。沿海各部很久以后仍保留着武器和大半旧信仰：1641年埃夫利亚·切莱比到访时，城堡没有常驻守军，附近的沙普苏格人和谢加克人只在武力逼迫下才缴什一税，顿河哥萨克还曾几度洗劫此地。俄国吞并克里木后，奥斯曼由费拉赫·阿里帕夏主持，于1781—1784年重修扩建安纳帕，把它变成切尔克斯海岸最大的奴隶市场，高加索俘虏从这里被运往帝国的后宫和桨帆船。1791年6月22日，古多维奇将军强攻拿下要塞并将其拆毁，同年12月《雅西和约》又把它交还土耳其。俄国舰队1807年4月再度攻占，一支登陆队1809年6月再将其拿下；俄国驻军一直守到1812年5月，依《布加勒斯特和约》把它还给苏丹。1821年的安纳帕重新成为奥斯曼要塞，而它背后的乌比赫、沙普苏格各部依旧未被征服。

en:
Guria is the well-watered Black Sea coast between the Rioni and Chorokhi rivers, backed by the mountains of Meshketi. Its fisheries and the anchorages of Batumi and Tsikhisdziri drew Trapezuntine and Italian merchants, while the Gurieli governors held their main seat at Ozurgeti. In 1444 the land was Orthodox and formally part of the crumbling Kingdom of Georgia, though the Gurieli family already commanded great local power. That same year a Burgundian flotilla tried to sack Batumi, known to the raiders as Vaty; the landing party was routed, Geoffroy de Thoisy was captured, and the Emperor of Trebizond secured his release.

The Gurieli joined Bagrat of Imereti to defeat George VIII at Chikhori in 1463 and received a semi-independent principality, with Giorgi I Gurieli recognized as a sovereign prince in 1491. A joint campaign with Odishi against the sea raiders of Jiketi ended disastrously in 1533: the Dadiani was killed and Mamia I Gurieli captured. Ottoman pressure mounted from the 1540s, when Batumi was briefly taken and recovered, and after further wars Mamia II retook the town and Adjara in 1609. His Cossack alliances could not save him: by the agreement signed at Batumi on 3 December 1614, Guria ceded Adjara and promised annual tribute. After Mamia was murdered in 1625, Odishi defeated Guria at Lanchkhuti, blinded Simon II and made the country a client. The Ottomans permanently secured Batumi in 1703, took Chakvi by 1718 and garrisoned the coastline in 1723. Guria supported Russia in the war of 1768-1774, after which Ottoman reprisals, slave raiding and Islamization emptied whole districts. Mamia V requested Russian protection in December 1809, and the autonomous principality was formally accepted under the tsar on 8 April 1811. A Russian fort was built at Shekvetili in 1814, but when the 1820 Imeretian rebellion spread into Guria, Russian forces crushed it and destroyed Shemokmedi Castle.
zh:
古里亚位于里奥尼河与乔罗赫河之间，背靠梅斯赫季山地，是一片水源丰沛的黑海沿岸。巴统和齐希斯吉里锚地吸引特拉比松与意大利商人，渔业和海运支撑沿岸生活，古里埃利家族的统治中心则在奥祖尔盖蒂。1444年时，这里仍是东正教土地，形式上属于日薄西山的格鲁吉亚王国，但古里埃利家族已掌握强大地方权力。同年，一支勃艮第舰队试图洗劫欧洲人称为瓦蒂的巴统，登陆部队被击溃，骑士若弗鲁瓦·德·图瓦西被俘，最后由特拉比松皇帝出面促成获释。

古里埃利家族后来加入伊梅列季的巴格拉特一方，在1463年的奇科里战役击败格奥尔基八世，并获得半独立公国；吉奥尔基一世·古里埃利于1491年被承认为主权王公。1533年，古里亚与奥季希联合征讨海上掠夺者吉赫季人，却遭惨败，达季阿尼战死，马米亚一世·古里埃利被俘。奥斯曼压力从1540年代开始加剧，巴统一度失守又被收复；马米亚二世在1609年收复巴统和阿扎尔，却未能长期据守。1614年12月3日，双方在巴统签约，古里亚放弃阿扎尔并承诺年年纳贡。马米亚1625年被杀后，奥季希在兰奇胡提击败古里亚，弄瞎西莫内二世，使此地沦为附庸。奥斯曼1703年稳固取得巴统，1718年前又取得查克维，并于1723年在海岸驻扎守军。古里亚在1768至1774年战争中支持俄国，随后遭到奥斯曼报复，奴隶掳掠和伊斯兰化使许多地区荒无人烟。马米亚五世1809年12月请求俄国保护，这个自治公国最终在1811年4月8日正式纳入沙皇保护之下。1814年，俄军在谢克韦蒂利修建要塞；1820年伊梅列季起义蔓延到古里亚后，俄军将其镇压并摧毁了舍莫克梅季城堡。

en:
Kabardia is the foothill country between the Baksan, Chegem, Malka and upper Terek, where Adyghe clans moving east from the western Caucasus settled the plains as Golden Horde power receded. By 1444 their princes and warrior nobles were consolidating the Eastern Circassian polity later called Greater Kabardia, while Balkar and Ossetian neighbours held the high gorges. Herds of sheep, cattle and sturdy mountain horses grazed between valley auls and summer pastures. Christianity brought by Byzantine and Georgian contacts still shaped much of religious life, though older mountain customs remained strong, and raiders from the Kuma steppe kept princely retinues in arms.

Crimean and Ottoman pressure drew Kabardia into wider dynastic struggles. In 1561 Prince Temryuk Idarovich married his daughter, baptized Maria, to Ivan IV of Russia. Muscovite musketeers and Cossacks intervened for Temryuk in the princely wars of 1562–1567, helping him defeat a rival coalition and its Dagestani ally, Shamkhal Buday. Over the following century Crimean and Ottoman influence made Sunni Islam dominant. In 1708 Kurghoqo Hatokhshoqo used a night attack near Mount Kanzhal to destroy a Crimean-Ottoman army under Qaplan I Giray. The 1739 Treaty of Belgrade recognized Kabardia as a free buffer between Russia and the Ottoman Empire, but Russia's completion of Mozdok fortress in 1763 opened a new frontier war. In 1818, as Russian frontier armies tightened their hold, Aleksey Yermolov founded the fort of Nalchik in this foothill basin.
zh:
卡巴尔达位于巴克桑河、切格姆河、马尔卡河与捷列克河上游之间的山麓地带。金帐汗国势力衰退时，从西高加索东迁的阿迪格诸部进入平原；到1444年，王公和武士贵族正在整合这个后来被称为大卡巴尔达的东切尔克斯政权，巴尔卡尔人与奥塞梯邻人则据守高山峡谷。河谷村落与夏季牧场之间放牧着绵羊、牛和强健的山马。拜占庭和格鲁吉亚传来的基督教仍影响着大部分宗教生活，但古老山地习俗仍很牢固，库马草原的袭扰也使王公骑兵常年保持武备。

克里米亚和奥斯曼的压力，把卡巴尔达卷入更大的王朝角逐。1561年，王公捷姆留克·伊达罗维奇将女儿嫁给俄罗斯的伊凡四世；她受洗后改名玛丽亚。1562年至1567年的王公内战中，莫斯科射击军和哥萨克出兵支持捷姆留克，帮他击败敌对王公联盟及其达吉斯坦盟友沙姆哈尔·布代。此后一个世纪里，在克里米亚与奥斯曼影响下，逊尼派伊斯兰教逐渐成为主流。1708年，库尔戈科·阿塔茹金趁夜袭在坎扎尔山附近击溃卡普兰一世·格莱率领的克里米亚—奥斯曼军队。1739年的《贝尔格莱德条约》承认卡巴尔达为俄罗斯与奥斯曼之间的自由缓冲地，但俄罗斯1763年建成莫兹多克要塞后，新的边境战争随之爆发。1818年，阿列克谢·叶尔莫洛夫在这片山麓盆地建起纳利奇克要塞，此时俄国边防军已步步收紧对卡巴尔达的控制。

en:
Khundzia is the high Avar country around Khunzakh, a strong aul on a plateau about 1,600 metres above the Caspian lowlands. The old Christian kingdom of Sarir had its capital there, and by the thirteenth century Khunzakh was the seat of the Avar rulers bearing the title nutsal. In 1444 their authority ran through a loose network of mountain villages and pasturelands rather than a tightly governed kingdom. Muslim rulers had governed from Khunzakh for generations, but many highland communities still kept their own assemblies and remembered older Christian ties to Georgia; livestock, raiding and steep alpine pastures shaped their power.

During the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries the rise of the Kumukh shamkhals and the Ottoman-Safavid struggle narrowed the nutsal's freedom of action. Islam then became the common cause of Dagestani highlanders as rival chiefs led raids into Georgia and the Caspian principalities. In September 1741 Avar and neighbouring village contingents fighting around Chokh and Sogratl defeated Nader Shah's 100,000-strong invading army and forced the shah back through the mountains. Under Umma Khan, who ruled from 1774 to 1801, Avaria reached its height and received tribute from King Erekle II of Georgia and the rulers of Derbent, Quba, Baku, Shirvan and Shaki. After Umma Khan died, the khanate submitted to Russia in 1803.
zh:
库因吉是以洪扎赫为中心的阿瓦尔高地，洪扎赫是海拔约1600米高原上的坚固山村。古老的基督教王国萨里尔曾以此为都，到13世纪，洪扎赫又成为称「努察尔」的阿瓦尔统治者驻地。1444年时，他的权威建立在山村与牧场组成的松散网络上，而不是一个严密集权的王国。穆斯林统治者已在洪扎赫执政数代，但许多高地村社仍保留自己的议事会，也记得早先与格鲁吉亚的基督教联系；牲畜、袭掠和陡峭的高山牧场决定了这里的力量格局。

15至16世纪，库穆赫沙姆哈尔势力兴起，奥斯曼与萨法维又在此争斗，努察尔的行动空间不断收窄。此后，伊斯兰教成为达吉斯坦山民的共同纽带，各部首领陆续向格鲁吉亚和里海沿岸诸邦发动袭掠。1741年9月，阿瓦尔及相邻村社的联军在乔赫和索格拉特利一带击败纳迪尔沙阿十万大军，迫使沙阿从山间撤退。1774年至1801年在位的乌马汗时期，阿瓦尔势力达到鼎盛，格鲁吉亚国王伊拉克略二世以及杰尔宾特、库巴、巴库、希尔凡和舍基诸汗都向他纳贡。乌马汗死后，汗国于1803年归附俄国。

en:
Tarki, also written Tarku, climbs the Tarki-tau ridge above the Kumyk coastal plain, a short distance from the Caspian. Fishing villages and the Derbent-Astrakhan road lay below it, while tracks over the ridge led into the Dagestani mountains. The town had long been a Kumyk stronghold and a link between Caspian caravans and highland herdsmen. In 1444 it belonged to the Sunni domains of the shamkhal ruling from Gazi-Kumukh; that mountain residence gave the dynasty its authority, while Tarku watched the coastal approaches and served as its lowland base.

Russian forces briefly occupied Tarki in 1557, after a Kabardian prince appealed to Ivan the Terrible. Under Chopan-shamkhal, Kumyk troops joined an Ottoman and Crimean expedition against Astrakhan in 1570 and fought with the Ottomans against the Qizilbash in 1577; for much of the 1580s and 1590s the shamkhalate acknowledged Ottoman suzerainty. In 1605 Kumyk forces under Soltan-Mut of Endirey destroyed a Russian army at Karaman. After the Gazi-Kumukh polity broke up in the 1640s, the shamkhals settled permanently at Tarki. Stepan Razin's Cossacks sacked the town in 1668. The Tarki ruler accepted Russian subject status in 1776, and the 1813 Treaty of Gulistan confirmed Russian rule; Burnaya Fortress rose above Tarki in 1821.
zh:
塔尔基又译塔尔库，沿塔尔基套山的山脊展开，俯瞰库梅克滨海平原，距里海不远。山下分布着渔村和杰尔宾特通往阿斯特拉罕的道路，翻山的小径则深入达吉斯坦群山。这里早就是库梅克人的要塞，连接着里海商队与高地牧民。1444年，它属于以加齐库穆赫为统治中心的逊尼派沙姆哈尔领地；山中的驻地赋予王朝权威，塔尔基则扼守滨海通道，是其低地根基。

1557年，一名卡巴尔达王公向伊凡雷帝求援，俄军一度占领塔尔基。乔潘-沙姆哈尔在位时，库梅克军队1570年参加奥斯曼与克里木远征阿斯特拉罕的行动，1577年又随奥斯曼人同基兹尔巴什作战；1580至1590年代，沙姆哈尔政权大体承认奥斯曼宗主权。1605年，恩迪列伊的苏丹-穆特率领库梅克军队在卡拉曼歼灭一支俄军。1640年代加齐库穆赫政权解体后，沙姆哈尔一族长期定居塔尔基。1668年，斯捷潘·拉辛的哥萨克洗劫此城。1776年，塔尔基统治者接受俄国臣属地位，1813年《古利斯坦条约》确认俄国统治；1821年，布尔纳亚要塞在塔尔基上方建成。

en:
Alania is the Terek gateway at the northern end of the Darial Pass. Its medieval Alan kingdom, long Christian through Byzantine and Georgian contacts, was broken by the Mongol sack of 1239 and Timur's campaigns of 1395–1400. Its Iranian-speaking survivors withdrew into steep mountain gorges, where tower villages kept cattle and small livestock on high summer pastures. In 1444 no king ruled from lost Maghas; the people were forming the Ossetian highland societies later known as Iron and Digor, preserving Orthodox rites alongside older customs, while Kabardian princes dominated the neighbouring plains and the future Dzaudzhikau crossing remained a strategic prize.

War often came through Darial. In 1614 Safavid troops of Abbas I entered the mountains during his Georgian campaigns, but a cave fortress in the Kurtat Gorge blocked the route and forced a Persian column back. During the 17th century Kabardian contacts brought Islam to western communities, while Orthodox elders sought Russian protection: Russian-sent Georgian priests arrived in 1744 and an Ossetian embassy was received by Empress Elizabeth in 1751. Northern Ossetia came under Russian rule in 1774, and in 1784 Russia built Vladikavkaz, called Dzaudzhikau by Ossetians, on the Terek near the village of Zaur. Regular Darial passage opened in 1799, and after Georgia came under Russian rule in 1801 the military road tied the fortress to Tiflis and turned the old Alan gate into an imperial garrison.
zh:
阿兰是达里亚尔山口北端、捷列克河上的门户。中世纪阿兰王国长期受拜占庭和格鲁吉亚影响而信奉基督教，却在1239年蒙古破城和1395—1400年帖木儿战役后瓦解。说伊朗语的幸存者退入陡峭峡谷，在塔楼村落中生活，夏季把大小牲畜赶上高山牧场。1444年，旧都马加斯已无国王统治；这些人正形成后来称为伊龙和迪戈尔的奥塞梯山地社会，保留东正教仪礼与古老习俗，卡巴尔达王公则控制着周边平原，日后的扎乌吉考渡口仍是各方争夺的要地。

战争常经达里亚尔而来。1614年，阿拔斯一世的萨法维军队在格鲁吉亚战役中进入山地，但库尔塔特峡谷的岩洞要塞挡住去路，迫使一支波斯军队撤退。17世纪，卡巴尔达的影响也把伊斯兰教带入西部社群；与此同时，东正教长老寻求俄罗斯保护，俄国派来的格鲁吉亚司铎于1744年抵达，奥塞梯使团则在1751年获伊丽莎白女皇接见。北奥塞梯于1774年并入俄国，1784年俄军在捷列克河畔扎乌尔村附近修建弗拉季高加索要塞，奥塞梯人称之为扎乌吉考。达里亚尔通道1799年开通常规定期通行；1801年格鲁吉亚并入俄国后，军用道路把这座要塞同第比利斯连接起来，使古老的阿兰之门成为帝国驻军之地。

en:
The wooded highlands of mountainous Karabakh rise above the steppe where Ganja and the Kura lie. Long the Armenian land of Artsakh, its princes of Khachen, descending from the old kings of Artsakh, weathered Seljuk and Mongol rule from fortresses such as Jraberd and Kachaghakaberd, and in the thirteenth century Hasan-Jalal Dawla built the Gandzasar monastery, later seat of the catholicosate of Aghvank. As Khachen broke into five principalities – Gulistan, Jraberd, Khachen, Varanda and Dizak, the Khamsa melikdoms – their Beglarian, Israelian, Hasan-Jalalyan, Shahnazarian and Avanian lords held their own castles, signal beacons and mounted followings, with free peasants grazing stock on the high pastures. In 1441 a Hasan-Jalalyan commander in Qara Qoyunlu service helped bring the Armenian catholicosate back from Sis to Etchmiadzin. In 1444 the meliks governed Karabakh under the loose overlordship of Jahan Shah's Qara Qoyunlu, guarding what were widely seen as the last strongholds of Armenian self-rule.

In 1469 the Aq Qoyunlu Uzun Hasan defeated and killed the Timurid Abu Sa'id at Qarabagh, and the highlands passed to his dynasty before the Safavids rose in 1501; Shah Abbas I confirmed the meliks' semi-independent status by edict in 1603. Their sons fought the Ottoman incursions of the 1720s, and Nader Shah, taking Karabakh from the governors of Ganja, gave the five princes command over neighbouring lands. At the end of the seventeenth century Israel Ori of Karabakh carried their cause to the courts of France and Austria, dying in 1711 before help came. Independence ended through division among the princes: in 1747 Panah Ali Khan of the Turkic Javanshir clan seized lowland Karabakh, and Melik Shahnazar II of Varanda, at feud with his peers, became his vassal and gave him the Shusha stronghold, where Panah built the Panahabad fortress; by the 1750s the other four melikdoms had been subdued into the Karabakh Khanate. The Emperor Paul recognized the five princes' rights in a charter of 1799, but power lay with Ibrahim Khalil Khan, who submitted to Russia at Kurekchay in May 1805. Russian rule was formalized by the Treaty of Gulistan in 1813, and the meliks entered imperial service as officers and nobles.
zh:
林木密布的卡拉巴赫山地，高耸于占贾与库拉河所在的草原之上。这里古称阿尔察赫，哈琴的王公出自阿尔察赫列王后裔，凭借贾拉贝尔德、卡恰卡卡贝尔德等要塞熬过了塞尔柱与蒙古统治；13世纪，哈桑·贾拉尔·道拉修建甘扎萨尔修道院，这里后来成为阿格万卡托利科斯（教会牧首）的驻锡地。哈琴后来分为五个公国——古利斯坦、贾拉贝尔德、哈琴、瓦兰达、迪扎克，即「哈姆萨」五梅利克国，贝格拉里扬、以色列良、哈桑-贾拉良、沙赫纳扎良、阿瓦尼扬诸家的梅利克各有城堡、烽火台和骑兵随从，自由农在高山牧场上放牧牲畜。1441年，一名在黑羊王朝军中效力的哈桑-贾拉良将领，促成亚美尼亚卡托利科斯教座从奇里乞亚的西斯迁回埃奇米阿津。1444年，五位梅利克在贾汉沙赫黑羊王朝的松散宗主权下治理卡拉巴赫，守着外界眼中亚美尼亚人自治的最后据点。

1469年，白羊王朝的乌尊·哈桑在卡拉巴赫击败并处死帖木儿系的阿布·赛义德，山地转入白羊王朝之手，1501年萨非王朝兴起；1603年，沙阿·阿拔斯一世下诏确认梅利克们的半独立地位。他们的子弟在1720年代抗击奥斯曼入侵，纳迪尔沙赫把卡拉巴赫从占贾总督手中收回后，授予五位王公统辖邻地的军权。17世纪末，卡拉巴赫人伊斯拉埃尔·奥里面见法国和奥地利宫廷为复国奔走，1711年抱憾而死。自治最终亡于王公内部分裂：1747年，突厥贾万希尔部的帕纳赫·阿里汗夺取卡拉巴赫低地，与同族相争的瓦兰达摩利克沙赫纳扎尔二世向他称臣，献出舒沙要塞，帕纳赫在那里修建帕纳哈巴德堡；到1750年代，其余四个梅利克国均被征服，并入卡拉巴赫汗国。1799年沙皇保罗下诏承认五位王公的权利，但实权掌握在易卜拉欣·哈利勒汗手中，他于1805年5月在库列克恰伊投降俄国。1813年《古利斯坦条约》正式确认俄国统治，梅利克们以军官和贵族身份进入帝国效力。

en:
Kakheti covers the warm Alazani and Iori valleys east of the Tsiv-Gombori Range, a Georgian vineyard country guarded by the Caucasus. Telavi was an old market and craft town, while Gremi later became the royal seat. Wine, grain, cattle and silk gave the lowlands more wealth than most war-torn Georgian provinces. In 1444 Kakheti was still an Orthodox land within the weakening Kingdom of Georgia, but its strong local lords and distance from Tbilisi were already drawing it toward separate rule.

After Qvarqvare II of Samtskhe captured George VIII in 1465, the dethroned king established himself in Kakheti in 1466; Alexander I was recognized as its king in 1490. The sixteenth century brought prosperity as Gremi, Zagemi, Karagaji and Telavi served the Ghilan-Shemakha-Astrakhan silk route, although the Peace of Amasya in 1555 placed Kakheti in Safavid Iran's sphere. Shah Abbas I's invasions of 1614-1616 killed tens of thousands, deported more than 100,000 people to Iran and ruined Gremi. A general rising in 1659 blocked plans to settle Turkomans there, and in the 1670s Archil made Telavi his capital and began rebuilding. Nader Shah granted Kakheti to Erekle II in 1744; after Iran collapsed into disorder in 1747, Erekle and his father ruled as virtually independent kings. In 1762 Erekle united Kartli and Kakheti, signed the Russian protectorate treaty of Georgievsk in 1783, and lost Tbilisi to Agha Mohammad Khan's army in 1795. Russia annexed Kartli-Kakheti in 1801, and Telavi ceased to be a royal capital.
zh:
卡赫季位于齐夫-贡博里山脉以东，是阿拉扎尼河与伊奥里河流域的温暖地带，也是受高加索群山屏障的格鲁吉亚葡萄园之乡。泰拉维早已是商贸和手工业城镇，格列米后来则成为王都。酒类、粮食、牲畜和丝绸使这片低地比多数饱受战火的格鲁吉亚省份更为富庶。1444年时，卡赫季仍是日趋衰弱的格鲁吉亚王国境内的东正教土地，但地方贵族强大，又远离第比利斯，分离统治的趋势已经显现。

1465年，萨姆茨赫的夸尔克瓦雷二世俘获格奥尔基八世；被废国王于1466年在卡赫季立足，其子亚历山大一世最终在1490年被承认为卡赫季国王。16世纪，吉兰—舍马哈—阿斯特拉罕丝绸之路经过，格列米、扎格米、卡拉加吉和泰拉维一度繁荣，但1555年的《阿马西亚和约》将卡赫季划入萨法维伊朗势力范围。阿拔斯一世在1614至1616年连续入侵，数万人被杀，十余万人被迁往伊朗，格列米也沦为废墟。1659年的全民起义阻止了土库曼人移居计划；1670年代，阿尔希尔以泰拉维为都并开始重建。1744年，纳迪尔沙将卡赫季封给伊拉克略二世；1747年伊朗陷入混乱后，他与父亲成为近乎独立的君主。1762年，伊拉克略合并卡特利和卡赫季，1783年签订受俄国保护的《格奥尔基耶夫斯克条约》，1795年又遭遇阿迦·穆罕默德汗军队洗劫第比利斯。1801年俄国兼并卡特利-卡赫季，泰拉维的王都地位随之终结。

en:
This Meskhetian province is a mountain crossroads between Kartli, Javakheti, Tao-Klarjeti and the roads toward Kars and Erzurum. Its chief fortress is Akhaltsikhe, the 'new fortress' on the Potskhovi River and seat of the Jaqeli atabegs since the thirteenth century; markets there linked Georgian towns with Tabriz, Istanbul, Astrakhan and India. In 1444 Samtskhe was still ruled by its Orthodox Jaqeli prince, but Jahan Shah of the Qara Qoyunlu marched on Akhaltsikhe. King Vakhtang IV met him there in inconclusive fighting, and the Turkmen army withdrew after exposing how exposed the southern frontier had become.

Qvarqvare II completed the break from Georgia after he defeated and captured George VIII near Lake Paravani in 1465, then fought off Aq Qoyunlu and Ottoman pressure around his borders. In 1535 Bagrat III of Imereti and Luarsab I of Kartli defeated Qvarqvare III at Murjakheti, abolished the Jaqeli principality and divided its lands. The exiled heir called in the Ottomans; although the Georgians won at Karagak in 1543, their defeat at Sokhoista in 1545 made Samtskhe an Ottoman vassal. The Peace of Amasya in 1555 split the country between Ottoman and Safavid spheres, and Lala Mustafa Pasha's campaign of 1578 completed the Ottoman conquest recognized by the peace of 1590. An Ottoman land survey in 1595 tied military holdings to Islam and pushed much of the old Christian nobility toward conversion or exile. Kartli briefly seized Akhaltsikhe in 1609, but could not hold it; in 1625 the atabegate was dissolved and reorganized as the Ottoman pashalik of Akhaltsikhe. Its citadel became a slave-market centre and a multi-ethnic garrison town of Turks, Armenians, Georgians, Greeks and Jews. A Russian attempt to take Akhaltsikhe failed in 1810, leaving the pashalik under Ottoman rule at the end of 1821.
zh:
这片梅斯赫季土地是卡特利、贾瓦赫季、陶-克拉尔杰季以及通往卡尔斯、埃尔祖鲁姆诸路之间的山地十字路口。首要要塞是波茨霍维河畔的阿哈尔齐赫，意为「新堡」，自13世纪起便是贾凯利阿塔贝格的驻所；当地市场把格鲁吉亚城镇与大不里士、伊斯坦布尔、阿斯特拉罕和印度连接起来。1444年，萨姆茨赫仍由信奉东正教的贾凯利王公统治，但黑羊王朝的贾汉沙进逼阿哈尔齐赫。瓦赫坦格四世在此迎战，战斗未分胜负，土库曼军队最终撤退，却也暴露出南部门户的虚弱。

夸尔克瓦雷二世在1465年于帕拉瓦尼湖附近击败并俘获格奥尔基八世，最终完成从格鲁吉亚的分离，随后又在白羊王朝和奥斯曼的压力下维持边界。1535年，伊梅列季国王巴格拉特三世与卡特利国王卢阿尔萨布一世在穆尔贾赫季击败夸尔克瓦雷三世，废除贾凯利公国并瓜分其地。流亡继承人向奥斯曼求援；格鲁吉亚人虽在1543年的卡拉加克取胜，却于1545年在索霍伊斯塔战败，萨姆茨赫就此成为奥斯曼附庸。1555年的《阿马西亚和约》将其分割进奥斯曼和萨法维两个势力范围，拉拉·穆斯塔法帕夏1578年的远征完成奥斯曼征服，并在1590年和约中得到伊朗承认。1595年的土地调查将军事封地与伊斯兰身份绑定，迫使许多旧基督教贵族改宗或流亡。卡特利军队1609年一度攻占阿哈尔齐赫却未能守住；1625年，阿塔贝格国被废除，改组成奥斯曼的阿哈尔齐赫帕夏辖区。这座要塞后来成为高加索奴隶贸易中心，也是土耳其人、亚美尼亚人、格鲁吉亚人、希腊人和犹太人杂处的驻军城镇。俄国1810年攻城失败，因此到1821年底，帕夏辖区仍在奥斯曼统治之下。

en:
Nakhchivan spreads across the foothills of the Zangezur mountains on the Nakhchivan-chay, a tributary of the Aras, its vineyards and gardens watered by mountain streams; downstream at Julfa, caravans forded the Aras between Tabriz and the Caucasus. The Roman geographer Ptolemy knew the city as Naxuana. It became a residence of the Seljuk sultans and, in the twelfth century, one of the capitals of the Eldiguzid atabegs, whose architect Ajami Nakhchivani raised the tower-tombs of Yusif ibn Kuseyir in 1162 and of Momine Khatun in 1186, the masterpieces of the Nakhchivan school. The Mongols left it desolate – William of Rubruck, passing in the 1250s, found ruins where a great city had stood – and Timur's armies sacked it in 1401. Ruled thereafter by the Qara Qoyunlu, Nakhchivan in 1444 was an Armenian market town under Jahan Shah, its people of the Armenian Church and its wine sold along the Aras trade road.

The region passed to the Aq Qoyunlu with Jahan Shah's fall, and from 1501 the Safavids made it part of the Erivan province. In the war of 1578–1590 the Ottomans occupied Nakhchivan and kept it by the peace signed at Istanbul on 21 March 1590. Shah Abbas retook the region in the autumn of 1603, and when an Ottoman counter-attack came in 1604 he laid it waste and deported its whole population, Armenian and Muslim, deep into Persia; the Armenians of Julfa were settled across from Isfahan at New Julfa. Restored to Persia by the peace of 1612, Nakhchivan endured another Ottoman occupation in 1635–1636, and the Treaty of Zuhab of 17 May 1639 fixed the frontier with the region left to Persia; when Evliya Çelebi visited in 1648 he described a crowded city of mosques, caravanserais and bazaars. With the Safavid collapse of 1722 the Ottomans returned until Nader Shah's recovery of 1736, and in 1746 Nader deported a thousand Armenian families to Khorasan. In 1747 Heydar Qoli Khan of the Kangarlu tribe founded the Nakhchivan Khanate. Kalb-Ali Khan's overtures to Russia cost him his sight when Agha Mohammad Khan seized him in 1796, though he later returned to rule under Fath-Ali Shah. Russian troops briefly held the city in 1808, and after the Treaty of Gulistan in 1813 Nakhchivan remained a Persian border khanate.
zh:
纳希切万坐落在赞格祖尔山山麓，城在阿拉斯河支流纳希切万河畔，山间溪流浇灌着葡萄园与果园；下游的朱利法是商队涉渡阿拉斯河、往来大不里士与高加索的要津。罗马地理学家托勒密已称它为纳克苏阿纳。这里曾是塞尔柱苏丹的驻跸之地，12世纪又成为伊尔迪古兹阿塔伯克的都城之一；建筑师阿杰米·纳希切万尼1162年为优素福·伊本·库赛伊尔、1186年为穆米内·哈顿修建的塔式陵寝，是纳希切万建筑学派的杰作。蒙古人使城市沦为废墟——1250年代路过此地的威廉·鲁布鲁克看到，昔日大城只剩残垣；1401年帖木儿的军队又洗劫了它。此后黑羊王朝入主，1444年的纳希切万是贾汉沙赫治下的一座亚美尼亚集镇，居民信奉亚美尼亚教会，所产葡萄酒沿阿拉斯商路远销各地。

贾汉沙赫败亡后，地区转入白羊王朝之手，1501年萨非王朝将其划入埃里温省。1578–1590年战争中奥斯曼占领纳希切万，1590年3月21日的《伊斯坦布尔和约》确认其归属。1603年秋，沙阿·阿拔斯收复此地；1604年奥斯曼反攻时，他实行焦土，把居民（无论亚美尼亚人还是穆斯林）尽数迁往波斯腹地，朱利法的亚美尼亚人被安置在伊斯法罕对岸的新朱利法。1612年和约后纳希切万重归波斯，1635–1636年再遭奥斯曼占领，1639年5月17日的《席林堡条约》划定边界，地区仍归波斯；1648年埃夫利亚·切莱比到访时，看到的是一座清真寺、商队客栈和市集密布的繁华城市。1722年萨非王朝崩溃，奥斯曼人卷土重来，直到1736年纳迪尔沙赫收复；1746年，纳迪尔又把一千户亚美尼亚人强迁至呼罗珊。1747年，坎加尔卢部的海达尔·库里汗建立纳希切万汗国。卡尔卜·阿里汗因联络俄国，1796年被阿迦·穆罕默德汗掳走并弄瞎双目，后来在法特赫-阿里沙赫时期又回来执政。1808年俄军一度占领城市；依1813年《古利斯坦条约》，纳希切万仍是波斯的边境汗国。

en:
Urmia stands on a fertile, well-watered plain 17 kilometres west of the great salt lake that bears its name, where roads from the Caucasus, Mesopotamia and Anatolia meet. Bronze Age villages tilled the plain under the influence of the kingdom of Van, and Arab armies took the town around 640. Tenth-century geographers ranked it third among the cities of Azerbaijan, after Ardabil and Maragheh, praising its fruit and grain. The storms of the age passed over it too: Turkmen raiders taxed it in 1226, and the fugitive Khwarazmshah Jalal al-Din wintered in the region in 1230. Around 1400 Timur planted a clan of Afshar Turkmen at Topraq Qaleh nearby to hold down the Kurdish highlanders. In 1444 Urmia lies within the Qara Qoyunlu dominions, a largely Sunni Kurdish market town of vineyards and orchards with old Christian communities in its quarters, living from caravans between Tabriz, Mosul and Anatolia.

Under the Aq Qoyunlu, the conqueror Uzun Hasan founded a congregational mosque in the town, completed by his son Ya'qub. The Safavids then claimed Urmia with the rest of Azerbaijan, and in the Ottoman wars it changed hands more than once: it was held by the Ottomans after the peace of 1590 until Shah Abbas's reconquest of 1603. The Kurdish lords of the lake shore then rose in the great Dimdim revolt, and after a siege from November 1609 to the summer of 1610 the grand vizier Hatem Beg stormed Dimdim; the Mukri and Baradust Kurds were massacred or deported to Khorasan, and Afshar clans were settled around Urmia in their stead. In 1622 Qasem Sultan Afshar, fleeing a plague at his governorship of Mosul, founded the Afshar community of the town, which Evliya Çelebi in 1655 found ringed with whitewashed walls and crowded quarters. The Ottomans took Urmia in 1725 and confirmed the local Afshar chiefs in their hereditary rule; Nader Shah's forces retook the region in 1729, lost the town again in 1731 and recovered it under the peace of 1736. After Nader's death the Afghan adventurer Azad Khan made Urmia the capital of his short-lived principality, until Karim Khan Zand reduced it in a months-long siege in 1759-1760. The Afshar khanate of Urmia then carried on under Qajar overlordship into the next century.
zh:
乌尔米耶位于同名大盐湖以西17公里的肥沃平原上，是高加索、美索不达米亚和安纳托利亚商路的交汇之地。早在公元前两千年，受凡湖王国影响的村落已遍布这片平原；约640年，阿拉伯军队攻占此城。10世纪的地理学家把它列为阿塞拜疆第三大城，仅次于阿尔达比勒和马拉盖，盛赞这里果木繁盛、粮食丰足。中世纪的游牧风暴也席卷于此：1226年土库曼人攻占并向它征贡，1230年流亡的花剌子模沙札兰丁在乌尔米耶一带过冬。1400年前后，帖木儿把一支阿夫沙尔土库曼人安置在附近的托普拉克堡，以压制库尔德山地部落。1444年的乌尔米耶处在黑羊王朝疆域之内，是一座以逊尼派库尔德人为主的商业城镇，葡萄园和果园遍布，坊中有古老的基督教社群，靠往来于大不里士、摩苏尔和安纳托利亚之间的商队为生。

白羊王朝的征服者乌尊·哈桑在城中修建了一座聚礼清真寺，由其子叶尔孤卜完工。萨法维王朝随后把乌尔米耶连同整个阿塞拜疆纳入版图；在与奥斯曼的战争中它多次易手，1590年和约后归奥斯曼统治，直到1603年阿拔斯沙将其收复。湖滨的库尔德领主随后发动了声势浩大的迪姆迪姆起义：1609年11月至1610年夏，大维齐尔哈提姆贝格围攻并攻陷迪姆迪姆堡，穆克里和巴拉杜斯特的库尔德人或遭屠杀、或被迁往呼罗珊，阿夫沙尔部落被安置到乌尔米耶周围填补其地。1622年，为躲避摩苏尔瘟疫的总督卡西姆·苏丹·阿夫沙尔在此奠定阿夫沙尔人社群；1655年旅行家艾弗里亚·切莱比见到的乌尔米耶白色城墙环绕，坊里密布。1725年奥斯曼攻占此城，承认当地阿夫沙尔首领的世袭统治；纳迪尔沙的军队1729年收复周边，1731年城市再度失守，依1736年和约才最终收回。纳迪尔死后，阿富汗冒险家阿扎德汗一度以乌尔米耶为其短命政权的都城，1759至1760年卡里姆汗·赞德经数月围城将其攻克；乌尔米耶的阿夫沙尔汗国此后在恺加王朝宗主权下延续到19世纪。

en:
Maragheh lies in a well-watered valley at the southern foot of Mount Sahand, on the Sufi Chay running west to Lake Urmia. Long identified with Phraata, winter capital of ancient Atropatene, it fell to Arab armies around 642. In 893 the Sajid prince Muhammad ibn Abi'l-Saj made it his capital in Azerbaijan, until his brother Yusuf tore down its walls and moved the seat to Ardabil. Mongol generals Jebe and Subutai sacked it on 30 March 1221; the Khwarazmshah Jalal al-Din retook it in 1225, and Mongol rule was made definite in 1231. Its great age followed: after taking Baghdad Hulagu made Maragheh his capital for its cool air and pastures, and in 1259 founded the observatory directed by Nasir al-Din al-Tusi, where the Tusi-couple and new star tables were devised and scholars from across the Islamic world assembled. In 1312 Oljeitu appointed Qara-Sunqur, formerly grand amir of Aleppo, its ruler; Ibn Battuta heard the town called 'Little Damascus', and the poet Awhadi Maraghai, settled here in 1306, died in 1338. After the Ilkhanate weakened, Chupanid and Jalayirid lords divided the region. In 1444 Maragheh is a Qara Qoyunlu town, where merchants trade in grapes, raisins, marble and soap beneath the ruined observatory on the hill.

With the rest of Azerbaijan the town passed from the Qara Qoyunlu to the Aq Qoyunlu and then, in 1501, to Shah Ismail's Safavids. Shah Abbas I enfeoffed the province to Mir Aqa Khan of the Moqaddam branch of the Javanshir tribe, whose line governed Maragheh hereditarily through the Safavid age; its bazaar wove silk, and dye-works, soap-boiling and dried-fruit trade spread its name. In 1724 Ottoman armies overran the town and placed it under Timur Pasha, until the Moqaddam chief Hasan Ali Vakil rose up and, with Nader Qoli's forces, drove the Turks out in 1729-1730. Nader, soon to be shah, confirmed Moqaddam governors in 1730, 1737 and 1744; when he was assassinated in 1747 the last of them, Ali Qoli Khan, cast off dependence and ruled as khan of an independent Maragheh. The Moqaddam khanate weathered the long succession wars, and in the early Qajar age Maragheh still numbered among Iran's ten largest cities, its caravans carrying silk, carpets, soap and raisins towards Tabriz.
zh:
马拉盖位于萨汉德山南麓水源丰足的河谷，临苏菲河，河水西流注入乌尔米耶湖。学界长期把它考定为古代阿特罗帕特尼的冬都弗拉阿塔；约642年，阿拉伯军队攻取此城。893年，萨吉德王公穆罕默德·伊本·艾比勒-萨吉以它为阿塞拜疆的都城，后来其弟优素福拆毁城墙，把治所迁往阿尔达比勒。1221年3月30日，蒙古名将哲别和速不台猛攻焚城；花剌子模沙札兰丁1225年一度收复，1231年蒙古最终确立统治。马拉盖的鼎盛期随之到来：巴格达陷落之后，旭烈兀看中这里凉爽的气候和丰美牧场而定为都城，1259年下令修建天文台，由纳西尔丁·图西主持——图西偶合模型和新星表都诞生于此，伊斯兰世界各地的学者云集城中。1312年，完者都任命曾在阿勒颇执掌大权的异密卡拉·松古儿为马拉盖长官，伊本·白图泰到访时听说此城有「小大马士革」之称；诗人奥哈迪1306年定居于此，1338年卒于城中。伊利汗国衰落之后，出班系和札剌亦儿系贵族瓜分了这一地区。1444年的马拉盖是黑羊王朝治下的城镇，山上天文台已成废墟，商人仍在这里经营葡萄、葡萄干、大理石和肥皂。

随着阿塞拜疆的大局，马拉盖先后从黑羊王朝转入白羊王朝之手，1501年又被伊斯玛仪沙的萨法维王朝兼并。阿拔斯沙在位时，把全省作为封邑授予贾万希尔部落穆卡丹支系的米尔·阿迦汗，其子孙在整个萨法维时代世袭统治马拉盖；城里的巴扎织造丝绸，染坊、熬皂业和干果贸易也使它声名远播。1724年奥斯曼军队攻陷此地，交由帖木儿帕夏管辖，直到穆卡丹首领哈桑·阿里·瓦基勒起兵，配合纳迪尔·库里的大军，于1729至1730年逐走土耳其人。随后登基为纳迪尔沙的他，在1730、1737和1744年三次确认穆卡丹家族的长官之位；1747年纳迪尔遇刺后，末任长官阿里·库里汗宣布独立，自称马拉盖汗。穆卡丹汗国捱过了此后漫长的王位混战，到恺加王朝初期，马拉盖仍是伊朗十大城市之一，商队满载丝绸、地毯、肥皂和葡萄干运往大不里士。

en:
Terek covers the middle reaches of the Terek, where the Caucasian foothills open into the Nogai steppe. In 1444 the riverbanks and winter pastures belonged to the political world of the Great Horde: Tatar and Nogai horsemen moved their flocks along the left bank, while Kabardian princes and highland communities guarded the fords leading into the mountains. The river watered herds and carried a road between the Volga, the Caspian shore and the Darial route, but no Russian fortress yet stood at Mozdok, then a wooded Kabardian tract.

As the Golden Horde split, Mahmud founded the Astrakhan Khanate in 1459, giving the lower Volga and Caspian steppe a new centre. After Russia conquered Astrakhan in 1556, its frontier moved toward the Terek: a Russian town built there in 1567 was abandoned under Ottoman pressure, but Volga Cossacks returned in 1577, beginning the Terek Cossack tradition. In 1759 Kurgoko Konchokin, a baptized prince of Lesser Kabardia, settled with his followers at Mozdok, and Russian troops built a fortress there in 1763. Volga Cossack villages were planted around it, Christian Ossetians and Kabardians were settled within, and Kabardian attempts to remove the fort in 1764 failed. From 1799 Mozdok's fairs drew Russian, Georgian, Armenian and Azerbaijani merchants, especially for Caucasian horses; linked by the fortified line to Kizlyar, the town became Russia's gateway toward Darial and Georgia.
zh:
捷列克位于捷列克河中游，是高加索山麓展入诺盖草原的交界地带。1444年时，河岸与冬牧场处在大帐的势力范围：鞑靼人和诺盖牧民在左岸驱赶畜群转场，卡巴尔达王公和高地村社则扼守通往山中的渡口。河水滋养牧群，也维系着连接伏尔加河、里海沿岸与达里亚尔通道的道路；此时莫兹多克还没有俄国要塞，只是卡巴尔达人的一片林地。

金帐汗国分裂后，马哈茂德于1459年建立阿斯特拉罕汗国，伏尔加河下游与里海草原由此有了新的中心。1556年俄国征服阿斯特拉罕后，边界推进到捷列克河：1567年俄国人在河畔建起城寨，后因奥斯曼压力放弃，1577年伏尔加哥萨克重返此地，开启了捷列克哥萨克的传统。1759年，小卡巴尔达受洗王公库尔戈科·孔乔金率部众定居莫兹多克，1763年俄军在此修筑要塞。伏尔加哥萨克村镇环绕要塞设立，信奉基督教的奥塞梯人和卡巴尔达人被迁入城内，卡巴尔达人1764年要求拆毁要塞的行动失败。从1799年起，莫兹多克集市吸引俄国、格鲁吉亚、亚美尼亚和阿塞拜疆商人，尤以高加索马匹贸易闻名；它通过堡垒线连接基兹利亚尔，成为俄国通向达里亚尔和格鲁吉亚的门户。

en:
Ilam is the mountain country west of the Luristan ridges, historically called Masabadhan and later Posht-e Kuh. Its oak heights, western plains and caravan tracks look toward Baghdad as well as Kermanshah and Khorramabad. After the Kurdish Annazids gave way, the western part of Little Luristan passed to the Khorshidi atabegs, while Southern Kurdish, Lur and Lak clans kept the seasonal pastures and fortified valleys. In 1444 these highlands stood on the Qara Qoyunlu frontier, where Turkoman imperial claims met the older authority of Lur atabegs and tribal khans.

Khorshidi rule lasted into the reign of Shah Abbas I. In 1597-98 Abbas's forces killed Shahverdi Khan at Changuleh and installed Husayn Khan Solvizi, beginning the Feyli vali line; its lords guarded the Ottoman frontier and paid tribute and musketeers to the Iranian court. When Evliya Çelebi crossed the country in 1655-56, he described Lorestan as ruled by its vali and independent of both Safavids and Ottomans. The name Feyli covered the Kurdish, Lur and Lak tribes under that house. The valis survived the Afsharid and Zand upheavals, and in the early nineteenth century Mohammad-Ali Mirza Dowlatshah, son of Fath-Ali Shah and governor of Kermanshah, took the eastern Pish-e Kuh lands, leaving Posht-e Kuh around Ilam to the old line. By 1821 Ilam was the centre of that remaining mountain government.
zh:
伊拉姆是洛雷斯坦山脊以西的山地，旧称马萨巴赞，后来称普什特库，意为山后。橡树林覆盖的高地、西部平原和商道既朝向巴格达，也连通克尔曼沙赫与霍拉马巴德。库尔德人的安纳兹王朝衰落后，小洛雷斯坦西部并入胡尔希迪阿塔贝格的领地，南库尔德、卢尔和拉克部落则仍掌握季节性牧场与设寨谷地。1444年，这片高地位于黑羊王朝边境，土库曼王朝的宗主权在这里与卢尔阿塔贝格和部落汗王的旧有权力相遇。

胡尔希迪人的统治延续到阿拔斯一世时代。1597年至1598年，阿拔斯的军队在昌古莱杀死沙韦尔迪汗，扶植侯赛因汗·索尔维齐，开启费利瓦利王朝；历代瓦利防守奥斯曼边界，向伊朗朝廷纳税并提供火枪手。1655年至1656年埃夫利亚·切莱比经过此地时，记载洛雷斯坦由本地瓦利统治，不受萨法维和奥斯曼支配。「费利」一名后来统指该家族治下的库尔德、卢尔和拉克部落。瓦利家族度过阿夫沙尔与桑德时期的动荡；19世纪初，法特赫-阿里沙之子、克尔曼沙赫总督穆罕默德-阿里·米尔扎·道拉特沙夺取东部皮什库，伊拉姆所在的普什特库仍留在旧家族手中。到1821年，伊拉姆已是这个残存山地政权的中心。

en:
Kermanshah commands one of the easiest caravan gaps between the Iranian plateau and Mesopotamia. Sasanian rulers kept it as a summer residence below the spring-fed rocks of Taq-e Bostan, before Hulagu's Mongols sacked the town in 1257. By 1444 it had become a contested market and fortress on the Persian Iraq frontier, lying between weakening Timurid power and Qara Qoyunlu-held Baghdad. Kalhor Kurdish clans dominated much of the countryside around Mahidasht and the tracks leading toward Khanaqin and Baghdad.

The Safavids fortified Kermanshah and used its Kurdish tribes as frontier guards. Kalhor power weakened through internal feuds and occasional Ottoman alliances, and under Shah Abbas I the Zangana became the court-favoured Kurdish tribe of the region. In 1640 Shaykh Ali Khan Zangana became their chief; he later governed Kermanshah for Shah Abbas II and served as grand vizier under Shah Soleyman. After the Safavid collapse the Ottomans held the city in 1723-1729 and 1731-1732, until Zangana and Kalhor forces recovered it for Nader Shah. In 1752-1753 Karim Khan Zand besieged the fortress to seize its armoury and secure western Iran, and later appointed Allahqoli Khan Zangana governor. Under early Qajar rule Fath-Ali Shah gave the city to his son Mohammad-Ali Mirza Dowlatshah, who developed Kermanshah as a western frontier command; an Ottoman attack was repulsed in the same reign.
zh:
克尔曼沙阿扼守伊朗高原通往美索不达米亚最便捷的商路山口之一。萨珊君主曾把这里作为夏宫，城上方是泉水涌出的塔格·博斯坦岩刻；1257年旭烈兀的蒙古军洗劫此城。到1444年，它已成为波斯伊拉克边境上几经争夺的市场与要塞，夹在势力衰退的帖木儿政权和据有巴格达的黑羊王朝之间。卡尔霍尔库尔德部落则控制着马哈伊达什特周边的大片乡村，以及通往哈奈根和巴格达的山路。

萨法维王朝加固克尔曼沙阿，并以当地库尔德部落戍守边界。卡尔霍尔人因内争和数次倒向奥斯曼而衰落，到阿拔斯一世时，赞加纳部落成为朝廷扶持的地区强权。1640年，谢赫阿里汗·赞加纳成为部落首领，后来受阿拔斯二世任命统治克尔曼沙赫，并在苏莱曼沙阿朝中出任大维齐尔。萨法维崩溃后，奥斯曼人两度占据该城，分别是1723年至1729年和1731年至1732年，最后由赞加纳与卡尔霍尔武装为纳迪尔沙收复。1752年至1753年，卡里姆汗·桑德围攻城塞以夺取军械库、巩固西伊朗，后来任命安拉库里汗·赞加纳为总督。卡扎尔王朝初期，法特赫-阿里沙把克尔曼沙赫交给儿子穆罕默德-阿里·米尔扎·道拉特沙；他扩建城市，将其经营为西部边镇，同一时期奥斯曼的一次进攻也被击退。

en:
Ardalan covers the cold high valleys of the central Zagros, where Kurdish clans grazed their flocks and wove the woollen cloth carried along the Kermanshah–Tabriz road. Its hereditary Ardalan dynasty, whose mirs claimed descent from Saladin, emerged toward the end of the Mongol era and made itself lord of Shahrizor; Gorani was the language of its court and poets. In 1444 the principality still stood on its own, ruling from the old seat of Hasanabad above the village of Sinna, and its princes played the Qara Qoyunlu and the Aq Qoyunlu off against each other.

The battle of Chaldiran in 1514 drew Ardalan into the long Ottoman–Safavid contest, and its mirs changed suzerains whenever it suited them, until in 1617, under Ahmad Khan, the emirate entered the Safavid Empire as the hereditary frontier province of Ardalan. In 1636–37 Soleyman Khan, the Safavid beglerbegi of Kurdistan, laid out the new capital of Sanandaj on the site of Sinna. The collapse of the Safavids left the country exposed: between 1721 and 1727 the Ottomans and their Kurdish allies overran the Ardalan domains, and the Baban withdrew only in 1730 as Nader Shah's army marched west; Nader and the Ottomans occupied Ardalan repeatedly in the wars that followed. In 1749 Karim Khan Zand stormed the principality and destroyed Sanandaj when its ruler Hasan Ali failed to make terms. The court recovered under Amanollah Khan, who reigned from 1797: Sanandaj became a busy market exporting carpets, oak galls, tragacanth and furs, and Gorani letters flourished under his patronage.
zh:
阿达兰地处扎格罗斯山脉中段的高寒山谷，库尔德氏族在此放牧，并织造毛料，沿克尔曼沙赫至大不里士的商道外运。世袭的阿达兰王朝自称出自萨拉丁一系，在蒙古时代末年崛起，成为沙赫拉佐尔的统治者，宫廷与诗人使用的语言是戈拉尼语。1444年，这个王公国仍然自立，以辛纳村上方的旧都哈桑阿巴德为治所，王公们在黑羊与白羊两强之间周旋自保。

1514年的恰尔德兰战役把阿达兰拖进奥斯曼与萨法维的长期争夺，米尔们随时势改换宗主；1617年艾哈迈德汗在位时，埃米尔国作为世袭的边疆省「阿达兰」并入萨法维帝国。1636至1637年，库尔德斯坦的萨法维贝格勒贝格苏莱曼汗在辛纳故地营建新都萨南达季。萨法维崩溃后国土洞开：1721至1727年间，奥斯曼及其库尔德盟友攻占阿达兰领地，1730年纳迪尔沙的军队西进，巴班人才撤走；此后的战争中，纳迪尔与奥斯曼又多次占领阿达兰。1749年，卡里姆汗·赞德攻入王公国，因统治者哈桑阿里未能谈和而摧毁萨南达季。1797年阿马努拉汗即位后宫廷复兴：萨南达季成为繁忙商市，出口地毯、五倍子、黄蓍胶和毛皮，在他庇护下戈拉尼语文学也盛极一时。

en:
Zanjan, called Zangan by medieval writers, lies in the valley of the Zanjan-chay on the road from Tabriz to central Iran. Arab forces took it in 645, and in the tenth century it was held by the Daylamite Musafirids. Under the Seljuks it was a flourishing market town on the east–west caravan road; in 1154 the philosopher Shihab al-Din al-Suhrawardi, founder of the school of Illumination, was born in the village of Suhraward nearby. The Mongols sacked it in 1230, but the Ilkhan Öljaitü later patronized the town, where Shia Islam now spread, and his new capital of Soltaniyeh next door drew its people away. Timur stormed it late in the fourteenth century, massacring the inhabitants and carrying off artisans to Samarkand, and in 1404 the Spanish envoy Clavijo found most of the town uninhabited, its walls beyond repair. In 1444 Zanjan was still a half-ruined town within the Qara Qoyunlu realm of Jahan Shah.

Recovery began under the Safavids, who rebuilt the town and its old walls and made Twelver Shi'ism the faith of its people. As late as the 1670s the French traveler Chardin saw the ruins of the old city stretching for more than a mile and heard how Timur had carried off its craftsmen. Under the Qajars, Fath-Ali Shah made Zanjan the seat of a new province named Khamseh, 'the Five', after its five river valleys, and the long covered bazaar was built as the market of the province.
zh:
赞詹在中世纪文献中称作「赞甘」，地处赞詹河谷，扼守大不里士通往伊朗中部的大道。645年阿拉伯军队攻占此地，10世纪时由德莱木人的穆萨菲里德王朝统治。塞尔柱时期，它是东西商道上繁荣的集镇；1154年，照明学派哲学的创立者希哈卜丁·苏赫拉瓦迪出生在附近的苏赫拉瓦迪村。1230年蒙古人洗劫该城，后来伊儿汗完者都加以经营，什叶派随之在此传播，而他在邻近营建新都苏丹尼耶，又使赞詹的人口流散。14世纪末帖木儿攻破此城，屠戮居民、把工匠掳往撒马尔罕；1404年西班牙使节克拉维约经过时，见城区大半无人居住，城墙已无法修复。1444年的赞詹仍是座半毁的城镇，处在贾汉沙的黑羊王朝版图内。

城市在萨法维时期开始复苏：城镇与旧城墙得到重建，十二伊玛目派成为居民的信仰。迟至1670年代，法国旅行家夏尔丹仍见到旧城废墟绵延一英里有余，并听当地人讲述帖木儿掳走工匠之事。卡扎尔王朝的法塔赫-阿里沙将赞詹设为新省「哈姆塞」（意为「五」，得名于境内五条河谷）的首府，长长的有顶大巴扎也在此时建成，成为全省的集市。

en:
Qom stands on the Qom River, along the road linking Ray with Kashan and Isfahan. Fatima Masumeh died here in 816 or 817 while travelling to Khurasan, and her shrine turned a war-battered market town into one of the oldest centres of Shia learning, drawing pilgrims, Alid families and madrasa students. Mongol forces destroyed the city in 1224, and Timur's army sacked it and massacred inhabitants late in the fourteenth century. In 1444 Qom was Persian-speaking and Shia, nominally within Shah Rukh's Timurid empire while northern Iran was governed around Ray by his grandson Sultan Muhammad ibn Baysunghur. Pilgrimage, more than princely power, sustained its recovery.

Shah Rukh died near Ray in 1447 while marching against Sultan Muhammad, and the succession wars opened western Iran to the Qara Qoyunlu; by 1453 Timurid heirs had been driven from the region, which later passed to the Aq Qoyunlu. Safavid rule transformed Qom: by 1503 it was a major Shia theological centre, and in 1519 Tajlu Khanum, wife of Shah Ismail I, improved drainage around the shrine and rebuilt the tomb chamber as a domed octagon with an iwan and two minarets. Abbas I later presented books to its seminary library, and Safavid royals were buried near the sanctuary. Afghan invasion, followed by Afsharid and Zand conflicts, damaged and impoverished the city. Agha Muhammad Khan Qajar secured Qom in 1793; Fath-Ali Shah then repaired the shrine and gilded its dome, opening a Qajar revival before 1821.
zh:
库姆位于库姆河畔，处在雷伊通往卡尚和伊斯法罕的道路上。法蒂玛·玛苏玛在前往呼罗珊途中于816或817年卒于此地，她的圣陵使这座屡遭兵燹的集镇成为最古老的什叶派学术中心之一，吸引着朝圣者、阿里家族和经学院学生。1224年蒙古军摧毁库姆，14世纪末帖木儿的军队又洗劫城市并屠杀居民。1444年的库姆通行波斯语、信奉什叶派，名义上仍在沙哈鲁的帖木儿帝国内，北伊朗则由沙哈鲁之孙苏丹·穆罕默德·伊本·拜宋豁儿以雷伊为中心统辖。维系城市复苏的，主要是朝圣而非王权。

1447年，沙哈鲁在征讨苏丹·穆罕默德途中死于雷伊附近，继承战争使西伊朗门户大开；到1453年，帖木儿后裔已被逐出这一地区，库姆随后又随阿贾姆伊拉克转入白羊王朝之手。萨法维王朝改变了库姆的命运：到1503年，它已是重要的什叶派神学中心；1519年，伊斯玛仪一世之妻塔吉卢·哈努姆整治圣陵排水，并把墓室重建为带拱门回廊和两座宣礼塔的八角穹顶建筑。阿拔斯一世后来向经学院图书馆赠书，萨法维王族也安葬在圣陵周边。阿富汗入侵以及随后的阿夫沙尔、赞德战乱使库姆遭到破坏并陷入贫困。1793年，阿迦·穆罕默德汗·卡扎尔取得库姆；法特赫-阿里沙阿随后修复圣陵并为穹顶贴金，在1821年前开启了卡扎尔时期的复兴。

en:
The Astarabad plain is the south-eastern corner of the Caspian, the ancient Hyrcania, where the road from Sari goes on to Khorasan. The Sasanians raised the Great Wall of Gorgan across it against the steppe nomads, and medieval Jurjan, a city of silks and scholars, was ruined in the Mongol storm, after which Astarabad took its place and dealt in raw silk and woven stuffs. It was already a Shia town when the mystic Fazlallah Astarabadi, founder of the Hurufi sect, was born here in the fourteenth century; he was executed in 1394. In 1444 Astarabad was a Timurid march under the successors of Shah Rukh, its garrisons facing the Turkmen and Uzbek steppe beyond the Kopet Dag.

In 1458 the Qara Qoyunlu seized Herat but withdrew under treaty, and Astarabad passed with Khorasan to Abu Sa'id Mirza of Samarkand. Early in the next century the Uzbeks overran it, until Shah Ismail drove out their governor in 1510. Under the Safavids it became the chief seat of the Qajar Turkmens, Qoyunlu and Develu, marcher-lords who held the frontier against raiding Turkmen of the steppe. Nader Shah's chief secretary and historian, Mirza Mehdi Khan Astarabadi, was born here, and when Nader's empire collapsed the Qajar chief Mohammad Hasan Khan held the city as his own from 1749; his son Agha Mohammad Khan, born in Astarabad in 1742, repaired its walls, crushed Turkmen raiders, and in December 1781 turned a banquet there into a trap for the Russian commander Voinovich, who was fortifying the island of Ashurada – the Russians agreed to withdraw. Called Dar al-Mu'minin, the 'abode of the faithful', Astarabad entered the Qajar century a city of sayyids, bazaars and frontier arms.
zh:
阿斯塔拉巴德平原位于里海东南角，即古代的希尔卡尼亚，从萨里通往呼罗珊的道路经过这里。萨珊人曾在此修筑戈尔甘长城，抵御草原游牧部族；中世纪的朱尔坚是丝绸与学者之城，在蒙古风暴中化为废墟，阿斯塔拉巴德随后取而代之，经营生丝和丝织品。14世纪，胡鲁菲教派的创立者、神秘主义者法兹卢拉·阿斯塔拉巴迪出生于此，他于1394年被处死，那时这里已是一座什叶派城市。1444年，阿斯塔拉巴德是沙哈鲁继承者治下的帖木儿边镇，守军面对的是科佩特山外土库曼人与乌兹别克人的草原。

1458年黑羊王朝攻占赫拉特后依约撤军，阿斯塔拉巴德随呼罗珊归入撒马尔罕的阿布·赛义德·米尔扎之手。16世纪初乌兹别克人席卷此地，直到1510年伊斯玛仪一世赶走他们的总督。萨法维时期，这里成为卡扎尔土库曼人（科云卢与德韦卢两支）的主要聚居地，这些边地领主镇守边城，抵御草原土库曼人的劫掠。纳迪尔沙的首席秘书兼史官米尔扎·迈赫迪汗·阿斯塔拉巴迪出生于此；纳迪尔帝国崩溃后，卡扎尔酋长穆罕默德·哈桑汗从1749年起割据阿斯塔拉巴德，1742年出生在该城的儿子阿迦·穆罕默德汗修缮城墙、镇压土库曼劫掠者，又在1781年12月以一场宴席诱捕了正在阿舒拉代岛筑垒的俄国舰长沃伊诺维奇，俄国人随后同意撤离。阿斯塔拉巴德素有「达尔·穆米宁」（信徒之地）之称，进入卡扎尔世纪时，它是一座圣裔云集、市集繁华的武装边城。

en:
Qazvin stands on a cold, dry plain south of the Alborz, where the roads from Tehran, Tabriz and the Caspian meet. The Sasanian king Shapur II planted it as a garrison against the Daylamite highlanders, and in 644 the Arab commander al-Bara' ibn Azib took it; Harun al-Rashid ordered a wall that was finished only in 868. Nasir-i Khusraw in 1046 found a strongly walled city of bazaars and gardens, short of water from a single kariz. The Mongols massacred its people in 1220, and Turkic families then settled among the mostly Sunni Shafi'i population. Timurid times brought repeated plunder, and in 1444 Qazvin was a quiet, diminished town within the Qara Qoyunlu realm.

Ismail I's Safavids valued its position between the Ottoman and Uzbek fronts, and in 1546 Tahmasp I moved his court and capital from exposed Tabriz to Qazvin, styled dar al-saltana. For half a century it was the seat of the Safavid state: Tahmasp laid out the royal garden and the Chehel Sotun pavilion, and Ismail II in 1576 and Abbas I in 1587 were enthroned there. English Muscovy Company merchants – Jenkinson in 1561, Edwards in 1567 – reached its markets through Russia, while the ulama pressed Twelver Shi'ism on a city that had long been Sunni. In 1598 Abbas I carried the capital away to Isfahan.

Plague struck in 1635, and Chardin in the 1670s counted 12,000 houses and perhaps 100,000 people. The city surrendered to the Afghans under Aman Allah Khan in 1722, but on 8 January 1723 its people rose in the lutibazar revolt, killed some 2,000 Afghans and drove the rest out; an Ottoman garrison admitted in 1726 was expelled as well. Jonas Hanway in 1744 heard that the houses had dwindled from 12,000 to 1,100. With the Qajar peace Qazvin revived as the 'mart of all the commerce of the Caspian', the junction of the Tabriz, Anzali and Tehran roads, weaving velvets, brocades and cotton cloth.
zh:
加兹温位于厄尔布尔士山脉南麓寒冷干燥的平原上，德黑兰、大不里士与里海三个方向的道路在此交会。萨珊国王沙普尔二世为抵御德莱木山民而在此设立军镇；644年，阿拉伯将领巴拉·伊本·阿齐布攻占此地，哈伦·拉希德下令修筑的城墙直到868年才完工。1046年路过的纳赛尔·霍斯鲁见到一座城墙坚固、市集与花园遍布的好城市，只是全靠一条坎儿井供水。1220年蒙古人屠戮居民，此后不少突厥家族在以逊尼派沙斐仪教徒为主的居民中定居。帖木儿时期此地屡遭劫掠，1444年的加兹温是黑羊王朝境内一座平静而衰落的城镇。

萨法维的伊斯玛仪一世看重它介于奥斯曼与乌兹别克两线之间的位置，1546年塔赫玛斯普一世把宫廷和首都从易受攻击的大不里士迁到加兹温，上尊号「达尔·苏丹纳」（意为王城）。此后半个世纪这里是萨法维国家的中枢：塔赫玛斯普辟建皇家花园与四十柱宫，伊斯玛仪二世1576年、阿拔斯一世1587年都在此登基。莫斯科公司的英国商人——1561年的詹金森、1567年的爱德华兹——经俄罗斯来到这里的市集，宗教学者们则在这座久奉逊尼派的城市推行十二伊玛目派。1598年阿拔斯一世迁都伊斯法罕。

1635年瘟疫来袭；1670年代夏尔丹到访时，统计有1.2万户、约10万居民。1722年城市向阿曼·阿拉汗的阿富汗军队投降，但1723年1月8日市民发动「卢蒂巴扎」起义，杀死约两千名阿富汗人，把残部逐出城外；1726年放进来的奥斯曼守军也同样被赶走。1744年乔纳斯·汉威听说这里的住户已从1.2万户跌到1100户。卡扎尔时期和平恢复，加兹温作为「里海全部贸易的商埠」再度繁荣，成为大不里士、安扎利与德黑兰道路的交会处，织造丝绒、织锦和棉布。

en:
Semnan lies where the southern Alborz descend toward the Dasht-e Kavir, on the road between Ray and Damghan. Medieval geographers placed it on the shifting border of Tabaristan, Ray and Qumis; some counted it in Qumis, others in Ray. Caravans used its wells and markets, and the town kept the memory of Ala al-Dawla Semnani, a local Sufi who served the Ilkhan Arghun before returning to found khanqahs and dying near Semnan in 1336. Mongol and Timurid armies had ravaged the district. In 1444 Semnan was a Sunni, Persian-speaking road town in the northern Iranian lands of Shah Rukh's Timurid empire, administered around Ray by the prince Sultan Muhammad ibn Baysunghur.

After Shah Rukh died near Ray in 1447, the route was caught in Timurid, Qara Qoyunlu and Aq Qoyunlu succession wars. During the Aq Qoyunlu collapse, Kiya Husayn II seized Ray and Semnan. In 1504 Shah Ismail I overthrew him, taking Firuzkuh and the neighboring mountain strongholds after sieges and bringing the Semnan district under Safavid rule; the town was rebuilt and brought into the Twelver Shia order. The Zand ruler Karim Khan later entrusted Semnan and the neighboring Qumis towns to Qajar chiefs. When Karim Khan died in 1779, Agha Muhammad Khan gathered tribal followers in Komesh and used the district as a base on the road from Tehran to Mashhad. After 1797 Fath-Ali Shah appointed Zolfiqar Khan Sangsari governor of Semnan, and Qajar estates and fortifications made the old caravan route more secure.
zh:
塞姆南位于厄尔布尔士山南麓向卡维尔盐漠过渡之处，坐落在雷伊与达姆甘之间的道路上。中世纪地理学家把它放在塔巴里斯坦、雷伊和库密斯不断变动的交界；有人将它算入库密斯，也有人将它归入雷伊。商队使用这里的水井和市集，城镇也保留着苏非行者阿拉·道拉·塞姆纳尼的记忆，他曾效力于伊儿汗阿鲁浑，后来退回家乡修建道堂，并于1336年在塞姆南附近去世。蒙古和帖木儿军队都曾蹂躏这一带。1444年的塞姆南是逊尼派、说波斯语的道路城镇，位于沙哈鲁帖木儿帝国的北伊朗领地，由以雷伊为中心的宗王苏丹·穆罕默德·伊本·拜宋豁儿统辖。

1447年沙哈鲁死于雷伊附近后，这条道路又卷入帖木儿、黑羊王朝和白羊王朝的继承战争。白羊王朝瓦解时，基亚·侯赛因二世攻占雷伊和塞姆南。1504年，伊斯玛仪一世推翻了他，经围攻拿下菲鲁兹库赫及附近山地要塞，把塞姆南一带纳入萨法维治下；城市得到重建，并被纳入十二伊玛目派什叶派秩序。赞德统治者卡里姆汗后来把塞姆南和邻近的库密斯城镇交给卡扎尔部首领管辖。1779年卡里姆汗死后，阿迦·穆罕默德汗在库密斯聚集部众，把这里当作德黑兰通往马什哈德道路上的基地。1797年后，法特赫-阿里沙阿任命佐勒菲卡尔汗·桑格萨里为塞姆南长官，卡扎尔贵族的庄园和防务也使这条古老商路更加安稳。

en:
Yasuj is a high valley of the central Zagros, hard by the Persian Gates, the pass through which Alexander's army forced its way into the Persian heartland in 331 BC. The upland meadows were summer grazing from the Bronze Age, and in the Middle Ages the district formed part of Greater Lur, ruled from Idaj in the lowlands by the Hazaraspid atabegs; when the Timurid Shahrukh overthrew their last lord, Ghiyath al-Din, in 1424, the mountain valleys fell back under their own Luri khans. In 1444 the Boyer-Ahmad clans moved their flocks each year between the cold highlands and the lowland garmsir and wove the kilims and jajim cloth of the Zagros tribes, while there was no town here worth naming; the chiefs of Upper Boyer-Ahmad kept their seat at Tall Khosrow.

At the end of the fifteenth century the Arab Musha'sha of Hoveyzeh, at the height of their power, raided as far as Kohgiluyeh. The Safavids organized the highland as the district of Kuhgiluyeh under its own governor, whose military authority after 1632 extended over the lowland towns of Arabestan, Shushtar and Dezful, and who in 1663 secured the restoration of his own candidate as vali of Hoveyzeh. The pastures on the Qashqai frontier kept the Boyer-Ahmad clans in running feuds with their Turkic neighbours. After Nader Shah's murder in 1747 the khans of the southern Lur went their own way through the Zand and early Qajar years, and the valley of Yasuj remained nomad country until Ardakan traders began wintering there in the later Qajar period.
zh:
亚苏季是扎格罗斯山中段的一处高谷，紧挨波斯门——公元前331年亚历山大的军队正是从这道关隘强行突入波斯腹地。早在青铜时代，这里的高山草甸就是夏季牧场；中世纪时，本区属于大洛雷斯坦，由驻跸低地伊达季的哈扎尔阿思普阿塔贝格王朝统治。1424年帖木儿王公沙哈鲁推翻末代君主吉亚斯丁后，山谷重新回到本地卢尔汗王的治下。1444年，布叶尔艾哈迈德各部每年赶着畜群在寒冷高地与低地加尔姆西尔之间转场，编织扎格罗斯诸部通行的基利姆毯和贾吉姆粗呢；这一带还没有像样的城镇，上布叶尔艾哈迈德首领的驻帐设在塔勒霍斯鲁。

15世纪末，霍韦伊泽的阿拉伯穆沙沙政权极盛时兵锋远达科吉卢耶。萨法维王朝把这片山地编为科吉卢耶区，各设长官治理；1632年以后，科吉卢耶长官的军权还覆盖阿拉伯斯坦、舒什塔尔和迪兹富勒等低地城市，1663年又正是经他运作，属意的候选人才得以重回霍韦伊泽的瓦利之位。毗邻卡什凯人的牧场，让布叶尔艾哈迈德各部与东邻的突厥语部落世代仇杀。1747年纳迪尔沙遇刺后，南卢尔诸汗在桑德王朝和卡扎尔初年各自为政，亚苏季谷地始终是游牧人的天下，直到卡扎尔时代后期才有阿尔达坎商人来此冬居。

en:
Shiraz lies on a fertile Fars plain beneath the Zagros, with roads running south toward the Persian Gulf ports. The Buyids made it a capital, and its poets, scholars and gardens earned it the name House of Knowledge; Sa'di and Hafez were both born here. It escaped Mongol destruction by submission and came to terms with Timur in 1382. In 1444 Abdullah Mirza, grandson of Shah Rukh, was in his ninth year as Timurid governor of Fars, and Shiraz painters and calligraphers were still producing fine manuscripts, including a Shahnama copied that year. Its vines, gardens and bazaars tied the city to trade with Bushehr and other southern ports.

Shah Rukh's death in 1447 opened a succession war in which Abdullah Mirza lost Fars; around 1452 Jahan Shah's Qara Qoyunlu overran western Iran. Shah Ismail I's Safavid army captured Shiraz in 1504, and under Abbas the Great, Governor Emam Qoli Khan adorned the provincial capital with palaces and gardens. After the Safavid collapse, Afghan raids and a revolt against Nader Shah ended in a long siege and sack; by Nader's murder in 1747 many monuments were ruined and the city had about 50,000 people. Karim Khan Zand made Shiraz his capital in 1762, employing more than 12,000 workers on an arg, congregational mosque, covered bazaar, walls, moat and irrigation works. Agha Mohammad Khan Qajar took the city in 1792, dismantled its fortifications and moved Iran's capital to Tehran, though Shiraz remained a rich provincial market on the Gulf roads.
zh:
设拉子坐落在扎格罗斯山下法尔斯的肥沃平原上，道路向南通往波斯湾各港。白益王朝曾以此为都，诗人、学者和花园为它赢得「知识之府」的名号，萨迪和哈菲兹都出生于此。它因臣服而躲过蒙古破坏，又在1382年与帖木儿达成和议。1444年，沙哈鲁之孙阿卜杜拉·米尔扎正担任帖木儿王朝的法尔斯总督，这是他任职的第九年；设拉子画家和书法家仍在制作精美写本，其中包括一部当年抄成的《列王纪》。葡萄园、花园和集市把城市同布歇尔等南方港口的贸易连接起来。

1447年沙哈鲁之死引发继承战争，阿卜杜拉·米尔扎最终失去法尔斯；约1452年，贾汗·沙阿的黑羊王朝席卷伊朗西部。沙阿·伊斯玛仪一世的萨法维军队1504年攻占设拉子；阿拔斯大帝在位时，总督伊玛目·库里汗用宫殿和花园装点这座行省首府。萨法维王朝崩溃后，阿富汗袭扰加上当地总督反叛纳迪尔沙阿，使设拉子遭到长期围攻和洗劫；到1747年纳迪尔沙阿遇刺时，许多建筑已经残破，城中约有五万居民。卡里姆汗·赞德1762年以设拉子为都，动用一万两千多名工人修建城堡、聚礼清真寺、有顶集市、城墙、护城河和灌溉设施。阿迦·穆罕默德汗·卡扎尔1792年攻下此城，拆除防御工事并把伊朗都城迁往德黑兰，但设拉子仍是波斯湾商路上富庶的行省市场。

en:
Bandar Langeh is a roadstead on the hot Arab coast west of Hormuz, with the older anchorage of Kong close by. Gulf dhows sailed these waters for India and the pearl banks, and a ruined old port named Lenge nearby had once been held by the Portuguese; through Safavid times Langeh itself was no more than a fishing village of Huwala Arabs in huts of cane and palm leaf, which the French traveller Abbé Carré still found in 1674. A Dutch report of 1764 counted fifty craft and seven hundred men there, most of them living from carrying firewood and charcoal about the gulf. In the fifteenth century its boats shared in the carrying trade ruled from Hormuz, while the governors of Lar on the plateau claimed the inland tributes.

The Portuguese made Kong one of their gulf stations, with an anchorage and a fort by the water. After Nader Shah's murder in 1747 the coast slipped from every hand: the Qawasem Arabs of Julfar made Lengeh their base, backing Naser Khan Lari of Lar, who besieged the town without success in 1760. Their raids on Qeshm in 1765, 1773 and 1777 were beaten back by Sheikh Mohammad Khan Bastaki of Bandar Abbas, who nevertheless let them settle at Lengeh and Lashtan as his revenue tenants. In the 1790s they took up the Wahhabi cause and joined raids on Muscat, until in 1809 an expedition from Lar harried the coast and the British Bombay Marine burned twenty of their vessels at anchor. Lengeh entered the nineteenth century with its pearl fishers and its caravan road to Lar, poised to become the gulf's pearl market.
zh:
班达尔兰格（伦格港）是霍尔木兹以西炎热的阿拉伯海岸上的一处锚地，旁边便是更古老的孔格港。海湾的帆船经此往来印度航线与珍珠渔场，附近一座已毁的老港伦格曾被葡萄牙人占据；整个萨非时期，兰格不过是胡瓦拉阿拉伯人的渔村，屋舍用芦苇和棕榈叶搭成，法国旅人卡雷神父1674年见到的仍是这番景象。1764年的一份荷兰报告清点出当地有五十艘大小船只、七百名男丁，多数人靠把柴薪和木炭贩运到海湾各处为生。15世纪里，它的小船依附霍尔木兹掌控的转运贸易，高原上的拉尔总督则向内陆索取贡赋。

葡萄牙人把孔格当作他们在海湾的据点之一，在水边修建了锚地和要塞。1747年纳迪尔沙遇刺后，海岸陷入权力真空：朱尔法的卡瓦西姆阿拉伯人以兰格为基地，支持拉尔的纳赛尔汗·拉里，后者1760年围攻兰格却无功而返。1765、1773和1777年，他们三次袭掠格什姆岛，都被阿巴斯港总督谢赫·穆罕默德汗·巴斯塔基击退；后者最终准许他们留居兰格和拉什坦，充当他的包税人。1790年代，他们改奉瓦哈比派，参与对马斯喀特的袭击；1809年，拉尔出兵进剿海岸，英国孟买海军也在兰格港焚毁了他们的二十艘船只。进入19世纪时，兰格拥有采珠船队和通往拉尔的商路，正站在成为海湾珍珠贸易中心的门槛上。

en:
Bam is a date-palm oasis on the edge of the Dasht-e Lut, where qanats support cotton fields and a great adobe fortress on the roads from Kerman toward Sistan, Makran and Kandahar. The citadel's core took shape in the Parthian and Sasanian periods, and between the 7th and 11th centuries Bam grew wealthy as a Silk Road junction making silk and cotton clothing. Muslim geographers described busy bazaars, fine durable cotton cloth, palm groves and walls that seemed almost impregnable. From 1240 to 1363 the oasis flourished under its Mongol-era Khitan rulers, who kept it on the spice and silk routes. In 1444 Bam was a small Sunni Muslim frontier place in the Timurid Empire, where oasis markets met Baluchi pastoral country.

Safavid rule between 1502 and 1722 gave Bam a long interval of security, and the citadel was expanded with new quarters and the Four Seasons Palace. Mahmud Hotak's Afghan invasion overturned that order: his forces took Kerman and Bam before moving on Isfahan in 1722, and the old walled city was largely abandoned. Bam was gradually resettled but remained a sensitive eastern stronghold against Afghan and Baluchi raids. In 1794 tribal leaders from Bam and Narmashir gave the last Zand ruler, Lotf Ali Khan, about a thousand horsemen for his campaign against the Qajars. After Kerman fell, he fled back to Bam, whose ruler arrested him and handed him to Agha Mohammad Khan. Under Qajar rule the old citadel served mainly as a fortress and garrison while settlement spread outside its walls.
zh:
巴姆是卢特沙漠边缘的椰枣绿洲，坎儿井滋养着棉田，也托起一座巨大的土坯城堡；此地位于克尔曼通往锡斯坦、莫克兰和坎大哈的道路上。城堡核心在帕提亚和萨珊时期成形，7至11世纪间，巴姆作为丝绸之路交汇点，因生产丝绸和棉布衣物而繁荣。穆斯林地理学家记下这里繁忙的巴扎、结实精美的棉布、椰枣林和看似难以攻破的城墙。1240年至1363年，绿洲在蒙古时代的契丹统治者治下继续兴盛，保持在香料路和丝绸路上的位置。1444年，巴姆是帖木儿帝国境内一座小型逊尼派边疆据点，绿洲市集与俾路支人的游牧地域在此相接。

1502年至1722年的萨法维统治给巴姆带来长期安定，城堡得到扩建，新增城区并修建四季宫。马哈茂德·霍塔克的阿富汗入侵打破了这一秩序：他的军队在1722年进兵伊斯法罕前攻占克尔曼和巴姆，旧城墙内的城市因而大半废弃。巴姆后来逐渐有人重新定居，但仍是防备阿富汗和俾路支袭掠的东部要冲。1794年，巴姆和纳尔马什尔的部落首领向末代赞德统治者卢特夫·阿里汗提供约一千名骑兵，支持他对抗卡扎尔人。克尔曼陷落后，他逃回巴姆，却被当地统治者擒获并交给阿迦·穆罕默德汗。卡扎尔统治时期，旧城堡主要作为要塞和驻军营地，居民点则在城墙外扩展。

en:
Mashhad began as Sanabad, a Silk Road village near Tus, and owes its fame to a grave: in 818 the eighth Shia imam, Ali al-Rida, died at the camp of the caliph al-Ma'mun and was buried beside Harun al-Rashid. The sanctuary that rose over the tomb gave the town its name, Mashhad, 'place of martyrdom'. The Mongol storm of 1220 spared the shrine, and refugees from ruined Khurasan made it prosper; Ibn Battuta in 1333 found a large town of domes and tiled walls. When Miran Shah sacked neighbouring Tus in 1389, its surviving people moved here, and Mashhad took Tus's place as capital of the district. Under the Timurids it became one of the chief cities of Shah Rukh's realm, and in 1418 his wife Goharshad founded beside the shrine the mosque named after her. In 1444, as the ageing emperor lay ailing at Herat, Mashhad lived by its pilgrim caravans, its bazaars and colleges clustered around the domed sanctuary.

After Shah Rukh's death in 1447 the Timurid princes' wars washed over Khurasan; Mashhad fell to Abul-Qasim Babur in 1449, and in 1458 Jahan Shah's Qara Qoyunlu army overran the province and held Herat for six months before a peace left Mashhad to Abu Sa'id Mirza of Samarkand. The Uzbeks under Muhammad Shaybani took the city in 1507, and though Shah Tahmasp recovered it in 1528, the Shaybanid Abd al-Mu'min forced it to surrender in 1589 after a four-month siege. Shah Abbas I, who had lived in Mashhad as a young prince, retook it in 1598, drove the Uzbeks beyond the Oxus and walked on pilgrimage from Isfahan to the shrine, endowing the madrasas around it. Nader Shah made the city his capital, and his tomb was raised there after his murder in 1747; his blind grandson Shahrokh then held a shrunken Afsharid state at Mashhad until Agha Mohammad Khan Qajar conquered Khurasan in 1796 and had him tortured and killed. The last Afsharid prince, Nader Mirza, seized the city back in 1797 and beat off two Qajar armies, but a third campaign took Mashhad in May 1802 and he was executed in Tehran in April 1803. In 1821 it was a Qajar provincial city whose wealth still came up the pilgrim roads.
zh:
马什哈德原名萨纳巴德，是图斯附近丝绸之路上的一座村庄，它的声名来自一座陵墓：818年，什叶派第八任伊玛目阿里·礼萨在哈里发马蒙的营中去世，葬在哈伦·拉希德墓旁。陵上建起的圣祠使城镇得名马什哈德，意为「殉道之地」。1220年蒙古风暴中圣祠得以保全，呼罗珊诸城的难民纷纷来投，城镇随之繁盛；1333年伊本·白图泰见到的已是一座遍布穹顶与彩砖城墙的大城。1389年米兰沙洗劫邻近的图斯，幸存者迁居于此，马什哈德遂取代图斯成为这一区的首府。帖木儿王朝时期，它成为沙哈鲁治下最重要的城市之一，1418年王后高哈儿绍德在圣祠旁敕建后来以她为名的大清真寺。1444年，年迈的皇帝在赫拉特缠绵病榻，马什哈德靠朝圣商队为生，集市与经学院环聚在穹顶圣祠四周。

1447年沙哈鲁死后，帖木儿王公们的战争席卷呼罗珊：马什哈德1449年落入阿布勒-卡西姆·巴布尔之手，1458年札罕沙的黑羊军队横扫全省、占领赫拉特六个月，最终议和，马什哈德归撒马尔罕的阿布·赛义德·米尔扎。昔班尼汗率乌兹别克人1507年攻占此城，塔赫玛斯普一世1528年将其收复，1589年昔班尼宗室阿卜杜勒·穆明围城四个月后又迫其投降。年轻时曾在马什哈德居住的阿拔斯一世1598年收复此城，把乌兹别克人逐过阿姆河，并从伊斯法罕徒步前来朝觐，还为圣祠周围的经学院广施捐赐。纳迪尔沙以此城为都，1747年遇刺后安葬于此；他的盲孙沙哈鲁克此后在马什哈德维持着一个版图大缩的阿夫沙尔小朝廷，直到1796年阿迦·穆罕默德汗·恺加征服呼罗珊，将他酷刑处死。末代阿夫沙尔王公纳迪尔·米尔扎1797年夺回马什哈德，两度击退恺加军队，但1802年5月第三波攻势攻陷城池，他本人于1803年4月在德黑兰被处死。1821年的马什哈德是恺加王朝的一座省城，它的财富仍随朝圣之路源源而来。

en:
Ardakan lies sixty kilometres north-west of Yazd, where the last palm groves and qanat-watered fields give way to the central desert. Its older name Artakan means 'place of righteousness' in Middle Persian, and tradition holds that its founders were Zoroastrians; the ruined site of Zardug preserves dwellings of the eleventh and twelfth centuries, while the nucleus of the present town was laid out in the fourteenth. Its walled quarters, cisterns and wind-catchers served caravans on the road between Yazd and Khurasan, and the neighbouring villages of Sharifabad and Torkabad kept Zoroastrian fire temples and their priests. In 1444 Ardakan belonged to Shah Rukh's Timurid empire, a quiet Sunni market town on the desert road, beneath mountains that hold the Zoroastrian shrine of Pir-e Sabz at Chak Chak.

The town's Friday Mosque and the Zirdeh Mosque were built in the sixteenth century, in the Safavid age when Yazd turned to Shia Islam while its Zoroastrian community endured. From the late fifteenth century Parsi emissaries from India came to consult the priests of Sharifabad, an exchange of questions and rulings that continued for three hundred years. At Kharanaq, a day's journey east, Shah Abbas I restored the ancient caravan station and its cisterns. Ardakan was famed for sesame halvah and for the pistachio and pomegranate orchards watered by its qanats. From the Afsharid period onward the town was counted part of the province of Yazd, and so it remained throughout Qajar rule.
zh:
阿尔达坎位于亚兹德西北六十公里，地处最后的椰枣园和坎儿井灌区与中部大漠交界之处。其旧名阿尔塔坎在中古波斯语中意为「正直之地」，相传建城者是琐罗亚斯德教徒；废弃的扎尔杜格遗址留有11至12世纪的民居，而今日城市的核心奠定于14世纪。带围墙的街区、蓄水池和风塔服务于往来亚兹德与呼罗珊道上的商队，附近的沙里夫阿巴德、托尔卡巴德等村落世代守护着琐罗亚斯德教火庙与祭司。1444年，阿尔达坎属沙哈鲁治下的帖木儿帝国，是沙漠商道上一座安静的逊尼派集镇，镇外群山中便有恰克恰克的皮尔·萨布兹琐罗亚斯德教圣所。

16世纪，即萨法维王朝统治波斯的时代，本地的聚礼清真寺和齐尔代清真寺先后建成，亚兹德一带改奉什叶派，而当地的琐罗亚斯德教徒社群仍然存续。自15世纪末起，印度的帕西人使者前来向沙里夫阿巴德的祭司请教教义，这种问答往来延续了三百年。向东一日路程的哈拉纳格，古商站及蓄水池由阿拔斯沙阿下令重修。阿尔达坎以芝麻糖闻名，坎儿井浇灌出开心果和石榴园。自阿夫沙尔王朝起，此地并入亚兹德省，整个卡扎尔王朝时期都隶属该省。

en:
Larestan is the sun-baked corridor of southern Fars between the Shiraz plateau and the gulf ports, and its walled town of Lar stands on the caravan road from Hormuz. Sunni princes of the Miladian dynasty ruled it from a dragon-shaped castle old in Sasanian times, keeping out of the plateau's wars while levying customs on every caravan between the island emporium and the inland cities; their silver lari was the preferred coin of Persian Gulf trade from the fifteenth century into the seventeenth. Ibn Battuta, passing through in 1330, found gardens and crowded markets, and Lar's merchants — among them a Jewish community later strengthened by Sephardic exiles from Hormuz — dealt in sulphur, metals and Indian goods. Timur's grandson Muhammad Sultan raided the Lar-Jahrom road in 1396-97, yet in 1444 the Miladian prince still sat at Lar, grown rich on Hormuz's carrying trade.

His successors tested Hormuz itself: a fleet of sixty vessels sent in 1498 was destroyed and its admiral Abu Bakr Lari killed, and a landing on Qeshm failed in 1505. From 1508 the princes acknowledged the Safavid shah but kept their autonomy and coinage and fought the Portuguese for the coast for decades, until Shah Abbas's general Allahverdi Khan ended the dynasty after a long siege completed in 1015 AH (1606-07); the last prince died in his besieged fort, Lar became crown land, and its Qaysariyya bazaar was copied for the great bazaar of Isfahan. Around 1700 a European visitor found its foundries casting the best cannons in all Persia, and Lar's sulphur reached the Portuguese through Jewish brokers. Through the seventeenth century Lari merchants settled across Bahrain, Kuwait and the Arab shores, and in the wars after Nader Shah's death Lar's governor Naser Khan Lari was a power on the coast in his own right.
zh:
拉雷斯坦是法尔斯南部连接设拉子高原与海湾港口的炎热走廊，城墙环绕的拉尔城正处在霍尔木兹通向内陆的商道上。逊尼派的米拉德王朝王公据守一座萨珊时代便已存在的龙形古堡统治此地，置身高原诸强的战争之外，向每一支往来海岛商都与内陆城市的商队征收关税；他们铸造的银币「拉里」在15至17世纪是波斯湾贸易最通行的货币。伊本·白图泰1330年（伊斯兰历730年）经过时，见到的是果园连绵、市集拥挤的景象；拉尔商人经营硫磺、五金和印度货，城中的犹太社区后来又因经霍尔木兹前来的塞法迪流亡者而更加兴旺。帖木儿之孙穆罕默德苏丹1396至1397年劫掠了拉尔至贾赫罗姆一线，但1444年米拉德王公仍坐镇拉尔，靠霍尔木兹的转运贸易富足一方。

他的后继者甚至觊觎霍尔木兹本岛：1498年派出的六十艘船队全军覆没，统帅阿布·贝克尔·拉里被杀；1505年在格什姆岛登陆又告失败。1508年起，拉尔王公承认萨非沙赫的宗主权，却保留自治和铸币权，并与葡萄牙人在海岸征战数十年。直到阿拔斯一世的大将阿拉维尔迪汗长期围城，于伊斯兰历1015年（1606—1607年）终结这个王朝，末代王公死在被围的堡垒中，拉尔成为王室直领；阿拔斯十分推重城中的盖伊萨里耶巴扎，伊斯法罕大巴扎即仿它而建。约1700年路经此地的欧洲游客称，拉尔的铸坊能铸造全波斯最好的大炮，本地的硫磺也经犹太商人之手卖给葡萄牙人。整个17世纪，拉尔商人陆续移居巴林、科威特和阿拉伯沿岸；纳迪尔沙死后的混战中，拉尔总督纳赛尔汗·拉里本人也成了海岸上的一方豪强。

en:
Farah sits on the Farah river, astride the old road between Herat and Kandahar where the desert highway meets water and pasture. The Greeks knew the place as Phrada, later Prophthasia, and its great citadel was traditionally counted among the fortresses founded by Alexander the Great in 330 BC; under the Sasanians it guarded the eastern frontier towards India and Sistan. In Islamic centuries Farah was one of the sixteen districts of Sistan, passing from the Saffarids of Zaranj through Ghaznavid, Ghurid and Khwarazmshah hands to the Kartids of Herat, who lost it to Timur after the fall of Herat in 1381. In 1444 its Sunni, Khorasani-speaking people held the fortress for Shah Rukh, watered their flocks and orchards from the Farah Rud, and charged caravans on the Herat–Kandahar road to rest and water here.

After Shah Rukh's death Farah followed Herat through the Timurid succession: Mashhad and Herat fell to Abu'l-Qasim Babur Mirza in 1449, and Abu Sa'id re-united the province with Khurasan in 1458. The Indian preacher Sayyid Muhammad Jaunpuri, who had declared himself the Mahdi at Mecca in 1496, died at Farah in 1505, and his mausoleum became a place of pilgrimage for his Mahdawi followers; in 1507 the Shaybanid Muhammad Shaybani ended Timurid rule there. Farah then passed to the Safavids, fell to the Transoxanian Uzbeks and was recovered only around 1600, in the counter-offensive that retook Herat and Sabzavar. In 1709 it went over to Mirwais Hotak's Afghan rising, and in January 1730 Zulfaqar Khan launched his revolt from Farah; Nader Shah's brother Ebrahim Khan Afshar re-conquered the town during the Herat campaign of 1730–1732. From 1747 it was part of Ahmad Shah Durrani's Afghan empire.
zh:
费拉赫城临法拉河，正当赫拉特与坎大哈之间的古道，荒漠商路在此与水草相接。希腊人称之为弗拉达，后称普罗弗塔西亚；城外的大堡相传是公元前330年亚历山大大帝东征时所筑要塞之一，萨珊时代它则是扼守通向印度与锡斯坦道路的东境重镇。伊斯兰时代，费拉赫是锡斯坦十六区之一，先后经扎兰季的萨法尔王朝、加兹纳维王朝、古尔王朝、花剌子模沙之手，归赫拉特的卡尔特王朝，1381年赫拉特陷落后落入帖木儿之手。1444年，信奉逊尼派、操呼罗珊语的居民替沙哈鲁戍守这座要塞，引法拉河水放牧畜群、浇灌果园，赫拉特与坎大哈道上的商队也在此歇脚补水。

沙哈鲁死后，费拉赫随赫拉特卷入帖木儿继承之争：1449年阿布勒·卡西姆·巴布尔·米尔扎夺得马什哈德与赫拉特，1458年阿布·赛义德又将此地并回呼罗珊。1496年在麦加自称马赫迪的印度传道者赛义德·穆罕默德·江普里于1505年在费拉赫去世，其陵墓后来成为马赫迪派信众的朝谒之地；1507年昔班尼汗终结了帖木儿在当地的统治。费拉赫随后归入萨法维，又被河中的乌兹别克人夺去，直到约1600年波斯反攻、收复赫拉特与萨卜泽瓦尔时才一并收回。1709年，此地响应米尔维斯·霍塔克的阿富汗起义；1730年1月，祖勒菲卡尔汗在费拉赫举兵，纳迪尔沙之弟易卜拉欣汗·阿夫沙尔在1730—1732年的赫拉特战役中将该城攻克。1747年起，费拉赫成为艾哈迈德沙·杜兰尼的阿富汗帝国的一部分。

en:
Bamyan lies at 2,550 metres on the plateau between Kabul and Herat, a green valley cut by a river through red cliffs. From the second century it was the greatest Buddhist centre on the western reaches of the silk road, and in the sixth century two standing Buddhas, 53 and 35 metres high, were carved into the cliff with a thousand painted caves around them; Xuanzang, who stayed fifteen days about 630, described the court of the king of Bamyan. Saffarid armies first brought Islam in 870, Mahmud of Ghazni made it the faith of the valley, and under the Ghurids Bamyan was the seat of a kingdom from 1155 to 1212. Genghis Khan, besieging the city in 1221, lost a grandson beneath its walls and on taking it put the people to the sword; Shahr-e Gholghola, the hill of the 'city of screams', never rose again. Only under the Kart and Timurid princes did a small town return to the valley. In 1444 Bamyan was a quiet Timurid backwater on the Kabul road, its cliff Buddhas already old and strange above the bazaars.

After Babur took Kabul in 1504 the Bamyan district followed the fortunes of that kingdom. It passed to his Mughal heirs and for a generation was held by Humayun's son Mirza Hakim, who ruled Kabul almost as an independent king until his death in 1585, when Akbar's officers brought the province directly under the empire. The Mughals kept a garrison on the old caravan road against the Uzbeks, and Aurangzeb, campaigning in the Hindu Kush, had the great Buddha battered with cannon. Later in the seventeenth century imperial control loosened and the Hazara clans of the surrounding mountains largely governed themselves. Ahmad Shah Durrani's horsemen made the valley part of the new Afghan empire after 1747, drawing cavalry and tribute from its clans, but the high passes left Bamyan a world of its own.
zh:
巴米扬海拔2550米，位于喀布尔与哈烈之间的高原，河流在红色崖壁间切出一道翠绿谷地。2世纪起，它是丝绸之路西段最负盛名的佛教中心；6世纪，崖壁上凿出高53米和35米的两尊大佛，周围环绕上千座绘满壁画的洞窟。约630年玄奘在此停留十五日，记下巴米扬国王的宫廷。870年萨法尔王朝的军队首次带来伊斯兰，伽色尼的马哈茂德将其立为谷地之教；古尔王朝治下，巴米扬在1155至1212年间是一个王国的都城。1221年成吉思汗围攻巴米扬，爱孙战死于城下，城破后他下令屠城；「哀号之城」沙赫尔·古勒古勒从此再未复兴。直到卡尔特与帖木儿宗王治下，谷地中才重新出现一座小镇。1444年的巴米扬，是帖木儿治下喀布尔道上一处安静的边地，崖壁上的大佛在巴扎之上早已显得古老而奇异。

1504年巴布尔攻取喀布尔后，巴米扬这片属地便随喀布尔一同沉浮。它归入巴布尔的莫卧儿后裔，一度由胡马雍之子米尔扎·哈基姆管辖——他以近乎独立之主的身份统治喀布尔，直到1585年去世，该省才由阿克巴的官员直接兼领。莫卧儿在古道上屯戍，防备乌兹别克人；奥朗则布在兴都库什用兵时，曾下令用大炮轰击大佛。17世纪后期帝国控制松弛，周围山地的哈扎拉诸部基本自行其是。1747年以后，艾哈迈德沙·杜兰尼的骑兵把谷地纳入新生的阿富汗帝国，向诸部征兵索贡，但高山险隘仍让巴米扬自成天地。

en:
Jalalabad guards the eastern exit of the Kabul river from the hills, where the Kabul and Kunar meet before the road runs on through the Khyber Pass to Peshawar. In antiquity this was Nagarahara, whose Buddhist shrines and monasteries at Hadda drew the Chinese pilgrim Faxian around 400 and Xuanzang in 630. The Ghaznavids brought Islam in the tenth century, and the Mongols wrecked its towns in the thirteenth. In 1444 the chief place of the warm Nangarhar plain was still old Adinapur, a small fortress-town in country increasingly held by Afghan tribes and owning little more than nominal allegiance to the Timurids of Kabul; its gardens were already famed for oranges, dates and sugarcane.

In 1505 Babur marched through Adinapur and the Khyber on his first raid towards Peshawar, and in 1508–09 he laid out a charbagh below the fortress, the Bagh-e Wafa, his Garden of Fidelity. His grandson Akbar built the present city on the chosen site in 1570 and named it Jalalabad after his own name, Jalal-ud-din; it became the chief Mughal fortress and posting-stage on the road between Kabul and India, though Mirza Sulaiman of Badakhshan seized it briefly in his Kabul war of 1564. Nader Shah's army poured through the valley in 1738 on its way to Peshawar and Delhi, and in 1748 the country passed to Ahmad Shah Durrani, whose son Timur Shah kept his winter court in the mild climate of Jalalabad. On 29 June 1809 Shah Shuja, rallying his army near the town after losing Peshawar, was decisively beaten at Nimla by Mahmud Shah, and fled into exile in India.
zh:
贾拉拉巴德扼守喀布尔河穿出东部山地的出口：喀布尔河与库纳尔河在此汇合，古道再向东经开伯尔山口通往白沙瓦。古时这里是那揭罗曷，哈达的佛教寺院与圣迹在400年前后迎来到访的法显，630年玄奘也来此礼佛。10世纪加兹尼王朝把伊斯兰教带到此地，13世纪蒙古人摧毁了这里的城镇。1444年，温暖的楠格哈尔平原上的首邑仍是古城阿迪纳布尔，这座小小军镇日益处在阿富汗部落的掌握中，对喀布尔的帖木儿王公只担一个虚名；当地园林已以柑橘、椰枣和甘蔗闻名。

1505年，巴布尔经阿迪纳布尔和开伯尔山口首次奔袭白沙瓦；1508—1509年，他在城堡南面的高地上辟建四分花园「忠诚园」。其孙阿克巴1570年在选定的城址上建起今日的城市，并以自己的名字贾拉尔丁命名为贾拉拉巴德；它成为喀布尔通往印度的大道上莫卧儿人最重要的要塞和驿站，只是1564年巴达赫尚的米尔扎·苏莱曼进兵喀布尔时曾短暂夺取此城。1738年，纳迪尔沙的大军沿河谷涌过，直扑白沙瓦与德里；1748年楠格哈尔归入艾哈迈德沙·杜兰尼的帝国，其子帖木儿沙后来因气候温和而在此设立冬朝。1809年6月29日，丢掉白沙瓦的沙·舒贾在城旁集结军队，却在尼姆拉被马哈茂德沙决定性击败，随后流亡印度。

en: Kunduz lies where the Kunduz and Khanabad rivers meet in Tokharistan, the old Bactrian lowland north of the Hindu Kush. It is identified with ancient Drapsaka, a prosperous Buddhist centre in the third century, and its Timurid-era name Kuhandiz, meaning 'old fort', later became Qunduz. In 1444 its walled town and irrigated valley belonged to the Timurid Empire and formed an eastern approach to Balkh on the roads toward Badakhshan and Kabul. After Muhammad Shaybani's Uzbek conquest of Balkh in 1506, Tokharistan entered the orbit of Uzbek rulers, and Kunduz later became the seat of its own khanate. The region was absorbed into the Durrani Empire in the eighteenth century, but in 1815 Muhammad Murad Beg began building the Kunduz Khanate into a power reaching from Balkh toward the Pamirs.
zh: 昆都士位于昆都士河与汗阿巴德河交汇处，地处兴都库什山以北的吐火罗斯坦，即古代巴克特里亚低地。一般认为这里是古代的德拉普萨卡，3世纪时是繁荣的佛教学术中心；帖木儿时期使用的名称库汉迪兹意为「古堡」，后演变为昆都士。1444年，这座有墙垣的城镇及其灌溉河谷属于帖木儿帝国，是从巴尔赫东去巴达赫尚和喀布尔道路上的要地。1506年穆罕默德·昔班尼征服巴尔赫后，吐火罗斯坦进入乌兹别克统治者的势力范围，昆都士后来成为一个汗国的都城。18世纪，该地区并入杜兰尼帝国；1815年，穆罕默德·穆拉德·贝格开始把昆都士汗国建成从巴尔赫延伸至帕米尔高原的强权。

en:
Maymana lies on the Maymana River, a tributary of the Murghab, among the hills and steppes between Herat and the Amu Darya. Its citadel has early Iron Age roots, and in the early Islamic centuries the Juzjan district was ruled through local Iranian vassals. The Mongol invasions of the thirteenth century devastated its towns and caravan traffic, and the area took roughly two centuries to recover, with Iranian villagers and settled Arab descendants in the oases and Aimaq nomads in the surrounding grasslands. In 1444 it was a Sunni Muslim frontier district of the Timurid Empire, a modest market on the road from Herat and Iran toward Turkistan.

Uzbek power arrived with Muhammad Shaybani's early-sixteenth-century campaigns toward Turkistan and Herat; although the Safavids defeated Shaybani, Uzbek chiefs remained the dominant military elite. From 1621 the Ming tribe held the governorship of Maymana. When Nader Shah's empire collapsed in 1747, Hajji Bi Ming made the town the centre of the independent Uzbek Maimana Khanate, profiting from commerce between Herat, Iran and the cities north of the Amu Darya. After Ahmad Khan died in 1814, Sar-i Pol broke away, but Maymana itself remained the seat of the Ming khans in 1821.
zh:
梅马内位于穆尔加布河支流梅马内河畔，处在赫拉特与阿姆河之间的丘陵和草原上。其城堡渊源可溯至早期铁器时代；伊斯兰时代早期，朱兹詹地区由当地伊朗语附庸统辖。13世纪的蒙古入侵摧毁了城镇和商队贸易，这一地区约用两百年才恢复，绿洲中住着伊朗语村民和定居的阿拉伯人后裔，周围草原则有艾马克游牧民。1444年，这里是帖木儿帝国的逊尼派边地，也是赫拉特、伊朗通往突厥斯坦道路上的小型市集。

16世纪初，穆罕默德·昔班尼向突厥斯坦和赫拉特用兵，乌兹别克势力随之进入；尽管昔班尼被萨法维人击败，乌兹别克首领仍是当地占优势的军事精英。自1621年起，明部世代担任梅马内长官。1747年纳迪尔沙的帝国瓦解时，哈吉·比·明以该城为中心建立独立的乌兹别克梅马内汗国，借助赫拉特、伊朗与阿姆河以北诸城之间的贸易兴盛起来。1814年艾哈迈德汗死后，萨尔普勒脱离汗国，但到1821年，梅马内仍是明部汗王的驻地。

en:
Bost, whose ruins stand by Lashkargah on the lower Helmand, guards the point where the Arghandab joins the Helmand, the gateway of the Garmsir lowland and the road towards Kandahar. Arab armies took it from the Zunbil kings in the 650s, and under the Saffarids and Ghaznavids it became the winter capital of Mahmud of Ghazni's empire: the mansions of Lashkari Bazar lined the Helmand, while the richly decorated arch of the fortress of Bost served as the city's gate. It was a city of learning as well: Ibn Hibban al-Busti, born here in 884, returned in 951 to found a madrasa where his students received stipends, and Ibn Hawqal praised the townsfolk's manners. The Mongols sacked Bost in 1220 and Timur destroyed it in 1383, later ordering it rebuilt. By 1444 it was only a shadow of its old self, a fortress-town of the southern marches whose pastures and river crossings were held by Afghan herders under the loose reach of the Mihrabanid maliks of Sistan.

By the later sixteenth century Bost was claimed by the Safavid shahs. As the fortress covering the western approaches to Kandahar, it shared that city's long quarrel between the Safavids and the Mughals: Akbar acquired Kandahar by diplomacy in 1595, the two empires exchanged these borderlands more than once, and in the winter of 1648–1649 Shah Abbas II's armies retook Kandahar and held it against every Mughal counter-siege. In 1709 the district went over to Mirwais Hotak's Afghan rising, and in 1738 Nader Shah's Afsharid army marched through Bost on its way to the siege of Kandahar; from 1747 it formed part of Ahmad Shah Durrani's Afghan empire.
zh:
巴斯特的故址在赫尔曼德河下游、拉什卡尔加之旁，正扼阿尔甘达卜河汇入赫尔曼德河之处，是加尔姆西尔低地与通往坎大哈道路的门户。7世纪50年代，阿拉伯军队从尊比尔王公手中夺取该城；到萨法尔王朝与加兹纳维王朝时期，它成为加兹尼的马哈茂德帝国的冬都：拉什卡里巴扎的宫苑沿赫尔曼德河排开，巴斯特堡雕饰华丽的大拱门是全城的正门。这里也是学术之城：884年生于本地的伊本·希班951年回乡，创办一所向学生发放津贴的经学院；旅行家伊本·豪卡勒也曾称道此地居民举止文雅。1220年蒙古人洗劫巴斯特，1383年帖木儿再度毁城，后来又下令重建。到1444年，巴斯特只剩昔日残影，是南边的一座堡镇，牧场与渡口由阿富汗牧民掌握，仅受锡斯坦的米赫拉卜马利克们松散控制。

16世纪后期，巴斯特为萨法维沙阿所有。作为掩护坎大哈西路的要塞，它随坎大哈卷入萨法维与莫卧儿的长期争夺：1595年阿克巴以外交手段取得坎大哈，此后两大帝国几度交换这片边地，1648—1649年冬沙阿·阿拔斯二世的军队攻克坎大哈，此后莫卧儿历次反攻围城都未能夺回。1709年，此地响应米尔维斯·霍塔克的阿富汗起义；1738年，纳迪尔沙的阿夫沙尔大军取道巴斯特前往围攻坎大哈；1747年起，它成为艾哈迈德沙·杜兰尼的阿富汗帝国的一部分。

en: Chakhansur is the chief settlement of the Khashrud, the desert delta in north-eastern Sistan where the Khash river loses itself among reed-beds and shifting dunes. Canals and fields buried under the sand show that this was a populous Silk Road oasis in medieval centuries, perhaps the Saruzan described by the geographer al-Istakhri; flocks, dates and the rough Balochi carpets of its herders went down the river road to Zaranj. In 1444 it formed the north-eastern march of the Mihrabanid malik's Sistan, sharing the province's fate thereafter: the Uzbek inroad of 1507, Safavid rule from the time of Shah Isma'il, the Hotak conquest of 1717 and Nader Shah's recovery of Sistan in 1738. After Nader's death in 1747 the delta passed to the Durrani Afghans, and in the later eighteenth century it was held by local mīrs, loosely obedient to the Afghan crown, while Baloch herders and clan fortresses increasingly gave the oasis its character.
zh: 恰汉苏尔是哈什鲁德沙漠三角洲的首镇，位于锡斯坦东北部，哈什河在此消失在芦苇荡与流动沙丘之间。已被流沙掩埋的古渠和田地表明，中世纪时这里曾是丝路上人烟稠密的绿洲，地理学家伊斯塔赫里笔下的萨鲁赞可能就在此处；畜群、椰枣和牧民织的粗朴俾路支地毯沿河道运往扎兰季。1444年，这里是米赫拉卜马利克治下锡斯坦的东北边地，其后与全锡斯坦同命运：1507年乌兹别克人入寇，沙阿·伊斯玛仪时代起归萨法维统治，1717年被霍塔克王朝攻占，1738年纳迪尔沙收复锡斯坦。1747年纳迪尔沙死后，三角洲并入杜兰尼阿富汗；18世纪后期由当地的米尔家族统治，对阿富汗王室只行松散的臣礼，俾路支牧民与氏族堡垒也越来越深地塑造了这片绿洲的面貌。

en:
Bela lies where the Porali river, the Arabius of Alexander's historians, leaves the hills and crosses the Las plain to the sea. In 325 BC the army of Alexander found here the Oreitan town of Rhambacia; he judged the site so promising that he left Hephaestion to build a city. Arab writers knew it as Armabil, described in the Chachnama as the second port of Sindh after Debal, whose Buddhist chief offered his submission in 631, and Muhammad bin Qasim passed through on the conquest of Sindh in 711. The Hingol valley nearby held the Hinglaj shrine, to which Hindu pilgrims kept coming under Muslim rule. In 1444 Bela was a small Sunni town of date gardens and fish, the first stage on the road from Sindh into Makran.

The local state took shape in 1742, when the Jamote chief Jam Ali Khan founded the chiefdom of Las Bela with Bela as its capital. Nasir Khan I of Kalat, the Great, later invaded Las Bela and bound the Jam to his confederacy. Under the Jam dynasty Sonmiani, the plain's harbour on Sonmiani Bay, became a busy roadstead for trade with Muscat and Sindh; its boats worked the pearl banks and its merchants forwarded the goods of Kandahar and Kalat to the sea.
