In 1444 Saray-Jük was the seat and market through which the Nogai beys touched the wider world, ringed by the winter camps of their herdsmen.

In 1580 the Volga Cossack atamans Nechai and Bogdan Barbosha stormed and burned the city, and its survivors removed to Khiva; in 1640 Russian settlers built a small fort two kilometres above the ruins. That same year the merchant Mikhail Guryev raised a wooden stockade and fish-weir at the river mouth itself, the beginning of Guryev. The lower Yaik was then controlled by Kalmyk khans, to whom the settlers paid tribute until a stone fortress made the place secure. Stenka Razin seized it during his Volga revolt in 1668, and on 25 January 1774 the ataman Ovchinnikov, acting for Pugachev, took Guryev fortress by storm. When the rising was put down the imperial government in January 1775 renamed the Yaik the Ural and the Yaik Cossacks the Ural Host, while Guryev lived on as a fishing stronghold at the mouth of the renamed river.
zh:
亚伊克河下游在注入里海前水势趋缓，三角洲上沼泽遍布。诺盖汗国唯一名副其实的城市萨莱楚克就坐落在这里。该城1395年被帖木儿的军队摧毁，1430至1440年代重建，扼守从伏尔加河商埠通往花剌子模与中国的商路。城内铺着陶制的供水管道，作坊出产金属器和陶器，船只还在河上捕鱼。1444年，萨莱楚克是诺盖首领们与外部世界接触的驻地和市集，四周环绕着牧人的冬季营地。

1580年，伏尔加河哥萨克首领涅恰伊和波格丹·巴尔博沙攻占并焚毁该城，幸存者迁居希瓦；1640年，俄国移民在废墟上游两公里处建起一座小堡。同年，商人米哈伊尔·古里耶夫在河口立下木栅、筑起鱼梁，这便是古里耶夫的开端。当时亚伊克河下游受卡尔梅克诸汗控制，移民要向他们纳贡，直到石砌要塞落成才不再进贡。斯捷潘·拉辛在1668年的伏尔加河起义中一度占领此地；1774年1月25日，首领奥夫钦尼科夫奉普加乔夫之命强攻拿下古里耶夫要塞。起义被镇压后，俄国政府于1775年1月将亚伊克河改称乌拉尔河、亚伊克哥萨克改称乌拉尔哥萨克，河口的古里耶夫则作为渔业要塞留存下来。

en:
The dry heart of this province is the Saryesik-Atyrau desert along the southern shore of Lake Balkhash, where the Ili once emptied through many channels. Between the ninth and thirteenth centuries those waters fed Karamergen, 'the Black Hunter', the northernmost of the medieval farming towns of the Ili delta: a walled rectangle with corner towers, irrigated fields, fishing in the lake and game in the tugai woods, set on the caravan road that crossed the narrows of Balkhash by the Uzun-Aral peninsula. The Mongol invasions of the thirteenth century destroyed the town, and when the Ili changed course it was never rebuilt. In 1444 its walls stood empty above a dried channel, and the surrounding steppe was pasture for Moghulistan's nomad clans, the future Senior Juz.

With the rise of the Kazakh Khanate around 1465 the southern Balkhash became Senior Juz grazing ground from winter to summer. In 1723 the Dzungars swept through it in the opening blow of the calamity remembered as the Great Disaster, and the land remained under Dzungar rule until the Qing conquest of 1755–57 destroyed their empire and let the Kazakh clans drift back to the old pastures along the empty shore.
zh:
这片省份的干旱腹地，是巴尔喀什湖南岸的萨雷耶西克-阿特劳沙漠，伊犁河曾在此以众多汊道注入湖中。9至13世纪间，河水滋养着卡拉门根（突厥语意为「黑猎人」）这座伊犁三角洲中世纪农业城镇中位置最北的城：带角楼的方形城墙、灌溉农田、湖中的渔产与吐加依林中的猎物一应俱全，城旁就是借乌尊-阿拉尔半岛横穿巴尔喀什湖狭窄处的商道。13世纪的蒙古入侵毁了此城，伊犁河改道之后它再未复兴。1444年，城墙空立于干涸的河道之上，周围草原是东察合台游牧部落——日后的大玉兹——的牧场。

1465年前后哈萨克汗国兴起，巴尔喀什湖南岸成为大玉兹冬夏相继的牧地。1723年，准噶尔人在被后世称为「大灾难」的浩劫第一波中席卷此地，这片土地一直处在准噶尔统治之下，直到1755至1757年清朝征服准噶尔、其汗国覆灭，哈萨克部落才得以陆续返回空旷湖岸上的旧日牧场。

en:
The Upper Ishim – Esil in Kazakh, the longest of the Irtysh's left tributaries – rises in the Kazakh uplands and flows north through steppe and forest-steppe. These grasslands were already old nomad country when the fortified town of Bozok stood on Lake Buzykty, on the site of modern Astana: settled by Turkic newcomers in the seventh century, it became in the tenth century a residence of the Kipchak khagans, guarding caravan roads that linked Siberia with the Syr Darya cities of Sighnaq and Sauran, and it endured into Golden Horde times. In 1444 the Esil pastures belonged to the Uzbek ulus of Abu'l-Khayr, and among the clans grazing here were those who followed the sultans Janibek and Kerei.

Around 1465 Janibek and Kerei led their clans away from Abu'l-Khayr to live as free qazaqs, and when the khan died in 1468 his confederation dissolved, leaving the upper Ishim to the Kazakh khans. Under Kasym Khan, from 1511, their power reached from the Syr Darya to the Urals, and in 1520 they took the Nogai capital Saray-Juk. From the 1640s the Dzungars pressed in from the east: Erdeni Batur's invasion of 1643 carried off thousands, and Khan Jangir was killed in 1652. The catastrophe came in 1723–1727, the 'Years of the Great Disaster', when Dzungar armies swept the Middle Jüz off the Esil; the survivors rallied at Ordabasy in 1726 and fought their way back. In 1740 the Middle Jüz khans accepted Russian suzerainty, and in 1752 the Russians built the fortress of Saint Peter at the Kyzyl-Zhar tract on the Ishim – the future Petropavl, soon a mart for trade between Russia and the steppe. Ablai Khan (1771–1781) drew all three jüz together and kept the Esil clans self-governing in all but name.
zh:
伊希姆河上游——哈萨克语称叶西尔（Есіл），是额尔齐斯河最长的左岸支流——发源于哈萨克丘陵，向北穿过草原与森林草原。这里早就是古老的游牧之乡：今阿斯塔纳境内的布祖克特湖畔曾矗立着堡垒城镇博佐克，公元7世纪由西迁的突厥人建立，10世纪成为钦察可汗的驻地，扼守连通西伯利亚与锡尔河畔瑟格纳克、扫兰诸城的商路，一直延续到金帐汗国时代。1444年，叶西尔草原归阿布勒海尔的乌兹别克兀鲁思所有，而在此游牧的氏族中，就有追随贾尼别克与克烈两位苏丹的部众。

约1465年，贾尼别克和克烈率部脱离阿布勒海尔，做了自由的「哈萨克」；1468年阿布勒海尔死后，其联盟瓦解，伊希姆河上游归于哈萨克诸汗。哈斯木汗自1511年在位时，哈萨克势力东起锡尔河、西抵乌拉尔山，1520年又攻下诺盖汗国的都城萨莱楚克。17世纪40年代起，准噶尔人自东方压来：1643年额尔德尼·巴图尔入侵，掳走上万人口，1652年江格尔汗战死。1723至1727年的「大灾难年代」浩劫降临，准噶尔大军把中玉兹逐出叶西尔草原；幸存者1726年在奥尔达巴锡集结，逐步反攻。1740年，中玉兹诸汗接受俄国宗主权；1752年，俄国人在伊希姆河畔的克孜勒扎尔地段建起圣彼得要塞——即后来的彼得罗巴甫尔，很快成为俄国与草原间的贸易重镇。阿布莱汗（1771—1781年在位）将三个玉兹重新聚到一起，使叶西尔诸部在名义臣服之外仍保有自治。

en:
Kungirot, the Qońirat of Karakalpak sources, lies on the left side of the Amu Darya delta where the wetlands give way to the Ustyurt plateau. Its old fortified station guarded caravan tracks through Ustyurt toward the Caspian and the Ural country, and the place took its name from the Turkic Qongirat clan. In 1444, as the Golden Horde's power dissolved, this was Nogai-Manghit pasture frontier. Sunni herders bred horses, cattle and sheep, while fishing families, craftsmen and caravan traders lived around the older settlement and its delta channels.

Russian accounts date the separate Aral polity of the lower delta to 1625. In 1643 Abu al-Ghazi Bahadur was crowned at Kungirot before becoming ruler of Khiva, a sign of the lower delta's military weight. In November 1740 the Kazakh khan Abu al-Khair arrived and briefly installed his son Nuraly there. The Aral polity expanded eastward after 1747, bringing together Qongirat, Nogai and Qaraqalpak clans between the Amu Darya and Zhanadarya. The brothers Toremurat and Khojamurat made it effectively independent of Khiva in 1794 and 1795, but after the Qongirat dynasty took the khan's title at Khiva in 1804, Muhammad Rahim Khan reconquered the Zhanadarya lands in 1811 and captured Kungirot in 1812. The town remained a caravan market and the seat of a semi-independent Qongirat lordship.
zh:
昆格勒在卡拉卡尔帕克语中称Qońirat，位于阿姆河三角洲左岸、水泽让位于乌斯秋尔特高原的地方。古老的设防驿站扼守穿过乌斯秋尔特、通往里海和乌拉尔地区的商道，地名则来自突厥语的昆格拉特部。1444年金帐汗国权势瓦解之际，这里是诺盖—曼吉特人的牧地边境。信奉逊尼派的牧人繁育马、牛、羊，渔夫、工匠和商队居民则住在旧聚落与三角洲水道周围。

俄文记载把下游三角洲独立的阿拉尔领地追溯到1625年。1643年，阿布·哈齐·巴哈杜尔在成为希瓦统治者之前，先在昆格勒即位，显示出下游三角洲的军事分量。1740年11月，哈萨克汗阿布勒海尔抵达这里，一度立其子努拉里为当地统治者。1747年后，阿拉尔政权向东扩张，把阿姆河与扎纳达里亚之间的昆格拉特、诺盖和卡拉卡尔帕克各部联合起来。1794年至1795年，托列穆拉特与霍贾穆拉特兄弟使其实际脱离希瓦；但1804年昆格拉特王朝在希瓦正式称汗后，穆罕默德·拉希姆汗于1811年重新征服扎纳达里亚，1812年攻占昆格勒。此后这座城镇仍是商队市集，也是半独立昆格拉特领地的治所。

en:
Song La is the country of the Black River, which cuts through the northwestern mountains on its way to the Red River: a chain of warm, narrow valleys planted with wet rice, with tea gardens on the slopes. Tai Dam, Tai Khao and Tai Daeng lords — the Black, White and Red Tai — ruled their own mueang here, each chao master of a ring of villages, bound to his people by the spirit cults of house, paddy and mountain rather than by Buddhist temples. Fa Ngum's Lan Xang campaigns of the 1340s loosely bound these chau to Xieng Thong, and in 1444 their tribute still travelled down the Nam Ou to the king at Luang Prabang, though the Vietnamese court at Đông Kinh already regarded the Black River lands as the western gate of Đại Việt.

In 1448 the Black River chiefdoms passed into Đại Việt's sphere, and in 1479 the great armies of Lê Thánh Tông's war against Lan Xang marched through these valleys. The Mạc usurpation of 1527 and the long Lê–Mạc wars that followed left the highlands to their own lords, and in 1640 the chau formalised their loose league as the Sip Song Chau Tai, the 'Twelve Tai Cantons', keeping internal autonomy while sending tribute to Vietnam, China and the Lao kingdoms as power shifted. In the 1730s the great peasant rebellions of the Đàng Ngoài lowlands spilled upriver: Hoàng Công Chất, who rose in 1739, was driven into Hưng Hóa and after 1761 made the Mường Thanh valley his stronghold, raiding the lowland provinces until his death in 1769; his son fled into Yunnan, and in 1771 the Qing court settled his followers as far away as Xinjiang. The Tây Sơn victory of 1789 and then the new Nguyễn dynasty of Gia Long drew the cantons into Huế's orbit, and their muang were counted within the province of Hưng Hóa while the Tai chao kept their villages, their paddy fields and their old spirit rites. In 1821 the Black River country answered in name to the emperor at Huế but was still ruled valley by valley by its own lords.
zh:
山罗是黑水河的地盘——黑水河山高谷深，穿山越岭奔向红河，沿河是一串串温暖狭窄的水稻坝子，山坡上则种着茶树。泰担、泰考和泰登，即黑泰、白泰、红泰的首领，各有各的勐，每位「昭」管辖一圈村寨，维系他与部众的是家神、稻神和山神的祭仪，而非佛寺。1340年代，法昂东征西讨的澜沧大军把这些泰族州松散地系于川铜；1444年，他们的贡物仍沿南乌江送往琅勃拉邦的王廷，但东都的越南朝廷已把黑水河流域视作大越的西门户。

1448年，黑水河诸部转入大越势力范围；1479年，黎圣宗征澜沧的大军正是取道这些河谷南下。1527年莫登庸篡黎，此后黎莫长期相争，高地听凭本地土司自守。1640年，诸州把松散的联盟定为「西双朱泰」，即泰族十二州：内部事务自治，势力消长时向越南、中国和澜沧各邦分别进贡。1730年代，北河平原的农民大起义溯河而上：1739年起兵的黃公質被官军逼入兴化，1761年后以孟青河谷为据点，屡次出击平原各省，直到1769年病死；其子逃入云南，1771年清廷把他的余众远置新疆。1789年西山朝得胜、随后阮朝嘉隆帝立国，十二州被纳入顺化的轨道，各勐在名义上隶属兴化省，而泰族的「昭」们依旧保有村寨、稻田和古老的祭仪。1821年的黑水河之地，名义上听命于顺化的皇帝，实际上仍由一个个河谷里的本地首领统治。

en:
The waterfront that later became Haiphong lies where the Thái Bình river system meets the Gulf of Tonkin, with Cát Bà island sheltering a coast of creeks, rice lands and fishing villages. The city itself did not yet exist in 1444. Under the Ming occupation the shore had been administered through Lạng Giang and Tân An, and after Lê Lợi founded the Later Lê in 1428 it became part of the Eastern Circuit. Nguyễn Trãi praised the broader Hải Dương country as the first of the capital's four military marches and the eastern screen of Thăng Long. At the 1444 opening, therefore, this was the watery eastern flank of the Vietnamese realm rather than a separate port town.

In 1466 Lê Thánh Tông organized the region as the Nam Sách march, renamed Hải Dương in 1469. Mạc Đăng Dung, whose home was Cổ Trai in Nghi Dương on the site of modern Kiến Thụy, seized the Lê throne in 1527. After handing power to his son Mạc Đăng Doanh in 1529, he retired to Cổ Trai, made Hải Dương his secondary capital of Dương Kinh, and developed river ports linking the coast with Phố Hiến and Thăng Long. The restored Lê-Trịnh government recovered the region with the fall of the Mạc in 1592. In 1741 Hải Dương was divided into four circuits, including Đông Triều and An Lão. Gia Long returned Kinh Môn to the northern command in 1802, and in 1804 the regional seat moved to Thành Đông, the future Hải Dương.
zh:
后来成为海防的河海之地位处太平江水系注入北部湾的地带，吉婆岛外护，海岸上河汊、稻田与渔村交错。1444年时，海防城尚未出现。明朝占据期间，这一带分属谅江、新安两府；黎利1428年建立后黎后，海岸归入东道。阮廌在《舆地志》中把海阳地区列为京城四镇之首，称作升龙东面的屏障。因此开局之时，这里是大越政权水网纵横的东侧门户，尚不是后来独立设市的港口。

1466年，黎圣宗设立南策承宣，1469年改名海阳承宣，海阳一名正式出现。莫登庸的故乡在宜阳古斋，即今海防建瑞一带；他于1527年夺取黎朝皇位，1529年让位于儿子莫登瀛，以太上皇身份回到古斋，把海阳营建为陪都阳京，并在连通铺宪与升龙的河畔发展商港。1592年莫朝败亡，黎郑政权恢复对这一地区的控制。1741年，海阳分为上洪、下洪、东潮、安老四道。嘉隆帝1802年把荆门府拨回北方镇治，1804年又将地区治所迁到后来海阳市所在的城东。

en:
Hue lies on the Perfume River, where the coastal plain opens between the Truong Son mountains and a long, lagoon-fringed coast. It was Cham country until 1306, when King Che Man of Champa offered the two prefectures of O and Ly as the price of marrying the Vietnamese princess Huyen Tran. The Tran court renamed them Thuan and Hoa the following year, sent Doan Nhu Hai to govern, and settled migrants from Thanh Hoa among the Cham villages. The Ming held the land from 1407 to 1427, when the Lam Son rebels recovered it. In 1444 Thuan Hoa is the southern march of the Later Le realm, and the border is hot: Cham armies raided Hoa Chau in 1444 and 1445, and in 1446 the dowager queen Tuyen Tu sent Trinh Kha south and forced the Cham king to submit.

In 1558 Nguyen Hoang, son of the Le restoration leader Nguyen Kim, came south to hold Thuan Hoa and planted the seed of the Nguyen lordship; he raised the Thien Mu Pagoda above the river in 1601. His successors moved their seat to Kim Long in 1636 and to Phu Xuan in 1687, and the city was the capital of Dang Trong from 1738. Trinh armies under Hoang Ngu Phuc stormed it in 1775, but Nguyen Hue drove out the garrison in 1786 and made Phu Xuan the capital of the Tay Son. Nguyen Anh retook the city and in 1802 was enthroned there as the Gia Long emperor, founding the Nguyen dynasty. The great citadel was surveyed in 1803 and building began in 1805; at Gia Long's death in 1820, Hue was the undisputed imperial capital of a reunited Vietnam.
zh:
顺化位于香江之畔，沿海平原在长山山脉与礁湖相连的绵长海岸间展开。这里本是占婆疆土，1306年占王制旻以乌、里两州为聘礼求娶玄珍公主，陈朝翌年改二州为顺州、化州，总称顺化，遣段汝谐治理，又迁清化移民与占人村落杂处。1407至1427年此地属明，后由蓝山义军收复。1444年的顺化是后黎朝的南陲重镇，边境并不太平：占军于1444和1445年两度入寇化州，1446年宣慈太后派郑可南征，迫使占王臣服。

1558年，黎朝复辟领袖阮淦之子阮潢南下镇守顺化，扎下阮主基业，1601年他在香江边敕建天姥寺。继任者1636年移治金龙，1687年再迁富春，自1738年起富春成为南河之地的都城。1775年黄五福率郑军攻破城池，1786年阮惠逐走守军，以富春为西山朝之都。阮福映收复富春后，于1802年在此登基，是为嘉隆帝，开创阮朝。新京城1803年勘定，1805年动工修筑大城；1820年嘉隆去世时，顺化已是重新统一的越南无可争议的帝都。

en:
Kauthara (Hoa Anh in Vietnamese annals) stretched from Phú Yên to Cam Ranh in narrow coastal plains whose crafts and trade were second only to Vijaya. Its sacred centre was the temple of Po Nagar at Nha Trang, seat of the earth goddess Yan Po Nagar. Javanese raiders burned it in 774 and took the Shiva image, but King Satyavarman defeated them at sea and raised a victory stele there in 781. The Khmers sacked it around 950 and carried off the goddess statue, replaced when King Jaya Indravarman I rebuilt Po Nagar in 965. Lying far from both the Khmer and Vietnamese frontiers, Kauthara was spared the age's worst wars; in 1444 its temples still stood and aloewood and sea produce sailed the southern trade roads.

After 1471 Lê Thánh Tông enfeoffed a Cham lord between the Cù Mông and Cả passes as vassal king of Hoa Anh. In 1578 Nguyễn Hoàng's general Lương Văn Chánh stormed the citadel of An Nghiệp (Thành Hồ) west of Tuy Hòa, drove the Cham south of the Cả pass and opened the plain to settlers; during the Lê–Mạc wars Panduranga retook it several times. In 1611 Nguyễn Hoàng sent the Cham defector Văn Phong to seize Đồng Xuân and Tuy Hòa, founding Phú Yên prefecture. The end came in 1653: after King Po Nraup raided Phú Yên, Lord Nguyễn Phúc Tần's army crossed the Thạch Bi mountains to the Phan Rang river and set up Thái Khang and Diên Ninh prefectures over the whole principality; the Po Nagar image was carried to a new shrine at Pan Rang. Po Saut's 1692 attack on Diên Ninh was broken by Nguyễn Hữu Cảnh, and the five-article agreement of 1712 set mixed courts for Cham–Vietnamese suits. Through the 1700s Vietnamese settlers farmed beside Cham villages, mostly quarrelling over rice land, and missionaries still found Cham communities near Nha Trang. In the Tây Sơn wars rebels took Phú Yên in 1773, and in July 1775 Nguyễn Huệ marched from Quy Nhơn and destroyed a Nguyễn army that had overrun Diên Khánh from Hòn Khói; the coast returned to Nguyễn rule in 1802.
zh:
古笪罗在越南史籍中称华英，北起富安、南至柑兰湾，是一连串夹在山海之间的狭窄沿海平原，百工商贸之盛仅次于国都阇盘。其宗教中心在芽庄的婆那加塔，供奉地神杨婆那加。774年爪哇海寇焚塔掠走湿婆像，萨多跋摩王从海上追击破敌，于781年在婆那加立碑纪功并重修神殿。约950年高棉人再毁圣所、掠走女神像，965年因陀罗跋摩一世重建婆那加、另立神像。由于远离高棉与越南两个方向的边境，古笪罗少受兵燹；1444年时塔庙依旧，沉香和海产沿南方海路源源外运。

1471年阇盘陷落后，黎圣宗把居蒙隘到大岭隘之间的沿海之地封给一位占人首领，是为藩属华英国。1578年，阮潢麾下将领梁文政攻陷安业城（又称胡城，在今绥和市以西，是占婆史上最坚固宏大的城池），把守军逐回大岭隘以南，并开始向平原屯垦越人；黎莫相争期间，宾童龙又几度收复这一地区。1611年，阮潢派占人降将文封攻取同春、绥和，置富安府。古笪罗的终局在1653年：婆抋王入犯富安，阮主阮福濒发兵越过石碑山直抵潘郎江，在古笪罗旧地分设泰康、延庆二府，婆那加像也被迎往潘郎的新庙奉祀。1692年婆争攻打延庆，为阮有镜所破；1712年的五条之约规定占越争讼由占王与越籍官员会审。整个18世纪，越南移民与占人村落杂处耕作，争讼多因田产，欧洲传教士仍能在芽庄附近见到占人聚落。西山战火随后而至：1773年西山军夺取富安，1774年阮军自Hòn Khói海口席卷延庆，1775年7月阮惠自归仁奔袭，将其水陆军尽数歼灭。1802年一统之后，这段海岸重归阮氏统治。

en:
The southern Tây Nguyên rises in forested basalt plateaus around Di Linh and Lang Biang, above the upper Đồng Nai and the streams that feed the coast. K'Ho or Koho villagers made this country their own: some cultivated wet rice in Di Linh's valleys, while others cleared upland fields for dry rice, maize and vegetables, supplemented by forest products, iron forging and weaving. East of the passes, Cham lords and merchants of Kauthara and Panduranga traded for highland commodities, yet the mountains preserved local autonomy. In 1444 the K'Ho still lived under their own headmen and ancestral spirits; Champa was a nearby lowland power rather than an administration seated in the villages.

In 1471 Lê Thánh Tông's armies destroyed Vijaya, and Panduranga became the principal Cham polity on the coast below the highlands. When the Nguyễn lords reorganized Panduranga as the autonomous polity of Thuận Thành in 1693, Cham and Vietnamese administrative claims reached toward Lâm Đồng, but lowland garrisons and tax offices did not displace K'Ho headmen in these valleys. The coastal wars and the rise of Đàng Trong changed tribute and exchange; they did not end village self-rule. Through 1821, Di Linh's rice lands, upland fields and forest trade remained chiefly in highland hands.
zh:
西原南部是迪灵和浪平山一带森林覆盖的玄武岩高原，位于同奈河上游与通往沿海的诸溪之间。格贺（K'Ho，游戏中作Koho）村寨世代居住在这里：部分人在迪灵河谷种植水稻，另一些人在高地开辟旱田，栽种旱稻、玉米和蔬菜，并以林产、打铁和纺织补足生计。山口以东，古笪和宾童龙的占婆贵族、商人来此交易高地物产，但山地也保住了地方自治。1444年，格贺人仍由本族头人管理，奉行祖先与万物有灵信仰；占婆是邻近低地强权，却不是直接驻在各村的官府。

1471年，黎圣宗的军队摧毁毗阇耶，宾童龙成为高原下方沿海主要的占人政权。1693年，阮主把宾童龙改组为顺城自治政权，占人与越南人的行政名义延伸到林同一带，但低地驻军和税官并没有取代格贺山谷中的头人。沿海战争和广南国的兴起改变了朝贡与交换关系，却未结束村寨自治。到1821年，迪灵的水田、高地火田和林产贸易仍主要掌握在高地人手中。

en:
The Tiền and Hậu, the two great lower arms of the Mekong, cross an alluvial plain of rice fields and tidal mangrove creeks. The Khmer called the country Prek Ruessei, 'Bamboo Creek', the old name of its chief place at Cần Thơ on the Hậu. In 1444 the fishing and rice villages here belonged to the Cambodian king in Phnom Penh, though his authority ran thin so far downstream, while Chinese and Malay junks already called at the river mouths for rice, dried fish and timber. Vietnamese rule still lay two centuries ahead.

In 1679 the Ming loyalist general Dương Ngạn Địch brought more than 3,000 followers and fifty junks to seek refuge with the Nguyễn lords, who settled them at Mỹ Tho; the Chinese 'great market' they built was later remembered as the busiest trading town in all Cochinchina before the Europeans came. In 1739 Mạc Thiên Tứ, the Chinese governor of Hà Tiên, organised the Hậu river country as Trấn Giang county, the seed of Cần Thơ, and in 1755 and 1758 hard-pressed Cambodian kings ceded the lower-river lands of Gò Công, Sa Đéc and Châu Đốc to Huế. During the Tây Sơn wars a Siamese army came to restore Nguyễn Ánh, and on 20 January 1785 Nguyễn Huệ destroyed its fleet at Rạch Gầm–Xoài Mút on the Mỹ Tho river. The old Chinese port never regained its bustle and its merchants removed to Saigon; in 1792 Nguyễn Ánh moved his Định Tường garrison into Mỹ Tho and walled the town. After his coronation as the emperor Gia Long in 1802, these rich alluvial lands became Vietnam's five southern trấn, the rice basket whose grain filled the junks at every delta quay.
zh:
前江与后江是湄公河下游两大支津，横贯一片稻田与潮汐红树沟汊交织的冲积平原。高棉人把此地叫作ព្រែកឫស្សី（Prek Ruessei），意为「竹溪」，后江之畔的主邑芹苴旧名正是它。1444年，此间渔稻村落仍臣属于金边的柬埔寨国王，只是王命顺流而下已十分衰微；华人和马来商船早已往来河口，采办稻米、鱼干与木材。越南人的统治还要再过两个世纪才到来。

1679年，南明遗将杨彦迪率部众三千余人、战船五十余艘投奔阮主，被安置在美湫；他们建起的华人「大铺」瓦屋连云、帆樯如织，后来被追述为欧洲人到来前南圻最繁华的商埠。1739年，河仙华人统治者鄚天赐把后江一带编为镇江县，是为芹苴的雏形；1755和1758年，处境艰难的柬埔寨国王又把鹅贡、沙沥、朱笃等下游土地割让给顺化朝廷。西山战争中，一支暹罗军护送阮福映回国，1785年1月20日，阮惠在美湫江上的沥涔吹蔑之战全歼其舟师。旧华埠从此不复往日繁华，商人多迁往西贡；1792年，阮福映把定祥营治所移入美湫并筑城。1802年他称帝建元嘉隆后，这片肥沃冲积地被划为越南南方五镇，成为米仓，各码头的商船尽装此地之米出海。

en:
This drowned western shore of the Mekong delta is mangrove forest running into the Gulf of Siam; the Khmer called its peaty tidal water Teuk Khmao, 'black water', a name the Vietnamese later heard as Cà Mau, from its black-staining Melaleuca swamps. At the country's northern edge lay Óc Eo, Funan's great canal-linked port, where Roman, Indian and Chinese goods changed hands and which Greco-Roman geographers may have known as Cattigara; with Funan's seventh-century decline the harbour silted and the coast reverted to fishing hamlets. In 1444 the Khmer fishing and salt-making hamlets of Peam, Rạch Giá and Cà Mau still belonged to the Cambodian king, but this sea-edge of his realm was largely left to itself.

The Chinese merchant Mạc Cửu of Leizhou refused Qing rule and made his way to Cambodia; gathering Chinese and Vietnamese exiles, he had seven trading settlements along this coast from Kampot to Cà Mau by about 1680. Carried off to Siam by raiders in 1687, he escaped and fixed his seat around 1700 at the old Khmer haven of Peam, naming it Hà Tiên. In 1708 he offered his fief to the Nguyễn lords and was made tổng binh of Hà Tiên; under his son Mạc Thiên Tứ it became one of the great ports of the Gulf, and in 1739 four counties were created, Kiên Giang at Rạch Giá and Long Xuyên at Cà Mau among them. Taksin's Siamese army stormed and wrecked Hà Tiên in 1771, and the Mạc polity never recovered; its lord was executed in Siam in 1780 and the Tây Sơn swept the coast in 1777. Nguyễn Ánh recovered the south in 1788, and under the emperor Gia Long the fief became the southernmost of Vietnam's five trấn; in 1819 work began on the Vĩnh Tế canal linking Châu Đốc with Hà Tiên, driven through swamp and forest by Vietnamese and Cambodian levies who perished in great numbers.
zh:
这是湄公河三角洲西侧的水乡海岸，红树林一直铺展到暹罗湾边；高棉人把泥炭般的黑潮称作ទឹកខ្មៅ（Teuk Khmao），意为「黑水」——广袤白千层林的落叶染黑了河水，越南人后来把这个名字读成了金瓯。此地北缘有澳盖，是扶南时代以运河相连的大海港，罗马、印度和中国的货物在此转手，古希腊罗马地理学家所说的 Cattigara 或许就是它；7世纪扶南衰亡后，港口淤塞，海岸重归渔村。1444年，波末（Péam，即后来的河仙）、沥架、金瓯一带零散的高棉渔村和盐场仍臣属于柬埔寨国王，只是王国对这片海隅大体放任自流。

雷州华商鄚玖不甘清朝统治，流亡柬埔寨，招聚华越流民，到1680年前后已在这条海岸上从贡布到金瓯开设七处商村。1687年他被暹罗掠走，逃脱后约于1700年在高棉旧港波末立定根基，取名河仙。1708年他以封邑归附阮主，受封河仙镇总兵；其子鄚天赐之世，河仙跻身暹罗湾大埠之列，1739年领地分为四县，治在沥架的坚江、设在金瓯的龙川都在其中。1771年，暹罗国王郑信攻陷并焚毁河仙，鄚氏从此不振：鄚天赐出逃暹罗，1780年被害，西山军又于1777年席卷沿海。1788年阮福映收复南方，嘉隆帝1802年立国后，旧封邑成为越南南方五镇中最南的一镇；1819年，连通朱笃与河仙的永济河开工，越南和高棉民夫在沼泽丛林中开河，死去甚众。

en:
Kratie straddles a broad bend of the Mekong where the river leaves the last Lao hills and winds out into the Cambodian plain. It is old Khmer country: the riverside around Sambor was among the most densely settled lands of the Funan and Chenla eras, and an inscription of 683 found near Sambor is one of the earliest dated texts in the Khmer language, already using the zero. Eighth-century temples still stand at Khvas Pi and Koh Kring, and when the kingdom split in the early eleventh century Sambor and Kratie were the eastern strongholds of Suryavarman I. In 1444 the province belonged to the diminished Khmer kingdom whose kings now ruled from Chaktomuk: Khmer villagers grew rice along the banks and fished the river, Stieng and Bunong highlanders brought lac, cardamom and ivory out of the eastern forests, and boats traded upriver toward the Lao lands.

Through the post-Angkor wars Kratie remained a Khmer interior province; its river monasteries, among them Vihear Sasar Muayroy founded in the sixteenth century, served the boat traffic between Longvek and the upper Mekong. Change came from downstream: as the Nguyễn lords of Vietnam absorbed the Mekong delta during the seventeenth century and Nguyễn Hữu Cảnh organized Saigon in 1698, Cambodia lost its mouth to the sea, and the river towns above found themselves on a frontier with Vietnamese settlements spreading over former Khmer soil. The dynastic war of 1811–1813 nearly partitioned the kingdom between Siam and Vietnam; the campaigns ran west of Kratie, yet King Ang Chan returned from Saigon in 1813 under Vietnamese protection. By 1821 the people of Kratie still spoke Khmer and kept to their local spirits, but the crown at Oudong ruled as a vassal of Huế.
zh:
桔井位于湄公河一处宽阔的转弯上，河水在此辞别寮国丘陵，蜿蜒流入高棉平原。这是古老的高棉之地：桑波沿河一带是扶南、真腊时代人烟最稠密的区域之一，当地出土的一方683年碑铭是最早有纪年的高棉语文本之一，其中已经使用了数字零；华斯比、戈格林等地还存有8世纪的寺庙。11世纪初王国分裂之际，桑波与桔井是苏利耶跋摩一世的东部据点。1444年，这片土地属于已从吴哥南迁、定都四臂湾的衰落高棉王国：高棉村民沿河种稻捕鱼，斯丁、布农山民从东部山林里运来紫胶、豆蔻和象牙，船只则溯河与寮国之地通商。

后吴哥时代的诸场战乱中，桔井始终是高棉内地的省份；河畔的寺院——包括16世纪建立的维哈索索穆罗伊寺——照应着往来洛韦与湄公河上游的船旅。变局来自下游：17世纪越南阮主逐步吞并湄公河三角洲，1698年阮有镜设立嘉定，高棉就此失去入海门户，上游的河鎮发现自己成了边地，越南人正扩散到昔日的高棉故土上。1811至1813年的王室内乱几乎使王国被暹罗与越南瓜分；战事虽在桔井以西进行，国王安赞二世还是在越南庇护下于1813年自西贡复位。到1821年，桔井人仍说高棉语、敬奉本地神灵，但乌栋的王位已是顺化的藩属。

en:
Battambang sits on the Sangkae River, where the rolling rice country of northwestern Cambodia drains toward the Tonlé Sap. The town grew from an old trading crossing into an urban centre under Jayavarman VII, and the surrounding country is dotted with Angkorian shrines — above all Wat Ek Phnom, an 11th-century temple of Suryavarman I dedicated to Krishna, and Wat Banan, begun under Udayadityavarman II and completed under Suryavarman II, its five towers a smaller echo of Angkor Wat. When Ayutthayan troops sacked Angkor in 1431, Battambang became one of the western marches of a shrunken Khmer kingdom: fertile, Theravada Buddhist, and the first ground a Siamese army would cross.

Rice kept Battambang alive through the post-Angkor centuries, and its market drew Khmer, Siamese and Chinese dealers even as the kings at Lovek and Oudong became pawns of their neighbours. In 1795 the northwestern provinces passed under Siamese rule: Battambang was renamed Phra Tabong and made the chief town of Inner Cambodia, governed for Bangkok by a line of Khmer governors from the Aphaivong family, beginning with Chaophraya Aphaiphubet, whose people answered pressure to assimilate by minting their own coinage. The succession war of 1811–1813 was fought across this very borderland, when Prince Ang Snguon rose against his brother King Ang Chan II with Siamese backing while a Vietnamese army restored the king at Oudong. In 1821 Battambang was a prosperous Siamese-administered rice market, its Khmer population ruled from Bangkok through a local governor dynasty.
zh:
马德望位于桑盖河畔，柬埔寨西北的稻米平原经此向洞里萨湖排水。这座城镇从古老的贸易渡口发展起来，阇耶跋摩七世时期形成城市，乡野间吴哥时期的寺庙星罗棋布，其中最著名的是11世纪苏利耶跋摩一世为供奉黑天而建的埃克帕农寺，以及巴南寺——始建于乌迭蒂耶跋摩二世、完工于苏利耶跋摩二世，五座塔尖堪称吴哥窟的缩影。1431年阿瑜陀耶军队攻陷吴哥后，马德望沦为版图日蹙的高棉王国西部边镇之一：土地肥沃、笃信上座部佛教，也是暹罗军队入犯时首先踏足的地方。

后吴哥时代的数百年间，稻米维系着马德望的生机；当洛韦和乌栋的国王们沦为强邻棋子时，这里的市集仍吸引着高棉、暹罗和中国商人。1795年，西北诸省并入暹罗：马德望改称帕达邦，成为「内柬埔寨」的首镇，由阿派旺家族的高棉世家世代替曼谷治理，首任太守为昭披耶·阿派普贝；面对同化压力，当地高棉人以自铸钱币作答。1811至1813年的王位战争就以这片边地为棋盘：王子安斯农在暹罗支持下起兵对抗兄长安赞二世，越南军队则出兵恢复乌栋国王的权位。1821年的马德望是暹罗治下一座富庶的米市，高棉居民经由一个本地太守世家受曼谷管辖。

en:
Chaktomuk, the 'four-faced' river crossing, lies where the Mekong meets the Tonlé Sap and splits into the Bassac. The town later called Phnom Penh takes its name from Wat Phnom, the hill temple raised in 1372 by a wealthy widow, Penh, to house four Buddha statues found in a driftwood log. After Ayutthayan troops sacked Angkor in 1431, King Ponhea Yat led the court south and made Chaktomuk his capital. In 1444 it is the seat of the Khmer king and a busy river market, where cargoes from the Mekong valley and the lake country change hands at the meeting of the waters.

Ponhea Yat died around 1463, and strife among his sons eventually drove the court from Chaktomuk, first to Srey Santhor and later to Longvek and Oudong, while the riverside town kept its trade, with Japanese and Portuguese merchants settled there in the 1600s. In 1643 King Ramathipadi I, converted to Islam with the backing of Malay traders, turned on the Dutch East India Company, and in 1644 his warboats destroyed a Dutch fleet on the Mekong off Phnom Penh, killing the ambassador Pierre de Rogemortes; European merchants kept away from the Cambodian court for generations. In 1673–74 the town was the stronghold of the rebel king Kaev Hua II. In 1811 Prince Ang Snguon, backed by Siam, drove out his brother King Ang Chan II, who fled to Saigon; in 1813 a Vietnamese army under Lê Văn Duyệt restored him and built the fortress of Nam Vang at Phnom Penh, garrisoning a thousand men. By 1821 the old capital watched over a kingdom now under Vietnamese protection.
zh:
扎多木意为「四面」，是湄公河与洞里萨河相汇、又分出巴萨河的四河交汇之地。后来的金边得名于塔山：1372年，富孀边夫人在河中捞起一段漂木，内藏四尊佛像，便堆土成山、建寺供奉，是为塔山寺。1431年阿瑜陀耶军队攻破吴哥后，国王博涅亚率朝廷南迁至扎多木，以此为都。1444年的扎多木是高棉国王的居所，也是繁忙的河埠：湄公河流域与洞里萨湖一带来的货物在四水交汇处集散。

博涅亚约在1463年去世，诸子争位，朝廷最终弃扎多木而去，先迁斯雷桑托，后迁洛韦、乌栋，但河城的贸易未绝，17世纪已有日本和葡萄牙商人在此定居。1643年，在马来商人支持下改宗伊斯兰教的国王拉玛提巴迪一世与荷兰东印度公司反目；1644年，他的战船在金边附近的湄公河上歼灭一支荷兰舰队，荷兰使节皮埃尔·德·罗热莫尔特战死，此后几代欧洲商人都对柬埔寨朝廷避而远之。1673—1674年，这里是反叛国王乔华二世的据点。1811年，王子安斯农在暹罗支持下赶走其兄国王安赞二世，安赞逃往西贡；1813年黎文悦率越军护送他复位，并在金边修筑南荣堡，驻军千人。到1821年，这座旧都守护的已是一个受越南保护的王国。

en:
Luang Namtha is the forested north of the Lao world: the Nam Tha and its tributaries wind down from the Yunnan ridges to the Mekong through narrow green rice valleys cut in the hills. The older inhabitants were Khmu and other Mon-Khmer villagers of the slopes, and in the 14th and 15th centuries Tai Lue settlers moving south from Sipsong Panna planted wet-rice muang among them. The chief power of the country was Chiang Khaeng, a Mekong-bank town which its own chronicles say was founded by an exiled prince of Chiang Hung; its lords steered between Chiang Hung, Kengtung, Lan Na and Luang Prabang, paying tribute as power moved. In 1444 its ruler was Sao Krue Maing (1438–1446), and the king at Xieng Thong counted the Nam Tha valleys, rich in hill tea and forest ivory, within the wide mandala of Lan Xang.

By the beginning of the 16th century Chiang Khaeng was a vassal of Lan Na, and in 1558 the armies of Bayinnaung swept through on their conquest of the Tai world, carrying the little state into more than two centuries of Burmese overlordship, loosening whenever a Burmese empire faltered. Its line of ngwekunhmu lords kept their seat on the Mekong through these wars. After Sourigna Vongsa's death the frontier road carried Lan Xang's own succession quarrels: in 1705 the prince Kingkitsarat led a small army from his uncle's court in Sipsong Panna through these hills to seize Luang Prabang. In 1792 the widow of Chiang Khaeng's ruler founded Wiang Fa Ya in the Muang Sing valley and raised its great stupa, which drew Lue pilgrims from across the borderlands. By then Siamese arms of the new Chakri dynasty were reaching the upper Mekong, and in the early 19th century the country was repeatedly crossed by Burmese and Siamese armies, its muang sending tribute to whichever power's garrisons lay nearest. In 1821 Luang Namtha remained a forest march of overlapping lords — Bangkok, Burma and Chiang Hung — bound to each by tribute rather than ruled by any one.
zh:
琅南塔是老挝世界的北方林海：南塔河及其支流从云南方向的群山间蜿蜒而下，切开一道道狭长青翠的水稻坝子，汇入湄公河。这里更古老的居民是山坡上的克木人和其他孟—高棉语族村寨，14至15世纪，自西双版纳南下的泰楞（傣泐）人在他们中间建起种植水稻的勐。当地最强的政权是湄公河畔的香康，其编年史称该城由一位流亡的景洪王子所建；君长们周旋于景洪、景栋、兰纳和琅勃拉邦之间，势力消长时分别朝贡。1444年在位的是绍格孟（1438—1446年），川铜的澜沧王则把盛产山茶与林中象牙的南塔河谷算作澜沧曼荼罗的外缘。

到16世纪初，香康已成为兰纳的属邦；1558年，勃印曩的大军在征服泰语世界的途中席卷此地，将这个小邦带入长达两个多世纪的缅甸宗主权，只在缅甸各王朝衰弱的间隙稍得松动。其「银功穆」世系的君长们在战乱中始终坚守湄公河畔的王城。苏里亚旺萨死后，这条边境通道也卷入澜沧自身的继承之争：1705年，王子景吉萨从西双版纳的舅父处率一支小军穿过这些山岭，南下夺取琅勃拉邦。1792年，香康君主的遗孀在芒新河谷兴建万发雅，筑起大佛塔，吸引边境两侧的泰楞人前来朝拜。此时新兴的却克里王朝兵锋已及湄公河上游，19世纪初，这片土地屡遭缅军与暹军往来践踏，各勐向驻军最近的强权进贡。1821年的琅南塔，仍是曼谷、缅甸和景洪三方势力交叠的林边之地，对每一方都称臣纳贡，却不受任何一方实际统辖。

en:
The middle Mekong plains of Savanh Nakhone – 'the heavenly district', later called Savannakhet, Pali for 'field of gold' – were the rice heartland of southern Lan Xang. Its river muang of Khanthaburi stood where boats from Vientiane and the lower Mekong exchanged rice, salt, ivory and benzoin. The country had once been the centre of the Sikhottabong kingdom, whose court lay on the Banghiang River, and the Khmer temples at Heuan Hin date to the sixth and eighth centuries, when Angkor's reach ran this far north. Fa Ngum brought the plains into Lan Xang and restored the That Ing Hang stupa. In 1444, under King Chakkaphat, Savanh Nakhone was a wealthy Buddhist southern march of the million-elephant kingdom, its upland valleys still held by animist villages.

In 1478–1479 the White Elephant War brought Lê Thánh Tông's army through the plains on its march down the Mekong, until the crown prince destroyed the southern Vietnamese column and took the throne as Suvanna Balang in 1479. Setthathirat, who moved the Lan Xang capital to Vientiane in 1560, rebuilt That Ing Hang with a Lao-style spire. Burmese armies took Vientiane in 1574, and in 1579 a rising in Setthathirat's daughter's name swept up from Attapeu through these muang and seized the capital before it was crushed; Nokeo Koumane restored the kingdom's freedom in the early 1590s. Sourigna Vongsa's reign of 1637–1694 brought fifty-seven years of peace, and in 1641 the Dutch trader van Wuysthoff sailed past these banks on his way to Vientiane. After Lan Xang split, the plains passed to Vientiane, and in 1767–1770 Prince Kinnari crossed from here to found Mukdahan on the opposite bank. Siamese armies took Vientiane in 1778, and these river muang entered the Bangkok tributary order.
zh:
沙湾那空（Savanh Nakhone，意为「天域」，后改称沙湾拿吉，巴利语意为「黄金之地」）的湄公河中游平原，是澜沧南部的稻米之乡。河畔的勐坎塔武里（Khanthaburi，即后来的沙湾拿吉城）是渡口商镇，万象与湄公河下游的船只在此交易稻米、食盐、象牙和安息香。这一带古时是西科达崩古国的中心，王庭设在邦亨河畔；会欣（Heuan Hin）的高棉神庙建于6世纪至8世纪，当时吴哥的势力向北延伸至此。法昂将平原并入澜沧，并重修英航佛塔。1444年乍加帕王在位时，沙湾那空是澜沧这个「百万大象之国」富庶的南部佛教边陲，山地河谷里仍是泛灵信仰的村寨。

1478—1479年的白象之战中，后黎朝圣宗的军队穿过这片平原沿湄公河南下，太子苏瓦那·班朗歼灭了越军南路纵队，并于1479年即位为王。1560年迁都万象的赛塔提拉重修英航佛塔，为它加上老挝风格的塔尖。1574年缅军攻陷万象；1579年，以赛塔提拉之女之名发动的起义从阿速坡起兵，沿湄公河经过这些勐北上，一度攻克万象，终告失败；诺胶·古曼在1590年代初恢复了澜沧的独立。苏里亚旺萨在位的1637—1694年带来五十七年太平，1641年荷兰商人范·维斯霍夫乘船经过这段河岸前往万象。澜沧分裂后，平原归属万象王国；1767—1770年，金那里亲王从这里渡河西去，在对岸建立穆达汉。1778年暹罗军队攻陷万象，这些河畔诸勐从此纳入曼谷的朝贡体系。

en:
The southern Khorat Plateau rolls from the Mun River down to the wooded Dongrek crest dividing it from Cambodia. Moated Buddhist towns of the Dvaravati age grew here from the 7th century, and under the Khmer Empire the region was organised as Kok Khan, studded with stone temples such as Sikhoraphum on the road network centred on Phanom Rung. As Angkor collapsed in the 15th century, its towns shrank or were abandoned, and the forested borderland fell under Lan Xang, whose southern reach ran down to the Dongrek passes. In 1444 this was Lan Xang's remote south-western march: Khmer-speaking rice villagers along the Mun's watercourses and Kuy forest people, the oldest stock of the land, who caught and trained wild elephants for whichever king could claim their homage.

Records grow again only in the 18th century, when Kuy headmen led six stockaded clans in the woods. In 1759 a royal white elephant fled Ayutthaya into the Dongrek; the chief Ta Krachon ran it down and led it back, so King Ekkathat made him Luang Kaew Suwan and raised his village by the old Kok Khan site into the town of Khukhan. A fellow chief, Chiangpum, moved his people to better water at Ku Prathai in 1763, the future town of Surin, and carried elephants, ivory and rhinoceros horn as tribute to Ayutthaya. Kuy levies marched with Taksin's army in the Vientiane war of 1776-1778, and in 1786 Rama I renamed Chiangpum's town Surin after his title. After 1781, Khmer families fleeing civil war in Cambodia swelled the rice villages.
zh:
呵叻高原南部自蒙河缓缓向南抬升，直抵林木茂密、与柬埔寨分界的扁担山脉。7世纪起，陀罗钵地时期有壕沟围护的佛教城镇在此兴起；高棉帝国时期，这一带被划为「库坎」（Kok Khan），在以帕侬蓝为中心的道路网沿线建起西卡拉蓬等石庙。15世纪吴哥崩溃后，城镇或废或衰，这片林野边地转入澜沧之手，其南界一直延伸到扁担山各隘口。1444年，这里是澜沧西南的边远领地：蒙河水畔住着说高棉话的种稻乡民，林中有本地最古老的居民库伊人，他们为任何能使其称臣的国王围捕和驯练野象。

直到18世纪，库伊头人在林野中统领六个筑栅而居的氏族，记载才重新出现。1759年，阿瑜陀耶宫中的一头御赐白象逃入扁担山，头人达嘎琼（Ta Krachon）将其寻回献上，厄伽陀王封他为銮开素万，并把他在古库坎遗址旁的村落升为库坎城。同族头人清本于1763年率部众迁到水源更好的库巴泰，即后来的素辇城，并以大象、象牙和犀牛角向阿瑜陀耶入贡。1776至1778年郑昭远征万象时，库伊兵随征作战；1786年拉玛一世取清本的爵号，将其城改名素辇。1781年后，为躲避柬埔寨内战迁入的高棉人也充实了各稻米村落。

en:
The right-bank Mekong lands later called Nong Khai were older than the modern river town. Lan Xang chronicles name Wiang Khuk, Pakho and Pak Huai Luang on this reach, the last in present Phon Phisai; Fa Ngum took Pak Huai Luang around 1358, and Lan Xang later posted princes there as chao mueang. Monasteries and rice villages looked across the river toward Vientiane. In 1444, after Lan Xang's succession crisis, this remained a Lao Theravada borderland bound to the crown; the future site of Nong Khai was only a small settlement subject to Vientiane.

Local monastery inscriptions from this bank are dated 1555, 1566 and 1608, and Phra That Bang Phuan already stood before 1563, when Setthathirath endowed Buddhist lands and placed an image at the shrine. After Setthathirath withdrew down the Mekong before Burmese armies in 1560, Pak Huai Luang gradually lost importance, and Bayinnaung's later conquest of Vientiane brought the mueang into a period of Burmese overlordship and regency. When Lan Xang split in 1707, the right bank passed to the Kingdom of Vientiane. In 1779 Siamese forces under Chakri took Vientiane and resettled people from the capital at Phan Phrao, Pakho and Wiang Khuk. Through 1821 these settlements remained part of Anouvong's Siamese-protected Vientiane; the fortress town called Nong Khai had not yet been founded.
zh:
后来成为廊开的湄公河右岸地区，比近代廊开城镇更早形成聚落。澜沧编年史记载这一河段有Wiang Khuk、Pakho和Pak Huai Luang等孟，其中Pak Huai Luang在今蓬披赛一带；法昂约1358年攻取该地，后来澜沧派王族到此担任帕雅。寺院与稻田隔河朝向万象。1444年澜沧王统危机之后，这里仍是与王权相连的佬人上座部佛教边地；未来廊开城所在之处，当时还只是隶属万象的小村。

这一河岸留下了1555、1566和1608年的本地寺院碑铭；Bang Phuan佛塔在1563年前已经存在，赛塔提拉还曾向寺院捐赠土地并在塔中安置佛像。1560年赛塔提拉为避缅甸兵锋沿湄公河南撤后，Pak Huai Luang逐渐失去重要性；勃印曩后来攻占万象，这些孟邦进入缅甸宗主权与摄政时期。澜沧1707年分裂后，右岸各地归属万象王国。1779年，扎克里率领暹罗军攻破万象，把万象人口迁置到Phan Phrao、Pakho和Wiang Khuk。到1821年，这些聚落仍属于阿努冯治下、受暹罗保护的万象王国；名为廊开的军城尚未建立。

en:
Nong Bua Lamphu takes its name from the lotus marsh on the western approaches to Vientiane. A settlement had stood there in the older Khmer-influenced politics of the Khorat plateau before Lan Xang's expansion drew the route into Fa Ngum's mandala. The surrounding basin grew rice and linked Vientiane with Roi Et and the Chao Phraya world. In 1444, after Lan Xang's succession crisis, it was a Lao Theravada mueang on the kingdom's exposed western edge; the fortified town later became a traditional command for the crown prince, the uparat.

Setthathirat moved the capital to Vientiane in 1560 and in 1563 rebuilt old Nong Bua, settling Lao families and naming it Wiang Champa Nakhon Kab Kaeo Bua Ban as Vientiane's western frontier stronghold. In 1574 a Burmese-allied Ayutthayan army under Maha Thammaracha, with the young Naresuan in its train, camped there during the Vientiane campaign before smallpox forced Naresuan home. After Lan Xang split in 1707 the town passed to Vientiane. Around 1759 the nobles Phra Ta and Phra Vo rebuilt it as Nakhon Khueankhan; their open break with Ong Bun came in 1767, and Vientiane took the town in 1771, when Phra Ta was killed. Phra Vo's later killing in 1777 gave Taksin the casus belli against Vientiane. In December 1778 Chakri defeated Phaya Supho at Nong Bua Lamphu on the road to Vientiane, which fell in September 1779. Through 1821 the frontier remained under the Siamese-protected Kingdom of Vientiane.
zh:
廊磨喃蒲得名于万象西侧通道上的莲花沼泽。在澜沧扩张并把这条道路纳入法昂的盟邦体系之前，呵叻高原受高棉势力影响的旧政治中已有此地聚落。周围盆地种植稻米，把万象与黎逸以及昭披耶世界连接起来。1444年澜沧王统危机之后，这里是王国西陲的佬人上座部佛教孟邦；这座要塞后来成为王储（乌巴腊）的传统管辖之地。

赛塔提拉1560年迁都万象，1563年重建旧廊磨喃蒲，迁来佬人家族，将其命名为Wiang Champa Nakhon Kab Kaeo Bua Ban，作为万象西境重镇。1574年，玛哈·探玛拉差率领与缅甸结盟的阿瑜陀耶军队进攻万象，年幼的纳黎萱随军在此驻营，后来纳黎萱染上天花，被迫返回。澜沧1707年分裂后，该城归属万象。约1759年，贵族Phra Ta和Phra Vo将其重建为Nakhon Khueankhan；他们1767年与翁奔公开决裂，万象1771年攻破该城，Phra Ta战死。Phra Vo后来在1777年被杀，成为郑信征讨万象的导火索。1778年12月，扎克里在进军万象途中于廊磨喃蒲击败Phaya Supho，万象随后于1779年9月陷落。到1821年，这条西境通道仍处于受暹罗保护的万象王国治下。

en:
Chaiyaphum lies on the western Khorat Plateau, between the forested Phetchabun hills and the headwaters of the Chi, on the old road by which Dvaravati culture passed from the Chao Phraya plain into the northeast. Its Buddhist towns bounded themselves with carved sema stones, and Khmer rule later left small laterite sanctuaries such as Prang Ku; in 1186 Jayavarman VII numbered the district among his hospital foundations. As the old kingdoms faded the upland thinned to villages of Nyah Kur people, kin of the ancient Mon, in the western ridges. In 1444 this sparsely peopled grassland was a Lan Xang march facing Ayutthaya, its scattered hamlets held by Khmer-speaking villagers while Lao settlers filtered south along the streams.

The Lao-style chedi of Nong Sam Muen, built under King Setthathirath in the mid-16th century, marks Lan Xang's imprint, and in King Narai's registers Chaiyaphum appears as a dependency of Nakhon Ratchasima; its people later drifted away and the site decayed. In 1768 the headman Achan Kham of Ban Si Mum led his villagers to Taksin's army at the Cho Ho and Dan Khun Thot passes during the war on the Phimai faction, and was made Phra Narin Songkhram over a newly raised town placed under Khorat. Lao resettlement followed: under Rama I a Louang Phabang man named Phumi founded Khon San, and in 1809 Luang Krai Singhanat brought Vientiane families to Phu Khiao. In 1817 a Vientiane official named Lae crossed the Mekong with his following, moving in 1819 to within a few miles of the deserted site that would become Chaiyaphum.
zh:
猜也蓬地处呵叻高原西部，夹在林木覆盖的碧差汶山地与齐河上游之间，古时正是陀罗钵地文化从昭披耶平原传入东北的通道。当地佛教城镇以雕刻的界石标示地界，其后高棉统治留下普拉古（Prang Ku）等小型红土神祠；1186年，阇耶跋摩七世将这一带列入他兴建义诊院所的地方。古国消亡后，高原上人口日稀，西部山岭里住着与古孟人同源的尼亚库尔人（Nyah Kur）。1444年，这片人烟稀少的原野是澜沧面向阿瑜陀耶的边远领地，散布的村落住着说高棉话的乡民，老挝移民则沿溪流向南渗入。

农三满（Nong Sam Muen）的老挝式佛塔建于16世纪中叶赛塔提拉王时代，留有澜沧的印记；在那莱王的方志中，猜也蓬是那空叻差是玛的属城，后来居民流散，城址荒废。1768年，四木村（Ban Si Mum）头人阿赞堪率乡民在卓霍（Cho Ho）、坤武里（Dan Khun Thot）诸关加入郑昭讨伐披迈割据势力的军队，战后受封帕那林颂堪，四木被升为城，隶属呵叻。老挝人的再安置随之而来：拉玛一世时，琅勃拉邦人普密建立了贡善（Khon San）；1809年，銮凯辛纳率万象人家定居普乔（Phu Khiao）。1817年，万象官员莱率部渡过湄公河，1819年迁到日后猜也蓬城那处荒废城址附近。

en:
Phetchaburi straddles the Phetchaburi River at the northern end of the Malay peninsula, where the coastal road from Ayutthaya turns south. It began as a Dvaravati maritime port on the India–China trade route, was abandoned around the eleventh century with the decline of Dvaravati, and was refounded in the twelfth century as the small polity of Phrip Phri, whose rulers sent tribute to China. Ram Khamhaeng drew the town into Sukhothai's orbit, though it kept much of its autonomy, and in 1351 it entered the new kingdom of Ayutthaya as a fortified frontier city. In 1444 Phetchaburi was a Siamese, Theravada Buddhist garrison and market town guarding the road to the southern peninsula.

The frontier kept its wars. In 1581 a Cambodian raid stormed Phetchaburi, and the town returned to Siamese rule only after Naresuan's campaigns against Cambodia; Dutch and French sea captains knew it as Pipri and Piplee. When Maha Nawrahta's Burmese column marched on Ayutthaya in 1765–1767 the town was stormed again, and after the capital's fall it was recovered by King Taksin. Phetchaburi's levies went on serving in Taksin's Burmese wars and those of the early Chakri kings, through the Burmese wars of the late eighteenth and early nineteenth century.
zh:
碧武里横跨碧武里河，地处马来半岛北端，阿瑜陀耶南下的沿海道路在此折向南方。它最初是堕罗钵底时期印度—中国商路上的海港，约11世纪随堕罗钵底文明衰落而遭废弃，12世纪由碧里小国重建，其统治者向中国朝贡。兰甘亨将此城纳入素可泰的势力范围，但它仍保留相当大的自治权；1351年，碧武里作为设防的边塞城池并入新生的阿瑜陀耶王国。1444年的碧武里是一座暹罗人的上座部佛教驻军兼商镇，扼守通往南部半岛的道路。

这座边城此后仍屡经战阵。1581年高棉军队攻破碧武里，直到纳黎萱征伐柬埔寨之后，此城才重归暹罗；荷兰和法国的船长分别称这里为Pipri和Piplee。1765—1767年玛哈·瑙亚塔的缅军北上围攻阿瑜陀耶时，碧武里再遭攻破，都城陷落后由郑信收复。碧武里的军队后来继续随郑信及曼谷王朝早期诸王出征，投身18世纪末至19世纪初的历次对缅战争。

en:
Phitsanulok occupies a fertile Nan River plain on the routes between central Siam, the northern hills and the Mekong valleys. Its older town was Song Khwae, 'Two Rivers', where Sukhothai rulers built Wat Phra Si Rattana Mahathat and cast the revered Phra Phuttha Chinnarat. After Sukhothai's last king died there in 1438, Prince Ramesuan of Ayutthaya took charge of the town. In 1444 it was still the effective northern seat of the fading Sukhothai kingdom, bound closely to Ayutthaya and exposed to war with Lanna.

When Ramesuan became King Borommatrailokanat in 1448, Song Khwae passed fully under Ayutthaya. In 1463 he moved his residence there during the Ayutthaya-Lanna war, joined the eastern and western settlements behind one wall and renamed the place Phitsanulok. It later became the seat of the heir, and in 1563 submitted to Bayinnaung's Burmese army. Naresuan held it from 1571, emptied it in 1584 to deny supplies to Burma, and restored it in 1593 as a first-class governorship rather than a princely court. After Ayutthaya fell in 1767, Chaophraya Phitsanulok briefly claimed royal rank, but Thonburi forces took the city in 1768. A Burmese army under Maha Thiha Thura besieged it for four months in 1775 and largely destroyed it; in 1785 it was again abandoned, leaving the old frontier capital weakened into the early nineteenth century.
zh:
彭世洛坐落在难河的肥沃平原，控制暹罗中部、北部山地与湄公河流域之间的通道。旧城名为宋加洛，意为「两河」；素可泰诸王在此修建帕西雷达纳玛哈泰寺，并铸造备受尊崇的钦那拉佛。1438年末代素可泰国王在宋加洛去世后，阿瑜陀耶王子拉梅萱接管此城。1444年，这里仍是衰微的素可泰王朝实际上的北方都城，与阿瑜陀耶关系紧密，同时直面兰纳方向的战事。

1448年拉梅萱即位为波隆摩戴莱洛迦纳后，宋加洛正式并入阿瑜陀耶。1463年阿瑜陀耶与兰那交战期间，他把驻跸地迁到此城，将两岸聚落并入同一道城墙，并改名为彭世洛。此后这里常作为王储驻地，1563年向勃印曩的缅甸军队投降。纳黎萱1571年出镇此地，1584年为对缅作战而迁空城中人口，1593年将其恢复为一等城市，改由总督而非王储统治。1767年阿瑜陀耶陷落后，彭世洛昭披耶一度称王，但吞武里军队1768年攻取此城。1775年，马哈·蒂哈·图拉率缅军围城四个月，城破后城池大半被毁；1785年彭世洛再度遭弃，到19世纪初仍是一座元气大伤的北境旧城。

en:
Phra Bang, later Nakhon Sawan, stood where the Ping and Nan rivers meet to form the Chao Phraya. Settled by the Dvaravati period, it became the southern frontier city of Sukhothai, guarding the river road between the northern towns and the Ayutthaya plain. In a temple-land dispute of 1429, its governor described the town as lying within Ayutthaya's frontier. Thus in 1444 Phra Bang was still a Sukhothai border town in name, while its traffic and political future already pointed downstream to Ayutthaya.

After Borommatrailokanat's accession drew the Sukhothai lands into Ayutthaya in 1448, Phra Bang remained a northern administrative city and river market. Boats from the Ping and Nan gathered there before continuing to Ayutthaya, and armies moving between the capital and the northern frontier used the same crossing. Its position made it a staging point for Burmese forces; when Nemyo Thihapate's northern column entered northern Siam in August 1765, Phra Bang lay on the river road that ended at Ayutthaya, which fell in April 1767. During Taksin's restoration after 1767, the town was rearmed as a Siamese base against further Burmese incursions, and it remained a garrison and river junction into the Bangkok period.
zh:
勃拉邦（后称那空沙旺）位于宾河与难河汇合成昭披耶河之处。早在陀罗钵地时期这里已有聚落，后来成为素可泰南境的边关城市，扼守北方诸城通往阿瑜陀耶平原的河水道路。1429年的一场寺地争端中，城主已自称地处阿瑜陀耶边界内。因此到1444年，勃拉邦名义上仍是素可泰边城，商旅和政治走向却已指向下游的阿瑜陀耶。

1448年波隆摩戴莱洛迦纳即位、素可泰故土并入阿瑜陀耶后，勃拉邦仍是北部行政城市和河埠。宾河、难河来的船只在此汇合后继续南下阿瑜陀耶，军队往返北疆与都城也走同一通道。这种位置使它成为缅甸军队的集结地；1765年8月内苗·西哈波底的北路军攻入暹罗北部时，勃拉邦正处在通向阿瑜陀耶的河水道路上，都城最终于1767年4月陷落。1767年后郑信复国，勃拉邦被建设成暹罗抵御缅甸再次入侵的基地，到曼谷时代初期仍兼具驻军要塞与河运枢纽的地位。

en:
Chaiya faces the Gulf of Siam on the Malay Peninsula's east coast and may be the oldest settled place on this stretch of shore. Between the seventh and thirteenth centuries it was a Srivijayan seaport: Tang ceramics, Indian pottery and Persian glass have been found at Laem Pho, and matching finds on the Andaman coast at Takua Pa suggest a porter route across the isthmus that bypassed the pirates of the Strait of Malacca. A stone inscription of 775 records the Srivijayan king erecting stupas here, among them the Srivijaya-style stupa of Wat Phra Borommathat, built to house a relic of the Buddha. After Srivijaya's fall the town became the small mueang of Chaiya, and in 1444 it lay on the northern approaches of the Ligor kingdom, its people living from the Gulf's fishing grounds.

Unlike its neighbours, which answered to Ligor, Chaiya was administered directly from the Siamese capital, and it stayed a quiet Theravada market town through the Ayutthayan centuries, its ancient monastery drawing pilgrims to the old stupa. The south's allegiances shifted around it—Taksin retook the region in 1769 and Burmese armies sacked Ligor in 1786—but Chaiya's harbour went on landing fish for the coastal trade rather than the Indian Ocean cargoes of its Srivijayan heyday.
zh:
猜亚位于马来半岛东岸、临暹罗湾，可能是这一带海岸最古老的定居点。7至13世纪，这里是三佛齐的海港：兰坡海滩出土过唐代瓷器、印度陶器和波斯玻璃器，而在安达曼海沿岸的他古来也有同类遗物出土，说明当时可能存在一条横跨地峡的搬运道，绕开马六甲海峡的海盗。775年的一方石碑记载三佛齐国王在此建起数座佛塔，其中包括三佛齐式的帕波罗玛塔佛塔，用以供奉佛舍利。三佛齐衰落后，此地成为小城邦猜亚，1444年时地处洛坤王国的北缘，居民以暹罗湾渔场为生。

与臣属洛坤的邻邦不同，猜亚由暹罗王都直接管辖。整个阿瑜陀耶时代，它始终是一座安静的上座部佛教集镇，古寺香火不断，吸引香客前来礼拜佛塔。南方的归属几度反复——郑信1769年重新征服南方，缅军1786年洗劫洛坤——而猜亚的港湾依旧卸下渔获供应沿海贸易，再没有三佛齐鼎盛时期印度洋商船云集的景象。

en:
Thalang covers the large Andaman Sea island later called Phuket, whose old capital stood in its northern district and gave the province its name. Malays knew the island as Tanjung Salang, the 'Cape Salang' that European charts would corrupt into Junk Ceylon. Between the seventh and thirteenth centuries it belonged to the maritime world of Srivijaya, and late in the thirteenth century it passed, through Ligor, into the orbit of Sukhothai and the Siamese kingdoms that followed. Lying on the sea lane from India to China, it dealt in pearls, ambergris and forest produce and was troubled by Malay pirates. In 1444 it was a small Malay-speaking Muslim island mueang on the edge of the Ligor kingdom, its people living mainly by fishing.

The Portuguese traveller Fernão Mendes Pinto found Junk Ceylon a port of call in 1545, already harassed by pirates. The Dutch opened a factory in 1626, after which Dutch, English and French bidders competed for its tin: King Narai set the French missionary René Charbonneau over the island with his seat at Thalang, and in 1685 granted the French a tin monopoly, but after the revolution of 1688 a French expedition seized the town in April 1689 and abandoned it within a year. In 1785 a Burmese army invaded during the Nine Armies' War. The governor was dead, but his widow Chan, granddaughter of the Sultan of Kedah, and her sister Muk held Thalang for a month with a few hundred defenders and women paraded as soldiers on the walls; the Burmese withdrew on 13 March, and Rama I afterwards made the sisters Thao Thep Kasattri and Thao Si Sunthon. War returned in 1809, when Burmese forces stormed Thalang and Tha Rua, and by the peace of 1812 the island lay depopulated and its old town in ruins.
zh:
塔廊（中文维基译他朗，Thalang）占据安达曼海上后来称普吉的大岛，旧都在岛北，省名即由此而来。马来人称之为丹戎沙廊（Tanjung Salang），欧洲海图讹作Junk Ceylon，中国清代载籍称「养西岭」。7至13世纪，这里属于三佛齐的海洋世界，13世纪末经洛坤被纳入素可泰及此后暹罗诸王朝的势力范围。岛屿地处印度至中国的航道上，交易珍珠、龙涎香和山林特产，也常受马来海盗侵扰。1444年，它是洛坤王国边缘一个讲马来语的穆斯林海岛城邦，居民多以捕鱼为生。

葡萄牙旅行家费尔南·门德斯·平托1545年见到养西岭时，它还是商船的停靠港，只是已深受海盗之苦。荷兰人1626年在此设立商馆，此后荷兰、英国、法国为岛上的锡矿明争暗斗：那莱王派法国传教士勒内·沙博诺治理此岛、驻节塔廊，又在1685年把锡矿专营权授予法国；但1688年革命后，法国远征军于1689年4月攻占塔廊，不到一年便弃守而去。1785年九军之战，缅军大举来犯。府尹已经战死，他的遗孀莊——吉打苏丹的孙女——与妹妹穆率数百守军，并令妇女扮成士兵在城头列队，苦守塔廊一个月，缅军终在3月13日撤退；拉玛一世后来封姐妹二人为帖卡撒隄与席顺通。1809年战火再起，缅军攻陷塔廊和呈娘港，到1812年和议达成时，全岛人口流散，旧城已成废墟。

en:
The Klang River reaches the Strait of Malacca at Klang, the oldest settlement on this coast; bronze axes and a bronze bell of the second century BC have been dug up near its estuary, and the sailing charts used by Zheng He's fleets mark the port there. In the 15th century the coast behind it was not one kingdom but a chain of river chiefdoms, Klang and Jeram among them, whose chiefs were appointed by the Sultan of Malacca. In 1444 their rice, tin and jungle produce moved downriver to Malacca's bazaars, and the estuaries were counted among the northern provinces of the Malaccan realm.

After Malacca fell to the Portuguese in 1511 the river chiefdoms passed to Johor, whose wars brought Bugis mercenaries from Sulawesi; they settled the Selangor and Klang estuaries in growing numbers, led by the kin of five Bugis brothers. In 1743 Raja Lumu, son of the Bugis Yam Tuan Muda Daeng Chelak, was made ruler of Selangor at Kuala Selangor, and his later coronation as Sultan Salehuddin Shah by the Sultan of Perak founded the only Bugis dynasty on the peninsula. On 13 July 1784 a Dutch fleet stormed the fort at Kuala Selangor and drove out Sultan Ibrahim, who retook it in a raid in 1785 with Pahang's help. Ibrahim opened political relations with the British in 1818, leaving the Klang valley an independent Bugis sultanate as the period closed.
zh:
巴生河在巴生注入马六甲海峡，巴生是这片海岸最古老的定居点：河口一带出土过公元前2世纪的青铜斧和铜铃，郑和船队所用的航海图也把这里标为吉令港。15世纪时，后方沿海并非统一的王国，而是巴生、而榄等一连串由马六甲苏丹任命酋长的河口领地。1444年，此地的稻米、锡砂和林产顺河而下，运入马六甲的市集，这片河口地带是马六甲版图北方诸省之一。

1511年马六甲落入葡萄牙之手后，各河口领地转归柔佛；柔佛的战事把苏拉威西的武吉斯雇佣兵带来此地，他们越来越多地定居于雪兰莪河与巴生河的河口，五兄弟的族人势力最大。1743年，武吉斯副王邓切拉之子拉惹鲁穆在瓜拉雪兰莪受任为雪兰莪统治者，后来由霹雳苏丹册立为苏丹沙拉胡丁沙，开创了马来半岛唯一的武吉斯王朝。1784年7月13日，荷兰舰队攻陷瓜拉雪兰莪的河口要塞，驱逐苏丹依布拉欣；他于1785年借彭亨之援突袭收复要塞，又于1818年开始与英国通好；这一时期结束时，巴生河流域已是一个独立的武吉斯苏丹国。

en:
Terengganu stretches along the South China Sea coast between Pahang and Kelantan, its river mouths forming a string of roadsteads where Chinese junks anchored. Chinese seafarers recorded its name as early as the sixth century, and around 1330 Wang Dayuan visited and found lakawood, beeswax, camphor and tortoiseshell among its exports. At Kuala Berang, up the Terengganu River, stands a granite stele inscribed in Jawi with the edicts of a Muslim ruler, Seri Paduka Tuan, dated 1303 or 1387, the oldest Islamic inscription in the Malay world. The little kingdom passed from Srivijaya's orbit to Majapahit's tributaries in 1365. In 1444 its Muslim chiefs still governed the river valleys, owing loose homage to both Siam and the rising sultanate of Malacca.

In the later fifteenth century Terengganu became a Malaccan dependency, and after Malacca's fall in 1511 it passed into Johor's orbit while still sending tribute to Ayutthaya. By 1699 it was the chief pepper supplier for Chinese merchants on the east coast, though it could barely muster five hundred warriors and had no fleet. An Ayutthayan invasion in 1710 broke off when the Siamese turned to meet a Vietnamese attack in Cambodia, and in 1718 the fugitive Johor sultan Abdul Jalil Shah IV set up a rival court in Terengganu, granting its chiefs high Malay titles. In 1725 Tun Zainal Abidin, brother of a former sultan of Johor, was installed as its first sultan. Sultan Mansur, who reigned from 1741 to 1793, built a Malay league against the Bugis and in 1764 extended his power over divided Kelantan. By the early nineteenth century Terengganu sent the annual bunga mas tribute to Bangkok.
zh:
丁加奴（今登嘉楼）位于彭亨与吉兰丹之间的南海沿岸，各河河口形成一连串泊地，中国帆船常来停泊。中国水手早在6世纪就记下了它的名字；约1330年汪大渊到访，在《岛夷志略》中记载当地输出降真香、黄蜡、龙脑和玳瑁。丁加奴河上游的瓜拉伯浪立有一方爪夷文花岗岩石碑，碑文是穆斯林君主斯里·巴杜卡·端颁布的教法谕令，纪年可读作1303年或1387年，是马来世界最早的伊斯兰铭文。这个小国先在室利佛逝的势力圈内，1365年成为满者伯夷的藩属。1444年，本地的穆斯林酋长仍统治着各河谷，同时向暹罗和崛起的马六甲松散称臣。

15世纪后期丁加奴成为马六甲属邦，1511年马六甲灭亡后转入柔佛势力圈，同时也向阿瑜陀耶纳贡。到1699年，它已是东海岸中国商人的主要胡椒供应地，却只能凑出五百名战士，没有舰队。1710年阿瑜陀耶来犯，因暹军转赴柬埔寨抵御越南进攻而作罢；1718年，流亡的柔佛苏丹阿卜杜勒·贾利勒沙四世在丁加奴另立朝廷，向当地酋长授予高位。1725年，已故柔佛苏丹之弟敦再纳·阿比丁被拥立为首任苏丹。满速沙苏丹1741年至1793年在位，组成马来联盟对抗武吉斯人，1764年乘吉兰丹分裂将其纳入势力范围。到19世纪初，丁加奴每年向曼谷进献金花贡品。

en:
Rice flatlands stretch between jungled hills and the Strait of Malacca here, at the northern end of the great Malay rice belt. The Kedah River mouth is an old harbour, where Indian and Arab traders steered by Kedah Peak, and the Bujang Valley had held marts and temples since the days of Srivijaya. The date of the court's conversion to Islam is disputed, the Kedah Annals giving 1136 and an Acehnese account as late as 1474. In 1444 its ruler held a string of river capitals, sent the golden flowers of tribute north to Ayutthaya, and shipped rice and tin south to Malacca and onward into the Indian Ocean trade.

The Portuguese seizure of Malacca in 1511 exposed Kedah to every navy in the strait: Portuguese squadrons raided its coast, and in 1619 the fleets of Aceh's Sultan Iskandar Muda sacked the kingdom and its sultan was carried to Aceh. On 30 December 1735 the nineteenth ruler, Sultan Muhammad Jiwa, founded Kota Setar, later Alor Setar, the eighth capital in Kedah's history. In 1770 a Bugis armada under Raja Haji burned the new palace there, and the sultan turned for help to Francis Light and the East India Company; the bargain cost him Penang in 1786 and the mainland strip of Province Wellesley in 1800 without ever buying the promised protection. In November 1821 a Siamese army from Ligor stormed Kedah and drove out Sultan Ahmad Tajuddin, so that as the period closed the old kingdom lay under direct Siamese rule.
zh:
这里地处马来大米产区的北端，冲积平原在丛林丘陵与马六甲海峡之间展开。吉打河口自古是良港，印度和阿拉伯商人以吉打峰为航标，布秧谷一带自室利佛逝时代便有商埠和寺庙。吉打宫廷何时归信伊斯兰教说法不一，《吉打纪年》称始于1136年，亚齐方面的记载则作1474年。1444年，这里的君主在一连串河口设都，北方向阿瑜陀耶进贡金银花，稻米与锡砂南运马六甲，再转销印度洋。

1511年葡萄牙攻占马六甲后，吉打暴露在海峡各支舰队面前：葡萄牙船队屡犯海岸，1619年亚齐苏丹伊斯干达·穆达的大军洗劫吉打，苏丹也被带往亚齐。1735年12月30日，第十九任君主苏丹莫哈末吉瓦兴建哥打士打，即日后的亚罗士打，是吉打历史上第八座都城。1770年，拉惹哈吉率领的武吉斯舰队焚毁新都王宫；苏丹转而求助于法兰西斯·莱特和英国东印度公司，结果1786年割让槟榔屿、1800年再割大陆上的威斯利省，却始终没有换来承诺的保护。1821年11月，洛坤派出的暹罗军队攻陷吉打，驱逐苏丹阿末塔祖丁，这一时代结束时，古老的吉打已处于暹罗直接统治之下。

en: Hkamti Long, the 'Great Place of Gold' of the Hkamti Shan, fills the upper Mali river valley beneath the snowy ridges north of Myitkyina, with Putao as its main town: seven tiny principalities founded as an outlying dependency of Möng Kawng, their Buddhist rice villages ringed by the animist Kachin and Nung hills. In 1444 it answered to the sawbwa of Mogaung, and its fortunes followed his through Ava's campaigns and the Ming occupations; all the country yielded was gold washed from the Mali and a trickle of hill trade. In 1799 Hkamti bands that had drifted toward Assam joined the Mishmis and other hill peoples in a rising at Sadiya, and in 1810 and 1811 the Khamti and Singpho drove out its Ahom governor and ruled the tract, later guiding the Burmese invasions of Assam that began in 1817. When Bodawpaya annexed Mogaung in 1796, Hkamti Long carried on as the remnant of the old principality.
zh: 坎底（Hkamti Long，当地又作坎底龍）在坎底掸语中意为「大金地」，地处密支那以北、雪岭之下的迈立开江上游谷地，以葡萄为首镇。它本是孟拱的边陲属地，由七个小酋邦组成：坝子里是信奉上座部佛教的坎底掸人稻田村落，四周山中是奉泛灵信仰的克钦人和侬人。1444年它听命于孟拱诏法，阿瓦的征伐和明军的占领都随之波及于此；此地所出，不过是迈立开江中淘出的沙金和零星山货。1799年，已向阿萨姆方向迁去的坎底人联合米什米人等山地部族在萨地亚起事；1810至1811年，坎底人与新颇人驱逐阿洪总督，据有该地，后来又为1817年起缅甸数次入侵阿萨姆引路。1796年波道帕耶吞并孟拱后，坎底作为旧邦的残余继续存续。

en:
Möng Kawng, the Burmese Mogaung, had its seat on the Nam Kawng river in the northern hills; Shan chronicles trace the state to the saopha Sam Long Hpa, whom scholarship places in the mid-fourteenth century, ruling from the Mali country above Myitkyina to the Naga hills as a tributary of Mong Mao. Jade from the Uyu hills already passed through its markets into Yunnan in Ming times. When the Ming destroyed Mong Mao, Si Jifa, son of Si Renfa, fled to Möng Kawng, and in 1444 its sawbwa sheltered him, fending off Ming demands while the Kingdom of Ava pressed from the south.

Ava stormed Mogaung in 1477 and carried the sawbwa off to rule Tagaung, and Ming armies occupied the country from 1479 to 1483 and again briefly in 1495. In 1524 a Mogaung host crossed the Patkai to Sadiya in Assam and was beaten back. Möng Kawng submitted to Bayinnaung in 1557, joined the great revolt of 1571 and rose again in 1574; the king marched north in person, and the sawbwa Si Gefa, ruling since 1564, was hunted in the hills for years before being taken around 1580. Burmese occupation ran from 1651 to 1742 and again from 1771 to 1775. In 1769 Fu Heng crossed the upper Irrawaddy and the Mogaung chiefs submitted, presenting elephants, until the Kaungton treaty restored Burmese rule; in 1796 Bodawpaya annexed the state and set wuns over it, while the reopened caravan trade carried its jade into a China mad for the stone under the Qianlong emperor.
zh:
孟拱，缅语称莫冈，首府在南拱河（今莫冈河）畔的北境群山间。掸族编年史把它的兴起追溯到诏法三隆法，史家考证他实为14世纪中叶的人物；其疆域北抵迈立开江上游、西达那加丘陵，向麓川称臣。明代时，雾露河（乌尤河）谷所产的翡翠已通过孟拱的市集转贩云南。麓川被明朝攻灭后，思任法之子思机法逃入孟拱，1444年孟拱诏法容留了他，一面应付明朝的追索，一面抵挡南面的阿瓦。

1477年，阿瓦攻破孟拱，把诏法迁往太公城安置；1479至1483年明军占领其地，1495年又再度短暂占领。1524年，孟拱的大军翻越巴特开山攻入阿萨姆的萨地亚，被击退。1557年孟拱臣服于莽应龙，1571年参与大叛乱，1574年再度起兵；莽应龙亲自北征，1564年继位的诏法思个法在山中被追缉多年，约1580年被擒。1651至1742年孟拱被缅甸占领，1771至1775年再度被占。1769年傅恒渡过大金沙江上段，孟拱土司归降并献驯象，老官屯和议后其地复归缅甸；1796年波道帕耶正式吞并孟拱，改派温官治理，重新打通的马帮贸易则把翡翠源源运往正为翡翠狂热的乾隆朝中国。

en: Tamanthi is a riverside clearing on the upper Chindwin, where the river runs through forested hills between the Naga country and the gold-bearing Uyu stream. Its Shan villagers kept the old animist rites and, with the hamlets around Homalin, answered to the great Shan saopha of Möng Yang (Mohnyin); in 1444 the upper Chindwin was still their world, untouched by the Buddhist kings downriver. Bayinnaung's armies changed that in 1557, when his conquest of the northern Shan states reached to the Patkai range. Around 1700 the villages here planted tea gardens and won a name for pickled tea, laphet. In 1820 Hkamti Shan migrants moving down from Hkamti Long founded a new chief's seat below Tamanthi at Singkaling Hkamti, while Kachin raiders kept the upper river unsettled.
zh: 德曼迪是钦敦江上游江畔的一处村落，江流在此穿过森林山地，西边是那加丘陵，东边不远的乌尤河沙里产金。村中的掸人保留着古老的泛灵祭仪，他们和霍马林一带的村寨都听命于北方大邦孟养（莫宁）；1444年时，钦敦江上游还是掸人的天地，不受下游佛教诸王管辖。1557年，莽应龙（勃印曩）平定北方诸掸邦，兵锋直抵帕特凯山，这里的局面随之改变。约1700年，沿江村寨开辟茶园，以腌茶闻名，缅语称这种茶为勒派。1820年，自坎蒂隆南迁的坎蒂掸人在德曼迪下游另立坎蒂土司治所，而克钦袭掠者仍使上游江路不得安宁。

en:
Thaungdut was the Burmese name of Hsawnghsup, called Somsok in the Manipur chronicles, an outlying Shan principality in the northern Kabaw Valley, where the forests run up to the ridge above Manipur. Its saopha kept his seat west of the Chindwin over Shan rice-growers and Chin villagers of the hills. Thaungdut was one of the three old principalities of the Kale-Kabaw country, and in 1444 the little state lay on the contested edge between Ava, the greater Shan powers and the Manipur kingdom.

In 1470 King Kiyamba of Manipur and the saopha of Pong, or Mogaung, overran Thaungdut and divided it; the Chindwin share passed to Pong, under which it long remained. Bayinnaung's rise soon made Burma a rival claimant to the valley, and the empire had to send levies to beat off Manipuri raids on Thaungdut in 1647 and 1692. Alaungpaya made it a base of the Burmese reconquest, garrisoning Tamu and Thaungdut after his invasion of Manipur in 1758, and Hsinbyushin carried the war back in 1764, carrying off many captives. In 1804 the chiefs of fourteen villages, Thaungdut and Tamu among them, sent tribute to the Manipuri king Bhagyachandra; by the Konbaung years the saopha's seat had been moved to a riverside post on the Chindwin, to which the name Thaungdut attached.
zh:
当都是一个边远小掸邦的缅语名称，曼尼普尔的宫廷编年史里也记载着这个邦。它位于格包河谷北部，密林一直铺到俯瞰曼尼普尔的山脊；诏法的治所原在钦敦江以西，治下既有种稻的掸人，也有山里的钦人。当都是格礼—格包一带三个古老小邦之一，1444年正夹在阿瓦、北方大掸邦与曼尼普尔王国之间，是各方势力拉锯的边地。

1470年，曼尼普尔王与「蓬国」（即孟拱）的诏法联手攻占当都并瓜分其地，钦敦江一侧归蓬国，当都此后长期附属于孟拱。莽应龙（勃印曩）崛起后，缅甸历代王朝也对格包河谷提出主权；1647年和1692年，曼尼普尔两度袭掠当都，缅甸朝廷都调兵驰援。雍笈牙把这里变成反攻的基地：1758年亲征曼尼普尔后，在德穆、当都屯驻守军；辛标信又于1764年再征曼尼普尔，掳走大量人口。1804年，包括当都、德穆在内的十四个村寨头人向曼尼普尔王进贡。贡榜年间，诏法的治所已东迁到钦敦江畔，这个新治所便被称作当都。

en:
Bagan stands on the east bank of the Irrawaddy amid the greatest temple plain in Southeast Asia. The chronicles date its walls to 849 and King Pyinbya, and from Anawrahta's accession in 1044 it was the capital of the first Burmese kingdom: for two and a half centuries kings, nobles and monks raised more than 10,000 brick pagodas and monasteries, and the city drew students of Pali from India, Sri Lanka and the Khmer lands. Mongol invasions after 1277 broke the kingdom, and by 1297 the court was gone. In 1444 Bagan is a small town of the Ava kingdom, kept alive by pilgrimage to a score of great temples, among them the Ananda, Shwezigon and Sulamani, while thousands more crumble slowly into the dry plain.

After the Mohnyin Shans sacked Ava in 1527, Bagan passed under Shan rule until Bayinnaung folded it back into his Toungoo empire in 1555. It fell to the Mon armies of Pegu with the rest of Upper Burma in 1752 and was recovered by Alaungpaya's Konbaung forces soon after. Konbaung kings then sponsored sweeping, often heavy-handed renovations, repainting frescoes and whitewashing the Thatbyinnyu and the Ananda, and pilgrims kept the old royal city alive long after its political power had departed.
zh:
蒲甘位于伊洛瓦底江东岸，坐拥东南亚最壮观的佛塔平原。据缅甸编年史记载，彬比亚王于849年筑起城墙；1044年阿奴律陀即位后，这里成为第一个统一缅甸的王国之都。此后两个半世纪里，国王、贵族与僧侣建起上万座砖构佛塔和寺院，远道来学巴利经典的僧人遍及印度、斯里兰卡与高棉。1277年后蒙古大军连年入侵，王国瓦解，到1297年宫廷已彻底迁出。1444年的蒲甘是阿瓦王国治下的一座小城，只靠阿难陀寺、瑞喜宫、苏拉曼尼寺等二十来座大刹的香火延续，其余数千座寺塔在干旱平原上渐渐倾颓。

1527年孟养掸军攻破阿瓦，蒲甘转入掸族统治，直到1555年勃印曩将它重新收入东吁帝国。1752年它又随上缅甸一同落入勃固孟族之手，不久被雍笈牙的贡榜军队收复。此后贡榜诸王大兴修缮，手笔却常常粗重：重绘壁画，把他冰瑜寺和阿难陀寺刷成白色；在王权远去之后，是往来不绝的朝圣者维系着这座古都的生机。

en:
Hsipaw, the Burmese Thibaw and the Chinese Xibo, sits in the rice valley where the Nam Tu (the Myitnge) breaks out of the northern Shan hills towards Ava. Its saophas came of the Onbaung line, ruling first from the old capital of Onbaung before the court moved to Hsipaw. The sawbwa Hsan Hpa, known to the Burmese as Le Than Bwa, had kept the state independent of Ava since 1426 and had even engineered the murder of King Thihathu of Ava in 1425; but the great Ming armies campaigning against Möng Mao on his northern border forced him to submit to Ava in 1444. In that year Hsipaw stood as Ava's foremost Shan ally, a Theravada Buddhist principality whose levies were soon to be the chief prop of the shrinking Ava kingdom.

His successors remained Ava's steadiest friends through the long war with the Confederation of Shan States, and a son of the saopha Hkonmaing sat on the Ava throne itself from 1543 to 1546. Hsipaw submitted to Bayinnaung in March 1557, was seized later that year by a rebellious Mone which killed the Burmese nominee, and was reconquered by the king's armies in November. In 1605 it fell without a fight to Nyaungyan Min, who died south of the town on his way back to Ava. Hsipaw's last battle came with the Qing invasion of 1767: Ming Rui's Bannermen took the town within days and routed Maha Sithu's army at the Goteik Gorge just to the south in late December, the opening blow of a campaign that ended in annihilation at Maymyo the following March.
zh:
昔卜，缅语称迪波，中国史籍作锡箔，坐落于南杜河（米界河）冲出掸北群山、流向阿瓦的稻米谷地。其诏法出自 Onbaung 世系，早先定都同名旧城，后来宫廷迁至昔卜。诏法 Hsan Hpa（缅语称 Le Than Bwa）1426年起使本邦脱离阿瓦自立，他还曾于1425年策划刺杀阿瓦国王梯诃都；但明朝征讨麓川的大军压境北境，迫使他在1444年向阿瓦臣服。1444年的昔卜由此成为阿瓦在掸邦中最主要的盟邦，这个上座部佛教小邦的军队不久后更成了日薄西山的阿瓦王国的支柱。

其后继者在阿瓦对抗掸邦联盟的漫长战争中始终是阿瓦最坚定的盟友，诏法 Hkonmaing 之子更于1543至1546年登上阿瓦王位。昔卜1557年3月归顺勃印曩，同年即被起兵的孟乃攻占、缅方任命的诏法被杀，11月又被缅王大军收复。1605年，昔卜不战而降于良渊王，良渊本人在返回阿瓦途中病逝于城南。昔卜的最后一场大战是1767年清军入侵：明瑞麾下的八旗兵数日之内拿下该城，又于12月底在城南的谷特峡谷击溃玛哈·西都的缅军，这一仗拉开了整场入侵的序幕，而入侵最终于次年3月在眉苗全军覆没。

en:
Möng Pai, called Mobye in Burmese, was a small Shan möng set in the forested frontier where the southern Shan Plateau meets the Karenni hills. The chief town was a saopha's seat, and the tracks around it linked Ava's lowland frontier with the greater Shan principalities, including Onbaung-Hsipaw. Shan families shared the uplands with Karenni and other Karen-speaking communities. In 1444 Möng Pai was a minor highland chiefdom on the troubled southeastern edge of the Ava world, exposed to the rivalries of greater Shan and Burmese courts.

Its chief entered those rivalries in 1545, when Sao Hso Kaw Hpa, son of Hkonmaing of Onbaung-Hsipaw, took the Ava throne as Narapati III. He made peace with Toungoo but could not overcome Sithu Kyawhtin at Sagaing, and in October 1551 he was driven from Ava to Pegu, where Bayinnaung received him. Bayinnaung's campaigns of 1556-1557 then broke the Shan confederation and brought Möng Pai under Toungoo suzerainty; its local saopha remained to rule the hills under Burmese overlordship.
zh:
孟拜，缅语称莫别，是南掸高原与克耶山地交界处森林中的一个小型掸人「勐」。首邑是诏法驻地，周围山路连接阿瓦低地边疆与翁包—昔卜等较大的掸邦。掸人家族与克耶人及其他克伦语社群共同居住在这片高地。1444年，孟拜是阿瓦势力东南边缘的小土邦，直接暴露在诸掸邦强藩与缅甸宫廷的竞争之中。

1545年，孟拜诏法、翁包—昔卜统治者孔迈之子登上阿瓦王位，称那罗波蒂三世。他与东吁议和，却无法战胜据守实皆的西都觉丁，1551年10月被逐出阿瓦，南逃勃固，受到勃印曩庇护。1556—1557年，勃印曩的征战击垮掸邦同盟，孟拜被纳入东吁宗主权之下；本地诏法仍在缅甸最高权力之下统辖山地。

en:
Sandoway, now Thandwe and called Dvaravati in Arakanese tradition, lies in a narrow hill-girt valley on the Sandoway River, a few miles from a Bay of Bengal roadstead. After the collapse of Launggyet, southern Arakan became a separate power around Sandoway. In the 1420s Saw Yin Mi ruled as queen after her husband's death; when one son killed another and seized power, she offered the town to Mrauk U in 1437 and married King Min Khayi. In 1444 Sandoway was therefore the southern port of a newly unified Arakanese kingdom, a Buddhist Arakanese market town between the Rakhine hills and the sea.

Khayi's reign gave the coast stability, and in 1455 Ava recognized Mrauk U as a sovereign kingdom. Sandoway lay behind the sea power of Arakan's great age: Mrauk U repulsed Toungoo invasions in 1546-1547 and 1580-1581, while Arab, Portuguese, Dutch and Danish traders frequented the kingdom's shores. The independent era closed when Bodawpaya's Konbaung armies conquered Arakan in 1785. Sandoway then became a provincial town of the Burmese empire, its river and roadstead carrying the rice, timber and salted fish of the surrounding hills.
zh:
山多威即今丹兑，在阿拉干传统中称德瓦拉瓦底，坐落在山多威河一片群山环抱的狭谷中，距孟加拉湾的锚地数英里。隆吉崩溃后，阿拉干南部以山多威为中心形成独立势力。1420年代，苏茵米在丈夫死后以女王身份统治；后来一个儿子杀死兄弟夺位，她便在1437年把山多威献给妙乌，并嫁给卡意王。1444年，山多威已是重新统一的阿拉干王国南部门户，是若开山地与海洋之间的上座部佛教市镇。

卡意的统治给海岸带来稳定，1455年阿瓦承认妙乌为主权王国。山多威也处在阿拉干海上盛世的屏障之后：妙乌在1546—1547年和1580—1581年两度击退东吁入侵，阿拉伯、葡萄牙、荷兰和丹麦商人也出入王国海岸。1785年，波道帕耶的贡榜军队征服阿拉干，独立时代结束。山多威随之成为缅甸帝国的地方城镇，河口与锚地运输周围山地出产的稻米、木材和咸鱼。

en:
Moulmein, now called Mawlamyine, stands on the east bank of the Salween at its mouth, where the Gyaing and Ataran rivers join it and Bilu Island shelters the anchorage, across the water from Martaban. It is an old Mon town, with the Kyaikthanlan pagoda on its ridge above the harbour. In 1444 it was a district town of the Martaban province of the Mon kingdom of Hanthawaddy, sharing the roadstead with the far greater port of Martaban on the opposite shore, where the glazed jars known across the Indian Ocean as martabans were shipped.

In 1479 the Kalyani inscriptions set up by King Dhammazedi at Pegu numbered Moulmein among the thirty-two Mon towns of the Martaban division. When Tabinshwehti's Toungoo armies stormed Martaban in May 1541 they crossed the estuary and took Moulmein as well. In 1594 its governor rebelled in league with Naresuan of Siam, and the town stayed under Siamese rule until Burmese armies recovered the coast in 1614. It was swept into the Mon restoration of Hanthawaddy in 1740 and brought back under the Konbaung kings by 1757. The long Burmese–Siamese wars then made it a staging post: in 1760 the general Minkhaung Nawrahta repaired the town on his way back from the Ayutthaya front, and in 1764 Maha Nawrahta repaired the Kyaikthanlan pagoda while marching on Tavoy.
zh:
摩棉，即今毛淡棉，位于萨尔温江口东岸，吉英河与阿特兰河在此汇入，比卢岛为港湾遮风挡浪，隔水便是马达班。这是一座古老的孟人城镇，吉桃兰塔（Kyaikthanlan）雄踞港湾上方的山脊。1444年，它是孟人勃固王国马达班地区的一座属城，与对岸远为繁盛的马达班共用这片锚地——在印度洋上通称「马达班」的釉陶瓮正是从那里装船外运。

1479年，勃固国王达马塞底（Dhammazedi）所立的迦梨耶尼碑铭（Kalyani Inscriptions），把摩棉列为马达班地区三十二座孟人城镇之一。1541年5月，德彬瑞梯的东吁军队强攻下马达班后，渡湾又取摩棉。1594年，摩棉守将联合暹罗国王纳黎萱起兵反叛，此后城市一直处于暹罗治下，直到1614年缅军收复海岸。1740年它被卷入孟人的勃固复兴，1757年又重归贡榜诸王。随后的缅暹长期战争使它成为兵站：1760年，明康瑙拉塔（Minkhaung Nawrahta）将军从阿瑜陀耶前线班师时修治此城；1764年，玛哈·瑙拉塔（Maha Nawrahta）进军土瓦途中重修了吉桃兰塔。

en:
Mergui faces the Andaman Sea, sheltered by the Mergui Archipelago, a screen of more than eight hundred wooded islands. From the eleventh to the thirteenth century it was the southernmost outpost of the Pagan Empire; after Pagan collapsed in 1287 the town passed to Sukhothai and then to Ayutthaya. Its harbour was the western terminus of the shortest crossing of the Malay peninsula: merchants from across the Indian Ocean landed there, poled upriver to Tenasserim and crossed the Tenasserim Hills to reach the Gulf of Siam and Ayutthaya. In 1444 Mergui was a Mon-speaking, Theravada Buddhist port, the main Siamese window on the Andaman Sea.

Bayinnaung's Burma held the town from 1564 to 1593, when Naresuan recovered the coast for Siam, and Mergui afterwards grew busy with European shipping. Englishmen and Frenchmen competed for King Narai's favour there: in 1687 fighting expelled the English factory and its governor Samuel White, the king entrusted the town to the French officer the Chevalier de Beauregard, and the Siamese revolution of 1688 drove the French out in their turn. The port stayed Siamese until 1765, when an army of the new Konbaung dynasty stormed it, opening the invasion that destroyed Ayutthaya two years later. Burmese fleets sailed against Siam from these same waters in 1809–1812.
zh:
丹老面向安达曼海，港外有丹老群岛作为屏障，那是八百多个林木葱郁的岛屿。11至13世纪，这里是蒲甘帝国最南端的据点；1287年蒲甘崩溃后，此城先后归入素可泰与阿瑜陀耶。它的港湾是横越马来半岛最短通道的西端：来自印度洋各地的商人在此登岸，溯河而上抵达丹那沙林城，再翻过丹那沙林山脉，去往暹罗湾和阿瑜陀耶。1444年的丹老是一座讲孟语、信奉上座部佛教的港口，也是暹罗面向安达曼海的主要窗口。

1564年至1593年，勃印曩的缅甸曾占据此城，纳黎萱才为暹罗收复海岸，此后丹老的欧洲商船日渐繁忙。英国人与法国人在此争夺那莱王的恩宠：1687年的冲突赶走了英国商馆及其长官塞缪尔·怀特，国王把城交给法国军官博勒加德，1688年暹罗政变后，法国人也被逐走。港口一直属于暹罗，直到1765年贡榜王朝的军队将其攻陷，为两年后攻灭阿瑜陀耶的入侵打开通道。1809—1812年，缅甸舰队又从这片海域出征暹罗。

en:
Tighina guarded the chief crossing of the lower Dniester, on the road from Moldavia toward the Crimean steppe and the Black Sea. Genoese traders from Cetatea Albă knew the ford as Teghenaccio, and on 8 October 1408 Prince Alexandru cel Bun named it in the charter granting the merchants of Lviv passage through his lands, the town's first written mention. It grew up as Moldavia's busiest customs post, its officers taking dues on the cattle and goods moving to the Crimea, and Stephen the Great later raised an earth-and-timber palanka there against Tatar raiders. In 1444 Tighina was still an open toll town on the river bank, watching the steppe road into Moldavia.

In 1538, when Petru Rareș withheld the tribute and was abandoned by his boyars, Suleiman entered Tighina without a fight, annexed it with eighteen surrounding villages as an Ottoman raia, and renamed it Bender; the fortress was rebuilt to a design by the architect Mimar Sinan and finished in 1541. John III the Terrible's siege of 1574 failed, as did Michael the Brave's assaults of 1595 and 1600, and Zaporozhian Cossacks raided it in their turn. Early in the eighteenth century Antioh Cantemir enlarged the works, sending Moldavian boyars and labourers to build for the sultan. Charles XII of Sweden, beaten at Poltava in 1709, camped at nearby Varnița with Ivan Mazepa; Pylyp Orlyk's Cossack constitution was accepted in the king's camp on 5 April 1710, and in 1713 Ottoman troops stormed the Swedish quarters to force his departure. Bender fell to the Russians in 1770 and 1789, and again without a fight in 1806; the Treaty of Bucharest in 1812 attached it, with all of Bessarabia, to the Russian Empire.
zh:
蒂吉纳扼守德涅斯特河下游最重要的渡口，位于摩尔达维亚通往克里米亚草原与黑海的道路上。来自白堡的热那亚商人把这个渡口称作特盖纳乔，1408年10月8日，善人亚历山德鲁在赐予利沃夫商人通行特权的诏书中提到此地，这是该城最早的文字记载。它发展为摩尔达维亚最繁忙的税卡，官吏对运往克里米亚的牲畜和货物抽税；后来斯特凡大公又在这里筑起土木结构的栅栏堡，防备鞑靼人来袭。1444年的蒂吉纳还是一座面向草原、不设城墙的税镇，从河岸上监视着通入摩尔达维亚的草原之路。

1538年，彼得·拉雷什停纳贡赋又被波雅尔背弃，苏莱曼一世兵不血刃进入蒂吉纳，把它连同周围18座村庄并为奥斯曼的拉亚，改名本德尔；新要塞按建筑师米马尔·希南的设计重建，1541年完工。1574年「可怖者」约翰三世围攻不克，勇敢者米哈伊1595年和1600年两度来攻也都失败，扎波罗热哥萨克则轮番前来劫掠。18世纪初，安东尼奥克·坎泰米尔奉奥斯曼之命扩建工事，征调摩尔达维亚的波雅尔和民夫为苏丹筑城。瑞典国王卡尔十二世1709年在波尔塔瓦战败后，携伊万·马泽帕驻跸于附近的瓦尔尼察；1710年4月5日，皮利普·奥尔利克的哥萨克宪法在瑞典大营获得通过，1713年奥斯曼军队强攻瑞典人的营区，迫使卡尔离去。本德尔1770年和1789年两度被俄军攻占，1806年又不战而降；1812年《布加勒斯特和约》把它和整个比萨拉比亚并入俄罗斯帝国。

en:
Ingil covers the steppe between the Inhul river and the lower Dnieper, where the Tavan crossing carried the trade road from Kyiv to Caffa. At the end of the fourteenth century the land belonged to Lithuania: on the site of a former residence of Tokhtamysh, Vytautas built a small fort and customs post, remembered as 'Vytautas's Customs'. In 1444 a handful of Ruthenian ferrymen and customs men held the grand duke's furthest outpost on the Dnieper, while the Crimean steppe opened immediately to the south.

In 1484 the Crimean khanate, now under Ottoman protection, built the fortress of Dogan at the crossing; the Cossacks destroyed it, and in 1665–1666 the Ottomans raised the stone fortress of Gazi-Kermen, the Kyzy-Kermen of Russian records, which together with Islam-Kermen and Tavan guarded the crossing and barred the Zaporozhians' road to the sea. Ivan Sirko breached it in 1670 and partly dismantled it the following year. On 30 July 1695 the Russo-Cossack army of Boris Sheremetev and Ivan Mazepa stormed it after a long summer siege, taking thirty guns, and by the Treaty of Constantinople in 1700 the works were demolished. Russian troops rebuilt the fort in 1737 and gave it back after the Peace of Niš, until it passed to Russia under the 1774 Treaty of Küçük Kaynarca. In 1784 the town reborn on the ruins was named Beryslav, settled chiefly by migrants from the Poltava and Chernihiv lands.
zh:
因吉尔位于因古尔河与第聂伯河下游之间的草原，塔万渡口就在这里，基辅通往卡法的商路从此过河。14世纪末这片土地属于立陶宛：维陶塔斯在脱脱迷失旧驻地的旧址上建起一座小堡垒兼税关，后世称为「维陶塔斯税关」。1444年，寥寥数名鲁塞尼亚渡夫和税吏守着大公在第聂伯河上最边远的据点，南面便是一望无垠的克里米亚草原。

1484年，已受奥斯曼庇护的克里米亚汗国在渡口修建多安堡；哥萨克将其摧毁后，奥斯曼人又于1665至1666年筑起石堡加济克尔缅，即俄文记载中的克孜克尔缅，它与伊斯兰克尔缅、塔万两堡共同扼守渡口，封锁扎波罗热哥萨克入海的通道。1670年伊万·西尔科攻破此堡，次年又拆毁了部分工事。1695年7月30日，鲍里斯·舍列梅捷夫与伊万·马泽帕的俄哥联军经漫长的夏季围攻后强攻克孜克尔缅，缴获三十门火炮；依1700年君士坦丁堡和约，堡垒被拆毁。1737年俄军重筑此堡，尼什和约后再度归还，直至1774年库楚克开纳吉和约将其划归俄国。1784年，废墟上重生的城镇得名别里斯拉夫，居民主要是来自波尔塔瓦和切尔尼戈夫的移民。

en:
Pereiaslav lies on the Trubizh River near its meeting with the Alta, southeast of Kyiv. Grand Prince Vladimir fortified it about 992 as a southern bulwark of Rus', and from the mid-eleventh century it was the capital of the Principality of Pereiaslav, guarding the frontier against Pecheneg and Cuman raids. The Tatars destroyed the city in 1239. Its lands passed to the Grand Duchy of Lithuania in the fourteenth century, and in 1444 a small Orthodox Ruthenian settlement lived among the ruins on fertile grain country exposed to the steppe.

On 6 March 1585 King Stephen Báthory authorized Prince Konstanty Ostrogski to rebuild Pereiaslav and its castle; the restored town received Magdeburg rights and its own coat of arms, confirmed in 1620. After the Kurukove agreement of 1625 it became a Cossack regimental centre, and in the summer of 1648 Bohdan Khmelnytsky made the Pereiaslav Regiment, eighteen sotnias strong, a major supply and diplomatic base. In January 1654 the Pereiaslav Council accepted the protectorate of Tsar Alexis, and the 1667 Truce of Andrusovo confirmed the town under Moscow. Hetman Ivan Mazepa later paid for the cathedral of the Ascension Monastery. The regiment was abolished in 1782, when Pereiaslav became a county town of the Kyiv Viceroyalty; in 1816 it had 6,720 inhabitants.
zh:
佩列亚斯拉夫位于特鲁比日河与阿尔塔河交汇处附近，在基辅东南。约992年，弗拉基米尔大公在此筑造大型要塞，作为罗斯南方屏障；11世纪中叶起，这里是佩列亚斯拉夫公国的都城，抵御佩切涅格人和库曼人的袭扰。1239年，鞑靼人摧毁了这座城市。14世纪，其土地并入立陶宛大公国。1444年，一座信奉东正教的鲁塞尼亚小聚落生活在旧城废墟之间，周围是面向草原的肥沃谷物地带。

1585年3月6日，国王斯蒂芬·巴托里授权王公康斯坦丁·奥斯特罗兹基重建佩列亚斯拉夫和城堡；复兴后的城镇获得马格德堡权利和自己的城徽，并于1620年得到确认。1625年《库鲁基夫协议》后，这里成为哥萨克团级中心；1648年夏，博赫丹·赫梅利尼茨基将拥有十八个百人队的佩列亚斯拉夫团建成重要的补给与外交基地。1654年1月，佩列亚斯拉夫拉达接受沙皇阿列克谢的保护，1667年《安德鲁索沃停战协定》确认城镇归莫斯科。盖特曼伊万·马泽帕后来出资修建了升天修道院大教堂。1782年团制被废除，佩列亚斯拉夫成为基辅总督区的县城；1816年，当地有6720名居民。

en:
Yelets guards a crossing of the Bystraya Sosna, a Don tributary running through the black-earth steppe. A Rus town was recorded there in the mid-twelfth century, and it later became the seat of a small frontier principality. Timur's armies sacked it in 1395; in 1415 Tatar raiders killed its prince and drove many survivors toward Ryazan. Although the district then depended on Ryazan, in 1444 Yelets was little more than a name on a dangerous border, its old crossing and pastures exposed to the steppe.

In 1483 the Ryazan prince transferred administration of the deserted Yelets lands to Ivan III of Moscow, but a permanent town returned only at the end of 1591, when Tsar Feodor I ordered a fortress built under the voivode Ivan Myasnoy. Service Cossacks, musketeers and gentry's sons from Tula, Livny and other southern towns settled the new district. Under False Dmitry I it served as a base for a planned Crimean campaign, and in 1606 the town joined Ivan Bolotnikov's revolt when Istoma Pashkov defeated a royal army outside its walls. In 1618 Zaporozhian Cossacks under Petro Konashevych-Sahaidachny burned and plundered Yelets and seized a Muscovite embassy carrying tribute to Crimea. Service families repopulated the county through the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries. Yelets was assigned to Azov Governorate in 1708, became a provincial seat under Voronezh Governorate in 1719, and passed to the new Oryol Governorate in 1796. Grain trade replaced the old fortress as its reason for prosperity.
zh:
叶列茨扼守顿河支流贝斯纳亚索斯纳河的渡口，周围是黑土草原。12世纪中叶，史料已记载这里有一座罗斯城镇，后来成为小封邑公国的治所。1395年，帖木儿的军队洗劫此地；1415年，鞑靼袭扰者杀死叶列茨王公，把许多幸存者逐往梁赞。尽管这一地区此后依附梁赞，但1444年的叶列茨几乎只是危险边线上的一个地名，旧渡口和牧场完全暴露在草原之前。

1483年，梁赞王公依约把荒废叶列茨土地的管辖权交给莫斯科的伊凡三世，但永久城镇要到1591年底才恢复：费奥多尔一世下诏筑城，由督军伊万·米亚斯诺伊主持。来自图拉、利夫内等南部城镇的服役哥萨克、火枪手和贵族子弟定居新城及新设县域。伪德米特里一世时期，这里成为计划征讨克里米亚的基地；1606年，叶列茨响应伊万·博洛特尼科夫起义，伊斯托马·帕什科夫在城外击败王军。1618年，彼得·科纳舍维奇-萨盖达奇内率领扎波罗热哥萨克焚掠叶列茨，并截获一支携带贡礼前往克里米亚的莫斯科使团。17至18世纪，服役家族陆续填满县内土地。1708年，叶列茨划归亚速省，1719年成为沃罗涅日省下的区级治所，1796年改隶新设立的奥廖尔省。旧要塞不再是重心，粮食贸易撑起了城镇的繁荣。

en:
Bakhmut lies on the small Bakhmutka River where it joins the Siverskyi Donets, open steppe cut by chalk ridges and traversed by the Izyum trail, the road Crimean and Nogai raiders rode north towards Muscovy.
