Its brine springs had supplied salt since early times, but in 1444 this was the pasture of Great Horde herds, empty of towns and avoided by settled life. A Muscovite border watch named after the Bakhmutka is first recorded in 1571, part of Ivan the Terrible's chain of patrols against slave raids on the southern frontier.

Through the seventeenth century fugitives and Cossacks boiled salt at the springs, and in the 1680s and 1690s Cossacks of the Izium Sloboda Regiment founded a permanent settlement; their fortified ostrog on the Bakhmutka, approved by Moscow, went up in 1703 and was first described in 1704. Peter I ordered Cossacks settled to work the salt in 1704, and the saltworks began operating in 1715, drawing thousands to the steppe. Kondraty Bulavin had served as the Bakhmut sotnyk, and in the autumn of 1705 his Don Cossacks seized the salt mines and held the town until government troops retook it, an overture to his great rebellion of 1707-08. Bakhmut became the centre of a province in 1719, and in 1721 the region's first industrial coal seams were found nearby. From 1753 to 1764 it was the capital of Slavo-Serbia, settled by thousands of Serb and other Balkan soldiers who formed the Bakhmut hussars; the town received city status in 1783, and in 1811 it was granted a coat of arms bearing the salt vats that had made its fortune.
zh:
巴赫穆特坐落在巴赫穆特卡河注入北顿涅茨河之处，开阔草原间横亘着白垩山脊，克里米亚与诺盖人北上劫掠莫斯科所走的伊久姆大道正经过此地。当地的盐泉自古产盐，但1444年这里还是大帐汗国牧群的草场，没有城镇，定居者避之不及。以巴赫穆特卡命名的莫斯科边防哨首见于1571年的记载，是伊凡雷帝为防御南方掠奴而设的巡逻哨链之一。

整个17世纪，逃亡者和哥萨克不断在盐泉煮盐；1680至1690年代，斯洛博达乌克兰伊久姆团的哥萨克建起固定聚落，1703年经莫斯科政府许可在巴赫穆特卡河畔筑成木寨，1704年留下第一份记录。1704年，彼得一世命令哥萨克定居采盐，煮盐厂于1715年开工，吸引了数千人来到草原。孔德拉季·布拉文曾任巴赫穆特百人队长，1705年秋，他的顿河哥萨克夺取盐场、占据城镇，直到被官军收复——这正是他1707至1708年大起义的先声。1719年，巴赫穆特成为省治；1721年，附近发现了这一地区最早的工业煤层。1753至1764年，它是斯拉夫塞尔维亚的首府，数千名塞尔维亚及其他巴尔干军人移居于此，后来编成巴赫穆特骠骑兵团。1783年巴赫穆特正式设市，1811年获颁城徽，徽上的煮盐锅正是此地致富之源。

en:
The cliff city of Mangup, ancient Doros, crowns the southwestern Crimean mountains, the heart of a country the world still called Gothia. Gothic-speaking highlanders had grazed these valleys since the third century; by the fourteenth they were Greek in prayer and letters, ruled from Mangup by the Gabras princes of Theodoro, who paid tribute to the Golden Horde and fought the Genoese for the southern harbours. Timur sacked the city in 1395, but under Alexios I, prince from about 1411, it recovered: his daughter Maria married the last Trapezuntine emperor, David, in 1426, and in 1433–34 Theodoro backed a Greek rising in Genoese Cembalo and reclaimed its own port of Kalamita. In 1444 this Orthodox principality of Greek lords and Gothic herdsmen, its mountain valleys planted with vines, is the last Roman state, its aged prince nearing the end of a reign that had made it a Black Sea power.

Alexios died about 1445, and the throne passed through his sons John and Olubei to Isaac, who in 1472 married his sister Maria of Mangup to Stephen the Great of Moldavia. In June 1475 that alliance placed Isaac's nephew Alexander on the throne with three hundred Moldavian soldiers; three months later the Ottoman army of Gedik Ahmed Pasha, fresh from the fall of Caffa, appeared before Mangup. Its garrison of some 2,000 Greeks, Moldavians and Tatars repelled five assaults and even cut the Janissary corps to pieces, but famine opened the gates at the end of December 1475. Alexander was beheaded in Constantinople, his son was converted to Islam, and the fugitive Crimean khan Meñli Giray was carried off from the citadel as well. Mangup became an Ottoman kaza of Kefe, taking in Inkerman, Balaklava and 49 villages; the Greek quarters shrank from about eighty households in 1520 to twenty-five in 1542, though in 1560 the envoy Busbecq could still take down sixty-nine words of the old Gothic speech from two Gothic envoys in Istanbul. By 1777 a visitor found only fifty Karaite and Tatar houses on the rock. After the Treaty of Küçük Kaynarca of 1774 Mangup passed to the Crimean khanate, Russian annexation followed in 1783, and in 1790 the last Karaites left the cliff to its vines and ruins.
zh:
悬崖上的城市曼古普——古称多罗斯——雄踞克里米亚西南山地之巅，是外界仍称作「哥提亚」之地的心脏。讲哥特语的山民自3世纪起在这些山谷放牧，到14世纪他们已以希腊语礼拜和书写，由曼古普的加布拉斯家族——狄奥多罗公侯统治；公侯向金帐汗国纳贡，又为争夺南部港湾与热那亚人不休。1395年帖木儿洗劫此城，但约自1411年在位的阿列克修斯一世治下它重又复兴：其女玛丽亚1426年嫁给特拉布宗末代皇帝大卫，1433至1434年狄奥多罗支持热那亚人钦巴洛城中的希腊人起义，并夺回自己的港口卡拉米塔。1444年，这个由希腊贵族和哥特牧人组成、山谷遍植葡萄的东正教小邦，已是最后的罗马政权；年迈的公侯执政日久，一生已使本国跻身黑海强权之列。

阿列克修斯约1445年去世，王位经其子约翰、奥卢贝伊传到以撒手中；以撒1472年把妹妹曼古普的玛丽亚嫁给摩尔达维亚大公斯特凡三世。1475年6月，凭借这层关系，以撒的侄子亚历山大带三百名摩尔达维亚士兵夺位；三个月后，刚攻克拉法的格迪克·艾哈迈德帕夏率奥斯曼大军兵临曼古普城下。约两千名希腊人、摩尔达维亚人和鞑靼人组成的守军击退五次猛攻，甚至歼灭了耶尼切里精锐，但饥荒最终在1475年12月底打开城门。亚历山大被押往君士坦丁堡斩首，其子被迫改宗伊斯兰教，就连避难城中的克里米亚汗明里·格来也被一同掳走。曼古普成为奥斯曼凯费省的一个卡扎，辖有因克尔曼、巴拉克拉瓦和四十九个村庄；希腊人社坊从1520年的约八十户缩减到1542年的二十五户。不过1560年，使节布斯贝克在伊斯坦布尔仍能从两名哥提亚使节口中记下六十九个古哥特语词汇。到1777年，旅人所见只剩五十户卡拉伊姆人和鞑靼人。1774年《小凯纳尔贾条约》后曼古普划归克里米亚汗国，1783年随汗国并入俄国，1790年最后几户卡拉伊姆人离去，悬崖归于葡萄藤与废墟。

en:
Mansur is the inland Azov steppe behind the northern shore of the Sea of Azov, the grazing country of the Vovchi Vody and the upper Samara. In 1444 it belonged to the young Crimean khanate of Hacı I Giray: Tatar herds moved along the old tracks from the Molochna river towards the Donets, while the Mangyt clans, Nogai descendants of Edigu led by the Mansur mirzas, pastured their flocks as the khan's most powerful vassals. Crimean records called their host the Mansur ulus.

Under Divey-mirza (1542–1572) and his son Esinei, the Mansur horde held the steppe between the Mius and the Molochna, screening Perekop from the north, and in 1577 the fugitive prince Adil Giray founded his town of Bali-Saray in their pastures. The ulus vanishes from the records in the 1630s, when Kantemir Diveyev led its remnants west to Perekop and the Budjak. After Peter the Great took Azov in 1696 the northern grazing grounds emptied; Russian armies swept across them in 1736, but the Treaty of Belgrade in 1739 returned the steppe to the khan. In 1770, in Catherine's first Turkish war, all the Nogai hordes accepted Russian protection; they were soon disbanded and, under the Treaty of Karasubazar, removed to the Kuban. With the Zaporozhian Sich abolished in 1775, the adjoining Cossack lands were thrown open too, and the empty steppe was settled under the Russian crown.
zh:
曼苏尔是亚速海北岸以北的内陆草原，沃夫奇沃季河与萨马拉河上游的牧地。1444年，这里属于哈吉一世·格来新建的克里米亚汗国：鞑靼牧群沿着莫洛奇纳亚河通向顿涅茨的古道转场，曼格特诸部作为汗最有权势的封臣在此放牧，他们是也迪该的诺盖后裔，首领称曼苏尔米尔扎，克里米亚档案把这一帐人马称为曼苏尔乌鲁斯。

季韦伊米尔扎（1542—1572年在位）及其子叶西涅伊时代，曼苏尔斡耳朵据有米乌斯河与莫洛奇纳亚河之间的草原，从北面拱卫彼列科普；1577年，出奔的阿迪尔·格来王子在他们的牧场上建起巴雷萨莱城。17世纪30年代，该乌鲁斯从文献中消失，坎捷米尔·季韦耶夫率余部西迁彼列科普和布贾克。1696年彼得大帝夺取亚速后，北方牧场为之一空；1736年俄军虽横扫草原，1739年贝尔格莱德和约仍把它归还汗国。1770年叶卡捷琳娜二世的第一次对土战争中，所有诺盖斡耳朵都接受了俄国保护，旋即被解散，并依卡拉苏巴扎尔条约迁往库班。1775年扎波罗热塞契被取缔后，相邻的哥萨克土地也随之开放，空旷的草原在俄国治下开始移民开垦。

en:
Kyzyl-Yar is the low Azov shoreland between the Molochna river and the sea, a coast of limans and salt lakes with the steppe opening behind it. In 1444 these pastures belonged to Hacı I Giray's Crimean khanate: the Jamboyluk Nogais camped along the lagoons with their herds, while the fords on the Molochna marked the southern end of the Muravsky trail, the raiding road by which Tatar columns rode north into the Ruthenian and Muscovite borderlands. The Nogai aul of Kyzyl-Yar, the 'red bank', later grew beside the Sheep ford.

From 1478 the khanate was an Ottoman vassal. During the war of 1735–1739 a band of Zaporozhian Cossacks under the otaman Mykyta Moiseev routed a Kalmyk ulus near the ford; Russian troops held the coast in 1736, but the Treaty of Belgrade in 1739 gave it back. In 1769 a Russian redoubt garrisoned by Zaporozhians was raised here, and in 1771 the Nogai hordes accepted Russian protection, confirmed by the Treaty of Küçük Kaynarca in 1774; the land was annexed with the Crimea in 1783. The Molochna settlements became Melitopol uyezd in 1784, yet the old aul lived on—about two hundred souls in 1816, when it was renamed Novoaleksandrovka. In 1803 Mennonite settlers invited from Prussia founded Halbstadt on the Molochna, the first of the Molochna Mennonite colonies, granted generous land and a ten-year tax exemption.
zh:
克孜勒亚尔是莫洛奇纳亚河与亚速海之间的低岸地带，潟湖与盐湖罗列海滨，北面是敞开的草原。1444年，这片牧场属于哈吉一世·格来的克里米亚汗国：詹布伊卢克诺盖人傍着海湾水洼扎幕放牧，莫洛奇纳亚河上的渡口是穆拉夫斯基古道的南端，鞑靼骑兵沿这条袭掠之路北上，深入鲁塞尼亚和莫斯科的边境。诺盖人的村庄克孜勒亚尔（意为「红岸」）后来就在「羊渡」旁形成。

1478年起，克里米亚汗国成为奥斯曼的附庸。1735至1739年战争中，统领尼基塔·莫伊谢耶夫率一队扎波罗热哥萨克在渡口附近击溃一个卡尔梅克乌鲁斯；俄军1736年占领海岸，但1739年贝尔格莱德和约又把它归还。1769年，俄国人在此修筑由扎波罗热哥萨克戍守的多面堡；1771年诺盖诸斡耳朵接受俄国保护，1774年库楚克开纳吉和约予以确认，1783年此地随克里米亚并入俄国。1784年莫洛奇纳亚河沿岸居民点划为梅利托波尔县，旧村庄仍在——1816年约有两百居民，同年改名新亚历山德罗夫卡。1803年，应俄国政府之邀从普鲁士迁来的门诺派教徒在莫洛奇纳亚河畔建立哈尔布施塔特，这是莫洛奇纳亚门诺派移民区的第一个村镇，移民获得大片土地和十年免税的优待。

en:
Tyn is the dry Azov grassland crossed by the upper and middle Kalmius, whose valley runs south from the Donets Ridge toward the Sea of Azov. The Mongol victory on the nearby Kalka in 1223 opened these pastures to the Golden Horde, and they later became part of the thinly held Wild Fields. In 1444 no town stood here: Crimean and Nogai herds moved along the river, while the Kalmius sakma branched from the Muravsky raiding road and carried Tatar columns north toward the Donets. The country lay on the uncertain frontier between Hacı Giray's rising Crimean khanate and Küçük Muhammad's Great Horde, its wealth in horses, cattle and sheep rather than walls.

Zaporozhian Cossacks reached the Kalmius in the fifteenth century, using its rapids as a hidden route to the Azov fisheries and salt. In the sixteenth century they established the Domakha watch post above the river mouth, later the centre of their Kalmius palanka, with winter camps and shelters for refugees from the war-torn Ukrainian lands. The Treaty of Constantinople in 1700 forbade settlements and fortifications on this coast as far as the Mius, and Peter I destroyed the Zaporozhian Sich in 1709; after the Cossacks returned in 1734, Empress Elizabeth's decree of 1746 made the Kalmius the boundary between the Zaporozhian and Don hosts. The last great Tatar raid burned the Kalmius camps in 1769. The Treaty of Küçük Kaynarca in 1774 and the destruction of the Sich in 1775 opened the country to Russia; a Kalmius sloboda appeared in 1776, Pavlovsk was laid out at the mouth in 1778, and Crimean Greeks were resettled around the renamed Mariupol in 1780.
zh:
提恩是卡利米乌斯河中上游穿过的干燥亚速草原，河谷从顿涅茨海脊南延，通向亚速海。1223年蒙古人在附近的卡尔卡河获胜，这片牧场随后纳入金帐汗国势力范围，后来又成为控制松散的荒野的一部分。1444年这里没有城镇：克里米亚和诺盖牧群沿河转场，卡利米乌斯袭扰路从穆拉夫斯基大道分出，鞑靼骑兵经此北上顿涅茨河。此地处在哈吉·格来新兴的克里米亚汗国与库楚克·马哈麻大帐汗国之间的模糊边疆，财富是马、牛、羊，而不是城墙。

15世纪，扎波罗热哥萨克已进入卡利米乌斯河流域，借急流暗道前往亚速海捕鱼、取盐。16世纪，他们在河口上方建立多马哈哨所，后来成为卡利米乌斯帕兰卡的中心，设有冬营，并庇护从战火中的乌克兰土地逃来的人。1700年《君士坦丁堡条约》规定直到米乌斯河口的亚速海岸不得设居设防，彼得一世又在1709年摧毁扎波罗热塞契；1734年哥萨克返回后，伊丽莎白女皇于1746年颁令，以卡利米乌斯河作为扎波罗热哥萨克与顿河哥萨克的分界。1769年，最后一次大规模鞑靼袭掠烧毁卡利米乌斯营寨。1774年《库楚克开纳吉条约》和1775年塞契被取缔后，这片土地向俄国开放；1776年出现卡利米乌斯洛博达，1778年河口另建帕夫洛夫斯克，1780年克里米亚希腊人被迁至改名后的马里乌波尔周围。

en:
This is the open grassland between the lower Don and the Manych, drained eastward by the Kalaus and Yegorlyk and studded with the kurgans of Sarmatian herdsmen. Ptolemy knew a station called Azaraba on the Lesser Rombites, one of the rivers feeding the Maeotis, and Sarmatian clans such as the Siraces grazed the interior behind the Greek trading posts on the coast. Khazars, then Cumans, then the Mongols of the 1240s in turn made it the pasture of their empires; it had no towns of its own, only tracks between Azak on the Don and Majar on the Kuma. In 1444 it is a disputed march: the Tatar clans moving their herds here lean toward Hacı Giray's rising Crimean khanate, while Küçük Muhammad's Sarai Horde still claims the fore-Caucasus beyond the Manych.

Meñli Giray settled the question in June 1502, when he destroyed the Great Horde and divided its lands. In 1557 Kazy-mirza led the Lesser Nogais out of the breaking Nogai confederation into the Azov steppe and on to the Kuban, and from the 1590s their uluses nomadized along the Manych and the Kuma, vassals of the Girays and partners in their slave raids into Rus'. Between 1628 and 1634 Kho-Urluk's Kalmyks overran the Volga pastures and drove the Nogai remnants to the Kuban, after which the country became a raiding corridor disputed between Kalmyk, Nogai and Don Cossack horsemen until January 1771, when Ubashi led the bulk of the Kalmyks back across the steppes to Dzungaria. Potemkin's Azov–Mozdok line, decreed in April 1777, pinned the land down with fortresses on the Kalaus and the Yegorlyk; after Suvorov crushed the Nogai rising in 1782 and the Crimean khanate was annexed in 1783, the nomads swore allegiance. Khoper and Volga Cossacks held the new stanitsas, and peasant villages followed in the 1790s as the old wandering pastures were broken into fields.
zh:
这是下顿河与马内奇河之间的开阔草原，卡劳乌斯河和叶戈尔雷克河向东流贯，大地散落着萨尔马提亚牧人的坟丘。托勒密曾记载，注入迈奥提斯湖的诸河之一——小罗姆比特河畔有一处名叫阿扎拉巴的驿站；西拉克等萨尔马提亚部落在沿海希腊商站身后的腹地游牧。可萨人、钦察人、1240年代的蒙古人先后把这片草原变成各自帝国的牧场，这里始终没有自己的城市，只有连接顿河畔阿扎克与库马河畔马贾尔的商道。1444年的阿扎拉巴是一块争议中的边地：在此放牧的鞑靼部落倒向哈吉·格来正在崛起的克里米亚汗国，而马内奇河彼岸，库楚克·马哈麻的萨莱汗庭仍宣称前高加索草原归其所有。

1502年6月，明里·格来攻灭大帐汗国并瓜分其土地，争端就此了结。1557年，卡兹米尔扎率领小诺盖人脱离崩解中的诺盖联盟，西迁亚速草原直至库班；从1590年代起，他们的兀鲁思沿马内奇河和库马河游牧，作为格来王朝的藩属，参与其北上罗斯的奴隶劫掠。1628至1634年间，和鄂尔勒克的卡尔梅克人席卷伏尔加河牧场，把诺盖残部逼向库班，此后这里成为卡尔梅克、诺盖和顿河哥萨克骑兵反复争夺的袭扰走廊，直到1771年1月渥巴锡率大部分卡尔梅克人东归准噶尔。1777年4月，波将金奏准修筑亚速—莫兹多克防线，卡劳乌斯河和叶戈尔雷克河上的要塞把这片土地钉入版图；1782年苏沃洛夫镇压诺盖起义、1783年克里米亚汗国被兼并后，游牧各部宣誓臣服。赫奥尔斯克和伏尔加哥萨克驻守新建的村镇，1790年代又有农民村落相继而来，游荡的旧日牧场被开垦成连片的农田。

en:
This is the forest-steppe country where the little Atkara River joins the Medveditsa, dense oak woods giving way to open pasture. In 1358, the Russian chronicle tradition holds, the Tatar prince Etkara founded his ulus here in the thick forest, a place strong for defence and good for cattle, tillage, fishing and the chase, and the river came to bear his name. His herdsmen were Mishar Tatars, and in 1444 Etkara still belonged to the Great Horde, though that power was visibly breaking apart: horse and cattle herds grazed the river valleys, and the old war trails along the Medveditsa carried both trade and raiding parties between the Volga towns and the steppe.

After the fall of Kazan in 1552 and Astrakhan in 1556, Moscow began planting armed settlements along this frontier, and in 1699 a decree of Peter I chose the 'fit and strong place' at the mouth of the Etkara for a watch sloboda, manned by ploughing soldiers who stood guard and sowed the grain themselves; the settlement kept the name Yetskara. In 1780 Catherine II raised it to town status as Atkarsk and made it the uyezd centre of Saratov Viceroyalty, and in 1781 it received a coat of arms showing the fish-hunting birds that swarmed over its river. The town was stripped of its status in 1798 and only recovered it in 1804, remaining a quiet place of about 1,200 souls at the dawn of the nineteenth century, most of them descendants of its soldier-farmers.
zh:
这里是森林草原地带，阿特卡拉小河在此汇入梅德韦季察河，茂密的橡树林之外是开阔牧场。据俄国编年史传统的说法，1358年鞑靼王公埃特卡拉在密林之中建立了自己的兀鲁思——此地宜于防守，也利于畜牧、耕作、渔猎，小河后来便以他的名字命名。他的部民是米萨鞑靼人；1444年时埃特卡拉仍属大帐汗国，尽管这个汗国正明显走向瓦解：马群和牛群在河谷里吃草，梅德韦季察河畔的古道则载着商旅和袭掠队伍往来于伏尔加城镇与草原之间。

1552年喀山、1556年阿斯特拉罕相继陷落后，莫斯科开始在这条边防线上布设武装聚落；1699年彼得一世下诏，选中埃特卡拉河口这块「合用而坚固的地方」设置警戒集镇，由既站岗戍守又自己种粮的屯田士兵驻守，聚落沿用埃特卡拉之名。1780年叶卡捷琳娜二世将其升格为城市，定名阿特卡尔斯克，作为萨拉托夫总督区的县城；1781年又获赐城徽，上绘河上成群的食鱼鸟。1798年城市地位被撤，直到1804年才恢复；19世纪初这里仍是一座约1200人的安静小城，居民大多是当年军屯士兵的后裔。

en:
Majar was a Golden Horde city on the Kuma River, set where caravan roads from Transcaucasia branched toward the Black Sea and the Volga. Its workshops and bazaars drew a mixed population of Turks, Alans, Russians and Jews, and in 1310-1311 the city held a special fiscal status and struck its own coin. Ibn Battuta, visiting around 1332, called al-Machar one of the finest cities of the Turks, with a great river, gardens and abundant fruit. Coins show that under Janibeg, in 1342-1357, Majar served as one of the khan's residences. Timur's army under Miran Shah sacked it in 1395, but local coinage shows a partial recovery. In 1444 the weakened caravan city still belonged to the Great Horde, surrounded by the livestock pastures of the North Caucasian steppe.

From 1459 Majar formed part of the Astrakhan Khanate. After Russian forces took Hajji-Tarkhan and ended the khanate in 1556, the city on the Kuma gradually emptied; neighbouring Muslims continued to honour its mausolea as ancestral burial ground, while Nogai herds grazed the surrounding plain. Settlement returned only at the end of the eighteenth century. An Armenian trading and crafts community called Karabagly occupied the Old Majar site in 1795, and on 28 October 1799 Emperor Paul I granted Armenian settlers from Derbent permission to establish the town of Svyatoy Krest there. In 1821 it remained a small frontier town whose people lived chiefly by trade, vineyards and wine.
zh:
马加尔是金帐汗国在库马河畔的城市，地处外高加索商路分赴黑海与伏尔加河流域的要冲。作坊和市集吸引了突厥人、阿兰人、俄罗斯人和犹太人等混居；1310—1311年，城市拥有特殊财政地位并铸造自己的钱币。伊本·白图泰约在1332年到访，称阿拉—马查尔是突厥人最美好的城市之一，依傍大河，园圃众多、果实丰饶。铸币表明，札尼别汗在位的1342—1357年间，马加尔曾是汗的驻地之一。1395年，帖木儿麾下米兰沙的军队洗劫城市，但当地铸币显示它后来有所恢复。1444年时，这座已经衰落的商路城市仍属大帐，周围是北高加索草原的牧场。

1459年起，马加尔归入阿斯特拉罕汗国。1556年俄军夺取哈吉—塔尔汗、灭亡汗国后，库马河畔的城市逐渐荒废；邻近穆斯林仍把城中陵墓视为祖先墓地而前来朝拜，诺盖牧群则在周围平原游牧。直到18世纪末，定居生活才回到这里。1795年，一个名为卡拉巴格雷的亚美尼亚工商业聚落占据老马加尔遗址；1799年10月28日，帕维尔一世颁布特许状，准许来自杰尔宾特的亚美尼亚移民在此建立圣十字城。到1821年，它仍是一座小型边城，居民主要依靠商业、葡萄园和酿酒为生。

en:
Kuma is the steppe province along the Kuma River, an 802-kilometre watercourse that rises in the Greater Caucasus and flows north-east through the Caspian Depression to the Kizlyar Gulf. In 1444 the river linked the Great Horde's pastures with the caravan towns of the lower Volga, the ruins and bazaars of Majar, and the routes leading toward the Terek and Caucasian passes. Tatar and Nogai herders watered horses, cattle and sheep along its banks and moved camp between the dry steppe and the greener foothills. There was no great walled town at the crossing called Kuma; its importance lay in pasture, water and passage.

After the Astrakhan Khanate fell in 1556, the Kuma corridor became a Muscovite frontier rather than a Volga khan's road. In the 1630s Oirat Kalmyks advancing from the Volga steppe defeated the Great Nogai Horde and drove surviving Nogai groups toward the Caucasian plain, the Terek and Crimean protection. About 1,500 Don Cossack Old Believers settled on the Kuma in the 1680s. On 24 April 1777 Catherine II ordered the Azov-Mozdok fortified line, which Potemkin planned through the Kuma valley with a fortified post where the local commander was to quarter troops. Cossack settlements and land grants after 1782 tied the river to Russia's Caucasian frontier. By 1821 the Kuma was both a nomadic grazing ground and a military road between Astrakhan, Mozdok and the mountain approaches.
zh:
库马是沿库马河展开的草原省份。库马河全长802公里，发源于大高加索山脉，向东北流经里海低地，注入基兹利亚尔湾。1444年时，这条河把大帐的牧场、伏尔加河下游的商队城镇、马加尔的废墟与市集，以及通往捷列克河和高加索山口的道路连接起来。鞑靼与诺盖牧人在河畔饮马、牛和羊，并在干旱草原与较湿润的山麓之间转场。名为库马的渡口并没有一座高大城墙环绕的城市；它的重要性在于牧场、水源和通路。

1556年阿斯特拉罕汗国灭亡后，库马通道成为莫斯科的边疆，而不再是伏尔加汗的道路。1630年代，从伏尔加草原推进的卫拉特卡尔梅克人击败大诺盖帐，把残存的诺盖部众驱向高加索平原、捷列克河和克里米亚的庇护。1680年代，约一千五百名顿河哥萨克旧礼仪派在库马河定居。1777年4月24日，叶卡捷琳娜二世下令修筑亚速—莫兹多克防线；按照波将金的规划，防线穿过库马河谷，并在库马设置要塞，作为当地指挥官驻军之处。1782年后，哥萨克定居点和土地赏赐把库马河纳入俄罗斯的高加索边疆。到1821年，库马既是游牧牧场，也是连接阿斯特拉罕、莫兹多克和山地入口的军用通道。

en:
Ukek stood on the high right bank of the Volga where the river narrows to a convenient crossing, one of the first cities the Mongols built in the Golden Horde, in the 1250s and roughly halfway between Sarai and Bolghar. The Polo brothers stopped at Oukaka in 1262, and Ibn Battuta in 1334 found a town of middling size, fine buildings and abundant goods but extreme cold. Under Khan Tokhta around 1300 its mint struck silver coin and perhaps ten thousand people lived here; ditches and ramparts were thrown up during the Horde's civil wars later in the century. Timur's army sacked Ukek in 1395 while pursuing Tokhtamysh. In 1444 the city survived only as a much-reduced settlement within its old walls, a forlorn holding of the crumbling Great Horde.

Coins of Great Horde khans were still minted at Ukek in the fifteenth century, and Fra Mauro's map of 1459 marks the place as Iochahi, but when the English merchant Anthony Jenkinson passed in 1558 only a ruined fortress remained. After Grigory Zasekin founded Saratov nearby in 1590 the old city's dressed stone was carried off for the new town, and Ukek lived on only as a name beside the Volga.
zh:
乌凯克位于伏尔加河右岸高地，正当河面收窄、便于涉渡之处，是蒙古人在13世纪50年代为金帐汗国新建的最早一批城市之一，大致地处萨莱与保加尔两都之间的中点。波罗兄弟1262年曾路过此城，马可·波罗将其记为「乌卡卡」；1334年伊本·白图泰见到的，是一座规模中等、建筑精美、百货丰足却酷寒难耐的城市。1300年前后脱脱汗在位时，这里设厂铸造银币，居民约有万人；14世纪后期汗国内战，城外又挖壕筑墙。1395年帖木儿追击脱脱迷失时攻破并洗劫了乌凯克。到1444年，故城只剩旧墙内一个大为凋敝的聚落，是江河日下的大帐汗国手中一处凄凉据点。

15世纪仍有大帐汗的钱币在乌凯克铸造，弗拉·毛罗1459年的地图还把此地标作「约恰希」；但1558年英国商人安东尼·詹金森经过时，所见只剩一座残破要塞。1590年格里戈里·扎谢金在附近建起萨拉托夫后，故城的琢石被拆去营建新城，乌凯克便只作为伏尔加河畔的一个地名存留。

en:
Kanadey lies in the forest-steppe between the Sura and the Volga, where the little Kanadeyka stream joins the Syzranka. A Tatar settlement of that name, the name itself a Turkic-Mongol personal name, stood on the spot from the thirteenth century, when the country belonged to the Golden Horde. In 1444 it was the open south-western march of the Khanate of Kazan: Kazan and Mishar Tatars with Mordvin neighbours pastured their herds on the empty grasslands, and no Russian ploughland or fortress yet reached so far south-east.

For more than two centuries after the fall of Kazan this remained a grazing frontier, settled only as Moscow's defence lines moved south. The Syzran cherta was decreed in 1685 on a plan by the Simbirsk voevoda Matvey Golovin and cancelled the following spring; instead a strong fortress called Kanadey, with a stone gate-tower, was raised in the middle of the line and attached to Simbirsk uyezd. Around 1700 its lands passed to the Pechersky Monastery of Nizhny Novgorod, whose peasants resettled the district, roughly half of them Old Believers by 1722, and a stone Intercession church went up in 1739. In 1780 Catherine II made Kanadey an uyezd town and granted it arms of three golden arrows, but in 1796 the uyezd was abolished and Kanadey became a minor town within Syzran uyezd.
zh:
卡纳德伊地处苏拉河与伏尔加河之间的森林草原，卡纳德伊卡小河在此注入瑟兹兰卡河。早在13世纪金帐汗国时期，同名的鞑靼人聚落已存在于此，其地名本身来自一个突厥-蒙古语人名。1444年，这里是喀山汗国开阔的西南边地：喀山鞑靼人、米萨鞑靼人与相邻的莫尔多瓦人在空旷草场上放牧畜群，俄国人的耕地和要塞尚未延伸到这么远的东南方。

喀山灭亡后的两个多世纪里，此地始终是放牧边地，直到莫斯科的筑垒防线南移才有人定居。1685年，朝廷按辛比尔斯克督军马特维·戈洛文的规划下诏修筑瑟兹兰鹿寨防线，次年春天又撤销成命；作为替代，人们在防线中段建起坚固的卡纳德伊要塞，配有一座石砌门楼，并划归辛比尔斯克县。1700年前后，当地土地转入下诺夫哥罗德佩切尔斯基修道院名下，修道院农民前来垦殖，据1722年记载约半数居民是旧礼仪派信徒；石筑的圣母帡幪教堂于1739年落成。1780年叶卡捷琳娜二世将卡纳德伊设为县城，赐下红底三枚金箭的城徽；1796年该县遭裁撤，卡纳德伊降为瑟兹兰县下属的小镇。

en:
The upper Belaya (Aghidhel) runs through the southern Urals, high valleys where the Nogai-road Bashkir tribes—the Burzyan, Usergan, Tamyan and Kipchak—pastured their herds; Mount Atach on the upper Yaik, later called Magnitnaya, was already known to the Bashkirs for its lodestone ore. In 1444 the country lay in the Nogai Horde's grazing world, its southern edge open to Kazakh raids.

In 1734 the Russians founded the Verkhoyatskaya landing on the upper Yaik with the leave of the Bashkir tarkhan Taymas Shaimov, the first post of the Orenburg expedition; a Bashkir attack destroyed it in 1736, and Vasily Tatishchev rebuilt it in 1737. The Magnitnaya fortress rose beside the iron mountain in 1743, and in 1762 the merchants Ivan Tverdyshev and Ivan Myasnikov built the Beloretsk ironworks on the upper Belaya, hauling Atach ore across the steppe. Pugachev reached the works on 13 April 1774 and made them his headquarters for three weeks, casting cannon while Kinzya Arslanov mustered Bashkir cavalry; on 6 May his men stormed Magnitnaya and abandoned it two days later. After the revolt the Yaik was renamed the Ural and Verkhoyatskaya became Verkhneuralsk, a town from 1781.
zh:
阿吉代尔即别拉亚河上游，纵贯南乌拉尔山区；「诺盖路」的巴什基尔各部——布尔江、乌谢尔甘、塔缅、克普恰克——在高山谷地间放牧。亚伊克河上游的阿塔奇山（后称马格尼特纳亚山）出产磁石，早已为巴什基尔人所知。1444年时，这一带属于诺盖汗国的游牧世界，南缘常受哈萨克人袭掠。

1734年，俄国人经巴什基尔塔尔罕泰马斯·沙伊莫夫许可，在亚伊克河上游设立上亚伊茨克码头，这是奥伦堡考察团修建的第一处据点；1736年巴什基尔人发难将其摧毁，1737年瓦西里·塔季谢夫又予重建。1743年，铁矿山下筑起马格尼特纳亚要塞；1762年，商人伊万·特维尔德舍夫与伊万·米亚斯尼科夫在别拉亚河上游创办别洛列茨克铁厂，从草原对岸运来阿塔奇的矿石。1774年4月13日普加乔夫抵达铁厂，在此设大本营达三周，一面铸造火炮，金贾·阿尔斯拉诺夫则替他征集巴什基尔骑兵；5月6日义军经强攻拿下马格尼特纳亚要塞，两日后将其放弃。起义平定后亚伊克河被改名为乌拉尔河，上亚伊茨克要塞改称上乌拉尔斯克，并于1781年设城。

en:
Juketau, the Lime Mountain of the Volga Bulgars, stood on the left bank of the Kama near later Chistopol. Founded at the end of the tenth century, it became the seat of the Juketau duchy and one of Volga Bulgaria's chief fur markets. Batu Khan's army took it in 1236, but under the Golden Horde it remained a princely centre and was marked on the Pizzigano map of 1367 and the Catalan Atlas of 1375. Novgorod river raiders plundered Zhukotin and old Kazan in 1391. By 1444 the new khanate at Kazan overshadowed the old Kama landing, and the town was in its last years; Russian sources place its abandonment around the middle of the fifteenth century.

The earthen ramparts above the Kama then belonged to the Kazan Khanate until Ivan the Terrible's conquest of Kazan in 1552 drew the region into the Russian frontier. Near the forgotten Bolgar site, Tatar villagers and runaway Russian peasants later formed the settlement of Chistoye Pole; after an early-eighteenth-century burning, the village was rebuilt on the empty field that gave it its name. Its census population passed one thousand in 1761, and in 1781 Catherine II granted it a coat of arms and the status of district town under the name Chistopol. The fur citadel of an older age had thus given way to a grain town on the Kama.
zh:
朱克陶是伏尔加保加尔人的「椴树山」，坐落在卡马河左岸、日后奇斯托波尔附近。它建于10世纪末，后成为朱克陶公国的都城，也是伏尔加保加利亚最重要的毛皮市场之一。1236年，拔都的军队攻占此城，但金帐汗国统治时期它仍是王公驻地，并出现在1367年皮齐加尼地图和1375年加泰罗尼亚地图上。1391年，诺夫哥罗德河上武装商队劫掠了朱克陶和旧喀山。到1444年，新兴的喀山汗国已使这座卡马河旧港黯然失色，城镇也走到最后阶段；俄文资料将其废弃时间定在15世纪中叶。

卡马河畔的土墙随后归属喀山汗国，直到1552年伊凡雷帝征服喀山，这片地区才被纳入俄罗斯边界。在被遗忘的保加尔遗址附近，伏尔加鞑靼村民和逃亡的俄罗斯农民后来建立了「纯洁原野」村；18世纪初村庄遭焚毁后，人们在空地上重建家园，村名也由此而来。1761年，该村登记人口超过一千；1781年，叶卡捷琳娜二世赐下城徽，将其设为县城，命名为奇斯托波尔。旧时代的毛皮城寨就此让位于卡马河畔的谷物城镇。

en:
The high right bank of the Volga between Nizhny Novgorod and Kazan was Bulgar-Chuvash country, the Gornaya storona, the Mountain Side, of the Kazan tax rolls. After the Mongols ruined the old Bulgar cities in 1236, a new town grew on the Cheboksarka stream, shown on Italian charts from 1367 and marked 'Veda-Suar', the Middle Suvar, on Fra Mauro's map of 1459; in the Tatar age it was called Chabaksar. Its farmers were the Chuvash, descendants of Volga Bulgar tribesmen, who grew grain on the river terraces while Volga traffic called at the landing. With the breakup of the Golden Horde the land passed to the Kazan khans, and in 1444 Chabaksar was a small market town on the khanate's western road, ruled by Muslim governors while its Chuvash villagers kept largely to the old Bulgar customs.

The Russian chronicles first name the place in May 1469, when the voivode Ivan Runo's flotilla 'spent the night at Cheboksar' on its way against Kazan. After Ivan the Terrible took Kazan in 1552 the Chuvash became yasak-paying subjects of Moscow, and in 1555 a wooden kremlin rose on the hill above the landing, its site consecrated by Archbishop Gury of Kazan; the town became the seat of a new uyezd. Volga commerce paid for the Vvedensky Cathedral, four monasteries and eight churches built there over the following century. After a fire in 1704 the kremlin was not rebuilt, and in 1708 Peter I made Cheboksary an uyezd town.
zh:
伏尔加河在下诺夫哥罗德与喀山之间的高峻右岸，是保加尔-楚瓦什人的土地，即喀山册籍上的「山那边」。1236年蒙古人摧毁旧保加尔诸城后，切博克萨尔卡河畔兴起一座新的保加尔城镇：1367年的意大利海图上已画出它的城郭，1459年弗拉·毛罗地图把它标作「韦达-苏瓦尔」（楚瓦什语意为「中苏瓦尔」），鞑靼时代称恰巴克萨尔。种地的乡民是楚瓦什人——伏尔加保加尔诸部的后裔，在河岸台地上种植谷物，伏尔加河上的船队在它的码头停靠。金帐汗国解体后，这片土地归入喀山汗统治；1444年的恰巴克萨尔是汗国西路上一座小商城，由穆斯林长官管辖，而楚瓦什村民大体仍守着保加尔旧俗。

罗斯编年史首次提到此地是1469年5月，将领伊凡·鲁诺的船队进兵喀山时「在切博克萨尔过夜」。伊凡雷帝1552年攻灭喀山后，楚瓦什人成为向莫斯科缴纳牙萨克的属民；1555年，码头旁的山上立起木构克里姆林宫，喀山大主教古里为城址祝圣，该城成为新县的县城。一个世纪里，伏尔加河的商利供养了圣母领报大教堂、四座修道院和八座教堂。1704年大火后克里姆林宫不再重修，1708年彼得一世把切博克萨雷定为县城。

en:
Alatyr stands where the Alatyr River enters the Sura, in the forest-steppe country of the Mordvins. An Erzya settlement, remembered in local place-names as Sandulei, occupied the river fork long before the Russians came, and finds there reach back to the tenth century. The first Russian stronghold in these parts was Kurmysh, founded on the Sura in 1372 by Prince Boris Konstantinovich of Nizhny Novgorod against Mordvin, Mari and Tatar raids; for two centuries it marked the eastern limit of settled Russian power. In 1444 the Alatyr fork itself held only the old Mordvin village, a debatable march between the outposts of Nizhny Novgorod and the Khanate of Kazan.

On 4 August 1552, on his last march against Kazan, Ivan IV ordered a timbered town raised at the river mouth and named it after the Alatyr; a pentagonal kremlin with an adjoining ostrog made it a military and missionary base on the new frontier. Alatyr became an uyezd seat in 1565, and the Trinity monastery was founded in 1584. Razin's rising reached the Sura in 1670: rebels joined by local people seized Alatyr on 16 September and held it until Prince Baryatinsky retook the town on 23 November. Assigned to Kazan Governorate in 1708 and made a provincial centre under Nizhny Novgorod in 1719, Alatyr passed to the Simbirsk viceroyalty in 1780, when it received arms of three golden quivers filled with arrows in honour of the archery of its people. In 1812 an infantry regiment formed here marched with the Simbirsk militia.
zh:
阿拉特里位于阿拉特里河汇入苏拉河之处，属莫尔多瓦人的森林草原地带。早在俄国人到来之前，河汊处就有一座埃尔济亚人的村落，桑杜列伊之名一直留在当地地名中，考古发现更可上溯至10世纪。这一带最早的俄国据点是库尔梅什：1372年，下诺夫哥罗德王公鲍里斯·康斯坦丁诺维奇为防御莫尔多瓦人、马里人和鞑靼人袭扰，在苏拉河畔筑城，此后两个世纪里它都是俄国定居势力的东界。1444年的阿拉特里河口只有那座古老的莫尔多瓦村落，是下诺夫哥罗德据点与喀山汗国之间一片归属不定的边地。

1552年8月4日，伊凡四世最后一次出征喀山途中，下令在河口修筑木城，并以阿拉特里河为名；五边形的克里姆林与相连的栅栏堡使它成为新疆域上的军事与传教基地。1565年阿拉特里设县，1584年圣三一修道院建立。1670年拉辛起义波及苏拉河：9月16日，得到当地居民响应的起义军攻占阿拉特里，直到11月23日巴里亚京斯基公爵才收复该城。1708年当地划入喀山省，1719年成为下诺夫哥罗德省下辖的州城，1780年改属辛比尔斯克总督区，同年获赐城徽——红底上三只装满箭矢的金箭囊，以表彰此地居民善射。1812年，在阿拉特里组建的步兵团随辛比尔斯克民团出征。

en:
Peremyshl is the San River country around Przemysl, where the Carpathian foothills open through the Przemysl Gate. A Lendian stronghold there became one of the Cherven towns; in 1085 it was made the seat of the Principality of Peremyshl, but in 1134 Volodymyrko moved his capital to Halych. The town came under Mongol suzerainty in 1246 and was taken by Casimir III in 1340, after which a new stone castle rose above the San. Queen Jadwiga restored Red Ruthenia to Poland in 1387, and Jogaila confirmed its Magdeburg rights in 1389. In 1444 Przemysl was a royal town and seat of Przemysl Land in the Ruthenian Voivodeship, with Orthodox and Latin bishops, trading suburbs, and a Jewish presence first recorded in 1440.

Stephen III of Moldavia's retaliatory expedition sacked the town in 1498. The sixteenth century brought walls, waterworks, town houses and the Old Synagogue of 1559, while Polish, Ruthenian, German, Jewish and Armenian merchants shared the trade through the San gap. After the Union of Brest in 1596, Orthodox bishop Michal Kopystenski refused the union; supporters of union had their own bishop from 1610, and the local see only entered communion with Rome under Bishop Innocenty Winnicki in 1691. A Jesuit college opened in 1628. War followed at mid-century: Cossacks and Tatars struck in 1648, Swedes in 1655, and Hungarian troops in 1657. Adam Klein opened a printshop in 1754, and Stanislaw August Poniatowski served as local starosta from 1756 to 1764. Austrian troops annexed Przemysl in 1772 and made it a Galician district capital.
zh:
佩列梅什利是普热梅希尔周围的桑河流域，喀尔巴阡山麓在此经普热梅希尔门通向低地。当地的伦迪安人要塞后来成为切尔文诸城之一；1085年，这里成为佩列梅什利公国的都城，但1134年沃洛迪米尔科把都城迁往哈利奇。1246年，普热梅希尔臣服蒙古；1340年，卡齐米日三世夺取此地，随后桑河畔建起一座新石堡。1387年，雅德维加将红鲁塞尼亚归还波兰，1389年雅盖沃确认其马格德堡法。1444年时，普热梅希尔是国王直辖城镇和鲁塞尼亚省佩列梅什利地区的治所，驻有东正教与罗马天主教主教，城郊贸易繁忙，犹太人的存在最早见于1440年记载。

1498年，摩尔达维亚大公斯特凡三世的报复军队洗劫普热梅希尔。16世纪，城市修筑城墙和供水设施，兴建宅邸，1559年老犹太会堂落成；波兰人、鲁塞尼亚人、德意志人、犹太人和亚美尼亚商人共同经营穿过桑河缺口的贸易。1596年布列斯特联合后，东正教主教米哈乌·科皮斯滕斯基拒绝加入联合，联合派从1610年起拥有自己的主教，当地教区直到1691年才在因诺肯季·温尼茨基主教主持下与罗马共融。耶稣会学院于1628年开办。17世纪中叶战事接踵而至：1648年哥萨克与鞑靼人来攻，1655年瑞典人入侵，1657年匈牙利军队抵达。1754年，亚当·克莱因开设印刷所；1756年至1764年，斯坦尼斯瓦夫·奥古斯特·波尼亚托夫斯基担任当地长官。1772年，奥地利军队吞并普热梅希尔，并将其设为加利西亚的区治。

en:
Ostyaki is the old Russian name for the Khanty, Ob-Ugrian hunters and fishermen of the western Siberian lowlands. Along the marshy Kazym, a right-bank tributary of the Ob, their clans built up the Kazym principality from the fourteenth century; log-walled towns such as Mozym near the river mouth and Kazym-vosh commanded fishing waters, portages and sable grounds. Southern merchants sought their furs, and Tatar influence from the Siberian khans reached the ruling families, whose princes were later often called murzas. In 1444 the northern clans kept their own chiefs and ancestral cults, their freedom protected by forests that no southern army could easily control.

Moscow entered the rivalries of Yugra in 1483, when the Koda prince Moldan fought its campaign, and Kazym recognized Moscow in 1499 only to break away the next year. In 1557 the Russian court demanded yasak from Prince Pevgey, who instead recognized Kuchum of Siberia in 1563. After Yermak shattered Kuchum's power in 1582, Prince Sengep submitted in 1586, promising tribute and no opposition to Christianity. The agreement did not last: in 1593, after Beryozov fort was founded on the Ob, Russian troops took Kazym-vosh and turned the principality into a yasak district, charged with 160 sables and two black foxes. Kazym nobles joined northern risings in 1607 and 1663, but after their defeat the old princes survived mainly as collectors of tribute from neighbouring forest Nenets.
zh:
奥斯恰克是俄罗斯人对汉特人的旧称。汉特人是西西伯利亚低地的鄂毕—乌戈尔猎人和渔民。在鄂毕河右侧沼泽密布的卡济姆河沿岸，各氏族从14世纪起组成卡济姆公国；河口附近的莫济姆、卡济姆沃什等木栅城镇控制着渔场、连水陆路和紫貂猎场。南方商人渴求这里的毛皮，西伯利亚汗廷的鞑靼影响也深入统治家族，当地首领后来常被称为穆尔扎。1444年，北方诸氏族仍保有自己的酋长和祖灵信仰，南方军队难以深入的森林庇护着他们的自主。

1483年，莫斯科卷入尤格拉诸部的纷争，科达公摩尔丹在战事中抵抗俄军；卡济姆1499年承认莫斯科，次年便重新独立。1557年，俄罗斯宫廷要求佩夫盖缴纳牙萨克，他却在1563年臣服西伯利亚的库楚姆。1582年叶尔马克击溃库楚姆势力后，森格普于1586年归降，承诺纳贡并不阻挠基督教传播。这项约定未能持久：1593年，俄军在鄂毕河建立别廖佐夫堡后攻占卡济姆沃什，把公国改为牙萨克乡，定额贡纳160张紫貂皮和2张黑狐皮。卡济姆贵族1607年和1663年参加北方起事，均告失败，旧王公此后主要靠替莫斯科向邻近森林涅涅茨人收贡保留权势。

en:
The Bolshoy Yugan rises in the Vasyugan marshes and winds 1,063 kilometres to the Ob, draining a basin of lakes, pine bog and taiga. The people Russians called Ostyaks, Khanty in their own language, named themselves by their river and lived by fishing, hunting and reindeer; sable and squirrel pelts were the country's wealth. In 1444 no town commanded the waterway. Tatar power to the south was reaching into Yugra, and over the following decades some Khanty principalities were drawn into the Siberian Khanate, while camps up the Yugan kept their own chiefs and rites.

After Yermak's campaign against the Siberian Khanate began in 1581, the tsar's men built Surgut on the Ob in 1594, near the Yugan mouth. A guest yard followed in 1596, and the stockade became a centre for hostages, baptized chiefs and yasak furs taken from the river clans; for many Khanty, Orthodoxy long coexisted with older shrines and shamans. Surgut held 199 inhabitants in 1642 and remained a Russian military and fiscal post through the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries, becoming a district town in Tobolsk province in 1782. The Yugan basin itself stayed a country of winter trails, river camps and fur tribute rather than a settler town.
zh:
大尤甘河发源于瓦休甘沼泽，蜿蜒1063公里注入鄂毕河，流域内湖泊、松林沼泽和泰加林交错。俄国人称为奥斯恰克人的居民自称汉特人，常按所居河流称呼自己，以捕鱼、狩猎和养驯鹿为生；紫貂和松鼠皮是此地的财富。1444年，没有任何城镇控制这条水道。南方鞑靼势力正向尤格拉伸展，此后几十年间，一些汉特王公领地被纳入西伯利亚汗国，而尤甘河上游的营地仍保留自己的首领和仪式。

1581年叶尔马克远征西伯利亚汗国后，沙皇的人于1594年在鄂毕河畔、靠近尤甘河口处修建苏尔古特。1596年寨堡中又建起商馆，使这里成为扣留人质、接纳受洗首领和向沿河部落征收毛皮贡赋的据点；对许多汉特人而言，东正教长期与旧有神龛和萨满仪式并存。苏尔古特1642年有199名居民，17至18世纪始终是俄国的军事和财税据点之一，1782年成为托博尔斯克省的县城。尤甘河流域本身没有发育成移民城镇，仍主要由冬季道路、河畔营地和毛皮贡赋联系在一起。

en:
The Agan flows 544 kilometres through marshy taiga to join the Tromyogan near the Ob, draining 32,200 square kilometres of bog, oxbow lakes and conifer forest. Khanty and Forest Nenets camps knew the river as a living presence guarded by the goddess Agan, and they lived by fishing, reindeer, hunting and sable pelts. In 1444 there was no Russian town here, and the rising power of Sibir touched Yugra chiefly through demands for furs and allegiance; river clans kept their own chiefs, shrines and animist rites.

Yermak's campaign after 1581 opened the Ob route from the west, and Surgut, founded in 1594, became the nearest tsarist stronghold. Cossacks and tribute collectors drew the Agan camps into the yasak system, taking hostages and encouraging baptism while Khanty and Nenets rites persisted around river shrines. Through the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries the basin remained a remote country of winter trails, fishing camps and reindeer pastures; its sable, squirrel and fish moved out through Surgut rather than supporting a town of its own.
zh:
阿甘河穿过沼泽泰加林，流淌544公里后在鄂毕河附近汇入特罗姆约甘河，流域面积32200平方公里，遍布沼泽、牛轭湖和针叶林。汉特人与森林涅涅茨人的营地把阿甘河视为有灵的存在，受女神阿甘守护；他们以捕鱼、养驯鹿、狩猎和猎取紫貂为生。1444年这里还没有俄国城镇，西伯利亚汗国势力对尤格拉的影响主要表现为索取毛皮和臣服，沿河各部仍保留自己的首领、神龛和万物有灵仪式。

1581年后叶尔马克的远征打开了自西方进入鄂毕河的道路，1594年建立的苏尔古特成为最近的沙皇据点。哥萨克和贡使把阿甘诸营地纳入毛皮贡赋体系，扣留人质并鼓励受洗，但汉特人与涅涅茨人的仪式仍在河畔神龛附近延续。17至18世纪，该流域始终是一片由冬季道路、渔场和驯鹿牧场组成的边远之地；紫貂、松鼠和渔获经苏尔古特外运，本地并未形成自己的城镇。

en:
Baykha is the cold river country between the Turukhan's upper and lower Baikha tributaries and the left bank of the Yenisei. In 1444 Samoyed and Ostyak bands moved through its taiga and forest-tundra, fishing, hunting wild reindeer and sable, and using the rivers as roads after the ice broke. Russian records would later call one such group the Baikha Ostyak clan, moving between the Turukhan, Baikha and Yenisei. The future capital Troitskiy was then only riverbank: no monastery, fur post or permanent Russian settlement stood above the long Arctic winter.

After the Mangazeya fur trade opened the Taz-Turukhan-Yenisei canoe route, the Yenisei bank gained a religious center. In 1657 the monk Tikhon settled near the mouth of the Lower Tunguska and built a chapel; in 1660 his community became the Trinity Turukhan Monastery, known as Troitskiy. The relics of St Vasily of Mangazeya were brought there in 1670, and royal grants secured fishing grounds and winter camps. Between 1669 and 1724 the monastery bought twelve winter camps along the lower Yenisei and Arctic coast, and by the mid-eighteenth century held twenty-three, nearly half the district's total; its salt works sent up to two thousand poods of salt a year to Tomsk. A fire in 1726 destroyed its early records, and the secularization of 1764 stripped away most monastic lands.
zh:
巴伊卡是上巴伊哈河、下巴伊哈河等图鲁汉支流与叶尼塞河左岸之间的寒林水地。1444年时，萨莫耶德与奥斯恰克群体在泰加林和林苔原间迁徙，捕鱼、猎取野生驯鹿与黑貂，等冰面开化后又把河道当作道路。后来的俄文记录把其中一支称为巴伊哈奥斯恰克氏族，他们在图鲁汉河、巴伊哈河与叶尼塞河之间往来。未来首府特罗伊茨基此时还只是河岸：漫长北极寒冬之上，没有修道院、毛皮站或俄罗斯永久定居点。

曼加泽亚毛皮贸易打开塔兹河—图鲁汉河—叶尼塞河独木舟航路后，叶尼塞河畔出现了一处宗教中心。1657年，修士吉洪在下通古斯卡河口附近定居并建起小圣堂；1660年，他的团体成为三一图鲁汉修道院，即特罗伊茨基。1670年，曼加泽亚的圣瓦西里圣骨迁到此处，皇家敕令又为修道院确认渔场和冬营。1669年至1724年间，修道院在叶尼塞河下游和北冰洋沿岸买下十二处冬营，到18世纪中叶已有二十三处，接近全区冬营的一半；盐场每年最多向托木斯克运售两千普特盐。1726年的大火烧毁早期档案，1764年世俗化改革又剥夺了修道院的大部分土地。

en:
The Uchamin country lies on the Central Siberian Plateau, where the 466-kilometre Uchami River flows westward through a broad valley to join the Lower Tunguska. Its Evenki name referred to riding a reindeer, and that animal shaped life here: clans rode between winter and summer grounds, pitched conical tents, hunted elk and wild reindeer, fished under ice, and trapped sable. In 1444 these were trails and camps of Tungus clans, not a Russian administrative district; the Yenisey approaches were still beyond Mangazeya's fur collectors.

In 1607 Mangazeya voivodes founded the Turukhansk wintering post at the mouth of the Lower Tunguska, opening a river route into Uchami country. From 1620 to 1623 the fur hunter and explorer Pyanda ascended the Lower Tunguska from Turukhansk, passed through the Tungus river system, and reached the approaches to the Lena. His voyage turned the valley into a source of yasak furs. The Turukhansk Trinity Monastery was founded in 1660, and the old settlement became New Mangazeya in 1672. By the turn of the century depleted fur stocks and southward-shifting routes had weakened the northern gateway; Turukhansk had only 498 inhabitants in 1801.
zh:
乌恰明一带位于中西伯利亚高原，长约466公里的乌恰米河穿过宽阔河谷西流，汇入下通古斯河。河名在埃文基语中与骑驯鹿有关，而驯鹿正塑造了这里的生活：氏族骑着驯鹿往来于冬夏营地，搭起锥形毡帐，猎取驼鹿和野鹿，在冰下捕鱼，并猎捕紫貂。1444年，这里还是通古斯氏族的小径与营地，而不是俄罗斯人的行政区；叶尼塞河方向也尚未出现曼加泽亚毛皮商人的据点。

1607年，曼加泽亚的督军在下通古斯河口建立图鲁汉斯克越冬地，打开了进入乌恰米地区的水路。1620年至1623年，毛皮猎人、探险者皮扬达从图鲁汉斯克溯下通古斯河而上，穿过通古斯水系，抵达通往勒拿河的边缘地带。他的航行使这一河谷成为雅萨克毛皮的来源地。图鲁汉斯克三一修道院于1660年建立，旧据点则在1672年改称新曼加泽亚。到19世纪初，毛皮兽减少和商路南移削弱了这座北方门户；1801年，图鲁汉斯克只有498名居民。

en:
The Chulym river basin was already becoming a Turkic frontier by 1444. Turkic-speaking clans had entered the upper Chulym in the twelfth and thirteenth centuries, moved down the Kiya, and during the fifteenth century spread toward the lower river. As they mixed with Selkup and Ket fishing and hunting peoples, the clans later called Chulym Tatars took shape. They fished, hunted, gathered pine nuts, and after contact with Siberian Tatars raised barley, oats, rye, cattle and horses; Yenisey Kyrgyz raiders coming from the Kiya drove them into the taiga.

Tomsk was founded in 1604 as the main Russian strongpoint against the Yenisey Kyrgyz. On the Chulym, the first Achinsk stockade was built in 1641; after a fire it was moved in 1683, and a new wooden fort rose at the Achinka mouth in 1710. Russian taxation and Orthodox baptism gradually bound the Chulym clans to the empire, while their recorded numbers fell from 1,040 to 830 in the seventeenth century before recovering to about 3,900 by 1816. Achinsk became an uyezd town in 1782 and was attached to Tomsk Governorate in 1804.
zh:
楚利姆（Chulym，河流中文通译丘雷姆河）流域在1444年已是突厥语世界的前沿。突厥语氏族在12至13世纪进入丘雷姆河上游，随后沿基亚河而下，并在15世纪扩散到下游。他们同以渔猎为生的塞尔库普人和凯特人融合，逐渐形成后来所称的楚利姆鞑靼人。他们捕鱼、狩猎、采集松子，又在与西伯利亚鞑靼人接触后种植大麦、燕麦和黑麦，饲养牛马；叶尼塞吉尔吉斯袭掠者从基亚河方向来袭时，人们便带着财物躲入泰加林。

1604年，托木斯克建城，成为俄罗斯对抗叶尼塞吉尔吉斯人的主要据点。第一座阿钦斯克寨堡于1641年在丘雷姆河畔修筑，1683年火灾后迁移，1710年又在阿钦卡河口建起新的木堡。俄国人的赋税和东正教化逐渐把楚利姆氏族纳入帝国秩序；有记载的人口在17世纪从1040人降至830人，到1816年又恢复到约3900人。阿钦斯克1782年成为县治，1804年划入托木斯克省。

en:
The Vakh rises in the wetlands dividing the Ob, Yenisei and Taz systems and runs 964 kilometres west through marshy taiga to the Ob. Its basin covers 76,700 square kilometres, and a short portage from its upper waters reached the Sym and the Yenisei, making the river an Ob–Yenisei highway. Eastern Khanty clans fished, hunted and carried squirrel and sable pelts along its tributaries. In the fifteenth century their camps fell within the sphere of Kod, the Khanty principality of the middle Ob. In 1444 the Kod princes held fortified river towns, raided both tundra Samoyeds and neighbouring Yugra principalities, and acknowledged the Tyumen khan as overlord.

Moscow's expeditions of 1483 and 1499 made Kod submit briefly, but its allegiance remained nominal and shifted during the wars after Yermak. Kod troops helped the Russians build Surgut in 1594, marched against the Pegaya Orda in 1598 and defeated Prince Kichey of the Little Pegaya Orda in 1602. For those campaigns Prince Igichey Alachev received the Vakh volost of Surgut district, bringing the river under his dynasty's holding. In 1609, during Russia's Time of Troubles, Princess Anna Purteeva conspired with chiefs from Kondia and Obdorsk for a rising, until the plot was exposed. Kod warriors later helped build Makovsky ostrog in 1617 and Yeniseysk in 1619. Internal princely strife ended the buffer state in 1643, when Dmitry Alachev was summoned to Moscow and Kod passed under direct Russian rule.
zh:
瓦赫河发源于分隔鄂毕河、叶尼塞河与塔兹河流域的沼泽地带，向西穿过泰加林964公里后注入鄂毕河，流域面积76700平方公里。其上游经短途水陆联运即可接入瑟姆河与叶尼塞水系，使瓦赫河成为鄂毕河与叶尼塞河之间的通道。东部分支的汉特人沿各支流捕鱼、狩猎，运送松鼠皮和紫貂皮。15世纪，这些营地落入鄂毕河中游汉特政权科达公国的势力范围。1444年，科达王公据有设防的河上城镇，既北掠冻原萨莫耶德人、又与邻近尤格拉诸公国交战，同时承认秋明汗为宗主。

1483年和1499年莫斯科的远征一度迫使科达臣服，但这种臣属关系有名无实；叶尔马克战争期间，科达王公也在各方之间反复。1594年，科达军队协助俄国人修建苏尔古特；1598年随俄军征讨佩加亚奥尔达，1602年击败小佩加亚奥尔达王公基切伊。为奖赏这些战功，伊吉切伊·阿拉切夫获封苏尔古特县的瓦赫乡，瓦赫河由此归入其家族领地。1609年俄国混乱时期，科达王公夫人安娜·普尔捷耶娃与孔达、奥布多尔斯克的首领密谋起事，事后事机泄露。科达军人又在1617年参与修建马科夫斯克寨堡，1619年参与修建叶尼塞斯克。王公家族内斗最终结束了这个缓冲政权；1643年，德米特里·阿拉切夫被召往莫斯科，科达并入俄国，由俄廷直接统治。

en:
At the foot of the Altai, the Barnaulka flows into the upper Ob through open pastures. In 1444 this grass country was grazed by Turkic herdsmen, the ancestors of the Teleuts, who moved with their flocks between the Irtysh and the Ob under the loose dominion of the Oirat confederation; hunters from the taiga edge traded furs at their summer camps. There was no town here, only wintering grounds along the rivers and tracks leading south toward the mountain passes.

Russian stockades first reached the upper Ob in the early eighteenth century; the village of Ust-Barnaulskaya is mentioned in 1724. In 1730 the mine-owner Akinfiy Demidov moved two hundred assigned peasants to the Altai to build works, and in 1739 his copper and silver smelter on the Barnaulka began operating, drawing settlers from central Russia and the Urals. The Crown seized the Demidov factories in 1747 and made Barnaul the headquarters of the Kolyvan-Voskresensk mining district, which became the Russian Empire's main source of silver. In 1766 Ivan Polzunov built Russia's first steam engine on the Barnaulka, and in 1771 Barnaul received mining-town status; Siberia's first mining school opened there in 1785 and its first regional museum followed in the next century.
zh:
阿尔泰山麓，巴尔瑙尔卡河流经开阔草原注入鄂毕河上游。1444年，在这片牧场上放牧的是铁列乌特人的突厥语先民，他们在额尔齐斯河与鄂毕河之间随畜群迁徙，松散地臣属于瓦剌联盟；泰加林边缘的猎人带着毛皮到他们的夏营交易。此时这里没有城镇，只有河畔的冬牧场和通向南方山口的小路。

18世纪初，俄罗斯人的堡寨首先推进到鄂毕河上游，1724年文献首次提到乌斯季-巴尔瑙利斯卡亚村。1730年，矿主阿金菲·杰米多夫把200名注册农民迁到阿尔泰办厂，1739年他在巴尔瑙尔卡河畔的铜银冶炼厂开工，吸引了俄罗斯中部和乌拉尔的移民。1747年皇室没收杰米多夫的工厂，把巴尔瑙尔设为科雷万-沃斯克列先斯克矿区的中心，这里由此成为俄罗斯帝国最主要的白银产地。1766年伊万·波尔祖诺夫在巴尔瑙尔卡河畔造出俄国第一台蒸汽机，1771年巴尔瑙尔获得矿业城镇地位，1785年西伯利亚第一所矿业学校在此开办，下一世纪又有了西伯利亚第一座地方志博物馆。

en:
Nukhtui covers the taiga and plateau country drained by the lower Olyokma, a 1,436-kilometre Lena tributary whose Evenki name has been read as 'squirrel river' or 'rich in squirrels'. Its valleys cut through the Olyokma-Chara Plateau toward the Stanovoy ranges, offering fish, reindeer pasture and forest fur. In 1444 Evenki hunting bands knew the portages and winter camps along its banks, while Yakut clans occupied the Lena meadows near the mouth; no Russian party had yet reached the river.

Russian explorers first reached the Olyokma in 1633 and established a yasak winter camp near its mouth. Pyotr Beketov built Olyokminsky Ostrog there in 1635, initially opposite the mouth and later twelve kilometres upstream on ground safe from spring floods. The Lena-Olyokma junction made the fort a staging point for eastern expeditions and river trade to Yakutsk. In spring 1649 Yerofey Khabarov ascended the Olyokma and Tungir, portaged to the Shilka, and reached the upper Amur in early 1650. Olyokminsk remained a river junction and supply town, receiving town status in 1783.
zh:
努克图伊是奥廖克马河下游泰加林与高原地带。奥廖克马河全长1436公里，汇入勒拿河，其埃文基语地名一说意为「松鼠河」或「多松鼠之河」。河谷切过奥廖克马—恰拉高原，通向斯塔诺夫山脉，出产鱼类和林中毛皮，也可供牧鹿。1444年，埃文基猎队熟悉沿河的转运路和冬营，雅库特氏族则在河口附近的勒拿河草甸活动；俄国人此时尚未抵达这条河。

1633年，俄国探险者首次到达奥廖克马河，并在河口附近设立征收毛皮税的冬营。1635年，彼得·别克托夫在那里修筑奥廖克明斯克小堡；堡寨最初正对河口，后来向上游迁移12公里，以避春汛。勒拿河与奥廖克马河的交汇使这里成为东进探险和通往雅库茨克河运的补给站。1649年春，叶罗费·哈巴罗夫溯奥廖克马河与通吉尔河而上，经连水陆路进入石勒喀河水系，1650年初到达阿穆尔河上游。奥廖克明斯克此后一直是河运枢纽和补给城镇，1783年取得城市地位。

en:
The Chuna rises on the northern slope of the Eastern Sayan and runs 1,203 kilometres across the Central Siberian Plateau; above its lower reaches it is called the Uda, and at its western end it joins the Biryusa to form the Taseyeva. In 1444 its upper grasslands belonged to the Uda Buryat clans later led by Oylan, while Evenki or Tungus bands used the river and taiga farther downstream for reindeer, elk, fish and sable. There was no Russian stockade on the Uda, only seasonal camps, river crossings and the trails connecting the Sayan slopes with the Taseyeva country.

Russian penetration began through Krasnoyarsk. In August 1645 Cossack atamans Miloslav Koltsov and Elisey Tyumentsev defeated the main Uda Buryat force; Oylan submitted in 1647 and asked for a fort as protection and as a yasak post. On 14 October 1648 Tyumentsev founded the sovereign's wintering settlement, Pokrovsky Gorodok, on the high right bank. It became Udin Stockade in 1664, was sacked in 1666 by Yenisey Kyrgyz under Irenek, and was renamed Nizhneudinsk in 1700. The Moscow road brought a post station and inns in the mid-eighteenth century, and in 1783 the settlement became an uyezd town.
zh:
丘纳河发源于东萨彦岭北坡，全长1203公里，横穿中西伯利亚高原；它的上游称乌达河，西流后与比留萨河汇合，形成塔谢耶瓦河。1444年，上游河谷草原属于后来由奥伊兰统领的乌达布里亚特氏族，下游河川与泰加林则有埃文基人（即通古斯人）活动，依靠驯鹿、驼鹿、渔获和紫貂为生。当时乌达河畔没有俄罗斯寨堡，只有季节性营地、渡口和连接萨彦岭坡地与塔谢耶瓦地区的小径。

俄罗斯人从克拉斯诺亚尔斯克方向进入。1645年8月，哥萨克首领米洛斯拉夫·科利佐夫和叶利谢伊·秋缅采夫击溃乌达布里亚特人的主力；奥伊兰于1647年臣服，并请求修筑堡垒以获得保护、兼收雅萨克。1648年10月14日，秋缅采夫在高高的右岸建起君主的冬季据点波克罗夫斯基堡。它于1664年成为乌达寨堡，1666年遭伊列涅克率领的叶尼塞吉尔吉斯人洗劫，1700年改名下乌金斯克。18世纪中叶，莫斯科驿道经过此地，设下驿站和客栈；1783年，这个据点成为县治。

en:
Seganka denotes a roadless stretch of the Vilyuy Plateau, where upper Vilyuy streams wind through larch taiga and lake-dotted muskeg between the Vilyuy headwaters and the Tunguska rivers. Evenki, then called Tungus by Russians, had long inhabited this country, keeping reindeer that could be ridden and packed, hunting elk and wild reindeer, fishing beneath the ice, and camping in conical tents. In 1444 their clans controlled the trails and river crossings themselves, while Russian power still lay far beyond the Ilim-to-Lena portages.

After Lensky Ostrog opened the Lena route in 1632, the voivode Ivan Galkin sent Yenisei Cossacks under Posnik Ivanov into the Vilyuy. In spring 1634 they established Verkhne-Vilyuyskoye zimovye, the first Russian post on the river, as a yasak collection point and a base for pushing into the basin. The demand for sable and squirrel furs was enforced through hostages from prominent clans; some Evenki resisted, while others moved deeper into the forest or eastward. Over the following decades Cossack parties extended fur tribute through the upper taiga, and its pelts travelled down the Vilyuy and Lena to Yakutsk.
zh:
塞甘卡指维柳伊高原上一段无路泰加林。维柳伊河上游支流蜿蜒穿过落叶松林和湖泊散布的沼泽，处在维柳伊河源与通古斯河水系之间。埃文基人后来被俄国人称为通古斯人，早已生活在这片土地上；他们饲养可供骑乘和驮物的驯鹿，猎捕驼鹿与野鹿，冰下捕鱼，并在迁徙时搭建锥形帐篷。1444年，各氏族自行掌控猎道与河口渡口，俄国势力仍远在伊利姆河通往勒拿河的联运路之外。

1632年连斯克堡打开勒拿河通道后，督军伊万·加尔金派遣波斯尼克·伊万诺夫率领叶尼塞哥萨克进入维柳伊河流域。1634年春，他们设立上维柳伊冬营，这是俄国人在维柳伊河上的第一个据点，用作毛皮税征收点和深入盆地的前进基地。紫貂皮与松鼠皮的索求靠扣押显贵氏族的人质来保证，一些埃文基人起而反抗，另一些则迁入更深的林地或向东迁徙。此后数十年，哥萨克队伍把毛皮贡赋扩展到上游泰加林，当地毛皮经维柳伊河和勒拿河运往雅库茨克。

en:
Between the Lena and the upper Aldan the Tatta and Amga water a wide, open stretch of the central Yakutian plain, some of the best pasture the Sakha people knew. Here the Baturu and Bayagantay clans grazed their cattle and horses, and their toyons kept smiths, clients and herds; their forefathers had come from the Baikal country in the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries and held the land in kin pasture-grounds when the first Cossacks heard tell of them. In 1444 the log balagans stood alone among the snowfields, and the only overlord was Tengri the Sky.

The Lensky ostrog rose on the Lena in 1632, and in January 1634 a thousand Sakha besieged its thirty Cossacks. The clans of the eastern volosts rose again in 1636 and, hardest, in 1642, when voivode Golovin answered with hangings, mutilation and burned settlements; smallpox followed the yasak, and the Yakut people fell by an estimated seventy per cent before 1682. The last eastern rising came in 1684, when Oryukan and Dagincha of the Batulin volost led Sakha and Tungus against the tribute men and ravaged the country under Yakutsk, until a Cossack detachment drove the survivors beyond the Aldan. From the 1650s the Yakutsk–Okhotsk track crossed the Amga meadows; it became a post road in 1731, with stations from 1735. By the early nineteenth century the clans were baptised and counted in the ulus rolls, though they kept many of the old Tengri ways.
zh:
勒拿河与阿尔丹河上游之间，塔塔河和阿姆加河灌溉着雅库特中部平原上一片开阔地带，是萨哈人所知最好的几处牧场之一。巴图鲁、巴亚甘泰氏族在这里牧养牛马，酋长蓄养着铁匠、属民和畜群；他们的祖先在14至15世纪从贝加尔湖一带迁来，第一批哥萨克听到他们的名声时，各氏族正按血缘公社占有着这片草场。1444年，圆木的巴拉甘孤零零立在雪原之间，唯一的主宰是腾格里苍天。

1632年，连斯基寨堡在勒拿河畔立起；1634年1月，上千名萨哈人围攻寨中仅有的三十名哥萨克。东部各乡氏族1636年再度起事，最猛烈的一次在1642年——督军戈洛温以绞刑、断肢和焚村回应；天花随毛皮贡而来，到1682年雅库特人口估计已减少约七成。东部最后一次起义发生在1684年：巴图林乡的奥留坎和达金恰率领萨哈人与通古斯人攻打征税者，在雅库茨克城郊连破数地，直到一支哥萨克部队把幸存者赶过阿尔丹河。从1650年代起，雅库茨克—鄂霍茨克通道穿过阿姆加草甸，1731年成为驿道，1735年起设立驿站。到19世纪初，各氏族已受洗并编入乌卢斯册籍，不过仍保留着不少腾格里旧俗。

en:
Yarmanka is the middle Indigirka country, a land of forest-tundra and great river bends between the Verkhoyansk highlands and the Alazeya plateau; in these years the Russians called the Indigirka the Dog River. Yukaghir clans lived here in conical tents, driving wild reindeer into the rivers, netting the autumn fish runs and trapping sable in the southern woods; the Alai clan wandered the Alazeya to the east. Their clans reached from the Yana to the Kolyma, and in 1444 the spring gatherings at the river bends had never seen a bearded stranger.

In 1639 the Yenisei Cossack Posnik Ivanov, after skirmishes with the Yukaghirs, built a winter post below the Indigirka rapids, the shivera, later named Zashiversk, 'beyond the rapids'; Ivan Rebrov raised Podshiversk further downstream in the same year. It became the supply stage on the Yakutsk-to-Kolyma road, where Stadukhin and Dezhnyov drew provisions and Yukaghirs and Tungus delivered sable yasak. Abuses by the collector Andrei Bulygin helped bring a Yukaghir and Even attack in 1666 and a siege in 1679, the year after a wooden ostrog wall went up, making it the only permanently garrisoned fort on the Indigirka. The larch Spassky church built by Andrei Khabarov followed in 1700, and in 1721 the Indigirsky ostrog was formally named Zashiversk. Chartered as a town and uyezd seat in 1783, it was already failing with the sable trade: measles and smallpox swept the district in 1773 to 1776, reform moved the uyezd offices to Verkhoyansk in 1804, and when Ferdinand von Wrangel passed through in 1820 only five inhabited houses remained.
zh:
亚尔曼卡是因迪吉尔卡河中游的一片土地，森林冻原上河曲纵横，西接上扬斯克山地，东邻阿拉泽亚高原；这一时期俄国人把因迪吉尔卡河叫作「狗河」。尤卡吉尔各氏族住在这里，他们住锥形帐篷，把野鹿赶进河里，秋天撒网捕捞洄游鱼群，在南部林子里猎捕紫貂；阿莱氏族则在东面的阿拉泽亚河一带游牧。各氏族的地界西起亚纳河、东到科雷马河。1444年，河湾处的春季聚会上还从未出现过长胡子的外来人。

1639年，叶尼塞哥萨克波斯尼克·伊万诺夫在与尤卡吉尔人交战后，于因迪吉尔卡河险滩（当地称「希维拉」）下游建起冬营，后来得名扎希维尔斯克，意为「险滩之后」；同年伊万·列布罗夫在更下游建起波德希维尔斯克冬营。这里成为雅库茨克通往科雷马官道上的补给站，斯塔杜欣、杰日尼奥夫都曾在此歇脚补给，尤卡吉尔人和通古斯人把紫貂实物税送到寨中。税吏安德烈·布雷金的盘剥激起反抗，尤卡吉尔人与埃文人1666年来攻，1679年又发兵围困；此前一年寨中已筑起木墙，使它成为因迪吉尔卡河上唯一常驻守军的要塞。1700年，木匠安德烈·哈巴罗夫用落叶松原木建成斯帕斯教堂；1721年，因迪吉尔卡寨堡正式定名扎希维尔斯克，1783年设市，为扎希维尔斯克县治。此时紫貂渐尽，市镇已在衰落，1773至1776年麻疹与天花又席卷全区；1804年，县署奉1803年行政改革之命迁往维尔霍扬斯克。1820年费迪南德·冯·弗兰格尔路过时，全城只剩五栋有人居住的房屋。

en:
Kagyrgyn was the Chukchi name for the mouth of the Anadyr, where the river opens into a broad gulf of the Bering Sea. In 1444 no town stood there. Coastal Chukchi camps took salmon, seals and whales from the estuary, while the Chavchu, reindeer Chukchi whose name meant people rich in deer, moved between inland pastures and came to the coast to exchange hides and meat. This was Chukchi country beyond the reach of Russian tribute.

Semyon Dezhnev's expedition reached the gulf in 1648, built winter quarters up the Anadyr in 1649 and gave Russia its route toward Kamchatka; Anadyrsk itself was fortified in 1660. Yet the Cossack road did not subdue the Chukchi. Afanasy Shestakov's detachment was destroyed in 1730, and Major Dmitry Pavlutsky's campaigns burned camps and drove off reindeer herds until his own force was beaten on the Orlova River and he was killed in March 1747. After more than a century of costly war, Russia evacuated and burned Anadyrsk in 1771. In 1775 the Angarka post on a tributary of the Bolshoy Anyuy opened an annual fair, where Chukchis brought reindeer hides, live deer, seal skins, whalebone and furs. By 1821 the estuary remained in Chukchi hands, linked to Russian commerce but not brought under regular fur tribute.
zh:
卡基林是楚科奇人对阿纳德尔河口的称呼，河水由此注入白令海的宽阔海湾。1444年时，那里还没有城镇。滨海楚科奇人在河口设营捕捞鲑鱼、猎捕海豹和鲸；自称「恰夫丘」的养鹿楚科奇人——其名称意为「多鹿之人」——在内陆牧场间迁移，再到海岸交换鹿皮和鹿肉。这里仍是俄国贡赋未曾到达的楚科奇土地。

谢苗·杰日尼奥夫的远征1648年抵达阿纳德尔湾，1649年在阿纳德尔河上游修建冬营，为俄国打开通往堪察加的道路；阿纳德尔堡则于1660年建成。但哥萨克的道路并没有使楚科奇人臣服。1730年，阿法纳西·舍斯塔科夫的队伍被歼；德米特里·帕夫卢茨基少校的远征焚烧营地、驱走鹿群，直到他自己的部队在奥尔洛瓦河战败，他本人也于1747年3月被杀。经过一个多世纪代价高昂的战争，俄国于1771年撤离并焚毁阿纳德尔堡。1775年，大阿纽伊河支流上的安加尔小堡开设年度集市，楚科奇人带来鹿皮、活鹿、海豹皮、鲸须和毛皮。到1821年，阿纳德尔河口仍掌握在楚科奇人手中，与俄国商业相连，却没有承受固定的毛皮贡赋。

en:
The future village of Iglino did not exist in 1444. Its land lies on the wooded Ufa Plateau, about twenty kilometres east of later Ufa, around the Belekes, a forty-one-kilometre Bashkir-named tributary of the Ufa River whose name means 'little river'. These were Bashkir hereditary grounds, where Turkic clans grazed horses and cattle on forest-edge meadows. As the Golden Horde broke apart, the western Bashkirs were drawn into the rival orbits of Kazan, Sibir and the Nogai Horde. Most were Sunni Muslims, although older sky and spirit cults survived; in 1444 outside lordship still reached the clearings through clan elders rather than a Russian fortress.

After Kazan fell, the western and north-western Bashkirs accepted Ivan IV in the winter of 1554, retaining title to their lands in return for yasak and military service. The Russian fortress founded at Ufa in 1574 anchored the new frontier. Disputes over seized land, taxes and mosques brought Bashkir risings in 1662-1664, 1681-1684 and 1704-1711, and many clans joined Pugachev's war of 1773-1775 under leaders such as Salavat Yulayev. Peaceable settlement followed on the old pastureland: in 1786 Major Sergei Vasilyevich Iglin bought Bashkir patrimonial land by deed and settled serfs brought from Kazan Governorate, naming the village Belekes after the river. By the early nineteenth century its people were working as carpenters, potters and saddlers.
zh:
1444年时，后来的伊格利诺村还不存在。这片土地位于林木覆盖的乌法高原、日后乌法以东约20公里，别列克斯河流贯其间；河名在巴什基尔语中意为「小河」，全长41公里，注入乌法河。这里原是巴什基尔人的世袭土地，突厥语诸部在林缘草地放牧马匹和牛群。金帐汗国分裂后，西部巴什基尔人被卷入喀山、西伯利亚和诺盖汗国的势力角逐。他们多为逊尼派穆斯林，同时保留古老的天神与精灵崇拜；1444年时，外部宗主权仍经由氏族首领触及这些林中空地，俄罗斯人的堡垒尚未出现。

喀山陷落后，西部和西北部巴什基尔人在1554年冬接受伊凡四世的宗主权，以缴纳牙萨克和服军役为条件保留土地所有权。1574年乌法建立俄罗斯堡垒，成为这条新边界的支点。土地被占、赋税和清真寺争端引发1662—1664年、1681—1684年和1704—1711年的巴什基尔起事；1773—1775年，许多部众又在萨拉瓦特·尤拉耶夫等首领率领下参加普加乔夫战争。此后旧牧地上出现定居村落：1786年，谢尔盖·瓦西里耶维奇·伊格林少校依契约购下巴什基尔世袭土地，把从喀山省带来的农奴安置于此，村庄初以河名称为别列克斯。到19世纪初，村民已从事木工、制陶和马具制作。

en:
Ust-Kut province lies on a great western bend of the Lena, at the mouth of the Kuta amid boggy taiga. Evenki gives Kuta its name, meaning 'peat bog'. In 1444 no Russian winter camp or fort stood there. Evenki clans hunted elk and sable, fished the Lena, and moved with reindeer across seasonal grounds; trails up the Kuta also led toward Buryat pasture lands near Baikal. The low route between the Lena and Ilim systems made the river mouth a natural canoe and portage crossing, but its traffic was still entirely in indigenous hands.

Vasily Bugor's Cossacks used the Kuta route and set up winter quarters at its mouth in 1628 or 1629. In 1631 Ataman Ivan Galkin built the large winter camp that became Ust-Kut ostrog. Yerofey Khabarov found salt springs there in 1639 and opened a salt-boiling works, while Lena ploughland and the post service helped turn the fort into a permanent settlement; nearby villages already formed Ust-Kut volost in 1640. As the Lena end of the Ilim-Lena portage, it built flat-bottomed doshchaniki for Cossack parties pushing east and later fitted vessels for Vitus Bering's Northern Expedition. Its military value faded in the later seventeenth century, yet salt, grain, boatbuilding and Lena shipping made it one of the chief starting points for trade down the great river. Through the eighteenth century it remained a fair and river-port village rather than a chartered town.
zh:
乌斯季库特地区位于勒拿河向西的大弯曲处，库塔河在沼泽泰加林间汇入河口；「库塔」来自埃文基语，意为沼泽地。1444年，这里还没有俄罗斯人的冬营或堡寨。埃文基氏族猎捕驼鹿和紫貂，在勒拿河捕鱼，随驯鹿往返于季节猎场；沿库塔河上行的小路又通向贝加尔附近的布里亚特牧地。勒拿河与伊利姆水系之间的低矮通道，使这个河口成为天然的舟楫和水陆转运口，只是往来仍完全掌握在本地居民手中。

1628或1629年，瓦西里·布戈尔的哥萨克沿库塔路线到来，在河口设立冬营。1631年，首领伊万·加尔金修建大型冬营，后来发展为乌斯季库特堡。叶罗费·哈巴罗夫1639年在此发现盐泉并开设煮盐场；勒拿河畔的耕地和驿邮又促使堡寨变成常住定居点，附近村落1640年已组成乌斯季库特乡。作为伊利姆—勒拿连水陆路的勒拿端，这里为东进哥萨克队伍建造平底多板船，后来也为维图斯·白令的北方探险队整备船只。17世纪后期，它的军事价值下降，但盐业、粮食、造船和勒拿航运使其成为顺河贸易的主要起点之一。整个18世纪，这里始终是设有集市的河港村落，而未取得城市地位。

en:
The Kan province follows the Kan River through forest-steppe east of the Yenisei forts and below the eastern Sayan. In 1444 this was the country of small Sayan Samoyedic clans later recorded by Russians as Kamasins. Taiga bands hunted, herded reindeer and fished, while steppe relatives on the lower Kan kept cattle and horses; the wider region lay on the edge of Yenisei Kirghiz tribute power, and Buryat riders also entered its pastures. There was no town, only seasonal camps and crossings linking the mountains with the Yenisei country.

In 1628, on Andrei Dubensky's order, Ataman Yermak Ostafyev established winter quarters at the Komarovo rapids to collect fur tribute, but the site lay too far from native migration routes. In 1636 Mikhail Koltsov and fifty Cossacks built the new Kan ostrog below the Bratsky crossing, and in 1640 the post was moved farther up the Kan. The fort was burned by Buryats in one early attack and by Tubins in 1677. Twenty Cossack families were resettled from Krasnoyarsk in 1717; between 1720 and 1724 the fort had twenty-two households and 126 male inhabitants, and its Church of the Saviour was built in 1722. From 1724 to 1782 Kansk was a centre of the Kan commissariat and a post station. The Siberian road reached it in the 1740s, bringing peasant settlers and exiles, and in 1782 it became a volost centre rather than a chartered town. Its stone Church of the Saviour was begun in 1800 and consecrated in 1814, when Kansk remained a small river-and-road settlement.
zh:
坎地区沿坎河展开，位于叶尼塞诸堡以东、东萨彦岭脚下的森林草原盆地。1444年，这里是后来被俄国人记作卡马辛人的萨彦萨莫耶德小氏族之地。泰加林群体狩猎、饲养驯鹿并捕鱼，坎河下游草原上的亲族则放牧牛马；这一带处在叶尼塞吉尔吉斯人贡赋势力的边缘，布里亚特骑兵也会进入其牧场。这里没有城镇，只有季节性营地，以及连通山地与叶尼塞方向的渡口。

1628年，叶尔马克·奥斯塔菲耶夫头领奉安德烈·杜边斯基之命，在科马罗夫险滩设立冬营以收取毛皮贡赋，但地点离本地部落的迁徙路线太远。1636年，米哈伊尔·科利佐夫率五十名哥萨克在布拉茨基渡口下方新建坎堡；1640年，据点又被迁到坎河上游。坎堡早年曾被布里亚特人焚毁，重建后又在1677年遭图宾人烧毁。1717年，二十户哥萨克从克拉斯诺亚尔斯克迁来；1720至1724年间，堡内有二十二户、126名男性居民，救世主教堂也在1722年建成。1724至1782年，坎斯克是坎河专员区中心和驿站。1740年代西伯利亚驿路经过这里，迁来农民和流放者；1782年它成为乡治，而非特许城市。石造救世主教堂1800年动工，1814年祝圣，此时坎斯克仍是一座小型河路聚落。

en:
Bashgird is the forest and forest-steppe beyond the southern Urals, the country of the Iset and Techa, streams that run to the Tobol. In 1444 its hunters and herders were trans-Ural Bashkirs of the Siberian road, trapping fur among the lakes and shifting their allegiance between the fading khanate of Sibir and the Nogai hordes; medieval Arab geographers had counted these grazing grounds among the two regions of Bashgird.

After the fall of the Sibir khanate these trans-Ural Bashkirs accepted Russian rule at the turn of the seventeenth century. In 1644 the elder Dalmat, a monk from Verkhoturye, settled as a hermit on the Iset at the Techa mouth, on land given him by Iligey, a Tyumen yasak Tatar; his cloister, chartered in 1659, was the first Russian settlement in the Iset valley. The Shadrinsk stockade went up in 1662, and in the Bashkir rising of that year Sary Mergen's riders sacked and burned the monastery. By 1686 Shadrinsk was the largest sloboda of western Siberia, and it became a town in 1712. In Pugachev's war the rebel yesaul Prokhor Pesterev brought some 2,000 men against the walled monastery from 11 February to 2 March 1774, but the defenders beat back the assaults of 12–13 February and the siege was raised.
zh:
巴什基尔德是南乌拉尔山外的森林与森林草原，伊谢季河与捷恰河流经此地，二水最终汇入托博尔河。1444年时，这里的猎人和牧人是「西伯利亚路」的外乌拉尔巴什基尔人，在湖沼间猎取毛皮，在走向衰落的西伯利亚汗国与诺盖诸帐之间权衡归附；中世纪的阿拉伯地理学家早已把这片牧场算作巴什吉尔德的两大区域之一。

西伯利亚汗国灭亡后，外乌拉尔的巴什基尔人于17世纪初接受俄国统治。1644年，来自韦尔霍图里耶的修士长老达尔马特在伊谢季河畔、捷恰河口隐居，土地是秋明的亚萨克鞑靼人伊利格伊所赠；他的修院于1659年获沙皇敕书正式设立，是伊谢季河谷的第一个俄人定居点。1662年沙德林斯克木堡建成，同年的巴什基尔起义中，萨雷·梅尔根的骑兵洗劫并焚毁了修院。到1686年，沙德林斯克已是西西伯利亚最大的集镇，1712年正式设城。普加乔夫战争期间，义军首领普罗霍尔·佩斯特列夫率约两千人，于1774年2月11日至3月2日围攻围墙坚固的修院，守军击退了2月12、13日的强攻，围困终告解除。

en:
The Mangazea country lies along the Taz River, between the lower Ob and the Yenisei, where Arctic tundra meets the last stands of sable forest. In 1444 it was still Samoyed country: Nenets and Selkup families followed reindeer, fish and game through the river lowlands, while their furs were gathered along winter trails and carried toward the Ob. No Russian town or permanent trading post yet stood on the Taz.

In 1600 Tsar Boris Godunov sent Miron Shakhovskoy and Danila Khripunov from Tobolsk with about a hundred streltsy and Cossacks. After an attack in which they lost some thirty men, the survivors reached the Taz and raised a wooden ostrog; in 1601 Vasily Mosalsky and Savluk Pushkin completed the fort and founded the posad. Fyodor Bulgakov established a merchants' court in 1603, and five towers were raised in 1607. The town had about 750 permanent residents and could hold one thousand to two thousand people during trading seasons, receiving yasak from Nenets, Selkups, Kets and Evenkis by 1608. Isaac Massa published a plan of it in Amsterdam in 1612, but in 1620 Moscow banned the sea route through the Yamal portage on pain of death, fearing loss of customs revenue and English or Dutch penetration. The voevodes' feud in 1629 and the great fire of 1642 hastened its decline as sables grew scarce. Mangazea was deserted in 1662, abolished by Tsar Alexis in 1672, and its garrison withdrew to Turukhansk, called New Mangazea, in 1677.
zh:
曼加扎（俄语常译曼加泽亚）地区位于塔兹河流域，地处鄂毕河下游与叶尼塞河之间，北极冻原在这里与最北缘的紫貂林相接。1444年，这里仍是萨莫耶德人的土地：涅涅茨和谢尔库普人家族在低地间追逐驯鹿、捕鱼狩猎，毛皮沿冬季道路汇集，再被带往鄂毕河方向。此时塔兹河畔还没有俄罗斯城镇或常驻商栈。

1600年，沙皇鲍里斯·戈东诺夫从托博尔斯克派出约一百名射击军和哥萨克，由米龙·沙霍夫斯科伊与达尼拉·赫里普诺夫率领。队伍遇袭并损失约三十人后，幸存者抵达塔兹河，建起木寨；1601年，瓦西里·莫萨利斯基和萨夫卢克·普希金完成要塞并设立城郊商业区。1603年，费奥多尔·布尔加科夫建立商馆；1607年，五座塔楼相继修成。城内约有750名常住居民，贸易季可容纳一千至两千人，到1608年已向涅涅茨人、谢尔库普人、凯特人和埃文基人征收毛皮贡。1612年，伊萨克·马萨在阿姆斯特丹出版了曼加扎的平面图；但1620年，莫斯科因担心关税流失以及英国、荷兰势力渗入，以死刑相威胁禁止取道亚马尔连水陆路的海航。1629年两名督军内讧，1642年大火又加速衰败，紫貂资源也日益枯竭。曼加扎于1662年荒芜，1672年被沙皇阿列克谢正式废城，1677年守军撤往被称为新曼加扎的图鲁汉斯克。

en:
Chara is the basin of the 851-kilometre Chara River, which cuts through the mountains of northern Transbaikalia before joining the Olyokma, a tributary of the Lena. Its Evenki name means a shoal or shallow ford. In 1444 Evenki, then called Tungus by Russians, moved through the larch taiga, Kodar passes, and Chara Basin with reindeer, hunting, fishing, and trapping sable and squirrel; the moving dunes of the Chara Sands stood sharply against swamp and forest. Mongol and Buryat power lay mainly to the south, and there was no town at Chara.

Russian pressure arrived along the Lena-Olyokma route rather than through a southern conquest. Russian promyshlenniki reached the Olyokma in 1633 and set up a fur-tribute winter post near its mouth, where Pyotr Beketov built the small Olyokminsky fort two years later. In 1649 Yerofey Khabarov ascended the Olyokma on his way to the Tungir, Shilka, and Amur. As the Siberian fur trade expanded, Evenki clans using the Chara valley were drawn into the same yasak system, though its river corridors remained a remote hunting frontier.
zh:
恰拉指恰拉河流域。恰拉河全长851公里，切出外贝加尔北部山地，最终汇入勒拿河支流奥廖克马河；河名在鄂温克语中意为浅滩、浅渡。1444年，后来被俄国人称为通古斯的鄂温克人带着驯鹿，往来于落叶松泰加林、科达尔山口与恰拉盆地之间，狩猎、捕鱼并捕捉紫貂和松鼠；恰拉沙地的流动沙丘镶嵌在沼泽和森林之间，景象格外突兀。蒙古与布里亚特势力主要在南方，恰拉本地还没有城镇。

俄国势力并非从南面征服此地，而是沿勒拿河至奥廖克马河的水路逼近。1633年，俄国毛皮猎手抵达奥廖克马河，并在河口附近设立征收毛皮贡赋的冬营；两年后，彼得·别克托夫在那里修建小堡奥廖克明斯克。1649年，叶罗费·哈巴罗夫溯奥廖克马河而上，转经通吉尔河、石勒喀河前往阿穆尔河。随着西伯利亚毛皮贸易扩张，使用恰拉河谷通道的鄂温克氏族也被纳入同样的雅萨克贡赋体系，但这里始终是偏远的游猎边地。

en:
The Taman peninsula is a knot of land between the Maeotis and the Euxine. Greeks from Lesbos founded Hermonassa here about 600 BC; Bosporan kings, Khazar tuduns and Byzantine archons held it in turn, and in the tenth century it became the Rus trading city of Tmutarakan, whose prince Gleb measured the frozen strait to Kerch in 1068. Cut off from Rus by the Cumans after 1094, it passed under the Mongols and then to Genoa, which knew it as Matrega, one of the two Pri-Kuban colonies named in its Black Sea statute of 1449. In 1419 the Genoese lord Vincenzo de Ghisolfi married the Adyghe princess Bika-khanum, and in 1444 their family holds the town as vassals at once of the Genoese consul in Caffa and of the Circassian princes of the mainland: a mixed town of Greeks, Adyghe, Armenians and Jews, shipping slaves, fish and wine through the strait.

In 1453 Genoa made over its Black Sea possessions to the Bank of St George, and the Ghisolfi governed Matrega on the bank's behalf until the Ottoman fleet took it in 1475; Zaccaria de Ghisolfi kept his seat by making his peace with the Porte. The Turks built the fortress of Khunkala and called the town Taman, and its slave market remained one of the busiest on the Circassian shore. In 1556 Adyghe princes in Ivan the Terrible's service stormed the island and took both Taman and Temryuk, until an Ottoman army restored them in 1570. In July 1782 a revolt drove the Russian-backed khan Şahin Giray to Kerch and a Turkish garrison returned to Taman, but the Russian annexation of the Crimean khanate in 1783 carried the peninsula with it. The question was fought over once more in the war of 1787–1791, ended by the Treaty of Jassy, and on 25 August 1792 the first Black Sea Cossacks landed on the shore; Suvorov laid out the new fortifications, and Taman became the seat of the host judge Anton Golovaty and the base of the Cossack flotilla.
zh:
塔曼半岛是迈奥提斯海与攸克辛海之间的一块要冲之地。莱斯沃斯岛的希腊人约在公元前600年建立赫尔莫纳萨；博斯普鲁斯诸王、可萨的图敦和拜占庭的执政官先后统治此地，10世纪它成为罗斯人的商贸城市特穆塔拉干——1068年，王公格列布曾在此丈量冰封海峡到刻赤的距离。1094年后钦察人把它与罗斯故地隔断，城市先后落入蒙古人和热那亚之手，得名马特雷加；1449年热那亚黑海殖民地宪章中，它是普里库班耶仅有的两处殖民地之一。1419年，热那亚领主文琴佐·德·吉佐尔菲迎娶阿迪格公主比哈汗，1444年他们的家族同时作为卡法热那亚领事和大陆切尔克斯王公的藩属据有此城：希腊人、阿迪格人、亚美尼亚人和犹太人混居一城，经海峡贩运奴隶、鱼和葡萄酒。

1453年，热那亚把黑海属地移交圣乔治银行，吉佐尔菲家族代银行治理马特雷加，直到1475年奥斯曼舰队将其攻取；扎卡里亚·德·吉佐尔菲向朴特输诚，保住了城主之位。土耳其人筑起洪卡拉要塞，改称塔曼，这里的奴隶市场仍是切尔克斯海岸最繁忙的市场之一。1556年，臣属伊凡雷帝的阿迪格诸王公袭取海岛，拿下塔曼和捷姆留克，1570年奥斯曼大军又将其夺回。1782年7月，叛乱把俄国拥立的沙辛·格来汗赶到刻赤，土耳其驻军重回塔曼，但1783年俄国兼并克里米亚汗国时连半岛一并收入版图。1787至1791年战争中此地再遭争夺，最终以《雅西条约》定局；1792年8月25日，首批黑海哥萨克登岸，苏沃洛夫规划新的工事，塔曼随后成为军法官安东·戈洛瓦季的驻地和哥萨克舰队的基地。

en:
Fezzan is the chain of oases threading south-western Libya between the sand seas of the Sahara, where dry wadi beds in the north hold wells and date palms. The Garamantes made these oases a pivot of trans-Saharan trade from the fifth century BC, sending north the gold, ivory and slaves of the Sahel; after their empire faded, Kanem and then Bornu stretched suzerainty over the wadi towns. Arab Banu Sulaym tribes drifted in during the thirteenth century, and Murzuk grew around its oasis fortress on the road from Tripoli and Ghadames to the Kawar salt mines and Bornu beyond. In 1444 the oases were ruled by local lords in the shadow of Bornu, and in the later fifteenth century they became tributaries of the Hafsid sultan in Tunis.

The Awlad Muhammad gave Fezzan its lasting dynasty. Tradition credits its founding to Muhammad al-Fasi, a sharif at the head of a caravan, whom the Murzuk lords invited to rule in the early sixteenth century as Tuareg raids worsened; from the mid-1500s the sultans of his line held Fezzan with Murzuk as their capital. The town became the greatest slave market of the central Sahara, outstripping Ghat and Ghadames by the end of the century. The Ottoman pashas of Tripoli invaded as early as 1574, but their grip stayed loose: the sultans of Murzuk kept internal rule, and Turkish garrisons appeared only on occasional marches south, as in 1679–1682 and 1718. Tripoli finally made its claim good and annexed the sultanate in 1813.
zh:
费赞是串起利比亚西南部沙海的一串绿洲，北方的干河谷中藏着水井和椰枣林。公元前5世纪起，加拉曼特人便把这些绿洲经营成跨撒哈拉贸易的枢纽，将萨赫勒的黄金、象牙和奴隶运往北方；他们的帝国衰落后，卡涅姆、继而博尔努的宗主权延伸到这些河谷城镇。13世纪，阿拉伯巴努·苏莱姆部落陆续迁入，穆尔祖克依托绿洲上的要塞兴起，正处在的黎波里、古达米斯通往卡瓦尔盐矿和远方博尔努的大道上。1444年，各绿洲由本地首领统治，仍笼罩在博尔努的阴影之下；15世纪后期，他们又向突尼斯的哈夫斯苏丹称臣纳贡。

奥拉德·穆罕默德王朝给了费赞持久的统治世系。相传创立者穆罕默德·法西是带领商队的圣裔，16世纪初图阿雷格袭扰加剧，穆尔祖克的地方首领请他出面主政；自16世纪中叶起，他的后裔以穆尔祖克为都城统治费赞。这座城成为撒哈拉中部最大的奴隶市场，到16世纪末已盖过加特和古达米斯。奥斯曼的黎波里帕夏早在1574年就攻入费赞，但控制始终松散：穆尔祖克苏丹保留内部统治，土耳其驻军只在偶尔南下时出现，如1679至1682年和1718年。的黎波里最终把宗主权落到实处，于1813年吞并了这个苏丹国。

en:
The Jufra is the chain of oases – Sokna, Hun and Waddan – that breaks the desert in the heart of Libya, where the road south from the coast at Sirte turns into Fezzan. Medieval geographers knew the district simply as the land of Waddan, its oldest town: Arab raiders first reached it under Busr ibn Artat in 642, extracting only tribute, and Uqba ibn Nafi placed a garrison there in 666–667; by the mid-thirteenth century Waddan was the northernmost point held by the kings of Kanem. The eleventh-century geographer al-Bakri described Hun as a crowded oasis of vast palm groves and many springs, a market a day's journey from Waddan on the road to Sabha. In 1444 the oases kept their own shaykhs and their Berber speech, Sokna still speaking its Eastern Berber tongue, and lived by dates, livestock and the passing caravans.

With the rise of the Awlad Muhammad in the early sixteenth century, the Jufra became the northern march of the Fezzan sultanate, whose authority at its height ran from Sokna to Murzuk. The Ottoman pashas of Tripoli passed through these oases on the marches south that began in 1574, and the Jufra shared the sultanate's loose tributary life until Tripoli made it part of its eyalet together with Fezzan in 1813.
zh:
朱夫拉是苏克纳、洪、瓦丹一线绿洲的总称，嵌在利比亚腹心的沙漠中，海岸锡尔特南往费赞的道路正是从这里折向南方。中世纪的地理学家只把这一带称作「瓦丹之地」——瓦丹是其中最古老的城镇：阿拉伯袭掠军642年在布斯尔·本·阿尔塔特率领下首次抵达，仅取贡赋而退，666至667年欧格白·本·纳菲又在此设下驻军；到13世纪中叶，瓦丹已是卡涅姆君王控制的最北据点。11世纪的地理学家白克里记载，洪是个人口稠密的绿洲，椰枣林广袤、泉水众多，是瓦丹往塞卜哈道上的商站，距瓦丹仅一日路程。1444年，各绿洲由本地谢赫治理，仍保留柏柏尔人的语言——苏克纳说的是东柏柏尔方言——居民靠椰枣、牲畜和过路商队为生。

16世纪初奥拉德·穆罕默德王朝兴起后，朱夫拉成为费赞苏丹国的北部边区，其极盛时的辖地北起苏克纳、南至穆尔祖克。1574年起，的黎波里的奥斯曼帕夏们南下征讨时屡屡取道这些绿洲；朱夫拉也随苏丹国过着松散的朝贡生活，直到1813年与费赞一道被的黎波里并入其行省。

en:
Ghadames, the Roman Cydamus, is a palm oasis on the Tripolitanian edge of the Sahara, hard by where Tunisia, Algeria and Libya meet. Lucius Cornelius Balbus captured it for Rome in 19 BC, a Severan garrison held it around 202, and a Byzantine bishopric sat there before the Arab conquest of 667. Its spring, Ain al-Faras, was shared among the townsfolk in fixed water-turns, and around it rose a walled ksar of seven Berber clans, each with its own quarter. Muslim merchants made the oasis a chief station of the trans-Saharan road, with caravans running south to Timbuktu and Ghadamsi leather famed across the Maghreb. In 1444 it was loosely tied to the Hafsid rulers of Tunis and the Djerid oases, its merchant clans managing most of their own affairs.

In the sixteenth century Ghadames passed under the Ottoman regency of Tunis, and in the eighteenth under the pashas of Tripoli, when the ksar reached its greatest prosperity. An Ottoman castle was raised, and the slave market and the caravan trains linked the Mediterranean shore with Timbuktu and the lands beyond.
zh:
古达米斯是撒哈拉边缘的的黎波里塔尼亚境内一处椰枣绿洲，毗邻突尼斯、阿尔及利亚和利比亚三地交界。公元前19年，卢修斯·科尔内利乌斯·巴尔布斯为罗马攻取此地，约202年塞维鲁王朝曾在此驻军，拜占庭时期这里设有主教区，直到667年阿拉伯人征服。绿洲中心的马泉按固定份额分给全城，泉边建起有城墙的堡寨，七个柏柏尔氏族各居一区。穆斯林商人把这里经营成跨撒哈拉大道上的主要驿站，商队南下廷巴克图，古达米斯皮革也风行整个马格里布。1444年，它在名义上臣属于突尼斯的哈夫斯王朝和杰里德绿洲，市政大半由本地商人氏族自理。

16世纪，古达米斯转入以突尼斯为中心的奥斯曼行省治下，18世纪改归的黎波里的帕夏，堡寨也在此时臻于鼎盛：奥斯曼城堡拔地而起，奴隶市场和南来北往的商队把地中海沿岸与廷巴克图乃至更南方的土地连在一起。

en:
Thubaqt, the Phoenician Thubactis, is the coastal oasis of Misrata; its later name comes from the Misrata, a branch of the Berber Hawwara whom Ibn Khaldun found on this shore. After the Arab conquest it became a caravan station and a port, its looms famed for carpets, while palms, olives and market gardens crowded the springs. In 1444 the town and its roadstead were held with Tripoli by the Hafsid sultans of Tunis.

Spanish troops seized Tripoli in 1510, and the Knights of St John held the coast from 1530 until Turgut Reis took it for the Ottomans in 1551. Under the Karamanli dynasty, founded in 1711, Misrata grew into a principal mart of the trans-Saharan road, where caravans from Fezzan sold gold, leather and slaves; the harbor at Qasr Ahmad shipped grain and carpets to Egypt and the Levant. The Muntasir and Adgham clans, enriched by this trade, led the town and its tribes through the last Ottoman generation.
zh:
图巴克特即腓尼基人的图巴克提斯，也就是米苏拉塔滨海绿洲；其后来的名字得自柏柏尔豪瓦拉联盟的分支米苏拉塔部落，伊本·赫勒敦曾记载他们住在这段海岸。阿拉伯征服后，这里成为商队驿站和港口，织机以地毯闻名，泉水周围椰枣、橄榄和菜园密布。1444年，城镇和锚地与的黎波里一同处在突尼斯哈夫斯王朝苏丹治下。

1510年西班牙军队攻占的黎波里，1530年起圣约翰骑士团据守这段海岸，1551年图尔古特·雷伊斯为奥斯曼人将其夺取。1711年建立的卡拉曼利王朝治下，米苏拉塔成长为跨撒哈拉商路上的主要商市，费赞来的商队在此出售黄金、皮革和奴隶，盖斯尔·艾哈迈德港则把粮食和地毯运往埃及和黎凡特。门塔西尔和阿德加姆两大家族靠这宗贸易致富，在奥斯曼统治的最后世代主导着城镇和部落事务。

en:
Zuwarah is a Berber fishing town on the coast west of Tripoli, set among salt flats on the edge of the Nafusa country, whose people kept the Ibadi faith when it survived in Libya only here and in the Nafusa mountains. Al-Bakri numbered the Zuwarah among the Berber tribes of this shore, and al-Tijani, visiting in 1306 to 1309, found two villages: Little Zuwarah, already ruined by Christian corsairs raiding its salt pans, and Greater Zuwarah, the walled Qutayn among the palms. In 1444, some two thousand strong, it lived by salt, fish, lime and gypsum and owned only a loose allegiance to Tunis.

Leo Africanus found Qutayn's walls crumbling a century later, its people dreading the corsairs, yet under the Karamanli pashas after 1711 Zuwarah revived: treaties with the Italian republics opened the salt trade, its roadstead of Tibuda became one of the coast's busiest salt harbours, and an Ottoman-built port carried its fish and esparto to Tripoli.
zh:
祖瓦拉是的黎波里以西的柏柏尔渔镇，四周盐沼环绕，地处奈富塞山区边缘；当伊巴德派在利比亚仅存于奈富塞山与祖瓦拉时，这里的居民仍守着这一信仰。贝克里已把祖瓦拉人列为这段海岸的柏柏尔部落之一，提贾尼1306至1309年间到访时见到两座村庄：小祖瓦拉已因基督徒海盗反复劫掠盐田而荒废，大祖瓦拉则是椰枣林中带围墙的库泰因。1444年，全镇约两千人，靠盐、鱼、石灰和石膏为生，对突尼斯只维持松散的臣属。

一个世纪后，利奥·阿非利加努斯见到库泰因城墙倾颓，居民终日担心海盗来袭。1711年以后的卡拉曼利帕夏时代，祖瓦拉重获生机：与意大利诸共和国订立的条约打开了盐的销路，蒂布达锚地成为海岸最繁忙的盐港之一，奥斯曼时期修建的新港把鱼和阿尔法草运往的黎波里。

en:
Sfax was founded in 849, when the Aghlabid emir of Kairouan had a walled town raised beside the old Byzantine watch-post of Taparura. Its deep olive groves made the city's fortune: by the tenth century the geographer Ibn Hawqal saw Sfax oil shipped to Egypt, Sicily and the Christian ports of the north, while herds were ferried to graze on the Kerkennah islands. The Normans of Sicily held the town from 1148 to 1156, when a citizens' revolt ended the occupation in the wars that soon brought in the Almohads; Hafsid rule followed from the early thirteenth century. Its merchants sailed to Genoa and Marseille as well as Damascus and Cairo. In 1444, in the long Hafsid peace of Abu 'Amr 'Uthman, Sfax was the busiest port of the Tunisian south, girdled by walls and famous for olive oil and fish.

The Ottoman–Habsburg struggle shattered that order. Hayreddin Barbarossa brought the town into the Ottoman camp in 1534; after years of Spanish domination Dragut Pasha conquered it in 1551, and the Ottoman fall of Tunis in 1574 made the new rule permanent. Andalusi exiles of the Nasrid collapse joined its merchant and scholarly families. Under the Muradid deys Sfax became a corsair port and a city of learning: its ulama founded madrasas while its captains cruised against Christian shipping, not least that of the Knights of Malta. Venice fought the fleet at Ras al-Makhbaz in 1747 and bombarded the town four times in 1785–86. Under the Husainid beys the Great Mosque received its mihrab in 1758 and its enlargement was completed in 1783; from 1776 the new Frankish suburb by the sea housed Jewish and Christian merchants, proof that oil and trade still paid for the city's wars.
zh:
849年，凯鲁万的艾格莱卜埃米尔下令在拜占庭旧哨站塔帕鲁拉旁筑起一座城墙环绕的城镇，是为斯法克斯。成片的橄榄林造就了它的富庶：到10世纪，地理学家伊本·豪盖勒已见到斯法克斯的橄榄油远销埃及、西西里和北方基督教港口，畜群则被渡海送到盖尔甘奈岛放牧。1148年西西里诺曼人占领此城，1156年市民起义终结了占领，随后的战乱把穆瓦希德人引入突尼斯；13世纪初起斯法克斯归入哈夫斯王朝。这里的商人既航行到大马士革和开罗，也航行到热那亚和马赛。1444年，在阿布·阿慕尔·奥斯曼治下的漫长太平岁月里，斯法克斯已是突尼斯南部最繁忙的港口，城墙环抱，以橄榄油和渔产闻名。

奥斯曼与哈布斯堡的争夺打破了旧秩序。1534年，「红胡子」赫伊尔丁把斯法克斯带入奥斯曼阵营；经过多年西班牙人的控制，德拉古特帕夏于1551年攻克此城，1574年奥斯曼攻陷突尼斯后，新统治就此稳固。奈斯尔王朝覆灭后出走的安达卢斯人，也加入了这里的商人和学问世家。穆拉德迪伊们治下，斯法克斯成了海盗港与学术之城：乌理玛兴办经学院，船长们出海劫掠基督教船只，尤以马耳他骑士团为对手。威尼斯舰队1747年在拉斯马克赫兹之战中来攻，又在1785至1786年间四次炮轰此城。侯赛因王朝的贝伊们给了城市新的营建：大清真寺1758年立新米哈拉布，扩建工程1783年完工；1776年起，海边新建的法兰克区住满犹太与基督教商人——橄榄油和贸易，仍在为这座城市的战争买单。

en:
El Kef crowns a cliff of the Jebel Dyr in the High Tell, the strong hill country of northwestern Tunisia. Carthaginians knew it as Sicca and the Romans as Sicca Veneria, a favoured colony and one of the chief Christian cities of Africa; Arab raiders reached it in 688, and in time the rock fortress became al-Kaf. In 1444 it was the dominant stronghold and market of the Hafsid western march, on the road from Tunis to Constantine, where the wool clipped from the flocks of the Tell was gathered and the governors sent from Tunis watched the frontier.

Ottoman rule made the rock a garrison town: its kasbah was built in 1600 to hold a permanent garrison, and ramparts were added in 1740. El Kef gave the Husainid dynasty its founder and its second bey, for Hussein ibn Ali was born there in 1675 and Ali Pasha on 30 June 1688.
