The bishops gradually became secular rulers: Bishop Otto von Rietberg received the regalia in 1281, and after the Battle of Worringen in 1288 the bishopric moved clearly within the Empire's immediate nobility. Bernhard V gave the young territory its first estates constitution, and in 1371 Heinrich III rebuilt Neuhaus Castle as a western seat of government. In 1444 the see was held by Dietrich III of Moers, who also ruled Cologne as archbishop. His debts and the Soest Feud of 1444-1449 were already drawing war over the Catholic Westphalian market towns, monasteries and village estates around Paderborn and Warburg.

Lutheran preaching reached Paderborn in 1526, and under the Lutheran bishop Heinrich IV of Saxony-Lauenburg much of the territory accepted the Augsburg Confession. The cathedral chapter called in the Jesuits in 1580, and after 1585 Dietrich IV von Fürstenberg carried through the Catholic renewal, subdued the city in 1604 and founded the University of Paderborn in 1614. The Thirty Years' War struck anyway: Christian of Brunswick sacked Paderborn in 1622, Hessian troops held the land from 1632 to 1636, and Carl Gustaf Wrangel took the city in 1646. Paderborn was captured or besieged sixteen times, and plague and war reduced the bishopric's population by about a third. Ferdinand II von Fürstenberg's baroque building programme after 1661 brought a limited recovery, but the Seven Years' War again turned the countryside into a supply ground and brought fighting near Warburg. Prussian troops occupied the bishopric on 1 August 1802 and secularisation followed in 1803; between 1807 and 1813 it belonged to the Kingdom of Westphalia, after which it returned to Prussia.
zh:
帕德博恩是威斯特伐利亚东部以主教座堂城市帕德博恩为中心的教会领地。799年，查理大帝与教宗良三世在此会面，并设立主教区。主教们逐渐取得世俗统治权：奥托·冯·里特贝格1281年获授王权象征，1288年沃林根战役后，帕德博恩更明确地成为神圣罗马帝国的直辖教会领地。伯恩哈德五世为这片年轻领地制定最早的等级宪法，海因里希三世又于1371年重建新豪斯城堡，作为西部治所。1444年，主教默尔斯的迪特里希三世同时担任科隆大主教。他背负沉重债务，1444—1449年的索斯特封邑冲突又把战火引向帕德博恩、瓦尔堡一带的天主教威斯特伐利亚集镇、修道院和乡村庄园。

路德宗讲道1526年传入帕德博恩；在路德宗主教萨克森-劳恩堡的海因里希四世治下，领地大部分地区接受《奥格斯堡信纲》。主教座堂参事会1580年召来耶稣会，1585年以后迪特里希四世·冯·菲尔斯滕贝格推动天主教复兴，1604年制服城市，并于1614年创办帕德博恩大学。三十年战争仍严重打击此地：不伦瑞克的克里斯蒂安1622年劫掠帕德博恩，黑森军队1632—1636年占领这片土地，卡尔·古斯塔夫·弗兰格尔1646年攻占城市。帕德博恩先后十六次被攻占或围困，战争与瘟疫使采邑主教区人口减少约三分之一。1661年后，斐迪南二世·冯·菲尔斯滕贝格的巴洛克建设计划带来有限复苏，但七年战争再度使乡间成为军需补给地，瓦尔堡附近也发生战斗。1802年8月1日，普鲁士军队占领主教区，1803年完成世俗化；1807—1813年这里归属威斯特伐利亚王国，此后又回到普鲁士。

en:
Meppen lies where the Hase, in those days split into three branches, ran into the Ems, and its Old Saxon name means 'at the mouths'. It is first documented in 834, when the Emperor Louis the Pious gave the missionary settlement of Meppen to Corvey Abbey. Otto the Great granted it minting and toll rights in 945 and market rights in 946, while the lords of Meppen administered the place as ministeriales. In 1252 Countess Jutta of Vechta-Ravensberg sold her Emsland lands to the bishop of Münster, and Meppen became part of the Niederstift, the northern half of the prince-bishopric. Bishop Adolf granted it town rights and leave to fortify in 1360, and the lords of Langen succeeded as its local lords in 1392. In 1444 it was a small walled market and river-crossing town of the bishop of Münster, living from its market and the traffic on the Ems.

Jesuits settled in Meppen in 1613, and their college helped the Emsland remain Catholic through the age of the Reformation. The town's walls and bastions were enlarged until 1660, but in 1762, towards the end of the Seven Years' War, the fortress was demolished and only the outer embankment survived. The secularisation of 1803 made Meppen the capital of the new Duchy of Arenberg-Meppen, granted to the Duke of Arenberg in compensation for his lost lands west of the Rhine. French annexation followed in 1811, when the town became a cantonal seat in the department of the Upper Ems. Prussian troops arrived in 1813, and the Congress of Vienna assigned Meppen to the Kingdom of Hanover in 1815.
zh:
梅彭位于哈瑟河（当时分为三汊）注入埃姆斯河之处，古萨克森语地名意为「河口」。它首见于834年的文献：虔诚者路易把梅彭传教站赠予科尔维修道院。945年奥托大帝授予这里铸币权与关税权，946年又授予市集权，梅彭家族作为陪臣管理此地。1252年，费希塔-拉文斯贝格女伯爵尤塔把她在埃姆斯兰的领地卖给明斯特主教，梅彭遂归入主教区北半部的「下主教区」。1360年，主教阿道夫授予其城市权和筑城权；1392年起，朗根家族接任此地的世袭长官。1444年，这里是明斯特主教治下一座有城墙的小型集市与渡口城镇，靠集市和埃姆斯河上的航运为生。

1613年，耶稣会士来到梅彭，他们创办的学校帮助埃姆斯兰在宗教改革的年代保持了天主教信仰。城镇的城墙和棱堡一直扩建到1660年，但在七年战争末期的1762年，要塞被拆毁，只有外围堤防留存。1803年的世俗化中，梅彭成为新设立的阿伦贝格-梅彭公国首府，封给阿伦贝格公爵，以补偿他在莱茵河左岸丧失的领地。1811年法国直接吞并，梅彭成为上埃姆斯省的一个县治。1813年普鲁士军队抵达，1815年维也纳会议将梅彭划归汉诺威王国。

en:
Loon took its name from the early count's stronghold at Borgloon, a name meaning a castle on a wooded hill. Around 1020 the county covered little beyond that settlement in Haspengouw, but by 1200 its rights stretched across much of the later Belgian Limburg, combining fertile Hesbaye villages, Kempen heaths and Maas valley towns. Count Gerard moved the court to Kuringen, later part of Hasselt, after Liège troops devastated Borgloon in 1179, yet the old town remained one of Loon's recognized Good Cities. When the comital line failed, Prince-Bishop Engelbert III of the Marck seized Loon in 1362 and incorporated it into Liège in 1366. In 1444 it was therefore a Catholic, Dutch-speaking quartier of the Prince-Bishopric, ruled by Prince-Bishop John of Heinsberg but keeping its own estates and towns.

The crisis of the later fifteenth century came from Burgundy. Louis de Bourbon became prince-bishop in 1456, and his subjects revolted three times between 1465 and 1468. Burgundian troops under Charles the Bold defeated the Liégeois at Brustem, near Sint-Truiden, on 28 October 1467, and the city of Liège was twice burned. Charles's death in 1477 allowed the principality to recover its autonomy, and in 1492 Liège proclaimed its neutrality after the Peace of Donchery ended the war between Bishop John of Horne and the House of the Marck. Loon thus stayed outside the Seventeen Provinces and the Burgundian Netherlands. The Liège Revolution of 1789 overthrew episcopal rule and set up the Republic of Liège, but Austrian forces restored the prince-bishop in 1791. French revolutionary armies annexed the principality in 1795, dissolved the old County of Loon and placed the country in the department of Meuse-Inférieure. In 1815 it passed to the United Kingdom of the Netherlands.
zh:
隆恩得名于伯爵在博尔赫隆的早期据点，其地名意为林木山丘上的城堡。约1020年时，伯国还只包括哈斯彭高的这处聚落周边；到1200年，其权力已延伸到日后比利时林堡的大部分地区，兼领肥沃的哈斯拜乡村、肯彭荒原和马斯河谷城镇。1179年列日军队摧毁博尔赫隆后，伯爵赫拉德把宫廷迁往库林根，即后来哈瑟尔特的一部分，但旧城仍是洛恩受承认的「良城」之一。伯爵血脉断绝后，列日采邑主教恩格尔贝特三世·范·德·马克于1362年夺取洛恩，1366年将其并入列日。因此在1444年，它是列日采邑主教区内一个讲荷兰语的天主教分区，由采邑主教约翰·范·海因斯贝格统治，但保留自己的等级会议和城镇。

15世纪后期的危机来自勃艮第。路易·德·波旁1456年成为采邑主教，他的臣民在1465年至1468年间三次起义。大胆的查理率领勃艮第军队于1467年10月28日在圣特赖登附近的布鲁斯特姆击败列日军，列日本城也两度遭焚。1477年查理战死后，采邑主教区恢复自主；1492年，《栋什里和约》结束主教约翰·范·霍恩与马克家族之间的战争后，列日宣布中立。洛恩因此没有并入十七省或勃艮第尼德兰。1789年列日革命推翻主教统治，成立列日共和国，但奥地利军队在1791年恢复采邑主教。法国革命军队1795年吞并主教区，废除旧洛恩伯国，把这片土地划入下默兹省。1815年，它转入尼德兰联合王国。

en:
Cleves straddled the Lower Rhine, with the Schwanenburg castle on its steep bluff above the town. The name Cleve is first recorded in 1092, and Count Dietrich granted the settlement town rights on 25 April 1242; the transfer of the Marian collegiate foundation from Monterberg later swelled the four-part medieval town with its New City. When the native comital line died out in 1368, Adolf of the Mark inherited Cleves, and the County of Mark was reunited with it in 1398. On 7 June 1397 Adolf captured William II of Jülich-Berg at Kleverhamm in a fight over the Kaiserswerth Rhine toll, and marriages tied his daughters to the Palatinate and Burgundy. At Constance in 1417 Sigismund raised him to Duke of Cleves and Mark. In 1444 Soest placed itself under Adolf's protection against Cologne, opening the Soest Feud; the Catholic Rhenish duchy then lived by Rhine tolls, market towns and cloth traffic.

Adolf died during the feud in 1448, and his son John I secured the renunciation of Cologne's feudal claim. The Klever Union of 1496, the marriage of John III and Maria of Jülich-Berg in 1510, and the succession of 1521 created the United Duchies of Jülich-Cleves-Berg; Maria's daughter Anne married Henry VIII of England in 1540. The dukes stayed Catholic while tolerating Protestant communities in Wesel and Duisburg. After the dynasty died out in 1609, the Treaty of Xanten in 1614 assigned Cleves and Mark provisionally to Brandenburg, confirmed in 1666. Johann Moritz of Nassau-Siegen governed from 1647 to 1679, rebuilding the Schwanenburg and laying out gardens that made Cleve a third Brandenburg residence. French forces took the town in October 1794 and the left bank was ceded in 1795; after Napoleonic rule and the Grand Duchy of Berg, Cleves returned to Prussia in 1815.
zh:
克莱沃据有莱茵河下游两岸，天鹅堡高踞城镇旁的陡峭崖上。「克莱沃」之名最早见于1092年；1242年4月25日，伯爵迪特里希向聚落颁发城市权。后来领主的圣母修道院从蒙特贝格迁来，推动由四部分组成的中世纪城镇扩张，新城也随之形成。1368年旧伯爵家族绝嗣，马克的阿道夫继承克莱沃，1398年马克伯国与克莱沃重新合并。1397年6月7日，双方因凯泽斯韦尔特的莱茵河关税发生冲突，阿道夫在克莱弗哈姆俘获于利希-贝格的威廉二世；他的女儿们又分别嫁入普法尔茨和勃艮第家族。1417年，西吉斯蒙德在康斯坦茨将他升为克莱沃与马克公爵。1444年，索斯特为摆脱科隆而接受阿道夫保护，索斯特封地战争由此爆发；当时这个信仰天主教的莱茵公国正依靠莱茵河关税、市集城镇和布匹贸易为生。

阿道夫在战争期间于1448年去世，其子约翰一世最终迫使科隆放弃封主权。1496年的《克莱沃联盟》、1510年约翰三世与于利希-贝格的玛丽亚成婚，以及1521年的继承，共同造就于利希-克莱沃-贝格联合公国；玛丽亚的女儿安妮1540年嫁给英格兰国王亨利八世。历代公爵仍信奉天主教，同时容忍韦瑟尔和杜伊斯堡的新教社群。王朝1609年绝嗣后，1614年《克桑滕条约》先把克莱沃和马克分给勃兰登堡，最终归属在1666年确认。1647年至1679年，约翰·莫里茨·冯·拿骚-锡根担任总督，改建天鹅堡并规划园林，使克莱沃成为勃兰登堡的第三座驻地。1794年10月法军攻占该城，莱茵河以西土地于1795年割让；经历拿破仑统治和贝格大公国之后，克莱沃于1815年回归普鲁士。

en:
Perugia crowns a high ridge above the upper Tiber, the Etruscan Perusia and one of the twelve cities of the Etruscan League. Its medieval commune grew into a Guelph power, warring with Assisi, Siena and Arezzo and sheltering popes driven out of Rome; five papal conclaves met within its walls, and its university, founded in 1308, drew students of law from across Italy. Signorie followed the commune: Biordo Michelotti ruled from 1393, the city submitted to Gian Galeazzo Visconti in 1400 and to Ladislaus of Naples in 1408, and the condottiero Braccio da Montone made himself lord in 1416, only to die at the siege of L'Aquila in 1424. In 1444 Perugia was effectively self-governing under the covert lordship of Braccio I Baglioni, nominally subject to the Church, its noble factions held in check by Baglioni gold and arms.

The Baglioni made the city a court of the Umbrian Renaissance: Perugino frescoed the money-changers' Sala del Cambio between 1498 and 1500, while Pinturicchio and the young Raphael worked in and around Perugia. Family feuds darkened the patronage: on 14 July 1500 rival Baglioni branches slaughtered one another in the so-called Red Wedding, and in 1520 Leo X lured Giampaolo Baglioni to Rome and had him beheaded. In 1540 the Salt War against Paul III put an end to Perugian liberty, as papal troops under Pier Luigi Farnese forced the city to surrender on 3 June; the Rocca Paolina, built to designs by Antonio da Sangallo the Younger, then rose over the levelled Baglioni quarter. French troops entered in 1797, and on 4 February 1798 Perugia became capital of the short-lived Tiberina Republic, absorbed into the Roman Republic the next year; in 1809 its lands joined the French Department of Trasimène, until the Papal States were restored in 1814.
zh:
佩鲁贾雄踞台伯河上游的山岭，古称佩鲁西亚，是伊特鲁里亚联盟十二城之一。中世纪时，城中公社成长为圭尔夫派强权，与阿西西、锡耶纳、阿雷佐等邻邦连年交战，又多次收留被逐出罗马的教宗，先后有五次教宗选举秘密会议在此召开；1308年创办的大学吸引着全意大利攻读法律的学生。公社之后是强人政权：比尔多·米凯洛蒂1393年起统治佩鲁贾，城市1400年臣服于吉安·加莱亚佐·维斯孔蒂，1408年落入那不勒斯国王拉迪斯劳之手，雇佣军队长弗泰布拉乔（Braccio da Montone）1416年成为城主，1424年死于拉奎拉围城战。1444年的佩鲁贾在布拉乔一世·巴廖尼的隐性统治下实际自治，名义上臣属教宗，城中的贵族世仇靠巴廖尼家的金钱和武力压制着。

巴廖尼家族把佩鲁贾变成翁布里亚文艺复兴的宫廷：佩鲁吉诺在1498至1500年间为钱商行会的坎比奥厅绘制湿壁画，平图里乔和年轻的拉斐尔也在佩鲁贾一带作画。家族仇杀却给庇护之风蒙上阴影：1500年7月14日夜，巴廖尼家的两支旁系在所谓「红色婚礼」上互相屠戮；1520年，良十世把詹保罗·巴廖尼诱往罗马斩首。1540年，对抗保禄三世的食盐战争终结了佩鲁贾的自由，皮埃尔·路易吉·法尔内塞率领的教宗军队在6月3日迫降城市；小安东尼奥·达·桑加罗设计的保利纳堡垒随后在被夷平的巴廖尼宅第上建起。1797年法军入城，1798年2月4日佩鲁贾成为昙花一现的台伯里纳共和国（Repubblica Tiberina）首都，次年并入罗马共和国；1809年其地并入法兰西帝国的特拉西梅诺省，1814年随教宗国复辟重归教廷。

en:
Urbino sits on a steep ridge of the Marche, the Roman Urvinum Mataurense on the route between the Apennines and the Adriatic. The counts of Montefeltro made themselves its lords in 1234 and led the Ghibelline party of the Marche through its long wars with the Malatesta of Rimini. In 1443 Pope Eugene IV raised the town to a duchy for Oddantonio da Montefeltro, but within a year the young duke was murdered by his own subjects, and in 1444 his half-brother Federico, a proven condottiere, seized power. Thus 1444 sees the most brilliant of Urbino's rulers just beginning a reign that would turn a rough hill fortress into one of the polished capitals of the Renaissance.

Federico had Luciano Laurana rebuild the Palazzo Ducale and gathered one of Italy's finest libraries, holding court for Piero della Francesca and Pedro Berruguete; Pope Sixtus IV confirmed him as duke in 1474, and when he died in 1482 his court was among the most admired in Italy, with Raphael born in the town the following year. Cesare Borgia drove out Duke Guidobaldo in 1502, the university was founded in 1506, and in 1508 the duchy passed to the Della Rovere, who moved the court to Pesaro in 1523, leaving Urbino to a long decline. The last duke, Francesco Maria II, signed the devolution of his state to the Papacy in 1625, and on his death in 1631 Pope Urban VIII incorporated it into the Papal States, thereafter ruled by a legate. Cardinal Giovanni Francesco Albani, born in the city, was elected pope as Clement XI and spent lavishly on his hometown, which from 1717 to 1718 sheltered the exiled British pretender James Stuart. French troops occupied Urbino from 1797 to 1800; after the earthquake of 1789 shattered the cathedral dome, Giuseppe Valadier's new Duomo was consecrated in 1809.
zh:
乌尔比诺坐落在马尔凯地区一道陡峭的山梁上，罗马时代称乌尔维努姆-马陶伦塞，扼守亚平宁山脉通往亚得里亚海的要道。1234年，蒙特费尔特罗家族成为这里的领主，此后作为马尔凯吉伯林派的领袖，同里米尼的马拉泰斯塔家族长期相争。1443年，教皇尤金四世将乌尔比诺升为公国，封奥丹托尼奥·达·蒙特费尔特罗为首任公爵；不出一年，年轻的公爵便被自己的臣民杀死，1444年，他的异母兄、久经战阵的雇佣军首领费代里科夺取政权。就在这一年，这位乌尔比诺最杰出的统治者刚刚登位，日后正是他把一座粗陋山城改造为文艺复兴最精致的都城之一。

费代里科请卢恰诺·劳拉纳主持修建公爵宫，又建起意大利首屈一指的图书馆，皮耶罗·德拉·弗朗切斯卡、佩德罗·贝鲁格特等画家齐聚宫中；1474年教皇西克斯图斯四世正式确认他的公爵头衔。他1482年去世时，乌尔比诺宫廷已为全意大利所艳羡，次年拉斐尔在城中出生。1502年切萨雷·波吉亚驱逐了圭多巴尔多公爵，大学于1506年创立；1508年公国传入德拉·罗韦雷家族，1523年宫廷迁往佩萨罗，乌尔比诺从此长期衰落。末代公爵弗朗切斯科·马里亚二世1625年签署文书把国家交还教廷，1631年他去世后，教皇乌尔班八世将公国并入教皇国，此后由教皇特使治理。出生于此的枢机主教乔万尼·弗朗切斯科·阿尔巴尼后来当选教皇，称克莱门特十一世，斥资整修故乡；1717至1718年，流亡的英国王位觊觎者詹姆斯·斯图亚特也曾在此驻留。1797至1800年乌尔比诺被法军占领；1789年大地震震塌大教堂穹顶，朱塞佩·瓦拉迪耶设计的新大教堂于1809年祝圣。

en:
Arezzo occupies a basin where routes from the Val di Chiana, Casentino and Valdarno meet before the Apennine passes. It was one of the twelve cities of Etruria and, as Roman Arretium, traded its red-gloss pottery across the Roman world. In the Middle Ages its bishop-counts and commune generally took the Ghibelline side against Guelph Florence. Defeat at Campaldino in 1289 broke Aretine expansion, though Bishop Guido Tarlati gave the city a final period of power in the 1320s. In 1384 Enguerrand de Coucy sold his occupation of Arezzo to Florence, so in 1444 the city was a subject Florentine stronghold on the republic's eastern frontier.

Between 1452 and 1466 Piero della Francesca painted the Legend of the True Cross frescoes in San Francesco, still the city's most famous Renaissance monument. Arezzo rose against Florentine rule in 1529, and around 1560 the Medici government built the bastioned Fortezza Medicea to overawe it. Giorgio Vasari, born in Arezzo in 1511, became the biographer of the Italian artists whose work surrounded him. During the 1700s the malarial marshes of the neighbouring Val di Chiana were drained, opening healthier land for cultivation. In 1799 Arezzo became a centre of the anti-French Viva Maria rising; from 1808 the city was included in the French department of the Arno, and the Accademia Petrarca was founded there in 1810.
zh:
阿雷佐坐落在一处盆地，瓦尔迪基亚纳、卡森蒂诺和瓦尔达诺的道路在此会合，再通向亚平宁山口。它曾是伊特鲁里亚十二城之一，罗马时代称阿雷提乌姆，红釉陶器远销罗马世界。中世纪时，主教兼伯爵与城市公社大多站在吉伯林派一边，对抗归尔夫派的佛罗伦萨。1289年坎帕尔迪诺战败后，阿雷佐的扩张受挫，只有圭多·塔尔拉蒂主教在1320年代让城市重振一时。1384年，昂盖朗·德·库西把占领下的阿雷佐卖给佛罗伦萨；因此到1444年，这里已是佛罗伦萨共和国东部边境上一座受其统治的要塞城市。

1452年至1466年间，皮耶罗·德拉·弗兰切斯卡在圣方济各堂绘制《真十字架传奇》湿壁画，这是阿雷佐最著名的文艺复兴遗迹。1529年，阿雷佐起兵反抗佛罗伦萨统治；约1560年，美第奇政府修建棱堡式的美第奇要塞，以威压全城。1511年生于阿雷佐的乔尔乔·瓦萨里，后来为身边这些意大利艺术家写下传记。18世纪，邻近瓦尔迪基亚纳的瘴气沼泽得到排干，更多土地得以安全耕种。1799年，阿雷佐成为反法的「玛利亚万岁」起事中心；1808年起，城市被划入法国的阿诺省，彼特拉克学院则于1810年在此创立。

en:
Novara began as Novaria, a Roman municipium on the road from Vercelli to Milan, whose cross-street plan survives in its centre. A free commune of the Lombard League, it sent men to fight at Legnano in 1176, and by 1200 had accepted the protection of Milan, whose Visconti dukes built the castle later held by the Sforza. In 1444 Novara was a grain-growing town of Filippo Maria Visconti's Milanese state, its roads linking Turin and Milan with the Alpine passes.

The Italian Wars made the Novarese a battlefield. In 1495 troops of the French Duke of Orléans took the city and were besieged in it by Ludovico Sforza's army. On 8 April 1500 his Swiss mercenaries refused to fight their compatriots in French pay; Ludovico was handed over outside the walls and died in captivity in 1508. A French siege collapsed in 1513 when Swiss in Massimiliano Sforza's pay routed the besiegers. Savoyard troops occupied it in 1706, but Utrecht left it with Habsburg Milan; Charles Emmanuel III took it in 1734 and it passed to Savoy the next year. Under Napoleon it became capital of the Department of the Agogna, returning to the Savoyards in 1814; on 8 April 1821 Sardinian and Austrian regulars defeated Piedmontese liberals outside its walls.
zh:
诺瓦拉的前身是罗马人的诺瓦里亚，一座位于韦尔切利通往米兰大道上的自治城，市中心的十字街道仍保留着罗马时代的格局。12世纪时它是加入伦巴第联盟的自由市镇，1176年莱尼亚诺战役中有它的士兵参战；到1200年前后，它接受米兰的庇护，维斯孔蒂公爵在此修建城堡，后来又为斯福尔扎家族所有。1444年的诺瓦拉是菲利波·马里亚·维斯孔蒂的米兰公国境内一座盛产谷物的城镇，道路连接都灵、米兰与阿尔卑斯山隘口。

意大利战争把诺瓦拉一带变成战场。1495年，法兰西奥尔良公爵的军队占领此城，反被卢多维科·斯福尔扎的大军围困。1500年4月8日在城外，卢多维科麾下的瑞士雇佣兵拒绝与为法兰西效力的同胞作战，公爵被交出，1508年死于法国囚所。1513年，为马西米利亚诺·斯福尔扎效劳的瑞士军队击溃围城法军，又一次围城告吹。1706年萨伏依军队占领诺瓦拉，但《乌得勒支和约》把它留在哈布斯堡治下的米兰；1734年卡洛·埃马努埃莱三世再度攻取，次年正式并入萨伏依王朝。拿破仑时期诺瓦拉成为阿戈尼亚省的首府，1814年重归萨伏依。1821年4月8日，撒丁与奥地利的正规军在城外击败了皮埃蒙特自由党人。

en:
Lucca lies in the fertile plain of the Serchio. A Roman colony of 180 BC, under the Lombards it was capital of the duchy of Tuscia from 576, and the Holy Face, the great crucifix said to have reached the city in 742, made it a halt on the Via Francigena. Silk weaving began in the 11th century — Lucca cloth, woven with threads of gold and silver, was sold across Europe — and from 1160 the city governed itself as a commune and then a republic. After the factional strife of the early 14th century, the condottiero Castruccio Castracani held it from 1316: in September 1325 he destroyed a Florentine army at Altopascio and was made duke of Lucca, dying in 1328. The city then passed from one master to another until Emperor Charles IV restored its freedom. Its only later lord was Paolo Guinigi, who ruled from 1400 to 1430 and whose wife Ilaria received the marble tomb Jacopo della Quercia carved for the cathedral; a Florentine siege of 1429 was broken by Francesco Sforza's Milanese horse, and the Lucchese restored their republic in 1430. In 1444 Lucca is a small free republic grown rich on silk and banking, its merchant houses, the Arnolfini among them, keeping offices as far away as Bruges.

Lucca kept its independence for another four centuries, backing neutrality with stone. The great bastioned ring, eleven bastions in four kilometres of earth-backed wall, was raised from 1544 and finished in 1648, and no enemy ever attacked it. In 1628 the popular republic became a closed oligarchy, but the silk looms and merchant banks carried on as before. The power that finally ended the republic was Napoleon's: French troops took the city in 1799, a democratic charter followed in 1801, and on 23 June 1805 Napoleon made his sister Elisa princess of Lucca and Piombino. On 18 November 1812 the walls were tested at last, not by cannon but by the flooded Serchio; the gates were barred with mattresses and the centre was saved. The Congress of Vienna turned Lucca into a duchy for Maria Luisa of Bourbon, who took possession in 1815 and planted the ramparts as a public promenade above the plain that fed Lucca's silk.
zh:
卢卡位于塞尔基奥河的肥沃平原上，公元前180年成为罗马殖民城，576年起是伦巴第人托斯卡公国的都城；742年迎入的圣容苦像使它成为法兰契杰纳朝圣路上的要站。丝绸织造始于11世纪——织入金线银线的卢卡绸行销全欧；1160年起城市以公社、继而以共和国自治。14世纪初的党争之后，佣兵队长卡斯特鲁乔·卡斯特拉卡尼自1316年主政：1325年9月他在阿尔托帕肖歼灭佛罗伦萨大军，受封卢卡公爵，1328年死去。此后城市数易其主，直到皇帝查理四世恢复其自由。唯一的僭主是1400至1430年在位的保罗·圭尼吉，其妻伊拉里娅的大理石墓由雅各布·德拉·奎尔恰雕成，安置在大教堂中；1429年佛罗伦萨围攻卢卡，被弗朗切斯科·斯福尔扎的米兰骑兵击退后，卢卡人于1430年恢复共和国。1444年的卢卡是一个靠丝绸和银行业致富的自由小邦，阿尔诺尔菲尼等商族在远达布鲁日的地方设有商行。

卢卡又把独立维持了四个世纪，并以城墙为中立兜底。十一座棱堡、四公里长的夯土巨环1544年动工、1648年完工，却从未遭到攻击。1628年平民共和国变成封闭的寡头政体，但丝织机和商人银行依旧运转。最终终结共和国的是拿破仑：法军1799年入城，1801年颁布一部民主约法，1805年6月23日拿破仑封姐姐埃莉萨为卢卡与皮翁比诺公主。1812年11月18日，城墙第一次受到考验——敌人不是大炮，而是泛滥的塞尔基奥河；城门用床垫堵死，城区得以保全。维也纳和会把卢卡改为波旁家族玛丽亚·路易莎的公国，她1815年入主，把城墙辟为俯瞰绸乡平原的林荫步道。

en:
Montferrat is a rolling country of vineyards between the Po and the Ligurian Apennines, once the land of the Aleramic margraves: Boniface I led the Fourth Crusade and wore the crown of Thessalonica. When the last Aleramic margrave died in 1305, Montferrat passed in 1306 to the Byzantine Palaiologoi, who ruled from Chivasso. Hard pressed by Milan and Savoy, Marquis John Jacob lost Chivasso to Amadeus VIII of Savoy and in 1434 moved his capital to Casale, his remaining lands accepting Savoyard protection. In 1444 Montferrat thus survived as a small imperial marquisate of the Palaiologoi, its wine-growing hills ringed by greater neighbours.

Its last Greek marquess, John George, died without male heirs in 1533; in 1536 Charles V granted Montferrat to Federico II Gonzaga of Mantua, husband of the Palaeologan heiress. French troops held Casale in 1555 until the Peace of Cateau-Cambrésis, and in 1574 the fief was raised to a duchy. The Mantuan succession wars brought Savoyard armies in 1613 and again in 1628; the settlement of 1631 detached the western lands for Savoy, and in 1708, when the Gonzaga lost Mantua, all of Montferrat passed to the House of Savoy. It shared Piedmont's fate in the Napoleonic wars and returned with the Kingdom of Sardinia in 1814.
zh:
蒙费拉托是波河与利古里亚亚平宁山脉之间一片遍布葡萄园的丘陵地，曾是阿莱拉莫家族边疆侯爵的领地：博尼法乔一世曾率领第四次十字军，并戴上塞萨洛尼基的王冠。1305年末代阿莱拉莫侯爵去世，1306年封地转入拜占庭帕里奥洛加斯王朝之手，以基瓦索为都。在米兰和萨伏依的夹攻下，侯爵吉安·贾科莫把基瓦索丢给萨伏依公爵阿梅迪奥八世，于1434年迁都卡萨莱蒙费拉托，余下的土地也接受萨伏依保护。1444年的蒙费拉托便是这样一个帕里奥洛加斯王朝治下的帝国小侯国，产酒的丘陵被强邻环伺。

末代希腊裔侯爵乔瓦尼·乔治于1533年去世，没有男嗣；1536年查理五世把侯国封给曼托瓦公爵费代里科二世·贡扎加，他娶了帕里奥洛加斯家族的女继承人。1555年法军占领卡萨莱，直到《卡托-康布雷西和约》才将其归还；1574年侯国升格为公国。曼托瓦继承战争引来了萨伏依军队，1613年和1628年两度入侵，1631年的和约把西部土地划给萨伏依；1708年贡扎加家族失去曼托瓦，整个蒙费拉托并入萨伏依王室。此后它随皮埃蒙特经历拿破仑战争，1814年随撒丁王国一并归还。

en:
Syracuse occupies Ortygia and the great harbour on Sicily's southeastern coast. Corinthian settlers founded it in 733 BC, and for centuries it was one of the richest Greek cities in the Mediterranean; Roman forces took it in 212 BC during the siege remembered for Archimedes' defence. It served briefly as the Byzantine capital under Constans II from 663 to 668, fell to Arab forces on 21 May 878, and was recovered by Robert Guiscard's Normans in 1085, although Palermo remained Sicily's capital. Frederick II brought it under direct royal rule in 1234, and after 1302 the Queen's Chamber gave the city wide autonomy within the Crown of Aragon. In 1444 Syracuse was an Aragonese-ruled port and market town, smaller than Palermo or Messina but still commanding the sea lanes toward Malta and the Levant.

Charles V's reign turned Ortygia into a fortress. The Hospitallers, exiled from Rhodes, reached Syracuse in 1529, but Charles refused the city as a base and sent them to Malta in July 1530. After Germaine de Foix died in October 1536, he abolished the Queen's Chamber and made Syracuse a directly governed fortress city. In 1565, during the Great Siege of Malta, Spanish forces gathered there under Viceroy García de Toledo to watch the Ottoman fleet and prepare relief. Caravaggio, fleeing the Hospitallers, reached Syracuse in 1608 and painted the Burial of Saint Lucy. On 11 January 1693 an earthquake and tsunami killed some 4,000 people and wrecked Ortygia; rebuilding gave the old centre its late Baroque form. The Treaty of Utrecht assigned Sicily to Savoy in 1713. The Spanish invasion of 1718 brought blockade and a British naval victory off Capo Passero before the island passed to Habsburg Charles VI in 1720 and later to the Bourbons. During the Napoleonic wars the Royal Navy used Syracuse as a base from 1807 before Bourbon rule returned as the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies in 1815.
zh:
锡拉库扎（通行译名为锡拉库萨）位于西西里东南海岸，城防核心是奥尔蒂贾岛和大港。公元前733年，科林斯殖民者在此建城，此后数百年它是地中海最富庶的希腊城市之一；公元前212年，罗马军队在因阿基米德防守而闻名的围城中将其攻占。663年至668年，它在君士坦斯二世治下短暂成为拜占庭帝国首都；878年5月21日落入阿拉伯军队之手，1085年由罗贝尔·吉斯卡尔的诺曼人收复，但西西里都城仍留在巴勒莫。1234年，腓特烈二世把它收归王室直接统治；1302年后，这里成为西西里王后的居城，并由王后府（Camera reginale）长期治理，在阿拉贡王权内保有近乎国中之国的自治。1444年，锡拉库扎是阿拉贡治下的港口与集镇，规模不及巴勒莫或墨西拿，却仍控制着通往马耳他和黎凡特的海路。

查理五世时期，奥尔蒂贾被改造成要塞。1529年，被逐出罗得岛的医院骑士团抵达锡拉库扎，但查理五世拒绝以此为新基地，而是在1530年7月让他们前往马耳他。1536年10月热尔梅娜·德·富瓦去世后，他废除王后府，将锡拉库扎改为由王室直辖的要塞城市。1565年马耳他大围攻期间，西班牙军队在副王加西亚·德·托莱多指挥下集结于锡拉库扎，监视奥斯曼舰队并准备救援。1608年，逃离医院骑士团的卡拉瓦乔来到这里，绘成《埋葬圣路济亚》。1693年1月11日，地震和海啸造成约四千人死亡，奥尔蒂贾几乎被毁；重建使老城呈现晚期巴洛克面貌。1713年《乌得勒支和约》把西西里划给萨伏依；1718年西班牙入侵后，锡拉库扎遭陆上封锁，英国舰队在帕塞罗角外海摧毁西班牙舰队。1720年，西西里转归哈布斯堡的查理六世，后来又落入波旁王朝。拿破仑战争期间，英国皇家海军从1807年起以锡拉库扎为基地；1815年波旁王朝恢复统治，两西西里王国随之建立。

en:
Salerno stands on the Tyrrhenian Gulf of Salerno, where the Roman colony of Salernum guarded the road into Lucania. Under Lombard rule it became the capital of the independent Principality of Salerno in 839; its merchants shared in the Mediterranean traffic of nearby Amalfi, while the Schola Medica Salernitana made the city a byword for healing across western Europe. Robert Guiscard took Salerno in 1077 and built its cathedral, but Henry VI's troops sacked the city in 1194 and Frederick II later favoured Naples. Charles I of Anjou granted the Principality of Salerno to the royal heir in 1272. By 1444 the city belonged to the Kingdom of Naples, while much of the surrounding country was held by the Sanseverino princes, whose power rivalled the crown.

During the Italian Wars the local lords shifted between the Angevin and Aragonese causes. Ferrante Sanseverino, the last Prince of Salerno, quarrelled with the Spanish viceregal government and the Inquisition and died in exile at Orange in 1568; his fall brought the city a long decline. In 1544 a storm scattered Barbarossa's fleet as it moved against Salerno. The eighteenth century brought refined palaces and churches, and in 1799 revolutionaries incorporated the city into the Parthenopean Republic. Joseph Bonaparte and Joachim Murat later ruled Naples under French supremacy, and on 29 November 1811 Murat suppressed the ancient medical school during a reorganization of public education.
zh:
萨莱诺临第勒尼安海的萨莱诺湾，罗马殖民城萨莱努姆曾扼守通往卢卡尼亚的道路。伦巴第统治时，它于839年成为独立的萨莱诺亲王国都城；商人借邻近阿马尔菲的网络参与地中海贸易，萨莱诺医学校则让此地以医术闻名西欧。罗贝尔·吉斯卡尔1077年攻占萨莱诺并修建主教座堂，但亨利六世的军队1194年洗劫城市，腓特烈二世后来更倚重那不勒斯。1272年，安茹的查理把萨莱诺亲王国封给王储。到1444年，这里臣属那不勒斯王国，周边大部分土地掌握在圣塞韦里诺诸侯手中，其权势几可与王权抗衡。

意大利战争期间，本地领主在安茹与阿拉贡阵营间反复。末代萨莱诺亲王费兰泰·圣塞韦里诺与西班牙副王政府及宗教裁判所冲突，最终流亡，1568年死于奥朗日；他的败落也使城市长期衰退。1544年，巴巴罗萨的舰队准备进攻萨莱诺时被风暴吹散。18世纪，城里建起精致的宅邸和教堂；1799年，革命者将萨莱诺并入帕特诺珀共和国。约瑟夫·波拿巴和若阿尚·缪拉后来在法国支配下统治那不勒斯；1811年11月29日，缪拉整顿公共教育，下令废除古老的萨莱诺医学校。

en:
Cosenza commands the Crati valley in northern Calabria. The ancient Consentia was capital of the Bruttii, then a station on the Roman road to Rhegium; after destruction in the Saracen wars it was rebuilt around 988. Norman and Hohenstaufen rulers made it a centre of the Val di Crati justiciarate, and Frederick II enlarged its castle, cathedral and annual Maddalena fair. The town kept royal privileges and was never enfeoffed. In 1432 Louis III of Anjou, heir to Naples, settled in Cosenza castle with Margaret of Savoy; his death in 1434 left him buried in the cathedral. In 1444, two years after Alfonso V's Aragonese victory, Cosenza was an autonomous Catholic town in the Kingdom of Naples, surrounded by villages that raised grain, livestock and vines such as the wine of Donnici.

Spanish troops under Gonzalo Fernández de Córdoba occupied Cosenza in 1500, and the town later became a governor's seat for Calabria Citeriore. Its learned life flowered when Aulo Giano Parrasio founded the Parrasian Academy in 1511, the society later reorganized by Bernardino Telesio toward natural philosophy and remembered as the Accademia Cosentina, earning Cosenza the name 'Athens of Calabria'. The earthquakes of 27–28 March 1638 destroyed more than a hundred villages across the upper Crati, Savuto and neighbouring valleys, with an estimated ten to thirty thousand dead. In 1799 Cosenza briefly supported the Parthenopean Republic before Fabrizio Ruffo's Sanfedist forces restored Bourbon rule. French administration after 1806 abolished feudal jurisdiction and reorganized northern Calabria around the provincial capital, though brigand resistance endured in the Sila highlands.
zh:
科森扎控扼北卡拉布里亚的克拉蒂河谷。古城孔森蒂亚是布鲁提人的都城，后来成为罗马通往雷吉乌姆大道上的驿站；撒拉逊战争中遭毁后，约于988年重建。诺曼和霍亨斯陶芬君主把它设为克拉蒂谷司法区中心，腓特烈二世又扩建城堡、大教堂和一年一度的马达莱纳集市。城市始终保有王室特权，从未被封作私人采邑。1432年，那不勒斯继承人安茹的路易三世携萨伏依的玛格丽特入住科森扎城堡；他1434年去世后葬入大教堂。1444年，也就是阿方索五世代表阿拉贡势力获胜两年后，科森扎是那不勒斯王国一座享有自治权的天主教城市，周围村落经营谷物、牲畜和葡萄园，多尼采等村镇便以葡萄酒闻名。

1500年，贡萨洛·费尔南德斯·德·科尔多瓦率领西班牙军队占领科森扎，城市后来成为近卡拉布里亚的长官驻地。1511年，奥洛·贾诺·帕拉西奥在此创立帕拉西奥学会，城市的学术生活由此兴盛；贝尔纳迪诺·特莱西奥后来把它改组为偏重自然哲学的特莱西奥学会，即后世所称的科森扎学会，科森扎也因此得到「卡拉布里亚的雅典」之称。1638年3月27日至28日的地震摧毁了上克拉蒂谷、萨武托谷及邻近山谷的一百多个村庄，估计有一万至三万人死亡。1799年，科森扎一度支持帕尔瑟诺佩共和国，随后被法布里齐奥·鲁福的圣信派军队夺回，恢复波旁统治。1806年后的法国行政当局废除封建司法，并以北卡拉布里亚省城为中心重组地方，但西拉高地的盗匪式抵抗仍未止息。

en:
Capitanata is northern Apulia, the old Daunian land north of the Ofanto river and across the broad Tavoliere plain beneath the Gargano heights. Around 1230 Frederick II made it a royal judicial district of the Kingdom of Sicily; Foggia held his palace and court, while a survey of 1231 recorded twenty-four castles and twenty-eight royal houses in the district. After the Angevin conquest of 1266 the central court moved towards Naples, yet Capitanata remained valuable for grain, pasture and its Adriatic outlets. In 1444, two years after Alfonso V of Aragon took Naples, transhumant flocks from Abruzzo still came down the tratturi to Foggia's fairs and winter pastures, making livestock the wealth of this Catholic Neapolitan province.

In 1447 Alfonso built a customs palace at Foggia to tax the sheep drovers, turning the seasonal migration into a tightly administered royal revenue. Earthquakes struck in 1456 and again in 1731, when about a third of Foggia was destroyed. During the sixteenth century the provincial administration alternated between Lucera and San Severo, and in 1579 it settled at Lucera, where it remained for more than two centuries. Bourbon rule later encouraged cereal cultivation and rebuilding on the Tavoliere. The French-backed reforms of 1806 abolished feudal jurisdiction, separated Molise from Capitanata, and moved the provincial seat permanently to Foggia; the new administration was regulated in 1817.
zh:
卡皮塔纳塔位于普利亚北部，是奥凡托河以北的古道尼人之地，横跨加加诺高地脚下广阔的塔沃列雷平原。约1230年，腓特烈二世把它设为西西里王国的王家司法区；福贾设有他的宫殿与宫廷，1231年的一份清查还记录下境内24座城堡和28处王室宅邸。1266年安茹王朝征服后，中央宫廷逐渐转向那不勒斯，但卡皮塔纳塔仍因谷物、牧场和亚得里亚海出口而保持重要。1444年，也就是阿拉贡的阿方索五世夺取那不勒斯两年后，阿布鲁佐的转场羊群仍沿牧道南下，来到福贾的市集与冬季牧场；牲畜贸易因此成为这个信奉天主教的那不勒斯省份的财富所在。

1447年，阿方索在福贾修建海关宫，向牧羊人征税，把季节性转场变成受严密管理的王室收入。地震曾在1456年袭击此地，1731年再度发生，福贾约三分之一城区在后者中被毁。16世纪，省级行政机构在卢切拉和圣塞韦罗之间交替驻设，1579年固定于卢切拉，并在此后两个多世纪里保持不变。波旁王朝统治时期，塔沃列雷的谷物种植和城区重建得到推动。1806年，法国支持下的改革废除封建司法权，将莫利塞从卡皮塔纳塔分出，并把省治永久迁至福贾；新行政体系于1817年定型。

en:
Cagliari stands on Sardinia's southern shore, where a sheltered bay, salt lagoons and the wheat fields of the Campidano meet. The Phoenicians planted Caralis, later the seat of Rome's praetor on the island; after the Saracen raids its people sheltered at Santa Igia, capital of the native Giudicato of Cagliari. In 1215 the Pisan Lamberto Visconti seized the hill above the harbour and Pisan merchants raised the walled town of Castel di Castro. In 1258 Pisa and its Sardinian allies destroyed Santa Igia and sowed salt on the ruins, and the colony, called the key of the Mediterranean, fell to the Crown of Aragon only in 1323-1326, when the Infante Alfonso built the rival fortress of Bonaria and his fleet took the town in December 1325. Cagliari became the capital of the new Kingdom of Sardinia and the seat of its viceroy, and from 1333 native Sardinians were barred from the Catalan Castello. In 1444 the port ships Campidano grain, silver from the Iglesiente mines and lagoon salt to Barcelona.

Under the Spanish Habsburgs the bastioned walls made Cagliari an imperial stronghold of the western Mediterranean; a university opened in 1607, and in 1668 the viceroy Camarassa was assassinated in the city. An Anglo-Dutch fleet ended Spanish rule in 1708, and after the Treaty of Utrecht in 1713, a brief Spanish return under Cardinal Alberoni in 1717 and the Treaty of The Hague, the House of Savoy took the island on 20 February 1720. In 1793 the Cagliaritani beat off French revolutionary troops landed on the Poetto beach, and when their claims were refused they drove out the Piedmontese on 28 April 1794, a date later kept as Sardinia's national day. From 1798 to 1814 the Royal Palace housed the Savoyard court expelled from Turin, making Cagliari the kingdom's working capital; public lighting arrived in 1811. In 1821 Cagliari remained the viceregal capital of the Kingdom of Sardinia.
zh:
卡利亚里位于撒丁岛南岸，避风海湾、咸水潟湖与坎皮达诺平原的麦田在此相接。腓尼基人在这里建立卡拉利斯，罗马时代是岛上裁判官的驻地；萨拉森海盗来袭后，居民退守本土卡利亚里吉乌帝卡提的都城圣伊贾。1215年，比萨人兰贝托·维斯孔蒂夺下港口上方的山丘，比萨商人筑起城墙环绕的卡斯泰尔迪卡斯特罗城。1258年，比萨及其撒丁盟友毁掉圣伊贾，在废墟上撒盐；这座被称为「地中海之钥」的殖民地直到1323至1326年才落入阿拉贡之手：阿方索王子在对面山丘建起与之抗衡的博纳里亚要塞，他的舰队于1325年12月攻克此城。卡利亚里随后成为新生的撒丁王国都城和总督驻地，1333年起本地撒丁人被禁止进入卡塔兰人居住的城堡区。1444年，它的港口把坎皮达诺的小麦、伊格莱西安特矿山的白银和潟湖出产的盐运往巴塞罗那。

西班牙哈布斯堡统治时期，棱堡城墙使卡利亚里成为帝国在西地中海的重镇；大学于1607年开办，1668年总督卡马拉萨在城中遇刺。1708年，英荷联合舰队结束了西班牙的统治；经过1713年的《乌得勒支和约》、1717年枢机主教朱利奥·阿尔贝罗尼支持下的西班牙短暂收复和《海牙条约》，萨伏依王朝于1720年2月20日接管全岛。1793年，卡利亚里军民击退在波埃托海滩登陆的法国革命军；犒赏落空后，市民于1794年4月28日赶走皮埃蒙特人，这一天后来被定为撒丁岛的民族节日。1798至1814年，被法国人逐出都灵的萨伏依宫廷以王宫为驻地，卡利亚里成为王国实际施政的都城；1811年城里有了第一批公共路灯。1821年，卡利亚里仍是撒丁王国的总督都城。

en:
Urgell is the inland plain of western Catalonia around Tàrrega, crossed by the valleys of the Ondara, Sió and Corb. A Frankish county from 785, it became one of the chief Catalan counties, with its comital court moving from La Seu d'Urgell to Balaguer in 1130. Tàrrega grew after Count Ramon Berenguer I took its castle in the 11th century, and its crossroads, fairs, markets and goldsmiths made it a busy medieval town. The Black Death broke that prosperity: the town was depopulated, and on 26 July 1348 about 800 Jews were killed there. When Martin I of Aragon died without an heir, James II of Urgell claimed the crown, rejected Ferdinand of Antequera elected at Caspe in 1412, and rose in revolt. He surrendered at Balaguer on 31 October 1413, and the county passed to the Crown of Aragon. In 1444 Tàrrega was therefore a Catholic, Catalan-speaking market town only a generation removed from annexation.

The Catalan Civil War of 1462-1472 divided the surrounding countryside, setting John II and the Remença peasants against the Catalan institutions and nobility. The peasant question remained open until Ferdinand II issued the Sentencia de Guadalupe on 21 April 1486, allowing redemption from the mals usos in return for payments. From the 16th century Tàrrega took on a more rural character and was dominated by wealthy local families, while recurrent wars disturbed the region. The Napoleonic wars reached its roads in October 1811: after Luis de Lacy's Spanish column attacked a French force near Cervera on 10 October, the French withdrew to Tàrrega and joined its garrison; on 14 October the Spanish took 178 prisoners at nearby Bellpuig.
zh:
乌尔赫尔是加泰罗尼亚西部以塔雷加为中心的内陆平原，翁达拉河、西奥河与科尔布河的谷地穿行其间。785年它成为法兰克人设立的伯国，后为加泰罗尼亚最重要的伯国之一，1130年伯爵宫廷从拉塞乌杜尔赫利迁到巴拉格尔。11世纪拉蒙·贝伦格尔一世夺取塔雷加城堡后，城镇逐渐发展；路口、集市、市场和金银匠使它成为繁忙的中世纪城镇。黑死病终结了这段繁荣：城镇人口锐减，1348年7月26日又有约800名犹太人在当地遇害。阿拉贡国王马丁一世无嗣而终后，乌尔赫尔伯爵海梅二世要求继承王位，拒绝接受1412年卡斯佩会议选出的安特克拉的斐迪南，并举兵反叛。1413年10月31日他在巴拉格尔投降，伯国并入阿拉贡联合王国。因此1444年的塔雷加是一座讲加泰罗尼亚语的天主教集镇，被吞并才过去一代人。

1462年至1472年的加泰罗尼亚内战分裂了周边乡野，胡安二世与雷门萨农民同加泰罗尼亚政权机构和贵族兵戎相见。农民问题直到1486年4月21日才出现转机：斐迪南二世颁布《瓜达卢佩仲裁判决》，允许农民支付赎金，摆脱「恶习」封建负担。16世纪起，塔雷加日益乡村化，由本地富户把持，连绵战事也不断扰动这一地区。1811年10月，拿破仑战争蔓延到这里的道路：10月10日，路易斯·德·拉西率领的西班牙部队在塞尔韦拉附近袭击法军后，法军退入塔雷加与守军会合；10月14日，西军又在附近的贝尔普奇俘虏178人。

en:
Tarragona rises on a coastal hill beside the Francolí, at the heart of the Camp de Tarragona. As Roman Tarraco it was capital of Hispania Tarraconensis, a bishopric and a wine port whose sweet red wine was sent to Rome. It had shrunk to a frontier settlement when Barcelona's counts recovered it in 1117; the archiepiscopal see was restored in 1118, and from 1129 to 1173 the Norman-influenced Principality of Tarragona oversaw its recolonization before full incorporation into the Crown of Aragon. The medieval archbishop remained the leading churchman of Catalonia, while the Camp's vines and the harbour sustained the city. In 1444 Tarragona was therefore a Catholic, Catalan-speaking Aragonese port and primatial see, still living among the monuments of its Roman past.

The Catalan Civil War split the city itself: Archbishop Pere Ximénez de Urrea supported John II, while the town council joined the Generalitat and repaired the walls. John besieged Tarragona on 17 October 1462; after relief by sea failed, Damià de Montserrat's garrison capitulated on 31 October, with the king's army kept outside the town. During the Reapers' War, Catalan and French forces blockaded the royalist port in 1641 and again attacked it in 1644, but neither siege took Tarragona. Allied troops captured it in 1705 during the War of the Spanish Succession and held it until the Treaty of Utrecht in 1713; after Barcelona fell in 1714 the Nueva Planta abolished Catalonia's old institutions. In the Peninsular War Louis-Gabriel Suchet's French army besieged the port from 4 May to 28 June 1811, when it stormed the upper town despite Juan de Contreras's defence and British naval support. A second allied siege failed in June 1813, before the French withdrew later that year.
zh:
塔拉戈纳位于弗兰科利河旁的滨海高岗，地处塔拉戈纳原野中心。罗马时代的塔拉科曾是塔拉科西班牙行省的首府、主教驻地，也是葡萄酒港，甜红酒曾输往罗马。巴塞罗那伯爵1117年收复这里时，城市已衰为边境据点；总主教区于1118年恢复，1129年至1173年，受诺曼人影响的塔拉戈纳亲王国主持重新殖民事宜，随后该地完全并入阿拉贡联合王国。中世纪时，塔拉戈纳总主教是加泰罗尼亚地位最高的神职人员，原野上的葡萄园和港口维持着城市生计。1444年的塔拉戈纳因此是阿拉贡治下一座讲加泰罗尼亚语的天主教港口和首席主教驻地，仍生活在罗马遗迹之间。

加泰罗尼亚内战也分裂了这座城市：总主教佩罗·希门尼斯·德·乌雷亚支持胡安二世，市政会则站在加泰罗尼亚总议会一边，修补城墙。1462年10月17日，胡安二世围攻塔拉戈纳；海上援军失败后，达米亚·德·蒙特塞拉特所部于10月31日投降，条件是国王的军队不得入城。收割者战争期间，加泰罗尼亚与法国军队1641年封锁这座保王港口，1644年再度进攻，但两次围城都没有攻下。西班牙王位继承战争中，同盟国军队1705年攻占塔拉戈纳，据守至1713年《乌得勒支条约》；1714年巴塞罗那陷落后，《新基本法令》废除加泰罗尼亚旧有制度。半岛战争期间，路易-加布里埃尔·絮歇的法军从1811年5月4日围城至6月28日，尽管胡安·德·孔特雷拉斯坚守、英国舰队从海上支援，上城仍在强攻中陷落。1813年6月同盟国第二次围城失败，法军则在同年稍后撤出。

en:
Rioja lies along the Ebro, where roads from Castile, Navarre and Aragon met the Way of Saint James. Christian forces took much of the valley for Pamplona in 923; after the partition of Navarre in 1076 it passed to Castile, whose hold was confirmed in 1177. Alfonso VI granted Logroño its fuero in 1095, using the Ebro crossing and pilgrim bridge to settle a loyal border town, and the name Rioja is first recorded four years later. John II of Castile made Logroño a city in 1431 and on 20 July 1444 named it 'very noble and very loyal' for holding out against John II of Aragon. By then the vineyards of the upper valley were already specializing in wine.

During the Franco-Navarrese invasion of 1521, André de Foix besieged Logroño but abandoned the walls on 11 June, the feast of St Barnabas; Francis I later added three fleurs-de-lis to the city's arms. In January 1609 the Spanish Inquisition opened the Basque witch trials in Logroño. Wine, meanwhile, became the region's lasting trade: producers adopted a quality mark in 1560, the town banned carts beside cellars in 1635 to protect must from vibration, and quality rules were recorded in 1650. The Royal Society of Rioja Growers was founded in 1787 and met in 1790 with fifty-two towns, seeking better roads to market. Napoleonic forces occupied Rioja during the Peninsular War and held it until 1814, two years after the Cortes of Cádiz had recognized it as a province in 1812.
zh:
里奥哈地处埃布罗河谷，卡斯蒂利亚、纳瓦拉和阿拉贡之间的道路与圣雅各之路在此交汇。923年，基督教军队为潘普洛纳夺取谷地大部；1076年纳瓦拉被瓜分后，这里转入卡斯蒂利亚之手，其统治权又于1177年得到确认。1095年，阿方索六世向洛格罗尼奥颁发特许状，借埃布罗渡口和朝圣桥营建效忠王室的边境城镇；四年后，「里奥哈」之名首次见于记载。卡斯蒂利亚国王胡安二世1431年升洛格罗尼奥为城市，又因它在对抗阿拉贡国王胡安二世时坚守不降，于1444年7月20日赐其「极高贵、极忠诚」之名。到这时，上游谷地的葡萄园已经专门从事葡萄酒生产。

1521年法国—纳瓦拉联军入侵时，安德烈·德·富瓦围攻洛格罗尼奥，却在圣巴纳伯节的6月11日撤围；弗朗索瓦一世后来把三朵鸢尾花加入城徽。1609年1月，西班牙宗教裁判所在洛格罗尼奥启动巴斯克女巫审判。与此同时，葡萄酒成为此地持久的贸易支柱：种植者1560年采用品质标记，市政当局1635年禁止马车在酒窖旁通行，以免震动损坏葡萄汁，1650年又形成成文的品质规范。1787年，里奥哈葡萄种植者皇家学会成立，并在1790年集合五十二个城镇，筹划改善通往市场的道路。半岛战争期间，拿破仑军队占领里奥哈并一直控制到1814年；此前加的斯议会已于1812年承认其为行省。

en:
Teruel was founded in 1171 on the high southern frontier of Aragon, after Alfonso II captured the Muslim outpost of Tirwal and offered fueros to settlers. The town guarded the approaches toward Valencia, and Peter IV raised it to the rank of city in 1347 after its service in the wars of the Union. Jewish weavers and a large Mudéjar population shaped its markets, while the ore-bearing Sierra Menera had supplied iron since the Andalusí period. In 1444 Teruel was a Catholic royal town beneath brick Mudéjar towers, its Santa María church already a collegiate church and its craftsmen known for wool and green-glazed pottery.

The old frontier law was printed in 1531, but Philip II's reforms of 1565 brought Teruel's customs into growing conflict with the general law of Aragon; after the 1591 disturbances in Zaragoza the separate fueros ended in 1598. Martín de Montalbán raised the cathedral's octagonal lantern in 1538, and the collegiate church became Teruel Cathedral in 1587. The expulsion of the Moriscos from the Crown of Aragon in 1610 struck the town directly, when hundreds left Teruel and nearby Bezas for the coast, taking much of the old tile-making tradition with them. During the War of the Spanish Succession Aragon sided with Archduke Charles; Bourbon victory after Almansa brought the Nueva Planta decrees of 1707 and ended the kingdom's autonomous courts.
zh:
特鲁埃尔是1171年阿拉贡国王阿方索二世在南部高地边境建立的城镇；他攻占穆斯林前哨蒂尔瓦尔后，向迁居者授予特许状。此地扼守通往瓦伦西亚的道路，1347年佩德罗四世因居民在联盟战争中效命，将其升为城市。犹太织工和人数众多的穆德哈尔人塑造了本地市场，梅内拉山脉的铁矿自安达卢斯时代便已开采。1444年的特鲁埃尔是一座天主教王家城镇，砖造穆德哈尔高塔林立，圣马利亚教堂已升为协同教堂，工匠以毛织和绿釉陶器闻名。

古老的边境法于1531年印行，但腓力二世1565年的改革使特鲁埃尔习惯法与阿拉贡一般法律的冲突日益加深；1591年萨拉戈萨骚乱后，这套地方法于1598年废止。1538年，马丁·德·蒙塔尔万为教堂增建八角采光塔，1587年协同教堂又成为特鲁埃尔主教座堂。1610年阿拉贡联合王国驱逐莫里斯科人，数百人从特鲁埃尔和邻近的贝萨斯被押往海岸，古老的瓷砖工艺也因此大受打击。西班牙王位继承战争中，阿拉贡支持查理大公；波旁军队在阿尔曼萨取胜后，1707年的《新基本法令》废除了阿拉贡的自治法院。

en:
Forcalquier sits on a hill between the Lure and Luberon ranges, west of the Durance in Haute-Provence. Its Roman name, Furnus Calcarius, referred to lime kilns, and by the tenth century a castle crowned the butte above the early settlement. In 1060 the exiled bishop of Sisteron made its church a concathedral, and in the twelfth century the counts of Forcalquier ruled a broad county reaching from the upper Durance toward Cavaillon, with Sisteron, Gap, Embrun, Manosque and Apt among its towns. A charter of 26 May 1206 granted the town privileges and tax exemptions in exchange for militia service; in 1209 Garsende of Sabran's marriage to Alfonso II of Provence returned Forcalquier to the Provençal succession. Plague and the raids of Charles de Duras and Raymond de Turenne weakened it, but the communal charter of 23 June 1385 preserved broad self-government. In 1444 it was a Catholic, Occitan-speaking town of Provence under René of Anjou.

In 1452 the commune redefined its citizen body, and when Louis XI claimed Provence in 1481 Forcalquier resisted for three weeks before falling and being sacked on 21 July. The town bought its last feudal dues in 1521 amid the financial needs of Francis I. During the Wars of Religion it had a Protestant consul by 1559; Huguenot troops seized it on 12 June 1562 and sacked the cathedral and Cordeliers' church, and Catholic forces retaliated against the town. The Peace of Saint-Germain-en-Laye in 1570 made Forcalquier one of two Protestant surety places in Provence, with Mérindol, yet further sieges followed in 1576, 1580 and 1585, and Catholic commanders invested it in 1587 and 1588. It rallied to Henry IV in 1589, and the old castle was razed in 1601. Plague carried off some 2,000 inhabitants in 1630; later the Revolutionary government sacked the cathedral in 1794, and the Consulate made Forcalquier a subprefecture. Its walls were demolished between 1806 and 1813.
zh:
福卡勒基耶（通行译名福卡尔基耶）位于上普罗旺斯迪朗斯河以西，坐落在吕尔山与吕贝龙山之间的山丘上。其罗马名称Furnus Calcarius意为石灰窑，到10世纪时，一座城堡已经雄踞早期聚落上方的山岗。1060年，流亡的锡斯特龙主教把城中教堂升为共主教座堂；12世纪时，福卡勒基耶伯爵统治着从迪朗斯河上游延伸到卡瓦永一带的广阔领地，锡斯特龙、加普、昂布兰、马诺斯克和阿普特均在其城镇之列。1206年5月26日的特许状以提供民团为条件，授予城市特权和免税权；1209年，萨布朗的加尔桑德嫁给普罗旺斯的阿方索二世，福卡勒基耶由此回到普罗旺斯继承体系。瘟疫以及杜拉佐的卡洛和蒂雷纳的雷蒙的袭掠削弱了此地，但1385年6月23日的城市特许状保留了广泛自治权。1444年，它是安茹的勒内治下普罗旺斯的一座奥克语天主教城镇。

1452年，城市重新界定公民身份。1481年路易十一取得普罗旺斯时，福卡勒基耶抵抗三周，最终在7月21日陷落并遭洗劫。1521年，城市趁弗朗索瓦一世财政需要，赎买了最后的封建赋税。宗教战争期间，到1559年这里已有新教执政官；1562年6月12日，胡格诺派军队攻占城市，洗劫主教座堂和科德利埃教堂，天主教军队随后又报复城中居民。1570年《圣日耳曼昂莱和约》把福卡勒基耶与梅朗多勒并列为普罗旺斯新教的两个担保地之一，但1576年、1580年和1585年仍接连遭到围攻，天主教统帅又在1587年和1588年围城。它于1589年归顺亨利四世，旧城堡在1601年被夷平。1630年的瘟疫夺去约两千人的生命；大革命时期，主教座堂在1794年遭劫掠，执政府时期福卡勒基耶成为副省会。城墙则在1806年至1813年间被拆除。

en:
Albenga, the Roman Albingaunum, was the capital of the Ingauni, Ligurian sailor-traders whose lands ran from Finale to Sanremo. Rome broke their sea power in 181 BC, and the Via Julia Augusta of 13 BC later linked the town with Gaul and Spain; its early bishopric and fifth-century baptistery mark late-antique wealth. A free commune from 1098, Albenga sent its own ships to the First Crusade and long rivalled Genoa, until a burdensome convention of 1251 forced it under Genoese rule. Its own statutes followed in 1288; after the lordships of the Del Carretto, the Visconti in 1355–1379 and the French in 1396–1413, it returned to Genoa. In 1444 Albenga was Genoa's chief city on the western Riviera, its Centa-mouth harbour shipping inland timber and wool, its skyline crowded with noble towers.

The Italian wars made the Centa plain an army road: eight thousand men landed in 1524, Francis I's troops bivouacked here for a month in 1525, and Charles V passed through in 1536, while Saracen raids forced the Albengans to rebuild their walls. In 1552 Andrea Doria anchored offshore with forty-eight galleys, and when the Centa flooded in September 1564, sweeping away houses and ramparts, Bishop Luca Fieschi spent his fortune on the rebuilding. Piedmontese troops took the city in 1625 and again in 1672; Spanish regiments used it as a supply depot in 1744–45, and in July 1746 its militia beat the Piedmontese at Zuccarello, capturing the Marchese Del Carretto, before Genoese rule returned. French troops entered on 4 April 1794, and three days later Napoleon Bonaparte, newly given command of the Army of Italy, met Masséna here and planned the campaign from the Palazzo Rolandi-Ricci. Under the Ligurian Republic of 1797 Albenga became capital of the Centa jurisdiction, passed to the French Empire in 1805, and was assigned to the Kingdom of Sardinia at the Congress of Vienna, which made it a provincial capital in 1818.
zh:
阿尔本加在罗马时代称阿尔宾高努姆，曾是利古里亚海岸的因高尼人的首府；这些人以航海和贸易为生，势力范围从菲纳莱延伸到圣雷莫。公元前181年罗马击溃他们的海上力量，公元前13年修成的尤利亚·奥古斯塔大道后来把这座城镇与高卢和西班牙连在一起；很早设立的主教区和5世纪的洗礼堂，见证着它在罗马帝国晚期的富庶。1098年阿尔本加成为自由公社，派出自己的船只参加第一次十字军东征，长期与热那亚争雄，直到1251年一项苛刻的协约迫使它臣服热那亚。它1288年争得自己的法规，在历经德尔卡雷托家族、维斯孔蒂（1355—1379年）和法国人（1396—1413年）的统治后重归热那亚。1444年的阿尔本加是热那亚在利古里亚西海岸的首要城市，琴塔河口的港口运出内陆的木材和羊毛，天际线上挤满贵族的塔楼。

意大利战争把琴塔平原变成大军往来的通道：1524年八千名士兵在此登陆，1525年弗朗索瓦一世的军队在城中驻扎月余，1536年查理五世途经此地，撒拉森海盗的袭掠又迫使阿尔本加重修城墙。1552年，安德烈亚·多里亚率四十八艘桨帆船出现在外海；1564年9月琴塔河洪水冲毁房屋和城墙，主教卢卡·菲耶斯基倾尽家产主持重建。皮埃蒙特军队1625年、1672年两度占领该城，1744至1745年西班牙兵团把它用作补给站；1746年7月，城中民兵在祖卡雷洛击败皮埃蒙特人，生俘指挥官德尔卡雷托侯爵，此后热那亚恢复了统治。1794年4月4日法军入城，三天后新任意大利军团司令拿破仑·波拿巴在此与马塞纳会面，在罗兰迪-里奇宫中筹划意大利战役。1797年利古里亚共和国成立，阿尔本加成为琴塔辖区首府，1805年并入法兰西帝国，维也纳和会后归属撒丁王国，1818年成为省府。

en:
The Uckermark is the fertile country of the Uecker and the Ucker lakes, named after the Slavic Ukrani. Their gords at Drense and near modern Prenzlau guarded routes through the lakeland, before Pomeranian dukes opened the country to Christian missions and Low German settlers. A Premonstratensian house was founded at Gramzow in 1177 or 1178. Prenzlau itself appears in 1187 as a fortified market with one of Pomerania's three mints, and Duke Barnim I granted it German town law in 1234. It stood on the busy Magdeburg–Stettin road and by 1250 had walls, four parish churches and a monastery. The Treaty of Landin transferred the Uckerland to Brandenburg in 1250; after long rivalry with Pomerania and Mecklenburg, Prenzlau returned to Hohenzollern rule in 1426 and the Peace of Wittstock secured the region for Brandenburg in 1442. In 1444 its fertile farms and long-distance market were set under a still-Catholic Brandenburg frontier government.

The Thirty Years' War reached the Uckermark in 1626; plague followed in 1630, and the body of Gustavus Adolphus lay in Prenzlau's St Mary's Church for three days in December 1632. By the peace, almost forty percent of the region's 222 settlements were destroyed or empty. Dutch settlers and a French Huguenot community founded in Prenzlau in 1687 helped revive crafts, though the wars of 1658–1660 and 1674–1679 again wasted the countryside. The Finow Canal opened in the southern Uckermark in 1746, improving the timber and grain trade, but the Seven Years' War brought more garrisons and marching armies. On 28 October 1806 General Hohenlohe surrendered about 12,000 Prussian troops near Prenzlau, and French occupation and contributions lasted until 1812. In 1817 the region was reorganized into the Prenzlau, Templin and Angermünde districts of Prussian Brandenburg.
zh:
乌克马克是于克河与乌克湖群一带的肥沃乡土，得名于斯拉夫乌克拉尼人。他们在德伦瑟和今普伦茨劳附近设有堡寨，守卫湖沼间的通道，后来波美拉尼亚公爵把此地开放给基督教传教团和低地德意志移民。1177年或1178年，格拉姆措建立普雷蒙特雷会修道院。普伦茨劳1187年已见记载，是设有波美拉尼亚三大铸币厂之一的设防市场，1234年由公爵巴尔尼姆一世授予德意志城市法。它位于繁忙的马格德堡至斯德丁商路上，到1250年已有城墙、四座教区教堂和一座修道院。1250年的《兰丁条约》把乌克兰划给勃兰登堡；在与波美拉尼亚、梅克伦堡长期争夺后，普伦茨劳于1426年重归霍亨索伦家族统治，1442年的《维特施托克和约》确保勃兰登堡取得这一地区。1444年，这里肥沃的农田和远途市场已归仍奉天主教的勃兰登堡边境政权统辖。

三十年战争于1626年波及乌克马克，1630年瘟疫随之而来；1632年12月，古斯塔夫二世·阿道夫的遗体曾在普伦茨劳圣母教堂停放三天。战争结束时，全区222个聚落中近四成已被毁或无人居住。荷兰移民和1687年在普伦茨劳建立的法国胡格诺教徒社区帮助复兴手工业，但1658年至1660年、1674年至1679年的战事又使乡村遭到破坏。1746年，乌克马克南部的菲诺运河通航，改善了木材和粮食贸易；七年战争却再次带来驻军与过境大军。1806年10月28日，霍恩洛厄将军在普伦茨劳附近率约一万二千名普军投降，法国占领和沉重摊派一直持续到1812年。1817年，此地被重组为普鲁士勃兰登堡治下的普伦茨劳、滕普林和安格尔明德三县。

en:
Wolgast guards the Peenestrom between the mainland and the island of Usedom. A Slavic trading and toll station stood there in 1123, and Otto of Bamberg destroyed the temple of Jarovit on his second Pomeranian mission in 1128. During the German eastward settlement a planned town was laid out beside the older Wendish settlements; its town rights are documented by 1259 and Bogislaw IV confirmed Lübeck law in 1282. After the Pomeranian partition of 1295 Wolgast became the seat of the Griffin dukes of Pomerania-Wolgast, their castle rising on the island later called Castle Island. In 1444 Wartislaw IX, who had reigned since 1417, held this Catholic but commercially modest Hanse residence in the shadow of the stronger port of Stralsund.

The Wolgast duchy was absorbed into Bogislaw X's reunited Pomerania in 1478, though the castle remained a Renaissance ducal residence until the Wolgast line ended with Philipp Julius in 1625. On 2 September 1628 Wallenstein's imperial army defeated Christian IV of Denmark outside the town, and in 1630 Gustavus Adolphus landed nearby at Peenemünde; his body was carried back from Wolgast to Sweden in 1633. From 1648 the town belonged to Swedish Pomerania. Russian troops burned most of it and finally destroyed the castle in 1713 during the Great Northern War, leaving St Peter's Church among the few Gothic survivors. After 1720 Wolgast profited as a customs point at the Oder entrance while the Swine channel silted up, and its baroque town hall rose amid the rebuilding. It passed to Prussian Pomerania in 1815.
zh:
沃尔加斯特扼守大陆与乌泽多姆岛之间的佩讷海峡。1123年，这里已有斯拉夫人的贸易和征税站；1128年，班贝格的奥托第二次到波美拉尼亚传教时摧毁了雅罗维特神庙。东向殖民时期，一座规划城镇在古老文德聚落旁建成，1259年已有城市议会记载，博古斯瓦夫四世又在1282年确认其吕贝克法。1295年波美拉尼亚分封后，沃尔加斯特成为格里芬王朝波美拉尼亚-沃尔加斯特支系公爵驻地，城堡坐落在后来称为城堡岛的岛上。1444年，自1417年在位的瓦季斯瓦夫九世统治着这座信奉天主教、商业却不算显赫的汉萨公爵驻城；它的声势也在更强的港口施特拉尔松德之下。

1478年，沃尔加斯特公国并入博古斯瓦夫十世重新统一的波美拉尼亚，但城堡仍是文艺复兴式公爵驻地，直到1625年菲利普·尤利乌斯去世、沃尔加斯特支系绝嗣。1628年9月2日，华伦斯坦的帝国军队在城外击败丹麦国王克里斯蒂安四世；1630年，古斯塔夫二世·阿道夫在附近的佩讷明德登陆，他的遗体1633年又从沃尔加斯特运回瑞典。1648年起，城市归属瑞典属波美拉尼亚。大北方战争期间，俄军1713年焚毁大半个城镇并最终摧毁公爵城堡，圣彼得教堂是少数幸存的哥特式建筑之一。1720年后，由于希维纳水道淤塞，沃尔加斯特作为奥得河入口的税站获利，巴洛克式市政厅也在重建中落成。1815年，它转入普鲁士所属的波美拉尼亚。

en:
Stolp grew around a fortified ford on the Słupia on the old Danzig–Stargard road, where river fish weirs gave the place its Slavic name and Pomeranian traders could move between the coast and the interior. Swietopelk II of Pomerelia granted Lübeck law in 1265, and Westphalian and Holstein merchants founded a new ward on the river bank in 1276. After passing through Brandenburg and being pledged to the Teutonic Order, the town returned to the Griffin dukes in 1341, when its knights, clergy and burghers raised the ransom themselves. Its citizens had already bought the downstream port of Stolpmünde in 1337, which opened Baltic and North Sea trade in fish, amber and craft goods. In 1368 Stolp became a residence of the dukes of Pomerania-Stolp, and in 1444 it was a Catholic Hanseatic town under a branch of the Griffin dynasty.

Fire almost destroyed Stolp in 1477, and Duke Bogislaw X built the Renaissance ducal castle there in 1507. The townspeople turned to Lutheranism during the disturbances of 1524–1525, while later epidemics, repeated fires and a long quarrel with the dukes weakened the town and helped end its Hanseatic role. Swedish troops took it in 1630 during the Thirty Years' War, Wallenstein's imperial forces occupied it in 1637, and Swedish troops under Banner left it ruined. The Peace of Westphalia assigned Further Pomerania to Brandenburg, which actually took over Stolp in 1653. Huguenot settlers later helped revive trade, Frederick the Great made the town a cavalry garrison and founded a cadet school in 1769, and a public library followed in 1788. Polish troops fighting with Napoleon briefly seized the town in February 1807; after 1816 it became a district seat in the Prussian Province of Pomerania.
zh:
施托尔普（斯武普斯克）位于斯武皮亚河上的渡口，处在但泽通往施塔加德的旧商道旁。河中的捕鱼栅架给了这个西斯拉夫人地名，波美拉尼亚商人也经此往来海岸与内陆。1265年，波梅雷利亚公爵希维托佩乌克二世授予此地吕贝克法；1276年，威斯特伐利亚和荷尔斯泰因商人在河西建立新街区。此地先后归属勃兰登堡并被抵押给条顿骑士团，1341年由当地骑士、教士和市民凑齐赎金，重新回到格里芬公爵治下。市民早在1337年就购得下游港口施托尔普明德，使鱼类、琥珀和手工业品得以进入波罗的海与北海市场。1368年，施托尔普成为波美拉尼亚—施托尔普公爵的驻地；1444年时，它是格里芬王朝一支统治下的天主教汉萨城镇。

1477年，大火几乎烧毁施托尔普，博吉斯瓦夫十世1507年在此兴建文艺复兴式公爵城堡。1524—1525年的动荡中，市民改宗路德宗；此后疫病、反复火灾以及与公爵的长期争执削弱了城市，也促使它结束汉萨角色。三十年战争中，瑞典军队1630年占城，华伦斯坦的帝国军队1637年进驻，随后巴内尔所率瑞典军队又将城市破坏殆尽。《威斯特伐利亚和约》把后波美拉尼亚划归勃兰登堡，施托尔普实际于1653年被接管。胡格诺移民后来帮助恢复贸易，腓特烈大帝把这里设为骑兵驻地并于1769年创办幼军校，公共图书馆也在1788年设立。1807年2月，随拿破仑作战的波兰军队短暂夺取该城；1816年后，施托尔普成为普鲁士波美拉尼亚省的县治。

en:
Wismar occupies a sheltered Baltic bay behind Poel island, in land once held by the Obotrites. German settlement took shape under Henry Borwin I around 1226; the town is first documented in 1229, received Lübeck law soon afterwards, and by 1276 its wall enclosed the quarters around St Mary's, St Nicholas' and St George's churches. From 1257 until 1358 it served as the residence of the dukes of Mecklenburg. In 1259 its envoys made a piracy-protection treaty with Lübeck and Rostock, one of the agreements that grew into the Hanseatic Wendish network. Wool processing, cloth, beer and Baltic trade sustained the town, though about 2,000 people died in the Black Death of 1350. Craft unrest returned in 1427, when a fleet commander and Mayor Johann Bantzkow were executed on the market square. In 1444 Wismar remained a Catholic Hanse port under Mecklenburg lordship.

The Franciscan Heinrich Never became an early Lutheran preacher, carrying the Reformation into the town's friaries and parishes. In 1594 the Viechelner Fahrt canal opened a water route toward Lake Schwerin and the Elbe. Imperial troops took Wismar in 1627, Sweden conquered it in 1632, and the Peace of Westphalia assigned it to the Swedish crown in 1648. From 1653 the Fürstenhof housed the supreme tribunal for Sweden's imperial fiefs. Danish forces captured the fortress in 1675 and held it until November 1680; after its return Wismar became one of Sweden's strongest Baltic strongpoints. Prussian and Danish troops took it in 1716, and the fortifications were subsequently dismantled. In 1803 the Treaty of Malmö pledged Wismar to Mecklenburg-Schwerin for 99 years. Napoleonic troops occupied it from 1806 to 1813, and after 1815 the port remained with Mecklenburg-Schwerin.
zh:
维斯马坐落在珀尔岛后方一处受遮蔽的波罗的海海湾，这片土地原属奥博特人。德意志人聚居地约在1226年由海因里希·博尔温一世推动形成；城市最早见于1229年文献，不久后采用《吕贝克法》，到1276年城墙已环抱起圣马利亚、圣尼古拉和圣乔治各教堂周围的市区。1257年至1358年，这里是梅克伦堡公爵的驻跸地。1259年，维斯马使者与吕贝克、罗斯托克缔结抵御海盗的互助条约，这类协议后来发展为汉萨的文德城市网络。毛纺、布料、啤酒和波罗的海贸易支撑着城市，但1350年的黑死病仍造成约两千人死亡。1427年手工业骚乱再起，一名舰队指挥官和市长约翰·班茨科在市集广场被处死。1444年的维斯马仍是梅克伦堡治下的天主教汉萨港口。

方济各会修士海因里希·内弗很早就传讲路德宗，把宗教改革带入修院和堂区。1594年，维谢恩航道开通，形成通向什未林湖和易北河水系的水路。1627年帝国军队占领维斯马，1632年瑞典将其攻克，1648年《威斯特伐利亚和约》把它划归瑞典王室。1653年起，侯爵宫成为瑞典在神圣罗马帝国各封地的最高法院所在地。1675年丹麦军队夺取要塞并占领至1680年11月；城市归还后被建成瑞典在波罗的海最强的据点之一。1716年普鲁士和丹麦军队攻占维斯马，此后要塞被拆除。1803年，《马尔默抵押条约》把维斯马抵押给梅克伦堡-什未林99年。1806年至1813年拿破仑军队占领此地，1815年后港口仍属梅克伦堡-什未林。

en:
Tuchola, German Tuchel, lies on the rivers and lakes at the south-western edge of the great Tuchola Forest in Gdańsk Pomerania. It began as a trading settlement serving the early castellany at Raciąż and stood on the road from Gdańsk through Nakło to Greater Poland, Silesia and Bohemia. Archbishop Jakub Świnka consecrated its church on 9 October 1287, when it was already one of the larger settlements of south-western Pomerania. The Teutonic Order took it in 1330 and made Tuchola the seat of a wide forest commandery; Grand Master Heinrich Dusemer confirmed Chełmno town law there on 22 July 1346. A brick castle, walls, moats, town hall and St Bartholomew's Church then guarded a market in grain, timber and forest produce. After Grunwald in 1410 the town and castle were caught in fierce fighting, and the First Peace of Thorn in 1411 left them to the Order. In 1440, however, Tuchola joined the Prussian Confederation, so in 1444 it was formally a Teutonic commandery but already drifting toward Poland.

At the Confederation's request, Casimir IV proclaimed the region's reincorporation into Poland in 1454; a Polish garrison held Tuchola Castle, and Mikołaj Szarlejski became its first royal starosta. A Polish victory nearby in 1464 and the Second Peace of Thorn in 1466 made Tuchola a royal town and county seat in Royal Prussia. The Gdańsk trade brought prosperity, and by 1570 the town had 123 houses, another seventy-three in the suburbs and eight merchant warehouses. The Deluge ended that growth: Swedish troops occupied Tuchola without a fight in 1655 and withdrew in 1656, while five later assaults were beaten off amid plague, fire and damage to the castle. The town passed to Prussia in the First Partition of 1772, when it had only 108 houses and 490 inhabitants. A fire set by Johann Philipp Voigt on 17 May 1781 destroyed St Bartholomew's, the town hall and most of the wooden town, but rebuilding and weaving revived it; French, Polish, Prussian and Russian troops passed through during the Napoleonic campaigns of 1806–1807.
zh:
图霍拉，德语称图赫尔，位于格但斯克波美拉尼亚、广袤的图霍拉森林西南缘，坐落在多条河流与湖泊之间。它最初是服务于拉琼什早期城堡辖区的贸易聚落，控制着从格但斯克经纳克沃通向大波兰、西里西亚和波希米亚的商路。1287年10月9日，格涅兹诺大主教雅库布·希温卡为当地教堂祝圣，那时图霍拉已是波美拉尼亚西南部较大的聚落之一。条顿骑士团1330年取得此地，并把图霍拉设为管辖大片森林辖区的指挥官驻地；1346年7月22日，大团长海因里希·杜塞默确认其享有海乌姆诺城市法。砖造城堡、城墙、壕沟、市政厅和圣巴多罗买教堂，护卫着谷物、木材和林产品市场。1410年格伦瓦尔德战役后，城镇和城堡卷入激烈战事，1411年《第一次托伦和约》仍把它留给骑士团。但图霍拉1440年加入普鲁士联盟，因此1444年时它形式上还是条顿指挥官驻地，实际上已经倾向波兰。

1454年，应普鲁士联盟请求，卡齐米日四世宣布把这一地区重新并入波兰；波兰守军进驻图霍拉城堡，米科瓦伊·沙尔莱伊斯基成为第一任王室镇长。1464年波军在附近取胜，1466年《第二次托伦和约》使图霍拉成为皇家普鲁士的王室城镇和县治。格但斯克贸易带来繁荣，到1570年，城区有123栋房屋、郊区另有73栋，并设有八座商人仓库。「大洪水」终结了这段增长：瑞典军队1655年不战占领图霍拉，1656年撤走；此后五次进攻虽被击退，瘟疫、火灾和城堡损毁仍相继而来。1772年第一次瓜分波兰时，城镇并入普鲁士，当时只有108栋房屋、490名居民。1781年5月17日，约翰·菲利普·福格特纵火掠取教堂财宝，圣巴多罗买教堂、市政厅和大半个木构城镇被毁；重建和纺织业后来使其复苏，1806年至1807年拿破仑战争期间，法国、波兰、普鲁士和俄国军队都曾经过或驻扎于此。

en:
Buzău lies where the river of the same name breaks out of the Carpathian foothills into the Bărăgan Plain, at the crossing of roads linking Wallachia with Moldavia and Transylvania. A fortress stood here in the Middle Ages, and a princely document from the reign of Dan II (1420–1431) certified the settlement as a market town and customs point; by 1431 it was already a flourishing trading place, gathering the livestock and wool of the surrounding plains. In 1444, in a Wallachia under Ottoman suzerainty, Buzău lived by that traffic, as shepherds coming down from the mountains after the shearing met merchants bound for the Danube and the passes.

In the early 16th century Buzău became an Orthodox episcopal see, and its bishops its greatest patrons: the Dormition cathedral and the merchants' 'Greeks' church' both went up in 1649, during the reign of Matei Basarab. War then dominated the town for two centuries, from the campaigns of Michael the Brave to the rising of 1821; raids, fires, plague and earthquakes emptied it again and again, and each time the townspeople rebuilt, putting the phoenix on their city seal in the early 18th century. The shepherds' midsummer wool fair, Drăgaica, moved down from the mountains to the town, and in 1778 Prince Alexandru Ipsilanti granted its organisation and tolls to the bishopric, a privilege confirmed by Mihai Șuțu in 1792. In 1806 the Ottoman army burned Buzău to the ground during the Russo-Turkish war, and its people fled into the hill villages; the old fair was not held again for many years.
zh:
布泽乌位于同名河流从喀尔巴阡丘陵注入伯勒甘平原之处，正当瓦拉几亚通往摩尔多瓦和特兰西瓦尼亚的道路交汇口。中世纪时这里建有一座要塞；丹二世大公在位期间（1420—1431年）的一份宫廷文书确认此地为集镇和税关，到1431年它已是兴旺的商埠，集散周围平原的牲畜和羊毛。1444年，在向奥斯曼称臣纳贡的瓦拉几亚，布泽乌靠这宗贸易为生：剪毛季后从山里下来的牧人，在此同前往多瑙河和各个山口的商人交易。

16世纪初，布泽乌成为东正教教座，历任主教成了城市最大的庇护者：安息大教堂和商人的「希腊人教堂」都建于1649年马泰伊·巴萨拉布在位时。此后两个世纪，战争成了小城生活的主线，从勇士米哈依的征战一直延续到1821年起义；劫掠、火灾、瘟疫和地震一再使它荒无人烟，而居民每次都重新营建，并在18世纪初把不死鸟铸上市印。山里牧羊人仲夏举行的羊毛集市「德拉加伊卡」后来迁到城中，1778年大公亚历山德鲁·伊普西兰蒂把集市的经办权和税收判给主教区，米哈伊·舒图又于1792年确认这一特权。1806年俄土战争期间，奥斯曼军将布泽乌付之一炬，居民逃入丘陵中的村庄，老集市也由此停办多年。

en:
Hormuz is a bare, waterless island of salt rock and red ochre at the throat of the Persian Gulf, across a narrow channel from the mainland. Until 1301 the kings of this coast ruled from old Hormuz near Minab; in that year Baha ud-Din Ayaz and his merchants moved their city to the island, then called Jarun, to escape raiders from the interior, and gave it the old name. With no spring and scarcely soil enough for a garden, New Hormuz lived by the sea alone: Arab, Persian and Indian merchants made it an emporium for spices, pearls and jewels, drinking water came by boat from the shore, and an Arabic proverb held that 'if the whole world were a golden ring, Hormuz is its jewel'. The Chinese treasure fleets of Zheng He lay at anchor here on the fourth voyage in the 1410s, and Ma Huan found even the commoners wealthy. In 1444 the island city, ruled by its own Arab dynasty, was the greatest mart at the mouth of the Gulf.

The Portuguese agent Covilhã had reconnoitred the port in 1488, and in September 1507 Afonso de Albuquerque stormed the island. From 1515 the Fort of Our Lady of the Conception made Ormuz the hinge of Portugal's Indian Ocean customs empire, the king a vassal, and his fleet joined the conquest of Bahrain in 1521; the Ottoman admiral Piri Reis besieged the fortress in vain in 1552. In 1622 Shah Abbas I, using an English fleet, expelled the Portuguese and ended the kingdom. Distrusting the islanders, he let the city die and built Bandar Abbas on the mainland shore. The salt city that handled the Indies trade shrank to a fishing village exporting only rock salt and red iron-oxide ballast, and in 1794 the island passed, with Bandar Abbas, under Omani lease; in 1821 only fishermen and salt-quarriers lived where the emporium had stood.
zh:
霍尔木兹是扼守波斯湾咽喉的一座荒岛，遍地盐岩与红赭石，没有淡水，与大陆之间只隔一道狭窄海峡。1301年以前，海岸诸王的都城在米纳布附近的旧霍尔木兹；这一年，巴哈乌丁·阿亚兹和商民为躲避内陆劫掠，把城池迁到当时叫杰龙的岛上，并沿用旧名。新霍尔木兹没有泉水，几乎连种菜的土都没有，全靠大海为生：阿拉伯、波斯和印度商人把它经营成香料、珍珠和宝石的总汇，饮水靠船只从大陆运来，阿拉伯谚语说「若把全世界比作一枚金戒指，霍尔木兹就是戒指上的宝石」。15世纪10年代，郑和宝船队在第四次下西洋途中停泊于此，马欢见到的是一座连平民都很富足的城市。1444年，这座由阿拉伯世系国王统治的岛城，是海湾入口处最大的商埠。

1488年葡萄牙密使科维良已先到港中窥探，1507年9月阿方索·德·阿尔布克尔克强攻夺取该岛。1515年起，「圣母受孕堡」使霍尔木兹成为葡萄牙印度洋海关帝国的枢纽，国王沦为附庸，其舰队还参与了1521年对巴林的远征；奥斯曼海军将领皮里·雷斯1552年围攻要塞而不克。1622年，沙阿·阿拔斯一世借英国舰队逐出葡萄牙人，灭亡其国；他不信任岛民，听任城市衰亡，转而经营对岸大陆上的阿巴斯港。这座曾吞吐整个印度贸易的盐城最后缩成渔村，出口只剩岩盐和压舱用的红铁矿；1794年，它随阿巴斯港一并被租给阿曼，到1821年，旧日商埠上只剩渔民和采盐人。

en:
Niš commands the Nišava valley on the old road between Belgrade, Sofia and Constantinople. Roman Naissus was a garrison and market town in Moesia, and Constantine the Great was born there in 272; under his dynasty it became a major imperial residence. It later passed between Byzantium, Bulgaria, Hungary and Serbia, and Stefan Nemanja made it his capital by 1188 before receiving Frederick Barbarossa's crusaders there in 1189. After the Ottoman conquest of the late fourteenth century, the road town was fought over again. On 8 November 1443 a Hungarian and Serbian army under János Hunyadi defeated the Ottomans outside Niš, returning the town to Serbian rule. In 1444 it was an Orthodox frontier market of the Serbian Despotate, crowded with soldiers and livestock on the route south.

The Ottomans retook Niš in 1448 and made it a military and civil administrative centre. Austrian troops seized the town in 1689 but lost it in 1690; the present Ottoman fortress was then raised on earlier ramparts between 1719 and 1723. Austrian forces took Niš once more in 1737, only for the Ottomans to return without a fight later that year. During the First Serbian Uprising, insurgents attacked at Čegar near Niš in 1809, and after their defeat the Ottomans built Skull Tower from fallen Serbs' heads as a warning. Repression remained sharp to the end of the period: in 1821 Bishop Milentije and two hundred local Serbs were arrested after preparations for an uprising, and the bishop and other leaders were hanged on 13 June.
zh:
尼什扼守尼沙瓦河谷，位于贝尔格莱德、索非亚和君士坦丁堡之间的古道上。罗马时代的纳伊苏斯是默西亚的驻军与集镇，君士坦丁大帝于272年出生在这里；在他的王朝治下，城市发展为重要的帝国驻跸地。此后它在拜占庭、保加利亚、匈牙利和塞尔维亚之间数度易主，斯特凡·尼曼雅到1188年时已以此为都，并于1189年在此接待腓特烈·巴巴罗萨的十字军。14世纪后期奥斯曼征服后，这座道路城镇再度成为战场。1443年11月8日，匈雅提·亚诺什率领匈牙利和塞尔维亚军队在尼什城外击败奥斯曼人，城市重归塞尔维亚统治。1444年的尼什是塞尔维亚专制公国的东正教边贸城镇，南通的道路上挤满士兵与贩运的牲畜。

奥斯曼人1448年再取尼什，将其建成军政中心。1689年奥地利军队攻占城市，1690年又被奥斯曼夺回；现存的奥斯曼要塞随后于1719年至1723年在旧城墙基址上修筑。1737年奥军再度占领尼什，但奥斯曼军队同年便兵不血刃地返回。第一次塞尔维亚起义期间，起义者1809年在尼什附近的切加尔进攻，战败后，奥斯曼人用阵亡塞尔维亚人的头颅筑起骷髅塔，以儆效尤。高压一直延续到这一时期末：1821年，米伦蒂耶主教和二百名当地塞尔维亚人因准备起义被捕，主教与其他领导人于6月13日被公开绞死。

en:
Skopje lies in a broad valley on the upper Vardar, where the road from the Danube to the Aegean crosses the river beneath a fortress hill. Roman Scupi, ruined in the earthquake of 518, was rebuilt by Justinian I on the promontory of the modern citadel. The town served as the Bulgarian capital from 972 to 992 under Tsar Samuel, fell to Basil II in 1004, and was taken by the Serbian king Stefan Milutin in 1282; under the Nemanjids, merchants from Venice and Dubrovnik kept shops there. Stefan Dusan made Skopje his capital and was crowned emperor of the Serbs and Greeks there on 16 April 1346. After the battle of Maritsa in 1371 it passed to Vuk Brankovic, and on 19 January 1392 the Ottomans took it. In 1444 Skopje, called Uskup, was an Ottoman market town of Rumelia, its bazaar serving the Vardar road, its people Orthodox Slavs beside a growing Muslim quarter.

Sultan Mehmed II had the Stone Bridge built across the Vardar between 1451 and 1469, and the Old Bazaar spread around its caravanserais, mosques and baths; the Mustafa Pasha Mosque rose in 1492. In 1535 the governor ordered all the town's churches demolished, and the earthquake of 1555 laid much of Skopje low, though it was quickly rebuilt. The sixteenth and seventeenth centuries were a golden age: when Evliya Celebi visited in 1660-1661 he counted 12,000 houses, some 60,000 people, 2,150 shops and 120 mosques, with caravans running to Salonika, Belgrade and Dubrovnik. In October 1689, during the Great Turkish War, the Habsburg general Silvio Piccolomini seized a town already weakened by cholera and set it ablaze; it burned for two days, and Piccolomini himself died of the plague. The rebel Petar Karpos was impaled on the Stone Bridge, and Skopje spent the eighteenth century reduced, plague-ridden and passed over by trade.
zh:
斯科普里位于瓦尔达尔河上游的宽阔河谷中，多瑙河通往爱琴海的大道在要塞山下渡河。罗马古城斯库皮于518年的大地震中被毁，查士丁尼一世在今城堡所在的岬角上重建新城。972—992年，这里是沙皇萨穆伊尔治下的保加利亚都城，1004年落入巴西尔二世之手，1282年被塞尔维亚国王斯特凡·米卢廷攻取；尼曼雅王朝时期，威尼斯和杜布罗夫尼克的商人在此开店。斯特凡·杜尚定斯科普里为都，并于1346年4月16日在此加冕为塞尔维亚人与希腊人的皇帝。1371年马里查河战役后，城市归武克·布兰科维奇所有，1392年1月19日被奥斯曼人攻占。1444年的斯科普里（突厥语称于斯屈普）是鲁米利亚的一座奥斯曼集镇，巴扎服务于瓦尔达尔大道，居民以信奉东正教的斯拉夫人为主，穆斯林区已在扩大。

穆罕默德二世在位时，石桥于1451—1469年横跨瓦尔达尔河建成，旧巴扎连同商队旅馆、清真寺和浴池在桥周兴起；穆斯塔法帕夏清真寺建于1492年。1535年，总督下令拆毁城中所有教堂；1555年的大地震又摧毁大半城区，不过城市很快得到重建。16—17世纪是斯科普里的黄金时代：埃夫利亚·切莱比1660—1661年到访时，记下城中有1.2万栋房屋、约6万居民、2150间店铺和120座清真寺，商队往来于萨洛尼卡、贝尔格莱德和杜布罗夫尼克。1689年10月大土耳其战争期间，哈布斯堡将军西尔维奥·皮科洛米尼攻占已遭霍乱削弱的城市并纵火，大火连烧两天，他本人也死于瘟疫。起义者佩塔尔·卡尔波什被钉死在石桥上；整个18世纪，斯科普里元气大伤、瘟疫不断，商路也绕它而去。

en:
The Visoko valley, where the Fojnica joins the Bosna, was the cradle and ceremonial heart of the medieval Bosnian state. Its hill-fortress of Visoki, first named in a charter of 1 September 1355, guarded Podvisoki below, the busiest market town of the kingdom, where Ragusan merchants bought the grain and hides of the fertile plain. At nearby Mile the stanak assembled and Tvrtko I was crowned king in 1377, later to be buried there beside his uncle Stjepan II; at Moštre the Bosnian Church kept a school famed for medicine and theology, and Biskupići yielded Ban Kulin's inscribed plate of 1193 from the ruins of his old church. The last royal charter issued from Visoki dates to 1436. In 1444 the valley remained the rich centre of the kingdom under its new king Tomaš, though the court had withdrawn to Bobovac and the Ottomans were closing on the Drina.

When the kingdom collapsed in 1463 the old strongholds fell into ruin, Visoki vanishing from the records before 1503. A new Ottoman town rose in the valley below under Ajas-beg, a local man converted from the Bosnian Church, who by 1477 had built a Muslim quarter with a hammam, mekteb, madrasa, aqueduct and a bridge over the Bosna, and endowed a Naqshbandi tekke in the new town. Visoko became the seat of a nahiya and a centre of trade and leatherwork, its medieval stećak graveyards slowly overgrown as the townspeople turned to Islam. Unlike the frontier lands on the Sava and the Una, the Visoko basin saw no great battle through the long Ottoman centuries, and as a quiet market town it passed into the nineteenth century.
zh:
福伊尼察河注入波斯纳河处的维索科河谷，是中世纪波斯尼亚国家的摇篮和礼仪中心。山岗上的维索基要塞首见于1355年9月1日的一份诏书，山下拱卫着波德维索基——王国最繁忙的集镇，拉古萨商人在此收购肥沃平原出产的谷物与皮革。附近的米莱是贵族会议召开之地，特尔特科一世1377年在此加冕为王，身后与舅父斯捷潘二世同葬于此；莫什特雷有波斯尼亚教会的学府，以医学和神学著称，班·库林的旧教堂遗址则出土了他那块1193年的铭文石版。维索基颁出的最后一份王家诏书是在1436年。1444年，这条河谷仍是新王托马什治下王国的富庶中心，只是宫廷已退守博博瓦茨，而奥斯曼人正逼近德里纳河。

1463年王国覆灭，旧日堡垒沦为废墟，维索基在1503年之前便从记载中消失。一座新的奥斯曼城镇在下方河谷兴起，营造者是出身本地、从波斯尼亚教会改宗伊斯兰的阿亚斯贝伊：到1477年，他已建起配有公共浴室、经文小学、经学院、水道和波斯纳河桥的穆斯林区，并在新城中捐建了一座纳克什班迪教团道堂。维索科成为一个纳希耶的治所和贸易与皮革业中心，随着居民渐渐改奉伊斯兰，中世纪的斯特恰克石墓也慢慢荒芜。与萨瓦河和乌纳河畔的边地不同，维索科河谷在漫长的奥斯曼数百年间没有经历大的战事，作为一座安静的集镇走入19世纪。

en:
Euboea is a long island stretched along the eastern shore of Greece, cut from the mainland only by the narrow Euripos strait at Chalcis, whose black-stone bridge gave the town its Italian name of Negroponte. After the Fourth Crusade Lombard barons divided the island into the Triarchy, but Venice secured its commerce in the Euboeote Succession war of 1256–1258 and held full sovereignty from 1390. The Republic planted Albanian clans to repeople the countryside — 10,000 settlers in 1425 alone — and kept Negroponte as a fortified staging port on the sea lane to Constantinople. In 1444 the island was thus a Venetian colony of Greek Orthodox villagers and fishermen under Latin garrisons, a key link joining Venice to its Aegean ports.

During the Ottoman–Venetian war Mehmed II came in person in the summer of 1470, bringing 70,000 men and 400 ships; his fleet closed the Euripos with a chain and laid a bridge of boats to the island, and after a month of costly assaults Negroponte was stormed on 12 July. By Venetian report the bailo Paolo Erizzo was sawn in two, and all Euboea passed to the Sultan. Renamed Eğriboz, Chalcis became the seat of a sanjak stretching over much of the Greek mainland; Ottoman families took the richest plains while the Greeks held the hills. Francesco Morosini besieged the town for three months in 1688 without success. On 8 May 1821 the island rose against the Turks, beginning at Istiaia under Angelis Govios, with Kymi, Limni and Styra following.
zh:
埃维亚是一座与希腊本土东岸平行的长岛，只在哈尔基斯被狭窄的埃夫里普海峡与大陆隔开；海峡上黑色石头砌成的桥，让这座城得了内格罗蓬特这个意大利名字。第四次十字军东征后，伦巴第男爵把该岛分成三方领地，威尼斯在1256—1258年的埃维亚继承战争中掌握了它的贸易，又于1390年取得完整主权。共和国迁来阿尔巴尼亚部族充实乡野——仅1425年就有一万人——并把内格罗蓬特经营成通往君士坦丁堡航线上设防的补给港。1444年的埃维亚因此是一块威尼斯殖民地：信奉东正教的希腊村民与渔民受拉丁守军管辖，是威尼斯串联其爱琴海港口的重要一环。

1470年夏的威土战争中，穆罕默德二世亲率七万陆军、四百艘战船而来；舰队用铁链封死埃夫里普海峡，又以船只搭成浮桥直通岛上。经过一个月伤亡惨重的强攻，内格罗蓬特于7月12日陷落。据威尼斯人记述，驻节长官保罗·埃里佐被处以锯刑，整个埃维亚随之归入苏丹版图。哈尔基斯更名埃格里博兹，成为一个管辖范围深入希腊本土大片土地的桑贾克治所；奥斯曼家族占去最肥沃的平原，希腊人退守山地。1688年，总督弗朗切斯科·莫罗西尼围城三个月，无功而返。1821年5月8日，岛屿在安盖利斯·戈维奥斯领导下于伊斯蒂亚亚起事，库米、利姆尼和斯蒂拉相继响应。

en:
The Comoros—Ngazidja, Ndzuwani, Mwali and Mayotte—form a volcanic chain at the northern mouth of the Mozambique Channel. Settlers from East Africa, Madagascar and the Indonesian archipelago had reached the islands by the eighth century, and Dembeni villages spread across them from the eighth to the tenth centuries. From the eleventh to the fifteenth century, merchants from Kilwa, Sofala, Mombasa and the Middle East drew the islands into Indian Ocean trade, handling coral, ambergris, tortoiseshell, ivory, gold and slaves while Islam took root with Hadrami settlers. At Domoni, on Ndzuwani, walls, mosques and thirteenth-century royal palaces marked an old Swahili trading town. In 1444 the Comoros were Muslim, prosperous and politically divided, shortly before Ndzuwani was united under one sultanate.

Late in the fifteenth century, high-ranking Hadrami Arabs married into Ndzuwani's ruling families and established the Sultanate of Anjouan; around 1500 it became the strongest power in the islands, while Ngazidja remained split among several sultans. The first Portuguese fleet visited in 1503, and for much of the sixteenth century the islands supplied Portugal's fort on Mozambique Island, though no royal conquest followed. English sailors called Ndzuwani Johanna, and ships bound for India stopped there for coconuts, cattle and tortoiseshell; the same maritime traffic later carried slaves to plantations in the Mascarenes. From the 1790s Betsimisaraka and Sakalava raiders from Madagascar burned villages and carried off islanders. In 1812 Sultan Alawi bin Husain asked Britain for help against the slavers and was refused. By 1821 the islands remained under local rulers, their villages and populations badly depleted.
zh:
科摩罗——恩加济贾（大科摩罗）、恩祖瓦尼（昂儒昂）、姆瓦利（莫埃利）和马约特——是莫桑比克海峡北端的火山群岛。至迟8世纪，来自东非、马达加斯加和印度尼西亚群岛的移民已经抵达，8至10世纪的登贝尼聚落遍布各岛。11至15世纪，基尔瓦、索法拉、蒙巴萨和中东商人把群岛带入印度洋贸易网，珊瑚、龙涎香、玳瑁、象牙、黄金和奴隶在此转手，伊斯兰教也随哈德拉毛移民扎根。恩祖瓦尼东岸的多莫尼有城墙、清真寺和13世纪王宫，是一座古老的斯瓦希里商镇。1444年的科摩罗已是穆斯林聚居、商路繁荣之地，却仍分治于众多地方首领，恩祖瓦尼统一为苏丹国还要等到15世纪末。

15世纪末，哈德拉毛的阿拉伯望族与恩祖瓦尼统治家族联姻，建立昂儒昂苏丹国；1500年前后它成为群岛最强的政权，恩加济贾则仍由若干苏丹分治。葡萄牙船队首次到访是在1503年，16世纪大部分时间里，各岛为葡萄牙人在莫桑比克岛的要塞提供补给，但葡萄牙王室没有正式征服。英国水手把恩祖瓦尼称作约翰娜，驶往印度的船只在此停靠，换取椰子、牲畜和玳瑁；同一条航路后来也向马斯克林群岛的种植园输送奴隶。1790年代起，马达加斯加的贝齐米萨拉卡人和萨卡拉瓦人不断来袭，焚毁村庄并掳走人口。1812年，苏丹阿拉维·本·侯赛因请求英国援助抵御奴隶劫掠者，却遭到拒绝。到1821年，各岛仍在本地统治者手中，只是村社和人口已遭重创。

en:
Antankara is the northern tip of Madagascar, where the Ankarana massif splits the coast with its grey tsingy limestone, caves and dry forest, and the great harbour of Diego-Suarez bites into the shore. In 1444 the Vohilava, Antambohitsy and other Malagasy clans of the tip lived by fishing in dugout canoes, herding zebu and making salt, trading tortoiseshell to the dhow captains who called along the coast; they answered to no king, for the Sakalava kingdoms were still gathering far to the south-west.

In the early seventeenth century the Zafin'i'fotsy, a defeated branch of the Sakalava royal line, migrated north, and their chief Kozobe laid claim to the whole tip, dividing it among five sons. Hard pressed by the new Sakalava kingdom of Iboina, Andriantsirotso (r. 1692–1710) led the people into the Ankarana rocks, took refuge at Maroantsetra and with his host's help drove the Sakalava back, founding the Antankarana kingdom under a line that lasted centuries. Lamboeny, who followed him, ruled for eighty years, and the kings traded tortoiseshell and slaves for guns from ships calling at Diego-Suarez, keeping their court near Ambatoharaña. In the reign of Tsialana I, from 1809, the expanding Kingdom of Imerina reached the northern trade routes, set up garrisons and tax posts, and around 1818 forced the Antankarana king to accept vassalage — the position in which the north stood in 1821.
zh:
安坦卡拉位于马达加斯加岛最北端，安卡拉纳山地横亘海岸，灰色的钦吉岩溶石林、溶洞与旱生林密布，迪耶果-苏瓦雷斯深水港深深切入海岸。1444年，岛尖的沃希拉瓦、安坦博希齐等马尔加什氏族以独木舟捕鱼、牧养瘤牛、煮晒海盐为生，并把玳瑁壳卖给沿岸停靠的单桅帆船船长；他们不奉国王——萨卡拉瓦诸王国此时还在遥远的西南方向成形之中。

17世纪初，在王位之争中落败的萨卡拉瓦王族支系扎菲尼夫齐北迁，其首领科佐贝宣称领有整个岛尖，把土地分给五个儿子。面对新兴的萨卡拉瓦伊博伊纳王国的重压，安德里安齐罗措（1692—1710年在位）率众退入安卡拉纳石林，又避往马鲁安采特拉，凭东道主之兵击退萨卡拉瓦人，建立起传承数百年的安坦卡拉王国。继他而立的兰博埃尼统治长达八十年，历代国王以玳瑁和奴隶向来迪耶果-苏瓦雷斯停靠的船只换购火枪，宫廷设在安巴托哈拉尼亚一带。从1809年齐亚拉纳一世在位时起，扩张中的伊梅里纳王国推进到北方商路，设立驻军和税卡，约在1818年迫使安坦卡拉王接受臣属——这正是1821年北方的处境。

en:
The shores of Boina Bay and the Betsiboka estuary were for centuries the busiest sea edge of western Madagascar. Muslim, Swahili-speaking Antalaotra had settled here from the tenth century, and by 1444 their ports welcomed dhows from Mozambique, Arabia and the Comoros, trading beads, cloth and metalware for cattle, rice and captives. Inland, Sakalava-speaking clans grazed zebu on the plains and answered to no single ruler. Europeans had not yet reached the island, and the great emporium of Mahajanga had not yet been built.

Portuguese ships reached Madagascar around 1500, and by the later sixteenth century Mazalagem Nova was the richest Muslim mart on the northwest coast. About 1685 Andriamandisoarivo, a son of the Menabe king Andriandahifotsy, lost a succession war and marched north with his followers; he stormed Mazalagem Nova, killed its sultan and around 1690 founded the kingdom of Iboina, seat of the Volamena dynasty, making the newly founded port of Mahajanga his commercial capital. The god-kings who followed drew tribute from the Antankarana of the far north, and in 1720 King Toakafo was held the mightiest ruler on the island. An English captain in 1764 found Mahajanga a cosmopolitan town built 'after the Indian fashion', its stone houses and mosques thronged with merchants from Surat, Anjouan and Mozambique. The long reign of Queen Ravahiny (c. 1778-1808) saw French probes in the 1770s beaten off and a community of Indian traders settle at the Betsiboka mouth. In 1817 Radama I of Imerina traded the abolition of the slave trade for British arms and turned his reformed armies on the Sakalava. The Boina court drew close to its Muslim councillors and to France, but in 1821 the Merina had not yet crossed the Betsiboka.
zh:
博伊纳湾沿岸与贝齐布卡河口，几个世纪里一直是马达加斯加西部最繁忙的海岸。讲斯瓦希里语的穆斯林安塔劳特拉人自10世纪起在此定居，到1444年，他们的港埠迎接着来自莫桑比克、阿拉伯和科摩罗的独桅帆船，用珠子、布匹和金属器皿交易牛只、稻米和人口；内陆平原上，讲萨卡拉瓦语的诸氏族放牧瘤牛，不奉任何共主。此时欧洲人尚未到达这座大岛，后来的巨港马任加（马哈赞加）也还没有兴建。

1500年前后，葡萄牙船只到达马达加斯加；到16世纪后期，马扎拉任诺瓦已是西北海岸最富庶的穆斯林商埠。约1685年，梅纳贝国王安德里安达希富齐之子安德里亚曼迪苏阿里武在内争中失败，率部众北上，攻克马扎拉任诺瓦、杀死其苏丹，于1690年前后建立伊博伊纳王国，开创武拉梅纳王朝，并把新建的港口马任加设为商业都城。此后的神王们接受极北之地安塔卡拉纳人的朝贡，1720年时，国王托阿卡福被视为全岛最强大的统治者。1764年，一名英国船长见到的马任加是座「按印度样式」建成的国际都市，石屋与清真寺之间挤满了来自苏拉特、昂儒昂和莫桑比克的商人。女王拉瓦希尼漫长的统治（约1778—1808年）击退了法国人1770年代的试探，贝齐布卡河口也形成了印度商人社区。1817年，梅里纳国王拉达马一世以废除奴隶贸易换取英国军火，把经过整编的军队转向萨卡拉瓦人。博伊纳宫廷虽倚重穆斯林谋臣并与法国走近，但到1821年，梅里纳人尚未越过贝齐布卡河。

en:
The Tsimihety country is the broken mountain land of north-central Madagascar, between the Merina highlands and the Sakalava plains, where misty valleys run down toward the Sofia river. Its people kept rice fields and herds of zebu on the hillsides, and lived in independent village clans with no king above them; even in 1444, when the island's coasts were taking shape as Muslim trading sultanates, these remote valleys answered to no outside ruler.

Their name, 'those who never cut their hair', remembers that independence: when the Sakalava kingdom to the west claimed them and demanded the mourning haircut after a ruler's death, they refused. Through the eighteenth century they remained a warlike, kingless people and resisted the unifying armies of Andrianampoinimerina and his son.
