In 1444 the young Thomas FitzJohn FitzGerald, seventh earl, held a Catholic marcher lordship on the Pale edge, its walled towns watching for raids by the O'Byrnes and O'Tooles.

His son Gearóid Mór, the eighth earl and Lord Deputy of Ireland, defeated Clanricarde at Knockdoe on 19 August 1504. Fitzgerald autonomy ended when Silken Thomas rose in 1534. William Skeffington bombarded Maynooth in March 1535; the castle fell after a ten-day siege and its garrison was executed, while Silken Thomas and five uncles were executed at Tyburn on 3 February 1537. Elizabeth I granted Naas a new charter in 1568, but Rory O'More burned the town in 1577. Maynooth was restored in 1630–1635 and damaged again in the Confederate wars of the 1640s. On 24 May 1798 some 1,000 rebels failed in an attack on Naas, and in 1801 the borough lost its separate seats in the Irish Parliament.
zh:
基尔代尔是都柏林以西的肥沃内陆，郡治和市场中心是内斯（Nás na Ríogh）。1176年，诺曼领袖强弓把这片地区封给莫里斯·菲茨杰拉德；约1203年动工的梅努斯堡后来成为菲茨杰拉德家族的主要居所，基尔代尔镇则围绕圣布里吉德的教堂和修道院发展起来。基尔代尔1297年设郡，伯爵爵位创立于1316年；内斯1409年获得特许状，1413年获准征收城门税用于修筑工事，约1415年建起城墙，爱尔兰议会还曾在1441年在此开会。1444年，年轻的第七代伯爵托马斯·菲茨约翰·菲茨杰拉德领有这个信奉天主教的边疆伯国，设防城镇警戒着奥伯恩和奥图尔家族的袭扰。

他的儿子第八代伯爵杰拉尔德·莫尔·菲茨杰拉德担任爱尔兰副总督，1504年8月19日在诺克杜击败克兰里卡德。1534年「绸衣托马斯」起兵，菲茨杰拉德家族的自治地位终结。1535年3月，威廉·斯基芬顿炮轰梅努斯堡；城堡在十天围攻后陷落，守军被处决，绸衣托马斯和五个叔伯也于1537年2月3日在泰伯恩被处死。伊丽莎白一世1568年向内斯颁赐新特许状，罗里·奥莫尔却在1577年焚毁了城镇。梅努斯堡1630—1635年得到修复，又在1640年代爱尔兰邦联战争中受损。1798年5月24日，约一千名起义者进攻内斯失败；1801年，这个自治市镇在爱尔兰议会的独立议席也被取消。

en:
This part of Ulster centres on Carrickfergus, the rock above Belfast Lough where John de Courcy built his castle in 1177 as the seat of the Anglo-Norman Earldom of Ulster. Hugh de Lacy strengthened the castle after taking de Courcy's lands, and in 1210 King John brought it under royal authority. Edward Bruce captured the town in 1315 and the castle in 1316, and Scottish forces destroyed much of the town in 1402. After the earldom collapsed, Carrickfergus remained the only English outpost in Ulster, while the Clandeboye O'Neills held the Gaelic countryside to the south and west. In 1444 its Catholic townsmen and garrison lived by the castle's command of the lough, surrounded by cattle lords only intermittently obedient to Dublin.

Elizabethan attempts to colonise the region met plague, factional war, and rebellion. The Earl of Essex's settlement of 1573 was decimated by disease, and in 1574 his men seized Brian McPhelim O'Neill, who was hanged in Dublin. In November 1597 the MacDonnells defeated crown troops near Carrickfergus, before Sir Arthur Chichester took charge in 1599, settled English and Scots, and rebuilt the town walls. Covenanter chaplains formed Ireland's first presbytery there in 1642. The castle held out for James II until 28 August 1689, and William of Orange landed at Carrickfergus on 14 June 1690. François Thurot's French squadron captured and ransomed the town in February 1760. John Paul Jones defeated HMS Drake in the North Channel in 1778, and the United Irishmen William Orr and Henry Joy McCracken were hanged and captured nearby in 1797 and 1798.
zh:
阿尔斯特这一地区以卡里克弗格斯为中心。这座扼守贝尔法斯特湾的岩堡由约翰·德·库西于1177年兴建，作为诺曼人阿尔斯特伯国的统治中心。休·德·莱西夺取库西领地后加固城堡，1210年约翰王又将其置于王室直接管辖之下。爱德华·布鲁斯1315年攻占城镇、1316年夺取城堡；1402年苏格兰军队又摧毁了大片城区。阿尔斯特伯国崩溃后，卡里克弗格斯成为英格兰在阿尔斯特仅存的据点，而南部和西部的盖尔乡村则由克兰德博伊奥尼尔家族控制。1444年，城中的天主教居民与驻军依托城堡控制海湾，周围的畜牧首领却只是偶尔听命于都柏林。

伊丽莎白时代对这一地区的殖民遭遇了瘟疫、派系战争和反叛。埃塞克斯伯爵1573年的定居点被疫病削弱，1574年他的部下又擒获布莱恩·麦克费林·奥尼尔，并将其送往都柏林处死。1597年11月，麦克唐奈家族在卡里克弗格斯附近击败王军；1599年阿瑟·奇切斯特爵士接管此地，迁入英格兰和苏格兰移民并重修城墙。1642年，誓约派随军牧师在此建立爱尔兰第一个长老会区。城堡为詹姆斯二世坚守至1689年8月28日，奥兰治的威廉则于1690年6月14日在卡里克弗格斯登陆。1760年2月，弗朗索瓦·蒂罗的法国分舰队攻占城镇并勒索赎金。1778年，约翰·保罗·琼斯在北海峡击败「德雷克号」；1797年和1798年，爱尔兰人联合会成员威廉·奥尔被处绞刑，亨利·乔伊·麦克拉肯则在城郊被捕。

en:
Russian historians often identify Shenkursk with Chudin, a place named in a charter issued in 1137 by Prince Sviatoslav Olgovich of Novgorod for the collection of dues. In 1315 the Novgorod posadnik Svoezemtsev bought the Shenkursk pogost on the Vaga, and later lists of Russian towns knew the settlement as the town on the Vaga. In 1444 it was an Orthodox Novgorodian river outpost in the fur-bearing northern forest, small but useful to merchants travelling between the Dvina lands and Novgorod's markets.

In 1446 the settlement was recorded as the posad of Shenkurye, and in 1475–1477 two of its men petitioned Ivan III during his campaigns against Novgorod. Ivan the Terrible made Vaga an oprichnina town in 1565. From 1586 Boris Godunov held it as a feeding grant, and in 1602 he willed it to Johann of Schleswig-Holstein, betrothed to Tsarevna Xenia; the duke's death left the settlement to the Romanov tsars. Its hill fort, listed among the Vaga towns in 1606, had a church, a voivode's court, twenty-nine shops and fifty-nine posad households. Local merchants helped pay for a new wooden fortress built in 1640–1643. Shenkursk passed into Archangelgorod Governorate in 1708 and became the seat of Shenkursky Uyezd in 1780.
zh:
俄罗斯史家多把申库尔斯克比定为丘金；1137年，诺夫哥罗德王公斯维亚托斯拉夫·奥利戈维奇颁给圣索菲亚大教堂的征税宪章提到了这个地点。1315年，诺夫哥罗德地方长官斯沃耶泽姆采夫买下瓦加河畔的申库尔斯克乡，后来的罗斯城镇名录则把这里称作「瓦加河畔城」。1444年，它是诺夫哥罗德在北方毛皮森林中的一座东正教河滨据点，规模不大，却便于商人往来德维纳地区与诺夫哥罗德市场。

1446年，这里被记为申库里耶城郊；1475—1477年伊凡三世进军诺夫哥罗德期间，两名申库尔斯克人曾向他陈诉当地官员。1565年，伊凡雷帝将瓦加划入特辖区。1586年起，鲍里斯·戈东诺夫以食禄方式领有此地，1602年又在遗嘱中把它留给与公主克谢尼娅订婚的石勒苏益格—荷尔斯泰因公爵汉斯；公爵不久身死，申库尔斯克随后归于罗曼诺夫王朝。1606年的记载显示，申格—库里耶山上的木堡内有教堂、督军庭院和二十九间商铺，城郊有五十九户住家。当地商人出资协助，在1640—1643年建起一座新木堡。1708年，申库尔斯克划入阿尔汉格尔哥罗德省，1780年成为申库尔斯克县治。

en:
Pirkanmaa, Swedish Birkaland, is the lake district of the Kokemäenjoki watershed around Pyhäjärvi and the future site of Tampere. By the 8th century the Finnish belt of peasant settlement reached here from Satakunta, and by the 11th century farms were concentrated along the river and the lake. In the 14th century the country belonged to Upper Satakunta and was administered through the vast medieval parish of Suur-Pirkkala. A wooden chapel was built at Messukylä in 1434, and the place was first named in documents in 1439. In 1444 it was a thinly settled Catholic Swedish inland country of scattered farms, lakes, hunting grounds and fur routes, with no town of its own.

Great Pirkkala gradually gave birth to new parishes: Ruovesi separated in 1576 and Messukylä became an independent parish in 1636, its stone church having been built about 1510-1530. The Otavala spinning school of 1759-1767 taught flax working and pointed toward the textile economy to come. The decisive change came in 1779, when Gustav III founded Tampere within Messukylä; in 1821 the new town was still small, and the mills that would make it Finland's leading industrial centre lay in the future.
zh:
皮尔卡（芬兰语称皮尔坎马，瑞典语名比克兰）是科凯迈基河流域的湖区，环绕皮海耶尔维湖和后来坦佩雷所在之地。到8世纪，芬兰农民定居带已从萨塔昆塔延伸至此，11世纪时农田集中在河流与湖畔。14世纪时，这里属于上萨塔昆塔，由广阔的中世纪大皮尔卡拉教区统辖。梅苏屈莱1434年建起木堂，1439年首次在文献中得名。1444年，这里是天主教瑞典治下人口稀少的内陆，散布着农场、湖泊、猎场和毛皮商路，还没有自己的城市。

大皮尔卡拉逐渐分出新教区：鲁奥韦西于1576年分出，梅苏屈莱则在1636年成为独立教区，其石堂约建于1510年至1530年。1759年至1767年的奥塔瓦拉纺纱学校教授亚麻加工，预示了后来的纺织经济。决定性变化发生在1779年，古斯塔夫三世在梅苏屈莱境内设立坦佩雷；1821年时这座新城仍然不大，使它日后成为芬兰首要工业中心的工厂群此时尚未出现。

en:
This Karelian district covers the forests and long shorelines around Lake Pielinen, with Lieksa standing on the river that leaves the lake. The Treaty of Nöteborg in 1323 divided Karelia between Sweden and Novgorod and placed the Pielinen country in Novgorod's sphere. Under Novgorodian rule, permanent Karelian occupation took root as families moved north from southern Karelia to hunting grounds they already knew; the villages of Lieksa and Viensuu are named only from the late fifteenth century. In 1444 the province was therefore a sparse Orthodox Karelian wilderness of trappers, fishermen and river routes, bound to Novgorod rather than organized around a town.

The Treaty of Teusina in 1595 left Pielisjärvi in Moscow's sphere, but the Peace of Stolbovo transferred it to Sweden in 1617, when it became part of Käkisalmi County; Savonian settlers then opened slash-and-burn fields. A Karelian chief, Luka Räsänen, had fought through the Russian-Swedish border wars of the preceding century. In 1653 Count Per Brahe founded Brahea at the Lieksanjoki mouth to support White Sea trade. During the war of 1656–1658 the little town received a log sconce; it later had an Orthodox chapel, a school from 1663, a Lutheran church completed in 1667, and at most about 350 inhabitants. Brahea was abolished in 1681 and razed in 1685. Famine, tax farmers and the Great Wrath brought further disorder and years of Russian occupation, while the Treaty of Nystad fixed the frontier in 1721. A district judge used the name North Karelia in 1767.
zh:
这个卡累利阿省份涵盖皮耶利宁湖周围的森林与漫长湖岸，列克萨位于湖水流出的河畔。1323年的《奥列霍夫和约》在瑞典与诺夫哥罗德之间瓜分卡累利阿，皮耶利宁地区被划入诺夫哥罗德势力范围。诺夫哥罗德统治期间，卡累利阿人逐渐在此建立永久聚落，一些家庭从南卡累利阿北上，来到他们早已熟悉的猎场；列克萨、维恩苏等村落直到15世纪末才有名称可考。因此在1444年，这里还是一片人烟稀少的东正教卡累利阿荒野，居民以捕猎、捕鱼和利用水路为生，归属诺夫哥罗德，却尚未形成城镇。

1595年《佳夫津条约》仍把皮耶利斯耶尔维留在莫斯科势力范围内，但1617年《斯托尔博沃和约》将其割予瑞典，归入卡基萨尔米省；萨沃拉移民随后前来开辟刀耕火种的田地。卡累利阿首领卢卡·雷萨宁曾在上一世纪的俄瑞边境战争中作战。1653年，佩尔·布拉赫伯爵在列克萨河口建立布拉海亚城，以支持白海贸易。1656至1658年战争期间，这座小城修建了木栅要塞；城中后来设有东正教小祈祷所，1663年开办学校，1667年建成路德宗教堂，人口最多时约350人。布拉海亚于1681年被撤销，1685年遭拆毁。饥荒、包税人和大愤怒时期又带来动荡，并使俄军一度占据多年；1721年《尼斯塔德和约》确定了边界。1767年，一名地区法官已使用「北卡累利阿」这一名称。

en:
Szolnok stands where the Zagyva runs into the Tisza, the chief crossing of the central Great Plain. First recorded as Zounok in a charter of King Géza I in 1075, it was a market town and the place where the salt brought from Transylvania was distributed up and down the river. The Mongols destroyed it in 1241, and it recovered slowly; King Sigismund freed it from the thirtieth tax in 1422 and from customs in 1429, after which the quays, ferries and cattle trade drew fresh life. In 1444 Szolnok was a modest Hungarian market town of fishermen, boatmen and graziers under the crown of Hungary.

After the fall of Timișoara, Szolnok and Eger were the only two fortresses covering the north of the plain, so in 1550–51 Ferdinand I had its earthworks rebuilt under István Dobó and gave the command to Lőrinc Nyáry with 1,400 men and 24 cannon. On 2 September 1552 Ahmed Pasha appeared with 40,000 men; the mercenaries deserted within two nights and the castle fell, though the Turks were later repulsed at Eger. In 1553 Szolnok became a sanjak, and in 1562 the Ottomans built here the first permanent bridge over the Tisza. Habsburg troops retook it in 1685 and Antonio Caraffa rebuilt the fortress, but Imre Thököly burned it in 1697 and the Rákóczi wars razed the town again, the castle being fired by its own garrison in 1706.
zh:
索尔诺克位于佐吉沃河注入蒂萨河处，是匈牙利大平原中部最重要的渡口。它在1075年盖佐一世国王的一份特许状中以Zounok之名首见记载，是一座集镇，也是特兰西瓦尼亚所产之盐沿河道分销上下游的集散地。1241年蒙古人将其摧毁，恢复十分缓慢；西吉斯蒙德国王1422年免除其三十分之一税、1429年又免除关税，码头、渡口和牲口贸易才重新兴旺。1444年的索尔诺克是匈牙利王冠治下一座不大的集镇，居民以渔夫、船户和牧人为主。

蒂米什瓦拉陷落后，索尔诺克与埃格尔成了屏蔽大平原北部仅有的两座要塞。1550—1551年，斐迪南一世命伊什特万·多博主持加固其土木工事，由勒林茨·尼亚里率一千四百名守军、配二十四门大炮据守。1552年9月2日，艾哈迈德帕夏率四万大军兵临城下，雇佣军两夜之内逃散，要塞遂告失守——不过土耳其人随后在埃格尔被击退。1553年索尔诺克成为桑贾克驻地，1562年奥斯曼人在此建起蒂萨河上第一座常设桥梁。1685年哈布斯堡军队夺回此城，安东尼奥·卡拉法重修要塞；但1697年特克伊·伊姆雷将其焚毁，拉科齐战争中城镇再遭兵燹，要塞又于1706年被己方守军纵火破坏。

en:
Bács is the old stronghold of the southern flats between the Danube and the Tisza, the water-girdled town from which the whole of Bačka takes its name. A Slavic fort stood here before the Hungarian conquest, and Bács became one of the earliest county seats, with a comes recorded in 1074. In the 1080s King Ladislaus I moved the archiepiscopal chapter of Kalocsa here and raised a cathedral (the see soon returned to Kalocsa, though its prelates kept the double title of Kalocsa-Bács). The Arab geographer al-Idrisi in 1154 found a rich town of merchants and craftsmen, a land of wheat, and Charles Robert later strengthened its walls; the great cathedral burned in 1351. In 1444 Bács is a prosperous market and fortress of the southern marches, whose open pastures carry the great herds of the Hungarian plain, while the chain of border forts alone holds back the Ottoman advance.

Matthias Corvinus and Vladislaus II numbered Bács among their favourite residences, and national diets met within its walls. After Mohács the fortress, long defended by the Serbian despot Stevan Berislavić, fell to the Ottomans in October 1526; Bács became the seat of a kaza in the sanjak of Szeged, most of the old Hungarian population fled, Serbs moved into the empty villages, and a short-lived Serbian rising ran through the region in 1526-27. The Habsburgs retook the town in 1687, but Ottoman power was expelled from Bačka only after Prince Eugene's victory at Zenta in 1697 and the peace of Karlowitz in 1699, the eastern flats going to the Military Frontier. Serbian refugees led by Patriarch Arsenije Čarnojević had crossed the Danube in 1690, yet the census of 1715 still found Serbs, Bunjevci and Šokci making up 97 per cent of the people. Vienna then opened the country to settlers: Hungarians from the 1730s, then Slovaks and Catholic Germans, the future Danube Swabians, so that by 1800 they formed roughly half the population. Rákóczi's kuruc stormed and burned the old fortress on 8 July 1704; it was never rebuilt, and in 1802 the two counties were joined into Bács-Bodrog.
zh:
巴奇是多瑙河与蒂萨河南部冲积平原上的旧重镇，这座被水道环绕的城镇便是整个巴奇卡（Bačka）得名的由来。匈牙利人到来之前这里已有一座斯拉夫人的堡垒，立国之后巴奇成为最早的州治之一，1074年已有伯爵的记载。1080年代，国王拉斯洛一世把考洛乔总主教的教士团迁来并营建主教座堂（教座不久迁回考洛乔，但此后的总主教一直使用「考洛乔—巴奇」的双名）。阿拉伯地理学家伊德里西1154年见到的巴奇是座富商与工匠云集、小麦丰足的城市，查理一世后来又加固了城防；宏伟的主教座堂于1351年焚毁。1444年的巴奇是南部边地上一座富庶的集市与要塞，开阔草场上牧放着匈牙利平原的大群牛马，唯有南方的要塞链阻挡着奥斯曼人的推进。

匈雅提·马加什和乌拉斯洛二世都把巴奇列为喜爱的驻跸之地，国会也多次在此召开。莫哈奇战役之后，由塞尔维亚专制公斯特万·贝里斯拉维奇长期坚守的城堡于1526年10月落入奥斯曼之手；巴奇成为塞格德桑贾克名下的一个卡扎，旧匈牙利居民大多逃散，塞尔维亚人迁入空出的村庄，1526至1527年一场短暂的塞尔维亚人起义还曾席卷此地。哈布斯堡军队1687年收复巴奇，但奥斯曼势力要到1697年欧根亲王在森塔大捷、1699年《卡尔洛夫齐和约》签订后才被完全逐出巴奇卡，东部平原则被划入军事边区。1690年，总主教阿尔塞尼耶·查尔诺耶维奇已率塞尔维亚难民渡过多瑙河，而1715年的普查显示，塞尔维亚人、布涅夫齐人和绍克齐人仍占当地人口的97%。此后维也纳大举招民垦殖：匈牙利人从1730年代起迁入，斯洛伐克人和信奉天主教的德意志人（后来的多瑙河士瓦本人）接踵而至，到1800年前后已约占人口的一半。1704年7月8日，拉科齐的库鲁茨军攻克并焚毁旧城堡，城堡再未修复；1802年，巴奇与博德罗格两州合并为巴奇—博德罗格州。

en:
Turda stands on the Arieș River in northern Transylvania, above the salt deposits of ancient Potaissa. The Dacian and Roman settlement already drew wealth from nearby salt workings, and after the Hungarian conquest the mines at Castrum Turda were granted to Benedictine monks in 1075. Mongol raiders destroyed much of the town in 1241–42, though many inhabitants survived in the surrounding caves and royal privileges helped the settlement recover. The first assembly of Transylvanian nobles met there in 1288, and people from the Turda district joined the Bobâlna peasant rising in 1437. In 1444 Turda was a Hungarian market town and salt centre, its roads and estates shared by Hungarian lords, Saxon settlers and Orthodox Romanian villagers.

Matthias Corvinus held a Hungarian Diet at Turda in 1467. In 1514 Turda salt workers joined György Dózsa's peasant revolt. After the Battle of Mohács the town passed to the Eastern Hungarian Kingdom, and in 1570 to the Principality of Transylvania. The Diet's Edict of Torda in 1568 gave rare European protection to Catholic, Lutheran, Calvinist and Unitarian worship, while Orthodoxy remained a tolerated faith. Michael the Brave, who had briefly united Wallachia, Transylvania and Moldavia, was killed nearby in 1601. Princes Gabriel Báthory and Gabriel Bethlen later confirmed the town's privileges. After the 1711 Peace of Szatmár, rebels used Turda Gorge against Habsburg rule in 1712. Joseph II's tolerance edict of 1781 eased Orthodox and Protestant worship, a Romanian school opened in 1782–84, and Turda salt workers joined the Horea, Cloșca and Crișan revolt in 1784.
zh:
图尔达位于北特兰西瓦尼亚的阿列什河畔，地下是古代波泰萨的盐层。达契亚与罗马时代的聚落已靠附近盐场致富，匈牙利征服后，卡斯楚姆·图尔达的盐矿在1075年被赐给本笃会修士。1241—1242年，蒙古入侵者摧毁了城镇大半，许多居民躲入周围洞穴幸存，王室特权随后帮助聚落复苏。1288年，特兰西瓦尼亚贵族的首次集会在此召开；1437年，图尔达一带的人参加伯伯尔纳农民起义。1444年，图尔达是匈牙利治下的集镇和盐业中心，匈牙利贵族、萨克森移民与信奉东正教的罗马尼亚乡民共用这里的道路和庄园。

1467年，马加什·科尔温在图尔达召开匈牙利议会。1514年，图尔达盐工加入哲尔吉·多扎领导的农民战争。摩哈赤之战后，城镇归入东匈牙利王国，1570年成为特兰西瓦尼亚公国的一部分。1568年，图尔达议会颁布《图尔达敕令》，罕见地保护天主教、路德宗、加尔文宗和一位论派的崇拜，东正教则作为被宽容的信仰保留下来。1601年，曾短暂统一瓦拉几亚、特兰西瓦尼亚和摩尔达维亚的勇敢的米哈伊在附近被杀。后来的公侯加布里埃尔·巴托里和加布里埃尔·拜特伦都确认过城市特权。1711年《索特马尔和约》后，反抗者在1712年以图尔达峡谷为据点抵抗哈布斯堡统治。约瑟夫二世1781年的宽容敕令放宽了东正教和新教信仰，罗马尼亚语学校在1782—1784年开办，图尔达盐工则在1784年参加霍雷亚、克洛什卡和克里尚起义。

en:
The King's Land (Hungarian Királyföld, German Königsboden) is the free Saxon country of southern Transylvania, a band of walled towns and fortified villages between the Olt and the Târnava, with Hermannstadt — Nagyszeben, now Sibiu — at its head. German settlers from the Rhine and Moselle lands were planted here under King Géza II in the mid-twelfth century, and the Diploma Andreanum of 1224 confirmed their autonomy: their own seats and judges, a single tax paid to the crown, no Hungarian lord within their borders. By 1376 the craftsmen of Hermannstadt worked in nineteen guilds, and the town led the seven Saxon cities that gave Transylvania its German name of Siebenbürgen. In 1438 its burghers held out against Sultan Murad II's great raid, and in March 1442 John Hunyadi, regrouping beneath its walls, routed the akinji raiders of Mezid Bey and killed their commander. In 1444 the King's Land is the richest and most self-governing corner of the Hungarian realm, still Catholic, living by its cloth and the southern trade.

In 1493 the town militia led by Mayor Georg Hecht defeated an Ottoman force at the Red Tower Pass. The Saxons went over to Luther almost to a man under the influence of Johannes Honterus: a Lutheran catechism printed at Hermannstadt in 1544 was among the first books in Romanian, and in 1551 Conrad Haas, commander of the town arsenal, carried out the first known rocket experiments there. Their common affairs were run by the Saxon University, one of the three nations of the Transylvanian Union. After the Habsburg takeover Hermannstadt became capital of the Principality of Transylvania in 1692, holding the seat until 1791, and entered its baroque age: Samuel von Brukenthal built his palace and opened its collections to the public in 1817, and Protestant Landlers exiled from Upper Austria were settled in the surrounding country. Learning throve as well — Franz-Joseph Müller von Reichenstein discovered the element tellurium here in 1782, and Martin Hochmeister opened a permanent theatre in 1788 — but the old privileges bred resentment: in 1703 Mayor Johann Sachs von Harteneck was beheaded for protesting that the Saxons, a tenth of Transylvania's people, paid three fifths of its taxes.
zh:
国王属地（匈牙利语 Királyföld，德语 Königsboden）是特兰西瓦尼亚南部撒克逊人的自由之乡：奥尔特河与塔尔纳瓦河之间散布着高墙城镇和设防的教堂村庄，为首的是赫尔曼施塔特（德语名 Hermannstadt，匈牙利语名 Nagyszeben，今罗马尼亚锡比乌）。12世纪中叶，匈牙利国王盖萨二世从莱茵兰和摩泽尔地区迁来德意志移民；1224年的《安德烈诏书》确认了他们的自治权——自组辖区、自选法官，只向国王缴纳一份税，匈牙利贵族不得入境置产。到1376年，赫尔曼施塔特的工匠已分属十九个行会，这座城市位列撒克逊七城之首，特兰西瓦尼亚的德语名「七堡之地」便由此而来。1438年，市民死守城池，令穆拉德二世苏丹亲率的大袭掠军伤亡惨重；1442年3月，匈雅提·亚诺什在城墙下重整军队，击溃梅齐德贝伊的阿金基轻骑并阵斩其帅。1444年的国王属地是匈牙利王国境内最富庶、自治最充分的一隅，居民仍奉天主教，靠呢绒织造和通往南方的商路致富。

1493年，市长格奥尔格·赫希特率领的城市民兵在红塔关口击败一支奥斯曼军队。宗教改革中，受霍特鲁斯影响，撒克逊人几乎整体皈依路德宗：1544年赫尔曼施塔特印出路德宗《教理问答》，属最早的罗马尼亚语印本书之一；1551年，城市兵工厂长官康拉德·哈斯在此进行了已知最早的火箭试验。撒克逊人的公共事务由「撒克逊人社群议事会」（Universitas Saxonum）主持，它是特兰西瓦尼亚「三民族联盟」中的一方。1692年哈布斯堡接掌特兰西瓦尼亚后，赫尔曼施塔特成为特兰西瓦尼亚公国首都（直至1791年），进入巴洛克鼎盛期：萨穆埃尔·冯·布鲁肯陶尔修建府邸，并于1817年将其藏品向公众开放；从上奥地利流亡来的新教兰德勒人被安置在城郊一带。学术也很兴盛——1782年弗朗茨·约瑟夫·米勒·冯·赖兴施泰因在此发现碲元素，1788年马丁·霍赫迈斯特开办常设剧院；但旧特权也招来嫉恨：1703年，市长约翰·扎克·冯·哈滕内克因抗议「撒克逊人只占特兰西瓦尼亚人口十分之一，却缴纳六成赋税」而被斩首。

en:
Ust-Vym, Yemdin in Komi, stands where the Vym enters the Vychegda in the old Perm lands. Beside a Komi shrine, Stephen of Perm built a wooden Church of the Annunciation in 1380, founded the monastery that grew around it, and in 1383 became head of the new Perm diocese with his seat at Ust-Vym. The Old Permic alphabet he devised gave the Komi their first church literature. A Mansi band under the captain Pam came down the Vychegda and besieged the town in 1392, but withdrew at news of Ustyug's men. In 1444 Ust-Vym was therefore the Orthodox bishopric and missionary centre of the fur-bearing Komi country, still close to a raiding frontier.

The Perm bishops governed an enormous diocese reaching toward the Urals and often acted as Muscovy's agents there. In 1492 Ivan III attached Vologda and former Novgorod lands to the diocese, shifting its centre of gravity westward; in 1589 the cathedral was moved to Vologda and the bishops took the style of Vologda and Great Perm. The Book of the Great Map in 1627 still located the Vym's mouth beneath the town of Old Perm. The monastic community, much reduced after the departure of the see, was revived in the 1680s, and a separate Veliky Ustyug and Ust-Vym diocese was formed in 1682. Catherine II's secularisation closed the ancient Michael-Arkhangelsk Monastery in 1764, leaving Ust-Vym as a riverside parish and trading village.
zh:
乌斯季维姆在科米语中称叶姆丁，位于旧彼尔姆土地上维姆河注入维切格达河之处。1380年，彼尔姆的斯特凡在科米人的神龛旁建起木制报喜教堂，并在周围建立修道院；1383年，新的彼尔姆教区成立，他成为主教，座堂就设在乌斯季维姆。他创造的古彼尔姆文字使科米人第一次有了教会书面语。1392年，百人长帕姆率领曼西人沿维切格达河而下围攻此城，听说乌斯秋格援军可能逼近后才撤退。因此到1444年，乌斯季维姆已是东正教彼尔姆教区的主教驻地和科米毛皮之地的传教中心，却仍紧邻容易遭袭的边地。

彼尔姆主教管辖着远及乌拉尔山的广阔教区，也常替莫斯科处理当地事务。1492年，伊凡三世把沃洛格达和原诺夫哥罗德土地并入该教区，使教权重心向西移动；1589年，主教座堂正式迁往沃洛格达，主教改称沃洛格达和大彼尔姆主教。1627年的《大地图册》仍把维姆河口标在旧彼尔姆城之下。座堂迁走后，修道院长期衰微，到1680年代才恢复；1682年，独立的大乌斯秋格与乌斯季维姆教区成立。1764年，叶卡捷琳娜二世推行教会地产世俗化，古老的米哈伊洛-阿尔汉格尔斯克修道院被关闭，乌斯季维姆此后只是河畔教区和贸易村落。

en:
Somerset runs from the Avon valley and the Mendips to the wet Levels beside the Bristol Channel. Bath began as Roman Aquae Sulis around its hot springs; after Roman rule the baths silted, but a walled medieval town survived around the Benedictine abbey whose church had once served as a bishop's seat. Much of the shire's wealth came from sheep and wool: Frome, south of Bath, grew with the wool and cloth trade, while Glastonbury and Wells made the Church a great local landlord. In 1444 the old abbey church at Bath was sliding into disrepair, yet the Catholic English town remained the natural market for north-eastern Somerset, close to flocks and roads toward Bristol.

Oliver King, Bishop of Bath and Wells, found the abbey ruined in 1499 and ordered its Perpendicular rebuilding from 1500; the new church was completed shortly before the priory surrendered in 1539, and Elizabeth I later backed its repair as Bath's parish church. The springs also revived: a royal charter confirmed city status in 1590, Anne of Denmark took the waters in 1613, and Thomas Guidott's 1676 treatise advertised them to the English aristocracy. The Battle of Lansdowne in 1643 left Bath in Royalist hands for two years, while Thomas Fairfax's victory at Langport on 10 July 1645 broke the last Royalist field army in the West. On 6 July 1685 James II's forces defeated the Duke of Monmouth on Sedgemoor. Under Beau Nash and the two John Woods, eighteenth-century Bath became the limestone spa town of pump rooms, assemblies, crescents and polite society.
zh:
萨默塞特从埃文河谷和门迪普丘陵，延伸到布里斯托尔湾旁湿润的萨默塞特平原。巴斯最初是温泉旁的罗马城镇阿奎埃·苏利斯；罗马统治结束后浴场淤塞，但一座有城墙的中世纪城镇仍围绕本笃会修道院存续，修道院教堂还曾担任主教座堂。郡中大量财富来自绵羊和羊毛：巴斯以南的弗罗姆靠毛纺织业兴起，格拉斯顿伯里和韦尔斯则使教会成为当地的大地主。1444年，巴斯古老的修道院教堂已日渐失修，但这座信奉天主教的英格兰城镇仍是萨默塞特东北部的天然集市，靠近牧场和通往布里斯托尔的道路。

1499年，巴斯暨韦尔斯主教奥利弗·金发现修道院已成废墟，1500年下令按垂直哥特风格重建；新教堂刚建成不久，修道院便在1539年解散，伊丽莎白一世后来支持把它修复为巴斯教区教堂。城中温泉也重新兴盛：1590年王家特许状确认城市地位，丹麦的安妮1613年来此沐浴，托马斯·吉多特1676年的论著又把泉水疗效介绍给英格兰贵族。1643年的兰斯当战役后，巴斯被王党占据两年；1645年7月10日，托马斯·费尔法克斯在兰波特获胜，摧破王党在西部最后一支野战军。1685年7月6日，詹姆士二世的军队在塞奇穆尔击败蒙茅斯公爵。18世纪，在博·纳什和约翰·伍德父子主持下，巴斯成为以泵房、集会厅和新月形宅邸闻名的温泉石灰岩名城。

en:
This is the far north of Honshū, the snowy Nukanobu country beyond the Ōu range. It was long the Emishi frontier: the Koromo River once marked the edge of the Kyoto court's world, and around 1100 Fujiwara no Kiyohira built Hiraizumi there, where Chūson-ji and its gilded Konjiki-dō graced a capital of Ōshū that could be set beside Kyoto, until Minamoto no Yoritomo destroyed the Northern Fujiwara in 1189. The Nanbu house held that it won Nukanobu in that very campaign, and it certainly came to hold the nine fortified horse ranches numbered from Ichinohe to Kunohe, whose warhorses made the clan's fortune. By 1444 the main Nanbu line, seated at Sannohe, ruled these northern marches as one of the oldest warrior houses of the east.

At the Odawara campaign of 1590 Nanbu Nobunao had his seven districts confirmed by Hideyoshi, and in 1591 the rising of his kinsman Kunohe Masazane was crushed by Hideyoshi's armies. The three western districts had already fallen to the renegade Nanbu retainer Ōura Tamenobu, now confirmed as lord of Tsugaru, and Waga and Hienuki were added to the Nanbu in compensation. In 1592 the clan began the castle town of Morioka as its new centre and entered the Edo order as a 100,000-koku domain. In 1659 master casters were brought to Morioka to work the fine local sand iron, beginning the celebrated Nanbu ironware, and in 1664 a cadet line was enfeoffed at Hachinohe. Warhorses, gold dust and the river trade down the Kitakami sustained a domain dogged by frequent famines, and in 1689 Bashō stood amid the summer grasses of ruined Hiraizumi and wrote of the warriors whose dreams had passed away.
zh:
这里是本州的极北之地，奥羽山脉之外冰雪覆盖的糠部原野。此地长期是虾夷人的边陲，衣川曾是京都朝廷势力所及的尽头；约1100年藤原清衡在平泉建立据点，中尊寺与金光璀璨的金色堂装点出一座堪与京都比肩的奥州之都，直到1189年源赖朝攻灭奥州藤原氏。南部家自称在同年的奥州合战中因军功得到糠部，后来确实领有从一户到九户的九座牧马栅，靠供应战马起家致富。到1444年，世代以三户为居城的南部宗家，已是东国最古老的武家之一，统治着这片北方边境。

1590年小田原征伐时，南部信直的七郡领地得到秀吉承认；1591年，同族九户政实的叛乱被秀吉的大军镇压。西部三郡此前已落入叛离的南部家臣大浦为信之手——他被确认为津轻领主，幕府便将和贺、稗贯两郡补偿给南部氏。1592年，南部氏开始营建以盛冈城为中心的城下町，作为新的统治中心，并以十万石列入江户诸藩。1659年，盛冈招来铸物师，用当地优质砂铁制作铁瓶，南部铁器由此成名；1664年，一门旁支受封八户。良马、砂金和北上川的舟运，支撑着这个屡遭饥荒的藩国。1689年，松尾芭蕉站在平泉废墟的夏草之间，写下了武士功名如梦的名句。

en:
Dithmarschen is the low North Sea country between the Eider and the Elbe, where diked marsh parishes meet inland geest. Meldorf, with the old parish church later called the Meldorf Dom, was the chief place. During the fourteenth century, local thing assemblies grew into a confederation of parishes. Bremen's overlordship remained loose, and no noble manorial system took root as it did in Holstein; peasant forces beat off Holstein invasions in 1319 and again in 1403-1404. In 1444 the Catholic, Lower Saxon-speaking farmers of Meldorf, Heide and the coastal parishes still governed themselves through parish elders and wealthy farming families, their wealth resting on carefully drained marshland.

In 1447 Dithmarschen's land law was written down and a high court of 48 life-appointed judges was created. An alliance with Lübeck in 1468 opened trade with Livonia and other Baltic destinations under Hanseatic protection. On 17 February 1500 Wulf Isebrand opened the dikes and trapped the army of King Hans and the Black Guard on a flooded road near Hemmingstedt, destroying one of the largest forces sent against the peasants. Lutheranism, at first violently resisted, became the territorial church in 1533. In 1559 Johan Rantzau's army conquered Dithmarschen in the Last Feud, after which Frederick II, Adolf and John divided it into three shares. A revised land law followed in 1567 and Büsum was diked to the mainland in 1585. The Thirty Years' War, the Great Northern War and the Christmas flood of 1717 then damaged land and trade. The 1773 Treaty of Tsarskoye Selo placed all Dithmarschen under the Danish king as Duke of Holstein, and partitions of common land, enclosure and road reforms reshaped its farms.
zh:
迪特马尔申位于艾德河、易北河与北海之间，沿海是修筑堤坝的沼泽教区，内陆则是沙砾高地。首府梅尔多夫的古老教区教堂后来被称为梅尔多夫大教堂。14世纪时，本地庭会逐渐发展成教区联盟。不来梅大主教的宗主权始终松散，这里也没有像荷尔斯泰因那样形成贵族庄园制度；农民军队在1319年和1403—1404年两次击退荷尔斯泰因入侵。1444年，梅尔多夫、海德及沿海教区那些操下萨克森语、信奉天主教的农民仍由教区长老和富裕农户自治，财富来自精心排水开垦的沼泽农田。

1447年，《迪特马尔申领地法》成文，并设立由48名终身法官组成的高等法庭。1468年与吕贝克结盟后，本地在汉萨保护下开通了通往利沃尼亚和其他波罗的海地区的贸易。1500年2月17日，伍尔夫·伊塞布兰德掘开堤坝，把国王汉斯的军队和黑色卫队困在黑明施泰特附近被淹没的道路上，歼灭了来犯大军。宗教改革最初遭到激烈抵抗，但路德宗仍于1533年成为领地教会。1559年，约翰·兰曹的军队在「最后仇杀」中征服迪特马尔申，弗雷德里克二世、阿道夫和约翰随即将其分为三份。修订后的领地法于1567年施行，比苏姆也在1585年筑堤与大陆相连。此后三十年战争、大北方战争和1717年圣诞风暴潮相继破坏土地与贸易。1773年《沙皇村条约》后，全境归丹麦国王以荷尔斯泰因公爵身份统辖，公地划分、田块合并和道路改革随之改变了农庄面貌。

en:
Eastern Jutland runs from the broad bay of Aarhus to the Djursland peninsula, a fertile coast facing the Kattegat. Aarhus began as the Viking trading settlement of Aros in the late eighth century, where the Aarhus River met the sea; a church stood there around 900, a bishopric was created in 948, and Bishop Peder Vognsen founded the great brick cathedral in the late 1100s. To the north, Randers on the Gudenå won market privileges as early as 1302, and there in 1340 Niels Ebbesen slew Count Gerhard III of Holstein, a deed that helped shake off the German counts' rule of Denmark. Off Djursland, King Eric VI built Kalø Castle on a sea-girt islet in 1313 to bridle the Jutish nobility. In 1444 this was a firmly Catholic Danish province, its towns freshly confirmed in their rights—Christopher III had granted Aarhus its market charter only in 1441—living from grain, sea fisheries, shipbuilding and the Kattegat shipping lanes.

In 1518-19 King Christian II held the future Gustav Vasa of Sweden captive at Kalø until he escaped to Lübeck disguised as a peasant. During the Count's Feud of 1534-36, Skipper Clement's peasant rebels overran parts of Jutland and tried to storm Randers, until Christian III's forces crushed the rising and carried the Reformation through Denmark. Imperial troops raided eastern Jutland in 1627-29, and in the Torstenson War of 1643-45 Lennart Torstenson's Swedes occupied the peninsula and extorted ransom from Aarhus in 1644; Kalø was left a ruin, and the Peace of Brömsebro in 1645 sealed Denmark's defeat. Swedish armies occupied Aarhus again in 1657-59, and plague and fires darkened the rest of the century. Trade then revived: Randers gloves and Aarhus grain, some 36,000 barrels a year by the early eighteenth century, sold from Lübeck to Amsterdam, and in 1810 Aarhus enlarged its harbour for the growing traffic.
zh:
东日德兰从开阔的奥胡斯湾延伸到久斯兰半岛，是一片面朝卡特加特海峡的肥沃海岸。奥胡斯起源于8世纪末奥胡斯河入海口的维京商镇阿罗斯；约900年当地已有教堂，948年设立主教区，12世纪末当地主教动工兴建宏伟的砖石大教堂。北面古曾河畔的兰讷斯，1302年便获得市集特权；1340年，尼尔斯·埃布森在那里刺杀荷尔斯泰因伯爵格哈德三世，此举推动丹麦摆脱德意志伯爵的统治。久斯兰外海，埃里克六世1313年在一座海岛上修建卡勒城堡，用以钳制日德兰贵族。1444年的东日德兰是丹麦治下虔诚信奉天主教的省份，各市镇的特权刚获确认——克里斯托弗三世1441年才向奥胡斯颁发市集特许状，生计依赖谷物、海产、造船和卡特加特海峡的航路。

1518至1519年，丹麦国王克里斯蒂安二世把后来成为瑞典国王的古斯塔夫·瓦萨囚禁在卡勒城堡，他最终乔装农夫逃往吕贝克。1534至1536年伯爵战争期间，「船长」克莱门特的农民起义军席卷日德兰部分地区并试图攻打兰讷斯，最终被克里斯蒂安三世的军队镇压，宗教改革也随之推行到整个丹麦。1627至1629年，帝国军队袭扰东日德兰；1643至1645年的托尔斯滕森战争中，伦纳特·托尔斯滕森率领瑞典军队占领半岛，1644年向奥胡斯勒索赎金，卡勒城堡在战乱中沦为废墟，1645年的《布勒姆瑟布鲁条约》宣告丹麦战败。1657至1659年瑞典军队再度占领奥胡斯，瘟疫和火灾笼罩了这个世纪余下的岁月。此后贸易复兴：兰讷斯的手套和奥胡斯的谷物（18世纪初每年出口约三万六千桶）远销吕贝克至阿姆斯特丹，1810年奥胡斯扩建港口，以容纳日益繁忙的航运。

en:
Smålenene, the 'small fiefs', are the fertile coastal lowlands between the Glomma's mouth and the Swedish border, in old Vingulmark, the heart of medieval Viken. At the Sarpsfossen falls stood Borg, the town Saint Olaf founded in 1016, where the Borgarting made law for the fjord districts; on the Oslofjord the falls at Moss drove saws and mills, and Moss itself is named in the sources as a trading place in 1396. By 1444 this countryside had been parcelled into small fiefs held of Akershus, Catholic and Norwegian under the Kalmar Union, and its timber was already going out through the Glomma harbours.

In 1567, during the Northern Seven Years' War, Swedish troops burned Borg, and Frederick II founded Fredrikstad downstream the same year, which grew into a timber-exporting port girdled with fortifications from the 1660s. Inland, Basmo Fortress in Marker was approved in 1683 to watch the road in from Sweden. Moss received an ironworks in 1704 and its merchant-town charter in 1720. During Charles XII's first Norwegian campaign the town changed hands in two hard-fought battles in 1716, and its final loss forced the Swedes out of Christiania a week later. On 14 August 1814 the Convention of Moss was signed in the town, ending the Swedish-Norwegian war and settling Norway's personal union with Sweden.
zh:
斯末莱恩（Smålenene，意为「小封邑」）是格罗马河口与瑞典边境之间肥沃的沿海低地，古称维高麦（Vingulmark），是中世纪维肯的核心。圣奥拉夫于1016年建立的博格城坐落在萨尔普斯瀑布旁，博格庭（Borgarting）曾在此为峡湾诸郡立法；奥斯陆峡湾畔，莫斯的瀑布驱动着锯木场和磨坊，莫斯作为商埠在1396年的文献中已有记载。到1444年，这片乡野被划为隶属于阿克什胡斯的众多小封邑，居民是卡尔马联盟下信奉天主教的挪威人，木材已经从格罗马河各港运出。

北方七年战争期间，瑞典军队于1567年焚毁博格，弗雷德里克二世同年在下游另建腓特烈斯塔；该城后来发展为木材输出港，1660年代起筑起环城要塞。内陆方面，扼守瑞典入境道路的巴斯莫要塞于1683年获准在马克尔修建。莫斯1704年建起铁厂，1720年获得商镇特许状。1716年卡尔十二世第一次入侵挪威时，莫斯在两场恶战中易手，瑞典最终失守，一周后被迫撤出克里斯蒂安尼亚。1814年8月14日，《莫斯公约》在此签署，结束了瑞典-挪威战争，定下了挪威与瑞典结成共主邦联的安排。

en:
Bratsberg is the hill country behind the Skien fjord, the Grenland lowlands and the Telemark valleys, where the Skienselva drops through Skien at the head of navigation. Inland farmers and sea traders met there before the year 1000, dealing in furs and whetstones from the interior, and the Benedictine nunnery of Gimsøy Abbey was founded on the river island of Klosterøya around 1115. In the early 13th century the district became Skiensysla, covering Grenland, Telemark and Numedal, and in 1358 Haakon VI granted Skien its market charter; by the 15th century a council of twelve governed the town and Dutch merchants sailed up to its quay. In 1444, Catholic and part of the Norwegian kingdom within the Kalmar Union, Skien was the timber-and-plank town of the south.

At the Reformation of 1536 Gimsøy Abbey passed to the crown and burned in 1546; from 1539 Fossum Ironworks, Norway's oldest, worked local ore and gained its first blast furnace in 1625, while in 1546 the Saxon Hans Glaser struck the first Gimsøy daler on Klosterøya. Swedish troops reportedly burned the town during the Northern Seven Years' War, and great fires followed in 1583, 1732 and 1777. Log-driving from the 1600s made Skien the kingdom's leading timber port, crowded with English and Dutch buyers, and in 1663 the burgers bought the crown's 39 sawmills when Frederick III paid the lord of Bratsberg in land. As the land rose from the sea and the river shallowed, the outports of Porsgrunn, Brevik and Langesund drew the deep-water trade away through the 18th century.
zh:
布拉茨堡是希恩峡湾背后的丘陵地带，即格伦兰低地与泰勒马克诸谷地，希恩河在航运终点、希恩城旁跌下瀑布。公元1000年以前，内陆农民与海商便在此相会，买卖毛皮和内陆出产的磨刀石；约1115年，本笃会的吉姆瑟伊（Gimsøy）女修院在河中岛修道院岛建立。13世纪初，这一带设为希恩行政区（Skiensysla），统辖格伦兰、泰勒马克和努梅达尔；1358年哈康六世颁给希恩集市特许状，到15世纪该城已由十二人市政会治理，荷兰商人驾船直抵码头。1444年，信奉天主教、隶属卡尔马联盟中挪威王国的希恩，是南方的木材与板材之城。

1536年宗教改革中，吉姆瑟伊修院被收归王室，1546年毁于火灾；1539年投产的福苏姆（Fossum）铁厂是挪威最古老的铁厂，1625年建起第一座高炉；1546年，萨克森人汉斯·格拉泽在修道院岛铸出第一枚吉姆瑟伊塔勒银币。北方七年战争期间，瑞典军队据传曾焚毁该城，1583年、1732年和1777年又连遭大火。17世纪起，河道木材流放使希恩成为王国首屈一指的木材港，英国和荷兰买主云集；1663年，弗雷德里克三世以土地抵偿欠布拉茨堡封臣的债务，市民们买下了王室的39座锯木场。随着冰期后陆地抬升、河道变浅，整个18世纪里，深水海贸逐渐被波什格伦、布雷维克和朗厄松等外港夺走。

en:
Agdesiden is the old name for Norway's southern tip, the Skagerrak coast and hills between Lista and Nedenes — the medieval Egðafylki, once a petty kingdom of its own. There was no large town: people gathered in outer harbors such as Kleven by Vester-Risør, where German, Dutch and English ships waited for wind and loaded timber and salmon; King Erik of Pommern had granted the Vester-Risør men their salmon-trading rights at the end of the 1300s. Inland lay the forest parishes of Råbyggelaget. In 1444 Agdesiden was Norwegian land within the Kalmar Union, Catholic and under the diocese of Stavanger, ruled for the king by his officials.

In the 1500s water-powered sawmills turned the oak and pine forests into sawn timber for Scotland and Holland, and around 1585 one of Norway's first ironworks was built at Barbu near Arendal, working the rich ore of the Arendal field. Flekkerøy harbor was fortified as early as 1555. Vester-Risør, renamed Mandal in 1662, became a loading place in 1632, and on 5 July 1641 Christian IV founded Christianssand on the Otra, ordering the merchants of Agder to move into its regular grid; the town became a garrison in 1666 and received the bishop's seat from Stavanger in 1682. Arendal won full town rights in 1723 after paying dues to the new city for a century. In the Great Northern War prizes were already being condemned at Kristiansand in 1711–1713, and during the gunboat war of 1807–1814 the town outfitted some 70 privateers, which brought in about 300 captured ships. In 1814 Agdesiden followed Norway into the union with Sweden.
zh:
阿格德西登是挪威最南端的旧称，指利斯塔到内德内斯之间的斯卡格拉克海岸与丘陵，即中世纪曾为独立小王国的埃格扎菲尔基。这里没有大城市：居民聚居于韦斯特里瑟尔旁克莱文这样的外港，德意志、荷兰和英格兰的船只在此候风，装走木材和鲑鱼；14世纪末，波美拉尼亚的埃里克国王已授予韦斯特里瑟尔人鲑鱼贸易特权。内陆是罗比格勒格特的森林教区。1444年的阿格德西登是卡尔马联盟中的挪威土地，信奉天主教，属斯塔万格教区，由国王的官吏治理。

16世纪，水力锯木厂把橡木和松林加工成板材销往苏格兰与荷兰；约1585年，挪威最早的铁厂之一在阿伦达尔附近的巴尔布建立，开采阿伦达尔矿区的富矿。弗莱克岛港湾早在1555年就筑起堡垒。1632年韦斯特里瑟尔成为装卸港，1662年改名曼达尔；1641年7月5日，克里斯蒂安四世在奥特拉河畔建立克里斯蒂安桑，勒令阿格德商人迁入棋盘式布局的新城，该城1666年成为驻军城，1682年又从斯塔万格接来主教座。阿伦达尔向新城纳了一个世纪的捐后，于1723年争得完整市镇权。大北方战争期间，缴获的商船已于1711至1713年押到克里斯蒂安桑裁决；1807至1814年的炮舰战争中，仅该城就装备约70艘私掠船，押回约300艘战利品。1814年，阿格德西登随挪威并入与瑞典的联盟。

en:
Rostov lies on Lake Nero, in country once held by the Finnic Merya, and is one of Russia's oldest towns, first entered in the chronicles under 862. It headed the Rostov-Suzdal land until primacy passed to Vladimir, and in 1207 became the seat of its own princes, under whom the Dormition Cathedral was rebuilt between 1214 and 1231. The Mongols took it without a fight in 1238. Around 1328 the dwindling principality split into two shares, one of them soon subject to Moscow, whose Tatar-backed troops had already burned the town in 1317; a Rostov squadron fought at Kulikovo in 1380. On the Volga below it, Uglich, first mentioned in 1148, had been sold to Moscow by its princes in 1328 and was sacked by Tver in 1371. Thus in 1444 the old Rostov line still kept a diminished court under the eye of a Muscovite governor, while Uglich was a Moscow border town more than once burned by Lithuanians and Tatars.

In 1462 Ivan III granted Uglich to his brother Andrey the Great, whose red-brick palace was completed in 1481 and still stands; the last Rostov princes sold their remaining rights to Ivan in 1473–74. In the winter of 1550–51 Uglich carpenters built a wooden fortress in the forests, floated it down the Volga before Kazan, and it became the town of Sviyazhsk. On 15 May 1591 the eight-year-old Tsarevich Dmitry, Ivan the Terrible's last son, was found with his throat cut in the palace courtyard, the murder that opened the Time of Troubles; the bell that roused the town had its tongue and ear cut off, was whipped and exiled to Tobolsk. In 1608 the Tushino bands sacked Rostov and carried off Metropolitan Filaret, future patriarch and father of the first Romanov tsar, and Lisowski's and Sapieha's raiders returned in 1610–11. The Dutch engineer Jan Cornelius raised Rostov's earthen fortress in 1632–34, and from the 1660s Metropolitan Iona Sysoyevich built the walled bishop's court called the Rostov Kremlin, with its famous bell tower. Uglich raised the stone Church of St Demetrius on the Blood in 1692. Made an uyezd town in 1777, Rostov held a great annual fair into the 19th century and grew skilled in painted enamel, though the metropolitan see moved to Yaroslavl in 1788.
zh:
罗斯托夫坐落于涅罗湖畔，这片土地原属芬兰语族的梅里亚人；它是俄罗斯最古老的城镇之一，编年史在862年条下首次提到它。罗斯托夫曾是罗斯托夫—苏兹达尔地方的中心，直到首邑之位让给弗拉基米尔；1207年它成为独立王公的都城，1214至1231年间在本支王公治下重建了圣母升天大教堂。1238年蒙古人不战而下此城。约1328年，日益缩小的公国分裂为两份，其中一份很快受制于莫斯科——而早在1317年，莫斯科借助鞑靼骑兵的军队就已焚毁过此城；1380年，罗斯托夫的队伍参加了库利科沃之战。在伏尔加河下游，首见于1148年记载的乌格利奇已于1328年被当地王公卖给莫斯科，1371年又遭特维尔洗劫。因此到1444年，古老的罗斯托夫王族仍在莫斯科派驻总督的眼皮底下守着缩小的宫廷，而乌格利奇是一座多次被立陶宛人和鞑靼人焚毁的莫斯科边境城镇。

1462年，伊凡三世把乌格利奇封给弟弟「大安德烈」，他的红砖宫苑1481年落成，历经五百余年仍在；罗斯托夫末代王公则在1473至1474年把剩余权利卖给了伊凡三世。1550至1551年冬，乌格利奇工匠在林中造起一座木要塞，拆开运到喀山城下重新组装，这就是斯维亚日斯克城的由来。1591年5月15日，伊凡雷帝的幼子、八岁的皇子德米特里被发现割喉死在宫中庭院，这桩血案揭开了大动乱的序幕；呼唤市民起事的大钟被割去钟锤和钟耳、当众鞭笞后流放托博尔斯克。1608年，图希诺部队洗劫罗斯托夫，俘走都主教费拉列特——他后来成为牧首，也是第一位罗曼诺夫沙皇的父亲；1610至1611年，利索夫斯基和萨佩加的骑兵又两度到此劫掠。1632至1634年，荷兰工程师扬·科尔尼洛夫修筑了罗斯托夫土木要塞；自1660年代起，都主教约拿·瑟索耶维奇建起城墙环绕的主教官邸，即著名的罗斯托夫克里姆林宫和那座宏伟的钟楼。1692年，乌格利奇建成石造的德米特里浴血教堂。1777年罗斯托夫成为县城，此后一年一度的大集市延续到19世纪，彩绘珐琅工艺也让此城扬名，只是都主教驻地在1788年迁往了雅罗斯拉夫尔。

en:
The Luki country takes its name from the great bends of the Lovat River, whose forests and boat routes formed Novgorod's southern approach. Novgorod chroniclers first mention the town as Luki on the Lovat in 1166, when Prince Rostislav I came there to negotiate with Novgorod's boyars. A fortress was built in 1211 to guard the roads toward Novgorod and Pskov, and by 1406 the town was already called Velikiye Luki, 'the Great Luki'. Its soldiers earned it the nickname 'Novgorod's shoulder'. In 1444 it remained an Orthodox Novgorodian border town on the edge of Lithuanian expansion, a timbered strongpoint where river traffic, forest produce and southern war trails met.

Ivan III brought Velikiye Luki under Moscow with the rest of Novgorod's lands in 1478. During the Livonian War Ivan IV kept his headquarters there, but in 1580 Stephen Báthory's Polish-Lithuanian army stormed the fortress; the Yam-Zapolsky peace returned it to Russia in 1582. The town suffered heavily in the Time of Troubles and never matched its wartime importance, though Peter I had its fortress rebuilt in 1707-1708 as an artillery-age work in the Dutch manner; the mathematician Leonty Magnitsky prepared the project and General Semyon Naryshkin supervised construction. In 1727 Velikiye Luki became the centre of a province in Novgorod Governorate, and after 1777 it served as an uyezd seat under Pskov. Catherine II confirmed its coat of arms in 1781. During the eighteenth century the Belarusian post road and the Moscow-Riga postal route carried trade and dispatches through the town.
zh:
卢基之名得自洛瓦季河的大片河曲；这里的森林、船路和南方陆路共同构成诺夫哥罗德的南方门户。诺夫哥罗德编年史在1166年首次提到洛瓦季河畔的卢基，当时罗斯季斯拉夫一世前来与诺夫哥罗德波雅尔谈判。1211年，当地修建要塞，守卫通往诺夫哥罗德和普斯科夫的道路；到1406年，城镇已被称为大卢基。其军民为它赢得了「诺夫哥罗德之肩」的别称。1444年时，它仍是信奉东正教的诺夫哥罗德边境城镇，处在立陶宛扩张方向的边缘，也是河路、林产品和南方战道交汇的木筑据点。

1478年，伊凡三世将大卢基随诺夫哥罗德土地一并并入莫斯科。利沃尼亚战争期间，伊凡四世曾在此设置大本营，但1580年斯特凡·巴托里率领波兰—立陶宛军队攻陷要塞；1582年的《亚姆—扎波利斯克和约》将其归还俄国。城镇在混乱时期遭受重创，再未恢复战时的重要地位。1707—1708年，彼得一世下令按适合炮战的荷兰式工事改建要塞，数学家列昂季·马格尼茨基负责设计，谢苗·纳雷什金将军监督工程。1727年，大卢基成为诺夫哥罗德省下一个省的中心；1777年后成为普斯科夫辖区下的县城。1781年，叶卡捷琳娜二世批准其城徽。18世纪里，白俄罗斯邮政大道和莫斯科—里加邮路都经过此城，输送贸易与公文。

en:
Kolding guards the fjord and river crossing where the Danish kingdom met the duchies of Schleswig, with Vejle and Skanderborg lying farther north. The town is first recorded as Kaldyng in 1231, and its market privileges were confirmed by Christopher II in 1321 and again in 1422. Above it stood Koldinghus, the southern border castle founded in the mid-thirteenth century and first completed under Eric V in 1268. On 30 April 1440 Christopher of Bavaria enfeoffed Adolf of Schleswig with his duchy at a court assembly in Kolding. In 1444 the town was thus a Catholic royal residence, customs frontier and outlet for the cattle of eastern Jutland.

The Greyfriars' monastery was dissolved in 1529, and during the Count's Feud Christian III met Christopher of Oldenburg at Kolding in December 1534 without reaching peace. Christian III and Queen Dorothea later made the castle a Renaissance residence, founded St George's Hospital and the Latin school in 1558, and built Denmark's first Protestant princely chapel there. The ox toll made Kolding one of the kingdom's chief cattle-export towns; in 1621 it yielded 13,820 daler, far more than the tolls on horses or Rostock beer. Imperial troops occupied the town in 1627, it was fought over in January and May 1644, and the wars of 1657-1660 left Koldinghus stormed and plague-stricken. Frederiksodde, the new fortress town that became Fredericia, was privileged in 1650, fell to Sweden in October 1657, was recovered in June 1659 and renamed Fredericia in 1664. Fire gutted Koldinghus in 1808, leaving the castle a long-unused ruin.
zh:
科灵扼守海湾与河口渡口，正处丹麦王国与石勒苏益格诸公国相接之地，北方则通向瓦埃勒和斯坎讷堡。城镇在1231年以Kaldyng之名首次见于记载，1321年由克里斯托弗二世确认市镇权，1422年再次获得确认。城北上的科灵城堡始建于13世纪中叶，1268年在埃里克五世治下首次建成，是防卫南境的城堡。1440年4月30日，巴伐利亚的克里斯托弗正是在科灵的宫廷会议上将石勒苏益格公国封授给阿道夫。1444年，这里是天主教王室驻跸地、关税边界，也是东日德兰牲畜外销的港口。

1529年，方济各会修道院被解散。伯爵战争期间，克里斯蒂安三世与奥尔登堡的克里斯托弗于1534年12月在科灵谈判，但未能达成和议。克里斯蒂安三世与多萝西亚王后后来把城堡改建成文艺复兴式居所，1558年创办圣乔治医院和拉丁学校，并在城堡中修建丹麦第一座新教王公礼拜堂。牛税使科灵成为王国最重要的牛只出口城镇之一；1621年，牛税收入达13820塔勒，远高于马匹或罗斯托克啤酒的关税。1627年帝国军队占领科灵，1644年1月和5月这里又几经交战；1657年至1660年战争中，科灵城堡遭到强攻，瘟疫也随之来袭。新设防城镇腓特烈斯奥德于1650年获得特权，1657年10月被瑞典攻陷，1659年6月收复，1664年改称腓特烈西亚。1808年，大火烧毁科灵城堡内部，使它长期沦为废墟。

en:
Évora rises over the wheat plains of the Alto Alentejo. The Celtici had their regional town of Ebora here, and after the Roman conquest of 57 BC Julius Caesar named it Liberalitas Julia; Pliny, seeing the surrounding fields, called it Ebora Cerealis, and the Corinthian temple still standing in the city centre was raised in the first century. Under Muslim rule from 715 the city, Yaburah, belonged to the taifa of Badajoz, until Gerald the Fearless took it by a night surprise in September 1165 and delivered it to Afonso I the next year. The kings of the new Avis dynasty made Évora their favourite southern residence, holding cortes and royal weddings there and endowing churches and palaces. In 1444 it was the foremost inland city of southern Portugal, set among vineyards, olive groves and grain fields, and the dukes of Braganza, created in 1442, were already gathering great estates around it.

The city's golden age came under Manuel I and John III: Nicolau Chanterene worked its stone, Gil Vicente staged his plays at court, and André de Resende made it a centre of humanist letters. Évora became an archiepiscopal see in 1540, and in 1559 the Jesuits opened its university, where Luis de Molina later taught. The dukes of Braganza acquired Vila Viçosa in 1461 and built their ducal palace there from 1502; in 1637 the townsmen rose in the Manuelinho revolt against Habsburg taxation, a prelude to 1640, when the eighth duke left Vila Viçosa to rule as John IV. During the Restoration War a Spanish army under John of Austria seized Évora in 1663 but abandoned it after its defeat at Ameixial on 8 June. Pombal closed the Jesuit university in 1759. On 29 July 1808 a French division under General Loison stormed the city, routing its militia and sacking it amid a great slaughter.
zh:
埃武拉矗立在上阿连特茹的麦海平原之上。凯尔特西人曾以这里的埃博拉为区域中心；公元前57年罗马人征服后，尤利乌斯·凯撒赐名「尤利亚的慷慨」（Liberalitas Julia），老普林尼见四周麦田广布，在《自然史》中称之为「麦城埃博拉」，城中心现存的科林斯式神庙即建于1世纪。715年起此地受穆斯林统治，名作亚卜拉，隶属巴达霍斯泰法王国；1165年9月，「无畏者」热拉尔多乘夜奇袭夺取此城，次年将它献给阿方索一世。新兴的阿维斯王朝把埃武拉当作最喜爱的南方驻跸之地，在此召开议会、举行王室婚礼，广建教堂与宫殿。1444年的埃武拉是葡萄牙南部首屈一指的内陆城市，四野尽是葡萄园、橄榄林和谷田；1442年获封的布拉甘萨公爵家族也已在这一带积聚庞大领地。

埃武拉的黄金时代在曼努埃尔一世和若昂三世治下：雕刻家尼古拉·尚特雷纳在此留下石刻，吉尔·维森特在宫中上演剧作，安德烈·德·雷森德使这里成为人文主义学术中心。1540年埃武拉升任总主教区，1559年耶稣会创办大学，路易斯·德·莫利纳后来在此任教。布拉甘萨家族1461年取得维拉维索萨，1502年起在当地兴建公爵宫；1637年，埃武拉市民掀起「曼努利尼奥起义」反抗哈布斯堡王朝的苛税，成为1640年复国的先声——第八代公爵正是从维拉维索萨启程，登基为若昂四世。复国战争中，奥地利的胡安率西班牙大军于1663年攻占埃武拉，但6月8日在阿梅希亚尔战败后被迫弃城。1759年，蓬巴尔侯爵关闭了耶稣会大学。1808年7月29日，卢瓦宗将军率领的法国师攻破埃武拉，击溃民军，随即展开大屠杀和洗劫。

en:
Enare covers the northern heart of old Kemi Lappmark, the fur country around Lake Inari, Kitinen and the headwaters of the Kemi. Its Forest Sámi wintered in fixed villages and scattered in summer to fish, hunt wild reindeer and trap furbearers. Taxation showed how weak any single frontier was: Kvens, Karelians, Norwegians and Swedish birkarls all collected dues, and Inari continued paying to Sweden, Russia and Denmark-Norway into the early nineteenth century. In 1444 the Swedish crown claimed the land, but no church or market town yet anchored its tundra and forest.

Lutheran mission came only in the seventeenth century. Inari's first church was completed in 1646, trade was directed to Inari markets from the 1650s, and Kemi Lapland became its own parish in 1673. At Sodankylä, Charles XI paid for a wooden church begun in 1688 and completed in 1689; when Sodankylä became an independent parish in 1747, the small building served an enormous hinterland. A new church rose at Pielpajärvi in 1754-1760, and the first permanent Finnish settler established himself by the Ivalo River in 1758. The old Kemi Lappmark tax district passed with Finland from Swedish rule in 1809.
zh:
伊纳里覆盖古凯米拉普兰的北部核心，是伊纳里湖、基蒂宁河与凯米河上游一带的毛皮之地。森林萨米人冬天住在固定村庄，夏天四散到各处捕鱼、猎取野鹿并捕捉毛皮兽。税权正说明任何单一边界都很薄弱：凯努人、卡累利阿人、挪威人和瑞典的比尔卡尔商人都曾征收贡赋，伊纳里甚至到19世纪初仍同时向瑞典、俄罗斯和丹麦—挪威纳税。1444年，瑞典王冠声称拥有此地，但冻原与森林间还没有教堂或市镇作为依托。

路德宗传教直到17世纪才到来。伊纳里的第一座教堂于1646年落成；1650年代起，贸易被引导到伊纳里集市；1673年，凯米拉普兰成为独立教区。在索丹屈莱，卡尔十一世出资修建木教堂，工程1688年开始、1689年完工。1747年索丹屈莱成为独立教区时，这座小教堂服务着极其广大的腹地。1754年至1760年，皮尔帕耶尔维湖畔建起新教堂；1758年，第一名永久芬兰居民在伊瓦洛河畔定居。1809年，古凯米拉普兰税区随芬兰脱离瑞典统治。

en:
The wooded highlands of Kainuu were the southernmost reach of Kemi Lapland: by the great lakes Kitkajärvi and Kuusamojärvi stood the Sámi winter villages of Kitka and Maanselkä, the latter giving this district its name. They wintered in the villages, moved to the rivers in spring and the lakes in summer, and lived on wild reindeer, fish and furs sold to Bothnian-coast Finns and White Sea Karelians. In 1444 this was a borderland only on parchment, for the Swedish claim reached no further than tribute-gathering while Russia taxed the country it held to be masterless.

After the Russo-Swedish peace of 1595 drew the frontier east of the lakes, Finnish settlers from Kainuu and the Torne and Kemi valleys poured in from the 1670s; the Sámi who summoned them to court were overwhelmed, for the newcomers already numbered nearly 200 by 1685. Kuusamo became its own parish in 1675 and got its first church in 1680. A tally of 1713 counted 79 Finnish families against 10 Sámi ones, and by the 1760s no Sámi household remained, as the district became a crossroads of the White Sea fur and reindeer trade. Transferred from Lappmark to the new Oulu province in 1775, it held some 3,000 people by 1800 and passed with Finland to Russia in 1809.
zh:
凯努的森林高地是凯米拉普兰的最南缘：基特卡湖和库萨莫湖两大湖畔坐落着基特卡与曼塞尔凯两个萨米人的冬季村落，后者正是本游戏省名称所指。萨米人在村里过冬，春天迁至河畔、夏天移往湖边，以捕猎野驯鹿、捕鱼和毛皮为生，把皮货卖给波的尼亚湾沿岸的芬兰人和白海沿岸的卡累利阿人。1444年，这里只是纸面上的边地——瑞典的宗主权仅限于征收贡赋，俄国也向它视为无主之地的这片土地收税。

1595年俄瑞和约把边界划到湖群以东后，来自凯努以及托尔讷河、凯米河谷的芬兰移民从1670年代起大量涌入；萨米人把他们告上法庭也无济于事，到1685年移民已近二百人。库萨莫于1675年成为独立教区，1680年建起第一座教堂。1713年的清查显示当地有79户芬兰移民、10户萨米人，到1760年代已不剩一户萨米人家，此地则成了白海毛皮和驯鹿贸易的枢纽。1775年此地从拉普兰划归新设的奥卢省，到1800年约有三千居民，1809年随芬兰并入俄国。

en:
Around Fofa, the mountain kingdom of Yamma, known to Amharic speakers as Janjero, fills the angle formed by the Omo and the Jimma Gibe; Mount Bor Ama, Mount Azulu and Mount Toba mark its skyline. Its people are the Yem, speakers of the Omotic language Yemsa. A victory song for Yeshaq I records Yamma among the lands south of the Abay that sent horses as tribute to the Ethiopian emperor. In 1444 a small Yem court still ruled this river-girt pocket, tied to the highlands by tribute but preserving its own ritual kingship.

In 1614 the Portuguese priest António Fernandes entered Yamma while searching for a southern route to Malindi. He found the king seated on a carpet atop a railed wooden tower about six yards high, while courtiers stood below; the ruler gave audience, settled disputes and dispatched business there, clad in a white silk Indian garment. Long after that visit, Yamma remained a small Yem polity wedged between Jimma to the west and Garo to the south, keeping its separate court through the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries.
zh:
富法一带的山间小国亚马，在阿姆哈拉语中称詹吉罗，位于奥莫河与吉马吉贝河形成的角地，博尔阿马山、阿祖卢山和托巴山标示着它的天际线。居民是说奥莫语族耶姆萨语的耶姆人。耶沙克一世的一首凯歌记载，亚马是阿巴伊河以南向埃塞俄比亚皇帝进贡马匹的地方之一。1444年，耶姆人的小朝廷仍统治着这块河流环抱的山地，虽以贡赋与高地相连，却保留自身的仪式性王权。

1614年，葡萄牙神父安东尼奥·费尔南德斯为寻找通往马林迪的南方路线进入亚马。他看到国王坐在约六码高、围有栏杆的木塔顶端的地毯上，廷臣都立于下方；国王身着白色印度丝衣，在塔上接见来使、裁决争讼并处理政务。这次到访之后很久，亚马仍是西临吉马、南接加罗的耶姆小国，在17和18世纪保住自己的朝廷。

en:
The Göta älv was medieval Sweden's only road to the North Sea: Bohuslän on the north bank belonged to Norway and Halland to the south to Denmark. To guard this narrow gateway Älvsborg castle rose on the Klippan rock at the river mouth, first mentioned in 1366, with Lindholmen fortress on the opposite bank. Rebel troops stormed it in vain in 1434; in 1436 the marshal Karl Knutsson persuaded its German castellan to surrender, and a Norwegian army abandoned a ten-week siege in 1439. Upstream the old market town of Lödöse carried the trade of the Västergötland plains to Hanseatic ports. In 1444, with the Kalmar Union restored under Christopher of Bavaria, Älvsborg was a frontier royal castle, the Swedish crown's single western window, ringed by rival lands.

Norwegian armies besieged it again in 1452 and 1455 and were beaten off by Tord Bonde, but in 1502 Crown Prince Christian of Denmark took and burned the castle, and the Danes held it once more from 1519 until the end of the Swedish War of Liberation. Gustav I rebuilt Älvsborg as a modern Renaissance fortress and laid out Älvsborg town beside it in 1547. The Danes wrecked that town and held the castle through the Northern Seven Years' War, returning it only in 1570 for the First Älvsborg Ransom of 150,000 riksdaler. Captured again in the Kalmar War of 1612, it was redeemed under the Peace of Knäred in 1613 with a second ransom of about a million riksdaler, and the Danes remained until 1619. Gustavus Adolphus founded Gothenburg downriver in 1621, its canals dug by Dutch engineers and the new port absorbing the older trading towns. After Halland and Bohuslän became Swedish at Roskilde in 1658, the old castle was demolished in 1673 and replaced by the island fortress of Nya Älvsborg. The Swedish East India Company based its China trade in Gothenburg in 1731, and the gateway Älvsborg had guarded became Sweden's busiest western port.
zh:
约塔河是中世纪瑞典通往北海的唯一通道：北岸的布胡斯兰（Bohuslän）属于挪威，南岸的哈兰属于丹麦。为扼守这条狭窄水路，埃尔夫斯堡要塞在河口的克利潘岩（Klippan）上建起，1366年初见于记载，对岸还矗立着林霍尔门堡。义军1434年猛攻要塞不克；1436年，政务元帅卡尔·克努特松说服德意志籍守将交出城堡，一支挪威军队1439年围攻十周后也只能撤兵。上游的老集镇勒德瑟（Lödöse）把西约塔兰平原的物产运往汉萨诸城。1444年，卡尔马联盟在巴伐利亚的克里斯托弗治下重归一统，埃尔夫斯堡是一座边塞王城，是瑞典王室唯一的西部门户，四周尽是敌手的土地。

挪威军队1452年和1455年两度来攻，均被托德·邦德（Tord Bonde）击退；但1502年丹麦王储克里斯蒂安攻陷并焚毁城堡，1519年丹麦人再度占领，一直守到瑞典解放战争结束。古斯塔夫一世把埃尔夫斯堡改建为新式文艺复兴要塞，1547年又在堡旁设立埃尔夫斯堡镇。北方七年战争中丹麦人摧毁市镇、占据要塞，直到1570年才以十五万里克斯达勒的「第一次埃尔夫斯堡赎金」归还。1612年卡尔马战争中要塞再度失守，1613年《克奈勒德和约》（Knäred）规定了约一百万里克斯达勒的第二次赎金，丹麦军队留驻到1619年。古斯塔夫二世1621年在下游建立哥德堡，由荷兰工匠排干沼泽、规划运河，这座新港最终吞并了早先的集镇。1658年《罗斯基勒条约》使哈兰和布胡斯兰并入瑞典后，旧堡于1673年拆除，由岛上的新埃尔夫斯堡要塞接替。1731年，瑞典东印度公司在哥德堡经营对华贸易，这座曾由埃尔夫斯堡守护的门户，就此成为瑞典最繁忙的西方大港。

en:
Dal, the valleys along Lake Vänern, was a remote forested part of Västergötland; the provincial law of 1442 called it Dal in Västergötland. Dukes Erik and Valdemar built Dalaborg at the outlet of the Dalbergsån in 1304, guarding lake traffic and the roads towards Norway, but rebels burned the fortress in 1434 during the Engelbrekt feud. In 1444 the scattered farmers and woodsmen of this Catholic Swedish border country lived around lake landings and forest tracks, with the old castle already in ruins above Vänern.

The name Dalsland is first recorded in 1508; before then the region was simply Dal. War often crossed its Norwegian marches: in 1568, during the Nordic Seven Years' War, 281 farms were burned, and campaigns swept the woods again in 1611–1612, 1644–1645 and 1675–1679. On 1 April 1643 Queen Christina's regency granted town privileges to Åmål on Vänern, founding Dalsland's only chartered town to control country trade and especially timber sales to Norway; smuggling continued nonetheless. Åmål was nearly destroyed in 1645, attacked in 1676 and 1679, and briefly held by Danish troops in 1788. Fires in 1777 and 1809 also gutted parts of the little timber town.
zh:
达勒是维纳恩湖畔的一片谷地，原为西约特兰的偏远林区；1442年的地方法称其为「西约特兰的达尔」。埃里克公爵与瓦尔德马公爵1304年在达尔贝里河入湖口修建达拉堡，用以控制湖上交通和通往挪威的道路，但城堡在1434年恩厄尔布雷克特叛乱中被焚毁。1444年，这片信奉天主教的瑞典边陲地散布着农户与林居者，人们依湖岸码头和林间道路生活，维纳恩湖畔的旧堡已成废墟。

1508年，文献首次记载Dalsland（达尔斯兰）一名，此前这里只称Dal。挪威边境屡屡卷入战事：北方七年战争期间，1568年有281座农场被焚；1611—1612年、1644—1645年和1675—1679年，军队又先后穿过林地。1643年4月1日，克里斯蒂娜女王的摄政政府授予维纳恩湖畔奥莫尔城市特权，在此建立达尔斯兰唯一的特状城镇，以控制乡间贸易，特别是输往挪威的木材贸易，但走私仍未断绝。奥莫尔1645年几乎被毁，1676年和1679年再遭进攻，1788年又被丹麦军队短暂占领。1777年和1809年的火灾也焚毁了这座木材小城的部分城区。

en:
Eastern Scania runs from the open Österlen coast up through the forests of Göinge to the Småland border. At Gladsax stood Gladsaxehus, royal castle of Gladsax län, from the 14th to the 17th century one of the chief fiefs of the Danish province; after its last private holder, Ide Pedersdatter Falk, died, Queen Margaret made it a crown fief. Inland the stony soils of the Göinge hundreds drove peasants to smithcraft and woodworking, and Swedish raiders had been met there as early as Mjölkalånga in 1318. In 1444 the whole district was Danish, governed from Gladsax and watchful towards the forest frontier.

Swedish troops invaded Göinge in the Northern Seven Years' War and again in the Kalmar War, when the fight at Vittsjö on 11 February 1612 covered their retreat; after raiders burned Vä, Christian IV founded fortified Kristianstad in 1614 and moved the rights of Vä and Åhus there to guard the east. The skirmish of Sibbarp south of Osby in 1657 was followed by the Peace of Roskilde in 1658, which ceded eastern Scania to Sweden. The woods then became the heartland of the pro-Danish snapphanar in 1658–1660 and the Scanian War of 1676–1679, where captains such as Lille Mads harried the garrisons until the revolt drowned in executions; a Danish incursion in 1710 ended at Hästveda.
zh:
东斯科讷从开阔的厄斯特伦海岸一直伸入约因厄的森林，直抵斯莫兰边境。格拉德萨克斯的格拉德萨克斯城堡是王室封邑格拉德萨克西兰的治所，14至17世纪间为斯科讷的主要封邑之一；末代私人领主伊德·佩德斯达特·法尔克死后，玛格丽特女王将封邑收归王室。内陆约因厄诸乡土地多石，农民兼营锻铁和木工；早在1318年，米约尔卡隆加之战便在这里迎击过来袭的瑞典人。1444年，整个地区属丹麦，由格拉德萨克斯统辖，对森林边境保持戒备。

北方七年战争中瑞典军侵入约因厄，卡尔马战争时再度来犯，1612年2月11日的维特舍之战掩护了瑞典军撤退；韦镇在袭掠中被焚后，克里斯蒂安四世1614年建起设防的克里斯蒂安斯塔德，移来韦镇和奥胡斯（瑞典）的城市权以扼守东侧门户。1657年乌斯比以南的西巴普交兵，次年罗斯基勒和约便将东斯科讷割让瑞典。此后这片森林在1658—1660年起事和1676—1679年斯科讷战争中成为亲丹麦自由射手（snapphanar）的大本营，「小个子马兹」等头目不断袭扰驻军，直到起义被处决压平；1710年丹麦军入侵也在海斯特韦达告终。

en:
Tiohärad was the inland law-district of south-western Småland, joining the three small folklands of Finnveden, Värend and Njudung and their ten hundreds, from which it took its name. Its assembly is recorded from the late 1100s, and its own Småland law survived until the general national law displaced it in the later 1300s. Roads met at Växjö on the northern shore of Lake Växjö, the centre of Värend: a diocese was created there about 1170 under the patronage of Saint Sigfrid, and Magnus Eriksson granted the town its charter in 1342. In 1444 this was a Catholic forest borderland of Sweden, close to Danish Blekinge and Halland, where Växjö's markets and the Småland timber trade supported a scattered population of farmers and foresters.

Växjö's two great free fairs are first documented in 1473, drawing merchants from Danish Ronneby and Vä, and a Franciscan monastery was founded there in 1485. Bishop Ingemar Pedersson supported Gustav Eriksson at the opening of the war that broke the Kalmar Union, but royal taxes and Lutheran seizure of church silver soon turned the countryside against Gustav Vasa. Nils Dacke's peasants held Växjö from the summer of 1542 until after New Year 1543; blockaded and attacked from both Östergötland and Västergötland, the rising ended when Dacke was shot in August 1543. War returned to the border town in 1570 and 1612. The Kronoberg Regiment was formed in 1623, Växjö became a county seat in 1634 and its cathedral school gained gymnasium rights in 1643. After the Treaty of Roskilde in 1658 moved the Danish frontier far south, fire cleared the old town later that year and Växjö was rebuilt on a regular grid.
zh:
蒂约海拉德是斯莫兰西南部的内陆法区，由芬韦德恩、韦伦德和尼乌东三个小民间地区及其十个海拉德组成，地名也由此而来。法区集会在12世纪末已有记载，本地的《斯莫兰法》一直沿用到14世纪后期，才被全国性普通法取代。道路在韦克舍湖北岸的韦克舍交汇，使这里成为韦伦德中心：约1170年，当地在圣西弗里德的尊崇下设立教区，马格努斯·埃里克松又于1342年授予城市特许状。1444年，这里是瑞典靠近丹麦布莱金厄与哈兰的天主教森林边地，韦克舍市集和斯莫兰木材贸易养活着分散的农户与林民。

韦克舍的两大自由市集最早见于1473年记载，商人甚至从丹麦的龙讷比和维镇前来；1485年，城内又建立方济各会修道院。古斯塔夫·埃里克松发起瓦解卡尔马联盟的战争时，主教英厄马尔·佩德松曾予以支持，但王室重税和路德宗没收教会银器很快使乡村反对古斯塔夫·瓦萨。尼尔·斯·达克率领农民军在1542年夏至1543年新年后控制韦克舍；在遭到封锁并同时受东约特兰、西约特兰两路军队进攻后，起义以达克1543年8月被枪杀告终。战火又在1570年和1612年波及这座边城。克鲁努贝里团组建于1623年，韦克舍1634年成为郡治，座堂学校1643年获得高级中学特权。1658年《罗斯基勒条约》把丹麦边界远远推向南方，同年稍后大火清理旧城，韦克舍随后按整齐网格重建。

en:
Abarquh stands on the high desert plain midway between Yazd and Shiraz, where the roads from Shiraz, Isfahan and Yazd converged. In the tenth century Ibn Hawqal found a prosperous, populous town, walled and crowned with a citadel, that shipped cotton cloth across an otherwise treeless country. The octagonal Gonbad-e Ali mausoleum was raised in 1056/57 for the Firuzanid amir Hazarasp, and under the Seljuks and Ilkhanids the town kept a mint and gained its four-iwan Friday mosque; coins struck here by Ilkhanids, Injuids, Mozaffarids, Timurids and the Aq Qoyunlu all survive. In 1340 Hamdallah Mustawfi called Abarquh small but prosperous, its grain and cotton watered by qanats, and marvelled at its ancient cypress, already the most famous tree in the world. In 1444 Timurid rule was slackening, leaving the town between that crumbling empire and the rising Qara Qoyunlu.

Under the Safavids Abarquh was crown domain, farmed out to high officials; in the early seventeenth century the Tadhkirat al-Muluk valued the district at 711 tomans, assigned to the commander of the musketeers. The Hotak Afghans sacked the town in 1722, in the invasion that overthrew the Safavids, and in 1793/94 Lotf Ali Khan Zand briefly held its citadel during his losing war with the Qajars. The town's four adobe ice-houses date from the Qajar age, when the caravan traffic that had fed it for a thousand years had moved to other roads and Abarquh had gained a name for unrest.
zh:
阿巴尔古矗立在亚兹德与设拉子之间的高原荒漠上，正处在设拉子、伊斯法罕、亚兹德三条古道的交汇处。10世纪时，伊本·豪盖勒见到的是一座繁荣稠密、有城墙和城堡的城镇，在这片不生树木的土地上外销棉布。八角形的贡巴德·阿里陵墓建于1056至1057年，墓主是菲鲁赞家族的埃米尔哈扎拉斯普；塞尔柱和伊儿汗时期，城中设有铸币厂，四伊万格局的聚礼清真寺也在这一年代建成，存世钱币上可见伊儿汗、因朱、穆扎法尔、帖木儿和白羊诸朝的印记。1340年，哈姆杜拉·穆斯图菲称阿巴尔古城小而富庶，坎儿井浇灌着谷物与棉花，年税达十四万第纳尔；他还惊叹于城中古柏，说它已是天下最负盛名的树。1444年，帖木儿的统治日渐松弛，这座城镇夹在衰败的帝国与崛起的黑羊王朝之间。

萨法维时期，阿巴尔古是王室直辖领地，被封给朝中高官；17世纪初的《王臣备忘录》（Tadhkirat al-Muluk）把该区估值711托曼，拨给火枪兵统领作采邑。1722年，推翻萨法维王朝的阿富汗霍塔克人洗劫了此城；1793至1794年间，卢图夫·阿里汗·赞德在与卡扎尔人的败战中曾短暂据守这里的城堡。城中的四座土坯冰库建于卡扎尔时代；彼时维系城镇千年的商队贸易已改走他路，阿巴尔古也以动荡不宁闻名。

en:
Syrmia is the broad grain country between the Danube and Sava, with the wooded Fruška Gora rising along its Danube side. The capital, Mitrovica, grew on the Sava as the town of Saint Demetrius near the ruins of Sirmium, after Hungary secured the region in 1180. Hungarian counties and frontier lords governed the plains; Stefan Dragutin ruled a Syrmian realm between 1282 and 1316, and Serbian despots later held estates there as vassals of the Hungarian crown. By 1437 local evidence described most of Syrmia as settled by Serbs, so in 1444 the Orthodox, grain-growing border province belonged to Hungary while the Ottoman advance moved up the Balkans.

After Serbia fell in 1459, Hungarian kings maintained titular Serbian despots at Kupinik, while Laurence of Ilok ruled wide lands from Ilok until 1524. Ottoman forces took parts of Syrmia in 1521, and Mitrovica itself came under their rule in 1526; Radoslav Čelnik governed the region as an Ottoman vassal from 1527 to 1530, and the whole plain had been absorbed by 1538 under the Sanjak of Syrmia. In 1663 Evliya Çelebi described Mitrovica with fifteen hundred houses, mosques, madrasas, baths, caravanserais and four hundred shops. Austrian troops briefly held it from 1688 to 1690 and finally secured it in the 1717 campaign, confirmed by the 1718 Treaty of Passarowitz. Western Syrmia had already passed to Austria in 1699; after 1745 it was divided between Syrmia County and the Military Frontier, with the Serbian Orthodox see at Sremski Karlovci lending authority to its Serbian life. Peasants on the Ruma and Ilok estates rose in 1807, centred on Voganj.
zh:
叙尔米亚（通行称斯雷姆）是多瑙河与萨瓦河之间广阔的谷物之乡，多瑙河畔耸立着林木覆盖的弗鲁什卡山。首府米特罗维察（今斯雷姆斯卡米特罗维察）位于萨瓦河畔，是1180年匈牙利控制这一地区后，在西尔米乌姆遗址附近发展起来的圣迪米特里城镇。匈牙利诸县和边境领主治理着平原；斯特凡·德拉古廷曾在1282年至1316年统治一个斯雷姆政权，后来的塞尔维亚专制公也作为匈牙利王冠封臣在此保有领地。到1437年，当地材料已称斯雷姆大部分居民为塞尔维亚人。因此1444年时，这片信奉东正教、出产谷物的边地属于匈牙利，而奥斯曼军队正沿巴尔干向北推进。

1459年塞尔维亚陷落后，匈牙利国王仍在库皮尼克维持名义上的塞尔维亚专制公；伊洛克的洛夫罗则以伊洛克为中心统治广大土地，直至1524年。1521年，奥斯曼军队攻占斯雷姆部分地区，米特罗维察本身于1526年被纳入其统治。拉多斯拉夫·切尔尼克在1527年至1530年作为奥斯曼封臣治理此地，到1538年整片平原都被并入斯雷姆桑贾克。1663年，埃夫利亚·切莱比记载米特罗维察有一千五百栋房屋，以及清真寺、伊斯兰学校、浴场、商队旅馆和四百家店铺。奥地利军队曾在1688年至1690年短暂占领该城，最终在1717年战役中将其拿下，并由1718年《波扎雷瓦茨和约》确认。西斯雷姆此前已在1699年转归奥地利；1745年后，这一地区被分划为斯雷姆县和军事边屯区，设在斯雷姆斯基卡尔洛夫奇的塞尔维亚东正教牧首区也维系着当地塞尔维亚人的宗教生活。1807年，鲁马和伊洛克领地上的农民以沃甘村为中心起事。

en:
Durrës, the ancient Epidamnus and Dyrrachium, faces the heel of Italy from a flat Adriatic bay. As the western end of the Via Egnatia, it had linked the Adriatic with Thessalonica and Constantinople since Roman times, and its salt pans were already drawing Jewish merchants in the thirteenth century. Byzantine, Angevin, Serbian and Thopian rule passed over the walls before Venice acquired the city from Gjergj Thopia in 1392. In 1444 the Republic held it as Durazzo, a fortified port of Albania Veneta; Venetian galleons used the harbour, Albanian villagers farmed the coastal plain, and the citadel guarded the sea road between Vlorë and Lezhë.

Mehmed II besieged Durrës in 1466 during his war against Skanderbeg's Albania, but the Venetian garrison held out. Ottoman forces finally took the city in 1501, shortened its overgrown ancient walls into a smaller fortress, and gradually made Islam the faith of many townspeople. The port declined at first: when Evliya Çelebi visited in 1670-71 he counted about 150 houses. Salt then revived the economy, and by 1699 roughly a hundred Turkish and Greek merchants were shipping wax, cloth, leather and grain toward Venice. France, England, the Netherlands and Austria opened consulates in 1700. In 1769 grain and olive oil still dominated trade with Venice, but after Napoleon extinguished the Venetian Republic in 1797, Durrës increasingly traded through Austrian Trieste.
zh:
都拉斯古称埃庇达诺斯、都拉基乌姆，坐落在亚得里亚海一处平坦海湾，与意大利半岛南端隔海相望。自罗马时代起，它便是埃格纳提亚大道的西端，经由此地可通往帖撒罗尼迦和君士坦丁堡；13世纪时，这里的盐田已经吸引犹太商人前来。拜占庭、安茹、塞尔维亚和托皮亚家族先后统治这座城墙环绕的城市，威尼斯又在1392年从杰尔吉·托皮亚手中取得它。1444年，共和国以「杜拉佐」之名据有此地，把它作为阿尔巴尼亚·威尼塔的设防港口；威尼斯桨帆船使用海港，阿尔巴尼亚村民耕种沿岸平原，城堡则扼守发罗拉与莱什之间的海路。

1466年，穆罕默德二世在征讨斯坎德培领导的阿尔巴尼亚时围攻都拉斯，但威尼斯守军坚守不退。1501年，奥斯曼军队终于攻占城市，把延伸过长的古城墙收缩改建成较小的堡垒，伊斯兰教也逐渐成为许多城镇居民的信仰。港口起初衰败，埃夫利亚·切莱比1670至1671年到访时，只记有约一百五十栋房屋。盐业随后复兴经济，到1699年，约有一百名土耳其和希腊商人把蜂蜡、布匹、皮革和谷物运往威尼斯。1700年，法国、英国、尼德兰和奥地利在此开设领事馆。1769年，对威尼斯贸易仍以谷物和橄榄油为主；1797年拿破仑灭亡威尼斯共和国后，都拉斯便越来越多地通过奥地利的的里雅斯特进行贸易。

en:
Lezhë, the ancient Lissus, guards the mouth of the Drin on the Adriatic. It was a stronghold of the Illyrian Labeatae; Philip V of Macedon seized its citadel in 211 BC, and the Illyrian king Gentius struck his own coinage there before the Roman conquest. After Slav and Byzantine centuries, the Dukagjini family handed the town, known to Italians as Alessio, to Venice in 1386. On 2 March 1444, with the Republic's consent, Gjergj Kastrioti Skanderbeg assembled the Albanian nobles — Kastrioti, Arianiti, Muzaka, Thopia, Dukagjini and the rest — in the church of Saint Nicholas and was proclaimed chief of the League of Lezhë against the Ottomans. The walled town itself still belonged to Venice, but the Catholic and Orthodox Albanian clans of its sheep-rearing hills had answered his summons, and the sultan's armies were already marching.

Lezhë could not stay neutral: during the Albanian–Venetian war Skanderbeg's forces besieged the town in 1448, until the peace of 4 October reconciled him with the Republic. He died on 17 January 1468 and was buried in Saint Nicholas', which became the shrine of the Albanian cause. The Ottomans took the town in 1478 during the great siege of Shkodra and turned the cathedral into the Selimiye Mosque; it returned to Venice only for the brief span of 1501–1506. As Leş it then served as an administrative seat of the Sanjak of Shkodra, and in 1757 the region passed under the semi-autonomous Bushati pashas of Shkodra, under whom it lay in 1821.
zh:
莱什古称利苏斯，扼守亚得里亚海滨的德林河口，曾是伊利里亚人拉贝阿特部族的重镇：马其顿的腓力五世于公元前211年夺取其卫城，伊利里亚国王还曾在此自铸钱币，此后才落入罗马之手。历经斯拉夫人与拜占庭的数百年统治，杜卡吉尼家族于1386年把这座意大利人称作阿莱西奥的城镇交给威尼斯。1444年3月2日，经威尼斯当局许可，乔治·卡斯特里奥蒂·斯坎德培在圣尼古拉教堂召集阿尔巴尼亚贵族——卡斯特里奥蒂、阿里亚尼蒂、穆扎卡、托皮亚、杜卡吉尼等家族齐聚——被推举为莱什联盟的领袖，共抗奥斯曼。城墙之内当时仍属威尼斯，但周围山地以牧羊为业的天主教和东正教阿尔巴尼亚部族已响应他的号召，苏丹的大军也已逼近。

莱什终究无法置身事外：1447至1448年阿尔巴尼亚与威尼斯交战期间，斯坎德培的军队曾围攻此城，直到1448年10月4日双方议和。1468年1月17日斯坎德培病逝，安葬于圣尼古拉教堂，这里由此成为阿尔巴尼亚人心中的圣地。1478年，奥斯曼人在围攻斯库台期间拿下莱什，把大教堂改为塞利米耶清真寺；1501至1506年它曾短暂重归威尼斯，此后便以莱什之名成为斯库台桑扎克的治所之一。1757年，这一带归入斯库台布沙蒂家族半独立的帕夏领地，1821年时仍在其治下。

en:
This province takes its name from Braničevo, a land of pastures and river crossings between the Danube, the Great Morava and the Homolje and Kučaj highlands. Its medieval fortress rose near Roman Viminacium on the Mlava and guarded the Via Militaris; Byzantine emperors used it as a Danubian base against Hungary, and the armies of the Second and Third Crusades passed along the road. From the late thirteenth century the region belonged to Serbian rulers. Farther up the Morava system, Kruševac was founded by Prince Lazar in 1371 and became his fortified seat; the Lazarica church was built between 1375 and 1378, and his army gathered there before Kosovo in 1389. Ottoman troops held the town in 1413 and 1427 and Hungarian forces in 1437, but Đurađ Branković recovered Kruševac in 1444. That year its stock routes and fortresses were again part of a hard-pressed Orthodox Serbian Despotate.

Ottoman armies returned in 1454. Serbian forces inflicted heavy losses at the Battle of Kruševac, but Mehmed II reinforced his troops and the town fell before the end of the campaign, while Braničevo's Danubian strongholds also passed under Ottoman rule in these middle decades of the century. Kruševac, called Alacahisar, became the seat of an Ottoman sanjak, and the Lazarica was used to store gunpowder. The town changed hands in the Habsburg-Ottoman wars, with Austrian occupations from 1688 to 1690 and again from 1717 to 1739. The uprisings after 1804 transformed the Serbian lands farther north, but in 1821 Kruševac was still an Ottoman administrative and garrison town.
zh:
这片地区以布兰尼切夫得名，地当多瑙河、大摩拉瓦河与霍莫列、库查伊山地之间，遍布牧场与渡口。中世纪要塞建在姆拉瓦河畔罗马城市维米纳基乌姆遗址附近，扼守军用大道；拜占庭皇帝曾以它作为多瑙河上对抗匈牙利的基地，第二次和第三次十字军的军队也先后取道于此。13世纪后期起，这一地区归塞尔维亚统治者所有。在摩拉瓦水系更上游，克鲁舍瓦茨由拉扎尔公建于1371年，成为他设防的驻地；拉扎里察教堂建于1375年至1378年，他的军队1389年出征科索沃前在此集结。奥斯曼军队曾于1413年和1427年占领该城，匈牙利军队又在1437年占据，但久拉吉·布兰科维奇1444年收复克鲁舍瓦茨。这一年，这里的牲畜商路和各处要塞重新归入处境艰难的东正教塞尔维亚专制公国。

1454年，奥斯曼大军再度南下。塞尔维亚军队在克鲁舍瓦茨之战中给敌军造成重大伤亡，但穆罕默德二世增兵反攻，城市在同一年战役结束前陷落；布兰尼切夫的多瑙河要塞也在15世纪中叶相继转入奥斯曼统治。克鲁舍瓦茨改称阿拉贾希萨尔，成为奥斯曼桑贾克的治所，拉扎里察教堂则被用来储存火药。哈布斯堡与奥斯曼的战争中，城市两度被奥地利占领，分别是1688年至1690年和1717年至1739年。1804年后的起义改变了更北面的塞尔维亚土地，但到1821年，克鲁舍瓦茨仍是奥斯曼的行政与驻军城镇。

en:
Hyuga faced the Pacific along southeastern Kyushu, a province of coastal plains, mountain valleys and fast rivers. Under the eighth-century codes it first reached south over later Satsuma and Osumi; those districts separated in 702 and 713, while the provincial temple and presumed provincial seat stood near Saito and Hyuga horses were prized at court. Nanboku-cho warfare split the country among local lords: the Tsuchimochi held the north, the Ito the centre, and Shimazu kinsmen the southeastern approaches around Obi. In 1444 Obi itself was still a Tsuchimochi stronghold above the Sakatani river, linked downstream to the port of Aburatsu, even as the Ito pressed south from their central Hyuga lands.

In 1458 the Shimazu installed Niiro Tadatsugu in Obi to check Ito expansion. Ito Sukekuni was killed attacking the castle in 1484, and Obi passed to the Hoshu Shimazu line; Ito Yoshisuke opened another long siege in 1544, Ashikaga Yoshiteru mediated in 1560, and the Ito took the castle in 1562. Their collapse after the Battle of Kizakiwara in 1572 let the Shimazu recover Obi in 1576 and crush an Otomo army at Mimigawa in 1578, bringing Hyuga under their control. Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Kyushu campaign reversed that in 1587; Ito Suketaka returned as castellan in 1588 and, after serving the eastern cause at Sekigahara in 1600, became lord of Obi Domain. The rest of Hyuga remained a patchwork of shogunal land and small domains. Major earthquake repairs finished the stone walls and moats in 1691 and the palace in 1693, while Obi cedar was floated to Aburatsu for shipment. In 1821 the Ito still ruled their compact, timber-rich domain from Obi.
zh:
日向位于九州东南，面朝太平洋，是沿海平原、山谷与急流交错之国。8世纪律令制下，日向最初曾统有后来的萨摩和大隅；两地于702年和713年分立，国分寺与推定国府则在西都一带，日向良马也为宫廷所知。南北朝战乱使该国分裂于众多国人领主：土持氏据北，伊东氏据中，岛津一族控制饫肥一带的东南要地。1444年的饫肥仍是酒谷川旁、由土持氏掌握的城塞，顺河可通油津港，而伊东氏正从中部领国向南施压。

1458年，岛津氏派新纳忠续进入饫肥城，以阻挡伊东氏南扩。1484年伊东祐国攻城时战死，饫肥随后归入丰州岛津氏；伊东义祐1544年再攻饫肥，足利义辉曾于1560年调停，伊东氏仍在1562年取得城池。1572年木崎原之战后伊东氏由盛转衰，岛津氏1576年再占饫肥，又在1578年耳川之战大败大友军，控制整个日向。1587年丰臣秀吉九州征伐扭转局势；伊东祐兵1588年回到饫肥任城主，并在1600年关原之战从属东军，此后作为饫肥藩主延续至幕末。日向其余土地则由天领和若干小藩分治。地震促使饫肥城大规模修缮，石垣与护城河在1691年完工，御殿于1693年落成；饫肥杉也顺酒谷川运到油津出海。1821年，伊东氏仍在饫肥统治这个不大却盛产木材的藩。

en:
Higo occupied central Kyushu, running from coastal plains inland toward Mount Aso and the Kuma mountains. The old Hi no Kuni split into Hizen and Higo during the seventh century, and the name Higo appears in records around 696. Under the Muromachi shogunate the Kikuchi served as military governors, while the Aso held shrine-based power around Mount Aso and the Sagara were rooted in the southern Kuma valley. In 1444 Higo was therefore still a mosaic of governor, shrine lords and local warriors rather than one tightly ruled domain. The Kikuchi gave the province its weight in Kyushu politics, but the later castle town of Kumamoto had not yet risen.

Chiba Castle, the first fortification on Kumamoto's future site, was built by Ideta Hidenobu between 1469 and 1487, and Kanokogi Chikakazu built Kumamoto Castle between 1521 and 1531. The Kikuchi were drawn into Aso succession struggles, the Otomo of Bungo intervened, and the Shimazu overran much of Higo before Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Kyushu conquest of 1587. Sassa Narimasa then received the province, but his forced land survey provoked a local rising and he was ordered to take his life in 1588. Kato Kiyomasa entered northern Higo that year, while the Christian general Konishi Yukinaga held the centre and south. After Konishi was defeated and executed following Sekigahara in 1600, Kiyomasa acquired his lands and formed the 520,000-koku Kumamoto Domain. He began rebuilding the castle in 1591, completed its keep around 1600, and changed its name from Kumamoto written with 隈本 to the present 熊本 in 1607. When Kato Tadahiro was attainted in 1632, Hosokawa Tadatoshi entered with 540,000 koku and began long Hosokawa rule. The swordsman Miyamoto Musashi completed The Book of Five Rings under Hosokawa patronage, and in 1821 Kumamoto remained one of Tokugawa Japan's greatest castle towns.
zh:
肥后位于九州中部，从沿海平原伸向阿苏火山与球磨山地。古代的火国在7世纪分为肥前与肥后，「肥后国」之名约在696年见于文献。室町幕府时期，菊池氏担任守护，阿苏氏在阿苏山一带拥有神社势力，相良氏则扎根南部球磨谷地。因此1444年的肥后仍是守护、神社豪族与地方武家并立的拼图，而非由单一势力严密统治的领国；菊池氏决定着它在九州政局中的分量，但后来的熊本城下町尚未兴起。

熊本城址最早的千叶城由出田秀信在1469年至1487年间修筑，1521年至1531年间，鹿子木亲员又筑隈本城。菊池氏随后被卷入阿苏氏的继嗣纷争，丰后的大友氏趁机介入，岛津军则在丰臣秀吉1587年九州征伐前席卷肥后大部。佐佐成政受命领有肥后，却因强行检地触发国人一揆，1588年被勒令切腹；同年加藤清正进入北肥后，基督教徒武将小西行长领有中南部。1600年关原之战后，小西作为西军败将被处死，清正获得其旧领，建立52万石的熊本藩。清正1591年开始改造熊本城，天守约在1600年完成，1607年又把地名由隈本改为熊本。1632年加藤忠广被改易，细川忠利以54万石入封，开启细川氏的长期统治。剑术家宫本武藏受细川氏招待，在肥后完成《五轮书》；到1821年，熊本仍是德川日本最重要的城下町之一。

en:
Hizen faced the seas of western Kyushu, covering the lands that became Saga and most of Nagasaki. Formed from the old Land of Hi by the late seventh century, it had provincial ranches, sheltered harbours and the seafaring Matsuura districts. During the Middle Ages the Shoni, heirs of the Kamakura military government in Kyushu, contended with the Muromachi-period Shibukawa and with local houses such as the Chiba, Matsuura, Omura and Arima. In 1444 the Shoni name still carried weight, but no lord ruled all Hizen; Nagasaki itself was still only a small anchorage overshadowed by older ports such as Hirado.

The Portuguese transformed that coast. Omura Sumitada opened Nagasaki to their trade in 1570 and the first Portuguese ship arrived in 1571; in 1580 he placed the port under Jesuit administration, and the Tensho embassy sailed from this Christian coast in 1582. After Hideyoshi's Kyushu campaign of 1587, the port came under direct ruler control, and from Nagoya in Hizen he directed the 1592 invasion of Korea while appointing the first Nagasaki magistrate. The twenty-six martyrs were crucified at Nagasaki in 1597. Under the Tokugawa, the Nabeshima dominated much of the province from Saga while Nagasaki remained shogunal land. The tax-driven and Kirishitan Shimabara rising of 1637-38 ended in the long siege and destruction of Hara Castle; in 1641 the Dutch factory was moved to Dejima, making Nagasaki Japan's controlled European window.
zh:
肥前面向九州西部海域，范围相当于后来的佐贺县和长崎县大部。它在7世纪末由旧肥国分置而来，境内设有官营牧场，又有众多避风良港和熟悉海路的松浦诸郡。中世时，继承镰仓幕府镇西职能的少贰氏，与室町幕府的涩川氏以及千叶、松浦、大村、有马等地方武家相争。1444年，少贰的名号仍在北九州有分量，却没有一位领主能统制整个肥前；那时的长崎还只是小港湾，声势尚不及平户等老港。

葡萄牙人彻底改变了这片海岸。大村纯忠于1570年向葡萄牙贸易开放长崎，第一艘葡萄牙船在1571年来航；1580年，他又把长崎交给耶稣会管理，天正遣欧少年使节也于1582年从这片基督教盛行的海岸出发。1587年丰臣秀吉平定九州后，长崎被置于直辖市配之下；秀吉还在肥前名护屋指挥1592年侵朝，并任命了首任长崎奉行。1597年，日本二十六圣人在长崎被处死。德川时代，锅岛氏以佐贺为中心支配肥前大部，长崎则作为幕府天领由奉行管理。1637至1638年，以重税农民和吉利支丹为主体的岛原之乱爆发，最终以原城长期围城和陷落告终；1641年，荷兰商馆迁到出岛，长崎由此成为日本受严格管制的欧洲窗口。

en:
Iwami runs along the Sea of Japan west of Izumo, a narrow chain of fishing inlets and river mouths beneath the Chūgoku mountains, whose provincial capital stood at Hamada from Heian times. The Kamakura age gave the country to the Masuda, a Genji house that kept its coastal estates through the Muromachi years, when the Yamana held the shugo title and the family deferred to the Ōuchi across the border in Suō. In 1444 Iwami was a quiet western edge of the Yamana lands, its villages farming the narrow valleys and its boats working the cold offshore fishing banks, with no hint of the wealth sleeping under its hills.

In 1526 Kamiya Jutei, a merchant from Hakata, opened the first deep workings at Ōmori with Ōuchi backing, and in 1533 smelters brought in the Korean haifuki cupellation process: Iwami silver now poured out by the ton, and the mountain became a battlefield. The Amago of Izumo seized the mines in 1537, lost them and retook them, and beat the Mōri in two pitched battles in 1556 and 1559, until the truce of 1562 left Iwami to Mōri Motonari. After Sekigahara, Ieyasu took the mines for himself in 1600 and named Ōkubo Nagayasu first ginzan-bugyō in 1601; in the early seventeenth century Iwami produced some 38 tons of silver a year out of Japan's 200, and Sekishū chōgin ingots circulated across western Japan and sailed out with the China, Portuguese and Dutch trade. A guarded silver highway carried the bars over the mountains to Onomichi and on to the Kyoto guild. Output ebbed after the 1670s, the commissioner was reduced to a district magistrate in 1675, and in the famine of 1731 the daikan Ido Heizaemon opened the granaries and planted sweet potatoes, earning the name 'potato magistrate'. Around the shogun's Ōmori domain rose the castle towns of Tsuwano and Hamada.
zh:
石见位于出云以西的日本海沿岸，是中国山地脚下由渔湾和河口串成的狭长之地，平安时代起国府便设在滨田。镰仓以来，源氏出身的益田氏领有这片土地，中世时山名氏担任守护，益田氏则对周防的大内氏恭顺。1444年的石见是山名领国西陲一处安静的角落，村落在狭窄的河谷里种稻，渔船在寒冷的近海渔场作业，还无人知晓群山下沉睡着财富。

1526年，博多商人神屋寿祯得大内氏资助，在大森开出第一批深入矿脉的坑道；1533年，博多工匠带来朝鲜的灰吹炼银法，石见白银自此成吨涌出，这座山也随之成为战场。1537年出云尼子氏夺取银山，此后得而复失、失而复得，并在1556和1559年两度击败毛利军，直到1562年云芸和议约定尼子不干涉石见，银山才落入毛利元就之手。关原之战后，德川家康于1600年直接接管银山，1601年任命大久保长安为首任银山奉行；17世纪初石见年产银约38吨，而日本全国年产约200吨，石州丁银流通西日本，并随中国及葡萄牙、荷兰商船从贸易中流出。有专人警备的银山街道翻山越岭把银锭运到尾道，再送往京都银座。1670年代后产量渐衰，1675年银山奉行降格为大森代官；1731年大饥荒时，代官井户平左卫门开仓放粮、率先引种甘薯，被领民称作「芋代官」。在幕府大森天领的四周，兴起了津和野、滨田两藩的城下町。

en:
Bizen, called Bishū for short, was the easternmost of the three provinces carved from the ancient kingdom of Kibi on the San'yō coast, a flat, well-watered country of rice fields, salt pans and sea lanes running straight to the capital; in 713 its six northern counties were hived off as Mimasaka. Its forges had worked iron since the Kofun age, and from Heian times the smiths of Osafune and Fukuoka, of the Osafune and Ichimonji schools, made Bizen blades the most prized in Japan, while Bizen ware pottery traveled the same shipping routes. Under the Muromachi shoguns the Akamatsu of Harima held the shugo post, but after their ruin in the Kakitsu incident of 1441 the Yamana extended their power into the province. In 1444 Bizen is ranked a 'superior country' in the old codes, rich in grain and steel yet caught between its old governors and the rising Yamana.

In the Sengoku wars the deputy Urakami tried to rule in the Akamatsu's place, but it was their own vassal Ukita Naoie who overthrew them and made the hill fort of Okayama his seat, holding Bizen with Mimasaka and parts of Bitchū. His son Hideie, one of Hideyoshi's five elders, completed the black-lacquered keep in 1597, its roof tiles gilded so that men called it the Golden Crow Castle; but he fought for Ishida Mitsunari at Sekigahara in 1600, was attainted, and ended exiled on Hachijōjima. Kobayakawa Hideaki held Okayama for two years and died heirless, after which the province passed to Ikeda Tadatsugu, second son of the Himeji lord Ikeda Terumasa, whose house ruled all Bizen until the nineteenth century. The fourth lord, Ikeda Tsunamasa, set his retainer Tsuda Nagatada to cut flood channels and open new fields, and between 1687 and 1700 laid out beside the castle the great promenade garden later named Kōraku-en. Under the Ikeda peace cotton spread across reclaimed coastal land, the island of Kojima was joined to the mainland, and the Bizen kilns never cooled.
zh:
