备前简称备州，是古代吉备国拆分出的三国中最东的一国，地处山阳道沿海，平原广阔、河渠纵横，稻田与盐田之间舟船可直通畿内；713年，北部六郡被划出另置美作国。这里自古坟时代起便出产铁矿，从平安时代起，长船、福冈两地的刀工——长船派与一文字派——锻造的「备前物」成为全日本最受珍视的刀剑，备前烧也借同一条海路行销列国。室町幕府时期备前守护由播磨赤松氏担任，1441年嘉吉之乱赤松氏败亡后，山名氏的势力伸入备前。1444年的备前在律令中位列上国，粮铁丰足，却已夹在旧守护与崛起的山名氏之间。

战国乱世中，守护代浦上氏一度架空主家、把持备前，但最终推翻浦上氏的是其家臣宇喜多直家：他以冈山的山上城砦为本据，领有备前、美作和备中一部。其子宇喜多秀家身为丰臣五大老之一，1597年建成漆黑的天守，瓦片贴金，号称「金乌城」；但他在1600年关原之战中加入石田三成一方，战败后被除封，最终流放八丈岛终老。小早川秀秋领有冈山两年便无嗣而终，备前随即转封给姬路城主池田辉政的次子忠继，池田氏统治备前一国直至19世纪。第四代藩主池田纲政起用家臣津田永忠开凿排洪水道、开垦新田，又于1687至1700年间在城北营建宏大的回游式庭园，即后来得名的后乐园。江户太平之世，沿海新田广种棉花，儿岛经围垦与陆地相连，备前的窑火也始终不熄。

en:
Tango is the mountainous peninsula thrust into the Sea of Japan north of Kyoto, cut off from Tanba in 713 to form its own province, with its seat and the Kono Shrine at Miyazu, whose bay is closed by the pine-clad sandspit of Ama-no-Hashidate. Its fleets worked the rough offshore fishing banks and carried coastal goods between Wakasa and the capital. After the Yamana, the Muromachi shogunate gave the shugo post to the Isshiki in 1392, who governed from their hall at Hatta beneath Mount Takebe. In 1444 Isshiki lords still ruled the peninsula as a house close to the Ashikaga court, its harbours busy with fishing boats and scarcely touched by the wars of the age.

In 1579 Oda Nobunaga's generals Akechi Mitsuhide and the scholar-poet Hosokawa Yūsai, with his son Tadaoki, overran Tango and ended Isshiki rule; Yūsai built Tanabe Castle on the old shugo site at Maizuru. In 1600, retired and outnumbered, he burned Miyazu and held Tanabe for fifty days against 15,000 western troops, sending the secret manuscripts of the Kokinshū transmission to Emperor Go-Yōzei lest they perish; the emperor intervened to spare his life, and the besiegers let him march out. After Sekigahara, Tadaoki was moved to Kyushu and Kyōgoku Takatomo received all Tango at 123,000 koku in 1600; on his death in 1622 it split into the Miyazu, Tanabe and Mineyama domains of 75,000, 35,000 and 13,000 koku. The Kyōgoku lost Miyazu to misrule in 1666 and left Tanabe for Toyooka in 1668, though Mineyama remained theirs; the shogun kept Kumihama as his own, and in the Kyōhō years Nishijin weavers brought in the silk-crepe craft that made Tango chirimen the domains' chief new wealth.
zh:
丹后是京都以北伸入日本海的多山半岛，713年从丹波分出另为一国，国府与一之宫笼神社都在宫津，宫津湾被青松成荫的沙洲天桥立横扼。当地船队在风浪险恶的近海渔场捕鱼，也往来若狭与京都之间贩运海货。山名氏之后，室町幕府于1392年将守护一职授予一色氏，一色氏在建部山脚下的八田馆理政。1444年，一色家作为亲近足利幕府的家族统治着这座半岛，港内渔船往来，几乎未被战祸波及。

1579年，织田信长麾下的明智光秀与文人武将细川幽斋（藤孝）、忠兴父子平定丹后，终结一色氏统治；幽斋在舞鹤的旧守护所八田修筑田边城。1600年关原之战，已隐居的幽斋寡不敌众，便烧掉宫津城，在田边城抵挡一万五千西军达五十天；他怕世代相传的《古今集》秘传授书毁于战火，将其献予后阳成天皇，天皇出面调停保全其性命，围兵放他出城。战后忠兴被转封九州，京极高知于1600年领丹后一国十二万三千石；1622年高知死后，丹后分为宫津、田边、峰山三藩，石高分别为七万五千、三万五千、一万三千石。1666年宫津京极氏因恶政被改易，1668年田边京极氏转封但马丰冈，只有峰山一支留到幕末；幕府在久美浜设代官所治理天领，享保年间西阵织工传来缩缅技法，丹后绉绸成为各藩最大的新生财路。

en:
Iyo, or Yoshū, is the northwestern province of Shikoku, a much-indented coast facing the Geiyo Islands and the busiest channels of the Seto Inland Sea; the hot springs at Dōgo, behind the port of Matsuyama, were famed in the age of the early chronicles, and the ichinomiya of the province is the Ōyamazumi Shrine on Ōmishima, guardian of sea roads and warriors. These waters sheltered the pirate Fujiwara no Sumitomo in the 930s, and sea power has ruled Iyo ever since. The Kōno, an ancient local house, held the shugo title and in 1335 built Yuzuki Castle beside Dōgo, but their strength rested on the Murakami sea lords, the Noshima and Kurushima fleets that levied tolls on every passing ship. In 1444 the Kōno rule Iyo in name, the southern valleys obey houses such as the Utsunomiya and Saionji, and their own island retainers are the true masters of the sea lanes.

Sengoku strife exposed the weakness: succession feuds, Ōuchi seizure of the Geiyo Islands and Chōsokabe pressure from Tosa after 1581 left the Kōno leaning on Mōri aid, until Hideyoshi's Shikoku campaign of 1585 ended them in a month's siege of Yuzuki; the last lord Michinao was spared and died heirless at Takehara in 1587. Kobayakawa Takakage briefly held the province, after which it was divided among many domains: work began on Matsuyama Castle on Mount Katsuyama in 1602, its lords passing from the Katō to the Gamō and then the Hisamatsu Matsudaira, and in 1614 Ieyasu granted the southern Uwajima Domain at 100,000 koku to Date Hidemune, eldest son of Date Masamune, whose house ruled there into the nineteenth century. In 1691 the Sumitomo opened the Besshi copper mine in the mountains behind Niihama; its rich ore made it one of Japan's three great copper mines, output reached its pre-modern peak in 1698, and the copper fed the shogunate's coinage and Nagasaki export trade for the rest of the Tokugawa age.
zh:
伊予别称予州，地处四国西北部，海岸曲折，北临濑户内海的艺予群岛与最繁忙的水道；松山港后方的道后温泉自早期史书的年代便已闻名，一之宫大山祇神社坐落在大三岛上，是海路与武人的守护神。930年代，这片水域曾庇护海贼藤原纯友，此后制海权便一直左右着伊予。古老的地方豪族河野氏世袭守护，1335年在道后筑起汤筑城，但其真正的实力依托于能岛、来岛等村上水军——这支岛上舰队向过往船只征收关船钱。1444年的伊予，河野氏徒具守护之名，南部山谷的宇都宫、西园寺等家族自行其是，真正掌控海路的是其麾下的村上诸氏。

战国乱世暴露了河野氏的虚弱：家督纷争不断，大内氏夺取艺予诸岛，1581年起长宗我部氏又从土佐压境，河野氏只能依靠毛利氏的支援苦撑。1585年秀吉发动四国征伐，汤筑城在约一个月的围困后开城，末代当主河野通直获免，1587年在竹原无嗣而终，身为大名的河野氏就此断绝。小早川隆景一度领有伊予，其后该国被分为多个藩：松山城1602年在胜山动工，藩主由加藤氏而蒲生氏、再到久松松平氏；1614年，德川家康把南部十万石的宇和岛藩封给伊达政宗的长子伊达秀宗，伊达氏在此一直统治到19世纪。1691年，住友家在新居滨背后的山中开坑别子铜山，富矿使其跻身日本三大铜山之一，1698年产量创下明治以前的最高纪录，在此后的江户岁月里支撑着幕府铸币与长崎出口。

en:
Kii curved across the south-western side of the Kii Peninsula, where river valleys cut through forested mountains and opened onto the Kii Channel and the Kumano Sea. Kumano's shrines and pilgrimage roads, Koya-san, Negoro-ji and Kimiidera made it a land of temples, retreats and armed religious communities; the old name Ki, associated with trees, also fitted its timber-rich hills, while Kumano mariners linked its coasts to Inland Sea traffic. After the Northern and Southern Courts were reconciled, the Hatakeyama held the title of provincial shugo, but their authority was hemmed in by powerful monasteries, local gentry and seafaring bands. In 1444 Kii therefore belonged to the Hatakeyama in name more than in daily fact.

In the Sengoku decades the Saika musketeers, Negoro monk-soldiers and local communes kept Kii fragmented, and Luis Frois described several republican-style communities that no lord had been able to destroy. When they raided toward Osaka while Toyotomi Hideyoshi was locked in war with Tokugawa Ieyasu in 1584, he answered with the Kishu campaign: his troops burned Negoro-ji on 23 March 1585 and forced Ota Castle to surrender after about a month of floodworks. Hideyoshi ordered a sword hunt and had Wakayama Castle built as the new centre of the province. After Sekigahara in 1600, Asano Yoshinaga was enfeoffed at Kii; in 1619 the Asano moved to Hiroshima and Tokugawa Yorinobu, Ieyasu's tenth son, took Wakayama with 555,000 koku. His Kii Tokugawa house became one of the three Tokugawa collateral houses, and its lord Yoshimune later became the eighth shogun.
zh:
纪伊位于纪伊半岛西南侧，河谷穿过多林的山地，西入纪伊水道，南接熊野滩。熊野三山与熊野古道、高野山、根来寺、纪三井寺使这里遍布寺院、修行场和武装寺社；古称与树木相关，正合山地富产木材的景况，熊野水军也让沿海各地卷入内海航运。南北朝合一后，畠山氏担任纪伊守护，但强大寺社、国人豪族和海上海贼团不断分割其权限。因此1444年的纪伊虽在名义上归于畠山氏，日常统治却远非一纸守护职所能贯穿。

战国时代，杂贺铁炮众、根来寺僧兵和各地自治共同体使纪伊长期割据，路易斯·弗洛伊斯曾说这里有若干个任何权力者都无法消灭的共和国式存在。1584年，这些势力趁丰臣秀吉与德川家康交战时进逼大阪，秀吉随后发动纪州征伐：1585年3月23日火烧根来寺，又以水攻围困太田城约一个月，迫其投降。平定后，秀吉下令刀狩，并以新建的和歌山城作为纪伊新的中心。1600年关原之战后，浅野幸长受封纪伊；1619年浅野氏转封广岛，德川家康第十子德川赖宣以五十五万五千石入主和歌山。纪州德川家此后成为德川御三家之一，其藩主德川吉宗后来更成为第八代将军。

en:
Shinano, or Shinshū, was the broad mountain province of central Honshū that became Nagano, its high ranges split by the Matsumoto, Ina and Zenkō-ji basins and traversed by the Tōsandō, later the Nakasendō. Suwa Taisha was its ichinomiya, while in the north Zenkō-ji, a temple founded by the seventh century, gathered the monzen town that would become Nagano under the saying that everyone ought to pray there once in a lifetime; its high pastures bred the small sturdy horses of Kiso. The Kamakura Hōjō held it as a Kantō province, but after 1402 the Muromachi bakufu kept Shinano as its own land and let the shugo's office fall vacant. Restored by Shōgun Yoshinori, Ogasawara Masayasu briefly pacified the province, yet in 1444 it remained a patchwork of warrior houses — Ogasawara, Murakami, Takanashi, Suwa and the Kiso in their valley — none strong enough to rule the whole.

In 1541 the Suwa and Murakami joined Takeda Nobutora of Kai against the Unno of Chiisagata, but Nobutora's son Shingen, seizing power that year, soon turned on Shinano himself: he destroyed the Suwa in 1542, lost at Uedahara to Murakami Yoshikiyo in 1548, and by 1550 had expelled the shugo Ogasawara Nagatoki and taken most of the province, even carrying Zenkō-ji's hidden Buddha off to Kōfu. The northern lords called in Uesugi Kenshin, and the five Kawanakajima battles of 1553–64 made the Chikuma plain the bloodiest border in Japan; in 1558 the court named Shingen himself shugo of Shinano. After the Takeda fell in 1582 Nobunaga parcelled the province to his generals, and the Tenshō-Jingo disturbance left northern Shinano to the Uesugi and the rest to Tokugawa Ieyasu, with Sanada Masayuki holding Ueda, whose fortress stopped Tokugawa armies twice — in 1585 and under Hidetada in 1600. Under Tokugawa peace Shinano held nineteen domains, among them the Sanada fief of Matsushiro; Ishikawa Kazumasa built Matsumoto Castle's black keep after 1590, Nakasendō post towns served the Kiso valley, whose cypress forests supplied the Owari lords of Nagoya, and new irrigation canals opened fresh fields, though the great eruption of Mount Asama in 1783 drew famine in its train.
zh:
信浓（简称信州）是本州中部的山岳大国，即后来的长野县，崇山之间散布着松本、伊那和善光寺平等盆地，东山道（后来的中山道）穿行其间。一之宫为诹访大社；北方的善光寺最迟在7世纪已经立寺，「一生一度上善光」的参诣者络绎于途，门前町发展为后来的长野；高山牧场还出产木曾的矮壮良马。镰仓时代它是北条氏治下的关东御分国之一，1402年以后成为室町幕府的料国，守护一职长期空悬。小笠原政康经将军足利义教恢复守护之职，曾一度平定信浓，但到1444年，这里仍是诸将割据之地——小笠原、村上、高梨、诹访与据守木曾谷的木曾氏，谁也没有号令全境的实力。

1541年，诹访氏与村上氏还联合甲斐的武田信虎攻入小县郡、驱逐海野氏；同年信虎之子晴信（信玄）夺权，随即把刀锋转向信浓：1542年攻灭诹访，1548年在上田原被村上义清挫败，到1550年已驱逐守护小笠原长时、占取大半国土，还把善光寺的秘佛迁往甲府。北信国人请来越后的上杉谦信，1553至1564年间五度交锋的川中岛之战使千曲川平原成为全日本最惨烈的边境，1558年信玄自己也被补任为信浓守护。1582年武田氏灭亡后，信长把信浓分封给诸将；本能寺之变后的天正壬午之乱，最终使北信四郡归上杉、其余归德川，真田昌幸则在上田自立——1585年和1600年关原之战期间，上田城两度挡住德川大军。江户太平之世，信浓分为十九个藩，真田氏的松代藩即在其中；石川数正1590年入城后修筑了松本城的黑漆天守，中山道宿场町承载着木曾谷的往来交通，谷中的桧林为领有木曾的名古屋尾张藩供应木材；各地新修的灌溉渠开出大片新田，而1783年浅间山的大喷发又引来了天明大饥馑。

en:
Sagami was the Tōkaidō province facing Sagami Bay, where coastal plains and the Ashigara passes linked Kanto with Suruga and the road to Kyoto. Samukawa Shrine was its ichinomiya, and the old provincial capital was variously placed at Hiratsuka, Ōiso or Ebina. In 1180 Minamoto no Yoritomo entered Kamakura, which became the seat of Japan's first samurai government and remained the Hōjō regents' centre until 1333. An Ashikaga Kamakura government continued to rule the east, but Kamakura kubō Ashikaga Mochiuji's quarrel with the Uesugi and the Muromachi shogunate opened the Eikyō conflict in 1438; Kamakura was taken by force in 1439 and Mochiuji killed himself. In 1444 Sagami was back under Ashikaga authority, yet the old military capital no longer held Kanto as firmly as before.

That weakening became permanent in 1455, when Ashikaga Shigeuji moved the Kamakura government to Koga in Shimōsa. Early in the sixteenth century Ise Moritoki, later remembered as Hōjō Sōun, took Odawara; five Later Hōjō lords made it their chief fortress, while Tamanawa Castle secured eastern Sagami and the clan rebuilt Kamakura's Tsurugaoka Hachimangū after fighting the Satomi. Odawara outlasted Uesugi Kenshin's 1561 siege and Takeda Shingen's armed demonstration before its walls in 1569, but in 1590 Toyotomi Hideyoshi's three-month siege forced the Later Hōjō to surrender almost without bloodshed. Under Tokugawa Ieyasu, Ōkubo Tadayo rebuilt the castle on a reduced scale. Edo-period Odawara became a fudai castle town and the largest post station of the fifty-three Tōkaidō stages, Uraga checked shipping at the mouth of Edo Bay, and pilgrim and travel traffic brought new life to Kamakura. The Genroku earthquake shattered Odawara in 1703, followed by the Hōei earthquake and Mount Fuji's eruption in 1707.
zh:
相模是面朝相模湾的东海道令制国，沿海平原和足柄隘口把关东、骏河以及通往京都的道路连接起来。寒川神社是国内一之宫，古代国衙位置有平冢、大矶与海老名等说。1180年源赖朝进入镰仓，这里随后成为日本第一个武家政权的所在地，并在北条执权统治下维持中心地位至1333年。足利氏的镰仓府继续统辖关东，但镰仓公方足利持氏与上杉氏及室町幕府对立，于1438年引发永享之乱；1439年镰仓遭武力攻占，持氏自尽。1444年的相模重归足利幕府权威之下，但这座旧武家都城对关东的掌控已经大不如前。

1455年，足利成氏把镰仓政府迁往下总国的古河，镰仓的衰落已成定局。16世纪初，后来被称为北条早云的伊势盛时夺取小田原；后北条氏五代领主以此为首要据点，又以玉绳城控制东相模，并在与里见氏交战后重建镰仓的鹤冈八幡宫。小田原顶住了1561年上杉谦信的围攻，也经受住1569年武田信玄兵临城下的军事示威，但1590年丰臣秀吉以三个月围城，几乎兵不血刃地迫使后北条开城。德川家康入主关东后，大久保忠世按较小规模重建小田原城。江户时代，小田原成为谱代大名的城下町和东海道五十三次中规模最大的宿场，浦贺在江户湾口盘查船只，参拜与旅行人流也为镰仓带来新的生气。1703年元禄大地震重创小田原，1707年又发生宝永地震和富士山喷发。

en:
Shimosa lay across the lower Tone and Edo River lowlands north of Boso, covering most of later northern Chiba and southwestern Ibaraki. It was formed in the seventh century, when the old land of Fusa was divided; its provincial capital stood near Ichikawa, and Katori Shrine was its chief sanctuary. The Chiba clan had supported Minamoto no Yoritomo and became hereditary governors of Shimosa, but by the Muromachi period their authority was shared with the Yuki and other local warrior houses. In 1444 the Chiba, still seated around Inohana, were the leading family of a fragmented province whose river plains, hemp lands and fishing shores were divided among competing estates.

The province's future turned on the heights of Konodai. In 1538 the Later Hojo of Odawara defeated Ashikaga Yoshiaki and the Satomi there, and their victory in the second battle in 1564 drew the Chiba, Hara and Takagi houses firmly into the Hojo orbit. When Odawara fell to Toyotomi Hideyoshi in 1590, Chiba Shigetane surrendered Sakura to Honda Tadakatsu and Sakai Ietsugu, and the Chiba lost their old dominion. Tokugawa Ieyasu then partitioned Shimosa among vassal domains and direct shogunal lands. Doi Toshikatsu rebuilt Sakura Castle between 1610 and 1617, guarding the eastern approach to Edo; after many changes of lords, the Hotta family became Sakura's best-known Edo-period rulers.
zh:
下总位于房总半岛以北，地处利根川下游与江户川低地，辖境主要是后来的千叶县北部和茨城县西南部。7世纪旧总国分为上下两国时设立，国衙在市川附近，香取神宫为国内一宫。千叶氏曾支持源赖朝，此后世袭下总守护；到室町时代，其权威已必须与结城氏等地方武家分享。1444年，本据仍在亥鼻一带的千叶氏仍是国内最有势力的家族，但这片河川平原、麻地和渔业海岸已被彼此竞争的庄园分割。

下总的命运系于国府台高地。1538年，小田原的后北条氏在此击败足利义明和里见氏；1564年第二次国府台之战又击败里见氏，千叶、原、高城诸家随之被纳入后北条氏的势力范围。1590年小田原落入丰臣秀吉之手后，千叶重胤将佐仓交给本多忠胜和酒井家次，千叶氏丧失旧领。德川家康进入关东后，把下总分割为家臣藩领和幕府直辖领。土井利胜于1610年至1617年重建佐仓城，使其守卫江户东面；此后藩主屡次更替，堀田氏则成为江户时代佐仓最知名的统治家族。

en:
Shimotsuke covered the inland Tochigi basin beyond northern Kanto, taking its present two-character name in 713. Its Nara-period capital stood near the city of Tochigi, where the great Shimotsuke Yakushi-ji was founded, while Futarasan Shrine at Utsunomiya was the province's chief shrine. Around 1063 a castle was raised south of that shrine, at the meeting of the roads later called the Oshu and Nikko highways; the Fujiwara-descended Utsunomiya clan held it for five centuries. Other estates belonged to the Nasu and to the Ashikaga family, from whose Kamakura-period shōen the Muromachi shoguns sprang. In 1444 Utsunomiya Castle therefore commanded rich grain lands along the Kinugawa, yet Shimotsuke remained a mosaic of powerful northern Kanto warrior houses.

During the Sengoku wars the province was pressed by the Later Hojo, Takeda and Uesugi, and the Utsunomiya repeatedly defended their castle against Odawara. Utsunomiya Kunitsuna joined Toyotomi Hideyoshi at Odawara in 1590 and was confirmed in his domain, only to be dispossessed in 1597 after his reported revenues proved far larger than authorized. Gamo Hideyuki entered the castle in 1598, and after Sekigahara the Tokugawa placed Okudaira Iemasa there in 1601. Honda Masazumi, enfeoffed in 1619, rebuilt Utsunomiya with multiple water moats and reorganized the post town for traffic to Nikko, but in 1622 he was exiled on the famous hanging-ceiling charge against the shogun. Fudai lords then succeeded one another rapidly; the Toda returned in 1774 and governed Utsunomiya into the nineteenth century.
zh:
下野位于关东以北的栃木盆地，713年定今名。奈良时代的国衙在后来的栃木市一带，宏伟的下野药师寺亦建于此；宇都宫的二荒山神社则是国内一宫。约1063年，二荒山神社南侧、后来奥州街道与日光街道交会处筑起城堡，藤原氏支流宇都宫氏在此盘踞五百年。那须氏和足利氏也在国内拥有领地，室町幕府的足利将军家就出自镰仓时代的足利庄。1444年，宇都宫城控制着鬼怒川沿岸的富饶粮田，但下野仍是北关东诸武家领地交错之地。

战国时代，下野受到后北条、武田和上杉势力逼迫，宇都宫氏多次据城抵御小田原方面的进攻。1590年，宇都宫国纲参加小田原征伐并获丰臣秀吉承认本领，却在1597年因实际收入远超额定石高而被改易。1598年蒲生秀行入城，关原之战后德川氏又于1601年安置奥平家昌。1619年受封的本多正纯环绕宇都宫城开凿多重水濠，并为前往日光的交通重整宿场，却在1622年因著名的吊天井谋害将军嫌疑被流放。此后谱代大名频繁更替；户田氏于1774年再封宇都宫，一直统治到19世纪。

en:
The fertile coastal plain below the Ōu range faces the Sea of Japan and, beyond it, Ezo. In 733 the Nara court built Akita Castle here to bring the northern Emishi under control, and the anchorage at Tsuchizaki became the coast's trading port, where dealings with the Ainu passed through the Andō clan; installed at Tsugaru in the Kamakura age, they managed the Ezo trade on behalf of the Hōjō. In 1444 the Andō were the lords of this coast, their wealth drawn from the northern fisheries and the Ezo traffic. In the Sengoku wars the Nanbu drove them out of Tsugaru, and Andō Chikasue made Akita his seat and took the clan name Akita; under Toyotomi Hideyoshi, Akita Sanesue held the country round the city at 50,000 koku.

After Sekigahara the Satake of Hitachi, distrusted by Ieyasu for their conduct in the crisis, were transferred to Akita in 1602 with their huge old retinue, while Akita Sanesue was moved the other way to Shishido in Hitachi. Kubota Domain's rating was not fixed until 1664, at 205,800 koku, though the land really yielded twice that; the swollen household kept its finances chronically strained, and the Satake Disturbance over paper currency erupted in 1754. Its lords were patrons all the same: the eighth lord, Satake Yoshiatsu, who called himself Shōzan, founded the Akita school of Western-style painting from 1773 to 1780 with his retainer Odano Naotake, who had studied in Edo under Hiraga Gennai, first invited to Akita to advise on the domain's copper mines, whose metal was shipped out through Nagasaki. In 1807, when Russian raiders fell on Ezo, the domain sent a garrison to Hakodate, kept there for only forty days.
zh:
奥羽山脉之下这片肥沃的沿海平原，隔日本海与虾夷相望。733年，奈良朝廷在此修筑秋田城，以制服北方虾夷；土崎的泊地成为海岸上的贸易港，与阿伊努人的往来长期由安東氏掌管——镰仓时代他们奉北条之命驻在陆奥津轻，经营对虾夷贸易。1444年，安東氏正是这片海岸的主人，财富取自北方渔场和虾夷生意。战国乱世中，南部氏把他们逐出津轻，安東爱季改以秋田为据点并取姓秋田；丰臣秀吉时，秋田实季领有秋田周边五万石。

关原之战后，德川家康以佐竹氏在变局中的态度为由，于1602年将其从世代经营的常陆（五十四万石）转封秋田，庞大的旧臣团随行，秋田实季则被对调往常陆宍户。久保田藩的表高迟至1664年才核定为二十万五千八百石，实际收成约有两倍之多；但背负旧常陆的家臣团，藩财政长期困窘，1754年还因发行藩札引发佐竹骚动。历代藩主却热心文教：八代藩主佐竹义敦（号曙山）在1773至1780年间与家臣小田野直武开创秋田兰画，直武曾在江户师从平贺源内，而源内最初是受请来指导藩内铜矿经营的——秋田的铜大量经长崎输出。1807年俄国船寇犯虾夷，久保田藩受命派兵守备箱馆，约四十天后便获准归藩。

en:
Oshima is the mild southern finger of Ezo, the only corner of the island where Japanese had settled. From the late fourteenth century migrants and traders from Tsugaru built fortified houses along its coasts, twelve in all by the next century, running from Shinoridate on Hakodate Bay to Hanazawa at Kaminokuni; their lords served the Andō family, the shogunate's deputies for the northern seas. At Katsuyama, the hill stronghold above Kaminokuni, archaeologists find Japanese and Ainu dwellings side by side. The ports of Matsumae, Esashi and Usukeshi, later called Hakodate, shipped herring, salmon, kelp and furs south for iron, rice and cloth. In 1444 the Andō banner still flew over the twelve houses, while everything beyond their stockades was Ainu country.

In 1454 Andō Masasue crossed into Ezo with the warrior Takeda Nobuhiro, driven from Tsugaru by the Nanbu. Three years later Koshamain united the eastern Ainu against the settlers and ten of the twelve houses fell, but Takeda slew Koshamain and his son in 1458 and raised the Kakizaki house at Katsuyama. In 1513 another Ainu rising under the brothers Shoya and Koji took the Matsumae stronghold, and Takeda's son Kakizaki Mitsuhiro made himself its master. In 1593 his descendant Yoshihiro was confirmed by Hideyoshi as lord of Ezo, independent of the Andō, and took the name Matsumae; his Fukuyama Hall at Matsumae went up from 1600 to 1606, and in 1604 Ieyasu's black-seal patent granted the clan exclusive trade with the Ainu. The Russians then entered these waters: Adam Laxman's mission reached Hakodate in 1793 to hand back castaways, and Inō Tadataka began his survey of Ezo from Mount Hakodate in 1800. The shogunate took East Ezo in 1799 and the whole island in 1807, removing the Matsumae lord to Yanagawa in Mutsu and ruling through its own magistrates; the Russian captain Golovnin was held at Matsumae from 1811 to 1813. In 1821 Ezo was restored to the clan.
zh:
渡岛是虾夷地南端气候温和的半岛，也是全岛唯一有和人定居的角落。14世纪末起，从津轻渡来的移民和商人陆续在沿海筑馆，到下一个世纪已有「道南十二馆」，东起箱馆湾的志苔馆，西至上之国的花泽馆；馆主们都奉统辖北方海域的安东氏为主君。上之国山冈上的胜山馆遗址中，和人与阿伊努人的住居交错并存。松前、江差、宇须岸（后来称箱馆）三处港口把鲱鱼、鲑鱼、昆布和毛皮南运，换回铁器、米和布匹。1444年，十二馆仍在安东氏的旗帜之下，栅栏之外则尽是阿伊努人的世界。

1454年，安东政季被南部氏所迫，带着武将武田信广渡海进入虾夷。三年后，科夏迈因联合东部阿伊努人进攻和人，十二馆陷落十馆；1458年，武田信广击杀科夏迈因父子，并在胜山馆壮大蛎崎氏。1513年，庶野、訇时兄弟率领阿伊努人攻陷松前大馆，信广之子蛎崎光广借机取而代之。1593年，其后人蛎崎庆广被丰臣秀吉承认为虾夷岛主，名实上脱离安东氏，改称松前；1600至1606年他在松前修筑福山馆，1604年又获德川家康颁发黑印状，垄断与阿伊努人的贸易。此后俄罗斯人进入这片海域：1793年，拉克斯曼使团驶抵箱馆送还日本漂流民；1800年，伊能忠敬从箱馆山开始测量虾夷地。幕府1799年将东虾夷地收归直辖，1807年接管全岛，把松前氏移封陆奥梁川，另设奉行治理；俄国舰长戈洛夫宁1811至1813年被囚禁于松前。1821年，整个虾夷地又归还松前氏。

en:
Yongping was the Ming prefecture seated at Lulong, on the grain-bearing coastal plain between the Yan Mountains and the Bohai Sea. The Yuan had administered the district as Yongping Route; in 1371 the Ming renamed it Yongping Prefecture, and a decade later Xu Da built Shanhai Pass where the mountains meet the coast. In 1444 the prefecture belonged to Northern Zhili and guarded the narrow Liaoxi corridor linking Beijing with Liaodong.

In the late sixteenth century Qi Jiguang thickened the walls, watchtowers and outworks around Shanhai Pass. War reached Lulong in 1629, when Hong Taiji bypassed the pass and led Later Jin troops through the mountains west of it. After Jin forces took Yongping early in 1630, Sun Chengzong organized the counterattack that recovered Luanzhou, Yongping, Qian'an and Zunhua. The pass nevertheless decided the dynasty in 1644: Wu Sangui joined the Qing regent Dorgon there, and their armies defeated Li Zicheng, opening the road to Beijing. Under Qing rule the city remained the seat of Yongping Prefecture, and in the early Qianlong reign Shanhai Guard became Linyu County.
zh:
永平是明代以卢龙为治所的府，位于燕山与渤海之间出产谷物的滨海平原。元代这里称永平路，明洪武四年（1371年）定名永平府；十年后，徐达在山海相接处修筑山海关。1444年时，永平府隶属北直隶，扼守连接北京与辽东的辽西走廊。

16世纪后期，戚继光加固山海关一带的城墙、敌台和附属城防。1629年，皇太极绕过山海关，从西侧燕山诸口攻入华北，战火波及卢龙。后金军于1630年初占领永平后，孙承宗组织反攻，收复滦州、永平、迁安和遵化四城。1644年，这座关隘仍决定了王朝命运：吴三桂在山海关与清朝摄政王多尔衮合兵，击败李自成，清军由此长驱北京。清代仍以卢龙为永平府治，乾隆初年废山海卫，设置临榆县。

en:
Zhending occupies the grain-growing country north of the Hutuo River, where the Taihang passes open onto the North China Plain. After the An Lushan rebellion it became the seat of the Chengde military governors; in 1048 the Song raised Zhenzhou to Zhending Prefecture and made it the administrative centre of Hebei West Route. Jin forces captured it in 1126 and carried off the Song prefect Li Miao, who refused to submit. The Yuan made it Zhending Route and the Ming restored Zhending Prefecture. Its Longxing Temple, founded in 586, was enlarged by order of Song Taizu from 971 around a 21.3-metre bronze thousand-armed Guanyin. The Battle of Zhending was fought here in 1399 during the Jingnan campaign. By 1444 Zhending was a major prefectural city guarding the roads south of Beijing, with monasteries and pagodas within and beyond its walls while the surrounding plain supplied grain.

In 1449 its earthen ramparts were enlarged to a circumference of twenty-four li, a height of three zhang and two chi, a top width of two zhang and a base width of three zhang. Brick facing began in 1571 and was finished in 1576; each of the four gates received an inner wall, a barbican and an outer enclosure. Under the Qing, the Zhili governor moved from Zhending to Baoding in 1669, ending the city's role as a provincial seat. The walls were repaired in 1686, and in 1710 the Kangxi Emperor granted a name plaque to Longxing Temple. In 1723, to avoid a sound in the Yongzheng Emperor's personal name, Zhending County and Zhending Prefecture were renamed Zhengding. Further wall repairs followed in 1728 and 1811.
zh:
真定位于滹沱河北岸的粮田平野，正当太行山隘通向华北平原的要冲。安史之乱后，这里成为成德军节度使驻地；1048年宋朝升镇州为真定府，并以其为河北西路治所。1126年金军攻占真定，宋知府李邈被俘，不屈而死。元代设真定路，明代复为真定府。隆兴寺始建于586年，971年奉宋太祖之命扩建，寺内供奉21.3米高的铜铸千手千眼观音。1399年靖难之役中，真定之战在此爆发。到1444年，真定已是拱卫北京南路的重要府城，城内外寺院、佛塔林立，周围平原则以粮食出产供给这座城市。

1449年，真定土城扩建为周长二十四里、高三丈二尺、顶宽二丈、底宽三丈的城垣；1571年开始包砖，1576年竣工，四座城门各设里城、瓮城和月城。入清后，直隶巡抚于1669年从真定移驻保定，这座城市随之失去省级治所地位。1686年城墙得到修葺，1710年康熙帝为隆兴寺赐额。1723年，为避雍正帝名讳，真定县、真定府改称正定县、正定府；1728年和1811年，城墙又先后重修。

en:
Where the Shandong hills give way to the Jiangsu coast, the Yuntai peaks rise over a shore of tidal flats and offshore islands. Qin set Qu county here, and in 212 BC the First Emperor raised a stone marker at the 'Eastern Gate of Qin' on the Qu headland. From the sixth century the place was known as Haizhou, its seat at Qushan, and after the Yuan renamed it Haining the early Ming restored the old name, folded Qushan into the department and placed Haizhou under Huai'an Prefecture of the Southern Province, with only Ganyu county attached. In 1444 it is a remote salt and fishing department: fishermen work the shallows off Yuntai and Lian Island, while the northern Huai salterns and the salt office at Banpu draw merchants to the coast.

The Ming-Qing transition left the department to the Qing, and in 1668 the great Tancheng earthquake convulsed the shore: the Ganyu flats were thrust upward and the sea withdrew some thirty li, leaving the waters around Yuntai to grow steadily shallower. In 1724 the Yongzheng Emperor raised Haizhou to a department directly under Jiangsu, adding Shuyang to Ganyu. The salt life of Banpu also made a literary fortune: in 1782 the nineteen-year-old Li Ruzhen followed his elder brother, a salt-tax official, to the town, studied under the scholar Ling Tingkan, and over nearly twenty years and three drafts completed in 1818 his novel Flowers in the Mirror, whose voyagers visit imagined kingdoms beyond the eastern sea.
zh:
山东丘陵向南没入江苏海岸，云台山在滩涂与海岛之滨拔起。秦代在此置朐县，公元前212年秦始皇在朐县临海处立石，号为「秦东门」。六世纪起此地得名海州，治所设在朐山；元代改名海宁，明初恢复海州旧称，省朐山县入州，隶南直隶淮安府，唯领赣榆一县。1444年的海州是一处偏远的海盐与渔业之州：渔民在云台山和连岛外的浅海劳作，淮北盐场与板浦的盐课司则把商人吸引到海边。

明清易代，海州归入清朝。1668年郯城大地震撼动海岸，赣榆滩涂隆起，海水后退约三十里，云台山四周的海域从此日渐淤浅。1724年，雍正皇帝升海州为直隶州，除赣榆外又划来沭阳县。板浦的盐务生涯还成就了一部奇书：1782年，十九岁的李汝珍随任盐课司大使的兄长李汝璜来到板浦，师事学者凌廷堪，以近二十年时间三易其稿，于1818年写成《镜花缘》，书中远航者游历的正是东海之外一个个想象中的国度。

en:
Huangzhou faced the middle Yangtze from its north bank, with the Dabie Mountains rising behind the river plain. In 1364, as Zhu Yuanzhang was building his Ming state, the old Huangzhou Route was reorganized as Huangzhou Prefecture, seated at Huanggang and governing the eastern Hubei counties together with Qizhou. Late Yuan warfare had emptied many valleys, and Hongwu-era settlers from northern Jiangxi reoccupied much of the land. In 1444 Huangzhou was therefore a repopulated grain district of Huguang, set on routes between Wuchang, Anhui and Jiangxi.

The prefecture's most lasting fame in these centuries came from Qizhou, where Li Shizhen was born in 1518. He compiled the Compendium of Materia Medica over twenty-seven years, drawing together drugs, plants, animals and mineral remedies; the draft was completed in 1578 and, after Li failed to find a local printer, was finally printed at Nanjing in 1596. Qing administration kept Huangzhou Prefecture at Huanggang. In 1729 Huangpi County, long attached to the prefecture, was transferred to Hanyang, while the river counties continued to supply grain and traffic on the Yangtze.
zh:
黄州位于长江中游北岸，北面是大别山脉。1364年，朱元璋建立明朝基业前夕，改黄州路为黄州府，以黄冈县为治所，统辖鄂东诸县和蕲州。元末战乱使许多河谷人烟空虚，洪武年间来自江西北部的移民重新开垦了大量土地。1444年的黄州是湖广一处人口渐复的谷物产区，地当武昌、安徽与江西之间的往来通路。

这一时期，黄州最持久的声名来自府境东部的蕲州。1518年，李时珍出生于此；他用二十七年编成《本草纲目》，汇总药物、植物、动物和矿物方剂。书稿1578年定稿，李时珍在蕲州、黄州、武昌等地未能觅得书商承印，最终于1596年在南京刊行。清代仍以黄冈为黄州府治，1729年将长期隶属该府的黄陂县划归汉阳府，滨江各县则继续承担粮运与长江往来。

en:
At the western end of the Guanzhong plain, where the Wei valley narrows between the Qinling range and the Long hills, Fengxiang commands the throat between Guanzhong and Longyou: Baoji to its south guards the Chencang road into Shu, while Longzhou opens the road into Gansu. The old city of Yong was a capital of the state of Qin, and in 757 the Tang made it Fengxiang Prefecture, briefly the Western Capital; Li Maozhen held it as capital of his Qi kingdom from 907 to 924. In 1061 the young Su Shi took his first office here as assistant prefect, and the Joyful Rain Pavilion he built gave its name to his famous essay. The Ming set up Fengxiang Prefecture in 1369, governing one department and seven counties, and in 1429 the Prince of Zheng, Zhu Zhanjun, took up residence; ordered to Huaiqing in 1443, he departed in 1444, so the age opens with the princely court of this grain city newly vacated.

Fengxiang lived by the wheat of the western plain and its wine, the distilleries of Liulin filling the town with the scent of the strong spirit later called Xifeng. The early Qing peace broke in 1674, when the Shaanxi commander Wang Fuchen joined the Three Feudatories' revolt, seized Lanzhou and turned the neighbouring Pingliang and Longyou marches into a campaigning ground until he surrendered to the Kangxi Emperor. The Qing rated Fengxiang a busy and populous post and made it the seat of the Feng-Bin intendant, its roads still carrying the grain and wine of the western plain between the Wei valley and the passes.
zh:
关中平原西端，渭河谷地在秦岭与陇山之间收窄，凤翔正卡在关中与陇右之间的咽喉上：南翼的宝鸡扼守入蜀的陈仓道，陇州则敞开通往甘肃的大路。雍城曾是秦国故都，757年唐朝于此置凤翔府，号为西京；907至924年，李茂贞又以这里为岐国都城。1061年，初入仕途的苏轼到任凤翔府签书判官，他所建的喜雨亭后来因名篇《喜雨亭记》传名天下。明朝1369年置凤翔府，领一州七县；1429年郑王朱瞻埈在此就藩，1443年朝廷下诏改封怀庆，1444年郑王启程南下，开局时这座粮城里的王府刚刚人去府空。

凤翔靠着西原的麦子和酒过活，柳林镇烧坊遍地，满城飘着烈酒的香气，所产之酒后来得名西凤酒。清初的太平日子在1674年被打破：陕西提督王辅臣响应三藩之乱起兵，攻破兰州，邻近的平凉与陇右尽成战场，直到他向康熙皇帝投降。清代将凤翔府考定为冲、繁缺分，凤邠道也驻节于此，往来大道依旧转运着西原的粮食与美酒。

en:
Tongren commands the Jin River gap in the Wuling Mountains on the border of Guizhou, Hunan and Sichuan. The Yuan organized the valleys as the Tongren Greater and Lesser Rivers native chief office under the Sinan pacification commissioner. In 1413, after the Sizhou and Sinan chiefs went to war over cinnabar, the Yongle emperor abolished their commissions and created Guizhou Province together with Tongren Prefecture; the Tongren native chief office shared the new prefectural town. The Dawanshan chief office was attached to Tongren in 1414, and after Wuluo Prefecture was abolished in 1438 most of its territory also passed to Tongren. In 1444 the city was therefore a young Ming prefectural seat and garrison at the edge of the Miao hills, near the Buddhist mountain of Fanjing, with cinnabar already being worked in the Wanshan hills.

In 1598 the Ming abolished the Tongren native chief office and established Tongren County in the same town, bringing the prefectural seat under regular county administration. In 1622, during the She-An rising, An Bangyan's army captured Tongren and Sun Keshu, vice intendant of the Si-Shi circuit, died defending the city. Under the Qing, Dawanshan's native administration was likewise replaced by officials appointed from Tongren. Qing forces campaigned against the Red Miao in 1703, established Zhengda post and an assistant prefect under Tongren, and in 1730 created Songtao Subprefecture in the northern hills. In 1795 Shi Liudeng launched the great Miao rising at Datang in Songtao, besieging Zhengda, Ganao and the Songtao seat. Songtao was promoted to an independent subprefecture in 1797, with the Pingtou and Wuluo native lands attached to it.
zh:
铜仁位于武陵山区的锦江峡谷，地处贵州、湖南、四川交界，是黔东门户。元代在大小江流域设铜人大小江蛮夷军民长官司，隶属思南宣慰司。永乐十一年（1413年），思州、思南两土司为争夺朱砂相攻，永乐帝废除两宣慰司，设贵州布政使司和铜仁、思南、石阡、乌罗四府；铜仁长官司与铜仁府同治一城。永乐十二年（1414年）大万山长官司划归铜仁府，正统三年（1438年）废乌罗府，其大部并入铜仁。1444年的铜仁是新设未久的明代府城和军镇，外临苗疆，邻近佛教兴盛的梵净山，万山一带则已开采朱砂。

万历二十六年（1598年），明朝废铜仁长官司，改置铜仁县，府城所在地纳入流官县治。天启二年（1622年），安邦彦叛军在奢安之乱中攻破铜仁府城，分巡思石道副使孙克恕战死。清代，大万山长官司也改由铜仁府派流官直接管理。康熙四十三年（1703年），清军讨平红苗，设正大营并置同知，隶属铜仁府；雍正八年（1730年）置松桃厅。乾隆六十年（1795年），石柳邓在松桃大塘发动苗民起事，围攻正大营、嘎脑营和松桃厅城。嘉庆二年（1797年），松桃升为直隶厅，并划入铜仁府属平头、乌罗两土司地。

en:
Hulan lies on the lower Hulan river, just above where it runs into the Songhua, in the fattest grazing belt of the northern plain. The Jin called the water the Hulahun and kept a stockaded village here under their supreme capital at Huining; the Ming recorded it as the Hulawen, the river from which the Hūlun took their name. Along its banks pastured the 'river Jurchen' of the Haixi, the Sibe among them: they raised horses and cattle, scratched fields of grain and sent sable and ponies to the Kaiyuan fairs. From the Zhengtong years their kin drifted south, carrying the Hūlun name to the later four tribes of Hada, Ula, Hoifa and Yehe. In 1444 the Hulan country was still their stockaded pasture, with no walled town in it.

The Later Jin gathered the country in with the rest of the Haixi lands, and under the early Qing it was a sealed hunting reserve, eight guard posts set along the river in 1683. Permanent building came on 27 December 1734, when the Yongzheng Emperor approved a walled city at Hulan under the military governor of Heilongjiang. The next year the post road from Maoxing reached it and five hundred banner soldiers moved in from Qiqihar and Boduna. In 1736 a river flotilla was stationed at the Hulan mouth to carry grain, and the Hengji granary began filling for the garrisons of Qiqihar, Mergen and Aigun. In 1737 four hundred manor bondsmen came up from Shengjing to work forty official manors; the cattle and goods markets at the city and its five stations were the first taxed markets in Heilongjiang, and Hulan became the breadbasket of the northern frontier.
zh:
呼兰在呼兰河下游，南距河水汇入松花江处不远，是北部平原最肥沃的一片牧场。金代称这条水为活剌浑水，河畔的胡剌温屯归上京会宁府管辖；明代典籍作忽剌温江，「扈伦」这个名字便得自这条江。沿江牧放的是海西女真中的「江夷」，锡伯部也在其中：他们养马放牛，粗放种谷，把貂皮和马匹送往开原边市。自正统年间起，部众不断南迁，把忽剌温之名带往南方，日后形成哈达、乌拉、辉发、叶赫四部。1444年的呼兰河两岸，仍是他们栅栏围起的牧场，境内没有一座城。

明末，这里随海西旧地一并归入后金。清初厉行封禁，1683年在呼兰河流域设卡伦八处，只准旗人猎户出入。1734年12月27日，雍正皇帝批准修筑呼兰城，直隶黑龙江将军；次年，茂兴至呼兰的驿道开通，又从齐齐哈尔、伯都讷移来旗兵五百，分驻呼兰河两岸。1736年，呼兰河口设立水师营专司运粮，城内建起黑龙江最大的恒积仓，常年供给齐齐哈尔、墨尔根和瑷珲三城。1737年，自奉天移来庄丁四百名，设官庄四十所；呼兰城与所属五站的牲畜、杂货市集，开了黑龙江征税的先河，呼兰也由此成为北边的粮仓。

en:
These wooded hills between the upper Hun and the middle Sungari, where modern Liaoning meets Jilin, are the country the Ming called Jianzhou. Its people had not always lived here: the Odoli, Huligai and Tuowen clans came south from the Ilan Tumen land at the confluence of the Mudan and Sungari, and the Ming enrolled them as frontier guards, Ahacu of the Huligai receiving the Jianzhou Guard as early as 1403. After decades of movement under pressure from Koreans and Wild Jurchens, the guard was settled in these hills in 1438, the Left Guard split off in 1440 and the Right Guard in 1442. In 1444 the Jianzhou already ploughed as well as hunted, carrying furs and ginseng to the Ming markets at Fushun and Kaiyuan.

The good years did not last. Jurchen raiding drew joint Ming and Korean expeditions in 1467 and 1478 that shattered the guards' power. Recovery came only with Nurhaci, whom the Ming had invested as commander of the Jianzhou Left Guard: in 1583 he marched on Tulun and opened his wars of unification, and in 1588 the fall of the Wanyan town made him master of all the Jianzhou. In 1616, at Hetu Ala in these same hills, he proclaimed the Later Jin, and the old guard country became the inner homeland of the new Manchu order. Under the Qing it remained the dynasty's ancestral country, where huntsmen and ginseng diggers worked the forests and tribute furs travelled to the capital.
zh:
这片林海丘陵夹在浑河上游与松花江中游之间，地当今辽宁、吉林两省相接处，便是明朝所称的建州。这里的人并非自来便居于此：斡朵里、胡里改、托温三部从牡丹江与松花江汇流处的三姓故地南迁，明朝将他们编为边地卫所，胡里改酋阿哈出早在1403年便受任建州卫长官。此后数十年间，在朝鲜和北方「野人」女真的挤压下辗转迁徙，1438年建州卫在这片丘陵定居，1440年分置左卫，1442年再置右卫。1444年的建州人已兼事农耕与狩猎，带着毛皮和人参到抚顺、开原的马市交易。

好景不长，女真的抄掠引来明朝与朝鲜的夹击，1467年和1478年两次联合进剿重创建州诸卫。复兴要等到努尔哈赤：受明朝袭封建州左卫都指挥使的他于1583年起兵攻打图伦城，开启统一之战，1588年攻克完颜城，成为全部建州之主。1616年，他在同一片丘陵间的赫图阿拉称汗，建立后金，建州旧地就此成为新满洲秩序的腹心故土。入清以后，这里始终是王朝的发祥之地，猎夫与刨夫穿行山林，人参、毛皮作为贡物运往京师。

en:
Taining is the grassland around Baichungtze on the middle Tao'er River, which crosses the western Songnen plain to join the Nen. The Liao emperors kept their spring travelling palace at Changchunzhou here, its ruins the old earthen city south of modern Baicheng; the Jin held it as Taizhou and the Yuan organised it as Taining circuit, from which the later guard took its name. In 1389 the Ming founded the Taining Guard, the first of the three Uriankhai guards, under Azhashili, a descendant of Genghis Khan's youngest brother Temuge, and in 1409 placed it under the Nurgan command. By 1444, harried by Ming expeditions and pressed by the Oirat, its clans had already begun drifting south, loyal to the Ming court and to the steppe by turns.

Between 1446 and 1448 Esen's Oirat armies overran the three guards and the Taining clans scattered. What survived was absorbed in the mid-16th century by the Inner Khalkha under Hulahaqi, while the Tao'er valley itself passed to the southward-moving Nun Khorchin. In 1636, when Hong Taiji organised the Khorchin into banners, the country entered the Qing order as part of the Khorchin right-wing banners, later joining the assembly of the Jirim league. For the rest of the period the Tao'er was quiet banner country: the jasak ruled from felt camps moved with the seasons, herds covered the plain, and neither walled town nor county office was raised here before the period closed.
zh:
泰宁的中心是洮儿河中游的白城子一带。洮儿河横贯松嫩平原西缘，东注嫩江。辽朝在此置长春州，是历代皇帝春捺钵的行宫所在，故城即今白城洮南的城四家子古城；金沿置泰州，元设泰宁路，后来的卫名即源于此。1389年，明朝置兀良哈三卫之首的泰宁卫，以成吉思汗幼弟铁木哥斡赤斤的后裔阿札失里统领，1409年改隶奴儿干都司。到1444年，在明军反复清剿和瓦剌逼压之下，部众已逐渐南徙，对明朝时降时叛。

1446至1448年间，也先的瓦剌大军进逼，三卫溃散，泰宁部众流离。16世纪中叶，残部被内喀尔喀首领虎喇哈赤吞并，洮儿河牧地则归入南下的嫩科尔沁。1636年皇太极编审蒙古旗分，这片地方被划入科尔沁右翼诸旗，后来会盟于哲里木盟。此后近两百年，洮儿河上下是平静的蒙古旗地：札萨克在随季节迁移的毡帐中理政，畜群遍布草原，直到本时期结束也没有出现城郭和州县。

en:
Ju Ud, 'a hundred willows', is the broad basin where the Xar Moron and Laoha rivers meet to form the Western Liao, grassland ringed by the last ridges of the Greater Khingan. The Liao emperors built both their Upper Capital at Linhuang and their Central Capital at Dading in this country, and the early Ming garrisoned Daning here; once the Yongle Emperor pulled the garrisons south, it became pasture of the loosely ruled Uriankhai guards. In 1444 herds grazed among overgrown ruins, and the clans later known as the Bairin, Ongniud and Aohan shifted with the wars of Taisun Khan and Esen.

Early in the 17th century Ligdan Khan fixed his capital at the White City, Chagaan Baishin, raised on the ruins of Liao-dynasty Qingzhou, and from it held the five Inner Khalkha tribes of the Bairin, Jarud and their kin. After his downfall their princes submitted to the Manchus, and in 1639 the Qing bound eight tribes and eleven banners—the Keshiketeng, Bairin, Ar Khorchin, Ongniud, Aohan and others—to assemble at Jaguun Uda in the Ongniud Left Banner, which gave the Ju Ud League its name. Chinese farmers followed the new peace northward: in 1774 the Qing established the Ulanhad hall below the 'red cliff', and in 1778 it became Chifeng County, a Chinese market town planted in Mongol pasture.
zh:
昭乌达，蒙古语意为「百柳」，是西拉木伦河与老哈河汇为西辽河的宽阔盆地，四周环着大兴安岭余脉。辽代的上京临潢府与中京大定府都建在这片土地上，明初曾设大宁卫屯守；永乐以后卫所南撤，此地改由受羁縻的兀良哈三卫游牧。1444年，牧群在荒城废墟间游走，后来的巴林、翁牛特、敖汉诸部正随着脱脱不花汗与也先的战事聚散迁徙。

17世纪初，林丹汗在辽庆州旧址筑起瓦察尔图察汉城（白城），作为号令全蒙古的都城，据此节制巴林、扎鲁特等内喀尔喀五部。林丹汗败亡后，诸部领主相继归附后金；崇德四年（1639年），清廷将克什克腾、巴林、阿鲁科尔沁、翁牛特、敖汉等八部十一旗会盟于翁牛特左翼旗境内的扎滚乌达，昭乌达盟由此而立。关内汉民也随着和平北上垦荒：1774年，清廷在褐色孤峰下置乌兰哈达厅，1778年改设赤峰县，蒙古牧场中长出了汉人的集镇。

en:
Anding took its name from the guard the Ming planted among the Sarïgh Yogïr, the 'Yellow Uyghurs' – Vajrayana Buddhist herdsmen, descended from the Ganzhou Uyghurs, who pastured the bleak country between the Qilian range and the Qaidam salt wastes. In 1375 Buyan Temür, who held the old Yuan title of Prince of Anding, led his people in submitting to the Ming and was confirmed at the head of a guard of his own. Feuding broke it within two years, but Lan Yu's western campaign of 1392 reopened contact, and in 1396 the envoy Chen Cheng restored the guard in the country south of Shazhou. In 1406 its camp was moved to Xierding, by the Sugan lakes in the empty steppe north of the Qaidam. Set astride the road from the Jiayu Pass to the Timurid realm, it passed Ming embassies on their way, and tribute missions were still arriving in the Zhengtong reign of 1444.

During the Zhengde reign of 1506–1521 the fugitive Mongols of Iburai fell upon Qinghai; the Anding tribes were scattered and the guard was never restored. Hard pressed later in the sixteenth century by Sa'id Khan and Altan Khan, the remnants of the outer guards were resettled inside the Jiayu Pass around Suzhou. In 1637 the Khoshut Güshi Khan made himself master of Qinghai, and this country became Khoshut pasture until Lobzang Danjin's rising of 1723 ended in defeat. From 1725 the Qing enrolled the Mongol herdsmen in jasagh banners under the amban at Xining, while Tibetan tribes grazed the higher valleys.
zh:
安定得名于明朝在撒里畏兀儿之地设立的安定卫。撒里畏兀儿即「黄头回鹘」，是信奉金刚乘佛教的牧民、甘州回鹘的后裔，在祁连山与柴达木盐滩之间的荒寒之地游牧。1375年，保有元朝安定王封号的卜颜帖木儿率部归附明朝，获准就其地设卫。两年后卫内纷争而衰，1392年蓝玉西征恢复往来，1396年使臣陈诚在沙州以南重建安定卫。1406年，卫治迁往昔儿丁，在柴达木以北空旷草原上的苏干湖畔。其地正当嘉峪关往帖木儿帝国的大道，转递明朝使团西行；1444年正统年间仍有贡使入朝。

正德年间（1506—1521年），亦不剌率领败亡入青海的蒙古部众袭来，安定部众散亡，卫遂废弃，再未恢复。16世纪后期，残部连受赛德汗与俺答汗打击，明朝把关外诸卫迁入关内安置，撒里畏兀儿余部东徙，在肃州附近与甘州南山定居。1637年和硕特固始汗攻取青海，这片土地成为和硕特牧场，直至1723年罗卜藏丹津起事失败。1725年起，清朝把蒙古牧民编入扎萨克旗，归西宁办事大臣管辖，藏族部落则在更高的河谷放牧。

en:
Nagchu, the Black River, rises in the Changtang pastures on the high road between Qinghai and Lhasa. After Mongol officers opened the imperial post route in 1269, stations and garrisons were planted through the country of the Hor tribes, while the plains around the Nagqu, Siling Lake and Namtso remained country of yaks, sheep and horses rather than walled towns. In 1444 the old Yuan garrisons had given way to Tibetan nomad headmen and Hor communities, whose camps controlled the grazing and the passes leading south toward Lhasa.

From the seventeenth century to the early eighteenth, Nagchu belonged to the Khoshut Mongol order, and Mongol cavalry stationed by Namtso helped overawe central Tibet. The Qing court brought the Thirty-Nine Tribes of Hor under the Lifan Yuan in 1725 through their Hor king, then fixed the Qinghai-Tibet boundary, took a census and placed the tribes directly under the Lhasa ambans in 1731. After Gyurme Namgyal was killed during his 1750 rising, the Qing reforms of 1751 created Kanxiang Dzong at Nagchu under the Kashag, administered jointly by a cleric and a tribal headman; it was the first dzong established on the northern Tibetan plateau, though some pastures remained under Panchen jurisdiction.
zh:
那曲意为黑河，发源于羌塘牧场，正处在青海通往拉萨的大道上。1269年，蒙古官员在青海到萨斯加的驿道上设站，驿路穿过霍尔诸部，今巴青、索县、比如、那曲和当雄一带开始有军士屯驻；那曲河、色林错和纳木错周围依旧是牦牛、绵羊和马匹的天地，而非墙垣城镇。1444年，旧日元朝屯戍已经转为藏族游牧头人与霍尔部众的势力，他们的营地控制着牧场和南下拉萨的山口。

17世纪至18世纪初，那曲属和硕特蒙古政权体系，驻扎在纳木错一带的蒙古骑兵震慑着西藏中枢。1725年，清廷通过第十二代霍尔王赤加吉钦统管霍尔三十九族，使其直属理藩院；1731年又勘定青藏地界、清查户口，把三十九族划归驻藏大臣直接管辖。珠尔默特那木札勒在1750年的变乱中被杀后，清廷于1751年改革藏政，在那曲设立隶属噶厦的坎囊宗，由宗教头领和部落头人联合管理，这是藏北高原设立的第一个宗；另有一部分牧场仍归班禅管辖。

en:
The cold basin of Barkol, around the salt lake its Mongol herdsmen called the Tiger Lake, lies on the northern slope of the Tian Shan, across the mountains from Hami. Its broad sweet-grass pastures, the old Pulei grassland of the Han chronicles, were long a prize grazing ground in the wars of nomad empires. Under the Yuan it was called Barkule on the eastern edge of Bechbaliq, and by the fifteenth century Khoshut and other Oirat tribes pastured their herds there. In 1444 it was Oirat land, given over to horses, sheep and camels.

Barkol submitted to the Qing together with Hami in 1697, and its pastures became the great forward base for the Qing wars against the Dzungars. A walled city was built there in 1731 with an Anxi subprefect posted to it, an admiral's headquarters followed in 1762, another garrison city in 1772, and in 1773 the seat was raised to Zhenxi Prefecture. Until the rise of Dihua, Barkol remained the regional command centre of the Qing north-western frontier, its horses and camels famed across the empire.
zh:
巴里坤的寒冷盆地环绕着一座盐湖——蒙古牧民称之为虎湖，即巴里坤湖——地处天山北坡，翻过天山就是哈密。湖畔丰美的牧场便是汉文史籍中的蒲类草原，历来是游牧帝国交争的肥美草场。元代称巴尔库勒，在别失八里东境；到15世纪，和硕特等瓦剌部落在此放牧。1444年的巴里坤是瓦剌之地，遍布马群、羊群和骆驼。

1697年，巴里坤随哈密归附清朝，这片牧场随后成为清军对准噶尔用兵的大军前出基地。1731年修筑巴尔库勒城，派驻安西同知；1762年设提督府，1772年再筑兵城，1773年升为镇西府。在迪化城兴起之前，巴里坤一直是清朝西北边疆的区域性指挥中心，所产马匹和骆驼闻名天下。

en:
The Turpan oasis lies in a deep basin below the Bogda Shan, where karez channels carried snowmelt to fields and walled towns on the Silk Road. Jiaohe and later Qocho were the old centres before Turpan itself rose between them. After the Uyghur kingdom of Qocho passed under Chagatai rule, the oasis became a settled corner of Moghulistan, its Uyghur cultivators and caravans living under Turco-Mongol lords. In 1444 Esen Buqa II headed the Eastern Chagatai regime; Islam was advancing with the Moghul elite, while older Buddhist and East Syriac Christian traces had not yet vanished.

As the eastern Chagatai centre shifted to Turpan, the rule of Ahmad Alaq and his son Mansur Khan brought firmer Islamic rule and long wars over Hami. Mansur conquered Hami in 1513, opening decades of raiding and diplomacy along the Ming frontier. A Yarkand army ended the separate Turpan line in 1570, though Chagatayid embassies from the region still reached Beijing in 1647 and 1657. The Dzungars later held the oasis until Qing campaigns broke their power; Qing forces took control in 1755, Emin Khoja returned with his people to Lukchun in 1756 and was made a commandery prince in 1758. From 1759 Qing garrisons and the six cities of Turpan tied the oasis firmly to the new north-western order.
zh:
吐鲁番绿洲位于博格达山南麓的深陷盆地中，坎儿井引来雪水灌溉农田，也滋养了丝绸之路上的城郭。交河、高昌（火州）曾先后是这一带的中心，后来吐鲁番城在两城之间兴起。高昌回鹘王国并入察合台势力后，这片绿洲成为蒙兀儿斯坦的定居农业角落，维吾尔农户和往来商队受突厥—蒙古贵族统治。1444年，东察合台政权由也先不花二世统领；伊斯兰教正随蒙兀儿上层扩展，而较早的佛教和东方基督教痕迹尚未完全消失。

随着东察合台的统治中心移到吐鲁番，阿黑麻与其子满速儿汗在位时，伊斯兰统治更为稳固，并围绕哈密展开长期战争。满速儿于1513年征服哈密，开启了明朝边境数十年的攻掠与遣使往来。1570年，叶尔羌军队攻灭吐鲁番的独立汗统，但这一带的察合台系统治者仍在1647年和1657年向北京遣使。准噶尔后来控制绿洲，直到清朝进军击破其势力；清军于1755年控制吐鲁番，额敏和卓1756年率部返回鲁克沁，1758年受封郡王。1759年起，清军驻防与「吐鲁番六城」的设置把这片绿洲牢牢纳入新的西北秩序。

en:
Qurqara-usu is the string of springs and oasis pastures below the Eren Habirga range on the northern slope of the Tianshan, where the road from Urumqi reaches the Ili country. The Mongol name means cold black water, after the river now called the Kuitun. Tang garrisons included Black Water Post, but after the Mongol age the district was chiefly pasture on the Moghul steppe. In 1444 the Muslim Chagatayid khan Esen Buqa claimed it through his tribal lords, while Oirat raids pressed in from the northern grasslands; its value lay in water, grain, horses and the track across the Dzungarian Basin rather than in a great walled city.

By the early Qing period the land was pasture of the Bulgut Oirats. Their chiefs Nima and Hunqi submitted when the Qing campaign against the Dzungars began in 1755, then joined Amursana's revolt. Qing forces killed Nima in 1757 and captured Hunqi the next year, bringing Qurqara-usu under the frontier administration. In 1772 a military superintendent was stationed at Qingsui Cheng, the later Wusu, under the Urumqi authorities. A civilian magistrate was added in 1781, and Anfu Cheng was built at Jinghe in 1783, securing the string of oases between Urumqi and Ili.
zh:
库尔喀喇乌苏位于天山北麓额林哈毕尔噶山北麓，是由泉水、绿洲和牧场连成的地带，扼守从乌鲁木齐通往伊犁的道路。蒙古语地名为「寒冷的黑水」，得名于今奎屯河一带。唐代曾在此设黑水守捉，蒙古时代以后主要成为蒙兀儿斯坦边缘的游牧地。1444年，信奉伊斯兰教的察合台汗也先不花通过部族首领领有此地，瓦剌的袭扰则从北方草原逼近；这里的重要性在水源、谷物、马匹和穿越准噶尔盆地的道路，而不在一座高墙大城。

清初，这一带是厄鲁特蒙古布尔古特部的牧地。1755年清军征讨准噶尔时，布尔古特台吉呢玛、浑齐率部投降，不久又随阿睦尔撒纳反叛。1757年，清军擒杀呢玛；次年又俘获浑齐，库尔喀喇乌苏纳入清朝边疆管辖。1772年，清朝在后来的乌苏庆绥城设领队大臣，受乌鲁木齐节制；1781年增设抚民同知，1783年又在精河筑安阜城，使乌鲁木齐与伊犁之间的绿洲通道得到稳固。

en:
Maralbexi, the old Barchuk, lies where the Yarkand River leaves the Kashgar oases and loses itself in the Taklamakan, astride the caravan road from Aksu to Kashgar and Yarkand. Its riverine marshes and reed-beds, alive with deer and wild boar, made it less a city than a scatter of grazing grounds and small oasis hamlets that supplied the western towns with wool and hides. In 1444 the country formed the eastern march of the Kashgarian oases held by the Dughlat emirs, vassals of the Moghul Chagatai khans.

In 1480 the Dughlat ruler Mirza Abu Bakr made himself independent here, until Sultan Said Khan overthrew his house and founded the Yarkand khanate in 1514. From about 1680 the Dzungars were overlords of Kashgaria, and in February 1759 Fude's relief column, marching from Aksu across the desert to raise the Black Water siege at Yarkand, routed the khojas' army at Qurman in this district. After the conquest Barchuk became a military relay station on the Qing official road, its grasslands the home of the semi-nomadic Dolan — herdsmen and hunters whose chanted Dolan muqam sounded nothing like the Twelve Muqams of the cities.
zh:
玛热勒巴什清代称巴尔楚克，即今巴楚，地处叶尔羌河离开喀什噶尔绿洲、没入塔克拉玛干沙漠的地方，扼守阿克苏通往喀什噶尔与叶尔羌的商路。沿河沼泽芦苇丛生，多马鹿野猪，与其说这里是一座城，不如说是散布的牧场和小绿洲村落，为西边的城镇供应羊毛和皮革。1444年，这片地方是喀什噶尔诸绿洲的东缘，由臣属于蒙兀儿察合台汗的杜格拉特异密统治。

1480年，杜格拉特部首领米儿咱·阿巴拜克热在此自立，直到1514年赛德汗推翻其政权、建立叶尔羌汗国。约1680年起，准噶尔成为喀什噶尔的宗主；1759年2月，富德的援军从阿克苏穿越戈壁驰援叶尔羌黑水营，在境内呼尔满击溃和卓军队。平定之后，巴尔楚克成为清朝官道上的军台，草滩上住着半游牧的刀朗人——他们牧放狩猎，吟唱的刀朗木卡姆和城里的十二木卡姆大异其趣。

en:
Yangi Hissar — the 'New Fortress' in Uyghur, Yingishar to the Qing — guards the short road between Kashgar and Yarkand, where the oasis belt narrows beneath the Pamir foothills. The walled market town sat among irrigated fields and sheep pastures, and its smiths were already known across Kashgaria for their forged pichak daggers. In 1444 it belonged to the Dughlat emirs who governed the Kashgar oases as vassals of the Moghul Chagatai khans.

In 1499 the Moghul khan Ahmad Alaq stormed Kashgar and Yangi Hissar from Mirza Abu Bakr Dughlat; fifteen years later Ahmad's son Sultan Said Khan folded the town into his new Yarkand khanate. In 1680 Galdan's Dzungars, guided in by the White Mountain khoja Afaq, overthrew that state, and Yangi Hissar remained under Dzungar overlordship until the Qing conquest of 1759. The Qing ranked it a middle-grade city under a fourth-grade hakim beg and a brigade general, and in 1766 posted a garrison commandant there to watch the Kashgar road.
zh:
英吉沙，维吾尔语意为「新城」（清代又译作英噶萨尔、英吉沙尔），扼守喀什噶尔与叶尔羌之间的近路，帕米尔山前的丘陵在两侧把绿洲夹成一条窄带。这座有城墙的集镇周围是灌溉田和牧羊场，城里的铁匠早已远近闻名，锻造的皮恰克小刀（英吉沙小刀）行销整个喀什噶尔。1444年，它属于杜格拉特异密统治的喀什噶尔诸绿洲，他们是蒙兀儿察合台汗的藩臣。

1499年，蒙兀儿汗阿黑麻从米儿咱·阿巴拜克热手中攻下喀什噶尔和英吉沙；十五年后，阿黑麻之子赛德汗建立叶尔羌汗国，此城归入汗国版图。1680年，噶尔丹的准噶尔军在白山派和卓阿巴克引导下攻灭叶尔羌汗国，英吉沙改受准噶尔役属，直到1759年清朝平定大小和卓。清廷把英吉沙划为中等城，设四品阿奇木伯克理政、总兵管理边务，1766年又改派领队大臣驻守，弹压这条喀什噶尔道上的重镇。

en:
Dazhou lies at the southern foot of the Daba Mountains, where Sichuan meets Shaanxi and Hubei, its valleys draining by the Zhou and Qu rivers into the Jialing. Ba people held the country in antiquity; in 96 AD the Eastern Han set up Xuanhan county here, and in 553 the Western Wei made it Tongzhou, a link between the Han river country and the Sichuan basin. The Northern Song renamed it Dazhou in 965 for its roads reaching in every direction. In 1376 the Ming reduced it to a county, then restored it as a department under Kuizhou Prefecture in 1514. In 1444 it was the quiet northeastern corner of Sichuan, timbered ridges above grain-growing valleys and walled market towns.

The thinker Tang Zhen, born at Dazhou in 1630, later served briefly as a county magistrate before retiring to write the Qianshu, with its fierce attack on autocratic rule. In 1728 the Yongzheng Emperor raised Dazhou to an independent department directly under the province. In the tenth month of 1796 the White Lotus rising reached the Daba country: Xu Tiande and Wang Dengting rose at Dazhou, Leng Tianlu and Wang Sanhuai in neighbouring Dongxiang, and in 1797 the converging rebel armies met at Dongxiang and were organised under coloured banners, Xu commanding the Dazhou Blue. The Qing needed until 1804 to put the revolt down in these mountains; in 1802 Dazhou had already become the seat of the new Suiding Prefecture.
zh:
达州地处大巴山南麓，川、陕、鄂三省交会之处，州河汇入渠江，渠江又南注嘉陵江。其地古为巴国所在，公元96年东汉分置宣汉县，553年西魏改万州为通州，控扼汉水流域与四川盆地之间的往来。965年北宋改通州为达州，因其地居四达之路而得名。1376年明朝降达州为达县，1514年复升为州，隶属夔州府。1444年的达州是四川僻静的东北角，山岭林木茂密，州县以河谷种粮为生计。

1630年，思想家唐甄生于达州；他后来短任知县，辞官著书，所撰《潜书》猛烈批判君主专制。1728年，雍正帝升达州为直隶州，直属四川省。1796年十月，白莲教起事蔓延到大巴山区：徐天德、王登廷在达州举兵，冷天禄、王三槐在邻县东乡继起；1797年各路教军在东乡会师，按黄、蓝、青、白各号编组，徐天德统领达州青号。清廷直到1804年才把这场乱事镇压下去，而达州已在1802年改设绥定府。

en:
Jiazhou stands where the Min River meets the Dadu and Qingyi, the busiest crossing on the water road below Mount Emei in southern Sichuan. Under the Han it was Nan'an county; under the Tang it was Jiazhou, and it is a Buddha that made the place famous. In 713 the monk Haitong began hewing a colossal Maitreya out of the red cliff at Lingyun Temple, hoping the image would calm the treacherous current; work was halted and resumed under the governor Zhangqiu Jianqiong, and Wei Gao, governor of Jiannan, saw it finished in 803 after ninety years of labour. In 1196 the Southern Song raised Jiazhou to Jiading Prefecture, and the Ming made it an independent department in 1376, its seat at Longyou on the river. In 1444 Jiading was a river port and Buddhist town, with Emei's monasteries drawing pilgrims to the west.

The Wanli reign saw the founding of Baoguo Temple at the foot of Emei, later given its present name by the Kangxi Emperor. Ming Sichuan collapsed under Zhang Xianzhong's invasion of 1644, but Jiading found a defender in a native son: Yang Zhan, a military jinshi of 1637, escaped execution at Zhang's hands, raised troops at Qianwei and killed the rebel-appointed magistrate, then retook Xufu and Jiading in 1646. In the seventh month of that year he struck at Jiangkou near Pengshan while Zhang's fleet of treasure barges was sailing downriver, routed it and sent its cargo into the water, then harried the retreat to Hanzhou; the Southern Ming court enfeoffed him Marquis of Xuanping. In 1649 his own hungry allies Wu Dading and Yuan Tao got him drunk at a banquet and killed him, and Jiading fell after a four-month siege, his son fleeing to Baoning to submit to the Qing. In 1734 the Yongzheng Emperor restored Jiading Prefecture and established Leshan county at its seat.
zh:
嘉州位于岷江与大渡河、青衣江三江交汇处，是峨眉山下川南水道上最繁忙的渡口。汉代在此置南安县，唐代为嘉州；让此地闻名的是大佛。713年，僧人海通为镇住湍急水势，在凌云寺旁的红砂岩崖上开凿巨型弥勒像；工程中辍后由剑南节度使章仇兼琼捐俸续修，西川节度使韦皋再主持其事，历时约九十年，至803年终告完工。1196年南宋升嘉州为嘉定府，明朝1376年降为嘉定直隶州，州治龙游就在江畔。1444年的嘉定是一座河港与佛城，西面的峨眉山寺刹林立，香火极盛。

明万历年间，峨眉山麓创建报国寺，后由清康熙帝赐改今名。1644年张献忠入川，明朝在四川的统治瓦解，嘉定却出了一位本地守将杨展：他是1637年武进士，成都城破后被押赴刑场时夺刀脱逃，到犍为起兵，杀掉大西所派县令，1646年收复叙府和嘉定。同年七月，他在彭山江口截击张献忠满载金宝东下的船队，大西军大败，辎重尽弃江中，他又追击至汉州；南明朝廷封他为宣平侯。1649年，前来就食的武大定、袁韬在席间将他灌醉杀害，嘉定被围四个月后陷落，其子杨璟新逃往保宁降清。1734年，雍正帝复升嘉定直隶州为嘉定府，并在治所置乐山县。

en:
Luzhou guards the confluence of the Tuo River and Yangtze, where the Sichuan basin opens toward Yunnan and Guizhou. A county named Jiangyang stood here under the Western Han, and between 535 and 546, under the Liang dynasty, the settlement was organized as Luzhou. Under the Southern Song it was called the granary of southern Sichuan; salt refining, distilling and trade with mountain peoples prospered, while walls and forts guarded the river routes. When the Mongols entered Sichuan, Luzhou's administration withdrew through a chain of mountain strongholds and held Shenbicheng until 1277. The Yuan kept its shipyards and trade in salt, liquor and tea. In 1373 the Ming made Luzhou directly subordinate to Sichuan, and in 1376 placed it under the provincial administration; in 1444 it was a Sichuanese river port living on grain, salt, liquor and shipping.

Long Ming peace widened the town's fame for liquor: in 1573, the first year of the Wanli reign, fermentation pits later associated with Luzhou Laojiao were built. The southern approaches became a battlefield in 1621, when the Yi tusi She Chongming rose at Yongning and An Bangyan rose in Shuixi; their revolt swept Sichuan and Guizhou until Zhu Xieyuan suppressed it in 1630. Warfare returned during the Three Feudatories' revolt. After Wu Sangui drew Sichuan into his rebellion, the Manchu bannerman Fenile broke the rebel position at Baozi Mountain and took Luzhou in 1680; when Wu forces returned to the south, Zhao Hongcan recovered Luzhou, Xuzhou and Yongning in 1681. In 1802 the Qing placed the port under the Chuannan Yongning circuit, marking its role as the river gateway between Sichuan, Yunnan and Guizhou.
zh:
泸州扼守沱江与长江的汇合处，是四川盆地通向云南、贵州的水口。西汉时这里设有江阳县，南朝梁535至546年间建置泸州。南宋时，泸州被称为川南粮仓，盐业、酿酒和与山地部族的贸易都很兴盛，城墙、堡寨守护着水路。蒙古军入蜀后，泸州治所辗转于一连串山城，神臂城一直坚守到1277年。元代继续发展造船，以及盐、酒、茶贸易。1373年，明朝将泸州直隶四川行省，1376年又改直隶四川布政使司；1444年的泸州已是依靠粮食、盐业、酒类和航运为生的蜀地河港。

长期的明代承平扩大了这座市镇的酒名：1573年，即万历元年，后来成为泸州老窖基础的一批窖池开始兴建。1621年，南方通路再成战场，彝族土司奢崇明在永宁起兵，安邦彦在水西响应，战事席卷四川、贵州，直到1630年才由朱燮元平定。三藩之乱时战火又至。吴三桂叛乱牵动四川后，满洲将领佛尼埒攻破豹子山，于1680年攻克泸州；吴军再扰南路时，赵弘灿又于1681年收复泸州、叙州和永宁。1802年，清廷将泸州划归川南永宁道，确认了它作为四川、云南、贵州之间河运门户的地位。

en: Ulch is the lower Amur country of forested right-bank channels behind Tyr, where lakes and tributaries meet the great river's salmon roads. In 1444 small sedentary villages, commonly only two to five houses, stood where summer and winter fishing was best. Families lived in log winter houses and bark or pile summer dwellings, took salmon with nets, hooks and weirs, dried yukola for themselves and their sled dogs, and also hunted seals, sea lions, elk, deer and sable. Flat-bottomed boats linked the villages with Nivkh and Nanai neighbours, while furs drew outside traders. The first Russian reports came from Vasily Poyarkov's expedition of 1643–1646 and later Cossack dispatches, which also brought the first demands for sable yasak; through the eighteenth century the villages remained fishing and fur camps rather than a Russian garrison town.
zh: 乌尔奇是提尔后方、阿穆尔河下游右岸的林地水网，湖泊与支流在这里接入大河的鲑鱼洄游路线。1444年，小型定居村落通常只有两三户到五户房屋，择冬夏渔获最便处而居。居民冬天住木构房屋，夏天住树皮屋或桩上屋，用网、钩和鱼梁捕鲑鱼，把鱼肉风干成鱼干，既供人食用也喂雪橇犬，同时猎捕海豹、海狮、驼鹿、鹿和紫貂。平底船把村落与尼夫赫人、那乃人邻部联系起来，毛皮则吸引外来商人。瓦西里·波亚尔科夫1643—1646年的探险队和后来的哥萨克报告留下俄国人最早的记载，也首次带来缴纳紫貂牙萨克的要求；整个18世纪，这里仍是渔村和毛皮营地，而不是俄国驻防城镇。

en:
Fudali is the wet, forested country between the lower Amur channels and the ranges that descend toward the Tatar Strait. In 1444 its Hezhen or Nanai clans were classed among the Wild Jurchens, ruled by clan elders rather than a settled court. Summer villages followed the sturgeon and salmon runs; families dried fish for winter, softened the skins of large fish into clothing, and travelled by birch-bark boat, dog sledge and ski. Sable moved through the regional fur trade, while shamans tended the spirits of water, mountains, bears and tigers.

The clans at first fought Nurhaci and the rising Manchus under Sosoku, their Hurka chief, before submitting to Hong Taiji in 1631; Manchu rule then brought the order to shave the forehead and wear the queue. Yerofey Khabarov's mid-century campaigns produced the first detailed Russian reports, in which related groups appear as Achans and Natkis. After Qing authorities moved Duchar farming communities deeper into Manchuria in the 1650s, Russian accounts describe Nanai groups spreading into riverine lands left open. French Jesuit geographers travelling for the Qing in 1709 met these fishing peoples, called them Fish-skin Tartars, and found tobacco almost their only cultivated crop.
zh:
傅达里是阿穆尔河下游水网与伸向鞑靼海峡的山岭之间一片湿润林地。1444年，住在这里的赫哲人（俄罗斯称那乃人）属于野人女真诸部，由氏族长老管理，而不受某个定居朝廷直辖。夏季村落跟随鲟鱼和鲑鱼的渔汛移动；居民把鱼风干备冬，将大鱼皮鞣软制成衣服，出行则用桦皮船、狗拉雪橇和滑雪板。紫貂皮进入区域毛皮贸易，萨满则侍奉水域、山岭、熊与虎的神灵。

诸部起初在虎尔哈首领索索库率领下抵抗努尔哈赤和兴起的满洲人，1631年归附皇太极；随后满洲统治带来剃发留辫的命令。17世纪中叶，叶罗费·哈巴罗夫的远征留下俄国人最早的详细报告，相关人群在报告中被称为阿昌人和纳特基人。1650年代清朝把务农的杜切尔人迁往满洲内地后，俄文记载称那乃群体逐渐进入空出的河畔地带。1709年为清朝测绘的法国耶稣会地理学者遇到这些渔猎部族，称他们为「鱼皮鞑子」，并发现烟草几乎是他们唯一种植的作物。

en:
Oroch is the Tatar Strait coast beyond the Amur approaches, where deep bays and river mouths meet the northern Sikhote-Alin forests. In 1444 Oroch clans, whose old self-name Nani meant local people, camped by the Amur, Lake Kizi and coastal streams. Their Tungusic name recalled reindeer, yet these groups had become settled fishers: they took chum salmon, pink salmon and taimen, paddled dugouts and plank boats into the bays after seals and sea lions, and hunted musk deer, elk, bear and sable in the taiga. Camps moved with the seasonal runs, while shamans tended the spirits of sea, forest and ancestors.

Russian naval charts reached the northern approaches in 1741, when Alexei Shelting and Mikhail Gvozdev surveyed the Uda mouth, Udsk and the Shantar Islands; Shelting sailed toward the Amur and Sakhalin in 1742 within Martin Spanberg's expedition. This coast itself became known to European navigators on 25 July 1787, when Jean-François de Lapérouse entered a sheltered roadstead and named it De Castries Bay after the French naval minister. No fort followed for decades, and through 1821 the anchorage remained a place whose winds, landing places and salmon runs were read by Oroch fishing and sea-hunting parties.
zh:
奥罗奇位于阿穆尔河口以远的鞑靼海峡沿岸，深水海湾与河口在这里接上锡霍特山脉北段的森林。1444年，奥罗奇诸氏族在阿穆尔河、基齐湖和海滨河汊旁设营而居；他们旧称「那尼」，意为本地人。其通古斯语族名称与驯鹿有关，但这些群体已转为定居渔人：他们捕捞大麻哈鱼、驼背大麻哈鱼和哲罗鱼，划独木舟与木板船进入海湾猎捕海豹和海狮，也在泰加林中猎取麝、驼鹿、熊和紫貂。营地随渔汛迁徙，萨满则侍奉海洋、森林与祖先的神灵。

俄国海图在1741年推进到北方邻近水域：阿列克谢·舍尔京格与米哈伊尔·格沃兹杰夫测绘了乌第河口、乌第堡和尚塔尔群岛；1742年，舍尔京格又在马丁·斯庞贝里的远征编制内向阿穆尔河与萨哈林方向航行。1787年7月25日，让-弗朗索瓦·德·拉彼鲁兹驶入一处避风锚地，并以法国海军大臣之名将其命名为德卡斯特里湾，欧洲航海者这才真正认识这段海岸。此后数十年间这里没有建起要塞，直到1821年，熟悉风向、登陆点和鲑鱼路线的仍是前来捕鱼和猎海兽的奥罗奇人。

en: Pijin was called the Bixing in Ming records and Bisin Bira in Manchu, the forest river now named Bikin. It winds for 560 kilometres through a 22,300-square-kilometre basin before entering the Ussuri. In 1444 Udege and other Tungusic fishing and hunting bands occupied its cedar and pine valleys, taking game and fish, gathering ginseng and floating timber on the middle reaches. Ming frontier records knew the waterway as the Bixing but placed no county town on its banks. Qing records later preserved the name Pijin, and through 1821 the valley remained a scattered indigenous hunting and fishing frontier.
zh: 毕歆在明代称必兴河，满语为毕歆必拉，即今比金河。它蜿蜒560公里，流经22,300平方公里的流域后汇入乌苏里江。1444年时，乌德盖等通古斯渔猎人群住在河谷的雪松与松林间，猎兽捕鱼、采集人参，并在中游河道流放木材。明朝边疆文献以必兴河记载这条水道，却未在河畔设置县城。入清以后，记载仍沿用毕歆之名；直到1821年，这片河谷依旧是村落分散的土著渔猎前沿。

en:
Buteha is the well-watered hill country where the eastern wall of the Greater Khingan falls away to the Nen. Its Manchu name Buthai means 'fish and hunt': here the Solon, as the Evenki were known, and the reindeer-keeping Oroqen lived by elk and sable in the mountain forests, while Korchin Mongol clans pastured their herds on the river flats. Its people kept shamans rather than lamas, and in 1444 these valleys were the northern hunting grounds of the Korchin.

In 1640 the Manchu armies of Hong Taiji crushed the Solon-Daur federation led by Bombogor and bound its clans to the Manchu cause. When Khabarov's Cossacks stormed the Daur towns on the Amur a decade later, Daur clans burned their villages and withdrew south, settling on the Nen between 1654 and 1656. In 1683 the country passed under the new Heilongjiang General, and in 1689 a Butha commandant's yamen was set at Yihqi on the Nen, ruling the three Daur jalan and the five Evenki aba. In 1731 these were mustered as the Butha Eight Banners, ninety-two companies of Daur, Evenki and Oroqen; they still hunted the Khingan sable but marched, generation after generation, in the Dzungar and Jinchuan wars and the other frontier campaigns of the Qianlong reign.
zh:
布特哈是大兴安岭东麓向嫩江倾斜的湿润丘陵之地。其名来自满语 buthai，汉译作布特哈，意为渔猎：被称作索伦的鄂温克人和使鹿的鄂伦春人在山林中逐貂捕鹿，河谷草甸上则是科尔沁蒙古人的牧场。这里的人奉萨满而不奉喇嘛，1444年，这些河谷是科尔沁部北方的猎场。

1640年，皇太极的满洲大军击破博穆博果尔的索伦—达斡尔联盟，把诸部纳入满洲阵营。十余年后，哈巴罗夫的哥萨克攻陷黑龙江上的达斡尔城寨，达斡尔诸部焚城南徙，于1654至1656年间落脚嫩江两岸。1683年，此地归新设的黑龙江将军管辖；1689年，布特哈总管衙门设于嫩江畔的后宜卧奇，统辖达斡尔人的三个扎兰与鄂温克人的五个阿巴。1731年，这些部众被编为布特哈八旗，共九十二佐——达斡尔三十九佐、鄂温克四十七佐、鄂伦春六佐；他们依旧在兴安岭猎貂，又一代接一代披甲从征，转战于准噶尔、大小金川等乾隆朝的边疆战场。

en:
Bayan Tumen lies on the Kherlen, the long river that rises in the Khentii Mountains and flows east toward Hulun Lake. The surrounding pastures had been Tatar country before Genghis Khan broke the confederation in 1202 and absorbed its people into the Mongols. For centuries the riverside site served mainly as a camp and post on the steppe trade route; Bayan Tumen did not yet exist as a town in 1444. In those years, herders moved between the Kherlen and the Hulun-Buir grasslands under the fractious lords of the Northern Yuan, living above all from horses, cattle, sheep and the caravan traffic passing their camps.

By the late Ming period, Moroibema's Mongol following grazed along the Kherlen, and his son Sholoi took the title Sechen Khan. Sholoi sent tribute to Hong Taiji in 1635, and from 1638 the Sechen court maintained the Qing 'nine whites' tribute. When Galdan's Dzungars invaded in 1688, the young khan Ömökhei and more than a hundred thousand households took refuge in the Ujimchin pastures. After the Dolon Nor assembly of 1691, the Qing organized them as the Sechen Khan aimag, the Eastern Road of the Khalkha, with twelve banners in 1692. The people returned to the Kherlen in 1697, and by 1755 the aimag had twenty-three banners, whose assemblies met at Kherlen Bars through the early nineteenth century.
zh:
巴彦图门位于克鲁伦河畔；克鲁伦河发源于肯特山，向东流向呼伦湖。这一带曾是塔塔儿人的牧场，1202年成吉思汗击灭塔塔儿联盟，将其部众并入蒙古。河畔地点长期只是草原商路上的营地和驿站，1444年时还没有形成城市。那时，牧人在克鲁伦河与呼伦贝尔草原之间随季节迁徙，处在北元诸部首领纷争不断的世界里，生计主要依靠马匹、牛、羊以及经过营地的商队。

明代末年，谟啰贝玛率部在克鲁伦河一带游牧，其子硕垒自称车臣汗。硕垒于1635年向后金皇太极遣使朝贡，1638年起车臣汗部向清廷行「九白」之贡。1688年噶尔丹率准噶尔东侵，年幼的车臣汗乌默客与十万余户部众退入乌珠穆沁牧场避难。1691年多伦诺尔会盟后，清朝将其编为车臣汗部，即喀尔喀东路，1692年分为十二旗。部众于1697年返回克鲁伦河游牧；到1755年，车臣汗部已扩至二十三旗，会盟地设在克鲁伦巴尔斯，这一秩序延续到19世纪初。

en:
Khiagt lies on a small tributary of the Selenge, where the Mongolian steppe runs into the southern edge of the Siberian taiga – couch-grass country, as its Buryat name records. In 1444 no fixed border crossed these hills. Mongol herdsmen pastured their stock on the open steppe, while forest clans to the north trapped sable and squirrel and sent their furs south as tribute to the Mongol khan; a settled market town was still three centuries away.

Later in the seventeenth century Russian Cossacks built the Selenginsk fort on the Selenge, and the Treaty of Nerchinsk in 1689 opened a guarded frontier with the Qing. After the Bura and Kyakhta treaties of 1727 drew the Russo-Qing boundary, the Serb envoy Sava Vladislavich raised the Troitskosavsk stockade on this spot, and in 1728 the Kyakhta trading settlement stood beside it. In 1730 the Qing built their own merchants' town, Maimaicheng, on the opposite bank, and the twin settlements became the great official emporium of the overland China trade. Until 1762 Russian state caravans went on from here to Beijing; afterwards merchants bartered on the spot, Siberian sable and squirrel furs and Russian leather for Chinese silk, cotton and, above all, tea. The Qing closed the market three times in diplomatic disputes, the last reopening sealed by the Kyakhta convention of 1792, the same year the Russian customs house moved here from Irkutsk. Shanxi merchants ran the Chinese side of the trade, and Hubei tea, carried by camel through Urga and across the Gobi, went on to supply all of Russia and much of Europe as 'Russian tea'. Troitskosavsk became a proper town in 1805, and its stone cathedral rose between 1807 and 1817 – monuments to a frontier that lived by fur and tea.
zh:
恰克图在色楞格河一条小支流畔，蒙古草原在此接上西伯利亚泰加林的南缘；其布里亚特语地名意为「长满冰草的地方」。1444年还没有固定边界穿过这些丘陵：蒙古牧民在开阔草原上放牧，北方林海中的部族猎取紫貂和灰鼠，把毛皮作为贡物南送蒙古汗廷，定居的商镇还要再过三百年才会出现。

17世纪后期，俄国哥萨克在色楞格河畔建起色楞金斯克寨堡，1689年《尼布楚条约》开启了与清朝之间设防的边界。1727年《布连斯奇条约》和《恰克图界约》划定俄清边界后，塞尔维亚出身的使节萨瓦·弗拉季斯拉维奇在此筑起特洛伊茨科萨夫斯克木堡，1728年，恰克图商埠在城堡旁落成。1730年，清朝在对岸建起自己的商镇买卖城，双子城从此成为陆路对华贸易的官设大市。1762年以前，俄国国家商队由此前往北京，此后改为商人就地易货：西伯利亚的紫貂、灰鼠皮和俄国皮革，换取中国的丝绸、棉布，而最重要的是茶叶。清朝曾三次因交涉关闭市场，最后一次随1792年《恰克图市约》重开，同年俄国海关也由伊尔库茨克迁此。中方贸易由晋商经营，湖北茶叶经驼队穿过戈壁、经过大库伦运抵此地，再行销全俄和欧洲大部，被称为「俄罗斯茶」。特洛伊茨科萨夫斯克1805年正式设城，石砌大教堂于1807至1817年间建成——这些都是一座靠毛皮与茶叶致富的边塞留下的纪念。

en:
The Middle Gobi is the driest belt of the Mongol plateau, a riverless waste of gravel and thin pasture broken only where the Ongi, born on the southeastern slopes of the Khangai, runs 435 kilometres south towards Ulaan Lake, drying up before reaching it in most years. Its lower valley had long been imperial ground: Ögedei built his southernmost winter palace, the Ongi Ordu, near Karakorum, and Güyük and Möngke kept the camp in turn, the very palace Rubruck heard described as Möngke's residence south of Karakorum. By 1444 it was pasture again, where Khalkha herders under Borjigin taijis grazed sheep and horses and still worshipped Tengri.

As the Gelug teaching spread among the Khalkha, the Ongi valley received Ongiin Khiid in 1660, twin monastic complexes facing each other across the river with four monastic universities and over a thousand monks at their peak. Galdan's Dzungars swept the Khalkha from these pastures in 1688, and the khans submitted to the Qing at Dolonnur in 1691; in 1696 Galdan himself turned back from the Ongi when he tried to seize the Qing army's grain stores there. Under Qing rule the valley became pasture for Sain Noyon banners: the northern Barlam complex went up in the eighteenth century, its great hall one of the largest temples in Mongolia, and by the end of that century Gimpil Darjaalan Khiid at Erdenedalai housed some five hundred monks.
zh:
中戈壁是蒙古高原最干旱的一带，砾石与薄牧场之间全无河流，只有发源于杭爱山东南坡的翁金河南流435公里奔向乌兰湖，多数年份半路便已干涸。它的下游早就是帝王的牧地：窝阔台在哈拉和林附近建起最靠南的冬宫翁金斡耳朵，贵由、蒙哥两代大汗相继沿用，鲁不鲁乞听说的「哈拉和林南方的蒙哥宫殿」正是此宫。到1444年，这里重又只是牧场，孛儿只斤台吉治下的喀尔喀牧人放牧着羊马，仍旧信奉腾格里。

格鲁派传入喀尔喀后，1660年翁金河畔建起翁金寺（Ongiin Khiid），鼎盛时河南河北两组建筑群隔河相望，设有四所僧院大学，僧侣逾千。1688年噶尔丹的准噶尔军把喀尔喀人逐出这片牧场，1691年诸汗在多伦诺尔臣服清朝；1696年噶尔丹南下，企图夺取清军囤在翁金河的粮草，最终被击退。清治之下，河谷成为赛音诺颜部各旗的游牧之地：河北的巴拉姆建筑群于18世纪落成，大经堂为全蒙古最大的殿堂之一；到18世纪末，额尔登达莱的Gimpil Darjaalan Khiid也有约五百名僧人。

en:
Ulaangom lies below Kharkhiraa Mountain at the southwestern edge of the Uvs Nuur basin, not far from Mongolia's largest saline lake. In 1444 no later town stood here: these were cold Oirat pastures within Esen Taishi's confederation. Herdsmen moved horses, cattle, sheep and camels between the lakeshore and mountain slopes, followed the Tengri cult, and used the shelter of Kharkhiraa during the harsh winters.

The settlement is traditionally dated to 1686, and historical evidence records grain cultivation nearby in the late seventeenth century, when the Dzungar wars drew the Uvs basin into conflict with the Khalkha and Qing. In 1753, during the Dzungar civil war, three Dörbet leaders submitted to the Qing with more than 3,000 households. The Qianlong Emperor received them in 1754, and their people were organized into the Left and Right Sain Zayaatu leagues: fourteen Dörbet banners pastured around Uvs Lake and Ulaangom, with two attached Khoit banners. From 1761 the banners came under the Kobdo councilor, giving the old seasonal pastures a fixed Qing frontier order.
zh:
乌兰固木位于乌布苏盆地西南缘、哈尔黑拉山脚下，不远处是蒙古面积最大的咸水湖乌布苏湖。1444年，后来的城镇尚未出现，这里只是也先太师瓦剌联盟境内的寒酷牧场。牧民在湖岸与山坡之间转场马、牛、羊和骆驼，信奉腾格里，并依靠哈尔黑拉山遮挡严冬风雪。

相传乌兰固木1686年形成定居点，17世纪末附近已有谷物种植；当时准噶尔的战争正把乌布苏盆地卷入与喀尔喀和清朝的冲突。1753年准噶尔内战期间，杜尔伯特三车凌率三千余户归附清朝。乾隆帝次年接见他们，将部众编为赛音济雅哈图左右两翼盟，十四旗杜尔伯特人分布在乌布苏湖畔和乌兰固木一带，另附辉特二旗。1761年起，这些旗归科布多参赞大臣管辖，旧日的季节性牧场由此纳入清朝固定的边地旗界秩序。

en:
Hetao is the great bend of the Yellow River, where the stream leaves the Ningxia plain, runs north-east along the foot of the Yin Mountains and then turns sharply south, enclosing a ring of warm, irrigable steppe that farmers have prized since Han times. The Ming once held it with the Dongsheng guards, but those were withdrawn inside the wall in 1403; no garrison or office remained in the rear loop, and the empty grassland was grazed by Tatar, Oirat and Uriankhai herders. In 1444 Beijing still counts the bend as its own, yet the real defence rests on a ragged line of forts rising along its southern edge, while the pastures north of the river belong to whoever commands the wells.

During the Chenghua reign raiders camped in the loop harried the Ningxia and Yansui borders year after year, and Yu Zijun, governor at Yansui, answered with a chain of earthen walls and forts along the southern rim. The herders who made the bend their home were the Ordos, keepers of Genghis Khan's eight white shrine-yurts, their name meaning the people of the royal ordo. In 1510 Dayan Khan made them one of the three right-wing tümens under his son Bars Bolud, the jinong; a generation later Bars Bolud's son Altan Khan led the whole right wing, and his horsemen were at the gates of Beijing in 1550. In 1571, after long wars, the Ming named Altan the Shunyi King and opened eleven border marts, including Ningxia, where loop herds sold horses and cattle for grain, cloth and iron. In 1578 Altan met the Geluk leader Sonam Gyatso and conferred on him the title Dalai Lama, binding the Mongols to Tibetan Buddhism; he died early in 1582. The Ordos submitted to Hong Taiji in 1635, and in 1649 the Qing settled them into six banners, with a seventh added in 1736, meeting in league at Yeke Juu.
zh:
河套是黄河画出的巨大河湾：河水离开宁夏平原后沿阴山山麓向东北流去，再折而向南，围出一片温暖、可引渠灌溉的草原，自汉代起就为农人所重。明朝曾以东胜诸卫戍守，1403年卫所尽数内迁，后套不再驻有官军、不设衙门，空旷的草场任由鞑靼、瓦剌和兀良哈的牧人游牧。1444年的北京仍把河湾视为版图，但真正的边防只能依靠南线陆续筑起的一串堡寨，而河北的草场属于控制水井的人。

成化年间，驻牧套中的骑兵连年寇掠宁夏、延绥边境，延绥巡抚余子俊于是沿河南缘补筑边墙、墩堡，把防线连成一线。定居河湾的牧人是鄂尔多斯部，世代守护祭祀成吉思汗的八座白色宫帐，部名意为宫帐的属民。1510年达延汗将其编为右翼三万户之一，以其子巴尔斯博罗特为济农；一代人之后，巴尔斯博罗特之子俺答汗统领整个右翼，1550年其骑兵直抵北京城下。长期交兵之后，明朝于1571年封俺答为顺义王，开放包括宁夏在内的十一处边口马市，套中牧人以牛马换取粮食、布帛和铁器。1578年俺答会见格鲁派领袖索南嘉措，上以「达赖喇嘛」尊号，蒙古各部由此皈依藏传佛教；俺答于1582年初去世。1635年鄂尔多斯归附皇太极，1649年清朝将其编为六个扎萨克旗，1736年又增设一旗，七旗在伊克昭会盟。

en:
Jinju guards the southwestern approach of Gyeongsang, on the roads leading toward Jeolla. The country around the fortress was once part of the Gaya world, then passed through Baekje and Silla rule; Goryeo gave it the name Jinju in 940 and established Jinju-mok in 983. By 1444, under Confucian Joseon, the town was one of the province's key prefectural seats, a walled mok centre set behind its fortress on the Nam River.

In November 1592 Hideyoshi's commanders sent about 30,000 Japanese troops against Jinju, seeing the fortress as a gateway to Jeolla. Kim Si-min held the walls with roughly 3,800 government soldiers and the townspeople, while Gwak Jae-u's righteous army pressured the besiegers from outside; the Korean defence halted the invasion's southwestern advance. The war returned on 20 July 1593, when a far larger Japanese army invested the fortress for seven days. The garrison refused calls to withdraw, and after the walls were lost nearly every soldier and civilian inside perished; the victors returned to the southern coast rather than pushing on into Jeolla.
zh:
晋州扼守庆尚西南、通往全罗方向的道路，是一处以城池为核心的要冲。其地原属伽倻世界，后经历百济与新罗统治；高丽于940年改其名为晋州，983年置晋州牧。到1444年儒教朝鲜治下，这里已是庆尚道重要府治之一，城墙内的牧镇依托南江畔的晋州城控制周边道路。

1592年11月，丰臣秀吉的将领们把晋州城视为进军全罗的门户，率约三万日军来攻。晋州牧使金时敏率约三千八百名官军和城中军民登城固守，郭再祐领导的义兵又在城外牵制日军，这场防御最终阻止了侵略军向西南推进。1593年7月20日，兵力远胜于前的日军再次围攻晋州城，战事持续七日。守军拒绝撤离，城破后城内军民几乎全部遇难；日军获胜后退回南海岸，并未继续攻入全罗。

en:
Naju lies on the middle Yeongsan River, where the broad Naju plain gave southern Jeolla one of its richest granaries. The settlement then called Geumseong belonged to Later Baekje until 903, when Wang Geon, the future founder of Goryeo, took it and renamed it Naju; his Naju wife, Lady Janghwa, became the mother of King Hyejong. Naju-mok was created in 983 and became one of the eight great mok in 1018. In 1404, after thirty-three Japanese pirate ships raided Jeolla, the town walls were rebuilt in three months. By 1444 the magistrate at Naju supervised a network of counties and districts, while Yeongsanpo gathered the region's tax rice for shipment to Hanyang.

The district's military weight grew under Joseon: in 1457 Sejo established the Naju garrison, with the moksa acting as its commander. Yi Bok-nam, serving as Naju's deputy magistrate when the Japanese invaded in 1592, marched out with the district's troops and later became Naju magistrate and Jeolla army commander. In 1597 he led seven hundred men into besieged Namwon and died when the fortress fell. In 1657 Hyojong reorganized the Naju garrison as the Jeolla Right Military Camp, whose commander controlled the forces of two counties and eight districts. The river grain trade and this command kept Naju a principal town of southern Jeolla through the rest of the dynasty.
zh:
罗州位于荣山江中游，开阔的罗州平原是全罗南部最富庶的谷仓之一。这里原称锦城，属后百济；903年，后来创建高丽的王建夺取此地并改名罗州，他娶罗州女子庄和王后为妻，其子即后来的高丽惠宗。983年设罗州牧，1018年成为全国八牧之一。1404年，三十三艘倭船侵入全罗道后，罗州邑城在三个月内紧急修筑。1444年，罗州牧使统辖周边郡县；荣山浦汇集这一地区的税粮，再由船只运往汉阳。

进入朝鲜时期，罗州的军事地位继续上升：1457年世祖设罗州巨镇，由牧使兼任兵马使。1592年日本入侵时，在罗州任判官的李福男率本邑兵出征，后来历任罗州牧使和全罗道兵马节度使。1597年，他率七百人进入被围的南原城，城破时战死。1657年，孝宗将罗州巨镇改编为全罗右营，右营将掌管两郡八县的军力。凭借荣山江粮运与这一军事指挥中心，罗州在朝鲜后期始终是全罗南部的首要邑治之一。

en:
Chungju occupies a broad basin of the South Han River between the Charyeong and Sobaek highlands, on the direct road from the southern provinces to Hanseong. It was Gukwonseong, a southern Goguryeo fortress, in 475, and Silla raised it to Jungwon-gyeong in 757. Goryeo renamed it Chungju-bu in 940, made it Chungju-mok in 983, and numbered it among the eight great mok in 1018. Joseon placed the Chungcheong provincial headquarters there in 1395, and the Chungju archive safeguarded dynastic records and important state books. In 1444 the magistrate of this walled town guarded a river gateway crowded with officials, soldiers, and traffic between Hanseong and the south.

In 1449 the left Chungcheong inspector was stationed at Chungju, with the moksa holding the office; in 1458 Sejo reorganized it as a garrison command over eight counties. The town's strategic value became catastrophe on 7 June 1592, when Konishi Yukinaga's army reached Tangeumdae. Sin Rip, the northern-frontier veteran whom Seonjo had given a royal sword, abandoned the Joryeong Pass position and met the invaders on the Dalcheon plain to use his cavalry. Japanese arquebuses broke the charges and encircled the Koreans; Chungju fell, Sin Rip died in the disaster, and the road to Hanseong lay open. The Chungju Annals archive burned, with only the Jeonju copy surviving. In 1602 the Chungcheong governor's seat was moved to Gongju, but Chungju remained a garrison town on the South Han River road.
zh:
忠州位于南汉江的宽阔盆地，处在车岭与小白山脉之间，是南方诸道通往汉阳的要冲。475年，这里是高句丽南方据点国原城；757年，新罗将其升为中原京。高丽940年改称忠州府，983年设忠州牧，1018年又列为八牧之一。1395年，朝鲜把忠清道的道监营设在忠州；忠州史库则负责保存王朝实录和重要文书。1444年，牧使镇守这座城邑，控制官员、军队和南北行旅往来的南汉江水陆门户。

1449年，忠清左道监司驻在忠州，由牧使兼任；1458年，世祖将其改编为忠州镇营，命忠州营将管辖八郡军务。1592年6月7日，小西行长的军队进抵弹琴台，忠州的战略价值骤然变成生死战场。宣祖赐下尚方剑、派往南方的宿将申砬放弃鸟岭险口，选择在达川平原以骑兵迎战。日军以铁炮打乱朝军冲锋并完成包围，忠州城陷落，申砬战死，通往汉阳的大路就此敞开。忠州史库所藏实录毁于战火，只有全州史库本幸存。1602年，忠清道监营迁往公州，但忠州仍是南汉江通道上的军事重镇。

en:
Suwon lies about thirty kilometres south of Hanyang on the broad Gyeonggi plain. In the Three Kingdoms period its Maehol lands passed between Baekje, Goguryeo and Silla; Silla called the district Susong, and Goryeo knew it as Suju. In 1271 it was raised to a protectorate after local forces killed Mongol troops who had entered Daebu Island, though its status later rose and fell. In 1413 King Taejong's eight-province reorganization established Suwon Dohobu, with Namyang, Ansan, Anseong, Jinwi, Yongin, Yangseong and Yangji attached to it; under King Sejo a garrison was added. In 1444 Suwon was thus a Confucian administrative and military seat just south of the capital, set among productive rice plains rather than a remote frontier.

War reached the district during the 1592 Japanese invasion, when General Gwon Yul held the Doksan position against the Japanese advance. In the 1636 Qing invasion, Kim Jun-yong raised a righteous army and repulsed a Qing force at Gwanggyosan. Suwon's greatest transformation came under King Jeongjo. In 1789 he moved his father Crown Prince Sado's tomb to nearby Hwasan and began building a new county seat beneath Paldalsan. From 1794 to 1796 the Silhak scholar Jeong Yakyong designed Hwaseong Fortress, combining Korean and Chinese fortress forms with brickwork, pulleys and cranes; its walls enclosed town quarters, government offices and the Haenggung palace. Jeongjo granted settlers ten years of tax exemption, hoping to make Suwon a reformist capital linking Hanyang with the Yellow Sea. The 1795 procession for his mother's sixtieth birthday used 5,661 people and 1,417 horses on the road to Sado's tomb.
zh:
水原位于汉阳以南约三十公里的京畿广阔平原上。三国时期，买忽一带先后受百济、高句丽和新罗控制，新罗时称水城郡，高丽时称水州。1271年，当地因杀死进入大阜岛的蒙古兵而升为都护府，后来地位又有升降。1413年太宗整顿八道行政，设水原都护府，领南阳、安山、安城、振威、龙仁、阳城、阳智等地；世祖时又在水原设镇。1444年的水原已是都城正南的儒教行政与驻防城邑，四周是盛产稻米的平原，并非偏远边镇。

1592年壬辰倭乱时，权栗将军在秃山城一带据守，阻击日军推进。1636年丙子胡乱时，金俊龙举起义兵，在光教山击退清军。水原最大的转变发生在正祖时期：1789年，正祖将父亲思悼世子的陵墓迁到附近的华山，并在八达山下营建新邑。1794年至1796年，实学者丁若镛设计水原华城，将朝鲜与中国的城制同砖作、滑轮和起重机结合起来；城墙内布置市街、官衙和华城行宫。正祖向迁入居民免税十年，希望把水原建成连接汉阳与黄海的革新都城。1795年为母亲花甲而往思悼世子陵寝巡幸的队伍，动用了5661人和1417匹马。

en:
