The forts of Makwanpur and Chisapani, the latter built around 1744-1745, then helped close the southern supply routes into the Kathmandu Valley. On 28 February 1816 the East India Company stormed Makwanpurgadhi during the Anglo-Nepalese War; ratifications of the peace treaty were exchanged there on 4 March.
zh:
马克万普尔扼守加德满都谷地与南部平原之间的山地通道。13世纪，森人的一支在弥萨罗北部建立统治，马克万普尔堡成为王朝要塞，后世传说将筑堡之功归于图拉·森。1444年，这片土地仍由印度教森王族控制，宫廷使用迈蒂利语，力量依托山脊上的堡垒，以及通往加德满都谷地的商道。

1762年8月21日，普利特维·纳拉扬·沙阿的廓尔喀军队在马克万普尔堡进攻迪格班丹·森。约八小时后，森人的防线崩溃；迪格班丹向孟加拉的米尔·卡西姆求援，但援军又在1763年1月20日被廓尔喀击败。马克万普尔堡和约建于1744至1745年的奇萨帕尼堡，此后帮助封锁了通往加德满都谷地的南部补给线。英尼战争期间，东印度公司于1816年2月28日攻破马克万普尔堡，和约批准书则于3月4日在此交换。

en:
The ridge of Tansen, crowning the Mahabharat hills above the Kali Gandaki gorges, was the heart of Barha Magarat, the confederation of the twelve Magar kingdoms. Its Magar name means the northern settlement: below lay the malarial Terai and the road to the plains, while the Kali Gandaki gorge above carried the trade with Tibet and Mustang. In 1444 Magar rajas still held the chain of ridge-top forts running from Rippdikot to the Kalika kot, and Tansen's marts already drew Newar merchants travelling between the hills and the plains.

Rudra Sen of Rippdikot founded the Hindu Sen kingdom of Palpa in 1493. Under Mukunda Sen, who reigned from 1518 to 1553, Palpa's armies invaded the Kathmandu valley in 1524; on his death in 1553 the dominion split into the Sen houses of Palpa, Tanahun and Makwanpur, the last of which later sent out the Chaudandi and Vijaypur branches, while Argha, Khanchi and Gulmi broke away. Palpa nevertheless remained the strongest of the Chaubisi states: it recovered Butwal in 1710 and for a time paid the nawab of Oudh for protection and the use of its Terai lands. In 1804 King Prithvi Pal Sen was lured to Kathmandu and his kingdom annexed, and on the night of 25 April 1806 he was killed in the Bhandarkhal massacre. In 1814 Ujir Singh Thapa, commanding the garrison of the old kingdom, defeated a British column at Jit Gadhi above Butwal. The Treaty of Sugauli two years later left Tansen within Nepal, its Newar bazaar on the India-Tibet road famed for metalwork and dhaka cloth.
zh:
坦森山脊雄踞摩诃婆罗多山、俯临卡利甘达基峡谷，是马嘉尔人十二邦联盟「巴拉·马格拉特」的核心。坦森在马嘉尔语中意为北方的聚落：山下是瘴疠流行的特莱平原与通往印度的道路，山上则借卡利甘达基峡谷与木斯塘和西藏通商。1444年时，马嘉尔拉杰们仍据守着从利普迪果德到卡里卡堡的一连串山顶寨堡，坦森的市集已吸引尼瓦尔商人往来于山间与平原之间。

1493年，利普迪果德的鲁德拉·森建立印度教森氏帕尔帕王国。穆昆达·森1518至1553年在位，1524年挥师攻入加德满都谷地；他1553年去世后，疆域分裂为帕尔帕、塔纳洪、马克万普尔三支森氏王统，马克万普尔一支后来又分出乔丹迪与维杰布尔，阿尔加、汗奇和古尔米也相继自立。尽管如此，帕尔帕仍是乔比西诸邦中最强的一个：1710年重新并回布特瓦尔，并一度向阿瓦德的纳瓦布称臣纳贡，以换取庇护和对特莱领地的使用权。1804年，国王普里特维·帕尔·森被诱往加德满都，王国随即遭兼并；1806年4月25日夜，他在班达尔卡尔事件中被杀。1814年，乌吉尔·辛格·塔帕统率旧地守军，在布特瓦尔以北的吉特加迪击败一支英军。两年后的《苏高利条约》将坦森留在尼泊尔版图之内，这座印藏商道上的尼瓦尔市集以金属工艺和达卡织物闻名。

en:
Purnia lies in the wet jungle lowlands between the Kosi and Mahananda rivers, on the eastern edge of Mithila where the Bengal plain meets the Morang Terai. Bakhtiyar Khilji conquered the southern clearings early in the thirteenth century after overthrowing Lakshman Sen at Nadia, but Kirat and other hill peoples long kept the northern forests. In 1444 the country was a remote military frontier of Mahmud Shah's Bengal Sultanate, facing Tirhut on one side and the Koch-Kamata marches on the other. Gaur's authority ran mainly through armed settlements, river crossings and jungle clearings rather than a dense provincial administration.

During Humayun's war with Sher Shah Suri, Purnia supplied levies in the campaigns of 1538–1539 before Sur governors took over Bengal. Under the Mughal Bengal Subah the district was divided between the sarkars of Purania and Tajpur, separated by the Mahananda, while its northern strip bordered the kingdom of Morang. In the early seventeenth century a faujdar with the title of nawab combined military command and revenue charge, using Jalalgarh as the chief northern outpost. Saif Khan, who became faujdar in 1722, built the surviving fort at Jalalgarh and in 1732 annexed Birnagar from Drujan Singh, bringing Dharampur and other zamindaris more firmly under Purnia. In 1757 the Purnia governor Shaukat Jang rebelled against Siraj-ud-Daulah and was defeated at Nawabganj. The East India Company received the district with the Bengal diwani in 1765 and began effective administration with a superintendent on 14 February 1770.
zh:
普尔尼亚位于科西河与马哈南达河之间潮湿的密林低地，地处米提拉东缘，也是孟加拉平原接入莫朗特莱的交界。13世纪初，巴赫蒂亚尔·哈尔吉在纳迪亚推翻拉克什曼·塞纳后征服南部开垦地，但基拉塔等山地族群长期据有北方森林。1444年，这里是马茂德沙阿的孟加拉苏丹国最偏远的军镇边地之一，西对提尔胡特，东接科奇—卡马塔边境。高尔朝廷的权威主要依靠武装聚落、渡口和林间开垦地维持，并未建立密集的行省行政。

胡马雍与舍尔沙·苏利交战时，普尔尼亚在1538—1539年的战事中提供兵援，随后孟加拉转入苏尔派任的总督之手。莫卧儿设立孟加拉苏巴后，这一地区被马哈南达河分为普拉尼亚和杰季普尔两个萨尔卡尔，北缘则与莫朗王国相接。17世纪初，一位拥有纳瓦布头衔的法乌贾达尔同时统辖边防军队和财政，贾拉尔格尔成为北方主要据点。1722年就任法乌贾达尔的赛义夫汗修建了现存的贾拉尔格尔堡，并于1732年从德鲁詹·辛格手中吞并比尔纳加尔，把达兰布尔等柴明达尔领地更牢固地收入普尔尼亚辖下。1757年，普尔尼亚长官绍卡特·章起兵反对西拉杰·乌德-道拉，在纳瓦布甘杰战败。东印度公司于1765年随孟加拉迪万尼取得该地，并在1770年2月14日设置监督官，开始有效统治。

en:
Saran is the fertile river plain north of Patna, bounded by the Ganges, Gandak and Ghaghara; Chhapra stands near the Ghaghara confluence and Sonpur where the Gandak meets the Ganges. In 1444 the country formed the eastern march of the Jaunpur Sultanate, whose Sharqi rulers had carried their power from the middle Ganges into north Bihar. Mahmud Shah Sharqi, who had succeeded his father in 1440, ruled a largely Hindu peasantry from Muslim garrisons and revenue posts.

The Sharqi kingdom collapsed in 1494 when Bahlul Lodi defeated Husain Shah Sharqi near Benares, and Saran passed into the Lodi and later Mughal imperial system. The Ain-i-Akbari listed it among the six sarkars of Bihar. Under Aurangzeb the old cattle market was moved from Hajipur to Sonpur, where dealers gathered at the river confluence to sell cattle, horses and elephants. Chhapra grew rapidly in the eighteenth century after saltpeter works were established there, and in 1765 the East India Company acquired the diwani of Bihar, bringing Saran's revenues under Company control.
zh:
萨兰是巴特那以北的肥沃河原，恒河、甘达克河与加格拉河环绕四周；恰普拉位于加格拉河汇流处附近，索恩普尔则在甘达克河入恒河之处。1444年，这里是章普尔苏丹国的东部边陲，沙尔基君主已把势力从中恒河推进到北比哈尔。1440年继位的马哈茂德·沙阿·沙尔基依靠穆斯林驻军和税站，统治以印度教徒为主的农户。

1494年，巴赫卢尔·洛迪在贝拿勒斯附近击败侯赛因·沙阿·沙尔基，沙尔基王国覆灭，萨兰随之进入洛迪王朝及后来的莫卧儿帝国体系。《阿克巴治典》将其列为比哈尔的六个萨卡尔之一。奥朗则布在位时，旧牲畜市场从哈吉普尔移到索恩普尔，商人在两河汇流处交易牛、马和大象。18世纪，硝石作坊设立后，恰普拉迅速发展；1765年东印度公司取得比哈尔的迪万尼，萨兰的财税也落入公司掌控。

en:
Champaran is the forested northern reach of Mithila along the Nepal terai, its name recalling the champa trees that once covered it. On the present border stood Simraon, the medieval Simraungadh. Nanyadeva founded the Karnat capital there in 1097, and a Tibetan traveler who reached it in 1236 described seven walls, water-filled ditches and many gates. In 1324-1325 Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq's army forced Harisimhadeva to flee northward, after which the Oiniwar Maithil Brahmins ruled Tirhut. In 1444 Champaran was a Hindu frontier realm of grain villages and ancient ramparts, still close to the court world served by the poet Vidyapati until his death in 1448.

The overlordship of north Bihar changed during the Afghan-Mughal wars. Babur defeated Mahmud Lodi and the Bengal army on the Ghaghra in 1529, while Sher Shah Suri's victory over Humayun at Chausa on 26 June 1539 restored Afghan power in Bihar. After the Oiniwar decline, Bettiah emerged as the chief local chieftaincy. Udai Karan submitted to Akbar's governor Muzaffar Khan Turbati, aided him against Afghan rebels at Hajipur and served the Mughal cause again in 1576. Shah Jahan granted the Bettiah chief Jay Singh the title of raja, and under Aurangzeb Gaj Singh's new fort at Bettiah was taken after a siege by Darbhanga. When the East India Company received Bihar's diwani in 1765, Champaran was a sarkar and Bettiah its largest landed estate.
zh:
查姆帕兰是弥萨罗北部毗邻尼泊尔特莱的森林地带，地名来自曾遍布此地的瞻波树。今边界上的西姆劳恩（西姆劳恩格尔）曾是中世纪重镇。1097年，纳尼亚德瓦在此建立卡纳塔王朝都城；1236年到访的西藏僧人描述它有七重城墙、注满水的壕沟和多座城门。1324-1325年，吉亚斯丁·图格鲁克的军队迫使哈里辛哈德瓦向北逃亡，奥伊尼瓦尔的迈蒂利婆罗门家族随后统治蒂鲁德。1444年的查姆帕兰是印度教边陲之地，分布着产粮村落与古老壁垒，也仍处在诗人维德亚帕蒂曾效力的宫廷文化圈中，他于1448年去世。

北比哈尔的宗主权在阿富汗人与莫卧儿人的战争中几经更迭。1529年，巴布尔在加格拉河击败马哈茂德·洛迪与孟加拉军队；1539年6月26日，舍尔沙·苏利在乔萨击败胡马雍，使阿富汗势力恢复对比哈尔的控制。奥伊尼瓦尔王朝衰落后，贝蒂亚崛起为本地最大酋长势力。乌代·卡兰归顺阿克巴任命的比哈尔总督穆扎法尔·汗·图尔巴蒂，协助其镇压哈吉普尔的阿富汗叛军，并在1576年再次为莫卧儿效力。沙贾汗封贝蒂亚酋长贾伊·辛格为罗阇；奥朗则布在位时，加杰·辛格在贝蒂亚新建的堡垒遭达尔邦格围攻后陷落。1765年东印度公司取得比哈尔迪万尼时，查姆帕兰已是一个萨卡尔，贝蒂亚则是境内最大的地产。

en:
Hajipur lies on the north bank of the Ganges at its meeting with the Gandak, opposite Patna. The place was once called Ukkacala, the first village beyond the Ganges crossing from Patna. Shamsuddin Ilyas Shah of Bengal occupied Tirhut in 1346, built a large fort there and urbanised the settlement; it was first settled as Hajipur around 1350 and later took its name from him. A century later, as the Sharqi sultans of Jaunpur extended their power through Bihar, the riverside fortress guarded the northern approach to Patna and the road into Tirhut.

In Akbar's wars with the Afghan Karrani rulers of Bengal, Hajipur's position made it a major battlefield. Imperial forces besieged and took the town twice, in 1572 and 1574, opening the way down the Ganges into Bengal. In 1587 Makhsus Shah, brother of Said Khan, Akbar's governor of Bihar, built a congregational mosque within the old fort of Ilyas Shah. Hajipur remained a Mughal river station and market opposite Patna, its landing place busy with traffic crossing between Bihar and Bengal.
zh:
哈吉普尔位于恒河北岸、恒河与甘达克河交汇处，与巴特那隔河相望。这里旧称乌卡卡罗，是从巴特那渡过恒河后的第一个村落。孟加拉的沙姆斯丁·伊利亚斯·沙1346年占据蒂尔胡特，在此修筑大堡并推动聚落城市化；约1350年，哈吉普尔正式定居建城，后来更以他的名号命名。一个世纪后，章普尔的沙尔基苏丹把势力伸入比哈尔，这座河畔要塞扼守着通往巴特那北侧和蒂尔胡特道路的要冲。

阿克巴与孟加拉阿富汗卡罗兰尼统治者交战时，哈吉普尔因位置险要成为主战场。莫卧儿帝国军队先后于1572年和1574年两度围城并攻占该镇，打开了沿恒河进入孟加拉的道路。1587年，阿克巴比哈尔总督赛义德汗的兄弟马克苏斯沙在伊利亚斯沙旧堡内修建了一座聚礼清真寺。此后哈吉普尔一直是莫卧儿人在巴特那对岸的河防据点和市镇，渡口往来着比哈尔与孟加拉之间的人流货物。

en:
Ghazipur lies on the high north bank of the Ganges where the river curves toward Bihar. Before the fourteenth century the place was still called Gadhipur. Local tradition places its new foundation in about 1330, when Sayyid Masud, a Tughlaq commander with the title Ghazi, overthrew the Chauhan raja Mandhata at nearby Kathot and raised the town that took its name from him. The country passed with the eastern provinces to the Sharqi sultans of Jaunpur, and in 1444 it is a quiet market and weaving town on the sultanate's Bihar frontier, its cloth shipped down the Ganges.

Ghazipur first enters contemporary records about 1494, when Sikandar Lodi made Nasir Khan Lohani its governor; under his long rule the town was refortified and drew a steady stream of Muslim settlers. In 1527 Humayun entered it unopposed while Babur campaigned from Jaunpur, and Nasir Khan made his submission in person in 1528. Under Akbar it was held by Ali Quli Khan Zaman, founder of Zamania, and after his revolt and death in battle in 1567 it became the seat of a sarkar of the Allahabad subah. Leased to the first Nawab of Awadh in 1727, Ghazipur had its own nawabs from 1738: Sheikh Abdullah built the Chihal Satun palace and laid out the Nawab's garden before his death in 1744. Control passed to Balwant Singh of Benares in 1757 and, after Chait Singh's fall in 1781, to the East India Company. Lord Cornwallis died here in 1805 and lies beneath a domed tomb above the river, and in 1820 the Company built its great opium factory at the town.
zh:
加齐普尔位于恒河北岸的高地，正当河道折向比哈尔之处。14世纪以前，这里仍旧名加迪普尔。据当地传说，约1330年，图格鲁克王朝称号「加齐」的将领赛义德·马斯乌德在附近的卡托特征灭乔汉人王公曼达塔，建起以自己称号命名的城镇。此后这一带随东部各省归入章普尔沙尔吉苏丹麾下；1444年，它是苏丹国比哈尔边境上一座安静的市集与纺织城镇，所产布匹沿恒河外运。

加齐普尔首次见于同时代记载约在1494年，西坎达尔·洛迪任命纳西尔汗·洛哈尼为总督；在他长期治理下，城市重筑堡垒，陆续吸引穆斯林定居者迁入。1527年，巴布尔在章普尔用兵时，胡马雍兵不血刃进入该城，纳西尔汗于1528年亲自归顺。阿克巴时期，这里由扎马尼亚的建立者阿里·库利汗·扎曼占据；1567年他叛乱兵败身死后，加齐普尔成为安拉阿巴德苏巴下辖一个萨尔卡尔的治所。1727年它被包租给初代阿瓦德纳瓦布，1738年起有了本地纳瓦布：谢赫·阿卜杜拉修建「四十柱宫」、辟出纳瓦布花园，1744年去世。1757年统治权转入贝拿勒斯的巴尔万特·辛格之手，1781年查特·辛格倒台后归东印度公司。康华里勋爵1805年在此去世，葬在河畔的穹顶陵墓中；1820年，东印度公司在城中建起庞大的鸦片工厂。

en:
Dang is a wide Inner Terai valley between the forested Siwalik ridges and the Mahabharat range, watered by the Babai, with the hotter Deukhuri valley below it on the Rapti. Tharu farmers have long worked its rich black soil, and the valley was famed as a land of the Gorakhnath yogis: its rajas patronised the monastery of Ratannath, whose Kanphata ascetics received half the valley's revenue and each year exchanged with the raja a sacred arrow, held to guard the kingdom. In 1444 Chauhan Rajputs of the Tulsipur house ruled from Chaughera, the site of modern Ghorahi, and Dang was counted among the twenty-two Baisi kingdoms.

The Gorkha upheaval reached Dang through marriage politics first: in 1763 Prithvi Narayan Shah promised the valley as dowry to the raja of Sallyan for his son's wedding to a Gorkha princess. Gorkha troops followed in 1786, during the western conquests of the regent Bahadur Shah, and the valley states of Dang and Chilli and their hill neighbours were absorbed into the expanding kingdom. The Chauhan raja withdrew to his southern estates at Tulsipur beyond the Siwaliks, while the rice lands of Dang became the granary of western Nepal under its new masters.
zh:
丹格是内特莱一片宽阔的谷地，夹在林木覆盖的西瓦利克岭与摩诃婆罗多山脉之间，巴拜河流经其中，下方拉普提河畔还有更为湿热的德乌库里谷地。塔鲁族农民长期耕作这里肥沃的黑土，谷地也以「戈拉克那特瑜伽士之地」闻名：历代罗阇供奉拉坦纳特庙，劈耳派苦行僧分得谷地一半赋税，每年还与罗阇交接一支被认为能护佑王国的神箭。1444年，图尔西普尔家族的乔汉王公以乔盖拉（今戈拉希所在地）为都进行统治，丹格被算作二十二个拜西王国之一。

廓尔喀的剧变先以联姻的方式波及丹格：1763年，普里特维·纳拉扬·沙阿把这片谷地许诺为嫁妆，将其子迎娶廓尔喀公主的萨利扬罗阇收为亲家。1786年，摄政巴哈杜尔·沙阿西征期间，廓尔喀军队随之而至，谷中的丹格、奇利两邦及周围山邦被并入扩张中的王国。乔汉罗阇退过西瓦利克山，退守南部的图尔西普尔领地；丹格的稻田则在新主人治下成为尼泊尔西部的粮仓。

en:
Doti fills the far-western hills between the Karnali and the Mahakali, where the Seti cuts south through ridge after ridge. It grew from the wreck of the Katyuri kingdom of Kumaon, which split into eight principalities in the 13th century: Niranjan Malla Dev, son of the last Katyuri raja, founded the Raika line, whose kings held the style Rainka Maharaj and ruled from the hill fort of Ajaymerukot above Dadeldhura. After defeating the Khas Mallas of the Karnali the Raikas made Doti the strongest of the Baisi kingdoms. In 1444 Kalyan Malla was on the throne, hard pressed through the long Doti-Kumaon war of 1438–1450.

Before that war ended Kalyan Malla moved his court east to a new fort at Dipayal. In the reign of Akbar a Mughal army from Lucknow under Hussain Khan, lured by the hill kingdom's reputed treasure, raided as far as Ajaymeru, sacked what it could and withdrew across the plains. Doti kept its independence until 1790, when the Gorkha armies of the regent Bahadur Shah forced the Seti line after fighting at Nari-Dang and Dumrakot; the Raika king Prithvipati Shah was driven out and fled to Pilibhit. He later took the field against the Gorkhalis beside the British in 1814, but the peace of 1816 left Doti inside Nepal.
zh:
多提占据着格尔纳利河与马哈卡利河之间的极西山国，塞提河在一道道山岭中向南切出深谷。它出自库毛恩的迦特尤里王国的废墟：13世纪迦特尤里王国分裂为八个邦国，末代迦特尤里罗阇之子尼兰詹·末罗·提婆开创了莱卡世系，其王号称「莱因卡·摩诃罗阇」，以达代尔杜拉山上的阿杰梅鲁科特堡为都。击败格尔纳利的卡萨·末罗人后，莱卡王朝把多提经营成拜西二十二国中最强的一个。1444年，迦利延·末罗在位，正苦撑1438至1450年那场旷日持久的多提—库毛恩战争。

战争结束前，迦利延·末罗已把宫廷东迁至迪帕亚尔的新堡。阿克巴在位时，一支由勒克瑙长官侯赛因汗率领的莫卧儿军队贪图这个山邦传闻中的财宝，突袭深入到阿杰梅鲁，饱掠后退回平原。多提将独立维持到1790年：摄政巴哈杜尔·沙阿的廓尔喀军经纳里丹格与杜姆拉科特之战突破塞提河防线，莱卡国王普里特维帕提·沙阿被逐出国外，亡命皮利比特。他后来在1814年随英军对廓尔喀人作战，但1816年的和议最终把多提留在尼泊尔境内。

en:
Sirmur, the southernmost of the Punjab Hill states, holds the ridges between the Giri river and the Yamuna on the edge of the plains. Its old Parmar rajas ruled from Sirmaur-Tal until, in 1195, a Giri flood swept the town away and drowned Raja Ugar Chand; Sobha, a son of the raja of Jaisalmer, seized the distracted country and founded the Bhati line, whose rajas took the title Prakash. The raiders of the Punjabi chieftain Jasrat, fresh from his wars against the Delhi sultans, swept through these hills as well. In 1444 a Hindu Pahari raja still held the Giri valley from its forts, the strongest of them Malaun, while the lower valleys grew cotton for the plains markets.

Karm Prakash founded the town of Nahan below the old forts and moved his capital there in 1616. His successors made Sirmur useful to the Mughals: Mandhata Prakash sent his men with Shah Jahan's general Khalil-ullah against Garhwal, and Sobhag Prakash twice joined Aurangzeb's Garhwal campaigns, earning grants of Kotaha and other lands. In 1685 Mat Prakash gave asylum to Guru Gobind Singh, who fortified Paonta and three years later defeated the allied hill rajas at Bhangani. Kirat Prakash, ruling from 1750, took Pinjaur and Naraingarh from the Sikhs and held the Gurkhas to a frontier on the Ganges, but in 1793 his successor Dharm Prakash was killed in single combat with Sansar Chand of Kangra. A disputed succession let the Gurkhas occupy Sirmur, and their general Amar Singh Thapa made his last stand in the Malaun fort, where David Ochterlony forced him to surrender in 1815. The British restored the dynasty under the boy-raja Fateh Prakash as a protected princely state, keeping part of the lowlands themselves.
zh:
色姆尔是旁遮普山邦中最靠南的一个，据有吉里河与亚穆纳河之间、俯临平原的一道道山岭。早先的帕马尔拉杰以锡尔毛尔-塔尔为都，1195年吉里河洪水冲毁城池，拉杰乌加尔·昌德溺死；杰伊瑟尔默拉杰之子索巴趁乱攻取这片无主之地，建立巴蒂家族的统治，其后裔以「普拉卡什」为号。旁遮普首领贾斯拉特的游骑刚在同德里苏丹交战，也曾横扫色姆尔的山岭。1444年，印度教的帕哈里拉杰仍凭借群堡统治吉里河谷，其中最坚固的是马劳恩堡，低地的棉花则沿山路销往平原市集。

1616年，卡拉姆·普拉卡什在旧堡下方修建纳亨城，把首府迁到那里。其后继者屡屡为莫卧儿效力：曼达塔·普拉卡什随沙贾汗的将领哈利勒-乌拉进攻加瓦尔，索巴格·普拉卡什两度参加奥朗则布的加瓦尔战事，先后得到科塔哈等土地作赏。1685年，马特·普拉卡什收容古鲁·戈宾德·辛格，后者在保恩塔筑寨，三年后在邦加尼击败诸山邦联军。1750年起在位的基拉特·普拉卡什从锡克人手中夺取平焦尔和纳拉因加尔，又逼廓尔喀人接受以恒河为界；但1793年，继任的达姆·普拉卡什在同冈格拉的桑萨尔·昌德单骑决斗时被杀。继承之争引来廓尔喀人占领色姆尔，其大将阿马尔·辛格·塔帕据守马劳恩堡作最后抵抗，1815年被戴维·奥克特洛尼围困迫降。英国人把王朝扶回王座，立幼主法塔赫·普拉卡什为受保护的土邦君主，却把部分低地留归己有。

en:
Khairabad stands in the level Awadh country between the Gomti and the Ghaghra, some eighty kilometres north of Lucknow. Its older name was Masi Chitra, a Hindu place of pilgrimage with a tank whose waters were held to heal, and local tradition makes the Pasi chief Khaira its founder: he refused to submit to the Turkish armies raiding Awadh and lost his kingdom, but the town kept his name. With the rest of the region it passed to the Sharqi sultans of Jaunpur in 1394, and in 1444 it was a small market qasba of Mahmud Shah Sharqi, its weavers and merchants quite overshadowed by the sultan's capital downstream.

The Lodis and then the Mughals brought scholars as well as soldiers. Under Babur and Akbar rent-free grants drew learned Muslim families to Khairabad, and in Akbar's settlement it became the seat of one of the sarkars of the Awadh subah. Its madrasas and Urdu poets gave the qasba a name that lasted into the eighteenth century, when pilgrims still visited the tombs of the two Makhdoom saints and the bazaars dealt in Kashmir shawls and Assamese elephants; the East India Company exported the hand-woven cloth made in Khairabad and Dariyabagh. Under the nawabs Khairabad was a faujdar's seat and then one of Asaf-ud-Daula's chaklas, though the posting passed for an undistinguished one, and in the early 1800s the old rent-free grants were resumed by the Nawab of Awadh, whose flag still flew over the town in 1821.
zh:
凯拉巴德坐落在戈默蒂河与加格拉河之间平坦的阿瓦德原野上，勒克瑙以北约八十公里处。它旧名马西奇特罗，是印度教的一处朝圣地，当地有一池圣水被认为能治病；据本地传说，城镇是帕斯（Pasi）首领凯拉所建——突厥军队袭掠阿瓦德时他拒绝臣服，战败亡国，城镇却留下了他的名字。1394年，此地随阿瓦德归入章普尔的沙尔基苏丹国；1444年，它是马哈茂德沙·沙尔基治下一座小集镇（qasba），织工与商贾的声名远不及苏丹的都城。

洛迪王朝和后来的莫卧儿人带来的不只是士兵。巴布尔与阿克巴两代，大量免租赐地吸引穆斯林学人之家迁居凯拉巴德；在阿克巴的行政区划中，它成为阿瓦德苏巴下辖一个萨尔卡尔的治所。这里的经学院和乌尔都语诗人为这座集镇赢得了延续到18世纪的声名，拜谒两位马克杜姆圣徒之墓的香客往来不绝，集市上交易着克什米尔披巾和阿萨姆大象，东印度公司还把凯拉巴德和达里亚巴格出产的机织布匹收购出口。纳瓦卜时代，凯拉巴德先成为统兵官（faujdar）的驻地，后被阿萨夫·乌德·道拉划为一个查克拉（chakla），只是这一职任被认为无足轻重。19世纪初，旧日的免租赐地被阿瓦德纳瓦卜收回；直到1821年，城头上飘扬的仍是阿瓦德的旗帜。

en:
The Feyzabad country lies on the lower Saryu east of Lucknow, and its ancient heart is Ayodhya, the Saketa of older days, a chief city of Kosala known to Buddhist and Jain travellers. When the Turks made it the seat of their new province of Awadh in 1226, Muslim writers found the place half wilderness: Hindu pilgrimage was tolerated but taxed, though the Gahadavala kings of the eleventh century had already filled Ayodhya with Vishnu shrines. In 1394 it passed with the province to the Sharqi sultans of Jaunpur, and in 1444 the governor of Awadh still kept his headquarters there under Mahmud Shah Sharqi, pilgrims bathing at the river tirtha while the sultan's cavalry held the old fort. Faizabad itself did not yet exist.

The Sharqi kingdom went down before the Lodi Afghans after 1478, and the country passed to the Mughals in 1526; in 1528-29 the mosque later called the Babri Masjid was raised at Ayodhya by Mir Baqi, a commander of Babur. Ayodhya remained the provincial headquarters until 1730, when Saadat Khan Burhan-ul-Mulk, the first Nawab of Awadh, built a hunting lodge four miles to its west and laid gardens around it. Under his successor Safdar Jang the new town took the name Faizabad, and Shuja-ud-Daula, withdrawing here after his defeat at Buxar in 1764, fortified the place and built a true capital of palaces, treasury and arsenal. He died early in 1775 and was laid in the Gulab Bari, and before the year ended his son Asaf-ud-Daula had carried the court to Lucknow. Faizabad lived on as the dower town of the dowager begams: Shuja's widow Bahu Begum kept a small court in the Moti Mahal, and on her death in 1816 was buried in the marble maqbara built by Darab Ali Khan at a cost of three lakh rupees. In 1821 the gardens were still fine, but the capital was gone.
zh:
法扎巴德这片地方位于勒克瑙以东的萨拉尤河下游，其古老的核心是阿约提亚，即古时的萨羯陀，曾是拘萨罗的首要城市，为佛教和耆那教行旅所知。1226年，突厥人把新置阿瓦德省的治所设在这里，穆斯林史家称此地当时近乎一片荒野：印度教朝圣虽被容忍却要课税，而11世纪的加哈达瓦拉王朝已在阿约提亚修建了多座毗湿奴神庙。1394年，它随全省归入章普尔的沙尔基苏丹国；1444年，阿瓦德长官在马哈茂德沙·沙尔基治下仍以此地为驻地，朝圣者在河边圣渡沐浴，旧堡里驻扎着苏丹的骑兵。那时还没有法扎巴德这座城。

1478年后，沙尔基王国败于洛迪阿富汗人，这片土地1526年转入莫卧儿之手；1528至1529年，巴布尔的将领米尔·巴基在阿约提亚修建了后来被称为巴布里清真寺的礼拜寺。阿约提亚作为省治一直延续到1730年：这一年，阿瓦德第一代纳瓦卜萨阿达特汗·布尔汉·穆勒克在城西四英里处建起一座猎舍，周围辟出园林。新城在继任者萨夫达尔·姜格时代得名法扎巴德；第三代纳瓦卜舒贾·乌德·道拉1764年布克萨尔战败后退居于此，加固城防，建起一座宫殿、国库与兵工厂齐备的真正都城。他1775年初去世，葬入古拉巴里陵园，同年年底之前，其子阿萨夫·乌德·道拉已把宫廷迁往勒克瑙。法扎巴德作为寡居太后们的封邑存续下来：舒贾的遗孀巴胡·贝古姆在莫蒂宫维持着一个小朝廷，1816年去世后葬入大理石陵园，墓由达拉卜·阿里汗主持修建，耗资三十万卢比。1821年时，这里的园林依旧秀美，都城岁月却已一去不返。

en:
Kora (Kora Jahanabad) stands in the Lower Doab between the Ganga and the Yamuna, a level farming country crossed by the old road from Delhi to Bihar. After the Muslim conquest the region was governed from nearby Kara, seat of one of the great iqtas of the Delhi sultans, and it was from this march that the eunuch Malik Sarwar, granted the lands between Kannauj and Bihar, founded the Sharqi kingdom of Jaunpur. Through most of the fifteenth century Kora followed the Sharqi court, its villages held by Bachgoti Rajput landholders. In 1444 it is the western march of Jaunpur, kept in check from the forts at Kara and Kora.

The Lodis reconquered the country for Delhi, and at the Mughal coming it was held independently by Jalal Khan, brother of Ibrahim Lodi. After the Suri interlude Akbar's forces conquered Awadh in 1559, and in 1567 the rebel Ali Quli Khan Zaman was defeated and killed in this district. Akbar made Kora a sarkar of the new Allahabad subah, divided into three dasturs, while the Grand Trunk Road and the new fort at Allahabad shifted the region's trade eastward. On 5 January 1659, at Khajwa near Kora, Aurangzeb defeated his brother Shah Shuja and secured the Mughal throne. After 1707 the district changed hands between the Bangash Afghans of Farrukhabad, the Nawabs of Awadh and Maratha raiders, who sacked it in 1736, and Bhagwant Singh of Asothar killed the faujdar of Kora and Kara before Awadh brought him down. Ceded to the Emperor Shah Alam II after Buxar in 1765, Kora fell to the Marathas and was then sold by the East India Company back to Awadh in 1773 for fifty lakh rupees; Almas Khan governed it from Kora until the Lower Doab was ceded to the Company in 1801.
zh:
戈拉（今科拉贾哈纳巴德）位于恒河与亚穆纳河之间的下河间地，地势平坦，旧德里通往比哈尔的大道由此穿过。穆斯林征服之后，这一地区由附近的卡拉统辖，那里是德里苏丹大伊克塔之一的治所；宦官马利克·萨尔瓦尔正是以这片边地为根基，受封从卡瑙杰到比哈尔的土地，建立章普尔沙尔基王国。15世纪的大部分时间里，戈拉臣属沙尔基朝廷，村社土地握在巴赫戈特拉杰普特地主手中。1444年时，它是章普尔的西部边陲，由卡拉与戈拉的堡寨共同弹压。

洛迪王朝后来为德里收复此地，莫卧儿人初来时，这里由易卜拉欣·洛迪之弟贾拉尔汗割据自守。苏尔王朝插曲之后，阿克巴的军队于1559年征服阿瓦德，1567年又在此地击败并击杀叛将阿里·库里汗·扎曼。阿克巴将戈拉设为新安拉阿巴德省下辖的萨卡尔，分为三个达斯图尔；大干道穿境而过，安拉阿巴德的新城堡也使商旅重心东移。1659年1月5日，奥朗则布在戈拉附近的卡杰瓦击败其弟沙·舒贾，坐稳了皇位。1707年以后，此地在法鲁卡巴德的班加什阿富汗人、阿瓦德纳瓦布与马拉塔袭掠者之间几度易手，1736年遭马拉塔人洗劫；阿斯塔尔的巴格万特·辛格袭杀戈拉与卡拉的军政长官，最终被阿瓦德平定。1765年布克萨尔之战后，戈拉被割让给皇帝沙·阿拉姆二世，后落入马拉塔人之手，1773年东印度公司又以五百万卢比的代价把它卖回阿瓦德；阿尔马斯汗以戈拉为治所统辖此地，直到1801年下河间地割让给东印度公司。

en:
Kannauj rises above the Ganges on the western edge of the great Doab, the granary between the Ganges and Jumna. Ancient Kanyakubja was a capital of the Panchalas, and under Harsha, who reigned from 606 to 647, it became the greatest city in northern India, crowded with monasteries and visited by the Chinese pilgrim Xuanzang; the Gurjara-Pratiharas made it their imperial capital in the ninth century. Mahmud of Ghazni sacked it in 1018, the Gahadavala kings raised it to fresh glory, and in 1193 Muhammad of Ghor slew their raja Jayachandra at Chandawar, after which Iltutmish drew the city into the Delhi sultanate. With Delhi enfeebled after Timur, the Sharqi sultans of Jaunpur pushed west to the Ganges; in 1444 Kannauj is the western fortress of Mahmud Shah Sharqi's kingdom, at once a frontier garrison against the Lodis and a grain mart where the Doab harvest is gathered for Jaunpur.

Kannauj stood on the fighting edge of the Sharqi decline: Sultan Mahmud's siege of Delhi failed against Bahlul Lodi in 1452, and in 1458 his son Muhammad Shah was killed in the city by his brother Hussain's rebels, before Bahlul's advance swallowed the Jaunpur frontier, the last Sharqi inscription at Kannauj dating to 1476. On 17 May 1540 Sher Shah Suri routed Humayun at the Battle of Kannauj and seized the Mughal throne. Under the restored Mughals the town became the seat of the sarkar of Kannauj in the subah of Agra, its parganas assessed in dams for Doab grain while its perfumers distilled flower attars and rose water for the markets of the empire. With Mughal power collapsing the city passed through neighbouring hands to the Nawabs of Awadh, and in 1801 it was ceded with the Lower Doab to the East India Company, under whose early rule Nawab Hakim Mehndi Ali Khan gave it its ghat, caravanserai and metalled roads.
zh:
卡瑙杰耸峙在恒河之滨、恒河与亚穆纳河之间的多阿布大粮仓西缘。古称羯若鞠阇，曾是般阇罗的都城；606至647年在位的戒日王以此为都，使它成为北印度最伟大的城市，寺院林立，中国求法僧玄奘曾到此城，9世纪瞿折罗-波罗提诃罗王朝又以它为帝国之都。1018年伽色尼的马哈茂德洗劫此城，伽诃达瓦罗诸王重振其荣光，1193年古尔的穆罕默德在昌达瓦尔击杀其王阇耶旃陀罗，此后伊勒杜迷失把这座城市纳入德里苏丹国。帖木儿之后德里衰弱，章普尔的沙尔基苏丹向西推进到恒河；1444年，卡瑙杰是马哈茂德·沙阿·沙尔基王国的西陲要塞，既是防御洛迪人的边境驻军重镇，也是汇集多阿布粮输往章普尔的粮食商埠。

卡瑙杰正处在沙尔基王朝衰亡的锋线上：1452年马哈茂德沙阿围攻德里，败于巴赫鲁尔·洛迪；1458年其子穆罕默德沙阿在城中被兄弟侯赛因的叛军所杀；此后巴赫鲁尔西进吞并章普尔边疆，卡瑙杰最晚一方沙尔基纪年铭文止于1476年。1540年5月17日，舍尔沙·苏尔在卡瑙杰之战击溃胡马雍，夺占莫卧儿皇位。莫卧儿统治恢复后，此地成为阿格拉苏巴下辖卡瑙杰萨尔卡尔的治所，各帕尔加纳以达姆折算多阿布的粮赋，而城中香匠蒸馏花卉精油与玫瑰香水，供应帝国各市场。莫卧儿政权瓦解后，卡瑙杰经邻邦势力之手转归奥德的纳瓦布；1801年随下多阿布割让给东印度公司，公司治下初年，纳瓦布·哈基姆·迈赫迪·阿里汗为城市修建了河阶、商队客栈与碎石公路。

en:
Sambhal is a market town on the western edge of Katehar, on the level road between Delhi, Agra and the Rohilkhand plain. It was already a Muslim military centre after Qutb-ud-din Aibak brought it into the Delhi Sultanate, and Firoz Shah Tughlaq later campaigned through the district. Ibrahim Shah Sharqi of Jaunpur established his authority there in 1407, and Sharqi coins circulated in the region. Thus in 1444 Sambhal was a north-western garrison of Mahmud Shah Sharqi's kingdom, close to the contested frontier with Delhi.

When the Lodis overcame the Sharqis, Bahlul Lodi granted Sambhal to his son Sikandar, who kept his court there for four years after becoming sultan. Babur's victory at Panipat in 1526 carried the town into the Mughal domains; he gave the jagir to Humayun, and after Babur's death it passed to Askari Mirza. Sher Shah Suri later granted Sambhal to his son-in-law Mubariz Khan. The town prospered under Akbar, but when Shah Jahan held the district its local headquarters was moved to Moradabad. As part of Rohilkhand it was drawn into the Rohilla Wars, passed to Awadh after 1774 and was ceded to the East India Company in 1801.
zh:
森珀尔是卡特哈尔西缘的集镇，位于德里、阿格拉与罗希尔坎德平原之间的平坦道路上。库特布丁·艾伊拜克把它纳入德里苏丹国后，这里已是穆斯林军事中心；菲鲁兹沙·图格鲁克后来也曾在此一带用兵。章普尔的易卜拉欣·沙·沙尔基于1407年在此建立权威，沙尔基钱币也在这一地区流通。因此1444年时，森珀尔是马哈茂德·沙·沙尔基王国西北端的驻军要地，紧挨着与德里争夺中的边界。

洛迪王朝击败沙尔基王朝后，巴赫鲁尔·洛迪把森珀尔封给儿子锡坎达尔；锡坎达尔成为苏丹后，曾在此驻跸四年。1526年巴布尔在帕尼帕特获胜，森珀尔随之进入莫卧儿版图；他把这块封地授予胡马雍，巴布尔死后又归阿斯卡里·米尔扎。谢尔沙·苏利后来把森珀尔封给女婿穆巴里兹汗。阿克巴时期城镇繁荣，但沙贾汗管辖此地后，地方治所被迁往莫拉达巴德。作为罗希尔坎德的一部分，它被卷入罗希拉战争，1774年后归属阿瓦德，1801年割让给东印度公司。

en:
Bareily, now Bareilly, lies on the Ramganga in the Katehar plain. The older power centre in these parts was Ahichchhatra, capital of northern Panchala, whose ruins survive near Aonla. By the fifteenth century the countryside was held by Katehriya Rajput clans and lay within the reach of the Sharqi sultans, whose dominions stretched from Etawah toward Bengal and from the Vindhyas toward Nepal. In 1444, decades before a town called Bareilly existed, this was a frontier district of Mahmud Shah Sharqi of Jaunpur, governed through local chiefs and watched from posts such as Budaun and Sambhal.

The settlement of Bans-Bareli was founded in 1537 by the Katehriya chief Jagat Singh, who named it after his sons Bansaldev and Bareldev. Mughal rule reached the district in 1569, and by 1596 it was the seat of a pargana. Mukrand Rai laid out a new town at Bareilly in 1657, and the next year it became headquarters of the governor of Budaun. Pashtun settlement under Mughal patronage then changed Katehar, and from 1719 Ali Muhammad Khan made Bareilly the capital of the Rohilla state. Hafiz Rahmat Khan ruled there until the Maratha invasion of 1772 and the Rohilla War; he was killed at Miranpur Katra in 1774. Awadh held the district until 1801, when it passed to the East India Company, which established a military station south of the town in 1811 and built a fort there in 1816.
zh:
婆雷利（今译巴雷利）位于卡特哈尔平原的兰甘加河畔。这一带更早的权力中心是北般阇罗的都城阿希查特罗，遗址在奥恩拉附近。到15世纪，乡野主要由卡特赫里亚拉杰普特诸氏族掌握，并处于沙尔基苏丹势力可达之处；沙尔基疆域西起埃塔瓦、东抵孟加拉，南起温迪亚山脉、北近尼泊尔。1444年，距离巴雷利建城还有数十年，这里是章普尔马哈茂德·沙·沙尔基的边地，由本地首领治理，并受布道恩、森珀尔等据点牵制。

1537年，卡特赫里亚首领贾格特·辛格建立「班斯-巴雷利」聚落，并以两个儿子班萨尔代夫和巴雷尔代夫的名字命名。莫卧儿势力于1569年到达这一地区，到1596年，这里已成为一个帕尔加纳的治所。1657年，穆克兰德·莱在巴雷利营建新城，次年它成为布道恩总督驻地。此后，莫卧儿庇护下的普什图人定居改变了卡特哈尔；1719年起，阿里·穆罕默德汗以巴雷利为罗希拉国家的都城。哈菲兹·拉赫马特汗在此统治，直至1772年马拉塔入侵和随后的罗希拉战争；1774年，他战死于米兰布尔·卡特拉。1801年之前该地区归阿瓦德所有，随后转交东印度公司；公司1811年在城南设立军站，1816年又在那里修建堡垒。

en:
Bharatpur is the open grazing and farming plain east of the Mewat hills, astride the country between Agra, Mathura and Delhi, where Hindu Jat clans kept cattle and held the village headmanships. In 1444 the land formed the eastern fringe of the Khanzada kingdom of Mewat, its Jat and Gujar peasantry subjects of the Muslim Rajput court at Alwar. It had no towns or rulers of its own, and for two centuries its history was the doings of turbulent village zamindars on the Delhi marches.

The Jat rising of 1669 turned those landholders into kings. Gokula, a Jat zamindar of Tilpat, led the farmers of the Mathura country against Aurangzeb's tax collectors and was captured and executed in 1670; Rajaram of Sinsini carried on the revolt, plundered Akbar's tomb at Sikandra, and fell in 1688, after which Aurangzeb granted Mathura as a faujdari to the Kachwaha raja of Amber. Early in the new century Churaman used the Mughal civil wars to make the Jat chiefs independent from their forts at Sinsini and Thun, and in 1722 Badan Singh founded a regular state with his capital at Deeg. His son Suraj Mal began the iron-hard Lohagarh fort in 1732 and founded the city of Bharatpur; on 12 June 1761 he captured Agra itself and melted the silver doors of the Taj Mahal, with his dominions stretching from Delhi to Alwar. In 1805 Lord Lake battered the Lohagarh for three months and failed four times to storm it; the siege ended by treaty and Bharatpur became a British-protected state with its reputation intact.
zh:
婆罗多布尔是梅瓦特丘陵以东一片开阔的农牧平原，正当阿格拉、马图拉与德里之间的地带，印度教贾特人在这里牧养大批牛群，把持着各村的柴明达尔之位。1444年，这里是梅瓦特汗赞达王国的东缘，贾特与古贾尔农夫都是阿尔瓦尔的穆斯林拉杰普特宫廷的属民；本地没有自己的城镇和君主，此后两百年间，这片土地的历史就是德里边疆上一群不安分的村庄柴明达尔的活动。

1669年的贾特人起义把这些土地持有者送上了王座。蒂尔帕特的贾特地主戈库拉率领马图拉一带农民反抗奥朗则布的税吏，1670年被俘处死；辛西尼的拉贾拉姆继起斗争，洗劫了锡坎德拉的阿克巴陵，1688年战死，奥朗则布随即将马图拉作为法吉达尔辖区封给安贝尔的卡奇瓦哈拉贾。18世纪初，丘拉曼乘莫卧儿内战之机，凭辛西尼和通两座堡垒使贾特首领们自立；1722年，巴丹·辛格正式建国，定都迪格。其子苏拉杰·马尔1732年动工修建铁一般坚固的洛哈加尔堡，并建立婆罗多布尔城；1761年6月12日他攻克阿格拉，熔取泰姬陵的银门，版图从德里一直伸展到阿尔瓦尔。1805年，莱克勋爵围攻洛哈加尔堡三个月，四次强攻均告失败，最终以缔约收场，婆罗多布尔就此成为英国的附属保护土邦。

en:
Bhilwara is the open grain country east of the Aravallis, the plain that joins Mewar to Ajmer and Bundi. Bhil villagers gave the district its name, and the town grew from a settlement raised around the Krishna temple of Bada Mandir in the mid-eleventh century; its mint struck the Bhiladi coins remembered in the district's name. Rana Kshetra Singh of Mewar took Mandalgarh in the fourteenth century, and in 1444 the pargana answers to Maharana Kumbha at Chittor, guarding Mewar's north-eastern approaches against Malwa.

In the mid-fifteenth century Mahmud Khilji of Malwa twice stormed Mandalgarh, and the fort began long alternations between the Ranas and the Sultans. In 1534 the armies of Bahadur Shah of Gujarat poured across this plain on their way to the sieges of Chittor, and the fort was sacked with the city in 1535. When Akbar moved against Chittor in 1567, his host camped at Mandal town. Mandalgarh kept passing between Mewar and the Mughals: Shah Jahan granted it to Raja Roop Singh of Kishangarh around 1650, Rana Raj Singh retook it in 1660, Aurangzeb's men seized the palace in 1680, and Rana Amar Singh recovered it in 1706, after which it stayed with Mewar.
zh:
皮尔瓦拉是阿拉瓦利山脉以东开阔的谷物之乡，这片平原把梅瓦尔与阿杰梅尔、本迪连接起来。比尔村民赋予了这一地区名字，城镇本身则起于11世纪中叶围绕奎师那神庙巴达曼迪尔形成的聚落；当地铸币厂打造的「比拉迪」钱币也留在了地区名字的记忆里。14世纪梅瓦尔的拉那·谢特拉·辛格夺取曼达尔加尔，1444年时这片帕尔加纳听命于坐镇奇托尔的马哈拉那·昆巴，扼守梅瓦尔朝向马尔瓦的东北门户。

15世纪中叶，马尔瓦的马哈茂德·卡尔吉两次攻破曼达尔加尔，这座堡垒从此开始在拉那与苏丹之间反复易手。1534年，古吉拉特巴哈杜尔沙的军队越过这片平原去围攻奇托尔，堡垒也随城市在1535年遭到洗劫。1567年阿克巴进兵奇托尔时，大军就扎营在曼达尔镇。曼达尔加尔此后仍在梅瓦尔与莫卧儿之间转手：沙贾汗约1650年把它封给基尚加尔的罗阇·鲁普·辛格，拉那·拉杰·辛格1660年将其夺回，奥朗则布的人1680年占入宫城，拉那·阿马尔·辛格1706年再度收复，此后一直留在梅瓦尔手中。

en:
Merta, the ancient Medantaka, lies on the open plain between Nagaur and Ajmer. Nagabhatta, a Pratihara chief of Mandore, made it his seat, and in the thirteenth century the conquests of Alauddin Khalji left a governor, Tajuddin Ali, in charge. By the fifteenth century it was a quiet market town on the cattle and caravan routes of the Nagaur hinterland, while from Mandore to the west the Rathores were gathering strength and eyeing its flat fields. In 1444 Merta was held from Nagaur, with Marwar rising on its doorstep.

After Rao Jodha founded Jodhpur he enfeoffed his son Rao Duda with Merta, from whom the Mertiya Rathores take their name; Duda built the first palace, the Chaturbhuj temple and the Dudasar tank. His successor Rao Viramdeo rode to the Battle of Khanwa in 1527, and his niece Mira Bai became the Krishna-bhakti poet whose hymns spread across northern India. Rao Maldev of Marwar seized Merta and built the Malkot fort; after the Battle of Sammel in 1544 it passed briefly to Sher Shah before returning to Marwar. Viramdeo's son Jaimal, lord of Merta, died commanding the Chittor garrison against Akbar in 1568, and the emperor afterwards divided Merta between Jaimal's sons Surtan Singh and Keshavdas. On 10 September 1790 the Mertiya horsemen charged De Boigne's drilled brigades in Mahadji Scindia's service at the Battle of Merta and were cut down almost to a man, and the Rajput states passed under Maratha influence.
zh:
梅尔达古名梅丹塔卡，地处纳高尔与阿杰梅尔之间的开阔平原。曼多尔的普拉蒂哈拉首领纳加巴塔曾以此地为都；13世纪阿拉乌丁·卡尔吉征服后，留部将塔杰丁·阿里镇守。到15世纪，这里是纳高尔腹地一处平静的集镇，处在牲畜与商队往来的通道上，而西面曼多尔的拉索尔人正日渐强盛，觊觎着这片平坦原野。1444年，梅尔达尚在纳高尔汗国治下，新兴的马尔沃尔已近在肘腋。

拉奥·乔达建立焦特布尔后，把梅尔达封给儿子拉奥·杜达，其后人便称梅尔蒂亚·拉索尔；杜达修建了最早的王府、查图尔布吉神庙和杜达萨尔水塘。继立的拉奥·维拉姆迪奥1527年参加坎瓦之战，他的侄女米拉拜则成为歌颂黑天的虔诚派诗人，赞歌传遍北印度。马尔沃尔的拉奥·马尔德奥夺取梅尔达，筑起马尔科特堡；1544年萨梅尔之战后，这里短暂落入舍尔沙之手，不久复归马尔沃尔。维拉姆迪奥之子、梅尔达领主贾伊马尔1568年在奇托尔抵御阿克巴时战死，战后皇帝把梅尔达平分给贾伊马尔的两个儿子苏尔坦辛格与凯沙夫达斯。1790年9月10日梅尔达之战，梅尔蒂亚骑兵向玛哈德吉·辛迪亚麾下德布瓦涅操练的新式军队冲锋，几乎全数战死，拉杰普特诸邦就此落入马拉塔势力之下。

en:
Mansura, also remembered as Brahmanabad, was founded by Arab governors on an old arm of the Indus and became the capital of caliphal Sindh. Its merchants sent textiles, spices, ivory and mirrors toward Baghdad, but an earthquake in 893 and Mahmud of Ghazni's sack weakened the city; the Indus later shifted away, leaving its great mosque and brick houses as ruins. In 1444 the old capital was no longer a royal seat: it formed part of the Samma jam's Muslim Sindhi realm, governed from Thatta, with villages and irrigated lands scattered across the flat country between the Indus and the Thar.

The Sammas reached their height under Jam Nizamuddin II from 1461 to 1508, before Shah Beg Arghun overthrew Jam Feruz in 1519-1520. Arghun and Tarkhan princes then contested lower Sindh until Mughal forces took the region in 1592 and incorporated it into the Thatta subah. Mughal rule loosened after 1701 as the Kalhoras built up their power, and in 1713 Mir Shahdad Khan Talpur founded Shahdadpur close to the old ruins, giving the district a new market and administrative centre. The Talpurs overthrew Kalhora rule at the Battle of Halani in 1783 and divided Sindh among their branches, which still held the Mansura country in 1821.
zh:
曼苏拉又称布拉赫曼纳巴德，由阿拉伯总督在印度河旧水道旁建立，后来成为哈里发信德省的都城。当地商人曾把纺织品、香料、象牙和镜子运往巴格达，但893年的地震和加兹尼的马哈茂德洗劫削弱了城市；印度河后来改道，宏伟清真寺与砖房只剩遗址。1444年，这座古都已不再是王都，而是萨马王朝贾姆治下、由特达统辖的穆斯林信德土地的一部分；印度河与塔尔沙漠之间的平原上散布着村庄和灌溉农田。

1461年至1508年，贾姆·尼扎姆丁二世在位时萨马王朝达到鼎盛，但沙赫·贝格·阿尔浑在1519年至1520年推翻末代贾姆·菲鲁兹。阿尔浑与塔尔汗王公随后争夺下信德，直到莫卧儿军队1592年夺取此地，将其并入特达行省。1701年后莫卧儿统治松弛，卡尔霍拉势力兴起；1713年，米尔·沙达德·汗·塔尔普尔在古城遗址附近建立沙达德布尔，使这一地区有了新的市场和行政中心。1783年，塔尔普尔人在哈拉尼战役中推翻卡尔霍拉统治，把信德分封给各支系；到1821年，曼苏拉一带仍在他们手中。

en: Nasirpur, also recorded as Naserpur or Nasarpur, is an old town in the alluvial corridor between Mansura and the Thar approaches. Tradition makes it one of the chief cities of medieval Sindh beside Thatta, Sehwan and Umarkot; an Arabic tradition dates its foundation to 132 AH, when the governor Nasr ibn Muhammad al-Khuzai established it. After Tughluq and Samma campaigns reached the district, it formed part of the Samma kingdom in 1444, a Muslim textile town in lower Sindh. Arghun conquest ended Samma power there in 1523, and Tarkhan lords followed before Akbar's forces took lower Sindh in 1592. Under the Mughals Nasirpur was a sarkar of the Thatta province, producing cloth for foreign trade; Kalhora rule in the eighteenth century later gave way to the Talpur amirs.
zh: 纳西尔布尔又拼作Naserpur或Nasarpur，是曼苏拉与塔尔沙漠边缘之间冲积走廊上的古城。传统说法把它与特达、塞赫万和欧迈尔果德并列为中世纪信德的主要城市；阿拉伯文献传统称此城建于伊斯兰历132年，由总督纳斯尔·本·穆罕默德·胡扎伊建立。在图格鲁克和萨姆马势力相继到达后，1444年的纳西尔布尔属于萨姆马王国，是下信德一座穆斯林纺织城镇。1523年阿尔洪人的征服终结了萨姆马权力，随后塔尔汗首领统治此地，阿克巴的军队又在1592年夺取下信德。莫卧儿时期，纳西尔布尔是特达省的一个萨尔卡尔，生产布匹并参与对外贸易；十八世纪的卡尔霍拉统治之后，此地转入塔尔普尔埃米尔之手。

en:
The country about Khairpur is the Indus's east-bank plain as it thins into the Nara flats and the dunes of the Thar, a grazing land of herdsmen, wells and villages strung along the river. For centuries it was the open eastern march of upper Sindh, bordering Jaisalmer and the desert road to Umarkot. In 1444 Sunni Sindhi herders graze their flocks here under the Samma Jam at Thatta, paying their dues in livestock rather than treasure.

Samma rule gave way to the Arghuns and then the Tarkhans, and with Jani Beg Tarkhan's submission in 1593 the country passed to Mughal governors and later to the Kalhoras. The fort and town that give the province its name are young: after the Talpur Mirs overthrew the Kalhoras at the Battle of Halani in 1783, Mir Sohrab Khan took upper Sindh as his share, made Khairpur his seat, and between 1785 and 1795 raised the great citadel of Kot Diji, Fort Ahmadabad, above the desert edge. In 1811 he made over power to his eldest son, Mir Rustam Ali Khan.
zh:
海尔布尔一带是印度河东岸的平原，渐行渐浅，没入纳拉低地与塔尔沙漠的沙丘之间，是一片牧人的土地，水井与沿河散布的村庄点缀其间。数百年来，这里都是上信德开阔的东部边陲，毗邻杰伊瑟尔梅尔和通往乌默科特的沙漠之路。1444年，信德逊尼派牧民在坐镇特达的萨姆马贾姆治下于此放牧，向官府缴纳的是牲畜而非财货。

萨姆马的统治先后让位于阿尔浑王朝与塔尔汗王朝，1593年贾尼·贝克·塔尔汗归降后，这片土地转入莫卧儿总督之手，后来又归于卡尔霍拉家族。赋予这个省份名字的堡垒与城镇都很年轻：1783年塔尔普尔的米尔们在哈拉尼战役推翻卡尔霍拉家族后，米尔·索赫拉布汗分得北信德，以海尔布尔为驻地，并在1785至1795年间于沙漠边缘筑起宏伟的科特迪吉堡，即艾哈迈达巴德堡。1811年，他把权柄交给长子米尔·鲁斯塔姆·阿里汗。

en:
The Mallani country around Barmer is the driest edge of the Thar along the Luni river, where herdsmen vastly outnumber townsmen. At Kiratakupa, the later Kiradu, half-ruined Shaivite temples raised by vassals of the Solanki kings still stand from the eleventh and twelfth centuries. The old town of Juna was founded by the Paramara chief Bahada Rao, who gave his name to Bahadamer, later Barmer. The region itself was called Mallani after Rawal Mallinath, the fourteenth-century warrior-saint of Mehwanagar, born in 1358, who routed the army of the Malwa governor Nizamuddin in 1378 and helped his nephew Rao Chunda win Mandore and Nagaur; his descendants, the Mahecha Rathores, hold their chief seat at Jasol, and the cattle fair beside his shrine at Tilwara drew breeders of Tharparkar cows, camels and Marwari horses. In 1444 the sandy thikanas of Mallani, overrun after Ranmal's murder six years before, lay under Rana Kumbha's Mewar.

Mallinath's grandson Rawat Luka drove the Paramaras from Juna and made it his capital, and in 1552 his descendant Rawat Bhima founded the present town of Barmer and moved the seat there. In time the district became part of the Jodhpur kingdom of Marwar: it shared the kingdom's ruin in 1679 when Aurangzeb's armies pillaged the country, and threw out the Mughal garrisons with the rest of Marwar in 1707. In January 1818 it entered a British subsidiary alliance as part of Jodhpur.
zh:
马拉尼，即今巴尔梅尔，是塔尔沙漠沿卢尼河最干旱的一角，牧人远多于城镇居民。在古称基拉塔库帕的基拉杜，还矗立着11至12世纪索兰基国王封臣所建、已半成废墟的湿婆神庙群。旧城朱纳为波罗马尔首领巴哈达·拉奥所建，地名由他演为巴哈达梅尔，再成巴尔梅尔。地区本身则得名于「马拉尼」——梅赫瓦纳格尔的武圣拉瓦尔·马林纳特。他生于1358年，1378年击溃马尔瓦总督尼扎姆丁的军队，又帮助侄子拉奥·春达攻取曼多尔和纳高尔；他的后裔马赫查·拉索尔人以贾索尔为宗座，蒂尔瓦拉的马林纳特神庙旁的牛市汇集着塔尔帕卡尔牛、骆驼和马尔瓦里马的牧人。1444年，兰马尔六年前遇害后被席卷的马拉尼沙地塔库尔领地，处在拉那·贡波的梅瓦尔治下。

马林纳特之孙拉瓦特·卢卡逐出朱纳的波罗马尔人并以此为都；1552年，他的后裔拉瓦特·比马建立今日的巴尔梅尔城并移治于此。这一地区后来并入焦特布尔的马尔瓦尔：1679年随马尔瓦尔一道遭奥朗则布军队劫掠，1707年又随各地逐走莫卧儿驻军，1818年1月作为焦特布尔的一部分接受英国的附属同盟。

en:
Churu is the easternmost stretch of Jangladesh, where the dunes of the Thar begin and the desert tracks run out toward Shekhawati and Bhatner. In 1444 there was no town here yet, only the scattered villages of the Kaler and other Jat pastoral clans grazing their herds on the thorn scrub and answering to their own headmen; the country to the north around Bhatner was held by Muslim Bhattis and Johiyas. It was a remote corner of the Janglu, crossed by the occasional caravan rather than commanded from any fort.

The Rathore conquest of Jangladesh under Rao Bika at the end of the fifteenth century brought Churu under Bikaner, and in the course of the sixteenth century a Jat headman, Chuhru Singh of the Kaler clan, founded the town that bears his name and raised its fort. It became one of the eastern thikanas of the Bikaner rajas: Maharaja Zorawar Singh ousted its refractory thakur Sangram Singh between 1735 and 1746, and the closing decades of the century were filled with raiding as Bikaner and Jodhpur wore each other down. In 1798 Maharaja Surat Singh founded Ratangarh nearby while returning from Churu, its fort completed in 1812; Prithvi Singh, thakur of Churu, stormed it twice in 1815 and 1816 with aid from Sikar. Two years later Bikaner accepted British protection and the border wars around Churu came to an end.
zh:
久鲁是禅伽罗最东端的一段，塔尔沙漠的沙丘从这里开始，沙上的小路向东通往谢卡瓦蒂，向北通往珀特纳。1444年此地还没有城镇，只有卡拉尔等贾特游牧氏族的零星村落，牧人在荆棘灌丛间放牧羊群，听从本族头人管束；北面珀特纳一带则在穆斯林巴蒂人和乔希亚人手中。这是姜加尔卢偏远的一角，只有商队偶尔经过，并无堡垒能真正统辖此地。

15世纪末拉奥·比卡率拉索尔人征服禅伽罗，久鲁归入比卡内尔；16世纪，卡拉尔氏族的贾特头人楚鲁辛格建起以自己名字命名的城镇和堡垒，此后成为比卡内尔拉贾东部的封邑之一。1735至1746年间，摩诃罗阇佐拉瓦尔辛格驱逐了桀骜的封臣桑格拉姆辛格；世纪末比卡内尔与焦特布尔互相攻伐，这一带劫掠不断。1798年，摩诃罗阇苏拉特辛格从久鲁返回途中在附近兴建拉坦加尔，城堡1812年落成；久鲁领主普里特维辛格在西卡尔援助下于1815和1816年两度强攻该堡。1818年比卡内尔接受英国保护，久鲁一带的边境纷争就此终结。

en:
Before there was a city here, this tract along the Sutlej was pasture and caravan country: Saraiki graziers raised herds between the riverine woods and the Cholistan dunes, while the Bhati forts of the desert guarded the roads from Multan towards Rajputana. In 1444 it belonged to the Langah sultans of Multan, loosely ruled through local chiefs, and its wealth lay in livestock and the tolls of the passing trade rather than in towns; the chief city of the region was still Uch, further west. Mughal rule later made it a quiet part of the Multan subah.

In the eighteenth century the Daudpotra clan, an Abbasi family from Shikarpur in Sindh, established itself on the Sutlej, settling kinsmen on newly watered canal lands. Nawab Bahawal Khan I founded the town named after him in 1748, replacing Derawar as his capital, and it throve as an emporium on the caravan route between Afghanistan and central India. In 1785 a Durrani army sent at the Kalhoras' request destroyed much of the town; Bahawal Khan II took refuge first in Derawar and later among the Rajputs, then returned by way of Uch to recover his capital. He proclaimed the state of Bahawalpur in 1802, and when Ranjit Singh's forces beleaguered Multan in 1807, families fleeing the siege swelled the new city.
zh:
在建城之前，萨特莱杰河畔的这片土地是牧场与商道之乡：讲萨拉基语的牧人在河滨林地与焦利斯坦沙丘之间放养牲畜，沙漠中的巴蒂人要塞守卫着从木尔坦通向拉杰普塔纳的道路。1444年时，它归属木尔坦的朗伽苏丹，由地方首领松散管辖，财富来自牲畜和过路商税，而非城镇；这一带的首城仍是西边的乌奇。莫卧儿时代，它成为木尔坦苏巴治下一处平静的角落。

18世纪，来自信德希卡布尔的阿巴西家族——达乌德波特拉部——在萨特莱杰河畔立足，把同族部众安置在新开渠水浇灌的土地上。纳瓦卜巴哈瓦尔汗一世于1748年建立以自己名字命名的城镇，取代德拉沃尔成为都城，巴哈瓦尔布尔随之成为阿富汗与印度中部之间商路上的商埠。1785年，应卡尔霍拉人之请而来的杜兰尼军队摧毁了城中大片建筑；巴哈瓦尔汗二世先退守德拉沃尔，后避入拉杰普特诸邦，最终经乌奇回师收复了自己的都城。他于1802年正式建立巴哈瓦尔布尔邦；1807年兰吉特·辛格的军队围攻木尔坦，逃离战区的家族涌入这座新城。

en:
Karor stands on the eastern edge of the Indus, whose waters once washed the walls of the old fort of Kot Karor. Hindus knew it as Depal Garh, a stronghold of Raja Deopal, until Mahmud of Ghazni took it in 1004; a companion of that conquest, Sultan Husain Khwarizmi, gave it its Muslim name and its first mosque. The family of the great Sufi Bahauddin Zakariya had settled here before he made Multan famous, though Mongol raids later wasted the fort and it lost its rank. In 1444 it was a half-ruined Indus crossing within the domains of the sultans of Multan, its river trade and grazing lands ruled by local chiefs.

Under Sultan Husayn Langah the place was restored as a provincial seat, entrusted first to his brother and then, after the brother rebelled, to Baloch jagirdars; it passed into the jagir of Malik Sohrab Dodai, until the quarrels of Ghazi Khan and Ismail Khan tore the town apart. In 1545 the Sufi Lal Esan settled in Kot Karor, and under the Mirani chief Ghazi Khan IV, who ruled from 1590 to 1614, the town became Karor Lal Esan in his honour. The Jaskani Baloch then held the country until 1787, when Timur Shah Durrani appointed his own governors, and in 1794 the Kabul pretender Humayun Shah was seized near here and blinded at Zaman Shah's command. With the fall of Mankera to Ranjit Singh in 1821, the whole tract passed under Sikh rule.
zh:
格罗尔位于印度河东缘，河水曾直接拍打着古城堡科特格罗尔的墙垣。印度教时代它称迪帕尔加尔，是拉贾·迪奥帕尔的要塞，1004年被加兹尼的马哈茂德攻取；随军圣者苏丹·侯赛因·花剌子米为它取了穆斯林名字，并建起第一座清真寺。大苏菲巴哈乌丁·扎卡里亚的家族在他扬名木尔坦之前就已定居于此，但蒙古人的侵袭后来毁废了城堡，此地也失去了旧日地位。1444年时，它是木尔坦苏丹辖境内一处半废的印度河渡口，河上贸易与牧场都由地方首领掌管。

侯赛因·朗伽苏丹在位时，此地被恢复为省级治所，先委于其弟，其弟称乱被擒后又改封给俾路支采邑主，最后落入马利克·苏赫拉布·多多伊的采邑；加齐汗与伊斯梅尔汗后来为争夺这份封地互相攻杀，科特格罗尔被打得四分五裂。1545年，苏菲修士拉勒·伊桑定居于此，在1590至1614年在位的米拉尼首领加齐汗四世治下，城镇为纪念他改称格罗尔·拉尔伊桑。此后贾斯卡尼俾路支人领有此地，直到1787年帖木儿沙·杜兰尼直接委任总督；1794年，喀布尔王位觊觎者胡马云沙在附近被俘，遵扎曼沙之命被刺瞎双目。1821年曼克拉陷落于兰吉特·辛格，整片地区随之归入锡克统治。

en:
Shorkot lies east of the Chenab, on the edge of the Sandal Bar, the open grazing lands of central Punjab. Its old fort-mound looks over riverine villages and the camps of pastoral clans, among whom the Nauls long overshadowed the Sials, then a small tributary tribe. Delhi's hold on the bar was loose; in 1444 the town's clansmen answered to whichever governor held Lahore or Multan, and cloth and cattle moved from the pastures through its market toward the river towns.

In 1462 the Sials founded nearby Jhang, and over the following century they rose above the neighbouring tribes. Babur, raiding these tracts in the 1510s, names Bhera and Chiniot, and perhaps Shorkot itself, in his memoirs. The town's lasting fame is religious: the Sufi Sultan Bahu was born here in 1630 into the Awan tribe, a Qadiri mystic whose Punjabi verses outran his forty Persian treatises in popular fame. After his death in 1691 his tomb at Garh Maharaja drew pilgrims, and it was moved twice when the Chenab shifted its bed. Walidad Khan of Jhang united the Sial clans into a kingdom early in the eighteenth century, but in 1760 Hari Singh of the Bhangi Misl sacked Jhang and made its chiefs his tributaries. Ranjit Singh had absorbed the country by 1810, and in 1821 Sikh governors sent from Lahore farmed its revenues.
zh:
绍尔果德位于奇纳布河以东，地处桑德尔巴尔边缘，那是旁遮普中部的开阔牧地。古老的堡寨高踞土丘，俯瞰河畔村落与游牧部族的营地；诸部中瑙尔人长期压过锡亚尔人一头，后者当时还是个纳贡的小部族。德里朝廷对这片牧地的控制松散，1444年时，城中各部听命于占据拉合尔或木尔坦的总督，布匹和牲畜从牧场经绍尔果德市集输往沿河城镇。

1462年，锡亚尔人在附近建起章城，此后一个世纪里逐渐压倒邻部。巴布尔在1510年代攻略这一带时，回忆录中提到了贝赫拉、吉尼奥德，或许还有绍尔果德本身。此城持久的声名与宗教有关：苏菲行者苏丹·巴胡1630年出生于此，属阿万部，是卡迪里教团的神秘主义者，他旁遮普语诗篇流传之广，胜过他那四十部波斯文论著。1691年去世后，他在格尔赫·默哈拉杰的陵墓引来朝圣者；奇纳布河两次改道，陵墓也两度迁移。18世纪初，章城的瓦利达德汗统一锡亚尔诸部、建立王国，但1760年班吉米斯尔的哈里·辛格洗劫章城，迫其首领称臣纳贡。兰吉特·辛格到1810年已吞并此地，1821年时由拉合尔派来的锡克总督包收赋税。

en:
Bhera lies on the old Kabul-India road just north of the Jhelum, below the southern exits of the Salt Range. Mahmud of Ghazni sacked the early town, and Mongol generals plundered it again; afterward its recovery depended on caravans and the rock-salt country to the north. Babur later described the Janjua and Jud clans as the old rulers of these hills between the Indus and Bhera. In 1444, two years after the death of Jasrat and the loosening of his upper Punjab confederacy, Sirhind's authority touched the road only weakly, while armed Salt Range clans controlled the passes and crossings.

Babur held Bhera to ransom in 1519. Sher Shah Suri founded the new town in 1540, and its congregational mosque was completed in 1541. Nearby Rohtas Fort, begun under Todar Mal's supervision in the same year, was intended to subdue the Gakhars and bar Humayun's return; Sher Shah died in 1545 before it was finished, and the fort passed to Humayun in 1555. Under Akbar, Bhera became the seat of a subdivision of the Lahore subah. During the reign of Muhammad Shah, Salamat Rai administered the town until Abbas Khan Khattak seized it, a rule soon reversed by Salamat's nephew Fateh Anand. Nader Shah and Ahmad Shah Durrani both used Rohtas in the following decades, and Charat Singh captured the fort from its Durrani governor in 1767. Under the later Sikh order, Bhera remained a Kabul-road trading town and possessed a mint of Ranjit Singh.
zh:
佩拉位于杰赫勒姆河以北的喀布尔—印度古道上，南接盐岭出山的通道。早期城镇曾遭马哈茂德·伽色尼洗劫，后来又被蒙古将领掠夺；此后它的复兴依靠商队和北方岩盐地带的贸易。巴布尔后来在《巴布尔回忆录》中把詹朱阿与贾德诸族称为印度河至佩拉之间山地的旧时统治者。1444年，贾斯拉特已去世两年，他的上旁遮普联盟随之松动，西尔欣德方面对这条道路的控制很弱，实际掌握山口与渡口的是盐岭上的武装氏族。

1519年，巴布尔迫使佩拉缴纳赎金。1540年，舍尔沙·苏利另建新城，城中的聚礼清真寺于1541年完工。附近的罗赫塔斯堡也在同年由托达尔·马尔督造，用以压制加哈尔人并阻挡胡马雍返回；舍尔沙1545年去世时堡垒尚未完工，最终在1555年落入胡马雍之手。阿克巴时期，佩拉成为拉合尔苏巴一个分区的治所。穆罕默德沙在位时，萨拉马特·拉伊管辖此城，后被阿巴斯·汗·哈塔克篡夺，但萨拉马特的外甥法塔赫·阿南德很快收复。此后数十年间，纳迪尔沙和艾哈迈德·沙阿·杜兰尼都曾利用罗赫塔斯；1767年，恰拉特·辛格从杜兰尼总督手中夺取堡垒。后来在锡克秩序下，佩拉仍是喀布尔商路上的贸易城镇，并设有兰季德·辛格的造币厂。

en:
Bharuch, recorded by the British as Broach, stands where the Narmada meets the sea, a roadstead the first-century Greek guide to the Indian Ocean knew as Barygaza: royal pilots led ships through its dangerous tidal estuary, and cotton cloth, silk, agate and long pepper went out to the Roman and Arab worlds. Centuries later the Chinese pilgrim Xuanzang found a flourishing port, and in 1345 Muhammad bin Tughluq defeated his rebel Afghan amirs beneath its walls. Under the Gujarat sultans Bharuch remained one of the busiest harbours on the Gulf of Khambhat, a city of Gujarati merchants and Bhargava Brahmins, and in 1444 its customs houses and shipyards served the court at Ahmadabad.

In 1547 a Portuguese squadron under Jorge de Meneses slipped up the estuary by night and sacked the city, a heavy blow to the Gujarat sultans' sea trade. Akbar's conquest of 1573 brought Bharuch under Mughal governors, and in later years its affairs fell to local nawabs, who accepted Maratha suzerainty in 1685 and made themselves independent in 1736. Its cotton drew the East India Company: a British attack in 1771 was followed on 18 November 1772 by the city's surrender, and Bharuch passed under Company rule, the dispossessed nawab receiving a hereditary pension.
zh:
布罗奇（今译珀鲁杰）位于讷尔默达河入海处，公元1世纪的希腊航海指南称其为巴里加扎：王家领航员引导船只穿过危险的潮汐河口，棉布、丝绸、玛瑙和长胡椒从这里运往罗马与阿拉伯世界。数百年后，中国求法僧玄奘见到的仍是一座繁荣港口；1345年，穆罕默德·伊本·图格鲁克在城下击败叛乱的阿富汗埃米尔。古吉拉特苏丹时期，布罗奇始终是坎贝湾最繁忙的港口之一，城中多古吉拉特商人和巴尔加夫婆罗门；1444年，它的海关与船坞为远在艾哈迈达巴德的宫廷效力。

1547年，若热·德·梅内塞斯率领葡萄牙分舰队趁夜潜入河口、洗劫城市，重创古吉拉特苏丹的海上贸易。1573年阿克巴征服古吉拉特后，布罗奇归莫卧儿总督管辖；后来政务落入本地纳瓦布手中，他们1685年接受马拉塔宗主权，又于1736年自立。当地的棉花引来了东印度公司：1771年英军来攻，1772年11月18日城市投降，布罗奇并入东印度公司治下，被废黜的纳瓦布得到一笔世袭年金。

en:
Dipalpur stands on the old bank of the Ravi in the Bari Doab, the march country between the Punjab rivers and the road to Delhi. Its earthen walls, raised long before Timur and rebuilt across the centuries, made it with Uch and Samana one of the three gateways by which invaders from the northwest were met. In 1285 Sultan Balban's son Muhammad Khan broke a Mongol invasion under Pir Muhammad Khan beneath its walls, only to be killed in the pursuit, and local tradition points to his tomb beside the town's Badshahi Mosque. Firuz Shah Tughlaq later visited often and raised a great mosque outside the walls. When Timur sacked the town in 1398 it was ranked second only to Multan, and as the old Beas ran dry soon afterwards it was left half deserted. In 1444 Dipalpur is a weathered border fortress, held for Delhi by the Afghan lords of Sirhind.

Babur writes in his memoirs that in 1524 he defeated Pahar Khan and took Lahore and Dipalpur. Under the Mughals it became a sarkar of the Lahore province, and the Ain-i-Akbari rates its militia at 5,210 horse and 53,300 foot. In 1578 Akbar and Prince Salim halted here on the way to Baba Farid's shrine at Pakpattan, and the emperor coined the name Bari Doab from the Beas and the Ravi. The Baghdad Qalandar Bahawal Sher settled at nearby Hujra Shah Muqeem, where his house and tomb-shrine joined the town's Sufi foundations. With Mughal power fading, the Sandhu Jat chieftain Heera Singh founded the Nakai Misl in 1748 over the Ravi-Sutlej country, and Dipalpur became one of its forts. In 1810 Ranjit Singh's general Mohkam Chand stormed it together with Chunian and Satghara, and in 1821 it is a garrison town of the Sikh Empire.
zh:
迪巴尔布尔坐落在拉维河故道旁的巴里河间地，是旁遮普诸河与通往德里大道之间的边地。它的土墙在帖木儿之前很久便已筑起，历代多次重修，使它与乌奇、萨马纳并列为抵御西北入侵者的三道门户之一。1285年，巴勒班苏丹之子穆罕默德汗在此城下击溃皮尔·穆罕默德汗率领的蒙古军，自己却在追击中战死，当地传说他的陵墓就在城中皇家清真寺旁。菲鲁兹沙·图格鲁克后来常来此地，在城外建起一座大清真寺。1398年帖木儿洗劫此城时，它的规模与重要性仅次于木尔坦；此后老比亚斯河干涸，城池一度半废。1444年的迪巴尔布尔是一座饱经风霜的边镇要塞，由西尔欣德的阿富汗诸酋代德里据守。

巴布尔在回忆录中写道，1524年他击败帕哈尔汗，夺取拉合尔与迪巴尔布尔。莫卧儿时期它成为拉合尔省下辖的萨卡尔，《阿克巴则例》记载其地可调发5,210名骑兵和53,300名步兵。1578年，阿克巴与皇子萨利姆前往帕克帕坦拜谒巴巴·法里德圣陵时曾在此停留，这位皇帝还取比亚斯河与拉维河之名，将这一带命名为巴里河间地。来自巴格达的卡兰达尔行者巴哈瓦尔·希尔在附近的胡吉拉·沙·穆基姆定居，他的道堂和圣祠为此地又添一处苏菲道场。莫卧儿权势衰落后，桑杜贾特首领希拉·辛格于1748年在拉维河与萨特莱杰河之间建立纳卡伊米斯尔，迪巴尔布尔成为其堡寨之一。1810年，兰吉特·辛格的大将莫哈姆·昌德连克迪巴尔布尔、楚尼安和萨特加拉，1821年时它是锡克帝国的一处驻防城。

en:
Sakya sits in a high valley about 130 kilometres west of Shigatse, and takes its name from the pale grey earth of Ponpori Hill. In 1073 Khon Konchog Gyalpo of the old Khon clan founded the first monastery beneath the hill, and under the Five Supreme Masters — above all Sakya Pandita and his nephew Phagpa — its lamas rose to rule Tibet. Phagpa became imperial preceptor of the Mongol Yuan, and in 1268 the dpon-chen Sakya Sangpo built the walled southern monastery with its great Lhakhang Chenmo, the seat of Tibet's Yuan-era government. The Phagmodrupa leader Changchub Gyaltsen overthrew Sakya's administration in the middle of the fourteenth century. In 1444 the Khon lamas kept only a small monastic domain in Tsang, which was now held by the Rinpungpa lord Norzang; he had occupied Shigatse in 1435 and himself administered Sakya's great hall as its dpon-chen.

Sakya scholarship still flourished in these years, and Sonam Senge, known as Gorampa (1429-1489), became the century's greatest master of its teachings. Later in the fifteenth century the Khon line, its other branches extinct, split into the Phuntsok and Dolma palaces, whose eldest sons held the Sakya throne in turn. The Tsangpa kings who seized Tsang from the Rinpungpa in 1565 favoured the Karmapas but spared Sakya, and the Lhakhang Chenmo was restored during that century. In 1642 the Mongol army of Gushi Khan overthrew the Tsangpa and installed the Fifth Dalai Lama: Sakya lost its last temporal claims but kept its palaces, rites and famous library under the Ganden Podrang and later Qing protection, the two palaces supplying throne-holders without interruption down to the end of the eighteenth century.
zh:
萨迦坐落在日喀则以西约一百三十公里的高山谷地，得名于本波山灰白色的山岩。1073年，古老昆氏家族的昆·贡却杰布在山下首建寺院；到萨迦五祖、尤其是萨迦班智达与其侄八思巴的时代，萨迦喇嘛一跃而成为西藏的统治者。八思巴受封为元朝帝师，1268年萨迦本钦释迦桑布主持筑起城墙环绕的南寺，宏伟的拉康钦莫（大佛殿）成为元代西藏地方政权的所在地。14世纪中叶，帕木竹巴的绛曲坚赞推翻萨迦政权。到1444年，昆氏喇嘛只保有后藏境内一处小小的教权领地，而后藏已落入仁蚌巴领袖诺布桑波之手：他1435年据有桑珠孜（日喀则），还以本钦身份兼管萨迦大寺。

这一时期萨迦的佛学仍然兴盛，1429年出生的索南僧格（Gorampa）后来成为15世纪最伟大的萨迦义理大师。15世纪后期，昆氏其余各支先后绝嗣，仅存的一支分出彭措颇章与卓玛颇章两房，由两房长子轮流出任萨迦法王。1565年取代仁蚌巴据有后藏的藏巴汗崇信噶玛噶举，却未为难萨迦，拉康钦莫也在16世纪得到修缮。1642年，固始汗的蒙古大军攻灭藏巴汗、拥立五世达赖喇嘛，萨迦失去最后的世俗权力，却在甘丹颇章政权及后来清朝的护持下保留了宫殿、法事和闻名全藏的藏书，两房法王相承不辍，直至18世纪末年。

en:
Gyirong, the 'happy valley', sits on the Gyirong Tsangpo, the headwater stream of Nepal's Trishuli River, at little more than 2,700 metres: a warm, wooded corridor through the Himalayas and the shortest road between Tsang and the Kathmandu valley, known to Nepali Newar traders as Kerung. After the collapse of the Tibetan Empire, princes of the old Yarlung royal line founded the kingdom of Mangyul Gungthang here, with its fortified citadel of Dzongka, the 'White Fortress'; under the Mongol Yuan it ranked among Tibet's thirteen myriarchies. The yogin-poet Milarepa was born into a Gungthang family in this valley in 1052. In 1444 King Thri Lhawang Gyaltsen (1404-1464) still ruled from Dzongka, and his daughter Chokyi Dronma (1422-1455), married to a prince of Lato in 1438, was to become the first Samding Dorje Phagmo. The little kingdom lived on the trans-Himalayan pack trade, its markets linked to the goldfields of western Tibet and the Newar towns of Nepal.

Gungthang survived under a succession of overlords until 1620, when the king of Tsang destroyed the kingdom and ended its royal line. Gyirong then became a frontier dzong under the Dalai Lamas' government, its pass crowded each trading season with Newar caravans climbing out of the Nepalese hills. In 1788 the Gorkha rulers of Nepal invaded through this very corridor and seized Kyirong and Kuti; Tibetan officials bought a hasty peace, but in 1791 the Gurkhas returned, stormed Kyirong, Tingri and Shigatse and sacked Tashilhunpo. In 1792 the Qing army under Fuk'anggan retook Kyirong and forced its way down the Trishuli towards Kathmandu, until the Gurkhas submitted and entered into tributary relations with Beijing. The Twenty-Nine Article Ordinance that followed remade Tibet's administration, and the Kyirong road saw only merchants and pilgrims for the rest of the period.
zh:
吉隆，藏语意为「快乐舒适之地」，坐落于吉隆藏布河畔——这条河就是尼泊尔特里苏利河的上游——海拔仅两千七百余米，是喜马拉雅山中一条温暖湿润、林木葱郁的走廊，也是后藏通往加德满都谷地最近的商道，尼泊尔的尼瓦尔商人称之为「基隆」。吐蕃王朝崩溃后，雅砻旧王的后裔在此建立芒域贡塘王国，王城建在宗嘎堡寨；元朝时，这里是西藏十三万户之一。瑜伽行者、诗人密勒日巴1052年就生在谷地中一户贡塘人家。1444年，国王拉旺坚赞（1404—1464）仍在宗嘎治国，他的女儿曲吉卓美（1422—1455）1438年嫁给拉堆的王子，后来成为第一世桑顶·多吉帕姆。这个小国靠着跨喜马拉雅的驮运贸易谋生，市上往来着西藏西部金矿与尼泊尔尼瓦尔城镇的货物。

贡塘在诸多大国之间苟存到1620年，终为藏巴汗攻灭，王统断绝。此后吉隆成为达赖喇嘛治下的边境宗，每到通商季节，山口仍挤满从尼泊尔山地攀援而上的尼瓦尔商队。1788年，尼泊尔的廓尔喀统治者沿这条走廊入犯，攻占济咙与聂拉木；西藏官员仓促以银赎地求和，1791年廓尔喀人却再次入侵，连下济咙、定日、日喀则，洗劫扎什伦布寺。1792年，福康安统率清军收复济咙，沿特里苏利河直逼加德满都，廓尔喀被迫归降，向北京称臣入贡。战后颁行《钦定藏内善后章程》，重塑西藏政务，吉隆商道在余下的年代里再无兵戈，只剩行商与朝圣者往来。

en:
Purang, called Taklakot by its Nepali neighbours, is the broad valley south of Mount Kailash and Lake Manasarovar, where the Karnali rises and the high passes lead down into Humla and Kumaon. Its cliff fort of Tegla Kar, the Lying Tiger, was already a stronghold of the old Zhangzhung kings, and it was here that the fugitive Tibetan prince Kyide Nyimagon first established himself after 910. His heirs made Purang a kingdom of its own when the Guge lands were divided around 1100, and about 1330 its king Sonam De inherited the Khasa kingdom beyond the Himalaya; his line died out before 1376, and after years of rivalry with Mustang a resurgent Guge absorbed Purang in 1378. The town lived on the caravan trade: salt and barley packed onto thousands of sheep went south, while rice and luxuries came back from Nepal. In 1444 Purang was the southern gateway of the Guge kingdom beneath its ancient fort.

Guge's eclipse drew Purang into its wars. From 1499 the kings at Tsaparang bowed to the Rinpungpa rulers of Tsang, and early in the seventeenth century the Balti ruler Ali Sher Khan Anchan raided as far east as Purang. When Ladakh overran Guge in 1635 the valley passed under Leh, until the Mongol-Tibetan army of the 5th Dalai Lama's general Galdan Chhewang conquered Ngari in 1679–80 and attached Purang to the government of Lhasa. Ruled thereafter through the Dalai Lama's officials in Ngari, the town saw few soldiers but many traders: every summer Purangpa caravans crossed the passes with wool, salt and grain while Hindu and Buddhist pilgrims climbed toward Kailash, and the first snows shut the valley off from the world.
zh:
普兰，尼泊尔邻人称之为塔克拉果特，是冈仁波齐峰与玛旁雍错以南的宽阔谷地，格尔纳利河发源于此，山口南通胡姆拉与库马盎。崖上的特格拉卡堡意为「卧虎堡」，早在象雄时代便是要塞；吐蕃王子吉德尼玛衮910年后西逃，最先立足的就是这里。约1100年古格诸土分封，普兰自成一支，约1330年国王索南德又继承了山那边的卡萨王国。王统在1376年前断绝，经过与木斯塘多年的拉锯，复兴的古格于1378年吞并普兰。城镇靠商路为生：盐和青稞驮在成千上万只羊背上下山南运，再从尼泊尔换回大米和杂货。1444年的普兰，是古格王国南境的门户，古堡俯瞰着往来市集。

古格的衰亡也把普兰拖入战火。1499年起，札布让的国王对藏地的仁蚌巴俯首；17世纪初，巴尔蒂王阿里·谢尔汗·安詹东征，兵锋远及普兰。1635年拉达克吞并古格，谷地转归列城治下，直到1679至1680年，五世达赖麾下将领噶丹泽旺率蒙藏联军攻取阿里，普兰才并入拉萨政权。此后这里由拉萨派往阿里的官员治理，城中兵戈渐少、商旅不绝：每年夏天普兰人的商队赶着羊群，驮着羊毛、盐和粮食翻过山口，印度教徒与佛教徒也结队朝觐冈仁波齐；而初雪一落，谷地便与世隔绝。

en:
Nedong guards the grain-rich Yarlung Valley above Tsetang, with the Yarlung Tsangpo road to Lhasa and the old royal shrines of Tradruk and Yumbulakang nearby. Tai Situ Changchub Gyaltsen overthrew Sakya supremacy between 1354 and 1358 and ruled Tibet from his palace at Nedong; in 1351 the valley also saw Tradruk restored and the Tsetang monastery founded. The long reign of Drakpa Gyaltsen from 1385 to 1432 was remembered as peaceful, but after his death the Lang family split. In 1444 Drakpa Jungne, invested by the Ming court as Chanhuawang in 1440, still ruled at Nedong, although the succession war of 1434 had been settled only in 1443 and powerful feudatories such as the Rinpungpa were overshadowing the court.

Drakpa Jungne died in 1445, and Rinpungpa pressure grew until Kunga Lekpa was deposed in 1481. Ngawang Tashi Drakpa recovered the Lhasa area in 1517 and 1518, but he was the last effective Phagmodrupa king and his authority shrank to Ü. The Tsangpa defeated the dynasty in 1613 and 1620, before Güshi Khan's victory in 1642 opened Tibet to the Fifth Dalai Lama's Ganden Phodrang regime. Under the Fifth Dalai Lama, Yumbulakang was turned into a Gelug monastery, while Tradruk received a golden roof and was enlarged under the Seventh Dalai Lama; by the late eighteenth century it was said to comprise twenty-one temples. Tsetang's old Kagyu monastery also passed to the Gelug school in the eighteenth century, and the former royal valley became part of the new monastic order.
zh:
乃东扼守泽当以上盛产谷物的雅砻河谷，通往拉萨的雅鲁藏布江道路与昌珠寺、雍布拉康等古老王统圣地都在附近。大司徒绛曲坚赞在1354—1358年间取代萨迦的优势地位，以乃东宫殿统治西藏；1351年前后，昌珠寺得到修复扩建，泽当寺院也建立起来。1385—1432年札巴坚赞的长期统治被后世视为太平岁月，但他死后朗氏家族分裂。1444年，1440年被明朝封为阐化王的札巴迥乃仍在乃东执政，只是1434年的继承纷争到1443年才和解，仁蚌巴等强藩已经使宫廷黯然失色。

札巴迥乃于1445年去世，仁蚌巴的压力持续增大，贡噶勒巴最终在1481年被废。阿旺札西札巴于1517—1518年恢复了拉萨地区，但他已是最后一位仍有实权的帕竹贡玛，势力缩后卫地。藏巴汗又在1613年和1620年击败帕竹，直到1642年固始汗获胜，西藏进入五世达赖喇嘛的甘丹颇章政权。五世达赖喇嘛时期，雍布拉康被改为格鲁派寺院；昌珠寺铺上金顶，并在七世达赖喇嘛时期继续扩建，到18世纪后期据说已有21座佛殿。泽当古老的噶举派寺院也在18世纪转归格鲁派，昔日的雅砻王都由此纳入新的教团秩序。

en:
Tsurphu stands high in the Tolung valley, on the upper reaches of the Tsurphu river some seventy kilometres upstream from Lhasa. The First Karmapa, Dusum Khyenpa, founded the monastery in 1187 and made it the seat of the Karma Kagyu order and the seat of every successive Karmapa; in time the walled complex housed a thousand monks. Religion and politics went hand in hand here, for the Karmapas were the spiritual preceptors of Tsang's lords. In 1444 the young Sixth Karmapa, Thongwa Donden (1416-1453), held the throne: a writer and organiser rather than a man of war, he composed new rituals, expanded the copying and printing of scriptures and founded a monastic college. Beyond the valley the Rinpungpa minister Norzang, who had taken Shigatse in 1435 and mastered Tsang, treated all the schools even-handedly, though his successors were to become the Karmapas' foremost military patrons.

Under the Seventh Karmapa, Chodrak Gyatso (1454-1506), author of the Kagyu textbook of logic, the Ocean of Logic, the order reached its zenith: backed by the Rinpungpa prince Donyo Dorje, its partisans barred the Gelugpa from Lhasa's great Monlam prayer festival from 1498 to 1517, and the Tsangpa kings went further, in 1613 sealing the Karmapa with the title 'lord of U-Tsang'. The wheel turned in 1642, when Gushi Khan's Mongols overthrew the Tsangpa: Kagyu monasteries across Tsang were converted to the Gelugpa or emptied, and the Tenth Karmapa, Choying Dorje, went into exile in 1648, wandering through Bhutan, Kham and Nepal. He returned to central Tibet in 1672 and was reconciled with the Fifth Dalai Lama at the Potala in 1674; by the end of the century the Eleventh Karmapa had been raised and ordained at Tsurphu, and the old seat lived on as a monastery, its political days over, through the Qing decades that followed.
zh:
楚布寺高踞堆龙山谷、楚布河上游，距拉萨约七十公里。第一世噶玛巴杜松虔巴1187年在此建寺，使这里成为噶玛噶举派的主寺和历代噶玛巴的驻锡地，城墙环绕的寺群最盛时住有上千名僧人。这里政教相依，噶玛巴历代都是后藏世俗统治者的宗教上师。1444年，年轻的第六世噶玛巴通瓦敦殿（1416—1453）住持法座：他长于撰述与组织而非征战，编订新的仪轨，组织抄写、刊印经书，还创办了一所佛学院。山谷之外，仁蚌巴首领诺布桑波1435年据有日喀则、统辖后藏，对各宗派一视同仁，而他的继任者将成为噶玛巴最得力的世俗护法。

到以因明学巨著闻名的第七世噶玛巴确札嘉措（1454—1506）时代，噶玛噶举的声势达到顶点：在仁蚌巴强势首领的庇护下，其支持者在1498至1517年间禁止格鲁派参加拉萨的传昭大法会；继起的藏巴汗走得更远，1613年封给噶玛巴「卫藏之主」的印信。1642年风向逆转，固始汗的蒙古大军攻灭藏巴汗，后藏各地的噶举寺院或被迫改宗格鲁，或僧众逃散，第十世噶玛巴秋英多杰1648年起流亡，辗转不丹、康区和尼泊尔。1672年他返回卫藏，1674年在布达拉宫与五世达赖喇嘛和解；到17世纪末，第十一世噶玛巴耶谢多杰已被迎至楚布寺抚养、受戒，这座古寺作为单纯的寺院延续下去，政治荣光不再，安然走过清朝治下的岁月。

en:
Damxung, or Dam in Qing records, means the chosen pasture. Its steppe lies southeast of Namtso, the Heavenly Lake, beneath the Nyenchen Tanglha Mountains on the northern approaches to Lhasa. In 1444 there was no great fortress here, only high grazing grounds worked by Tibetan herders whose sheep supplied wool and whose yaks and horses supported travel between Lhasa and the northern lake country. The weather over the pass could determine whether an army reached central Tibet or was broken before it arrived.

In the seventeenth century the Fifth Dalai Lama granted the Damxung pasture to Güshi Khan, and Khoshut cavalry who settled there became the Mongol Eight Banners of Dam; the grazing lands were later held by Sera Monastery's Ngakpa Tratsang. In 1717 the Dzungar commander Tsering Dondub led some six thousand men through Nagchu and past Namtso, surprised Lhasa and killed Lhabzang Khan, ending the Khoshut Khanate until Qing forces expelled the Dzungars in 1720. After Lobzang Danjin's Qinghai rising failed in 1723, fleeing Khoshut Mongols took refuge at Dam. In 1750 the Eight Banners of Dam were placed under the direct jurisdiction of the Qing ambans in Lhasa.
zh:
当雄在清代史料中多称达木，藏语意为「挑选的草场」。这片草原位于纳木错东南、念青唐古拉山下方，正处在拉萨北方通道上。1444年，这里没有大型堡寨，只有藏族牧民经营的高寒牧场：羊群提供羊毛，牦牛和马匹支撑着拉萨与藏北湖群之间的往来。山口外的风雪，往往决定一支军队究竟能进入西藏中枢，还是在抵达前就被拖垮。

17世纪，五世达赖喇嘛把当雄草原赐给固始汗，定居于此的和硕特骑兵后来形成达木蒙古八旗，牧场也一度由色拉寺的阿巴扎仓占有。1717年，准噶尔将领大策零敦多布率约六千人经那曲、纳木错一线突袭拉萨，杀死拉藏汗，灭亡和硕特汗国；清军最终在1720年将准噶尔势力逐出西藏。1723年罗卜藏丹津在青海的反清失败后，又有和硕特部众逃到达木。1750年，达木蒙古八旗改由拉萨的驻藏大臣直接管辖。

en:
Rutog is the high country beyond the Trans-Himalaya, a windswept plateau of salt lakes and pastures at some 4,500 metres where the eastern arm of Pangong Lake reaches toward Ladakh. Its old dzong crowned a hilltop with a fort and several monasteries, while rock carvings spoke of still older Zhangzhung times. After the Tibetan empire broke up, Rudok passed to Maryul, the Ladakhi kingdom founded around 930 by Palgyigon, whose lands ran from the Zoji La to Demchok and the Gogpo goldfields. With Guge's rise in the fourteenth century the frontier shifted back and forth, and in 1444 Rutog was the western march of the Guge kings; nomad herds of sheep and goats supplied the coarse wool and fine pashmina that Ladakhi caravans carried west.

Ties to Leh stayed close. The Jesuit António de Andrade, welcomed by the Guge court in 1626, was even allowed to open a second chapel at Rudok, but only a few years later Sengge Namgyal of Ladakh reclaimed the district when his armies overran Guge. Ladakhi rule lasted until 1679, when the 5th Dalai Lama's general Galdan Chhewang invaded at the head of a Mongol-Tibetan army. The Treaty of Tingmosgang in 1684 fixed Rudok under Lhasa yet made it the hinge of the Himalayan wool trade: none but Ladakh's royal trader might enter the town, two hundred horse-loads of Lhasa tea went west each year, and a triennial mission from Leh carried gold dust, saffron and Yarkand cotton the other way. Under those closely guarded terms, Rudok's caravans kept moving through the eighteenth century.
zh:
日土是喜马拉雅山以北的高地，平均海拔约4500米，盐湖散布、牧场辽阔，班公错的东段由此伸向拉达克。旧日土宗雄踞山巅，堡寨与数座寺院并立，岩画上还留着象雄时代的痕迹。吐蕃崩溃后，日土并入麻域——930年前后帕衮建立的拉达克王国，疆域从佐吉山口延伸到典角，日土和果普金矿都在其内。14世纪古格崛起，边界几经进退，1444年时日土是古格国王的西部边地；游牧人的羊群提供了粗羊毛和细软的羊绒，由拉达克商队源源西运。

日土与列城始终关系密切。1626年耶稣会士安德拉德在古格宫廷受到接待时，还获准在日土另设一座小教堂；不过数年之后，拉达克王僧格南嘉出兵攻灭古格，把这片地区重新收回。拉达克的统治持续到1679年，五世达赖的将领噶丹泽旺率领蒙藏联军西征。1684年的《丁莫岗条约》把日土划归拉萨，又使它成为喜马拉雅羊毛贸易的枢纽——除拉达克王廷的官商外，任何人不得入城；每年有两百驮茶从拉萨西运，列城则每三年遣使，带着金砂、藏红花和叶尔羌棉布东来。凭借这些受到严格管束的条款，日土的商队一路走到18世纪。

en:
Skardu opens the broad valley where the Shigar River meets the Indus, the heart of the Balti country the Mughals called Little Tibet. Tibetan in language and Buddhist in faith since the Tibetan kings of the seventh century, the valleys of Skardu, Shigar and Khaplu broke away when Tibetan power collapsed and passed to the Maqpon dynasty, which ruled from Skardu for some seven centuries. In the fourteenth century disciples of Mir Sayyid Ali Hamadani crossed the passes from Kashmir, and Balti tradition still points to the Chaqchan mosque they founded at Khaplu; missionaries of the Nurbakhshiya order carried the new faith further. In 1444 the Maqpon raja holds the Kharphocho fort above the town, his family turning to Islam while lamas and Buddhist villagers still people most of the valleys, and caravans carry mountain wool, fruit and river gold toward Kashmir and Yarkand.

Early in the sixteenth century Sultan Said Khan of Yarkand raided the valleys, and after Akbar conquered Kashmir in 1586 the Maqpon ruler Ghazi Mir acknowledged Mughal suzerainty, whose historians then called the kings of Skardu rulers of Little Tibet. The greatest of the line, Ali Sher Khan Anchan, answered a Ladakhi invasion of Kargil by marching round the enemy through Marol and seizing Leh about 1594, carrying King Jamyang Namgyal prisoner and sealing the peace with a marriage alliance; he then made Astore, Gilgit, Hunza, Chilas and Chitral his tributaries. His death in 1633 opened a war among his sons, and in 1637 an expedition under the Mughal governor Zafar Khan installed Adam Khan and fixed Mughal suzerainty over Skardu; a Mughal chronicler counted twenty-two parganas and thirty-seven forts in this poor, fruit-growing land. As Nurbakhshiya missionaries taught on, Islam became the faith of nearly all Baltis by the end of the century, most of them Shia. The Maqpon kings kept their mountain kingdom when Mughal power ebbed, and in 1821 it still stands behind its passes, small, remote and independent.
zh:
斯卡都位于什加尔河汇入印度河处的宽谷，是巴尔蒂人的中心，莫卧儿人称这片土地为小西藏。居民操藏语支的巴尔蒂语，自7世纪吐蕃诸王时代起信奉佛教；吐蕃崩溃后，斯卡都、什加尔、赫布利等河谷分立，落入自斯卡都发号施令的默格本王朝之手，该家族统治巴尔蒂斯坦约七百年。14世纪，米尔·赛义德·阿里·哈马丹尼的门徒从克什米尔翻山而来，当地相传赫布利的恰克钦清真寺即为他们所建，努尔巴赫希亚教团的传教士随后继续推进新信仰。1444年，默格本拉杰据守镇子上方的卡尔福乔堡，王族已在改奉伊斯兰教，而多数河谷仍是喇嘛与佛教村民的天下，商队把山羊毛绒、果物和沙金贩往克什米尔与叶尔羌。

16世纪初，叶尔羌的赛义德汗曾入掠各河谷；1586年阿克巴征服克什米尔后，默格本君主加齐·米尔承认莫卧儿宗主权，莫卧儿史官从此把斯卡都诸王称作小西藏之主。王朝最伟大的君主阿里·谢尔·汗·安钦为报复拉达克入侵卡尔吉尔，绕道马罗尔，约1594年直下列城，俘获拉达克拉杰甲央南嘉，并以联姻缔和；其后他又使阿斯托尔、吉尔吉特、罕萨、吉拉斯和奇特拉尔俯首纳贡。他1633年死后诸子争立，1637年莫卧儿总督扎法尔汗率军远征，扶立亚当汗，正式确立对斯卡都的宗主权；据一位莫卧儿史官统计，这片贫瘠而盛产果品的土地分为22个帕尔加纳、有37座堡垒。随着努尔巴赫希亚传教士持续奔走，到17世纪末，伊斯兰教已成为几乎全体巴尔蒂人的信仰，其中多数为什叶派。莫卧儿衰落后，默格本诸王保住了山地王国，到1821年，它依旧蜷缩在山口之后，国小民稀、地处绝域，却仍然独立。

en:
Inowrocław stands on a salt-rich plain in western Kuyavia. It was first mentioned in 1185 as Novus Wladislaw, a settlement planted by townsfolk from flood-stricken Włocławek above brine workings that had drawn wealth from the soil since the eleventh century. During the fragmentation it was the seat of the Kuyavian Piasts, capital first of the Duchy of Kuyavia and then, from 1267 to 1364, of the Duchy of Inowrocław; Duke Casimir Konradowic gave the town its Silesian-style charter around 1238. In 1321 a Polish–Teutonic tribunal sat here to judge the Order's seizure of Gdańsk Pomerania, the Knights held the town themselves from 1332 to 1337, and in 1337 Casimir the Great met John of Bohemia in its castle. During the 1410 war Jagiełło directed operations from the castle after Grunwald. In 1444 Inowrocław was a royal town living by its salt, on the edge of the quarrelsome Teutonic frontier.

Three years later the first Jews settled here, and in 1466 the town became the seat of the Inowrocław Voivodeship covering north-western Kuyavia; rich brine workings added to its wealth in the fifteenth century. The Deluge wrecked all that: the Swedes took it in the autumn of 1655, and of nearly 250 houses counted before the war only 23 stood in 1659, with about 500 inhabitants, and the Great Northern War brought fresh ruin. In the First Partition of February 1772 Inowrocław passed to Prussia and the Netze District. The 1807 Treaty of Tilsit assigned it to the Duchy of Warsaw, and Napoleon made the town his headquarters during the 1812 march on Russia; in 1815 the Congress of Vienna returned it to Prussia as part of the Grand Duchy of Posen, where it became a centre of Polish resistance to Germanisation.
zh:
伊诺弗罗茨瓦夫坐落在库亚维西部一片富盐的平原上。1185年它以「新瓦迪斯瓦夫」之名首见记载，是弗沃茨瓦韦克居民躲避洪水迁来建立的聚落，而当地煮盐业自11世纪便已从地下取利。分裂割据时期，这里是库亚维皮亚斯特公爵们的驻地，先后作为库亚维公国和1267至1364年间伊诺弗罗茨瓦夫公国的都城；卡齐米日·孔德拉托维奇公爵约在1238年按西里西亚模式为它颁下城市特许状。1321年，波兰—条顿仲裁法庭在此审理骑士团夺取格但斯克波美拉尼亚一案；1332至1337年骑士团一度占据此城；1337年卡齐米日大王又在城中城堡会见波希米亚国王约翰。1410年大战期间，雅盖沃在格伦瓦德获胜后以这座城堡指挥作战。1444年的伊诺弗罗茨瓦夫是一座靠盐业为生的王家城市，地处与条顿骑士团纷争不断的边境。

三年后首批犹太人来此定居；1466年，城市成为统辖库亚维西北部的伊诺弗罗茨瓦夫省首府，15世纪新开的盐泉更为它增添财富。「大洪水」毁了这一切：瑞典人1655年秋攻占此城，战前近二百五十栋房屋到1659年仅剩二十三栋，居民只剩约五百人；18世纪初的大北方战争又添新创。1772年2月第一次瓜分时，伊诺弗罗茨瓦夫落入普鲁士之手，划入内茨区。1807年《提尔西特条约》把它划给华沙公国，1812年拿破仑征俄途中还以此为大本营；1815年维也纳和会又把它交还普鲁士，成为波森大公国的一部分，此后这里成为波兰人抵制德意志化的一个中心。

en:
Dobrzyń guards a Vistula crossing in the Dobrzyń Land, the town from which the region takes its name. A stronghold stood on its castle hill from the tenth century and a castellan's gord is named as Dobrin in a document of 1065. In 1228 Konrad of Masovia enfeoffed the place to the Order of Dobrzyń, the short-lived brotherhood founded to defend Mazovia from the Prussians, and a town was laid out before 1230, probably under Lübeck law. Between 1288 and 1352 it was, with interruptions, the seat of the dukes of Dobrzyń: Lithuanians burned it on 14 September 1323, killing or carrying off some 2,000 people, and the Teutonic Knights took the castle in 1329. Restored to Poland and later pawned to the Order again, the town was stormed with artillery on 20 August 1409 and its defender Starosta Jan Chełmicki was beheaded; the First Peace of Toruń finally returned it to Poland in 1411. In 1444 Dobrzyń was a small royal town of the Inowrocław Voivodeship and a land-court seat, where the nobility of the Dobrzyń Land had held their first recorded sejmik in 1434.

Election sejmiks continued to meet there into the eighteenth century. The town never recovered from the Deluge: Swedish troops burned castle and town in 1657, and of some 600 houses standing before the wars a survey of 1661 found only 30 inhabited. In the Second Partition of 1793 Dobrzyń passed to Prussia, in 1807 to the Duchy of Warsaw, and after 1815 to Russian-ruled Congress Poland, where it became a district town in the Płock province.
zh:
多布任扼守维斯瓦河的一处渡口，是多布任地区得名的首镇。早在10世纪，城堡山上便有据点；1065年的一份文献中，这里的城堡长官府邸已以「多布林」之名出现。1228年，马佐夫舍公爵康拉德把此地封给多布任骑士团——为保卫马佐夫舍抵御普鲁士人而创立的短命修道武装修会；1230年前，一座可能依吕贝克法建立的城镇已在城堡脚下成形。1288至1352年间，这里几度成为多布任公爵的驻地：1323年9月14日立陶宛人焚城，约两千人被杀或掳走；1329年条顿骑士围攻并夺取城堡。城市归还波兰后又被典当给骑士团，1409年8月20日城堡在炮火下陷落，守将扬·海乌米茨基被斩首；1411年第一次托伦和约才把多布任最终归还波兰。1444年的多布任是伊诺弗罗茨瓦夫省的一座小王家城市，设有地区法庭，多布任贵族有记载的第一次地方议会1434年便在此召开。

选举议会一直在此办到18世纪。城市却再未从「大洪水」中恢复：1657年瑞典军队烧毁城堡和全城，战前约六百栋房屋，到1661年普查时仅剩三十栋有人居住。1793年第二次瓜分时多布任归属普鲁士，1807年并入华沙公国，1815年后落入俄国治下的波兰会议王国，成为普沃茨克省的县城。

en:
Rawa was first mentioned in 1228 above the Rawka River, and in 1313 a castellany was established there. In 1321 it received town rights and became the capital of the Duchy of Rawa, and between 1355 and 1370 Duke Siemowit III built a brick castle and ringed the town with walls as part of Casimir the Great's chain of border strongholds; under Siemowit, who reunited most of Mazovia, Rawa was for a time capital of the whole duchy. The wars of the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries passed it by, and in 1444 it was a prosperous walled seat of the Masovian Piasts on busy inland trade routes.

In 1462 Casimir Jagiellon incorporated the duchy into the Crown and made Rawa the capital of a new voivodeship. From 1562 the castle held the Rawa Treasury, tax money set aside to pay the Commonwealth's standing army, and in 1622 the Jesuits completed their collegium, where the memoirist Jan Chryzostom Pasek studied. Swedes seized the town on 8 October 1655, and in April 1656 Charles X Gustav's troops burned it and wrecked the castle; by 1676 only about a hundred inhabitants remained. Fresh destruction came with Lubomirski's rebellion and the Swedish return of 1702, and fire gutted most of Rawa in 1766. It passed to Prussia in 1795, to the Duchy of Warsaw in 1807 and to Congress Poland in 1815.
zh:
雷瓦首见于1228年的记载，坐落于拉夫卡河畔，1313年设立城主辖区。1321年它获得城市特许，成为雷瓦公国的都城；1355至1370年间，谢莫维特三世公爵修筑砖造城堡并环城筑墙，作为卡齐米日大帝边境要塞链的一环。谢莫维特三世重新统一了马佐夫舍的大部分土地，雷瓦一度成为整个公国的首都。14、15世纪的战火都未波及于此，1444年的雷瓦是马佐夫舍皮雅斯特王公治下一座繁荣的设防城市，地处繁忙的内陆商路。

1462年，卡齐米日·雅盖隆把公国并入王国，并以雷瓦为新置行省的省会。1562年起，城堡中存放「雷瓦金库」，那是拨给共和国常备军的税款；1622年耶稣会在此建成学院，回忆录作家扬·赫里佐斯托姆·帕塞克曾在此求学。1655年10月8日瑞典人占领城市，1656年4月卡尔十世·古斯塔夫的军队焚毁城市、破坏城堡，到1676年居民仅剩约一百人。卢博米尔斯基叛乱和1702年瑞典人再度来袭又添破坏，1766年一场大火烧掉大半个雷瓦。它于1795年归属普鲁士，1807年并入华沙公国，1815年成为波兰王国的一部分。

en:
Gniezno rises among the hills and lakes east of Poznań, on one of the central grounds of the early Piast state. A stronghold was built on Lech Hill in 940-941, and in 1000 Bolesław the Brave met Emperor Otto III there at the Congress of Gniezno, when the city became the seat of Poland's first archdiocese. Bolesław was crowned king in its cathedral in 1025, but the Bohemian duke Bretislav I sacked the city in 1038, after which the royal capital shifted to Kraków. Władysław Odonic granted town rights in 1238-1239; Przemysł II was crowned there in 1295 and Wenceslaus II of Bohemia in 1300. The Teutonic Knights ravaged Gniezno in 1331 and Casimir the Great rebuilt it. In 1419 its archbishop received the title of Primate of Poland. In 1444 the royal county seat drew merchants to four annual fairs and remained the ecclesiastical centre of the kingdom.

In 1458 Gniezno sent twenty infantrymen to relieve Malbork during the Thirteen Years' War. Fires struck in 1515 and 1613, and Primate Jan Łaski built a brick castle by Lake Jelonek in 1518. Swedish invasions and the plague of 1708-1710 emptied and impoverished the town, but in 1768 it became capital of the Gniezno Voivodeship. The Second Partition carried it to Prussia in 1793. During the 1794 rising General Jan Henryk Dąbrowski operated from Gniezno, and when he returned to Greater Poland in 1806 the town joined the Polish uprising that opened the way to the Duchy of Warsaw. From 1807 to 1815 it belonged to that Duchy, then passed to Prussia's Grand Duchy of Posen. A fire in 1819 led to a new market square and a wider street opening the cathedral toward the town.
zh:
格涅兹诺坐落在波兹南以东的丘陵湖泊之间，是皮雅斯特早期国家的核心地带之一。940—941年，莱赫山上建起要塞；1000年，博莱斯瓦夫一世在此会见神圣罗马帝国皇帝奥托三世，是为格涅兹诺会议，波兰第一个总主教区也在此设立。1025年，博莱斯瓦夫在城中大教堂加冕为王，但1038年捷克公爵布热季斯拉夫一世洗劫城市，王都随后迁往克拉科夫。瓦迪斯瓦夫·奥多尼奇在1238—1239年授予城市权；1295年普热梅斯尔二世、1300年捷克的瓦茨拉夫二世先后在此加冕。1331年条顿骑士团劫掠格涅兹诺，其后由卡齐米日大帝重建。1419年，格涅兹诺总主教获得波兰首席大主教头衔。1444年时，这座王家县城以每年四场市集吸引商人，同时仍是王国的教会中心。

1458年，格涅兹诺派出二十名步兵，在十三年战争中救援马尔堡。城市先后在1515年和1613年遭遇大火，首席大主教扬·瓦斯基1518年在耶洛内克湖畔修建砖石城堡。瑞典入侵和1708—1710年瘟疫使人口流失、经济凋敝，但格涅兹诺在1768年成为格涅兹诺省首府。1793年第二次瓜分波兰后，城市并入普鲁士。1794年起义期间，扬·亨利克·东布罗夫斯基将军曾在格涅兹诺活动；1806年他返回大波兰，城市参加波兰起义，为华沙公国的建立打开道路。1807年至1815年，格涅兹诺隶属于华沙公国，随后划归普鲁士治下的波森大公国。1819年火灾后，城市开辟了新市场和一条更宽的街道，使大教堂与城区相连。

en:
