西班牙人的第一个据点是1564年建立的矿业城镇托皮亚；1580年代打到的富银矿引来监护主、奴隶和被迫下矿的阿卡塞劳工，而1576至1577年、1590年、1596至1597年的几场瘟疫使人口减至仅剩数千。1600年，耶稣会士埃尔南多·德·桑塔伦偕队长迭戈·德·阿维拉巡视山区，把阿卡塞人迁入传教村镇，焚毁他们的神像、剃去长发。1601年12月，融合天主教与本土信仰、许诺得救降福的弥赛亚式首领佩里科率众起事：几周之内约五十名西班牙人被杀，矿营和四十座教堂被焚，四十名殖民者被围困在圣安德烈斯的教堂里，直到杜兰戈的援军赶到。银矿停采了两年，1603年西班牙军队及其印第安盟友才将起义镇压，佩里科和四十八名军事首领被处死，幸存的起事者被卖为奴。1607年的天花伴着哈雷彗星一同到来，抹去了阿卡塞人抗争最后的痕迹，只有少数人后来参加了1616年的特佩瓦起义。作为一个族群，阿卡塞人自此从记载中消失，群山留给了传教站、庄园和新比斯开亚的银矿；1767年耶稣会被逐，1821年之后，古老的托皮亚山区成为独立墨西哥的一部分。

en:
The Mayo, who call themselves Yoreme, held the hot coastal plain between the Mayo and Fuerte rivers, where seasonal floodwater made maize fields possible and the Gulf shallows supplied fish. Their Cahita speech was close to that of the Yaqui, and the river villages traded and intermarried while also guarding their autonomy. The country around later Navojoa and Huatabampo was densely enough settled to support mission towns, yet in 1444 it remained outside the empires of central Mexico, its life governed by the river, the rains, and the fishing coast.

Diego de Guzmán made the first recorded Spanish contact in 1533, and Francisco de Ulloa reached the mouth of the Mayo in 1539. Jesuits entered the region in 1591, and after Diego Martínez de Hurdaide's campaign the Yoreme submitted in 1599. In 1614 Pedro Méndez and Diego de la Cruz founded Santa María de Navojoa and the Santa Cruz del Mayo missions, with a school for Indigenous boys established there in 1622. Juan Calixto's Cahita rising swept through the neighboring Yaqui and Mayo country in 1740 before it was crushed, and the Jesuit expulsion of 1767 replaced the missionaries with secular and Franciscan clergy. The wars after 1810 were far away, but in 1821 the river towns passed with New Spain into independent Mexico.
zh:
马约人自称约雷梅，占据马约河与富埃尔特河之间炎热的沿海平原。季节性洪水让这里能够种植玉米，加利福尼亚湾浅滩则提供鱼获。他们的卡伊塔语与亚基语相近，河畔村落之间既贸易通婚，也各自守护自治。后来纳沃华和瓦塔万波周围的土地人口足够稠密，足以支撑传教村镇；但在1444年，这里仍不受墨西哥中部诸帝国统治，生活由河流、雨水和捕鱼海岸决定。

迭戈·德·古斯曼1533年留下有记载的首次西班牙接触，弗朗西斯科·德·乌略亚1539年抵达马约河口。耶稣会士1591年进入这一地区，迭戈·马丁内斯·德·乌尔戴德用兵之后，约雷梅人于1599年臣服。1614年，佩德罗·门德斯和迭戈·德·拉克鲁斯建立纳沃华圣玛利亚与马约河圣克鲁斯等传教村，1622年又在纳沃华为原住民男孩设立学校。1740年，胡安·卡利斯托领导的卡伊塔起事波及相邻的亚基和马约地区，随后被镇压；1767年耶稣会被逐，传教士改由世俗教士和方济各会士接替。1810年以后的独立战争离这里遥远，但1821年，这些河畔村镇随新西班牙转入独立的墨西哥。

en:
The Opatería, the Opata country, ran from the Sonora River valley toward the western canyons of the Sierra Madre Occidental. It was not a single kingdom but a chain of independent agricultural towns along the Sonora, Moctezuma, Bavispe, and Aros rivers, surrounded by scattered houses and irrigated fields of maize, beans, squash, and cotton. Opata traders carried corn and woven blankets toward the Zuni and Concho countries in exchange for turquoise, while sharing hunting and fishing grounds with the Yaqui, Mayo, and Seri. In the rougher eastern hills, the Jova lived more by hunting and gathering. In 1444 the valley statelets remained self-governing, densely settled for the Sonoran frontier, and unconnected to the empires of central Mexico.

Álvar Núñez Cabeza de Vaca passed through in 1538 and named one valley town Corazones. Francisco Vázquez de Coronado stationed eighty men at San Jerónimo de los Corazones in 1540, but abuse under his officer Alcaraz provoked an Opata rising in 1541; the post was destroyed and the Spaniards withdrew, while fierce resistance to Francisco de Ibarra in 1565 again checked conquest. Epidemics from 1601 to 1625 weakened the valley towns, and after Diego Martínez de Hurdaide's bloody campaign near Mátape in 1622, Jesuits under Pedro Méndez began missions in 1628, numbering twenty-two by 1688. Many Opata became Spanish allies against the Apache, yet forced mine labor and land disputes fed conspiracies in 1681 and 1696 and the broad native rising under Juan Calixto in 1740. Arizpe became capital of Sonora in 1778 and seat of the bishopric in 1783. By 1800 many Opata were Christians, vaqueros, and miners; the Bavispe revolt of 1820 spread through Sahuaripa, Arivechi, and Tonichi before royal troops executed its leaders Dorame and Espíritu on the eve of Mexican independence in 1821.
zh:
奥帕塔人之地被称为奥帕塔里亚，从索诺拉河谷一直延伸到西马德雷山脉西缘的峡谷地带。它不是统一王国，而是沿索诺拉河、蒙特苏马河、巴维斯佩河和阿罗斯河分布的一连串独立农业村镇；镇外散布着民居，以及灌溉种植玉米、豆类、南瓜和棉花的田地。奥帕塔商人带着玉米和织毯前往祖尼人与孔乔人地区交换绿松石，也与亚基人、马约人和塞里人共用狩猎场和渔场。东部崎岖山地的霍瓦人则更多依靠狩猎采集。1444年时，这些河谷小邦仍由本地人自治，在索诺拉边陲算得上人口稠密，也不属于墨西哥中部诸帝国。

阿尔瓦·努涅斯·卡韦萨·德·巴卡1538年经过此地，把一座河谷城镇命名为科拉索内斯。1540年，弗朗西斯科·巴斯克斯·德·科罗纳多在圣赫罗尼莫·德·洛斯科拉索内斯驻扎八十人；军官阿尔卡拉斯的虐待引发奥帕塔人1541年起事，据点被毁，西班牙人撤退。1565年，他们又猛烈抵抗弗朗西斯科·德·伊瓦拉的远征，使征服再度停滞。1601年至1625年的疫病削弱了各河谷城镇；1622年迭戈·马丁内斯·德·乌尔戴德在马塔佩附近打赢血战之后，佩德罗·门德斯率领耶稣会士于1628年开始建立传教区，到1688年已有二十二处。许多奥帕塔人后来成为西班牙人对抗阿帕奇人的盟友，但强制矿役和土地争端仍引发1681年、1696年的密谋，以及1740年胡安·卡利斯托领导的广泛原住民起事。阿里斯佩1778年成为索诺拉首府，1783年又成为主教驻地。到1800年，许多奥帕塔人已是基督徒、牧工和矿工；1820年，巴维斯佩的兵变蔓延到萨瓦里帕、阿里韦奇和托尼奇，最终被王军镇压，首领多拉梅和埃斯皮里图被处决，仅仅一年后，墨西哥便在1821年独立。

en:
Tsushima is a chain of mountainous islands in the Korea Strait, too short of good farmland to live by rice alone but perfectly placed for fishing, shipping and commerce with Korea. Its early inhabitants sailed north and south to buy grain, and the island became a frontier guard against the continent. The Mongol invasions of 1274 and 1281 struck Tsushima before Kyushu; the local commander So Sukekuni was killed and the islands briefly occupied. The rising So clan then turned maritime power into diplomacy. A Joseon army landed in 1419 to suppress wokou and withdrew after a month's fighting, and in 1443 the So concluded the Gyehae agreement with Korea. In 1444 Tsushima was therefore both a fortified sea frontier and the chief Japanese gateway to Busan.

Trade also drew Tsushima into Korean disorders. In 1510 Japanese residents rose at the Three Ports in the Sampo disturbance; a So relief force was defeated, the residents were expelled, and official relations were interrupted until 1512. In 1592 the So tried in vain to prevent Toyotomi Hideyoshi's invasion of Korea, after which Tsushima served as the relay between Busan and the Nagoya headquarters in Hizen. Although the clan joined the western army at Sekigahara, its domain was confirmed as the Tsushima-Fuchu domain, ranked at 100,000 koku. Even under Japan's seclusion laws, the So kept the formal Joseon channel, guided Korean embassies, maintained their trading house at Busan, and managed the sometimes forged correspondence exposed in the Yanagawa affair. To the end of the eighteenth century they remained a diplomatic domain rather than an ordinary island fief.
zh:
对马是朝鲜海峡中一串多山岛屿，良田不多，难以单靠稻米为生，却正适合渔业、航运和对朝鲜贸易。早期居民便乘船南北往返购粮，这里也成为面向大陆的海防前线。1274年和1281年元军两次侵日，都先在对马登陆；当地将领宗助国战死，岛屿一度被占领。此后兴起的宗氏把海上力量转化为外交资本。1419年，朝鲜为镇压倭寇派军登陆，交战一个月后撤退；1443年，宗氏又与朝鲜订立嘉吉条约。因此1444年的对马既是设防的海疆，也是日本通往釜山的主要门户。

贸易也把对马卷入朝鲜的动荡。1510年，居留朝鲜的日本人在三浦之乱中起事，宗氏派出的援军被击败，日侨遭驱逐，官方往来断绝至1512年。1592年，宗氏曾试图阻止丰臣秀吉侵朝，战争开始后，对马仍成为釜山与肥前名护屋大本营之间的中继地。关原之战中宗氏虽加入西军，领地仍获承认，对马府中藩按十万石格存续。即使在日本锁国之后，宗氏仍维持与朝鲜王朝的正式渠道，引导朝鲜通信使，在釜山设置倭馆，并处理后来在柳川一件中暴露的往来国书篡改问题。直到十八世纪末，对马都不是普通海岛藩，而是一个承担外交职能的藩国。

en:
Haicheng covers the head of Liaodong Bay, where the Daling and Liao rivers wind through reed marshes into the Bohai Sea and the coastal road from Shanhai Pass runs on toward Liaoyang. The Liao placed a prefecture here as Haizhou, and in 1376 the Ming sited the Haizhou Guard at old Linming, near Niuzhuang; farther west the Guangning Central-Tumet Guard held Jinzhou in the corridor, both answering to the Liaodong Regional Military Commission at Liaoyang. In 1444 the province was a chain of guard camps and fishing harbours on a quiet frontier, its western end facing the Mongol steppe and its eastern end the Jurchen hills.

The Haizhou Guard passed to the Later Jin with Liaoyang in 1621, while Jinzhou became the forward bastion of the Ming Guan-Ning-Jin defence line, withstanding six Qing sieges between 1627 and 1642. The last and greatest war began in 1639: after Hong Taiji fortified Yizhou in 1640 and cantoned his troops to stop the Ming border from sowing, the Qing invested Jinzhou in 1641. Hong Chengchou marched eight regional commanders and 130,000 men to relieve it, only to see his army shattered outside Songshan. The city fell in 1642 and Hong was carried off to the Qing court, Zu Dashou surrendered Jinzhou, and by the fourth month the war was over with the last Ming field army beyond the pass destroyed. Under the Qing the guards became counties: Haicheng in 1653, under Fengtian Prefecture from 1657, while Jinzhou took its guards into Jinxian County in 1662 and became the seat of Jinzhou Prefecture in 1665.
zh:
海城一省据有辽东湾湾顶：大凌河、辽河在芦荡间蜿蜒注入渤海，从山海关通往辽阳的滨海大路穿境而过。辽代在此置海州，明洪武九年（1376年）就旧海州临溟县地置海州卫，卫城初在牛庄；西段走廊上则有广宁中屯卫驻守锦州，二卫皆听驻于辽阳的辽东都指挥使司节制。1444年，这里是一串卫城和渔港连成的安静边地，西望蒙古草原，东接女真山林。

1621年辽阳失守，海州卫随入后金；西面的锦州则成为明军「关宁锦防线」的前沿，1627年至1642年间清军六次围攻锦州。最后也是最大的一战始于1639年：皇太极先于1640年在义州筑城屯田，令关外宁锦之地不得耕种，1641年清军合围锦州。蓟辽总督洪承畴率八总兵、步骑十三万赴援，却在松山外全线崩溃；1642年松山城破，洪承畴被掳北去，祖大寿献锦州投降，至四月战事结束，明朝关外最后一支野战军就此覆灭。清代卫所改设州县：1653年改海州为海城县，1657年起隶奉天府；锦州则在1662年并卫设锦县，1665年置锦州府。

en:
The wooded valley of the Tumen, east of the Changbai, was the country of the Maolian Jurchens, whose name meant 'horse' in their own language. They sprang from the same Hurga stock as the Jianzhou and were long treated as kin, the two guards forming the main body of the Jianzhou Jurchens. In 1405 their chief Ba'ersun travelled to the Ming court and the Maolian Guard was created with him as commander. Korea killed him in 1410, and in 1411 the Ming gave the guard to Mengge Buhua of the Jianzhou chief's house. Korea's campaign up the Pozhu River in 1433 shattered the Jurchen guards of the lower Tumen and occupied their settlements, and many survivors followed Li Manzhu west to the Hun River. In 1444 the old Maolian lands were a half-emptied border country, the clans left along the Tumen living as so-called submitted barbarians in Korea's shadow while Jianzhou still claimed them as kin.

Those remnant clans became known as the Warka, caught between Korea, the Ula and the rising Jianzhou. In 1607 the Warka lord of Feiyou on the Tumen offered his city to Nurhaci; when Ula tried to block the move, the Jianzhou army routed the Ula forces at Wujieyan near Korean Jongseong and killed their commander Bokdo, after which Ula abandoned the valley for good. Over the following decades the remaining Warka clans were enrolled in the Eight Banners. Under the Qing the country became a closed imperial reserve for ginseng and sable, governed from Ningguta after 1653, and in 1714 an assistant commandant was posted at Hunchun to watch the Tumen line. Farther out to sea, the Dane Martin Spanberg, sailing for Russia, crossed the Sea of Japan in 1738–39 and opened the Kuril route to Japan, the first Russian ships to appear on the waters beyond this quieted frontier.
zh:
长白山以东、图们江两岸的林海是毛怜女真人的故土，「毛怜」在女真语中意为「马」。他们与建州同出胡里改部，世代相亲，毛怜卫与建州卫同为建州女真的主体。1405年，其首领把儿逊入朝，明廷遂设毛怜卫，授以诰印；1410年把儿逊被朝鲜所杀，1411年明廷改以建州酋长世家的猛哥不花领卫事。1433年，朝鲜发动婆猪江之战，图们江下游一带的女真卫所多被摧毁、土地被占，残余部众随李满住西迁浑河流域。1444年的毛怜旧地已是人烟稀少的边外之境，留在图们江沿岸的各部作为「藩胡」在朝鲜的阴影下度日，建州则仍以宗亲之名声称对他们的管辖权。

这些遗部后来被称为瓦尔喀，夹在朝鲜、乌拉与兴起的建州之间。1607年，图们江畔蜚优城主策穆特黑举城投靠努尔哈赤，乌拉出兵截击，建州军在朝鲜钟城附近的乌碣岩大败乌拉，阵斩其主帅博克多，乌拉势力从此退出图们江流域。此后数十年间，瓦尔喀余部陆续被编入八旗。入清以后，这片地方划为封禁的皇家采参、猎貂之地，1653年起归宁古塔昂邦章京统辖；1714年，清廷在珲春设置协领，戍守图们江一线。而在东面远海，为俄国效力的丹麦人马丁·斯庞贝里于1738至1739年穿越日本海，探明了经千岛群岛前往日本的航路，这是俄国船只第一次出现在这条沉寂边地以东的海面之上。

en:
The Fuerhe is a forest land of the northern Changbai, where the Mudan and the Erdao Songhua rise among wooded ridges. Its river takes its name from the Manchu word for poplar, after the tall stands lining its banks. Around 698 Da Zuorong built his first capital at Aodong on the upper Mudan, and from there ruled the young kingdom of Balhae for fifty-seven years before the court moved south. After the Khitan overthrew Balhae in 926 the country became Jurchen hunting ground, and under the Ming it was counted among the lands of the Jianzhou Guard. When the Jianzhou clans drifted southwest to the Hun and Susu valleys in the 1430s, the woods swallowed their old trails: in 1444 only scattered bands wintered here, living on ginseng, sable and timber, with no walled town in the province.

Nurhaci's unification of the Jianzhou, from his first campaign in 1583 to the taking of the Wanggiya in 1588, drew these highland bands into his new order, and after the Qing entered China the Changbai became more than ever a forbidden land. In 1677 the Kangxi Emperor sent the inner grandee Wumuna to offer sacrifice at the mountain, and the next year Changbai was enfeoffed as a mountain god with rites equal to the Five Sacred Peaks. The upper valleys were then sealed for two centuries as the dynasty's dragon-vein ground: licensed parties sent out from Ningguta dug ginseng and trapped sable, while the pine and fir of these headwaters supplied the great Qing boatyard at Ningguta, which built vessels for the Mudan, Sungari and Amur. In 1709 Jesuits on the imperial survey reached these forests with a government ginseng party; in 1821 the province was still virgin woodland without a town or a county seat.
zh:
富尔河所在的长白山西北麓林海，是牡丹江与二道松花江的发源之地，山岭连绵。河名得自满语「富尔」，意为杨树，因两岸昔日白杨成林而得名。698年前后，大祚荣在牡丹江上游修筑敖东城、建立渤海国，定都于此达五十七年，后来才迁都南走。926年契丹灭渤海，此地重归女真人的渔猎世界，明代被划入建州卫之地。1430年代建州各部陆续西迁浑河、苏子河流域后，旧日的山道重新没入林海：1444年的这里只有零星部众过冬，以采参、猎貂和采伐为生，全境没有一座城寨。

努尔哈赤自1583年起兵、至1588年攻克完颜城统一建州，山地间的诸部也被卷入他的新秩序；清朝入关之后，长白山更成了禁地。1677年，康熙帝派内大臣武默纳等前往长白山拜谒，次年册封长白山之神，祀典与五岳相同。这片上游河谷随后被封禁两百年，作为王朝的龙脉所在：持照的刨夫从宁古塔进山采参猎貂，源头岭上的松杉顺流而下，供应宁古塔那座为牡丹江、松花江、黑龙江水系造船的大船厂。1709年，参与官方测绘的耶稣会士随皇家采参队进入这片森林；直到1821年，这里仍是没有城镇、未曾设治的原始林海。

en:
Shilimian is the high forest between the Ussuri and the Sea of Japan, the Sikhote-Alin spine where interior rivers gather under dark Korean pine and spruce. In January 1405 the Ming set up the Shilimian guard over the clans of the Suifen and Ussuri country, and its chiefs kept their patents in good order: the last recorded request to inherit office reached the throne in 1566. The Jin already called the hunters here the 'wild Udegei', the earliest written name of the Udeghe, and Yuan parties came through these mountains for gyrfalcons and sable until the Woji rose against the dynasty in 1343 and again in 1346. In 1444, nine years after the Nurgan commission was closed, the mountain camps move by themselves, following elk, sable and ginseng beneath headmen whose Ming patents have long since become heirlooms.

Nurhaci opened the mountains road by road: after the Wujieyan battle of 1607 the Suifen and Niman chiefs submitted, and in November 1614 a force of five hundred subdued the Yalan and Xilin roads on the seaward slope. The Qing never put a garrison in the highlands; instead the Kiyakara and Udeghe headmen were confirmed in their offices and every two years carried sable rolls to Sanxing, coming back with the imperial 'forest bounty' of cloth and silk. Through 1821 the ridges held neither walled town nor ploughed field, and the forest — tiger country, cedar and the ginseng dig — stayed the true master of Shilimian.
zh:
失里绵是乌苏里江与日本海之间的高山林地，即锡霍特山脉的主脊，一条条内河在红松与云杉的浓荫下汇流。1405年正月，明朝在绥芬河、乌苏里江一带的部族中设失里绵卫，该卫酋长一直妥善维系着敕书，最后一次请求袭职的记载迟至1566年。早在金朝，史籍已把这里的猎人称作「野人兀的改」，这是乌德盖人最早的文字记载；元朝为征海东青和紫貂不断进山，1343年、1346年吾者野人两度起兵反元。1444年，奴儿干都司撤销已九年，山里的营地照旧自来自往，人们追着马鹿、紫貂和人参迁徙，头人的明朝敕书早已成了传家之物。

努尔哈赤一路路打开山地：1607年乌碣岩之战后，绥芬、尼满诸部首领归附；1614年十一月，五百人的队伍又收服了靠海一侧的雅兰、锡林二路。清朝始终不在山里设兵，而是确认恰喀拉、乌德盖头人的职分，让他们每隔两年把成卷的貂皮解往三姓，再领回朝廷名为「赏乌林」的布匹绸缎。直到1821年，山梁上既无城镇也无耕地，真正掌管失里绵的仍是这片森林——老虎的领地、红松和人参的产地。

en:
Wolanhe takes its name from the Wolan, 'the girth' in Manchu, the river Russian maps call the Samarga. Rising on the eastern face of Mount Kupol in the Sikhote-Alin, it runs 218 kilometres through a forested trough into the Tatar Strait, the northern gateway of the Udeghe country; the Kema river bounds it on the north. The Ming established the Wolanhe guard here in February 1408, and its chiefs still asked Beijing to confirm their succession in 1593. In 1444, nine years after the Nurgan commission was withdrawn, the shore clans — Udeghe of the lower river and Oroch pressing down from the coasts to the north — live by the autumn salmon runs and the sable of the cedar shade, their headmen patent-holders whom no Ming clerk ever comes to inspect.

In November 1614 the five hundred men sent against the Yalan and Xilin roads brought the coastal roads between the Suifen and the Kema under Nurhaci's name, and the Wolan clans were counted among the Eastern Sea Woji. Under the Qing their headmen carried sable every two years to Sanxing and received the 'forest bounty' of cloth and silk, while the estuary never saw a banner post or a walled town. In 1787 Lapérouse's two French frigates coasted this shore on their way north to latitude 51, charting the strait for Europe; no settlement followed, and in 1821 the Samarga mouth was still only a summer fishing ground of the lower-river clans.
zh:
斡兰河得名于满语「额勒」，意为马肚带；俄国地图上称之为萨马尔加河。它发源于锡霍特山脉库波尔山东坡，穿过林木幽深的纵谷，奔流218公里注入鞑靼海峡，是乌德盖人分布区的北大门，北面以克马河为界。明朝于1408年二月在此设斡兰河卫，直到1593年，该卫酋长还在向朝廷请求袭职。1444年，奴儿干都司撤销已有九年，河口各部——下游的乌德盖人和从北方海岸南下的奥罗奇人——靠秋季的鲑鱼汛和冷杉林里的紫貂为生，头人都持有卫所敕书，却再也没有明朝的书吏前来查验。

1614年十一月，征讨雅兰、锡林二路的五百人队伍，使绥芬河与克马河之间的各滨海路都归到努尔哈赤名下，斡兰诸部被算作东海渥集的一部分。清代，头人们每隔两年把貂皮解往三姓，领回名为「赏乌林」的布匹绸缎，但河口始终没有旗营，也没有城寨。1787年，拉彼鲁兹的两艘法国护卫舰沿岸北上至北纬51度，为欧洲人测绘了这条海峡；此后并无定居者跟来，到1821年，萨马尔加河口仍只是下游各部夏季的渔场。

en:
Nanghar takes its name from a Yuan tribute post on northwestern Sakhalin, near Langry on the Strait of Tartary. This is Nivkh country: summer fishing camps faced the coast, winter bands moved up streams for salmon, and dog teams linked villages through the snow. Nivkh hunters supplied sable furs, while sea-mammal hunting and the bear ritual carried the older Okhotsk culture of the island. After Mongol campaigns on Sakhalin from 1264 to 1308, Nanghar was one of three posts, with Wuliehe in the Tym basin and Boluohe on the Poronay, where Ainu and Nivkh visitors presented tribute and received gifts. The Yuan withdrawal after 1320 loosened that system, though Ming titles from Nurgan followed after 1409. In 1444 the coast was therefore ruled more by Nivkh clan networks than by any distant dynasty.

The island trade outlasted the dynastic posts, linking Manchuria, Japan and Kamchatka through Sakhalin until the eighteenth century. In 1643 Vassily Poyarkov became the first Russian writer to describe the Nivkh from reports gathered at the Amur, using the Tungus exonym Gilyak. After the 1689 Treaty of Nerchinsk, Qing officers entered the Amur estuary and took sable tribute from Nivkh clans, who also acted as intermediaries among Manchu, Russian, Japanese and Ainu visitors. In 1787 La Perouse charted the Strait of Tartary and spoke with islanders near its narrow northern waters. Ivan Kruzenshtern surveyed much of the Sakhalin coast in 1805, and Japanese expeditions established in 1808 that the land was an island rather than a peninsula attached to the Amur mouth.
zh:
囊哈儿得名于萨哈林西北部、朗里附近鞑靼海峡沿岸的一处元朝朝贡站点。这里是尼夫赫人的土地：夏季渔营设在海岸，冬季人群溯溪而居捕捞鲑鱼，狗橇在雪地中连接村落。尼夫赫猎人供应紫貂皮，海兽捕猎和熊祭则延续着岛上更古老的鄂霍次克文化。1264年至1308年蒙古用兵萨哈林后，囊哈儿成为三处朝贡站点之一，另外两处是特姆河流域的兀列河和波罗奈河流域的波罗河；阿伊努人与尼夫赫人在此贡纳方物并领受回赐。1320年后元朝撤离，这一体系松弛，1409年后明朝又以奴儿干职衔维系当地。1444年时，这片海岸更多由尼夫赫氏族网络自行管理，而非受远方王朝直接统治。

海岛贸易比王朝站点延续得更久，以萨哈林为中心连接满洲、日本和堪察加的网络一直维持到18世纪。1643年，瓦西里·波亚尔科夫根据在黑龙江口收集到的消息，成为最早记载尼夫赫人的俄国人，并沿用通古斯人的外名称他们为「吉利亚克」。1689年《尼布楚条约》后，清朝官员进入黑龙江口，向尼夫赫氏族征收紫貂贡；尼夫赫人也在满洲、俄国、日本和阿伊努来客之间充当中介。1787年，拉彼鲁兹测绘鞑靼海峡，并在北部狭窄水域附近与岛民交谈。1805年，克鲁森施滕考察了萨哈林大部海岸；1808年，日本探险队确认这里是一座岛屿，而不是连接黑龙江口的半岛。

en:
Tulutingshan is the Chinese name for the Turan Range east of the Tom River, a three-hundred-kilometre wall of larch, fir and spruce taiga above the Zeya and Bureya hunting grounds. In 1406 the Ming created the Tulutingshan Guard for local Jurchen and other mountain people, granting chieftains seals and tribute duties rather than planting a Chinese city. By 1444 Ming power had drawn back from the Amur; Solon Evenki hunters moved through these valleys with reindeer, and sable was the country's richest product.

The guard's people submitted to Hong Taiji in 1634, and his campaigns of 1639-1640 completed the conquest of the Solon country. Cossacks entered the Amur river system in 1643 and challenged the Qing hold on the sable tribute until the fall of Albazin and the Treaty of Nerchinsk in 1689. The Qing then organized Evenki clans into companies, requiring their able men to deliver sable pelts and serve on frontier patrols. Through the rest of the period the high taiga remained a hunting, tribute and border-patrol country rather than a land of towns.
zh:
土鲁亭山是托姆河以东图腊纳山脉的汉名，这条约三百公里的山岭覆盖着落叶松、冷杉和云杉泰加林，俯视结雅河与布列亚河一带的猎场。1406年，明朝设土鲁亭山卫，授予当地女真等族首领印信，令其统领部众、按时朝贡，并未在此兴建汉式城池。到1444年，明朝在黑龙江的实际力量已经后撤，索伦鄂温克猎人驱使驯鹿往来山谷，紫貂是这里最贵重的出产。

1634年，土鲁亭山卫部众归附皇太极；1639年至1640年，皇太极的军队又完成对索伦地区的征服。哥萨克1643年进入黑龙江水系，争夺紫貂贡赋，直到阿尔巴津被清军攻取、1689年《尼布楚条约》签订。清朝随后把鄂温克氏族编为佐领，规定壮丁交纳貂皮并承担巡边义务。此后直到1821年，这片高山泰加林始终是狩猎、贡貂和巡边之地，没有兴起城镇。

en:
Tunhe is the valley of the Tangwang, the Jin-dynasty Tun river, which gathers the streams of the Xiao Hinggan forests and runs south some five hundred li into the Songhua above Yilan. At its mouth stood the walled town of Punuli, one of the Five Nations of the raw Jurchen, on the Liao 'falcon road' that carried gyrfalcons and sable to the Khitan court; under the Jin the same town was the Tunhe moung-an, and under the Mongols the Taowen myriarchy, one of the five Jurchen myriarchies of the lower Sungari. Ming maps called the water the Tuowan and kept a loose-reign guard there, the Chengtaowen, with a post station on the river road to Nurkan. By the 1440s the guard had lapsed, the myriarchy's people had scattered into the Hurka and Odoli clans moving south, and only fishing and herding Jurchen stockades remained along the banks.

Through the wars that founded the Qing and for the rest of the period the valley was a closed hunting ground, its ginseng and sable a banner reserve. The old Taowen city dwindled to the fishing village of Boorha, no Qing garrison or magistrate was placed on the river, and the clans were touched by the state only through the yearly fur tribute. In 1821 the Tun still flowed through empty forest, without a walled town on its banks.
zh:
屯河即今汤旺河，金代正名屯河，又叫涛温水，汇小兴安岭群溪南流五百里，在今汤原汇入松花江。河口的双河古城，本是辽代生女真五国部之一盆奴里部的城寨，正当辽国索取海东青、貂皮的「鹰路」之上；金代在这里设屯河猛安，元代又置桃温军民万户府，为松花江下游五个女真万户府之一。明代河名改写作托温江，旧城设羁縻的成讨温卫，还是通往奴儿干的海西东水陆城道上的托温城站。到1444年前后，卫所名存实亡，万户府的部众也已离散，并入南迁的胡里改、斡朵里诸部，河谷两岸只剩打鱼放牧的女真木寨。

从明清易代的战事到此后百余年，这道河谷始终是封禁的猎场，山中的人参与貂皮都是旗内的采捕之利。桃温旧城退化成名叫布尔和噶珊的渔村，清廷不在河边设官驻兵，各部与官府之间只靠每年的貂贡相连。1821年时，屯河仍在空旷的林莽中流淌，河畔没有一座城。

en:
Edala takes its name from the Tala, the 'open field' river of the Manchu gazetteers, which runs through the wooded hill country southwest of Ningguta, between the Zhangguangcai ridges and the upper Mudan. In 1407 the Ming created the Dala River Guard for the Jurchen clans of this valley, one of the many jimi guards posted between the Sungari and the Eastern Sea. They raised millet in the river bottoms and hunted sable and ginseng in the surrounding woj, the great forests, bartering pelts at the border markets. In 1444 the clans belonged to the Haixi world: their chiefs held Ming patents, but their allegiance ran to the Hūlun confederation that had gathered on the middle Sungari since the early fifteenth century, the line from which Ula would spring.

When Buyan built Ula in 1561, his domains stretched east toward Korea and north toward the Mudan and Lake Khanka, and the Tala country was part of them. Ula's wars with Nurhaci settled the valley's fate: Bujantai was captured when the nine-tribe host raised by the Yehe broke in 1593, and after the second defeat at Wujieyan in 1607 Nurhaci led thirty thousand men against Ula in 1613, scattered its army and drove Bujantai to take refuge with the Yehe. The Tala valley passed to the Later Jin and then to the Qing. After the Ningguta military governor moved to Jilin in 1676, the old trail through these hills became a trunk post road: Tala Station in the valley above Tala Lake and Emuhesoluo farther west bound the two garrison towns together, while station farms grew grain for the banners. In 1821 the valley still held no settlement larger than a posting station.
zh:
答剌河在清代官书中改译为塔拉河，即满语地名中「旷野」之水，穿行在宁古塔西南、张广才岭与牡丹江上游之间的山林之间。1407年，明廷为这一河谷的女真各部设立答剌河卫，它是松花江与东海之间众多羁縻卫所中的一个。部众在河谷底部种黍，到四周「窝集」大森林中猎貂采参，再把皮张拿到边市上交易。1444年时，这里的部落属于海西世界：首领虽持有明朝颁给的敕书，实际听命的却是15世纪初以来在松花江中上游聚拢声势的扈伦联盟——日后乌拉国正出于这一系。

1561年布颜建乌拉国，疆域东抵朝鲜、北达牡丹江与兴凯湖，塔拉一带也在其幅员之内。乌拉与努尔哈赤的战争决定了这片河谷的命运：1593年叶赫纠合九部联军，古勒山一役大败，布占泰被俘；1607年乌碣岩再败之后，努尔哈赤于1613年亲率三万大军攻灭乌拉，击溃其军，布占泰率残部投奔叶赫。塔拉河谷归入后金，随后纳入清朝版图。1676年宁古塔将军移治吉林后，穿过这片山林的旧道成为驿路干线：塔拉泡上游沟谷中的塔拉站与西边的额穆赫索罗站，把两座驻防城连成一线，站丁的官庄在河谷里为八旗种植粮食。直到1821年，这条河谷里最大的聚落仍不过是几处驿站。

en:
Halacha, also recorded as Sahalcha, was the Manchu name for the black-sable country on the lower Zeya. In 1444 Guobule, Dedule and related Daur clans farmed the river lowlands and kept horses and cattle, while Solon Evenki hunters ranged through the adjoining taiga. Ming frontier rule worked through native headmen and tribute rather than a walled garrison; dark sable, grain and livestock gave this cold valley its importance.

The native Halacha Guard cannot be dated precisely: one later historical geography places it after the Zhengtong reign, while the Ming Veritable Records mentions it only in the Jiajing-Wanli decades. Hong Taiji's campaigns of 1639-1640 broke Bombogor's Evenki-Daur federation. Poyarkov reached the Zeya in 1643, and Khabarov's Cossacks appeared there in 1650 to demand tribute; the Daur farmers answered that they already paid the Shunzhi emperor. Their villages were destroyed in the raids, and between 1654 and 1656 the Qing moved the population south to the Nen River. The old lower-Zeya lands later served the Aigun campaigns against Albazin and remained a thinly held Qing frontier after 1689, without growing into a town.
zh:
哈剌察又作萨哈尔察，是满语中对精奇里江下游「黑貂」之地的称呼。1444年，郭布勒、德都勒等达斡尔氏族在河畔低地耕作，饲养马和牛；索伦鄂温克猎人则在相邻的泰加林中游猎。明朝的边疆统治通过当地首领和朝贡关系维系，并没有兴建城墙戍堡；黑貂皮、粮食和牲畜使这条寒冷河谷显得重要。

哈剌察卫的设置时间没有精确记载：后世的历史地理研究将其系于正统以后，《明实录》则只在嘉靖、万历年间提到它。1639年至1640年，皇太极的战争击垮博穆博果尔领导的鄂温克—达斡尔联盟。1643年波雅尔科夫抵达结雅河流域，哈巴罗夫的哥萨克又在1650年到来强征贡赋；达斡尔农人回答说，他们已经向顺治皇帝纳贡。村落在袭掠中被毁，1654年至1656年间，清朝将这些人口南迁到嫩江流域。精奇里江下游旧地后来服务于瑷珲对阿尔巴津的战事，1689年后仍是清朝控制稀疏的边疆，没有发展为城镇。

en:
Hurha denotes the forest country drained by the Muling River, between the Wanda Hills and the Ussuri lowlands north of Lake Khanka. In 1444 scattered Jurchen bands rather than walled towns occupied the land. The Ming organized the wider region through the nominal guards of the Nurgan system, while local headmen controlled hunting paths, ginseng grounds and the exchange of furs. Chinese writers placed these Ussuri peoples among the Wild Jurchens, and early Manchu records use names such as Hurha or Kurka for related eastern forest groups.

From 1596 to 1625 the rising Jianzhou leader Nurhaci sent repeated campaigns against the Wild Jurchens; defeated bands were moved south or enrolled under his banners, bringing the Ussuri country into Manchu power. After the Qing entered China, the dynasty treated the region as a reserved northern homeland and restricted ordinary settlement. Ningguta, west of the Muling, became the military center: Qing troops garrisoned it in 1652, and the Ningguta military governorship was created in 1662. Small parties in the Ussuri basin continued to clear land and gather ginseng, but in 1821 the Hurha country remained a thinly peopled forest frontier.
zh:
虎尔哈指穆棱河流域的林地区，其地在完达山与乌苏里江低地、兴凯湖以北一带。1444年，这里没有城郭，只有分散的女真群落。明朝以奴儿干都司下辖的羁縻卫所名义统辖广大地区，实际掌握猎道、参场和毛皮交易的是当地头人。汉文记载把乌苏里江诸部列入野人女真，清初满文文献则以虎尔哈、库尔喀等名称呼相近的东海森林部落。

1596年至1625年，崛起的建州首领努尔哈赤多次出兵征伐野人女真，被击败的部众或南迁，或编入旗籍，乌苏里江地区由此逐渐进入后金和清的势力范围。清朝入关后，将这里视为龙兴之地并限制普通移民。穆棱河以西的宁古塔成为军事中心：清军1652年驻防宁古塔，1662年改设宁古塔将军。乌苏里江流域仍有少量人丁垦荒、采参，但到1821年，虎尔哈一带依旧是人口稀少的森林边地。

en:
Oroqen covers the eastern woods of the Khingan, where the forested ridges fall away towards the Nonni and the Amur. In 1444 these taiga valleys were the country of Evenki-speaking hunters, while beyond the Amur, on the southern slopes of the Outer Khingan, roamed the bands the Manchus called Orochen, 'the people who keep reindeer'. They lived entirely by the chase and the reindeer herd, clothing themselves in fur and skin, honouring the spirits of forest and river after the old shaman manner.

When Cossacks came up the Amur in the mid-seventeenth century, the Orochen pulled south into the Greater and Lesser Khingan. The Qing gathered them, with the rest of the Solon peoples, into the Butha hunt-banners under the Heilongjiang general, and their horse-using and reindeer-using bands served the dynasty on its frontiers. When Yaksa fell in 1685, the Orochen who had lived beside the Cossacks were taken with the garrison and enrolled in the Qing banners as well.
zh:
鄂伦春一省是兴安岭东侧的林海，山林向嫩江与黑龙江方向缓缓低降。1444年，这片泰加林谷是讲鄂温克语的猎手之地；而在黑龙江以北、外兴安岭南坡，游走着被满洲人唤作「鄂伦春」的部众，这个名字意为「养驯鹿的人」。他们完全以狩猎和驯鹿为生，以毛皮为衣，崇奉山林与江河之灵，奉行古老的萨满仪式。

17世纪中叶哥萨克沿黑龙江而上，鄂伦春人南迁进入大、小兴安岭之间。清廷将他们与其余索伦诸部一并收束，编入黑龙江将军治下的布特哈渔猎八旗，使马与使鹿的部众为朝廷戍守边疆。1685年雅克萨城破时，曾与哥萨克比邻而居的鄂伦春人也随守军一同被俘，被收入八旗当差。

en:
West Buteha lies on the south-eastern skirt of the Greater Khingan, where the Yalu, Jiqin and Arun rivers gather and run east to the Nen through open woods that thin into Korchin pasture. Solon and Oroqen hunters took sable, elk and reindeer in the high forests while Mongol herdsmen held the grassy valleys below. In 1444 these streams were the western marches of the Korchin: there were no towns, only shamanist camps whose furs went downriver to barter with the steppe.

As elsewhere in Butha, the Solon clans here were subdued by Hong Taiji in 1640 and placed under the Butha commandant in 1689. When the Butha Eight Banners were formed in 1731, the Plain Blue and Bordered Red banners were stationed on the Yalu, and a jalan-janggin held his yamen at the camp that grew into Zhalantun. The next year 1,636 Solon soldiers with their families were levied from these companies for the new Hulunbuir garrison on the Barga steppe, guarding the frontier towards Russia. These valleys also raised Hailancha: born of a Dular-clan Solon family on the Arun in 1739, he rose from common trooper to first-class duke, fighting in the Dzungar, Burmese and Jinchuan wars, in Taiwan against Lin Shuangwen and in the Gurkha campaign of 1791–1792, and he died in 1793.
zh:
西布特哈处在大兴安岭东南麓，雅鲁河、济沁河、阿伦河在此汇流东去入嫩江，疏林渐次没入科尔沁草原。索伦和鄂伦春猎手在高处的林海中猎貂、捕鹿、使役驯鹿，蒙古牧人则据有下方的草甸。1444年，这些河谷是科尔沁的西陲：没有城镇，只有奉萨满的营地，毛皮顺河而下，与草原互通有无。

与布特哈其他地方一样，这里的索伦诸部1640年为皇太极所征服，1689年起归布特哈总管管辖。1731年编设布特哈八旗时，正蓝、镶红两旗同驻雅鲁河，扎兰章京的衙门就设在后来发展为扎兰屯的营地。次年，朝廷从这些佐领中征调一千六百三十六名索伦兵及家眷，移驻呼伦贝尔草原编为驻防八旗，把守通往俄罗斯方向的边地。这片河谷还走出了海兰察：他1739年生于阿伦河畔的索伦多拉尔氏，从马甲积功至一等超勇公，身经准噶尔、缅甸、大小金川、台湾林爽文与1791至1792年的廓尔喀诸役，1793年去世。

en:
Barag is the cold pasture country between the Onon and Ergune rivers and the western approaches to the Greater Khingan. The Barga people traced their older homeland to the Barguzin lands east of Lake Baikal. After the Yuan collapse in 1368 they joined the Oirats and became scattered among Mongol groups, with many clans moving toward the Ergune and Khingan. Thus in 1444 this province was not a bounded tribal territory but a frontier of seasonal camps, horse herds and mixed Mongol, Daur and Solon neighbours, touched by both Oirat and Genghisid power.

In 1594 a large body of Khori-Barga fled to the Onon, where they came under Russian protection, while other Barga entered the Khalkha orbit and became subjects of the Sechen Khan. Galdan's invasion of 1688 drove many south into Inner Mongolia; after the Qing victory of 1697, some went on into Manchuria and others returned with the Khalkha. Barga under Sechen rule defected to Russia in 1730-1732, but in 1732 the Qing conscripted 275 Barga from Manchuria into two Solon banners and moved them with their families to Hulun Buir as border troops; these became the Old Barga. Russia returned the defecting Barga in 1734, and the Qing settled them nearby as the New Barga, organized on the Solon banner model. Through 1821 their camps guarded the Qing-Russian steppe frontier.
zh:
巴尔虎是鄂嫩河、额尔古纳河与大兴安岭西麓之间的严寒牧场。巴尔虎人的更早故乡在贝加尔湖以东的巴尔古津地方。1368年元朝灭亡后，他们归附瓦剌并散处于蒙古诸部之中，不少部众后来迁到额尔古纳河与大兴安岭一带。因此1444年时，这里还不是边界固定的部落领地，而是一片随季节迁徙的营地世界，牧马成群，邻人中有蒙古人、达斡尔人和索伦人，瓦剌与成吉思汗后裔的势力都能触及这里。

1594年，大批霍里—巴尔虎人逃到鄂嫩河一带并接受俄国保护，另一些巴尔虎人则进入喀尔喀势力范围，成为车臣汗属民。1688年噶尔丹东侵，许多人南逃内蒙古；1697年清朝取胜后，一部分人继续进入满洲，另一部分随喀尔喀人北返。1730年至1732年，臣属车臣汗的巴尔虎人叛投俄国；1732年，清廷从满洲征调275名巴尔虎人编入索伦两旗，连同家眷迁往呼伦贝尔戍边，称为陈巴尔虎。1734年，俄国交还先前投俄的巴尔虎人，清廷将他们安置在附近，按索伦旗制编设，称为新巴尔虎。到1821年，这些营地一直承担着清朝与俄国草原边界的防卫。

en: Bayan-Uul, 'rich mountain', is grassland between the Onon and Kherlen river countries in eastern Mongolia. In 1444 Mongol herders moved seasonally with sheep, horses, cattle and gers, and the pastures belonged to the divided Northern Yuan world under the nominal authority of Taisun Khan. After Gersenji Khongtaiji died in 1549, his descendants built the Khalkha khanates, and this eastern pasture became part of the Setsen khan's domain. When Galdan invaded in 1688, the Setsen khan fled south and sought Qing protection; in 1691 he submitted to the Kangxi Emperor at Dolonnuur with the other Khalkha rulers. After the 1696 campaign against Galdan, the Setsen banners returned to the Kherlen pastures, leaving Bayan-Uul as remote livestock country under Qing banner administration.
zh: 「巴彦乌拉」意为富饶的山，其地是东部蒙古鄂嫩河与克鲁伦河之间的草原。1444年，蒙古牧民赶着羊群、马群、牛群和毡帐随季节移牧，这片牧场属于岱总汗脱脱不花名义统辖下却已分裂的北元世界。1549年格哷森札札赉尔死后，他的后裔形成喀尔喀诸汗部，这片东部牧场后来被纳入车臣汗的领地。1688年噶尔丹东侵，车臣汗南逃并寻求清朝保护；1691年，他与其他喀尔喀统治者在多伦诺尔向康熙帝归附。1696年征讨噶尔丹之后，车臣汗部各旗返回克鲁伦河流域游牧，巴彦乌拉在清朝盟旗体制下仍是偏远的畜牧之地。

en:
The lower Orkhon country lies where Mongolia's longest river leaves the Khangai, receives the Tamir and Tuul, and turns through wooded valleys toward the Selenge. Khar Balgas and Karakorum, old capitals of the Uyghur and Mongol empires, stood farther up this valley; in 1444 they were memories overshadowed by nomad camps. Herds grazed the river meadows, fishermen took pike, carp and taimen, and hunters brought furs from the northern woods. Toghtoa Bukha, the Taisun Khan, was nominal khagan of the Northern Yuan, while Esen, the Oirat taishi, held real power; the Orkhon camps were thus Mongol country in an age of Oirat ascendancy.

Later in the fifteenth century Dayan Khan reorganized the central Mongols into the Khalkha tümen, the shield of the northern frontier, and Gersenji's descendants divided the northern Khalkha otogs. Their houses fought the Oirats and held the river pastures until Galdan's invasion of 1688 drove the Khalkha under Qing protection. After the Qing counter-campaigns, banner government replaced the old independent lordships. In 1727 the Treaty of Kyakhta fixed the frontier to the north and opened the Kyakhta-Maimaicheng market; Siberian furs, leather and textiles moved south while tea, silk and porcelain went north, and state caravans gave way largely to barter after 1762. The eighteenth-century Khalkh Juram used the Orkhon as the outer limit of the hunting reserve around Ikh Khüree, showing how closely the river's game and pastures were regulated.
zh:
鄂尔浑下游一带，是蒙古最长河流离开杭爱山、汇合塔米尔河与土拉河后，穿过林木幽深的河谷折向色楞格河的地方。回鹘汗国的斡耳朵八里和蒙古帝国的哈拉和林等旧都都在这条河谷上方；到1444年，它们已成为游牧营地旁的历史记忆。牧民在河漫滩放牧，渔人捕捞狗鱼、鲤鱼和哲罗鱼，猎人则从北方林中带来毛皮。脱脱不花（岱总汗）是北元名义上的大汗，瓦剌太师也先掌握实权；因此鄂尔浑营地虽属蒙古之地，却处在瓦剌权势上升的时代。

15世纪后期，达延汗把中央蒙古诸部重组为喀尔喀万户，作为北方边境的屏障，格哷森札札赉尔的后裔分领外喀尔喀诸鄂托克。各贵族家族与瓦剌交战，保有河谷牧场，直到1688年噶尔丹入侵，喀尔喀投附清朝。清军反攻后，盟旗体制取代旧有独立领主。1727年，《恰克图界约》确定北方边界，并开辟恰克图—买卖城市场；西伯利亚毛皮、皮革和织物南来，茶叶、丝绸和瓷器北往，1762年后官营商队大体转为以货易货。18世纪的《喀尔喀法规》以鄂尔浑河作为大库伦周边禁猎地的外界，可见河谷猎物和牧场受到何等细密的管束。

en:
Sainshand lies in the dry desert-steppe of the eastern Gobi, around the grazing grounds known as Bayan Gobi and Khashaat Gobi. Groundwater, sparse saxaul thickets and seasonal wells supported horses, cattle, sheep, goats and Bactrian camels, not a walled market town. In 1444 the herdsmen belonged to the Mongol order of the Northern Yuan: Taisun Khan sat as Great Khan, while Esen Taishi and the Oirat lords held much of the real power behind the Borjigin throne.

After 1480 Dayan Khan reunited the Mongols and assigned Eastern Mongol pastures to Borjigin princes, with the Khalkha guarding the steppe's southern and eastern approaches. Galdan's Dzungar invasion shattered that order in 1688, when the Khalkha khans sought Qing protection; at the Dolon Nor assembly on 3 June 1691 they submitted to the Kangxi Emperor and their grazing lands were organized under Qing banners. Tibetan Buddhism then gave this stretch of the Gobi a permanent religious centre. In 1820 Dulduityn Danzanravjaa, the fifth Noyon Khutagt, founded Khamar Monastery near Sainshand as a Nyingma Red Hat centre.
zh:
赛音山达位于东戈壁干旱的荒漠草原，地处巴彦戈壁、哈沙图戈壁的牧场之间。地下水、稀疏的梭梭林和季节性井泉养育着马、牛、绵羊、山羊和双峰驼，却没有形成城墙环绕的市镇。1444年，这里的牧民处在北元蒙古秩序之下：岱总汗身为大汗，也先太师与瓦剌贵族则在博尔济吉特氏汗廷背后掌握着实权。

1480年后，达延汗重新统一蒙古，把东蒙古牧场分封给博尔济吉特王公，喀尔喀部负责防卫草原的东南边缘。1688年，噶尔丹率准噶尔入侵，打破这一格局，喀尔喀诸汗转而寻求清朝庇护；1691年6月3日，他们在多伦诺尔会盟向康熙帝臣服，牧场随后被纳入清朝盟旗体制。藏传佛教随后也在这片戈壁留下固定的宗教中心。1820年，第五世诺因呼图克图在赛音山达附近建立哈马尔寺，作为宁玛派红帽教法的中心。

en:
Urad is the grassland behind the Yellow River's northern bend, where the irrigated banks of the back loop give way to dry steppe at the foot of the Lang Shan. In 1444 the Ming kept no garrison and no office here; the pasture belonged to Mongols of the Northern Yuan, Tatar, Oirat and Uriankhai bands following their herds between the river and the edge of the Gobi. The tribe later named Urad, “the craftsmen”, claimed descent from Khasar, a brother of Genghis Khan, and in those years still grazed far to the north-east in Hulunbuir.

In 1633 the Urad chiefs Ombu, Tuba and Seleng submitted to Hong Taiji. In 1648 the Qing settled their followers in three jasak banners, the three lords ranked as dukes, and in 1649 the banners moved to the north bank of the loop and took their place in the Ulanqab League. At its present site from 1702, Mergen Monastery became the heart of the Mergen tradition, the one Mongolian Buddhist school that chanted its liturgy in Mongolian rather than Tibetan. A string of bitter disasters in the 1700s destroyed herds across the three banners; ruined families sold more than three hundred of their own people to buy grain.
zh:
乌拉特是黄河北套以北的草原，后套灌溉平原在狼山脚下过渡为干旱牧场。1444年，明朝在此不设卫所、不置官吏；牧场属于北元治下的蒙古人，鞑靼、瓦剌和兀良哈部众赶着畜群，往来于黄河与戈壁边缘之间。后来号为乌喇特（蒙古语意为「工匠」）的部落自称是成吉思汗之弟拙赤合撒儿的后裔，那时他们还远在东北方的呼伦贝尔游牧。

1633年，乌喇特首领鄂木布、图巴、色棱归附皇太极。1648年，清朝将其部众编为三个札萨克旗，三位首领封爵国公；1649年，三旗移牧黄河北岸，会盟于乌兰察布。1702年在今址建成的梅力更召，后来成为梅力更法系的中心——这是蒙古佛教中唯一以蒙古语而非藏语诵经的法脉。18世纪连遭重灾，三旗畜群大损，走投无路的人家为换取口粮，卖掉的亲人超过三百口。

en:
Kalgan, Qaγalγan in Mongolian, “the Gate”, is the Great Wall pass the Chinese call Zhangjiakou, where the road climbs from the Xuanhua basin on to the Mongolian plateau. In 1429 the commander Zhang Wen walled the fortress of Zhangjiakoubu, a strongpoint of the Xuanfu garrison, one of the Nine Garrisons, which in the Yongle reign held more than 150,000 troops. In 1444 its gates faced a reunited Mongol power under Taisun Khan and his taishi Esen. Five years later Esen destroyed the imperial army at nearby Tumu and led the Zhengtong Emperor away captive.

The wall kept growing: a northern gate was cut through the fort in 1529, and in 1545–46 the governor Weng Wanda added more than 230 kilometres of rampart along the Xuanfu frontier. Trade followed peace. When the Ming invested Altan Khan as Prince of Shunyi in 1571, a horse market opened outside the gate, where Mongol horses, cattle and furs changed hands for silk, tea and porcelain; in 1619 Ivan Petlin passed this way at the head of the first Russian mission to China. The Qing built the Dajingmen, the Great Gate, in the wall in 1644, and after the Kyakhta treaty of 1727 long camel trains carried tea from Kalgan across the Gobi to Khüree and Russia, making the gate one of the busiest inland markets on the Qing frontier.
zh:
哈喇罕，蒙古语 Qaγalγan，意为「大门」，就是长城脚下的张家口，宣府盆地的道路由此登上蒙古高原。1429年，指挥张文筑起张家口堡，隶属九边之一的宣府镇——永乐年间宣府驻军曾超过十五万。1444年，城门之外是岱总汗脱脱不花与太师也先重新整合起来的蒙古势力。五年后，也先在近旁的土木堡击溃五十万明军，俘走明英宗。

边墙此后不断增修：1529年，指挥张珍在堡墙北向开小门；1545至1546年，宣大总督翁万达沿宣府边外新筑长城四百六十余里。和平也随城门而至：1571年明朝封俺答汗为顺义王，门外开设马市，蒙古的马匹、牲畜、皮货在此交换丝绸、茶叶与瓷器；1619年，伊万·佩特林率领首支俄国使团经此前往中国。1644年，清朝在墙上建大境门；1727年《恰克图条约》签订后，长长的驼队从张家口载茶横穿戈壁，运往库伦和俄罗斯，使这道门成为清代北方最繁忙的内陆商埠之一。

en:
Josutu is the broken hill country of the western Liao, where the Mongol plateau descends toward the plains beyond the Shanhaiguan pass and the Xifengkou road runs on to Beijing. The Ming once guarded it from Daning and the old Liao town of Xingzhong, but after the garrisons were withdrawn the Doyin Uriankhai, southernmost of the Three Guards, made it their pasture and traded horses at the border markets. In 1444 their chiefs owned only loose allegiance to Taisun Khan and held the gateway between Ming frontier and steppe, at once herdsmen, raiders and go-betweens.

In the 16th century Kündülün, a grandson of Dayan Khan, pushed the Kharchin east from the upper Luan into Doyin country, and the two peoples merged under the Kharchin name. Ligdan Khan shattered them in 1628 at Zhao Cheng; the remnant led by Subudi submitted to Hong Taiji, and in 1629 the Eastern Tümed under Ombu Chokhur submitted too and were settled at Bayan Khoshuu, which became the seat of their Tümed Right Banner. The Qing enrolled them as banners from 1635 on—two Tümed and two Kharchin banners by 1648, with a third Kharchin added under Kangxi—and in 1702 fixed the assembly at Josutu in the Tümed Right Banner, which named the league; the princes sent their tribute to Beijing by the Xifengkou road. Chinese farmers pressed up the same road: the Tazigou hall was opened in 1738 and the Sanzuota hall in 1774, becoming Jianchang and Chaoyang counties in 1778, as ploughland crept over the Mongol pastures.
zh:
卓索图是辽西的丘陵地带，蒙古高原从这里俯冲向山海关外的平原，通往北京的喜峰口贡道由此经过。明朝曾以大宁、兴中屯守，卫所撤废后，兀良哈三卫中最靠南的朵颜卫以此为牧场，在边口互市马匹。1444年，其首领对脱脱不花汗只有松散的臣属，扼守在长城与草原之间，既是牧人、抄掠者，也是两边的居间人。

16世纪，达延汗之孙昆都力哈率喀喇沁从滦河上游东进朵颜故地，两部融合，皆称喀喇沁。1628年林丹汗在赵城大破其所属的永谢布万户，喀喇沁溃散，苏布地率余部归附皇太极；1629年，鄂木布楚琥尔率领的东土默特一支也来归附，被安置在巴彦和硕，后来这里成为土默特右翼旗的旗府。清廷自1635年起编设旗分，至1648年已有土默特、喀喇沁各两旗，康熙年间又增喀喇沁中旗，共五旗；1702年定四旗于卓索图会盟，其地属土默特右翼旗，盟以地名，诸旗贡道即出喜峰口。汉民也沿同一条路北上：1738年设塔子沟厅，1774年设三座塔厅，1778年两厅分别改设建昌县与朝阳县，农田一步步漫上蒙古牧场。

en:
The Ujimqin pastures lie in northeastern Xilin Gol. The Mongolian word üzem means grape, and Üzemchin means grape growers. In 1444, before the tribal name was fixed, herds of horses, cattle and sheep here moved with the camps of eastern Mongol lords who recognized Taisun Khan as Northern Yuan khan; there was no walled capital; power followed pasture rights and Borjigin nobility.

The name formed around the following of Ongon-Dural, son of Bodi Alagh Khan, when the group belonged to the Chahar tumen. Hard pressed by Ligdan Khan, Ongon-Dural's son Dorji, titled Setsen Jinong, led his people north to the Kherlen and sought shelter with Sholoi Setsen Khan. In 1637 Dorji and his nephew Sereng submitted to Hong Taiji. In 1638 both joined the Qing campaign against the Khalkha, and in 1641 Ujimqin envoys presented camels, horses and sable furs at court. The Qing organized right and left banners in 1641 and 1646, enfeoffing Dorji as a jasagh prince in 1642 and Sereng as a jasagh beile in 1646. A Ujimqin contingent served in the 1646 expedition against the Sönid chief Tenggis; the two banners then held their Xilin Gol pastures under Qing rule.
zh:
乌珠穆沁草原位于锡林郭勒东北部。「乌珠穆」意为葡萄，乌珠穆沁意为「种葡萄的人」。1444年，在这个部落名称固定以前，这里的马群、牛群和羊群随东部蒙古领主的营地迁徙，他们承认岱总汗脱脱不花为北元大汗；当地没有城墙环绕的都城，权力随牧场分配和博尔济吉特贵族而转移。

后来，博迪阿拉克汗之子翁衮都喇尔的部众称乌珠穆沁，该部属于察哈尔万户。翁衮都喇尔之子多尔济号车臣济农，因不堪林丹汗逼迫，率部北走克鲁伦河，投奔车臣汗硕垒。1637年，多尔济与侄子色棱归附皇太极。1638年，二人随清军出征喀尔喀；1641年，乌珠穆沁使者到朝廷进献驼马和貂皮。清朝于1641年和1646年把该部编为右翼、左翼札萨克旗，多尔济于1642年受封札萨克和硕亲王，色棱于1646年受封札萨克多罗贝勒。1646年，一支乌珠穆沁部队还参加了征讨苏尼特部首领腾机思的战事；此后两翼一直在清朝统辖下保有锡林郭勒牧场。

en:
The Khorchin are the descendants of Khasar, Genghis Khan's younger brother, and in early Ming times their pastures lay along the Onon and Argun rivers, east of the Khingan. The Erdeni-yin tobchi counts the Adai Khan, whom the eastern Mongols raised against the Oirat, as one of theirs; when Toghan taishi destroyed their patron in 1438 and Adai was hunted down at Ejene, the Khorchin camps withdrew southward. In 1444, with Esen now master of the steppe, the Qasarid clans held their flocks east of the Khingan without a khan of their own, the greatest of the Mongol princely houses still outside Oirat rule.

In 1491 the Khorchin joined Dayan Khan's wars to reunite the eastern Mongols, and in 1510 helped him crush the Uriankhai; Dayan Khan enrolled them as a tümen honoured with the style 'Abaga Khorchin'. Early in the Jiajing reign their chief Kümüngkei Tasqal led them from the Onon and Argun across the Khingan to the Nen, absorbing the Jalayid, Dorbod and Gorlos and subduing the Sibe, and the Nun Khorchin became the strongest Mongol power beyond the Liao frontier. They rode with the Hūlun confederation against Nurhaci and were broken at Gule Mountain in 1593 and again in 1608, then sought his friendship. In 1624 their chief Ooba, pressed by Ligdan Khan of the Chahar, led the Khorchin over to Nurhaci, the first Mongol tribe to submit. Marriage sealed the bond: in 1614 the lady Jerjer, daughter of Manggusi, married Hong Taiji, and in 1625 her niece Bumbutai followed her — the future Empress Xiaozhuang, who guided the young Kangxi emperor. In 1636 the Khorchin were formed into five banners, and from 1710 their princes met the allied Jalayid, Dorbod and Gorlos in assembly at Mount Jirim, which gave the Jirim league its name.
zh:
科尔沁是成吉思汗之弟拙赤合撒儿的后裔，明初牧地在鄂嫩河、额尔古纳河流域，游牧于大兴安岭东西。据《蒙古源流》记载，东蒙古拥立的阿台汗就出自科尔沁；1434年太师阿鲁台败死后，阿台西逃亦集乃，1438年被瓦剌太师脱欢俘杀，部众被迫南徙。1444年也先雄霸草原，合撒儿的后裔们在大兴安岭以东保有部落和畜群而无共主，是瓦剌体系之外最强的蒙古宗支。

1491年，科尔沁参加达延汗统一东蒙古的战争，1510年助其击溃兀良哈，被编为一个万户，尊为「阿巴噶科尔沁」。嘉靖初年，首领奎蒙克塔斯哈喇率部从鄂嫩、额尔古纳河流域翻过大兴安岭迁至嫩江，收服扎赉特、杜尔伯特、郭尔罗斯诸部并役属锡伯人，号称嫩科尔沁，成为辽东边外最强的蒙古势力。他们随海西扈伦联盟攻打努尔哈赤，1593年在古勒山战败，1608年再败，此后转而与建州通好。1624年，首领奥巴因与察哈尔林丹汗失和，率部投奔努尔哈赤，是最早归附后金的蒙古部落。联姻随即开始：1614年莽古斯之女哲哲嫁与皇太极，1625年其侄女布木布泰再嫁，即日后辅佐少年康熙的孝庄文皇后。1636年科尔沁部编设五旗，1710年起与扎赉特、杜尔伯特、郭尔罗斯诸旗会盟于哲里木山，哲里木盟由此得名。

en:
Bayisingtu lies on the south-eastern edge of the Khorchin steppe, where the grassland meets the Ming frontier above Shenyang and the Yehe country. Its name means 'the place of houses': a bayising was a Chinese-style mud-walled, plank-built farmhouse, the kind that began to dot Mongol pastures wherever settlers crossed the border to plough. In 1444 there were only herds here, for the Fuyu Guard Mongols who traced their line to Khasar grazed the land after Adai Khan's fall—ancestors of the Nen Khorchin's left wing.

These were among the first Mongols to make terms with the rising Manchus, when their chief Oba submitted to Nurhaci in 1624, and the left-wing Khorchin became the Qing court's closest in-laws, its princesses marrying into the Aisin Gioro generation after generation. The banners kept their old pastures, but in 1802 the Khorchin Left Wing Rear Banner opened land at Tsantu Ereg, the 'frost-covered cliff', to Chinese farmers; so many came that in 1806 the Qing created Changtu Subprefecture, the first Chinese administration seated inside Khorchin pasture. As bayising multiplied across the ploughed steppe, Bayisingtu at last lived up to its name.
zh:
板申图在科尔沁草原的东南缘，草原在此接上沈阳以北、叶赫一带的辽东边墙。其名蒙古语意为「有房舍之地」——板申（板升）是蒙古人对汉人式土墙板筑房屋的称呼，只要汉民出边垦种，这类房舍便会在牧场边出现。1444年这里还只有牧群：福余卫蒙古人、合撒儿的后裔在阿台汗败亡后游牧于此，他们正是嫩科尔沁左翼的先祖。

这一支是最早与崛起的满洲人讲和的蒙古人之一，1624年首领奥巴归附努尔哈赤；科尔沁左翼也成为清朝最亲密的姻亲，蒙古格格一代接一代嫁入爱新觉罗家。旗人们保住了旧牧地，但到1802年，科尔沁左翼后旗在「常突额尔克」（意为挂霜的悬崖）招汉民放垦；来者之多，使清廷于1806年设立昌图厅，这是科尔沁牧地内第一个汉人行政机构。随着板申在开垦的草原上成片出现，板申图终于名副其实。

en:
The Badain Jaran is the great sand sea of the Alxa plateau, forty-nine thousand square kilometres of desert between the Gansu corridor and the road to Outer Mongolia, the third largest desert in China. Its dunes rise in places more than five hundred metres, the tallest fixed sand mountains on earth, while over a hundred spring-fed lakes, fresh and brine, lie in the hollows between them; the Ruo Shui, the 'weak water', cuts across the desert and spreads into an alluvial plain before reaching Juyan. Herders knew the lake pastures and the singing sand, but the desert heart held no towns, and the only road of note skirted its western edge past the black city of Khara-Khoto. When Ming forces took that city in 1372 and fell back behind the Jiayu Pass, the Badain Jaran and its wells were left to the nomads. In 1444 they are Oirat Mongols, of Esen's confederation.

After Esen's wars Oirat power ebbed westward, and for two centuries the desert was little more than a grazing march between the Gansu wall and the steppe khanates. In the 1670s the fugitive Khoshut prince Khoroli led his followers onto the Alxa pastures, and the banner the Qing created for them in 1697 made the Badain Jaran, with its scattered lake camps, Alxa Mongol country. The faith followed the banner: in 1755 a Geluk monastery was built on a lake deep in the dunes, the Badain Jaran temple at Sumin Jaran, subject to the Yanfu temple at Dingyuanying, where lamas chanted for herders whose other visitors were mostly passing caravans.
zh:
巴丹吉林是阿拉善高原上的大沙海，夹在河西走廊与漠北通道之间，广约四万九千平方公里，为中国第三大沙漠。沙山有的高达五百余米，是世界最高的固定沙丘；百余处泉水汇成的湖泊咸淡不一，散落在沙山坳里；弱水（额济纳河）横穿沙漠，在注入居延海前冲积出一片平原。牧人熟悉湖畔草场和会鸣响的沙山，但沙漠腹地没有城镇，唯一像样的道路沿西缘经过黑水城。1372年明军拿下黑水城、退回嘉峪关之后，巴丹吉林连同各处水井便留给了游牧人。1444年，在这里游牧的是瓦剌蒙古人，属于也先的联盟。

也先的战乱之后瓦剌势力西退，此后两百年间，这片沙漠不过是甘肃边墙与草原汗国之间的游牧地。1670年代，避乱西来的和啰理率和硕特部众进入阿拉善草场，清朝于1697年为其编设阿拉善旗，散布着湖畔营地的巴丹吉林由此成为阿拉善蒙古人的地方。信仰随旗帜而至：1755年，沙漠深处的湖畔建起一座格鲁派寺院——苏敏吉林的巴丹吉林庙，隶属定远营延福寺，喇嘛在此为牧人诵经；除此之外，沙海里难得的来客大多只是过路商队。

en:
Noyon covers a water-scarce stretch of the South Gobi, where stone desert and sparse wells favoured mobile herds of Bactrian camels, horses, sheep and goats over a permanent town. In 1444 these grazing grounds stood on the Oirat side of the Mongol world: Esen Taishi was the confederation's de facto ruler, while Taisun Khan held the Borjigin title of Great Khan and lent Chinggisid legitimacy to the Oirat war machine.

Five years later Esen's cavalry invaded Ming China and captured the Zhengtong Emperor at Tumu in 1449, but Esen's own seizure of the khan title ended in his death and the decline of Oirat power. Khalkha lords subsequently drew the South Gobi pastures into their order. Tümenkhen Sain Noyon, a patron of the Gelug school who lived from 1558 to 1640, supplied the name later used by the Qing administration. After Galdan's invasion of 1688, the Qing created Sain Noyon Aimag in 1725; Mongolian banner records place the future Noyon grazing lands in its southern Beile banner. Through the eighteenth century they remained camel-breeding pasture governed through the Qing banner system rather than a settled town.
zh:
瑙云位于南戈壁缺水地带，石质荒漠和稀疏井泉更适合驼、马、绵羊、山羊逐水草移动，而不是形成固定城镇。1444年，这片牧场处于蒙古世界的瓦剌一侧：也先太师是联盟的实际统治者，岱总汗则保有博尔济吉特氏大汗的名号，为瓦剌的军力提供黄金家族的合法性。

五年后，也先的骑兵入侵明朝，在1449年的土木之变中俘走明英宗；但他自称汗王后败亡，瓦剌霸权也随之衰落。南戈壁牧场此后逐渐纳入喀尔喀贵族的秩序。护持格鲁派的图蒙肯（1558—1640）称赛音诺颜，这一名号后来为清代行政建制所沿用。1688年噶尔丹入侵后，清朝于1725年设赛音诺颜部；蒙古文旗分记载把后来的瑙云牧场列入其南部贝勒旗。整个18世纪，这里仍是清朝盟旗体制下以养驼为主的牧场，而非定居城镇。

en:
This is the Orkhon valley, the sacred heart of the Mongol steppe, where the old Türkh khans had ruled from Ötüken and the Uyghur khans from Karabalgasun. Genghis Khan founded Karakorum here in 1220, and Ögedei walled it in 1235 and raised the Palace of Myriad Peace with the famous Silver Tree fountain; William of Rubruck found four walled gates, mosques, churches and pagan temples when he came in 1254. After Kublai moved the court to Dadu the city shrank to a provincial centre, and Ming troops burned its walls in 1372 and sacked it again in 1380. In 1444 the walls and palace were largely ruins among good pasture, and the grazing grounds around them belonged to the Four Oirats, whose taishis ruled while the Chinggisid khan reigned in name; the herders were Mongols of the rising Khalkha, who still worshipped the eternal blue sky.

Early in the sixteenth century Dayan Khan reunited the Mongol tribes and once more made Karakorum a khan's seat, but after his wars the old city was abandoned for good. In 1585 Abtai Sain Khan of the Khalkha, newly converted to the Gelug teaching after meeting the Third Dalai Lama, built the Erdene Zuu monastery out of Karakorum's carved stones, the first great Buddhist monastery in Mongolia. Galdan's Dzungars damaged it in 1688 when they overran the Khalkha lands, and in 1691 the Khalkha khans submitted to the Kangxi Emperor at Dolon Nor, bringing the Orkhon pastures into the Qing empire. In 1821 the valley was quiet Khalkha grazing country, its flocks moving between the monastery walls and the ruins of the once-great capital.
zh:
这里是鄂尔浑河谷，蒙古草原的圣地：突厥可汗曾以于都斤为号令之所，回鹘可汗的都城斡耳朵八里也在近处。成吉思汗1220年在此营建哈拉和林，1235年窝阔台筑起城墙、建成万安宫，宫中矗立着著名的银树喷泉；1254年鲁不鲁乞到此，看到城门四开、清真寺、基督教堂与异教庙宇并存。忽必烈迁都大都后，和林降为漠北的一方重镇，1372年明军北伐烧毁城墙，1380年再遭兵燹。1444年的和林，城墙宫殿大半已成废墟，散落在水草丰美的牧场上；周围牧场归四卫拉特所有——异密专权、黄金家族的汗徒拥虚名，牧人则是正在兴起的喀尔喀蒙古人，依旧信奉着永恒的苍天。

16世纪初，达延汗重新统一蒙古诸部，再度以哈拉和林为汗庭，但他身后的征战使这座古城被永久放弃。1585年，喀尔喀的阿巴岱赛音汗在谒见三世达赖喇嘛、皈依格鲁派之后，用和林废墟上凿好的石料建成光显寺——蒙古第一座大佛寺。1688年噶尔丹的准噶尔军席卷喀尔喀，寺院在战火中受损；1691年，喀尔喀诸汗在多伦诺尔归附康熙帝，鄂尔浑牧场就此纳入清帝国。1821年的河谷已是安宁的喀尔喀牧区，畜群在寺院围墙与昔日帝都的残垣之间往返。

en:
Lake Khövsgöl lies cupped in the mountains of northern Mongolia, its cold waters draining through the Eg river to the Selenga, and around it stretch some of the richest sable forests of the Siberian taiga. The Mongols called its hunting bands Uriankhai, 'the people living in the woods'. Jochi enrolled them in the Mongol empire in 1207, and after the Yuan collapse the country passed to the Oirats. In 1444 it was Oirat borderland, ruled through subject lords: thin camps of Tengri-worshipping hunters and herders, prized chiefly for the furs sent south along the steppe roads.

Khotogoid Khalkhas moved into the district in the 16th century, and around 1609 their prince Ubasi Khong Tayiji took the title Altan Khan. His khanate, centred on these lands, subdued the Yenisei Kirghiz and drove the Oirats westward, and his envoys made contact with the Russian forts rising in Siberia, where Krasnoyarsk was founded in 1628. The khanate disintegrated in wars with the Zasagtu khans. After the Khalkhas submitted to the Kangxi emperor at Dolon Nor in 1691, the Khotogoids were registered in 1694 as a banner of the Zasagtu Khan aimag, and the 1727 Treaty of Kiakhta drew the Russian boundary along the Sayan ranges north of the lake. In 1756 the Khotogoid prince Chingünjav raised the great anti-Qing revolt of Outer Mongolia; he was defeated and died in 1757, his banner was split into five, and the Qing organized the Uriankhai of the lakeshore as the separate Khövsgöl banner.
zh:
库苏古尔湖静卧在蒙古北部的群山之间，湖水寒冽，经额金河注入色楞格河；湖周绵延着西伯利亚泰加林中最丰饶的貂鼠林海。蒙古人把在林中狩猎的各部称作乌梁海，意为「林木中的百姓」。1207年术赤将他们收入蒙古帝国，元亡之后这片地方转归瓦剌。1444年，这里是瓦剌人通过附庸领主控制的边地：稀疏散布着崇拜长生天的猎户与牧人营地，其价值主要在于沿草原商路南运的毛皮。

16世纪，和托辉特部喀尔喀人迁入这一地区。约1609年，其首领乌巴什珲台吉称阿勒坦汗，以这一带为中心建立汗国，征服叶尼塞吉尔吉斯，把瓦剌逐向西方，还向1628年建成克拉斯诺亚尔斯克堡后不断推进的俄国据点遣使往来。汗国在与扎萨克图汗的战争中瓦解。1691年喀尔喀在多伦诺尔归附康熙皇帝，和托辉特于1694年被编为扎萨克图汗部的一旗；1727年《恰克图条约》沿湖北的萨彦岭划定了与俄国的边界。1756年，和托辉特王公青衮杂卜发动外蒙古反清大起义（撤驿之变），1757年败死，他的旗被分为五旗；清廷又将湖边的乌梁海人单编为库苏古尔旗。

en:
Zakhchin is the arid pasture country on the southeastern side of the Khovd borderlands, where Gobi steppe rises toward the Altai ranges around the later grazing grounds of Mankhan, Zereg and Uyench. In 1444 the Zakhchin name did not yet exist; these lands were part of Esen Taishi's Oirat confederation. Herders kept horses, cattle, sheep and camels on the dry continental pastures, followed the Tengri cult, and lived between Oirat power in the west and Khalkha princes in the east.

The Zakhchin, meaning 'frontiersmen', took shape from Oirat border guards serving the Dzungar Khanate. In 1754, during the Dzungar collapse, their zaisan Mamuut submitted to the Qing and was placed over his people and attached Baochin companies; he was later killed by Amursana. The Qing granted pastures around Zereg and Shar Khulsan in 1756 and gave the Zakhchin banner its seal in 1761. War and migration scattered much of the tribe, and in 1777 the remaining nine companies of more than 400 households were reorganized into four companies under the Kobdo councilor. A separate hereditary company became the Zakhchin duke banner in 1800, so by 1821 the old border guards were divided between two Qing banners.
zh:
扎哈沁是科布多边地东南侧的干旱牧场，戈壁草原向阿尔泰山抬升，后世的曼汗、泽雷格、乌音奇等牧地都在这一带。1444年，「扎哈沁」一名尚未出现，这片土地属于也先太师的瓦剌联盟。牧民在干燥的大陆性草原上牧放马、牛、羊和骆驼，信奉腾格里，身处西蒙古瓦剌与东方喀尔喀贵族之间。

扎哈沁意为「守边者」，由为准噶尔汗国戍守边境的卫拉特各部人众融合而成。1754年准噶尔崩溃之际，宰桑玛木特归附清朝，被授为总管并兼领包沁部众，后来死于阿睦尔撒纳之手。1756年，清朝把哲尔格、西喇呼鲁苏一带赐作牧地；1761年颁给总管旗印，正式设立扎哈沁旗。战乱和迁徙使部众大为离散，1777年残存的九佐领、四百余户被改编为四佐领，归科布多参赞大臣管辖。玛木特后裔的一个世袭佐领1800年扩为扎哈沁公旗；到1821年，旧日守边者的后裔已分属清朝的两个扎哈沁旗。

en:
The high pastures between the Mongol Altai and the Khovd River are the old country of the Oirats, the western Mongols whom the Secret History calls 'forest people'. After the Yuan withdrawal the Four Oirats grazed these valleys, and in 1444 they formed the confederacy led by Esen Taishi, who ruled through the puppet khan Taisun; sheep, horse and cattle herds moved between summer and winter pastures under the old sky-worship.

Esen's cavalry captured the Zhengtong Emperor of the Ming at Tumu in 1449, but after he claimed the title of khan he was killed in 1455, and the Oirats drew back west before the Khalkha. By the early 1600s the Khalkha Altan Khan, Ubasi Khong Tayiji, levied tribute from them; in 1623 the Oirats killed him in battle on the Irtysh and regained their freedom. The Dzungars who succeeded them made these mountains a wall of their khanate, and after Galdan's ruin at Jao Modo in 1696 he roamed the Khovd country with a few hundred followers until his death in 1697. When Qing armies destroyed the Dzungars in 1755–1758, smallpox and war emptied the valleys; Qing officials at Khovd ruled the survivors through Uriankhai banners, and by the late 1700s Kazakh herders were beginning to graze the abandoned pastures.
zh:
蒙古阿尔泰山与科布多河之间的高山牧场，是西蒙古瓦剌人的故土，《蒙古秘史》称他们为「林木中百姓」。元朝退回草原后，四卫拉特在这些山谷游牧。1444年，他们正处在也先太师的联盟之下，也先以岱总汗为名义上的共主发号施令，牛羊马群随季节转场，崇奉古老的腾格里。

1449年，也先的骑兵在土木堡俘虏明英宗；他自称可汗后于1455年被杀，瓦剌势衰，在喀尔喀的压力下向西退缩。17世纪初，喀尔喀的阿勒坦汗乌巴什珲台吉向他们征取贡赋；1623年，瓦剌人在额尔齐斯河畔击杀乌巴什，重获独立。继之而起的准噶尔人以这片群山为汗国屏障。1696年噶尔丹昭莫多兵败后，带着数百残部流徙于科布多一带，1697年死去。1755—1758年清军攻灭准噶尔，天花与战乱使山谷为之一空，科布多的清廷官员通过乌梁海旗佐治理遗民；到18世纪末，哈萨克牧民开始进入这些被遗弃的牧场。

en:
Monkhkhairkhan takes its name from the snowy sacred mountain of the Mongol Altai, whose glaciers feed the Bulgan, Senkher, Uyench and Bodonch rivers. In 1444 the high pastures and valleys were held by Esen Taishi's Oirats. Herders moved horses, cattle, sheep and camels below the snow line and through the mountain passes, while scattered camps followed the Tengri cult and made this a frontier pasture land without a permanent town.

After the Uriankhai tumen was defeated in 1538, one branch moved west into the Altai and later became subject to the Choros rulers of Dzungaria. Qing campaigns reached the mountain in 1754, when the Altai Uriankhai were organized into seven banners. After Chingünjav's revolt of 1756 the Qing placed the banners under Uriankhai zaisans led by Chadag; in 1759 they were assigned pastures on both sides of the Altai ranges, and in 1762 the seven banners were divided into two wings under the Kobdo administration. Monkhkhairkhan's camps and herds were thus enclosed within the Qing military-banner frontier.
zh:
蒙赫海尔汗因蒙古阿尔泰山中积雪覆盖的圣山得名，山中冰川融水汇成布尔根等河流。1444年，高山牧场与河谷属于也先太师的瓦剌。牧民在雪线以下和山口之间转场马、牛、羊、骆驼，分散的营地信奉腾格里，使这里成为没有常设城镇的瓦剌前沿牧场。

1538年兀良哈万户被击破后，一支乌梁海人西迁阿尔泰，后来臣属于准噶尔的绰罗斯统治者。1754年清军进入阿尔泰，将阿尔泰乌梁海编为七旗。1756年青衮咱卜反清后，清朝改由宰桑察达克等乌梁海首领统辖七旗；1759年将他们安置在阿尔泰山前后的牧地，1762年把七旗分为左右两翼，归科布多参赞大臣管辖。蒙赫海尔汗的营地和畜群由此纳入清朝边地旗佐的军事秩序。

en:
Altay is the high-pasture country below the Altai Mountains, where the Kelan River and upper Irtysh descend through forest and grassland. The Oirats, Mongolian forest people whose confederation grew up around these mountains, grazed horses, sheep and cattle in the valleys and hunted in the northern woods. During the fifteenth century their power centered on the Altai and the steppes west of Hami; in 1444, as Esen built the Oirat confederation into the dominant force among the western Mongols, these uplands were Oirat pasture and meeting ground rather than a land of walled towns.

After Esen's fall the Altai pastures remained within the western Mongol world, and in 1569 they were held by the Dörbet Oirats. Later the Altai Uriankhai who lived there became subjects of the Dzungars. They submitted to the Qing in 1754 and were organized into seven banners; Chadak, one of their zaisang chiefs, was placed over them the following year. In 1759 the court fixed their grazing grounds between the southern Altai and the upper Irtysh, and in 1763 it divided the banners into left and right wings. Kazakh herders also began moving into the high pastures in the years after Qianlong's reign, giving the frontier around Altay a mixed pastoral order.
zh:
阿尔泰是阿尔泰山南麓的高原牧地，克兰河与额尔齐斯河上游穿过森林和草原而下。卫拉特人本是在这一带山林间兴起的蒙古「林中百姓」，在山谷中牧放马、牛、羊，也在北方森林中狩猎。15世纪，卫拉特势力以阿尔泰山和哈密以西草原为中心；1444年，也先正把卫拉特联盟建设成西蒙古最强大的势力，这些山地是牧地和各部会合之地，而不是城墙城镇林立之邦。

也先败亡后，阿尔泰牧地仍属西蒙古世界，1569年成为卫拉特杜尔伯特部的游牧地。后来，居于此地的阿尔泰乌梁海臣属于准噶尔。1754年，他们归附清朝，被编为阿尔泰乌梁海七旗；次年，宰桑察达克受命统领该部。1759年，清朝划定阿尔泰山以南、额尔齐斯河以北为其牧地；1763年又将七旗分为左右两翼。乾隆以后，哈萨克牧民也陆续迁入高山牧场，使阿尔泰边地形成多族共处的游牧秩序。

en:
Below the northern foot of the Saur Mountains, where the grasslands run down to the Black Irtysh and the Zaysan basin, lay a pasture of the Four Oirats. Kereyid and Naiman herdsmen had ranged here before the Mongols, and after Genghis Khan's conquest of the Naiman in 1204 the land fell to the house of Ögedei; under the Ming it was the western Mongols' grazing ground. In 1444 Oirat camps moved along the river with their herds and took fish from the Irtysh waters.

The Oirats' war with their Khalkha overlord ended in 1623 on the Irtysh, when Ubasi Khong Tayiji, the Altan Khan, was killed and the Four Oirats declared themselves free. Under Erdeni Batur the Dzungars made the upper Irtysh a khuntaiji's camp ground, and in the 1640s and 1650s they drove the Kazakhs west beyond Lake Balkhash. As the Russians pushed a fortified line up the river, Dzungar cavalry surrounded and wiped out a 3,000-strong Russian force at Lake Yamysh in 1716, yet in 1720 Likharev's expedition reached Lake Zaysan and laid the Ust-Kamennaya fort, southern anchor of the Irtysh line. The Qing conquest of 1755–1758 emptied the Dzungar pastures; from 1762 the Ili general governed them through his councilor at Tarbagatai, and Kazakh herdsmen gradually moved into the vacant grasslands.
zh:
萨吾尔山北麓的草原向下延展至黑额尔齐斯河与斋桑盆地，这里曾是四卫拉特的牧地。蒙古兴起之前，克烈、乃蛮牧民在此游牧；1204年成吉思汗攻灭乃蛮后，此地封给窝阔台一系，明代则成为西蒙古瓦剌的游牧之地。1444年，瓦剌营地赶着牲畜沿河转场，并在额尔齐斯河上捕鱼为生。

瓦剌人与宗主喀尔喀的战争于1623年打到额尔齐斯河畔：阿勒坦汗乌巴什珲台吉兵败被杀，四卫拉特宣告独立。巴图尔珲台吉时代，准噶尔人把额尔齐斯河上游作为珲台吉的驻帐之地，并在1640至1650年代把哈萨克人逐到巴尔喀什湖以西。俄国人沿额尔齐斯河向上游推进堡垒线，1716年准噶尔骑兵在雅梅什湖包围并歼灭三千俄军；但1720年利哈列夫的远征队仍抵达斋桑湖，建起乌斯季卡缅要塞，成为额尔齐斯堡垒线南端的支点。1755—1758年清朝平定准噶尔，牧地为之一空；1762年起设伊犁将军，由塔尔巴哈台参赞大臣管辖此地，哈萨克牧民随后逐渐进入空旷的草场。

en:
Karagandy means the place of karagana, the yellow-flowered caragana shrub that covers wide stretches of this dry steppe. Its pastures lie in the Sary-Arka, or Kazakh Uplands, among low granite hummocks; the Nura and its Sherubainura tributary carry the spring freshets, while 60 kilometres to the south the 40-kilometre Bugyly range rises to 1,187 metres at Burkit. In 1444 Sunni Argyn clans, later counted in the Kazakh Middle Jüz, pastured sheep and horses and traded wool here under the loose rule of Abu'l-Khayr Khan's Uzbek ulus, far from the market towns of the Syr Darya.

After Abu'l-Khayr died in 1468 his ulus fragmented, and the Karagandy clans passed into the Kazakh confederation led by Kerei and Janibek. In the eighteenth century the Sary-Arka stood on the Dzungar war path. The invasion of 1723 opened the Years of the Great Disaster, when auls abandoned their winter camps and livestock, and the united Kazakh militia defeated the Dzungars at Bulanty in 1726. The Middle Jüz accepted Russian suzerainty in 1740. Abylai was captured during the next year's invasion and held at Galdan Tseren's headquarters until 1743; he was elected khan of the three jüzes at Turkestan in 1771 and died in 1781.
zh:
卡拉干达意为「长着锦鸡儿的地方」，这片干旱草原上遍生开黄花的锦鸡儿灌丛。牧地位于萨雷阿尔卡，即哈萨克丘陵的低矮花岗岩残丘之间；努拉河及其支流收纳春汛，以南约60公里处，长40公里的布格利山横亘草原，主峰布尔克特海拔1187米。1444年，后来被归入哈萨克中玉兹的阿尔浑诸部在此放牧绵羊和马匹、买卖羊毛；这些逊尼派牧户受阿布勒海尔汗的乌兹别克兀鲁思松散统辖，远离锡尔河畔的城镇。

阿布勒海尔1468年去世后，兀鲁思解体，卡拉干达一带的氏族归入克烈与贾尼别克领导的哈萨克联盟。18世纪，萨雷阿尔卡正处在准噶尔军队进出的路上。1723年的入侵开启「大灾难年代」，诸部纷纷抛下冬营和牲畜，三玉兹联军1726年在布兰泰击败准噶尔人。中玉兹1740年接受俄国宗主权。次年，阿布莱在新的入侵中被俘，关押在噶尔丹策零的营地，1743年才获释；1771年他在突厥斯坦被三玉兹推举为汗，1781年去世。

en:
There was no town of Ekibastuz in 1444. The province was a dry, closed basin southwest of the Irtysh, studded with salt lakes such as Atygay and Karasor. Kazakh herdsmen, later counted among the Middle Jüz, pastured sheep, horses and camels between the lakes, while the salt crusts gave the country value beyond grazing; the place name means 'two heads of salt'. At the opening date these seasonal camps formed part of Abu'l-Khayr's Uzbek confederation, and their people were Kazakh-speaking Sunni Muslims.

Abu'l-Khayr's death during his 1468 campaign opened the steppe to the Kazakh khanate led by Kerei and Janibek. When Russia advanced down the Irtysh, salt followed the flag: in 1720 the Koryakovsky outpost of the Irtysh line was built beside stores of Koryakov salt, initially with forty-eight men and two guns, and later with a customs post. The Dzungar invasion of 1739-1741 was already underway when the Middle Jüz khan accepted Russian subjecthood in 1740. By the early nineteenth century, Russian suzerainty and Irtysh garrisons framed the region, but the Ekibastuz basin remained Kazakh pasture and salt ground.
zh:
1444年还没有埃基巴斯图兹城。这片地区是额尔齐斯河西南一个封闭干旱盆地，散布着阿特盖、卡拉索尔等咸水湖。后来被归入中玉兹的哈萨克牧民在湖间放牧羊、马和骆驼，盐层则让这片土地拥有牧场之外的价值；地名含义为「两个盐头」。开局时，这些季节性营地属于阿布勒海尔的乌兹别克联盟，居民是说哈萨克语的逊尼派穆斯林。

阿布勒海尔1468年死于出征途中，为克列汗与贾尼别克领导的哈萨克汗国打开草原。俄国沿额尔齐斯河推进时，盐也随之招来了军旗：1720年，额尔齐斯防线的科里亚科夫前哨在科里亚科夫盐仓附近设立，最初驻有48名士兵和2门炮，后来又设置海关。1739—1741年的准噶尔战争已经爆发时，中玉兹汗于1740年接受俄国臣属。到19世纪初，俄国宗主权和额尔齐斯河驻军已框定这片地区的格局，但埃基巴斯图兹盆地仍是哈萨克人的牧场和取盐地。

en:
This stretch of the middle Irtysh, where the small Usolka joins the river among salt lakes, was known to Arab and Persian geographers as the country of Imakia, a town counted among the centres of the Kimek Khaganate in the ninth to eleventh centuries. That city had long vanished by 1444, when Turkic nomads pastured sheep and horses along the lakes under the loose overlordship of the Oirat confederation, moving camps between the steppe and the river crossings.

In 1720, as Russia pushed its Irtysh Line of forts south against Dzungar raids, a Cossack outpost named Koryakovsky was raised at the mouth of the Usolka. Salt works opened beside it in 1747, and salt from the lakes, carried down the Irtysh under convoy, became the post's living. Through the rest of the eighteenth century Koryakovsky remained a small way-station of the upper Irtysh, living by its salt traffic as the fortified frontier moved farther south.
zh:
乌索尔卡河在盐湖群间注入额尔齐斯河的这一段中游，阿拉伯和波斯地理学家知道这里曾有一座伊玛基亚城，在9至11世纪被算作基马克汗国的中心之一。到1444年古城早已不存，突厥语游牧民在湖边放牧牛羊马群，松散地臣属于瓦剌联盟，在草原与河口渡口之间迁徙营地。

1720年，为防御准噶尔袭扰、把额尔齐斯要塞线向南推进，哥萨克在乌索尔卡河口建起科尔亚科夫哨所。1747年哨所旁开办盐场，盐湖出产由武装船队护送经额尔齐斯河外运，成为据点的生计。此后整个18世纪，科尔亚科夫一直是额尔齐斯河上游的小型兵站，随着要塞防线继续南移，它靠盐业维持下来。

en:
The Baraba is the marshy birch steppe between the Ob and the Irtysh, dotted with lakes, of which Lake Chany is the greatest. Its people were the Baraba Tatars, Kipchak-speaking herdsmen and fishermen who wintered by the lakes and the Om and Tara rivers and summered along the smaller streams; in 1444 they formed the eastern flank of the Siberian Tatar world under the Taibugid princes, still mostly shamanist, trading furs and livestock south through Muslim middlemen. Their fortified camp of Ton-Tura stood on the Om.

Yermak's overthrow of the Khanate of Sibir in 1582 reached into the Baraba, where Kuchum had kept his governor Buyan-Biy at Ton-Tura. Russian yasak collectors soon followed, and in 1628 the Baraba princes Kogutei, Kushluduk and Enbai rose up, killed the collectors, wiped out an eighteen-man Cossack party and burned an outpost before withdrawing to the Teleuts on the upper Ob. For a century the Baraba played Russia off against the Dzungars, who also demanded tribute; in 1722 they again rebelled rather than swear allegiance to Peter the Great's heir, and were brutally put down. Forced conversion followed under Empress Elizabeth, and in the nineteenth century Russian peasant settlers took the better land, turning the Baraba into an agricultural district.
zh:
巴拉巴是鄂毕河与额尔齐斯河之间一片多沼泽的白桦草原，湖泊星罗棋布，其中以恰内湖最大。住在这里的是巴拉巴鞑靼人——说钦察语的牧人和渔人，冬天在湖边及鄂木河、塔拉河畔过冬，夏天转到小河边游牧。1444年，他们构成泰布加系王公治下西伯利亚鞑靼世界的东翼，多数仍信萨满，毛皮和牲畜经穆斯林中间商南运。他们在鄂木河畔设有设防营寨通图拉。

1582年叶尔马克攻灭西伯利亚汗国，兵锋及于巴拉巴——库楚姆的总督布延-比伊就驻在通图拉。俄国的牙萨克税吏随即到来，1628年，巴拉巴王公科古捷伊、库什卢杜克和恩拜起兵，杀死税吏、歼灭一支18人的哥萨克队伍、焚毁一处堡寨，随后退往上鄂毕河的铁列乌特人处。此后一个世纪里，巴拉巴人在同样索取贡赋的准噶尔与俄国之间周旋求生；1722年他们再次起义，拒绝对彼得大帝的继承人宣誓，遭到残酷镇压。伊丽莎白女皇时期又有强迫受洗，19世纪俄国移民占去肥沃土地，巴拉巴逐渐变成农业区。

en:
Where the Om slips into the Irtysh, the wooded country opens into the grasslands of the Baraba. Auls of Baraba Siberian Tatars fished the two rivers, herded cattle on the meadows and trapped sable and squirrel in the birch woods, their pelts passing south with Bukhara-bound traders. In 1444 the Om mouth lay on the eastern edge of the Taibugid khans' Tatar country within the Uzbek Horde, whose Muslim ruling class had barely begun to touch the shamanist people of the river.

As early as 1627 the Tara voevoda asked Moscow for an ostrog at the Om mouth, and Tsar Michael issued a decree for it in 1628, but nearly ninety years passed before anything was built. In 1716 Ivan Buchholz's expedition, retreating down the Irtysh after abandoning the Yamyshev fortress, raised a five-sided earthen fort at the mouth of the Om by order of the Siberian governor, Prince Gagarin; a stronger second fortress followed from 1717. Omsk guarded the up-Irtysh salt and China trade against Dzungar raiding parties and became the linchpin of the Irtysh Line. The fortress was rebuilt on a new site in 1768, and in 1782 Omsk was granted town status, growing as the military centre of the south Siberian frontier.
zh:
鄂木河注入额尔齐斯河之处，林地让位于巴拉巴草原。巴拉巴支系的西伯利亚鞑靼人在两条河上捕鱼，在草甸放牧，在白桦林中猎取紫貂和松鼠，毛皮随前往布哈拉的商人南运。1444年，鄂木河口位于乌兹别克兀鲁思境内泰布加系汗王的鞑靼土地东缘，穆斯林统治阶层的信仰还几乎没有传到河边仍信萨满的民众中。

早在1627年，塔拉督军就请求莫斯科在鄂木河口修筑堡寨，1628年米哈伊尔沙皇也颁下旨意，但近九十年过去仍未动工。1716年，伊万·布赫霍尔茨的探险队放弃亚梅舍沃堡后沿额尔齐斯河撤退，奉西伯利亚总督加加林公爵之命在鄂木河口筑起一座五边形土堡；1717年起又修建更坚固的第二座要塞。鄂木斯克护卫着额尔齐斯河上游的食盐与对华贸易，抵御准噶尔袭扰，成为额尔齐斯防线的枢纽。1768年要塞在新址重建，1782年鄂木斯克正式建城，作为南西伯利亚边疆的军事重镇发展起来。

en:
Ishim is the long forest-steppe valley of the Ishim, a left-bank tributary that joins the Irtysh after 2,450 kilometres. In 1444 no Russian town stood here. The river country lay within the orbit of Chimgi-Tura, which Abu'l-Khayr had made a capital of his Uzbek khanate in 1428 and ruled through appointed darughas. Turkic-speaking Siberian Tatars lived by stockbreeding, fishing and hunting along the river, while Ugric and Samoyedic hunters to the north tied the country to the fur trade. Islam marked the ruling Tatar circles more deeply than the camps and hunting grounds beyond them.

After Abu'l-Khayr's death in 1468, the Ishim-Irtysh country entered the long rivalry of the Tyumen and Sibir khanates. Ibak Khan held Chimgi-Tura until a Taibugid restoration around 1495 moved the capital to Qashliq on the Irtysh. Kuchum seized power in 1563 and later broke with Moscow; Yermak's Cossacks took Qashliq in 1582, and Kuchum's final defeat on the Ob in 1598 opened the fur routes to Russian forts and settlers. Korkina Sloboda was founded on the Ishim in 1687. In 1721 Peter the Great authorized its Nikolskaya fair, which became one of Siberia's great fairs, and in 1782 Catherine II renamed the settlement Ishim and granted it town status.
zh:
伊希姆是伊希姆河沿线漫长的森林草原走廊；这条河全长2450公里，是额尔齐斯河的左岸支流。1444年，这里还没有俄国城镇，河谷处在成吉-图拉的势力范围内。阿布勒海尔1428年将成吉-图拉作为乌兹别克汗国的都城之一，并派遣达鲁花赤治理。说突厥语的西伯利亚鞑靼人沿河畜牧、渔猎，北方的乌戈尔人和萨莫耶德猎人则把这片土地与毛皮贸易连在一起。伊斯兰在鞑靼统治圈中影响更深，外围营地和猎场仍保留着更古老的信仰。

1468年阿布勒海尔死后，伊希姆—额尔齐斯一带卷入秋明汗国与失必儿汗国的长期争夺。伊巴克汗据有成吉-图拉，直到约1495年台不花别吉家族复辟，把都城迁往额尔齐斯河畔的卡什雷克。1563年库楚汗夺取政权，后来与莫斯科决裂；1582年叶尔马克的哥萨克攻占卡什雷克，1598年库楚汗在鄂毕河畔最终战败，毛皮道路随之向俄国堡垒和移民敞开。1687年，伊希姆河畔出现科尔金斯洛博达。1721年彼得一世准许这里举办尼科利斯基集市，它后来成为西伯利亚最重要的集市之一；1782年叶卡捷琳娜二世将其改名为伊希姆并建为城镇。

en:
The As country occupies the middle Ob between the mouths of the Irtysh and the Kazym. Early in the fifteenth century its Khanty clans formed the principality of Koda, whose fortified towns commanded the river; Shorkar, later called Alachev, was the principal seat. In 1444 Koda stood between rival Yugra principalities, recognizing the overlordship of the Tatar khans to the south while raiding the tundra Nenets to the north and fighting Pelym and Kondia. Its people lived by fish, reindeer and sable, and the rulers kept their ancestral shrines rather than Islam.

Ivan III's commanders Fyodor Kurbsky and Ivan Saltykov-Travin reached Koda in 1483 and took Prince Moldan's submission, but he attacked Perm lands in 1484-85 and was again defeated by Semyon Kurbsky in 1499; after the Russians withdrew in 1500, Koda returned to the Siberian khans. In 1583 Prince Alach allied with Yermak, received the lands of Belogorje and allowed a Trinity church at Shorkar, where his wife was the first prominent convert; he briefly joined Kuchum against Yermak in 1585. Koda's three hundred warriors then served Moscow instead of paying yasak, campaigning at Obdorsk, Surgut and against the Ket-Selkup Piebald Horde in 1598-1602. During the Time of Troubles Prince Onzha briefly joined Bolotnikov before submitting, and a 1609 plot led by Princess Anna Purteeva was uncovered. Internal strife in 1636-37 weakened the dynasty, and in 1643 the last prince, Dmitry Alachev, was called to Moscow and Koda was annexed.
zh:
阿斯这片地方位于鄂毕河中游、额尔齐斯河口与卡济姆河口之间。15世纪初，当地汉特诸氏族组成科达公国，沿河设防的城镇控制着河道，都城是绍尔卡尔，后来又称阿拉切夫。1444年，科达夹在尤格拉诸公国之间：它一面承认南方鞑靼汗的宗主权，一面北掠冻原上的涅涅茨人，并与佩雷姆、孔达交战。居民以渔猎、养驯鹿和猎紫貂为生，统治家族保留祖灵神龛，并未改奉伊斯兰教。

1483年，伊凡三世的将领费奥多尔·库尔布斯基和伊万·萨尔蒂科夫-特拉温进抵科达，迫使摩尔丹王公臣服；但他在1484至1485年进攻彼尔姆各地，1499年再被谢苗·库尔布斯基击败。1500年俄军撤离后，科达重新归附西伯利亚诸汗。1583年，阿拉奇王公与叶尔马克结盟，获得别洛戈里耶土地，并允许在绍尔卡尔修建三一教堂，他的妻子成为最早受洗的重要人物；1585年，他又一度倒向库楚姆进攻叶尔马克。此后，科达的三百名战士以兵役代替牙萨克，随俄军出征鄂毕多尔斯克、苏尔古特，并在1598至1602年征讨以凯特人和谢尔库普人为核心的花斑帐联盟。动荡时期，翁扎王公曾短暂参加博洛特尼科夫起义后投降；1609年，安娜·普尔捷耶娃王妃主导的密谋又被破获。1636至1637年的内争削弱了王朝，1643年末代王公德米特里·阿拉切夫被召往莫斯科，科达正式并入俄国。

en:
The Turgay – Torgai in Kazakh, an 825-kilometre river with no outlet to the sea – rises in the Kazakh uplands and runs south down the broad Turgay Valley to lose itself in the reed-beds of Lake Shalkarteniz. Its name means 'the little lowland', and the valley is a natural corridor between the Urals and the open steppe down which migrating peoples passed for centuries. Pine-fringed lakes such as Naurzum break the grassland on which Kipchak clans pastured their herds. In 1444 these grazings formed the western flank of Abu'l-Khayr Khan's Uzbek ulus, the nomad country that later became the heartland of the Kipchak tribe of the Kazakh Middle Jüz.

With Abu'l-Khayr's death in 1468 the valley passed to the Kazakh khans, and under Kasym it lay within the Dasht-i Qipchaq they ruled. The great trial came in 1723, when the Dzungars struck without warning: the 'Years of the Great Disaster' scattered the Middle and Junior Jüz, refugees fleeing far to the west. In 1726 the clans gathered at Ordabasy under Abulkhair Khan and began their long counterstroke. To secure Russian arms against the Dzungars, Abulkhair swore fealty to Empress Anna on 10 October 1731, and the Middle Jüz's khans followed him into Russian suzerainty at Orenburg in 1740. The Orenburg fortress line, anchored on the town of Orenburg founded in 1743, began to fence the steppe in. Ablai Khan then fought the Dzungars and the Qing to a standstill, and when he died in 1781 the Turgay clans were Russian subjects in name alone. His son Vali still held the Middle Jüz khanship at his death in 1817, after which St Petersburg abolished the title; the clans went on pasturing nomadically between the river and the dry steppe.
zh:
图尔盖河——哈萨克语称托尔盖（Торғай），全长825公里，是一条没有出海口的内流河——发源于哈萨克丘陵，沿宽阔的图尔盖谷地南流，最终消失在沙尔卡尔捷涅兹湖的芦苇荡中。河名意为「小小的低地」；图尔盖谷地是乌拉尔山与开阔草原之间的天然走廊，千百年间诸多民族沿此迁徙。瑙尔祖姆一带的松林湖泊点缀着旷野，钦察诸部就在这片草场上放牧。1444年，这片牧场是阿布勒海尔汗乌兹别克兀鲁思的西翼，后来则成为哈萨克中玉兹钦察部的腹地。

1468年阿布勒海尔死后，谷地归于哈萨克诸汗，哈斯木时代被纳入其治下的钦察草原。1723年，大考验降临：准噶尔人不宣而战，「大灾难年代」使中玉兹和小玉兹离散，难民远遁西方。1726年，诸部在奥尔达巴锡集结，推举阿布勒海尔汗为首，开始漫长的反攻。为换取俄国武器对抗准噶尔，阿布勒海尔于1731年10月10日向女皇安娜宣誓臣服，中玉兹诸汗也于1740年在奥伦堡接受俄国宗主权。以1743年新建的奥伦堡城为枢纽的要塞防线，自此开始把草原圈起。此后阿布莱汗与准噶尔、清朝连番周旋，到他1781年去世时，图尔盖诸部仍只是名义上的俄国臣民。他的儿子瓦里保有中玉兹汗位直至1817年去世，圣彼得堡随即废除这一汗号；诸部依旧在图尔盖河与干草原之间游牧迁徙。

en:
Keriya is the oasis where the Keriya River, descending from the Kunlun, loses itself in the southern Taklamakan. The town stood on the old Southern Silk Road between Hotan and Niya, and Marco Polo, visiting in the late 13th century, called the province Pem or Peyn. He found Muslim townspeople living by manufacture and trade, with cotton in the fields and jasper and chalcedony gathered from the rivers. By 1444 this Sunni Turki oasis was tied to the fortunes of the Moghul khans and the Dughlat lords who governed the Tarim cities.

In 1514 Sultan Said Khan took Kashgar, Yarkand and Hotan from Mirza Abu Bakr Dughlat and folded Keriya into the new Yarkand Khanate. In 1680 Galdan's Dzungars made the khanate a client, and around 1700 Tsewang Rabtan ended Chaghatayid rule on the southern rim of the desert. After the Qing destroyed the Dzungar state, Burhan al-Din and Khwaja Jahan raised the Khoja revolt in 1757. Qing armies campaigned through Kuqa, Yarkand and Hotan in 1758, and the brothers' destruction in Badakhshan in 1759 brought Keriya and the other southern oases under Qing rule.
zh:
克里雅是克里雅河从昆仑山流下、最终没入塔克拉玛干南缘处形成的绿洲。城镇位于和田与尼雅之间的丝绸之路南道旧线上；13世纪末马可·波罗经过时，把这一带记作Pem（一作Peyn）。他看到居民已是穆斯林，靠手工业和贸易为生，田间种植棉花，人们还从河中捡拾碧玉和玉髓。到1444年，这座逊尼派突厥语绿洲的命运已同蒙兀儿汗廷和统治塔里木诸城的朵豁剌惕贵族连在一起。

1514年，苏丹萨亦德从米尔扎·阿布·伯克尔·朵豁剌惕手中夺取喀什噶尔、叶尔羌与和田，克里雅也被纳入新建立的叶尔羌汗国。1680年，噶尔丹统率的准噶尔人使叶尔羌汗国成为附庸；约1700年，策妄阿拉布坦终结了沙漠南缘的察合台后裔统治。清朝攻灭准噶尔后，波罗尼都与霍集占于1757年发动和卓之乱。1758年，清军在库车、叶尔羌与和田一带作战；1759年大小和卓在巴达克山败亡，克里雅与天山南路其他绿洲随之归入清朝统治。

en:
Foix is the high county of the Ariège valley, carved out of the old County of Carcassonne around 1012, its counts' castle crowning a rock above the town of Foix. At first vassals of the counts of Toulouse, the counts of Foix backed the Cathars during the Albigensian Crusade: Raymond Roger was excommunicated and his lands briefly granted to Simon de Montfort, yet the house survived the crusade as a direct vassal of the French king. From 1278 the counts were also co-princes of Andorra, and in 1290 Roger Bernard III married the heiress of Béarn, after which the richer Béarn became the heart of their domains and the counts rarely lived at Foix. Gaston Fébus made his lands sovereign in the 1340s, and the county passed through the House of Grailly to Gaston IV, who in 1444 ruled an autonomous fief of sixteen châtellenies, governed by a seneschal and the juge-mage at Foix while his own court sat in Béarn.

Gaston IV bought the viscounty of Narbonne in 1447, regulated the county's administration in 1448 and in 1458 had Foix raised to a peerage of France. His grandson Francis Phoebus became king of Navarre in 1479, and with the marriage of Catherine of Foix to Jean d'Albret in 1483 the county followed the Navarrese crown into the House of Albret. It was united to the French crown only in 1607, when Henry IV, born a prince of this house, reunited Foix, Bigorre and Nébouzan with the royal domain while leaving sovereign Béarn apart. Foix afterwards formed one of the kingdom's thirty-three military governments, and its three-order estates, meeting since 1398, continued to vote taxes until the Revolution. In 1790 the county was joined with Couserans to form the department of Ariège, with the little town beneath the rock as its capital.
zh:
富瓦是阿列日河谷中的山地伯国，约1012年从古老的卡尔卡松伯国分出，伯爵城堡高踞富瓦城头的巨岩之上。富瓦伯爵本是图卢兹伯爵的封臣，在阿尔比十字军战争中支持清洁派：雷蒙·罗歇被开除教籍，领地一度被封给西蒙·德·孟福尔，但家族熬过这场战争，成为法兰西国王的直属封臣。1278年起，富瓦伯爵还兼任安道尔的共治亲王；1290年，罗歇·贝尔纳三世娶贝亚恩女继承人，此后更富庶的贝亚恩成为领地核心，伯爵们很少住在富瓦。加斯东·孚比斯在1340年代使自己的领地成为主权之地，伯国后经格拉伊家族传到加斯东四世。1444年，他统治着一个分设十六个城堡管区的自治封邑，由驻守富瓦的司法总管和大法官治理，而他本人的宫廷设在贝亚恩。

加斯东四世1447年买下纳博讷子爵领，1448年整顿伯国行政，1458年使富瓦升为法兰西的贵族伯国。其孙弗朗索瓦·孚比斯1479年成为纳瓦拉国王；1483年富瓦的卡特琳嫁给让·达尔布雷，伯国随纳瓦拉王冠一同转入阿尔布雷家族。1607年，正是出自这一家族的亨利四世把富瓦、比戈尔和内布藏并入王领，但仍是主权之国的贝亚恩不在其列。富瓦此后成为法兰西三十三个军政区之一，1398年起召开的三级省议会继续表决税赋，直到大革命。1790年，富瓦与库斯朗合并为阿列日省，巨岩下的小城成为省府。

en:
Carcassonne commands the gap where the old Via Aquitania, running from the Mediterranean to the Atlantic, crosses the Aude between the Montagne Noire and the Corbières. Romans, Visigoths and Moors held its hilltop in turn, and the Trencavel viscounts made the Cité a stronghold of the Cathar faith.
