帕维亚古称提契努姆，位于提契诺河畔，曾是伦巴第国王的都城，数百年来也是意大利国王在圣米凯莱马焦雷教堂加冕的城市。作为吉伯林派公社和米兰的老对头，它一直顶住加莱亚佐二世·维斯孔蒂的攻势，直到1359年11月13日在长期围困后投降。此后维斯孔蒂家族把它当作第二都城：加莱亚佐二世将宫廷迁来，1361至1365年建起宏伟的维斯孔蒂城堡，大学也于1361年重建；1396年吉安·加莱亚佐为继承人设立帕维亚伯爵领，并动工兴建卡尔特修道院作为家族陵寝。船坞里停泊着公国的桨帆战舰，1431年，帕西诺·尤斯塔基率领的帕维亚舰队在波河上歼灭了一支威尼斯舰队。1444年，帕维亚虽被米兰盖过风头却未失分量：这里有公爵府邸、档案与圣物，还有一所声名远播、吸引全意大利学生前来的法学院。

斯福尔扎时期，大学声望不坠，1490年还增设了希伯来语教席，城墙外的卡尔特修道院也慢慢成形。意大利战争把帕维亚变成战场：1524至1525年法军围城，1525年2月24日在米拉贝洛的维斯孔蒂狩猎苑内，帝国火绳枪兵击溃弗朗索瓦一世的大军并生擒法王本人，围城战以法国失败告终，公国从此落入西班牙之手。1597年腓力二世驱逐城中犹太人；1655年，法兰西与萨伏依联军从7月猛攻至9月，却未能破城。1706年奥地利人到来，在玛丽亚·特蕾西亚治下，大学进入黄金时代，拉扎罗·斯帕兰扎尼和亚历山德罗·沃尔塔都曾在此任教——沃尔塔主持实验物理学教席近四十年，并于1799年制成电堆。1796年法军占领帕维亚；雅各宾党人推倒古老的「雷吉索莱」铜像后，市民举事反抗，被拿破仑在激烈巷战中镇压。经历拿破仑的意大利王国之后，奥地利于1815年卷土重来，帕维亚成为伦巴第-威尼托王国的一部分。

en:
Padua lies on the Bacchiglione river where the Venetian plain meets the Euganean Hills. As Roman Patavium it was a wealthy wool and horse-breeding centre and the birthplace of the historian Livy. The Lombard sack of 601 left it weakened for centuries, but the medieval commune recovered and founded its university in 1222. The Carraresi lords made Padua a centre of pre-humanist art and learning after 1318, until their wars with Milan and Venice ended with Venetian conquest in 1405. In 1444 the city was Venice's principal university city on the mainland, linked to the lagoon by the Brenta and Bacchiglione waterways.

Donatello completed the bronze equestrian monument to the Venetian condottiere Gattamelata in 1453, the first full-size Renaissance statue of its kind. During the War of the League of Cambrai, imperial troops took Padua in June 1509, but Andrea Gritti retook it on 17 July; Maximilian I besieged the city from 15 to 30 September and withdrew after his assaults failed. Padua's university then entered its greatest age: its botanical garden was established in 1545, the anatomical theatre opened in 1595, and Galileo Galilei taught there from 1592 to 1610. In 1678 Elena Lucrezia Cornaro Piscopia became the first woman to receive a doctorate in philosophy. Venetian rule ended in 1797, and after the Napoleonic Kingdom of Italy, Padua passed to Austrian Lombardy-Venetia in 1815.
zh:
帕多瓦位于巴基廖内河河畔，地处威尼斯平原与欧加内丘陵相接之处。罗马时代的帕塔维乌姆以毛织和养马致富，也是历史学家李维的出生地。601年伦巴第人洗劫城市，使它衰微了数百年；中世纪公社复兴后，于1222年创立大学。1318年后，卡拉拉家族把帕多瓦建成前人文主义艺术与学术中心，但他们与米兰、威尼斯的战争最终以1405年威尼斯征服城市告终。1444年的帕多瓦是威尼斯在大陆上最重要的大学城，借布伦塔河与巴基廖内河的水路同潟湖相连。

1453年，多纳泰罗为威尼斯雇佣兵将领加塔梅拉塔完成青铜骑马像，这是文艺复兴时期第一座等身骑马雕像。康布雷同盟战争期间，帝国军队于1509年6月攻占帕多瓦，安德烈亚·格里蒂又在7月17日将其收复；马克西米利安一世9月15日至30日围城，多次进攻失败后撤退。此后帕多瓦大学进入黄金时代：1545年设立植物园，1595年解剖剧场落成，1592年至1610年伽利略·伽利莱在此任教。1678年，埃莱娜·卢克雷齐亚·科尔纳罗·皮斯科皮亚成为世界上第一位获得哲学博士学位的女性。威尼斯统治于1797年结束，经过拿破仑意大利王国时期后，帕多瓦于1815年转入奥地利治下的伦巴第-威尼托王国。

en:
Bologna began as the Etruscan Felsina and became the Roman colony of Bononia in 196 BC, astride the Via Aemilia at the edge of the Apennines. Its free commune joined the Lombard League against Frederick Barbarossa, and in 1257 proclaimed the Liber Paradisus, buying the serfs' freedom with public money; by 1300 fifty or sixty thousand people lived among its bristling towers, and a network of canals carried goods and turned the mills. Irnerius and his pupils made its schools famous across Europe, and from 1088 the University of Bologna is reckoned the oldest on the continent. Pepoli and Visconti lords followed, and the Bentivoglio first seized power in 1401. In 1444 Annibale I Bentivoglio, who had recovered the city from Milan two years earlier, ruled as an all but independent prince under distant papal overlordship, his revenues drawn from canal mills and the cloth and silk trades.

After Annibale was murdered in 1445, power passed to Sante Bentivoglio and then to Giovanni II, whose long reign adorned Bologna with Renaissance palaces, until Pope Julius II deposed him in October 1506 and entered in triumph on 10 November as the Bentivoglio palace was razed. On 24 February 1530 Charles V was crowned emperor by Clement VII in San Petronio, the last emperor crowned by a pope; in 1547 Council of Trent sessions moved to the city for several months. The Archiginnasio opened as the university's seat in 1563, and the plague of 1629–31 carried off roughly a third of the population. Count Marsili founded his Institute of Sciences in 1714, Laura Bassi became its first salaried woman professor in 1732, and Galvani's frog experiments of 1780 opened the study of animal electricity. Napoleon entered on 19 June 1796 and ended papal rule; the constitution of 4 December was Italy's first democratic one, and after the Congress of Vienna papal government returned in 1815 with Carbonari plots gathering beneath it.
zh:
博洛尼亚最初是伊特鲁里亚人的费尔西纳，公元前196年成为罗马殖民地博诺尼亚，扼守艾米利亚大道，位于亚平宁山脉边缘。它的自由公社加入伦巴第同盟对抗腓特烈·巴巴罗萨，1257年颁布《天堂之书》，以公帑赎买农奴的自由；到1300年，已有五六万人生活在林立的高塔之间，运河水网往来货物、推动磨坊水轮。伊尔内留斯和弟子们让这里的学派名扬欧洲，1088年起的博洛尼亚大学被视为欧洲大陆最古老的大学。此后佩波利、维斯孔蒂等家族相继当权，1401年本蒂沃利奥家族首次夺取政权。1444年，两年前从米兰手中夺回城市的安尼巴莱一世·本蒂沃利奥以近乎独立的君主执政，仅在名义上奉遥远的教皇为宗主，运河磨坊与布料、丝绸贸易是他的财源。

安尼巴莱1445年遇刺后，政权先后归于桑特·本蒂沃利奥和乔瓦尼二世；后者的长期统治用文艺复兴宫殿装点城市，直到教皇尤利乌斯二世1506年10月将他废黜，11月10日本蒂沃利奥宫被夷平、教皇凯旋入城。1530年2月24日，克雷芒七世在圣白托略大殿为查理五世加冕，这是最后一次由教皇为皇帝加冕；1547年，特伦托公会议的议程一度迁至博洛尼亚数月。1563年阿奇吉纳西欧宫落成，成为大学的统一校舍；1629至1631年的瘟疫夺走约三分之一人口。1714年马尔西利伯爵创办科学院，1732年劳拉·巴斯成为大学第一位领薪女教授，1780年路易吉·伽伐尼的青蛙实验开启了生物电研究。1796年6月19日拿破仑入城，结束教皇统治，12月4日的宪法是意大利第一部民主宪法。维也纳会议后教皇政府于1815年卷土重来，烧炭党的密谋在其治下悄然聚集。

en:
Spoleto, the Roman Spoletium, guards a southern gateway to the Umbrian mountains: in 217 BC its colonists beat Hannibal back from the walls after Trasimene. Under the Lombards it became in 576 the seat of the Duchy of Spoleto, whose power ran across much of central Italy, until the duchy passed to the Church under Innocent III in 1198. Cardinal Albornoz reimposed papal order from the 1350s, and from 1359 the Rocca Albornoziana rose on the Sant'Elia ridge as the seat of his governors, while the tall arches of the Ponte delle Torri carried the aqueduct over the gorge beside it. Long torn by Guelph and Ghibelline feuds, the city was sacked in 1438 by troops of Francesco Piccinino's party, and a papal army recovered the fortress in 1440. In 1444 Spoleto was a fortified city of the Papal States, ruled by a rector and still repairing the damage of those wars.

Nicholas V, who took refuge here from a Roman plague in 1449, confirmed the city statutes and enlarged the fortress, and in 1455 Callixtus III named his nephew Cardinal Rodrigo Borgia its duke. The painter Filippo Lippi spent his last years at the cathedral, beginning the apse frescoes of the Virgin's life in 1467 and dying in the city in 1469, where his tomb still stands. In 1499 Alexander VI made his daughter Lucrezia Borgia governor, and she held court in the Rocca. Spoleto then settled into the quieter life of a provincial seat of the Church, until in 1809 Napoleon made it capital of the new French Department of Trasimène, covering most of Umbria. With his fall the city returned to the Papal States, and in 1816 Pius VII made Spoleto the centre of an apostolic delegation.
zh:
斯波莱托（罗马时代称斯波莱提乌姆）扼守翁布里亚山地的南部门户：公元前217年特拉西梅诺湖之战后，汉尼拔兵临城下，被这里的罗马殖民者击退。伦巴第人治下，它于576年成为斯波莱托公国的都城，势力遍及意大利中部大片土地，直到1198年公国在英诺森三世治下并入教会。阿尔沃诺斯枢机从1350年代起重整教廷统治，1359年起在圣埃利亚山岭上兴建阿尔沃诺斯堡垒，作为教宗总督的驻地，塔桥（Ponte delle Torri）的高耸拱券则把输水道送过堡垒旁的深谷。城市长期受圭尔夫派与吉伯林派仇杀困扰，1438年遭弗朗切斯科·皮奇尼诺一方的军队洗劫，1440年教宗军队收复堡垒。1444年的斯波莱托是教宗国的设防城市，由一位总督治理，仍在弥历年战乱的创伤。

1449年，为躲避罗马瘟疫的尼古拉五世驾临此地，批准城市法规并扩建堡垒；1455年，加里斯多三世任命外甥罗德里哥·波吉亚枢机为斯波莱托公爵。画家菲利普·利皮在主教座堂度过最后岁月，1467年起绘制后殿的圣母生平湿壁画，1469年在城中去世并安葬于此。1499年，亚历山大六世任命女儿卢克雷齐娅·波吉亚为总督，她在堡垒中开府治事。此后斯波莱托渐成教宗国安静的省治，直到1809年拿破仑将其设为新置的特拉西梅诺省省会，辖境覆盖翁布里亚大部。拿破仑败亡后城市重归教宗国，1816年庇护七世设立斯波莱托宗座代理区，以该城为首府。

en:
Terracina is the old Volscian town of Anxur, pressed between the Ausoni hills and the sea at the southern edge of the Pontine Marshes, where the Via Appia first meets the coast. Rome planted a citizen colony here in 329 BC, and the harbour was built under Trajan and his successor; above the town rises the temple of Jupiter Anxur. After Byzantine rule and a spell in the Duchy of Naples, Pope John VIII brought it under the Holy See in 872, and the election of Urban II held here in 1088 made Terracina the first place outside Rome to host a papal election. The Frangipane and other Roman barons then held it as their fortress until a commune drove them out in 1202. In the fifteenth century the city slipped back and forth between the Church and the kings of Naples, who returned it to the papacy in 1420 and again in 1447. In 1444 Terracina was a frontier garrison and small fishing port of the Papal States, its factional feuds only half tamed.

Final pacification came in 1499, when Alexander VI imposed order on the warring families. In 1514 Leo X granted the draining of the marshes around Terracina to his brother Giuliano de' Medici, who the next year called in Leonardo da Vinci to design the canals; but Giuliano died in 1516 and the townspeople blocked the works, leaving the malarial flats as they were. In the 1770s Pius VI took up the task again: from 1777 thousands of labourers dug the Linea Pia canal, reclaiming land between Terracina and Sezze and reconstructing the Appian Way, until the French Revolutionary Wars brought work to a halt. In 1809 Terracina followed the rest of the Papal States into Napoleon's empire, returning to papal rule with his fall, and in 1818 the concordat between Pius VII and Ferdinand I of the Two Sicilies was concluded here.
zh:
泰拉奇纳古称安克苏尔，是沃尔西人的城镇，紧夹在奥索尼山岭与大海之间，地处蓬蒂内沼泽南缘，阿庇亚大道在此第一次抵达海岸。公元前329年罗马在此建立公民殖民地，港口在图拉真皇帝及其继任者两朝修成；城镇上方矗立着朱庇特·安克苏尔神庙。它历经拜占庭统治，又一度隶属那不勒斯公国，872年被若望八世纳入教廷治下；1088年乌尔班二世在此当选，使泰拉奇纳成为罗马之外第一个举办教宗选举的地方。此后弗兰吉帕尼等罗马豪族把它据为堡垒，直到1202年公社起事将他们驱逐。15世纪，城市在教廷与那不勒斯诸王之间几度易手，那不勒斯于1420年、1447年两次将它归还教会。1444年的泰拉奇纳是教宗国的边境要塞兼小渔港，城中的派系仇杀只被压下去一半。

彻底平定要等到1499年，亚历山大六世压服了交战的各家豪族。1514年，良十世把泰拉奇纳一带的沼泽排垦权赐给弟弟朱利亚诺·德·美第奇，后者次年请来列奥纳多·达·芬奇设计渠系；但朱利亚诺1516年去世，居民又封堵工程，瘴疠弥漫的洼地依然如故。1770年代庇护六世重举此事：从1777年起，数千名工人开凿「庇护渠」（Linea Pia），垦出泰拉奇纳与塞泽之间的土地并重修阿庇亚大道，直到法国大革命战争才告中断。1809年，泰拉奇纳随教宗国其余地区并入拿破仑帝国，拿破仑败亡后重归教廷；1818年，庇护七世与两西西里国王费迪南多一世在此签订政教协定。

en:
Molise is a rugged Samnite country of mountains, castles and short valleys between Abruzzo, Capitanata and the Terra di Lavoro. The Lombards divided it among gastaldates, Bojano being established around 667 under Grimoald I. In 1045 Rudolf of Moulins took part in the Norman conquest and formed the county that became the Contado di Molise, probably named from his family; after his line lost power the land split into many small fiefs. Frederick II later joined Molise with the Terra di Lavoro in a royal justiciarate. Campobasso, the Lombard Campus Vassorum, became a Norman market and administrative centre whose blade-makers were documented by the fourteenth century. Cola Monforte struck coin and strengthened its castle and walls, but the Monforte supported Anjou. When Alfonso V won Naples in 1442, Campobasso passed to Aragon; in 1444 it was a Catholic Neapolitan land of mountain fiefs, cutlers and pastoral trade.

Under the new Aragonese order the fief soon passed to the De Capua family, though its position on the inland routes preserved Campobasso's commerce. In 1732 townspeople began building on the lower ground, and in 1763 they abandoned the old hill settlement for the lower valley. The French-backed legislation of 1806 abolished feudal jurisdiction and detached Molise from the Terra di Lavoro and Capitanata, giving it a provincial administration of its own. In 1814 Joachim Murat enlarged Campobasso across the Campo Basso, confirming the lower town as the centre around which the province would be governed. Scissors, knives and local cheeses remained the crafts and goods most closely associated with the town.
zh:
莫利塞是萨莫奈山地中一片崎岖之地，山岭、城堡和短促河谷夹在阿布鲁佐、卡皮塔纳塔与拉沃罗地区之间。伦巴第人把这里分为若干官长辖区，博亚诺便于约667年在格里莫阿尔德一世治下设立。1045年，穆兰的鲁道夫参与诺曼征服，建立后来成为莫利塞伯国的领地，名称可能便来自他的家族；其家族失势后，土地分裂成许多小封邑。腓特烈二世后来把莫利塞与拉沃罗地区合并为一个王家司法区。首府坎波巴索起源于伦巴第人的瓦索鲁姆营地，诺曼时期成为市场与行政中心，当地刀匠在14世纪已有明确记载。科拉·蒙福特曾在此铸币，并加固城堡与城墙，但蒙福特家族支持安茹派。1442年阿方索五世赢得那不勒斯后，坎波巴索转入阿拉贡手中；1444年，这里是天主教那不勒斯境内一片遍布山地封邑、刀匠和牧产贸易的土地。

在新的阿拉贡秩序下，这块封地很快转入迪卡普阿家族手中，而坎波巴索凭借内陆商路上的位置维持了商业。1732年，居民开始在较低处营建新城，1763年又离开山顶旧城，定居下方谷地。1806年，法国支持下的立法废除封建司法权，把莫利塞从拉沃罗地区和卡皮塔纳塔分出，使其拥有独立的省级行政机构。1814年，若阿尚·缪拉把坎波巴索向低地扩展，确立了下城作为全省行政中心的地位。剪刀、刀具和本地奶酪也始终是这座城市最具代表性的手艺与物产。

en:
Avellino lies in a mountain-ringed Campanian basin on the road between Salerno and Benevento. Its classical predecessor, Abellinum, was a centre of the Hirpini Samnites on the Civita hill before Rome conquered it in 293 BC; after the Gothic wars the old site was abandoned and a fortified borough grew on the nearby Terra hill. It passed from Benevento to the Principality of Salerno in 849, and in 1130 the antipope Anacletus II issued in its cathedral a bull recognizing Roger II as king in Sicily. A succession of Norman and feudal lords followed, including the Sanseverino, Montfort, Del Balzo and Filangieri families. In 1444 Avellino was a small castle town in the Kingdom of Naples, set where the roads and market routes of its plain met those leading to Naples, Salerno, Benevento and Apulia.

In 1512 Maria de Cardona became countess of Avellino. With the support of Francesco d'Este and Charles V, she established a free market and an annual fair, promoted ironworks, and in 1548 introduced a municipal council and the first mayor. Marino Caracciolo bought the fief in 1581 and became Prince of Avellino in 1589. His family introduced woolen manufacture and made the Grain Customs a commercial centre; Marino II patronized Giambattista Basile, author of the Pentamerone. The plague of 1656 carried off roughly three quarters of the population. In 1806 feudalism was abolished and the provincial capital moved from Montefusco to Avellino. Carbonari troops entered the town in July 1820 and proclaimed a Spanish-style constitution, before Austrian troops crushed the movement in March 1821.
zh:
阿韦利诺坐落在坎帕尼亚一片群山环抱的盆地中，地处萨莱诺通往贝内文托的道路。其前身阿贝林努姆在公元前293年被罗马征服前，是奇维塔山上的伊尔皮尼萨莫奈人中心；哥特战争后旧城废弃，一座设防集镇在附近的泰拉山成长。849年，它从贝内文托转归萨莱诺亲王国。1130年，对立教宗阿纳克莱图斯二世在阿韦利诺主教座堂颁布诏书，承认鲁杰罗二世为西西里国王。此后圣塞韦里诺、蒙福特、德尔巴尔佐、菲朗杰里等诺曼和封建家族相继领有此地。1444年，阿韦利诺是那不勒斯王国的一座小型城堡城镇，盆地内的道路和商路在此会合，通往那不勒斯、萨莱诺、贝内文托和普利亚。

1512年，玛丽亚·德·卡尔多纳成为阿韦利诺女伯爵。在弗朗切斯科·德斯特与查理五世支持下，她设立自由市集和年度集市，推动铁厂生产，并在1548年引入市政会议和首任市长。马里诺·卡拉乔洛1581年购得封地，1589年成为阿韦利诺亲王。卡拉乔洛家族引入毛纺织业，把谷物海关发展成商业中心；马里诺二世曾庇护《五日谈》作者詹巴蒂斯塔·巴西莱。1656年瘟疫夺去约四分之三居民的生命。1806年封建制被废除，省治从蒙特富斯科迁至阿韦利诺。1820年7月，烧炭党军队进入城镇并宣布实行西班牙式宪法，奥地利军队最终在1821年3月镇压了这场运动。

en:
Arborea was the central-western region of Sardinia, its heart the grain lands and lagoons around Oristano on the northern Campidano. As Byzantine rule ebbed it became one of the island's four native giudicati, and in 1070 Judge Orzocorre I moved its seat from Tharros, exposed to Saracen raids, to Oristano. Its great age came with Mariano IV (1347-1375), who for a time held all Sardinia save Cagliari, Alghero and Sassari and asked the pope for the island's crown, only to die in the plague of 1375. His daughter Eleanor, ruling for her young sons, issued the Carta de Logu in 1392, a code of 198 chapters for the whole realm. Brancaleone Doria all but rebuilt the kingdom, but Martin I of Sicily's army broke it at Sanluri on 30 June 1409; Oristano surrendered in January 1410, and in 1420 William III of Narbona sold the last Arborean rights to the Crown for 100,000 gold florins. In 1444 the old realm survives as a marquisate about Oristano, its grain lands administered from Cagliari.

The last marquess, Leonardo Alagon, rose against the crown and was crushed at Macomer in 1478, after which Oristano became a royal city and the plain was parcelled into fiefs. The town itself was exempt from feudal dues, but its villages lived under the seigneurial yoke and the old Carta de Logu, while malaria from the coastal lagoons kept the lowlands thinly peopled. With the rest of Sardinia the region passed from a brief Austrian rule to the House of Savoy in 1720. In the island-wide rising of 1794-1796 the feudal villages of the interior rose behind Giovanni Maria Angioy against dues that royal cities such as Oristano never paid, until the movement collapsed in 1796. In 1821 the Carta de Logu still ordered village life, and the plain's grain still went to sea through Oristano.
zh:
阿尔博雷亚位于撒丁岛中西部，核心在北坎皮达诺、奥里斯塔诺周围的粮田与潟湖。拜占庭势力退潮后，这里成为岛上四个本土吉乌帝卡提之一；1070年，君主奥尔佐科雷一世把都城从直面萨拉森海盗的塔罗斯迁往奥里斯塔诺。阿尔博雷亚的鼎盛随马里亚诺四世（1347—1375年在位）到来：他一度占据除卡利亚里、阿尔盖罗和萨萨里外的整个撒丁岛，还请求教皇把岛上王权封给自己，最终在1375年的瘟疫中死去。他的女儿埃莉诺代幼子执政，1392年颁行Carta de Logu，全法典共198条，通用于整个王国。布兰卡莱奥内·多里亚几乎重建了王国，但西西里国王马丁一世的军队于1409年6月30日在圣卢里将其击溃；奥里斯塔诺于1410年1月投降，1420年纪尧姆三世以十万金弗罗林把阿尔博雷亚的剩余权利卖给王室。1444年，旧王国缩为以奥里斯塔诺为中心的侯爵领地，粮田由卡利亚里方面统管。

末代侯爵莱奥纳多·阿拉贡（Alagon）举兵对抗王室，1478年在马科梅尔被击垮；此后奥里斯塔诺成为王属城市，平原被分封成采邑。城市本身免缴封建贡赋，周围的村庄却要承受领主管辖和旧法典Carta de Logu，沿海潟湖的疟疾也使低地人烟稀少。与撒丁岛其余地区一样，这里经过奥地利的短暂统治，于1720年转归萨伏依王朝。1794至1796年的全岛大起义中，内陆封建村落追随乔瓦尼·马里亚·安焦伊，反抗奥里斯塔诺这类王属城市从不缴纳的贡赋，运动最终于1796年瓦解。1821年时，Carta de Logu仍规范着村庄生活，平原的粮食依旧经奥里斯塔诺出海。

en:
Trapani curves around a sickle-shaped harbour beneath Monte Erice, at Sicily's western approach to the Egadi Islands. It began as the port of the Elymian city of Eryx, became the Carthaginian stronghold Drepana and defeated a Roman fleet in 249 BC before passing to Rome after the Battle of the Aegates in 241 BC. Arab rule and the Norman conquest of 1077 revived its commerce; Genoa, Pisa, Venice and Amalfi all kept consulates in the harbour. Trapani joined the Sicilian Vespers in 1282 and passed to Aragon, growing during the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries into the chief economic and political centre of western Sicily. In 1444 it was an Aragonese port sustained by coral work, salt pans and tuna fishing.

In 1478 Ferdinand II of Aragon honoured Trapani with the title Invittissima, 'Most Invincible'. The city joined the revolt against Hugo de Moncada in 1516, when Simone Sanclemente held power for several months. On 20 August 1535 Charles V landed there after capturing Tunis, called Trapani the 'Key to the Kingdom' and confirmed the privileges of its senate. Formal city status followed in 1589. Plague in 1624 and famine riots in 1647 and 1670-1673 marked a century of decline, but the eighteenth century brought recovery as population rose from about 16,000 to 25,000. After short Savoyard and Habsburg intervals in 1713 and 1720, Bourbon rule encouraged marsh drainage, while salt and tuna remained the port's principal trades.
zh:
特拉帕尼环抱埃里切山下的镰刀形海港，扼守西西里西端通往埃加迪群岛的航路。它最初是埃利米亚人城市埃里克斯的外港，后来成为迦太基要塞德雷帕纳，前249年在此击败罗马舰队；前241年埃加迪群岛海战之后转入罗马之手。阿拉伯统治和1077年诺曼征服恢复了这里的商业，热那亚、比萨、威尼斯和阿马尔菲都在港中设有领事馆。1282年，特拉帕尼参加西西里晚祷起事，随后归属阿拉贡，并在14、15世纪发展为西西里西部最重要的经济和政治中心。1444年时，它是阿拉贡治下的港口，依靠珊瑚加工、盐田和金枪鱼捕捞维持繁荣。

1478年，阿拉贡国王费尔南多二世授予特拉帕尼「不败之城」称号。1516年，城市加入反抗乌戈·德·蒙卡达的暴动，西蒙内·桑克莱门特一度掌权数月。1535年8月20日，查理五世攻占突尼斯后抵达这里，称特拉帕尼为「王国之钥」，并确认城市参议院的特权。1589年，特拉帕尼正式获得城市地位。1624年的瘟疫，以及1647年和1670年至1673年的饥荒暴动，标志着一个世纪的衰落；但18世纪城市复苏，人口从约一万六千增至二万五千。经历1713年萨伏依王朝和1720年哈布斯堡王朝的短暂统治后，波旁王朝推动沼泽排干，盐业和金枪鱼捕捞则始终是港口的主要生计。

en:
Girgenti, now Agrigento, crowns the western ridge of ancient Akragas above Sicily's southern shore. Around 580 BC settlers from Gela founded a Greek city whose temples and grainlands between the Platani and Salso rivers brought it wealth, until the Carthaginian sack of 406 BC ended its greatest age. Roman Agrigentum shrank during late antiquity, and its people withdrew uphill from coastal raiding. Muslim forces took the site in 828; after the Norman conquest it was re-established as the fortified town of Girgenti, with castle, cathedral and walls. The Sicilian Vespers of 1282 brought the island under the Aragonese royal house. In 1444 the walled upper town overlooked fertile estates whose wheat was loaded at the Marina di Girgenti.

Girgenti's Jewish community did not survive the expulsion enforced across Spanish-ruled Sicily in 1492. Grain remained the shoreline's purpose: from the fifteenth century the Marina di Girgenti was the region's cereal market and loading place. Between 1549 and 1554 Viceroy Juan de Vega restored the Torre del Caricatore to protect the trade from Saracen pirates. The medieval nucleus, enlarged during the fifteenth century, acquired Baroque churches and noble palaces in the following centuries. In 1749 work began on the first mole under Charles III and Bishop Lorenzo Gioeni; completed in 1763, it gave the grain port safer anchorage, while the town's population recovered during the eighteenth century.
zh:
吉尔真蒂（今阿格里真托）雄踞在阿克拉加斯古城西缘的山脊上，俯瞰西西里南岸。约前580年，来自革拉的殖民者建立这座希腊城市，普拉塔尼河与萨尔索河之间的神庙和粮田为它带来财富，直到前406年迦太基本洗城，终结了它的全盛时代。罗马时代的阿格里真托姆在古代晚期衰微，居民为躲避沿海袭扰而退居山上。828年，穆斯林军队夺取此地；诺曼征服后，山上重建起设防的吉尔真蒂，拥有城堡、主教座堂和城墙。1282年西西里晚祷后，西西里转入阿拉贡王室统治。1444年，城墙环绕的山城俯瞰肥沃庄园，小麦则在吉尔真蒂海滨码头装船。

1492年，西班牙统治下的西西里推行驱逐令，吉尔真蒂的犹太社群未能延续。谷物始终是海滨定居点存在的理由：自15世纪起，吉尔真蒂码头就是这一地区的谷物市场和装船地。1549年至1554年，总督胡安·德·维加下令修复装卸塔，保护贸易免受撒拉森海盗侵扰。15世纪扩建的中世纪城区，在随后几个世纪又增建巴洛克教堂和贵族宫殿。1749年，在卡洛三世和洛伦佐·焦埃尼主教推动下，第一座突堤码头动工，1763年完工后为粮食港口提供了更安全的锚地，城市人口也在18世纪有所恢复。

en:
Trieste lies on a narrow Adriatic shore beneath the Karst plateau, where the Roman harbour town of Tergeste once linked Aquileia with Istria. After centuries of decline, rule by its bishops gave way to a free commune in 1295, and Venice held the town from 1370 until 1378. In 1382 the leading citizens petitioned Duke Leopold III of Austria for protection, placing Trieste under the Habsburgs while preserving its council, bishop and municipal privileges. In 1444 the Catholic, Romance-speaking town beneath San Giusto Hill was still modest, living from its fishing boats, coastal traffic and the road climbing toward the Habsburg interior.

Venetian troops seized Trieste in 1508 during the war over the League of Cambrai, but the Habsburgs recovered it the following year. Its later growth came from imperial commerce: Charles VI declared Trieste a free port in June 1717, with the privilege taking effect during his visit on 10 September 1718, and from 1734 the town became the assembly point of the Austrian navy. Maria Theresa ordered the old walls dismantled in 1749 and promoted new building works and canal dredging, opening space for merchants and warehouses. French troops occupied Trieste in 1797, 1805 and 1809; from 1809 to 1813 it belonged to Napoleon's Illyrian Provinces and its free-port privileges were suspended, until Habsburg rule returned.
zh:
的里雅斯特位于喀斯特高原下的亚得里亚海狭长海岸，罗马时代的港口城镇泰尔杰斯特曾连接阿奎莱亚与伊斯特里亚。经历数百年衰落之后，主教统治在1295年让位于自由公社；威尼斯又在1370年至1378年间占据此城。1382年，城中显贵向奥地利公爵利奥波德三世请求保护，使的里雅斯特并入哈布斯堡领地，同时保留市议会、主教和城市特权。1444年，圣朱斯托山下这座讲罗曼语的天主教城镇规模仍不大，依靠渔船、沿海贸易以及通往哈布斯堡内陆的山路为生。

康布雷同盟战争期间，威尼斯军队1508年夺取的里雅斯特，但哈布斯堡在次年将其收复。它后来的兴盛来自帝国商业：查理六世1717年6月宣布的里雅斯特为自由港，特权在1718年9月10日皇帝到访时生效；从1734年起，这里又成为奥地利海军的集结地。玛丽亚·特蕾西亚1749年下令拆除旧城墙，并推动新建筑和运河疏浚，为商人与货仓腾出空间。法国军队先后在1797年、1805年和1809年占领的里雅斯特；1809年至1813年，它被并入拿破仑的伊利里亚行省，自由港特权中止，直到哈布斯堡恢复统治。

en:
Bergamo clusters on a hill where the Po plain meets the Bergamo Alps, its walled upper town above the newer town on the flat. The Roman Bergomum became a Lombard duchy in 569 and a free commune in 1098, joining the Lombard League against Frederick Barbarossa; in the thirteenth century the Visconti of Milan made it their outpost, and Pandolfo Malatesta held it from 1407. Milan ceded Bergamo to Venice in 1428 after the battle of Maclodio. In 1444 it was thus a frontier city of the Venetian Terraferma, looking north to the Alpine passes and west towards Milan, with local nobles such as the Colleoni long schooled in mercenary warfare.

The Bergamasque condottiero Bartolomeo Colleoni, captain-general of Venice, had the Renaissance Colleoni Chapel built beside Santa Maria Maggiore in 1472–1476 as his mausoleum. When Gaston de Foix sacked Brescia in 1512, Bergamo saved itself by paying the French some 60,000 ducats. Later in the sixteenth century Venice ringed the upper town with bastioned walls, which never had to face a siege. In 1797 the townsmen proclaimed a short-lived Bergamasque Republic; Bergamo then passed through the Cisalpine Republic into the Napoleonic Kingdom of Italy, and in 1815 to Austrian Lombardy–Venetia, where its first textile mills were planted.
zh:
贝加莫依山而建，坐落在波河平原与贝加莫阿尔卑斯山相接之处，城墙环绕的上城建在山丘上，下城铺展在平原。罗马时代的贝加莫姆于569年成为伦巴第人的公国，1098年成为自由公社，加入伦巴第联盟对抗腓特烈·巴巴罗萨；13世纪米兰的维斯孔蒂家族将其作为前哨，1407年起由潘多尔福·马拉泰斯塔占据。马克洛迪奥战役后，米兰于1428年把贝加莫割让给威尼斯。因此，1444年的贝加莫是威尼斯陆上领地的边城，北望阿尔卑斯山口，西对米兰，以科莱奥尼家族为代表的本地贵族久历雇佣战争。

贝加莫出身的雇佣兵队长、威尼斯统帅巴托洛梅奥·科莱奥尼，于1472至1476年在圣母大殿旁修造文艺复兴风格的科莱奥尼礼拜堂作为自己的陵寝。1512年加斯东·德·富瓦洗劫布雷西亚时，贝加莫向法军支付约六万杜卡特才免于同一下场。16世纪后期，威尼斯用棱堡城墙环绕上城，这道城墙从未遭到围攻。1797年，市民宣布成立短暂的贝加莫共和国；此后贝加莫经奇萨尔皮尼共和国并入拿破仑的意大利王国，1815年归入奥地利治下的伦巴第-威尼托，当地最早的纺织工场也在此时建立。

en:
Julius Caesar drained the marsh at the southern tip of its lake and refounded Como as Novum Comum, a walled town on the Roman grid; both Plinys were born here. As a medieval commune it fought a ten-year war with rival Milan, was stormed and destroyed on 27 August 1127, and rebuilt with Frederick Barbarossa's backing; the great Porta Torre facing Milan followed in 1192. After a century of the Rusca lords, Azzone Visconti annexed Como to Milan in 1335. In 1444 it was a cloth-working town of Filippo Maria Visconti's duchy, commanding the road and lake route from Lombardy into the Alpine passes.

On Filippo Maria's death in 1447 it formed the short-lived Republic of Sant'Abbondio, submitting to Francesco Sforza in 1450. The Italian Wars carried it between France, the Sforza and the Empire: a French governor reduced its gates to three in 1508, Spanish troops sacked it in 1521, and in 1527 the Spanish demolished the old Castel Baradello rather than yield it to the French, while the lord of Musso castle held half the diocese. Quiet decades followed under Spanish and later Austrian Milan. Alessandro Volta, born here in 1745, demonstrated the first electric battery, made in 1799, to Napoleon; French troops entered in 1796, Cossacks plundered the outskirts in 1799, and Austria returned in 1815.
zh:
科莫的前身是诺武姆·科穆姆：尤利乌斯·恺撒排干湖泊南端的沼泽，按罗马棋盘格局建起这座城墙环绕的城镇，老普林尼与小普林尼都出生于此。中世纪时它是自由市镇，与强邻米兰打了十年战争，1127年8月27日城破被毁，此后靠腓特烈·巴巴罗萨的支持得以重建，1192年面向米兰的宏伟城门落成。在鲁斯卡家族统治一个世纪后，阿佐内·维斯孔蒂于1335年把科莫并入米兰。1444年时，它是菲利波·马里亚·维斯孔蒂公国境内一座织造业城镇，扼守伦巴第通往阿尔卑斯山隘的陆路与湖水道。

1447年菲利波·马里亚去世后，科莫建立了短暂的「圣阿邦迪奥共和国」，直到1450年才向弗朗切斯科·斯福尔扎臣服。意大利战争中，它在法兰西、斯福尔扎与皇帝之间几度易手：1508年法国总督把城门减为三座，1521年西班牙军队洗劫城市，1527年西班牙人拆毁古老的巴拉德罗城堡以免其落入法军之手，穆索城堡的强人则据湖称雄，势力及于半个教区。此后科莫在西班牙、继而奥地利治下的米兰度过了长久太平。1745年生于科莫的亚历山德罗·伏打于1799年制成世界上第一个电池，并向拿破仑演示；法军已于1796年入城，1799年哥萨克劫掠城郊，1815年科莫随伦巴第重归奥地利统治。

en:
Halle rises on the Saale around salt springs that had been worked since prehistory. It was first mentioned as Halla in 806, and after the Archbishopric of Magdeburg was founded in 968 the town belonged to that see. Growing salt trade paid for a major expansion around 1120. At first the archbishops controlled the works, but from the late twelfth century the Pfänner, a guild of salt entrepreneurs, became a powerful citizen body. Their 1263 agreement with Archbishop Rupert barred him from building a castle within a mile of the town or opening new salt wells. Halle is first named as a Hanseatic member in 1281, and civic self-government was confirmed in 1310. In 1444 the Catholic town was a wealthy, self-confident salt community on the Saale, with the Red Tower begun in 1418, while the archbishopric retained its overlordship.

That independence ended in 1478. Archbishop Ernst II began the Moritzburg in 1484 and entered it in 1503 as a fortified residence meant to overawe the salt citizens. Cardinal Albert of Brandenburg made Halle a favourite residence, but when the Reformation reached the town he withdrew in 1541 to Mainz and Aschaffenburg with his court and the cathedral's movable works of art. From 1530 to 1554 the two old market basilicas were replaced by the four-towered Market Church, bridging Gothic and Renaissance forms. Halle remained tied to Magdeburg until 1680, when Brandenburg annexed the archiepiscopal lands as the Duchy of Magdeburg. August Hermann Francke founded the Francke Foundations there in 1698, making the town a Pietist centre of schools, orphan care and poor relief. On 17 October 1806 French and Prussian forces fought through the western bridges, streets, market and eastern suburbs, after which Halle passed under French occupation; in 1815 it joined the Prussian Province of Saxony.
zh:
哈雷位于萨勒河畔，史前时代便已开发的盐泉是城市兴起的基础。806年，它以Halla之名首次见载；968年马格德堡大主教区建立后，哈雷长期属于该教区。不断增长的食盐贸易为1120年前后的大规模扩建提供了资金。盐场最初由大主教控制，但12世纪末以后，盐场经营者行会Pfänner成为势力强大的市民群体。1263年，他们与大主教鲁珀特立约，禁止大主教在城市一英里内修建城堡，也不得开凿新盐井。1281年，哈雷首次以汉萨成员身份见载，1310年城市自治又得到契约确认。1444年，这座信奉天主教的城市是萨勒河畔富庶而自信的盐业社会，1418年动工的红塔正在修建，马格德堡大主教仍保有最高领主权。

这种独立地位于1478年终结。大主教恩斯特二世1484年开始修建莫里茨堡，1503年迁入这座设防王宫，用以压制盐业市民。红衣主教阿尔布雷希特·冯·勃兰登堡曾把哈雷当作宠爱的驻地，但宗教改革传入后，他在1541年率宫廷并带走大教堂可移动的艺术品，退往美因茨和阿沙芬堡。1530年至1554年，市场上的两座旧巴西利卡被改建为四塔的市场教堂，风格介于哥特与文艺复兴之间。哈雷与马格德堡的联系一直延续到1680年，勃兰登堡随后吞并大主教领地，设为马格德堡公国。1698年，奥古斯特·赫尔曼·弗兰克在此创立弗兰克基金会，使哈雷成为虔敬主义办学、孤儿教养和济贫的中心。1806年10月17日，法军与普军从城西廊桥一路打到街巷、市场和东郊，哈雷随后被法军占领；1815年，它并入普鲁士的萨克森省。

en:
Goslar lies beneath the north-western Harz, where the Gose descends from ore-bearing hills. Mining and smelting in the region date back to the third century, and the settlement is first documented in 979. Ottonian and Salian rulers made it one of the chief palaces of the Holy Roman Empire: Henry II held an imperial synod there in 1009, Conrad II laid the foundations of the Kaiserpfalz in 1025, Henry III made Goslar his favourite residence and Henry IV was born there on 11 November 1050. As emperors withdrew from northern Germany, the town council first appears in 1219, citizens joined the Hanseatic League in 1267 and Goslar secured imperial immediacy in 1290. Its mining law was codified in 1359. In 1444 the Catholic free imperial city was a Hanseatic mining town whose wealth rested on Rammelsberg silver, copper, lead and iron, together with Gose beer, slate and vitriol.

Duke Henry V of Wolfenbüttel seized the Rammelsberg works in 1527. Nicolaus von Amsdorf introduced the Reformation and issued the town's first church constitution in 1531, and Goslar joined the Schmalkaldic League in 1536. After the league's defeat at Mühlberg in 1547, Brunswick kept up the pressure. The city council signed the Lutheran Formula of Concord in 1580 and rejected Welf attempts to incorporate Goslar in 1582, 1605-06 and 1614-15. During the Thirty Years' War the Kipper und Wipper inflation touched off a weavers' rising in 1622; Swedish troops occupied the city from 1632 to 1635, and the Accord of Goslar in 1642 left the Rammelsberg in Welf hands. Fires struck in 1728 and again in 1780, when more than 400 houses burned. Goethe, visiting in 1777, called Goslar an imperial city rotting in and with its privileges. Prussia took it over in 1802, and the Reichsdeputationshauptschluss formally ended its imperial immediacy in 1803. After the war of 1806-07 Goslar passed to the Kingdom of Westphalia, until Prussia recovered it in 1813.
zh:
戈斯拉尔坐落在哈茨山西北麓，戈瑟河从富含矿脉的山间流出此地。这一带的采矿和冶炼可追溯到3世纪，定居点则在979年首次见载。奥托王朝与萨利安王朝的君主把它建成神圣罗马帝国最重要的行宫之一：亨利二世1009年在此召开帝国宗教会议，康拉德二世1025年为皇帝行宫奠基，亨利三世把戈斯拉尔作为最宠爱的驻地，亨利四世1050年11月11日出生于此。皇帝们逐渐退出北德意志后，市议会最早于1219年见载，市民1267年加入汉萨，戈斯拉尔1290年取得帝国直辖地位，其采矿法又于1359年编成。1444年，这座信奉天主教的帝国自由城市也是汉萨矿城，财富来自拉默尔斯贝格的银、铜、铅、铁，以及戈瑟啤酒、板岩和矾。

1527年，沃尔芬比特尔公爵亨利五世夺取拉默尔斯贝格矿场。尼古劳斯·冯·阿姆斯多夫1531年引入宗教改革并颁布第一部教会规章，戈斯拉尔1536年加入施马尔卡尔登同盟。1547年同盟在米尔贝格战败后，不伦瑞克方面继续施压。市政会1580年签署路德宗《协和信条》，并在1582年、1605至1606年、1614至1615年三次击退韦尔夫家族吞并城市的企图。三十年战争期间，「基珀尔与维珀尔」劣币危机在1622年引发织工起义；瑞典军队1632年至1635年占领戈斯拉尔，1642年的《戈斯拉尔协定》又把拉默尔斯贝格留给韦尔夫公爵。1728年和1780年两度发生大火，后一次烧毁四百多栋房屋。1777年到访的歌德称它是一座连同自身特权一起腐烂的帝国城市。1802年普鲁士接管戈斯拉尔，1803年《帝国代表会议总决议》正式终结其帝国直辖地位；1806至1807年战争后，它并入威斯特伐利亚王国，直到1813年被普鲁士收回。

en:
Weimar lies in a bend of the Ilm, where a settlement grew beneath the count's castle. The place called Wigmara was first recorded in 899, and the County of Weimar, later joined with Orlamünde, existed from 946 until the counts ceded Weimar to the Wettins in 1365. Its town rights came only in 1410. A great fire in 1424 destroyed much of the young town, but Wettin rulers encouraged rebuilding with tax relief, market privileges and a double ring of walls, and in 1438 Weimar won trading privileges for woad, the source of blue dye. In 1444 it was a small Catholic market town in Thuringia, away from the great Via Regia and still overshadowed by Erfurt.

After the Leipzig partition of 1485, Weimar passed to the Ernestine Wettins. Johannes Gau became its first evangelical parish priest in 1524, and when the Ernestines lost Wittenberg after the Schmalkaldic War, Duke John Frederick made Weimar his residence in 1552; repeated partitions made it the capital of Saxe-Weimar. The Thirty Years' War and the dynastic divisions shrunk the court's means, though the onion market was first held in 1653 and Johann Sebastian Bach served as court organist from 1708 to 1717. The Seven Years' War damaged the town in 1756, and under Duchess Anna Amalia the old walls were pulled down. Her son Carl August drew Christoph Martin Wieland, Johann Gottfried Herder, Friedrich Schiller and, from 1775, Johann Wolfgang von Goethe to a small but famous court. French troops plundered Weimar after Jena in 1806, the duchy became a grand duchy in 1815, and in 1816 Carl August granted Saxe-Weimar-Eisenach the first modern constitution in the German lands.
zh:
魏玛位于伊尔姆河的一处河湾，聚落最初在伯爵城堡下方发展起来。此地以「维格马拉」之名首见于899年文献；魏玛伯国（后与奥拉明德合并）自946年存续，1365年伯爵们将魏玛作为封地割让给韦廷家族。它迟至1410年才取得城市权。1424年的大火重创这座年轻城镇，但韦廷统治者以免税、市场特权和双重城墙鼓励重建；1438年，魏玛又取得蓝色染料原料菘蓝的贸易特权。1444年时，它还是图林根一座信奉天主教的小商业镇，偏离重要的国王大道，声势仍在爱尔福特之下。

1485年莱比锡分封后，魏玛归属韦廷家族恩斯特系。1524年，约翰内斯·高成为这里第一位新教牧师；恩斯特系在施马尔卡尔登战争后失去维滕贝格，约翰·腓特烈公爵遂于1552年定都魏玛。历经多次分封，它成为萨克森-魏玛的首都。三十年战争和家族分割使宫廷财力收缩，不过洋葱市场自1653年起举办，约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫也在1708至1717年担任宫廷管风琴师。七年战争中，城镇在1756年遭战火破坏，安娜·阿玛利亚女公爵执政时期拆除了旧城墙。她的儿子卡尔·奥古斯特把克里斯托夫·马丁·维兰德、约翰·戈特弗里德·赫尔德、弗里德里希·席勒，以及1775年起定居于此的约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德吸引到这座小国都城。1806年耶拿战役后，法军劫掠魏玛；1815年，公国升为大公国，1816年卡尔·奥古斯特颁布萨克森-魏玛-艾森纳赫宪法，这是德意志诸邦中的第一部近代宪法。

en:
Zwickau lies in the valley of the Zwickau Mulde, settled by Slavic Sorbs by the seventh century; its name is Slavic, and German colonists arrived from the tenth. The territorium Zcwickaw is first named in a Naumburg charter of 1118, and a merchant town grew where the salt road from Halle to Prague crossed the Polish track from Kraków. It is first called a town, oppidum, in 1212, had a council by 1273 and a mayor by 1297. A free imperial city from 1290 to 1348, it then fell to the Wettin margraves of Meissen. Mining in the hills began in 1316, and coal is first recorded in the statute book of 1348. Fires gutted it in 1328 and 1403, and a quarrel over jurisdiction in 1407 ended in executions on both sides. The Hussites besieged it in vain in 1430, and in 1444 the town recovered its jurisdiction, a busy cloth-making and mining borough beneath its Osterstein castle.

Silver found at nearby Schneeberg in 1470 enriched the Zwickau patriciate who worked the mines, and in 1473 the Emperor Frederick III granted the council the rare privilege of sealing in red wax; the mint struck the bearded 'Bartgroschen' in 1492–1493. St. Mary's church rose from 1451 to 1536, with an altar by Michael Wolgemut and a carved pietà by Peter Breuer. It then became one of the first cities of the Reformation: in 1520 Luther dedicated On the Freedom of a Christian to its mayor Hermann Mühlpfort, Thomas Müntzer preached there from October 1520 to April 1521, and the radicals called the Zwickau prophets carried the new teaching to Wittenberg. Luther came in April 1522 to calm the iconoclastic riots, the first press opened in 1523, and the cloth merchants raised their Gewandhaus in 1522–1525; around 1540, 230 of the town's 10,000 people were master clothiers. In January 1547 Duke Moritz's troops sacked the town, and the Augsburg settlement of 1548 attached it to Albertine electoral Saxony. Besieged nine times in the Thirty Years' War, it paid heavy contributions to Wallenstein and a Swedish fine, and suffered again in the Seven Years' War. The composer Robert Schumann was born here in 1810; Napoleon lodged here with the Empress Marie Louise in May 1812. After the Congress of Vienna in 1815 Zwickau remained within the much-reduced Kingdom of Saxony.
zh:
茨维考地处茨维考穆尔德河谷，7世纪时斯拉夫索布人已在此定居，地名来自斯拉夫语，10世纪起德意志移民陆续迁来。1118年，瑙姆堡主教的一份文书首次提到「茨维考地区」；在从哈雷通往布拉格的盐路与来自克拉科夫的波兰商道交会处，一座商城发展起来。1212年的文书首次称其为城镇（oppidum），1273年已有市议会，1297年已有市长。1290年至1348年间它是帝国自由城市，此后被迈森的韦廷藩侯收为领地。山区采矿始于1316年，1348年的城市法典首次记载了煤炭。1328年和1403年两度大火焚毁大半个城市，1407年一场围绕司法权的激烈冲突以双方都有人被处死告终。1430年胡斯派围城不克；1444年城市收回司法权，成为奥斯特施泰因城堡下一座繁忙的织布与采矿城镇。

1470年，附近施内山发现银矿，经营矿场的茨维考豪门由此暴富；1473年皇帝腓特烈三世赐予市议会罕见的红蜡封印特权，城里的造币厂在1492—1493年铸出带胡须选侯像的「胡须格罗申」。圣母教堂1451—1536年建造，祭坛画出自米夏埃尔·沃尔格穆特之手，哀悼基督木雕由彼得·布罗伊尔创作。茨维考随后成为宗教改革最早的城市之一：1520年路德把《论基督徒的自由》题献给市长赫尔曼·米尔普福特，托马斯·闵采尔1520年10月至1521年4月在此布道，被称为「茨维考先知」的激进派还把新教义带到维滕贝格。1522年4月路德亲来平息捣毁圣像的骚动，1523年首家印刷所开张，布商行会于1522—1525年建起布商大厅；1540年前后全城约一万人，其中有230名织布师傅。1547年1月，莫里茨公爵的军队洗劫城市，1548年的奥格斯堡帝国决议把它划归阿尔布雷希特系的萨克森选侯邦。三十年战争中城市九次被围，向华伦斯坦缴纳沉重的军税，又向瑞典支付和平罚金；七年战争期间再度在普鲁士、奥地利和帝国军队间反复易手。作曲家罗伯特·舒曼1810年出生于此，1812年5月拿破仑携皇后玛丽·路易丝在此驻跸。1815年维也纳会议后，城市留在版图大幅缩小的萨克森王国。

en:
Rügen lies off the Pomeranian coast, its chalk cliffs and broken bodden shores facing the Baltic. From the seventh century the West Slavic Rani built a sea power there, with their chief shrine to Svetovid at Arkona and their trade centre at Ralswiek. In 1168 King Valdemar I of Denmark and Bishop Absalon took Arkona, destroyed the temple and turned Prince Jaromar I into a Christian Danish vassal. Bergen Abbey, a Cistercian nunnery, was founded in 1193 beside the old Rugard stronghold, and German settlers gradually absorbed the Rani. When Wizlaw III, the last native prince, died in 1325, the Rügen succession wars ended with the island's transfer to Pomerania-Wolgast in 1354. In 1444 it was assigned to the Pomerania-Barth branch of the Griffin dynasty, while Bergen remained a small Catholic monastic and market settlement at the island's centre.

Fire nearly destroyed Bergen, its nunnery and parts of St Mary's Church in 1445. The Pomeranian Landtag's decree of 1534 brought the Reformation, and the nunnery passed to the dukes; only in 1613 did Duke Philipp Julius grant Bergen Lübeck law for 8,000 marks. War and plague after 1628 cut the town's population to about 400, and from 1648 Rügen belonged to Swedish Pomerania. A Brandenburg-Danish army invaded in 1678 before the island returned to Sweden in 1679, and it was conquered again during the Great Northern War in 1715; fires struck Bergen in 1690 and 1726. The House of Putbus, descended from the old Rügen princes, remained the greatest landowner and received the rank of princes in 1807. French forces held the island from 1807 to 1813, after which the Treaty of Kiel and the Vienna settlement gave Rügen to Prussia; in 1818 it was placed under the Stralsund administrative district of the Prussian Province of Pomerania.
zh:
吕根岛横亘在波美拉尼亚海岸外，白垩崖壁和曲折的潟湖海岸朝向波罗的海。7世纪起，西斯拉夫的拉尼人在此建立海上势力，阿尔科纳供奉斯维托维德的神庙是其最重要圣地，拉尔斯维克则是贸易中心。1168年，丹麦国王瓦尔德马一世和主教阿布萨隆攻占阿尔科纳、摧毁神庙，拉尼王公雅罗马尔一世成为受洗的丹麦封臣。1193年，贝尔根西多会女修道院在古老的鲁加德要塞旁建立，德意志移民随后逐渐同化拉尼人。末代本地王公维斯拉夫三世1325年去世后，吕根继承战争最终使岛屿在1354年转交波美拉尼亚-沃尔加斯特。1444年，岛屿被划给格里芬王朝的波美拉尼亚-巴尔特支系，岛中心的贝尔根则仍是一座信奉天主教的小型修道院与集市聚落。

1445年，大火几乎烧毁贝尔根、女修道院和圣马利亚教堂的一部分。1534年，波美拉尼亚邦议会的法令带来宗教改革，女修道院转归公爵；迟至1613年，菲利普·尤利乌斯公爵才在收取八千马克后授予贝尔根吕贝克法。1628年后的战争和瘟疫使城镇人口降至约四百人；1648年起，吕根归属瑞典属波美拉尼亚。1678年，勃兰登堡与丹麦联军入侵，但岛屿1679年又归还瑞典；大北方战争期间，它在1715年再度被征服。贝尔根还在1690年和1726年遭遇火灾。源出旧日吕根王公的普特布斯家族一直是岛上最大地主，并于1807年取得亲王衔。法国军队1807至1813年占据吕根，随后《基尔条约》和维也纳安排把岛屿交给普鲁士；1818年，它被划入普鲁士波美拉尼亚省的施特拉尔松德行政区。

en:
Stargard grew up on the Ina at the crossing of old Pomeranian routes from Szczecin to Kolberg and from Santok to Wolin. A Pomeranian stronghold stood nearby from the eighth or ninth century, and the settlement entered the early Polish state under Mieszko I around 967. Its first surviving mention dates to 1124; Magdeburg town rights were granted in 1243 and confirmed in 1253, while Lübeck law followed in the 1290s. From 1283 the town used a port at the Ina's mouth, through which barges carried the grain of the Pyrzyce and Stargard lands to the Baltic. It joined the Hanseatic League in 1363 and became capital of the Griffin Duchy of Pomerania-Stargard in 1377. In 1444 Stargard was a Catholic grain-trading town and ducal residence, already set against Stettin's claims to staple rights.

The rivalry became open war from 1454 to 1464, the so-called Wheat War, fought because Stargard claimed free navigation down the Ina while Stettin insisted that shipping stop at its wharves; Hanseatic mediation ended the fighting in November 1464. The town passed to the reunited Duchy of Pomerania in 1478, and Johannes Knipstro introduced the Reformation there in 1524. Its Protestant school, the Collegium Groeningianum, opened in 1633, only for fire in 1635 and repeated occupations in the Thirty Years' War to reduce the population by about nine-tenths. The Peace of Westphalia gave Stargard to Brandenburg in 1648. It served as capital of Further Pomerania from 1668 to 1720, attracted Huguenot settlers and new suburbs, then lost administrative primacy to Stettin. During the French occupation of Stettin in 1806–1814, Blücher temporarily moved the Pomeranian government to Stargard; in 1818 the town became a Prussian district seat.
zh:
施塔加德位于伊纳河畔，地处斯德丁至科尔贝格、桑托克至沃林的古老商路交会处。8或9世纪时，附近已有波美拉尼亚人的堡寨；约967年，这片聚落随梅什科一世进入早期波兰国家。现存最早记载见于1124年，城市1243年获马格德堡法，1253年得到确认，1290年代又改用吕贝克法。从1283年起，城市使用伊纳河口的港口，驳船把皮日采和施塔加德一带出产的谷物运往波罗的海。它在1363年加入汉萨同盟，1377年成为格里芬家族波美拉尼亚—施塔加德公国的首都。1444年，施塔加德是一座信奉天主教的谷物贸易城市和公爵驻地，并且已经与主张集散特权的斯德丁对立。

这场竞争在1454—1464年演变为公开的「小麦战争」：施塔加德要求沿伊纳河自由通航，斯德丁则坚持所有船只必须在其码头停靠，最终由汉萨城市在1464年11月调停休战。1478年，城市并入重新统一的波美拉尼亚公国；约翰内斯·克尼普斯特罗1524年在此推动宗教改革。新教学校格勒宁根学院1633年开办，但1635年的大火和三十年战争中的反复占领使人口减少约九成。1648年《威斯特伐利亚和约》把施塔加德划归勃兰登堡。1668—1720年，它是后波美拉尼亚的首府，吸引胡格诺移民并形成新的城郊，随后行政首位让给斯德丁。1806—1814年斯德丁被法国占领期间，布吕歇尔把波美拉尼亚政府临时迁到施塔加德；1818年，此城成为普鲁士的县治。

en:
Dramburg lay on the upper Drawa, where the Neumark's wooded settlements met the Pomeranian lake country. A Slavic strongpoint on the route from Greater Poland to the Baltic was absorbed into Brandenburg's eastward expansion in the late thirteenth century. The knightly Goltz brothers developed the settlement of Drawenborch with German colonists, and it received Magdeburg town rights in 1297; its walls made it one of the stronger marcher towns. On 13 February 1368, Dramburg hosted the peace between a Brandenburg margrave and King Casimir III of Poland, under which Wałcz returned to Poland. The Neumark was pawned to the Teutonic Knights in 1402 and passed fully to the Order in 1429. Hussite raids devastated the border country in 1433. In 1444 Dramburg was a Catholic, Pomeranian livestock district under Teutonic rule.

The Order pledged the Neumark back to Brandenburg in 1454 and Frederick II completed its purchase in 1463. The former Franciscan Faustinus Schliepe introduced Lutheran preaching in 1537, and from 1540 the town and its estates were held by the Order of St John until 1808. A fire in 1620 left only five houses standing, and seventeenth-century war and plague interrupted the river trade. Dramburg's staple right forced boats carrying Kolberg salt on the Drawa to offer their cargo at its markets, while wool weaving and shoemaking gave the cattle-raising district crafts of its own. It became Prussian with Brandenburg in 1701, and after the Napoleonic reorganization became a county seat in the Prussian Province of Pomerania in 1818.
zh:
德兰堡位于德拉瓦河上游，是诺伊马克林木聚落与波美拉尼亚湖区相接之处。大波兰通往波罗的海的道路旁原有一座斯拉夫人据点，13世纪末被纳入勃兰登堡向东扩张的范围。骑士家族戈尔茨兄弟招揽德意志移民，把名为德拉文堡的聚落发展起来；1297年，城镇获得马格德堡法，城墙使其成为边地较强的城镇之一。1368年2月13日，勃兰登堡藩侯与波兰国王卡齐米日三世在德兰堡缔和，瓦乌奇据此归还波兰。诺伊马克1402年被抵押给条顿骑士团，1429年全境转入骑士团之手，1433年胡斯派袭掠又蹂躏边境。1444年，德兰堡是条顿骑士团治下信仰天主教、使用波美拉尼亚文化语言的畜牧地区。

1454年，骑士团把诺伊马克重新抵押给勃兰登堡，腓特烈二世于1463年完成购地。1537年，原方济各会修士福斯蒂努斯·施利佩开始传布路德宗；1540年起，城镇及其地产由圣约翰骑士团掌握，直至1808年。1620年的大火只让五座房屋幸存，17世纪的战争与瘟疫又打断河运。德兰堡拥有堆货权，可迫使沿德拉瓦河运送科尔贝格食盐的船只在本地市集发售货物；毛织和制鞋业也让这片畜牧地区有了自己的手工业。1701年，它随勃兰登堡成为普鲁士的一部分；拿破仑战争后的行政改组中，它于1818年成为普鲁士波美拉尼亚省的县城。

en:
Brandenburg grew around Brennaburg, the Hevelli stronghold on the Havel's cathedral island. King Henry I of Saxony conquered it in 928 or 929, and Otto I's charter of 948 founded the Bishopric of Brandenburg. The Slavic rising of 983 restored native rule, but after the Hevelli prince Pribislav died in 1150, Albert the Bear retook the fortress in 1157 and founded the Margraviate of Brandenburg. Cathedral canons settled on the island in 1165, the Old Town was documented as a city in 1170, and the New Town across the Havel followed in 1196. For centuries Old Town, New Town and the bishop's cathedral district formed separate walled communities. Both towns joined the Hanseatic League in 1314 or 1315 and in 1431 allied with Berlin, Kölln and Frankfurt. In 1444 they still formed a Catholic bishop's seat and long-distance trading centre at the Havel crossing, though the Hohenzollern court was increasingly turning to Berlin-Cölln.

The two towns remained Hanseatic members until 1518. Bishop Matthias von Jagow promoted the Reformation after 1527, a Protestant church order appeared in 1540, and in 1560 most of the bishopric's estates passed to the Brandenburg elector. During the Thirty Years' War Gustavus Adolphus made Brandenburg his headquarters in 1631, while passing armies, plunder and plague completed the old city's loss of place to Berlin and Potsdam. The Old and New Towns were at last united in 1715, more than a generation after their slow recovery began. On 25 October 1806 Marshal Bernadotte's French troops entered Brandenburg, opening more than two years of occupation and exactions. In 1813 Bernadotte, now Swedish crown prince, returned at the head of the allied army covering the Havelland, and French rule collapsed in the campaigns that followed.
zh:
勃兰登堡兴起于哈弗尔河主教座堂岛上的赫维利要塞布伦纳堡。萨克森国王亨利一世在928年或929年征服这里，奥托一世948年的敕书设立勃兰登堡主教区。983年斯拉夫人起义后，本地统治一度恢复；1150年赫维利王公普里比斯拉夫去世，大熊阿尔布雷希特于1157年夺回要塞，并建立勃兰登堡边疆伯国。1165年，主教座堂司铎团迁入岛上；老城1170年被文献称为城市，哈弗尔河对岸的新城则出现于1196年。此后数百年间，老城、新城和主教的座堂辖区一直是彼此分立、各有城墙的共同体。两城在1314年或1315年加入汉萨同盟，1431年又与柏林、克尔恩和法兰克福结盟。1444年，它们仍是哈弗尔渡口的天主教主教驻地与远途贸易中心，只是霍亨索伦宫廷越来越偏向柏林-克尔恩。

两座城市作为汉萨成员一直持续到1518年。马蒂亚斯·冯·亚戈主教在1527年后推动宗教改革，1540年采用新教教会规程，1560年主教领的大部分产业转入勃兰登堡选帝侯手中。三十年战争期间，古斯塔夫二世·阿道夫于1631年把勃兰登堡设为司令部；过境军队、劫掠和瘟疫最终使这座老城彻底让位给柏林与波茨坦。老城和新城在缓慢恢复后，终于1715年合并为一城。1806年10月25日，贝尔纳多特元帅的法军进入勃兰登堡，开启两年多的占领与摊派。1813年，已是瑞典王储的贝尔纳多特率领掩护哈弗尔兰的联军重返此地，法国统治也在随后的战役中崩溃。

en:
Neubrandenburg lies on the Tollensesee, in the lake country of the old Stargard lordship. Slavic settlement had revived the region after the migration period, and Premonstratensians began Broda Abbey by the shore around 1240. On 4 January 1248 Margrave John I of Brandenburg founded a new town named after Brandenburg an der Havel; its citizens received nearly six years of tax exemption. In 1298 Neubrandenburg passed with the Stargard lordship to Mecklenburg, and after 1347 the dukes held it as an imperial fief. Brick walls and three stone double gates rose after 1300, later joined by the New Gate. In the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries the town was the chief residence of Mecklenburg-Stargard, and the surrounding estates brought cattle to its markets. In 1444 it was therefore a fortified Catholic market town and one of the leading towns represented in the Mecklenburg estates.

Johann Berckmann of Stralsund, preaching with ducal permission in 1523, introduced Lutheran doctrine; the Franciscan friary was secularized around 1552. During the Thirty Years' War a Swedish garrison held the walls until Tilly's imperial and Catholic League army stormed and sacked the town in spring 1631, killing hundreds. When Mecklenburg-Strelitz was formed in 1701, Neubrandenburg's citizens rejected the costs and constraints of becoming the permanent capital, so the court built Neustrelitz instead. The town remained the leading place of the Stargard circuit and the traditional site for a new ruler's act of enthronement, while horse and wool markets drew rural trade. From 1774 Duke Adolf Frederick IV built a residence on the market square and kept summer court there until his death in 1794. French troop quartering during the Napoleonic wars burdened the townspeople, and in 1815 citizen protests secured the first free election of a mayor by the whole burgher community.
zh:
新勃兰登堡位于托伦湖畔，地处旧施塔加德领地的湖沼地带。民族大迁徙后，斯拉夫人重新在此定居；1240年前后，普雷蒙特雷修会开始在湖畔兴建布罗达修道院。1248年1月4日，勃兰登堡藩侯约翰一世以哈弗尔河畔勃兰登堡为名建立新城，市民获得近六年免税权。1298年，新勃兰登堡随施塔加德领地转入梅克伦堡，1347年后成为公爵持有的帝国封地。1300年以后，砖砌城墙和三座石制双重城门相继建成，后来又增建新门。14至15世纪，这座城市是梅克伦堡-施塔加德的主要驻跸地，周围庄园把牲畜运到这里交易。因此在1444年，它是一座设防的天主教集镇，也是梅克伦堡等级会议中最重要的城市之一。

1523年，施特拉尔松德的约翰·贝克曼经公爵许可到此宣讲路德宗教义；方济各会修道院约在1552年被世俗化。三十年战争期间，瑞典守军据城抵抗，直到1631年春蒂利麾下的帝国与天主教同盟军队攻破并洗劫城市，数百人遇害。1701年梅克伦堡-施特雷利茨形成时，新勃兰登堡市民拒绝承担成为永久都城的费用与约束，宫廷遂另建新施特雷利茨。这里仍是施塔加德辖区的首要城市和新君传统即位仪式所在地，马市与羊毛市场也吸引着乡间贸易。1774年起，阿道夫·弗里德里希四世在市集广场修建宫邸，并在此举行夏季朝会，直至1794年去世。拿破仑战争期间，法军驻扎使市民负担沉重；1815年，市民抗争争取到首次由全体市民自由选举市长。

en:
Krujë perches on a spur of the northern Albanian mountains above the coastal plain between Durrës and Lezhë; the Illyrian Albanoi who lived here gave medieval Albania its name. In 1190 it became the capital of the Principality of Arbanon, the first Albanian state of the Middle Ages, and it later passed to the Angevin Kingdom of Albania and the Thopia lords. The Ottomans made it a subaşılık of the Sanjak of Albania after 1415, and Gjergj Kastrioti Skanderbeg, himself subaşi of Krujë in 1437–38, seized the fortress on 28 November 1443 with a forged sultan's firman and raised the Albanian standard over it. In 1444 he made Krujë the chief stronghold of the League of Lezhë: its gates guarded the wool roads from the high pastures to the sea, and the sultan's war was about to break over it.

The Ottomans came four times. In 1450 Murad II brought perhaps 100,000 men against fewer than 2,000 defenders under Skanderbeg and the old captain Vrana Konti, and failed; the armies of Ballaban Pasha and Mehmed II were repulsed in 1466 and 1467. After Skanderbeg's death a Venetian garrison held out and beat off Gedik Ahmed Pasha in 1476, but a siege of more than a year forced Krujë's surrender in 1478. Renamed Akçahisar, it slipped into provincial Ottoman life: Bektashi dervishes founded tekkes beneath the castle from the early 1700s, while down on the plain Sulejman Bargjini planted the new town of Tirana in 1614 with a mosque, hammam and bazaar. The Toptani lords of Krujë came to rule Tirana after 1816, and the Et'hem Bey Mosque, begun there by Molla Bey of Petrela, was completed in 1821.
zh:
克鲁耶（今译克鲁亚）雄踞阿尔巴尼亚北部山地的一处山嘴，俯瞰都拉斯与莱什之间的沿海平原；古时居住于此的伊利里亚阿尔巴诺伊部族，其族名后来演变为「阿尔巴尼亚」。1190年，这里成为中世纪第一个阿尔巴尼亚人国家——普罗贡家族所建阿尔巴农公国的都城，此后先后归入安茹王朝的阿尔巴尼亚王国和托皮亚家族之手。1415年后，奥斯曼把它划为阿尔巴尼亚桑扎克下辖的苏巴什辖区；曾在1437至1438年出任本地苏巴什的乔治·卡斯特里奥蒂·斯坎德培，于1443年11月28日用伪造的苏丹诏书智取城堡，在城头升起阿尔巴尼亚旗帜。1444年，他把克鲁耶建成莱什联盟的核心要塞：城关扼守着高山牧场羊毛出海的商路，而苏丹的战祸即将铺天盖地而来。

奥斯曼人四度来攻。1450年，穆拉德二世率约十万大军压境，而斯坎德培与老将弗拉纳·孔蒂手下守军不足两千，仍迫其退走；1466年和1467年，巴拉班帕夏与穆罕默德二世的军队又两度被击退。斯坎德培去世后，接防的威尼斯守军1476年击退格迪克·艾哈迈德帕夏，但持续一年有余的围城终于在1478年迫使克鲁耶投降。改称阿克恰希萨尔后，它沉入奥斯曼外省岁月：18世纪初起，拜克塔什托钵僧在城堡下陆续建起道堂；平原之上，苏莱曼·巴尔吉尼帕夏于1614年辟建新城镇地拉那，立清真寺、澡堂和市集。1816年后，克鲁耶的托普塔尼家族领主统治地拉那，而由佩特雷拉的莫拉贝伊动工的埃特海姆贝伊清真寺也于1821年落成。

en:
Cilli (Celje) occupies the lower Savinja valley where several small rivers meet beneath the great Upper Celje Castle. Roman Celeia was a wealthy municipality on the road from Aquileia toward Pannonia, and the medieval fortress became the seat of the Lords of Sanneck. Frederick of Sanneck acquired the Celje estates in 1333, was raised to comital rank in 1341, and the family became Princes of the Holy Roman Empire in 1436. Marriage alliances and service to Emperor Sigismund gave them castles and claims across Carniola, Croatia, Slavonia and Hungary. In 1444 Count Ulrich II ruled from Cilli at the height of the dynasty's power, only a year after a mutual inheritance treaty had defined its rivalry with the Habsburgs.

Count Frederick II granted Celje its town privileges on 11 April 1451. After John Hunyadi's death in 1456, Ulrich II became Captain General of Hungary, but on 8 November he was murdered at Belgrade by men of Hunyadi's son Ladislaus. The count's death ended the male line, and the inheritance war delivered Cilli to the Habsburgs, who administered it with the Duchy of Styria. Walls and a moat were built in 1473 as Ottoman raiding increased, and in 1515 peasant rebels seized the Old Castle before the great Slovene peasant rising was crushed. Many local nobles accepted Protestantism during the Reformation, although the Counter-Reformation later restored Catholic worship in the region.
zh:
采列在德语中称齐利，位于下萨维尼亚河谷，数条小河在此汇流，宏伟的采列上堡俯瞰全城。罗马时代的采莱亚是阿奎莱亚通往潘诺尼亚大道上的富庶自治市；中世纪时，这里的要塞成为绍内克勋爵家族的驻地。绍内克的腓特烈1333年取得采列产业，1341年升为伯爵，家族又在1436年成为神圣罗马帝国诸侯。凭借联姻和为皇帝西吉斯蒙德效力，他们在卡尼奥拉、克罗地亚、斯拉沃尼亚和匈牙利拥有城堡与继承权。1444年，乌尔里希二世伯爵正处在采列王朝权势的顶峰；仅一年前，王朝刚与哈布斯堡签订相互继承条约，划定了双方的竞争关系。

1451年4月11日，腓特烈二世伯爵授予采列城市特权。1456年匈雅提·亚诺什去世后，乌尔里希二世出任匈牙利总司令，却在11月8日于贝尔格莱德被亚诺什之子拉斯洛的部下刺杀。他的死使男系绝嗣，随后的继承战争把采列交给哈布斯堡，由施蒂利亚公国管理。随着奥斯曼袭扰加剧，城墙和护城河于1473年修筑；1515年，起义农民曾占领旧堡，但这场斯洛文尼亚农民大起义最终被镇压。宗教改革期间，许多当地贵族改奉新教，不过反宗教改革后来又使这一地区恢复天主教崇拜。

en:
Rijeka climbs from a deep inlet of Kvarner Bay beneath the old stronghold of Trsat. The Roman town of Tarsatica stood above the Rječina, and Venetian merchants mentioned 'Rika of Saint Vitus' as early as 1230. The townsmen took part in the Vinodol law code of 1288, and by the fifteenth century Rijeka was a walled Croatian Catholic port within the Hungarian-Croatian kingdom, held under the Walsee lords rather than by Venice. A hospital opened in 1438 and the first pharmacy two years later, so in 1444 it was already a small but well-established harbour serving the Vinodol hinterland and facing Venetian competition on the Adriatic.

In 1465 Wolfgang of Walsee's inheritance treaty delivered Rijeka to the Habsburg Frederick III, beginning centuries of Austrian rule. Venetian troops sacked and burned the town in 1509 during the War of the League of Cambrai, but Maximilian I rewarded its resistance with commercial privileges in 1515. Under Bishop Šimun Kožičić Benja a Glagolitic press began printing Croatian-language books in 1530, and the city received its written statute in 1531. Ottoman raiders reached nearby Grobnik Polje in 1595 but never took Rijeka. Charles VI made the port free in 1719 and promoted the road to Karlovac; after the 1750 earthquake Maria Theresa funded rebuilding, a sugar refinery opened in 1754, and in 1779 she made Rijeka a separate corpus directly under the Hungarian crown. French rule in 1809-1813 completed the Louisiana road toward the interior, and Austria recovered the port in 1813.
zh:
里耶卡位于克尔克湾一处深水港灣，背后是古老的特尔萨特要塞。罗马时代的塔尔萨提卡建在列奇纳河旁的高地上，威尼斯商人早在1230年就已提到「圣维特的里卡」。1288年，市民参与订立《维诺多尔法典》。到15世纪，里耶卡已是匈牙利—克罗地亚王国内一座有城墙的克罗地亚天主教港口，实际由瓦尔塞家族统治，而不属于威尼斯。1438年这里开设医院，两年后又有第一家药房；因此1444年时，它已是一座规模不大、建制完备的港口，服务维诺多尔内陆，并在亚得里亚海上面对威尼斯的竞争。

1465年，瓦尔塞的沃尔夫冈通过继承条约把里耶卡交给哈布斯堡家族的腓特烈三世，开启了奥地利长达数世纪的统治。1509年康布雷同盟战争期间，威尼斯军队劫掠并焚毁城镇，但马克西米利安一世在1515年以商业特权奖赏其抵抗。1530年，在主教希蒙·科日契奇·贝尼亚主持下，这里的格拉哥里字母印刷所开始印制克罗地亚语书籍，城市又在1531年获得成文法规。1595年，奥斯曼袭扰者抵达附近的格罗布尼克平原，却始终未能占领里耶卡。查理六世1719年宣布这里为自由港，并推动通往卡尔洛瓦茨的道路。1750年地震后，玛丽亚·特蕾西亚出资重建，糖厂于1754年开工；1779年，她又把里耶卡改为直属匈牙利王冠的单独自治体。1809至1813年法国统治期间，通往内陆的路易西亚娜公路完工，奥地利随后在1813年收复港口。

en:
Zadar began as the Liburnian settlement of Iader and became a Roman municipium in 59 BC. After the Western Empire fell it served Byzantium as the chief city of Dalmatia, and for centuries its allegiance passed between Venice, Croatia and Hungary. The Fourth Crusade, sailing in Venetian pay, sacked it in 1202; Hungary recovered it by the Treaty of Zadar in 1358. On 31 July 1409 Ladislaus of Naples sold Zadar and his Dalmatian claims to Venice for 100,000 ducats. In 1444 the city was the Catholic, Romance-speaking administrative seat of Venetian Dalmatia and a key guardian of Venetian shipping in the Adriatic.

After the Ottomans overran the hinterland in the early sixteenth century, Zadar lay within artillery range of Turkish positions. Forty years of works replaced houses, churches and a suburb with bastions, moats and sea-water canals, making it the strongest fortified city in Dalmatia. Renaissance learning nevertheless flourished behind the walls: Giovanni Francesco Fortunio wrote an early Italian grammar there, while Petar Zoranić, Juraj Baraković and other Croatian writers shaped vernacular literature. The Treaty of Karlowitz settled much of the nearby frontier in 1699, and the Teatro Nobile opened in 1783. Austrian rule followed Venice's fall in 1797, French rule from 1805 to 1813 saw the Croatian newspaper Il Regio Dalmata – Kraglski Dalmatin, and Habsburg rule was confirmed in 1815.
zh:
扎达尔最初是利布尔尼人的聚落亚德尔，公元前59年成为罗马自治市。西罗马帝国灭亡后，它是拜占庭达尔马提亚的首要城市，此后数百年间在威尼斯、克罗地亚和匈牙利之间易手。1202年，受威尼斯雇佣出航的第四次十字军洗劫了这里；1358年，匈牙利依《扎达尔条约》收回城市。1409年7月31日，那不勒斯的拉迪斯劳以十万杜卡特把扎达尔和自己对达尔马提亚的权利卖给威尼斯。1444年，这座讲罗曼语的天主教城市是威尼斯属达尔马提亚的行政中心，也是威尼斯亚得里亚海航运的重要护卫。

16世纪初奥斯曼人席卷腹地后，扎达尔已处于土耳其炮火射程之内。此后四十年的工程拆除房屋、教堂和一处郊区，代之以棱堡、壕沟和海水运河，使它成为达尔马提亚最坚固的设防城市。城墙之内，文艺复兴学术仍然兴盛：乔瓦尼·弗朗切斯科·福尔图尼奥在此写出早期意大利语语法，佩塔尔·佐拉尼奇、尤拉伊·巴拉科维奇等克罗地亚作家则推动了方言文学。1699年《卡尔洛维茨条约》大体确定附近边界，贵族剧院于1783年开幕。1797年威尼斯灭亡后城市归属奥地利，1805—1813年法国统治期间出版了克罗地亚语报纸《王家达尔马提亚人》，1815年哈布斯堡统治得到确认。

en:
Kotor lies at the hidden inner end of the Bay of Kotor beneath Mounts Orjen and Lovćen. The old Roman and Byzantine town of Ascrivium was a Dalmatian bishopric whose Romance citizens gradually mingled with Slavs from the hinterland. Stefan Nemanja took it in 1187 and made it the principal port of the Serbian kingdom and later empire; its statute of 1301 confirmed a largely autonomous city, and in the fourteenth century its commerce rivalled Ragusa. After the empire's collapse Kotor passed between Hungary, Venice and Bosnia, then governed itself as a city-republic from 1391 to 1420. Fearing Ottoman expansion, the citizens sought Venice, and in 1444 Kotor was a fortified Catholic port of Venetian Albania, linked by sea to Venice and by mountain routes to the Serbian Orthodox lands behind the bay.

Andrija Paltašić, born in Kotor in the 1440s, became the first known South Slavic printer when he worked in Venice from the 1470s. Venetian rule then weathered Ottoman sieges in 1538 and 1657, plague in 1572 and severe earthquakes in 1563 and 1667, while the walls and the fortress of St John were repeatedly rebuilt. Popular representatives kept a role in city government until 1627, when Fulgenzio Micanzio ended the custom during a conflict with the nobility. The Treaty of Campo Formio gave Kotor to Austria in 1797. The Treaty of Pressburg assigned it to Napoleonic Italy in 1805, though a Russian squadron first held the bay and French control continued only until 1813. That year Montenegrins and Bay of Kotor people, supported by a British squadron, secured the town; the settlement of 1814 gave it back to Habsburg Austria.
zh:
科托尔藏在科托尔湾深处，背靠奥尔延山和洛夫琴山。这座罗马与拜占庭古城原名阿什克里维乌姆，是达尔马提亚主教驻地，罗曼语市民逐渐与腹地迁来的斯拉夫人交融。斯特凡·尼曼雅1187年夺取此地，把它建成塞尔维亚王国及后来塞尔维亚帝国的首要港口；1301年的城市法规确认了它高度自治的地位，到14世纪时，科托尔的商业已可与拉古萨竞争。帝国崩溃后，城市在匈牙利、威尼斯和波斯之间易手，1391—1420年又作为城市共和国自治。由于畏惧奥斯曼扩张，市民向威尼斯求助；1444年，科托尔是威尼斯属阿尔巴尼亚的设防天主教港口，海路通向威尼斯，山路连接海湾后方信奉东正教的塞尔维亚土地。

15世纪四十年代生于科托尔的安德里亚·帕尔塔希奇从七十年代起在威尼斯印书，是已知最早的南斯拉夫印刷工匠。威尼斯统治期间，城市顶住了1538年和1657年的奥斯曼围攻，又经历1572年鼠疫以及1563年、1667年的严重地震，城墙和圣约翰要塞随之一再重修。平民代表原本在城市行政中保有一席之地，1627年富尔真齐奥·米坎齐奥在平民与贵族的冲突中废止了这项惯例。1797年，《坎波福尔米奥条约》把科托尔交给奥地利。1805年，《普雷斯堡条约》将它划给拿破仑的意大利王国，但俄国舰队一度控制海湾，法国统治持续到1813年。1813年，黑山人和科托尔湾居民在英国舰队支援下控制城市；1814年的安排使它重归哈布斯堡奥地利。

en:
Podrinje is the land of the Drina, where the river cuts through the forested mountains of eastern Bosnia on the road from the Morava to the Bosna. Long Nemanjić Serbian soil, it held the Dobrun monastery founded by župan Pribil before the 1370s, and when Nikola Altomanović's estates were divided in 1373 Tvrtko I of Bosnia added the middle Drina to his crown. Its lords were the Pavlovići, who held the right bank from the Lim to Višegrad, a caravan stop first mentioned in 1407 and busy with Ragusan traffic after 1427; vojvoda Ivaniš Pavlović confirmed the merchants' privileges from his court above the town, and the gentry buried their dead beneath carved stećci at Mramorje. In 1444 this Orthodox marcher land belonged to the Kingdom of Bosnia, exposed between the Serbian despotate across the river and the Ottoman raiders beyond it.

In 1448 Despot Đurađ Branković defeated the Bosnian forces and briefly brought Višegrad and Srebrenica back under Serbian rule, but Turkish sources record that Osman Pasha took Višegrad in 1454, and with the fall of the Bosnian kingdom in 1463 the Drina valley became the Ottoman nahiya of Brodar. The settled frontier then produced its great monument: between 1571 and 1577 the court architect Sinan built an eleven-arch stone bridge at Višegrad for Grand Vizier Sokollu Mehmed Pasha, an Orthodox boy taken from the nearby village of Sokolovići in the devşirme, who thus linked his birthplace to the imperial road. The bridge was repaired in 1664 and carried merchants and couriers along the Drina through the long, quiet Ottoman centuries that followed.
zh:
波德里涅意为德里纳河之地，河水在东波斯尼亚的山林间切出峡谷，扼守着从摩拉瓦河通往波斯纳河的大路。这里曾是尼曼雅王朝塞尔维亚的土地，茹潘·普里比尔在1370年代之前修建的多布伦修道院便在境内；1373年尼古拉·阿尔托马诺维奇的领地被瓜分，波斯尼亚的特尔特科一世把德里纳河中游并入自己的王冠。统治此地的是帕夫洛维奇家族，据有从利姆河到维舍格勒的右岸——维舍格勒作为商队驿站首见于1407年，1427年后拉古萨商队往来繁忙；公爵伊瓦尼什·帕夫洛维奇在镇外的府邸向商人确认了通商特权，贵族们则把逝者葬在姆拉莫列雕饰精美的斯特恰克石墓下。1444年，这片东正教的边地属于波斯尼亚王国，暴露在河对岸的塞尔维亚专制国与更远处的奥斯曼游骑之间。

1448年，专制公久拉吉·布兰科维奇击败波斯尼亚军队，一度把维舍格勒和斯雷布雷尼察收回塞尔维亚治下；但据土耳其史料记载，奥斯曼帕夏于1454年攻取维舍格勒，而随着1463年波斯尼亚王国灭亡，德里纳河谷被编为奥斯曼的布罗达尔纳希耶。安定下来的边境随后造就了此地最伟大的纪念物：1571至1577年间，宫廷建筑师锡南为大维齐尔索库鲁·穆罕默德帕夏在维舍格勒建起一座十一孔石桥——帕夏本是附近索科洛维奇村的东正教男孩，幼时被德夫希尔梅制度征走，借此把故乡与帝国大道连在一起。石桥1664年得到修缮，在随后漫长而平静的奥斯曼岁月里，驮载着商人与驿使的队伍沿德里纳河往来不息。

en:
Bjelovar is the grain country below the low Bilogora hills, crossed by the Bjelovacka and Plavnica streams and lying between the older Sava and Drava frontier zones. In 1444 there was still no planned town. The countryside was divided among noble and church estates such as Jakobove Sredice and Gudovačka Gradina, with parishes at Korenovo, Međurača and Nova Rača and a Pauline monastery at nearby Streza. Catholic Croatian villagers worked the heavy fields and brought grain and livestock to local fairs, while the Hungarian-Croatian kingdom's border with the Ottomans was moving closer.

The Belovarc estate first appears in a letter of 13 April 1465 from the bans Emeric Zápolya and Nicholas of Ilok. Ottoman raids in the 16th century scattered the population, but a small frontier fort was raised by the Bjelovacka, and the Croatian army checked further conquests in the 1591-1594 campaigns after Sisak. In 1666 General Ivan Herberstein reported the fort as G'schloss Bellovar, then in 1749 the old captaincies were reorganised into the Križevci and Đurđevac regiments. The Severin Uprising of 1755 showed Vienna how weak its control was, so in 1756 Baron Philipp Lewin von Beck began a planned garrison town on a dry plateau between marshy streams; he tried, without lasting success, to call it Novi Varaždin. Piarist brothers Hubert and Ignacije Diviš opened a school in 1761, Maria Theresa recognised Bjelovar as a privileged military community in 1771, a silk mill began work in 1782, Joseph II visited the garrison in April 1783, and a post office opened in 1805.
zh:
别洛瓦尔是低矮的比洛戈拉山南麓的谷物之乡，别洛瓦茨卡溪与普拉夫尼察溪穿流其间，地处更古老的萨瓦河与德拉瓦河边防地带之间。1444年这里还没有规划城市，乡野分属亚科博韦斯雷迪采、古多瓦奇卡格拉迪纳等贵族和教会领地，科雷诺沃、梅朱拉恰、新拉查等地设有教区，附近的斯特雷扎还有一座保罗会修道院。信奉天主教的克罗地亚村民耕种黏重土地，把谷物和牲畜带到当地集市；此时匈牙利—克罗地亚王国与奥斯曼势力之间的边界正日益逼近。

1465年4月13日，巴诺埃梅里克·扎波利亚和尼古拉·伊洛基在一封书信中首次提到「贝洛瓦茨」领地。16世纪奥斯曼袭扰使人口离散，但别洛瓦茨卡溪畔建起一座小型边防堡垒；1591年至1594年战事中，克罗地亚军队在锡萨克之后阻止了对方继续深入。1666年，将军伊万·赫伯斯泰因在报告中称这座堡垒为 G'schloss Bellovar。1749年，旧有的防区被改编为克里热夫齐团和久尔杰瓦茨团。1755年的塞韦林起义暴露了维也纳控制力的薄弱，因此菲利普·莱温·冯·贝克男爵于1756年在沼泽溪流间的干燥高地上动工修建规划驻军城镇；他试图将其命名为「新瓦拉日丁」，但没有被居民长期接受。1761年，皮亚里斯特会修士胡贝特·迪维什与伊格纳齐耶·迪维什兄弟开办学校；1771年，玛丽亚·特蕾西亚承认别洛瓦尔为特权军事城镇；1782年丝织厂开工，1783年4月约瑟夫二世视察驻军，1805年邮政所设立。

en:
The Kolubara rises at Valjevo, where the Obnica and Jablanica meet, and flows through western Serbia to the Sava. Though unnavigable, its valley carried the road between Belgrade and Bosnia, and Valjevo served as a staging post for Ragusan merchants. The town first appears in surviving Ragusan documents in the 1390s, already a market of medieval Serbia. In 1444 it was an Orthodox town of the Serbian Despotate, close enough to the Sava frontier to profit from passing trade but exposed to Ottoman invasion.

Ottoman rule reached Valjevo with the fall of the Serbian Despotate in 1459. Christians remained the majority in the mid-sixteenth century, but by the later sixteenth century most townspeople were Muslims. The late-eighteenth-century Muselim's Konak housed the Ottoman administrator and the prison where local commanders Aleksa Nenadović and Ilija Birčanin were held early in 1804. On 4 February they were beheaded on the Kolubara bank and their heads displayed on the building's roof; the Slaughter of the Knezes helped trigger the First Serbian Uprising. Valjevo was among the first towns freed, returned to Ottoman rule after the rising collapsed in 1813, and was recovered in the Second Uprising of 1815. In 1821 it was a market town of autonomous Serbia.
zh:
科卢巴拉河在瓦列沃由奥布尼察河与亚布拉尼察河汇合而成，流经塞尔维亚西部注入萨瓦河。河道虽不通航，河谷却承载着贝尔格莱德与波斯尼亚之间的道路，瓦列沃则是杜布罗夫尼克商人的中途驿站。现存杜布罗夫尼克档案在1390年代首次提到这座城镇，当时它已是中世纪塞尔维亚的集市。1444年，瓦列沃是塞尔维亚专制公国的东正教城镇，既因靠近萨瓦边境、往来贸易而获利，也直接暴露在奥斯曼兵锋之前。

1459年塞尔维亚专制公国灭亡，瓦列沃随之进入奥斯曼统治。16世纪中期基督徒仍占多数，但到16世纪后期，城镇居民已以穆斯林为主。18世纪末修建的穆塞利姆官邸是奥斯曼地方长官的驻地，其监狱在1804年初关押了本地首领阿莱克萨·内纳多维奇和伊利亚·比尔查宁。2月4日，二人在科卢巴拉河畔被斩首，头颅被挂在官邸屋顶示众；这场「屠杀王公」促成了第一次塞尔维亚起义。瓦列沃是最早获得解放的城镇之一，起义1813年失败后重归奥斯曼，又在1815年第二次起义中被塞尔维亚收复。1821年，它已是自治塞尔维亚的一座集镇。

en:
The Etschtal is the upper valley of the Etsch, where the river descends from the Reschen Pass through the Vinschgau and, below Castle Tyrol, receives the Passeier at Meran. The Romans kept the road station statio Maiensis on the Via Claudia Augusta, and Meran is first mentioned as Mairania in 857. The counts who held Castle Tyrol above the town made the market below it the seat of their county, which took its name from their castle: the town was walled in 1280 and in 1317 raised to a city with an elected council and its own seal. Meran throve for a time on the traffic over the Reschen between Italy and Germany, and the Görz-Tyrol dukes endowed it with trading privileges at the end of the fourteenth century. But after Margaret Maultasch bequeathed Tyrol to the Habsburgs in 1363 the new Kunterweg cart-road drew the Brenner traffic eastwards, and in 1420 Duke Frederick IV of the Empty Pockets moved his court down the Inn to Innsbruck. In 1444 Meran, still in name the capital of the county, was already a quiet market town overshadowed by Innsbruck.

The Minnesänger Oswald von Wolkenstein died while staying at the princely castle in Meran in 1445. The mint followed the court to Hall in the Inntal about 1475, and war reached the upper valley on 22 May 1499, when the Three Leagues routed the Habsburg and Swabian army at the Calven gorge beyond the Vinschgau in the Swabian War. The Etschtal afterwards lived quietly under Habsburg officials and was largely spared the wars of the early modern age. In 1805 the Peace of Pressburg handed the Tyrol to Bavaria, and in 1809 the valley joined the great rising: Andreas Hofer, the Passeier innkeeper born at St. Leonhard just up the side-valley, led the Tyroleans to victory over French and Bavarian troops on the Küchelberg above Meran. Captured after the collapse, he was shot at Mantua on 20 February 1810. By then the Meran district had been attached to Napoleon's Kingdom of Italy, and the Congress of Vienna returned the Etschtal to Austria in 1814.
zh:
埃奇塔尔是埃奇河上游的谷地，河水从雷申山口流出，穿过温施高，在蒂罗尔城堡下方与帕瑟伊河相会，梅拉诺就在这里。罗马时代，雷申山口的克劳狄亚·奥古斯塔大道上设有迈恩斯驿站；857年，梅拉诺以「迈拉尼亚」之名首见记载。盘踞在城上方蒂罗尔城堡的伯爵们把山下集市建成伯国的统治中心，伯国也因这座城堡得名：1280年集市筑墙为城，1317年升格为设有民选议会和城市印章的城市。梅拉诺一度靠着意大利与德意志之间经雷申山口的贸易而繁荣，14世纪末戈里齐亚-蒂罗尔公爵还授予它贸易特权。但1363年玛格丽特·毛尔塔施把蒂罗尔遗赠给哈布斯堡家族后，新修的昆特商道把布伦纳贸易引向东方；1420年，「空口袋」腓特烈四世又把宫廷迁往因河畔的因斯布鲁克。1444年的梅拉诺名义上仍是伯国首府，实际上已是一座被因斯布鲁克盖过风头的安静商城。

1445年，宫廷抒情诗人奥斯瓦尔德·冯·沃尔肯施泰因在梅拉诺的诸侯城堡作客时去世。造币厂也随宫廷而去，约1475年迁往因塔尔的哈尔。1499年5月22日士瓦本战争期间，三同盟军队在温施加以远的卡尔文峡谷击溃哈布斯堡与士瓦本联军，战火打进了上游谷地。此后埃奇塔尔在哈布斯堡官吏治下平静度日，大体躲过了近代早期的几场大战。1805年普雷斯堡和约把蒂罗尔交给巴伐利亚；1809年谷地响应大起义：出生在侧谷圣莱昂哈德的帕瑟伊客栈主人安德烈亚斯·霍费尔，率领蒂罗尔人在梅拉诺上方的屈歇尔贝格击败法、巴军队。起义失败后他被俘，1810年2月20日在曼图亚就义，此时梅拉诺地区已被并入拿破仑的意大利王国。1814年维也纳会议把埃奇塔尔归还奥地利。

en:
Upper Carinthia is the high upper Drau valley around Villach, where the road to Italy turns south through the Kanaltal. The 878 deed ad pontem Uillach already names its bridge, by the Warmbad springs where a Roman station once stood. In 1007 Henry II granted Villach and the Italy road to Pontafel to Bamberg; with market rights from 1060 and city status by 1240, it grew rich on tolls and the iron of its valleys. When the rest of Carinthia passed to the Habsburgs in 1335 Villach remained a Bamberg town. The 1348 Friuli earthquake sent the Dobratsch crashing into the Gail. In 1444 the valleys were Habsburg but Villach still answered to Bamberg, its Catholic people German or Slovene in speech.

Ottoman raiders burnt Arnoldstein in 1476 and cut a peasant league to pieces near Villach the next year; the Peasants' War of 1525 was likewise put down by Austrian troops. From 1526 townspeople and valley miners turned Protestant, until the Counter-Reformation around 1600 drove hundreds into exile and ruined the town's trade. In 1524 Gabriel of Salamanca received Ortenburg and began the Renaissance Schloss Porcia at Spittal. Maria Theresa bought the Bamberg lands for a million florins in 1759 and made Villach a district capital. In 1809 it became chief town of the Haut-Carinthie department of the Illyrian Provinces; the French demolished its walls and held it until Austria returned in summer 1813.
zh:
上克恩滕是菲拉赫一带高峻的德劳河上游谷地，通往意大利的大道在此折向南方，经卡纳尔河谷过山。878年的「ad pontem Uillach」文书已提到这里的桥，城郊瓦尔姆巴德的温泉旁罗马人曾设有驿站。1007年，亨利二世把菲拉赫和远至蓬塔费尔的意大利大路授予班贝格；菲拉赫1060年获得市集权，1240年已是城市，靠通行税和各山谷的铁致富。1335年克恩滕其余土地归于哈布斯堡家族时，它仍是班贝格的城市。1348年弗留利大地震使多布拉奇山崩入盖尔河。1444年时，高山谷地已属哈布斯堡，菲拉赫却仍听命于班贝格，居民信奉天主教，讲德语或斯洛文尼亚语。

1476年奥斯曼袭扰军焚毁阿诺尔德施泰因，次年又在菲拉赫附近击溃一支农民同盟；1525年的农民战争同样被奥地利军队镇压。1526年起市民和各山谷的矿工改宗新教，1600年前后的反宗教改革迫使成百上千人流亡，城市贸易凋敝。1524年，加布里埃尔·冯·萨拉曼卡受封奥滕堡，在德劳河畔斯皮塔尔动工兴建文艺复兴式的波尔恰宫。1759年，玛丽亚·特蕾西亚以一百万古尔登买下班贝格在克恩滕的领地，把菲拉赫设为专区首府。1809年，菲拉赫成为伊利里亚行省「上克恩滕省」的省会；法军拆除城墙据守于此，直到1813年夏天奥地利收复。

en:
Innbaiern is the strip of Bavarian land east of the lower Inn, around the towns of Braunau, Schärding and Ried, the country that after 1779 would be called the Innviertel. Ranshofen Abbey above the river is mentioned as early as 788; Braunau itself first appears in a deed of 1120 as Prounaw and received town rights in 1260, one of the oldest chartered towns on the lower Inn. It grew where the western road crossed the river, handling Inn ship traffic and the salt that came downstream from the Alps, while its walls made it a frontier fortress. In 1380 a fire destroyed the wooden town together with its bridge, and Braunau rebuilt in stone. In 1444 Innbaiern belonged to the Wittelsbach Duchy of Bavaria-Landshut, a Catholic, Bavarian-speaking land administered through the Rentamt of Burghausen, with Braunau as its busiest market.

The late-Gothic church of St Stephen went up in the mid-fifteenth century, and work on its 87-metre tower began in 1492. In the Landshut War of Succession of 1504, Palatine troops shelled and briefly held Braunau. During the Bavarian rising against Austrian occupation in 1705 the town became one of the movement's military and political centres: on 16 December 1705 an Austrian garrison surrendered to the insurgents, and the delegates of the 'Braunau Parliament', the provisional defence congress, sat in the town. During the War of the Austrian Succession an imperial army returned to besiege Braunau in May 1743. The Treaty of Teschen of 1779 tore Innbaiern from Bavaria and gave it, now named the Innviertel, to Habsburg Austria, turning the Inn into a border river. The coalition wars made Braunau a French-held fortress, where the Nuremberg bookseller Johann Philipp Palm was shot on Napoleon's order in 1806; the Innviertel returned to Bavaria in 1810 but was ceded again to Austria by the Treaty of Munich in 1816.
zh:
因拜恩是因河下游东岸的巴伐利亚地带，以布劳瑙、谢尔丁和里德诸城为中心，1779年后改称因河地区。河畔的兰斯霍芬修道院早在788年已有记载；布劳瑙本身首见于1120年的文书，写作Prounaw，1260年获得城市权，是因河下游最早获得特许状的城镇之一。它位于通往西方的大道与因河交会之处，经营因河航运和阿尔卑斯顺流而下的食盐，城郭又是边境要塞。1380年大火烧毁了木构全城和因河桥，布劳瑙此后以石头重建。1444年的因拜恩属维特尔斯巴赫家族的巴伐利亚-兰茨胡特公国，是讲巴伐利亚语的天主教领地，归布格豪森税区管辖，布劳瑙是其中最繁忙的市场。

15世纪中期，晚期哥特式的圣司提反教堂建起，1492年又为87米高的钟楼奠基。1504年兰茨胡特继承战争中，普法尔茨军队炮击并短期占领布劳瑙。1705年巴伐利亚人发动反抗奥地利占领的起义，布劳瑙成为运动的军事与政治中心之一：12月16日一支奥地利驻军向起义者投降，代表们还在此召开「布劳瑙议会」——临时的国土防御会议。1743年奥地利王位继承战争期间，帝国军队于5月再度围攻布劳瑙。1779年《特申和约》把因拜恩从巴伐利亚割出，改名因河地区交给哈布斯堡奥地利，因河就此成为界河。反法同盟战争中布劳瑙成为法军驻守的要塞，纽伦堡书商约翰·菲利普·帕尔姆1806年在此被拿破仑下令枪决；因河地区1810年一度重归巴伐利亚，又在1816年依《慕尼黑条约》最终割让给奥地利。

en:
Traungau is the old Upper Austrian iron country around Steyr, where the Steyr River joins the Enns. Celts mined Erzberg ore from about 600 BC, and Roman Noricum carried it along an Iron Road toward Lauriacum on the Danube. During the Hungarian raids the counts of Traungau built Styraburg above the river, first recorded in 980. From 1055 the Otakars held the castle, the Traungau and the March of Styria, controlling Erzberg iron and keeping a courtly residence at Steyr. The Georgenberg Pact of 1186 brought Styria to the Babenbergs in 1192, and Steyr remained a metal town even after it ceased to be a ducal seat. It was separated from Styria in 1254 and passed to the Habsburgs in 1278; Albert I confirmed its iron and timber staple rights in 1287. In 1444 its smiths were already sending knives, tools and arms across the Empire and toward Venice.

Lutheran teaching reached Steyr in 1525 through a Franciscan friar named Calixt, and most townspeople converted; when the Counter-Reformation began, only eighteen Catholic families remained. A Meistersinger school flourished there from about 1540 to 1616, but the iron trade declined and an iron-trading company founded in 1583 failed to restore it. After Upper Austria was pledged to Bavaria in 1620, Protestant expulsion orders drove 228 Steyr families into exile, some of them cutlers who helped build Solingen's steelware trade. The Innerberger Hauptgewerkschaft was formed in 1625 to reorganize mining and forges, and in 1626 Stefan Fadinger brought 40,000 rebellious peasants to Steyr, where citizens joined the rising before its defeat. Fire destroyed Styraburg on 29 August 1727, and the Baroque Lamberg Castle rose on its site. Josephine-era workshops turned to sabres, bayonets and musket parts; French troops occupied Steyr in 1800, 1805 and 1809, and the Armistice of Steyr was signed there on 25 December 1800.
zh:
特劳恩高是上奥地利以施泰尔为中心的旧铁乡，地处施泰尔河汇入恩斯河一带。凯尔特人约自公元前600年起开采埃尔茨山铁矿，罗马统治诺里孔时，矿石沿一条「铁之路」运往多瑙河畔的劳里亚库姆。马扎尔人袭扰期间，特劳恩高伯爵在河畔高地上修建施泰尔堡，该堡首见于980年记载。1055年起，奥托卡尔家族同时掌握城堡、特劳恩高和施蒂利亚边伯国，控制埃尔茨山铁矿，并在施泰尔维持宫廷驻地。1186年的《格奥尔根堡协定》使施蒂利亚于1192年转入巴本堡家族之手；施泰尔不再是公爵驻地，却仍是金属业城镇。它在1254年与施蒂利亚分离，1278年后归属哈布斯堡；1287年，阿尔布雷希特一世确认其铁器与木材堆货权。1444年，当地铁匠已把刀具、工具和兵器销往神圣罗马帝国各地及威尼斯方向。

1525年，一名叫卡利克斯特的方济各会修士把路德宗传入施泰尔，大多数市民随即改宗；反宗教改革开始时，城中只剩十八个天主教家庭。约1540年至1616年，这里还有一所工匠歌手学校。铁器贸易此时却走向衰落，1583年成立的铁器贸易公司也未能挽回。1620年上奥地利被抵押给巴伐利亚后，驱逐新教徒的命令迫使228个施泰尔家庭流亡，其中一些刀匠参与奠定了索林根钢器业的基础。1625年，因内贝格中央矿冶公会成立，用以重组采矿和锻铁；1626年，斯特凡·法丁格率四万名起义农民来到施泰尔，并得到部分市民响应，但起事最终失败。1727年8月29日，大火烧毁施泰尔堡，旧址上后来建起巴洛克式兰贝格宫。约瑟夫时代的工场转产马刀、刺刀和火枪零件；法军曾于1800年、1805年和1809年占领施泰尔，1800年12月25日，《施泰尔停战协定》在此签订。

en:
Wienerwald covers the forested Alpine foothills between Vienna and the Traisen valley, with Sankt Pölten as its chief western town. The woods were a royal hunting preserve from the 11th century, while their eastern thermal slopes carried vineyards toward Baden. Sankt Pölten occupied the site of Roman Aelium Cetium, a town of the 2nd to 4th centuries. After the Avar campaigns a Benedictine community dedicated to St Hippolytus grew up there, and the settlement name Treisma appears in 799. It received market rights around 1050 and was raised to a city by Bishop Konrad of Passau in 1159. A planned western extension and town walls followed in the 13th century, though pogroms struck the Jewish community in 1306 and 1338. In 1444 the surrounding woodland belonged to Habsburg Austria, but Sankt Pölten itself remained a walled town of the Prince-Bishopric of Passau.

In 1481 Bishop Friedrich Mauerkircher pledged Sankt Pölten to King Matthias Corvinus of Hungary, who made it a base against Frederick III and granted it arms and transport privileges in 1487. The Peace of Pressburg in 1491 left the town to Maximilian I, drawing it into the Habsburg princely domain. Reformation ideas arrived early: Philipp Hueter was questioned as a Protestant in 1522, and by 1569 most citizens were Protestant. An imperial decree of 1578 closed the reformed schools and reimposed Catholic ritual, and public Protestant life had vanished by 1623. The walls served the town during the Ottoman campaigns of 1529 and 1683. Jakob Prandtauer and Joseph Munggenast led its Baroque rebuilding, with the present cathedral erected between 1722 and 1750. Joseph II's Toleration Patent appeared in 1781, and the suppressed collegiate church became Sankt Pölten Cathedral when the diocese moved there in 1785. Napoleon entered the town unopposed and plundered it on 11 November 1805; French troops returned in 1809.
zh:
维也纳林山横亘在维也纳与特赖森河谷之间，是森林覆盖的阿尔卑斯山前丘陵，圣帕尔滕是其西端重镇。从11世纪起，这片山林就是王家猎苑，东侧温泉线一带的山坡则向巴登方向铺展葡萄园。圣帕尔滕建在罗马城镇埃利乌姆·凯蒂乌姆旧址上，该城存在于2世纪至4世纪。阿瓦尔战争后，这里形成奉祀圣伊波利特的本笃会团体，799年的文献已出现聚居地名「特赖斯马」。它约在1050年获得市场权，1159年由帕绍主教康拉德升为城市。13世纪，城区按规划向西扩展并环筑城墙；1306年和1338年，当地犹太社群两度遭到屠杀。1444年，周围山林属于哈布斯堡奥地利，但圣帕尔滕本身仍是帕绍采邑主教辖下的设防城。

1481年，主教弗里德里希·毛尔基歇尔把圣帕尔滕抵押给匈牙利国王马加什·科温；后者将其作为对抗腓特烈三世的据点，并于1487年授予城市纹章和运输特权。1491年的《普雷斯堡和约》把该城留给马克西米利安一世，使其并入哈布斯堡邦君领地。宗教改革思想很早就传入这里：菲利普·胡特在1522年因信奉新教受审，到1569年大多数市民已是新教徒。1578年的皇帝敕令关闭新教学校并恢复天主教仪式，到1623年，公开的新教活动已在城中消失。1529年和1683年奥斯曼军队进袭期间，城墙都保护了这座城市。雅各布·普朗道尔与约瑟夫·蒙格纳斯特主持了城市的巴洛克改建，现存主教座堂建于1722年至1750年。1781年约瑟夫二世颁布《宽容敕令》，1785年教区迁至圣帕尔滕，原已解散的参事会教堂成为主教座堂。1805年11月11日，拿破仑兵不血刃进入并劫掠该城；1809年法军再度占领圣帕尔滕。

en:
Salins commands a Jura defile cut by the Furieuse, on the roads from Burgundy to Switzerland and Italy by way of Pontarlier and to Lyon and Geneva down the Ain. Its wealth was brine: ancient salt springs fed two works, the Grande and Petite Salines, and Lons-le-Saunier was named for its Roman-era salt pans. Jean de Chalon made himself master of the barony and its wells in 1237 and took the Grande Saline into his own hand in 1241; with the county it passed to the dukes of Burgundy in 1384. By the fifteenth century its salt brought the duke about half his revenue from the Franche-Comté. After a fire in 1409 John the Fearless rebuilt them in stone; the town became a fortress of over twenty-five towers, its salt sold into Switzerland. At Arlay the prince of Orange, Louis II de Chalon, held the Jura's chief barony. In 1444 the country is Burgundian and Catholic under the Empire, at peace and living by salt.

The wars after Charles the Bold's death in 1477 stopped the salt pans, but its militia helped drive out the French before the 1493 return of the county to the Habsburgs; Salins's two halves were united in 1497, and the town hosted the estates of the Franche-Comté until they settled at Dole around 1530. Charles V's minister Nicolas de Granvelle took charge of the salt works in 1534. It beat off Henry IV in 1595, but the Ten Years' War was crueller: in 1639 Bernhard of Saxe-Weimar stormed Pontarlier, while spared Salins made its triple vow. Condé overran it in 1668 and gave it back at Aachen; the French returned in 1674, and the treaty of Nijmegen in 1678 made it French, after which fort Saint-André rose again to Vauban's designs. The Grande Saline became a royal manufacture, and from 1773 its brine was piped more than twenty kilometres to the new royal salt works at Arc-et-Senans.
zh:
萨兰扼守菲里约斯河切出的汝拉峡谷，地处勃艮第经蓬塔利耶通往瑞士、意大利和沿安河通往里昂、日内瓦的商路上。它的财富是卤水：盐泉自古开采，两座盐场——大盐场和小盐场——分踞城镇两半；隆斯勒索涅的名字也来自罗马时代就已开采的盐田。沙隆的让1237年夺取萨兰男爵领地和盐井，1241年又把大盐场收归己有；1384年它随伯国归入勃艮第公爵。到15世纪，萨兰盐税约占公爵在弗朗什孔泰全部收入的一半。1409年大火后，「无畏者」约翰下令用石料重建盐场，城市也变成拥有二十五座以上塔楼的要塞，食盐远销瑞士。在阿尔莱，奥兰亲王路易二世·德·沙隆据守着汝拉首屈一指的男爵领地。1444年，这片土地臣属神圣罗马帝国、由勃艮第统治、信奉天主教，太平无事，靠盐为生。

1477年大胆者查理败亡后的战事使煮盐业陷入停顿，但在伯国1493年归还哈布斯堡家族之前，萨兰民团已协助赶走法军。1497年，萨兰两半正式合并，城中还召开弗朗什孔泰三级会议，直到约1530年会议常设多勒。1534年，皇帝查理五世的重臣尼古拉·德·格朗韦勒出任盐场总监。1595年萨兰击退亨利四世的进攻；十年战争更为残酷：1639年萨克森-魏玛的伯恩哈德所部攻陷蓬塔利耶，幸免于难的萨兰则立下三重誓愿。1668年孔代的军队席卷伯国，又依《亚琛和约》将其归还；1674年法军卷土重来，1678年《奈梅亨条约》使萨兰永归法兰西，圣安德烈堡随后按沃邦的方案重建。大盐场改为王家手工工场，1773年起，萨兰的卤水经一条二十多公里长的管道输往新建的阿尔克-塞南皇家盐场。

en:
Mulhouse, Mülhausen in German, grew up among watermills on the Ill in southern Alsace, on the road between the Vosges and the Rhine. It was first recorded as Mulinhuson in 803, and after the citizens stormed and razed the Strasbourg bishop's castle with Rudolf of Habsburg's help, King Rudolf I made it an imperial free city in 1275.
